weekend-kanazawa は2025年4月18日開業・かなざわはこまち2.en: weekend-kanazawa confirms: opened 18 April 2025 on the 2nd floor of Kanazawa Hakomachi; house-made nihachi soba (Japanese buckwheat, made in the shop); bonito and kombu dashi; shrimp tempura soba ¥1,760; Musubi soba set ¥2,310; about 6 rice balls of Ishikawa rice (Noto pork with shiso miso and more). hakomachi (official) backs up the location.

weekend-kanazawa記事は島袋勇氏が2023年4月29日に片町(香林.en: A weekend-kanazawa article confirms: 島袋勇 opened on 29 April 2023 in Katamachi (behind Korinbo Tokyu Square); Daidai hanton rice (about ¥2,000: fried white fish, tartar, two big fried shrimp, daidai citrus as a hidden note); Kanazawa katsu curry (about ¥1,400); demi-glace, tartar and roux all house-made.

weekend-kanazawa記事は約70年前に祖父が創業・吉川家4代目・白銀.en: A weekend-kanazawa article confirms: founded about 70 years ago by the grandfather; the fourth generation of the Yoshikawa family; Shirogane-cho, near Omicho Market; the Ippan lunch (9 nigiri + thin roll + miso soup ¥1,100); conger eel simmered then seared; Kansai-style battera and grilled mackerel; a message wall from foreign guests.

xtone・busho-heart・nagoya-info・公式観光サイトによる.en: According to xtone, busho-heart, nagoya-info and the official tourism site, it has operated inside Nagoya Castle since Showa 47 (1972) as the only official shop in the castle of the Aichi noodle association. Signature kishimen ¥550, chilled kishikoro ¥600, topped with wakame, fried tofu and bonito flakes. A multilingual touch-panel ticket machine, and a rumour that the mayor drops in quietly.

yomiuri tabiyomiで1975年みゆき通りで八百屋から喫茶へ転換、2.en: yomiuri tabiyomi confirms: switched from a greengrocer to a coffee shop on Miyuki-dori in 1975; the second-generation owner's words "the ingredients matter, just like vegetables"; over 200 seasonal blends; a Showa-retro interior with an L-shaped marble counter and a world map; almond toast spread via Narita Coffee over 30 years ago. tanosu confirms regulars' tastes being guessed at a glance and 50 years of history; Tabelog confirms selection for "Kissa Top 100 2021" (the original's "100 famous music cafés" was wrong).

yousakana.jp (店の紹介と店自身の文章): 京都・哲学の道、薪窯のレ.en: yousakana.jp (an introduction and the restaurant's own text): monk, a wood-fired restaurant on the Philosopher's Path, Kyoto; cook (pizza maker) 今井義浩; simple dishes in a wood-fired oven from ingredients bought daily from fields and markets; address 左京区浄土寺下南田町147; 17:30–20:30 (last order); omakase from the day's ingredients; closed Monday; tel 075-748-1154; pizza as the main; ingredients bought daily from fields and markets (the English text: every morning to the Ohara fields and Kyoto markets). Tabelog: Italian, pizza; Tue–Sat 17:00–20:30; closed Monday and Sunday; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); non-smoking; the owner closed from January 2020 to focus on writing and reopened in March; Italian WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (2023–2026, in English): course ¥15,400; opened December 2015; Chef's Table; 6 counter seats and 2 tables; plain baked pizza; Ohara vegetables; half-and-half pizzas.

yume-kaze: 大阪・北新地の老舗そば「喜庵」の味を東大寺南大門近くの夢風.en: yume-kaze: the taste of 'Kian', a long-established soba shop in Kitashinchi, Osaka, served at Yume-kaze Hiroba near Tōdaiji's Great South Gate. Freshly ground, freshly made, freshly boiled, with seasonal buckwheat flour from all over Japan. Duck dipping soba, cold soba with tempura, plum soba, nameko. Yume-kaze Hiroba is a rest facility showcasing Nara's food and way of life.

¥4,510 (税込 ¥4,961) — 平日ランチ ランチグリルセット ¥2,.en: ¥4,510 (¥4,961 incl. tax) — weekday lunch grill set ¥2,220 (¥2,442 incl. tax)

こだわりのブレンドの粉＝小麦のブレンドと考えるべき。玉子の香り＝卵入り。.en: The carefully chosen blended flour should be taken as a wheat blend. The egg aroma = contains egg.

こだわりの生パスタ（明太子クリーム紫蘇パスタ、昔ながらの鉄板ナポリタンなど）とふ.en: Carefully made fresh pasta (mentaiko cream shiso pasta, old-fashioned hot-plate Napolitan and more) and fluffy pancakes.

こだわり出汁の金沢おでん.en: Kanazawa oden in a carefully made dashi

ことりっぷとfood-japonで、1957年大塚太蔵造氏創業、二代目正治→三代.en: co-trip and food-japon confirm: founded 1957 by 大塚太蔵造, second generation 正治 → third generation 正樹; the origin of hanton rice (1960s, recreating a dish from training days in Tokyo / 'Han' = Hungary + 'ton' = French for tuna / the spread-out egg on top became a talking point); 70–80% of customers order it, with queues; 正治's words, 'what matters is to keep carefully making good food'.

ことりっぷと公式コンセプトページで、店主森島幹裕（いわき市から避難）、2014年.en: co-trip and the official concept page confirm: owner 森島幹裕 (evacuated from Iwaki City); opened 2014; fully plant-based with no meat, egg, dairy or animal fat; Kaga vegetables; vegan veggie-combo lunch; soy-meat ginger pork and burgers; Ise Hikari rice; Tomo Farm / Eco Farm Okuno; 2–3 kinds of rice-flour gluten-free vegan muffins a day (sell out at once); logo by Sarah Williams (Cirque du Soleil's Viva Elvis).

ことりっぷ・iいじ金沢・週末金沢と検索で、1964年香林坊で創業（現社長の両親）.en: co-trip, Iiji Kanazawa, Shūmatsu Kanazawa and searches confirm: founded 1964 in Korinbo (by the current president's parents), moved to Kakinokibatake in 1984; at first two entrances and two signboards, a diner and a Western restaurant, with oden added later at customers' request; Kanazawa Oden 50-Year Shops Association (local ingredients, all year); kurumabu and daikon; a clear dashi of kombu and bonito with Noto salt and sake.

ことりっぷ・フォートラベルで、大正2年(1913)築の主計町の町家、浅野川沿い(.en: co-trip and 4travel confirm: a Kazuemachi townhouse built in Taishō 2 (1913), along the Asano River (between Asanogawa Ōhashi and Naka-no-hashi), a city-designated preserved building, red bengara walls; Tsuchiya coffee (about ¥500), Dalat coffee, wasanbon iced coffee / zenzai, Wajima lacquerware, welcome tea and sweets, river views from the second-floor tatami room.

ことりっぷ・金沢経済新聞・ishimoで、2022年9月9日開業、築100年超の.en: co-trip, Kanazawa Keizai Shimbun and ishimo confirm: opened 9 September 2022; a townhouse over 100 years old; a time-slip Taishō-romance coffee shop; the name comes from the goldfish in Murō Saisei's novel 'Mitsu no Aware'; cream soda in goldfish-bowl glasses, haikara punch, house-made pudding, white pancakes; rental as a photo studio.

ことりっぷ及び検索で、そばを打つのは『東湯』主人の息子・道端さん、東京で複数の蕎.en: co-trip and searches confirm: the soba is made by 道端 (Michihata), son of the owner of 'Higashi-yu', who returned home after helping launch several soba shops in Tokyo; Kaga roasted-tea soba (¥880) with Kaga bōcha kneaded into sarashina flour. higashiyu.com confirms soba by day and the soba bar Otoyu by night (Higashiyu Co.).

この店では基本的にお箸が出てきません。べた焼きはテコ（コテ）やヘラですくって食べ.en: This shop basically doesn't bring out chopsticks. The way is to scoop betayaki with a teko or hera. Eating with a metal spatula keeps the batter from cooling, so you can enjoy it piping hot to the end — that's the reason.

この行法は天平の昔、東大寺開山良辧僧正の高弟實忠和尚によって創められましてから今.en: This rite was founded in the Tenpyō era by Jicchū, senior disciple of Rōben, founding priest of Tōdaiji, and in the more than a thousand years since it has never once been interrupted: a sacred and powerful rite.

この麺嫌いな京都人おらんやろ.en: there's no Kyoto person who doesn't like these noodles

この６月１日をもちまして正式に閉店することにいたしました」.en: we have decided to close formally as of 1 June"

これからは息子と共に華祥をがんばっていきたい.en: from now on I will carry on Kasho with my son

これぞ京都の味.en: this is the taste of Kyoto

これまで和食一筋で歩んできましたが、常に心にあるのは、「美味しいものを、もっと美.en: I have kept to Japanese cooking all along, and what is always in my heart is the wish that good food be enjoyed even more deliciously

これも、変わらず支えていただいた皆様のおかげです.en: This too is thanks to everyone who has supported us without change

こんにゃく芋と水のみ、小麦不使用。.en: Only konjac and water, no wheat.

こんにゃく麺（極細・太麺）／ちぢれ卵麺」.en: konnyaku noodles (extra-thin, thick) / curly egg noodles'

ごま油とニンニクが主だが、醤油の有無が未記載。.en: Mainly sesame oil and garlic, but whether there's soy sauce isn't listed.

ごま油と塩なら小麦なしの可能性。たれは醤油。.en: With sesame oil and salt, possibly no wheat. The sauce is soy sauce.

ごま油と塩の店もあるが、たれ＝醤油＝小麦が一般的。要確認。.en: Some shops use sesame oil and salt, but sauce = soy sauce = wheat is common. Ask.

ごま油・塩が基本だが醤油使用の可能性。.en: Basically sesame oil and salt, but soy sauce may be used.

ごま油・調味料未記載（醤油の可能性）。.en: Sesame oil and seasonings not listed (possibly soy sauce).

ごま煎餅は小麦入りの製品が多く要確認。求肥はもち米。ミルクソース＝乳製品。.en: Many sesame crackers contain wheat; check. Gyuhi is glutinous rice. Milk sauce = dairy.

ごま豆腐自体はごまと葛粉で小麦不使用・植物性。掛けだれ（だし醤油・わさび醤油）に.en: Sesame tofu itself is sesame and kudzu starch, wheat-free and plant-based. The sauce poured over (dashi soy sauce, wasabi soy sauce) has wheat and bonito dashi, so check.

ごま麩も土台は小麦グルテン。味噌の種類未記載（麦味噌なら二重に不可）。.en: Sesame fu is wheat gluten at its base too. Type of miso not listed (doubly not OK if barley miso).

ご主人はこの道ひと筋で、御歳70オーバー.en: the master has devoted a lifetime to this, and is over 70

ご主人・奥さん.en: the owner and the owner's wife

ご会食】季節野菜と牛肉の個別陶板.en: dining] seasonal vegetables and beef on individual ceramic plates

ご利用をお控えいただいております」.en: are asked to refrain from using the restaurant"

ご夫婦／店主＋奥さんの2人.en: a married couple / the owner and wife, two people

ご希望に合わせてご用意いたします.en: we'll prepare them as you wish

ご指定のページが見つかりません。」.en: the page you specified could not be found."

ご注文は麺を半分ほど食べた頃合いで、スタッフにお声がけください.en: Please order from the staff when you've eaten about half your noodles

ご注文後にキャラメリゼして提供。乳・卵。土台の有無は要確認。.en: Caramelised after ordering. Dairy, egg. Ask whether there is a base.

ご飯がなくなり次第終了。.en: Ends when the rice runs out.

ご飯とキャベツのおかわり1回無料.en: one free refill of rice and cabbage

さざえのつぼ焼き.en: turban shell grilled in its shell

さざえの壺焼き.en: turban shell grilled in its shell

さつまいもが主原料だが麹に麦を使う銘柄がある。銘柄を要確認。.en: Mainly sweet potato, but some brands use barley in the koji. Check the brand.

さつまいもと米麹。麦麹は使わないが表示を要確認。.en: Sweet potato and rice koji. No barley koji, but check the label.

さつまいも・生クリーム・卵・砂糖なら小麦不使用。添えのクッキーの有無を要確認。.en: Sweet potato, fresh cream, egg and sugar would be wheat-free. Check whether there is a cookie on the side.

さつま揚げ＝すり身に小麦澱粉が入るのが一般的、揚げ物。.en: Satsuma-age = fish paste usually with wheat starch; fried.

さつま芋でんぷんで小麦不使用。ただし製品によっては小麦でんぷんを含むものがあり、.en: or sweet-potato starch, with no wheat. But some products contain wheat starch, so check that, and whether kinako and kuromitsu come with it.

さらしなそば.en: sarashina soba (from the white heart of the buckwheat)

さんたつ(2019.12): カフェ ルトン、銀座5-6-16 西五番館B2、ア.en: Santatsu (2019.12): Café de Ruton, Ginza 5-6-16, 西五番館 B2; Art Nouveau furnishings and porcelain collected by owner Toshimitsu Ida; mellow coffee from aged beans; Meissen blend (Brazil base) ¥900, waffle ¥600; "customers change, but the shop doesn't"; 38 years. Tabelog (2026): weekdays 11:00–17:00, weekends 11:00–18:00; cash only. 2026 reviews: a Ghibli-like space, antique clocks, stained glass, banana crêpe about ¥800, chocolate waffle, 2-hour limit when busy.

さんたつ(2019.12): 喫茶 アメリカン、ニューヨークのデリのような外観、.en: Santatsu (2019.12): Kissa American, a front like a New York deli, founded 1983; went jumbo-size when the Kabukiza was renovated; the famous owner Makoto Haraguchi: "one serving is a whole loaf"; bread baked that day; fist-size egg filling; takeaway available; sandwich set ¥1,200 (with salad, soup and a drink); posters of Saga Prefecture. Tabelog: Ginza 4-11-7; Mon–Fri 8:30–14:30, closed weekends and holidays; closes when the bread runs out; cash only. 2026 reviews: special egg sandwich (8 eggs' worth), ¥2,000 with an iced coffee, egg & potato takeaway set ¥1,000, shared tables, the hot coffee is mocha.

さんたつ(2020.2): 三州屋 銀座店、銀座一丁目の路地の大衆食堂、令和2年.en: Santatsu (2020.2): Sanshūya Ginza, a popular diner in a Ginza 1-chome lane, 51 years old in Reiwa 2; owner Masayuki Okada (born Showa 10, trained at Kanda Sanshūya, opened in Showa 43); goes to the market every morning; open straight through 11:30–22:00; Tokyo government staff and newspaper reporters; shared plain-wood tables for six, 7 counter seats, a tatami room upstairs; menus on the wall and a whiteboard; sashimi platter set ¥1,100, seafood bowl set, fried oyster set ¥1,350, chicken tofu ¥480; staff veterans of 20+ years. Tabelog: Taishū Kappō Sanshūya Ginza main shop, Ginza 2-3-4; Teishoku Top 100 2021; weekdays 10:30–22:30, Sat and holidays until 22:00, closed Sun; otoshi ¥500; all payment types. 2026 reviews: moved when the old building was demolished; horse-mackerel fry set ¥1,500, swordfish sashimi ¥1,100, sashimi set, mackerel in miso.

さんたつ(2021.03.10): 明治28年(1895)創業、4代目店主・木田.en: Santatsu (2021.03.10): founded in Meiji 28 (1895); fourth-generation owner Kōichirō Kida; founded by the great-grandfather, 木田元次郎. Original pork cutlet ¥2,000, Meiji-born omurice ¥2,100, consommé ¥900 (then). The pork cutlet derives from veal côtelette; the shredded cabbage dates from the Russo-Japanese War period; the omurice from around Meiji 33. Four floors from B1 to 3F, tatami room on 3F. Inshokuten.com (2019): most popular dishes began as staff meals. Tabelog: Ginza 3-5-16, Mon–Sat and holidays 11:15–15:00 (LO 14:00), 17:30–21:00 (LO 20:00), closed Sun, cash only.

さんたつ(2021.6.16): 310.COFFEE(さとうコーヒー)、銀座7.en: Santatsu (2021.6.16): 310.COFFEE (Satō Coffee), Ginza 7-chome, opened February 2016; calls itself a "kissaten (saten)"; opened by manager Yukie Satō (from Hokkaido, 15 years at the Ginza and Shimbashi shops of Miyakoshiya Coffee) and an owner who left a trading company in the owner's 40s; Satō's husband, Ryūma Ueno, also joined, and the couple are entrusted with everything in the shop; roasted almost every day in the shop's roaster; blend ¥900, refills half price. Tabelog: Ginza 7-11-6, GINZA ISONO Building 1F; 35 seats; weekdays 11:00–20:00, weekends and holidays until 19:00; smoking allowed at all seats. 2026 reviews: Napolitan set (drink up to ¥1,100), Mandheling.

さんたつ(2021.6.24): 樹の花、木挽町通りと松屋通りの角のビル2階、店.en: Santatsu (2021.6.24): Kinohana, 2F of a building at the corner of Kobikicho-dori and Matsuya-dori; owner Hiroko Narusawa; opened 1979; John Lennon and Yoko Ono came on August 4, its fourth day (a handwritten letter); the name comes from a book Narusawa, a lover of mountain walking, had at hand; beans from the roaster every other day; a copper kettle (the third); original blend from ¥700; eggplant keema curry with naan or rice ¥1,200, a curry from a young Indian man's recipe; cheesecake made by a friend since the opening; a book title by binding designer Nobuyoshi Kikuchi. Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat 11:30–18:30, holidays 12:00–17:30, closed Thu and Sun. 2026 reviews: bean and vegetable curry ¥1,100 (+¥650 for salad and coffee), John Lennon set ¥1,150, lemon meringue tart set ¥1,470.

さんたつ(2021.6.25): カフェ・ド・ランブル、1948年創業、創業者・.en: Santatsu (2021.6.25): Café de l'Ambre, founded 1948; founder Ichirō Sekiguchi (died 2018 at 103; established "old coffee"); current owner Fujihiko Hayashi (Sekiguchi's nephew, working at the shop since before age 20); an ice-cooled refrigerator and weight scale from the opening days, enamel pots and flannel drippers, a hammered copper pan; Blanc et Noir (Queen of Amber) single ¥850, Café Noir ¥750; a custom grinder. Tabelog: Ginza 8-10-15; Tue–Sat 11:00–20:00, Sun until 18:00, closed Mon; no cards, iD and PayPay accepted.

さんたつ(2021.7.1): 月のはなれ、銀座8丁目の雑居ビル5階、エレベータ.en: Santatsu (2021.7.1): Tsuki no Hanare, 5F of a mixed-use building in Ginza 8-chome, no elevator; a salon opened in 2013 by the art-supply shop "Gekkōsō", founded in Taisho 6; founder 橋本兵藏; Yosano Akiko; third-generation owner 日比康造, the founder's grandson (a musician); once an art-supply warehouse, half of it rooftop; tables from the Taisho era; exhibitions every two weeks; live music every night (no charge); Creole food, gumbo (New Orleans); pulled-pork rice ¥1,150; moon lemon cake ¥750; hand-drip coffee ¥680; drawing set ¥1,000; Yosano Blue Moon ¥1,200; "a sense of color and a sense of sound are life's treasures"; 58 steps. Official site (2026): Mon–Sat 12:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00), Sun and holidays 12:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:00); online booking; October 2026 performance schedule and wall exhibitions; recruiting manager candidates in view of the current manager going independent.

さんたつ(2022.02.10): 伊藤家 — 角館『自家製麺 伊藤』(伯父)、.en: Santatsu (2022.02.10): the Itō family — "Jikaseimen Itō" in Kakunodate (uncle), "Chuka Soba Itō" in 王子神谷 (father), "Mendokoro Yū" in Warabi (older brother); Hiromu Itō, owner of "Jikaseimen Itō" in Akabane, expanded to Ginza and Kanda and won a Bib Gourmand. The father's chuka soba and the uncle's Hinai-jidori soba are the two signatures. A central kitchen sends noodles and soup to each shop. Niboshi bought directly from Kujukuri every two months. Low-hydration, snappy noodles. Tabelog: Ginza shop opened January 20, 2014; 12 seats; cards, IC and QR accepted.

さんたつ(2022.10.18): はるちゃんラーメン、新橋駅前ビル1号館1階、.en: Santatsu (2022.10.18): Haru-chan Ramen, Shimbashi Ekimae Building 1, 1F; opened August 2021; 6 counter seats; run single-handed by the woman owner Haru-chan (about 20 years working in ramen shops). Chuka soba ¥890 (then), mori chuka (suspended). A salt-based soup: the pork stock from preparing the chashu, plus niboshi and aromatic vegetables. Original medium-thick (slightly flat) noodles from Daruma Seimenjo, 180 g; 60 g of pork shoulder and belly chashu, cut to order. Fu. Tabelog: Tue–Sat 10:00–18:00, closed Sun and Mon; 6 seats; no cash. October 2026: large chuka soba ¥1,100, special chuka soba ¥1,500, Michelin Bib Gourmand (per reviews).

さんたつ(2022.10.25): カフェテラス ポンヌフ、新橋駅前ビル1号館1.en: Santatsu (2022.10.25): Café Terrace Pont Neuf, Shimbashi Ekimae Building 1, 1F; opened 1967, a year after the building was completed in 1966; Pont Neuf = new bridge = Shinbashi; began as a jun-kissa, and under the second manager added Napolitan, hamburg spaghetti, Pont Neuf burg and hamburg sandwiches; third manager Uekusa (helping with dishwashing from around 2007, manager since 2018); pre-boiled thick noodles, 2.0 mm → 2.2 mm; Napolitan with ham; beef-and-pork hamburg steak done in the oven; an original sauce with minced meat; a food critic's "delicious!". Tabelog (2026): Mon–Thu 11:00–14:50, Fri evenings too, closed weekends and holidays. October 2026 reviews: Napolitan ¥1,100, hamburg spaghetti ¥1,400, evening-only bacon and cheese Napolitan ¥2,000, Top 100 2026.

さんたつ(2022.10.31): 銀座 スケベニンゲン、銀座三丁目の松屋通り、.en: Santatsu (2022.10.31): Ginza Scheveningen, on Matsuya-dori in Ginza 3-chome, down yellow stairs to the basement; manager 越塚; in 1977 the first owner, 小野澤邦夫 (from a travel agency), and chef 山口櫻子 opened a travel company & coffee shop in Shinbashi; the name comes from SCHEVENINGEN outside The Hague in the Netherlands; moved to Ginza in 1979 as a southern-Italian home-cooking restaurant; 山口 has passed away, and 小野澤 is in Okinawa; the famous frittata ¥1,100 (house meat sauce, whole eggs, Parmigiano, devised by 山口); 63 pastas; 24 seats. Tabelog: Tue, Wed, Fri 11:30–14:30, 17:30–22:00; Thu lunch only; Sat and holidays until 21:00; closed Sun and Mon; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted. 2026 reviews: frittata ¥1,200, handwritten placemats, one person on the floor.

さんたつ(2022.10.31): 銀座スイス、銀座ガス灯通り沿い大倉別館2F(.en: Santatsu (2022.10.31): Ginza Swiss, on Ginza Gas-tō-dōri, 大倉 Annex 2F (moved February 2022); founder 岡田進之助 was head chef at 宝亭 in Kojimachi and at the Prime Minister's Office; opened in 1947 as Grill Swiss, the name a wish for peace; third-generation mama 庄子あけみ; in 1948 Chiba Shigeru of the Giants devised katsu curry; original katsu curry set ¥1,430 (lunch only, 20 a day, with soup and salad); the curry is minced meat, onion, carrot, apple and ginger simmered two weeks, with no wheat flour; Chiba-san's cutlet curry; clam and bacon potage (evaporated milk, bacon from the same supplier); soup refills ¥220; Showa gratin ¥2,640; yōshoku-style shumai ¥660. Tabelog: main shop, daily 11:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); 42 seats; cards, IC and PayPay accepted. The Yaesu underground-mall shop is marked closed (last review September 2025). October 2026 reviews: queue before opening, lunch B (fried shrimp, fillet cutlet), hamburg steak and fried shrimp, cream croquettes, Chiba-san's premium katsu curry.

さんたつ(2022.11.02): 麺処 銀笹、店主・笹沼高広さん(日本料理の職.en: Santatsu (2022.11.02): Mendokoro Ginzasa; owner Takahiro Sasanuma (18 years as a Japanese-cuisine craftsman, worked at a Ginza restaurant popular for sea-bream chazuke); opened 2010. The soup is a double soup: chicken and pork rested overnight and skimmed of fat, plus kombu and niboshi dashi (not sea-bream dashi). Salt and white soy sauce; thin straight noodles, 150 g (then). Pork-belly chashu torched for each order. Sea-bream tsumire. For the sea-bream rice, a whole sea bream grilled head and all is cooked with the rice, flaked and returned. The bowls are Hanno-ware katakuchi made by the owner's pottery-class teacher. Tabelog: Mon–Sat 11:15–15:00, evenings suspended for lack of staff, closed Sundays and holidays; cash only; 18 seats; Ramen Top 100 2017–2025. October 2026: Ginzasa ramen, shio or white shoyu, ¥1,100 each; large +¥150.

さんたつ(2022.5.27): パーラーキムラヤ、新橋駅前ビル1号館B1、昭和.en: Santatsu (2022.5.27): Parlor Kimuraya, Shimbashi Ekimae Building 1, B1; founded Showa 42 (1967), opened together with the building; a showcase of food samples; regulars and women drawn by the jun-kissa boom; pudding à la mode ¥800 (firm custard pudding, vanilla ice cream), pudding ¥530, pudding royal ¥720, Napolitan ¥630, cream soda ¥530; opens 8:00. Tabelog: Mon–Fri 8:00–19:30, Sat 11:00–17:30, closed Sun and holidays; cash only. 2026 reviews: also said to be founded in 1966; shrimp pilaf set; Showa retro; no smoking inside.

さんたつ(2023.1.9): 薬膳Dining&Bar 銀座しんのう、東銀座駅.en: Santatsu (2023.1.9): Yakuzen Dining & Bar Ginza Shinnou, in a lane behind the Kabukiza 2 minutes from Higashi-Ginza exit A7; opened 2020; owner 三上康介 (from Iwate; a cook's child; moved from meals at an elder-care facility to yakuzen; Chinese medicinal-cuisine practitioner, international yakuzen practitioner, international TCM practitioner); the younger brother 隼平, a yakuzen coordinator, makes more than 30 medicinal liquors; the mother helps too; yakuzen keema curry (mixed minced meat, onions, 20+ spices, no sugar but licorice); Mornay sauce; Iwate Hitomebore rice (specially grown, from a classmate's family farm); yakuzen cheese keema curry ¥1,600; all-you-can-drink yakuzen tea; at night samgyetang, bak kut teh, tandoori chicken, karaage, mulberry-leaf tiramisu (monk fruit). Tabelog: Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00, 17:00–23:00, closed Sun and holidays; 34 seats; cards, IC and QR accepted. 2026 reviews: two-kind plate ¥1,800, pay cash up front at lunch, yakuzen soup chosen from a constitution check sheet, demi-glace curry ¥1,650, Shinnou salad (half) ¥1,650, mulberry-leaf tiramisu ¥770.

さんたつ(2023.10.06): 店主・柳沼英次さん、和食店・ラーメン店で修業.en: Santatsu (2023.10.06): owner Eiji Yaginuma trained at Japanese and ramen restaurants, met tsukemen in the owner's 30s, developed the soup self-taught, and opened in 2010. Rich seafood-tonkotsu tsukemen; special tsukemen ¥1,200 (then), the chuka soba served since opening ¥880 (then), takeaway available. Tabelog (official information, menu updated 2024/10/07): rich tsukemen ¥1,100, special tsukemen ¥1,400, chuka soba ¥950, chashu men ¥1,300. Current address Ginza 6-4-13, 浅黄 Building 1F; 8 counter seats.

さんたつ(2023.10.12): らーめん一郎、店主・長谷川一郎さん(そば屋・.en: Santatsu (2023.10.12): Ramen Ichirō, owner Ichirō Hasegawa (ran soba and Italian restaurants, lived in America), opened December 12, 2016. Aomori Shamo Rock chicken, shijimi clams from 十三湖, grilled flying fish (switched from grilled dried sardines during COVID), tomato. One soup for all the ramen (between paitan and chintan). Shijimi ramen ¥900 (then); the base tare uses salt and shottsuru. Yellow wavy medium-thick noodles for the shoyu, shio and curry ramen; thin straight noodles from 菅野製麺所 for the shijimi. No price rise since opening; open every day. Tabelog: 6 seats; cards and QR accepted.

さんたつ(2023.10.17): 共楽、1956年創業、屋台から初代・中野太一.en: Santatsu (2023.10.17): Kyōraku, founded 1956 when the first generation, 中野太一郎, went from a street stall to a shop in Ginza 2-chome; died in 1999 at 89. Third-generation Kazuhiko (trained in Cantonese cooking, took over at 26) runs it with the second-generation father, 喜久雄, and the mother, きよ子. Closed three years from 2016 for a building rebuild; on reopening in 2019 the noodles and wonton wrappers became house-made. Soup of chicken and niboshi; one shoyu chuka soba. Wonton men ¥1,000 (then); the menma is dried menma rehydrated over four days. 12 seats: 8 counter, 4 table. TV Tokyo (2022): founded Showa 31. Tabelog: reopened May 30, 2019; cash only.

さんたつ(2023.10.25): 大正時代に屋台から、昭和4年(1929)に旧.en: Santatsu (2023.10.25): from a street stall in the Taisho era, a shop in the former 木挽町 from Showa 4 (1929). The first generation came from Western cooking and ran a Western-and-Chinese restaurant. Third-generation Hidetaka Kubo (the grandfather was the first generation; took over from the father at about 25). Rebuilt in 2003. Chuka soba ¥800, pork rice ¥950 (then). Shoyu soup of seafood and meat stock, ginger, scallion oil, thin wavy noodles, pork-leg chashu, menma, spinach, naruto, and a triangle of thin omelet. Gendai Business: chuka soba unchanged for about 100 years since the stall days. Tabelog: 27 seats, cash only, closed Sundays and holidays.

さんたつ(2023.11.07): 船見坂、2001年に函館ラーメン店として開業.en: Santatsu (2023.11.07): Funamizaka, opened in 2001 as a Hakodate-ramen shop; in 2014 Masahiko Kiribayashi took it over (worked there about two years from 2010, independent in 2012). "Hakodate ramen of the early Showa era". The soup is a clear broth of Hokkaido ma-kombu, dried scallops, chicken bones, pork bones and vegetables; the salt tare uses Bizen rock salt. The noodles follow an early-Showa recipe with coarse-ground wheat flour, colored with gardenia. Pork-belly chashu in a topped-up soy-sauce-and-mirin tare. Shio soba ¥800 (then). Tabelog: 17 seats; Mon–Sat 11:00–4:00, Sun and holidays 11:00–22:00; transit IC accepted.

さんたつ(2023.11.10)より: 1975年創業の町中華。祖父が脱サラし『.en: From Santatsu (2023.11.10): a neighborhood Chinese restaurant founded in 1975. The grandfather left office work, trained at "Tsukemen Daio" and opened as a franchise, then went independent around 1977 as "Ginza-tei". Third-generation owner Shūhei Kitaoka (formerly at a yakitori shop, working with the father since 2020). A U-shaped counter, 5–6 people in the kitchen. One soup of chicken feet, pork trotters and vegetables serves all the noodle dishes. The house miso sauce is a little spicy. Miso chashu ¥1,300 (four slices of pork-shoulder chashu, medium-thick straight noodles). Orders run 6 set meals : 3 noodles : 1 snack. Address Ginza 7-11-10, Chuo-ku; open 11:30–1:15 LO, closed weekends. Tabelog: Chinese Top 100 2024 and 2026; 15 seats (counter only); cash only; no reservations; weekdays 11:30–1:30; closed weekends, holidays, and days before and after holidays.

さんたつ(2023.11.11): 銀座 梵天、銀座1-9-12、2011年開店.en: Santatsu (2023.11.11): Ginza Bonten, Ginza 1-9-12, opened 2011; manager Hikaru Satō; the name and old-house-style interior reflect the company president's taste. Tsukesoba "Machine Gun" (麻辛丸) regular ¥980 (then), a registered trademark; extra-thick noodles (noodle maker kept secret); the dipping sauce is a spicy chicken-bone base with shredded chashu and house menma. Extra chashu ¥400 (pork loin), seasoned egg ¥150, Japanese-style ramen ¥950 (ultra-thin needle noodles, Mikawaya Seimen). 20 seats. Tabelog: opened April 17, 2011; daily 11:00–0:30; cash only.

さんたつ(2023.11.17): らーめん松富、1996年創業、2013年に創.en: Santatsu (2023.11.17): Ramen Matsutomi, founded 1996; in 2013 Tsutomu Iwano took over from the founder (on staff since 2000). The basic soup of pork leg bones, Hidaka kombu from Hokkaido and more is shared by the shoyu ramen, tantanmen and clam ramen. Clam ramen ¥900 (then), 20 a day; patented shumai 2 for ¥360 at night, ¥270 in a lunch set. 17 seats. Tabelog: 15 seats, cash only, service charge, English menu, vegetarian menu (shop info), takeaway (gyoza, shumai).

さんたつ(2023.3.22 / 2024.3.8): Blood Moon-T.en: Santatsu (2023.3.22 / 2024.3.8): Blood Moon -Tokyo design noodles-, 2 minutes' walk from the SL Square in front of Shimbashi Station, next to Daiwa Roynet Hotel Shimbashi. Owner Tomoyoshi Takanashi (born and raised in Shimbashi, a former Ginza bartender) opened it in 2021. The tantanmen was produced by the owner of "noodle house 錦鯉" in 錦糸町. Mala tantanmen ¥950 (zhimajiang of house-ground sesame paste, cashews and scallion oil; chicken and dried goods with shijimi, Hokkaido ma-kombu and shiitake; Japanese coarse-ground pork meat miso; chili oil of four chilies), tantan tsukemen ¥1,000 (black vinegar), soupless tantanmen with hand-massaged medium-thick noodles, thin and medium-thick noodles with whole wheat developed with 菅野製麺所, chuka soba with wooden-barrel-brewed soy sauce, jarichi ¥300. 8 counter seats on 1F; a Chinese dining bar on 2F. Tabelog: Mon–Fri 11:30–16:00, 17:00–23:30, Sat until 15:00, closed Sun; cash only; opened July 10, 2021.

さんたつ(2024.10.22): 居酒屋 登運とん、有楽町の高架下のトンネル内.en: Santatsu (2024.10.22): Izakaya Tontonton, inside the tunnel under the Yurakucho tracks since 1953; manager Yūji Iwamoto (in izakaya since 15, also ran a shop of the manager's own, became manager during the COVID period); skewers threaded from 7:30 each morning for that day; charcoal; kashira (harami) ¥190, tsukune ¥190, pork-belly skewer ¥350 (2 skewers minimum each); a sauce topped up since the founding; garlic miso; miso-based beef-offal stew ¥630; Hoisu sour ¥500; address Yurakucho 2-1-10; weekdays 13:30–22:15 LO, Sat 12:00–22:00 LO, Sun and holidays 12:00–21:00 LO; open every day. ASCII.jp "Retro Sanpo" no. 5 (2023.9): founded Showa 28; popular with overseas tourists too.

さんたつ(2024.10.7): 居酒屋 金陵本店、1976年創業、有楽町ガード.en: Santatsu (2024.10.7): Izakaya Kinryō Honten, founded 1976, under the Yurakucho tracks; okami 武田理沙 (since 2022; the first generation was the okami's father); the name comes from being the first Tokyo dealer for Nishino Kinryo of Kagawa (founded 1789); several "Kinryo" sakes (dry honjozo ¥500 per gō, Setouchi Olive ¥500, 濃藍 ¥880); "the old man's fist" ¥880 (Kagawa hen thigh in a soy sauce, garlic and mirin sauce, with black pepper); chicken and pork skewers ¥190 (salt or sauce); ginkgo skewers ¥330; horse-mackerel namero ¥660 (house garlic miso); two grilled rice balls ¥450 (katsuobushi and soy sauce); about 80 dishes; kabuki-actor prints; a chicken painting by 伊藤若冲 on 2F; shop manager 榎; the "Kinryo Theater"; a rakugo show "Yurakugo" on the first Saturday of even months. Tabelog: 116 seats; Mon–Fri 17:00–22:45, Sat 14:00–22:45, closed Sun; cards, IC and QR accepted; smoking allowed. 2026 reviews: offal stew and fried cartilage ¥590, 8-skewer platter ¥1,430.

さんたつ(2024.10.7): 有楽町 天米、1952年創業の江戸前天ぷら、初.en: Santatsu (2024.10.7): Yūrakuchō Ten Yone, Edomae tempura founded 1952; the first generation trained at "Ten Yone" in Kanda 須田町 and was allowed to open under its name; the first generation died soon after, and 川口成一, a cousin of the okami, was adopted in as the second generation; the third son, 敬紀, is the third generation (joined at 29); the mother, 安子 (a former nurse, okami for over 50 years, from Kagoshima); sesame oil; a moist batter from dipping the tempura in the rice-bowl sauce; a topped-up rice-bowl sauce; lidded bowls; a 2-shō rice pot; bought at Toyosu every morning; tendon (kakiage, shrimp, kisu, vegetables) ¥1,200 with a small dish, miso soup and pickles; service set Tue, Thu and Fri only; 6 counter seats and sunken kotatsu; a painting by 熊谷守一; 11:30–14:00, 17:00–21:00 LO; closed weekends. Tabelog: 26 seats; no cards, e-money or QR. 2026 reviews: tempura and sashimi service set ¥1,400, evening tendon ¥1,800, kakiage bowl ¥2,100, omakase; the second-generation father fries, with the third generation at the center.

さんたつ(2024.7.16): 立ち呑み 庫裏、新橋駅前ビル1号館1F、201.en: Santatsu (2024.7.16): Tachinomi Kuri, Shimbashi Ekimae Building 1, 1F; opened May 22, 2012 (the same day as Tokyo Skytree); the parent business is the liquor shop "Sakaya Kurihara" in 南成瀬, Machida; the eldest son runs "Sakaya Kurihara" and the second son runs "Washu Pub Kuri" on B1 of the same building; a whole wall of sake labels from all 47 prefectures that okami Itsuko Kurihara has collected since 1983; about 30 seasonal sakes and about 10 aged sakes at ¥300–1,000 per 80 ml; omakase set ¥1,000; snacks such as pickles and dressed dishes ¥100–350; items with the "伊" mark are the okami's homemade (inari ¥200 with pickled-ginger sushi rice, potato salad ¥100 with boiled egg, seasoned eggs); pay on the spot; hours 17:00–23:30 (Sat 16:00–23:00); closed Sun and holidays. Tabelog: same hours; no cards, transit IC accepted. October 2026 reviews: three recommended for ¥1,000, Fukumasamune, Suminoe, satisfied for ¥1,500, recommended for sake beginners too.

さんたつ(2024.8.16): 有薫酒蔵、外堀通り沿い、九州の郷土料理、創業当.en: Santatsu (2024.8.16): Yūkun Sakagura, on Sotobori-dori; Kyushu regional food; high-school guestbooks kept since the founding (more than 3,400 schools; no. 1 was Kurume University Senior High School in 1987); okami Yōko Matsunaga and owner Tomokazu Matsunaga (the okami's husband, from Fukuoka) opened it in 1978; air-freighted from Kyushu daily; since the Isahaya Bay sea gates were closed, seasonal ingredients from all over Japan too; never-frozen horse sashimi from Kumamoto, kibinago sashimi, thin-sliced amberjack ¥1,700, gameni ¥1,050, grilled eggplant ¥900, Yūkun Daiginjo (高橋酒造) glass ¥900, Berkshire-pork skewers ¥800 (sweet-savory soy sauce). Address Shinbashi 1-16-4, Resona Shinbashi Building B1; 17:00–23:00; closed Sun and Mon. Tabelog: Tue–Fri 17:00–23:00, Sat from 16:30; closed Sun, Mon and holidays (open Mondays in December); VISA and Master accepted; phone bookings suspended, book online. 2026 reviews: high-school first-year course ¥3,800, sweet Kyushu soy sauce, booking recommended.

さんたつ(2024.9.5): 爐端本店、有楽町駅から徒歩3分、JR高架沿いの古.en: Santatsu (2024.9.5): Robata Honten, an old-house izakaya along the JR tracks 3 minutes from Yurakucho Station; manager Mō: "founded in the early Taisho era, more than a century of history"; came to Japan from Myanmar in 1992, working here since 2000, manager in 2023; run as a married couple; paintings and folk crafts collected by the previous owner; originally a robatayaki counter; tables with sunken hearths; niku-tama meshi ¥950 (braised pork belly in soy sauce and Shaoxing wine with star anise, a boiled egg, a mini salad and miso soup); pork-belly ginger pork; big-platter dishes suspended since COVID; duck simmered with orange ¥1,100; pork belly and shishito in tomato ¥980; yellowtail and daikon ¥1,100; creamy scallops ¥1,100. Tabelog: 50 seats; weekdays 11:30–14:30, 17:00–23:30, weekends and holidays 17:00–23:00; cards and IC accepted. 2026 reviews: original niku-tama meshi ¥1,000, lunch ¥900–1,100, sunken kotatsu upstairs, evening bookings are courses only.

さんたつ(2024.9.6): お食事 いわさき、大正9年(1920)有楽町ガー.en: Santatsu (2024.9.6): Oshokuji Iwasaki, founded Taisho 9 (1920) under the Yurakucho tracks as a 24-hour oden shop; a second shop in Showa 7 on the site of today's The Peninsula Tokyo; at the present spot since 1947; third-generation owner 岩崎博茂 (born 1942, took over in 1959 at 17); the owner's wife, 君榮, and the couple's daughters make four; about 15 seats; lunch only; daily set ¥750, tonkatsu set ¥1,100, salted mackerel set ¥900, katsudon set ¥950; batter (egg, water, wheat flour) and panko, fried in lard; the warishita is a trade secret; square bowls lined with nori; secret menu "Wakare"; cash only; 11:00–14:00; closed weekends and holidays. Tabelog: 12 seats; no cards, e-money or QR. 2026 reviews: katsudon set ¥1,000, daily ¥800 (ginger pork), chicken cutlet, rice ran out at 13:35, sesame salt.

さんたつ(2024.9.9): もつ焼き ふじ、JR有楽町駅から新橋方面へ徒歩4.en: Santatsu (2024.9.9): Motsuyaki Fuji, inside the tunnel under the tracks 4 minutes' walk from JR Yurakucho Station toward Shinbashi; around 1953 a politician's election office → a mistress's onigiri shop → motsuyaki from the second generation; third-generation owner 五十嵐義幸 (part-timer at 19 in 1974, took over in 1991); fourth generation 貴洋, the owner's son (a former carpenter); never-frozen Japanese pork offal; kashira is pork skirt; shiro is pre-boiled; the sauce is only soy sauce, sugar and sake, topped up; the offal stew is offal only, in two kinds of miso, ¥400; motsuyaki ¥180 each; draft beer ¥580, certified by Asahi as "Umai Tarunama"; more and more overseas customers; just after 17:00–22:00, closed Sundays and holidays. Tabelog: Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00, Sat 16:00–22:00; 30 seats; no cards or e-money, QR accepted. 2026 reviews: mobile ordering by smartphone, oden, potato salad, tsukune, go early or it sells out.

さんたつ(2025.3.25): 十一房珈琲店、有楽橋交差点近く、1978年創業.en: Santatsu (2025.3.25): Jūichibō Coffee, near the 有楽橋 intersection, founded 1978; at first in a basement on 柳通り, at the present spot about 30 years; a long single-plank counter, leather chairs, no groups of 4 or more; owner Yoshikazu Hasegawa (originally a regular; took over after working at coffee shops); roasted dark in a "buta-gama"; flannel drip; blend from ¥920; the staff hand-sew the flannel. Tabelog: Ginza 2-2-19; 31 seats (10 counter, 21 table); daily 11:00–21:30; cash only. 2026 reviews: Italian roast ¥920, Guatemala, royal milk tea, chocolate cake, dried-fruit and nut chiffon.

さんたつ(2026.1.23): 銀座 萬年堂本店、東銀座駅から徒歩3分、元和3.en: Santatsu (2026.1.23): Ginza Mannendō Honten, 3 minutes' walk from Higashi-Ginza Station; founded in Genna 3 (1617) at Teramachi-Sanjō in Kyoto, now in its 13th generation; supplied sweets to the imperial palace, the shoshidai and temples and shrines, with records of sweets for Emperor Go-Mizunoo; moved to Yaesu in Meiji 5 and also opened in Ginza; both shops burned in the war and only the Ginza shop was rebuilt; the present shop since 2022; jōnamagashi; tea room; awa zenzai ¥1,650 (Iwate Awakogane millet, in a wooden box, with a tea snack and hojicha); freshly kneaded bean-paste warabi with matcha ¥2,090 (Mannendō's special bean paste and bracken starch, kinako, brown-sugar syrup); 11:00–18:00 (tea room 12:00–17:00); open every day. Santatsu (2022.2.8): Iidabashi Mannendō was opened independently in 1993 by 樋口悠治, second son of the 11th generation of Ginza "Mannendō Honten". Rurubu (2023): moved from Ginza 5-chome to 7-chome in September 2022; seasonal jōnamagashi and matcha ¥1,650; steamed "Omedetō" with matcha ¥1,650. Tabelog: 10 seats; cards and QR accepted.

さんたつ「街の昭和を食べ歩く」第10回(2026年、前後編): バー ルパン、昭.en: Santatsu "Eating Through the Showa Town" no. 10 (2026, two parts): Bar Lupin, founded Showa 3 (1928); founder Yukiko Takasaki (a popular waitress at Café Tiger, backed by 菊池寛, 里見弴, 泉鏡花 and 久米正雄); a counter bar from Showa 10; a single plank of yachidamo ash; 林忠彦's photos of Dazai, Ango and 織田作之助; the golden fizz Ango loved; the 1945 air raids; renamed "麺包亭" and closed; reopened after the war as a coffee shop; the furnishings were stored during the 1972 rebuild and it reopened with the same layout; Yukiko was at the bar until around 1981; manager Naohiko Takasaki (grandson); bartender 開幾夫; shot glasses from the founding. Address Ginza 5-5-11; 17:00–23:00 LO; closed Sun and Mon. Tabelog: 塚本不動産 Building B1F; Mon–Sat 17:00–23:30; charge ¥800 (before tax); cash only. 2026 reviews: Bungo Stray Dogs fans, Moscow mule, Thunderclap, cucumber pickles.

さんたつ「街の昭和を食べ歩く」第6回(2025年、前後編): とんかつ あけぼの.en: Santatsu "Eating Through the Showa Town" no. 6 (2025, two parts): Tonkatsu Akebono, in the basement of the Tokyo Kotsu Kaikan; owner Bunzō Nakamura; the father opened a diner in "Sushi-Yoko" in Showa 37; Japanese pork from the same supplier since the previous generation; coarse fresh panko; high-temperature lard; bound with sauce and egg; Japanese rice cooked in a pot; niboshi-dashi miso soup; house pickles; katsudon ¥1,000; hard times after the government offices moved; "my cheerful father and mother". Address Yurakucho 2-10-1, Tokyo Kotsu Kaikan B1; 11:00–around 15:00 (until the rice runs out), 17:30–20:00; closed Sun. Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 11:00–14:30, 17:30–20:00; Wed and Sat lunch only; closed Sun, holidays and alternate Saturdays; cash only. October 2026 reviews: a queue of 12 before opening, write your order on the mini whiteboard at the entrance, katsudon ¥1,100, 11 counter seats, service set (fillet cutlet, fried shrimp, fried horse mackerel).

しぼりや 丸の内店は、愛知県南知多町内海で旅館「会席料理・お宿 しぼりや」を営む.en: Shiboriya Marunouchi is a lunch-only canteen opened in Marunouchi, Nagoya, on 13 March 2026 by Shiboriya, which runs the ryokan "Kaiseki Ryori · Oyado Shiboriya" in Utsumi, Minamichita, Aichi. It turns the seafood supply lines and frying skills honed by the ryokan on Ise Bay into set meals for city office workers.

すき焼きの割下＝醤油・味醂＝小麦。生卵使用。.en: Sukiyaki warishita = soy sauce and mirin = wheat. Uses raw egg.

The name 'Masara' comes from the Indian spice mix masala, and about 10 spices are used, including clove, star anise and cinnamon. Heat and numbness adjustable from 0 to 4. The Sichuan brothless dandan noodles went from a 3rd-anniversary limited item to the regular menu. Moved to Tatemachi in November 2025.

ろじうさぎは、宮川町・祇園の路地裏にたたずむ築100年あまりの京町家を活かしたカ.en: Roji Usagi is a café and sweets house that makes use of a Kyoto townhouse of a little over 100 years, standing in a back alley of Miyagawacho / Gion. Opened in July 2012, it keeps the charm of an old Kyoto townhouse and its cosy, almost lived-in air just as they were, and is run by a woman owner who is Kyoto born and bred. Tatami rooms and old Showa-feeling fittings remain, and its simple, homely comfort sets it apart from glamorous, tourist-built Kyoto cafés. Reached down an alley in Miyagawacho, known as a district of geiko and maiko, it is loved by locals and travellers alike.

Tabelog (English edition): RICHGARDEN Shinsaibashi main shop, Nishi-Shinsaibashi 2-13-5; opened 19 July 2013; daily 12:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); irregular closing days; no lunch bookings; 24 seats; non-smoking. Reviews (May–October 2026): the Grand Slam (said to have placed 4th at the Japan Burger Championship 2024, ¥2,100), bacon cheeseburger, mozzarella burger, a burger with bacon jam, golden beef melt cheese egg sandwich ¥1,750, nuggets, hamburg steak, an American atmosphere, many guests from abroad; one was not greeted on entering.

A gourmand blog records a menu without prices and a 2024 visit at about ¥18,480.

Tabelog: Menya Teru Nagahoribashi, 2-5-20 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station Crysta Nagahori exit 2B; Mon–Fri 11:00–14:30 (L.O. 14:20) and 18:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:50), Sat 11:30–14:00 and 18:30–22:00; closed Sundays and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 seats (counter); opened 7 July 2011; main shop in Sugahara, Higashiyodogawa-ku. Reviews (May–October 2026): chashu tsukemen large; limited B spicy tsukemen; rich niboshi tsukemen; a branch of a shop famous for seafood tonkotsu; seasoned-egg tsukemen ¥1,150; a strong soup of pork bones and vegetables simmered until they dissolve, combined with seafood and kombu; additive-free and gentle; one wished it were hotter; tsukemen ¥1,050; a seasoned egg on the house; a pleasant owner; the limited mackerel ramen sold out; special ramen with onsen egg; seafood tonkotsu heavy on niboshi; medium-thin, slightly firm noodles; the cold curry ramen is superb; once not open at the posted time; a rich seafood soup; firm noodles; easy to visit alone.

公式 tori-misono.com。食べログ(店舗会員): みその、大阪市中央.en: Official tori-misono.com. Tabelog (shop member): Misono, Hozenji MEOUTO Bldg 1F, 1-2-10 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; in the building next to Hozenji's Mizukake Fudo; Mon–Sat 17:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); closed Sundays; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; a chicken specialist using young domestic chicken. Reviews (February 2025 – March 2026): a course for a birthday; sashimi, wings, dry curry; counter and tatami; fried cartilage; chicken sashimi; fried wings; grilled liver; dry-curry omurice; salad; simmered liver; chicken skin; jjigae; a small sake list; shochu; tables in a private room at the back; fresh, springy sashimi; juicy karaage; garlicky tataki; fried chicken skin wrapped round leek; staff serve portions for you; spicy simmered chicken skin with rice; 4 plates of grilled cartilage; got in without booking but it soon filled; sashimi platter; gizzard; few words but kind; mizutaki and zosui in the course.

公式 toxnavi.com/egami/。食べログ(店舗会員): 江上、大阪市.en: Official toxnavi.com/egami/. Tabelog (shop member): Egami, Nippo Kasayamachi Kaikan (back of the ground floor), 2-8-3 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; south on Europe-dori at the third light from Midosuji; Mon–Sat 18:00–3:00 next morning; closed Sundays and holidays; no cards or e-money; 20 seats (counter 10, tables 8, 2 extra); private hire up to 20; smoking allowed; a teppan izakaya 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station, from classic okonomiyaki to seafood and meat. Reviews (October 2025 – June 2026): 27 years in business; agedashi tofu as the starter; kasu-hari ¥770 (abura-kasu and mizuna); ten-cheese ¥770; a favourite teppanyaki; hard to get in without booking; has lost count of visits; at the end of a narrow corridor in a mixed building; a cheerful, friendly owner; sautéed scallops; salt yakisoba (with fried pork fat); pork okonomiyaki with a fried egg; full with bookings; phone if you can't book online; curry yakisoba to finish.

公式 tsukemen-tsujita.com。食べログ: つじ田 心斎橋店、大.en: Official tsukemen-tsujita.com. Tabelog: Tsujita Shinsaibashi, 3-9-5 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station north stairs 8; Mon–Fri 11:00–24:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 10:00–22:00; transit IC accepted, no cards or QR; 16 counter seats; no smoking; opened 6 October 2024. Reviews (November 2024 – October 2026): a popular tsukemen shop on the Semba Shinsaibashi shopping street; some days easier to get into than at opening; chashu and soft-boiled egg; ticket machine; rich seasoned-egg tsukemen ¥1,210; a queue at 13:30 on a Sunday; many overseas tourists; a seafood-and-meat dipping soup; sudachi over the noodles; rich tsukemen large; seafood umami; classic and consistent; Kanda Tsukemen Tsujita; black shichimi; soup-wari; memories of the Awajicho shop.

公式 tsukemen.assets-name-innovation.co.jp.en: Official tsukemen.assets-name-innovation.co.jp. Tabelog: Osaka Tsukemen Shiraishi Namba, Hirose Bldg 1F, 15-11 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from the Namba stations; daily 7:00–25:00; open every day of the year; no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 14 seats (counter only); opened 10 November 2025; a tsukemen specialist, new brand of the 'Shiraishi' group; kombu-water tsukemen; rich chicken and seafood tsukemen; sets with an A5 wagyu rice bowl; morning ramen and night ramen. Reviews (September–October 2026): whole-wheat noodles; good even on their own; the sudachi a little bitter; no soup-wari (broth to thin the dip); busy with overseas visitors even at 8 p.m.; rich tsukemen large; spicy-egg tsukemen; extra-thick, like udon; a flame under the dipping soup keeps it hot to the end; lime; 5 waiting before noon, about 20 minutes; rich shrimp tsukemen; special rich shrimp tsukemen; sakura shrimp; large free; a line of about 10, about 30 minutes; touch-panel ticket machine; rich seasoned-egg tsukemen ¥1,200; counter only, cramped; mostly overseas diners; flat and chewy.

公式 unagi-nedoko-shinsaibashi.com: 注文ごとに捌.en: Official unagi-nedoko-shinsaibashi.com: live eel killed and filleted to order, Kansai-style jiyaki; an eel specialist 7 min from Shinsaibashi Station; featured on 'Matsuko no Shiranai Sekai' in June 2022; grilled over charcoal without steaming; mainly the domestic brand 'Kiso Sansen Unagi'; skewers and omakase courses of fine dishes; a single-plank table; unaju, hitsumabushi, skewers; lunch menu. Tabelog (shop member): Mitsudera Lees Bldg 2F, 2-6-11 Higashi-Shinsaibashi; daily 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–22:00; closes when the eel runs out; irregular closing days; Kansai-style jiyaki without steaming; skewers from ¥880 each; smoked eel and eel omelette; monthly omakase courses ¥8,800 and ¥11,000; cushions for children; 20 seats (counter 8); opened 1 October 2007. Reviews (August–September 2026): eel course; attentive staff; fully booked by 18:00; crisp skin and tender flesh; a sauce that isn't too sweet; Wakayama sansho; a round plate without a lid rather than a lacquer box; the best Kansai style; smoked eel; 5-skewer platter ¥4,180 (belly, neck, burdock wrap, nira wrap, tsukune); Manpuku-don (half an eel) ¥3,850; liver sashimi; shirayaki; eel salad; eel rice bowl.

公式 unchi-co.com。食べログ: くそオヤジ最後のひとふり なんば店、.en: Official unchi-co.com. Tabelog: Kuso Oyaji Saigo no Hitofuri Namba, 2-1-15 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nankai Namba Station south exit; Mon–Thu and Sun 11:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30), Fri, Sat and days before holidays 11:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); no cards, e-money or QR; 26 seats (counter 10, tables 16); no smoking; opened 8 January 2022. Reviews (June–October 2026): shellfish ramen; large rare chashu covering the rim of the bowl; plenty of shellfish; shellfish umami with deep shoyu; medium-thick straight noodles; thick menma; shredded white leek; summer-only cold version full of shellfish; staff checked whether myoga was OK; a well-balanced bowl; one wanted a bit more; with family; table seats suit children too; the shijimi ramen is even lighter, good after drinking; noodles with a whole-wheat-like flavour; always the shijimi ramen; shellfish rice; scallop-scented golden TKM; rice to finish.

公式 wixsite は オーガニック・マクロビ・ヴィーガン・グルテンフリー・ア.en: The official Wix site states organic, macrobiotic, vegan, gluten-free and allergy-friendly, and that the chef travels around organic farms nationwide to buy vegetables. Vegewel says it is run by a couple, with Kuwahara Michiko (first-class dietary life adviser) as operator, serving Japanese vegan food. Tabelog also confirms organic, macrobiotic and vegan.

公式 yakitori-kibitaki.com/bettei/。食べログ(店舗.en: Official yakitori-kibitaki.com/bettei/. Tabelog (shop member): YAKITORI KIBITAKI Bettei, Sanboa Bldg 2F, 2-1-10 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 6; daily 18:00–23:00; irregular closing days; book on the official site; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 11 seats; opened 12 December 2023. Reviews (October 2025 – September 2026): liver sashimi; neck (tare); heart (tare); gizzard; soft-boiled quail eggs; the main shop was full, so the Bettei; 5 kinds of sashimi; big grilled items; full-size neck and negima; beautiful presentation; booked by phone at 18:00 with 1 hour 20 minutes until the next booking; 11 counter seats; seat charge ¥500; chicken sashimi platter ¥1,800; 7-skewer omakase ¥2,800; overseas diners; cartilage ume-suisho; tsukune; main shop on the 3rd floor, Bettei on the 2nd; a dim, stylish bar-like interior; 7-skewer omakase; liver sashimi; tataki; fresh; chochin; quail; skewers on the large side; less salt on request.

公式 yakitori-midori.info。食べログ: 味鳥、大阪市中央区難.en: Official yakitori-midori.info. Tabelog: Midori, 1-5-21 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 30 seconds from Mizukake Fudo in Hozenji Yokocho; Mon–Sat 17:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); closed Sundays and holidays; may close early when sold out; reservations accepted (first-timers course only, à la carte can be added after; deposit and cancellation fee for 5 or more); cards accepted, no e-money; smoking allowed (with consent of the diners on either side); 12 seats (counter only); founded 1958; morning-slaughtered branded and local chickens such as Ise Akadori and shamo; Tajima chicken and shamo grilled over Kishu binchotan; a secret tare. Reviews (July–September 2026): 68 years in business; run by the second and third generations; the tare is only shoyu and sake, without needless sweetness; sake gets expensive unless you check prices; L-shaped counter; Matsu, Take and Ume courses; sashimi and skewers both good; Take course; skewers explained with a smile; negima; sasami with ume-shiso; Midori-yaki; asparagus wraps; burdock wraps; skin; tulip; shiitake stuffed with meat; one found the meat tough and had hygiene concerns; onsen egg and yamakake; ginkgo nuts; a tare that isn't too strong; ¥6,000 course; cartilage; junmai daiginjo.

公式 yasumaru.co.jp: PIENO vivace、大阪市中央区難波.en: Official yasumaru.co.jp: PIENO vivace, Daiko Center 1F, 4-8-2 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 20 seats (counter 10, semi-private about 10); private hire for 15 or more; group shops PIENO, PIENO villa, PIENO di cibo, PIENO festa, PIENO settimo in Kochi, ENO cafe and the butcher Maruhachi. Tabelog: 2 min walk from Namba Station exit 21; daily 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00); closed Tuesdays; counter for 3 or more by phone; cards and PayPay accepted; opened 4 October 2009. Reviews (February 2025 – October 2026): at the end of a street in Ura-Namba; a view of the Hanshin Expressway; nearly full; hard to get in without booking at 18:30–19:00 on Fridays and Saturdays; the same basic menu as the main shop plus handwritten daily specials; the famous sea-urchin pasta; carpaccio; ajillo; prosciutto salad; house sangria; pasta cooked firm; acqua pazza; burrata; soft-boiled-egg pizza; tomato cream pasta; the third shop; a Kochi shop too; roast-beef tartare; about ¥5,000 each; Genovese since 10 years ago; about ¥8,000 each with 2 bottles of red; wines explained; carpaccio of 3 fresh fish ¥1,298 (sea bream, yellowtail, salmon); seasonal fruit and mascarpone spring rolls ¥1,078 (prosciutto, fig); teppan beef skirt ¥1,408; oyster ajillo with baguette; sea-urchin pasta ¥1,188; a narrow counter; plenty of wine; large portions.

公式 yoshitaka-osaka.jp。食べログ(店舗会員): 由堂、大阪市.en: Official yoshitaka-osaka.jp. Tabelog (shop member): Yoshitaka, Nippo New Grand Bldg 2F, 2-8-5 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 8 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Namba stations; Tue–Sun 18:00–23:00; closed Mondays; 10% charge; cards and PayPay accepted; 11 seats (counter 7, one table for 4); opened 7 July 2014; oden, Japanese food, sake. Reviews (April–October 2026): oden-dashi soup of wild mushrooms and jidori; Sapporo Black Label; cured-mackerel sandwich; hairy crab; filefish with liver dressing; high-quality oden; at the very back of the 2nd floor; junsai and shirasu; daikon; konnyaku; hamaguri and kuzukiri; rock mozuku; yellow nira and beef tongue; shungiku and grated yam; sashimi platter; grilled eel; hard to book in winter; leek and abura-kasu; tuna negima; whale tongue; yuba; a cold somen starter; one says service was slow; classical music; sardine tsukune.

公式 zoo-jp.com/shop/chinmaya。食べログ: 陳麻家 長堀.en: Official zoo-jp.com/shop/chinmaya. Tabelog: Chinmaya Nagahoribashi, Alcohol Hanbai Bldg 1F, 1-18-16 Shimanouchi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 1 min east of Nagahoribashi Station exit 3; daily 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); closed over New Year; cards, PayPay and Alipay accepted, no e-money; 32 seats. Reviews (June–October 2026): the tantanmen alone is a little sweet but just right with the spicy mapo rice bowl; half sets; mapo ramen; busy at lunch; quiet at 8 p.m.; the reimen has a strong sesame sauce; sets with fried rice or tenshinhan; water spinach and gyoza; a wide menu; a soup you can finish; cold tantanmen (watercress, leek, cucumber, meat miso); mini mapo rice bowl (Chinma-han); tantanmen set (regular with half fried rice); mild even at heat 2; rich, creamy sesame; one found the thin noodles stuck together; light fried rice; spicy tantanmen ¥1,200, fried rice ¥880, draught beer ¥500; one says the heat comes from chili oil with little umami.

公式(ain-soph.jp/ginza): 2009年創業、アインソフ銀座本店.en: Official (ain-soph.jp/ginza): founded 2009, AIN SOPH. Ginza main shop. Vegan pâtisserie on 1F, vegan restaurant on 2F–4F. Everything 100% vegan, plenty of gluten-free dishes, dishes without the five pungent roots available. Dishes marked [GF] and [Sushoku]. Heavenly vegan pancakes ¥2,550, Fukurokuju BENTO ¥3,900 (Ginza main shop only), Fukurokuju BENTO course ¥7,800. *The factory and shops also handle allergens other than the above. Ginza 4-12-1, TEL 050-3134-4241. Tabelog: opened December 3, 2009; 30 seats.

公式(chayam.co.jp): CHAYA ナチュラル＆ワイルドテーブル 日.en: Official (chayam.co.jp): CHAYA Natural & Wild Table Hibiya, Yurakucho 1-2-2, Chiyoda-ku, Hibiya Chanter B2F; 11:00–22:00 (21:00 LO); closed when Hibiya Chanter is closed; TEL 03-3500-5514; 43 seats; run by CHAYA Macrobi Foods Co., Ltd. "Made without meat, eggs, dairy, white sugar or chemical seasonings." Renewed September 1. visit-chiyoda: plenty of dishes that vegetarians and vegans can enjoy too; a vegan Buddha bowl with seared soy meat ¥1,300 incl. tax.

公式(chocolatta.jp): ショコラッタ、〒542-0066 大阪市中.en: Official (chocolatta.jp): Chocolatta, Matsuyamachi Grand Heights 1F, 2-12-15 Kawaramachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka 542-0066, 06-6761-6565; Mon–Sat 12:00–20:30, Sun 11:30–19:00; irregular closing days (announced on the blog); a gluten-free gâteau au chocolat specialist; no wheat flour; naturally grown domestic rice flour, cane sugar, French organic chocolate and Belgian chocolate; cultured butter; cafe and takeaway; online shop; Karahori area. FindMeGlutenFree: reported as dedicated gluten-free; October 2026 reviews: French toast; the whole menu is gluten-free; bacon, sausage, sandwiches, waffles; opens early; run single-handed, so it takes time; about ¥5,000 for 2 plates and 2 coffees; BLAT and eggs; chicken sandwich to take away; few seats.

公式(comeconoco.com): Comeconoco Laborator.en: Official (comeconoco.com): Comeconoco Laboratory Cafe, 2-2-3 Shimamachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka 540-0034; a gluten-free rice-flour cafe and baking school in Tenmabashi and Kitahama; a specialist in gluten-free sweets and bread made with domestic rice flour; eat-in and takeaway Wed–Sat 11:00–17:00; baking classes on irregular days; online shop. FindMeGlutenFree: reported as dedicated gluten-free; a dedicated gluten-free kitchen space reported; October 2026 reviews: French toast with bacon; matcha espresso latte; the best sandwich; croque-monsieur lunch set; desserts; small but quick turnover; takeaway available.

公式(crayonsite)・local-prime・tanosu・budou-.en: From the official site (crayonsite), local-prime, tanosu and budou-chan. The owner is a former pâtissier who developed asthma, a runny nose, hand eczema and itchy eyes from wheat, and opened a rice-flour workshop. The shop states: “We do not use wheat flour in the workshop”, “100% rice flour”, “No wheat, dairy, egg or nuts (breads)”. Moved and reopened at Tadera 8-13-52 on 28 September 2025. No source names the owner.

公式(genjisoba.co.jp): 源氏蕎麦、大阪市中央区難波1-2-19.en: Official (genjisoba.co.jp): Genji Soba, Hozenji Sando, 1-2-19 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6633-5402; 7 min walk from the subway Namba Station; 11:30–21:30 (L.O. 21:30), break 14:30–17:00; irregular Wednesday closings; ¥1,300–3,000; no smoking. Now operating in the new shop (Hozenji Sando shop); the old shop (4-5-8 Namba) is closed for a while (not a complete move). March 2026 new-shop notice: founded 1929, Genji Soba Hozenji Sando main shop, Torikura Soichi. Menu: lunch Genji gozen ¥3,300 and dinner Genji gozen ¥4,800 (by reservation, 2nd-floor seats, gluten-free and vegan on advance request); juwari zaru soba ¥1,300; Oyada daikon spicy juwari soba ¥1,620; grated-yam juwari soba ¥1,920; Tamba black-soybean natto juwari soba ¥1,620; Hozenji A lunch ¥1,850 (two kinds of juwari soba, small rice bowl, salad, pickles, soy-milk pudding); wild large prawn and vegetable tempura with juwari zaru soba ¥2,950 (batter of buckwheat and rice flour, dedicated gluten-free fryer). FindMeGlutenFree (101 recent ratings): gluten-free labelling, a section for celiac diners, 30 reports of a dedicated fryer, one says celiac-safe only at dinner; ordering by QR code; soba made in the window; one found the dashi fishy; asked about egg when ordering vegan soba (September 2026).

公式(genraku.com): 銀座元楽、銀座4-10-12、TEL 03-3.en: Official (genraku.com): Ginza Genraku, Ginza 4-10-12, TEL 03-3541-5678; Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 11:00–23:00, Wed 11:00–22:30, weekends and holidays 11:00–20:00; no regular holiday (closed at Golden Week, Obon and New Year). Gen ramen (shoyu) ¥850, Raku ramen (shio) ¥850, Gen/Raku chashu men ¥1,250, half pork-rice set ¥1,200, hot tsukemen ¥1,000 and more. Particulars: only pork leg bones simmered three days with vegetables and chicken bones; back fat stir-fried, parboiled, hand-washed and simmered two hours; chashu of pork belly simmered two and a half hours; five kinds of noodles. © Genraku Co., Ltd.

公式(ginza-mikawaya.com 歴史): 明治20年(1887)9月.en: Official (ginza-mikawaya.com, history): in September Meiji 20 (1887), 保坂芳次郎 opened "Mikawaya Foodstore" next to Wako (in Hiroshige IV's print 「銀座繁昌之図」); successor 保坂幸治 chaired the Ginza-dori Rengokai; after the war, former president 渡仲豊一郎 took it over and revived it at the present spot as "French Cuisine Mikawaya"; taught directly by S. Weil, the first head chef of the Hotel New Grand; gratin (the prototype of doria); recipes from the founding days; French food eaten with chopsticks, with pickles and green tea. Tabelog: Ginza 4-7-12, Ginza Mitsukoshi Annex 1F; 42 seats; daily 11:00–21:00; 10% service charge. 2026 reviews: ¥11,000 course, crab cream croquettes, beef stew, hamburg steak, omurice, tempura of live sweet shrimp.

公式(ginza-restaurant-azuma.com): 1946年創業の.en: Official (ginza-restaurant-azuma.com): a yōshoku restaurant founded in 1946; "jūjū-yaki" (house sauce) since the founding; omurice, hamburg steak, a grown-up kids' plate, tonkatsu, fried rice, Japanese-style fillet; lunch with rice and soup from ¥1,400; reserved seats carry a ¥350 charge and a 2-hour limit. Tabelog: opened April 1, 1946; 45 seats; daily 11:20–21:00; cards, transit IC and QR accepted. 2026 reviews: mochi-pork jūjū-yaki, pork jambalaya ¥1,650, omurice, Napolitan, grown-up kids' plate ¥1,500, basement seats; the Shinjuku shop has closed.

公式(ginzabairin.com): 昭和2年(1927年)銀座で初めてのと.en: Official (ginzabairin.com): opened in Showa 2 (1927) as Ginza's first tonkatsu specialist; founder 澁谷信勝 (a pharmacist). Company profile: Bairin Ltd., founded February 22, Showa 2; incorporated March 29, Showa 22; representative director 澁谷昌也. Now in its third generation. Shop: Ginza Bairin Building B1F, 11:30–20:00 (L.O.), open every day (except January 1), no reservations. Franchises: Haneda Airport Terminal 1, Hawaii Waikiki, Korea Yeouido. Menu (as of April 2024): fillet-cutlet set ¥3,400, loin-cutlet set ¥3,600, special katsudon ¥2,300 and more.

公式(ichibanya.co.jp): 特定原材料を使用していないカレー(卵、.en: Official (ichibanya.co.jp): a curry made without specified allergenic ingredients (none of egg, milk, wheat, buckwheat, peanuts, shrimp or crab; not a food for special dietary use approved by the Consumer Affairs Agency; for safety the curry sauce is served still in its package; with rice 200 g ¥464 incl. tax, 100 g ¥232 incl. tax; not available at some shops); 7% late-night surcharge 22:00–5:00. Tabelog: CoCo Ichibanya Namba Sennichimae, 10-14 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6649-0617; daily 11:00–23:00, delivery 11:00–22:00; open every day of the year; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR payment accepted; 35 seats. 2026 reviews (March–October): next to NGK; not very crowded; many overseas staff; a mistaken order; low-carb curry (cauliflower rice) with spinach; spinach curry with crispy chicken; limited summer-vegetable curry (aubergine, okra, tomato, chicken) with scrambled egg; mild; unfamiliar with coupons and gift vouchers; hayashi rice; 400 g rice.

公式(matsusaka-projects.com): 松阪牛焼肉M 法善寺店.en: Official (matsusaka-projects.com): Matsusaka Beef Yakiniku M Hozenji Hanare, Daruma Bldg 2F, 1-5-24 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6211-2904. From 21 June 2026, weekdays 12:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30), Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00, no closing day. Shoes off at the entrance; 7 tables (6 semi-private, 1 private room); a 'gluten-free' tag. FindMeGlutenFree: shop's description 'Gluten-free requires advance booking. Every dish can be made gluten-free'; say so when booking. Reviews by diners with celiac disease: house-made gluten-free tare, shoyu and ponzu; checked again and again at the table; the grill net is changed; once another staff member brought the regular tare (2025); ¥8,800–12,000 per person; premium course ¥12,000; when full, guests are sent to another branch nearby. Manager's reply: there is a vegan menu as well.

公式(matsusaka-projects.com): 松阪牛焼肉M 道頓堀千日.en: Official (matsusaka-projects.com): Matsusaka Beef Yakiniku M Dotonbori Sennichimae, Kamigata Bldg 2F, 1-7-11 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka 542-0074, 06-4963-2994; 3 min walk from Namba Walk exit B20; about 100 m east of the Hozenji Yokocho shop; dinner 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30), lunch Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30); no closing day (may close occasionally); 14 tables (7 private rooms); a large hall for up to 32; lift; wheelchair accessible; a 'gluten-free' tag; cards and PayPay accepted; Lighthouse Co., Ltd. (authorised member No. 92 of the Matsusaka beef association). FindMeGlutenFree: all the tare is gluten-free (reply from general manager and chef Kenji Urata); staff show you the gluten-free shoyu bottle; non-GF items in a set are swapped; one says nearly everything but the soup is gluten-free; a staff member has celiac disease; reviews August–October 2026.

公式(nagahama-yamachan.co.jp): やまちゃんの創業は19.en: Official (nagahama-yamachan.co.jp): Yamachan was founded in 1986, from a street stall to a shop; two shops in Fukuoka (Tenjin, Nakasu); in Tokyo the Ginza shop (Ginza 3-11-10, 橋本 Building 1F) focuses on ramen; a tonkotsu soup that is rich yet light and without funky smell. Tabelog: Tue–Sat 11:00–4:00, closed Sun and Mon; 17 seats; transit IC and QR accepted. 2026 reviews: Nagahama ramen, Hakata platter ¥1,400, negi-bokkoshi ramen, spicy noodles, vinegared offal, draft beer, noodle firmness, free small rice at lunch.

公式(naki-vegansweets.com): 「誰でも食べられる優しいお菓.en: Official (naki-vegansweets.com): 'gentle sweets anyone can eat', a specialist in vegan and gluten-free sweets made from carefully chosen plant ingredients without eggs, dairy or other animal ingredients: cakes, cookies and baked goods; online shop. FindMeGlutenFree (30 recent ratings): 1-5-5 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 080-6217-5050; reported as dedicated gluten-free; about 4 seats; takeaway available; tarts ¥1,000 each (September 2026); mango, mixed-berry cheesecake, chocolate pistachio, matcha and white chocolate; cashew cream and almond crust; rice-flour and coconut-oil cookies; Italian espresso; was open 13:00–20:00 (August 2026); served in kimono; the oat milk carried a 'may contain gluten' label, so switched to soy milk (January 2026); one found it unfriendly (April 2026).

公式(nogata-hope.com): 銀座創龍は「野方ホープ」がプロデュース.en: Official (nogata-hope.com): Ginza Sōryū is produced by "Nogata Hope", using "Kikkogo shoyu" from Kondō Jōzō, Tokyo's only soy-sauce brewery, and Edo vegetables. Oedo scorched shoyu ¥1,180 (house shoyu tare scorched in lard), Oedo white shoyu ¥1,100 (two white soy sauces, white tamari, ishiru, deep-sea salt from Izu Oshima), Oedo dark shoyu ¥1,100 (a clear broth of chicken carcass, chicken feet and aromatic vegetables + flying-fish dashi), Gen ¥1,130 (pig heads, backbones and leg bones for about 10 hours), Nō ¥1,180 (seafood dashi, house black garlic oil, spicy miso), tomato ramen ¥1,200 (tomato + chicken salt), white-shoyu tsukemen ¥1,280 (whole-wheat flat noodles). Sōryū Co., Ltd. (Takadanobaba, Shinjuku-ku). Tabelog: Mon–Sat 11:00–3:00, Sun 11:00–23:00; 28 seats; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; English menu; opened October 29, 2018.

公式(ohmicho-inoya)・近江町市場公式(ohmicho-ichiba.en: Official site (ohmicho-inoya), the Omicho Market official site and hot-ishikawa: the shop where Omicho Market's seafood bowl was born (served since around 1989). Over 40 bowls, from under ¥1,000 for locals to high-end for tourists. Famous for the overflowing 'chirashi Omicho extra-large' and the gold-leaf 'Kinpika bowl'. Queue before opening for a 10% early-bird discount. Calls to passers-by in Kanazawa dialect.

公式(owst)がお好み村創業者の味を受け継ぎ約50年と記載。村長デラックス(そ.en: The official site (owst) states it has carried on the taste of the Okonomi-mura founder for about 50 years. Confirms the village chief deluxe (soba, squid, prawn, cheese, spring onion, pork, egg), soba-mochi-cheese, oysters in butter and more.

公式(owst)が袋町産業ビル2F、肩ひじ張らないワイン食堂、気分と料理に合わせ.en: The official site (owst) confirms Fukuromachi Sangyo Building 2F, an unpretentious wine eatery, suggestions to suit your mood and the food, house-made oil sardines and hand-kneaded hamburger steak since opening, and vegetables from contract farmers and the company's own farm. Over 250 wines.

公式(ramen-nobunaga.com): 濃厚魚介鶏白湯、独自製法で48時.en: Official (ramen-nobunaga.com): rich seafood chicken paitan, soup simmered 48 hours by its own method, original wavy noodles, chicken chashu, house-made eggs, seafood powder, shrimp oil and more than 10 toppings. Tsukemen only at the Kyobashi, 茅場町 and Shintomicho shops. The Tsukiji shop SHOGUN offers a tempura omakase course. Representative director Noriyasu Usuda (born 1987 in Saga; Maritime Self-Defense Force; Teppen Co., Ltd.; founded DLE Holdings). Release carried by Santatsu: run by NOBUNAGA Co., Ltd.; first shop in Kyobashi in December 2024; fourth shop in Shintomicho in March 2026. Tabelog: daily 10:00–3:00; 20 seats; all payment types; allergen labeling. Reviews: everything-on ¥1,580–1,650, seasoned-egg ramen ¥1,150.

公式(ramen-shiryu.jp): 完成に十年費やした至極のラーメン、ゲン.en: Official (ramen-shiryu.jp): "the ultimate ramen, ten years in the making"; soup of pork leg bones and chicken feet boiled over very high heat; noodles kneaded with wheat bran; choose back fat, garlic, noodle thickness and firmness, and chashu (pork belly or loin); 3 of 10 toppings; gyoza sauces (spicy shoyu, rich miso); 1 minute from Higashi-Ginza Station exit A8. Tabelog: 27 seats; weekdays 11:00–23:45, weekends and holidays until 22:30; open every day; e-money accepted. 2026 reviews: Goku Shiryū ¥1,100 (5 toppings), free rice at lunch, draft beer.

公式(roman-gp.com、株式会社ROMAN TALE): 茶屋しずく、鹿.en: Official (roman-gp.com, ROMAN TALE Co., Ltd.): Chaya Shizuku, a specialist in sweets made with organic matcha grown on the group's farm in Kagoshima Prefecture; the signature 'Matcha Fukashi Paun' freshly steamed from the seiro, lightly sweet, chewy, fluffy and light, made gluten-free without wheat flour; a rare organic matcha hardly grown anywhere in Japan; Namba shop 3-2-14 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; matcha × pistachio fair (19 October). Independent from Okayama Food Service Co., Ltd. FindMeGlutenFree: gluten-free menu; not dedicated gluten-free; gluten-free cones (October 2026); steamed matcha cake; matcha latte (soy milk); matcha confirmed gluten-free, no oat milk (September 2026); soft-serve; one visitor came every day. Opening hours not found.

公式(soranoiro-vege.com): 「麺スープトッピング全てに野菜を.en: Official (soranoiro-vege.com): "Vegesoba with vegetables in the noodles, soup and toppings", "vegan ramen for vegetarians", "gluten-free ramen for people with a wheat allergy". Ginza main shop: opened 14 years ago in Kojimachi, and the main shop moved to Ginza. The chuka soba uses Amakusa Daio chicken carcasses, niboshi, bonito and aromatic vegetables, house-made noodles from the Kojimachi workshop (Japanese wheat), and Seto mochi-pork chashu. Ginza 2-12-6 山崎屋 Building, 11:00–14:30, 17:00–22:00, closed Tuesdays, TEL 03-6264-7113. © SORANOIRO Co.,Ltd. FMGF (October 2026): at the Ginza shop, a separate gluten-free menu, gloves changed, vegan and gluten-free ramen.

公式(spys-oasis.com): スパイスオアシス、〒542-0076 大.en: Official (spys-oasis.com): Spys Oasis, 1-5-8 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka 542-0076, 06-6211-5115; medicinal spice curries by a yakuzen meister with gluten-free drinks and food; food and medicine from one source; three in one (yellow: soy-milk onion-tomato ginger chicken breast; black: black-sesame red-miso pork hijiki keema; green: mackerel and lotus-root green popeye); low-carb, low-GL basmati rice and 15-grain rice; Simple ¥1,600, Standard ¥2,000, Gorgeous ¥3,180, Luxury ¥3,880; vegan & gluten-free curries (root vegetables; soy mince with red-pepper salsa; pumpkin, banana, mango, corn, chickpeas; ¥1,700 each, 2 kinds ¥1,800, 3 kinds ¥1,900); toppings ¥200 each; roast chicken leg ¥1,280; 'we don't use gluten'; Mon–Wed and Fri–Sat lunch 11:30–15:00 and bar 18:00–24:00 (one-drink minimum), Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Thursdays; no phone reservations, online booking. Tabelog: 14 seats (ground-floor counter 7, 2nd-floor tables 7); allergen information available; vegan and gluten-free menu; opened 4 February 2023.

公式(ta-im.com): Ta-im 丸の内店 2018年11月8日オープン.en: Official (ta-im.com): Ta-im Marunouchi opened on November 8, 2018, the first branch serving the Israeli home cooking of Dan Zuckerman, owner-chef of the Ebisu main shop, on B1 of the Marunouchi 二重橋 Building; hummus and falafel that can be made vegan, and Israeli wine. Tabelog: Mon–Thu and Sat 11:00–15:00, 17:30–22:00, Fri until 22:30, closed Sun; cards, IC and QR accepted. A review from October 2026: hummus, baba ghanoush, matbucha, grilled vegetables with tahini, falafel pita + soup ¥1,200, lamb pita sandwich ¥1,700.

公式(tempura-kondo.com): 「小麦粉で作る天ぷらの衣が油を吸い.en: Official (tempura-kondo.com): "tempura batter made with wheat flour shouldn't soak up too much oil", "the essence of tempura is steaming", "the importance of bringing vegetables into tempura". Fumio Kondō, born 1947, head chef at the Yama-no-ue at 23, independent in 1991. 2019 Contemporary Master Craftsman, 2023 Mentor Chef Award, two Michelin stars continuously since 2008. Ginza 5-5-13 坂口 Building 9F; closed Sundays (and Monday if a holiday); from September 2026, lunch 11:30–15:30 (two sittings), dinner 17:00–22:00 (two sittings); counters of 12 and 8 seats. Courses: lunch 菫 ¥13,200, 椿 ¥16,500; dinner 藤 ¥22,000, 楓 ¥27,500, 蓬 ¥33,000 (tax incl.). nippon.com: Yama-no-ue Hotel in 1966, head chef for 21 years.

公式(tokichi.jp): 中村藤吉本店 銀座店、GINZA SIX 4F、.en: Official (tokichi.jp): Nakamura Tōkichi Honten Ginza, GINZA SIX 4F; nama-cha jelly, Maruto Bake, nama-cha jelly assortments. Tabelog: opened April 20, 2017; 50 seats; daily 10:30–20:30; café and shaved ice. 2026 reviews: matcha parfait, hojicha nama-cha jelly, anmitsu, matcha ice cream, complimentary cold-brewed tea, a tea-only menu, many overseas visitors and a queue in the afternoon.

公式(tonbox.jp): 鶏ではなく豚の旨みたっぷりの清湯スープに、トイ・ボ.en: Official (tonbox.jp): a clear soup rich in pork rather than chicken umami, with kaeshi (tare) by 山上, owner of Toy Box. Shoyu ramen ¥1,200, seasoned egg ¥1,400, special ¥1,600, chashu ¥1,700; shio at the same prices. Ginza main shop and Roppongi shop. A limited ramen for the Ginza main shop's first anniversary (October 10, 100 bowls). Tabelog: opened October 7, 2025; 7 seats; qualified invoice T8180001112331.

公式(uogashiya.com): 鮨とラーメン うおがしや、店舗は新橋・渋谷.en: Official (uogashiya.com): Sushi to Rāmen Uogashiya, shops in Shimbashi and Shibuya (Tokyo), main shop (Yokohama Central Wholesale Market), Noge, Tsuruyacho, Minato Mirai Ichibangai and Yokohama Landmark (Kanagawa). Bought directly from Toyosu Market and the Yokohama Central Wholesale Market; sushi-and-ramen sets from the ¥1,000 range; franchisees wanted. Tabelog: Shimbashi shop opened August 3, 2024; daily 7:00–5:00; closed Jan 1–3; 10 seats; cards, e-money and QR accepted. October 2026 reviews: oi-katsuo ¥890, five-piece sushi set ¥1,500, medium-thick wavy noodles, chashu, nori, menma, daikon sprouts, scallions, katsuobushi in a tea strainer.

公式(urc.jp): らーめん亀王 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区道頓堀2-2-17.en: Official (urc.jp): Ramen Kiou Dotonbori, Chubee Bldg 1F, 2-2-17 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6484-0090; weekdays and holidays 11:30–2:00 next morning (L.O. 1:30), Fri, Sat and days before holidays 11:30–4:00 next morning (L.O. 3:30); open every day of the year; thick chashu and piping-hot gyoza; the original Kyushu abura soba. Tabelog: 15 seats (counter 8, tables 7); Mon–Thu 11:00–2:30 next morning, Fri, Sat, Sun and days before holidays 11:00–4:30 next morning; no cards; smoking allowed; 'the strongest toro-chashu in Kansai'. Reviews (October 2025 – August 2026): the tomato ramen is like a soup pasta; Kyushu ramen; melting chashu; ordinary noodles; queues of nothing but overseas travellers; red-miso chashu-men; extra-thin Hakata-style noodles; multilingual menu; all staff from overseas except the manager; standard tonkotsu; fatty chashu; tomato ramen and tomato tsukemen; popular in Korea; Kiou ramen (salt tonkotsu).

公式(wholisticretreat.life): W RETREAT CAF.en: Official (wholisticretreat.life): W RETREAT CAFE, Luster On Shinsaibashi Bldg 10F, 4-5-8 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka 542-0081, 06-6755-8347; Shinsaibashi Station exit 2 and Crysta Nagahori north stairs 11; a gut-health cafe supervised by the beauty clinic 'W CLINIC'; ALL ORGANIC; a plant-based vegan lunch with no meat, seafood, eggs or dairy at all; October's monthly 'VEGAN gozen' ¥3,000 (9 small dishes of organic vegetables, mushroom kamameshi, autumn-vegetable miso soup, organic daikon pickles); organic seasonal-vegetable salad ¥1,650; dinner-only menu; a calendar of opening days; reservations via the official LINE; #glutenfree tag. FindMeGlutenFree: reported as dedicated gluten-free; pizza, pasta (bolognese), bread, açaí bowl, desserts; one diner struggled with online ordering (June 2026); hard to find on the 10th floor.

公式(yoyaku-abenohub.com): ABENO HUB、大阪市中央.en: Official (yoyaku-abenohub.com): ABENO HUB, Nakatani Bldg 1F, 2-3-26 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6211-0575; 3–8 min walk from the Namba stations; Tue–Fri 17:00–23:00, Sat 14:00–23:00 (another section says Sat from 17:00); L.O. food 22:00, drinks 22:30; closed Mondays and Sundays; reservations accepted (bookings via the site take priority); 40 seats (counter 5, 7 tables); semi-private rooms; private hire possible; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; separate smoking (smoking allowed on the outdoor terrace); average ¥3,000–3,999. Gluten-free okonomiyaki from 100% domestic Koshihikari rice flour; yakisoba with Akitakomachi rice-flour noodles; cooked in olive oil; vegetable-based sauce; British roots; organic wine; British organic tea. FindMeGlutenFree: not dedicated gluten-free; the gyoza is wheat and on the same griddle (October 2026); okonomiyaki ¥1,100; explained the fryer; ordering by app; an English-speaking chef-owner; gluten-free potato salad and pudding; no queue.

公式(yukou-kiyo.com)・osumituki・takemacheli.en: The official site (yukou-kiyo.com), osumituki and takemachelin confirm the move from Yatai Yukou in Kiyamachi to Shijo-Kawaramachi (two doors south of Takashimaya), the opening on 23 September 2021, and an owner from Jinrui Mina Menrui. Shellfish ramen (oyster, short-neck clam, freshwater clam) in Kyoto soy sauce, duck tsukemen limited to 15 a day, seared rare roast-pork rice bowl, and a café-like interior playing Mr. Children.

公式(アラカワフードサービス): 花丸軒 難波・法善寺店、〒542-0076 大.en: Official (Arakawa Food Service): Hanamaruken Namba Hozenji, 1-2-1 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka 542-0076, 06-6213-0131; open 24 hours, every day of the year; 5 min walk from subway Namba, Kintetsu/Hanshin Osaka-Namba and Nippombashi stations; 17 seats (counter 15, tables 2); completely non-smoking; cards and e-money accepted; ramen to its own carefully considered recipe; fried rice and gyoza popular too.
