Tabelog: lists closure over New Year. 2026 reviews: a 24-hour shop visited for years; the 2nd-floor toilet has narrow stairs; ticket machine taking many payment types; many inbound tourists; new garlic tonkotsu ramen (April); tonkotsu-shoyu base; rich but not heavy; medium-thin noodles; melting chashu; Hanamaruken after the sauna at Amza; toro-kotsu ramen (two big pieces of pork); nori, menma, naruto, leek; free kimchi; white rice; shorter queues now; champon; lighter than before; not piping hot; fried rice.

公式(ファンケル銀座スクエア B1F): 「玄米イタリアン」は小麦粉を一切使わな.en: Official (FANCL Ginza Square B1F): the "brown-rice Italian" is gluten-free, using no wheat flour at all. Brown-rice-flour fresh pasta made by hand in the shop every day. Weekday lunch plate from ¥2,400 (choose from five mains: brown-rice pasta, brown-rice risotto, roast 大山 chicken, garden salad, vegan menu); holiday lunch course from ¥4,800 (reservation required); dinner from ¥4,000 (table charge ¥500). Takeaway brown-rice bread ¥1,050. *Every item is gluten-free, made without wheat flour. 36 seats (1 private room). Lunch 11:30–16:00, café 14:00–16:00, dinner weekdays 17:00–22:00 / weekends and holidays 17:00–21:00; closed once a month. TEL 03-3289-0721. Declare food allergies when booking. Tabelog: opened September 27, 2019.

公式BASEショップ・Instagram・あまつしまっぷ・米パンなび・食べログよ.en: From the official BASE shop, Instagram, Amatsushimap, Komepan Navi and Tabelog: a rice farmer in western Owari (over 50 years of history) makes fully gluten-free bread, bagels and cakes from 100% home-grown rice with no wheat, egg, dairy or soy; the shop name means 'a fully gluten-free specialist run by a rice farmer'. A dog run is attached, in Yatomi.

公式Instagram habana_namba。食べログ: 葉花、大阪市中央区.en: Official Instagram habana_namba. Tabelog: Havana, 1-5-7 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min from Namba Station; Mon–Fri and days before holidays 16:00–23:15, Sat 15:00–23:15, Sun and holidays 15:00–22:15; irregular closing days; reservations accepted; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 2nd-floor seats ¥330; 20 seats (ground-floor standing for 18, 20 seats on the 2nd floor); opened 23 December 2022; Tachinomi Hyakumeiten 2025; a renovated old building with beams and earthen walls; daily obanzai on big platters. October 2026 reviews: mega highball; 6-starter platter; crab-miso cream croquettes; plain omelette; black-pepper highball; potato salad on the 2nd floor; sanma confit with aubergine purée; rare wild boar with red-wine sauce; sashimi platter ¥600; 3 vegetable starters ¥450; spicy pork shumai with coriander, 2 for ¥430; fig, prosciutto and ricotta ¥500; black-tea and mixed-berry sour ¥550; grated-peach Bellini ¥600; mobile ordering on the 2nd floor; neck meat with black shichimi ¥380; carbonara-style pasta salad ¥400; smoked chikuwa with mayo ¥380; corn and mitsuba fried dumplings ¥450; Okinawan-style marinated squid guts ¥380; a back alley leading to Hozenji; self-serve bottled-beer fridge; many regulars.

公式PR Times（prtimes 057）と kyo-soku が2025年.en: The official PR Times (prtimes 057) and kyo-soku confirm the opening on 16 October 2025, Jurakumawari-minamimachi, Nakagyo-ku, right by JR Nijo Station, the menu (aged-soy ramen ¥900, chicken paitan, sesame tantan, A5 wagyu ¥1,800, various vegan bowls) and the ¥500 opening promotion. Operated by F-Lead Inc. (Nagoya, founded May 2019).

公式X menno_yoji3rd。食べログ: 麺のようじ、大阪市中央区高津2-.en: Official X menno_yoji3rd. Tabelog: Men no Youji, Okoshi Bldg 1F, 2-1-2 Kozu, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 6–8 min walk from Nippombashi Station exit 7; daily 11:30–14:40 (L.O. 14:20) and 18:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); no cards, e-money or QR; 8 seats (counter 4, tables 4); opened 9 May 2013, renamed and renewed 28 January 2014; Ramen Hyakumeiten (WEST 2018–2020, OSAKA 2023–2025). Reviews (September–October 2026): a regular who keeps coming back (over 100 visits); tori-paitan ramen and stone-grilled cheese omurice; thick chicken tsukemen ¥1,300 and large ¥150; ticket machine outside; extra-thick flat straight noodles; a bubbling chicken-shoyu dipping soup; menu (chicken-bonito premium salt, chicken-bonito premium shoyu, thick chicken tsukemen, chicken-bonito abura soba, chicken salt, Shirakawa-style tsukemen, Shirakawa-style ramen, stone-grilled omurice, stone-grilled fried rice); limited Youji ramen ¥1,100; medium-thick wavy noodles; two staff; limited tori paitan (salt base); Teigaku noodles; chicken-bonito premium salt ¥1,000 and rare chashu rice bowl ¥350; 2 kinds of chashu; plenty of yuzu; shoyu ramen and chashu rice bowl; a wall of autographs; low-temperature chashu and chicken-thigh chashu; chicken-thigh chashu rice bowl ¥400; a salt packed with chicken umami.

公式aboutページとhalalgourmetが、店名カナック（金・小麦）の由来.en: The official about page and halalgourmet confirm the origin of the name Kanak (gold, wheat) and the wish to shine modestly, health-minded cooking light on oil, halal / vegetarian / vegan options, and a prayer space offered free during opening hours (except 12:00–13:00).

公式food.htmlはうなぎ湯葉を『昭和30年代に考案し、ずっと作り続けている.en: The official food.html says unagi yuba (mock eel of tofu skin) is 'a Konokonbou speciality devised in the 1950s and made ever since', that the cooking is named 'Muryoju' (Infinite Life), and that hōhan is a rice dish to finish with shojin dashi, eaten at Zenkoji's New Year 'Dōdōji' ceremony. Go! NAGANO (id20052) says serious shojin cuisine began about 50 years ago, with Konokonbou leading the way; the then head priest's wife set the course, and today 若麻績妙子 carries on the flavours.

公式tenpoページで安曇野スワンガーデン内の本店、一年中炭火の囲炉裏で購入した.en: The official tenpo page confirms the main shop in Swan Garden Azumino, the experience of grilling the oyaki you buy at a charcoal irori hearth all year round, always more than 20 kinds and over 40 a year, dough mixed with rice flour or sixteen grains, and the tenant shop inside Takahashi Shoten on Zenkoji Nakamise.

公式「北野家の歴史」ページより、明治33年に初代七郎右衛門が保科で創業、四代続く.en: From the official 'History of Kitanoya' page: founded in Meiji 33 (1900) in Hoshina by the first-generation 七郎右衛門, a long-established shop of four generations. The kaeshi has been kept in two heirloom jars for over 100 years; frigate-mackerel and small bonito flakes are shaved in-house 3–4 times a month, taking over two hours. A food blog (September 2024) confirms the texture of a limited 10-a-day 100% buckwheat soba of Togakushi buckwheat stone-milled in Shinano-machi.

公式『KOJI IDA』ページとJR東海の記事で、代表焙煎士は井田浩司、2013.en: The official 'KOJI IDA' page and a JR Central article confirm head roaster Koji Ida, CQI-certified Q Grader in 2013, winner of JCRC2018. Built on the kissaten 'ROCOCO' founded in 1974, it became a specialty-coffee shop in 2010. It serves croissants of Nara-grown wheat and the 'Rokumei Blend'.

公式『会社概要』に代表者『飯田紗央里』、2017年2月開業・2019年10月法人.en: The official 'company profile' states the representative, 飯田紗央里 (Iida Saori), opening in February 2017 and incorporation in October 2019. A Web-Komachi article describes the background (product development at a Tokyo café and research into vegan diets and food allergies as the starting point) and the move from Miwa, Nagano City to in front of Nagano Station (15 January 2022). Butter-sandwich flavours confirmed include seasonal fruit such as Kyoho grape. Some details, such as hometown, are unknown.

公式アレルギー表で12品すべて小麦・乳・卵とも「該当なし」（豆腐とりんごとナムル.en: On the official allergen chart, all 12 items are "not applicable" for wheat, dairy and egg (tofu, apple and namul show only soy, apple and sesame).

公式アレルギー表でこのサラダは乳.en: On the official allergen chart, this salad is dairy

公式アレルギー表で乳.en: on the official allergy chart, dairy

公式アレルギー表で卵.en: on the official allergy chart, egg

公式アレルギー表で小麦.en: on the official allergy chart, wheat

公式アレルギー表で小麦「該当なし」のトッピング：人参・大根・オニオン・紫キャベツ.en: Toppings with wheat "not applicable" on the official allergen chart: carrot, daikon, onion, red cabbage, tomato, cucumber, apple, corn, sweet potato, tofu, bean-sprout namul, brown rice, grilled potato, shio-koji shimeji, boiled egg (egg), smoked chicken, marinated onion, zucchini. Wheat

公式アレルギー表に掲載あり（3品とも複数のアレルゲン表示）。価格はメニューページ.en: Listed on the official allergen chart (all 3 items show several allergens). Prices not on the menu page.

公式アレルギー表：レモン＝28品目すべて該当なし。ごま塩＝ごま・大豆のみ。ハニー.en: Official allergen chart: lemon = not applicable for all 28 items. Sesame salt = sesame and soy only. Honey mustard = honey only. Wheat

公式サイト (3349seriu.wordpress.com): 炭焼芹生、炭火.en: Official site (3349seriu.wordpress.com): Sumiyaki Seriu, a charcoal kappou where charcoal grilling of seasonal seafood and meat is the heart of the course; 10 seats; closed Sunday; 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–22:00 (other times by arrangement); lunch and dinner course ¥16,500 (tax included); other budgets by arrangement; 7–10 dishes; beer, sake, wine. Tabelog: meat dishes, Japanese, seafood; 占出山町299 ヒラタビル 1F, Nakagyo-ku; Mon 17:00–22:00; Tue–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday; overseas visitors must book through their hotel concierge, and direct online bookings are cancelled; service charge "none" in the Japanese original (the English wording is a mistranslation); 10 counter seats; no smoking; cards accepted; no e-money or QR; opened 16 March 2017. Reviews (August 2025 – September 2026, in English): an L-shaped counter and a big charcoal grill; a friendly owner; a sake-sommelier staff member (gone by June 2026); condiments for the sashimi; charcoal-grilled eel; sweetfish; Hokkaido beef; firefly squid; junsai; soft roe; courses only, no à la carte; omakase ¥14,300 (June 2026); under ¥20,000 for two; many regulars.

公式サイト (51 panino): GOICHI PANINO、中京区河原町通.en: Official site (51 panino): GOICHI PANINO, 中京区河原町通三条上る恵比須町534番地28; nine panini (tax included): 1 mozzarella, prosciutto, rocket, tomato, parmigiano ¥2,400; 2 pistachio pesto, mortadella, stracciatella ¥2,400; 3 caponata ¥2,000; 4 tomato, mozzarella, basil ¥2,100; 5 swordfish ¥2,200; 6 meatballs ¥1,800; 7 porchetta ¥2,400; 8 grilled chicken ¥1,800; 9 prosciutto cotto ¥2,400; fries ¥660; arancini ¥770; tiramisu ¥770; espresso ¥330; Peroni ¥880. Tabelog: Tue–Sun 11:30–19:30; closed Monday; no reservations; cashless only (no cash); 10 seats; 3 terrace tables (dogs allowed); non-smoking; opened 10 August 2024. Reviews (2025–2026, in English): Italian staff; choose by QR and order at the register; half sizes; blood-orange soda; Aperol; many guests from abroad.

公式サイト (Operation Factory): 難波 ちょうつがひ、ランチ.en: Official site (Operation Factory): Namba Choutsugahi, lunch 11:00–15:30 (last order 14:30), dinner 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00), takes Osaka City premium vouchers, "a first for Namba, a space for two only floating in the night sky", pair sofas with a sense of privacy, Japanese cuisine as courses or à la carte, "a grown-up anniversary washoku with Namba's night view all to yourselves", anniversary courses with a whole cake, November and December menu of winter yellowtail, milt, snow crab and fugu, bookings on TableCheck. Tabelog (shop-maintained): Osaka Metroなんばビル 9F, Nambanaka 1-6-8, Naniwa-ku, Osaka, direct from Namba subway exit 6, open daily, phone 15:00–22:00, cards and PayPay accepted, 54 seats, all pair seats facing the windows, non-smoking, opened 21 May 2024, red-vinegar sushi by artisans, a lunch of one soup and many dishes with fresh tofu that keeps only half a day and Daigen miso soup, twelve birthstone cocktails. Reviews (October 2026): a limited lunch box of 20 a day (Saikyo-miso autumn salmon, tempura of autumn vegetables and sea bream with fried oysters, seared Omi-beef sushi) ¥2,380 on weekdays and ¥2,480 at weekends and holidays, refills of rice and miso soup, QR ordering, no same-day lunch bookings, book early for the window row, seared Omi-beef sushi, toro-taku hand roll, a golden-dashi hot pot, wagyu shabu-shabu grilled six seconds, an anniversary cake, and a report of cold service at reception.

公式サイト (a-nest.co.jp): 肉料理とワイン 遊山 Yuzan、心.en: Official site (a-nest.co.jp): Niku Ryori to Wine 遊山 Yuzan, a hideaway restaurant in a quiet area close to Shinsaibashi; since its founding in 1990 (elsewhere on the site, since its founding in 1992); all aged meat is aged on the bone; Omi beef rump and ichibo and older cows from サカエヤ in Kusatsu, Shiga; grazed shorthorn T-bone and misuji from エレゾ in Hokkaido; female black wagyu fed on fermented pineapple and sugarcane from やまさん牧場, founded more than 100 years ago (rare cuts such as fillet and shintama); horumon from fully free-grazed ジビーフ of 様似牧場 in Hokkaido ('the freest cattle in Japan'); no chemical seasonings at all; naturally brewed three-year soy sauce and miso from 井上本店, apple and rice vinegar from 内堀醸造, salt from 田野屋塩二郎, Awaji Island sun-dried salt, Kurata Pepper; a cellar of wines chosen by the owner-sommelier; drinking alone with wine and snacks is welcome; private rooms; whole-restaurant hire for up to 50. Sample dishes (tax excluded): own-pace yakiniku course ¥8,500, a modest, reasonable course ¥10,000, a full run of Yuzan's chosen meats ¥13,000 (Kagoshima black-wagyu top fillet raised on fermented feed), special course of a block of meat grilled by the chef ¥15,000–25,000 (the head chef grills it in front of you), red-wine shabu-shabu ¥12,000, premium ¥15,000 (Chateaubriand), seared black-wagyu carpaccio ¥2,300, 100% beef terrine ¥1,800, stewed jibeef horumon ¥850, special salted tongue ¥2,000, meat platter ¥5,000, a light-drinking set. Hours Tuesday–Saturday 17:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); reservations by phone; cancellation fees 30% two days before, 50% the day before, 100% on the day; Minami-Semba 1-10-2; 5 min on foot from Nagahoribashi exit 1. The same company's other restaurant: 薪火 全 (Makibi Zen; in a national park on Awaji Island, an 8-seat wood-fire counter, one guest room a day). Tabelog (shop-maintained): 17:00–23:00 (L.O. food 21:30, drinks 22:00); closed Sunday and Monday; table charge ¥550; 47 seats; smoking area on the terrace; children only when a private room is free; opened 4 November 1993; Yakiniku WEST 100 2020 and 2021; courses (tax included) ¥9,350, ¥11,000, ¥14,300. Reviews (September 2024–September 2026): the owner-chef brings a bone-in block and explains its origin and cuts; Kishu binchotan; omasum with a miso-based sauce; wagyu carpaccio; horumon stewed in tomato and horumon pâté; 40-day and 3-week aged top sirloin; Chateaubriand from a Kikaijima farm; spice curry with mango chutney; red-wine shabu-shabu; you can enter the wine cellar to choose; formerly in Ikuno Ward; one view that the soy, miso and sudachi sauces lacked punch; one view that the sudachi sorbet was too sour.

公式サイト (aisani.net): おばんざいと純洋食 アイサニ、マスターの.en: Official site (aisani.net): Obanzai to Jun Youshoku Aisani; the master's aim: "a casual shop, easy to enter even alone, centred on Kyoto obanzai and nostalgic yoshoku"; Aisani means "now and then" in Kyoto dialect; on the Takase River in Nishi-Kiyamachi; cherry blossoms in full bloom in spring; dinner 17:00–last order 20:30, closing 21:00; open over the New Year from 30 December to 3 January; 8 counter seats and tables facing the Takase River (4 × 2); menu: obanzai ¥550 each (Kyoto-style okara, eggplant simmered Dutch style, yuba and greens simmered, lotus root and celery kinpira, manganji peppers and jako simmered), three-kind assortment ¥920, five-kind assortment ¥1,380, Kyoto-style dashimaki ¥640, silken yuba ¥700, cream cheese cured in Saikyo miso ¥650, chicken liver simmered with sansho ¥880, demi-glace hamburger steak ¥1,280, menchi-katsu ¥1,280, bifkatsu ¥1,520, beef cheek stewed in red miso and wine ¥1,520, unseasoned grilled eel ¥1,800, seasonal clay-pot pilaf ¥950 and sea-bream rice ¥980 (from two servings), bottled beer (Akaboshi lager) ¥700. Tabelog: yoshoku, izakaya, Japanese cuisine; Nishi-Kiyamachi-dori north of Ayanokoji, Shimogyo-ku; 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Tuesday; bookings taken; 16 seats; no smoking; cards (JCB, AMEX) and QR accepted; opened 14 October 2016. Reviews (February–October 2026, in English): five-kind sashimi ¥980; strawberries and mozzarella with balsamic ¥900; sunken-kotatsu tables; view of the Takase River; 10th anniversary; some guests turned away when full.

公式サイト (ajyarimochi.com): 阿闍梨餅本舗 京菓子司 満月、.en: Official site (ajyarimochi.com): Ajari Mochi Honpo Kyogashi Tsukasa Mangetsu; products: the Kyoto speciality Ajari mochi (registered trademark), 蜜漬京納言, Kyoto speciality monaka, 眞菓満月. Tabelog: wagashi, 左京区鞠小路通今出川上ル; 9:00–18:00; closes when sold out; closed some Wednesdays; a few benches; takeaway; Ajari mochi keeps 5 days; no cards; parking; Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2018–2020, 2022; Japanese sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2023, 2026. Reviews (September–October 2026, in English): warm, freshly made Ajari mochi at the main shop, about ¥700 for five, the limited-time Mangetsu.

公式サイト (alabouteille.com): à La Bouteille.en: Official site (alabouteille.com): à La Bouteille, a bistro 1 min walk from Yotsuya Station, in the basement below Yoshinoya on Shinjuku-dōri, Yotsuya Itchome Building B1, Yotsuya 1-8-14; opened anew in July 2017 after Un Verre at Shinjuku west exit; a bistro for a first stop, a wine bar for a second; the food is a prix-fixe course; wine as a pairing, or a suggested bottle; open 17:00–23:00, lunch 12:00–14:00 only on days with a reservation, last order 22:00; closed Sundays and over New Year; non-smoking; about 100 wines, mostly French, chosen by season (Greece and the Basque Country, the Loire and Alsace); non-alcoholic pairings; the staff go to meet producers; nerve-killed fish from Ishinomaki (Miyagi), Susaki (Kochi), Ise-Shima (Mie) and elsewhere; sea bass baked in pastry with beurre blanc (since opening); game bought direct from hunters (Mr 儀間 of Ashoro sends only neck-shot deer); seasonal vegetable terrine from Gori-san in Kiyosato, Yamanashi; prosciutto from Hiroshi Ojima; a chef from a long-established restaurant; flannel-drip coffee; 9th anniversary on 12 July 2026, 9th-anniversary course ¥12,500 (before tax); an online shop for the chef's deli dishes; French osechi. Tabelog (shop member): Mon–Sat; amuse and bread charge ¥550; 20 seats (4 at the counter, 16 at tables); prix-fixe 5 dishes ¥6,050; lunch 4 dishes ¥3,850. Reviews (December 2025–October 2026): truffle madeleine, Kiyosato vegetable terrine, pairing of 4 glasses ¥4,950, owner-sommelier, some guests alone at the counter.

公式サイト (amakara9.com): 日本橋人形町と浅草にあるジビエレスト.en: Official site (amakara9.com): a gibier restaurant in Nihonbashi-Ningyocho and Asakusa; truly delicious game that even beginners can enjoy, with no unpleasant smell or toughness; owner 林育夫 (はやし いくお); representative director of the general incorporated association 熊肉活用研究所; gibier critic; opened in Ningyocho in September 1996, became a game specialist in its 15th year, thirty years in all in 2026; more than 40 species handled; about 100 badgers a year from 10 hunters, about 3,000 servings a year; over 300 kg a year each of bear, deer and boar; bears bought whole, mainly moon bears from Akita, Gifu, Nagano and Niigata; about 300 servings of bear paw a year; only meat that has passed through a licensed processing facility; operating company ティナズダイニング; the Ningyocho shop is on 2F of 大川ビル, between Daiso and Hidakaya, with Kushinaga on the ground floor; 17:00–22:30; closed Sundays and holidays; 20 seats; appetizer charge ¥390; 10% late-night charge after 22:00; featured in October 2026 on the YouTube channel of EXIT's りんたろー。. Tabelog: courses ¥18,800–25,000; bear paw ¥38,000; dolphin tataki, sea lion tataki, mountain crow; an Asakusa shop as well. Reviews (May–September 2026): little gamey smell and easy for beginners; badger sukiyaki with Inaniwa udon; brown bear braised in red wine; Ezo deer grilled over charcoal; an "animal encyclopedia" booklet and stickers for ¥300; fans of Masahiro Higashide; one diner found the service poor.

公式サイト (ami-gr1980.com): 1980年創業 フランス料理のお.en: Official site (ami-gr1980.com): a French restaurant founded in 1980, 1 min on foot from Daimaru Shinsaibashi, a 6th-floor hideaway, 'hidden for 45 years', owner 下村, chef 中川. About us: after joining 志摩観光ホテル at 賢島, Mie, and gaining service experience at a French restaurant in Osaka, the founder opened Amitie in 1980 with a dozen-odd seats and moved when the present building was completed in 1988; keeping the predecessor's spirit, the second-generation owner works with a chef who loves food and wine too much; natural vegetables from contract farms, kuroge wagyu, venison and Iberico pork, fish straight from the market, the dinner fish course cooked in a donabe, a message on the dessert plate for anniversary courses, courses made with preferences and allergies in mind, different dishes from the second visit on. Lunch: full-course lunch ¥5,000 (normally ¥6,000, online booking), chef's courses A ¥9,500, B ¥12,500, C ¥16,500, Déjeuner ¥4,000 (limited days and numbers). Dinner: chef's courses A ¥9,500, B ¥12,500, C ¥16,500, Gourmand ¥8,000 (online only), Menu Bonheur ¥7,500, Petit Bonheur ¥6,000. Shop: ラ・シーンビル 6F, lunch last order 13:30, dinner last order 19:30, close 21:30, closed Mondays (the next day if a holiday) and one irregular day a month, 28 seats, curtained spaces for 2–8, cards and QR payments. Christmas (19–26 December) limited courses only. Tabelog (shop member): French, tax and 10% service included, 26 seats, semi-private rooms, non-smoking (smoking on the terrace), wheelchair accessible, children's plate ¥2,800, sommelier. Reviews (June–October 2026): a starter of rare vegetables each explained, sea urchin and tomato jelly, onion potage, chestnut soup, aged venison, foie gras as an extra, a celebration message on the dessert, photos taken for guests, the lift at the back.

公式サイト (anjou.co.jp): サロン・ド・テ アルション法善寺本店、.en: Official site (anjou.co.jp): Salon de Thé Alcyon Hozenji main shop; 1F boutique and 2F salon (36 seats, all non-smoking); Namba 1-6-20, 3 min from Namba Walk exit B-12 or B-14; weekdays 11:30–20:00, weekends and holidays 11:00–20:00; 2F last order 19:00; irregular closing days; seats can be booked only for meals; cards accepted; 40th anniversary on 2 November 2026, with cakes and desserts from old recipes revived July–November; plated desserts made to order, devised by a patissier who won the award of the Minister's Secretariat, Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (puits d'amour ¥2,500, 40th-anniversary Mont Blanc ¥2,700, salted-caramel castella ¥1,800, each with tea); Alcyon Blue crème brûlée ¥1,250; savarin ¥1,250; two scones ¥900; petit afternoon tea from ¥2,980; one-plate lunch from ¥2,500 (until 14:00); Alcyon set A from ¥1,980, B from ¥2,310; flavoured teas ¥860, unflavoured ¥840; evening-only tea cocktails ¥950; the cakes arrive each morning from Atelier Alcyon; specified allergens: wheat, milk, egg; the teas are George Cannon blends with natural flavourings. Run by KameiAnjou Inc. Tabelog: Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 in 2020, 2022, 2023 and 2026; closed Monday (open on holidays); 36 seats; opened 2 November 1986; a 1-minute walk to Crêperie Alcyon. Reviews (September–October 2026): Japanese-chestnut Mont Blanc, strawberry shortcake, a Vin Fig tea soda; a 28-minute wait at noon on a Saturday; an antique room at the top of steep stairs; Alcyon set ¥1,980, one-plate lunch ¥2,500; tea in a pot; in the evening about 80% of customers from overseas; a takeaway paper bag costs ¥50.

公式サイト (aoike-kyoto.com): 青いけ、京都御所南の野菜が主の.en: Official site (aoike-kyoto.com): Aoike, a vegetable-led French restaurant south of the Kyoto Imperial Palace; prices from January 2026: lunch (today's omakase, 6 dishes) ¥9,800, 7 dishes ¥14,000, 8 dishes ¥18,000, ¥22,000; dinner 6 dishes ¥14,000, 7 dishes ¥18,000, ¥22,000, ¥27,000 (tax included); lunch 12:00–13:00 (last order), dinner 18:00–19:30 (last order); closed Sundays plus one or two irregular days a month; 8 counter seats; book by phone or Ikyu, not by social-media message; non-smoking; no phone calls or flash; no children 10 and under; interior and exterior produced by 中村義明 of 中村外二工務店, a patchwork zelkova counter, Danish chairs, Indian teak tables. Tabelog: French, 中京区竹屋町通高倉西入塀之内町631; no service charge; opened 4 February 2014; French WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025. Reviews (July 2025–September 2026, in English): some 60 kinds of vegetables grown by the chef, a vegetable terrine, Venetian glass tableware.

公式サイト (ashijimacoffee.com): 葦島珈琲、自家焙煎珈琲と.en: Official site (ashijimacoffee.com): Ashijima Coffee, house-roasted coffee and selected sweets, roasted in small batches on a direct-flame roaster; outlets: Kissa Ashijima, Ashijima Coffee (Kyoto Takashimaya S.C.), 葦 (takeaway only) and das (café); Kissa Ashijima weekdays 12:00–21:00 (last order 20:30), Tuesdays 12:00–17:00 (last order 16:30), weekends 11:00–21:00 (last order 20:30); no reservations; 中京区大黒町37, Bunmeido Building 5F. Tabelog: kissaten, café and cakes; 20 seats (counter 8, two tables of 6); non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; cards, QUICPay, PayPay and Alipay accepted; allergy information and gluten-free options; decaf available; the only food is curry; opened 15 May 2010; Kissaten Tabelog 100 2021, 2022, 2026. Reviews (September–October 2026, in English): the gluten-free rice-flour Sanjo cheesecake, Hyakunen Coffee, wire art made for the café, allergy checks.

公式サイト (assemblages.jp): 「パティシエ」「ショコラティエ」.en: Official site (assemblages.jp): the 'combinations' of taste woven by a chef with three faces — pâtissier, chocolatier, cuisinier — to enjoy with drinks; 中京区竹屋町通寺町西入る松本町587-5; takeaway 12:00–19:00; eat-in from 12:00; dinner 18:00–23:00 (last order 20:00); dinner by pâtissier Kakimoto ¥15,800 before tax; closed Tuesday and the second and fourth Wednesday (irregular). Tabelog: cakes and chocolate; Mon and Thu–Sun café 12:00–17:00, shop 12:00–19:00; dinner from 18:00 by reservation only; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; 10 counter seats; opened 21 April 2016; Sweets Tabelog 100 2017; Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2018–2020, 2022, 2023, 2026. Reviews (September–October 2026, in English): the Assemblages cake, Mont Blanc, a flaming chocolate plated dessert, baked goods, paying at the entrance first.

公式サイト (bar-rockingchair.jp): Bar Rocking.en: Official site (bar-rockingchair.jp): Bar Rocking chair; in November closed every Tuesday and on Monday 9 and Monday 16 November; open daily 17:00–01:00 (last order 24:00); bookings by phone accepted from opening until 18:00; up to 4 per group; the fireplace is opened on Thursday 19 November, with inoko-mochi, said to ward off fire; bookings basically for 17:00–18:00 only; after that, phone 30 minutes before arriving to check for a free seat, which is held for 30 minutes; when full, the phone may go unanswered; Kenji Tsubokura. Tabelog: bar, 下京区御幸町通仏光寺下る橘町434-2; 24 seats (9 at the counter, 5 tables); smoking allowed, cigars too; no minors; charge ¥880 (snack included); cards accepted; opened 2 February 2009; Bar Tabelog 100 2022. Reviews (June–October 2026, in English): rocking chairs and a fireplace, a watermelon salty dog, a prize-winning cocktail, seasonal fruit cocktails.

公式サイト (belamer-kyoto.jp): 伝統と国際性のある京都から世.en: Official site (belamer-kyoto.jp): a chocolate brand sending chocolate from Kyoto, a town of tradition and internationality, to the world; Japanese ingredients, techniques and seasons; a townhouse shop with a Chocolat Bar upstairs; Mizuho no Shizuku (masu-shaped chocolates filled with sake, tea, or fruit-and-honey jelly, 15 kinds); stick chocolates; Kyoto chocolates; flower- and temari-shaped bonbons. Chocolat Bar menu: Kyoto matcha Saint-Honoré ¥2,200, smoked fondant chocolat ¥1,540, parfaits ¥1,430, chocolat noir ¥1,210, Tever (matcha white-chocolate cake) ¥1,540, Japanese-style curry with chocolate, sansho and Kyoto vegetables ¥1,650, cacao Bolognese ¥1,430, autumn afternoon tea set ¥7,150 (only afternoon tea can be booked), chocolate sets ¥1,320–2,090; small plates from 奥田連峯堂; Sanjo main shop 10:00–20:00 (last order 19:30, closed irregularly); a JR Kyoto Isetan counter; run by J･WORKS INC. Tabelog: chocolate, café, cake; 中京区三条通堺町東入ル北側桝屋町66; 5 min on foot from Karasuma Oike Stn; no reservations; 24 seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 11 September 2015; Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2026. Reviews (October 2026, in English): jewel-like chocolates, Pare Chocolat ¥378, the café upstairs, takeaway when the café was full, afternoon tea, a brand born from Chocolat Bel Amer.

公式サイト (bistro-olympic.com): ビストロolympic、.en: Official site (bistro-olympic.com): Bistro Olympic, a casual popular-style Italian bar in Ura Namba, Osaka, for day drinking, girls' nights and dates; 12:00–24:00 (Wed–Thu 17:00–24:00; last order food 23:00, drinks 23:30); closed one irregular day a month; natural wines (white, red, rosé, orange); terrace, tables and counter; a group space for up to 45 on the 4th floor; Namba Sennichimae 4-19, 4 min on foot from Nankai Namba Station; sister shops: bar pond, 立ち飲みピラフ, お料理 だいち, tide pool, Meguri Osaka, ぱどる. Tabelog (shop member): bistro, Italian and izakaya, a cover charge, two-hour limit when busy, sometimes a shared large table, 41 seats, private hire for 20–50, non-smoking, cards, e-money and PayPay, opened 22 December 2017. Reviews (August–October 2026): carpaccio of five fish with four sauces, a soup as the appetizer, ajillo, bluefin-tuna-cheek steak, pasta of yam and dashi, fully booked on a Sunday evening, small insects when the doors are open, said to belong to the Hidezo group.

公式サイト (bistro-umami.com): 「地中海料理をもっと身近に」.en: Official site (bistro-umami.com): "Making Mediterranean cuisine more familiar"; Mediterranean cooking spreading out from the south of France, with carefully chosen wines; a room modelled on Santorini; fresh seafood, game and vegetables; food prepared by an owner with wide experience; a friendly owner; 4 min walk from Yotsubashi Stn; hours 11:30–14:30 (Sat, Sun and holidays from 12:00) and 17:30–22:00 (Fri, Sat and days before holidays to 24:00); irregular closing days (in November: the 3rd, 10th, 15th, 18th, 23rd and 30th); lunch walk-ins accepted from October 2026; the lunch course needs a reservation; Mediterranean hors d'oeuvres for two ¥2,860; lamb brochette with spicy couscous ¥580 (No. 1 in popularity); heaped seafood bouillabaisse ¥1,980; UMa lunch course ¥3,080; courses ¥5,000–7,700; fresh pasta from a noodle maker on Awaji; wine from ¥680 a glass. Tabelog: Shinmachi 1-22-22, Nishi-ku, Osaka, Shinmachi Daiya Palace 104 (south side of the building); 4 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi and Yotsubashi Stns; 14 seats (counter 8, tables 6); non-smoking; one-drink minimum; cards, iD, QUICPay accepted; English-speaking staff; opened 29 July 2024. Reviews (July 2024 – October 2026): run by the owner alone; a chef with experience in Dubai and London; fans from the previous restaurant; featured in an・an and Meets; Mediterranean appetizer platter (hummus, orange-marinated beets, roasted-eggplant paste, an Aleppo-born red pepper and walnut paste); bouillabaisse with risotto to finish; red-wine-braised beef cheek that takes three days; briouat; pita sandwich lunch since spring 2026 (chicken, lamb, a seasonal filling, lentil soup, potatoes, harissa, tzatziki); unusual wines; a cheerful owner; the passage behind the counter is narrow.

公式サイト (bistromaumu.com): 京都四条烏丸のフレンチビストロ.en: Official site (bistromaumu.com): French bistro at Shijo-Karasuma, Kyoto, open late; a Paris bistro; steak frites; daily pasta; a resident sommelier; lit until 1:30 at night; dinner 17:00–1:30; menu: assorted appetizers ¥2,980, burrata with seasonal fruit ¥1,800, seasonal fish carpaccio ¥1,800, rich tofu and fruit-tomato caprese ¥1,480, Spanish ham ¥1,380, pâté de campagne ¥1,280, chilled Kyoto duck loin ¥1,280, free-range egg œuf mayo ¥680, rich crab cream croquette ¥1,180, onion gratin soup ¥1,300, chicken fritters with gazpacho sauce ¥980, wagyu steak Rossini style ¥5,800, steak frites ¥3,200, pork-belly porchetta ¥1,580, seasonal pasta ¥1,950, seared-cheese Bolognese ¥1,880, Parmesan-cream gnocchi ¥1,650, crème brûlée ¥600; ¥9,000 and ¥6,000 courses. Tabelog: bistro, bar, Italian; 下京区綾小路通柳馬場西入綾材木町199-4; 2 min walk from Hankyu Karasuma Stn exit 15; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 17:00–1:00, Wed 17:00–23:00; 25 seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR; English, Chinese and Korean menus; English-speaking staff; vegetarian menu; opened 31 May 2024; invoice T6130001067887 (GMI Co., Ltd., head office 東山区祇園町北側270-4). Reviews (September–November 2026, in English).

公式サイト (bkk-peanuts.com): 中央区人形町の路地裏にあるタイ.en: Official site (bkk-peanuts.com): a Thai restaurant in a back alley of Ningyocho, Chuo-ku; a cook from Uttaradit who gained experience at Thai street stalls from age 15 serves unpretentious, tasty Thai food; since 2012; the popular khao man gai sells out every day, so come at lunch; a set of Thai condiments on each table; at banquets, non-spicy dishes on a separate plate for anyone who dislikes heat, and dishes without coriander on request; sister shops バンコックラララ食堂 (Higashi-Nihonbashi 3-1-4 2F) and バンコックポニー食堂 (Shinkawa 2-12-17, マルコウ八重洲通りビル 1F). Tabelog (shop member): Thai, curry, dining bar; 藤和ビル 1F, Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 1-4-6; daily 11:15–15:00 (L.O. 14:30), 17:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed only over New Year; 40 seats; cards accepted; no e-money or QR; no service charge; non-smoking; everything available to take away; vegetarian options listed; courses ¥4,200 (9 dishes, 1.5 h all-you-can-drink) and ¥5,000 (10 dishes, 2 h); opened 23 February 2012. Reviews (March 2025–October 2026): mini set ¥900 (two of gapao, green curry or Chiang Mai curry, with fried egg, salad and tapioca); green curry ¥850 plus mini gapao ¥150 and mini tom yum noodles ¥150; Gaeng Chiang Mai (pork and vegetable Chiang Mai curry) ¥850; Khao Soi; khao man gai; beef-tendon rice noodles; mild spice; greeted in Thai; redevelopment construction all around.

公式サイト (brooklynparlor.co.jp): ブルックリンパーラー.en: Official site (brooklynparlor.co.jp): Brooklyn Parlor Osaka, a place to enjoy food and music; music, cafe, books, eats, bar; produced by Blue Note Tokyo; © BLUE NOTE JAPAN; shops in Shinjuku and Osaka; Nishi-Shinsaibashi 2-2-3, A-PLACE Shinsaibashi B1F; 11:00–23:00 (lunch 11:00–16:00, café all day, dinner 16:00–23:00); phone calls answered by an automated voice system; live shows such as JAZZ@the Parlor. Lunch: Singapore-style popiah ¥2,700; Brooklyn-style salad bowl ¥1,900 (12 ingredients including edamame hummus, carrot rapée and salsa); spicy shrimp jambalaya ¥2,200 (cooked for about 20 minutes); smash hamburg ¥2,100; craft corned-beef melt sandwich ¥1,700; monthly pasta ¥1,600; classic burger ¥1,400; +¥400 for a drink. Dinner: burgers from the classic, half ¥850 and regular ¥1,470, to truffle cheese with a soft fried egg, ¥1,050 and ¥1,960; clam chowder ¥1,320; Tokachi herb-beef roast beef ¥1,210; garlic shrimp and avocado bake ¥990; Cobb salad ¥1,540; shrimp and avocado ajillo ¥1,210. Tabelog (shop member): American, hamburgers, dining bar; 160 seats; non-smoking (smoking booth); wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi; English menu; opened 20 April 2014.

公式サイト (cafe-annon.com): CAFE ANNON なんば本店.en: Official site (cafe-annon.com): CAFE ANNON Namba main shop, a hideaway café in Namba Sennichimae and Ura Namba busy with tourists; concept 'a space to take your time'; Japanese style with Ryukyu tatami and warm wood; fluffy soufflé pancakes; coffee brewed by siphon a cup at a time; ANNON means 安穏 (calm); 1F open kitchen, 2F private rooms and tables for solo guests; every dish made after ordering; Ronnefeldt tea; Cremia soft serve in the parfaits; web and dated reservations suspended, same-day queueing at the shop only; private rooms only bookable via Tabelog (not Fri–Sun or holidays); 8:00–22:45 (last entry and last order 21:30); shortened hours on 29 October; no closing day; 10 seats on 1F, 29 on 2F; a Shinsaibashi shop; たまごとミルク (ららぽーと門真, opened 17 April 2023). Tabelog (shop member): café, pancakes, sweets, from 8:30 on Sundays, birthday plate ¥350, cards and QR, English, Chinese and Korean menus, opened 9 November 2017. Reviews (July–October 2026): soufflé pancakes cooked one by one on a copper griddle, about 20 minutes; Cremia parfaits; Anmitsu NON ¥1,500; set coffee ¥300; tea ¥580; LINE tells you when your turn comes; many overseas customers.

公式サイト (cafe-hello.jp、最終更新2017年): Cafe Bi.en: Official site (cafe-hello.jp, last updated 2017): Cafe Bibliotic Hello!; 中京区二条柳馬場東入ル晴明町650; 11:30–24:00 (last order 23:00); Hello Bakery on the ground floor (11:30–23:00, closed Monday); Halo Galo, a rental gallery, upstairs. Tabelog: café and bakery; 11:30–23:00 daily; no reservations; 45 seats; no smoking inside (allowed in the small garden at the back); no cards, e-money or QR payments; Cafe Tabelog 100 2021 and 2022, Cafe WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (September–October 2026, in English): banana trees at the entrance, library-like bookshelves, a quieter second floor, seven kinds of fruit tart, mango tart ¥900, Basque cheesecake ¥750, banana lassi ¥900, Mandheling ¥750, hayashi rice, fruit sandwiches from 14:00, many guests from abroad.

公式サイト (cafe-sarasa.com): さらさ花遊小路「昼はコーヒー、.en: Official site (cafe-sarasa.com): さらさ花遊小路, "coffee by day, a drink with someone at night"; 12:00–22:00, closed Wednesday; 中京区新京極通四条上る中之町565-13; 株式会社サラサ (representative director 尾崎 友哉); its shops are さらさ西陣, さらさ花遊小路, さらさ3, サラサケーキ工房 and CLAMP COFFEE. History: December 1984, Sarasa opens on the second floor of "wood inn" at 富小路三条; 2000, the Nishijin shop; 2005, サラサ3; October 2007, the main shop moves to 新京極四条上ル and opens as the Sarasa Kayukoji shop; 2008, 尾崎 joins; April 2026, the new company 株式会社サラサ. Tabelog: café, yoshoku, creative cuisine; lunch 12:00–15:00, coffee only 15:00–18:00, dinner 18:00–22:00; closed Wednesday; phone bookings only; 60 seats; smoking area in the courtyard; no cards, e-money or QR payments; vegetarian options; opened 6 November 2007. Reviews (August–October 2026, in English): daily lunch ¥1,280, chicken curry ¥1,100, chai parfait ¥750, kara-age, taco rice, 90-minute limit, ordering by QR code.

公式サイト (cafecabin.net): 珈琲艇CABIN、営業時間9:00.en: Official site (cafecabin.net): Coffee Tei CABIN; hours 9:00–18:00; closed Tuesdays and Fridays (open when they fall on a holiday); Feeling on a boat; top three sandwiches: the Popeye sandwich (a spicy, sweet Japanese-style bacon and spinach sandwich and a mushroom and butter-soy omelette sandwich; half size available), cheese toast (homemade tomato sauce with cheddar, gouda, mozzarella and more), a lasagna-style quattro sandwich (homemade meat sauce and béchamel with soft egg and four cheeses); honeydew toasts (three honeydews from New Zealand and Germany; goat cheese and cream cheese; blue cheese and cream cheese; seven cheeses); coffee from ¥500 (full-city roast hot, Italian roast iced; beans from Brazil, Colombia, Peru, Indonesia and Vietnam); tea from ¥500 (Nilgiri straight, Assam for tea au lait and chai); 25 flavored drinks from ¥600; honey drinks from ¥700; cream soda, mixed juice and homemade ginger ale with a taste unchanged for 40 years; contents change with the season, check the QR-code menu in the shop; gifts; rental. Tabelog: no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 35 seats (counter 5, six tables for four, terrace 6); private room for 8; smoking allowed; takeaway. Reviews (July–October 2026): ship-like interior, round windows, mirrored ceiling, down a flight of stairs, QR ordering, iced coffee ¥500, Popeye sandwich, fruit sandwich, some find the service curt.

公式サイト (cenci-kyoto.com): cenci チェンチ、左京区聖.en: Official site (cenci-kyoto.com): cenci, Shogoin Entomi-cho 44-7, Sakyo; lunch 12:00 (last order) to 15:00, dinner 18:00–18:30 (last order) to 21:30; closed every Monday, and irregularly Tuesday and Sunday; lunch ¥21,780 (8 dishes and 3 desserts, same as dinner) and ¥12,100 (6 dishes and 2 desserts); dinner ¥21,780 (tax and service included); a sample dinner: prosciutto, potato, yuzu kosho; gazpacho, sakura shrimp, shiso flowers; tomato, new ginger, cutlassfish, coriander; Kamigamo cucumber, retired-dairy-cow beef, sesame; Chinese chives, turban shell, chitarra and more; teas to match the food too; bookings up to the same date two months ahead; tell the shop about allergies or disliked foods when booking; no children below elementary-school age, none below middle-school age at dinner; private room for 5–6; same-day cancellation 100%. Tabelog (corporate member): The Tabelog Award 2026 Bronze, Italian WEST Tabelog 100 2025, weekday lunch ¥12,100, weekend and holiday lunch ¥16,940, ¥24,200 (same as dinner), service charge 10%, 26 seats, opened 5 December 2014. Reviews (August–October 2026): the last petit four is cenci, new-squid risotto, a dish with no animal products, tea pairing, one star in the Michelin Guide Kyoto Osaka 2026.

公式サイト (chedi.jp): 本格タイ料理チェディルアン、タイ政府5つ星認.en: Official site (chedi.jp): authentic Thai restaurant CHEDI LUANG, certified five-star by the Thai government, THAI SELECT Signature (one of only 19 of about 180 shops nationwide); the Kitahorie main shop, opened in 2001, was built with an understanding of Thai culture, style, materials and craftwork, planned and sourced locally as far as possible: celadon tableware and tiles, teak, rattan, brass furniture, Jim Thompson fabrics and silk, wickerwork, hammered Ayutthaya cutlery, roof ornaments from temples, lotus candles; there are no clocks here; traditional cooking of Chiang Mai in northern Thailand; Singha on draft; also HERBIS ENT (2011), Yodoyabashi (2012), KOHSAMUI BY CHEDI LUANG and KRABI BY CHEDI LUANG (2021); the lunch buffet has 15+ dishes on weekdays and 20+ on weekends and holidays, with dessert, 90 minutes; a menu prepared to welcome inbound visitors with confidence. Tabelog (shop member): Kitahorie 1-17-11, Nishi-ku, 2 min from Nishi-Ohashi Station exit 4; Tue–Thu 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–22:00, Fri evenings until 22:30, Sat and holidays 11:30–15:30 and 17:30–22:30, Sun 11:30–15:30 and 17:30–22:00; closed Monday; lunch is buffet only, dinner courses or à la carte; table charge ¥498, private-room fee ¥770; 65 seats; non-smoking; children welcome; opened 20 December 2001; Tabelog Asian/Ethnic WEST 100 in 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2026. Reviews (December 2023–October 2026): a queue before opening, weekday buffet ¥1,680 (90 min), green curry, gapao, Pad Thai, khao man gai; some find it spicy or salty, others easy to eat and suited to Japanese tastes; warm service from the staff.

公式サイト (chez-moi.co.jp): 京都市役所の近く、御幸町御池を北.en: Official site (chez-moi.co.jp): a hideaway at the end of a narrow alley north of Gokomachi-Oike near Kyoto City Hall; French cooking served by the chef and madame together; soup kitchens for about a year and a half after the Noto Peninsula earthquake; supporting Noto, the chef's home, by bouillabaisse made with fish from a Wajima fishmonger; moved from Karasuma-Nishiki in July 2005; chef: born in Wajima, Ishikawa; Kyoto cookery school; 三笠会館 in Ginza; chef 大渕康文 at アタント, Roppongi; chef 小澤貴彦 of OZAWA, Shirokanedai; hobbies tea ceremony and shamisen; madame: born and raised in Kyoto, 30 years in the trade, a sommelier; hours 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 19:30); irregular closures; chef course ¥9,900 (tax included); lobster course ¥13,000; foie gras course ¥15,000; abalone course ¥13,200; takeaway set ¥10,800 (book by the day before; collect 16:00–17:30); closed 29 October–1 November 2026; soup-kitchen volunteering in Yatsushiro, Kumamoto, in October 2026; about 30 Madeira wines. Tabelog: French; reservation only; allergies and dislikes cannot be accommodated; 12 seats; terrace; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards; no shorts, T-shirts, sandals or sweatpants; French WEST Tabelog 100 2023 and 2025. Reviews (September 2025–August 2026, in English): run by a couple; seafood terrine; sea-urchin flan; the chef's piano and magic; the garden lantern.

公式サイト (claypotcurryohmiya.com): 14年間丸太町で.en: Official site (claypotcurryohmiya.com): a European-style curry specialist that moved to Shinkyogoku after 14 years at Marutamachi; bouillon made over a day; blended and roasted curry powder; sauce simmered two days with fruit and red wine; beef rib demi-glace curry ¥1,650; Tanba Kogen pork loin cutlet curry ¥1,550; Kyoto-beef curry ¥2,200 (Kuroge wagyu from Kyoto Tanba-Kameoka, chosen by the owner after eating around); house curry ¥1,000; six-hour simmered pork and onsen egg curry ¥1,550; head-on prawn and scallop fry curry ¥1,450; Kyoto pork keema ¥1,450; 100% domestic pork hamburg curry ¥1,800; children's curry; takeaway and delivery; sister shop SOUP CURRY OHMIYA; 中京区桜之町438-1 辨天堂ビル 2F; lunch 11:30–15:00 (15:30 at weekends and holidays), dinner 17:30–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); irregular closures; 17 seats. Tabelog: curry, yoshoku; former name 欧風土鍋カレー近江屋清右衛門; 16 seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR; English, Chinese and Korean menus; opened 11 August 2023; invoice T3130001077204. Reviews (March–November 2026, in English): bubbling in the clay pot, beef rib, QR ordering, many overseas guests.

公式サイト (coccinella77.com): 京都市下京区のイタリアン O.en: Official site (coccinella77.com): Osteria Coccinella, Italian in Shimogyo, Kyoto; a renovated townhouse full of warm wood; carefully chosen ingredients served simply with small accents; over 500 bottles of wine; welcome as a second-stop wine bar too; owner 森山 雅彦; sample menu: about 10 starters (wild yellowtail carpaccio ¥1,400, oysters sautéed in lemon butter ¥1,400, figs with sheep's feta ¥1,400, lamb or shamo terrine ¥900, country pâté of Daisen pork shoulder ¥700), 4–5 pastas (Oe-farm tomato pomodoro ¥1,300, Spanish garlic peperoncino ¥1,200, carbonara ¥1,300, red snow crab arrabbiata ¥1,800, lamb cacio e pepe ¥1,800, Kuroge wagyu brisket bolognese ¥1,800, Challans duck ragù ¥1,800); 下京区高倉通仏光寺東入ル新開町397-2; 18:00–23:30 (last order 23:00); closed Monday (plus a run of days off once a month); 21 seats (tables 12, counter 9); no credit cards. Tabelog: Italian, wine bar, bar; Tue–Sun 18:00–23:30, holidays 18:00–23:00; charge ¥300; 19 seats; non-smoking; cards and PayPay; invoice: 森山 雅彦 (individual). Reviews (2024–2026, in English).

公式サイト (cuorerudino.com): 堀江・四ツ橋のイタリアン ピッ.en: Official site (cuorerudino.com): Pizzeria CUORERUDINO, Italian in Horie and Yotsubashi; pizza that is chewy yet crisp to bite; punchy meat dishes; vegetable-rich side dishes based on Italian home cooking; a full wine list; takeaway, delivery, party plans; February 2026 the dinner-only CUORERUDINO T-BONE STEAK; June 2026 kakigori; September 2026 a party plan with 90 minutes of drinks. Tabelog (shop member): pizza, café, Italian, Minami-Horie 1-14-26, right in front of the south side of Horie Park, daily 11:30–22:00 (lunch 11:30–15:30, dinner 17:00–22:00, café on weekdays), open all year, limited booking times for weekend and holiday lunch, cards, e-money and PayPay, 70 seats, terrace, private hire, non-smoking (ashtray by the entrance), children welcome, opened 6 April 2012. Reviews (September–October 2026): a big wood-fired oven, Margherita ¥1,530, yudane bread with salted butter, pasta lunch ¥1,380, appetizers for two ¥2,400, seasonal Stagione ¥2,650, dogs on the terrace, many families.

公式サイト (da-yuki.jp): Pizzeria Napoletana.en: Official site (da-yuki.jp): Pizzeria Napoletana Da Yuki — 1F, Okazaki, Sakyo-ku; 12:00–14:30 (L.O. 14:30) and 18:00–21:30 (L.O. 21:30); closed Monday; ¥3,300 per person for an unannounced cancellation; disliked ingredients can be swapped. Tabelog: pizza; 375 m from Higashiyama Stn; cards and QR accepted. Reviews (July–October 2026, English): wood-fired oven, Margherita D.O.C., mushroom salad, abalone carpaccio, first visit since the move, near the Heian Shrine torii, terrace seats, takeaway, no pasta.

公式サイト (danskitchen-kyoto.com、多言語): 京都・河原.en: Official site (danskitchen-kyoto.com, multilingual): Dan's Kitchen, a handmade yoshoku shop at Kawaramachi-Gojo, Kyoto; seasonal ingredients and Japanese touches for yoshoku that is easy to eat and does not sit heavy; hamburg steak, fried shrimp, beef-tongue stew; lunch plates pairing a main with fries of your choice (cream croquette, mille-feuille cutlet, chicken cutlet); demi-glace sauce; soy-milk soup; courses ¥2,500–5,000 (hamburg steak course, mixed fry, beef steak, sharing course and more); same-day cancellation ¥3,000 per person; a hideaway of 15 seats down a flight of stairs; private hire for under 20; no smoking anywhere; opened on Kawaramachi-dori south of Matsubara on 15 May 2023; cards, e-money and QR accepted. Tabelog: yoshoku, hamburg steak; 河原町通松原下ル難波町410-2 河原町エイトビル, Shimogyo-ku; Mon, Tue, Fri, Sat, Sun 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–22:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday; 15 seats; children welcome; take-out. Reviews (March–September 2026, in English): lunch of beef-tongue stew and two fries ¥1,800; a ¥2,500 lunch; fluffy hamburg steak; cream croquette made with shellfish broth; cold potage with salt kombu at the bottom; a drinks-and-snacks set ("Horo-Yoi Set" in the English reviews); lunch fully booked, booking essential; one diner found the hamburg steak a little small.

公式サイト (dayuge.jp): 料理人弓削啓太が提案する京都の地で紡ぐ新た.en: Official site (dayuge.jp): a new "Kyoto Italian" spun in Kyoto, proposed by chef Keita Yuge. Tabelog: Italian; 158-2 Takeyacho, Sakaimachi-dori north of Oike, Nakagyo Ward; about 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn; Mon–Sat 18:00–22:00 (last entry 19:00); closed Sunday and some Mondays; reservation only; Menu Degustazione ¥22,000 (tax included); 5% service charge; 13 counter seats; private hire up to 20; non-smoking (smoking area outside); cards accepted; opened 3 April 2026; chef who won the 2019 Pasta World Championship; Japanese and Italian wines. Reviews (July–September 2026, English): cold pasta in Kesennuma shark broth with kombu-cured caviar; squid-ink tagliolini; Tonnarelli in salsa (40 g ¥1,620); a renovated townhouse; open kitchen; courtyard garden; one diner found it rushed and overpriced (August 2026).

公式サイト (dodici-kyoto.jp): 「ラグジュアリーな空間で圧倒的.en: Official site (dodici-kyoto.jp): 'Overwhelming hospitality and Kyoto's finest Italian cooking in a luxurious space'; interior in gold, silver and dark navy; head chef 尾本寛, over 30 years in Italian cooking (to Italy at 28; two Italian ristoranti listed); manager 中島丈晶 (JSA and AIS certified sommelier); DODICI is Italian for 12; the course changes every month; organic vegetables from 石割農園, Kyoto duck and venison from 亀岡, Omi beef from 中川畜産; about 500 wines; lunch ¥11,000 (8 dishes), dinner ¥19,800 (10 dishes), tax included, service extra; state allergies when booking, no changes on the day; book by the day before; 麩屋町通御池上ル上白山町239, opposite 白山神社; lunch from 12:00 (last entry 13:00); dinner 18:00–20:00 (last entry 19:00); closed Sunday and Monday. Tabelog: Italian; Tue–Sat and holidays 12:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; reservation only; 20 seats; private rooms for 2–8; service 10%; opened 12 December 2020; Italian WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (March–October 2026, in English): cold-brewed hojicha in the ground-floor waiting room, high ceilings upstairs, careful wine explanations, one Michelin star.

公式サイト (dogyan.jp): 炭火焼鳥・ラーメン 宮崎郷土料理どぎゃん、.en: Official site (dogyan.jp): charcoal yakitori and ramen, Miyazaki regional cuisine Dogyan; Shinsaibashi and Honmachi 立売堀; the main shop at Bakuromachi 3-1-13, Chuo-ku; the 立売堀 shop at 立売堀 1-6-14, Nishi-ku; 麺とかき氷 ドギャン 谷四店 (a kakigori specialist); a manager's blog. Tabelog (shop member): yakitori, ramen, izakaya; Bakuromachi 3-1-13, 戎センタービル 2F; 5 minutes' walk from Shinsaibashi or Honmachi Station; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00), Sat 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); closed Sundays and holidays; book by the day before; a booking stands at ¥2,500 or more per person; seat-only or all-you-can-drink-only bookings carry a ¥350 charge (before tax); cards from ¥3,500 (before tax); PayPay and LINE Pay accepted; 38 seats (14 on the raised tatami area); smoking allowed; opened 29 September 2008; charcoal-grilled thigh of long-raised hens, the famous chicken nanban, meat-wrapped rice balls, and 'Takaida Chuka Soba', the most popular dish, featured on TV many times; Miyazaki regional cuisine courses with all-you-can-drink ¥5,500–¥6,000. Reviews (April–October 2026): Tsubamesanjo backfat ramen ¥1,000; Takaida Chuka Soba with extra backfat ¥900; five kinds of ramen; cold tantan noodles; kasu ramen; weekday lunch sets from ¥950; refills of rice, miso soup and salad; chicken sashimi; chicken tataki; some find the chicken nanban tough; order by QR code; up two flights of stairs.

公式サイト (donuts.koe.com): koe donuts は出来立て.en: Official site (donuts.koe.com): koe donuts is an experiential donut factory where freshly made donuts are eaten knife-and-fork style; 'organic', 'natural origin', 'local production'; about 30 donuts (chewy koe donuts, crullers, raw donuts, yeast, old-fashioned, baked, plant-based); the eat-in-only donut melt; a dome of 572 hexagonal-weave bamboo baskets using Arashiyama bamboo, Kengo Kuma & Associates; artist Yu Nagaba; Shun Kawakami; 中京区新京極通四条上ル中之町557; 8:00–20:00; about 1 min walk from exit 9 of Hankyu Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn. Tabelog: café, donuts, sweets; daily 8:00–20:00; closed irregularly; no reservations; 65 seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR; Wi-Fi and power outlets; opened 21 March 2019; Cafe WEST Tabelog 100 2025; menu (English version, updated September 2026): dango donuts ¥380, six donut balls ¥590, French-toast morning plate ¥1,800. Reviews (September–November 2026, in English): koe donut plain ¥260, wasanbon cruller, fried in rice oil, donut melt from ¥1,100, morning set ¥500.

公式サイト (dotonboribeer.co.jp): 道頓堀麦酒醸造株式会社.en: Official site (dotonboribeer.co.jp): 道頓堀麦酒醸造株式会社, a brewery on B2 of the Osaka Shochikuza in Dotonbori, brewing daily; its official restaurants are 道頓堀たちばな (beside the beer works), Dotonbori Craft Beer Jozoujo (Namba CITY South Building 1F) and 道頓堀麦酒スタンド (inside the Osaka-Namba station gates). Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Dotonbori Craft Beer Jozoujo Nanba CITY, izakaya, kushiage and beer hall; Namba CITY South Building 1F, 5-1-60 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Nankai Namba Stn, reachable by underground passage from the subway; Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–22:00; open days follow Namba CITY; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 200 seats (private rooms, tatami rooms for up to 50); non-smoking; children welcome; opened 30 October 2015; specialities kushikatsu and Dotonbori Beer. Reviews (February–November 2026): Osaka Kölsch, Osaka Porter, Osaka Alt; kushikatsu, fried chicken, a large gyoza, beef-tendon skewers ¥539, chicken sashimi, a large croquette; lunch sets ¥890 and ¥990 (free miso soup refills); a lunch drinking set; touch-panel ordering; with all-you-can-drink, two dishes per person minimum; one diner found the beer selection small.

公式サイト (dotonboriterrace.com): 道頓堀てらす、大阪市.en: Official site (dotonboriterrace.com): Dotonbori Terasu, TMビル 1F, 1-6-5 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Namba Stn on the Midosuji Line; Tue, Thu, Fri 17:00–23:00, Sat–Sun 12:00–23:00; closed Mondays and Wednesdays; reservations accepted; no cards; e-money (au PAY, Rakuten Pay, PayPay) accepted; 18 seats (12 table, 6 counter); non-smoking; lunch ¥1,000–1,999, dinner ¥2,000–2,999; okonomiyaki, yakisoba, kushikatsu and takoyaki all at once; a moist yam-based batter with tenkasu added on top for crunch; courses available. Tabelog: Dotonbori Terasu, okonomiyaki, kushiage, yakisoba. Reviews (March 2024–February 2026): reopened after moving from a site along Dotonbori; the entrance is hard to find; mixed okonomiyaki ¥1,540; pork okonomiyaki; tomato and avocado; a yakisoba omelette with pink sauce; house mayonnaise; kushikatsu with sauce; tonpei-yaki; pork kimchi; grilled yam; one drink per person; queues at busy times; many overseas guests; kind staff.

公式サイト (ekaki-kyoto.crayonsite.info): その日.en: Official site (ekaki-kyoto.crayonsite.info): posts the day's hours (4 November: 15:00–22:00, for drinkers only); orders taken by voice; dishes cooked to the size of the group; 2 to 10 drinks a person; pay at the table; contactless card payment accepted; 2-hour seating when busy; one person does the cooking. Menu: wine by the glass and bottle, Sapporo draft, grape beer, sake (Nara, Shimane, Tottori and others), cardamom shochu, fresh-squeezed chuhai, 季の美; grown-up pudding, salted boiled peanuts, anchovy oeufs mayo, roast sweet potato and cardamom potage, fig with burrata, salad lyonnaise, fried Tanba chestnuts, fries (black shichimi), mussels steamed in white wine, shrimp and spinach quiche, busiate pasta with squid in oil, tripe and chickpeas in tomato, pork spare ribs braised in balsamic, roast duck breast, beef kainomi steak, croque monsieur (until 16:00), raisin butter, dashi omelette; same-day bookings and changes by phone; sister shop chichi (200 m away; croissant-cone soft-serve, wine). English notes: Japanese menu only, staff mostly speak Japanese, the chef studied natural wine and French cuisine. Tabelog: bistro, bar, 下京区貞安前之町611-3, 2 min on foot from Kawaramachi Stn (Hankyu); daily 12:00–22:00; reservations accepted; 20 seats; cards (JCB); opened 20 May 2015. Reviews (October 2025–April 2026, in English): a menu without prices, at least 2 drinks, natural wine, flap steak, dashi omelette, raisin butter, chestnut soup, a red door, seats upstairs, benches outside.

公式サイト (elove-kyoto.com): 京都・四条烏丸の野菜が主役のイ.en: Official site (elove-kyoto.com): ELOVE, a vegetable-led Italian restaurant at Shijo-Karasuma, Kyoto; about 20 kinds of morning-picked vegetables delivered every morning by contract farms; not the textbook season but "delicious at this moment"; a vegetable stand and a delicatessen; lunch course (four dishes with a drink) ¥2,500; stewed hamburg steak with seasonal vegetables ¥2,000; pasta or risotto of the day ¥1,500 each; dinner course (with one drink) ¥6,800; an ¥8,000 course; wine pairing set ¥3,000; natural wine; vegetable highballs; salad bowl ¥1,000; grill set ¥1,200; prices include tax; same-day cancellation may be charged 100%; lunch 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 13:30); dinner 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); irregular closing days; 30 table seats on two floors; private hire for 12–30; five sister shops. Group (株式会社セカンダイズ): the Ushinohone group runs six shops of different styles in central Kyoto and an online shop. Tabelog: Italian, cafe, deli; 帯屋町585, Nakagyo-ku; lunch in two seatings, 90 minutes when busy; dinner 2.5 hours when busy; bookings after 21:00 by phone; vegetarian options; no smoking; children welcome; take-out; opened 18 September 2021. Reviews (January–October 2026, in English): big portions; vegetables chosen to be grilled or fried; Spanish mackerel; clam risotto; white-miso and sweet-potato tiramisu; a message card with the guest's name.

公式サイト (eltesoro.jp): El tesoro (エル・テソロ)、.en: Official site (eltesoro.jp): El Tesoro, a bar in Gion, Kyoto; El Tesoro is Spanish for "treasure"; colour for everyday life, one glass of magic to step out of it; 16:00 to 1:00 (last entry 0:00, last order 0:30); bookings for 16:00–18:00 (after 18:00, up to 30 minutes before arriving); a designated smoking bar; seats are limited, so please call before coming; irregular closing days (in November: the 1st, 4th, 11th, 18th and 25th); tell the bartender what you would like, including original cocktails; 東山区大和大路通三条下ル三丁目弁財天町19番地 大和ビル一階 E号室; 4 min from Gion-Shijo Stn, 5 min from Sanjo Stn. Tabelog: Bar Tabelog 100 2022; table charge ¥1,000; 12 seats (8 at the counter, 4 at a table); cards and QR accepted; opened 22 November 2006. Reviews (July–October 2026): seasonal fruit cocktails, home-made cakes, whisky, a kind master, and one diner heard the bar does not take inbound tourists.

公式サイト (foods.jr-cross.co.jp/ts-tantan):.en: Official site (foods.jr-cross.co.jp/ts-tantan): we cook with plenty of vegetables and soy milk, using no meat, seafood, eggs, dairy or other animal ingredients at all. Allergy page: no animal ingredients are used in any menu item, but cooking uses shared equipment and utensils, and dishes cannot be adjusted for individual allergies. Shops: Gransta Tokyo, ecute Akihabara, Ikebukuro, Narita Airport Terminal 2, ecute Ueno. ecute Ueno menu (October 2026): golden sesame tantanmen special ¥1,800, black sesame tantanmen special ¥1,700, yuzu vegetable SIO ramen ¥1,250, golden sesame tantanmen ¥1,250, black sesame tantanmen ¥1,250, vegetable T's curry and Buddha bowl ¥1,700; noodles wheat, or rice-flour, pho (flat rice) or konnyaku (+¥150); Fortune vegetable boiled gyoza, three, ¥720; mini rice bowls ¥400; soy cheese, soy meatballs, seared soy char siu; matcha iced latte (oat milk) ¥750; organic sodas ¥750; Heartland beer ¥800; vegan gelato ¥650; items marked free of the five pungent vegetables. Allergen chart (4 October 2026): the yuzu vegetable SIO ramen with rice-flour, pho or konnyaku noodles shows no wheat (soybean only); the tantanmen show wheat, peanut, sesame and soybean; no item shows egg or milk; ingredients are not changed or removed; cross-contamination does occur. Interview (weeeat, 7 March 2025): owner 下川祠左都; a friend's illness was the trigger; opened in Jiyugaoka on 25 September 2009; T's Tantan in JR East station concourses. Tabelog: ecute Ueno 3F; Mon–Sat 10:00–22:00, Sun and holidays 10:00–21:00; 16 seats; non-smoking; opened 16 October 2025. Reviews (June–September 2026): handy inside the ticket gates; order and pay first; golden and black sesame tantanmen ¥1,250; black sesame special ¥1,700; switch to pho +¥150; Fortune vegetable gyoza ¥720; gentle spiciness; one was told about allergy handling and tofu noodles (July 2026); the menu is mostly in English; many overseas customers; 10% off with a museum ticket.

公式サイト (forbalmeat.com、©2021): フレンチとイタリアン.en: Official site (forbalmeat.com, ©2021): a chef who trained extensively in French and Italian cooking; courses suggested to suit allergies and budget; courses ¥5,000–8,500; closed Sundays and holidays (open on Sundays for private hire or wedding after-parties). Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Ueno 7-2-16, サウナ・カプセルホテル北欧 1F, 2 min on foot from the JR Ueno Station Asakusa exit; Mon–Thu 17:30–22:30, Fri–Sat 17:30–23:30; closed Sundays and holidays; 50 seats plus 4 at the counter; smoking room inside; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; children welcome; English menu; opened 9 February 2017; the chef holds a sommelier qualification; over 50 wines; glasses of wine from ¥650; an appetizer platter chosen from 11 kinds (one ¥480 to all 11 ¥2,480); A5 black wagyu fillet 110 g ¥4,980; three-meat platter ¥2,980; black wagyu grill 100 g ¥1,880; courses with all-you-can-drink from ¥6,000. Reviews (April–August 2026): potato salad with meat in it; the three-meat platter; red wine recommended by the manager; caprese; the 11 appetizers; a chunk of black wagyu; almost fully booked on Friday night; carbonara; large portions, leftovers can be taken home; birthday surprises; ajillo; sparkling wine.

公式サイト (francois1934.com): フランソア喫茶室、1934年.en: Official site (francois1934.com): Salon de thé FRANCOIS, founded 1934, in a lane a little south of Shijo-Kobashi; designed by young artist friends including 立野正一, 高木四郎 and the Italian ベンチベニ; stained-glass windows, a white ceiling, red velvet chairs, a copy of the Mona Lisa; a place to discuss anti-war and avant-garde art as the wartime mood deepened; the 'Saturday Newspaper' (the tabloid 'Saturday'); source: エキゾチック京都 (淡交社, 左方郁子); 下京区西木屋町通四条下ル船頭町184. Tabelog: kissaten and cakes; 11:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); open every day except 31 December–2 January; no reservations; 80 seats; non-smoking; no children; no cards; founded Showa 9; house rare cheesecake; Kissaten Tabelog 100 2021, 2022, 2026. Reviews (October 2026, in English): cake set ¥1,450, special pudding, a national registered tangible cultural property, weekend queues.

公式サイト (french-2h.jp): ドゥアッシュ、東心斎橋1-7-18、.en: Official site (french-2h.jp): Deux Ash, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-7-18, 7 min on foot from exits 5 and 6 of Shinsaibashi Station (Midosuji Line), partner parking; lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 13:30), dinner 17:30–22:30 (last order 21:00); closed Mondays and from the third Monday to Wednesday. Lunch: Menu Avantarge, 8 dishes ¥5,900; Menu Luxueux, 11 dishes ¥7,800; Menu Prestige, 11 dishes ¥13,600 (lobster for the fish course, beef fillet for the meat); dishes and dessert, then a drink and petits fours. Dinner: Menu Saison, 12 dishes ¥9,200; Menu Gastoronomie, 12 dishes ¥12,800; Menu Dégustation ¥16,500 (all left to the chef); Menu Spécialité de Chef ¥22,000 (book two days ahead); all prices include service and tax. Choose desserts from the dessert tree. A closure notice in March 2026; an Instagram account started. Tabelog (shop member): French and yoshoku; give allergies and dislikes (oysters, raw fish, shellfish, foie gras) in advance; 36 seats; private rooms (4–20); children in private rooms only; children's meal ¥2,800; one drink per person; 10% service included; non-smoking; vegetarian options; sommelier. Reviews (August–October 2026): the vault door from the building's securities-company days, a tree up to the ceiling, a stone floor like a river, private rooms on a mezzanine, as many desserts as you like, low-temperature chicken for a guest who does not eat much meat, lamb carved at the table, cheerful staff, birthday plates.

公式サイト (fuka-kyoto.com): 京生麩の専門店、古くから京都御所.en: Official site (fuka-kyoto.com): a specialist in Kyoto nama-fu; has long supplied fu to the Kyoto Imperial Palace; the founding year is unknown because the records burned in the upheavals of the late Edo period; a palace pass is dated in the Keio era; the present owner is the 7th generation; works mainly to order for ryotei; makes nama-fu every morning, 30–40 kinds a day, by hand with pumped groundwater; about 20 craftsmen, all of whom study the tea ceremony; Fuka also made the first nama-fu manju (said to be Emperor Meiji's idea); house-made smooth bean paste wrapped in aonori nama-fu and rolled in bamboo leaf; "craft, not commerce". Shops: 麩嘉 main shop (上京区西洞院通椹木町上る; no retail; reserve by phone or buy from the online shop) and 麩嘉 錦店 (中京区錦小路堺町角菊屋町534-1; 10:00–17:30; closed Monday). Tabelog: wagashi; 2 seats; reservations taken; cards accepted; closed the last Sunday of the month from February to August; Wagashi WEST Tabelog 100 2023 and 2026.

公式サイト (ful-kyoto.com): 河原町通三条下ル大黒町67-3 フ.en: Official site (ful-kyoto.com): 1F, 67-3 Daikoku-cho, Kawaramachi-dori south of Sanjo; Tue–Thu and Sun 17:00–24:00 (L.O. food 23:00, drinks 23:30); Fri–Sat 17:00–3:00 (L.O. food 2:00, drinks 2:30); closed Monday; the food menu (February 2026) lists allergens for each dish. Tabelog: bar; about 3 min walk from Sanjo Stn; reservations accepted; no minors; 10% service charge in the dining and lounge areas only; 80 seats, 120 standing; non-smoking (smoking area outside); wheelchair accessible; cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 12 July 2024; over 120 natural wines. Reviews (December 2024–October 2026, English): produced by Tomoyuki Tanaka; dashimaki sandwich; sukiyaki spring rolls; tacos; happy hour; some say the music is loud.

公式サイト (gin-nanba.com): 個室 和牛焼肉 吟〜ぎん〜、難波1.en: Official site (gin-nanba.com): private-room wagyu yakiniku Gin, Namba 1-8-16, Namba HIPS 10F, right by exit 15B of Namba Station (linked by the subway passage); Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00, Sat–Sun 16:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00, drinks 22:30); renewed and reopened 10 June 2025; A5 kuroge wagyu from ¥680 (¥748 with tax); Kobe beef aiming to be the best value in Japan; the famous tongue; wagyu mille-feuille yukhoe from a shop licensed to serve raw meat; luxurious rice cooked fresh one pot at a time. Menu: Tuesday–Thursday 彩 course ¥5,000 (Gin's famous fresh kimchi, two namul, salad of the day, raw tripe and heart sashimi, freshly cooked rice, salted beef tongue, two wagyu cuts of the day, Kobe beef special sukiyaki kalbi, pork skirt, ice cream of the day); 和 course ¥6,000 (seared lean wagyu sushi, Kobe beef dashi-shabu kalbi, yukgaejang gukbap and more); 竹 course ¥7,000; all-you-can-drink +¥2,000. Tabelog (shop member): yakiniku, horumon, steak; all private rooms (25 rooms, 2–16 people); 80 seats; night view; non-smoking; service charge extra (not on courses); same-day cancellation fee; lunch at weekends and holidays; opened 15 April 2015; Yakiniku WEST Tabelog 100 2022. Reviews (September–October 2026): top tongue, wagyu mille-feuille yukhoe, wagyu and ikura on rice, good-value courses, a report that private rooms are for course bookings only, a report that the grilled meat was ordinary.

公式サイト (ginka.biz): 京都、先斗町のそば処 河道屋銀華、創業明治.en: Official site (ginka.biz): Kawamichiya Ginka, a soba shop in Pontocho, Kyoto; founded Meiji 35; the same taste as ever; aiming for a taste found only in this shop; prices revised from November 2025; 192-3, Nakagyo-ku; 11:30–24:00 (last order 23:30); closed Wednesday; a little west of Pontocho Park; open from 5 pm (Pontocho honten page); set-meal lunches at the Kitaoji Vivre shop (site description). About Kawamichiya Ginka (2017): branched from the head house Kawamichiya in 1902 (Meiji 35); the head house had three daughters, who married craftsmen trained at Kawamichiya, and branched out under the house names 金華 (eldest), Ginka (second) and 銅華 (third); first at Kiyamachi-Sanjo; closed in the second generation because of the Pacific War; the third generation reopened in Pontocho. Tabelog: soba; no bookings; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR accepted, 5% fee on cards; 20 seats; smoking allowed. Reviews (December 2025 – October 2026, in English): herring set meal ¥1,980; kake soba ¥880; tempura soba ¥2,000; duck nanban; chicken nanban; tororo zaru; spicy-daikon soba; soba-yu; the fourth generation and a son; green onions on a separate plate.

公式サイト (gion-245.com): 祗園で味わう、京都ならではのイタリア.en: Official site (gion-245.com): Italian food you can only have in Kyoto, eaten in Gion — Gion 245. Tabelog: Italian, French, steak; 中之町245-1, east of Yamato-oji on Chion-in Shinmonzen, Higashiyama-ku; the fifth house east of Hanamikoji on Shinmonzen-dori, north side; 7 min walk from Keihan Gion-Shijo Station; 17:00–23:00; closing days not fixed; reservation only; 14 seats (8 counter, 6 table); private rooms; 10% service charge; corkage ¥5,000 a bottle; elementary-school age and up; smart casual; English menu and English-speaking staff; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; dinner course with black-wagyu Chateaubriand main, 8 dishes ¥15,000 (with tax); a Kyoto townhouse; Kyoto vegetables; Japanese-style Italian; Italian WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025. Reviews (September 2025–April 2026, in English): owner-chef Masakazu Yoshioka, Kanobiano, a wine cellar converted from an air-raid shelter, Amela tomato caprese, fresh pasta, a 7-dish ¥8,000 course, a single chef.

公式サイト (gion-adachiya.com): ぎをんの豚汁屋さん あだち.en: Official site (gion-adachiya.com): ぎをんの豚汁屋さん あだち家, a Japanese-style izakaya; a hideaway facing Kiritoshi in Gion, Kyoto; local sake from the home prefecture of the 大将, Niigata, and regional dishes; 東山区清本町368-4 セラヴィビル 1F; 18:00–3:00; closed Sunday; 18 seats (8 at the counter, 2 tables); cards; smoking allowed; menu: Kumamoto horse sashimi, four kinds; Hokkaido shishamo; wagyu tendon stew; house roast beef; thick grilled Tokushima shiitake; Niigata Tochio jumbo fried tofu (natto, negi miso or mentaiko mayo); Niigata squid sashimi with mentaiko; "men's" potato salad; Kyoto silver cod Saikyo-yaki; prawn fry; domestic chicken-thigh kara-age (curry, lemon soy, or grated daikon with sesame ponzu). Tabelog: regional cuisine, sake bar, izakaya; Mon–Sat 18:00–3:00 (last order 2:30), day before a holiday 17:00–24:00; closed Sunday (open Sunday and closed Monday when Monday is a holiday); cover charge ¥500 per person; 2-hour limit when busy; smoking allowed; cards, e-money and QR; opened 26 November 2013; invoice: 安達 秀行 (individual). Reviews (April 2025–November 2026, in English): owner from Niigata; pork miso soup; macaroni salad; nikujaga; oden.

公式サイト (gion-fuji.com): 2020年4月に開店した京都祇園の.en: Official site (gion-fuji.com): tempura 'Gion Fuji', opened in Gion, Kyoto in April 2020; tempura of seasonal seafood, vegetables and meat at a granite counter; fried fresh one piece at a time in front of you; first-press safflower oil only; spring: shirauo, clam, aburame wrapped in cherry leaf, wild greens, Kyoto bamboo shoot, white asparagus; summer: hamo, young ayu, aori-ika, kisu, white corn, Kamo eggplant, manganji pepper; autumn: hamo and matsutake roll, tachiuo, ginkgo, chestnut, wild maitake; winter: fugu, seko crab, kumoko, Horikawa burdock, Shogoin turnip, Kyo-kanzashi; omakase tempura courses ¥17,600, ¥19,800, ¥23,100, ¥25,300 (tax included, service extra); champagne from ¥12,000; 8 counter seats and a private room for 4; owner 藤元 健司 (The Ritz-Carlton Osaka, Japanese restaurant Hanagatami; 鉄板・てんぷら 義 Kita-Shinchi; head chef of Tempura Mizuki at The Ritz-Carlton Kyoto, one Michelin star three years running from the 2018 guide); 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 20:00); closed Sundays and holidays (irregular); booking via TableCheck. Tabelog: tempura, Japanese cuisine; 東山区祇園町南側570-121; Tue, Thu, Sat 12:00–15:00; Tue–Sat and holidays 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday and Monday; vegan, vegetarian, halal and gluten-free requests cannot be accommodated; cancellation 50% the day before, 100% on the day; children 6 and over who order a course; 10% service charge; 12 seats; Tempura Tabelog 100 2023 and 2025; invoice T9130001081365 (株式会社京都フードサービス). Reviews (August 2025–November 2026, in English): sesame tofu with sea urchin, tendon, lunch course Benikikyo ¥23,100.

公式サイト (gion-iwamoto.jp): 祇園 岩元、花街祇園の京町家、.en: Official site (gion-iwamoto.jp): 祇園 岩元 (Gion Iwamoto), a Kyoto townhouse in the Gion geisha quarter; a one-plank counter, a window counter looking onto the tsubo garden, private rooms; artistic, authentic Kyoto cuisine that makes the most of seasonal ingredients, made easy to enjoy; charcoal-grilled Omi Hime wagyu; the head chef's delicate cooking; banquets with maiko and geiko; seats: 1st floor counter 8 and garden-view counter 3, 2nd floor private rooms of 8 and 16, up to 26; service charge 10%, 2nd-floor private rooms 15%, 20% for two; cancellation 80% the day before, 100% on the day (lunch 100% the day before or on the day); 11:30–14:30 (last order 13:00), 17:30–22:30 (last order 21:00); closed irregularly; 東山区祇園町南側570-127; 7 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn; menu: half Kyoto anago rice box ¥2,530, Kyoto anago rice box ¥3,850, ogi bento ¥5,280, seasonal courses at lunch ¥8,800 and ¥12,100, at dinner ¥12,100, ¥16,500 and ¥22,000 (service extra), meat can be changed to fish; commercial-law notice: responsible representative 岩元 勝己. Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; 30 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair access; vegetarian menu; elementary-school age and up; opened 7 July 2009. Reviews (2024–2026, in English).

公式サイト (gion-kawakami.co.jp): 京都の割烹 祇園川上、.en: Official site (gion-kawakami.co.jp): Kyoto kappo Gion Kawakami — founded in Showa 35 (1960); Hanamikoji; 'kindness, sense, freshness'; no fixed monthly menu, the day's ingredients and each guest's wishes make the menu; Awaji Island sea bream; the same suppliers since the founding; itamae kappo; kabura-mushi from mid-November; November-only seasonal bento, one tier ¥5,250 (takeaway only, book two days ahead); 570-122 Gion-machi Minamigawa, Higashiyama-ku; notice of November–December holidays. Tabelog: Japanese / bento; 12:00–15:00 and 17:30–22:00; 24 seats; private rooms; non-smoking; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners). Reviews (December 2025–October 2026, English): a machiya over 100 years old, 10-seat counter and 7 private rooms, one Michelin star, konowata chawanmushi, lunch kaiseki ¥6,600, Chochin Bento, steamed sea-bream head, hamo.

公式サイト (gion-kon.com): ぎをん今、四季折々の食材を職人が手作.en: Official site (gion-kon.com): Gion Kon — seasonal ingredients made by hand by craftsmen; a long-established kappo that turns away first-time guests; 570-6 Gion-machi Minamigawa, Higashiyama-ku; irregular closing days; lunch from 12:00 and 13:00 (two sittings); hot-pot dinner from 17:30 (booking required); evening kappo is by introduction only and cannot be booked; budget lunch ¥5,000–10,000, hot-pot course from ¥10,000; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); bookings also by Instagram DM; private hire for 10 or more; private rooms; separate smoking area; cancellations 50% from three days before, 100% on the day; takeaway: eel sushi with Hamanako eel ¥8,100 a roll, half ¥4,320, two-bite inari ¥2,376. Tabelog: Japanese / eel; 5 min on foot from Gion-Shijo Stn; evenings by reservation only; 26 seats; private rooms. Reviews (April–October 2026, English): unadon, suppon ramen, mini eel course, karasumi, matsutake dobin-mushi, fried abalone, beef fillet; anyone can book lunch, evenings by introduction.

公式サイト (gion-matayoshi.com): 祇園又吉、茶懐石のこころ.en: Official site (gion-matayoshi.com): Gion Matayoshi; cherishing the heart of tea kaiseki, gathering the best of the season, a once-in-a-lifetime taste born from the day's conversation with guests; on Gion Hanamikoji, a stone path beyond the lattice door; the owner was head chef of a long-established ryokan; 祇園町南側570-123, 5 min on foot from Gion-Shijo Stn; first-time guests book online only; New Year osechi, three tiers of seven sun, ¥86,400; sister shop 'Matakichi' (opened 1 August 2021, 祇園町南側570-120 万治ビル 1F; lunch, shaved ice of natural ice, Italian on Japanese tableware at night). Tabelog (shop-maintained): Japanese cuisine; parties of two or more; the counter for 2–3, private rooms for 4 or more; one drink per person; proxy bookings may be refused; from 1 June lunch ¥20,000 (counter) / ¥22,000 (tatami room), dinner ¥36,000 / ¥38,000; service charge added; children from sixth grade in private rooms; 24 seats; opened 10 February 2015; The Tabelog Award Bronze 2019–2026; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025. Reviews (January 2025–October 2026, in English): a crab-only sushi roll, a hot pot of Ishigaki beef, sake centred on Aramasa, friendly staff.

公式サイト (gion-moriwaki.jp): 2014年に祇園町に10席だ.en: Official site (gion-moriwaki.jp): a small ten-seat shop born in Gion-machi in 2014; kaiseki of the seasons finished with the owner's handmade 100% buckwheat soba; a shop that stays close by for time alone or with someone dear; lunch entry at 12:00, dinner entry 18:00–19:00 (booking required); closed Thursday and Friday lunch, other days irregular; 570-177 Gion-machi Minamigawa; lunch ¥7,000, 9,000, 12,000, 15,000, 18,000; dinner ¥12,000, 15,000, 18,000 (tax extra, 10% service); payment in cash; cancellation 100% on the day or day before, 80% two days before, 50% three days before; no English spoken, so call through a hotel concierge; gifts to take home. Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; 10 seats (6 counter, one table for 4); no smoking (smoking spot outside); no cards, e-money or QR; 10% service at dinner only; babies welcome; opened 28 August 2014; one Michelin star in the 2016 guide (Tabelog introduction). Reviews (January 2025 – October 2026): starts with brown-rice soup; freshly shaved bonito; sea urchin and crab with egg-yolk vinegar; abalone; hamo and matsutake; guji; sweetfish; eel; finished with 100% buckwheat soba; head chef, proprietress and another chef; lightly seasoned Kyoto cooking; sent off at the door. A June 2026 review (in Japanese, ¥9,000 lunch): minazuki tofu with shrimp and sea urchin; a soup of blanched hamo; grilled Lake Biwa sweetfish; sashimi of sea bream, bluefin tuna, geoduck and squid.

公式サイト (gion-nishi.com): 祇園 にし、店主・西隼平は日本料.en: Official site (gion-nishi.com): Gion Nishi; the owner, 西隼平 (Jumpei Nishi), trained in a Japanese restaurant and an Italian one; young sensibility and an Italian essence on the Japanese tradition; no compromise on ingredients, drink, tableware or space; uses ingredients and techniques Japanese cooking usually does not; near Yasaka Shrine; GION NISHI CAFE upstairs; 東山区月見町21-2 1F; closed all day Monday and irregularly.
