Tabelog (corporate member): Tue and Wed dinner only, Thu–Sun lunch and dinner; 20 seats (6 at the counter, 14 at tables); cards and QR accepted; service charge 10%; opened 7 July 2016; The Tabelog Award Bronze 2019–2026; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025. Review (June 2026, in Japanese): the chef's delicate, inventive cooking; the care of the okami and staff; yam noodles with water shield and sea urchin from 大間; a white-miso bowl of peony-cut hamo; sashimi of aori squid, tuna, sea urchin and nodoguro; a hassun with lobster and corn mousse; ayu sushi rolled in nori; beef loin and Kamo eggplant with shrimp dengaku.

公式サイト (gion-nishimura.com): 祇園町南側570-160.en: Official site (gion-nishimura.com): 570-160 in south Gion; open from 5 p.m., last entry 8 p.m.; cards accepted; sells saba sushi "Yasaka no Yuki". Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; reservation only; the phone is hard to reach during service; Mon–Sat 17:00–20:00; closed Sunday; 17% service charge; 20 seats (8 at the counter, plus tatami rooms); private rooms for 2–20; counter non-smoking. Reviews (June 2023–June 2026, English): head chef Akihiko Nishimura; sesame tofu; saba sushi; sea-bream chazuke; suppon soup; hassun; upstairs private rooms and a courtyard garden; ¥12,000 course (June 2024); one diner found the seasoning a little strong (June 2026).

公式サイト (gion-shizuka.jp): 祇園 静水香、ミシュラン星付き.en: Official site (gion-shizuka.jp): Gion Shizuka — food supervised by a Michelin-starred chef; head chef; lunch 12:00–15:00 (L.O. 12:30); dinner 18:00–21:00 (all start at 18:00); no closing day; operated by EDGE (Fish Bank TOKYO, Bar&Lounge MAJESTIC, TOKYO Whisky Library, Cheese Tavern CASCINA, Snack Romantic); notice on ingredient restrictions (16 April 2026). Tabelog (shop member): Japanese; 371-2, Higashiyama-ku; 5 min on foot from Gion-Shijo Stn; 12:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; service 10%; 18 seats (10 counter, upstairs tatami room); no under-12s; English menu; opened 29 July 2024; sake direct from breweries kept at –5 °C; pairing of nine sake including Juyondai with ten dishes; Kazumi Sawada (one Michelin star 2008 and 2009); seasonal omakase ¥19,800, Yui ¥19,800, sake pairing course ¥26,400. Reviews (October 2025–October 2026, English): foie gras croquette, round tofu with sea urchin, hassun, guji with Inaniwa udon, black wagyu sukiyaki, Shiki ¥16,500, Chef Kimura, the sound of insects.

公式サイト (gion-yassan.com): 祇園肉割烹 安参（やっさん）、.en: Official site (gion-yassan.com): Gion meat kappo Yassan; founded in 1948 (Showa 23); the first owner, from 門前仲町 in Tokyo, created the oxtail stew in Kyoto, and the second generation raised it into meat kappo; Yassan's own style has been handed down; a calm Japanese-style room; counter seats and private rooms; 東山区祇園町北側347; about 10 min from Gion-Shijo Stn; cross the road opposite Gion Ichiriki-tei and walk about 2 min; bookings for the tatami rooms only (3 or more); 18:00–22:30; closed Sundays and holidays; mail order (OMAKASE, Ikyu.com). Tabelog: meat and Japanese cuisine; a 22-seat counter on the ground floor and tatami rooms upstairs; smoking allowed; cards accepted; The Tabelog Award Bronze 2025, 2026; the fourth generation was born in 1994. Reviews (September–October 2026, in English): queue for the counter, no photos of raw meat, tongue sashimi, tripe, oxtail stew, Kujo green onion and mustard.

公式サイト (gionhitsujicafe.com): 1F 祇をん ひつじカ.en: Official site (gionhitsujicafe.com): 1F Gion Hitsuji Cafe, a hideaway café with its own courtyard in the middle of Gion-machi, Kyoto; famous petit choux by a dedicated patissier; retro interior with jazz; French-press coffee; Gion is said to feel intimidating, so the café aims to be easy to drop into; Mon–Thu 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); Fri and Sat 14:00–25:00 (L.O. 24:30); closed Sundays and holidays (open in some seasons); 2F Gion Hitsuji (obanzai with shochu and sake, 18:00–23:00); representative 曽我 良子; 347 Gion-machi Kitagawa, inside the Gion Raku-en Koji; wasanbon choux (custard piped in after ordering), plate of 4 from ¥600, box of 10 from ¥1,300; seasonal creams (chestnut in October 2026, Anno sweet potato in November); beef-tendon curry ¥1,050; stewed hamburg steak ¥1,300; white-miso soy-milk gratin ¥1,200; yuba and namafu Kyoto-style ankake bowl ¥1,300; Napolitan ¥1,100 (menu of February 2024, with a price-revision notice since); celebration cakes and delivery. Tabelog: cafe; 18 seats; no smoking (smoking spot outside); PayPay only; opened 21 November 2011. Reviews (March–October 2026, in English): a courtyard at the end of an alley; a fire-watch tower and goldfish pond; wasanbon choux; matcha; parfaits; beef-tendon curry; open late at night; boxes of 10 to take away.

公式サイト (gionkarokuonline.com): 炭火焼肉 祇園 鹿六.en: Official site (gionkarokuonline.com): charcoal yakiniku Gion Karoku; a mansion built in Showa 2 (1927); carefully chosen Kuroge wagyu of A4 grade and up; salt and tare; the house negi mince; closed Monday (holiday openings with a day off in lieu); lunch without booking; the 28th–30th of each month are 'meat days' (one drink free with a course); parking vouchers ended 30 September 2025. Tabelog: yakiniku, offal, Korean; 東山区八坂通東大路西入ル小松町566-25; 3 min walk from the Kiyomizu-michi bus stop; Tue–Sun 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. food 22:00, drinks 22:30); 5% service charge; private room fee ¥3,000 or ¥5,000; 58 seats (4 private rooms, 8 at sunken kotatsu); children under 10 in private rooms only; cards; opened 11 May 1999; invoice T6010402017668 (有限会社鹿永アソシエイツ); menu (English version, updated August 2026): Yamagata beef yukhoe ¥3,500, chuck-rib hana aburi yaki ¥3,300, special negi-tan shio ¥4,200, Chateaubriand 100 g ¥9,000; courses ¥11,000–25,000; lunch charcoal courses ¥2,500 and ¥3,500. Reviews (November 2025–August 2026, in English): the 1927 building, tsubo-niwa, kakigori upstairs, komtang, cold noodles, mixed views of the service.

公式サイト (gionmaruyama.com): 祇園丸山、夜営業の最終入店を.en: Official site (gionmaruyama.com): Gion Maruyama; last dinner entry extended to 19:30; special bento; dishes to order for home (Kyoto-vegetable white-miso hot pot and Matsuba crab rice, Matsutake rice, charcoal-grilled ayu udon, wild hamo shabu-shabu and more). Tabelog: Japanese cuisine, 東山区祇園町南側570-171, 5 min on foot from Gion-Shijo Stn; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 11:00–13:00 and 17:00–19:30; closed Wednesdays; reservation only; service charge 15%; counter, tatami and sunken seating; private rooms; cards accepted; opened 15 January 1988; The Tabelog Award Bronze 2018–2021; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021. Reviews (April 2025–July 2026, in English): seasonal kaiseki, private rooms facing a garden, courses from ¥50,000 (before tax) to ¥75,900, two Michelin stars.

公式サイト (gionsasaki.com): 祇園さゝ木、佐々木浩、お客様の「.en: Official site (gionsasaki.com): Gion Sasaki; 佐々木浩 (Hiroshi Sasaki); what the chef most wants to hear from guests is "delicious… no, fun!"; the whole staff serve food while enjoying themselves, so the room shares one feeling; lunch Thu, Fri and Sat only, one start at 12:00; dinner one start at 18:30; lunch ¥22,000, dinner ¥44,000 (tax and service included, varying with the market); bookings from the first business day of each month up to the end of the month after next, by phone only; closed Sundays, Mondays and irregularly; 東山区八坂通り小松町566-27; 3 min from the Kiyomizu-michi bus stop; group shops Gion Rakumi, Sushi Rakumi and Shoku Bar Rakumi. Tabelog (corporate member): vegan menus cannot be accommodated; more than 30 minutes late counts as a cancellation; 20 seats (a counter of 13 and a private counter of 7); no children under 10; shoes off; service included at lunch, 10% at dinner; The Tabelog Award Bronze and Silver; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2025. Reviews (May–October 2026, in English): a shared start, many apprentices, a charcoal grill, sushi handed over by the chef, three Michelin stars seven years running.

公式サイト (gionsuetomo.kyoto): 祇園 末友、名料亭で腕を磨.en: Official site (gionsuetomo.kyoto): Gion Suetomo, opened in 2009 by Hisashi Suetomo, who honed skills at famous ryotei; 'the house is part of the cuisine'; a sukiya-style building of the owner's own design; 'Yasaka water' drawn from 40 m underground; an eight-dish kaiseki with a sakizuke on a seasonal word and a hassun on Kyoto culture; grilled dishes cooked in front of guests even in private rooms; the tea maxim of harmony, respect, purity and tranquility; four private rooms after the tenth-anniversary renovation; maiko entertainment (by reservation); dishes changed for allergies or religious reasons; a course without animal ingredients for vegan guests; foreign-language menus; lunch Yasaka kaiseki ¥12,100, kaiseki ¥36,300 / ¥72,600; dinner kaiseki ¥36,300 / ¥72,600, seasonal crab (7 November–20 March) ¥60,500 / ¥72,600; book by the day before; lunch entry 12:00–13:00, dinner entry 17:00–19:30; closed irregularly; cancellation 100% the day before or on the day; non-smoking; 大和大路四条下る四丁目 小松町151-73, opposite Kenninji's south gate. Tabelog: Japanese cuisine and sushi; 33 seats; no charge; gluten-free, vegan and vegetarian options; opened 11 February 2009; The Tabelog Award Bronze 2017–2022; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021. Reviews (January 2025–September 2026, in English): white rice porridge made with Yasaka water, a Gion Matsuri hassun, mixed views on value.

公式サイト (gokoumachi-tagawa.com): 御幸町 田がわ、夷.en: Official site (gokoumachi-tagawa.com): 御幸町 田がわ (Goko Machi Tagawa), Ebisugawa-dori Gokomachi-nishi-iru, Matsumoto-cho 575; theme "casually enjoying exquisite Japanese dishes"; hospitality that keeps guests at ease; cooking in front of guests across a flat counter; a ceramic hearth and binchotan; holds a Michelin star; seasonal ingredients from many regions, starting with the owner's home prefecture of Mie; omakase only, no à la carte; about 10 dishes, changing monthly; omakase course ¥26,400 (¥21,780 on another page); New Year course ¥33,000; flower-pepper hot-pot course ¥33,000 (April); matsuba-crab special course and crab nights, reference price ¥44,000; prices vary with buying; check dishes and ingredients with the shop; reservation only; phone around 11:00–17:00; hours 18:00–20:30 (last entry); irregular closing days; 12 counter seats; non-smoking; same-day cancellation 100%; the owner also buys the flowers. Tabelog (corporate member): The Tabelog Award Bronze 2018–2026, Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025, omakase course ¥29,040, service charge 10%, 10 counter seats, a sunken counter where shoes come off, socks required, opened 7 February 2017. Reviews (January–October 2026): Matsutake gatherings, flower-pepper hot pot, several clay-pot rices, seafood from Mie ama divers, the owner said to resemble Masato Sakai, hospitality from Ms. Tanaka.

公式サイト (goodnaturestation.com): GOOD NATU.en: Official site (goodnaturestation.com): GOOD NATURE STATION 4F; a casual restaurant where you can enjoy healthy dishes centred on vegetables; terrace seats under an open atrium; lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order), closing 16:00; dinner 17:30–21:00 (last order), closing 22:00; closed days follow the facility; dinner: hors d'oeuvre platter ¥2,200, farm tomato and burrata caprese ¥2,400, long pasta with Kyoto duck ragù ¥2,400, charcoal-grilled venison with mushroom koji-miso sauce 100 g ¥4,000, roast Kameoka beef loin 120 g ¥5,400; bookings via TableCheck. Tabelog: café and dining bar, 稲荷町318-6, Shimogyo-ku, Good Nature Hotel 4F; 54 seats; table charge on the terrace; tell the restaurant about allergies in advance (it may not be able to adapt on the day); vegetarian options; non-smoking; cards and PayPay; wheelchair accessible; opened 9 December 2019; lunch set ¥3,400; party plans ¥6,500 and ¥9,500. Reviews (2022–2026, in English): seasonal lunch sets (summer ¥2,500, autumn ¥3,400), medicinal food, Tanba chicken, Kyoto pork, shojin (vegetarian) dashi, Nature Beer Terrace 2026 (¥5,500), birds over the terrace, drinks ordered by smartphone, no split bills.

公式サイト (gosho-iwasaki.com): 京都市・丸太町、御所南エリ.en: Official site (gosho-iwasaki.com): Gosho Iwasaki, a Japanese restaurant south of the Imperial Palace near Marutamachi, Kyoto; delicate seasonal kaiseki served as a course; within walking distance of the Kyoto Imperial Palace and Nijo Castle; a once-in-a-lifetime menu (a returning guest is never served the same); "stay close to the season, satisfy the heart"; owner 岩崎義則: became a cook under the influence of an elder brother who was a cook; trained at Wakuden and Gion Maruyama; head chef at the inn 柊家; independent near the Imperial Palace in 2007 (Heisei 19); following inn hospitality, never serves the same menu; one Michelin star in the Michelin Guide Kyoto Osaka 2025; omakase course ¥23,100 (tax included). Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; Nakagyo-ku; everyone starts at 12:00 for lunch and 18:00 for dinner; closed Wednesday; allergies at booking; gluten-free and fish, crustacean or mollusc allergies cannot be accommodated; same-day cancellation or change 100%; 5% service; 8 seats (6 counter, 2 table); no smoking; primary-school age and up; cards accepted. Reviews (December 2022 – September 2026, in English): lunch course ¥11,000–11,500; crab in Tosa-vinegar jelly; karasumi mochi; abalone; sesame tofu in white miso; guji; hamo and matsutake; duck or beef-loin hot pot; kamadaki rice; the owner runs it alone; moved from near Karasuma Oike in 2021.

公式サイト (grainsdevanille.com): grains de v.en: Official site (grainsdevanille.com): grains de vanille — 'vanilla seeds' in French — named to evoke a sweet shop; no fixed concept, but a sense of the season, and for a customer's 'that was delicious'; 中京区間之町二条下ル鍵屋町486; closing days on Instagram or Facebook. Tabelog: cakes and café; Tue–Sat 10:30–18:00 (last order 16:30); closed Sunday and Monday; no phone reservations, reservations in person; 18 seats; no cards; opened 6 February 2011; Sweets Tabelog 100 2017; Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2018–2020, 2022, 2023, 2026. Reviews (September–October 2026, in English): small, layered cakes, eat-in, many cakes with alcohol, a regular disappointed by hurried service and employees being scolded in front of customers (October 2026).

公式サイト (grandmarble.com): GRAND MARBLE、グラ.en: Official site (grandmarble.com): GRAND MARBLE — Gion main shop, factory shop, pop-up shops at Daimaru Fukuoka Tenjin and Mito Keisei department store (November 2026). Tabelog (shop member): bread / chocolate; 570-238, Higashiyama-ku; about 5 min on foot from Gion-Shijo Stn; 10:30–18:30 (open daily; summer break 6–10 July); 4 seats; takeaway; cards, e-money and QR accepted. Reviews (June–September 2026, English): marble Danish, Prestige ¥1,188, matcha with azuki, matcha with kuromitsu, Kyoto Sanshoku, brown-sugar milk kinako, burnt-sugar butter pie ¥783, 11-day shelf life, the café upstairs, founded 1996, first in the furusato-tax bread category five years running.

公式サイト (grillkodakara.com): グリル小宝、左京区岡崎北御.en: Official site (grillkodakara.com): Grill Kodakara, 岡崎北御所町46, Sakyo-ku; closed every Tuesday and Wednesday; 11:30–20:30. Tabelog: yoshoku, omurice; 3 min walk from the Dobutsuen-mae and Okazakimichi city bus stops; Monday and Thursday–Sunday 11:30–20:30, closed Tuesday and Wednesday; no reservations; 33 seats (tables only); takeaway; cards, e-money and QR accepted; non-smoking; the name takes one character from Takarabune, the Gion yoshoku restaurant where the previous owner trained; Yoshoku Tabelog 100 2020 and 2022, Yoshoku WEST 2025. Reviews (September–November 2026, in English): omurice ¥1,540, demi-glace sauce, hayashi rice, fried shrimp, crab-cream croquettes, a queue from before opening, orders taken in the line, founded 1961.

公式サイト (guu-kyoto.main.jp): 中国菜 Guu、圧倒的な躍.en: Official site (guu-kyoto.main.jp): Chinese restaurant Guu; overwhelming dynamism; captivated on first stepping into a Hong Kong kitchen as a teenager — the cooks' energy, the skill of the dim sum, the rising steam, the roar of the flames; only six counter seats; dishes created right in front of the guests; Guu owner-chef 宮谷要 (Kaname Miyatani); shop news mainly on Instagram; referral-only mail order (dim sum Guu). Tabelog: Chinese, 中京区樋之口467-2; dinner starts at 18:00; lunch at 12:00 for private bookings only; closed Sundays, Mondays and irregularly; reservation only; for new guests, leftover seats for the following month go first-come by Instagram DM from midnight on the 1st; 6 counter seats; cards accepted; opened 17 September 2022; The Tabelog Award Bronze 2025, Silver 2026; Chinese WEST Tabelog 100 2024, 2026. Review (June 2026, in Japanese): near Kiyamachi-Nijo, a six-seat counter, jazz playing, the live feel of each plate finished in front of you, delicate seasoning with no greasiness, a seasonal vegetable and seafood hors d'oeuvre (Kamo eggplant, scallop, abalone in jelly), tuna chutoro marinated in Shaoxing wine with top-grade jellyfish, the signature pie (daikon, blue cheese, apple, potato paste).

公式サイト (hafuu.com): 肉専科はふう、京都御所の南、「は」は波、「.en: Official site (hafuu.com): Niku-senka Hafuu, south of the Kyoto Imperial Palace; 'ha' is wave and 'fu' is wind; the parent business has long run a butcher's shop in Kyoto; the main shop (Japanese style) and the Shogoin shop (oriental, with fully private rooms); main shop: 中京区麩屋町通夷川上る笹屋町471-1; 11:30–13:30 (L.O.) and 17:30–21:30 (L.O.); closed Wednesday and irregularly; lunch: premium sirloin steak ¥5,200, premium fillet steak ¥5,400, Hafuu special beef cutlet ¥3,100, beef stew ¥3,000, Hafuu steak don ¥3,350, fried prawns ¥2,200, hamburg steak ¥1,800, daily lunch (weekdays only) ¥1,100, curry rice and hayashi rice ¥1,400 each, katsu sando ¥2,500, premium katsu sando ¥5,800; dinner: seat charge ¥500 a head, Original Dinner ¥11,300, Niku-senka course and Hafuu course ¥9,200 each, premium beef fillet steak dinner ¥8,800, beef cutlet (fillet) dinner ¥6,200, hamburg dinner ¥4,500. Tabelog: yoshoku, steak, beef dishes; 36 seats (16 counter, 20 table); more than 20 minutes late counts as a cancellation; non-smoking; cards; opened 18 April 1999; Yoshoku Tabelog 100 2020, 2022, 2023, Yoshoku WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (July–October 2026, in English): yoshoku run by a butcher, beef cutlet, premium katsu sando, steak don, hamburg, beef sukiyaki don.

公式サイト (haku.kyoto): 京都三条 箔、鴨川を望む個室で味わう和牛.en: Official site (haku.kyoto): 京都三条 箔 (Kyoto Sanjo Haku), wagyu sukiyaki kaiseki in private rooms overlooking the Kamo River; a new style of wagyu sukiyaki kaiseki by a cook experienced in traditional Japanese cuisine; the house warishita; staff cook it in front of guests; tsubo-niwa garden supervised by the world-renowned garden designer 石原和幸; faces Kiyamachi-dori; site of the lodging of 武市半平太; in the Bakumatsu era the ryotei 四国屋丹虎; the tokonoma board and pillar of the 半平の間; 中京区木屋町通三条上る上大阪町528-3; 3 min walk from Sanjo Stn; 12:00–15:00 (last entry 13:00) Saturdays, Sundays and holidays only, 17:00–22:00 (last entry 19:00); closed Tuesday; menu: wagyu sukiyaki kaiseki ¥24,500, Omi-beef sukiyaki kaiseki ¥30,500, Omi-beef shabu-shabu kaiseki ¥30,500 (book ahead), Kobe-beef sukiyaki kaiseki ¥36,500, Omi-beef chateaubriand sukiyaki kaiseki ¥42,500 (tax and service included); lunch wagyu sukiyaki ¥12,100, wagyu and Omi-beef tasting ¥18,150, Omi-beef sukiyaki ¥24,200; private-room fee ¥1,100 at lunch, ¥1,650 at dinner. Press releases (San-tatsu): run by the GLION GROUP (Kobe, Hyogo; representative director 菊地秀武); New Year Kobe and Omi beef tasting sukiyaki kaiseki ¥38,500. Tabelog: sukiyaki, shabu-shabu, Japanese; 10% service charge; 34 seats (24 at tables, 10 at sunken kotatsu); private rooms; designated smoking area; cards, Alipay, WeChat Pay; English menu; BYO allowed; Hot Pot Tabelog 100 2026. Reviews (January–October 2026, in English).

公式サイト (hamasaku.kyoto): 日本最初の板前割烹 京ぎをん浜作.en: Official site (hamasaku.kyoto): Japan's first itamae kappo, Kyo Gion Hamasaku; founded on 1 September 1927 (Showa 2) by the grandfather, 森川榮, in Gion Tominaga-cho; this is the 100th year; regular service ends at the end of March next year; took over when the father died 36 years ago; a promise to the second-generation father; came back to the counter after a nine-hour heart operation over the New Year; the year from this April is the true farewell service; bookings from 23 February. Third-generation master Hiroyuki Morikawa: third-generation owner of Hamasaku and president of Hamasaku Co., Ltd.; born 1962 in Gion-machi, Kyoto; kabuki, classical music and opera as a student in Tokyo; took over as third generation in 1991 on the death of the second-generation father, 武; since the first generation, 森川栄, "creating something delicious"; Hamasaku cooking school, 2,300 sessions and 30,000 people in total; 2017 Contemporary Master Craftsman (youngest in Kyoto cuisine); books include 『和食の教科書 ぎをん献立帖』, 『京料理の品格』 and 『名食決定盤』; patrons: the Showa Emperor, Kawabata Yasunari, Shiga Naoya, Mukoda Kuniko, Robert De Niro, Princess Grace of Monaco and others. Bookings: telephone first (shop 075-561-0330; bookings 075-223-8118); dress code semi-formal, jackets for men. Access: Shinmachi-dori south of Rokkaku, Nakagyo-ku; hours 17:00–22:00 (closed irregularly); by taxi, say "蛸薬師新町上る 浜作". Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sat 18:00–21:00; closed Wed and Sun; reservation only; no smoking; cards accepted. Reviews (January 2023 – August 2026, in English): over ¥100,000 a head; L-shaped counter; hamo; yuba kuzukiri; fried Wakasa fish; eel and somen; kombu dashi.

公式サイト (harijyu.co.jp): 大正八年に初代社長藤本喜蔵が開業し.en: Official site (harijyu.co.jp): a kuroge wagyu specialist opened in Taisho 8 by the first president 藤本喜蔵, now over a hundred years old; in 1919 a small shop in Sakai, Osaka Prefecture; a few years later a sukiyaki restaurant and butcher in Shinsekai; in 1948 moved to Dotonbori and added yoshoku; a district where theatre-loving gourmets gathered; the great film stars and famous singers of the day; the Daihoji shop opened in 1970 (closed 30 December 2023); department-store meat counters from 1966; rooms and service like a high-class ryokan. Dotonbori main shop, Japanese restaurant: lunch 11:30–15:30 (last order 14:30), dinner 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:00), closed Tuesdays (open on holidays and in December), bookings for two or more; sukiyaki Yuki ¥9,900, 月 ¥12,100, Hana ¥14,300, Hoshi ¥16,500, special course ¥19,800; shabu-shabu 銀杏, 紅葉, 水仙, 桔梗 and special course (same prices); kaiseki from ¥12,100; butter-yaki from ¥13,200; lunch sukiyaki or shabu-shabu ¥7,150; mini kaiseki ¥9,900; prices include tax and service. Notices: from 1 November 2026 some menu prices including sukiyaki and shabu-shabu revised because of high wagyu prices; in December hours and last orders run an hour later. Tabelog (shop member): Hot Pot Tabelog 100 2024 and 2026, 200 seats, private rooms, non-smoking (smoking area), cards and PayPay. Reviews (September–November 2026): an old staircase, well-worn tatami, veteran servers, the staff cook first, warishita in from the start, beaten egg, a foreign-language menu, many overseas customers, refills of white rice.

公式サイト (hidamarino.com): RESTAURANT hidam.en: Official site (hidamarino.com): RESTAURANT hidamarino was born in Kyoto in October 2014; a 'round taste' like a sphere, with the five tastes (sweet, salty, sour, bitter, umami) in balance and flavour and texture in harmony; pairings with wine or fine Kyoto tea, based on 'harmony'; chef ますむら; 下京区高倉通四条下る高材木町218; right outside exit 15 of Hankyu Karasuma Stn; lunch 12:00–15:00 (L.O. 13:00), dinner 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 19:30); closed Wednesday; Kyoto-tea pairing ¥4,000 (4 teas including gyokuro); wine pairing 4 glasses ¥4,000, 6 glasses ¥6,000, SP 8 glasses ¥7,800 (before tax; 10% service charge extra); short course: oeuf à la coque, yokowa mi-cuit, hidamarino baguette, sautéed foie gras with pain d'épices, steamed sawara with white-wine sauce, roast duckling with Madeira sauce. Tabelog: French, creative; 16 seats (6 counter, 10 table); lunch by booking by the day before, cash only; dinner by booking only; one drink per guest; tell the chef about allergies by phone; opened 10 October 2015; sister shop komorebino natural wine bar; dinner omakase of 10 dishes ¥13,200; French WEST Tabelog 100 2023 and 2025. Reviews (June–October 2026, in English): 'W main' lunch ¥7,700, tea pairing, a baguette rubbed with garlic by hand.

公式サイト (hiiragiya.co.jp): 来者如帰、文政元年 (1818.en: Official site (hiiragiya.co.jp): "may you feel as if you had come home"; in 1818 (Bunsei 1) the first 庄五郎 came up from Fukui and began in transport and seafood; the name comes from 比良木神社 in the grounds of Shimogamo Shrine; the inn became the main business in 1861 (Bunkyū 1); registered tangible cultural property; an essay by Kawabata Yasunari; dinner of Kyoto kaiseki; breakfast of yudofu, grilled fish, clay-pot rice and home-made pickles (Western on request); dinner starts at 18:00 or 19:00; food allergies and vegetarian requests handled as far as possible with three days' notice; no halal or kosher; special orders five days ahead; dining only: dinner from two people, lunch from ten outside busy periods; corkage on brought drinks; cards accepted; 2026 Michelin Key hotel; joined Relais & Châteaux (July 2026); seasonal extras of wild hamo and wild ayu (summer 2026). Tabelog: ryokan, Japanese cuisine; 中京区麩屋町姉小路上ル中白山町277; reservation only; 10% service for meals only; lunch from 15 people; 48 seats (hall); private rooms. Reviews (January 2024–October 2026, in English): Kyoto Gosan-ke, founded 1850, dinner in the room or a dining room, soba, hamo, ayu, hairy crab, Matsuba crab, a dining-only first-meal celebration, a maiko, Kawabata Yasunari's room.

公式サイト (hishiiwa.com): 天保初年 (1829年) 創業の仕出.en: Official site (hishiiwa.com): a specialist caterer founded in the first year of Tenpō (1829); the spirit of being 'the customer's kitchen'; the third-generation master, 松之助, devised the Hangetsu bento; boxed bento Ume ¥3,780, Tsuki ¥4,860, Hana ¥6,480, Matsu ¥8,100, Shirakawa ¥11,880, Yasaka ¥14,040, Higashiyama ¥21,600 (tax included; Shirakawa, Yasaka and Higashiyama in limited numbers); Hangetsu bento ¥4,320–5,940; Shokado bento ¥7,020 and ¥8,640; all orders by phone, by advance booking up to the day before; sales and bookings 11:30–18:00; eat on the day; delivery to Higashiyama-ku, Nakagyo-ku and nearby; June–September sales generally stop for hygiene; closed Sunday and the second and last Monday. Tabelog: bento, 東山区西之町213; no eating in; no cards; The Tabelog Award 2020 Bronze. Reviews (October 2025–September 2026, in English): Japan's best catering bento, delivery to Minami-za, a limited-time lunch of hamo mabushi.

公式サイト (hokkyoku.jp): 北極、なんば戎橋筋、大阪名物手作りアイ.en: Official site (hokkyoku.jp): Hokkyoku, Namba Ebisubashi-suji, Osaka's famous handmade ice candy, founded in Showa 20 (1945); the original flavours milk, azuki and pineapple, now also cocoa, strawberry, matcha, mango, ramune and grape; each one handmade by craftsmen. History: founded in Namba, Osaka in Showa 20 (¥20 then); Showa 21 (1946) imported cocoa from the occupation forces and made cocoa ice candy; Showa 27 (1952) radio commercials; Showa 28 (1953) Toho film and TV commercials; Showa 30 (1955) Hokkyoku Building completed (factory in the basement, café and light meals on 1F and 2F, also Western and Japanese sweets); the second automatic door in Namba; full house every time for 力道山 wrestling on the colour TV; Heisei 17 (2005) 久保田光恵 became representative and Arctic Co., Ltd. was set up. Company page: just after the war the founder wanted 'at least to make cold, tasty ice candy for children and women'; Namba 3-8-22, 10:30–20:00, open all year. Craft: diagonal sticks of hinoki and cedar from Yoshino, Nara; white sugar crystals, no sweeteners; 100% Tokachi azuki from Hokkaido; eight craftsmen make 6,000 a day, 700,000 a year. Products: milk, cocoa, matcha, azuki, pineapple ¥200; mixed juice, mango, strawberry, ramune, grape ¥230; cups ¥380 (mango, milk, hyuganatsu, Osaka mixed juice). Tabelog: Ice cream and gelato Tabelog 100 2023 and 2026, café on 2F from 25 April 2023, no reservations, cards and QR accepted. Reviews (October–November 2026): soft serve ¥500 (Hokkaido milk, Uji matcha, mix), 1F takeaway only, one drink per person at the 2F café, free dry ice for an hour with six, discounted ices.

公式サイト (housendo.com): あずき処 宝泉堂、一粒ひとつぶに心を.en: Official site (housendo.com): azuki house Housendo, care in every single bean; the owner personally secures Tanba black soybeans and Tanba dainagon azuki at the source every year; no preservatives; sweets made in Shimogamo; outlets: Housendo main shop, the tea house 茶寮 宝泉, Hosen Kyoto Station shop (inside the Shinkansen gates, renovated summer 2020), and Saruya at Shimogamo Shrine. Tabelog: sweets café and wagashi, 下京区東塩小路高倉町8-3, Shinkansen JR Kyoto Station 2F, on the Hachijo-side concourse inside the Shinkansen gates; shop weekdays 9:00–19:00, weekends and holidays 9:00–20:00; tea room 10:00–18:00 (last order 17:45); open every day; no reservations; 30 seats; cards, transport IC and QR accepted; Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2018–2020, 2022; Japanese sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2023, 2026. Reviews (October 2026, in English): dainagon zenzai ¥1,400, white-azuki zenzai, chestnut kinton ¥490, matcha float ¥1,300.

公式サイト (ichigonoomise.com): メゾン・ド・フルージュ 苺.en: Official site (ichigonoomise.com): メゾン・ド・フルージュ, a strawberry shop; 渡部美佳 (Mika Watabe), who, while working in fashion planning and design, was moved by how good the strawberries a friend introduced were and opened the business in 2003; strawberries ripened in the field are sent directly from contract farms; more than 100 recipes; lives in Kyoto City; adviser on strawberry development to agricultural research bodies; wants to change how strawberries are distributed. Fresh cakes: premium strawberry shortcake ¥1,430, strawberry mille-feuille ¥1,078 (two per person), strawberry tart ¥1,430, strawberry and rhubarb cheese tart ¥902, strawberry cheesecake ¥880, strawberry roll cake ¥702, tea and berry mousse ¥858, strawberry pudding ¥418. Company profile: 株式会社ミュウ, representative director 渡部美佳, founded March 2013; 中京区東洞院通三条下ル三文字町201 1F; strawberry laboratory and production atelier at 岡山県英田郡西粟倉村; opened April 2003 on 千本通り in 上京区, moved to 三条 in 中京区 in March 2014; trading partners 三越伊勢丹, 大丸松坂屋, 高島屋 and 阪急阪神百貨店. Tabelog: cakes and café; 11:00–17:00, open all year; no reservations; 9 seats; cards accepted; opened 9 March 2014; Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2023 and 2026.

公式サイト (ido-kyoto.com/koke): KOKE (コケ京都)、.en: Official site (ido-kyoto.com/koke): KOKE, IDO KYOTO 1F, with shiro on 2F; spring water from the garden well; the tea spirit of host and guests made one; staff including 中村有作 and 中村瑳智子; lunch starts 12:00/12:30, ends 14:30, ¥15,000 (tax included, service extra); dinner starts 18:00/18:30, ¥29,000 (tax included, service extra); Tue–Thu dinner, Fri–Sat lunch and dinner, Sun lunch, Mon closed; a message from 福本伸也 of Ca Sento (中村有作 goes independent in Kyoto after training at Ca Sento, with 大山達也). Tabelog: innovative, 中京区蛸薬師287 ido 1F; reservation only; no children under 12; service and fuel charge 15%; 12 seats; English menu and English-speaking staff; opened 14 April 2021; Innovative Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (April–October 2026, in English): a chef from Okinawa, Spanish technique, firewood and charcoal, non-alcoholic pairings.

公式サイト (ido-kyoto.com/shiro): 白 (しろ)、IDO.en: Official site (ido-kyoto.com/shiro): 白 (shiro), IDO KYOTO 2F (IDOCHA and KOKE on 1F); uses spring water drawn from the garden well; the concept: "shiro" is not just a colour — blank space, purity; the five rules of shiro (keep harmony, respect nature, make space, stay simple, lead to emotion); 竹中厚志 (Atsushi Takenaka): entered the culinary world at 24, opened ミアパエーゼ (Mia Paese) in Shimane at 30, selected by Gault&Millau in 2020, supervised the food on JR West's Twilight Express 瑞風 as a food artisan, moved to Kyoto in 2024 and opened as "shiro"; lunch starts 12:00 (doors 11:45), dinner starts 18:00 (doors 17:45); ¥19,800 (tax and service included); Wed–Fri dinner, Sat–Sun lunch and dinner, closed Mon–Tue. Tabelog (corporate member): The Tabelog Award 2026 Bronze, Italian WEST Tabelog 100 2025, omakase course ¥21,000, with wine pairing ¥32,000, with tea pairing ¥29,000, service charge 10%, 8 counter seats, ages 13 and up, opened 14 August 2024. Reviews (March–October 2026): fried anago with prosciutto, ingredients from Shimane and Kyoto, pairings, simultaneous start, one drink per person.

公式サイト (iharada.jp): 御料理 いはら田、下京区西七条比輪田町2.en: Official site (iharada.jp): Oryori Iharada; 下京区西七条比輪田町26 (150 m north of Nishioji-Shichijo, west side); 17:30–22:00 (last entry 20:00); closed Sunday; 9 counter seats and a second-floor room (2–20 people); smoking corner; cards accepted; fish bought at the market every morning; vegetables from the Iharada farm in Ohara; aged Tajima beef fillet (carcass-aged, bought from Chuseini); hamo, soft-shelled turtle, matsutake, crab; a 6 m single-plank hinoki counter; calligraphy by 山田秋邨; a greeting from the okami; courses ¥12,000 (¥14,520 with tax and service), ¥15,000 (¥18,150), ¥20,000 (¥24,200); about 10–11 dishes; 100% charge for same-day cancellation; elementary-school age and up; press 2003–2008; TableCheck. Tabelog (staff-maintained): Japanese cuisine; Mon–Sat 17:30–22:00; closed Sunday (except holidays) and irregularly; 30 seats (10 at the counter downstairs, 20 at tables upstairs); 10% service charge; non-smoking; opened 5 October 2002. Reviews (December 2025–November 2026, in English): mackerel and tuna sushi, soft-shelled turtle pot, hassun, aged beef, ice-cream monaka, a remark about being rushed (March 2026).

公式サイト (ikiteiru.com): 株式会社生きている珈琲、販売責任者.en: Official site (ikiteiru.com): 株式会社生きている珈琲, person responsible for sales 小林弘樹; Minoya Shijo Building B1F, 立売東町24, Shimogyo-ku; Tuesday–Sunday and public holidays 10:00–19:00, Monday 11:00–19:00; closed 31 December and 1 January; full smoking separation with walled-off smoking seats; spaces for families, couples and business meetings; Red blend 100 g ¥850 (the shop's No. 1, "when in doubt, go for the Red"); Yemen Golden Mocha, Geisha. Tabelog: kissaten, café; Shijo-dori west of Fuyacho; 50 seats; bookings on weekdays only; cards, transport IC cards and QR accepted; English menu; Wi-Fi; opened 15 January 2011; Kissaten Tabelog 100 2021, 2022, 2026. Reviews (October–November 2026, in English): 8-hour cold brew, cheesecake, fondant au chocolat, coffee float ¥980, coffee soft serve ¥700, coffee jelly ¥800, mobile ordering, a menu likening coffees to actors.

公式サイト (ilgaragekyoto.com): IL GARAGE -イル.en: Official site (ilgaragekyoto.com): IL GARAGE; on the second floor above a garage; a restaurant of just two tables; seasonal Japanese ingredients in a course that follows the season; Italian regional cooking with a pinch of creativity; hoping to express the Italy the couple lived in for five years; Masato e Midori Shirakawa; 2009–2014 Locanda San Lorenzo* (Belluno), La Torre del Saracino** (Napoli), La Madia** (Agrigento); tell the shop about allergies in advance; changes on the day may not be possible; game in autumn and winter; dislikes generally cannot be accommodated; service charge 10%; 道祐町147 2F. Tabelog (corporate member): The Tabelog Award Bronze 2025, 2026; Italian WEST Tabelog 100 2023, 2025; lunch Sat–Sun from 12:00, dinner from 18:00; closed Wednesday and irregularly; two groups per sitting; book by the day before; 8 seats (2 tables); no children; no lift; opened 17 December 2018. Reviews (January–October 2026): beef prosciutto on Pione grapes (Japanese photo caption), the husband cooks and the wife runs service and desserts, lunch ¥13,200 (service extra).

公式サイト (ilghiottone.com): 京都 笹島シェフのイタリアンレ.en: Official site (ilghiottone.com): Chef Sasajima's Italian restaurant in Kyoto; owner-chef Yasuhiro Sasajima; "what if Italy had a region called Kyoto"; one-of-a-kind Italian cooking found only in Japan; Kyoto honten (388-1 Yasaka Kamimachi, Shimogawara-dori Tonomae-sagaru, Higashiyama-ku); Pranzo A ¥6,000, B ¥8,000, C ¥12,000, D ¥16,000; Cena A ¥12,000, B ¥16,000, C ¥20,000; tax and service (5% lunch, 10% dinner) extra; children 6 and under, please ask; à la carte and kids' plates available; Officina IL GHIOTTONE KYOTO (wine shop, frozen pasta sauces); IL GHIOTTONE DI PIÙ in Grand Front Osaka. Serai (spring 2013): born in Osaka Prefecture in 1964; opened IL GHIOTTONE in Kyoto in 2002 and a Marunouchi branch in 2005. Bunshun Online (2017): chef at イル・パッパラルド; independent in 2002; "Italian sent out from Kyoto"; kombu dashi; kinome and yuzu; Kujo leek and Shogoin turnip. Tabelog: Italian, pasta, innovative; 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–20:00 (last seating); closed Tuesday and Wednesday; 45 seats; private rooms (2–12); no smoking; cards accepted; Italian WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025. Reviews (August 2025 – October 2026, in English): Pranzo B ¥8,000; Cena A ¥12,000; chitarra, orecchiette, tagliatelle with black truffle; a townhouse next to the Yasaka Pagoda; service by the chef's wife; days when one person on the floor cannot keep up.

公式サイト (ilpiatto.info): 大阪心斎橋を中心に2店舗展開するイ.en: Official site (ilpiatto.info): the Il Piatto group, two shops centred on Shinsaibashi; signature appetizer platter; carbonara, the house's origin; Shinmachi Itchome for banquets and parties, Il Piatto Higashi-Shinsaibashi (10 seats, 17:00–2:00) as a hideaway Italian; a sommelier at each shop. Shinmachi Itchome page: authentic Italian with handmade pasta and pizza baked in a stone oven; carefully sourced fish and meat; fish brought in from Kyushu and Shikoku; wines chosen by the sommelier; freshly baked pizza to take away; everything available for takeout; fully non-smoking from 1 April 2020; lunch 11:30–14:00 (L.O.), dinner 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); no closing days. Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): opened 2 May 2008; 24 seats; bread ¥400 per person; stone oven over 400 °C; handmade pasta cut to order; about 60 wines; year-end hours. Menu (September 2025): 13-item appetizer platter ¥1,730, pizzas, pastas, zuppa di pesce, lamb chops. Reviews (September–October 2026): full right at the 18:00 opening; appetizer platter; marinated octopus; daily pasta lunch; one paid ¥400 for two small pieces of bread; some found the sauce heavy or the drinks pricey.

公式サイト (ishinabeinyon.com): 韓国肉料理・石鍋 イニョン.en: Official site (ishinabeinyon.com): Korean Nikuryori Ishinabe Inyon Dotonbori; a broth of beef bones, chicken carcasses and aromatic vegetables simmered over two days; eighty years since Atariya, an offal hot-pot shop by Nishikujo Station run by a grandmother from 1945; 'food that is gentle on the body, delicious and gives strength'; English menu; smoking allowed; fully renovated October 2022; Mon and Wed–Fri 17:00–23:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); closed Tuesdays. Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Korean, izakaya, hot pot; ゼルコバトレ B1F, 2-1-8 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Namba Stn; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 35 seats; smoking allowed; opened 12 May 2021; sister restaurant Ishinabe KOH; the signature stone-pot nakkopse (octopus, shrimp, domestic offal); a rich cheese-pasta finish. Reviews (March–October 2026): shrimp, octopus and offal under a mountain of bean sprouts; spice level to choose (3 is standard); udon to finish; wagyu bulgogi hot pot; samgyeopsal; yukhoe; bossam; seafood sundubu; chijimi; jeon; japchae; chige; one diner found the yukhoe frozen and the bossam dry; another found the side dishes seemed frozen; open from 16:30 one day; one diner found a woman from Myanmar running the shop alone.

公式サイト (issen-yosyoku.co.jp): 京都祗園名物「壹錢洋食.en: Official site (issen-yosyoku.co.jp): Kyoto Gion's famous Issen Yoshoku; the original flour-based grill dish at the root of okonomiyaki; the first president, 木下辰雄, chose Kujo leek, egg and domestic wagyu and worked on the konnyaku seasoning, dashi, sauce and grilling; Kyoto-style refinement; shredded nori instead of aonori; from a small shop by the Shirakawa in Gion to the larger shop at Shijo-Nawate; maiko, geiko and entertainers came too; decor with the wit of the pleasure quarter (saucy ema and beckoning figures); mail order on Rakuten from April 2011; how it is made: wheat flour mixed with dashi, bonito flakes, Kujo leek, two size-S eggs, tenkasu, pickled ginger, seasoned konnyaku, chikuwa, domestic wagyu; normal flavour has spicy sauce inside and sweet sauce outside, also sweet or spicy; Issen Yoshoku ¥950; draft beer ¥800; Kaku highball ¥600; Denki Bran ¥600; hiyashi-ame and ramune at the honten only; Gion honten (Gion-machi Kitagawa 238, open every day; weekdays 11:00–1:00, Saturdays and days before holidays 11:00–3:00, Sundays and holidays 10:30–22:00); Kyoto Takashimaya shop (B1F, 10:00–20:00). Tabelog: okonomiyaki; no bookings; 100 seats; no smoking; children welcome; cards and PayPay accepted; Okonomiyaki Tabelog 100 2018. Reviews (August–October 2026, in English): ¥950; mannequins; Showa retro; a foreign staff member; open late at night.

公式サイト (istanbul-saray.com): オスマン宮廷料理の流れを.en: Official site (istanbul-saray.com): authentic Turkish cooking carrying on Ottoman court cuisine, one of the world's three great cuisines; the only Turkish specialist in Kyoto; 34 seats in all; bookings up to 40 people; reservations by phone; weekdays dinner 17:30–22:00; Saturday, Sunday and holidays lunch 12:00–15:00 and dinner 17:30–22:00 (closed irregularly); menu: yaprak sarma ¥1,100, karışık meze ¥1,950, soup ¥650, hummus ¥800, imam bayildi ¥980, cacık ¥750, Antep ezme ¥750 and more. Tabelog: Turkish; 中京区河原町通三条上ル恵比須町534-28 松木ビル 3F; 2 min on foot from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn; 28 seats; non-smoking; cards, PayPay, d Barai and WeChat Pay accepted; no table charge; vegetarian, gluten-free, halal and Hindu options listed; shop text: all meat certified halal; opened 9 December 2002; Asian/Ethnic WEST Tabelog 100 2022–2024 and 2026. Reviews (August–November 2026, in English): weekend lunch ¥1,800–2,650, lentil soup, meze platter, Turkish bread, kebabs, pide, rice pudding, Turkish tiles.

公式サイト (izuu.jp): いづう、天明元年 (1781年) に初代いづみ.en: Official site (izuu.jp): Izuu — founded in Tenmei 1 (1781) by the first-generation Izumiya Uhe; Kyoto specialty saba sugata-zushi; fatty chub mackerel from Japanese waters; Izuu special rice; the kombu wrapping the whole sushi is from Hokkaido; main shop 367 Yasaka-shinchi Kiyomoto-cho, Higashiyama-ku; 11:00–22:00 (Sundays and holidays to 21:00); closed Tuesday (open on holidays and event days); eat-in (tax included): saba sugata-zushi ¥2,200, kodai suzume-zushi ¥1,980, amadai sugata-zushi ¥4,400, tai-zushi ¥1,980, hamo sugata-zushi (summer) ¥5,060, grilled-anago sushi ¥1,760, futomaki ¥1,760, Kyo-chirashi ¥3,300, mushi-zushi (winter) ¥3,300, Kyo-zushi assortment ¥3,960; Daimaru Kyoto and JR Kyoto Isetan shops. Tabelog: no bookings (only takeaway saba sugata-zushi by phone from 8:00); 16 seats (4 tables of 4); oolong tea the only soft drink; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted. Reviews (August–November 2026, English): yesterday's and today's saba compared, sea bream sushi in bamboo leaf scented with yuzu, an assortment with clear soup, the ajari's straw sandals.

公式サイト (johkoya.com): 上古屋、京都 四条/烏丸駅にほど近い西.en: Official site (johkoya.com): Joko Ya — a Japanese izakaya at Nishinotoin-Takoyakushi near Shijo/Karasuma Stn; ingredients and local sake from Kyotango, the owner's hometown; 17:30–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); 2nd-floor seats to 22:30 (L.O. 22:00); closed over New Year and in summer; closed 8 October; 22 seats (8 counter, 14 table). Tabelog (shop member): izakaya / seafood / nabe; starter ¥330; 21 seats; children basically not admitted; opened 31 August 2016. Reviews (June–October 2026, English): fish from Kyotango and Maizuru, salt-seared Kyoto sawara, sashimi platter, fried gasa shrimp, squid-leg tempura, grilled saba sushi, cold shinjo, cold oden with Kyoto tomatoes, named after the chef's surname, owner from Tango.

公式サイト (jumelles29.jp): 京都・河原町のフレンチ・ネオビスト.en: Official site (jumelles29.jp): a French neo-bistro in Kawaramachi, Kyoto; 下京区綾小路通麩屋町下ル塩屋町81-1; 17:00–23:00; closed Tuesday; about 60 dishes; half portions possible; the '29' in the name comes from a love of meat; 尾崎牛 (first met at a nearby restaurant, then the farm was visited); counter seats; a wine list chosen with a sommelier; new wines about every month; private hire from 17 people; booking through the app. Menu: chickpea-paste and cheese fritters ¥770, duck breast smoked over vine cuttings ¥2,550, 尾崎牛 grill 100 g ¥2,500, smoked marinated mackerel with potato salad ¥980, rich sea urchin pudding with garlic toast ¥1,350, cacio e pepe ¥1,650, wagyu Bolognese with potato gnocchi ¥2,100, hazelnut crème brûlée ¥750; warm dishes can take about 30 minutes; ¥500 a person for the appetiser and service; glass wine from ¥550. Tabelog: bistro, Italian, meat dishes; daily 17:00–23:00; closed irregularly; 24 seats; cards, QUICPay and PayPay; non-smoking; opened 12 July 2011; Bistro Tabelog 100 2021; about 200 wines; banquet course with free drinks ¥7,000. Reviews (August–October 2026, in English): prosciutto, mackerel potato salad, spare ribs, sea urchin pudding, quiche, rabbit, on the pricey side, a plate nearly taken away too early.

公式サイト (junkissa-american.com): 純喫茶 アメリカン.en: Official site (junkissa-american.com): Junkissa American, founded in Showa 21 (1946), opened by the grandparents; at first it traded elsewhere under the name 花月, then moved to the present spot and became American; now in its third generation; the founder's words 'put every profit back into the shop'; no ready-made products, everything made by hand from top-class ingredients; a spiral staircase added in the 1963 renovation; the 1F wall of 640 pieces of wood and stained glass from Showa 50 (1975); a 川島織物 dantsu weave on the 2F walls; Italian marble; said to be the first in Osaka with double-opening automatic doors and a jukebox; the owner arranges fresh flowers once a week; six staff-only uniforms; the owner roasts the original seven-bean blend on a German Probat; flannel drip, a little strong; hot coffee ¥700, cream soda ¥830, mixed juice ¥830, hotcakes ¥760, omurice ¥1,010, Italian spaghetti ¥1,010, beef curry rice ¥1,010, beef cutlet sandwich ¥1,680, morning service (weekdays 10:00–11:00) from ¥530, lunchtime service (weekdays 11:00–14:00) ¥1,450, pudding sundae ¥990, fruit à la mode ¥1,450, anmitsu ¥950, always 16 or more cakes at ¥720; 10:00–22:00, closed 31 December and about three Thursdays a month, no reservations, 245 seats, no private hire, cards (VISA, Mastercard), no e-money, no smoking inside or outside, 5 min on foot from Namba Station, 6 min from Nihonbashi Station. Tabelog: Kissaten Tabelog 100 2021, 2022 and 2026, English menu, no photography inside (only of dishes ordered), wheelchair accessible. Reviews (October 2026): Showa retro, chandelier, uniforms, omurice, hotcakes, matcha parfait ¥1,100, mixed juice, no PayPay, photos politely refused.

公式サイト (junshinan.com): 京都・祇園花街の創味割鮮 ステーキ.en: Official site (junshinan.com): 創味割鮮 Steak House Junshin An in the Gion hanamachi, Kyoto, since 1979 kyoto; a limited number of guests a day in roomy seats; grilled over binchotan; BOSS; 東山区松原通大和大路西入ル弓矢町24-1; 18:00–23:00; closed irregularly; about 240 m from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn; menu: Kuroge wagyu charcoal steak course about 100 g ¥10,000, about 150 g ¥13,000 (DX +¥3,200); BOSS omakase course A ¥10,000, B ¥12,000, C ¥15,000, Premium; live lobster and Kuroge wagyu (book two days ahead) ¥38,000–42,000 for two; abalone steak and Kuroge wagyu ¥38,000–42,000 for two; THE Junshin An course ¥50,000–54,000 for two. Tabelog: steak, European, yoshoku; 18:00–23:00; Friday–Sunday (other days by reservation only); closed irregularly; 10% service charge; 32 seats (7 counter, tables, private rooms, 2nd floor); non-smoking; cards. Reviews (2021–2026, in English): many regulars, anniversaries, crab, lobster, fresh oysters.

公式サイト (k-coeur.com): リュミエール本店、2006年心斎橋にオ.en: Official site (k-coeur.com): lumière main restaurant, the head restaurant of the Lumière Group, opened in Shinsaibashi in 2006; top ranking in the Zagat Survey in its first year; chef Yasushi Karato; the theme is 'Vegetable Gourmet'; 99% of the sauces use no wine, butter, cream, flour or sugar; a Michelin star for 12 years running since the guide was first published; as head of the Lumière Group, 10 shops (7 run directly, 3 supervised); imports Dammann Frères; author of the book 'Vegetable Gourmet'; made a Chevalier of the Ordre du Mérite agricole in October 2026; lunch 8 dishes ¥8,800, dinner A 9 dishes ¥13,200, B 10 dishes ¥17,600, special course ¥22,000 (tax included, plus 10% service); senior sommelier; sake and vegetable cocktails; the dessert speciality 'vegetable desserts'; a fully private room; a restaurant three generations can enjoy together; Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-19-15, UNAGIDANI BLOCK 3F. Tabelog (shop-maintained): French WEST Tabelog 100 in 2021, 2023 and 2025; Tue–Sun 12:00–15:00 (L.O. 13:00), 18:00–21:00 (L.O. 19:00); closed Monday (the next day if a holiday); service charge 10%; cards accepted; 39 seats; private room; wheelchair accessible; children welcome (preschoolers in the private room); over 200 wines; opened 20 December 2006. Reviews (February–October 2026): a soup of 20 vegetables, the Crystal Amusement Park, foie gras, Karato bread, a vegetable dessert of komatsuna, celery, burdock and daikon; the main course is chosen with supplements; the ¥8,800 lunch came to about double with supplements and drinks; one diner came from Nagoya; birthdays and family celebrations.

公式サイト (k-stage.jp): ザ ノーザンライツコーナー、Northe.en: Official site (k-stage.jp): The Northern Lights Corner; Northern Lights, a curtain of light like the aurora; opened as a bar for a light drink from midday; Shinkyogoku Hanayu Koji; terrace seats in front of the entrance; from beer to proper cocktails; open 15:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); 565-23 Nakanocho, Shinkyogoku Shijo-agaru, Nakagyo-ku, Kyoto. Company history: 1976 the Finnish restaurant FINLANDIA; 1982 Gion FINLANDIA BAR; 2002 K-stage Co., Ltd. founded; August 2013 The Northern Lights Corner and Bar The Northern Lights opened (Bar The Northern Lights upstairs closed in December 2021); first opened at 2 pm (now 3 pm). Tabelog: bar; 15:00–23:00; bookings taken; no cover charge; standing (terrace seats); 16 places; smoking allowed; cards and QR accepted; the first standing bar from Gion's Finlandia. Reviews (December 2024 – October 2026, in English): Earl Grey gin and tonic ¥1,300; yuzu gin and tonic ¥1,300; seasonal fruit Bellini; potato bread; cream cheese with rum raisins; a young manager; bartender Nakagawa; smoking allowed inside.

公式サイト (k-stage.jp): ザ・コモン・ワン・バー・キョウト、白川の.en: Official site (k-stage.jp): ザ・コモン・ワン・バー・キョウト, another world down an alley off the stone paving by the Shirakawa; a one-slab counter; cocktails with seasonal fruit, whisky, wine; cover charge ¥1,100; private rooms by reservation at ¥1,700; 18:00–02:00 (last order 01:30); 東山区新橋通大和大路東入元吉町46番地, inside 何生館. Company profile: 株式会社ケイ・ステージ, representative 世古昌弘; 2002, takes over the running of ぎをん FINLANDIA BAR; August 2010, opens 何生館 in a townhouse over 100 years old by the Shirakawa in Gion, and the bar at the same time; 2013, The Northern Lights Corner; 2016, TurQuois Bar 2 (later Turquoise Bar); 2021, 何生庵; 2023, sets up アルコ・ノルディック (importing コスケンコルヴァ vodka). Tabelog: bar; 25 seats; private rooms (4 and 6 people); smoking allowed; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); opened 23 August 2010; sister shop of ぎをん FINLANDIA BAR; Bar Tabelog 100 2022. Reviews (2026, in English): seasonal fruit cocktails, Martini, Rob Roy, single malt, non-alcoholic cocktails; two drinks and the cover ¥4,700 (May 2026).

公式サイト (kagizen.co.jp): 江戸中期より八坂神社の門前で祇園と.en: Official site (kagizen.co.jp): Kagizen Yoshifusa, walking with Gion at the gate of Yasaka Shrine since the mid-Edo period; at the Shijo honten and the 高台寺店, the famous kuzukiri that keeps an Edo tradition, and wagashi of the four seasons; ZEN CAFE; ZENBI Kagizen Yoshifusa KAGIZEN ART MUSEUM; museum shop Zplus; no change to November and December hours (October 2026 notice). Tabelog: sweets café, wagashi and café, 東山区祇園町北側264; shop 9:30–18:00; tea room 10:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); closed Monday (the next day if a holiday); no reservations for the tea room; 62 seats; cards, WAON and PayPay accepted; Sweets Tabelog 100 2017; Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2018–2020, 2022; Japanese sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2023, 2026. Reviews (October–November 2026, in English): kuzukiri, black and white syrup, warabi mochi, matcha, Kagimochi, weekend queues.

公式サイト (kaisekioui.tokyo): 大人の隠れ家 四ツ谷 会席応.en: Official site (kaisekioui.tokyo): an adult hideaway, Yotsuya Kaiseki Oui; counter seats and a semi-private room in a calm Japanese space; carefully chosen seasonal ingredients served as courses; inventive dishes from an owner unbound by convention; wine, sake and craft beer; lunch courses ¥3,000, ¥5,000, ¥7,000; omakase course 7–8 dishes ¥7,950, 10 dishes ¥9,980, top course 10 dishes ¥13,000 (tax included); please consult us about allergies; owner 宮島央一, who drew on experience abroad to train at shops of many genres, chiefly creative Japanese and kaiseki, sushi and Italian; lunch 11:30–14:00, dinner 17:30–22:00; closed Mondays and holidays, Sundays lunch only; 6th anniversary on 8 October 2026; アーバンビルサカス5 1B, Yotsuya 1-2-6. Tabelog (shop member): opened 8 October 2020; 10 seats (6 at the counter, one semi-private room for up to 4); A5 beef sukiyaki; same-day cancellations charged in full. Reviews (July 2025–October 2026): a narrow lane, leftover clay-pot rice made into onigiri, chocolate cake, cooking visible from the counter, lunch sometimes fully booked, à la carte sukiyaki ¥2,000, matsutake soup, one diner says the name comes from Hokusai.

公式サイト (kameya-yoshinaga.com): 創業1803年の京菓.en: Official site (kameya-yoshinaga.com): Kyoto confectioner Kameya Yoshinaga, founded 1803; brands Kameya Yoshinaga, Satomi Fujita and 吉村和菓子店; ubatama, sliced yokan, monaka, shiruko, summer sweets, rice-cake sweets, baked sweets, senbei, higashi, yokan; wagashi-making classes; SOU・SOU × Kameya Yoshinaga; phone 9:00–17:30 (closed 1–3 January). Tabelog: wagashi; 下京区四条通油小路西入柏屋町17-19; 351 m from Omiya Stn; shop 9:30–18:00, tea room 11:00–17:00; closed 1–2 January; 4 seats (2 tables); cards, e-money and QR; takeaway; a 吉村和菓子店 corner at the back; menu (updated January 2026): ubatama (6) ¥540. Reviews (August–October 2026, in English): ubatama (Hateruma black sugar), An no Hako, Kyo Monaka, Ichiyo Raifuku, Hane Usagi shiruko ¥540, founded 1803, an offshoot of Kameya Yoshian, some gluten-free products.

公式サイト (kameyakiyonaga.co.jp): 京御菓子司 亀屋清永.en: Official site (kameyakiyonaga.co.jp): Kyoto confectioner 亀屋清永, said to have been founded in Genna 3 (1617), living north of Sanjo on Teramachi with the trade name 亀屋冶兵衛, later 亀屋清永; the 1842 "Gosho makimono"; the seijō kankidan, a Tang confection brought by envoys in the Nara period and the root of Kyoto sweets; supplier to many temples and shrines; main shop in front of Yasaka Shrine's west gate (south of the Gion stone steps, Higashiyama-ku); 8:30–17:00; closed every Wednesday (other irregular days; in November 2026 the 4th, 11th, 12th, 18th, 19th and 25th); seijō kankidan and buto; Kyoto kintsuba "Ginkaku"; Kuri kuri; seasonal wagashi; online shop; main ingredients sugar, azuki, wheat flour and sesame oil (2024 price-revision notice); special sales at the 78th Shōsōin exhibition. Tabelog: wagashi; 祇園石段下南側534; Monday, Tuesday and Thursday–Sunday 8:30–17:30, closed Wednesday; cards, e-money and QR accepted; Japanese sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2026. Reviews (September–October 2026, in English): seijō kankidan ¥750 for one, ¥1,620 for two; Ginkaku ¥518; Kuri kuri ¥205; dorayaki; plaques of temple and shrine patronage.

公式サイト (kameyamutsu.jp): 1421年創業、京都・西本願寺前.en: Official site (kameyamutsu.jp): Kameya Mutsu, an old wagashi shop in front of Nishi Hongan-ji, Kyoto, founded 1421; supplier of offerings to Hongan-ji; founded by tradition in 1421; supplying offerings from around the time of 蓮如; the prototype of matsukaze born during the siege of the 石山合戦; named matsukaze when Hongan-ji moved to 六条堀川 in 1591 (from a poem by 顕如); around 1660 received a cypress turtle linked to Toyotomi Hideyoshi; in 1715 the court title 陸奥大掾; silver at the 1900 Paris Exposition; Kameya Mutsu Co., Ltd. founded in 1964; matsukaze: wheat flour, sugar, malt syrup and white miso fermented naturally, baked in a pan about 45.5 cm across and sprinkled with poppy seeds; 西六條寺内松風 (hama-natto); value bags; Ikujaku (rakugan); 滴翠 (fu-yaki senbei); seasonal sweets only at the main shop; 下京区西中筋通七条上る菱屋町153; 8:30–17:00 (closed Wednesday); in front of the Shichijo-Horikawa bus stop; about 12 min walk from Kyoto Stn; also sold at Nishi Hongan-ji shops, Kyoto Takashimaya, JR Kyoto Isetan and others; selected for Tabelog Wagashi & Kanmi WEST Tabelog 100 2026 (29 September 2026). Tabelog: wagashi; takeaway only; closed 1–3 January; cards, e-money and QR. Reviews (June–October 2026, in English): matsukaze 8 pieces ¥700, monaka ¥220, value bags.

公式サイト (karil.jp): 京都・新町丸太町のカレー製作所「カリル」、オ.en: Official site (karil.jp): Kyoto Curry Seisakusho Kariru at Shinmachi-Marutamachi, Kyoto; 'fragrant umami' from layered original spices; lunch 11:00–15:00, dinner 17:00–20:30 (L.O. 20:00); lunch only on Saturday and holidays; closed Sunday and irregularly; no children under junior-high age because the curry is fairly spicy; takeaway at the in-shop price + ¥100; October's monthly curry, oyster curry ¥1,800; chicken curry ¥1,100, pork curry ¥1,100, butter chicken curry ¥1,250, beef curry ¥1,500, keema curry ¥1,100, bean and vegetable curry ¥1,000, spice egg ¥150; allergens: beef, pork, chicken, milk, wheat, soy, cashew; 上京区新町通丸太町上ル春帯町349-1; about 4 min walk from exit 2 of Marutamachi Stn. Tabelog: curry, Indian curry; no reservations; 21 seats; non-smoking; opened 3 March 2015; Curry WEST Tabelog 100 2023, 2024, 2026. Reviews (September–November 2026, in English): oyster curry, mushroom curry, queues, mini salad and mango lassi set +¥50.

公式サイト (kashi.wabiya.com): 菓子wabiya、京都花見小.en: Official site (kashi.wabiya.com): Kashi wabiya — sweets from 侘家古暦堂, which runs a restaurant on Hanamikoji in Kyoto, worked out in conversation between its head chef and a pâtissier; naturally, carefully, making the most of the ingredients; cheese soufflé 'chef's hat' ¥303, Tanba chestnut ¥454 (autumn only); red-egg pudding cake; thin tuiles; nut cookies 'Gion Konomi'; amber nougat bar; reward crêpes (hojicha and Tanba chestnut, red-egg caramel); savoury crêpe of hojicha, prosciutto and persimmon (Nishi-Hanamikoji shop only); Osaka Takashimaya, Kyoto Takashimaya and Nishi-Hanamikoji shops. Tabelog: sweets / crêpes / galettes; 570-123 Gion-machi Minamigawa, Higashiyama-ku; shop 10:00–17:00, café 11:00–17:00 (L.O. 16:30); closed Wednesday; bookings taken; 6 seats (counter only); English menu; non-smoking; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; opened 29 October 2025; charcoal-roasted coffee from Ogawa Coffee. Reviews (April–October 2026, English): rice-flour crêpes, caramel made in front of you, kakigori, fig, cheese and basil crêpe.

公式サイト (kasyou.jp): 中国料理 華祥、左京区田中里ノ内町41-1.en: Official site (kasyou.jp): Chinese restaurant 華祥; 左京区田中里ノ内町41-1 (second house north of the Higashioji–Mikage-dori crossing, east side); 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–21:30; closed Wednesday; the owner, 田口 茂雄, died on 16 May 2021; named a Contemporary Master Craftsman by the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare in fiscal 2017; awarded the Medal with Yellow Ribbon in the spring honours of 2020; 田口 弥生: "my husband has passed away", "from now on I will carry on Kasho with my son"; "egg-white ankake fried rice" on the cover of Leaf's April–May issue; unpairō and bang bang chicken sauces sold online; 株式会社 華祥企画. Tabelog: Chinese, ramen; 2 min on foot from Mototanaka Stn; Mon, Tue, Fri, Sat, Sun 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday; reservations for dinner only; no cards or e-money; PayPay and au PAY accepted; no service or table charge; 32 seats (12 at the counter on the ground floor, tables upstairs); non-smoking; Chinese WEST Tabelog 100 2021 and 2024; moved here from 田中門前町. Reviews (July–October 2026, in English): egg-white ankake fried rice ¥1,100, ankake yakisoba ¥1,100 (large ¥1,300), cheese spring rolls two for ¥700, lunch set ¥1,300, Kyoto-style Chinese, an owner called "Waka".

公式サイト (katsui1999.com): 洋食Katsui 山の辺の道、御.en: Official site (katsui1999.com): four shops, 洋食Katsui 山の辺の道, 御堂筋ロッヂ, 柳本駅中食堂 ピクトン and 喫茶マウンテン; the Katsui family; 'Whether you are hungry or want a drink, we welcome you with plenty of hors d'oeuvres and yoshoku.' 御堂筋ロッヂ: Osaka Toyota Building B1F, Minami-Senba 4-3-11, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Shinsaibashi Station exit 3 (Midosuji side); lunch Wed–Fri 11:00–14:30 (last order 14:00), Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30); dinner Wed–Sat 17:00–21:30 (last order 21:00), Sun and holidays 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:30); closed Mon and Tue (holidays closed too); weekdays primary-school age and up; Sat, Sun and holidays younger children welcome too (from July 2021). Lunch is set meals only: Western-style bento (weekdays, 15 a day) ¥2,000, hamburg steak (weekdays) ¥2,000, fried shrimp 3 for ¥2,000 or 5 for ¥2,800, combination (grilled black wagyu and fried shrimp, weekends and holidays) ¥2,800, grilled black-wagyu loin ¥2,800, fried shrimp and cream croquette ¥2,200, grilled Yamagata pork belly ¥2,000, power lunch (salt-grilled black-wagyu loin) ¥4,500. Dinner: hors d'oeuvre platter ¥1,600, Tasmanian salmon marinade ¥1,600, fried shrimp (2) ¥1,600, grilled black-wagyu loin ¥3,000, black-wagyu fillet beef cutlet ¥4,000, special omurice ¥1,650, main-dish courses ¥4,800–10,000; to take home, grilled black-wagyu bento ¥2,500, minced-cutlet sandwich ¥2,000, black-wagyu fillet cutlet sandwich ¥4,500; tax included. Tabelog: reservations accepted; weekend and holiday lunch in two sittings, from 11:30 and from 13:30; no charge; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; non-smoking; no strollers; takeaway; opened 19 September 2011; Tabelog Yoshoku 100 in 2020, 2022 and 2023, Yoshoku WEST 100 in 2025. Reviews (October 2024–October 2026): free rice refills, pork miso soup, pickled plum, fried shrimp with tartare you can eat head and all, grilled black wagyu fragrant with sansho, hamburg on an iron plate with demi-glace and a poached egg, seafood gratin, Yujiro, pudding, garlic rice, a mountain-hut interior, full by noon on Saturday.

公式サイト (kawa-cafe.com、日本語・英語・フランス語): Sinc.en: Official site (kawa-cafe.com, in Japanese, English and French): since 2012; a Kyoto townhouse facing the Kamo River; terrace seats in the riverside-platform season; non-stop service from breakfast, brunch, lunch, sweets and tea, a pre-dinner drink, dinner to bar time; French bistro food, sweets and Japanese dishes; open daily from 10:00 to midnight (until 23:00 in English and French); private hire; preserving Kyoto's architectural heritage and resources. Tabelog: café, bistro, bar; 下京区木屋町通松原上ル美濃屋町176-1; daily 10:00–23:30; closed irregularly; no reservations; 20 seats; no cards, e-money or QR; non-smoking. Reviews (May–October 2026, in English): the shop cat Kawa-chan, the Kamo River view, terrace seats until September with a ¥300 seat charge, pear tart ¥950, iced chai ¥700, shandy gaff ¥900, quiche, galettes, pasta, pizza, ramen, staff from abroad, complaints about service.

公式サイト (kawaguchi-9489.com): 心斎橋かわぐち、心斎橋の.en: Official site (kawaguchi-9489.com): Shinsaibashi Kawaguchi, a Tabelog 100 yakitori shop grilling morning-slaughtered jidori over charcoal in a Shinsaibashi alley, 3 min on foot from Shinsaibashi Station, selected six times for Yakitori Tabelog 100 (2018, 2019, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024); a six-cut sashimi platter of morning-slaughtered jidori (breast, thigh, tender, heart, gizzard, liver); charcoal offal skewers (liver soft and melting, heart juicy); tamahimo shigure-ni; Tokushima jii-jii shiitake; rice with raw egg to finish; ¥6,000 course (¥6,600); seasoned liver sashimi ¥850; 14 seats at the counter and small private rooms; reservations essential; Mon–Sun 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30); no parking; cards JCB, AMEX, Diners; no e-money or QR; smoking allowed inside; Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-19-11, ピテカントロプスビル 1F. Tabelog: yakitori, chicken dishes, creative, reservations through the official site, private rooms (4, 6, 8), particular about sake, shochu and wine. Reviews (April 2025–October 2026): the sashimi platter is a must, white liver, chicken tail, tsukune, tender with wasabi, truffle salt bread, keema curry, dashimaki with meat, rice with raw egg, always full so book ahead, some have come for over ten years, Ise Akadori (October 2026).

公式サイト (kichikichi.com): ザ・洋食屋・キチキチ、オムライス.en: Official site (kichikichi.com): The Yoshoku-ya Kichi Kichi — making the world Happy with omurice; the master (Motokichi Yukimura); a fan club; a music release; omurice events abroad; a booking page. Tabelog: yoshoku; Sanjo Pontocho-sagaru, Nakagyo-ku; Tue–Fri 17:00–21:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–14:00 and 17:00–21:00; closed Monday; reservation only (through the official site); one-hour seating; late arrivals cancelled automatically; 16 seats (8 counter, 8 booth); no smoking; children welcome; English menu; vegetarian options; cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 2 December 1978; being able to order what you want, when you want, in the amount you want is the gateway to deliciousness. Reviews (March 2021 – February 2026, in English): omurice ¥2,700 (2021), ¥3,000 (2026); the master's performance; demi-glace sauce; cream croquette; chicken poêlé; the omurice song; online booking opens 9:00 for lunch and 13:00 for dinner and fills in minutes; many overseas guests.

公式サイト (kichisen-kyoto.com): 京懐石 吉泉、茶懐石の流.en: Official site (kichisen-kyoto.com): Kyo Kaiseki Kichisen, traditional hospitality cooking in the line of tea kaiseki, seasonal ingredients from all over Japan, the Tadasu no Mori woods; master of the house Yoshimi Tanigawa: knew the joy of cooking at 9 and came to Kyoto at 15; met some 50 teachers (tea ceremony, flower arrangement, incense, calligraphy, poetry); head chef of a ryotei in Saga-Arashiyama at 26; in 1983, at 31, opened 'Kichisen' in a corner of a hotel, and two years later 'Kyo Kaiseki Kichisen' in Shimogamo; The New York Times in 1986; in 1999 beat 森本正治 in the hamo battle on Iron Chef; Michelin two stars 2010–2013, three stars 2014–2019; the menu begins with a cup of sake; dew is sprinkled on the bowl lids with a tea whisk; dashi of kombu and bonito. Tabelog (shop-maintained): Japanese cuisine, 下鴨森本町5; lunch entry at 12:00 only, dinner entry at 18:00 only; closed irregularly; 17 seats; private rooms; kids' menu; service charge 10%; The Tabelog Award Bronze, Silver 2018; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023. Reviews (March 2025–August 2026, in English): Sakura-yu, tuna sushi, Matsutake, a Jakuchu scroll.

公式サイト (kicko.jp): 鮨割烹 六本木亀甲、日本全国の漁場や市場から.en: Official site (kicko.jp): Sushi Kappo Roppongi Kicko; heartfelt hospitality with seasonal ingredients chosen daily from fishing grounds and markets across Japan; seats are limited, so please book; owner Kasai. Menu, 'Kame' course ¥13,000 (¥14,520 total): starter, three obanzai, two sashimi, two first nigiri (e.g. sumi-ika, madai), seasonal grilled fish, seasonal chawanmushi, five later nigiri (e.g. masunosuke, kohada, sea urchin, natural hon-maguro lean and chutoro), kanpyo roll, miso soup, tamagoyaki. Tabelog (shop-maintained): Roppongi 4-5-7, スタジオD 1F; Mon–Sat 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Sundays and holidays; irregular closures; reservation only; 10% service included; 8 seats (counter 4, one private room); heated tobacco in the private room only; cards accepted; English- and Chinese-speaking staff; children's menu from ¥5,000. Turned from obanzai kaiseki into sushi kaiseki in summer 2023; Kame course ¥15,730, Kō course ¥21,780, Goku course from ¥27,830. Reviews (September 2025–May 2026): hairy crab; botan shrimp in Shaoxing wine; whale; red-vinegar shari; hairy-crab and karasumi chawanmushi; crab and sea-urchin risotto; a chef from Muroran who has worked in China and Okinawa.

公式サイト (kikunoi.jp): 菊乃井本店、昼懐石16,500円・22,.en: Official site (kikunoi.jp): Kikunoi Honten; lunch kaiseki ¥16,500, ¥22,000 (shorter courses), ¥33,000, ¥55,000, ¥77,000, ¥110,000; dinner kaiseki ¥33,000, ¥55,000, ¥77,000, ¥110,000 (a shorter ¥22,000 course too); tax included, 15% service extra; bookings 10:00–22:00; entry 12:00–12:30 at lunch and 17:00–19:30 at dinner; closed the first and third Tuesday (and over the New Year; may change by month); three stars in the Michelin Guide Kyoto Osaka 2024, 2025 and 2026; also 露庵, 赤坂菊乃井 and 無碍山房. Tabelog (corporate member): 東山区下河原通八坂鳥居前下ル下河原町459; a ryotei founded in the first year of Taisho; third generation; 120 seats in 10 tatami rooms; smoking area; parking; cards accepted; The Tabelog Award Bronze; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025. Reviews (August–November 2026, in English): a menu that changes monthly, Matsutake and hamo dobin-mushi, ayu with roe shown before grilling, tuna with egg-yolk soy sauce, a room with Ito Jakuchu screens, some found booking easy.

公式サイト (kinmata.com): 創業1801年 (享和元年) の京懐石.en: Official site (kinmata.com): Kyoto kaiseki restaurant founded in 1801 (Kyowa 1); a Kyoto townhouse that is a registered tangible cultural property; began as the regular inn of medicine merchants from Omi; the first 又八 opened the inn as 近江屋 and in the time of the fourth 又八 it was renamed 近又; ingredients from Nishiki Market; the small counter 近また serves mini kaiseki and tempura at lunch, and at dinner tempura courses or the head chef's special course including teppanyaki. Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; 407, Nakagyo Ward; 5 min walk from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn; lunch 12:00–13:30, dinner 17:30–19:00 (last entry; counter lunch to 13:00, counter dinner from 18:00); closed mainly Wednesday, irregularly; service charge 15%; tatami-room lunch kaiseki ¥10,000, ¥15,000 and ¥20,000; 50 seats (9 at the counter and six tatami rooms); non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted. Reviews (February 2023–September 2026, English): the seventh and eighth generations; tempura-bowl lunch ¥2,200–5,750; sesame-tofu tempura; the counter's Uni Bread; hojicha dashi chazuke; one diner waited about 50 minutes for a tempura bowl.

公式サイト (kitapan.com): 手づくりパンの店 き多や、心斎橋・南船.en: Official site (kitapan.com): Kitaya, a shop of handmade bread, baking in Shinsaibashi, Minami-Senba and Honmachi; Minami-Senba 2-8-14; open from 8:00 until sold out; closed Sundays and holidays; the Kitapan newsletter (a monthly sheet); March 2026: sakura anpan and coffee; June 2026: bánh mì is a standard; 19 July–16 August 2026 summer holiday; September 2026: bitter melon × curry; October 2026: new-season wheat; December 2025: stollen; January 2026: 'besides safety and security, we will work hard at making delicious bread and a good shop'. Tabelog: bread and sandwiches, Mon–Fri 8:00–17:00, Sat 8:00–16:00, closed Sundays, takeaway only, no cards or e-money, QR accepted, non-smoking. Reviews (April–October 2026): opened 2000, a second shop nearby, the special curry bread with curry simmered for a whole day ¥420, mentaiko French ¥360, walnut-apple ¥340, loaves from one slice, French bread of new-season Tokachi wheat ¥247, a rusk for following on Instagram, a handwritten newsletter, run by a couple, and per a friend the founder, once a chef of Spanish cuisine, runs it with a Spanish spouse.

公式サイト (kiwa-group.co.jp): 柚子元 先斗町、柚子を使った.en: Official site (kiwa-group.co.jp): 柚子元 Pontocho; dishes and drinks made with yuzu; a small, cute shop in a renovated Kyoto townhouse in the historic Pontocho geisha district; counter on the first floor, tatami seating on the second; 11:30–14:00 L.O. and 17:00–22:00 (21:00 L.O.); closed Tuesday; 48 seats; private rooms; cards, QR and e-money accepted; non-smoking; takeaway and Uber Eats; 鍋屋町212, north of Shijo on Pontocho, Nakagyo-ku. Menu (March 2025, with tax): yuzu nabe (per person, from two servings): black-wagyu yuzu shabu ¥4,800, shrimp and sea bream ¥3,300, sea bream ¥3,000, pork ¥2,800, chicken ¥2,800; yuzu noodles ¥1,380–1,800; green-yuzu and yellow-yuzu gyoza (8 for ¥1,000, 6 for ¥750, 4 for ¥500); sea bream yurin, fried chicken, yuzu cabbage, smashed cucumber, yuzu sake. Tabelog: Chinese, hot pot, izakaya; 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed Tuesday; two-hour seating; ¥3,000 a head for same-day cancellations and no-shows; service charge; vegetarian options; opened 16 July 2005. Reviews (December 2025–October 2026, in English): pork yuzu nabe, sea bream nabe, two kinds of yuzu gyoza, noodles and porridge to finish, steep stairs, many guests from abroad.

公式サイト (koga-kyoto.jp): RESTAURANT KOGA、シ.en: Official site (koga-kyoto.jp): RESTAURANT KOGA — chef Koga Ryuji; born in Fukuoka Prefecture; after École Tsuji's school in France, trained in regional France; from 2006 at Joël Robuchon (Ebisu), then Le Chabichou, Villa Archange, Ledoyen; in 2016 the first Japanese deputy head chef and menu developer at Le Cinq under Christian Le Squer; back in Japan in 2019 as head chef of the Four Seasons Hotel Kyoto; a total art in which space, service and cuisine come together; lunch ¥12,000, dinner ¥22,000 (tax included, 10% service); Lunch 12:00–13:00 L.O., Dinner 18:00–19:30 L.O.; closed every Tuesday and Wednesday; cannot cater for vegetarians or vegans. Tabelog: French; 230 Naka-Ogawa-cho, Ogawa-dori Imadegawa-agaru, Kamigyo-ku; a renovated 120-year-old machiya; 32 seats, private room for 16; sommelier; English menu; BYO allowed; opened 9 January 2025; 100% charge for same-day cancellation. Reviews (August–October 2026, English): warm vegetable salad, freshly baked soufflé, one Michelin star (2026 edition), pairing 60 ml ¥8,000 / 30 ml ¥6,000.

公式サイト (kokyu-kyoto.com): 京都 出町柳の日本料理店 弧玖.en: Official site (kokyu-kyoto.com): Kokyu, a Japanese restaurant at Demachiyanagi, Kyoto; time to feel the season and touch Japanese culture through the food; where the Kamo and Takano rivers meet, near Shimogamo Shrine and the Kyoto Imperial Palace Park; 9 counter seats and one private room (up to 6); reservation only, by phone by the day before; TableCheck; the phone connects most easily 9–11, 14:30–17:30 and 20:30–23:00; non-smoking; no strong perfume; children under 10 in the private room; cancellation 50% the day before, 100% on the day; lunch from 12:00, dinner from 18:00; closed Mondays and irregularly; guests from abroad should book through their hotel; omakase ¥14,000; prices are not fixed, ask by phone. Tabelog: Japanese cuisine, 上京区青龍町204; no cards; opened 21 October 2015; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021. Reviews (March 2025–September 2026, in English): owner Sho Maeda, ten years at Sakurada; lunch course ¥16,500; a Matsutake course; run by a couple.

公式サイト (konamondokoro-mitsukuni.com): 粉もん.en: Official site (konamondokoro-mitsukuni.com): Konamon Dokoro Mitsukuni Ura Namba, a 'one rank above' okonomiyaki shop in Namba-Sennichimae, Osaka; a special recipe perfected by the head chef through trial and error; 100% Japanese wheat; a fragrant Kyoto-style bonito dashi; about ten kinds of monjayaki such as gratin, black-sesame tantan and Genovese; fresh yakisoba noodles sent straight from the noodle works that is the shop's parent company; every KENZO ESTATE wine; 響, 山崎 and 白州; horigotatsu-style tables; Namba Sennichimae 3-18, 中村ビル 2F; 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); no courses at lunch; no closing day; cards, e-money and transport IC cards. Menu: one drink and one dish per person; Japanese yen or card; two hours when busy; lunch limited to 90 minutes; allergy pictograms; pork okonomiyaki ¥1,300, shrimp ¥1,800, scallop ¥2,000, mozzarella ¥1,900, seafood special ¥2,700; fresh-noodle modern-yaki from pork ¥1,600 to seafood special ¥3,000; Genovese monja ¥2,700; white-miso Mitsukuni monja with melting mochi ¥2,800; Sichuan mapo monja ¥2,600. Tabelog (shop member): Okonomiyaki Tabelog 100 2025, 40 seats, smoking area for heated tobacco only, private hire, children welcome. Reviews (September–October 2026): booking recommended, all horigotatsu seats, plenty of seafood, fluffy batter, thick chewy yakisoba, staff cook the monja, Genovese, courses with all-you-can-drink, many overseas customers.

公式サイト (ksix.jp): Bar K6、京都市中京区木屋町二条東入ル ヴ.en: Official site (ksix.jp): Bar K6, Vals Building 2F, east of Kiyamachi on Nijo, Nakagyo-ku, Kyoto; 18:00–2:00; closed Monday and Tuesday; staff blog (through November 2026); 角打酒場KASK (open every day 14:00–2:00); Cave de K (15:00–0:00, closed Tuesday). Tabelog: bar, dining bar; 東生洲町481, Vals Building 2F, east of Kiyamachi on Nijo-dori, Nakagyo-ku; 5 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Station; Wednesday–Sunday 18:00–2:00; 40 seats; smoking allowed; cards and e-money accepted; opened 24 March 1994; Bar Tabelog 100 2022. Reviews (April–September 2026, in English): gin and tonic, cocktails, whisky, cigars, ¥550 charge at the counter, last food order 1:00, liver pâté, kinmedai carpaccio.

公式サイト (kudan-shabushabu.com): 人形町駅徒歩2分、黒.en: Official site (kudan-shabushabu.com): 2 min from Ningyocho Station; all-you-can-eat shabu-shabu of Black Wagyu and Japanese pork; in summer a spicy mala shabu-shabu; all meat cut to order; Black Wagyu, Saga beef, Iwate's Iwachu pork; six broths built on a house additive-free dashi of kombu and bonito (kombu, Japanese dashi, sukiyaki, medicinal, mala, soy milk), chosen one per person; vegetables all-you-can-eat from the vegetable bar by the counter; dashi-maki tamago ¥660, tripe sashimi ¥380, daily roast beef ¥980; 5–6 kinds of the 青梅 local sake 澤乃井 at all times; autumn hiyaoroshi ¥1,200 a gō; Black Wagyu all-you-can-eat course ¥6,500; Wagyu & Iwachu pork set ¥3,780; two IH burners per table; mobile ordering; private hire for up to 18; 人形町共同ビル 1F, Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 3-6-7. Tabelog (shop member): Tue–Fri 12:00–14:30 and 18:00–22:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 17:00–22:00, closed Monday; 18 seats; opened 23 July 2014; menu (updated 1 November 2026): Iwachu pork set ¥3,580, Wagyu & Iwachu pork set ¥4,100, Black Wagyu chuck eye roll set ¥4,780, special Black Wagyu set ¥6,600, all-you-can-eat ¥5,650 and ¥6,700. Reviews (October 2025–October 2026): meat cut for each order; self-serve vegetables; at lunch a hot pot of about ¥1,000 with free salad and rice; the owner or manager working alone; soy-milk hot pot, tomato-cheese hot pot; marbled beef.

公式サイト (kusunoki-official.co.jp): しあわせの源、.en: Official site (kusunoki-official.co.jp): the source of happiness; its hallmark is draining the oil, so the paper shows no oil stain through a course of about 2½ hours; kuruma prawn is the only item served all year; the best ingredients from Toyosu market; Tabelog Silver 2020–2025, Tabelog 100 2023 and 2025, OAD 17th in 2024 and 16th in 2025; Kusunoki, both the representative and the lead craftsman, entered a kappo restaurant at 16, trained in ryotei, and as sous-chef was given the tempura shop inside a ryotei; appeared on a regional TV programme in Kita-ku, Nagoya; moved to Yotsuya, Tokyo; sold bento during the April 2020 closure; 橋本祐輔 became the third fryer; the 20th anniversary on 13 September 2023. Careermap: Kusunoki Co., Ltd., representative director 楠忠師 (クスノキタダシ), フローラ四谷 1F, Yotsuya 1-9-4; Tempura Kusunoki Nakameguro; 12 employees. Tabelog (shop member): reservation only; courses Wed–Fri from 18:00 and Sat from 13:00, tendon Sat 18:00–19:40; closed Mondays and Sundays; 6 seats (counter); opened 14 June 2018. Reviews (August–October 2026): bara tendon fried by apprentices ¥5,500 (¥5,940 with one dish), 35 minutes, 200 g of rice, Taiwanese tea, a hinoki counter, an ice-cooled refrigerator, sea-urchin tempura.
