公式サイト (kyo-kinana.com): 店主 大本勝司のあいさつ「きなな.en: Official site (kyo-kinana.com): the greeting of owner 大本勝司: "kinana is kinako ice cream"; more than 20 years ago ran the restaurant 一碗, shaped by the Slow Food idea; its after-meal kinako ice cream is the root; Tanba black-soybean kinako; no chemical colourings or preservatives; low fat; no eggs, so suitable for guests with egg allergy; the restaurant 一碗 on the ground floor, the sweets café on the first floor; not something that looks good only because it is "Kyoto" or "Gion", but ice cream truly gentle on the body and delicious. Shop: 570-119, Gion, Higashiyama-ku; a lane one street west of Hanamikoji; with its own workshop; 12:00–last order 17:30 (closing 18:00); irregular closing days (next month's posted on Instagram around the 20th); first floor counter and tables, 18 seats; reservations take priority; cashless payment only (no cash); no smoking; children under 12 not admitted; wheelchair users can ask two weeks ahead to be served in the separate ground-floor shop. Ingredients: milk, cream, sugar, glucose, kinako (soy), skim milk powder, starch, agar, konjac flour. Menu: freshly made kinana drink set ¥1,400; three-scoop set ¥1,600; kinana hapon ¥1,600; kinana italian ¥1,600; kinana tiramisu ¥1,700; a day's vegetables plate ¥2,600 (last order 14:00); black syrup and kinako ice ¥1,800; Uji kintoki ¥2,100. The 一碗 page: 21 years in Gion; kinana remade last autumn with fewer seats and bookings; 味司一碗 reopened on the ground floor after 21 years; 6 counter seats; reservation only; omakase course ¥10,000. Instagram notice: October bookings paused; days, hours, menu and whether to keep reservations under review. Tabelog: kanmidokoro, gelato, café; 12:00–17:30; closed Thursday; reservations take priority; cashless only; 18 seats; no children under 6; English menu; Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2018–2020, 2022; Wagashi WEST Tabelog 100 2026. Reviews (August–November 2026, in English): freshly made kinana ¥600; kinana hapon ¥1,100; with hojicha ¥1,400; mugwort and black-sesame ice; one order per person; one-hour limit when busy.

公式サイト (kyo-yokoi.com): よこい、店主 横井裕史 (Yoko.en: Official site (kyo-yokoi.com): Yokoi; owner 横井裕史 (Yokoi Yushi); from 18, trained for 12 years in shops of the 高台寺和久傳 group; head chef of 二条やま岸 at 32; independent at 36 at Karasuma-Gojo, Kyoto; in the Michelin Guide since 2023; one star in the Michelin Guide Kyoto–Osaka 2026; lunch 12:00–15:00 (Wednesday, Thursday, Saturday, Sunday); dinner 18:00–22:00 (start at 18:00 or 19:00); closed Monday; omotase to take away (saba-zushi, kinpira-and-salmon bento, yuba chirimen sansho); 万寿寺中之町88, Shimogyo-ku; by taxi say "Takakura Manjuji". Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; 5 min walk from exit 1 of Gojo Station; 14 seats (10 counter, private room for 4); private room ¥2,200 a head; 10% service from 1 December 2026; smart casual; shoes off inside; children only if they can eat the adult course; cards accepted; non-smoking; opened 1 December 2023; a 180-year-old Kyoto townhouse; chef Hiroshi Yokoi. Reviews (June–October 2026, in English): tomato jelly on a lotus leaf, scallop, sweet shrimp, peach jelly and caviar, abalone tempura, hamo, ayu, lunch ¥15,000–17,000, a woman owner and a head chef.

公式サイト (kyoryori-nakamura.com): 一子相伝 なかむら.en: Official site (kyoryori-nakamura.com): Isshisoden Nakamura; 'taste is the heart'; 中京区富小路御池下ル136; sixth-generation master Motokazu Nakamura; founded Bunsei 10 (1827), when the first master, 若狭屋清兵衛, carried Wakasa fish along the mackerel road for the palace and court nobles; catering and off-site cooking from the second generation; tea-kaiseki catering under the third, 中村庄三郎; during the war the fourth, 中村正蔵, catered for the inns 柊家, 俵屋 and 炭家; after the war the Kyoto ryori restaurant Nakamura was founded; the present master graduated from Tokyo University of Fisheries, trained at the 天龍寺 monastery, and in 2021 earned a doctorate (food and agricultural science) at 龍谷大学; the signatures are guji salted overnight, sprinkled with sake and grilled, and a zoni of white miso worked with water alone, without dashi. Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; lunch 12:00–14:00; dinner 17:00–19:30 last entry; closed Sundays (open by reservation for 10 or more); 67 seats; private rooms; cards accepted; The Tabelog Award Bronze 2017–2023; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021. Reviews (April 2025–October 2026, in English): three Michelin stars, sake-grilled guji, white-miso zoni, the house sake, and a view that its devotion to tradition leaves few surprises.

公式サイト (kyoseika.com): 京、静華、左京区岡崎円勝寺町36-3.en: Official site (kyoseika.com): Kyo Seika, 左京区岡崎円勝寺町36-3 2F; closed every Monday and Tuesday and irregularly (check the calendar); one start at 18:00; seasonal course ¥25,000 (¥27,500 with tax); special menus for whole-room bookings (up to 6); bookings by phone up to the end of the month two months ahead (11:00–16:00 on business days); cancellation 100% on the day, 50% the day before; no children below junior-high age (except whole-room bookings); no bookings by Instagram or Facebook messages; closed for maintenance and training from 1 May 2026; reopened from September; beware of fake websites using the name. Tabelog: Chinese; 16 seats (a round table of 10, two tables of 3); cards accepted; service charge 10%; opened 20 April 2008; The Tabelog Award Bronze; Chinese WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2024, 2026. Reviews (October 2025 – October 2026, in English): spring rolls with spicy sorbet, shark fin and abalone soup, char siu, an owner from Hamamatsu, the chef cooking alone since reopening.

公式サイト (kyosyoku.com): 祇園天ぷら晩餐、京都祇園のカウンター.en: Official site (kyosyoku.com): 祇園天ぷら晩餐 (Gion Tempura Bansan), a counter-only tempura shop in Gion, Kyoto; six counter seats are "the distance at which freshly fried tempura can be served without losing its taste"; à la carte also after 21:00; seasonal tempura served as courses, one guest at a time; "Gion no Bansan" course ¥12,100 (lunch ¥11,000), lighter course ¥7,700 (lunch ¥6,600), lunch-only tempura kaiseki ¥3,300; a sample day: wagyu tail soup to start, sashimi of the day, seared domestic Kuroge wagyu, tempura (kuruma prawn, eggplant, sea urchin, thick shiitake, sawara with yuzu-yuan marinade, koppe crab, eel, clam, domestic Kuroge wagyu, tilefish), tempura rice ball, red miso soup, dessert; 東山区富永町112 キャッスルギオン; dinner 17:00–25:00 (last order 24:30), lunch from 12:00 (only by full reservation made by the day before). Kyosyoku Co., Ltd.: president 眞鍋 and cooks 藤原 and 山内, who studied together at a cooking school; shops うらやま京色, BANSAN 京色, 祇園 晩餐 京色, 祇園天ぷら晩餐 and 角打ちと麺 ばんさん. Tabelog: tempura, izakaya, Japanese; 大和大路通四条上る富永町112 キャッスルギオンビル 1F; lunch last entry 13:30, dinner last entry 21:00 (courses only, book by the day before); closed irregularly; 6 seats (counter); private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards; opened 21 March 2021. Reviews (September 2025–October 2026, in English): 100% cottonseed oil; English-speaking staff.

公式サイト (kyoto-horibe.com): 研覃 (けんたん) とは「深.en: Official site (kyoto-horibe.com): 研覃 (kentan) means "to pursue and explore deeply, and to cultivate and polish oneself"; owner 堀部 努; lunch ¥12,000 and dinner ¥25,000 (tax and service included); lunch 11:30–12:30 (last entry), closes 14:00; dinner 18:00–19:30 (last entry), closes 22:00; closed Tuesday; phone bookings 14:00–17:00; TableCheck; cancellation fees (25% two days before, 50% the day before, 100% on the day); one Michelin star nine years running (July 2026); twentieth anniversary (August 2026); osechi; 4 min on foot from Shijo and Karasuma stations, exits 22 and 24. Tabelog (staff-maintained): Japanese cuisine, seafood, creative; 中京区錦小路通室町西入ル天神山町273; limited courses for foreign guests, lunch ¥15,000 (cash only) and dinner ¥28,000; dress code; cover tattoos; preschool children in private rooms only; 14 seats; private rooms (room charge 10–20%); cards accepted; opened 10 December 2016; shop text: Kyoto's five flavours, five colours and five methods, a townhouse with a small garden. Reviews (November 2025–September 2026, in English): a famous house since its Gion days, soft-shelled turtle and egg-tofu soup, Akashi sea bream, fried hamo with Joyo figs, Omi beef, Tango rice, hassun, cedar-plank grilling.

公式サイト (kyoto-kikusui.com): 京都東山の和食・洋食を愉し.en: Official site (kyoto-kikusui.com): a cooking ryokan in Higashiyama, Kyoto, for Japanese and Western food; a rare garden by the seventh-generation Ogawa Jihei; a "cooking ryokan" that is neither restaurant nor inn; Italian with seasonal ingredients of the terroir around Kyoto. Tabelog: ryokan, Italian; 31, Nanzen-ji, Sakyo Ward; 260 m from Keage Stn; lunch 12:00–16:00 (food L.O. 13:30), dinner 18:00–22:00 (food L.O. 20:00); open year-round; reservations accepted; cancellation 20% three or two days before, 50% the day before, 100% on the day; private room fee ¥11,000 a room; 26 seats (private rooms for 6 and 16); cards and PayPay accepted; 5 parking spaces; opened 11 June 2018; handmade pasta; a chef with experience in Italian three-star restaurants; 100+ wines chosen by a sommelier. Reviews (November 2025–October 2026, English): lunch Italian of 8 dishes ¥11,000 (November 2025); private rooms facing the garden; sea urchin pasta; chestnut tiramisu; afternoon tea; a children's plate.

公式サイト (kyoto-kuriya.jp): 栗の和菓子製造・販売、銘菓「金.en: Official site (kyoto-kuriya.jp): makes and sells chestnut wagashi; signature sweet "Kin no Mi", specialty "kuri ohagi"; 大文字町42-4, Nakagyo-ku; weekdays (Tuesday–Saturday) 9:00–18:00, Sundays and holidays 10:00–15:00; closed New Year's Day and Mondays (the next day if a holiday); 2 min walk from the Horikawa-Marutamachi bus stop, 8 min from Marutamachi Station; parking ticket with purchases of ¥2,500 or more (くるっとパーク大文字町); regular items: 金の実 candied chestnuts, chestnut dorayaki, 山の端, chestnut yokan, 山里, るりの里, おちょぼ, さいからせんべい; seasonal: mizu-yokan, 梅香水・紫香水, wakaayu, kuri ohagi, 栗の園, brown-rice manju, bite-size yokan; simple sweets that bring home to mind rather than the showiness of Kyoto confections. Tabelog: wagashi; reservations up to the day before; no seats; cards, e-money and QR (PayPay) accepted; Japanese sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2023 and 2026. Reviews (September–October 2026, in English): Kin no Mi ¥259, kuri ohagi ¥324, 100% Tanba chestnuts, founded in the Taisho era, queues, sold out.

公式サイト (kyoto-mikura.com): 京都・先斗町で鴨川越しに比叡.en: Official site (kyoto-mikura.com): teppanyaki in Pontocho, Kyoto, looking across the Kamo River to Mt Hiei; vegetables from Kyoto; counter seats only; A4-and-up domestic Kuroge wagyu, lobster, seasonal Kyoto vegetables; chef's omakase course ¥8,800 (7 dishes; loin 80 g ¥8,800, 100 g ¥11,000, 120 g ¥13,200; fillet 80 g ¥12,100, 100 g ¥14,850, 120 g ¥17,600); special Mikura course from ¥11,000 (10 dishes: Kyoto yuba and seafood parcel, special shrimp teppanyaki with shiso and cashew sauce, Kyoto vegetable teppanyaki); 10% service charge; 中京区先斗町三条下る橋下町135 先斗町ビル 3F; about 4 min walk from exit 6 of Sanjo Stn; lunch 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:00); dinner 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed irregularly. Tabelog: steak, teppanyaki, seafood; former name 味くら; 15 seats (counter); designated smoking area; cards and QR; invoice register: 西藤 啓太 (individual). Reviews (July–October 2026, in English): pancake and mini steak plate ¥2,640 (some July–August reviews ¥2,400), the Kamo River view, a report of tougher meat.

公式サイト (kyoto-motoi.com): Restaurant MOTO.en: Official site (kyoto-motoi.com): Restaurant MOTOÏ, new French through the filter of chef 前田元 (Motoi Maeda); "hospitality of host and guest as one"; lunch Collection de Saison ¥13,200 (about 10 dishes), Gourmand ¥18,700 (beef main, lobster starter); dinner Création ¥25,300 (about 13 dishes); special room (2–8 guests) with its own menu, lunch ¥27,500, dinner ¥46,200; all tax included, plus 10% service; because each day's course is prepared fresh, food allergies and dislikes are asked at booking, and so is visit history; same-day cancellation 100%; MOTOI's gyoza shop "モトイギョーザ" (Motoi Gyoza); online shop. Tabelog (corporate member): The Tabelog Award Bronze 2019–2026, French WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025, Tomikoji-dori Nijo-sagaru, Tawaraya-cho 186, a standalone house renovated from a Taisho-era kimono merchant's residence, a courtyard, 32 seats, private room, no children under 13, English menu, English-speaking staff, vegetarian options, opened 31 January 2012. Reviews (August–October 2026): cold mapo tofu, a salad of 50–55 Ohara vegetables, Chinese seasonings, wine pairing, Japanese tea pairing, ¥47,000 with pairings.

公式サイト (kyoto-okakita.com): 京うどん 生蕎麦 岡北、創.en: Official site (kyoto-okakita.com): Kyo Udon Nama Soba Okakita, founded in Showa 15 (1940); buckwheat flour from the foot of 白山 in Ishikawa Prefecture, organic rice, nama-fu from 京麩 半兵衛, fresh yuba, domestic wagyu, young chicken, wild shrimp, fried tofu hand-fried every morning by a local tofu shop, Kyoto vegetables; the dashi uses only natural Rishiri kombu; the technique the founder mastered in seventeen years of training is finished with skills the second generation has built over more than fifty years; thin noodles boiled 10 to 15 minutes; wooden chairs made by craftsmen; karakami paper with an autumn-grass pattern printed from woodblocks dating from the Edo period; 左京区岡崎南御所町34; 2 min walk north of the Zoo city bus stop; 11:00–19:00 (L.O.); closed every Tuesday and Wednesday. Menu: kitsune ¥970, shippoku ¥1,400, tori-nanba ¥1,280, nishin soba ¥1,500, tempura soba ¥1,680, nabeyaki udon ¥1,850, oyako-nanba ¥1,430, ten-toji ¥1,780, tanuki ¥1,100, noppei ¥1,450, fresh yuba keiran ¥1,680, sweet-kitsune curry ¥1,180, tori-nanba curry ¥1,400, beef curry ¥1,950, seiro ¥980, ten-seiro ¥2,200 (udon or soba); donburi: tamago-don ¥1,000 to ten-don ¥2,000 (with red-miso soup with fresh yuba). Tabelog: udon, soba, donburi; no reservations; 36 seats; no cards, e-money or QR; non-smoking; children's bowls and forks; renewal opening 20 August 2008; Udon Tabelog 100 2017–2019, Udon WEST Tabelog 100 2020 and 2024. Reviews (May–November 2026, in English): queues (20–40 min), orders taken in line, tempura udon ¥1,680, curry udon, beef udon ¥1,850, curry spicy or mild.

公式サイト (kyoto-sakuragawa.jp): 京都・木屋町の日本料理.en: Official site (kyoto-sakuragawa.jp): Japanese cuisine in Kiyamachi, Kyoto; a ten-seat white-wood counter and one semi-private table; lunch 12:00–14:00 and dinner 18:00–22:00; 10% service charge at lunch and dinner; closed Sunday and over New Year; freshly shaved katsuobushi; 15–20 sakes and wines at all times; sake vessels by artists; dinner kaiseki ¥22,000 and ¥27,500 (tax included); à la carte at night too; lunch kaiseki ¥8,800 and ¥16,500 (book by the day before); seasonal examples (hamo shabu-shabu in an onion dashi, autumn eggplant and ochiayu steak and more); tsukudani, nabe sets and ponzu by mail order; osechi; the branch おばんざい櫻川 closed in February 2026. Tabelog (staff-maintained): no reservations for vegetarians or guests with gluten allergies; other dietary restrictions may be declined; counter from middle-school age; cancellation fees (50% the day before, 100% on the day); 14 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; cards accepted. Reviews (May–November 2026, in English): lunch kaiseki ¥16,500 plus service, hamo shabu-shabu, matsutake, kombu-cured sea bream, clay-pot rice, pudding, a Michelin star.

公式サイト (kyoto-tagoto.co.jp): 京料理 御旅町田ごと、下.en: Official site (kyoto-tagoto.co.jp): Kyoto cuisine 御旅町田ごと, 御旅町34, east of 寺町 on Shijo-dori, Shimogyo-ku; about 10 m east of Hankyu Kawaramachi Station exit 6; lunch 11:30–15:00, dinner 17:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:00); closed Wednesday and the second Thursday (except public holidays); November Kōetsu mizusashi bento (with sea bream and turnip hot pot and sashimi) ¥7,700 with tax; Kōetsu mizusashi bento from ¥4,950 with tax; yuba course from ¥4,950 with tax; lunch kaiseki ¥7,700 with tax; kaiseki 「うさぎ」 ¥11,000, 「杵」 ¥13,200, 「臼」 ¥16,500, 「鶴」 ¥22,000 (with tax; drinks and service charge extra); the third-floor tatami rooms take kaiseki of ¥11,000 or more, with a separate room charge. History: Meiji 4 (1871), first generation 堀部徳兵衛; Showa 13 (1938) renamed from 「田毎」 to 田ごと; Showa 20 (1945) moved from 新京極 to Shijo Otabi-cho; Showa 25 (1950) 株式会社田ごと founded; Showa 39 (1964) 「田ごと光悦舗」 opened in the Keio department store, Shinjuku; Heisei 20 (2008) honten reopened after renovation; Heisei 25 (2013) Kyoto shinise award; fifth generation 堀部素久 (representative director); today the Shijo honten, Shinjuku Keio shop, Kyoto Takashimaya shop and Kyoto Porta shop. English page: vegetarian and vegan meals with advance notice; the broth for most dishes is bonito. Tabelog: Kyoto cuisine, 108 seats, private rooms, cards, e-money and QR accepted, English menu, English- and Chinese-speaking staff, vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free options (shop information). Reviews (January–September 2026, in English): yuba course, Kōetsu mizusashi bento, lunch kaiseki, tempura soba, kabura-mushi.

公式サイト (kyoto-yoshikawa.co.jp): 料理旅館・天ぷら.en: Official site (kyoto-yoshikawa.co.jp): cooking ryokan and tempura Yoshikawa; near Kyoto Gyoen; founded after the war as a cooking ryokan; a garden said to be by Kobori Enshu, called 退享園; a sukiya house that was a wealthy merchant's home. About Yoshikawa: founded in 1952 as an inn; the building is early Taisho; the garden is said to be by Kobori Enshu; once the home of the poet 江馬天江; works by 太田垣蓮月 and 富岡鉄斎; the eight rooms are each furnished differently; itamae tempura began in 1964, the year of the Tokyo Olympics, in a converted tea room. Meals: lunch 12:00–13:30 last order (closes 15:00); evening 17:30–19:30 last order (closes 22:00); tempura kaiseki; special courses of hamo, crab, fugu and kue; tax and 15% service extra; vegetarian menu (extra charge); vegan and gluten-free cannot be catered for; tempura counter 11:00–13:30 and 17:30–20:00 last order; 5% service (counter lunch tax only); no children aged 5 or under; counter hire for up to 10; menus for memorial services and children. Tabelog: tempura, Japanese cuisine, cooking ryokan; Tominokoji south of Oike, Nakagyo-ku; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; reservation only; 100 seats (8 private rooms, hall for up to 25, 8 counter seats); English menu and English-speaking staff; cards accepted; parking for 3 (reservation needed); opened 1 February 1952; Tempura Tabelog 100 2022, 2023, 2025. Reviews (June–October 2026, in English): counter lunch ¥6,600 for 12 pieces; starts and ends with shrimp; tencha +¥1,100; matcha salt and tempura sauce; a guest of 30 years.

公式サイト (kyoto-yoshitsugu.com): 京都よしつぐ、裏千家.en: Official site (kyoto-yoshitsugu.com): Kyoto Yoshitsugu; matcha whisked by an Urasenke teacher; sweets all made by hand in the shop every day by artisans; a Kyoto townhouse built about 150 years ago (1877, Meiji 10); ground floor the shop, upper floor for matcha classes, entertaining and groups; a storehouse and garden at the back; koicha from ¥2,420, usucha from ¥880, gyokuro (pot) ¥1,320; 100% bracken warabi-mochi ¥1,815; ten-flavour dango set ¥1,320; Yoshitsugu zenzai (shiratama/chestnut/toasted mochi) from ¥1,320; roast-sweet-potato Mont Blanc ¥1,210; chilled inaniwa udon (roasted brown-rice-tea broth) from ¥1,650; steamer rice sets Nagomi ¥1,650, Irodori ¥1,870, Kanade ¥2,090; four iced teas; flower-anko cake; 10:00–18:00; closed Wednesday (Thursday if Wednesday is a holiday); no takeaway; 30 seconds from Nishiki Market; notice of 13 October 2026: bookings moved to TableCheck; the flower-anko cake by pre-order on TableCheck (card details needed); bookings via Tabelog paused; seats only also by phone. Tabelog: Japanese sweets café, wagashi, café; 42 seats; private room (8); non-smoking; Wi-Fi; cards, e-money and QR; menu in English, Traditional Chinese and Korean; vegetarian options; opened 18 December 2023; invoice T3140001048195 (株式会社インテ). Reviews (August–October 2026, in English): flower-anko cakes (hydrangea, sunflower, cosmos, chrysanthemum), ten dango, warabi-mochi, ordering by touch panel, staff in kimono.

公式サイト (kyoto-zizai.com): 料理屋 自在 (りょうりや じ.en: Official site (kyoto-zizai.com): Ryoriya Jizai, teppan creative cuisine in a lane of Kyoto machiya off Sanjo-dori; flexible ideas including the latest cooking methods; set courses only at lunch and dinner; the course changes monthly; the owner picks the season's ingredients and designs it; dinner course ¥10,000 (tax included); bookings for two or more by the day before; pairing set (champagne, red and white, three glasses) ¥3,300; free message plate for anniversaries; house non-alcoholic cocktails; counter downstairs facing the teppan, tables upstairs (private hire for 10–16); 24 seats; 11:30–14:30 and 17:30–22:00; irregular closing days; same-day cancellation may be charged 100%; sister shops 牛の骨, 牛の骨あなざ, 草風土 牛の骨, DUE and ELOVE (株式会社セカンダイズ); this month's course (to 3 November): pumpkin declinaison, Japanese chestnut flan, autumn salmon with Anno sweet potato and Shine Muscat, fig and house duck prosciutto, gastrovac autumn mackerel with squid-ink mash, black wagyu ribeye steak, Handa somen with hamo consommé, sorbet and desserts. Tabelog: creative cuisine, teppanyaki, steak; 三条通富小路西入ル中之町12-3, Nakagyo-ku; 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–23:30; irregular closing days; no service charge; 24 seats; no smoking; no preschool children; wheelchair accessible. Reviews (July 2025 – November 2026, in English and Japanese): lunch course ¥5,500; a wheat allergy accommodated (somen swapped for a corn and edamame risotto); a birthday message on dessert; the counter given as eight seats (November 2026) or six (September 2026); one diner found the squid-ink mash a bit hard going.

公式サイト (kyototachibana.com): 焼鳥 京都橘 (やきとり.en: Official site (kyototachibana.com): Yakitori Kyoto Tachibana; owner 坂田知紀; trained for years in sushi and kaiseki restaurants, fell for Takasaka chicken and turned to yakitori; opened in Nakagyo-ku in November 2021; Yakitori WEST Tabelog 100 2023–2025; Michelin Guide Kyoto Osaka 2025 Selected Restaurant; Kyoto Takasaka chicken omakase full course ¥16,500 (tax included): starter, sashimi, nine skewers, five small dishes, palate cleanser, closing rice dish, dessert; chicken-broth chawanmushi, kombu-cured chicken breast nigiri, white-liver pâté, seasonal clay-pot rice, chicken-broth ramen; reservation only, by TableCheck and phone; same day by phone 11:00–15:00; cancel at least 11 days ahead; no proxy bookings; no strong perfume; 押小路通御幸町西入橘町612, basement 1 of the Aiina building. Tabelog: yakitori; from October, daily at 18:00 and 20:30 (short course, grilled by someone other than Sakata); closing days on Instagram; 10 seats; service 10%. Reviews (August–October 2026, in English): white liver sashimi, crisp skin, a smokeless grill, the chef seeing guests off.

公式サイト (kyoya-kiyomizu.com/kiyokiyo): 京都の.en: Official site (kyoya-kiyomizu.com/kiyokiyo): "Kyoto Stand Kiyokiyo", recommended for standing and daytime drinking in Kyoto; Gion-Shijo, Kawaramachi, Kiyamachi, Pontocho; opened in July 2018 in Kiyamachi as a sister shop of the popular izakaya Kyoya Kiyomizu, which has four shops in Kyoto; a wide range of carefully chosen Kyoto sake; three-sake tasting sets; Kyoto food centred on obanzai; fruit chuhai full of fruit pulp; open from 14:00; house dishes are beef tongue simmered slowly in Kyoto-style dashi and the daily Kyoto obanzai; pickled ginger between dishes; heated tobacco only; further shops on the Sanjo shopping street and at BiVi Nijo. Tabelog: standing bar, izakaya, Japanese cuisine; FORUM building 1F, Kiyamachi-dori Shijo-agaru, Nakagyo-ku; every day 14:00–22:30 (last order 22:00); irregular closing days; bookings taken; no service or cover charge; 31 places (15 counter, 4 tables); cards, e-money and QR accepted; vegetarian options; English menu; opened 5 July 2018. Reviews (July–October 2026, in English): obanzai ¥300 each; omakase three dishes ¥900; beef tongue stew ¥1,000; draft beer ¥550; lemon sour ¥600; local sake from ¥400; chinchiro dice game; sansho potato salad.

公式サイト (kyoyamato.com/kyorinsen): 京林泉は明治1.en: Official site (kyoyamato.com/kyorinsen): Kyorinsen is a sister restaurant of the Higashiyama ryotei Kyo Yamato, founded in Meiji 10; light, delicate tempura; fried crisp at the right temperature for the right time; ingredients from trusted suppliers; a frying oil blending white cottonseed oil and premium pure sesame oil; natural salt from a Mongolian salt lake. Lunch courses "Yasaka" ¥7,000 and "Higashiyama" ¥5,000; weekday-only "Kyo-gozen" ¥3,500; dinner courses "Tsuki" ¥15,000, "Yuki" ¥12,000, "Hana" ¥9,000 (tax included). Tabelog: tempura; Hotel Granvia Kyoto M3F; 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00, courses 20:30); closed Monday (except holidays) and the Tuesday after a holiday; weekend and holiday lunch in two sittings at 11:30 and 13:30; 90 minutes at lunch, 120 at dinner; allergies in advance; 20+ minutes late counts as a cancellation; 15% service included; à la carte only incurs a ¥1,500 table charge; 27 seats (counter 6+1, tables 21); no smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome, kids' menu; opened 11 September 1997; Tempura Tabelog 100 2022, 2023, 2025. Reviews (September–November 2026, in English): Kyo-gozen ¥3,500; Higashiyama ¥5,500; ¥1,000 off the Yuki course before 18:00; kakiage rice bowl or chirimen-jako rice; salt, curry salt, lemon, tempura sauce.

公式サイト (la-biographie.info): 歴史ある平安宮中和院跡、.en: Official site (la-biographie.info): authentic French restaurant on Shimodachiuri-dori at Senbon, on the historic site of the 中和院 of the Heian Palace; 上京区田中町422-1 セントガーデン 1F; chef 滝本 将博 (TAKIMOTO Masahiro): 1982 entered the world of cooking as a pâtissier; 1983 trained at a hotel in Kyoto, then went to Europe; 1987 trained at hotels and Michelin-starred restaurants in Switzerland and France; 1992 returned to Japan and joined a Kyoto hotel; 1999 head chef; 2009 won a star in the Michelin Guide 2010 edition (the only star for French cuisine in a Kyoto of Japanese cuisine); 2011 founded T&T Company Ltd. and opened La Biographie...; 2017 selected for La Liste 1000 two years running; 2020 closed the 御池衣棚 shop to prepare a move; 2021 reopened east of Senbon on Shimodachiuri-dori; kept its star in the Michelin Guide Kyoto/Osaka 2026. Lunch ¥16,500 (Friday, Saturday and Sunday only; 8 dishes including dessert; about 2 hours); dinner ¥28,000 or ¥38,500 (11 dishes; about 2.5–3 hours); 10% service charge extra; omakase only; vegetarian and vegan menus available; barrier-free; closed Monday and Tuesday, and irregularly; lunch last entry 12:00, closes 15:00; dinner last entry 18:00, closes 22:00. Philosophy of heating: heat each ingredient without stress at a temperature that suits it. Tabelog: French; reservation only; 8 seats; allergies, vegetarian and vegan requests to be discussed in advance (no changes on the day); opened 18 March 2021; French WEST Tabelog 100 2023 and 2025. Reviews (2024–2026, in English): aperitif of five tastes, the egg 'microcosm', Kasumi crab, Kyoto mushroom soup, low-temperature Kyoto Hime beef, herbal tea.

公式サイト (la-mergiki.com): 屋根裏レストラン ラメールギキ、.en: Official site (la-mergiki.com): attic restaurant La Mer giki; La Mer is French for 'the sea'; the interior evokes the sea of southern France and of the owner's home town; owner 冝喜 慎吾 (Shingo Giki); 下京区茶磨屋町228-2; lunch 12:00–15:00 (L.O. 13:00); dinner 18:00–21:30 (L.O. 19:30); closed Tuesday (and irregularly); lunch A course ¥4,500, B course ¥5,300 (tax included); La Mer course ¥6,500 (mains: roast duck, oysters Burgundy-style, domestic beef cheek in red wine +¥800, beef steak +¥1,400, roast lobster +¥1,800); bouillabaisse course ¥6,700; lobster course ¥9,000; special course ¥11,000 (book two days ahead); dislikes and allergies at booking; 2027 osechi. Tabelog: French, bistro; bookings 9:00–12:00; same-day cancellation 50%; 12 seats (10 table, 2 counter); exclusive hire from 9 guests; cards and QR. Reviews (2023–2026, in English): Kintoki-carrot mousse, three-layer soup, oysters Burgundy-style, Mont Blanc, the chef's wife serving on weekdays.

公式サイト (lepetitmec.com): Le Petit Mec、28周.en: Official site (lepetitmec.com): Le Petit Mec, 28th anniversary; ル・プチメック 今出川店, 御池店, 大丸京都店 (B1), 日比谷店 (Hibiya Chanter 1F); Le Petit Mec co. Ltd. Tabelog: bread, Western sweets and café; 上京区今出川通大宮西入ル元北小路町159 大晋メゾネ西陣今出川 1F; 2 min on foot from the Imadegawa-Omiya city-bus stop; daily 8:00–18:00; no reservations; 18 seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR payments accepted; takeaway; opened 30 October 1998; Bread Tabelog 100 2017–2020, Bread WEST Tabelog 100 2022. Reviews (2026, in English): "Aka Mec" with its red door; croissant au beurre ¥270, aux amandes ¥430, Earl Grey ¥440; pain au chocolat ¥330; Olivier ¥250; ciabatta; chestnut pie; lemon custard pie; warmed and sliced for eat-in.

公式サイト (leschampsdor.jp): レ・シャンドール (Les C.en: Official site (leschampsdor.jp): Les Champs d'Or, 'golden fields'; founded in 1983 by chef 田島福廣 and manager 奥田孝雄; taken over by 熊﨑隆一・香 from April 2026; orthodox French cuisine; 中京区柳馬場蛸薬師上る419; lunch 12:00–15:00 (last entry 13:30); dinner 18:00–22:00 (last entry 19:00) Tue, Thu and Sat only (since 2022); closed Sunday and Monday; seasonal breaks in January and August; lunch A ¥6,655, B ¥7,865; special course 'Celestial Dinner' ¥21,780 (tax and service included); autumn menu; booking by phone and Ikyu; online shop (baked goods, duck roast, Deli Set 2027). Tabelog: French, 柳馬場通六角下ル井筒屋419; 24 seats; cards accepted; The Tabelog Award Bronze 2021–2025; French WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025. Reviews (November 2025–September 2026, in English): classic French cooking, Chef Tajima's retirement, the feel of a Showa-era grand French restaurant, wine.

公式サイト (linamha-pontocho.com): 京都 李南河 (りな.en: Official site (linamha-pontocho.com): Kyoto 李南河 (Rinanha), a Korean restaurant of fine wagyu overlooking the Kamo River; in 2000 the Osaka-born cook 李南河 opened 代官山 李南河, using the cook’s own name for the shop; in Kyoto a sister shop opened in a renovated old house in a Pontocho back alley, now moved to the Kamo riverside within Pontocho; wagyu from the Kyoto meat market; house fruit liqueurs; ZAGAT SURVEY and the Korean Food Foundation’s best Korean restaurants; the bulgogi shop SURAGAN (Ebisu) in 2005; 中京区先斗町通四条上る鍋屋町232; Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00), Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–23:00; closed irregularly; private-room fee ¥6,000; courses: jidori dakhanmari set and black-pork samgyeopsal set ¥7,000 each (¥10,000 with 2 hours of drinks, from 5 people), seasonal Korean set ¥9,500, November omakase ¥12,000; à la carte: house kimchi platter ¥2,000, seasonal bossam kimchi ¥2,500, Kyoto Kujo-negi chijimi ¥1,800, Shinshu premium wagyu bulgogi (for two) ¥7,500, Omi-beef skirt shabu-shabu spicy hot pot (for two) ¥7,500, jidori dakhanmari ¥5,000, vegetable bibimbap ¥1,800, house naengmyeon ¥1,600; 10% service charge. Grateful Co., Ltd.: owner-chef 李 南河; Kyoto 李南河 opened July 2009; 9 shops. Tabelog: Korean and steak; 50 seats; non-smoking; cards; invoice T5011001151289 (Grateful Operation Co., Ltd.); Asian/Ethnic WEST Tabelog 100 2026. Reviews (2025–2026, in English).

公式サイト (ludens-kyoto.net): 薬膳イタリアン LUDENS.en: Official site (ludens-kyoto.net): medicinal Italian LUDENS, innovative fusion with ingredients that please body and mind; 'Ristorante' comes from 'ristorare', to restore with food and rest; Nijo-dori to the south once thrived with herbal-medicine wholesalers; Italian-based courses rich in nourishing ingredients; at the chef's counter 田淵薬膳研究所, chef 田淵, a practitioner of Japanese-Chinese medicinal cooking, serves a 'seasonal yojo course' matched to your condition, lunch from 13:00 and dinner from 20:00 (when counter seats are free); starting with a medicinal tea; four amuse-bouches, a vegetable plate and medicinal soup; medicinal liqueurs and herbal drinks; a mail-order medicinal hot-pot set; lunch starts together at 12:00, dinner at 18:00 or 19:00; closed Sunday and Monday. Tabelog: Italian, innovative, 中京区間之町通二条上ル夷町560-8, 6 min on foot from Marutamachi Stn; reservation only; lunch about 2 hours, dinner about 2.5; opened 19 September 2017; Italian WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (August–October 2026, in English): medicinal Italian, spices ground at the table, the medicinal breakfast paused from 11 October 2026, careful explanations and a warm send-off.

公式サイト (lurrakyoto.com): LURRA˚ はバスク語で「地球.en: Official site (lurrakyoto.com): LURRA˚ is Basque for "earth", and "°" stands for the moon; from Kyoto, a showcase of Japan's seasons and culture for the world; chef Jacob Kear, born in California, after LA and Tokyo trained at Noma in Denmark and followed it to Noma Tokyo, and as head chef of Clooney in New Zealand won three hats; 東山区石泉院町396; hours from 17:30 (counter, shared start) and from 18:30 (table only); closed Sundays and Mondays. Tabelog (corporate member): innovative; a townhouse over 250 years old; vegetables from the Ohara countryside; embers in a kiln and oven; with seasonal ingredients, changes for allergies or dislikes may be difficult; 18 seats (10 at the counter, 8 at a table); ages 13 and up; English-speaking staff; vegetarian options; service charge 10%; opened 9 July 2019; The Tabelog Award Bronze 2025; Innovative/Creative Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (May–August 2026, in English): a wood fire, a limited à la carte lunch in August, fried ice-cream doughnuts, one Michelin star.

公式サイト (madam-ko-ran.com): マダム紅蘭〜京町家でいただく.en: Official site (madam-ko-ran.com): マダム紅蘭 — authentic Chinese in a Kyoto machiya; south-east of the Kyoto Imperial Palace; a 90-year-old all-hinoki sukiya building converted from the main house of a confectioner; "First, serve the guest the flavours you yourself have found delicious"; Sichuan cuisine at heart, but with vegetable oil and almost no spices, light to suit Japanese tastes; seasonal Kyoto-vegetable menus four times a year (morning-dug bamboo shoots, Kamo eggplant, manganji peppers, lily bulb and more); the "refined happosai"; spring-only sakura dongpo pork; the Dongpo burger (popular as a gift); takeaway by phone; closed Monday (open on holidays, closed the next day instead), the front page says Monday and the fourth Tuesday; lunch 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00), dinner 17:00–21:30 (last order 21:00); chairs on the ground floor; children from primary-school age. Tabelog: Chinese, Sichuan, tantanmen; 中京区寺町丸太町下御霊前町631-2; Wednesday–Sunday, closed Monday and Tuesday; 30 seats; private rooms; non-smoking; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; Chinese WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2024 and 2026.

公式サイト (madrague.info): 喫茶 la madrague、8:.en: Official site (madrague.info): Kissa la madrague; 8:00–18:00 (last order: food 17:00, drinks 17:30); closes when ingredients run out; seats bookable at the shop or by phone for 8:00 or 9:30 (morning) or 12:00 (lunch); closed irregularly; only the Corona sandwich can be taken away (phone at least two days ahead); menu: Corona egg sandwich ¥1,180, iron-plate Napolitan ¥1,100, slow-cooked pork curry rice ¥990, blend coffee ¥600, Monte Carlo ¥600 and more. How the shop began: the name is that of Brigitte Bardot's villa in Saint-Tropez in the south of France; the premises were 喫茶セブン, open about 50 years from 1963; its master died in 2011, and through the master's son the shop opened that September; about a year later the free paper 音読 asked it to carry on the egg sandwich of the closed western-style restaurant Corona; part-time work at 喫茶フランソア; a lesson in person from Corona's master; the 京都喫茶文化遺産 team. Tabelog: kissaten, sandwiches, western food, 中京区上松屋町706-5; daily 8:00–18:00; reservations accepted; 18 seats; no cards, e-money or QR; non-smoking; opened 1 September 2011; Kissaten Tabelog 100 2021, 2022, 2026. Reviews (October–November 2026, in English): Set A ¥1,800, the Corona egg sandwich, Monte Carlo, seated by reservation.

公式サイト (mankamerou.com): 享保七年 (1722年) 創業、.en: Official site (mankamerou.com): founded in Kyoho 7 (1722); began as the sake brewery 萬屋 in a corner of Kyoto's Nishijin and later, as a restaurant, took the name 萬亀楼; formally carries on the Ikama-ryu ceremonial knife school and yusoku-ryori connected with the Imperial Palace; the present head is the tenth generation; "sincerity, wisdom, humility"; 上京区猪熊通り出水上ル蛭子町387; closed every Wednesday and the 1st and 4th Tuesdays; closed 26 December–5 January; parking for 5 cars; 3 min on foot from the Horikawa-Shimochojamachi city-bus stop. Tabelog: Japanese cuisine and bento; 上京区猪熊通出水上ル; 12:00–22:00; irregular closures; reservations taken (Pocket Concierge); about 20% added for service and tax; 60 seats; private rooms; cards, e-money and QR payments accepted. Reviews (2025–2026, in English): yusoku-ryori; private tatami rooms and a garden; hamo soup; grilled ayu; sea-bream chazuke; hassun; kago bento; the proprietress's hospitality; shikibocho and maiko.

公式サイト (mariebelle.jp): ニューヨーク・SoHo 生まれのチ.en: Official site (mariebelle.jp): a chocolate brand born in SoHo, New York; Kyoto honten (中京区槌屋町83番地); shop 11:00–19:00; Cacao Bar 11:00–19:00 (last order 18:00); closed Tuesday; café seats cannot be booked, sign in at the entrance; the upstairs can be hired; MarieBelle the Lounge at Daimaru Shinsaibashi, Osaka; MarieBelle Shibuya opened 28 October 2026; cacao beans from farms supported in the homeland, Honduras; every design is a painting by an artist; the Kyoto honten's 14th anniversary (April 2026); run by MarieBelle Japan. Tabelog: chocolate, gelato, café; 20 seats; no reservations; cards and QR accepted; opened 24 April 2012; Sweets Tabelog 100 2018; Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2018–2020, 2022. Reviews (September–November 2026, in English): art ganache, Carré de Chocolat, hot chocolate, chocolate crepe, gelato, chestnut crepe, an entrance down a narrow alley.

公式サイト (marukyu-koyamaen.co.jp): 西洞院店・茶房「.en: Official site (marukyu-koyamaen.co.jp): Nishinotouin shop and tea room "Motoan"; the shop sells matcha, gyokuro, sencha, genmaicha and matcha sweets; the tea room serves sets of matcha, sencha or hojicha with wagashi, ice cream and roll cake (13 seats); a proper two-mat tea room (no tea ceremony performed); Nishinotoin-dori Oike-sagaru, west side, Nakagyo-ku; tea room 10:30–17:00 last order (closes 17:30); shop 9:30–18:00; closed every Wednesday, the third Tuesday and the New Year; menu (tax included): matcha 「雅の院」 (this shop only) usucha with wagashi ¥1,595; Uji matcha ice cream ¥990; Kyoto hojicha ice cream ¥880; matcha 「長安」 usucha with wagashi ¥2,035, koicha with wagashi ¥2,860; gyokuro 「滴の院」 with wagashi ¥2,255; hojicha with wagashi ¥1,430; matcha roll cake set ¥1,925 (a slice ¥1,100; no reservations; until sold out); matcha shaved ice 「京氷室」 ¥1,210 and matcha-azuki ice ¥1,320 (summer only); matcha zenzai (winter only); koicha rice ¥1,600 (until 2 pm); take-home roll cake ¥3,780 a roll (phone reservation only, in advance). Company profile: directly run shops in Kyoto only (headquarters shop, Nishinotouin shop with tea room Motoan, JR Kyoto Isetan, Kyoto Takashimaya). Tabelog: café, kanmidokoro, shaved ice; closed Wednesday (open on holidays); 10 seats; no smoking; children welcome; cards, e-money and QR accepted; Cafe WEST Tabelog 100 2025.

公式サイト (marus-bar.com): MARU'S Bar マルズバー、.en: Official site (marus-bar.com): MARU'S Bar, a wine bar where you can try many different wines in one evening, casually and comfortably; Roppongi 3-9-3, 第2六本木ビレッジビル 1F (notice of 9 April 2026: moving to the 3rd floor); Mon–Sat 18:00–23:30; closed Sundays, plus irregular closures; monthly holidays posted. Dishes are one portion sized for two; half portions possible: シークァーサー pickles ¥600, three olives ¥600, ratatouille without tomato ¥1,400, 平田牧場 prosciutto ¥1,500, foie gras terrine ¥2,000, white asparagus baked with 吉田牧場 caciocavallo ¥2,200, potato salad ¥800, 山形 wagyu carpaccio ¥2,000, crab cream croquettes ¥2,000, minced-meat cutlet ¥2,600 (with foie gras ¥3,400), 山形 beef steak or cutlet ¥3,400, the signature wagyu oxtail stew ¥3,500, karasumi and cabbage pasta, kissaten-style meat-sauce spaghetti ¥2,200, omurice ¥2,000, one cheese from 20 for ¥800. Tabelog: 10 seats (counter 6, one table); non-smoking; cards accepted; 30 years. Reviews (January 2024–September 2026): run by a couple; 3- and 5-glass wine sets; opened in 1994; free bread refills; moved upstairs.

公式サイト (mashiro-kyoto.com): 真白 MASHIRO ジャ.en: Official site (mashiro-kyoto.com): MASHIRO, genre-free cuisine; each day begins with a deep breath of pure white air; the best ingredients arrive from producers every morning; pickling, grilling, simmering, steaming, frying, fermenting, ageing; the chef trained at the Rihga Royal Hotel in Osaka and, at 33, became the youngest chef in the hotel's history at Restaurant Chambord in 小倉; chef at DOUZE GOUT 12+ in Kyoto; a Japan finalist for the Bocuse d'Or 2015; opened Cosimo Plus in Ashiya in May 2012 (one star in the Michelin Guide Kyoto Osaka 2014) and Gion Roshoku in November 2017 (one star in 2018); opened MASHIRO in Karasuma-Rokkaku in August 2023; "make your heart pure white"; 堂之前町234 OHG京都六角ビル 2F; lunch from 12:00 and dinner from 18:00, shared start; irregular closing days; tie-in plans with 南座. Tabelog (corporate member): 11 counter seats; ages 10 and up; smart casual; service charge 10%; pairing ¥8,800 at lunch, ¥11,000 at dinner; opened 20 August 2023; The Tabelog Award Bronze 2026. Reviews (July–October 2026, in English): the signature sea urchin, message plates, seasonal fish, pairings.

公式サイト (mashkyoto.com、2017年まで更新): ブランジュリー.en: Official site (mashkyoto.com, updated until 2017): Boulangerie まっしゅ京都, at 東洞院高辻 near Shijo-Karasuma, Kyoto; 8:00 am–7:30 pm; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; second-floor Cafe 8 huit (12:00 to about 18:30); French bread fermented long at low temperature (baguette, épi, boule); small French breads made with a shio-koji starter; Kyoto-sweet breads: purple sweet potato anpan 「花のいろは。」, matcha anpan 「藤壷-fujitsubo」, cherry-blossom-shaped melon bread. ルルブ (updated 29 July 2023): the owner-baker 増野, who found the fun of bread at a Japanese bakery, trained in Paris, France, and opened in home-town Kyoto; a building renovated from an old house; "I want to make interesting breads that feel like Kyoto"; 花のいろは ¥299, chimaki anpan ¥275, 藤壺 ¥297, 六条御息所 ¥297 (black-cocoa dough with strawberry jam, raspberry jam and custard cream), にぬき ¥318; closes when sold out. Tabelog: bread, sandwiches, sweets; 燈籠町568, south of Takatsuji on 東洞院通, Shimogyo-ku; Monday and Thursday–Sunday 8:00–19:30, closed Tuesday and Wednesday; takeaway only (no eat-in); cards accepted; opened 25 March 2004; Bread WEST Tabelog 100 2020, 2022, 2026. Reviews (September–October 2026, in English): sells out early; 藤壷 ¥410, croissant ¥280, pain de mie ¥290, tandoori chicken ¥370, shio-koji bacon ¥290.

公式サイト (matsunosukepie.com): 松之助 本店 (京都市中.en: Official site (matsunosukepie.com): Matsunosuke honten (高倉御池下ル亀甲屋町605, Nakagyo-ku, Kyoto; 9:00–17:30, last order 17:00; closed Tuesday) and MATSUNOSUKE N.Y. (Hillside Terrace, Daikanyama, Tokyo); pancakes at the Kyoto honten 9:00–16:00 April–September and 9:00–14:00 October–March (until sold out); apple pies: sour cream ¥770 (eat in ¥784), Big ¥890 (¥1,111), custard ¥770, maple ¥820, caramel ¥810, 14 Lincoln Street ¥770; cherry pie ¥780; banana cream pie ¥760; New York cheesecake ¥750; scones from ¥370; biscuits ¥330; whole pies need ordering a week ahead; Big Apple Pie on sale from 1 October 2026. Profile of 平野顕子: born in Kyoto into a family of Noh-costume weavers; graduated from ノートルダム女学院; in 1995, while studying at the University of Connecticut, studied under シャロル・ジーン; opened Cafe & Pantry Matsunosuke at Takakura, Kyoto, in October 2000; special lesson at the CIA in Hyde Park in April 2003; the shop is named after a grandfather who was a master Noh-costume craftsman. Tabelog: café, cake, pancakes; 17 seats; no reservations; no cards; non-smoking; closed Tuesday; Cafe Tabelog 100 2021, 2022; Cafe WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (October–November 2026, in English): order and pay at the counter; up to three items per person; cakes in the showcase; biscuits; scones.

公式サイト (menshou-taketora.com): 個室で食べるラーメン.en: Official site (menshou-taketora.com): ramen and tsukemen eaten in private rooms, Mensho 'Taketora'; shops: head shop, Shinjuku, Roppongi and 沖縄新都心店 (2025 year-end notice). Tabelog: Mensho Taketora Roppongi, Roppongi 3-14-14, 六本木314ビル 1F, 3 min from Roppongi Stn exit A5 (Oedo line); Mon–Sat 11:00–09:00 next day (L.O. 8:30); Sun 11:00–05:30 next day; open all year; 49 seats (counter 7, tables 42); private rooms (2, 4, 6); non-smoking; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; opened 29 September 2010; head shop in Kabukicho, Shinjuku. Reviews (March 2025–November 2026): Ura Taketora ramen ¥1,280 (back fat, garlic, thick curly noodles, thick chashu), Ura Taketora tsukemen ¥1,280, yuzu seafood tonkotsu tsukemen ¥1,280, dashi shoyu ramen ¥1,180; one diner found the rich shrimp seafood ramen too salty; chashu rice ¥450; free topping at lunch; eight groups waiting on a Friday night.

公式サイト (micasadecoandcafe.com): MICASADEC.en: Official site (micasadecoandcafe.com): MICASADECO & CAFE; 'Mi casa' is Spanish for 'my home' and 'Deco' is 'Decoration'; the first shop, Osaka Namba, opened in 2013; the theme is 'Cool & Cute'; aimed at overseas tourists and Gen Z; shops in Osaka, Tokyo (Jingumae) and Kyoto, plus THE PARK (なノにわ); franchise recruitment; the signature fluffy ricotta pancake, cooked one at a time after ordering, became known as the 'dancing pancake'; three stars in the Kansai pancake section of the SARAH JAPAN MENU AWARD 2018 (second half); a morning menu 9:00–11:00 at the Namba shop only; weekdays 9:00–17:00 (L.O. 16:00), weekends 9:00–18:00 (L.O. 17:00); closed 31 December–3 January; seasonal pancakes (espresso pancake with cinnamon apple and nuts ¥2,400, pumpkin-pie chewy pancake ¥2,200); coconut custard pancake; chewy plain pancake; pasta; truffle omelette rice; keema curry. Tabelog (shop member): pancakes, Italian, café; Saiwaicho 1-2-8 (Naniwa-ku), Minatomachi82bld 1F; no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 27 seats; non-smoking; takeaway and delivery; free Wi-Fi; opened 16 September 2013. Reviews (March–October 2026): ricotta pancake ¥1,750, about 20 minutes; order by smartphone; the queues of the boom are gone and you can walk in; many guests come from overseas.

公式サイト (mikaku.co.jp): 1929年 (昭和4年) 創業、雌牛.en: Official site (mikaku.co.jp): founded in 1929 (Showa 4); only the finest cuts of female cattle; founder 三田進太郎, second generation 三田昌治, third generation 三田兼司; began with gyūnabe and the founder's oil-grilled beef; teppan steak began after the war at the request of occupation officers; calves raised in Sanda, Hyogo bought whole, aged and boned in the shop; centenary in 2029; 東山区常盤町165番地 (祇園縄手四条上ル車道); 16 counter seats; 12:00–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); booking required; closed Monday; Mikaku three-way course ¥30,000; Mikaku beef steak course (round 150 g ¥26,500, fillet 150 g ¥38,500, loin 200 g ¥40,000); lunch Mikaku beef teppan steak 100 g ¥5,000 to 250 g ¥9,500; Kitashinchi Mikaku. Tabelog: steak, sukiyaki; a long-established house from 1927; young female Tajima cattle (shop text); book dinner a day or two ahead; dress code; elementary-school age and up, no infants; cards accepted. Reviews (December 2025–June 2026, in English): a view of the Shirakawa from the windows, the chef grilling in front of you, lunch for two about ¥16,000.

公式サイト (mishima-tei.co.jp): 創業明治6年 三嶋亭、霜降.en: Official site (mishima-tei.co.jp): Mishima Tei, founded Meiji 6; marbled-beef sukiyaki; Kyoto kaiseki, oil-grilled beef, mizutaki; over 150 years of tradition since the Meiji "civilisation and enlightenment"; in the sukiya-style building the courtyard garden, railings, ceilings and lattices are mostly as at the founding; the founder 三嶌兼吉 learned gyunabe in Nagasaki together with the founder's wife てい and founded the shop at Teramachi-Sanjo in Meiji 6; now the fifth generation; black wagyu chosen from across Japan regardless of origin and aged in the house's own way; electric heaters with an effect close to charcoal; the warishita is a secret recipe refined by the fifth generation; the fifth generation, 三嶋太郎, studied Japanese cuisine, tea and ikebana for eight years and devised the kaiseki-style "Hana course"; sister restaurant 翁樹庵; online bookings up to a month ahead, by phone for the same day or within a month. Tabelog: sukiyaki, Japanese cuisine, beef; Teramachi-dori Sanjo-sagaru, Nakagyo-ku; every day 11:00–21:00; bookings taken; a Meiji building, not barrier-free; shoes off on the ground floor and up the stairs; socks please on the tatami; 10% service charge; 250 seats; private rooms; no smoking; no children's menu (seat fee ¥1,210 from age 3); cards, e-money and QR accepted; prices as of May 2025: Premium Tsuki ¥21,780, Tsuki ¥17,545, lunch course ¥8,591 (tax and service included); Tabelog Award Bronze 2017–2019; Sukiyaki & Shabu-shabu Tabelog 100 2024, 2026. Reviews (July–October 2026, in English): cooked with sugar and warishita and dipped in beaten egg; Kujo leek, grilled tofu, shungiku, fu; melon; every room now has tables.

公式サイト (mitoho.jp): 京都 宮川町の日本料理 mitoho ky.en: Official site (mitoho.jp): Japanese restaurant mitoho kyoto bettei in Miyagawacho, Kyoto; an immersive lunch course to enjoy Kyoto with all five senses; four starters (Kyoto and Japanese cuisine, Kyoto vegetables); grilled dish (choose fish or meat when booking, with Kyoto vegetables and a special sauce); rice (a jewel-shaped three-tier box, Kyoto pickles, bonito flakes, rich egg for tamago-kake-gohan); dessert; winter Jerusalem-artichoke soup and duck loin simmered with yellow yuzu; grand opening 28 January 2025; the story of a woman who grew up in 南山城村, Kyoto. Tabelog: Japanese cuisine, sukiyaki, shabu-shabu; reservation only; 東山区宮川筋四条下る宮川筋5-324-2; 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo and Kiyomizu-Gojo Stns; lunch at 10:00, 12:00 and 14:00 (one hour each); dinner 17:00–20:30 last entry (about two hours); closed Wednesday; all start together; 10 seats (counter); non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR; invoice T2120001154574 (株式会社リーフィ); courses: lunch ¥5,000 and ¥8,000, dinner ¥13,800, ¥14,800 and ¥16,000. Reviews (December 2025–August 2026, in English): a young owner cooking alone, tamago-kake-gohan, Omi beef, sukiyaki.

公式サイト (mizai.jp): 御料理 未在、主人 石原仁司、2026年6月.en: Official site (mizai.jp): Mizai; the master, 石原仁司 (Hitoshi Ishihara); 22 years since opening in June 2026 (greeting dated August, Reiwa 8); "still only halfway along the road"; for the anniversary, the master's own spice blend "八味" (¥2,000 a bottle including tax, two for ¥3,500); everyone starts together at 18:00; about three hours for the tea kaiseki (the Mizai-style menu); cuisine charge ¥65,000 (tax excluded), service charge 10% extra; market price in January and October; tea room (private room) ¥35,000 (tax excluded); payment basically in cash (cards accepted); bookings from a year ahead; the phone is hard to reach during service and an hour either side; portion size and allergies are checked; the shop calls a week before; cancellation fees 50% from seven days before, 100% from five days; smart casual or better (kimono included); "一座建立"; children from middle-school age. Tabelog (corporate member): Mizai, Japanese cuisine, 東山区八坂鳥居前東入ル円山町613, Maruyama Park; closed Wednesday and irregularly; 14 counter seats and a private room; The Tabelog Award Silver 2019–2023, Bronze 2024–2026; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025; moved from 円山町620-1. Reviews (May–September 2026): no food photos, tea-kaiseki etiquette explained at the start, large portions, sashimi, hassun, scorched-rice tea porridge, fruit, matcha whisked by the master.

公式サイト (mizuno-osaka.com): 本場大阪、道頓堀お好み焼の老.en: Official site (mizuno-osaka.com): Mizuno, a long-established okonomiyaki shop on Dotonbori in Osaka itself; from February 2026 the Thursday closing ended and the shop is open as usual; just inside the arcade from Dotonbori; a small okonomiyaki shop with no name that has lasted more than 70 years here; from yoshoku-yaki to yam-yaki; choice ingredients from Kuromon Market, Osaka's kitchen, and tenkasu, salt, ichimi, ponzu and rice from shops known by face; customers from all over Japan and overseas; 11:00–22:00 (last order 21:00), open every day. Commitment: the swirl of the character の; rooted in yoshoku-yaki; minced meat added at the idea of the previous owner, an ideas man; fish from the fishmonger, meat from the butcher, pickles from the pickle shop, konnyaku from the konnyaku shop, delivered by bicycle. Menu: a mix of six fillings (pork, squid, shrimp, scallop, octopus, oysters in winter, and the house minced meat); yoshoku-yaki on the chewy batter handed down from the grandparents; yam-yaki of 100% yam with no flour, the steady No. 1 for 34 years since its debut; modern-yaki; Doton-yaki, made in thanks to 安井道頓; Doton soba with noodles and sauce produced by the 粉モン協会; courses for two or more; tax included. Tabelog: Okonomiyaki Tabelog 100 2018, 2019, 2022, 2024 and 2025, no reservations, cards from ¥3,000, 38 seats (12 at the counter), non-smoking. Reviews (December 2024–October 2026): always a line of about 30 minutes, order while waiting, yam-yaki with scallops and pork belly, mustard mayonnaise, Mizuno-yaki ¥1,650, Doton soba ¥1,300, the staff cook for you, many overseas customers.

公式サイト (muromachi-yui.jp): 京都烏丸御池の会席料理店、1.en: Official site (muromachi-yui.jp): a kaiseki restaurant at Karasuma Oike, Kyoto; 17:00–20:30 (last entry); closed Wednesday; reservation only; "aiming for a meal like no other"; goes to the market every morning and buys only the best; daily contact with Tango fishing ports; menus not bound by convention; a counter-centred interior and a garden; sencha blended for the season; sake including vintages; owner 前田一光 (MAEDA KAZUTERU): born in Nakatsugawa, Gifu; in the kitchen from childhood under a father who ran a restaurant; trained in Kyoto after high school; became owner of 室町 唯 in December 2019. Tabelog (staff-maintained): Japanese cuisine; 中京区押小路通烏丸西入金吹町459; 3 min on foot from Karasuma Oike Stn exit 2; reservation only (by the day before); omakase course only; 10 seats (counter); private hire up to 20; cards accepted; opened 15 December 2019. Reviews (July 2025–September 2026, in English): course ¥30,000, two Michelin stars, nine or ten side dishes for the rice, hoba sushi, hairy crab, prawn tempura wrapped in corn, a curved counter looking onto the garden.

公式サイト (nakamitsu-kyoto.com): 中満、御所南の日本料理.en: Official site (nakamitsu-kyoto.com): Nakamitsu — Japanese cuisine south of the Imperial Palace; seasonal ingredients, mostly local, chosen by the owner; new life breathed into tradition; from an anteroom into the counter room; 5-chome 496-2 Sanbonki, Nakagyo-ku; from 17:00 (Wednesday closed, irregular); booking online or by phone. Tabelog: Japanese; 5 min on foot from Marutamachi Stn; 18:00–22:00; closed Wednesday; reservation only; everyone starts together (online bookings 18:00 only); 6 seats (counter); private hire for 20; service charge 10%; junior-high age and up, eating the same food as adults; shoes off at the entrance; non-smoking; cards accepted; opened 24 September 2024. Reviews (November 2024–September 2026, English): omakase ¥25,000 (tax included); owner Keijiro Nakamitsu, with the owner's wife; trained at Tomikoji Yamakishi and Anku; called Michelin-starred (August 2025 review); steamed crab and egg custard, Awaji saba sushi, kōbako crab, white-miso soup, fugu milt, sakura-shrimp rice; a couple from Shiga Prefecture.

公式サイト (nikolabo1201.com): ワインのための煮込み料理研究.en: Official site (nikolabo1201.com): NIKOLABO, a stew research lab for wine; researches dishes for wine every day; seasonal ingredients ordered in from Kyotango City, the chef's home area too; wines chosen by the chef, who is also a sommelier; 下京区稲荷町329 エリッツ四条河原町ビル 2F; 12:00–14:00 (booking by the day before, one-drink minimum), 18:00–23:00 (from 17:00 on Saturday and Sunday; last order 22:00); closed Monday. Tabelog: Italian, meat dishes, wine bar; 1 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn; lunch Tue, Thu, Sat 12:00–14:00; dinner Tue–Fri 18:00–23:00, Sat–Sun 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); closed Monday; 16 seats (6 counter, 10 table); private hire up to 25 standing; BYO wine ¥2,000 a bottle; cards and PayPay; opened 1 December 2017; menu (updated December 2024): Kyotango fresh-fish carpaccio ¥1,200, more than 30 stews, more than 40 wines, all-you-can-drink courses ¥7,000 and ¥8,000. Reviews (2023–2026, in English): braised pork belly (lotus-root or apple sauce), lamb stewed in tomato, water eggplant with parmesan, persimmon with gorgonzola, the owner cooking and serving alone.

公式サイト (niku-miyoshi.com): にくの匠 三芳（みよし）、2.en: Official site (niku-miyoshi.com): Niku no Takumi Miyoshi, opened at the end of 2004 in Gion, Kyoto; the starting point was the thrill of "peak freshness" when, before the shop opened, the finest meat craftsman served beef butchered that same day; "I want to create meat dishes no one has ever seen"; exploring new flavours every day in conversation with the meat; please come hungry; at the inn "THE MIYOSHI" (one group only), the finest wagyu kaiseki found only at Miyoshi; Gion-machi Minamigawa 570-15, Higashiyama; two sittings, 17:00 and 20:00; closed Sundays; bookings by phone (12:00–23:00, not Sundays) and through OMAKASE, TABLEALL (English) and foodies-reserve; closed for renovation 3 January – 30 June 2023. Waraku web: the owner, 伊藤力 (Tsutomu Ito), entered the world of meat because a friend was a beef grader; self-taught as a cook; the shop opened in 2005; the building was originally a salon run by the owner's mother. Serai.jp (山本益博): the master, Ito-san, cooking behind the counter, talks about the beef; an o-shinogi of Shanghai crab, beef and caviar. Tabelog (corporate member): The Tabelog Award 2026 Silver, Tajima beef special course ¥60,000, with sukiyaki ¥75,000, service charge 10%, 8 counter seats, middle-school age and up. Reviews (May–October 2026): tongue sashimi, beef tongue cured on kombu, beef toro sashimi, shabu-shabu, steak, sukiyaki, soy-marinated egg yolk with rice.

公式サイト (noeud.osaka.tagaya.co.jp): 自然、季節、.en: Official site (noeud.osaka.tagaya.co.jp): a sustainable restaurant where nature, the seasons and food are in harmony; weddings in the chapel too. Tabelog (English edition): Noeud. × THE CHEF'S, Minami-Senba 3-3-17, KOKOHOTEL Osaka Shinsaibashi 1F, 5 min on foot from Shinsaibashi Station; opened 18 January 2023; sister restaurant of Noeud.TOKYO; Thu–Sat 12:30–15:00 and 18:30–21:30 (last order 19:00), Sun 12:30–15:00, closed Mon–Wed, hours may change for weddings and private hire; 10% service charge; non-smoking; wheelchair access; kids' plate or mini course on request; English-speaking staff; vegetables from contracted farms used down to leaves and peel; fish bought without fixing the species; culled game; one animal-free dish in every course and a fully vegan course. Lunch (October 2026): Déclic 4 dishes ¥4,455, Grâce 6 dishes ¥6,050. Reviews (November 2025 to October 2026): Chef Minato, salmon tartare, a plate made only of carrots, sesame and apple butter, a calm room with mostly Japanese guests, some plates hard to eat, group bookings only for a while in March 2026, Halloween afternoon tea.

公式サイト (ohashitei.co.jp): 総本家 肉の大橋亭、近江牛匠技.en: Official site (ohashitei.co.jp): Sohonke Niku no Ohashi Tei — Omi beef craftsmanship, founded Meiji 27 (1894); main shop on Matsubara-dori west of Yamato-oji, Higashiyama-ku; 10:00–17:30; closed Sunday; South processing centre (Minami-ku); autumn sale in September 2026; meat-day sale on 29 October 2026; a stall at the 11th Kyoto meat festival. Tabelog: croquettes; 10:00–17:30 (daily); 3 seats; cards and QR accepted; founded in Meiji 27 by the first generation (Zen'emon Ohashi in the English translation). Reviews (2017–2025, English): Omi beef croquette ¥180, menchi-katsu ¥300, fillet cutlet ¥600, freshly fried to eat in, cards from ¥3,000.

公式サイト (oldhongkong-kyoto.net): 老香港酒家京都 (.en: Official site (oldhongkong-kyoto.net): 老香港酒家京都 (Old Hong Kong Restaurant Kyoto), Hong Kong cuisine joining the Cantonese tradition with the latest trends; seafood from the live tank; dim sum served from carts; cooks from Hong Kong; individual plating at the table; began in Kobe's Ijinkan district; opened in December 2004 with COCON KARASUMA; KDA Co., Ltd.; general manager 陳暁冬 (Chin Gyoto, born 1972 in Beijing); culinary adviser 劉錦超 (Ryu Kincho, born 1965 in Taishan, Guangdong); head chef 陳李富 (Chin Rifu, born 1964 in Guangdong, came to Japan in 1992, head chef in 2026); eight carts; Hong Kong dim sum course (90-minute order buffet) ¥5,000, elementary-school children ¥2,500, infants ¥1,500; lunch courses ¥6,600 and ¥8,800; chef's lunch ¥2,280 (tax and service included); 10% service charge extra; 下京区烏丸通四条下ル水銀屋町620 COCON烏丸 B1; lunch 11:30–15:30 (last order 15:00), dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); open all year (except two building closure days). Tabelog: Chinese and dim sum; 92 seats; 5 private rooms; non-smoking; wheelchair access; cards, UnionPay and PayPay; no same-day cancellations; Chinese WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023 and 2024. Reviews (2020–2026, in English).

公式サイト (pasta-entoen.net): PASTA＋ (パスタピュ.en: Official site (pasta-entoen.net): PASTA+ (Pasta Più), a pasta workshop that also sells food and goods; the '+' means it is not only pasta; Italian food that makes Italians feel at home; everything including bread and cakes made in house; OEM pasta for the trade. Same-day, seat-only and 5+ bookings by phone; online booking sites take courses only. A stall at the Harukas Kintetsu main store, 8–13 October 2026; frozen pasta featured in Amakara Techo, August issue. Tabelog (English edition): Itachibori 2-4-4, Nishi-ku, 永瑞 Building 1F, 6 min on foot from Nishi-Ohashi Station exit 1; opened 21 April 2022; Tue–Sat 9:00–21:00, Sun 9:00–15:00 (last order), closed Monday and the day after a holiday; English menu and English-speaking staff; non-smoking. Menu (July 2026): three seasonal appetizers ¥1,500 (a plant-based selection of three available), tortellini, potato gnocchi, Tosa akaushi lasagna, breakfast hot sandwiches and eggs Benedict, dinner courses ¥6,600–11,000. Reviews (2026): handmade tagliatelle, ravioli, mushroom cream, self-imported olive oil, attentive service, plates divided for sharing, one diner found the clams and bottarga flat, the cheese dishes did not suit one family.

公式サイト (patisserie-s.com): パティスリーエス、本店は下京.en: Official site (patisserie-s.com): Patisserie S; main shop at 下京区高辻通室町西入繁昌町300-1, カノン室町四条 1F, 11:00–19:00 (last order 18:30); salon at 中京区朝倉町546, Wealth Early Tenpo 1F, 13:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); both closed Wednesday and Thursday; may close early once the fresh cakes are gone; fresh cakes, baked goods, chilled sweets, confitures. Tabelog: cakes and café; no reservations; cards and e-money accepted; Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2023, 2026. Reviews (July–October 2026, in English): the signature cake 'S', eat-in only at the salon, sold out by early afternoon, terrace seats.

公式サイト (perkeo-kyoto.com): 京都市岡崎のドイツパン専門店.en: Official site (perkeo-kyoto.com): German bakery Bäckerei Perkeo in Okazaki, Kyoto; Johnny and Mariko, who hold the Meister, the highest qualification for German bakers; 100% handmade from natural yeast; domestic rye and wheat, and organic German spelt (dinkel) milled in house; about 20 of some 30 recipes each day; 8 types of natural yeast built from 3 starters brought from Germany; the story of Perkeo: Johnny from Germany and Mariko from Kyoto; went to Germany alone in August 2004; apprenticed at a Heidelberg bakery; Geselle in February 2007; met Johnny at the state bakery school in Weinheim; Meister in July 2009; opened in Kyoto in December 2009; Perkeo is the name of a figure in Heidelberg legend; later married Johnny; Johnny main chef from September 2018; café: Dallmayr coffee and tea, German beer, coffee ¥550, cappuccino ¥750, iced coffee ¥620; shop: 左京区岡崎天王町54-1 クリヨン岡崎 1F; weekdays 9:00–18:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 7:30–18:00; closed Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday. Tabelog: bread, chocolate, café; 6 seats; cards, e-money and PayPay; opened 6 December 2009. Reviews (May–November 2026, in English): Laugen pretzel ¥350, Brötchen ¥240, Roggen ¥590, Linzer Torte, greetings in English or German.

公式サイト (petitlapin-fr.com): フランス地方家庭料理とフラ.en: Official site (petitlapin-fr.com): French regional home cooking and French wine; a shop where food-lovers gather, never without a smile, like a greedy rabbit forever munching; house "a little rye" bread; lunch 12:00–15:00 (last entry 13:30); café and dessert 14:30–17:30 (last order 16:30); dinner 18:00–23:00 (last entry 21:30); children welcome from January 2026 (a course at lunch, a main at dinner, booked by the day before only); closed Wednesday, plus one run of days off a month; 396, Gokomachi-dori Ayanokoji-agaru, Shimogyo-ku. Lunch menu A ¥3,000, menu B ¥4,000 (+¥1,200 for two starters); Bistro menu ¥5,500 (18:00–21:00 last order); à la carte: escargots, mussels, Nagahama Anegawa ayu confit, Satsuma pork tongue sauté, tête de cochon, boudin noir; mains: venison crépinette with foie gras, roast beef, lamb rump, roast French duck, lobster. Venison from ジビエ堂 in Hino, Shiga. Tabelog: bistro, French, wine bar; lunch 12:00–15:00; dinner 18:00–22:30; closed Wednesday; bread and amuse-bouche ¥700; corkage ¥2,000; no mobile phones in the room; no children; 15 seats (5 counter, 10 table); no smoking; English menu; opened 5 July 2009; vegetables, meat and fish from Miyama; about 70 à la carte dishes. Reviews (December 2023 – September 2026, in English): venison crépinette, tarte Tatin, crème brûlée, the owner-chef's warm service.

公式サイト (petitrestaurant-naito.com): 季節の料理.en: Official site (petitrestaurant-naito.com): a shop for seasonal dishes and tonkatsu; opened in 2001 at Kawaramachi-Sanjo as an 8-seat, four-tsubo counter (the owner was 33); moved to Yanagibaba-dori south of the Imperial Palace in 2004 and to Fuyacho-dori south of the palace in 2019; owner 内藤毅彦; from September 2026 open straight through 13:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); 13:00–16:00 one drink per person (coffee or tea after the meal counts); from 16:00 one drink plus a seasonal otsukidashi ¥800 (table charge); the lunch set menu ended at the end of August 2026; reservations preferred; closed Monday; Naitou special plate (10 a day, 13:00–15:00): fillet tonkatsu, hamburg steak, fried shrimp, pork-shabu salad, green salad, plate only ¥2,900, with rice and tonjiru ¥3,500; menu: loin tonkatsu, Gorgonzola pork cutlet, ginger-and-shiso mille-feuille cutlet, pizza katsu, house ham cutlet, tonteki, wild sea bream curry rice, shrimp-and-crab cream croquettes, oyster fry (seasonal), wagyu hamburg steak, black-wagyu beef stew; 尾張町217, Sun Lotus Ikeji 1F, Nakagyo-ku. Tabelog: yoshoku, tonkatsu, hamburg steak; 25 seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; Yoshoku WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (October 2025–November 2026, in English): beef cutlet ¥3,300, Naitou plate, tonjiru, hamburg steak.

公式サイト (provision-tokyo.com): 六本木 大人のフレンチ.en: Official site (provision-tokyo.com): Provision, a French restaurant for grown-ups in Roppongi, opened in winter 2016 in a back alley close to Roppongi crossing and Midtown, and became a subscription restaurant in autumn 2017. The members-only door opens by registered fingerprint; nearly all food and drink is covered by the monthly fee: Unison (up to 4 including the member) ¥55,000 a month, De Luxe (up to 4 including the member) ¥88,000 a month (including caviar, foie gras and truffle); some items extra; billed monthly to a credit card; annual payment also possible. Open 18:00–2:00; phone from 15:00. Roppongi 4-5-13, Reve Roppongi 3F, 2 min walk from Roppongi Station exit 7. Tabelog: daily 18:00–24:00; 20 seats; non-smoking; BYO allowed; opened 18 February 2016. Reviews (October 2025–October 2026): a fingerprint entrance; clams steamed in white wine; risotto in the clam broth; drinks keep coming unless you say otherwise.

公式サイト (radice-kyoto.com): RADICE〈ラディーチェ〉.en: Official site (radice-kyoto.com): RADICE (Radice), Kagamiya-cho 50, 3 min from Marutamachi Stn exit 6; lunch (Fri, Sat, Sun and holidays only) starts together at 12:00, dinner (Thu–Mon) at 18:30; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; online booking only; autumn break 27 October – 5 November 2026; chef 根本嘉彦 (Yoshihiko Nemoto): born in Shiga Prefecture in 1977, a cook from age 15, about 10 years of Japanese cooking at ぎをん浜作 in Kyoto and in Kitashinchi, Osaka, to Italy at 29, about 2 years' training at Ristorante Magnolia, chef at 祇園t.v.b and Vineria t.v.b, opened RistoriaRadice as owner-chef in 2013, renewed in 2021 as today's Radice. One omakase course, "Idee e Sapori", ¥19,800 (tax included, plus 10% service), the same at lunch and dinner; pairing full (8 or more) ¥9,900, half (5) ¥6,600; a walk-in wine cellar of about 600 bottles; Selected Restaurant in the Michelin Guide Kyoto Osaka 2026; takeaway roast beef; New Year osechi. Tabelog (corporate member): The Tabelog Award Bronze 2019, 2025, 2026, Italian WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025, 12 seats (8 at the counter, one table for 4), no children under 10, smoking space on the balcony, opened 21 December 2013. Reviews (August–October 2026): tart of 11 vegetables, panzerotti, pistachio and lobster capellini, a pasta event, a renovated townhouse.

公式サイト (ramen-toka.com): 塩つけ麺 灯花、四谷2-11 龍.en: Official site (ramen-toka.com): Shio Tsukemen Toka, 龍文堂ビル 1F, Yotsuya 2-11; 11:00–22:00; open year-round; 12 seats; light chicken shio soba, shio tsukemen, rich seafood tsukemen, boiled gyoza, kombu soba-yu to thin the broth, oimeshi rice to finish; run by Good Noodle Innovation, which also runs the 鯛塩そば灯花 brand (a Chofu shop opened in October 2026). Tabelog: the shio tsukemen has a delicate aroma of chicken and seafood and the sharpness of a special salt tare, served with yuzu pepper; the soy tsukemen with wasabi; 11:00–23:00; 12 seats; non-smoking; no cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; allergy information available; opened 28 August 2019. Reviews (August–October 2026): shio tsukemen ¥990, a clear golden soup richer than it looks, chewy straight noodles, grilled chashu, kombu soba-yu, oimeshi, ticket machine, one diner found the soy tsukemen ordinary.

公式サイト (reine-des-pres.com): 素材はすべて自ら選びとっ.en: Official site (reine-des-pres.com): every ingredient is a fine one chosen in person, finished with the utmost simplicity; omakase course only; lunch ¥11,000, dinner ¥22,000 (with tax, 10% service extra); wine pairing: dégustation ¥10,000, standard ¥16,000; a chef with sommelier qualifications; concept "ingredients × heat × simplicity"; one-of-a-kind dishes made with artists; bookings by phone (075-223-2337); reservations at least two days ahead; 100% cancellation charge from three days before; dress code (no shorts, trousers shorter than the calf, beach sandals and the like); 駒之町537-1, south of Marutamachi on 中町通, Kamigyo-ku; 3 min walk from Keihan Jingu-Marutamachi; lunch 11:30–12:00 (L.O.), dinner 18:00–19:00 (L.O.); closed Wednesday and the second and third Thursday (may vary); 6 seats; private hire for 8; overseas guests book through Pocket Concierge; news: summer break 16–22 August, peaches from 桃里庵 in Okayama, summer asparagus from ジェットファーム長谷川, Aichi duck, a curry event at Jingu-michi. Michelin Guide: the chef's themes are ingredients, heat and simplicity; no more than three ingredients on a plate; Kiyomizu-ware dishes. Tabelog: French, creative, innovative; reservation only; 6 seats; cards accepted; 10% service; opened 26 November 2012; French WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025; allergies and disliked ingredients to be told in advance; middle-school age and up. Reviews (October 2025–September 2026, in English): tomato consommé, Homage to the Master, Playful Spirit, premium pumpkin, game, tea in test tubes, Chef Akai.

公式サイト (ristorante-noro.com): リストランテ野呂、「ふ.en: Official site (ristorante-noro.com): Ristorante Noro, "For ordinary days and special days alike. A restaurant like a kappo, serving a hundred guests a hundred different dishes."; a course menu and a daily-changing menu. Tabelog: Italian and yoshoku; 中京区西ノ京職司町67-14; 8 min on foot from JR Nijo Station; Tue–Sun 11:30–13:30 and 17:30–20:30; closed Monday; reservations taken; 12 counter seats (tables upstairs); non-smoking; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); sommelier; opened 13 June 2017; Italian WEST Tabelog 100 2021 and 2025. Reviews (July–October 2026, in English): chef Noro trained in Italy, then worked at Hotel Granvia Kyoto's La Risata and at Yoshoku Ogata before opening; menchi-katsu with demi-glace and balsamic; menchi-katsu set ¥3,300; dinner course ¥10,000 (¥11,000 with tax).

公式サイト (ristorante-tvb.com): 京都祇園のイタリアン「リ.en: Official site (ristorante-tvb.com): Italian 'Ristorante t.v.b' (Ristorante Ti Voglio Bene) in Gion, Kyoto; courses reflecting the seasons; choose starter, pasta and main from the day's recommendations; wines chosen by a sommelier; 東山区祇園町南側570-155; lunch 12:00–13:00 (L.O.), dinner 18:00–20:00 (L.O.); closed Sundays and irregular weekdays; dinner ¥15,000 (tax included, 10% service extra): edamame purée with cuttlefish and fresh sea urchin, salad of 13 vegetables with whelk, truffle-scented egg and karasumi, Canadian lobster wrapped in kadaif (+¥1,500), chilled pasta with fruit-tomato sauce, ripe Yamanashi white peach with caviar, Nagasaki kasago with okahijiki in oil sauce, Kameoka beef Bolognese with zucchini, Wakayama abalone and ito-nori risotto (+¥2,500), roast Wakayama kinmedai, roast Kyoto Kameoka beef misuji, Australian black truffle (+¥2,000), shirokuma ice, tiramisu with crunchy espresso cookie; lunch ¥6,800 (tax included, 10% service extra). Tabelog: Italian, wine bar; phone easiest 11–12 and 14–16; allergies and dislikes in advance; 10% service charge; 14 seats; private rooms (2, 4, 6); cards, e-money and QR; opened 30 January 2007; invoice T9130001058710 (株式会社ｔｖｂ). Reviews (April–October 2026, in English): machiya exterior and modern interior, wine cellar, kadaif lobster, chilled capellini, tiramisu, lunch ¥7,480, dinner ¥16,500.

公式サイト (robecarre.com): エンメエッセ北新地、大阪府大阪市北.en: Official site (robecarre.com): Emme Esse Kitashinchi, 浜村サンプラザビル 2F, 1-2-15 堂島, Kita-ku, Osaka; 3 min on foot from Kitashinchi Station; 12:00–14:30 (last entry 13:00); 17:00–23:00 (last entry 22:00); allergies and dislikes asked when booking; allergies accommodated as far as possible, but not egg, wheat or dairy, or two or more. Tabelog (shop member): Emme Esse, Italian and innovative; 5 min from Oebashi and Kitashinchi stations; lunch and dinner Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat and holidays; Wednesday dinner only; closed Sundays; courses until 20:00, à la carte after; service charge 8%; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 12 seats (counter of 4, table of 8); a private room for 2–3; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; opened 21 March 2023; ingredients from the Kinki region and around; a monthly course; omakase of nine dishes ¥15,000; with caviar and wagyu fillet ¥27,500; The Emme Esse with Ise lobster and truffle ¥33,000; wine and sake pairing free-flow ¥6,500; non-alcoholic ¥2,998. Invoice registration: M・Y Co., Ltd. Reviews (November 2025–October 2026): Laborie ham sliced on a Berkel slicer with water eggplant; squid with cauliflower paste and sea urchin; squid-ink lace; chilled tagliolini; seafood brodetto; abalone with pesto; sweet-shrimp tart; Spanish mackerel; homemade fettuccine in matsutake broth with truffle; a comment that the chef is Mr Tanigami (from Roberto Carera); a comment that Tom Curioza used to be here; a cheerful, kind chef.

公式サイト (roppongiinakaya.jp): 六本木田舎家は昭和45年.en: Official site (roppongiinakaya.jp): Roppongi Inakaya is a robatayaki izakaya founded in 1970 (Showa 45), visited by dignitaries such as US presidents and by celebrities. Tabelog (shop member): Roppongi Inakaya East, Roppongi 3-14-7, アロービル 1F, 1 min walk from the Toei bus stop Roppongi-Go-Chome, 4 min from Roppongi Station exit 5; daily 17:00–23:00; closed 2–7 January; 10% service charge; 38 seats (all counter); private hire possible; non-smoking; cards, Alipay and WeChat Pay accepted; children welcome. Reviews (December 2025–September 2026): no menu or prices — you choose from the ingredients in front of you; grilled over charcoal and passed on long wooden paddles; kinki ¥15,000; kuruma prawn ¥6,800; small sashimi platter ¥6,710; appetizer ¥880; ¥20,000–50,000 a head; mochi pounding; cold green-tea soba to finish; many overseas guests; said to have been visited by former President Trump and former Prime Minister Abe.

公式サイト (rustsabi.com): 立礼茶室「然美」、祇園と御所南、創設.en: Official site (rustsabi.com): Ryurei Chashitsu "Sabi", in Gion and Gosho-Minami; created by the contemporary artist Taiga Takahashi (1995–2022). Tabelog: cafe; 570-120 in south Gion, T.T 2F, Higashiyama Ward; 7 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn; 12:00–18:00; reservation required; open year-round; 8 counter seats; private hire; non-smoking; cards accepted (no e-money or QR); opened 4 December 2021; the shop text speaks of Rust (the beauty of change over time) and the beauty of imperfection, and of sukiya-style architecture. Reviews (October 2024–September 2026, English): tea and sweets kaiseki ¥7,700; three sittings a day; same price with or without alcohol; five sweets with teas; hojicha with cardamom; matcha gin; pickles to finish; one diner unhappy with the service.

公式サイト (sakuichi.com): 作一、日本料理、作一に行けば、本物が.en: Official site (sakuichi.com): Sakuichi, Japanese cuisine; 'go to Sakuichi and you can eat the real thing'; in business for more than 40 years; two shops in one building: 作一本店 (3rd and 4th floors, fully private rooms: 4th floor for 2 or 4, 3rd floor for 6 or 8) and 弘作一 (ground floor, renewed 12 June 2020, manager 河村幸貴, owner 奥長弘一); moved from 三津寺筋 in October 2002; interior concept 'medieval Naniwa, Japan' by 喜多俊之 of IDKデザイン; at the counter the owner personally cooks with the season's produce; Nishi-Shinsaibashi 1-10-3, エースビル 3rd and 4th floors; from 22 March 2022, 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); from February 2024 closed Sundays and the third Monday; course from ¥15,000 (starter, sashimi, simmered dish, vinegared dish, grilled or fried dish, dressed dish, hassun, seasonal rice or kamameshi, dessert); seasonal picks (November 2026): roe-filled shishamo dried overnight, autumn mackerel bōzushi. Tabelog (shop member): Japanese cuisine, 40 seats (8 at the counter, private rooms), smoking allowed on the 3rd floor and in a 4th-floor two-person room, cards and e-money, no service charge. Reviews (September 2025–August 2026): a washi menu over a metre long, choose your ingredient and cooking style, sashimi platters, matsutake picked from a basket, dobin-mushi, mackerel bōzushi, fried fugu, for business dinners, behind the Nikko Hotel Osaka, entrance on the 4th floor.

公式サイト (sakura-sommelier.com): Sakura (六本.en: Official site (sakura-sommelier.com): Sakura (Roppongi / Italian); the chef goes to Toyosu market every day and serves seafood and seasonal vegetables picked that day; Italian cooking that brings out the ingredients; antipasto, pasta and seafood of the day; authentic Neapolitan pizza from a wood-fired oven by ジャンニ・アクント, the oldest in Naples, in the middle of the room; the menu changes daily; sommeliers pair the wine; fish sent direct from Sukumo Bay, Kochi; seasonal oysters from around Japan with wine; Roppongi 6-1-12, 21六本木ビル 1F, just behind the Lapiros Roppongi station building. Tabelog: daily 11:30–23:00; ¥550 a person after 17:00; 80 seats; non-smoking; opened 28 September 2010; a bakery, sweets shop, wine and a wagyu restaurant in the same building.
