Reviews (February–October 2026): oysters ¥830 each, horse-mackerel carpaccio ¥1,980, shirasu aglio e olio ¥2,580, lunch Margherita with salad ¥1,500; in August, one diner found the service slow.

公式サイト (salsa-cabana.com): 四谷・新橋・中野の本格メキシ.en: Official site (salsa-cabana.com): Salsa Cabana, an authentic Mexican bar in Yotsuya, Shimbashi and Nakano (current shops: the Yotsuya bar and the Nakano shop); Mexican text throughout the exterior and interior; many ingredients and seasonings brought from Mexico; Mexican beer, homemade sangria, original tequila cocktails; from August the Yotsuya shop opens 15:00–24:00 on weekends and holidays; delivery; catering. Tabelog: Salsa Cabana Bar Yotsuya ten, Mexican, bar, izakaya; Yotsuya 1-20-9 1F; 1 min walk from JR Yotsuya Station; Mon–Fri 17:00–24:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 15:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); 20 seats; non-smoking; open terrace; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 'Grill Cabana' and 'Salsa Cabana' merged. Reviews (October 2025–October 2026): hand-rolled tacos, corn tortillas, guacamole, avocado salsa, skirt-steak skewers, mojitos, tequila, the Sello M certification, full and lively at weekends.

公式サイト (sanbongi-shoten.com): 京都市、丸太町の居酒屋.en: Official site (sanbongi-shoten.com): 三本木商店 (Sanbongi Shoten), an izakaya at Marutamachi, Kyoto; mainly charcoal grilling with wine and sake; vin nature that reflects its land without relying on chemistry; sake mainly served warm; game such as boar and venison, Shinshu pasture pork, Kawamata shamo and Kyoto duck grilled over binchotan; between the Imperial Palace and the Kamo River, in Sanbongi, once a lively pleasure quarter; a renovated Kyoto townhouse over 100 years old; 9 counter seats and one large table (10 seats, shared); 上京区真町478; phone the shop for hours; closed Monday (and irregularly); 3 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn exit 3. Tabelog: izakaya; Wed–Sat 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00), Sun and holidays 16:00–21:00 (last order 20:00); closed Monday and Tuesday; charcoal dishes until an hour before last order; 19 seats; non-smoking; cards; opened 28 March 2019; izakaya WEST Tabelog 100 2026. Reviews (April–November 2026, in English): phone bookings only; opening calendar on Instagram; a report that non-drinkers are not admitted; handwritten menu.

公式サイト (sancho.co.jp): 1972年にサラダの専門店としてオー.en: Official site (sancho.co.jp): opened in 1972 as a salad specialist; carefully chosen fresh vegetables and additive-free ingredients; a green salad of six vegetables with house dressing comes with every grill; about 18 salads; Kawaramachi shop 11:30–22:00 (last order 21:00; basically closed 15:30–17:00); closed Wednesday, plus two consecutive days off twice a month; 中之町572, north of Shijo on 裏寺町通, Nakagyo-ku. Weekday lunch: omelette-and-croquette lunch ¥1,200, teriyaki hamburg-and-egg lunch ¥1,250, fry lunch ¥1,300, teriyaki-and-croquette lunch ¥1,480, mixed lunch ¥1,230, mini juice set +¥150. Weekend lunch (with today's fresh juice): A lunch ¥1,400, B lunch ¥1,600, C lunch ¥1,880. Teriyaki steak with salad ¥1,880, handmade hamburg steak with salad ¥1,330, demi-glace hamburg steak with salad ¥1,560, Select set ¥2,880, green salad ¥750, house dressings ¥650 each (with tax). Prices of teriyaki beef and wine revised from 1 May 2026. Extra closing days in 2026 (10 and 24 November, 8 and 22 December, 30 December–6 January). Sancho's history: Showa 47 (1972) opened as an individual's shop; Showa 50 (1975) サンチョ株式会社; Showa 55 (1980) Fushimi branch. Tabelog: yoshoku, hamburg steak, steak; 20 seats (8 counter, 12 table); no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; non-smoking. Reviews (April–October 2026, in English): queues of 30 minutes to over an hour, teriyaki steak, fresh juice, salad.

公式サイト (sangmi.jp): 実身美 心斎橋、Made by sangm.en: Official site (sangmi.jp): Sanmi Shinsaibashi; made by sangmi since 2002; shops in Abeno, Kyobashi, Shinsaibashi and Otemachi; the daily healthy meal for Monday 2 November (main: pork and chunky vegetables stewed in soy-milk ginger miso; three deli sides: vegetable chili con carne with Kyoto Fushimi peppers and koya tofu, satsuma mandarin and red radish pickles, Kagoshima makomodake nametake on chilled tofu); Shinsaibashisuji 1-2-22, 日宝サニーサイドプレイス 1F; Mon–Sat 11:00–21:00 (lunch 11:00–15:00, L.O. 14:30; café 15:00–17:00; dinner 17:00–21:00, L.O. 20:30); closed 15:00–17:30 once a month for staff training; closed Sundays; 3 minutes' walk from gate 2 of Shinsaibashi Station on the Midosuji Line; enzyme dressings. Tabelog (shop member): organic; reservations; cards, PayPay and Alipay accepted; 31 seats; non-smoking; Wi-Fi; power outlets; particular about vegetables; healthy menu; allergy information; vegetarian options; kids menu; takeaway and delivery; opened 2 March 2015. Reviews (April–October 2026): the daily healthy meal; brown rice and miso soup; purple cabbage dressing; taco rice ¥1,880; brown-rice curry; no white sugar; large rice free; water at room temperature or hot; some say the portions are small or the water lukewarm.

公式サイト (sawaichi.jp): 澤いち SAWAICHI GROUP、.en: Official site (sawaichi.jp): Sawaichi SAWAICHI GROUP, Japanese cuisine in Roppongi; its shops are Sawaichi head shop, 炭屋 and Una Ichi Kurofune. Tabelog (shop-maintained): Sumiya, Roppongi 3-9-12, 2 min from Roppongi Stn exit 5; Mon–Sat 18:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00, last entry 22:00); closed Sundays and holidays; 10% service charge; 10 counter seats; non-smoking; cards accepted. Brand chicken from all over Japan, and kaiseki-style and seafood dishes rare at a yakitori restaurant. Courses: skewer course of 17 items ¥12,000 (before tax and service; ¥14,520), with a half bottle of KENZO ESTATE ¥18,000 (¥21,780). Reviews (March–October 2026): over 10 kinds of brand chicken; negima; ginkgo; LYB pork from Shizuoka; liver pâté; eel hand roll; abalone and eggplant; oyakodon to finish; an owner with a sommelier qualification; leftovers can be taken home.

Official site (sawaichi.jp): Sawaichi SAWAICHI GROUP, Japanese cuisine in Roppongi; its shops are Sawaichi head shop, 炭屋 and Una Ichi Kurofune. Tabelog (shop-maintained): Una Ichi Kurofune, Roppongi 3-9-12, 源氏ビル 1F, 3 min from Roppongi Stn (Hibiya line); daily 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–21:00; closed on public holidays (may open Sundays and holidays; see Instagram); no service or cover charge; 14 seats; non-smoking; cards and PayPay accepted; menus in English, Chinese and Korean; takeaway and delivery; opened 15 April 2025. Grilled over charcoal and straw, with a house sauce simmered with eel bones. Reservation-only dinner course, 10 dishes, ¥6,600. Reviews (October 2026): four starters, Uzaku, eel liver, eel with egg, shirayaki with maitake, eel hot pot, mini hitsumabushi; hitsumabushi ¥2,800; full with bookings and walk-ins.

公式サイト (sekitei0204.com、2016〜2019年): 海鮮とお.en: Official site (sekitei0204.com, 2016–2019): Seafood and Obanzai Seki Tei; proud of dishes made with very fresh fish bought from Aomori and seasonal ingredients; fish and produce from Hachinohe, Aomori Prefecture; cooking methods such as raw, grilled and simmered; about ten carefully chosen sakes at all times; a homely, relaxed atmosphere; homemade dishes with the owner's own ideas; in December 2017 mackerel from the Hachinohe offshore grounds, surf clams and cod arrived from Hachinohe; the former shop was at Nihonbashi-Koamicho 13-3; a notice of 14 December 2019 announced the move to Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 1-18-6, opening Monday 16 December; lunch came with rice, salad and senbei-jiru (2016). Tabelog (shop member): seasonal Aomori seafood and obanzai; local sake chosen by the owner; courses from ¥3,980 (before tax); omakase course of 6 dishes ¥5,000 (tax included); after-work set ¥980; appetizer charge ¥500 (2 small dishes); Mon 16:30–23:00, Tue–Thu 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–23:00, Fri until 24:00, Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–22:00; closed Sundays and holidays; 15 seats; 日宝人形町ビル 2F; opened 16 December 2019. Reviews (December 2025–September 2026): service seafood bowl ¥1,200 (up ¥200 in April 2026; one diner paid ¥1,300 in August); fish broth to make seafood chazuke; a cook from Hachinohe; about 100 dishes; plenty of sake; non-smoking by September; a big TV in the room.

公式サイト (shabutei.co.jp): しゃぶ亭の胡麻だれは銀胡麻をじっ.en: Official site (shabutei.co.jp): Shabu Tei's sesame sauce is silver sesame slowly roasted to bring out its sesamol, kneaded for hours in a stone mill and blended with 22 spices; its flavour and body stay even as it thins, and at the end it becomes soup; shabu-shabu is decided by the meat and the sauce; shops: Shinsaibashi (formerly the 清水町 shop), Nishi-Umeda, Hankyu Kappa Yokocho, 三ツ寺筋. Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Shabu Tei Shinsaibashi, shabu-shabu, Japanese cuisine and izakaya; しゃぶ亭ビル, 1-4-11 Shinsaibashi-suji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Shinsaibashi Stn exit 6; daily 11:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed 31 December and 1 January; reservations accepted; cards accepted, no e-money; 188 seats (counter 24, tables, private and semi-private rooms, rooms for 12, 30 and 40); sunken seating, karaoke, darts; non-smoking; opened 1 December 2003; over 200,000 servings of sesame sauce a year across four shops in Osaka City; one pure-copper pot per person; with a coupon, all-you-can-eat black wagyu and all-you-can-drink ¥7,800. Reviews (June–October 2026): you can watch sesame being ground in a stone mortar; beef shabu-shabu ¥1,900 (vegetables, udon); pork shabu-shabu double 160 g; tofu; rice and pickles refilled; garlic and green onion for the ponzu and sesame sauce; courses (starter, premium loin or special black wagyu, udon, ice cream); many solo diners on 1F; some days about half the guests from overseas; one diner asked for separate chopsticks for raw meat.

公式サイト (shinkyogoku-stand.jp、新京極スタンド): 昭和.en: Official site (shinkyogoku-stand.jp, 新京極スタンド): a taishu sakaba founded in 1927 (Showa 2); open 12:00–21:00, closed Tuesday; 中京区新京極通り四条上ル; a public dining hall opened by the first owner, who moved from Asakusa in Tokyo after the Great Kanto Earthquake, in a Taisho-era building; it began as a 'ten-sen shokudo'; there was once a Stand north shop and stalls in Yasaka Shrine and Maruyama Park; the marble counter and tables are as they were at the founding; an electric register; early-Showa posters. Menu: daily set meal, om-demiglace don, fried noodles, ramen, oden, homemade croquette, karaage, Gekkeikan 伝匠, a Kirin 'perfect draft' shop (prices from that time). Tabelog: izakaya, croquette, shokudo, 中京区新京極通四条上ル中之町546; 12:00–21:00, closed Tuesday; no reservations; 42 seats; no cards, e-money or QR; smoking allowed; tobacco sold inside; English menu; vegetarian options. Reviews (March–October 2026, in English): daytime drinking, shared tables, a red slip, the bill done on an abacus, croquette ¥800, agedashi eggplant ¥650, kizushi ¥800, draft beer ¥650, one dish and one drink each, smoking allowed.

公式サイト (shinrin-syokudo.com): 「出張ケータリングカレ.en: Official site (shinrin-syokudo.com): 'Travelling catering curry: Shinrin Shokudo has been a shop for almost 14 years'; 'the travelling curry stand that became a shop'; pouring the spirit of making things into the spices, the way an artist wrestles with material; irregular closing days, so check the calendar; a blank day or one with no hours listed is a day off; sometimes closed for catering jobs; 中京区西ノ京内畑町24-4; event stalls 2006–2010. Tabelog: curry; 11:30–14:30 and 18:00–20:00; irregular closing days; reservations accepted; 22 seats (counter 4, tables 8, a tatami private room for about 10); no cards, e-money or QR; opened 24 March 2012; Curry Tabelog 100 2017, 2018, 2022; Curry WEST Tabelog 100 2019, 2020, 2023, 2024, 2026. Reviews (August–October 2026, in English): a room surrounded by plants, daily plates of two or three curries, squid-ink duck keema, queues and waiting.

公式サイト (sio.tokyo): 食堂 松おか (ザ・ニューワールド)、大阪.en: Official site (sio.tokyo): Shokudo Matsuoka (The New World); Shinsaibashi, Osaka; izakaya; oden in an ultimate dashi and sashimi, casual Japanese food; carefully chosen seasonal ingredients and the plates of craftsmen; drinks from around Japan; a calm space; Matsuoka's ultimate-dashi oden (chef's choice, five kinds) ¥1,280 (¥1,408 with tax); sashimi platter (from one portion) ¥1,680 (¥1,848); Amakusa Kuroge wagyu steak ¥2,200 (¥2,420); udon in oden dashi ¥650 (¥715); Kujo negi and bluefin tuna ramen ¥1,800 (¥1,980); Shinsaibashisuji 1-8-3, Shinsaibashi PARCO North Building B2F; lunch 12:00–15:00, dinner 17:00–22:00; irregular closures; 25 seats; cards, e-money and QR accepted. Tabelog (shop member): a diner run by the Sio Group; izakaya, seafood; former name The New World; opened 18 March 2021; weekdays 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–22:00; closed days follow Shinsaibashi PARCO; about 25 kinds of oden from ¥240, in a dashi of kombu and bonito flakes layered with chicken and finished with white soy sauce; fresh fish delivered daily and aged; ramen at weekday lunch; courses currently suspended; non-smoking (smoking area on the same floor); free Wi-Fi. Reviews (June–October 2026): renamed from The New World; omakase course; fried horse mackerel with bettara-pickle tartar; soft-boiled egg with fuki miso sauce; shumai in dashi; straw-grilled bonito tataki; Kujo negi and bluefin tuna ramen ¥1,200 (whole-wheat noodles, yuzu); a Bib Gourmand in the Michelin Guide; some find the QR ordering confusing.

公式サイト (soba-shiraishi.j-silver.co.jp): 銀.en: Official site (soba-shiraishi.j-silver.co.jp): 銀座蕎麦うどんしら石 Roppongi, a specialist soba and udon shop; carefully chosen hachiwari soba (80% buckwheat flour, 20% wheat flour), made under the full supervision of 山根店長 of 「たぬきときつね」, a well-known soba shop in Matsudo, Chiba; Shinshu buckwheat; terrace seats; a second shop (Ginza) opened in Ginza 8-chome on 5 August 2025. Menu: Shiraishi soba, chilled tanuki soba, neba-neba soba, ume-oroshi soba, mori soba, Kyoto duck soba (nanban, zaru), salmon bowl, sweet-shrimp bowl, tendon, negitoro bowl, niku-sui, breakfast sets. The menu has been formally halal-certified by the Japan Halal Certification Promotion Organization (JHCPO), so Muslim guests can eat with peace of mind. Hours: Tue–Sat 24 hours, Sun 0:00–15:00, Mon 6:00–0:00. Operator: 株式会社KIRIKO (J.Group). Tabelog: Roppongi 6-7-8, アパホテル六本木駅前 1F, Roppongi Station exit 3, 20 seconds past FamilyMart; Tue–Sat 24 hours, Mon 6:00–24:00, Sundays and holidays 0:00–23:00; no reservations; 20 seats (counter 12, 2 tables, terrace 5); non-smoking; menu in English, Chinese and Korean; allergy information available; opened 15 February 2025. Reviews (April–October 2026): Shinshu hachiwari soba, mentaiko udon, tororo-kombu soba, neba-neba, beef-tendon kamatama udon, curry udon, bukkake inaka soba, negitoro bowl set ¥600, long udon with scissors provided, many overseas guests.

公式サイト (sobayoshi.com): 喫酒オルタナ、グループ直営店、世界.en: Official site (sobayoshi.com): Kissa Alterna; a directly run group shop; marked by the world's only existing hieroglyphs; restaurant × bar × soba; 17:00–24:00 (L.O. food 23:00, drinks 23:30); irregular closures; Shinmachi 1-8-10 (Nishi-ku), 横山ビル 1F; 22 seats; separate smoking (outdoor smoking space); 5 minutes' walk from Yotsubashi and Nishi-Ohashi stations. Tabelog (shop member): izakaya, soba, creative; 17:00–23:00, closed Wednesdays (the shop text says open daily 17:00–23:00, closed the last day of consecutive holidays); reservations; ¥550 appetizer charge; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 24 seats (counter 14, tables 10); English-speaking staff; no allergy accommodation (same kitchen and utensils, cross-contamination possible); opened 17 June 2023; the signature Shimi-ton; craft gin and original cocktails. Reviews (August–October 2026): Shimi-ton ¥2,000; Miracle Ebi Mayo ¥1,000; carpaccio ¥1,100; rare salmon cutlet; fig and prosciutto with white miso; soba to finish (cold soba with natural-yam foam, sudachi soba, tantan soba); mobile ordering; one wished for more dishes.

公式サイト (sougo.tokyo): 宗胡 SOUGO、モダンな感性を加えた.en: Official site (sougo.tokyo): Sougo, shojin cooking with a modern sensibility served kaiseki-style; shojin cooking was established in Zen temples in the 13th century; to offer fun, delicious and comfortable Japanese food in Roppongi. Owner-chef Daisuke Nomura is the eldest son of the family that runs the shojin restaurant Daigo in Atago, Tokyo; Daigo's third-generation head chef; two Michelin stars continuously from 2008; went independent in 2015 and opened Shojin Sougo; teaches and promotes shojin cooking in Japan and abroad; Plant Forward Global 50. Menu: shojin cooking built on seasonal ingredients; vegan guests can eat with peace of mind; the menu changes about every three weeks; allergies and dietary restrictions to be notified two days ahead. Dinner 17:30–23:00 (last entry 21:30); shojin kaiseki Hasu ¥18,700 (aperitif, 9 dishes, 2 desserts), Zen ¥15,400 (7 dishes, 1 dessert); 10% service charge. Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last entry 14:00): two-tier bento (10 a day) ¥6,600, lunch tray ¥1,980, shojin curry set ¥1,980, lunch kaiseki ¥13,200. Takeaway: Sougo bento ¥2,500, Shinju Box ¥4,000. Roppongi 6-1-8, 六本木グリーンビル 3F; closed Sundays and holidays; private room (7 people, room fee ¥5,000), semi-private room (5 people, ¥2,000). 淡路宗胡: THE PASONA 2F, 兵庫県淡路市岩屋. Tabelog: 42 seats, opened 23 February 2015. Reviews (January–August 2026): lunch tray ¥1,980; set with salad, dessert and drink ¥3,080; salad with kadaif; bamboo-shoot rice; fried sesame tofu; sushi in monaka; eggplant somen; you can take home the chopsticks and hand towel; many guests from overseas; vegans and soy-milk allergies accommodated.

公式サイト (soujiki-nakahigashi.jp): 草喰なかひがし、.en: Official site (soujiki-nakahigashi.jp): Soujiki Nakahigashi; operating company 有限会社草喰なかひがし; representative 中東久雄 (Hisao Nakahigashi); 浄土寺石橋町32-3, Sakyo; entry 12:00–13:00 and 18:00–19:00; closed Mondays, alternate Tuesdays (ask) and the last day of the month; cash or credit cards; bookings by phone from 8:00 on the 1st of each month for the following month (Japanese only; other languages through a booking site); lunch course from ¥12,100, dinner course from ¥24,200 (tax and service included); from 1 April 2026 lunch from ¥10,000 and dinner from ¥20,000 (tax and service extra); wild plants and vegetables gathered in the hills of Ohara, Kyoto; hassun; charcoal-grilled dishes; rice from the okudo-san stove with dried sardines (mezashi); free rice refills; the chef's lively talk; private rooms upstairs; "eat everything that can be eaten"; Michelin Green Star; 3 min from the Ginkakuji-michi bus stop. Tabelog (corporate member): The Tabelog Award Gold 2020 and others; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025; 30 seats (12 at the counter, two tatami rooms upstairs); children from upper elementary school; smart casual. Reviews (September–October 2026): Matsutake with soft-shelled turtle (Japanese photo caption), ayu, venison, Matsutake rice topped with karasumi, dried sardines and pickles, the booking line is hard to get through.

公式サイト (soupcurryohmiya.com): 阪急河原町駅徒歩2分、.en: Official site (soupcurryohmiya.com): 2 min on foot from Hankyu Kawaramachi Station, in Urateramachi; a special soup curry of Kyoto ingredients, more than 15 spices and a Japanese dashi taste, in an orange clay pot; Kyoto Akajidori chicken, 京の肉 beef, vegetables from contract farms around Japan; 7 spice levels; Mashiko-ware bowls; sister shop of the European-style curry shop CLAY POT CURRY OHMIYA; reservations by Instagram DM; former name 土鍋スープカレー近江屋清右衛門. Menu: Kyoto Akajidori chicken drumstick soup curry ¥1,580, domestic pork hamburg steak soup curry ¥1,880, 京の肉 beef braised in red wine soup curry ¥2,200, braised pork belly soup curry ¥1,650, colourful vegetable soup curry ¥1,280, extra vegetables +¥200, extra soup ¥300, potato salad ¥350, caramel ice cream ¥330. Tabelog: soup curry; 中京区裏寺町607-3 2F; 16 seats; up to two groups booked per slot; one-hour limit; menus in English, Chinese and Korean; cards, e-money and QR payments accepted; opened 21 August 2018.

公式サイト (spicegate.jp): SPICE GATE (スパイスゲー.en: Official site (spicegate.jp): SPICE GATE; "we want you to feel closer to spices"; spice curry on basmati rice from 7:30 in the morning, chai, spice sweets and drinks, blend your own garam masala, "the Village Vanguard of spices"; breakfast 7:30–11:00 (last order), lunch to dinner 11:30–21:00 (last order), Thursday 11:30–15:00 only; no regular closing day; 下京区寺町通仏光寺下る恵美須之町546番地1 しきさい寺町ビル2F; INDIA GATE (biryani and curry, 中京区天神山町271). Tabelog: curry, café, Asian and ethnic; no reservations; 22 seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR payments accepted; opened 12 May 2022; Curry WEST Tabelog 100 2024 and 2026. Reviews (September–November 2026, in English): curries ¥1,300–1,500, dashi curry katsu don ¥1,680, salmon rare-katsu curry large ¥1,980, bone-in mutton curry ¥1,580, hayashi rice ¥1,430, craft cola ¥500, lemongrass sour, a white spiral staircase.

公式サイト (starbar.jp): ４店舗ある STAR BAR (銀座、並.en: Official site (starbar.jp): STAR BAR has four shops (Ginza, Namiki, Kyoto, Hibiya Midtown); Kyoto: Pontocho is Kyoto's best-known hanamachi; with an ice-making licence, the shop makes craft ice, Raku Hyou, from fine waters around Kyoto; a kakigori shop by day in summer, with kakigori laced with liquor at night now a new speciality; 中京区木屋町通三条下る材木町185-5; made ice the star of the bar; three kinds of ice frozen in different ways; the only ice-making licence in Kyoto city. Tabelog: bar; a directly managed shop of STAR BAR GINZA; daily 17:00–24:00 (drinks L.O. 23:00); irregular closures; cards only (cashless); groups of three or more must book; table charge ¥2,200; 12 seats (8 counter, 4 table); fully non-smoking; opened 11 July 2016; Bar Tabelog 100 2022; invoice register: 松田 高雅 (individual); menu (English version, updated April 2026): Raku Hyou kakigori ¥2,500 (matcha, yuzu and fermented-milk syrups), smoked mixed nuts ¥1,000, dried fruit ¥1,000. Reviews (May–September 2026, in English): the master in a kimono, matcha kakigori, no charge until 19:00, some days open from 14:00, cocktails ¥2,000–3,000.

公式サイト (stillfoods.com/k36): K36 | The Ba.en: Official site (stillfoods.com/k36): K36 | The Bar & Rooftop — the rooftop bar & restaurant and main bar of The Hotel Seiryu Kyoto Kiyomizu, open to guests and visitors; 360-degree panoramic view; view of Hokan-ji's Yasaka Pagoda; The Bar 15:00–24:00 (23:00 L.O.); Rooftop 15:00–24:00 (food 23:00 L.O., drinks 23:30 L.O., 16 September–30 November 2026); rooftop closed in bad weather; no minors in The Bar at any time; smart casual; butler Minoru Nishida (Bar K6, Cave de K, Bar Keller); Stillfoods inc. Tabelog (shop member): dining bar / bar; 2-204-2 Kiyomizu 4F, Higashiyama-ku; no seat-only bookings; reserved seats ¥25,000 per person minimum; 10% service plus a ¥1,100 charge; 108 seats (rooftop 72, bar 36); opened 22 March 2020. Reviews (July–November 2026, English): K36 gin and tonic ¥1,650, night view of the Yasaka Pagoda, former Kiyomizu Elementary School, about an hour's wait without a booking.

公式サイト (sublime-g.com): 店舗は名駅 鮨 Sublime、難.en: Official site (sublime-g.com): shops are 名駅 Sushi Sublime, Namba Teppanyaki Sublime, Ginza French Sublime, Sublime Premium Ginza teppanyaki and Ebisu teppanyaki Sublime; a Michelin star three years running, 2018–2020. Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Namba Teppanyaki Sublime, steak, teppanyaki, Japanese cuisine; 味わいばしビル 6-D, 3-4-13 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Namba Stn; daily 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; open year-round; reservations accepted; 10% service charge; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 38 seats; private rooms; non-smoking; children welcome; a collaboration with Azabu-Juban Sublime; Kobe beef teppanyaki; lunch course comparing lean and sirloin ¥3,800; Christmas courses ¥12,000 and ¥18,000. Reviews (July–October 2026): an appetizer box, conger eel and eggplant terrine, black wagyu shabu-shabu in mushroom bouillon, live Hyogo abalone on the teppan, sirloin and lean cuts, garlic rice ¥1,200, seared wagyu sirloin sushi ¥3,500, ice cream; an 8-seat counter; the sushi restaurant on the same floor is a sister shop; dietary restrictions accommodated on request; one diner found the course too fast at about an hour; water ¥660 a litre.

公式サイト (sugitora.com): 寺町商店街と新京極商店街の間の路地の.en: Official site (sugitora.com): a hideaway in the alley between the Teramachi and Shinkyogoku arcades; original parfaits in the 2nd-floor café; gelato for walking; Sugitora Fruit Shop, a fruit shop at Kawaramachi-Sanjo for over 100 years, closed in 2008 and came back in 2017 as the gelato shop SUGiTORA; owner-chef 杉田 晋一 (Shinichi Sugita), who represented Japan at the Coupe du Monde de la Pâtisserie 2015 and won silver, and after a famous Tokyo hotel opened in Kyoto, the chef's home town; 10:00–12:00 baked goods to take away only; café from 13:00; mini parfaits and gelato to take away from 13:30; last order 18:00; closes when the gelato sells out; closed every Tuesday and Wednesday (another panel: every Tuesday and every other Wednesday); shops: SUGiTORA, Patisserie labo, 京都タワーサンド店; takeaway: Tora-chan's paw, milk (high-fat milk from Nemuro), 60-days chocolate, red fruits and tea, rich pistachio (+¥50), Uji matcha; café: SUGiTORA douhua, morning plate, peach and savarin parfait, summer citrus parfait, lemon tart summer parfait, caramel apple and light fromage parfait. Tabelog: café, sweets; 中京区中筋町488-15; 6 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn; 8 seats; non-smoking; cards; opened 13 March 2017; Cafe WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (July–October 2026, in English): Tora-chan's paw ¥1,350, single ¥864, prepayment on TableCheck, Mont Blanc parfait, apple pie and coffee ¥1,700.

公式サイト (suiren-group.com): 宮川町 水簾 京都本店、四季.en: Official site (suiren-group.com): Miyagawa Cho Suilen Kyoto honten; authentic Japanese and Kyoto cuisine reflecting the four seasons; a space that makes the most of a Kyoto townhouse; lunch 9 dishes ¥10,000, dinner 12 dishes ¥20,000 (with tax, 10% service extra); rice freshly polished and cooked in a Nanbu iron pot on the okudo; first-floor counter of 10 seats, three private rooms on the second floor; executive chef 島谷宗宏; deliberately no signature or famous dishes; local sake from around Japan chosen by the head chef; 宮川筋2-253, Higashiyama-ku; closed Monday; 3 min walk from exit 1 of Keihan Gion-Shijo Station; Tokyo Midtown shop. Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; lunch 12:00–15:00 (L.O. 13:30), dinner 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 20:00); closed Monday; courses only; 20 seats; private rooms; cards accepted; non-smoking; opened 22 May 2012. Reviews (November 2025–September 2026, in English): soft-shelled turtle chawanmushi, saba sushi, a consommé like draft beer, hamo katsu sandwich, seconds of dashimaki and rice, hospitality, and some who felt it was not worth the price.

公式サイト (suppon-daiichi.com): すっぽん 大市、ショッピ.en: Official site (suppon-daiichi.com): Suppon Daiichi; the shopping site is suspended for now (November 2026). Tabelog: Daiichi, soft-shelled turtle, Japanese cuisine and hot pot, 上京区六番町364; lunch 12:00 (last entry 12:30); dinner in two sittings, 17:00 (last entry 17:30) and 19:00 (last entry 19:30); closed Tuesday; summer break (late July to early August) and New Year; reservation only; 12 table seats and private rooms; no children; parking for 6; no service charge (included in the course price); the course centred on turtle hot pot and zosui is ¥26,000 per person (tax included) at lunch or dinner; extra hot pot from ¥10,600 per person; zosui refills too; The Tabelog Award Bronze 2021–2026. Reviews (June–October 2026): about 340 years, 18 generations, marunabe served twice, zosui, Shigaraki clay pots and a coke fire (English reviews), ginger, Yasunari Kawabata and Naoya Shiga were patrons.

公式サイト (sushi-kaminari.com): 鮨かみなり、日本橋人形町.en: Official site (sushi-kaminari.com): Sushi Kaminari, 日本橋芸者新道ビル 1F, Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 1-5-10; 3 min from Ningyocho Station, 5 min from Suitengumae Station; Mon–Sat 17:30–23:00, Sunday 12:00–14:30 (all start together at 12:00) and 17:30–23:00; irregular closing days; lunch and dinner on Sundays only; after 20:00 seats if available; 9 counter seats; a private room (up to 6); private hire for 6 or more; cards accepted; no e-money or QR; all non-smoking; fish from Toyosu market and the chef's home region of Kansai, with strict temperature control; small dishes that show the chef's playfulness; shari blended from red and black vinegar; tuna from Ishiji; about 20 sakes the chef chooses from around Japan, incl. local sake from the chef's home town 姫路 and labels such as 十四代, 黒龍 and 新政, served from 720 ml bottles; the Sunday-only lunch needs booking. Tabelog (shop member): opened 3 December 2024; omakase course ¥27,000; Sunday-only lunch ¥16,000; 9 seats. Reviews (October 2025–October 2026): a young, friendly chef, Daiki Araki, long trained at Sushi Saeki; Akashi anago and sea bream; kombu soy sauce or salt; plum chawanmushi; hokki clam shabu-shabu; toro-takuan roll; castella-like tamago; the shari has been changing; the shop's name comes from the owner's father.

公式サイト (sushi-ovino.com): 鮨 おび乃、2020年10月オ.en: Official site (sushi-ovino.com): Sushi Obino, opened October 2020; from September 2023 the single omakase and simultaneous start were dropped, guests can come at any time; counter sushi for younger generations and overseas guests; young-artisan course ¥6,000 (3 small dishes, 12 nigiri, soup); head chef's course 15 items ¥12,000, 20 items ¥17,000; lunch TEYUI-SUSHI ¥4,800 (3 small dishes, 10 toppings, 10–15 balls of rice, 15 sheets of Ariake nori toasted yourself over a shichirin, miso soup); partner fish wholesaler at the central market; always over 10 sakes; red wine recommended with sushi; 中京区高宮町585 若葉ビル 1F at the back; east side of Tomikoji north of Nishiki (south of Takoyakushi); hours 17:00–21:00 (last entry 19:30); irregular closures; 8 counter seats; cards. Tabelog: sushi, Japanese cuisine; 8 seats; non-smoking; children welcome, children's menu; opened 1 October 2020. Reviews (2022–2026, in English): owner-sommelier; sake and red-wine pairings; in 2022 the head chef was Kosakai (Sushi Masuda line).

公式サイト (sushi-suehiro.jp): 京のすし処 末廣、天保年間に.en: Official site (sushi-suehiro.jp): Suehiro, a Kyoto sushi house founded in the Tenpo era as a cooked-food shop at Teramachi-Nijo south of the Imperial Palace; about 200 years of Kyoto sushi; mackerel, box, rolled, inari and chirashi sushi, and steamed sushi in winter; prices revised from 2 April 2025 because of rising rice prices. Menu: famous mackerel sushi, roll of 12 ¥5,800, half size available; anago box sushi ¥1,840; inari ¥1,190; assortment ¥2,310; Kyoto chirashi ¥2,200; sukeroku ¥1,380; Kyoto box sushi ¥1,920; box and roll ¥1,660; futomaki ¥1,750; Edo-style assortment ¥2,700; iso-maki ¥1,440; eel and cucumber roll ¥2,000; small sea-bream sushi ¥2,800; small rolls from ¥480; clear soup or red miso ¥600 each. Tabelog: sushi, Japanese; 寺町二条上ル要法寺前町711, Nakagyo-ku; Wed–Sun 11:00–18:00 (until sold out, dine-in until 15:00); closed Monday and Tuesday; no reservations; 6 seats; no smoking; cards, e-money and QR; take-out; steamed sushi from November to the end of March. Reviews (December 2019 – October 2026, in English): premium steamed sushi ¥2,750; half mackerel roll ¥2,900; winter queues of 30 minutes or more; phone ahead for take-away; friendly owner and staff; one found the steamed sushi ordinary.

公式サイト (taimeshi-maki.com): 宇和島出身の夫婦が手掛ける.en: Official site (taimeshi-maki.com): "authentic Uwajima tai-meshi" run by a couple from Uwajima; raw sea bream sashimi eaten with house-made dashi soy sauce and an egg yolk, "a luxurious egg over rice with red sea bream"; red sea bream from the 来島海峡 strait (about 2 kg, ikejime-killed; the source can change); 4 counter seats and 10 at tables; lunch tai-meshi course ¥6,600 (6 dishes, up to 1 hour 30 minutes); tai-meshi gozen ¥2,200, double ¥2,860, triple ¥3,520, salmon roe ¥2,860, sea urchin ¥3,000, sea urchin and salmon roe ¥3,660, grated yam ¥2,530; tai-meshi in a box from ¥2,200; dinner course ¥16,500; reduced-pesticide rice from Kumakogen, Ehime; clay pot; Shimanto River natural water; barley miso; "big brother's special mikan juice", made only for Maki by the okami's brother (Uwajima, Ehime) (also as a chuhai); lunch 11:30–14:00 (ends when the sea bream runs out), dinner from 18:00; courses must be booked by 18:00 two days ahead; closed irregularly; sister shops: 鯛めし槇 金閣寺店, 鯛めし槇 松山店, 京都寺町 鯛めし槇. Tabelog: Japanese cuisine, seafood, kaisen-don; 下京区市之町240-2; daily 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–21:00; closed irregularly; reservations for 10 or more (with notes on lunch bookings); 14 seats; cards accepted; non-smoking; children welcome; no service charge; opened 23 June 2019; Chef Makino. Reviews (March–November 2026, in English): tai-meshi gozen; three ways to eat it (sashimi, dashi chazuke, egg yolk); mikan juice ¥715; the restroom is outside; greeted by name; squid swapped for taro on request.

公式サイト (taiyounotou.com): 中崎町・なんばのレトロ喫茶、c.en: Official site (taiyounotou.com): a retro kissa in Nakazakicho and Namba; cafe Taiyo No To main shop, GREEN WEST, NAMBA CITY; the 太陽ノ塔洋菓子店 cake shops, at Hanshin Umeda main store; ニュー太陽ノ塔パーラー at Daimaru Umeda; a counter at Shin-Osaka Station. Tabelog: Cafe Taiyo No To Nanba shiti ten, café; なんばカーニバルモール, Namba CITY, 5-1-60 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 11:00–22:00 (food L.O. 21:00, drinks L.O. 21:30); closed when Namba CITY closes; reservations accepted (none taken 12:00–18:00; two-hour limit when busy); cards, e-money and QR accepted; 100 seats; smoking on the terrace; children order one kids-menu item or pay a ¥200 charge; English menu; opened 26 April 2011. Reviews (April–October 2026): cakes around ¥900, plates painted with sauce, lemon cake, Mont Blanc, berry cakes, a parfait, loco moco and tomato pasta lunches (drink bar and soup), passion-fruit cream soda, draft beer, a tatami area with toys and children's chairs, staff who reheated a parent's food, a parent surprised that even a baby needs an order, QR-code ordering.

公式サイト (takayama-kyoto.com): TAKAYAMA、テーマ.en: Official site (takayama-kyoto.com): TAKAYAMA; theme "comfort + excitement = happiness"; a full open kitchen with counter seats; inspired creative dishes from seasonal ingredients; TAKAYAMA Creative Experience, lunch or dinner ¥30,000 (tax and service included); about three hours; many small dishes; owner-chef Takayama; 下京区河原町通四条下ル2丁目稲荷町318番6 GOOD NATURE STATION 2F; lunch at 12:00 and dinner at 18:00, all starting together; non-smoking; no shorts or sandals; children only if they can stay seated to the end of the course; toilets in the building on the same floor; photos of the food only. Tabelog (corporate member): innovative, creative and Italian; 12 seats; closed Mondays and irregularly; from November to 11 January only the Winter Special Course, ¥35,000; water charge ¥1,000 per person; service included; cards accepted; opened 9 December 2019; The Tabelog Award Bronze 2025, 2026; Innovative/Creative Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (December 2025 – September 2026, in English): a white-chocolate juice printed with a QR code, Japan Caviar, about 25 dishes, many overseas guests.

公式サイト (takekishi.com): 割烹 竹きし、祇園で出会う正統派京.en: Official site (takekishi.com): 割烹 竹きし (Kappo Takekishi), an authentic Kyoto-cuisine kappo in Gion; right by Shirakawa-minami-dori and Shinbashi-dori; an unpretentious shop loved by locals; kaiseki and à la carte; Kyoto vegetables, nama-fu, yuba, Wakasa guji, seafood sent direct from the Sea of Japan; the famous kamameshi (chicken and mushroom, taro and chirimen, seafood butter, paella-style, seasonal crab, oyster, ayu — about 10 kinds at any time); kamameshi gozen ¥4,180 and sashimi gozen ¥5,390 (before tax); Takekishi kaiseki ¥7,480; kamameshi: wild vegetables ¥1,600, taro and chirimen ¥1,600, chicken and mushroom ¥1,700, gomoku ¥1,800, seafood butter ¥1,800, paella-style ¥2,100, turban shell ¥2,000, ayu ¥2,000, sea bream ¥2,200; shijimi soup ¥300; 東山区祇園花見小路末吉町西入ル 高見ビル 1F; lunch 12:00–14:00 (booking required), dinner 17:00–22:00; closed Sundays and holidays; 17 seats (counter 9, tatami rooms 4×2); cards; average spend lunch ¥2,600–5,000, dinner ¥10,000–15,000. Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; starter cover plus appetiser ¥1,600; smoking allowed; opened 9 September 1996. Reviews (2017–2026, in English).

公式サイト (takusandokyoto.com): Taku Sando K.en: Official site (takusandokyoto.com): Taku Sando Kyoto; Kyoto shops at Sanjo (海老屋町327) and Kiyomizu (4 Chome-148-3 Kiyomizu, as written in English), plus a Brooklyn shop. Sanjo menu (English PDF): Ton-Katsu Sando ¥1,500; Chicken-Katsu Sando ¥1,500 (breast and thigh); Classic Korokke Sando ¥1,300 (vegetarian); Tamago Sando ¥1,300 (vegetarian); Japanese Beef Fillet Katsu Sando ¥4,000; Matcha Strawberry Sando ¥850; Kids Sando ¥900; Dashi Fries ¥600 (furikake of fish and vegetable dashi); Shiso Edamame ¥700 (vegetarian); sake by the glass, 100 ml ¥900; owner-sommelier Sakaki Nakamura picks sake from all over Japan; "HELLO, Kyoto ! WE ARE FROM BROOKLYN". Brooklyn site: a shop by the team behind Takumen (LIC); shokupan baked in-house daily is the star. Tabelog: sandwiches and sake bar; 御幸町通三条下ル海老屋町327, Nakagyo-ku; daily 12:00–17:00 (L.O. 16:30); no reservations; 12 counter seats; no smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; take-out; English menu and English-speaking staff; kids menu; opened 15 October 2024. Reviews (October 2024 – April 2026, in English): egg sandwich; freshly fried katsu; big portions, half taken home; many customers from overseas.

公式サイト (tankuma.jp): 京料理 本家たん熊、創業より100年の「.en: Official site (tankuma.jp): Kyoto cuisine Honke Tankuma; 'monmo' Kyoto cooking kept for 100 years since the founding ('monmo' is Kyoto dialect for 'as it is'); founded on 13 December 1928 (Showa 3) by the first-generation 栗栖 熊三郎 together with 栗栖 フミ子, the founder's wife, as a five-seat counter by the Takase River; the name from 丹 of Tanba, the founder's home, and 熊 of 熊三郎; signature dishes the 丸鍋 (suppon hot pot), quail manju and 玉子宝楽; moved to the present site in 1954 and opened the Kyoto Takashimaya shop; renamed 本家 たん熊 in 1989; in 1991 the third generation, 栗栖 富滋, took the name 栗栖 熊三郎; in 2009 栗栖 純一 joined after training at 東京 柿傳; two Michelin stars in 2010; certified by the Kyoto Halal Council in 2014; certified by Kosher Japan in 2023; in September 2026 栗栖 純一 became the fourth-generation owner; the okami 栗栖晴子 speaks English; over 150 wines and 30 sakes; Honten: 下京区木屋町通仏光寺下る和泉屋町168; 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 19:30); closed Sunday, the 2nd and 4th Monday and 25 December–6 January; Suma ¥22,000, Kocho ¥33,000 (15% service extra); shojin kaiseki ¥22,000 (two days ahead); halal kaiseki ¥33,000; special halal kaiseki ¥44,000; kawadoko 1 May–30 September (seat fee ¥1,650); one Michelin star in the Kyoto/Osaka 2024 guide; shops: Honten and Kyoto Takashimaya. Tabelog: Japanese cuisine, suppon; 15% service charge; 50 seats, 7 private rooms; English menu; children's platter ¥3,000 (booking required); founded 13 December 1928. Reviews (2015–2025, in English): suppon liver and shoulder sashimi, zosui, dobin-mushi, ayu with roe.

公式サイト (tanzen-pontocho.com): ゆったり 炙ジビエとワ.en: Official site (tanzen-pontocho.com): ゆったり 炙ジビエとワイン 炭然 (read Tanzen), a "grown-up hideaway" in Pontocho, on the second floor; charcoal-grilled game such as deer, boar and bear, changing with the season; wagyu, sausages and appetizers too; open until 1 a.m.; grilled over charcoal for 20–30 minutes after ordering — grilled, wrapped and rested; the Tanzen course "Gathering of Beasts" (6 dishes, book the day before; skewers of deer, boar, pheasant, rabbit and quail); 18:00–1:00 (last order 0:30); irregular closures (6th and 23rd in November); 18 seats; all seats non-smoking. Tabelog: game, pasta, dining bar; 中京区先斗町通四条上ル鍋屋町220-6 弥栄ビル先斗町2F; daily 17:00–1:00; fully cashless; no charge; English menu; corkage charged; opened 1 December 2011. Reviews (2024–2026, in English): charcoal-grilled higuma ¥3,630, rabbit, duck, raccoon, nutria, capybara, kangaroo, grilled vegetables.

公式サイト (teramachi-fukuda.jp): てらまち福田、店主・料.en: Official site (teramachi-fukuda.jp): Teramachi Fukuda; owner and cook 福田竹志; in Japanese cooking since 18; kaiseki-style dishes served casually; 'not too much, just right'; the first of a season, its peak and its last; the handwork of a kappo with the ease of an izakaya; 下京区寺町通仏光寺下る恵美須之町528 えびすテラス 2F (the building opposite Watts; the stairs at the back of the 1st floor); lunch 12:00–13:30 (L.O.), closes 14:00; dinner 17:00–22:00 (L.O.), closes 22:30; no lunch bookings; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (from November 2024); lunch: daily set ¥1,000, saba in sansho miso set ¥1,100, tendon set ¥1,300, kaisen-don set ¥1,500, saba-zushi and seasonal nyumen (somen) set ¥1,500; evening: suppon dobin-mushi, zosui and ramen ¥2,600 each, Kyoto duck roast ¥1,800, tempura platter ¥1,650, sashimi platter ¥2,000, potato salad with prosciutto ¥550, steamed onion with sea-urchin soy ¥850, tempura spring roll of toro yuba and salted uni ¥900; courses from ¥5,000 (booking required; full charge for same-day cancellations). Tabelog: izakaya, Japanese cuisine; former name 美碧; 20 seats; non-smoking; no children under junior-high age; English menu; cards and QR at night only; opened 5 July 2012; renamed 5 June 2020; Izakaya WEST Tabelog 100 2024. Reviews (November 2025–July 2026, in English): saba-zushi, hamo cutlet, clam ramen, lunch cash only, wine by the bottle only.

公式サイト (ternura.owst.jp): スペインバル Ternura.en: Official site (ternura.owst.jp): Spanish bar Ternura; a hideaway bar marked by its sign and small window; 12:00–24:00 (food last order 23:00, drinks 23:30); closed Wednesday; tapas and paella can be ordered 12:00–23:00; tortilla of the day ¥500; Iga mochi-pork roast ham ¥850; terrine of the day ¥950; Spanish meatballs ¥1,100; grilled Iga mochi-pork shoulder ¥1,200; special fish and sea-urchin cabbage roll; mussel and scampi paella ¥2,600 (rich seafood stock based on prosciutto fat); arroz negro (squid ink) paella ¥2,800; duck and porcini paella ¥3,400; ajillo from ¥1,000 (Tanba shiitake and prosciutto, and others); coca ¥1,500; Basque-style burnt cheesecake ¥600; house bread (Manitoba flour, Guérande salt, hard water, malt syrup, 100% hydration); glass of wine ¥800; courses ¥3,500–6,500 (some with free flow); private hire for 10–20. Tabelog: Spanish, bar, izakaya; 565 Nakanocho, Shinkyogoku-dori Shijo-agaru, Nakagyo-ku; 12:00–24:00; closed Wednesday; bookings taken; 40 seats in all (ground floor 20, first floor 20, terrace 3); no smoking; cards and e-money accepted, no QR; children welcome; opened 1 April 2005; moved from 146 Aburaya-cho, Takoyakushi-dori Fuyacho nishi-iru. Reviews (March 2024 – August 2026, in English): squid-ink paella, ajillo, bonito marinated in balsamic, Iga pork shoulder, fish cabbage roll, girls' party course ¥3,500, house sangria ¥700.

公式サイト (three-six.jp): 元祖串しゃぶ専門店 まつたけ、北新地.en: Official site (three-six.jp): the original kushi-shabu specialist Matsutake; Kitashinchi main shop (北原ビル 1F, 1-9-8 曽根崎新地, 17:00–5:00), Douyama shop (イーグルビル 1F, 17-3 堂山町, 18:00–5:00, closed Mondays, or the following Tuesday when Monday is a holiday), and a third shop, 北新地別邸 (ガーデニアビル 3F, 1-2-23 曽根崎新地, 18:00–24:00); shabu-shabu served in skewer style; Inobuta pork 'Blessing of Eve' from Susami, Wakayama; Omi beef; Galician chestnut pork; seafood and vegetables from Mie; the skewers are dipped straight into a light house broth, so no chopsticks go into the shared pot; a bonito-based broth; three courses, Ume, Take and Matsu; about ten sakes at any time, changed twice a month. Tabelog (shop member): the second shop of a popular Kitashinchi restaurant; Tue–Sat, holidays and the day before a holiday 18:00–5:00 (last order 4:00); Sun 18:00–3:00 (last order 2:00); closed Mondays; Ume course ¥3,300, Take ¥4,400, Matsu ¥5,500; no service charge; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 15 seats (a counter of 8, tables for 7); private hire up to 20; smoking allowed; opened 4 April 2019. Reviews (June 2025–November 2026): the first clam; Negi Bakudan; sesame sauce and salt; beef tongue; wagyu rolls; quail and lettuce; asparagus; scallops; yellowtail; pork rolls; nama-fu; shrimp; onion; clams added for ¥500; ramen, udon or rice porridge to finish; the sashimi is good too; the entrance is down a narrow passage; a small shop suited to two to four people.

公式サイト (tobeian.jp): 京都錦市場 斗米庵、錦市場の細い路地の奥.en: Official site (tobeian.jp): Kyoto Nishiki Market 斗米庵, a Kyoto-cuisine restaurant at the end of a narrow alley in Nishiki Market; the name comes from an art name of the painter Ito Jakuchu, closely tied to Nishiki Market; at lunch the signature "KIRIBAKO 錦" (persimmon cup, terrine, sashimi, rolled egg, grilled dish, warm dish, rice, sweet, Yamadashiya kabuse tea) ¥4,600 + 1 drink; at night "宵の京錦 八寸", 7 dishes ¥8,500, and "宵の京錦 会席" with wagyu steak, 8 dishes ¥10,000 (with tax); dashi from Nishiki's famous water and freshly shaved bonito, Rishiri and Rausu kombu, Kotohiki-hama salt, Suehiro soy sauce (domestic soybeans and wheat), Kokonoe mirin; yuba chirimen to take home ¥1,600. Tabelog: Japanese cuisine, seafood; 東魚屋町196-1, Nakagyo-ku; entrance inside Nishiki Market; Tuesday–Saturday 11:00–16:00 and 18:00–22:00, Sundays and holidays 11:00–16:00; closed Monday and the first and third Tuesday; 18 seats; no service charge; English menu; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; opened 7 April 2018; foreign nationals book with advance payment. Reviews (April 2025–November 2026, in English): KIRIBAKO, a dry-ice flourish, adjustments for a seafood allergy, hospitality.

公式サイト (tokura-hamburg.com): 手づくりハンバーグの店.en: Official site (tokura-hamburg.com): Tokura, a handmade hamburg-steak shop; hamburg overflowing with juices; the mix is fine-tuned daily by checking the onions' moisture and the meat's fat; 12 sauces such as an original red-wine sauce and grated-daikon ponzu; takeaway; the Lucua Osaka shop opened on 5 April 2022. Tabelog: hamburg steak; 京都三条ビル 1F, 桝屋町57, Nakagyo-ku; 4 min walk from Karasuma Oike Station; Monday, Tuesday and Thursday–Sunday 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–20:30, closed Wednesday; no reservations; counter seats; non-smoking; cards (JCB, AMEX), e-money and QR accepted; main shop at 516-6 Kamikuze-cho, Kuze, Minami-ku, with a branch at 24 Takeda Nakahata-cho, Fushimi-ku; Yoshoku WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (October 2026, in English): original hamburg ¥1,030, rice ¥275, 300 g ¥1,250, Japanese set +¥345, cheese, negi-miso and mentaiko, fried shrimp, Hachidaime Gihei rice, a queue.

公式サイト (tokuwo.com): 下京区木屋町通り仏光寺上る天王町151、.en: Official site (tokuwo.com): 下京区木屋町通り仏光寺上る天王町151; 21st anniversary on 11 February 2026; a 10% service charge from 1 February 2026; closed Sunday and Monday, no lunch on Tuesday; 12:00–14:00 (last entry 12:30) and 18:00–22:00 (last entry 20:00); lunch booked by the day before; same-day calls welcome; solo diners welcome; 10 counter seats and a private table room (up to 6); ingredients the owner buys every day; no showy effects, but food you never tire of; lunch omakase course ¥9,000 (¥10,800 with tax and service, 11 dishes); lunch short course ¥7,000 (¥8,400, 8 dishes); Tokuo omakase course ¥20,000 (¥24,000, 13 dishes); short course ¥13,500 (¥16,200, 9 dishes); à la carte at the counter (about 20% dearer); staff: Shinji Tokuo (born 19 January, from Kyoto Prefecture, hobbies travel and band) and four others; sake, shochu, fruit liqueurs, Swiss wine, Bulgarian wine, Kenzo Estate. Tabelog: Japanese cuisine, 天王町151; Tabelog Award Bronze 2017–2021; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021; 16 seats; private room; cards accepted; non-smoking; Chef Shinji Tokuo; house dishes marunabe (soft-shelled turtle) and charcoal-grilled wagyu. Reviews (February–October 2026, in English): omakase course, soft-shelled turtle chawanmushi, karasumi daikon, uzaku, Saikyo-yaki, warabi mochi, a zelkova counter, the proprietress; bookings from inbound tourists generally not accepted (an April 2026 review).

公式サイト (tombe.co.jp): お好み焼 とんべえ、大阪 難波、道頓堀.en: Official site (tombe.co.jp): Okonomiyaki Tonbee; Namba, Osaka; 2 minutes' walk from Ebisubashi in Dotonbori; a standard Osaka taste since its founding in 1976 (Showa 51); a carefully made batter using a secret soup; okonomiyaki, modern-yaki, pechan-yaki (negiyaki with Kujo green onion), yakisoba and omusoba; Namba 1-6-16; no reservations; lunch 11:00–15:45 (L.O. 15:00), dinner 17:00–21:45 (L.O. 21:00); closed Thursdays; latest opening news on X @Tombe1976; Tombe Corporation. Tabelog (shop member): 2F; 24 seats; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; power outlets; menus in Japanese, English, Chinese and Korean; no cards, e-money or QR; closed 31 December to 2 January; opened 1 November 1976; batter made with a dashi simmered for over ten hours; house-made sauce and mayonnaise; the popular Pork and Cheese Ball ¥1,056. Reviews (February–September 2026): staff cook at the table; butatama ¥924; takotama ¥980; pork modern ¥1,110; sweet, regular and spicy sauces and homemade mayonnaise on the table; bonito flakes before grilling; cash only; staff from overseas; some found it a little small or a little burnt.

公式サイト (tominokoji-yamagishi.com): 呑小路やま岸.en: Official site (tominokoji-yamagishi.com): Nominokoji Yamagishi, a gourmet izakaya produced by Tomikoji Yamagishi; à la carte, eat what you like as much as you like; ingredients chosen by 山岸隆博 and craftsmen's technique; open kitchen; budget ¥15,000–19,999; shop list: Tomikoji Yamagishi, Nominokoji Yamagishi, 二条やま岸, 祇園やま岸, Yakiniku Yamachan, 饗宴, Ginza Nominokoji Yamagishi, Tomikoji Yamagishi Azabudai Hills. Tabelog: izakaya, 中京区下白山町293-3, about 5 min on foot from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sat and holidays 16:00–23:30; Sunday last order 23:00; closed Wednesdays and irregularly; reservations accepted; more than an hour late counts as a cancellation; 12 seats (counter 10, table 2); cards accepted; opened 28 July 2022; Izakaya WEST Tabelog 100 2024–2026. Reviews (July–October 2026, in English): four omakase dishes ¥8,800, anago, Matsutake fry, oden, a menu without prices, many overseas guests.

公式サイト (tonkatsu-butashabu-hizono.com): と.en: Official site (tonkatsu-butashabu-hizono.com): Tonkatsu Butashabu Hizono, 3 min from Yotsubashi Station, tonkatsu and pork shabu-shabu by a pork-loving owner; bookings through this site take top priority; the 'phantom pork' TOKYO X and Kagoshima kurobuta; the signature is a top-loin katsudon of TOKYO X; TOKYO X shabu-shabu hot pot; a hot-pot course for each brand pork; shochu starting with 夢幻 (imo); our chef is from Kagoshima Prefecture, home of shochu; shabu-shabu with an original soba dashi (no buckwheat flour) and ponzu, yuzu kosho; green-tea soba to finish (can be changed to zosui); a course comparing three pork; Shinmachi 1-22-19, Nishi-ku, 桑名ビル 1F; 3 min from Yotsubashi Station exit 2, 2 min from Nishi-Ohashi Station exit 2, 8 min from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–22:30, Sat 18:00–22:30; closed Sundays and public holidays (occasionally open on holidays). Tabelog (shop member): tonkatsu, pork shabu-shabu, katsudon; 22 seats (8 at the counter); a tatami private room (no sunken floor); one drink per person at night; a ¥330 appetizer charge with alcohol; non-smoking; children welcome; takeaway and delivery; English, Chinese and Korean menus; opened 3 April 2023. Reviews (May–October 2026): TOKYO X with salt; the frying changed in summer 2026 as 'Shin Hizono'; a new lunch from September (loin tonkatsu set ¥1,500, free rice refills); TOKYO X shabu-shabu course ¥4,950; a tonkatsu course; pork miso soup full of burdock; guests from Kanto and France; one chef, so food takes a little time.

公式サイト (torahachishoten.com): 寅八商店の店舗は梅田店.en: Official site (torahachishoten.com): Torahachi Shoten has shops in Umeda, Shinsaibashi and Sannomiya. Shinsaibashi: swimming squid and straw-seared bonito tataki; 'swimming squid' sent direct from Hagi, Yamaguchi, and 'straw-seared bonito tataki' sent direct from Kochi; live squid swimming in the tank until just before; no regular closing day; takeaway (seared mackerel sushi, Tosa-maki sushi); courses at prices from April 2025: with all-you-can-drink ¥12,000 and ¥15,000, a special course with 120-minute all-you-can-drink ¥10,000, the Torahachi course (9 dishes); extra swimming squid or extra bonito ¥1,300 each; 29 September 2026 'apology and improvement regarding the menu wording for nodoguro' (the shop served cut portions of large 1 kg nodoguro but the menu wording was unclear; it has been rewritten so what is served is clear at a glance). Tabelog (shop member): seafood, izakaya, regional cuisine, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-18-24, X-city SHINSAIBASHI B1F, daily 17:00–24:00, closed over the New Year, swimming squid may be unavailable in bad weather, ¥600 appetizer charge (not for courses), 110 seats (17 private rooms, horigotatsu), non-smoking, wheelchair accessible, English, Chinese and Korean menus, opened 16 August 2010. Reviews (October 2025–October 2026): swimming squid with the legs as tempura, straw-seared bonito with salt, fried oysters, water-octopus tempura, sea-bream kamameshi, Ise lobster at ¥3,000 per 100 g, days when no squid came in, a view that the shellfish smelled fishy.

公式サイト (torishin.my.coocan.jp、鳥新): 創業は約12.en: Official site (torishin.my.coocan.jp, 鳥新): founded about 120 years ago in the mid-Meiji era; the present owner said to be the fourth generation; there were also 鳥新 shops at Shijo Kobashi, Kawaramachi, Teramachi and Shinkyogoku; bird dealing since around Oda Nobunaga's entry into Kyoto; the Kobashi shop in the last scene of Shiba Ryōtarō's Ryōma ga Yuku; the Teramachi shop in Tanizaki Jun'ichirō's essay on Kansai food (Bungei Shunjū, 1924); on Nawate at the north end of Yamato-bashi, east side; mizutaki the main dish since about Showa 40; two courses, mizutaki and sukiyaki; とり新 serves oyakodon at lunch: Kujo or Kamo green onion, Koshihikari from Tsuruga in Fukui, a yolk in the centre, about 2.5 eggs, home-made pickles and miso; delivered from the end of Meiji or the start of Taisho; delivery ended around Showa 30; served again after about fifty years; the sansho on the yakitori is from Shichimiya; Asahi Super Dry; Instagram ktorishin. Tabelog: yakitori, chicken dishes, oyakodon; 東山区祇園縄手四条上ル; 3 min on foot from Gion-Shijo Stn; lunch 12:00–14:00 (oyakodon only, no reservations) and dinner 18:00–22:00; closed Thursday; 14 seats; no cards, e-money or QR; smoking allowed. Reviews (June 2025–October 2026, in English): oyakodon, queues, an owner in tall geta, skewer omakase ¥2,200, medium bottle ¥770, chicken soup, mizutaki in a private room with a sunken kotatsu (November 2025).

公式サイト (touentei.com): 創業100有余年、山東出身の王澤文が.en: Official site (touentei.com): over 100 years in business; 王澤文, from Shandong, opened a shop serving noodles, steamed buns and fried rice on Teramachi around Taisho 3 (1914) and, with three friends, named it 桃園亭 after the story of the Peach Garden Oath; in the mid-Showa period it moved to a three-storey building on Kawaramachi and called itself "pure Peking cuisine"; sister shop 中国料理 龍門; 下京区河原町通四条下る稲荷町335 宝源ビル 13th floor; lunch 11:00–14:30 (last order), dinner 17:00–21:00 (last order); closed Monday (open on holidays); fully non-smoking; parking for 4 cars (book by the day before); banquet hall for up to 100, private room for 4. Lunch: noodles and mini rice bowl ¥1,200; crab omelette, mapo tofu or chicken in sweet miso set ¥1,200; happosai, tantanmen or sweet and sour pork set ¥1,300; summer cold noodles ¥1,000 (set ¥1,400); "Fuku", "Roku" and "Ju" sets ¥2,000. Tabelog: Chinese and dim sum; 120 seats; lunch courses by reservation; cards accepted (not for lunch set meals); PayPay accepted; vegetarian options.

公式サイト (tsuneyadensuke.com): 京都の本格割烹居酒屋 恒.en: Official site (tsuneyadensuke.com): Tsune Ya Densuke, an authentic kappo izakaya in Kyoto; 25 years since opening; the owner chooses seasonal fish and vegetables; no courses, every dish à la carte; over a hundred dishes; grilled shirokuji, charcoal-grilled wagyu, saba sushi (book takeaway by the day before), bear hot pot, sashimi platter; 観音町84 at the corner of Sakaimachi and Nijo, Nakagyo-ku; about 7 min walk from Marutamachi and Karasuma Oike stations; Monday–Saturday 17:30–22:30, closed Sunday, two irregular days a month; November 2026 closures (1, 5, 8, 12, 15, 19, 23, 26, 29). Tabelog: izakaya, seafood, Japanese cuisine; Monday–Wednesday, Friday and Saturday 17:00–22:30, closed Thursday and Sunday; no children under junior-high age; 14 seats (5 counter, 10 table); private room; non-smoking; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); Izakaya WEST Tabelog 100 2024. Reviews (April–September 2026, in English): a menu without prices, sashimi platter, bear meat with sansho flowers, hamo shabu and matsutake, fried whale, Kamo eggplant dengaku, saba sushi.

公式サイト (ueno-tsutaya.com): 上野そば処 つたや、上野7-.en: Official site (ueno-tsutaya.com): Ueno soba shop Tsutaya, Ueno 7-10-6; lunch weekdays 11:00–14:30, Saturdays and holidays 11:00–14:00; dinner weekdays 17:30–20:00; closed for lunch on Sundays and for dinner on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays; reservations and enquiries 03-3844-3493. Notice of 24 September 2026 (from the owner): in September hours and menu were partly changed, but normal service resumed on 24 September, with set and tempura menus back; weekdays 11:00–14:30, Saturdays 11:00–14:00; closes when food runs out; dinner to resume on 5 October; closed Sundays and holidays; winter menu from 5 October. Menu: mori ¥800, zaru ¥900, kake ¥800, tanuki or kitsune ¥850, tsukimi ¥950, curry nanban ¥1,150, duck seiro ¥1,400, tenzaru regular ¥1,700 / premium ¥2,200, nishin soba ¥1,600; winter thick udon: nabeyaki udon regular ¥1,700 / premium ¥2,200, sukiyaki udon ¥1,600, miso-nikomi udon (red or white miso) ¥1,500; oyster nanban ¥1,500, oyster curry nanban ¥1,600; tamago-don ¥1,100, oyako-don ¥1,300, katsudon ¥1,350, asari-don ¥1,400, tendon regular ¥1,900 / premium ¥2,500. Tabelog: 16 seats; non-smoking; cards and PayPay accepted; evening reservations only. Reviews (December 2022–May 2026): founded 1935; duck seiro; curry nanban; a friendly owner and hostess; oyster tempura soba; oden; soba miso; thin stone-ground soba; tamago-don set; katsudon; a slightly sweet tsuyu; family-run; chilled sesame-miso soba; chilled mekabu soba; closes early in the evening.

公式サイト (umezono-kyoto.com): 甘党茶屋 京 梅園 河原町.en: Official site (umezono-kyoto.com): 甘党茶屋 京 梅園 河原町店; menu: amami tenshin ¥1,110, mitarashi dango with matcha or brown-sugar warabi mochi ¥1,070, mitarashi dango with kinako shiratama ¥900, mitarashi dango ¥600, mitarashi dango with a small parfait ¥1,350, mitarashi dango with anmitsu and kuromitsu ¥1,170, Uji chilled zenzai ¥1,150, warabi mochi ¥950, shiratama anmitsu with kuromitsu ¥950, kakigori (Uji kintoki shiratama with matcha warabi mochi ¥1,680 and others). Shops: 河原町店, 清水店, 三条寺町店, うめぞの CAFE&GALLERY, 梅園 oyatsu ジェイアール京都伊勢丹店, みたらし 京 梅園 西武池袋店; prices revised at all shops from 1 October 2026; うめぞの茶房 closed on 20 October 2025. Tabelog: amami café; 中京区河原町三条下る山崎町234-4; daily 10:30–19:30; no reservations; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; non-smoking; takeaway; Wagashi WEST Tabelog 100 2023 and 2026. Reviews (September–November 2026, in English): founded 1927; small square mitarashi dango; charred edges; hojicha included; one item per person.

公式サイト (unicoco.tokyo): ウニ専門レストラン unico-c.en: Official site (unicoco.tokyo): Uni Senmon Restaurant unico-co (Unicoco), aiming to be the world's best at sea urchin; a restaurant of uni maniacs, by uni maniacs, for uni maniacs; 15–20 kinds of uni from around Japan at all times; owner-chef Hironobu Tsujita, born 1977 in Kagoshima Prefecture, came to Tokyo at 26, at 31 went to 辻調理師専門学校 in Abeno, Osaka, then learned cooking and wine at an osteria in Shinjuku and qualified as a sommelier; June 2012 opened Osteria T in Yotsuya; its summer-only uni festival; November 2016 opened unico-co; reopened after a refit in 2018; Standard ¥19,800, Special ¥26,400, Luxury ¥30,800, Trial ¥9,350, Lunch ¥6,600; rich uni pasta ¥4,950, karasumi and uni pasta ¥3,080; 10% service charge on top; à la carte at the adjoining Italian restaurant, Oliva Vava; the only sake is the original-label 'unico-co' (co-produced with the owner of the members-only sake bar 鎮守の森 animism bar in Arakicho, from organically grown Yamada Nishiki by 杉山信一郎 of Tottori Prefecture); more than 380 wines; weekdays 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–22:30; reservation only; Act World Building 3F, Yotsuya 1-7-18. Tabelog: reservation only; closed on days with no reservations; 14 seats; private rooms for 2–24 (room fee 10%); lists the opening as 11 November 2015. Reviews (November 2025–August 2026): uni tasting; red, black, bafun, purple and hadate uni; Aomori and Hokkaido; uni from Hagi; uni even in the dessert and the pudding; a blue room; birthday surprises; stairs up to the third floor.

公式サイト (unten.store): ペストリーうんてん、「うれしい」がめぐ.en: Official site (unten.store): Unten Pastry Shop, built on the concept of sweets that pass happiness around, mindful of health and the environment; its Meguru cookies use sugarcane left after juicing; shops in 豊見城 (豊見城市平良76-1, Okinawa) and Yotsuya (Wakaba 1-16-7, Shinjuku-ku); online shop. Tabelog: Unten Yogashi Ten Yotsuya ten, Western sweets, café; Wakaba 1-16-7; 7 min walk from Yotsuya Station; Mon and Thu–Sun and holidays 11:30–19:00 (last order 18:30); closed Tue and Wed (open on holidays); no reservations; 10 seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; takeaway; opened 22 December 2023. Reviews (June–October 2026): passion fruit parfait ¥1,700, purple sweet potato Mont Blanc parfait ¥1,500 (soy-milk cream, shikuwasa jelly), carrot cake ¥780, passion fruit shortcake ¥980, cream puffs, Meguru cookies, order and pay at the register first, kind staff, strong air conditioning.

公式サイト (vel-rosier.com): 岩崎祐司 (YUJI IWASA.en: Official site (vel-rosier.com): Yuji Iwasaki (YUJI IWASAKI); after ten years of training at a hotel Chinese restaurant, opened VELROSIER in Ashiya-Kurakuen in 2014 and moved to Kawaramachi, Kyoto in 2019; lunch 12:00–15:00 (enter by 13:00), dinner 18:00–22:00 (enter by 19:00); closed every Wednesday; Dejeuner ¥11,000 and ¥20,000, Diner ¥22,000 (tax included, service 10%); Shaoxing wine, wine, Chinese tea. TableCheck: shark-fin courses, lunch ¥30,000 and dinner ¥32,000; state allergies for the whole party when booking; no changes on the day; no vegan, vegetarian, pescatarian or gluten-free menus; children on the same terms as adults; same-day cancellation charged in full. Tabelog: Chinese, innovative; GOOD NATURE STATION 2F; 16 seats; wheelchair accessible; Chinese WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2024, 2026. Reviews (May–October 2026, in English): two Michelin stars, foie gras monaka, 'add on', big portions.

公式サイト (voiture.buyshop.jp): 京都・岡崎のタルトタタン.en: Official site (voiture.buyshop.jp): a tarte tatin shop in Okazaki, Kyoto; the first owners, 松永ユリ and 辰夫, started the café 紅屋 in Gion in 1959, turned it into the gallery 紅 in 1964, and in 1971 moved to Okazaki, where the French restaurant LA VOITURE began alongside the gallery 紅; Yuri, captivated by the tarte tatin, kept baking it with an artist's feeling and in 2006 was admitted in France to the Confrérie des Lichonneux de tarte tatin; died in 2014 at 96; the recipe and the feeling behind it are now baked on by the grandchild. Online shop: tarte tatin, 2 slices (Sun Tsugaru and early Fuji) ¥2,250, 15 cm whole ¥7,150, sent frozen; allergens: milk, wheat, egg, apple; products containing walnuts are made on the same line; maker 株式会社 紅 (聖護院円頓美町47-5, Sakyo-ku). Tabelog: cake and café; Tuesday–Sunday 11:30–18:00 (last order 17:00); closed Monday; no reservations; 18 seats; non-smoking; cards and e-money, no QR; one parking space; Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2020, 2022, 2023, 2026. English articles: Leaf Kyoto (March 2021) — opened in 1971 with the daughter, Tomomi, and became today's café in 1987; Fashion Headline (January 2016) — died at 92; the grandchild Maya Wakabayashi carries it on. Reviews (August–November 2026, in English): Fuji ¥950, takeaway ¥1,000, walnut tart ¥730, Darjeeling ¥730, iced café au lait ¥800, a choice of 3–4 apples, served with yogurt.

公式サイト (wakuden.jp): 室町和久傳、京都市中京区堺町通り御池下ル.en: Official site (wakuden.jp): Muromachi Wakuden, 京都市中京区堺町通り御池下ル東側; lunch 12:00–15:00 (Mon, Fri, Sat, Sun only), ¥13,000, ¥25,000, ¥35,000; dinner 18:00–21:00, ¥25,000, ¥35,000; sake pairing courses (lunch ¥23,000, dinner ¥37,000 and ¥50,000); crab course around ¥70,000 (November–March); shojin course ¥25,000 (book three days ahead); closed Wednesdays; also closed 5 November and 25–30 December; prices include tax and service; cancellation the day before or on the day 80%; credit cards accepted; 5 min east of Karasuma Oike Stn exit 3-1. Other Wakuden places: 高台寺和久傳, 京都和久傳, a soba-and-dishes restaurant, gift shops. Tabelog (corporate member): founded in 1870 as an inn in Tango; a townhouse; a counter of 15 and four private rooms; counter from junior-high age, children in the private rooms; English menu; vegetarian options; The Tabelog Award Bronze; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025. Reviews (September–October 2026, in English): Matsutake dobin-mushi, narai-yaki of Matsutake wrapped in eel, three closing rices with leftovers made into onigiri, many overseas guests with English explanations, some found it salty.

公式サイト (walden-woods.com): Coffee & Chai.en: Official site (walden-woods.com): Coffee & Chai / Walden Woods Kyoto. Tabelog: café; Shimogyo-ku; every day 8:00–18:00; no bookings; standing, or benches on the second floor; takeaway; children welcome; no smoking; cards accepted (UnionPay too); no e-money or QR; Cafe WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (August–October 2026, in English): themed on a white forest; tiered benches round a white tree upstairs; no sign; light-roast coffee; Americano ¥550; chai latte and matcha latte ¥700; morning combo ¥1,000; pudding ¥400; cream puff ¥300; ice cream ¥500.

公式サイト (watoribar.com): 心斎橋駅5番出口から徒歩約6分の路.en: Official site (watoribar.com): "WA Tori BAR", a hideaway yakitori izakaya down a back alley about 6 minutes' walk from Shinsaibashi Stn exit 5; creative chicken dishes from fresh Daisen gainadori chicken; sashimi, "Mune Pon" kara-age fried rare, "rock-salt grill" cooked on heated rock salt; seasonal sake, wine and fruit liqueurs; sofa seats on 2F for up to 20; Mon–Sat 17:00–3:00, Sun and holidays 17:00–24:00; irregular holidays; a Tenma shop; sister shop 屋台CHU華 ジャスミン. Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): WA Tori BAR main shop, yakitori, Japanese cuisine, bar; 2-5-7 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; reservations accepted (two-hour limit when busy); cards and QR accepted, no e-money; 30 seats (9 at the 1F counter, tables on 2F); smoking allowed; English menu; courses with all-you-can-drink ¥4,400 and ¥5,500. Reviews (December 2024–October 2026): chicken served off the skewer on a rock-salt slab, rare kara-age with grated daikon and ponzu, chicken sashimi with foamed soy sauce, bone-in chicken, saliva chicken, harami and seseri, broccoli with cheese fondue, potato salad, breast jerky, kakiage, half-size oyakodon, the potato shochu Maho; steep stairs to 2F; diners call the staff and the owner fun.

公式サイト (yagenbori.co.jp): 御二九と八さい はちべー、京都.en: Official site (yagenbori.co.jp): 御二九と八さい はちべー, on a corner of a small lane that keeps Kyoto's alley culture; fresh beef uchiniku (horumon) served as Kyoto-style "niku kappo" with Kyoto vegetables and seasonal ingredients; evening omakase ¥8,800 (about 12–13 dishes, with the signature beef-tongue harihari hot pot and Chinese noodles to finish, liver-pâté salad, beef-tongue dumpling stew, whole tail, blanched mino, senmai, fried urute, aorta (hatsumoto) in Chinese dressing, Achilles tendon with ponzu); all grilling done by the staff; lunch 11:30–14:30 (with small dish, rice, red miso soup, dessert and coffee; no bookings): seasonal-vegetable harami rice bowl ¥2,500, beef-tongue hamburg steak with warm vegetables ¥1,800, beef-neck stew ¥1,800; drink pairing ¥4,000; original sake 佳風; wine corkage ¥3,000; takeaway: seared beef sagari bento ¥2,200, eel-and-beef bento ¥3,700; first-floor counter for 8, second floor 3 tables (up to about 12); 中之町577番地17, north of Shijo on Shinkyogoku, Nakagyo-ku; lunch 11:30–14:30, dinner 17:00–23:00; closed Tuesday; the yagenbori group's 6 restaurants. Tabelog: beef dishes, horumon, Japanese cuisine; 20 seats; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; non-smoking; the name comes from the nearby 八兵衛明神 shrine. Reviews (December 2025–October 2026, in English): omakase course, Achilles tendon, aorta, liver with garlic chives, beef-tongue harihari hot pot with ramen to finish, harami bowl at lunch ¥2,500.

公式サイト (yagenbori.co.jp): 祇をん う桶や う、祇園名物.en: Official site (yagenbori.co.jp): 祇をん う桶や う (Gion Uokeya U); Gion speciality Edo-style eel in a tub; "five years to learn splitting, eight years for skewering, a lifetime for grilling"; live eels split from the back, the dorsal fin, tail fin and rib bones removed, skewered on bamboo and white-grilled over high heat, purified with natural water and steamed, then grilled with the secret tare; digging a well (Nishi-Hanamikoji, near Kenninji); Edo-style eel laid like a raft in a cedar tub; slim eels; the house-name u-oke: large (5 people) ¥21,000, medium (4) ¥16,800, small (3) ¥12,600 (with liver soup or red miso, leftovers can be taken home); eel bowl matsu ¥5,250, take ¥4,200; kabayaki matsu ¥4,700, take ¥3,700; shirayaki ¥3,700; eel tataki ¥1,900; uzaku ¥1,800; yawata-maki ¥2,100; liver yakitori ¥850; eel skewers ¥1,050; umaki ¥1,800; dashimaki ¥1,300; cold sake 佳風-カーフ- 300 ml ¥1,850; 東山区祇園西花見小路四条下ル; lunch from 11:30 (last order 14:00), dinner from 17:00 (last order 20:00); closed Monday; bookings up to the end of the following month (Japanese only); 7 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn. Company profile: Yagenbori Group Co., Ltd., representative 岡本 美科, annual sales ¥390 m; Uokeya U opened in Heisei 3; 花遊小路 江戸川 founded in Meiji 37. Tabelog: eel and Japanese; Tue–Sun 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–20:00; closed Monday; no service charge; 24 seats (2nd floor: tatami 16, tables 4; more on the 1st floor); non-smoking; cards; take-away; Unagi Tabelog 100 2018, 2019 and 2022.

公式サイト (yakiniku-choice.com): 炭火焼肉 CHOICE.en: Official site (yakiniku-choice.com): Charcoal Yakiniku CHOICE, yakiniku in Namba, Shinsaibashi and Amerikamura; carefully chosen top cuts of kuroge wagyu; charcoal × kuroge wagyu; courses stopped from July; temporary closures on Instagram; platter of top loin, top belly and top skirt 100 g ¥1,780, 200 g ¥3,560; thick-cut special tongue 80 g ¥2,480; menus in Korean, English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese. Tabelog (shop member): yakiniku, izakaya and Korean, Nishi-Shinsaibashi 2-8-33, Tue–Sun 11:30–22:00 (last order 21:30), lunch 11:30–14:30, closed Mondays, lunch set meals booked by phone only, 120 minutes when busy, cards accepted, no e-money or QR, no service or table charge, 30 seats, smoking allowed. Reviews (March–September 2026): special cuts ¥2,580 (outside skirt, brisket, tongue), horumon platter of five ¥1,680, the signature horumon stew, raw omasum, choregi salad ¥880, regular cuts can be tough so order the better grades, smoking at the table, said to be popular with professional baseball players, a kind owner and staff.

公式サイト (yakitoriseisakusyo.com): 京都焼鳥製作所.en: Official site (yakitoriseisakusyo.com): 京都焼鳥製作所 (Kyoto Yakitori Seisakujo); 下京区足袋屋町324; only female Kyo Akajidori; binchotan charcoal; Guérande salt; yakitori served with salt by default; aburi-yaki (thigh ¥1,320, neck ¥880, breast ¥968, chicken harami ¥748); skewers (thigh ¥352; negima, neck, breast with skin, bonjiri ¥275; white liver ¥330; sasami ¥253; tsukune ¥330); beef-tendon doteyaki ¥825 (made since training days in Osaka); kara-age with grated daikon and ponzu ¥715; chicken-stock dashimaki ¥715; iburi-gakko potato salad ¥528; oyakodon ¥880 (Ranno eggs); courses with all-you-can-drink ¥4,000–7,000; hot-pot course ¥6,000 (book by the day before); Sun–Thu 17:00–24:00, Fri–Sat 17:00–25:00; irregular closures; 53 seats. Tabelog: yakitori, chicken dishes, izakaya; ¥330 service charge; 60 seats; non-smoking; cards, PayPay and Alipay accepted; menus in English, Chinese and Korean; vegan options; opened 25 February 2015.

公式サイト (yamamotomenzou.com): 山元麺蔵、月・火・金 1.en: Official site (yamamotomenzou.com): Yamamoto Menzou; Mon, Tue, Fri 10:00–16:00 (last order); Wed 10:00–15:30 (last order); Sat, Sun and holidays 10:00–17:00 (last order); closed Thursdays and irregularly (posted monthly on Instagram); closes when the noodles run out; phone bookings on the day 9:00–11:00 (for the 11:00–13:45 slots); online from midnight three days ahead (9:45–10:45 am, 2:00–4:30 pm, to 5:00 pm at weekends and holidays); a credit card is required to book; payment in the shop is cash only; at your time, queue outside the shop and order, then you are seated as places free; 10 counter seats and two tables for four; 岡崎南御所町34; run by Yamamoto Menzou Co., Ltd. (person responsible: 山元克之); menu: Red Menzou Special, beef and burdock udon, Kyoto curry udon, chicken tenderloin tempura udon, burdock tempura udon, aromatic-oil udon, tsukemen, zaru udon, almond tofu and more; the founder's message: the land where grandma ran an udon shop, freshly made and boiled udon, natural dashi made properly with bonito. Shop blog (8 October 2026): prices revised from 9 October. Tabelog: Udon Tabelog 100 2017–2019; Udon WEST Tabelog 100 2020, 2022, 2024; children welcome; parking for 3; opened 27 August 2006. Reviews (October–November 2026): burdock tempura, chicken tenderloin tempura, scissors for the long noodles, complimentary almond tofu, warm service, many overseas guests.

公式サイト (yamamotorestaurant.com): 山本料理店 (や.en: Official site (yamamotorestaurant.com): Yamamoto Ryori Ten; 4 min walk from exit 1 of Gojo Stn; Yuasa Kaikan 2F; a chicken restaurant run by an owner who honed the craft for over 20 years at a famous yakitori restaurant; "yakitori is proper cooking too"; Omi Kurodori, Kyoto Akadori and others chosen cut by cut; thigh skewers about 60 g; skin wrapped in as it is skewered; binchotan; Guérande salt or a light sweet tare; the signature zaji is a whole Kyoto Akadori, boiled, glazed with starch syrup, hung to dry half a day, fried at 140 and then 170 degrees, with a dip of Hatcho miso, sesame paste and black vinegar; 25–30 wines chosen by the sommelier-qualified owner; omakase course with drinks ¥12,000 (tax included); 8 counter seats; 17:00–23:00; closed Sunday and two Mondays a month; same-day cancellation may cost ¥7,000 per person; cards and e-money. Tabelog: yakitori, chicken, izakaya; 五条通高倉上ル亀屋町172 湯浅会館 2F, Shimogyo-ku; courses last 2 hours 30 minutes; "¥500" in the charge field; 8 seats (9 with an extra chair); no smoking (smoking spot inside); school-age children and up; English menu; BYO allowed; opened 3 March 2026. Reviews (April–October 2026, in English): a Taisho-era building; Omi Kurodori; necktie; white liver; outside skirt; neck; cartilage; tsukune; breast tataki; Peking-duck style; shark-fin rice; chicken soba; ramen; oyakodon; hard to book within six months; a discount for sold-out items.

公式サイト (yaoiso.com): 創業明治2年の果物専門店、進物用の高級果.en: Official site (yaoiso.com): a fruit specialist founded in Meiji 2 (1869); from luxury gift fruit to fruit for the home; Okayama white peaches sent direct in the summer gift season and Saga Sagahonoka strawberries in the winter gift season; a fruit parlour added in Showa 47 (1972); its signature "fruit sandwich"; certified fruit-adviser shop; governor's award as an old Kyoto business. Main shop 9:00–18:00, open every day (except the New Year), 488, east of Shijo-Omiya, Shimogyo-ku. Parlour 9:30–17:00 (last order 16:45), at 496. The shop on Karasuma-dori north of Imadegawa (east side, next to Doshisha University) also has a parlour, 10:00–17:00, irregular closures. Menu (from April 2022, before tax): fruit sandwich and mixed juice set ¥900, special sandwich set ¥1,100, mini parfait set ¥1,250, royal fruit sandwich ¥1,100, seasonal fruit parfait ¥1,100, cream kuzu-arare ¥900, cut fruit ¥1,100, ladies' set ¥1,000, fruit kanten ¥750, musk-melon parfait ¥1,100, takeaway fruit sandwich ¥750, and more. About ¥50 (before tax) added from February 2025. Lemon squash ¥550 (tax included); Yamagata cherry parfait (Shijo-Omiya shop only). Tabelog: fruit parlour, café; 496; every day 9:30–17:00 (last order 16:30); bookings for takeaway only; 32 seats; no smoking; children welcome; cards (JCB, AMEX) and e-money; opened 23 May 2013; Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2022, 2023, 2026. Reviews (July 2025 – November 2026, in English): peach feast ¥2,700; mango feast ¥2,600; classic fruit parfait ¥1,045; mixed juice; special fruit sandwich.

公式サイト (yasaiya.tokyo/kunpuu): 薫風、六本木の総作料.en: Official site (yasaiya.tokyo/kunpuu): Kunpu, a 'sosaku' restaurant in Roppongi; depending on the course, all-you-can-drink includes Juyondai, Moriizo, Yamazaki, Ichiro's Malt and more; creative food and homemade bread are the specialities; every seat semi-private (divided by roll screens); 272 m from Roppongi Stn; on courses, beer and highball glasses keep growing; premium drinks at nearly cost; fresh-baked bread with every course; nothing frozen or made ahead; for celebrations, message dishes, salt-crust dishes and 'meat cakes'; half the room (30) can be hired for a ¥30,000 room fee; Roppongi 4-8-3, 日栄ビル 2F; 18:00–24:00; closed Saturdays, Sundays and holidays (hire for 20 or more possible). Tabelog: 日栄ビル 2F–3F, 5 min from Roppongi Stn exit 6 (Oedo line); closed Sundays and holidays; sometimes open until 5 am; 100 seats; no service charge; non-smoking; cards and QR accepted; children welcome; opened 1 September 1999. Reviews (February 2025–July 2026): Juyondai, Moriizo, Maou, Murao; all-you-can-drink ¥5,000; Caesar salad tossed in front of you; fresh bread with honey; bone-in hamburg; Oita Seki-aji and Seki-saba; Bungo beef hamburg; one diner mentions the owner's strong personality.

公式サイト (yelo.jp): かき氷 yelo とホットドッグ・ホットサンド.en: Official site (yelo.jp): kakigori yelo and the hot-dog and hot-sandwich counter Amber; good pure ice kept at the right temperature for a fine, pleasant melt; homemade syrups and fresh milk sauce; to enjoy all year; NIGHT KAKIGORI; hot dogs with sausages from an old workshop keeping traditional German methods and a semi-hard bread developed with a well-known baker; hours change by season and are posted on X; Roppongi 5-2-11, パティオ六本木 1F; a paid summer priority service (Table Check FastPass). Tabelog: Mon–Thu 11:00–02:00, Fri 11:00–05:00, Sat 11:30–05:00, Sun 11:30–02:00; to 5 am on weekdays in summer; no reservations; 16 seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; English menu; self-service water and rooibos tea; opened 1 April 2014. Reviews (August–October 2026): tiramisu ¥1,300 plus espuma ¥200; pistachio ¥1,400; mango; strawberry; rum raisin; quiet even late at night; reviews range from 'Japan's best' to 'average'.

公式サイト (yofu-izakaya-zakiyama2026.com): 洋.en: Official site (yofu-izakaya-zakiyama2026.com): Yofu Izakaya Zakiyama — Western-style food and drinks in a modern space; fresh fish bought at the market every day; roast beef; half sizes; whisky and sake; 18:00–26:00 (Sun, Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat and holidays); omakase course ¥3,000, chef's recommended course ¥6,000; cancellations later than 24 hours ahead ¥3,000 a person. Tabelog: izakaya / Italian; 201-2 Ayazaimoku-cho, Shimogyo-ku; about 5 min on foot from Hankyu Karasuma Stn; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 18:00–2:00 (food L.O. 1:30); closed Wednesday; irregular closing days; seat charge (incl. starter) ¥500; 14 seats; e-cigarettes only; cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 4 September 2023; creative Italian with Omi beef and fresh fish; over 50 whiskies, mainly Japanese.
