Reviews (March–September 2026, English): duck loin, spare ribs, carpaccio, soft-shell crab fritters, half carbonara, hamo pasta, tiramisu, Basque cheesecake.

公式サイト (yu-alacarte.com): 焼鳥祐 アラカルト、谷町九丁目.en: Official site (yu-alacarte.com): Yakitori Yuu A La Carte, the second shop of the popular 焼鳥祐 in Tanimachi 9-chome; 1 minute from Namba Station; branded and local chickens such as the house brand 六角大魔王 and Nagoya Cochin; the signature mixed-bird platter (chicken, Kawachi duck, ostrich, pheasant, pigeon and more, as sashimi or tataki, depending on the day's buying); 水煙蒸し steamed in front of you (六角大魔王 and Awaji Island vegetables); the recommended yukke; an omakase course with two-hour all-you-can-drink ¥5,500; a Monday–Thursday course with two-hour all-you-can-drink ¥4,500; the same level as the main shop; about 20 wines and sakes; a counter on the first floor, tables on the second; Nambanaka 1-15-23, 難波清覚ビル; 20 seconds' walk from exit 5 of Namba Station; hours Mon–Thu 17:00–23:00, Fri, Sat and the day before a holiday 17:00–24:00, closed Sundays; cards and PayPay accepted; the same group runs 鶏家 六角鶏, 麺屋 たにぐち and others. Tabelog (shop member): yakitori, izakaya, chicken dishes; open daily from 11:30 (to 23:00 Mon–Thu, Sun and holidays; to 24:00 Fri, Sat and the day before a holiday); chuhai and highballs ¥99 at lunch; reservations; 50 seats; non-smoking; opened 20 April 2022. Reviews (August–October 2026): ostrich yukke; the mixed-bird platter; tsukune with egg yolk; chicken nanban; liver pâté; yam fries; chicken paitan ramen; mobile ordering; seats up to the third floor; a hard-to-find entrance.

公式サイト (yutaka-steak.com): 祇園ゆたか、東山区祇園町南側.en: Official site (yutaka-steak.com): 祇園ゆたか (Gion Yutaka); 東山区祇園町南側 四条花見小路下ル四筋目東入ル; a remodelled Kyoto machiya that was once an ochaya; on the ground floor a 10-seat counter and a 6-seat private room; upstairs a zashiki with a stage (for parties with geiko and maiko); lunch from ¥8,800 (11:30–last order 13:30); dinner from ¥32,000 (from 17:30); service and tax included; cards accepted; special steak course ¥32,000, Yutaka standard course ¥38,000, Yutaka special course ¥66,000, steak lunch course ¥8,800; only the centre of domestic black wagyu fillet, steamed over garlic laid on the griddle; mostly French wine. Owner-chef Mamoru Takada: second generation of Steak House Yutaka, founded Showa 37; following the founder, the father, entered cooking after high school; put in charge of the Gion shop at 24; "cooking is conversation". Yutaka Ginza (Tokyo). Tabelog: steak; reservation only; 24 seats; private rooms (4 and 6); closed Sundays and holidays; moved from 末吉町西入 on 7 May 2012; Steak and Teppanyaki WEST Tabelog 100 2022, 2024 and 2025.

公式サイト (zen-kashoin.com): 京都室町御菓子司 然花抄院、2.en: Official site (zen-kashoin.com): 然花抄院, Kyoto Muromachi confectioner; the Kyoto Muromachi main store opened on Muromachi-dori in August 2009, with shop, café, gallery and workshop; a townhouse built in Genroku 13; paving stones from the Kitano tram; the well by the courtyard and kamado; karakami by Karacho; hospitality with a heart of flowers; "flowers and sweets, each in its proper form"; tearoom "Zen Café"; 中京区室町通二条下ル蛸薬師町271-1; 11:00–18:00 (café last order 17:30); no café seat bookings; 6 min walk from Karasuma-Oike Stn exit 2; Shibuya Hikarie ShinQs store (April 2012); ZENKASHOIN (gift products, in mass retailers and station and airport souvenir shops); menu: grill-your-own mitarashi dango ¥1,870 (1 November–31 May), autumn chestnut set ¥1,870, purple sweet-potato parfait ¥1,870, autumn cream anmitsu ¥1,870, three-castella set ¥1,760, castella-custard set ¥1,650, "Zen" ice ¥1,320 (all with a drink); sencha, genmaicha, ume bancha, hojicha, kombu tea, Kyo-bancha ¥880, matcha ¥990, bamboo-charcoal roast coffee ¥880. Company page: Nagasakido Co., Ltd., founded August 1960, capital ¥30 m, chairman 荒木貴史, makes and sells Japanese and Western sweets. Tabelog: café, wagashi, Japanese sweets café; 20 seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR; opened 8 August 2009; run by Nagasakido (Shinsaibashi); Cafe WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (December 2024–November 2026, in English): zarame castella ¥702.

公式サイト (ふぐ茂の姉妹店): うなぎ料理専門店「うな茂」、大きさと鮮度を厳選.en: Official site (sister shop of Fugushige): eel specialist Una Shige; eel chosen for size and freshness and grilled Kansai-style without steaming; turned again and again for a fragrant outside and a soft inside; kabayaki set ¥5,220, unagi set ¥3,530, Una Shige set ¥2,160, eel bowls matsu ¥3,960, take ¥2,810, ume ¥1,820, premium kabayaki ¥3,240 (can be white-grilled), regular kabayaki ¥2,120, yawata-maki ¥1,690, carp sashimi ¥830, simmered liver ¥770, fried bones ¥410, uzaku ¥1,410, grilled liver ¥830, eel omelette ¥770, eel-omelette bento ¥2,810, tax included, take-out available, hot pots in winter (reservation only), beer ¥550. Tabelog: Bakuromachi 2-3-11, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Mon–Fri 11:00–22:00, Sat 11:00–21:00; closed Sundays and holidays; no reservations; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners), PayPay and Rakuten Pay accepted; 40 seats; counter and tatami; non-smoking; moved from Bakuro-cho 2-2-4 in August 2009. Reviews (July–October 2026): an eel omelette as big as an inkstone box, liver soup, phoning ahead on the Day of the Ox, bento sold outside, generous portions and good value, one review of a 20-minute-plus wait while the owner was on the phone.

公式サイト (やげんぼりグループ): しぐれ茶屋侘助、東山区祇園白川通縄手東入ル.en: Official site (yagenbori group): Shigure Chaya Wabisuke; 東山区祇園白川通縄手東入ル; a small, counter-led shop on the Shirakawa in Gion; Kyoto cuisine of fresh fish from around Kyoto and Kyoto vegetables; head chef 筒井, promoted after training at yagenbori; omakase course of nine dishes ¥11,000; à la carte (autumn salmon saikyo-yaki, steamed Kyoto turnip ¥1,500, saba heshiko, funazushi, whale bacon, karasumi, duck loin); seasonal specials (Kyoto dashimaki, homemade karasumi, wakatake-ni, Kyoto jidori grilled with salt, tempura, saba-zushi, jako rice); saba-zushi and braised pork to take away; 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Tuesday; 8 counter seats and one table. The group's shops: 花見小路やげんぼり, 出逢ひ茶屋おせん, しぐれ茶屋侘助, 祇をん う桶や う, 花遊小路 江戸川, 御二九と八さい はちべー. Tabelog: 13 seats; ¥1,000 otoshi; cards accepted; non-smoking; no seats for children. Reviews (2019–2026, in English): about 35 years ago an elderly woman ran it alone; later it joined the yagenbori group; the head chef changes every few years; on the Shirakawa; near Tatsumi Shrine.

公式サイト (カトープレジャーグループ): 博多廊 法善寺店、難波1-6-21、.en: Official site (Kato Pleasure Group): Hakata-ro Hozenji, Namba 1-6-21; lunch 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:00), dinner 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00). Shops: Hozenji, Osaka (Nakanoshima 3-4-15, Mitsui Garden Hotel Osaka Premier 2F, with breakfast), Fukuoka main shop (Daimyo 1-1-38, South Side Terrace 5F) and Nishi-Nakasu. Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): opened 26 August 2017; open year-round including the New Year; ¥500 cover charge (not with courses); 40 seats; private rooms (2–20); hire for 20–50; non-smoking; private rooms on four themed floors; dishes from across Kyushu with Shochu and sake. Menu (August 2026): live squid sashimi from ¥2,280 per 100 g, Kumamoto horse sashimi, seasonal sashimi, Hakata Ramen salad, Mentaiko Dashimaki, Karashi renkon, Nakatsu Kara-age, Miyazaki chicken Nanban, Beppu chicken tempura, steamed sea-bream head, squid Shumai, Motsunabe, Mizutaki. Reviews (July–October 2026): squid often sold out, especially on holidays; Yobuko squid with a booking the day before; weekday lunch bookable for one; Tempura and sushi lunch; black-wagyu Sukiyaki set; chicken rice; all-you-can-drink in the 4th-floor free space; calm private rooms; good for business dinners.

公式サイト (ガーデンバール＆コーヒージャパン): 心斎橋焙煎所、木の壁から銀色.en: Official site (Garden Bar & Coffee Japan): Shinsaibashi Baisenjo; a silver chimney jutting from a wooden wall; the roaster inside the shop; coffee beans roasted in front of you; house-roasted beans blended by top Japanese baristas; green beans selected from around the world; latte art; a CIMBALI espresso machine; a daily drip coffee; flavoured lattes such as caramel macchiato, honey cappuccino and chai mocha; the 2nd floor is a calm café in natural light from a skylight; OPEN 11:00–CLOSE 19:00; Nishi-Shinsaibashi 1-10-1, Chuo-ku, Osaka; pumpkin pudding and an apple-caramel upside-down cake in autumn 2026; the company also runs Welcome the Coffee. Tabelog: daily 9:00–18:30, no reservations, cards for ¥1,000 and over, transport IC and PayPay accepted, 24 seats, non-smoking, take-out, opened 15 January 2015. Reviews (June–October 2026): order on 1F and sit on 2F, one drink each to eat in, in the same building as a taiyaki shop and a chiffon-cake shop, a bacon-cheese taiyaki breakfast, Basque cheesecake ¥800, café latte ¥550 (September 2026) and ¥650 (October 2026), cold brew ¥750, Rwanda, overseas customers too.

公式サイト (レストラン乃呂): 1958年に先代の野呂伸一が心斎橋周防町に『グ.en: Official site (Restaurant Noro): founded in 1958 by the first-generation owner 野呂伸一 as 'Grill Noro' on Suocho in Shinsaibashi, about 65 years, owner 野呂太一, featured in the Louis Vuitton City Guide Osaka, Japanese edition (published April 2025), lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30), dinner 17:30–21:00 (last order 19:30), closed every Wednesday with occasional other closures, phone before coming, reservations by phone or online (Ikyu, Gurunavi), private room at the back of 2F for 5 or more, courses only, osechi and takeout. Introduction (from あまから手帖's separate volume 'The Power of Osaka's Famous Restaurants', 2010): the founder 野呂伸一 came from the renowned Western-cuisine house アラスカ in Higobashi, had no menu or recipes and made anything customers asked for; around the Osaka Expo thick steaks sold; when a regular asked for something different, the founder grilled meat in the yakiniku sauce made for the family, the origin of the standing 'wire-grilled beef'; "My father always said to make food that is light yet rich," says the second generation, 太一; a demi-glace skimmed of fat, enriched with vegetables and cooked for two weeks; the founder ordered a horsehair strainer to be used; beef cutlet in fine, thin breadcrumbs with tomato sauce; the special hamburg steak with a half-demi, half-tomato sauce and a soft yolk; chopsticks, rice, pickles, red miso soup, Worcestershire sauce on request; the second generation's monthly 'Noro-style kaiseki'. Menu (tax included): Noro-style hamburg ¥3,850, minced cutlet ¥3,850, fried shrimp ¥3,850, fried oysters (autumn and winter) ¥3,850, bite-size wagyu cutlet ¥4,400, wire-grilled wagyu loin ¥4,950, tongue stew ¥4,950, beef stew ¥4,950, wagyu fillet beef cutlet ¥6,050, lunch mini-kaiseki course ¥6,050, Noro-style kaiseki course ¥8,800–19,800 (November: foie gras terrine, octopus simmered sakura-ni style, chowder, oyster gratin, persimmon salad, granita), à la carte hors d'oeuvre platter ¥2,200, live kuruma prawn fry ¥6,600, black-wagyu fillet steak 150g ¥14,300, desserts of savarin and orange tart. Media: a book by 伊集院静 (2020), 家庭画報 December 2020, あまから手帖 March 2020. Tabelog: Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-16-10, cards accepted, no e-money or QR, 36 seats (6 counter, 30 tables), private room, non-smoking, Yoshoku WEST 100 2025. Reviews (September 2025–September 2026): hamburg and stew in clay pots, soft-boiled egg, ¥3,300 in 2025 and ¥3,850 in May 2026, calm seats on 2F, attentive service, and a view that it is not worth the price.

公式サイト (日本語): W大阪の Oh.lala...、朝食からランチ、ディナ.en: Official site (Japanese): Oh.lala... at W Osaka, breakfast through lunch to dinner; windows looking onto the tree-lined Midosuji; modern white, black and blue interior with polka-dot accents; breakfast is a buffet; 3F, 160 seats; breakfast 7:00–11:00 (L.O. 10:45), lunch 12:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:00), dinner 17:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); traditional French with Japanese ingredients and a modern sensibility; a free 4-dish steak frites course for one birthday guest (parties of 2 or more); boulangerie dinner; wine buffet; kids eat free; address Minamisemba 4-1-3 (the English menu page writes "4-3-1 Minami Semba"). Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): opened 16 March 2021; lunch limited to 90 minutes; no seat requests; Marriott Bonvoy benefits and discounts not applicable; no à la carte on some December 2026 dates; allergy information available; vegetarian options; parking ¥1,500 an hour (free time depending on spend). Reviews (September–October 2026): all-you-can-eat bread and desserts; lasagna; steak frites; night view; only one pasta choice; salty salad; desserts taste alike; one diner received a Marriott member discount; one says the menu was co-developed with Chef Yusuke Takada of La Cime.

公式サイト (株式会社タイガー・アイ): 北新地で季節の食材の割烹・小料理『割烹.en: Official site (Tiger Eye Co., Ltd.): runs 'Kappou Ootagawa' (かっぽう おおたがわ), kappo and small dishes of seasonal ingredients in Kitashinchi; 堂島メリーセンタービル B1F, 1-3-16 堂島; Mon–Sat 11:30–13:30 and 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:00); seasonal ingredients and the skill of a craftsman with twenty-five years on this path; a hideaway in Kitashinchi known to those in the know; for business dinners, betrothals, family introductions and couples' anniversaries; creative kaiseki; each ingredient chosen by the craftsman and prepared with time; osechi at year end; tatami private rooms for up to 12; counter seats; the owner trained at 石和川 in Kitashinchi. Tabelog (shop member): Kappou Ootagawa, Japanese cuisine, seafood and tempura; closed Sundays and holidays; Saturdays fully by reservation made by the day before; lunch ends when sold out; 100% fee for cancellations from three days before; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 20 seats; sunken-floor private rooms; smoking allowed; children's meals on request; opened 20 November 2006; about 50 seasonal ingredients; Hana course ¥12,100, with drinks ¥16,500; chef's omakase chicken course ¥14,300; Kaze course ¥16,500; Wa course ¥19,800. Reviews (February–October 2026): four lunch sets at ¥1,300 each; crab cream croquette under a vegetable sauce (bamboo shoot, konnyaku and bean sprouts, curry-flavoured); fried chicken wings and beef croquettes; salted mackerel; chicken rice with dashi poured over; ginger pork; spring rolls; three small dishes, rice, miso soup, pickles and a jelly dessert; full quickly with a queue; a comment that the head chef is from Tokunoshima; dashimaki; bacon and daikon; smoking allowed; attentive staff.

公式サイト (株式会社心屋): 心屋の店舗一覧は地魚と地野菜 心屋 上通り店と個.en: Official site (Kokoya Co., Ltd.): the Kokoya shops are 'local fish and local vegetables' Kokoya Kamidoori and 'private rooms and local fish dishes' Kokoya Hondoori. Tabelog (shop member): Kokoya Honten, seafood, izakaya and sake bar, 新地萬年ビル 2F, 1-3-33 堂島, Kita-ku, Osaka; 4 min on foot from JR Kitashinchi Station; on the second floor of the building with the flower shop on Kitashinchi's Kamidori; Mon–Sat 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Sundays and Mondays that are holidays; reservations accepted; two hours when busy; parties of two at the counter only; service charge 10%; cards and PayPay accepted; 20 seats; semi-private rooms; smoking allowed; opened 10 May 2010; fish and vegetables sent directly by friends of the owner, who is from Awaji Island; over 20 sakes at all times; Awaji's local sake Tomi Bijin; fugu and milt in winter; banquet courses from ¥6,800; summer Awaji hamo hotpot course ¥7,000; a grilled eel and eel hotpot course. Invoice registration: Kokoya Co., Ltd. Reviews (July 2025–October 2026): noresore; white amadai sashimi; grouper liver; abalone steak; grilled kinmedai; buri and aosa shabu-shabu; Hinai chicken soup and Kawachi chicken tsukune; six kinds of sashimi; ayu with fruit tomato; eel and matsutake tempura in buckwheat flour; Awaji beef roast; tomato and yuba 'mapo'; beltfish tempura; aburi beltfish sushi; hamochiri; zosui with sansho oil; eel shabu-shabu; a wide range of sake; smoking allowed; attentive head chef, owner and staff.

公式サイト (株式会社２４、代表取締役 西 真澄): 酒屋の次男だった創業者が1.en: Official site (Twenty Four Co., representative director 西 真澄): the founder, second son of a liquor shop, opened AT THE 21 in Toyonaka in 1984; okonomiyaki as the dish closest to Osaka people; glass-fronted like a café, with no noren or sign; a bright, modern shop that solo diners and women can enter easily; no iron plates on the tables, the finished dish served on a small made-to-order one-person iron plate; from 2016 also a shop in Panasonic Stadium Suita; the batter uses a house dashi of chicken bones, kombu and more, and fine cake flour; cabbage and green onion from whichever region is best each season (description of the Toyonaka shop). Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): Namba Sennichimae 4-5; opened 1 June 2023; Mon–Fri 12:00–15:30 and 17:30–22:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–22:00; irregular closing days; reservations; cards (VISA, Master) and PayPay; 28 table seats; non-smoking; children welcome. Menu (updated 2023): okonomiyaki, cheese okonomiyaki, yakisoba, negiyaki (soy-sauce flavour), modern-yaki, cheese modern-yaki, omusoba; mayonnaise and mustard can be left off. Reviews (September–November 2026): fluffy and thick, big portions, orders by QR code, pork modern-yaki ¥1,700, seafood negiyaki ¥2,100, many guests from abroad; some found the batter dry or the sauce light.

公式サイト (祇園さゝ木): 祇園楽味、テーマは「大人の割烹居酒屋」、全国各地や.en: Official site (Gion Sasaki): Gion Rakumi, themed as an 'adult kappo izakaya'; the season's ingredients, bought from around Japan and sometimes abroad, are laid out in an ingredient box, and guests decide with the chefs how to have what they choose; charcoal at the centre of the counter; lunch from 12:00 or 12:30; dinner 17:30–20:20 (last entry 18:30) and 20:30–23:00 (last entry 21:30); average ¥7,000 at lunch and ¥20,000 at dinner; closed Sunday, the second and fourth Monday and irregularly; bookings up to the end of the second month ahead; 東山区祇園町南側570-206; the group also runs Gion Sasaki, Sushi Rakumi and Shoku Bar Rakumi. Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; Mon–Sat 17:30–23:00; 14 seats; non-smoking; cards and e-money accepted. Reviews (December 2025–September 2026, in English): young chefs; simmered nodoguro, wagyu steak, crab gratin, corn tempura, hamburg steak, curry; even a Chinese wok; opened November 2013; OAD 2026.

公式サイト (銀座店): 北新地の人気焼肉店「さつま」が東京・銀座に初出店、大阪.en: Official site (Ginza shop): the popular Kitashinchi yakiniku shop Satsuma opens its first Tokyo shop in Ginza; founded 40 years ago in Kitashinchi, Osaka. Tabelog (shop-maintained): Kitashinchi Yakiniku Satsuma Roppongi, Roppongi 5-1-10, カドガンビル 1F, 5 min from Roppongi Stn (Hibiya line); 18:00–08:00 (L.O. 7:30); 10% late-night charge after 22:00; 15 seats (10 at the counter); e-cigarettes only; cards, e-money and QR accepted; English menu and English-speaking staff; opened 23 February 2023. Courses ¥7,000 and ¥8,000; Kuroge wagyu tongue and Tsurami only at the Roppongi shop. Reviews (August 2024–October 2026): busier in the early morning; premium salt tongue, outside skirt, liver, yukhoe, mountain-jellyfish kimchi, omasum sashimi; unlimited umeboshi sour; about 70% of the customers from overseas.

公式サイト bakerykagome.net によれば「小麦・乳製品・卵（・白砂.en: According to the official site bakerykagome.net, 'a gluten-free bakery using no wheat, dairy or egg (or white sugar)', centred on rice-flour sandwich loaves made with Shirakami Kodama yeast, with a gallery inside. A Gogai NET Toyohashi/Tahara article reports a husband-and-wife business, with the wife baking and the husband running the shop, and the popularity of its chewy texture. A gluten-free guide (empacede) rates it as handling no wheat.

公式サイト nanakoshi.com は創業50年以上・鳥羽の名物（伊勢うどん.en: The official site nanakoshi.com says the shop has been going for over 50 years and serves Toba specialities such as Ise udon. The Ise-Shima tourism association (iseshima-kanko.jp) lists chewy, thick Ise udon, house-made udon, tekone-zushi and turban shells grilled in the shell. A personal blog (sirokuroomochi, Golden Week 2025) confirms a family business, a tamari-soy dashi sauce handed down through the generations, Ise udon boiled for about 40 minutes, and a tekone-zushi set (about ¥1,540).

公式サイト(aitsunoramen.com)とgenjitsutouhi等より.en: The official site (aitsunoramen.com), genjitsutouhi and others confirm representative Yasunori Ueshima, the May 2014 opening, about 10 minutes on foot from Tambaguchi Station, opening at 10:30, from Ore no Ramen Appareya, rich-mellow salt / cloudy-creamy salt / Ultra Tsukemen, and a solo-diner shop with a LINE numbered-ticket system.

公式サイト(fukuchian.jp)より、株式会社新福知庵(福知山市)。平成8.en: From the official site (fukuchian.jp): Shin-Fukuchian Inc. (Fukuchiyama). In Heisei 8 (1996) the textile firm 丸三加工 changed its trade name to Fukuchian Inc., switched to a ramen specialist, and opened the Fukuchian main shop. The Nijojo-mae shop opened in Reiwa 4 (2022). Nijojo-mae shop: street address on Higashi-Horikawa-dori, Nakagyo-ku, Kyoto, TEL 075-212-7620, 11:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30), open every day (except New Year), 27 seats. The soup is pork bone of domestic leg bones and Tamba chicken bones simmered over 20 hours; the base tare is naturally brewed soy sauce aged a year in cedar barrels; house-made noodles use Nisshin 'Toku Number One'. The allergen chart lists wheat for every ramen, side and topping. Instagram (2026/10/03) announced a vegetarian ramen (miso-based, house-made noodles, 'almost' no meat or fish ingredients).

公式サイト(ginza-ashibi.com): 手打ち蕎麦とお酒の美味しい店.en: Official site (ginza-ashibi.com): Ashibi, a shop of hand-made soba and good sake, on Sukiya-dori in Ginza 6-chome; a plain-wood counter, tables and private rooms; Hitachi Aki soba (rooted in a heirloom variety from 赤土町 in the former 金砂郷村), finely ground with its inner husk in a 蟻巣石 stone mill; hospitality of "everyday quality"; "a smile at the table is the best feast"; tendon and 100% buckwheat soba at reasonable prices on weekdays 15:30–18:00; phone line 15:30–21:30. Tabelog: Ginza 6-4-17, 出井 Building 2F; no hours or seat count listed. Reviews (2025–2026): private rooms like a high-end ryōtei; a Japanese course finished with soba; the owner's hospitality; 100% buckwheat soba; soba-mae snacks such as nori, miso-pickled cream cheese, shiokara and dried squid; opens at 16:00; jumbo shrimp-tempura soba; house satsuma-age; grilled nori; soba water with Ashibi shochu.

公式サイト(ginza-sushikou-honten.com): 銀座寿司幸本.en: Official site (ginza-sushikou-honten.com): Ginza Sushi Ko Honten, Edomae sushi founded in Meiji 18 (1885); fourth-generation master 杉山衛 (representative director as the fourth generation in 1992); a pioneer of pairing sushi with wine; ingredients from Japan's coastal waters such as tuna, spotted flounder and shinko; 40 seats in all at a plain-wood counter and private rooms; three shops: Ginza main shop, Marunouchi Building and Kojun Building; Mon–Sun 12:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:00), 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 20:00); no regular holiday; takeaway available; book through the official site. Tabelog: Ginza 6-3-8; 24 counter seats and 3 tatami private rooms; introduction "tradition is not something to protect but something to create". 2026 reviews: a shop associated with Ikenami Shōtarō; the 2F counter; the fourth generation makes nigiri while chatting cheerfully; striped jack and shiitake nigiri; white wine to go with sushi; 140 years since founding; many young craftsmen; nigiri at lunch.

公式サイト(ginzasonypark.com/nibunnoichi、Sony.en: Official site (ginzasonypark.com/nibunnoichi, Sony Enterprise): [ Nibun no Ichi ], Ginza 5-3-1, Ginza Sony Park B3; 11:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:00); weekdays 15:30–17:30 desserts and drinks only; closed on Ginza Sony Park closing days and at New Year; no cash, cashless only; about 20 seats each at high and low tables; private rooms for 6–8; the "SONY" neon from the former Sony Building roof. Menu: 1/2 plates combining two yōshoku classics on one plate (grown-up Napolitan × egg sandwich ¥1,200; Ginza miso curry × Ginza katsu toast ¥1,600; classic omurice × beef-belly hayashi rice ¥1,600; soft-egg-on-hamburg × crab cream croquette ¥1,900; three-mushroom doria × Ginza beef katsu toast ¥2,800; and more); à la carte includes a chickpea and broad-bean falafel steak [vegan] ¥800 and maitake hummus [vegan] ¥800; desserts such as pudding à la mode ¥800; mainly natural wine. Tabelog: 36 seats; opened January 26, 2025; allergen labeling; English menu. 2026 reviews: about half-size, so you can try lots; chocolate parfait; curry and katsu sandwich; some say small portions, poor value.

公式サイト(kyushujangara.co.jp)より: タスグループ(代表取.en: From the official site (kyushujangara.co.jp): TAS group (president 下川高士, founded September 1979). 1979 ブルカン塾, 1984 founded Kyushu Jangara Akihabara main shop. The Ginza shop opened in 1991 on Mihara-dori in Ginza 7-chome (company history); per Tabelog, on July 7, 2010 it moved from Ginza 7-11-10 to the current address (Ginza 6-12-17 Ginza 片桐 Building 1F). Hours 11:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:15); pay at the register when leaving; cash, transit IC, PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay and cards. Ginza menu: Kyushu Jangara, Bonshan, Kobonshan, Kyushu Jangara miso, Karabon, and a dark-shoyu vegan ramen. The noodles are several wheat flours and egg white. English, Chinese, Korean and Thai menus at every shop (FAQ).

公式サイト(m-yukichi.jp)は水戸の特選中華蕎麦諭吉が父子で作り上げた.en: The official site (m-yukichi.jp) states the house-made noodles and soup were created by father and son at Tokusen Chuka Soba Yukichi in Mito. kyo-soku / kusamoto confirm the Teramachi Honpo opening on 24 September 2024, A5 wagyu teppanyaki, truffle oil, and an operator from Amino, Kyotango.

公式サイト(paisvasco.jp、Granada Inc.): 銀座7丁目の.en: Official site (paisvasco.jp, Granada Inc.): a house in a back lane of Ginza 7-chome; a restaurant of Spain's Basque Country; traditional Basque and Spanish dishes plus originals; always 50+ Spanish wines including the Basque local wine txakoli; 1F bar style, 2F and 3F tables; the regional dish pil-pil (dried cod cooked in olive oil, garlic and chili without boiling); txakoli poured from high to make it foam; 40 seats; Mon–Fri 17:30–26:00, Sat and holidays 15:00–23:00, closed Sun. Tabelog: Ginza 7-3-16, 3 minutes from Ginza Station exit C3; at the end of a narrow lane beside the vending machines between the 東郷 Building and the Oritchin Building; charge ¥400; smoking only at the terrace seats by the entrance; opened September 20, 2012. 2026 reviews: a staffer with a Dalí-style mustache; watercress salad; Ibérico jamón; Spanish omelet; Galician octopus; the txakoli pour; tapas platter; Basque salad; crab gratin; beef shoulder loin braised in red wine; squid-ink risotto; wine mostly by the bottle.

公式サイト(ryouriya-terado.com)で店主『寺戸 昌規』と『ご家.en: The official site (ryouriya-terado.com) confirms owner 'Masanori Terado' and the hospitality concept 'a lively, fun time with family and friends'. osumituki confirms the previous tenant Menya Itadori (closed 2019/9/30), the December 2019 opening, and curry tsukemen rich with bonito dashi (aonori, summer vegetables, chicken, soft-boiled egg).

公式サイト(sanyasou.co.jp)は農家のお母さんたちが地元野菜で一つ一.en: The official site (sanyasou.co.jp) says its mainstay is oyaki hand-made one by one by farming mothers with local vegetables, and that it also sells suiton, oden and amazake. Spicy radish and nozawana oyaki are confirmed. JA operation, founding year, additive-free and a direct-sales model are not stated, so those lines were removed or softened. The anecdotes of seasonal changes (jalan) and the thoughtful cold water (55anz) were confirmed in the cited sources.

公式サイト(taiko-noodle.com)は太閤うどんの姉妹店として2023.en: The official site (taiko-noodle.com) says it opened on 30 January 2023 as a sister shop of Taiko Udon, serving shoyu / salt ramen (¥1,100 each). A Tabelog review (January 2026) records that the usual whole-wheat noodles can be swapped for gluten-free rice-flour noodles, and explains a double soup of seafood and pork with no added amino acids or hydrolysed protein. No guarantee about wheat in the rice-noodle cooking water or the soy tare.

公式サイト: 1979年創業、元祖「自分でたこ焼を焼いて食べるお店」、先代が開発.en: Official site: founded in 1979; the original 'shop where you grill your own takoyaki and eat it'; a smokeless table developed and patented by the previous owner; teppan in use since the founding; a secret batter blended by the previous owner; fresh, never-frozen octopus bought daily; Kujo green onions from a contracted Kyoto farm; shaved bonito flakes; a house sauce developed with Oliver Sauce; sesame soy sauce made daily by the head chef; doro sauce, tako-tsuyu dipping broth and ponzu; takoyaki ¥860, Tako no Tetsu-yaki ¥960, tako-shiso cheese ¥960; weekday lunch comes with a drink and free refills of rice and miso soup; also a Grand Green Osaka shop and a KITTE Osaka shop (opening notice dated 31 July 2024); the closure notice for the Marubiru shop is dated 25 May 2023. Tabelog (shop-maintained): 1F of a building at Kakuta-cho 1-10, Kita-ku, Osaka; daily 11:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); weekday lunch 11:30–15:00; closing days not fixed; 47 seats; tatami and sunken kotatsu seating; semi-private room for 6; non-smoking; English menu; children welcome; courses with all-you-can-drink ¥4,300 and ¥5,000; opened 1 August 1979. Reviews (August–October 2026): staff put in the first batter and octopus for you; 12 pieces a serving; a wall of celebrity autographs; ponzu yakisoba; a wait on a Friday night; one diner found self-grilled takoyaki no match for a professional's.

公式サイト: Certo Wine ＆ Dining、10月27日にマーガレット.en: Official website: Certo Wine & Dining; a wine dinner featuring Margaret River on 27 October (¥15,000); Mondays irregular since January this year (open if booked); take-out, chilled dishes and wine sales. Tabelog: Certo, Italian, wine bar, pasta; Suga-chō 1-26; 3 min walk from Yotsuya-sanchome Station Exit 3; Mon–Sat 17:00–24:00 (last order 22:30), closed Sundays and holidays; dinner only since 2017; ¥550 appetizer charge; 25 seats; one private room, one group a day; non-smoking; English menu and staff; born in Sydney in 1999, opened in Yotsuya-sanchome on 15 December 2006. Reviews (2022–2026): Australian and New Zealand wines; handmade tagliatelle; lamb; some say the dishes come out slowly.

公式サイト: Craft Burger co、2015年より創業、無添加100%.en: Official site: Craft Burger co, founded 2015, additive-free 100% domestic beef; chosen cuts from Hokkaido ground in the shop every day and shaped into patties by hand, no filler; buns, sauces and meat all handmade, the same as a restaurant; cheese imported directly from around the world. Japanese and English menus: Horie shop, Kita-Horie 1-6-12, Nishi-ku, Osaka; daily 11:00–22:30; sizes petit, regular and double; a free side (fries, onion rings, salad or soup); a salad plate can replace the bun; Craft Burger ¥890 / ¥1,550 / ¥2,250; Craft Burger Deluxe ¥1,190 / ¥1,990 / ¥2,690; tofu steak burger (vegetarian) ¥790 / ¥1,290; tax included; eat-in and take-out prices are the same. Kansai Walker (2018): the Australian owner パット アゴスティネリ and co-owner 美希, married to the owner; the Kitahorie shop opened on 11 November 2015 and the Dojima shop on 18 June 2018; now a godo kaisha. Tabelog (shop-maintained): 23 seats (7 at the counter), smoking allowed on the terrace, pets on the terrace only, reservations from 16:00, cards, e-money and PayPay accepted, Minoh Beer and more, Hamburger 100 in 2019, 2021, 2022 and 2024. Reviews (May–October 2026): Deluxe ¥1,990, lunch set ¥1,390, a petit size, some overseas customers.

公式サイト: GOODMAN ROASTER、台北に2店舗・京都に1店舗のスペシ.en: Official site: GOODMAN ROASTER, a specialty coffee roaster with 2 shops in Taipei and 1 in Kyoto; message from 伊藤 篤臣 (Atsuomi Ito): “make time to do nothing”; Cropster and Diedrich roasters (5 kg machine in Kyoto); hand-brewed Alishan coffee served in tea ware; Q graders; Kyoto shop at 下京区矢田町115-2 (Shijo-Nishinotoin, south then first lane east, south side); 3 min on foot from Karasuma Station; opening hours on Instagram; wholesale. Tabelog: 8:00–18:00; closed Wednesday; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; terrace; English menu; opened 22 November 2019. Reviews (2026, in English): light and dark roast Americanos; Ethiopian; iced coffee ¥760; flat white; carrot cake; blueberry cheesecake; coffee soft serve; a free coffee when you buy beans; cash only.

公式サイト: Hamac de Paradis アマーク・ド・パラディ、心斎橋・.en: Official site: Hamac de Paradis, a modern bistro in Shinsaibashi and Minami-Senba, since 1995, an established presence in Minami-Senba, counter seats with a live feel and an atrium, a Dear Ingo lamp, monochrome decor with modern art and mosaic tiles, simple modern European cooking with seasonal colour, daily plates, the signature croquette loved since the founding (crisp outside, soft inside, handmade), parties and wedding after-parties, private hire up to 50, LUNCH 11:30–15:00 (last order), DINNER 17:00–21:00 (last order), CAFE DRINK 11:30–21:30 (last order), CLOSE 22:00, Minami-Senba 4-12-21, Chuo-ku, Osaka. Tabelog (shop-maintained): open year-round, lunch bookable only at weekends and holidays for 11:30–12:00, 90 minutes when busy, cards, e-money and PayPay accepted, 112 seats (42 at tables on 1F and 2F, 10 at the counter, 60 on the 3F sofa floor), karaoke and a projector on 3F, non-smoking, vegetarian options, more than 50 wines mainly from Italy, an anniversary course ¥5,000 (all-you-can-drink ¥1,800), appeared on "Gochi ni Narimasu!" on 20 April 2023. Reviews (September–October 2026): the signature croquette lunch ¥1,200 (bread or rice), a mushroom and porcini cream croquette with demi-glace, a daily plate ¥1,200 plus a croquette for ¥300, a lunch drink ¥200, half an angel-food cake ¥300, full of nearby office workers, daily events (Halloween candy and more), and a view that the portions are small.

公式サイト: Mealthy、ダイバーシティー株式会社 (代表 立花真由美) が.en: Official site: Mealthy, run by Diversity Co. (representative 立花真由美), focused on seasonal vegetables and balanced nutrition. Plates: monthly, beauty, gut-health, vegan (a two-croquette Buddha bowl, ¥1,900), immunity-boost (a rich spicy dry curry, gluten-free) and body-building; the others ¥1,700; takeaway has the same contents. Lunch 11:00–14:30 (L.O. 14:00); closed Saturdays, Sundays and holidays.

公式サイト: No.4、カフェでもレストランでもベーカリーでもない、朝から晩まで.en: Official website: No.4 — not a café, not a restaurant, not a bakery, a space to enjoy "handcraft" from morning to night; Yonbanchō 5-9; reservations after 17:30; take-out from 11:30, only 8 popular items on weekends and holidays. Tabelog: café, bread, pizza; 5 min walk from Kōjimachi and Ichigaya Stations; daily 8:00–21:00 (last order food 20:00, drinks 20:30); breakfast 8:00–10:45; closed over New Year; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 48 seats; terrace; non-smoking; opened 1 December 2015; bread from domestic wheat, wood-fired pizza, T.Y.HARBOR craft beer. Reviews (2025–2026): French toast ¥1,680–1,740; pumpkin French toast ¥2,480; free coffee refills; long queues; take-out customers get in quickly.

公式サイト: OSTERIA SUDO (オステリアスドウ)、大阪市浪速区難波中.en: Official site: OSTERIA SUDO, Nambanaka 2-6-20, Naniwa-ku, Osaka, 5 minutes on foot from Namba Station on each line; Tue–Sat, Sundays and holidays lunch 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00), dinner 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed the 1st and 3rd Sundays and Mondays; 16 seats (tables and counter). Owner's greeting: the authentic taste of someone who trained in Italy. Lunch: pranzo A ¥1,100 (dish of the day, pasta of the day), B ¥1,400 (with dessert and espresso or tea), C ¥2,000 (assorted antipasti, pasta of the day), pranzo speciale ¥3,000 (reservation only); one order per person; please refrain from bringing strollers. Dinner: table charge ¥330 per person, three kinds of homemade bread (grissini, ペットレ, focaccia; focaccia refills available), assorted antipasti small ¥1,400 / large ¥2,100, fresh-fish carpaccio, handmade tagliatelle in fresh sea-urchin tomato cream sauce ¥2,100, potato gnocchi with gorgonzola and walnut sauce ¥1,550, roast duck breast with Marsala orange sauce ¥2,000, veal cotoletta, beef cheek braised in red wine, prosciutto and porcini risotto, Margherita ¥1,350, courses ¥3,400–¥6,000. Website-only coupon: arrive by 19:00 and glass drinks are half price for an hour (reservation required, cash only). Tabelog (English): opened 10 October 2006; over 40 wines, mainly Italian; on Tuesdays house wine and glass sparkling are half price; on Thursdays ¥1,000 off bottles of ¥4,000 or more; no cards or e-money, PayPay accepted; appetizer charge ¥300 (before tax); 16 seats (6 counter, 10 table); non-smoking; vegetarian options. Reviews (July–October 2026): at lunch, two of the day's three pastas on one plate, large size ¥200 extra, focaccia refills free, the tea is always strong, popular so booking is recommended; at dinner, sautéed sea bream with porcini sauce, roast duck, penne with gorgonzola; one diner regretted that the dish of the day was swapped without explanation when it sold out.

公式サイト: PAUSE COFFEE、2019年11月19日オープン、PAUS.en: Official site: PAUSE COFFEE, opened 19 November 2019; PAUSE COFFEE 8:00–18:00; PAUSE 10:00–19:00; closed Mondays; your old self and your new self; a time to switch between on and off; a time for local people to drop in and enjoy conversation; to become a brand that designs and supports customers' lifestyles through beauty and food. Tabelog (shop member): PAUSE COFFEE, café, 6-12-19 Fukushima, Fukushima-ku, Osaka; about 7 min from JR Fukushima Station; about 10 min from JR Osaka Station; Tue–Sun 8:00–18:00; closed Mondays; no reservations; cards and transport IC cards accepted; 10 seats; terrace; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi; children and strollers welcome; breakfast; carefully dripped coffee and seasonal French toast; local produce. Reviews (March–September 2026): order and pay first; queues; Habikino fig French toast (with lemon sorbet added); Benihoppe strawberry French toast; Shimizu white peach with lemon honey and tea jelly; banana French toast; plain; Costa Rica drip; café latte; espresso tonic; organic juice; lemonade; avocado open sandwich; breakfast set; house-made bread; many Western and overseas guests.

公式サイト: SAKANAZA MAEDA、御予約制・おまかせコースで営業、御予.en: Official site: SAKANAZA MAEDA, reservation only with an omakase course, book by two days before, occasional closures, check Instagram or phone for the latest, 3 min walk east from the クリスタ長堀 south exit 10 of Shinsaibashi Station. Tabelog: SAKANAZA MAEDA, French, ケイティーズ心斎橋 2F, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-19-19, Chuo-ku, Osaka, Tue–Sun 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–21:00, closed Monday, cards and QR accepted, 24 seats, counter, non-smoking. Reviews (June 2023–August 2026): opened about 30 years ago (per the staff), seasonal-vegetable appetizers, a cold soup in a big bowl, crisp-skinned fish, tender steak, in 2024 an omakase at ¥6,000, lunch ¥3,300 and a ¥6,600 lunch course, onion gratin soup, peach vichyssoise, a couple returning to the place of a first date 23 years before, business dinners, a calm counter.

公式サイト: SIK eatery、中華・香港・台湾料理がベースのカフェレストラ.en: Official site: SIK eatery, a café-restaurant based on Chinese, Hong Kong and Taiwanese food, with Thai, Vietnamese, Korean and other Asian dishes too; the concept is a 'Chinese restaurant' a woman can easily enter alone; renamed from 'CAFE' to 'eatery' in April 2024; Utsubo Park branch and Grand Green Osaka branch (opened September 2024); the Grand Green Osaka branch is a small-plate Chinese bar in Umekita Park; takeaway; sales of opened bottles of wine; free loan of picnic sets; featured in SAVVY (October and November 2026 issues), Meets Regional (April 2026) and Mapple Osaka '27. Tabelog (shop member): Asian, ethnic, yum cha and Chinese, 大深町5-70, Building E of the South Park of Umekita Park, Grand Green Osaka Shops & Restaurants, Kita-ku, Osaka; 5 min on foot from the Umekita underground entrance of JR Osaka Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); Sat, Sun and holidays 8:00–22:00; reservations accepted; terrace seats and bookings with pets by phone only; pets on the terrace at any time, indoors in part of the room at set hours; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 33 seats (7 at the counter, 18–22 at tables, 8 on the terrace); opened 6 September 2024; dim sum by a chef experienced at renowned restaurants; natural wine; courses with two hours of drinks ¥5,500, ¥6,600 and ¥7,700. Reviews (June–November 2026): Chinese congee with three dim sum ¥1,430; mushroom congee; Hainan chicken rice ¥1,600; coriander optional; tobiko shumai; seafood gyoza; shark-fin gyoza; shrimp gyoza; xiao long bao; pickled mustard greens; Yurinchi as the daily plate; a limited sweet-and-sour pork lunch; free large jasmine rice; ordering by QR code; water in paper cups; takeaway bento; next to the Waldorf Astoria; dogs welcome; many women among the customers.

公式サイト: XIRINGUITO Escribà (チリンギート エスクリバ).en: Official site: XIRINGUITO Escribà (Xiringuito Escribà), serving Barcelona's best paella, opened its first Kansai shop on 31 July; opened in 1992 in Barcelona, Spain; a seafood restaurant loved by locals for over 25 years; owner and executive chef Joan Escribà, born in Barcelona, opened it by the Mediterranean in 1992, the Olympic year; owner of the beach club Guingueta Escribà and the modern Spanish restaurant La Picanteria; owner-chef and chocolatier of Escribà. Menu: Escribà paella (shrimp, mussels, clams, white fish, eaten with wooden spoons); squid-ink fideuà (paella made with pasta, with aioli); 'Airbag' prosciutto slices and crispy bread; sangria of cava, white wine or red wine. Tabelog (shop member): Spanish and seafood, 梅田3-2-123, 3F of Innogate Osaka, Barchika 03 (バルチカ03エキウエ), Kita-ku, Osaka; directly connected to the west exit of Osaka Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:30 and 17:00–23:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–23:00; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 82 seats; non-smoking; children welcome; opened 31 July 2024; paella cooked 17 minutes over a direct flame; a beach-house interior; a limited fruit roll cake; XIRINGUITO course of 7 dishes ¥4,800; Mon–Thu courses with two hours of drinks, 6 dishes ¥7,000, 8 dishes ¥8,500. Reviews (October 2026): about five paellas plus a daily one; squid ink recommended; the crust at the bottom; mushroom salad with cheese; meatball stew; garlic shrimp; the Airbag broken with a hammer; small-size paellas; fig roll cake; Basque cheesecake; squid-ink short pasta; about ¥7,900 a head with all-you-can-drink; some found the portions small; came with a stroller; potatoes with dill sauce.

公式サイト: barefoot LLC の店、ネパールから来た人たちのインド・ネ.en: Official site: a shop of barefoot LLC; Indian and Nepali food by people who came from Nepal; the shop's name comes from a grandmother's barefoot strength; the chef trained in India before coming to Japan; the Links Umeda shop opened in 2023; 30 kinds of curry, biryani and mutton BBQ skewers are popular; all-you-can-eat naan; well liked by vegetarian and VEGAN guests too; lunch 11:00–16:00, café 15:00–17:00, dinner 16:00–23:00; Dal Bhat set ¥2,255 (tax included); cheese naan set ¥1,870 or ¥2,090; also a Minami Senba shop and Wanowa Cafe in Abeno Bel-ta. Tabelog (shop-maintained): Links Umeda 8F, Ohfuka-cho 1-1, Kita-ku, Osaka; daily 11:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); open all year; 50 seats; non-smoking; English menu; English-speaking staff; vegan, vegetarian, halal and Hindu options; opened 21 June 2023. Reviews (May–August 2026): a naan set with two curries ¥1,650–1,850; naan and rice refilled freely; cheese naan; butter chicken; spinach curry; tandoori shrimp ¥780; a spicy mutton Tukpa; you choose the spice level.

公式サイト: milia burger (ミリアバーガー)、選んでつくる、120.en: Official site: milia burger, the build-your-own shop with 1.2 million burger combinations; buns in brown, white or whole wheat, or lettuce instead of a bun; meat: beef patty, pork rib or chicken leg; all 10 sauces house-made; choose 3 vegetables; Shinmachi 1-17-8, Nishi-ku, Osaka, ハイネス新町公園 1F; Tue–Wed 11:00–18:00, Thu–Sat 11:00–21:00, Sun and holidays 11:00–17:00; last order 30 minutes before closing; closed Monday; no parking; Uber Eats. Tabelog (corporate member): reservations accepted; private hire possible; dogs now allowed only for takeout; 5 min walk from Yotsubashi and Nishi-Ohashi Stns; cards, transit IC, iD, QUICPay, PayPay accepted; 17 seats; counter, sofas, terrace, power outlets; non-smoking; children welcome; cocktails; drinks only is fine; fries, nuggets, hot dogs; opened 16 June 2016; Japan's first custom burger specialist. Reviews (February 2025–August 2026): ABC Burger ¥1,668, Tex-Mex Burger ¥1,668, bacon cheeseburger ¥1,496, fries and drink set +¥590, buffalo wings ¥716; coarse-ground patty with chunks, cooked rare; the owner explained the menu; teriyaki burger; truffle burger; cheeseburger with salad and fries; one diner found the portion small for the price.

公式サイト: muse umekita (ミュゼ ウメキタ)、気軽に立ち寄れる大.en: Official site: muse umekita (ミュゼ ウメキタ), a restaurant & café that is an adult's playground you can drop into casually; the theme is 'Farm to table'; salads of farm vegetables delivered every morning from contract farms, seafood carpaccio, ajillo, grills, stone-oven Neapolitan pizza, pasta, organic wine, homemade dolci of seasonal fruit; natural-style Italian; Grand Front Osaka North Building 6F, UMEKITA FLOOR; 11:00–23:00; irregular holidays; sofa seats with the Umeda night view; the name comes from a museum. Weekday-only buffet lunch ¥2,180 (farm-vegetable salad, starters, stone-oven Neapolitan pizza, free drinks; mains of weekly pasta in three styles, keema curry of Daisen chicken and colourful vegetables, grilled swordfish), 90 minutes. Weekend and holiday premium lunch: casual ¥2,580, standard ¥2,980, share ¥2,700. Dinner: contract-farm salad from ¥1,180, prosciutto from ¥780, starters from ¥680, ajillo ¥1,180, fried dishes from ¥880, pizza from ¥1,080, pasta from ¥1,880, grills from ¥1,080, meat mains from ¥2,480. WINTER FAIR 2026 from 1 November. Tabelog (shop member): Italian, buffet and dining bar, 大深町3-1, 6F of Grand Front Osaka North Building, Kita-ku, Osaka; 1 min on foot from JR Osaka Station; 11:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed 1 January; reservations for dining only; lunch 90 minutes, dinner 120 minutes; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 50 seats; non-smoking; children welcome; sommelier; opened 26 April 2013. Reviews (August–October 2026): buffet lunch priced by the main, ¥1,890–2,380, ¥1,700 between 11:00 and 11:30; wine among the free drinks; dessert pizza; honey; bacon in the pumpkin salad; meat-sauce pasta with octopus; Margherita; shrimp ajillo; cheese platter ¥1,280; caprese ¥680; white-peach and Earl Grey tea soda ¥780; night view; one drink and one food each; ordering by QR code; lively; one diner was bothered by the staff's language.

公式サイト: tanpopo、JR北新地駅から徒歩1分のおしゃれな鉄板焼き、シッ.en: Official site: tanpopo, a stylish teppanyaki shop 1 min on foot from JR Kitashinchi Station; okonomiyaki and seasonal ingredients cooked on the teppan in a chic, refined space; carefully chosen Italian wines, so it also works as a wine bar; omakase course by phone in advance; private room from 4; representative 神谷 圭介; 6F of the 永楽ビル building, 曽根崎新地 1-10-16, Kita-ku, Osaka; Mon–Sat 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:15); closed Sundays and irregular days. Tabelog (shop-maintained): Tabelog Steak/Teppanyaki WEST 100 in 2024 and 2025; large-plate sharing course ¥6,800, luxury course ¥10,800; ¥660 cover; 16 seats; non-smoking; sommelier; opened 7 November 2017. Reviews (August–October 2026): fluffy okonomiyaki, thin-noodle yakisoba, thick asparagus and pork belly, teppan chicken, scallops and shiitake, wagyu, always full, guests from overseas too.

公式サイト: wad 和道、「日本の良きモノ」がコンセプト、茶道の精神をアレンジ.en: Official site: wad (和道), built on the concept of 'good things of Japan'; a cafe (2F) for enjoying tableware and ingredients, arranged from the spirit of the tea ceremony; a gallery for contemporary artists, wad+ (3F, open during exhibitions only); classes in traditional gold kintsugi; tea delivered directly from farms in 和束町, Kyoto and 牧之原, Shizuoka; real tea brewed in a teapot; tableware by artists from Japan and abroad; tea leaves, antiques chosen by the owner and artists' pieces sold at the entrance; Minami-Senba 4-9-3, 東新ビル 2F and 3F; 5 min from Shinsaibashi Stn exit 3; diagonally across from the Organic Building; up the outside stairs; 12:00–19:00 (last order 18:30); closing days not fixed; no reservations; cash only. Tabelog: written as 東進ビル 2F; cafe and kakigori; 20 seats; non-smoking; no cards, e-money or QR; Tabelog Cafe WEST Top 100, 2025. Reviews (August–October 2026): matcha in a bowl chosen from 14, ¥1,000; kabuse sencha and wad monaka with brown rice; a salad of spent tea leaves with soy sauce and bonito flakes; kakigori with Uji syrup and condensed milk; hojicha syrup; matcha latte and hojicha latte; Chinese tea refilled up to 5 times; Tanba black-bean zenzai; take a number and get a phone call when it is your turn; waits of 40 minutes to an hour and a half; loud voices, laptop work and watching videos not allowed; many overseas customers.

公式サイト: うめだ一丁目スカイビア、屋上×BBQ×鍋、梅田のど真ん中、大阪駅前.en: Official site: Umeda Icchome Sky Beer; rooftop × BBQ × hot pot; in the very centre of Umeda; a Showa-retro space spread over the roof of Osaka Station Front Building No. 1; lanterns at dusk; a mood like Jiufen in Taiwan; an Inari shrine of the highest rank; a rooftop food-stall experience; private hire up to 440 seats (220 in winter); eight draft beers from the four big brewers; 20-plus highballs; 47 prefectural shochu from November to March; all all-you-can-drink. Tabelog (shop member): beer garden, BBQ and izakaya, 梅田1-3-1, rooftop 13F of Osaka Station Front Building No. 1, Kita-ku, Osaka; 1 min on foot from Nishi-Umeda Station, 3 min from Kitashinchi Station; take the lift on the Nishi-Umeda Station side (right) of the central lift hall to R; daily 15:00–22:30; April–December open every day (tent in rain); January–March closed Mondays; closed 1–3 January; may close for typhoons or heavy rain; crowded around 19:00; 10% off before 17:00; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 220 seats; no smoking at the seats, a smoking area; children welcome; menu in English, Chinese and Korean; opened 17 June 2025. Courses (tax included, all-you-can-drink): Standard ¥5,800 (Satsuma Chami pork, domestic pork belly, homemade tandoori chicken of Bichu Kogen chicken, sausages, two seafood, eight vegetables); Deluxe ¥7,300 (thick beef tongue, Saroma wagyu sirloin, shrimp, squid, scallops); Premium ¥10,000 (Japanese Black wagyu, four wagyu compared). Reviews (December 2025 – October 2026): beef motsunabe; lamb course ¥5,800; self-poured beer at the push of a button; choose your mug; highballs on the whisky you like; a roof and plastic curtains in rain; a corner seat got a little wet; a wanted drink had run out; some say the meat portions are small, others enough; gas grills; two sauces with salt and pepper; city views; a friendly manager and staff.

公式サイト: おおさか料理 淺井、運営は株式会社一是、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-6.en: Official site: Osaka Ryori Asai, run by 株式会社一是, ロイヤル中家 1F and 7F, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-6-19, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 4 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station, 5 min from Shinsaibashi Station, Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00, holidays 17:00–22:00, closed Sunday, 16 counter seats, 30 table seats, cash and cards, phone booking recommended. "Osaka good food", Japan's seasons cooked with time and care, the day's menu set by what comes from the market each morning, more than 150 dishes always on a scroll-long menu, Japanese, Western and Chinese, choose what you like or take the chef's omakase course, the traditional taste and skill of Osaka cuisine. Courses (tax included): Take course ¥14,300, Ume course ¥18,700, Raku course ¥22,000, five dishes left to the chef ¥14,300 or ¥18,700, also hamo shabu-shabu, tecchiri and crab hot pot, tell the restaurant about dislikes and allergies in advance. To take home: sansho jako ¥2,200, sardines for chazuke ¥2,200, bento from ¥4,320. Tabelog: former name Osaka Ryori Kikawa Asai, 45 seats, private rooms, separate smoking area, children and kids menu welcome, closed Sundays and holidays. Reviews (April–October 2026): a long menu with no prices, about seven cooks, the counter recommended, sashimi, tender simmered octopus, beef cutlet, hamo, hamo with plum, abalone and asparagus in butter, red clam with junsai, tempura of spring vegetables and young ayu, fried whale skewers, eggplant and crab in a thickened sauce, marinated tuna bowl, Nara-zuke with cream cheese, just under ¥30,000 for two, deep dashi, a foreign staff member on the booking phone, and a view that it was flawless but unexciting.

公式サイト: お好み焼き・鉄板焼き、大阪・ミナミのど真ん中、和気あいあいの法善寺.en: Official site: okonomiyaki and teppanyaki, in the very heart of Minami, Osaka, in friendly Hozenji Yokocho, "We make lots of tasty food, so come and eat and relax", the famous Modan-yaki, negiyaki, salt yakisoba, yakisoba, doteyaki, Yokocho-yaki, a special batter that is not floury and stays moist and chewy even cold, with a secret sauce, "old-fashioned okonomiyaki", a nostalgic taste of Osaka, 28 seats, 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:15), 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30), closed every Wednesday for the time being (open if it is a holiday, closed the Thursday instead), menus as PDFs in Japanese, English, Chinese and Korean, Yokocho-yaki sold on the Takashimaya online store. Tabelog (shop-maintained): Namba 1-1-18, Chuo-ku, 4 min walk from Namba Station exit 14, reservations accepted (a mobile number reachable on the day; more than 15 minutes late may be cancelled), cards accepted, no e-money or QR, 28 seats (13 counter, three tables for 4, one for 3), 1F counter without teppan, 2F tables with teppan, parties up to 8, non-smoking, children welcome, takeout, opened 30 November 2003, Okonomiyaki 100 in 2018, 2019, 2022 and 2024. Grilled for 15–20 minutes, domestic pork, squid and beef tendon, hand-cut cabbage and green onion, a house sauce refined over 20 years, doteyaki of domestic beef tendon simmered about two hours in Saikyo white miso, Yokocho-yaki born from the owner's playful spirit (double the batter). Reviews (August–October 2026): Modan-yaki ¥1,750, negiyaki with beef tendon ¥1,720, bottled beer ¥800, soy-flavoured negiyaki with tendon, pork okonomiyaki, salt yakisoba, doteyaki with cucumber, October's new Mentaiko Cheese W, an owner easy to talk to, many overseas guests, a report of bland flavours and poor service, and one of an average meal.

公式サイト: お気軽天ぷら処 天神、大阪市中央区博労町3-4-11、11:00〜.en: Official site: Okigaru Tempura Dokoro Tenjin, Hakuromachi 3-4-11, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); no fixed closing day (except New Year); 18 seats; the name comes from Tenjin in Fukuoka, busy with casual tempura shops, and 'the god of tempura'; a tempura specialist serving it freshly fried in front of you; 100% rice oil; moshio salt made from Seto Inland Sea water; tentsuyu of dashi from kombu and bonito, mackerel and sardine flakes, cut with a soy-sauce kaeshi; rice cooked continuously in small cookers, free refills, barley rice on request; homemade daikon pickles on the table; Tamago tempura set ¥1,350 (most popular), Tenjin tempura set ¥1,200, vegetable tempura set ¥1,000, angel shrimp tempura set ¥1,700, Osusume tempura set ¥1,550, large anago ¥1,700, large shrimp ¥1,500, Kiwami ¥2,450, tororo ¥1,200, October's monthly bonito tempura set ¥1,400, evening seasonal set ¥2,100, Tenjin evening set ¥1,600, seasonal tempura assortment ¥1,950, draft beer set ¥1,000, mentaiko tencha ¥600, course ¥3,200 (two or more). Patria Co.: Tenjin is its only shop; the manager is Takimoto Youhei from Hokkaido; the representative director is Tomiyasu Mieko from Fukuoka Prefecture (aimed to become an art teacher at Saga University, went into martial arts, founded the company after retiring). Tabelog: daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; 16 seats (counter 6, tables 12); tell the staff directly about allergies; English, Chinese and Korean menus. Reviews (September 2025–October 2026): casual Hakata-style tempura, freshly fried three pieces at a time in two rounds; the Tamago set; rice refills; scallop and aosa kakiage ¥450; angel shrimp, kisu, sardine, cheese chikuwa, pork tempura, seasonal eel, oysters, dorayaki tempura with butter; the staff changed and potato salad now comes out; closes early in the evening.

公式サイト: お魚と白ワインのバル agiyao、下京区深草町592-3 1階、.en: Official site: Fish and White Wine Bar agiyao; 下京区深草町592-3 1F; a grown-up bar for seasonal fish and plenty of white wine; supporting Kyoto's food culture and local industry with Kyoto ingredients; weekdays 17:00–24:00; weekends and holidays 14:00–24:00; lunch with white wine served from 12:00 at Uo Ryori agiyao on the 2nd floor. Tabelog: Mon–Thu 17:00–23:00; Fri–Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00; irregular closures; reservations taken; ¥7,700 cancellation fee from two days before; otoshi ¥550; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 24 seats (8 at the counter, two tables for 4, a private room for 5, room fee ¥2,500); non-smoking; opened 3 February 2014. Reviews (2026, in English): the owner, Aoyagi, also runs a fish restaurant near Gion; the sister restaurant upstairs has a Michelin star; taiyaki-shaped monaka otoshi; sea urchin pan con tomate; ajillo; grilled kinmedai; soup paella; white wine.

公式サイト: ぎをん縄手とり安、東山区弁財天町18、創業七十年の水だき専門店、昭.en: Official site: Gion Nawate Tori Yasu; 東山区弁財天町18; a mizutaki specialist founded seventy years ago; opened in 1955 by the previous owner, 岸澤邦夫, in Kawaramachi-Takoyakushi; moved in 1962 to Nawate-Shinbashi in Gion; white chicken-bone broth; morning-killed Kyoto Tanba chicken; broth taken over a full day with Higashiyama well water from the premises; house ponzu; 17:00–22:00 (last entry 21:00); closed Monday and Thursday; mizutaki course ¥11,000; chicken sukiyaki course ¥9,500 (tax and service included); à la carte (simmered liver, salt-grilled thigh, karaage, duck loin, zosui). Notice of 21 February 2026: reopening on 1 March with fewer seats, mainly by reservation, signed 岸澤邦和. Tabelog: 15 seats; private rooms (for 2 and 4); non-smoking; cards accepted; children welcome. Reviews (2025–2026, in English): simmered liver; salt-grilled thigh; mizutaki; zosui; fruit; a 70-year-old broth.

公式サイト: けむり屋＆FLOWER【本格中華】難波本店・なんば2号店・お初天神.en: Official site: Kemuriya & FLOWER (authentic Chinese), Namba main shop, Namba no. 2 shop and Ohatsu Tenjin shop; from July 2026 the Namba no. 2 shop opens Mon–Fri 17:00–24:00, Sat, holidays and Sundays before holidays 15:00–24:00 (closed Sunday, dinner only, lunch suspended for now); the main shop marks its 20th anniversary; in 2026 it partners with Niku no Nire's Osaka office to bring in much wagyu, with a Kagoshima black-wagyu campaign; from December 2024 a hire-only party room for 15–40 behind the first-floor kitchen of the main shop; the Namba no. 2 shop turns 12 in 2026. Tabelog (English edition): Wagyu and Chinese cuisine Kemuriya & Flower Osaka Namba main shop, Namba Sennichimae 6-12; Mon–Fri 17:00–23:30, Sat, Sun and holidays 15:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); closed 1–2 January; lunch suspended; ¥440 table charge (not with courses); 110 seats; authentic Cantonese and Sichuan food with ingredients the owner sources; takeout. Menu (November 2025): wagyu tataki yukhoe, Matsusaka beef and foie gras, wagyu mapo tofu, wagyu mala yakisoba, wagyu fried rice, wagyu Peking-duck-style crepes, saliva chicken, bang bang chicken, braised shark fin. Reviews (July–October 2026): assorted appetizers, ebi mayo, curry mapo tofu, tantanmen to finish, creative sweet and sour pork and spicy chicken, a wooden American-bar interior, a narrow alley; one found it a bit pricey; one noticed many staff from abroad.

公式サイト: こだわりの朝引き鶏を最高級の紀州備長炭で焼く、素材ごとに切り方、打.en: Official site: carefully chosen morning-slaughtered chicken grilled over top-grade Kishu binchotan; cut, skewered and grilled differently for each ingredient; seasonal vegetables direct from producers; the finish is the oyakodon, the regulars' number-one choice; in winter, a hot pot of chicken broth. Hours: lunch 11:30–14:00, dinner 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Sundays.

公式サイト: すし処 錦、毎朝大阪中央卸売市場でその日一番の新鮮な魚を仕入れ、お.en: Official site: Sushi Dokoro Nishiki; buys the freshest fish of the day at the Osaka central wholesale market every morning; sushi, à la carte dishes, hot pots and kaiseki; hot-pot banquets in the tatami room (up to 20); private rooms; banquets booked by the day before; omakase banquet course from ¥7,535 (tax included); Nishiki hot-pot banquet course from ¥13,200 (three-year fugu of about 1.8 kg). Menu (tax included): nigiri per piece from ¥550 (kohada, house tamagoyaki, saba, hamachi, ebi, ikura, maguro, kanpachi, ken-ika, hirame, akagai, scallop, tsubugai), from ¥770 (anago, uni, fugu, unagi), from ¥1,980 (toro, abalone, kuruma ebi); thin rolls from ¥2,200; toro tekka, negitoro and taku-toro rolls ¥4,180; live tora-fugu tecchiri courses ¥13,200 and ¥17,200 (booked two days ahead); grilled shirako ¥2,750, fugu kara-age ¥3,850, tessa ¥2,530; the head chef's omakase kaiseki ¥7,535 and ¥8,800 (from ¥11,000 too); 5% service charge in the tatami rooms; sakes include 久保田 萬寿, 呉春 and Ehime's 吹毛剣 and 五億年. Points of pride: saba bo-zushi finished with gyuhi kombu; sushi rice a blend of old and new Noto Koshihikari; Kagoshima's 財宝 spring water as the chaser and for cooking rice; a house-brand shochu. Shop guide: 12 counter seats; 20 tatami seats (sunken tables, 3–20 people); private rooms. Sennichimae 1-chome 7-6; 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00 in the tatami rooms); closed Sundays and Monday holidays. Tabelog (shop-maintained): one minute east of Hozenji; 3 min from Nipponbashi Station; 28 seats (10 counter, 18 tatami); cancelled if no contact after 20 minutes; same-day cancellation charged; bookings for guests from overseas only through a hotel; cards accepted; non-smoking; children only in the tatami room. Reviews (September 2025–September 2026): about 40 years in business; an L-shaped counter and tatami upstairs; order what you like from the fish case; assorted sashimi, fugu sashimi, shirako grilled with soy sauce, hamachi collar, live sweet shrimp, dobin-mushi, simmered sea-bream head, grilled eel, toro-taku, hamo with plum, salad roll, blue crab, grilled kinki, young ayu tempura; a regular of more than 30 years; a cheerful head chef and a talkative owner; staff from abroad; one view that the ¥7,535 course was ordinary.

公式サイト: すするか、すすらんか。は麻婆豆腐ラーメン専門店。オーダーメイドで調.en: Official site: Susuruka, Susuranka. is a mapo-tofu ramen specialist. Mapo tofu cooked to order is poured over smooth, chewy medium-thick noodles, a little different from ordinary mapo noodles. Naramachi main shop (28-34 Minamishirotocho, Nara; 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–21:00; closed Tuesdays). Tabelog: Susuruka, Susuranka. Shinsaibashi, Daiichi KS Bldg B1F, 1-15-22 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-7634-7598; no reservations; Mon–Thu and days before and after holidays 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30), Fri–Sun 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–4:00 next morning; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 26 seats; no smoking; wheelchair accessible; vegetarian and halal menus (ask staff). 2026 reviews (July–October): October-only hearty seafood meat-miso maze-soba ¥1,300 (meat miso, egg yolk, nira, bean sprouts, fish powder, fried onion, shredded nori, garlic on the side, thick chewy noodles); mackerel-dashi rice ¥300; July-only mega-garlic mapo-tofu ramen ¥1,500; summer-only cold basil mapo-tofu ramen; the mapo tofu is the Naramachi main shop's; mapo rice bowl; yu lin chicken; teriyaki rice bowl; a calm counter; a late-night last stop; one says it was quiet on a Friday lunchtime and staff didn't come unless called.

公式サイト: たいやき わかば、演劇評論家安藤鶴夫先生より戴いた「鯛焼きのしっぽ.en: Official site: Taiyaki Wakaba; its house motto, given by the theatre critic 安藤鶴夫, is 'may there always be bean paste in the taiyaki's tail'; in business in Yotsuya since 1953; taiyaki ¥250 each (tax included); both anko and batter made in-house; a thin skin packed with tsubu-an from head to tail; an original mould, with 'Wakaba' on the tail; anko 300 g ¥600, 600 g ¥1,200, 1 kg ¥1,950 (salty house anko made the same way since the first generation); dango (April–October) ¥180 a stick; kakigori (July–September) ¥500–800; open Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat and holidays other than Wed and Sun 9:00–17:00; closed Wednesdays and Sundays; baking starts at 9:00, taiyaki on sale from about 9:15; advance orders paused for lack of staff; no shipping; cash only; allergens: taiyaki wheat and starch syrup (corn starch), an-dango starch syrup (corn starch), mitarashi dango soy sauce (soy, wheat flour); takeaway boxes and bags cost extra. TV Tokyo アド街ック天国 (2020): founded 1953, a standard snack for 上智大学 students, house anko rested a day, traditional single irons. Tabelog: Tabelog 100 (sweets 2018, 2019, 2020, 2022; Japanese sweets 2023, 2026); 14 seats. Reviews (October 2026): 30–70-minute lines, edges trimmed with scissors, salty-sweet anko, one regular says the cook has changed.

公式サイト: ぢんとら、創業明治11年、一子相伝の七味、中京区中魚屋町494 (.en: Official site: Jintora; founded in Meiji 11 (1878); fragrant shichimi passed down to a single heir in each generation; 中京区中魚屋町494 (inside Nishiki Market); 3 min on foot from Hankyu Karasuma Station; 10:00–18:00; open every day (closed at New Year); Kyoto shichimi, ichimi, yuzu-kosho, sansho; shichimi and sansho soft serve; sansho limited to two bags per person because it is very hard to obtain. Tabelog: 9:30–18:00; no reservations; cards and e-money accepted; 4 seats. Reviews (2024–2026, in English): shichimi soft serve ¥430 (¥480 in July 2026); sansho soft serve ¥480; pink, sweet first then a tingle in the throat; yuzu shichimi about ¥450.

公式サイト: とらふぐ城、大阪心斎橋の国産ふぐ料理、ふぐ・かに・うなぎ・季節限定.en: Official site: Torafugu Jo, domestic fugu cuisine in Shinsaibashi, Osaka; fugu, crab, eel and seasonal specials; tessa that is aged to draw out the umami and is translucent; tecchiri prepared at each visit, savoured down to the marrow; torafugu, the king of fugu; snow crab; good food comes from good ingredients; year-end parties with fugu, toasting with hirezake; Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-4-24; summer (April–September) 12:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:45) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00), winter (October–March) 16:00–23:30; 1 min on foot from Nagahoribashi Station exit 7. Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): opened 11 September 2014; domestic tiger fugu only; 78 seats; private sunken-kotatsu rooms on the 2nd floor; tatami hall for up to 32 on the 3rd; year-end hours and service charge; no eel in December and January. Menu (August 2026): tessa ¥2,180, charcoal grill, garlic stone-grilled fugu, Kara-age, Shirako, fugu hot pot. Reviews (December 2025–October 2026): grilled fugu, aged tessa, grilled Shirako, the staff grill and make the hot pot, the fugu in the pot was still moving, conger eel in summer, Unaju, Tenshu course ¥7,980, one found the Zosui mild, a six-time regular.

公式サイト: なにわ天ぷら 維心、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-3-36 竹新ビル3階.en: Official site: Naniwa Tempura Ishin, 曽根崎新地1-3-36, 3F of 竹新ビル, Kita-ku, Osaka; lunch 12:00–14:00 (booked by the day before); dinner 18:00–22:30; closed Sundays and holidays; enjoy the world of Ishin with champagne chosen by the sommelier; 畑島 亮; TV features (2018: モモコのOH！ソレ！み〜よ！, おはよう朝日です, よ〜いドン！). Tabelog (shop member): tempura; 2 min on foot from Kitashinchi Station; on the narrow lane between Kitashinchi's main and upper streets, near a florist; Mon 18:00–22:30; Tue–Sat 12:00–14:00; closed Sundays and holidays; dinner for two or more from 18:00; online booking until 17:00 on the day, then by phone; full charge for same-day cancellation; 5% service at dinner only; lunch by course only, booked two days ahead; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 13 seats (a counter of 7, sunken-kotatsu private rooms); non-smoking; sommelier; opened 10 November 2016; tenth anniversary; fried in rare cottonseed oil; signature truffle tamago-kake-gohan; sea-urchin tamago-kake-gohan; champagne and tempura pairing; Osaka ingredients; Tabelog Tempura 100, 2022 and 2023; short tempura course ¥8,000; seasonal omakase ¥12,000; premium-ingredient course ¥15,000. Reviews (January–October 2026): live young sweetfish shown before frying; wild vegetables; asparagus; corn; sweet shrimp; foie gras wrapped in beef as tempura; truffle tamago-kake-gohan; sea-urchin tamago-kake-gohan; mini tendon; champagne recommended by the sommelier; sunken-kotatsu private rooms; a regular on a 31st visit.

公式サイト: なんばパークス2F、南海なんば駅中央口・南口直結、御堂筋線なんば駅.en: Official site: Namba Parks 2F; directly connected to the central and south exits of Nankai Namba Station, 3 min on foot from Namba Station (Midosuji Line); LUNCH 11:00–15:00 (L.O.), CAFE&BAR 11:00–22:30 (L.O.), DINNER 17:00–22:00 (L.O.); closing days follow the facility; 89 seats in all (65 inside, 24 terrace); © BALNIBARBI Co.,Ltd. Tabelog (English edition): opened 29 April 2019; daily 11:00–23:00; 85 seats (65 inside, 20 terrace); curtained private rooms (5–10); seat-only bookings must order food; no café-only bookings; no bookings for the 12 o'clock hour; one drink each at dinner; a service charge may apply. Menu (October 2026): seasonal pizzas (Awaodori chicken cacciatore, Sanma marinara style), pasta, assorted appetizers, carpaccio, ajillo, prosciutto, cheese. Reviews (June–October 2026): lunch comes with all-you-can-eat bread (about 20 kinds), soup curry, soup and rice; terrace seats; parfaits; Basque cheesecake; pistachio-raspberry chiboust; celebration plates; mocktails; ordering by QR code; one thought the fettuccine came too fast and might be pre-made; one found one pizza too little for three in a ¥3,000 course.

公式サイト: なんば・南堀江のレストラン、夜景を楽しみながらディナーを、Rest.en: Official site: a restaurant in Namba and Minamihorie; dinner with the night view; Restaurant & CAFÉ MOULiN; private hire for up to 400 (standing); BBQ and beer-garden plans with 120-minute all-you-can-drink; farewell and welcome party plans; a Sanriku–Joban seafood fair (February 2026); Minamihorie 1-5-26, Canal Terrace 1F; daily LUNCH 11:00–15:00 (L.O.), DINNER 17:00–22:00 (L.O.), CAFE 11:00–22:30 (L.O.), CLOSE 23:00; ©BALNIBARBI Co.Ltd. Balnibarbi securities report (edinetdb.jp): in July 2008 opened the restaurant & café "Moulin" in Minamihorie, Nishi-ku, in partnership with Osaka City, beginning waterside restaurant development; Moulin is run at Canal Terrace under a permit to use the Dotonbori River waterside, with barbecue and more. Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): daily 9:00–23:00 (morning 9:00–11:00 L.O.); 200 seats (102 inside, 98 terrace); smoking allowed on the terrace; private room for up to 30; no café bookings; one drink per person after 17:00. Menu (January 2026): charcoal grill (Awaji beef, Yumi pork, Awaodori chicken, lamb, black wagyu), pasta, Awaji beef lasagna, veal cotoletta, ajillo with baguette from Loaf Bakery in Toyonaka. Reviews (September–October 2026): terrace beer-garden buffet ¥4,000, riverside with sightseeing boats passing, Moulin lunch, Basque cheesecake, chiffon cake, a cream puff cut with a knife, ordering by QR code; one found the spare ribs now off the bone and the food less careful.

公式サイト: にんにくラーメン 幸ちゃん 東三国店 (ニンニクラーメン コウチャ.en: Official site: garlic ramen Kou Chan Higashimikuni ten (read as Ninniku Ramen Kou Chan Higashimikuni ten); 1-33-8 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; Sun, Mon, Wed and Thu 11:00–24:00, Fri and Sat 11:00–02:00; closed Tuesday; a light yet rich tonkotsu soup simmered for a long time, with the shop's curly noodles; miso, red miso and more; side dishes and courses besides ramen; homemade grilled pork; a sister shop. Tabelog (shop member): 1-33-9 Higashimikuni; 5 seconds from the footbridge on the south side of Higashi-Mikuni Station; 28 seats; non-smoking; opened 13 September 2011; Kujo green-onion ramen ¥900; red miso ramen ¥800. Reviews (June 2024 to October 2026): garlic on request; shoyu tonkotsu; light yet full of umami; kimchi chashu ramen; tsukemen with a rich, slightly salty dip; red miso wakame ramen ¥1,200; Kujo green-onion ramen ¥1,180; chashu ramen ¥1,500; special miso chashu ramen ¥1,550; beef paitan ramen; mini chashu bowl ¥350; grilled chashu bowl; mini curry ¥500; fried rice set ¥400; one diner has gone to the main shop for 30 years; PayPay accepted; a late-night last stop.

公式サイト: アラビヤコーヒー、SINCE 1951、戎橋から南へ二筋目を左、戎.en: Official site: アラビヤコーヒー, since 1951; south from Ebisubashi, second street on the left, halfway along the street linking Ebisubashi-suji and Hozenji east to west; look for the coffee-roaster signboard; 1F has 4 tables with 16 seats and a reservable table at the back for up to 8, and a counter of 7 (chairs the former master made by converting a table); 2F holds the former master's treasures and the hand-cranked roaster used at the opening, 4 tables with 16–20 seats; roasted with care every morning, brought daily from the company's own roastery in Taisho-ku; Arabiya-style hot-air roasting and direct-fire roasting; Mon–Fri 12:00–18:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 10:00–19:00, closed some Wednesdays. The Arabiya Story: the former master 高坂光明 turned from an elite officer to a life of coffee on 9 February 1951 (aged 25); in the heyday of strong coffee, often quarrelled with customers who called it 'thin'; the belief in only the real thing passed to the second generation, 明郎; South American beans such as Brazil and Colombia ground coarse and dripped through flannel filters made by hand from cloth found in Senba; aimed to be a professional baseball player but gave up for being a little short; skiing and golf; the wooden reliefs in the shop carved by hand and the slogans self-written; chose Namba because of a dance hall nearby; the founder's wife was a star of women's professional baseball around 1950–1955 and a department-store worker and player at Sogo Shinsaibashi; the second generation worked part-time in the shop from junior high school: 'Dad never told me to take over the shop, but I took it for granted that I would' (Meets Regional, January 2001 and April 1998 issues; CAFE BOOK, 2000). Contribution by 坂東三津五郎, the tenth (January 2001): learned of Arabiya's coffee and Arabiya sandwich from 中村富十郎; breakfast here every day during Osaka performances; early-morning baseball with the eldest son 明朗, the same age. 70th anniversary on 9 February 2021, aiming for 100; ARABIYA Coffee (limited company), representative director 高坂明郎. Menu (tax included): blend coffee ¥650, single origins ¥860–890, Elephant Mountain peaberry ¥1,050, iced coffee ¥720, Dutch coffee ¥840, Arabiya sandwich ¥1,010, toast ¥390, toast with jam or butter ¥420, fresh-jam toast ¥420, honey toast ¥770, French toast ¥910, pizza-style toast ¥1,010, pancakes ¥950, homemade pudding ¥880, homemade coffee jelly ¥880, boiled egg ¥170. Tabelog: Namba 1-6-7, Chuo-ku; 2 min on foot from Namba Station exit 14; reservations accepted; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 50 seats (counter 7, tables 43); non-smoking; opened 9 February 1951; Tabelog Kissaten 100 in 2021, 2022 and 2026. Reviews (December 2025–October 2026): blend and pudding ¥1,530, firm pudding, a fragrant blend, people waiting outside, many overseas customers, the owner's 'ookini', fresh-jam toast sold out some days, no breakfast menu, à la carte only.

公式サイト: イタリアンスイーツ Ruggeri、大阪市浪速区難波中2丁目8-9.en: Official site: Italian Sweets Ruggeri, Nambanaka 2-chome 8-93, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 11:00–19:00 (closing at 19:00 from 1 October 2026); closed Tuesday and Wednesday. Always 13–16 kinds of gelato; a Solo can be taken home; dry ice available; premium gelato costs ¥50 or more extra. Recipes balanced to taste better than the ingredient itself; fruit ripened and the recipe matched to its sugar level; about −13 °C gives authentic smoothness, so eat it in the shop first. Premium: シチリアピスタチオ (Sicilian pistachio from Bronte, the most popular), チョコラートビオンド (blond chocolate), マンドルラート (almond), ティラミスドルチェ (tiramisu), メープルゴルゴンゾーラ (maple and gorgonzola). Seasonal: ペスカマトゥーロ (peach), イタリアンモンブラン (Italian Mont Blanc), グアバランチャ (guava and orange), さくらもち (sakura mochi), クレマトルティメーラ (custard and apple). Milk-based: ミルクロッソ (milk), ニューヨークレアチーズ (New York rare cheese), ジャンドゥイア (gianduia). Sorbets: あまおう ソルベ (Amaou strawberry), アグルーメデコポン (dekopon citrus), イチジク ソルベ (fig), すもも ソルベ (plum), ポモリモーネ (tomato and lemon). ジェラノーラ ¥450 (yogurt gelato with granola, in the shop only); gift sets shipped; online shop; wholesale and joint development. Tabelog (English): Tabelog Ice cream/Gelato "Tabelog 100" 2023 and 2026; opened 1 July 2011; about 100 kinds a year; no reservations; takeout up to 2 hours; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 8 counter seats and 3 terrace seats; non-smoking; allergy information available; vegetarian options; children and strollers welcome. Reviews (October 2026): a showcase decorated three-dimensionally with seasonal fruit (Halloween); Solo (98 ml), Duo (140 ml), Medio (180 ml); cup or cone; Sicilian Pistachio Solo cone ¥450 plus ¥100 premium; Maple Walnut Solo ¥500; Italian Mont Blanc; pumpkin; sweet-potato-pie gelato with purple yam; guava and orange; Jewelry Viola; counter seats and a restroom at the back; one diner says other flavors appear about an hour after opening; prices reasonable.

公式サイト: イルソーレ・ロッソは2004年に心斎橋でオープン、20年以上ナポリ.en: Official site: Il Sole Rosso opened in Shinsaibashi in 2004 and has served the taste of Naples for over 20 years; authentic Neapolitan pizza by a pizza-association-certified chef; pizza flour brought from Italy; lunch from ¥1,100; a 6-seat counter facing the wood-fired oven. Company profile (Il Sole Co., Tenjinbashi 3-5-16, founded April 1994): founder 中西康之 (Tsuji culinary school graduate, training in Italy in 1990, founded the company in 1994, adviser after retiring in October 2022); second-generation president and head manager 谷健太郎 (opening staff of Il Sole Rosso, shop manager at 26 in 2009, training in Cetara in 2010, Kansai area leader of the Associazione Verace Pizza Napoletana and sommelier in 2013, president in 2022); history includes Rosso in April 2004 and TEN-3 (Tenjinbashi) in July 2012. Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): opened 27 April 2004; in April 2007 the 242nd member worldwide and first in Osaka of the Associazione Verace Pizza Napoletana; wood-fired oven made in Naples; Tue–Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–22:00; closed Monday (open on holidays, then closed Tuesday); 2–4 irregular days off a month; 54 seats; elevator; multilingual menu (English, Chinese, Korean); vegan and vegetarian options listed. Reviews (September–October 2026): Margherita, four-cheese with honey, octopus-in-tomato pasta, a regular of about 15 years, big portions, à la carte pasta a bit pricey, queues at weekends.

公式サイト: オステリア ガウダンテ、大阪・神戸の本格イタリアン、大阪駅前第4ビ.en: Official site: Osteria Gaudente, authentic Italian in Osaka and Kobe; Osaka Station Front Building No. 4 branch, Kobe Harborland branch, LUCUA Osaka branch; authentic Italian, enjoyed casually; the portions and taste of real Italy, with Italian wine; an osteria is an izakaya; not stiff like a ristorante, with friendly staff; open every day; the 46th wine dinner, 'Carnival', on 29 November; takeaway and Uber Eats delivery (Osaka Station Front Building No. 4 branch). Tabelog (shop member): Italian, pasta and European, 梅田1-11-4, B1F of Osaka Station Front Building No. 4, Kita-ku, Osaka; Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–22:30 (last order 21:30); Sundays and holidays 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); open all year; weekend and holiday lunch 90 minutes; reservations accepted; no charge; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 46 seats; opened 5 September 1998; Tabelog Italian WEST 100, 2021; weekday pasta lunch from ¥1,500; prix-fixe course ¥4,880; chef's omakase ¥5,500; anniversary course with a whole cake ¥7,000 (Ise lobster soup, Japanese beef fillet).
