Reviews (May–October 2026): Festa lunch ¥2,400; pasta lunch; Serbian lunch set (pita sa sirom and pita sa mesom ¥2,000 each, cevapi sandwich ¥2,300); fresh porcini linguine ¥4,000, +¥1,200 on the course; antipasti platter ¥1,800; mussels ¥1,800; roast live lobster ¥4,800; Prosecco ¥880; wine by the glass ¥770; clam tagliatelle; penne arrabbiata; grilled sea bream; full on Sundays; the staff's memory; help with birthday desserts.

公式サイト: オレ達のタコ部屋、営業時間18:00〜LAST、50種類以上のドリ.en: Official site: Ore Tachi no Tako Beya; open 18:00 until late; over 50 kinds of drinks; tequila; top picks No. 1 premium tacos, No. 2 Oretako taco rice, No. 3 quesadilla with plenty of mozzarella. Tabelog (shop member): Mexican, bar, izakaya; 5-8-8 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, 2nd floor; about 5 minutes on foot from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; Mon–Fri 18:00–05:00, Sat 18:00–03:00, Sun and holidays 18:00–01:00; November lunch Tue, Wed and Thu 11:30–14:00 (not on holidays, until sold out); closing days not fixed; reservations accepted; parties of three or fewer should ask before booking a table; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 16 seats; private rooms for 7–20 on the 3rd floor, whole hire for over 30 together with the 2nd floor; smoking allowed; English menu; menu with photos; opened 1 October 2011; moved from 1-9-7 Higashinakajima, Higashiyodogawa-ku; the owner is a Tequila Maestro; over 600 Mexican spirits; late-night tacos from October; two-hour all-you-can-drink party plans ¥5,000 and ¥6,000, after-party plan ¥4,500 (tax included). Reviews (August 2025 to October 2026): 2nd floor of a building just off Shin-Midosuji; founded 2011; the owner is a Tequila Maestro and Mezcalero; tortilla chips; mozzarella quesadilla; a taco set with a choice of yellow or blue tortillas; premium tacos on a fried tortilla; Mexican dog; taco rice; large portions; spice adjusted with hot sauce; full of office workers at lunch; table charge ¥500; the door at the back of the stairs is the restroom; a coffee and tequila cocktail; takeaway tacos.

公式サイト: ステーキハウス デボン、創業1970年、大阪・北新地、月〜金・祝前.en: Official site: Steakhouse Devon, founded 1970, Kitashinchi, Osaka; Mon–Fri and the day before a holiday 17:00–23:30 (last order 22:00); Sat 17:00–22:30 (last order 21:00); closed Sundays and holidays; 'a heart of gratitude' to guests; fine Kobe beef bought on long experience; simple teppanyaki; sofa seats around large teppan for up to seven; semi-private, partitioned; counter seats. Tabelog (shop member): steak, teppanyaki and yakiniku, 曽根崎新地1-5-10, 5F of 北新地地田ビル, Kita-ku, Osaka; 1 min on foot from Kitashinchi Station on the JR Tozai Line; 12:00–17:00 by reservation made the day before; bookings confirmed by a return call; eight or more by phone; 10% service, no cover; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 36 seats (4 booths, 8 at the counter); non-smoking (smoking room); a dedicated chef grills in front of you; Kyushu A5 special black-wagyu steak 100 g course ¥14,850; teppan feast with live Ezo abalone, Akashi octopus and black wagyu ¥18,150; year-end and New Year course ¥17,600 (four or more); beef fillet cutlet sandwich; dozens of wines. Reviews (September 2024 – April 2026): Devon course ¥17,930; chef's recommended course ¥22,000; roast beef; butter-grilled seafood; homemade tartar; oysters; Ise lobster; abalone; buttered potato; Aomori garlic; garlic rice; crab omelette fried rice; beef pilaf; curry; coffee and cookies; a cow greets you at the lift; dishes checked for a pregnant diner; one wished for more seasonal touches.

公式サイト: ステーキ＆ワイン オクソン、大阪ミナミの1974年創業のステーキ専.en: Official site: Steak & Wine OXON, a steak house founded in 1974 in Osaka Minami; an extensive wine list; seasonal starters, soups and vegetables; desserts with homemade sweets and digestifs in the salon downstairs; Art Nouveau antiques; A5 Kobe beef steak from black-haired heifers; counter up to 13, table up to 7, private room for 10–15; rare wines such as Romanée-Conti; siphon coffee; OXON concerts; its own balsamic vinegar; a rooftop garden; the menu from opening; a special dinner by invited executive chef of the Imperial Hotel, Vienna; a wine evening with a former president of the Japan Sommelier Association; contributions by 藤本義一 and 桐島洋子 in the menu; Nishi-Shinsaibashi 2-3-9, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 minutes from Osaka-Namba Station, 6 minutes from Namba Station; Mon–Sat and the day before holidays 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:30), 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Sundays and holidays (dinner every day in December); reservations by phone; cancellation 50% the day before, 100% on the day; cards accepted (UnionPay too); on 2F, the sister restaurant なにわ懐石しゃぶしゃぶ 久壷庵. Tabelog (shop-maintained): service charge 10%, 32 seats, smoking only in the private room, Steak 100 in 2021, courses ¥23,000–29,600. Reviews (February 2025–July 2026): sea-bream carpaccio, consommé or potage, salad, fillet or sirloin, garlic rice, a paper apron, cakes and siphon coffee in the basement salon, concerts in the basement, the female owner serving guests in person.

公式サイト: ハラールレストラン、ハラール和牛、ディナーコース、毎週木曜定休、心.en: Official site: halal restaurant, halal wagyu, dinner courses, closed every Thursday, Shinsaibashi Station exits 4 and 5. Tabelog: ALI'S KITCHEN, Tres Bldg B1F, 1-10-12 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-4708-5745; reservations accepted; Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 11:00–15:00 (lunch 11:00–14:30) and 17:00–22:00; closed Thursdays (for now); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 32 seats; no smoking; vegetarian and halal menus; Hyakumeiten (Curry WEST 2019 and 2020, Asian & Ethnic WEST 2022–2024). October 2026 reviews: chicken biryani ¥1,600; spicy curry ¥1,800 (bone-in meat); potato samosa ¥800; baingan aloo (aubergine and potato curry) ¥1,200; biryani set ¥1,000 (with drink, large portion); tandoori chicken ¥250 a piece; falafel set ¥2,000 (chickpea croquettes, hummus, Arab pickles, bread); the lunch chicken and vegetable curries are mild; naan; lassi; mixed kebab; hummus shawarma; palak paneer; many overseas diners; talk of halal certification.

公式サイト: ビストロ・ダ・アンジュ、A little Paris in Osa.en: Official site: Bistro d'Ange, A little Paris in Osaka, since 1972; a little Paris in Osaka where you can unwind; French cooking with seasonal ingredients and wine that comes from the producers; born in Osaka's Minami in 1972; its motto since opening has been to let guests enjoy good things at reasonable prices, like a restaurant in the backstreets of Paris; unpretentious and properly good, a neighbourhood bistro that never changes; 32 seats; Shinsaibashi Hayakawa Bldg B1F, Shinsaibashi-suji 2-6-18, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min from Shinsaibashi Station exit 4-B; lunch 11:30–16:00 (L.O. 14:30), dinner 17:30–22:30 (L.O. 21:30, last entry 21:15); closed Monday (open on holidays, then closed the following Tuesday); cash and credit cards; in October 2026 a special fair for the visit of chef Patrick Terrian (8–18 October, with changed hours). 株式会社かめいあんじゅ (anjou.co.jp): patisseries, a boulangerie, a crêperie, the tea salon アルション and more. Tabelog (shop member): a bistro founded in 1972; wines imported directly from Europe and chosen by the sommelier; vegetables straight from farms; Ange Course ¥5,500; weekday Ange Lunch ¥1,980; Bistro Lunch ¥2,500 on weekdays, ¥2,680 on weekends and holidays; 32 seats; non-smoking; children welcome; Tabelog Bistro 100 in 2021. Reviews (February 2025–October 2026): always full, so book; à la carte portions are for two; braised pork shoulder; purple sweet potato Mont Blanc; free bread refills; no separate bills; one day dessert took 70 minutes to arrive.

公式サイト: マレーシア ボレ、大阪唯一のマレーシア料理店、スカイビルとうめきた.en: Official site: Malaysia Boleh, Osaka's only Malaysian restaurant, near the Sky Building and Umekita; based on Nyonya cooking, a fusion of Chinese and Malay food, with plenty of halal dishes; seasonings bought in Malaysia every year; halal-marked seasonings and ingredients used; satay, water spinach stir-fried with belacan, spicy thick noodles with shrimp; Penang course ¥4,200 (prawn crackers, tofu and egg roll salad, satay, tom yum goong, water spinach, chicken curry and rice, spicy seafood thick noodles, dessert of the day; from 2 people, booked in advance; ask about allergies); 大淀南 1-4-20, Kita-ku, Osaka; 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00), 17:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Tuesdays; cards, transit IC cards, PayPay, d Barai and au PAY accepted; notice of a price revision from 1 December. Tabelog (shop-maintained): Malacca course ¥4,700, Makan course with all-you-can-drink ¥5,000; 26 seats; non-smoking; children welcome; 2-hour limit when busy; halal and vegetarian options.

公式サイト: ラーメン家 みつ葉、奈良県奈良市富雄元町、泡系、豚骨塩ラーメン、醤.en: Official site: Ramenya Mitsuba; 富雄元町, Nara; foam style; tonkotsu shio ramen; shoyu ramen; paitan soup; founded in Tomio, Nara, in 2011; みつ葉 the second at Horyuji in 2017; みつ葉 あべの出張所 in Abeno Hoop in 2019; かどま出張所 at LaLaport Kadoma and ミ・ナーラ出張所 in 2023. Abeno branch: Abenosuji 1-chome 2-30, B1 Hoop; 11:00–23:00; irregular closures. Points of pride: domestic bones boiled about 8 hours on a high flame, stirred every 3–5 minutes to draw out the umami of chicken and pork; house-made noodles of 100% domestic wheat (high-hydration noodles at 48%, chewy); shoyu tare of four blended soy sauces; shio tare of six salts with dried scallop and kombu; chashu seared at high heat outside and slow-cooked in the oven inside, hand-cut daily; domestic 奴ネギ green onions; tanzaku menma desalted over a week; ajitama of 京たまご eggs. Awards: 2013 rookie grand prix of the magazine 'The Ultimate Ramen'; 2nd nationwide in the ramen category of the 2015 Tabelog Ramen Award; 15th nationwide in 2016. Menu (main shop): 豚CHIKI shio ramen and shoyu ramen ¥1,100, chashu-men ¥1,300. Tabelog: Ramenya Mitsuba Abeno shucchousho, Abeno Hoop B1F, daily 11:00–23:00, 400 seats (food court), opened 13 September 2019. Reviews (May 2024–October 2026): foam soup (espuma, like a bisque); rich and creamy; chicken and pork; the shio has a sharp saltiness and black pepper; medium-thick noodles; chewy; rare chashu; long menma; ajitama; shio ramen ¥1,100, large ¥1,250, special ¥1,500; large chashu ramen ¥1,650; rice ¥290; limited tsukemen; the ticket machine now a touch panel; cashless accepted; a line of about six (September 2026); views that it is monotonous and the chashu underwhelming.

公式サイト: ワインとチーズと旨い肴のBAR à VIN 徳蔵 とくぞう 心斎橋.en: Official site: Wine, cheese and tasty nibbles BAR à VIN 徳蔵 (Tokuzo) Shinsaibashi; a long-established restaurant founded in 1983 and run by a wine importer; over 40 wines by the glass and over 100 labels at all times; bottles from the wine shop next door can be brought in for ¥2,000 corkage (about 2,000 wines); unfiltered, unheated "nama" wine bottled at the company's own plant in Yamanashi; a bright, casual first floor decorated with fresh flowers; a chic second floor for fine wine and courses (TOKUZO FIFTYS); a chef who trained at many restaurants; the special beef stew with 40 years of tradition (red wine used freely because the shop is run by a wine trading company); directly imported cheese; November seasonal dishes (lamb and mussels stewed in tomato, kombu-cured sea bream and pear carpaccio, red snow crab and shungiku quiche, eel and beef spring rolls, oyster and bacon cutlet, cod milt ajillo, miso-marinated Spanish mackerel); ham cutlet with blue cheese; escargots; Norwegian salmon marinade; same-day cancellations may be charged in full. Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): opened 3 October 1983; Mon–Thu 12:00–22:00, Fri, Sat and eve of holidays 12:00–23:00, Sun and holidays 12:00–21:00; 47 seats; 2-hour limit; predecessor the izakaya-style "Wainya"; the ham cutlet ordered by over 80%. Reviews (February–October 2026): the beef stew tastes the same despite name changes; cheese quality; range of wines by the glass; the blue cheese is strong; the liver pâté was dry; hard chairs; a smell in the room; ordering by barcode; all-you-can-drink.

公式サイト: ワインと炭火焼 カーサ エム、18:00〜24:00 (L.O..en: Official site: Wine and charcoal grill Casa M; 18:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00); closing days not fixed; a wine bar from 21:00; 19 seats; over 100 wines, 13 by the glass; 2 min on foot from Kitashinchi Station exit 11-21; follow the arrows down the alley to the 4th floor of 薬師堂ビル.

公式サイト: 中菜バル食堂 杏月、大阪市中央区南船場2-8-2 1階、長堀橋駅2.en: Official site: Chusai Baru Shokudo Azuki, Minamisenba 2-8-2 1F, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 6 min walk from Nagahoribashi Stn exit 2B; 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–22:30 (food last order 21:30, drinks 22:00); closed Sunday and public holidays; lavish Chinese food at reasonable prices: spicy mapo tofu, special yurinchi, Taiwanese sausage stir-fried with salt and Chinese vegetables, shio-koji pork with black-vinegar sauce, braised pork fried rice, sesame balls, custard peach buns; the Azuki course with two kinds of xiaolongbao, mapo tofu, a half chicken fried and served with cumin salt, and golden fried rice with shrimp; all-you-can-drink with over 30 drinks including draft beer; private hire for up to 20; daily lunch, shrimp and green-onion tenshindon lunch, dan dan noodle lunch with rice and a side dish; the recommended lunch is yurinchi with plenty of green onion. Tabelog: Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–21:30, Sat 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–21:00; closed the 1st and 3rd Saturdays; 14 seats (seven tables for two); non-smoking; wheelchair access; children welcome; take-out and delivery; English and Chinese menus; opened 7 January 2025. Reviews (January 2025–September 2026): lunch ¥1,000 at opening, ¥900–980 from February 2025; dan dan noodles, seafood champon lunch ¥1,200, daily special ¥1,000, mapo curry; queues at lunch; warm service from a married couple; a well-known woman on the floor; Shanghai yakisoba, xiaolongbao, grilled gyoza, black-vinegar sweet and sour pork, potato salad with apple, drunken shrimp; course with all-you-can-drink ¥5,000; all-you-can-drink ¥1,800; open every other Saturday.

公式サイト: 中華酒場 黒門-轍-（わだち）、日本橋1-18-4 南地ビルB1階.en: Official site: Chinese tavern Kuromon Wadachi, Nipponbashi 1-18-4, 南地ビル B1; seafood-rich Cantonese cooking by an owner who trained for many years under a former embassy head chef; domestic vegetables; fish bought directly at Kuromon Market, sometimes live fish; the name-dish shumai of domestic pork belly, Thai vannamei shrimp and Awaji onion, wrapped by hand and steamed, with a house dipping sauce of a Japanese-style base and yuzu pepper; courses with all-you-can-drink; banquets for 25–35; 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:45) and 17:30–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); closed Monday (the next weekday if a holiday); scholarship-repayment support for staff from April 2024. Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): 38 seats (6 counter, 20 table, 12 tatami); private rooms; smoking allowed; delivery and takeout; about 14 lunches from ¥670; free rice refills; shumai, three from ¥230 (¥290 on the December 2024 menu); Chinese ingredients from Kobe; seafood from Toyosu and Kuromon. Reviews (2023–October 2026): the shumai is the favourite; a diner who comes monthly; lunch draws a line but can be booked on Tabelog; famous set ¥1,300, shumai set ¥1,180, daily set ¥1,100; half-size plates at night; a complimentary tsukune.

公式サイト: 串揚げ 名倉、北新地の一角、和食の道で20余年の研鑽を積んだ店主の.en: Official site: Kushiage Nagura, in a corner of Kitashinchi; skewers by an owner with over 20 years of training in Japanese cuisine; the flavours of the season; for birthdays, business entertaining, dinners and anniversaries; an emphasis on seasonal produce chosen at the market in person; a thin coat made by separating the flour, egg and breadcrumb steps; reading the sound, colour and bubbles of the oil; frying adjusted to each ingredient; standard course ¥12,100; recommended course with abalone, shark fin and caviar ¥15,400; special course with truffle ¥18,700; about 20 kinds of skewer; sauce, salt, lemon and tentsuyu with plenty of coarse-grated daikon; rice dishes to finish are not included in the courses. Tabelog (shop member): 堂島メリーセンタービル 4F, 1-3-16 堂島; 5 min on foot from Kitashinchi Station and the Yotsubashi Line; Mon–Sat, holidays and the day before and after a holiday 17:30–23:00; closed Sundays; reservations accepted; no service charge; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; non-smoking; English menu; BYO allowed; children from elementary school age; opened 7 August 2020; ultra-fine crumbs from French bread dough and rice oil; Yoshida Farm caciocavallo; homemade curry bread; techniques learned at Kahala. Reviews (January–September 2026): potato, mascarpone and caviar; sweet shrimp; okra; horse mackerel; Amanoyuki pork; cheese wrapped in nori; abalone with liver sauce and wasabi; corn skewered kernel by kernel; eel rolls; beef and paprika; dried abalone; two kinds of pepper; sweet-potato curry bread; sukiyaki truffle skewer; shoyu ramen of Daisen chicken broth; sea urchin jelly; cabbage with onion dressing; no heaviness the next day; a friendly head chef; a regular of 18 visits.

公式サイト: 串焼き たなかや、JR東淀川駅・大阪メトロ東三国駅近くのカウンター.en: Official site: Kushiyaki Tanakaya, a 12-seat counter izakaya near JR Higashi-Yodogawa and Higashi-Mikuni stations; the owner's care that both taste and comfort matter; ingredients chosen first, then care over the cut, the skewering and the grilling; fair prices; solo drinkers welcome; please phone before coming; 2-4-8 Miyahara, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; Tue–Sat 18:00–01:00 (last order 0:00), Sun and holidays 18:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Monday and the third Sunday. Tabelog (shop member): cover charge ¥500 (before tax); cards, e-money and QR accepted; 12 counter seats; whole hire up to 20; smoking allowed; opened 30 November 2009. Reviews (2023 to August 2026): big seseri skewers; negima made with neck meat; tsukune; thigh; special outside skirt; beef harami; wagyu liver; jidori tataki; chicken sashimi; raw senmai; scallop; shrimp mayo; heart; gizzard; grilled corn; daily obanzai; akaten; cabbage with baby sardines; thick fried tofu; garlic toast; a friendly owner and an attentive woman on the floor; booking recommended.

公式サイト: 丸太町十二段家、中京区常真横町184-3 (丸太町通両替町西入)、.en: Official site: Marutamachi Junidan Ya; 中京区常真横町184-3 (Marutamachi-dori west of Ryogaemachi); an ochazuke house running since the Taisho era; originally a sweets shop in Gion, named after the twelve acts of the kabuki Chushingura; began with ochazuke served to settle the palates of tipsy guests; the original ochazuke; Suzushiro (dashimaki, red-miso soup, rice, assorted seasonal pickles); dashimaki made with a first dashi of Makurazaki katsuobushi and Rishiri kombu; dashi started every morning at 4:00; vegetables from contract and local farms; Ippodo hojicha; beef shabu-shabu and wagyu steak; lunch 11:30–14:00; dinner 17:00–19:00; closed Wednesday; no reservations; closed temporarily on 6 November 2026; bookings reopened for the upstairs shabu-shabu rooms (September 2026). Tabelog: 22 seats; cards and e-money accepted; non-smoking; children welcome; only the first floor open, with a limited menu. Reviews (2026, in English): Suzushiro ¥1,500; fluffy dashimaki; service in Kyoto dialect; English-speaking staff; queues in autumn.

公式サイト: 京フレンチ 先斗町きしもと、中京区先斗町三条下ル若松町141番地、.en: Official site: Kyo French Pontocho Kishimoto; 中京区先斗町三条下ル若松町141番地; lunch 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:30); dinner 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed Tuesday; reservations by phone only; cards: VISA only; no cards at lunch; tables limited to two hours; Kamo River yuka 1 May–30 September (also at lunch in May and September); outside the yuka season a terrace for two a day (10% extra). More than twenty years devoted to French cooking; soy sauce as a hidden seasoning; wasabi with the steak; black shichimi with the duck; chopsticks provided. Dinner courses ¥6,600–16,500; lunch ¥4,400–11,000; yuka courses ¥7,260–18,150; amadai meunière or beef fillet. Tabelog: 16 seats (10 at the counter, 6 at tables; 16 on the yuka in summer); non-smoking. Reviews (2022–2026, in English): French on the yuka; eaten with chopsticks; tender fillet; three desserts.

公式サイト: 京天神 野口、京の四季に寄り添う味、移ろう季節と向き合い、その日そ.en: Official site: Kyotenjin Noguchi; 'flavours that follow Kyoto's four seasons'; facing the changing seasons, treasuring what is in season that day and that moment, putting heart into every dish; cooking rooted in the culture and climate of Kyoto; owner Daisuke Noguchi. Restaurants: Kyotenjin Noguchi, のぐち継, Noguchi Grand Green Osaka. Tabelog (shop member): Noguchi Grand Green Osaka, Japanese cuisine, 大深町5-54, 1F of the Grand Green Osaka South Building, Kita-ku, Osaka; 3 min on foot from the west exit of JR Osaka Station; daily 17:30–23:00; closing days not fixed; omakase course ¥38,000 (tax included); drinks and extra dishes paid on the day; cancellation fees (30% 7 to 4 days before, 50% 3 to 2 days before, 100% the day before or on the day); allergies or disliked foods affecting two or more dishes of the course are treated as a cancellation; broad dietary restrictions such as vegetarian cannot be accommodated; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 18 seats (12 at the counter, 6 at tables); private rooms for 4 and 6 (¥5,000 when used by two); non-smoking; please avoid perfume and other strong scents; children from primary-school age; kids' menu; opened 21 March 2025; The Tabelog Award 2026 Bronze; a new shop of Kyoto's Kyotenjin Noguchi, booked up to a year ahead; the head chef trained at the main restaurant. Reviews (July–October 2026): the main restaurant near Kitano Tenmangu; referral only; large portions; run by three people; the head chef of the main restaurant comes on Thursdays and Fridays; start times chosen every 30 minutes; abalone, hamo, ayu, matsutake, soft-shell turtle, sea-bream rice; about eight finishing dishes to choose from (karasumi soba, sudachi soba, Kitakata ramen, meat sauce, cold dandan noodles, ikura rice, jako rice, tekka-don, ochazuke); small, regular or large; Grand Green is easy to get lost in.

公式サイト: 京寿司の老舗 祇園石段下 いづ重、東山区祇園町北側292-1、八坂.en: Official site: Izuju, long-established Kyoto sushi house below the Gion Ishidan steps; 東山区祇園町北側292-1; at the northwest corner of the crossing below the Yasaka Shrine steps; methods almost unchanged since the Meiji founding; more than a hundred years from the first owner, 重吉; saba-zushi orders suspended (no good mackerel being caught); reopened on 5 September (the longest closure since the forced evacuations of 1945); closed Wednesday and Thursday; jo-hako-zushi ¥2,160; maki ¥1,200; inari ¥950 (hemp seeds, yuzu, burdock); adult inari with grilled Kujo green onion (October–March); guji sugata-zushi ¥5,160; kodai sasamaki ¥1,620; aji sushi ¥1,500; Kyoto chirashi ¥1,560; hamo chirashi ¥1,800; awafu roll ¥600 (a shojin cooking method; shojin sushi boxes also made to order); seaweed roll ¥900 (all before tax); takeaway also at Kyoto Station, Takashimaya Kyoto and Osaka, and Abeno Harukas. Tabelog: 10:30–17:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday; closes when sold out; no reservations; cards accepted; 20 seats; non-smoking; English menu; mackerel dishes suspended for a poor catch (as of end of April 2026). Reviews (2026, in English): aji sushi ¥2,200; three inari ¥990; sasamaki; hamo chirashi; jo-hako-zushi.

公式サイト: 京都・北白川の夫婦で営む隠れ家的な割烹、2009年開店、京都の名店.en: Official site: a hideaway kappo in Kitashirakawa, Kyoto, run by a married couple; opened 2009; the owner honed skills at famous Kyoto restaurants; the okami's attentive care; Setouchi seafood and vegetables from Ohara; local sake and Italian and French wines; pairings; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 18:30–23:30 (last order 20:30); closed Wednesday; nearest station Mototanaka; no parking; cards accepted (JCB, AMEX, Diners); book through the official site. Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; 左京区北白川久保田町26; 3 min on foot from the Ginkakuji-michi bus stop; 10 seats (6 at the counter, 4 at a table); lunch by reservation only. Reviews (May 2022–February 2026, in English): the owner is said to have trained at Kikunoi; the okami is a sake sommelier; omakase about ¥14,000; more lavish in February and September; hamo, densuke anago, guji soup, hassun, saba sushi; leftover rice made into onigiri; called a Michelin one-star restaurant (September 2025).

公式サイト: 京都八百一本館、中京区三文字町220、3階のレストラン セイボリー.en: Official site: Kyoto Yaoichi Honkan, 中京区三文字町220; the third-floor restaurant SAVORY; lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order); tea time 14:00–16:30 (L.O. 16:00); dinner 17:30–21:00 (food L.O. 20:00, drinks L.O. 20:30); closed Wednesday (open on holidays, closed the following Thursday); the Rokkaku Farm on the roof; venison steak recommended in autumn and winter; limited-time Shine Muscat pavlova; BYO bottle wine notice; operated by Central Fruit Co., Ltd. (Kyoto Yaoichi). Tabelog: 東洞院通三条下る三文字町220 八百一本館3F; 375 m from Karasuma-Oike Station; reservations by phone or in person only; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); 60 seats; private room (10–20 people); non-smoking; English menu; vegetarian options; opened 24 April 2013. Reviews (2026, in English): vegetables from the rooftop farm; vegetable parfait; Omi beef; ayu confit; fish wrapped in magnolia leaf; peach parfait.

公式サイト: 京都小川生薬、中京区油小路通押小路上る二条油小路町272、2F レ.en: Official site: Kyoto Ogawa Shoyaku; 中京区油小路通押小路上る二条油小路町272; 2F restaurant; 20 seats centred on a counter (12 m long); semi-private rooms; reservations only; a course-style breakfast drawing on nature's gifts; weekdays 8:00–13:30; weekends and holidays 7:30–15:00; 1F café (health teas and sweets); 3F lodging for one group a day. Tabelog: 90-minute sessions; all start together; cards accepted; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome; English menu; opened 6 April 2024. Reviews (2026, in English): seasonal course ¥5,500; mulberry-leaf tea; barley-granola yogurt; yudofu; Agu pork or domestic duck shabu-shabu; 1996 pu-erh; Kyoto small dishes; karasumi Handa somen; kuromoji gelato; soup curry with 100 herbal ingredients.

公式サイト: 六覺燈 黒門本店、串揚げ専門店、黒門市場のアーケードの中、1980.en: Official site: 六覺燈 Kuromon main shop, a kushiage specialist inside the Kuromon Market arcade, founded 1980; seasonal ingredients sent direct from producers around Japan; no menu, everything is an omakase course; tell the staff any ingredients you dislike; omakase course of 20 creative skewers starting with live-killed kuruma prawn, a vegetable platter, homemade bread, homemade dessert and coffee ¥10,800 (tax included); 17:00–22:00; closed over New Year and on Wednesdays; 60 seats; all non-smoking; cards accepted; handmade bread and desserts; wines bought by visiting the great wine regions in person. About 六覺燈: from a master's words, 'value the six senses' (sight, hearing, smell, taste, touch and the cook's sense); never forget the first resolve, never let the light go out; 'stick to the obvious'; kushikatsu goes with any drink. Company outline: 株式会社 六覺燈, representative director 水野幾郎; founded November 1980 in Konohana-ku, Osaka; moved into Kuromon Market June 1995; incorporated September 1998; Ginza shop opened October 2004; A-MARKeT (wine import and sales, representative director 水野冨貴子). News: lunch ended December 2022; 六覺燈 Cafe opened April 2024; a new brand, 燈のひとさじ, October 2026; winter break 31 December 2025–7 January 2026. Tabelog (shop-maintained): Nipponbashi 1-21-16, たこそうビル 2F; 3 min on foot from Nipponbashi Station; L.O. 21:30; a 90-minute course from 20:30; 10% service charge; marked 'vegetarian options'; children pay only for what is eaten. Reviews (August–October 2026): kuruma prawn, beef fillet, scallop, edamame croquette, tonburi with minced chicken, myoga with pork fillet, anago with makomo, hamo, ginkgo nuts, duck, shiitake, salmon, kisu with mitsuba, lotus root, cheese; vegetables as much as you like; rice-flour bread and bagels with cheese cream; a choice of three desserts; pudding; skewers keep coming until you say stop; salt or sauce suggested for each skewer; each guest has a sauce pot; wine pairing; shops in Ginza and in the Daimaru Shinsaibashi food hall too; a light batter.

公式サイト: 北新地 うえはら、北新地駅から徒歩3分、大将が目利きする旬魚のしゃ.en: Official site: Kitashinchi Uehara, 3 min on foot from Kitashinchi Station; shabu-shabu of seasonal fish chosen by the head chef and whale harihari-nabe of rare cuts; delicate small dishes; antique ware such as Ko-Imari, Kutani and Oribe; 'shabu-suki nabe' of seasonal fish the head chef picks at the market each morning; a dashi of freshly shaved bonito and kombu with grilled kinmedai bones; whale harihari-nabe sent direct from a whaling master in 太地町, Wakayama; about ten sakes including unlisted ones the owner recommends; a craft beer made with sake koji; a ten-dish course of select ingredients ¥16,500 (service extra); à la carte after 20:00; sashimi and straw-grilled dishes; message plates for celebrations; a white-wood counter; a fully private room for 3–10. Tabelog (shop member): Kitashinchi Uehara, seafood, shabu-shabu and Japanese cuisine, CriceNikko薬師堂ビル 1F, 1-3-20 堂島, Kita-ku, Osaka; Mon 17:30–24:00; Tue–Fri 11:30–13:30 and 17:30–24:00; Sat 17:30–21:00; closed Sundays and holidays; service charge 10%; cards and PayPay accepted; 20 seats (counter of 10, a sunken-floor private room); non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; English menu and English-speaking staff; harihari-nabe ¥7,480; whale course of seven dishes ¥16,500; autumn hamo shabu-shabu course ¥13,200; hamo, matsutake and Miyazaki beef course ¥16,500; special course ¥19,800. Invoice registration: 日本環境コンサルティング株式会社 (same address as the shop). Reviews (April–July 2026): weekday lunch ¥1,500 (seafood bowl, meat dashimaki, nyumen, small dish, pickles, homemade ice cream); yokowa, sea bream, hiramasa, amberjack, negitoro, boiled shirasu; the owner alone at lunch; ice creams such as matcha, hojicha, black sesame and coconut; hamo course; whale sashimi; hamo and pork shabu-shabu; noodles to finish.

公式サイト: 北新地 ステーキ ロン、太田牧場産 神戸牛専門の鉄板焼き、北新地駅.en: Official site: Kitashinchi Steak Ron, teppanyaki specialising in Kobe beef from Ota Farm; about 1 min on foot from Kitashinchi Station; founded 60 years ago in Kitashinchi; exterior and interior renewed in 2020; an L-shaped counter of 10 and a private room for up to 7; Baccarat lamps and glasses; every seat faces the teppan; temperature and doneness adjusted to your eating pace; appetizers such as Kobe sirloin sashimi and charcoal-grilled Kobe hiuchi; licensed to sell raw meat; the signature since the founding, golden-grilled wild shrimp. Steak Ron since-1964 special dinner course from ¥13,200 (changes with the cut and weight): Kobe sirloin or fillet 100 g ¥19,800, 120 g ¥22,000, 150 g ¥24,750; Kobe chateaubriand 100 g ¥24,200 to 150 g ¥29,700; special black-wagyu fillet 100 g ¥13,200 to 150 g ¥16,500; special black-wagyu chateaubriand 100 g ¥15,950 to 150 g ¥19,800; grilled seasonal vegetables; onion salad with sesame; a rice dish to finish (Kobe-beef shigure-ni with red-yolk egg over rice, spicy curry, fried rice with beef tendon, garlic rice); red miso soup; pickles; a special plated dessert; coffee, tea or herbal tea. Courses 'Snow' ¥19,800 (120 g) and '月' ¥22,000 (150 g). Specially grown Koshihikari rice from Tottori Prefecture. Tax included, plus 10% service. Monthly notices of closing days and lunch days. Tabelog (shop member): steak, hamburg and teppanyaki, 曽根崎新地1-10-2, 1F of Kitashinchi Place, Kita-ku, Osaka; Mon–Wed 17:00–22:00 (last order 20:30); Thu–Sat 11:30–14:30 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–22:00; closed Sundays and holidays; lunch only on set days; phone 12:00–17:30 or 20:00–21:00; parties of five or more by phone only; 10% service charge (dinner); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 17 seats; non-smoking; BYO allowed; Snow course ¥19,800; lunch C course ¥13,200; Christmas course ¥26,400. Reviews (December 2025 – October 2026): oxtail and shark-fin double consommé; sirloin sashimi with yama wasabi; tartare monaka; roast beef; wild shrimp; Kesennuma shark-fin steak; lily-bulb rice; vichyssoise; corn rice; the golden grill in an egg sauce that tastes like sukiyaki; some find the room dark; foreign guests and staff.

公式サイト: 北新地はらみ 法善寺店、道頓堀1-7-8 仲谷ビル1F、国産高級黒.en: Official site: Kitashinchi Harami Hozenji shop, Dotonbori 1-7-8, 仲谷ビル 1F; a harami-specialist shop serving only selected cuts of top domestic black wagyu; healthy and delicious; "dishes that women also find easy to eat"; plenty of wine; interiors and exteriors by a popular shop designer; tableware made for the house by the fifth-generation potter of やすお陶房 (Shigaraki ware); a wooden shop tucked away inside Hozenji Yokocho; ranked 3rd in Japan in the fine-dining category of TripAdvisor's Best of the Best 2026 (notice of 6 October 2026). Group site (harami.jp): shops are the Kitashinchi Harami main shop, the Kitashinchi annex, the Hozenji shop and the Shin-Omiya shop (Nara, opened 12 May 2020); the signature harami steak is grilled by staff in front of the guest. Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): opened 21 September 2018; daily 12:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); irregular closing days (announced on Instagram); courses limited to 2 hours; 10% service charge; 24 seats; non-smoking; produced by Ryuka Hattori (ex-Ponte Vecchio); Japan's first harami specialist; only 2–3 kg of harami per cow; the manager visits farms and picks the red meat every week; courses ¥9,900, ¥13,200 and ¥16,500. Reviews (March–August 2026): Hozenji course ¥13,200; harami steak flambéed with brandy and eaten with egg yolk, truffle, red-wine salt and more; thick-cut tongue; meat sushi; the staff grill for you; all the other guests were foreigners (June); opinions vary but satisfied.

公式サイト: 千とせべっかん、大阪の老舗「千とせ」がなんばグランド花月1階に、1.en: Official site: Chitose Bekkan, the long-established Osaka shop Chitose on the 1st floor of Namba Grand Kagetsu; 11:00–19:30 L.O., closing 20:00; closes when the dashi sells out; open every day; the Chitose noren has passed from parent to child, and the third generation 森井一光 is now the owner; fifty years in Namba Sennichimae, first a shop known for good meat udon and loved by 吉本興業 comedians; niku-sui began when the Yoshimoto Shinkigeki actor 花紀京, hungover, ordered 'meat udon, without the udon' and the previous owner obliged; the branch Chitose Bekkan opened in April 2012, where the fourth generation 森井勇貴 keeps the taste of the niku-sui; a dashi blended from katsuo and urume; slightly sweet beef, a soft-boiled egg, green onion, with tofu if you like; 'kodama', small rice with a raw egg and a dedicated soy sauce; niku-sui ¥1,180, niku-sui with tofu ¥1,280, meat udon ¥1,180, half-noodle meat udon ¥1,380, kodama ¥400, kasu udon ¥1,280, meat-and-kasu udon ¥1,580, curry udon ¥1,480, kasu curry udon ¥1,880, kitsune udon ¥1,100, tsukimi udon ¥900, draft beer ¥600. Tabelog (shop-maintained): prices revised 15 May 2026, no reservations, no cards, e-money or QR, 28 seats, non-smoking, opened 8 April 2012. Reviews (September–October 2026): a ticket machine, queues of 10–20 people and 15–30 minutes, a little pricier than the main shop, the curry udon only at the bekkan, pour the niku-sui over the kodama.

公式サイト: 占いダイニングバー 小川のおかん、2016年11月23日に大阪心斎.en: Official site: Ogawa no Okan, fortune-telling dining bar, opened 23 November 2016 in Amerikamura, Shinsaibashi, Osaka; every member of staff is a fortune-teller and readings are free (four pillars of destiny, ISD personality psychology, biorhythms, tarot, palm reading); readings for more than 10,000 people a year; all-homemade menu (the fries are frozen); house curry udon 1,320 yen; special mapo tofu made by Okan's son 1,320 yen; handmade mentaiko cream pasta 1,265 yen; big dashimaki omelette 1,320 yen; stewed hamburg 1,100 yen; takoyaki cooked to order (10) 880 yen; milk shaved ice 913–968 yen; cocktails to raise your luck. Okan's story: first a bank employee; quit soon after a row with a boss; ran a company and school for MCs and narration; handed the company to a friend and became a fortune-teller; 25 years of fortune-telling (as of 2023); learned dashimaki from a teacher from the cooking days; the son turned the mapo tofu learned while training at a Chinese restaurant into a recipe. Group companies: Vocal Space B and 日本音楽株式会社; a mapo-tofu lunch shop opened in September 2024 sharing Ogawa no Okan's space. Tabelog (shop-maintained): Bamboo Alley 1F, 1-9-20 Nishi-Shinsaibashi; daily 18:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); irregular closing days; table charge 2,200 yen (tax included); cards and PayPay accepted; 20 seats (12 counter, 8 table); whole-shop hire for up to 20; non-smoking. Reviews (October 2024–September 2026): a personality-analysis sheet drawn from your birth date and animal fortune-telling; tarot and palm reading; a homey, snack-bar-like feel; full soon after 6:30 pm on a weekday; some found the readings accurate and some did not; the food is good too.

公式サイト: 古民家ビストロ 燕食堂、市谷本村町2-33、市ヶ谷駅から徒歩5分、.en: Official website: old-house bistro Tsubame Shokudo, Ichigaya Honmura-chō 2-33; 5 min walk from Ichigaya Station, 8 min from Yotsuya Station; the last house at the end of an alley; lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30), dinner 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed Saturday, Sunday and holidays; organic and low-pesticide vegetables direct from farms (NAO FARM in 江津市, Shimane); Kirishima pork, Aomori duck, Hokkaido Ezo venison; all meat prepared in the shop from first preparation to finish; house-made natural-yeast bread; all Japanese wines by the glass; Galo cheese from 山田農場 in 亀田郡, Hokkaido; lunch is main + salad + 2 side dishes + lightly milled brown rice + soup ¥1,200; farm-direct ¥2,500 lunch (reservation required); a house renovated from a writer's bookshop. Tabelog: Italian, bistro, wine bar; 62 seats (30 on the 1st floor, 32 on the 2nd); private rooms; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; appetizer charge ¥330; opened 6 October 2009. Reviews (2026): full of office workers at weekday lunch; a vegetable-only plate; some say dinner is small-portioned and on the pricey side.

公式サイト: 吟味屋、黒毛和牛一頭買いにこだわる、焼肉・内装・食器にこだわる、高.en: Official site: Ginmiya; particular about buying black wagyu as whole cattle, about yakiniku, the interior and the tableware; a calm Japanese atmosphere recalling high-end ryotei and kappo; the finest black wagyu chosen from around Japan, grilled over charcoal; banquets too; kimchi taught by a Korean chef, chijimi, ika-fe, changja, cold noodles of Ginmiya's own noodles, Korean dishes; reservations by phone to each shop. Shops: Tenma, Nishiku Shinmachi (Shinmachi 1-18-3), Shin-Osaka, Kitahama, Baltica 03 (opened at the end of July 2024). Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): Ginmiya Nishiku shimmachi ten; yakiniku, steak, Korean; 5 min on foot from Nishi-Ohashi and Yotsubashi Station exit 2; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 17:00–23:15 (L.O. 22:45); closed Wednesday and the third Thursday (the Tenma main shop, Shin-Osaka and Baltica 03 stay open); reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR (Alipay, WeChat Pay and others) accepted; 40 seats; private rooms (2–20); non-smoking throughout; Kobe, Omi and Yamagata beef. Reviews (November 2025–October 2026): sukiyaki dipped in egg; rare thigh steak with a peppery egg-yolk sauce; negi-shio tongue; thick-cut tongue (may run out without a booking); Nakaochi kalbi; outside skirt; hanging tender; salted tongue; fillet; Chateaubriand; meat marinated in a jar; sausage; toro sushi; seafood chijimi; Ginmiya salad; abalone porridge; garlic rice; green tea or pineapple juice at the end; celebrity signatures at the entrance; one view that bookings are only taken on the day around opening; a Saturday wait; about ¥10,000 a head in one view; a diner who has also been to the Kitahama shop.

公式サイト: 味乃家 本店、1965年創業、食いだおれ大阪・難波で50年以上続く.en: Official site: Ajinoya main shop, founded 1965, a long-established okonomiyaki house that has carried on for over 50 years in Namba, Osaka, the city of eating till you drop; in front of the stage door opposite the 松竹座; 現代こいさんビル 2F, Namba 1-7-16, Chuo-ku, Osaka; shop manager 空山 嘉津子; 10 counter seats, 10 tables, up to 45 people; Tue–Sun and holidays 11:00–22:00 (fully closed at 22:00); closed Monday and New Year's Day, and sometimes the last Monday and Tuesday; no same-day reservations; no reservations by phone or email; TableCheck FastPass (1 to 4 people per purchase, valid until 15 minutes after the set time, 90 minutes at busy times, the whole party must arrive together); reservations through AutoReserve are void; about 15 minutes until an okonomiyaki is done; part of the menu revised and prices changed from 15 April 2026; Ajinoya Mix okonomiyaki ¥1,780 (No. 1), mix yakisoba ¥1,980 (No. 2), Kyoto Kujo green-onion negiyaki with beef tendon ¥1,580 (No. 3, with ponzu and sesame sauce), fresh tomato and choice cheese okonomiyaki ¥1,780, mochi okonomiyaki ¥1,680, special mix okonomiyaki ¥3,480, Hiroshima-yaki ¥1,580, house-made stewed beef tendon ¥980, Ajinoya special set B ¥5,340 (for two), tax included. Sister shops: Ajinoya Hanare (reservation only, the former 寺田町 central kitchen shop, Daido 2-5-11, 天王寺区) and Yondaime Aji no Ya (opened 31 July 2026, Namba Oriental Hotel 1F). Tabelog (shop-maintained): a taste carried through four generations, plenty of cabbage and a light batter, fluffy okonomiyaki, PayPay accepted, no cards, non-smoking, English menu, Okonomiyaki 100 in 2018, 2019 and 2022–2025. Reviews (October 2026): a queue of over an hour, check in at the terminal outside and get an SMS as your turn nears, order while waiting, staff cook on the iron plate at each table, the Kujo green-onion negiyaki is popular, solo diners sit at the counter, many overseas customers too.

公式サイト: 和風もつ料理 あらた、スキー大好き人間の集まるお店、大阪市淀川区西.en: Official site: Wafu Motsu Ryori Arata, a shop where ski lovers gather; 4-2-8 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, basement; no reservations taken; 84 m from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; 17:00–21:30; closed Monday, Sunday and holidays; special closures at New Year and other times; check X for changes. Tabelog: beef dishes; Tue–Sat 17:00–20:00; no reservations; cash only; no service charge; 12 counter seats; non-smoking; The Tabelog Award 2025 and 2026 Bronze. Reviews (2018 to 2026): a line before opening (from before 16:00); two seatings of two hours each; omakase of about nine dishes; Japanese-style offal stew; chire sashimi or yukke; tongue and tail stews (gentle demi-glace); blanched mino; smoked neck; cold tongue; skewers; raw senmai with sesame sauce; heart sashimi with grated daikon; soy-glazed lung; tail soup or zosui to finish; bottled beer ¥600; special highball ¥300; about ¥5,000–6,300 a head; the owner explains the dishes.

公式サイト: 四季の味 京都 浜町、中京区河原町通三条上ル恵比須町448-2 (.en: Official site: Shiki no Aji Kyoto Hamacho; 中京区河原町通三条上ル恵比須町448-2 (Kiyamachi north of Sanjo, first lane, west side; by the Takase River); 17:00–23:00; irregular closures (closed 8 November 2026); lunch by reservation and courses only; November monthly omakase course ¥5,000; autumn flavours course ¥7,000; autumn Kyoto-style kaiseki course ¥9,000; banquet course ¥3,500; daily à la carte; sesame tofu, yuba, nama-fu, Kyoto vegetables, obanzai; more than 15 local sakes; sister restaurant Pontocho Yoshina; operated by 株式会社 四季企画; new noren for the first time in 25 years since opening (February 2025). Tabelog: 100 seats; private rooms ¥300 per person; cards, e-money and QR accepted; non-smoking; vegetarian options; children welcome. Reviews (2026, in English): sashimi; tsukune; shrimp-gyoza spring rolls; grilled hamachi collar; sea bream rice with yuba sauce ¥700; courses with all-you-can-drink.

公式サイト: 四季乃味 今井きしょう、おしゃべりの切れ間にお出しする料理が句読点.en: Official site: 四季乃味 Imai Kishou; that the dishes served in the pauses of your conversation may become its punctuation and its keynote, the shop is particular about each day's ingredients, and there has not been a single day since opening without a change to the menu; a deep simplicity can be found only in ingredients in season; Imai Kishou's cooking is a pure, light pleasure left for grown-ups; lunch 12:00–14:00, dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Saturdays, Sundays and holidays (Sundays and holidays by reservation only); 梅田1-3-1, B1F of Osaka Station Front Building No. 1, Kita-ku, Osaka. Lunch menu: Saga black-wagyu 牛黄味丼, Ise red-chicken 'hand-in-hand' bowl (oyako-don), seafood bowl of three kinds of fish and shellfish (¥1,000 each, with a small dish, salad, soup and pickles); daily set ¥1,500. Tabelog (shop member): Japanese cuisine and izakaya; 70 m from Nishi-Umeda Station; Mon–Fri 12:00–14:00 and 17:00–22:00; Saturdays by reservation only; closed Sundays and holidays; closed at Obon and New Year; in summer from 16:00 for phone bookings only; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) accepted, no e-money or QR; 20 seats (10 at the counter, a table for up to 12); smoking allowed; BYO allowed; opened 19 September 2012; 'Ofukuro no Aji Imai', loved in the Osaka Ekimae building for over forty years since the Showa era, merged with 'Shiki no Aji Kishou' of the Tenjinbashi-suji shopping street (head chef Sato, fifteen years of Japanese cooking); courses ¥4,400, ¥5,500 and ¥6,600. Reviews (July 2025 – July 2026): the beef bowl ¥1,000; small side dishes (fish, simmered taro); the seafood bowl of three marinated fish; the owner alone at lunch; dobin-mushi; sashimi; crab with lettuce; attentive service from the woman serving; no one was smoking; a day with no rice; a menu like a scroll; about seven beers; beef-tendon stew; cream croquettes; dobin-mushi in summer; a chatty chef.

公式サイト: 堀江発酵堂、からだが喜ぶ発酵料理、自然のちからが活きた発酵食、無農.en: Official site: Horie Hakkodo; fermented dishes your body will thank you for; fermented food alive with the power of nature; pesticide-free, additive-free ingredients with hand-made seasonings and traditionally made seasonings (price-change notice, February 2023); open 11:00–19:00; no closing day. Tabelog: 1-15-17 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka, 06-6541-8111; reservations accepted; daily 11:00–19:00; cards AMEX only; QR (PayPay, d-barai) accepted; no smoking; opened 12 November 2021. 2026 reviews (June–October): Orange Street; roomy seats; fermented karaage set meal (crisp outside, moist inside); 5 small side dishes; ordering by touch panel; healthy fermented-vegetable set meal (no meat, fragrant miso soup, fermented-enzyme brown rice); fermented monkey-banana shake and seasonal fermented-enzyme juice; fried mackerel set meal; items to take home too; busy at lunch.

公式サイト: 大衆酒場 ちょーちんスピカ 新大阪東口店、新大阪駅東口から徒歩1分.en: Official site: Taishu Sakaba Chochin Supika, Shin-Osaka east-exit shop; 1 minute on foot from the east exit of Shin-Osaka Station; a shop where "fun" gathers every day; creative dishes to go with drinks, made with seasonal ingredients and fresh seafood; "chochin" for the warmth of the red lantern, "Spica" for the brightest star of Virgo shining in the spring night sky; over ten sakes chosen by the owner; banquets of up to 70; Mon–Thu, Sun and holidays 16:00–24:00 (last order 23:00), Fri, Sat and the day before a holiday 16:00–01:00 (last order 24:00); no closing day; 78 seats. Signatures: Spica special grilled gyoza ¥530; the gout bowl ¥980 (a signature dish sold at a loss); a 25 cm salmon rare katsu ¥980; the tower salad "Shin-Osaka Station Building, local-sake sauce" ¥980. Also toro-taku, tuna, thin-sliced octopus, a four-kind chicken sashimi plate, doteyaki bistro Spica style, vinegared mackerel, beef tripe with kimchi, rolled omelette, kara-age marinated in ago dashi, Neapolitan Spica style, homemade pudding. Courses (with 120 minutes of drinks, tax included): Tsuruhashi beef-offal hot pot course ¥4,500, ¥5,000, ¥6,000; okonomiyaki course ¥4,500, ¥5,000, ¥6,000; snack course ¥4,000. Tabelog (shop member): izakaya, seafood, hot pot; 1-20-9 Higashinakajima, Higashiyodogawa-ku, 2nd floor; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 78 seats; non-smoking; takeaway; children welcome; opened 7 February 2017. Reviews (January 2025 to October 2026): Neapolitan on an iron plate; free gyoza for following on Instagram; plenty of food on the ¥5,000 course; gyoza skin stuck to the iron plate and burnt; the gout bowl is about the size of a rice bowl; noisy; doteyaki; vinegared mackerel; gyoza without chives; cheese gyoza; fried gyoza; beef offal kimchi; edamame; energetic staff; quick food.

公式サイト: 大阪うどん いなの路、山根 正也、伝統的な味の継承と「発展」「改良.en: Official site: Osaka Udon Inanoji, 山根 正也; carrying on the traditional taste while seeking 'development' and 'improvement'; the aim is for people all over Japan to taste it; a carefully made dashi from chosen ingredients; the signature meat udon and rice bowls; small dishes such as dashimaki and tempura with drinks, then udon or niku-sui to finish; the taste of the earlier Shinano Soba, whose detailed recipe did not survive, recreated over a long time from the memory of its flavour; many famous people and customers come for the taste they remember; the dried-fish supplier and the noodle maker have changed since then, but the taste is carried on; counter seats on 1F, and a 2F too. Menu: signature meat udon, special curry udon, kizami udon, tori-namba udon, kitsune udon, oyako-namba udon, niku-sui (with egg), dashimaki, onigiri. Main shop Sennichimae 1-8-2, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 11:00–20:00 (Fri and Sat to 22:00), closed Thursday, closing when the noodles sell out; 桜井店 (箕面市, 27 June 2023); 西宮えびす店 (西宮市, 5 December 2025). Tabelog: no reservations, AMEX the only card, non-smoking, opened 3 September 2022, meat udon ¥1,100. Reviews (May–October 2026): slightly sweet dashi, soft noodles, a queue from opening, order by QR code, about 5 counter seats on 1F, a steep stair to 2F, niku-sui, haikara udon, curry soba, chestnut rice (limited time).

公式サイト: 大阪の味 お好み焼 千日前はつせ、明治末に千日前で「はつせ旅館」と.en: Official site: The taste of Osaka, okonomiyaki Sennichimae Hatsuse; founded at the end of the Meiji era in Sennichimae as the 'Hatsuse inn'; closed for a time by the war; in 1945 the first generation, 長谷川清之, rebuilt the burnt-out building and started 'Hatsuse canteen'; its 'surprise udon' in a huge bowl was a hit; the okonomiyaki house opened later; some 70 years since; all private rooms, a holdover from the inn; customers cook both okonomiyaki and yakisoba themselves; a family meal at leisure; a secret batter of four selected flours with Japanese dashi; crisp outside and fluffy inside; fillings lightly fried and returned to the batter; pork-and-egg with shoulder loin, the original mix, the deluxe series; a 'double sauce' of Worcester-type and sweet thick sauce; open over New Year; featured in 旅の手帖 (May 2020) and ぴあMOOK関西; Hatsuse building 2F, Namba Sennichimae 11-25, Chuo-ku, Osaka. Tabelog (shop-maintained): Mon–Fri 11:30–24:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00); reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 120 seats; private rooms (2 to over 30); non-smoking; children welcome. Reviews (July–October 2026): cooking instructions on the wall, mixed ¥1,243, lunch mixed ¥994, beer ¥580, ordering by the room phone, reviews saying smoking or e-cigarettes are allowed in the rooms, 2F with no lift, a review bothered by the wear, yakisoba cooked by staff, right by Namba Grand Kagetsu.

公式サイト: 大阪・心斎橋・堀江の鉄板焼き「鉄板Kitchen DAI（ダイ）」.en: Official site: 'Teppan Kitchen DAI', a teppanyaki restaurant in Shinsaibashi and Horie, Osaka; hamburg, wagyu steak, Ise lobster and other teppanyaki with wine at reasonable prices in a homey hideaway; welcomes dates, birthdays, anniversaries and families with small children; some regulars have come since childhood and still come as adults; steaks chosen by an owner who knows meat inside out; the main seats are at the counter; kids' plates; three courses (seafood course ¥6,270, special beef steak course ¥8,030, SPECIAL DAI course ¥8,580); pair course for two ¥22,000; black-wagyu fillet steak from ¥4,158 per 100 g; fluffy wagyu hamburg with a fried egg ¥1,848; old-style bifkatsu ¥2,728; grilled vegetables ¥748 for 3 kinds to ¥1,628 for 7; teppan pizza, Napolitan, omurice; wine by the glass from ¥880; the owner suggests wines; moved to Kitahorie 2-5-3; a crowdfunding for the 15th anniversary; 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Monday. Tabelog (shop-maintained): Tue–Sun 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); starter charge ¥330; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 20 seats (12 counter, 8 table); private hire possible; non-smoking; English menu; children welcome. Reviews (November 2022–September 2026): run by a married couple; an owner from Miyazaki; a friendly owner; grilled vegetables, hamburg, French toast; birthday plate and fireworks; foie gras and daikon steak; some say the choice of meat is small.

公式サイト: 大阪市西区のイタリア料理店 トラットリアパッパ、魚介系パワフルイタ.en: Official site: Trattoria Pappa, an Italian restaurant in Nishi-ku, Osaka; powerful seafood Italian; a glass-fronted open kitchen; owner-chef 松本: 'I love seafood! So the Italian at Pappa is seafood only (except lunch)'; buys fresh seafood at the Osaka central wholesale market every morning; visiting fishing ports around Japan is a life's work; early-summer tomatoes from Mr Yamanaka in Wakayama; a counter of African bubinga about 1,000 years old; works by the artist TALA; a painting by the painter 少路和伸 made for the 50th birthday. Omakase courses (tax excluded): ¥4,000 (lunch only), ¥6,000, ¥10,000, ¥15,000, ¥25,000 (¥25,000 booked two days ahead); one course per table; coperto (bread, table charge, etc.) ¥500 per person (dinner only); a drinking course, a pasta course, a whole fish, Italian cheese instead of dessert; seasonal tomatoes, broccoli, white asparagus, truffle, Pacific saury, cod milt, tiger puffer, ayu. Notice ending the lunch menu: the set lunch menus served since the 2002 opening ended on 29 November 2025; à la carte and courses at both lunch and dinner; courses booked by the day before; Pappa owner 松本喜宏. Pappa representative 松本 喜宏: born 1964 in Hokkaido; after cooking school, trained under chef 鮎田淳治 at ラ・コメータ in Tokyo; Fontana at ホテルニューオータニ大阪; launching Italian restaurants; went independent in 2002 and opened Trattoria Pappa; in 2005 baR pappA and PAPPABAR (closed 31 May 2020). Hours 11:30–14:00 / 17:30– last entry 20:00; closed Sundays and irregular days. Tabelog (shop-maintained): Shinmachi 2-3-9; 4 min on foot from Nishi-Ohashi Station exit 1; seafood Italian only, no meat dishes; dinner for middle-school age and up; a booking may be cancelled if the shop cannot reach you 20 minutes after the time; coperto ¥550 (tax included, none at lunch); cards and PayPay; 31 seats (18 at tables, 13 at the counter); non-smoking; private hire for 20–50; opened 22 February 2002; Italian WEST 100 2021 and 2023. Reviews (June–October 2026): summer chilled capellini (sea urchin and tomato), mackerel and tomato pasta, cabbage and anchovy oil sauce, clam and broccoli cream pasta, shrimp gratin, white-tomato jelly with onion mousse, fish with crisp skin, Gorgonzola ice cream; regulars name the ingredients and leave the method to the chef (Ise lobster, abalone, eel, sea urchin, summer truffle, lobster topped with caviar); seen on MBS 'Kitchen Puipui'; lunch course ¥4,400; salt and pepper on the table.

公式サイト: 大阪道頓堀から徒歩2分の高級和牛焼肉、オープンキッチンの長いカウン.en: Official site: a high-end wagyu yakiniku restaurant 2 min on foot from Dotonbori, Osaka; a long counter (8 seats) at an open kitchen and a modern Japanese interior; skilled grillers cook in front of you; 7 salts a day chosen to suit the meat from 32 natural salts from around the world; tables for 4 ×2 and for 6 ×1; a private room for 2–5 (charge ¥3,300); 34 seats in all; Special Chateaubriand course ¥19,800, Special Fillet (hire) course ¥16,800, 35-day aged meat course ¥13,200 (assorted appetizers, the signature Toro-tan (a registered 3D trademark), salt-grilled cuts, seasonal grilled vegetables, fresh-picked vegetables, wagyu sukiyaki, aged sirloin or aged rib roast, a rice dish, dessert); à la carte also available; 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed every Monday and over New Year; 10% service charge; all seats non-smoking from 1 April 2025; no entry for children 10 and under. Daikoku Sengyu: only A5 heifers fattened for 29 months or more, aged 21 or 35 days at 90% humidity and 0°C in one of the largest aging houses in western Japan, in Kakogawa, Hyogo. Company outline: FULL STEAM AHEAD co. ltd., representative Nobuhiro Morikawa, founded March 2001; runs Nikushou Nakata and opens further shops; online shop for Daikoku Sengyu. Shops: the main shop and 匠のお重 和牛 韋駄天 (IDATEN). Tabelog (shop-maintained): Namba 1-7-16, 現代こいさんビル 5F; 1 min on foot from Namba Station exit 14; course L.O. 21:00; closed Tuesday when Monday is a holiday; 2-hour seating; appetizer charge ¥550; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; English menu; opened 7 March 2001; Yakiniku WEST 100 2020–2026 and 2018. Reviews (September 2024–October 2026): Toro-tan, Chateaubriand, tail slices, bagna càuda, Oni Oroshi, beef-tendon curry, wagyu sushi, beef ochazuke, Chinese-cabbage jelly, wagyu roast beef, homemade curry, Dan Dan noodles, chestnut Mont Blanc, a dish of uni, ikura and abalone, matsutake, sukiyaki eaten with egg yolk, a counter like an irori, the salts get spicier clockwise, the private room fills with smoke, one wish to be asked about doneness.

公式サイト: 天富羅 拾幸 (じゅこう)、大阪・北新地 堂島の天富羅専門店、京都.en: Official site: Tempura Juko (じゅこう), a tempura specialist in Dojima, Kitashinchi, Osaka; a craftsman in the lineage of 天宗 in Gion, Kyoto, frying select ingredients one by one in tempura courses; 大日ビル 2F, 1-2-17 堂島; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 (closed the first and third Saturdays) and 17:30–21:30; reservations accepted; non-smoking; 10 seats. Tabelog (shop member): Kitashinchi Tempura Juko, tempura and Japanese cuisine; closed Sundays and holidays and the first and third Saturdays; lunch from 20 May 2026; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 10 counter seats; English menu; opened 23 December 2024; 12 kinds of seasonal tempura including two shrimp; a dashi starter, sashimi, a simmered dish and seasonal fruit; TENKO, 17 items, ¥17,000; TENKO short, 15 items, ¥14,000; the anniversary course SHUKO with a wine toast ¥20,000. Invoice registration: 株式会社岡部. Reviews (September–October 2026): 10% service charge; kuruma shrimp with the head; Himeji lotus root; beef loin sandwich; asparagus; makomotake; ayu; ribbonfish in shiso; maitake; sardine under sea urchin; persimmon namasu; whelk; sansho-simmered eel; black edamame; barracuda stick sushi; matsutake dobin-mushi; soba to finish; bonito salt; Awaji seaweed salt; sudachi; tentsuyu; tempura set lunch ¥2,500 (two shrimp, anago, vegetables, kakiage, with tendon sauce or tencha); a same-day booking was possible.

公式サイト: 宗寿苑、店主 竹城成吉、祖父の代から三代目、約60年間、流行に左右.en: Official site: Soujuen; owner 竹城成吉, third generation since the grandfather, about 60 years; not swayed by fashion, keeping to the basics while adding a new sensibility; heifers of black wagyu only, chosen on colour, size and fat quality from long-trusted suppliers; offal where freshness is everything, proven by tsurami sashimi; cuts that value texture and a sauce that draws out the meat's flavour; namul and salads of vegetables bought each morning; rice blended by a five-star rice meister to suit the meat, cooked in a gas kama; real unpasteurised makgeolli with live lactic bacteria; reasonable prices. Menu: special ribeye (yaki-shabu or steak cut), special wagyu assortment, tongue platter, today's lean thigh, seared yukke dipped in egg. Shops: Soujuen (酉島1-14-17, Konohana-ku, the nostalgic main shop), Soujuen HANARE (Minami-Semba 4-11-8; counter, tables, private table rooms), Kobe Soujuen. Group shops: tsukemen 雀 and きりん寺. Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): 5 min on foot from Shinsaibashi and Yotsubashi Stations; Mon–Sat and holiday eves 17:00–1:00, Sundays and holidays 17:00–23:00; cards and PayPay accepted; 46 seats (8 counter, 5 tables for 4); private rooms; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; opened 8 October 2021; courses (tax included): Namba Senba ¥5,500, Soujuen ¥8,800, Goku ¥11,000. Reviews (June–October 2026): tsurami sashimi; seared Yukhoe; raw omasum; tongue; outside skirt; Chateaubriand; seared liver; Akasen; special ribeye steak about ¥3,000; tail soup; counter on 1F, tables on 2F; athletes' signatures on the stairs; e-cigarettes allowed on 2F; one complaint that the meat came all at once and was frozen on an earlier visit.

公式サイト: 寿司はせ川 心斎橋本店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-16-20 ステー.en: Official site: Sushi Hasegawa Shinsaibashi head shop, ステージアビル 4F, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-16-20, Chuo-ku, Osaka, sushi from the finest seasonal ingredients and kaiseki that values traditional Japanese skill, a lively counter, private rooms for 2 to 24, chosen tableware (by the ceramicist 内田鋼一), a space evoking Kyoto's stone paving, seasonal decor, reopened after renovation in March 2024, osechi and hot-pot sets to order, private-party plans with all-you-can-drink at BAR HASEGAWA. Company (hasegawa-group.jp): 株式会社はせ川, founded October 2001, representative director 古塚建一, 6 shops: 寿司はせ川 Shinsaibashi head shop, 京風鉄板 はせ川, BAR HASEGAWA, 寿司はせ川 西麻布店, and 日本焼肉はせ川 銀座本店, 表参道店 and 別亭 銀座店; "carry on the good old culture of Japan while evolving it", tableware by noted potters and late-Edo antiques, interiors by a leading plasterer. Tabelog (shop-maintained): daily 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00), irregular closures, service charge ¥1,200, cards and QR accepted, 84 seats, sunken-seat private rooms for 2–24, table rooms for 4–12, non-smoking, Wi-Fi, children and kids menu welcome, takeout, 21st anniversary in November, a takeaway sushi set (48 pieces and 3 rolls for three) ¥30,000, osechi. Reviews (June–October 2026): Genji course ¥15,000, corn tofu, matsutake and wheat-gluten salad, fugu-skin jelly, hamo with plum, dobin mushi, five sashimi, sanma sushi, Spanish mackerel grilled with miso, Kawachi duck, five nigiri, red miso soup, Takara Farm soft-serve, a view that the top ¥30,000 course gave only five pieces of sushi, a limited course of Ise lobster, abalone and matsutake, birthday celebrations.

公式サイト: 居酒処 田村、港区六本木3-13-3 第5六本木ビレッジビル1F、.en: Official site: Izakadokoro Tamura, Roppongi 3-13-3, 第5六本木ビレッジビル 1F, 3 min from Roppongi Stn (Hibiya and Oedo lines), 5 min from Roppongi-itchome Stn (Namboku line); Mon–Sat and holidays 18:00–08:00 (takeaway 19:00–05:00); Sundays for private bookings only. Real charcoal grilling in front of you; the meat is fresh, so liver, hearts and sasami come a little rare (well done on request); sasami with yuzu pepper, wasabi or plum; chicken soup limited to three a day; crisp cabbage with a special meat miso; a cosy counter with a nostalgic feel. Tabelog (shop-maintained): Mon–Tue 18:00–23:00, Wed–Sat 18:00–05:00, closed Sundays; ¥500 otoshi; 11 seats; smoking allowed; cards and QR accepted; private-hire all-you-can-drink omakase (4–11 people, up to 13) ¥50,000 in total (¥60,000 on Fridays), cash only. Reviews (June 2024–October 2026): about 30 years; oden; liver sashimi; chicken nanban; all-you-can-drink for women ¥3,000; bottle keep; Google Maps leads you round the back.

公式サイト: 店主 八木一真、学生時代に料理の喜びを知り、京都嵐山吉兆で16年、.en: Official site: owner 八木一真; found the joy of cooking as a student; trained 16 years at Kyoto Arashiyama Kitcho and 8 years at Hiiragiya ryokan before opening Kanzan; vegetables grown in the Shugakuin Imperial Villa grounds (a farm with 300 years of history); reservation only, at least 2 days ahead; cancellation fees 100% on the day, 50% the day before, 30% two days before; lunch Wed, Fri, Sun 12:00–14:00 (last entry 12:00) ¥11,000 and ¥15,000; dinner 18:00–22:00 (last entry 20:30) ¥22,000 and ¥26,000; tax included, 10% service extra; closed Monday (open on holidays), irregular days and 26–31 December; 10 counter seats; cards accepted; mackerel sushi and house seasonings to take away or ship; 10th anniversary on 10 November 2026; a notice titled 'Michelin Guide Kyoto–Osaka 2026'. Tabelog: Japanese cuisine, kamameshi; 下京区高辻通高倉泉正寺町465-2 たかくらビル 1F; 10% service charge; allergies to be notified in advance. Reviews (March 2023–June 2026, in English): plum sauce with wasabi; a monthly hassun; donabe rice; Shugakuin peas; homemade sweets; Imari tableware; from a family of potters.

公式サイト: 御菓子屋 廣井堂、明治十年創業、かつて花街だった新町、店の上の看板.en: Official site: confectioner 廣井堂 (Hiroi Do), founded Meiji 10 (1877) in Shinmachi, once a hanamachi; the sign above the shop escaped the wartime fires and 御菓子司 廣井堂 was revived after the war; the married couple 小澤康雄 and 小澤ゆう子; the two make and sell everything; "the unchanging taste of a changing town"; Shinmachi 1-17-8, Nishi-ku, Osaka, ハイネス新町公園 1F; Tuesday–Saturday 9:00–18:00. Chestnut steamed yokan: large domestic chestnuts peeled, simmered and candied in-house, with Hokkaido azuki koshian; in 2026 sold from 21 September to late December, handed over from about 11:00; reserve by phone or in the shop; no same-day sales; keeps 4 days chilled; half ¥3,000 (boxed ¥3,250), whole ¥5,900 (boxed ¥6,200); cash, PayPay, premium vouchers and cards accepted; chilled shipping. Catalog: fresh sweets from ¥220 (by reservation, even one piece): daifuku, hanabira mochi, uguisu mochi, strawberry daifuku, sakura mochi, kusa mochi, kashiwa mochi, chimaki, tsukimi dango, steamed pumpkin manju, yuzu manju; baked sweets (季の彩菓, 梅の香, 菊からくさ, chestnut manju, いも黄金, wakaayu); pies; five-colour senbei and lattice senbei; chilled sweets (Warawazu mochi, fu manju, matcha azuki, fruit kanten, mizu manju); bar sweets (しんまち, chestnut yokan, persimmon yokan, yuzu yokan); Yūgiri monaka ¥200, honey cream cheese monaka ¥300; sekihan on the 1st and 15th of each month; a thank-you festival on Wagashi Day, 16 June. Tabelog: Tue–Sat 9:00–18:00; closed Sun, Mon and holidays; irregular closures; reservations from one item; no cards or e-money; QR accepted; 2 seats; non-smoking; takeout. Reviews (August 2025–October 2026): Yūgiri monaka with a shell that stays crisp; the owner's service; fruit kanten with crunchy watermelon; Warawazu mochi; matcha azuki; mizu manju; dorayaki with fresh cream and butter; bear-shaped honey cream cheese monaka; fu manju; wakaayu; Osaka-style tsukimi dango; a short wait behind a few customers.

公式サイト: 心斎橋の「ダイニングカフェバー フラット」、ディナーデートに人気、.en: Official site: Dining Cafe Bar Flat in Shinsaibashi, popular for dinner dates; an English greeting for international travellers (one of the most popular spots for international visitors in Shinsaibashi); owner 尾崎英司 has appeared on Yomiuri TV's "Gochiso Concierge" and NHK's "Eeyan Kono Hito"; pets welcome with pet food; opened 1996. Tabelog (English edition): Dining Cafe Bar Flat, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-18-20, 心斎橋EOビル 2F, 1 min on foot from Shinsaibashi Station exits 5 and 6; Mon–Thu 12:00–23:30, Fri, Sat and eves of holidays 12:00–24:00, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00; irregular closing days; late fees of 10% after 15 minutes and 20% after 30. Menu (September 2025): golden omurice (over 6.6 million served), Kobe-beef tendon and hamburg omurice curry, A5 black-wagyu yakiniku and sukiyaki bowls, A5 roast beef and ikura bowl, eel and dashi-egg bowl, "30-year aged" Shinsaibashi curry. Reviews (June 2023–October 2025): beef hitsumabushi, basil Genovese, red-egg omurice curry (28 years), green interior, sofas, all-you-can-eat courses, English and Chinese menus; one found it pricey.

公式サイト: 心斎橋の日本料理 岡﨑 (おかざき)、店名変更のご挨拶: 2026.en: Official site: 岡﨑 (Okazaki), Japanese cuisine in Shinsaibashi; renaming notice: from 1 October 2026 '心斎橋 翠 岡﨑' becomes '岡﨑 (OKAZAKI)'; an independent Japanese restaurant in Higashi-Shinsaibashi that took over its shop name from '日本料理 翠'; its own cooking while valuing tradition; mainly counter seats, plus two private rooms; experience gained at ryotei and kappo; tableware by contemporary artists; chef 岡﨑 直哉: interested in cooking since primary school; culinary college after high school; three and a half years as head chef at an Osaka ryotei; five years' training at '日本料理 翠 (now 翠 大屋)', rising to second-in-command; opened '翠 岡﨑' in 2023 as a noren-wake; became '岡﨑' in 2026. Courses (tax included, plus 10% service): lunch (Tue, Fri, Sun, all start at 12:00) 8 dishes ¥11,000; dinner 10 dishes ¥19,800; changing monthly; a clear soup (white amadai, sesame tofu, mizu, a dashi of two kombu with karebushi and tuna flakes); a grilled dish (Spanish mackerel, wild mushrooms, scented with charcoal, straw or firewood); hassun; a meat dish (Miyazaki beef, wild watercress); 15–20 sakes; about 50 wines; one red and one white by the glass; mail-order hamo hot-pot and hamo-and-matsutake hot-pot sets. Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-16-20, Shinsaibashi Stage A Building 2F; 3 min on foot from Shinsaibashi Station exit 6; dinner first seating 18:00, second 20:30 (no time limit); lunch Tue, Fri, Sun from 12:00; closed Wednesday; 26 seats (6 table, 10 counter, 10 in private rooms); 15% private-room service charge; children only at lunch and all day at weekends; bookings up to 10; 100% cancellation charge from two days before. Tabelog: opened 11 April 2023; non-smoking (smoking outside allowed). Reviews (August 2024–October 2026): a disciple of 翠's chef; the renaming suggested by 翠's chef; Michelin Guide Selected Osaka 2026; fish from fisherman Fujimoto in Ehime; hassun; sashimi with several soy sauces; clay-pot rice with corn and shirasu; maitake and oyster spring rolls; fillet; warabi mochi; matcha; Chateaubriand at dinner; leftover rice to take home; a friendly chef; one meal took about three hours; one view that the grilling has room to grow.

公式サイト: 志る幸 (しるこう)、昭和七年創業、「汁講」に由来、汁は白味噌・赤.en: Official site: Shiruko (しるこう); founded in Showa 7 (1932); named after 'shirukō'; soups of white miso, red miso or clear broth, with more than ten fillings always on hand; a counter modelled on a Noh stage; seats styled after the railings of the Sanjo and Gojo bridges; the signature Rikyu bento (a tea-style light meal); à la carte and soups from ¥550; kaiseki by reservation (tax and 5% service extra); tai chirimen as a souvenir; 11:30–15:00 (last entry 14:00) and 17:00–21:00 (last entry 19:00); closed Tuesday evening, Wednesday and irregularly. Tabelog: Japanese cuisine, bento; 下京区西木屋町四条上ル真町100; 2 min on foot from Kawaramachi Stn; closed Wednesday; no reservations; cash only; 29 seats; tatami room (10–20 people); non-smoking; takeaway. Reviews (August–October 2026, in English): Rikyu bento ¥3,300; white-miso soup; the filling can be changed to grated yam or sweet potato; kayaku rice; low counter seats; queues before opening on holidays.

公式サイト: 日式飲茶 点心の気持ち、大阪市大正区三軒屋西1-2-11、工房併設.en: Official site: Japanese-style yum cha 点心の気持ち, Sangenya-nishi 1-2-11, Taisho-ku, Osaka; a gyoza restaurant with its own workshop; chosen for Tabelog Gyoza 100 in 2024; preservative-free, all-handmade gyoza, everything by hand from kneading the dough to wrapping; an analogue process that goes against an age of mechanisation and efficiency; frozen gyoza by mail order (96 pieces ¥4,980, 24 pieces ¥1,980, sale prices); a February 2021 notice: a gyoza tavern with a gyoza workshop opening in April in Taisho-ku, Osaka; Japanese ingredients only; Tsumagoi highland cabbage. Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): Nama Gyoza Seizo Tokoro Tenshin no Kimochi; 1 min on foot from Taisho Station; daily 11:00–24:00 (L.O. food 23:00, drinks 23:30); open all year; set lunches until 14:00, ending when the rice runs out; lunch bookings only for the 11:00 opening; one drink per person after 14:00; cards, PayPay and au PAY accepted; 44 seats (12 counter, 34 table); non-smoking; private hire for 20–50; children welcome; kids menu; English menu; menu with photos; takeout; opened 6 April 2021; Gyoza 100 2024; wrappers of 100% Hokkaido Haruyutaka wheat; oyster and dim sum banquet course, 12 items, ¥5,000 (until 31 January). Reviews (February–November 2026): two pieces a plate for ¥380–580; pan-fried, boiled, fried, fried with tartar sauce, steamed in sesame sauce, truffle and shrimp gyoza; no garlic; fried gyoza set ¥1,180 (coriander salad, soup, help-yourself zha cai and celery); four kinds and rice ¥1,720; a set of boiled and pan-fried gyoza with Chinese-style chawanmushi; appetizer pickles (pickled mustard greens); Taiwanese mazesoba; all-you-can-drink courses from ¥2,000; staff explain how to eat each; one complaint that dishes came all at once and cooled; one complaint of hearing about the one-drink rule only afterwards; near Kyocera Dome.

公式サイト: 日本一古いおでん屋「たこ梅」、関東煮 (おでん) とたこ甘露煮が名.en: Official site: Tako Ume, the oldest oden shop in Japan, famous for kanto-daki (oden) and tako kanroni; a sake-warming house founded in 1844; from the founder 岡田梅次郎 to the fifth generation 岡田哲生; the whale tongue 'saezuri®' that 梅次郎 first used; baleen-whale tongue prepared in house; tako kanroni of madako simmered in the traditional broth; sake warmed in tin tanpo and served in tin cups; loved by 織田作之助, 池波正太郎, 檀一雄, 田辺聖子, 吉田健一 and others, and 開高健 wrote ten pages on it in the novel 新しい天体; the previous owner, an uncle, said 'the shop has lasted a hundred years because parents bring their children'; what came back on a winter night after the Lehman shock; the next hundred years too. News (October–November 2026): whale harihari for November only ¥550 (before tax), shiho-chiku bamboo, sarashi whale, ginkgo, shiitake, a monthly sake. Tabelog (shop-maintained): Dotonbori 1-1-8, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 16:00–21:50 (L.O. 21:30), hours shortened from 20 February 2024 for lack of staff; closed 31 December–3 January; reservations by phone only, after 15:00; appetiser ¥275; cards accepted; 21 seats (12 counter, 9 table); non-smoking; English menu. Reviews (June–October 2026): tako kanroni ¥495, whale saezuri ¥990, whale suji ¥605, daikon ¥330, shumai ¥220, egg ¥220, rolled cabbage, potato, thick fried tofu, mochi kinchaku, yomogi fu, mozzarella, the copper sake warmer, the Dotonbori River through the back window.

公式サイト: 日本料理しうが、日本伝統の和食を新たな切り口で、四谷3-1 スガビ.en: Official website: Nihon Ryori Shiuga, traditional Japanese cuisine from a new angle; Yotsuya 3-1, SUGA Building B1F; 18:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); irregular closing days; owner 渡邊 雅之, born in 1983 in Yamagata Prefecture, became a cook under the influence of the family sushi shop; 6 years at つきぢ田村; head chef at a Japanese restaurant in Germany; independent at 28; moved and opened here in October 2021; monthly courses; uses cumin and coriander too; does not rely on salt, fats or MSG; sake centred on warmed sake; Burgundy red wines; 2 private rooms. Tabelog: reservations taken; online bookings ¥200 per person; private room fee ¥5,000; 19 seats; non-smoking. Reviews (2026): seasonal course ¥8,500; mackerel with Pecorino; ayu wrapped in kadaif; venison; some say the explanations are curt.

公式サイト: 日本酒と料理 くろ川、大阪市北区曾根崎新地1-10-22 ミヤプラ.en: Official site: Japan Shu to Ryori Kurokawa, 8F of the ミヤプラザ building, 曾根崎新地 1-10-22, Kita-ku, Osaka; 2 min on foot from Kitashinchi Station; 18:00–2:00 (L.O. 1:30), Sundays 18:00–24:00; closing days not fixed (check Instagram); always over 100 sakes, from ¥600 (tax included) a glass; rice bought as brown rice from Hokkaido, polished in Osaka and pot-cooked; natural water known as sake-brewing water is used; a ¥12,000 10-dish course (appetizer, sashimi, sake snacks, soup, grilled dish, a small dish, vinegared dish, charcoal-grilled black wagyu, clay-pot white rice and miso soup, homemade sake ice cream); courses by reservation for eight guests a day; a Japanese-modern room with a night view; the owner has kept to Japanese cooking throughout; booking on the website brings a cup of the owner's recommended sake; cards accepted; QR via d Barai. Tabelog (shop-maintained): Mon–Fri 18:00–3:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 18:00–24:00; late-night à la carte from 21:00; courses ¥12,000, ¥15,500 and ¥22,000; 5% service charge; a U-shaped counter of 12 seats; run by one person; opened 10 December 2024.
furi: 市北区曾根崎新地1-10-22 ミヤプラザ 8F、北新地

公式サイト: 昭和21年創業「道頓堀今井」、昔ながらの八升釜で一杯ずつ浪花の味、.en: Official site: 'Dotonbori Imai', founded in 1946; the Osaka taste, one bowl at a time, from an old-style eight-shō pot; shop manager 水野 浩明; Dotonbori 1-chome 7-22; 5 min on foot from Namba Station; 11:30–21:30 (L.O. 21:00); hot-pot last order 7:30 pm; closed Wednesday (open on holidays) and the 4th Tuesday (except December); cash, e-money and credit cards; reservations by phone only; kitsune udon ¥930, nabeyaki udon ¥1,850, oyakodon (with clear soup) ¥1,500, udon yose-nabe ¥5,500 per person; October seasonal soba, chestnut steamed an-soba ¥2,000; red-wine apples ¥580 (October 2026); shaved-ice warabi ¥650 (July 2026). Dashi: natural ma-kombu from southern Hokkaido and Kyushu mackerel and round-herring flakes (soda bonito too); the kombu simmered about an hour in alkaline water, finished in the eight-shō pot. Allergies: cooked in the same kitchen, with shared cooking and washing equipment, so traces may get in. History: the theatre teahouse 稲竹 (1838, by たけ, only daughter of the first generation 今井佐兵衛); the fifth generation 今井寛三 founded 今井楽器店, among the top three shops in Japan for Western instruments; burned out in the Osaka air raids, the family came back to Dotonbori in 1946 selling kanten and shaved ice in summer and zenzai and roasted chestnuts in autumn, and noodles on the quiet; 寛三's wife マチ子 felt 'this is it', and 御蕎麦処 今井 began; in 1949 マチ子 perfected Imai's dashi; 株式会社今井 in 1956; in 1957 the sixth generation 清三 became president (April 1964 in the company outline's history), adding seasonal soba and dim sum; in 1995 the seventh generation 徹 became president; the main shop burned in a fire that spread in 2002 (company outline: burned in the 中座 fire in September 2002; Dotonbori main shop opened in July 2003). Company outline: representative director 今井 徹; founded November 1946; incorporated December 1956; 198 staff (70 employees); 今井楽器店 lost in the war in March 1945; main shop, リーガロイヤルホテル shop, 大阪のれんめぐり shop (Shin-Osaka Station), 泉北タカシマヤ shop, 大丸心斎橋 shop; takeaway-only counters at 大丸梅田, 近鉄上本町, 高島屋大阪 and あべのハルカス; Itami Airport shop (franchise). Tabelog (shop-maintained): Udon 100 2017–2020; 138 seats; private rooms, tatami rooms, sunken seating; wheelchair accessible; non-smoking; children welcome; courses such as hot pot must be booked by the day before. Reviews (October 2026): under the willow tree; a number tag from the ticket machine in front of the shop; called in groups of five; kitsune udon; set C (small rice bowl, small dish of simmered food, pickles) + ¥800; duck and egg udon ¥1,600; kachin udon (three pieces of grilled mochi); anago udon; chestnut steamed an-soba; oden; warabi mochi; Tai Sasamaki Sushi ¥280; many tourists.

公式サイト: 月島屋、難波千日前の焼肉屋、個室あり、産地にこだわらずその時期にい.en: Official site: Tsukishima Ya, a yakiniku restaurant in Namba Sennichimae with private rooms; A5 black wagyu chosen as the most delicious of the season regardless of origin; bought through its own route and sold at reasonable prices; 20 table seats on 1F; private rooms on 2F; Sennichimae 2-7-13; 17:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); lunch (Saturday and Sunday only) 12:00–15:00; open every day (closed over New Year); motto 'Delicious. Fun. Comfortable.' Menu: Tsukishima set (kalbi, loin, belly) ¥4,980; premium set (premium kalbi, premium loin, kainomi) ¥6,500; special trio (special loin, ichibo, Chateaubriand, salt) ¥4,400; tongue assortment ¥2,500; horumon tasting ¥1,680; belly ¥1,480; kalbi and loin ¥1,880; harami ¥2,200; ichibo and premium kalbi ¥2,300; fillet ¥3,200; Chateaubriand (130 g) ¥5,500; kurashita loin sukiyaki-style ¥2,200; special yaki-shabu ¥3,000; Kobe beef loin ¥3,800 to special ¥6,800; Kobe beef nigiri ¥1,280; special salted tongue ¥2,880; salted tongue ¥1,880; a yakiniku-house ramen ¥1,380. Banquet courses (tax included, booked by the day before): Sennichimae ¥5,500, Tsukishima ¥6,800, Takumi ¥9,800, finishing with shoyu ramen, cold noodles or gukbap. Tabelog (shop-maintained): dinner bookings for 2 or more; weekend lunch bookings only at 12:00 for 4 or more; cards and PayPay accepted; 50 seats (1F 20, 2F 30); smoking only in private rooms; sunken seating; private rooms for 2–18.
