Reviews (April–October 2026): for weekend lunch write your name from 10:00 and wait; large yakiniku set meal ¥1,980 (140–150 g); with cold noodles ¥2,380; Korean seaweed; wakame soup; only female black wagyu; a slightly sweet, light soy tare; Tsukishima set 300 g; salted tongue; black-wagyu tail braised in soy sauce ¥780; Yukke; tongue sashimi; stone-grilled bibimbap; many overseas guests; one diner who could no longer pay by card and used PayPay; one view that it was average for the price.

公式サイト: 本場インドカリーの店new Hira、NewHira!へようこそ、.en: Official site: new Hira, a shop of authentic Indian curry; welcome to NewHira!; the flour used at our shop is gluten-free; lunch served; small banquets welcome; healthy Indian food for a women's night out; all kinds of drinks. Tabelog (shop member): Hira Nishinakajima ten; Indian, Indian curry, dining bar; 5-8-29 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, ground floor; 5 minutes on foot from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station and Hankyu Minamikata Station, 8 minutes from Shin-Osaka Station; daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:30; reservations accepted; cards, transport IC cards and PayPay accepted; 34 seats; whole hire for 20–50; non-smoking (smoking area outside); Wi-Fi; English menu; English-speaking staff; kids' menu; takeaway. The shop's introduction: about 30 curries; five spice levels; tandoori dishes; Indian whiskey; chai and lassi; an Indian and Nepalese atmosphere; two-hour all-you-can-eat-and-drink, men ¥3,300, women ¥3,000. Reviews (January 2024 to September 2026): blue-framed entrance; big naan; free naan refills; sets with two curries; seekh kebab; tandoori chicken; carrot dressing; all-you-can-eat lunch ¥1,300 (2024) and ¥1,480 (2025); lunch from ¥850; ¥100 off after 13:30; evening set ¥900; cheese naan set; prawn curry; garlic naan; full of office workers at lunch.

公式サイト: 本格イタリアン PESCE-ROSSO、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-3.en: Official site: authentic Italian PESCE-ROSSO, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-3-18, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min west of Nagahoribashi Station exit 7, 5 min east of Shinsaibashi Station exit 5; hours 17:30–24:30 (last order); closed every Monday (open on holidays); notices of November closing days and a private booking. Omakase course (3 antipasti, 2 pasta, a meat dish) ¥9,000, ¥12,000 or ¥15,000 (before tax); switch one dish to Italian autumn truffle +¥6,000; one course per group; all dishes are left to the kitchen, so please mention anything you can't eat or any allergies; every course includes dessert and coffee. À la carte (before tax): carpaccio of autumn sea bream with risoni, seasonal vegetables and Sardinian bottarga ¥3,200; Hokkaido oyster meunière with mushroom cappuccino and Italian truffle ¥3,600; Chitarra with Awaji blue crab in fruit-tomato sauce ¥3,400; herb-kneaded tagliolini with confit of roe-laden ayu and matsutake ¥3,400; agnolotti dal plin with truffle ¥6,800; risotto with plenty of Italian truffle and a soft warm egg ¥8,400; charcoal-grilled A5 Saga beef with pickled-onion sauce ¥6,000; Saga beef braised in red wine Piedmont-style, 'stracotto', ¥5,200; coperto ¥1,000 per person; pasta alone cannot be ordered. Tabelog (shop member): 17:30–23:00, closed Monday, charge ¥1,100; 36 seats (10 at the counter, tables, a private room for 6); terrace; over 1,000 bottles of wine; opened 1 April 2010; Tabelog Italian WEST 100 in 2021 and 2025. Retty (2012 post): an Italian in Higashi-Shinsaibashi by a chef who trained at ボンテベッキオ; a long counter and a wide kitchen. Reviews (April 2025–October 2026): same-day bookings possible; the pasta is the best part; truffles; an interior with goldfish motifs; olive oil and bread; staff explain each dish carefully.

公式サイト: 本格インド料理カジャナ、大阪・西中島南方の老舗インドカレー。食べロ.en: Official site: authentic Indian cuisine KHAZANA, a long-established Indian curry restaurant in Nishinakajima-Minamigata, Osaka. Tabelog (shop member): KHAZANA; Indian, Indian curry, curry; 4-6-30 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, ground floor; 3 minutes on foot from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:30; closed at New Year; reservations accepted; JCB the only card; PayPay, Rakuten Pay and au PAY accepted; 30 seats; whole hire for 20–50; smoking allowed; live music; vegetarian options. Reviews (October 2024 to May 2026): 25th anniversary (2024); some say 30 years; lunch from ¥880; two curries ¥980; Indian lunch ¥1,100 (daily curry, vegetable curry, chicken tikka, saffron rice, choice of naan, lassi); cheese naan set ¥1,300; lamb biryani; Gujarat thali; thin, crisp naan; Indian families among the customers; embroidery by the owner on the walls; belly dance in the evening; lunch delivered by bicycle.

公式サイト: 東京四谷にある日本料理店「四ツ谷みね村」、旬の食材と職人の技で料理.en: Official website: "Yotsuya Minemura", a Japanese restaurant in Yotsuya, Tokyo, reflecting the four seasons in each dish with seasonal ingredients and craftsmanship. Tabelog: Yotsuya Minemura, Japanese cuisine; Arakichō 3-21, 宮内ビル 2F; 6 min walk from Yotsuya-sanchome Station; from about 18:00 (may vary); irregular closing days; reservation only; no children; 5% service charge; cancellation fees; 6 counter seats; non-smoking; opened 10 September 2023; a chef with 13 years' experience; handmade ju-wari (100% buckwheat) soba; about 10 sakes. Reviews (2026): omakase course; handmade soba and clay-pot rice to finish; hairy crab; young ayu grilled for 40 minutes; pike-conger soup; abalone; a regular of 9 visits; about ¥30,000–50,000 a head.

公式サイト: 株式会社Keep running が運営、代表取締役 税所 孝広、.en: Official site: run by 株式会社Keep running, representative director Takahiro Saisho; Le Premier Cafe opened on 5 September 1997; an owner who does not take to alcohol but loves coffee opened it as a bar-like place to linger over coffee after a meal; moved to the 3rd floor of the present ビギ1stビル in July 2002; black tea, juices and the like dropped in January 2006 for coffee only; all seats non-smoking in 2012; own roasting from 2014 (a Fuji Royal Discovery); a roastery on 1F of the ルネッサ難波 building in 湊町, Namba, in September 2017 (a 12 kg Probat); a shop inside ei-to on Awaji Island in December 2023; three shops now. Representative's greeting: did not drink coffee at all, took a part-time job at a coffee chain because the hourly wage was high, and drinking it every day made it indispensable; the Hanshin Tigers and combat sports (as a spectator); ultramarathons and ultra-trail races through the forties, still running in Osaka Castle Park. Company outline: incorporated 1 February 2022, 7 staff (including part-timers). Shinsaibashi main shop: Shinsaibashi-suji 1-3-28, ビギ1stビル 3F; Mon–Thu and Sun 10:00–23:30, Fri and Sat 10:00–24:00; opens at 12:00 on the first Thursday of each month; last order 30 minutes before closing; all seats non-smoking; a slightly calm space in Shinsaibashi for coffee late at night, to close a meal or a night of drinking. Menu: two blends and about ten single origins; café superbe ¥1,300, Irish coffee ¥1,200, coffee jelly (summer only) ¥980, honey café con leche ¥950, café mocha ¥850, Vienna coffee ¥850, café au lait ¥800, strong iced coffee ¥750, juice of the day ¥840, toast ¥320, honey toast ¥680, hot-pressed sandwich ¥700, hot dog ¥750, egg and bacon sandwich ¥950, club house sandwich ¥1,100; cake set = drink price + ¥600 (cake alone ¥800); five cakes including a pudding cake made with Koshu free-range eggs; two half slices allowed. Tabelog: Kissaten 100 2022 and 2026; 27 seats (12 at the counter); no reservations; 90-minute limit when busy; no black tea; cards, e-money and QR accepted; Wi-Fi; morning service on weekends and holidays 10:00–11:30. Reviews (March–October 2026): Strong Blend ¥750, decaf, rare cheesecake with cinnamon, pudding cake, coffee jelly, morning set at drink price + ¥200–550, every guest gets a different cup, lively with young people at 10 pm on a Saturday.

公式サイト: 株式会社おくお、九州の味を関西でも、関西・大阪エリアを中心に飲食店.en: Official site: 株式会社おくお; Kyushu flavours in Kansai too; runs restaurants mainly in Kansai and Osaka; Sennichimae 1-7-11, 上方ビル 1F; 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); no regular closing day (closed at New Year and Obon); its shop list also has a lunch shop at the same address (10:30–14:00, closed Wednesday) and a shop at Minami-Honmachi 1-5-14, グルラジビル 1F. Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): Gyutan to Yasai Makigushi Okuwo Nanba ten; izakaya, beef tongue, motsunabe; 5 min on foot from Namba and Nipponbashi Stations; daily 17:00–24:00 (L.O. food 23:00, drinks 23:30); closed 31 December 2026–4 January 2027; table charge ¥550; cards, PayPay and au PAY accepted; 47 seats (17 counter, 30 table); every table in a private room (3–16 people); heated tobacco only; opened 1 April 2017. Shop text: marbled beef-tongue shabu-shabu, thick-cut beef-tongue skewers, vegetable-wrapped skewers from Fukuoka, black-wagyu motsunabe, old-house style. Courses (tax included): beef-tongue shabu-shabu course ¥12,500 (A5 wagyu 'Nikura', marbled tongue and uni Yukke, thick-cut grilled tongue, tongue stewed in demi-glace, premium tongue shabu-shabu with A5 strip loin), A5 wagyu strip-loin sukiyaki course ¥15,000. Reviews (July 2024–October 2026): marbled beef-tongue shabu-shabu ¥4,400, Uniku ¥770, marbled tongue sashimi ¥1,760, a kombu broth, wrapped around green onion, a tongue tasting platter, tongue sushi, charcoal-grilled tongue, grilled liver, pork shabu-shabu, mapo tofu, vegetable-wrapped skewers such as asparagus, spicy motsunabe, wagyu sashimi; smiling service; one view that the closing tongue hot pot was bland; one view that the appetizer never changes.

公式サイト: 株式会社しん家、鉄板串酒場 しん家 (大阪市北区梅田1丁目2-2.en: Official site: Shin Ya Co., Ltd.; 鉄板串酒場 しん家 (梅田1-2-2, B1F unit 52 of Osaka Station Front Building No. 2, Kita-ku, Osaka) and たこ焼酒場 しん家 (梅田1-11-4, B1F unit 50 of 梅田駅前第4ビル); skewers and takoyaki at the centre; a wide range of drinks; parties large and small. Tabelog (shop member): Shin Ya, kushiyaki, izakaya and teppanyaki; 1 min on foot from Kitashinchi Station, 5 min from JR Osaka Station; daily 11:00–23:30 (last order food 22:30, drinks 23:00); open all year; a booking is held 15 minutes; smoking allowed at every seat; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; 44 seats (10 at the counter, 34 at tables); Showa retro; creative skewers from ¥100; 'seafood skewers' of seasonal fish and shellfish; sake and shochu; opened 29 May 2013; omakase course ¥1,500, with 90 minutes of drinks ¥3,000, Manpuku course ¥2,300. Reviews (April–September 2026): beef skirt, chicken neck, chicken tail, a fluffy grilled yam, spam steak, pork-wrapped asparagus, bacon-wrapped quail egg, sea bream carpaccio skewer, sweet potato with maple butter, rare wagyu shabu with egg yolk, potato salad with baguette, avocado salad, chicken sashimi, Okinawa-style yakisoba with shisa-shaped kamaboko, horumon stir-fry with garlic rice, garlic beef rice, horumon yakisoba, the blackboard specials; all-you-can-drink ¥1,000; a regular noticed the staff had changed and the calls were quieter; smoking at every seat; from about 15:00 at weekends.

公式サイト: 梅田お初天神大人の神戸牛焼肉、大阪梅田の隠れ家のような焼肉屋、シェ.en: Official site: Umeda Ohatsu Tenjin Otona no Kobe Yakiniku, a hideaway-like yakiniku shop in Osaka Umeda; Kobe beef chosen by the chef and wines that suit yakiniku; virgin Kobe heifers not exceeding 470 kg; A4 rank and above; the tare blends 三ツ星醤油 soy sauce from Wakayama; the sommelier-qualified owner suggests wines; about 80 bottles, mainly French; Kobe beef tabetsukushi course ¥14,300 (¥10,780 with web booking or the newsletter); Kobe beef couple course ¥13,200; sommelier pairing of 4 glasses ¥4,840; owner 酒井 克 (born in Osaka in 1983, about 14 years' training at famous Osaka yakiniku shops, sommelier qualification in 2013, opened in April 2019); 2F, 曽根崎 2-2-12, Kita-ku, Osaka; about 3 min on foot from Higashi-Umeda Station; 17:00–25:00; irregular holidays; 8 counter seats and 4 table seats; no children aged 12 or under. Tabelog (shop-maintained): daily 17:00–1:00; bring-your-own wine ¥3,000 a bottle; non-smoking; opened 29 March 2019; super premium ¥44,000, premium ¥27,500, couple course ¥20,900. Reviews (August–October 2026): courses of ¥9,000 and ¥10,780; seared yukke, kimbap, two kinds of tongue, three salt-grilled and two sauce-grilled cuts; the owner runs the shop alone and speaks English.

公式サイト: 涿屋 (たくや)、お初天神裏、変作豚活、カウンター八席の隠れ家、「.en: Official site: Takuya, behind Ohatsu Tenjin; '変作豚活' (as written); a hideaway with eight counter seats; not 'tonkatsu' but making the most of the pork; the signature black butakatsu has a gluten-free brown-rice crumb ground from house-made 100% brown-rice squid-ink bread, cooked slowly in lard so the inside is faintly pink, eaten with salt; fillet, loin and toro cuts; the course runs from a seasonal starter assortment (soft-cooked egg, sea grapes, seasonal seafood and vegetables) to the butakatsu, finishing with squid-ink risotto or flat-grilled brown-rice fried rice; the menu changes daily; fruit-tomato katsu (an ultra-thin crisp coat); house-smoked dishes; à la carte only is fine; an old-house exterior and a grass-green noren; 8 counter seats, completely non-smoking; the owner runs the shop alone; in the lane near the east torii of Tsuyu Tenjin shrine (Ohatsu Tenjin); 4 min on foot from Higashi-Umeda and Kitashinchi stations; 18:00–23:30 (last order 23:30); closed Sundays and holidays; cards, QR and e-money accepted; reservations by phone only (9:00–17:00, except Sundays and holidays); same-day visits if seats are free. Tabelog (shop member): reservation only; seat charge (otoshi) ¥1,100; 8 seats; non-smoking; children welcome; private courses from ¥80,000 including drinks; Tabelog Tonkatsu 100 in 2018, 2019, 2021, 2024 and 2026. Reviews (April 2025–October 2026): gluten-free tonkatsu; squid-ink and brown-rice crumb; three salts; sudachi; two to four starters with the seat charge; smoked platter (fillet, loin, shoulder); toro katsu; brown rice; squid-ink risotto; a toro katsu course ¥5,500; an ¥8,800 course; fruit-tomato salad; goya sashimi with bonito flakes and junmai soy sauce; brown-rice salt-koji soup; six small bean dishes; yam with aosa; fried yuba; omelette with pancetta; fried sweetfish; fried in lard; no prices on the menu; slow because the owner works alone; a quiet owner; a regular of twelve visits.

公式サイト: 焼肉 㐂舌（きたん）KITAN 大阪 南船場・法善寺・韻、予約ペー.en: Official site: 焼肉 㐂舌 (Kitan) KITAN, Osaka: Minami-Semba, Hozenji and 韻; a booking page (TableCheck 'kitan-in') and links to Tabelog. Tabelog (shop-maintained): Yakiniku Kitan Minami senba, Minami-Semba 4-11-22 B1F (YOC Building), 5 min on foot from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 17:30–23:00 (L.O. food 22:20, drinks 22:30); irregular closures; closed 1 January; lunch and bento takeout ended; 2-hour seating; courses booked by the day before; every seat in a private room (2–20 people); tatami and sunken seating; non-smoking (smoking area outside); Wi-Fi; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 5% service charge from 28 December to 5 January; children welcome (kids menu, toys, children's chairs, Bumbo seats, blankets); English menu; menu with photos; opened 3 June 2019; Yakiniku WEST 100 2021, Yakiniku/Steak WEST 100 2024; affiliated shops 焼肉㐂舌 法善寺 and 㐂舌 響 (steak). Shop text: 㐂舌 means 'the tongue rejoices'; black wagyu aged cut by cut, with dry aging. Courses (tax included): Casual ¥7,700, Namba Senba ¥9,350, Kitan ¥11,000, Premium ¥13,000, with all-you-can-drink ¥10,000 and ¥13,000. Menu (updated 8 September 2026): aged tongue with sudachi instead of lemon, thick-cut tongue ¥3,100, premium thick-cut salted tongue ¥2,300; aged lean beef with salt and grated daikon and ponzu, or sauce; Chateaubriand ¥6,200; dry-aged U.S. Prime outside skirt ¥2,300; special strip loin Yaki-suki ¥4,000 (Oita eggs); horumon in miso sauce; wagyu sushi platter ¥2,750; cold noodles with buckwheat flour; oxtail soup; French toast ¥750; a whole aged tongue to take home ¥9,000. Reviews (August–October 2026): thick-cut tongue, outside skirt, omasum sashimi, wagyu sushi, Awaji Island onion salad, Jeju japchae, Yaki-suki; private rooms throughout, families and young couples; the shop where Kitan was founded; after the renovation; one view that the French toast disappointed; one wish for more kinds of tongue.

公式サイト: 焼肉 侘び寂び 法善寺横丁本店、侘び寂びの美しさを大切に、ただの焼.en: Official site: Yakiniku Wabi Sabi, Hozenji Yokocho main shop; valuing the beauty of wabi-sabi, enjoy the skill of an owner from a kappo background, with a sense of Japan that is more than just yakiniku; a wide range of wines; the stone paving and lanterns of Hozenji; Namba 1-1-5 1F, Chuo-ku, Osaka (inside Hozenji Yokocho); reservations by phone. Tabelog (shop-maintained): daily 17:00–23:00, service charge 10%, cards, iD, PayPay and Alipay accepted, 38 seats, private rooms (2 and 4 people), non-smoking, children welcome, menus in English, Chinese and Korean, English-speaking staff, Muslim-friendly certification, Kobe beef, rare cuts and aged meat, OMAKASE course (Wabi) ¥16,500 for 12 items (aged tongue, today's steak, three lean cuts, wagyu harami, seared salted yukke, seared sushi), opened 1 July 2022. Reviews (August–October 2026): starters of the day such as tempura, kombu-cured sea bream and okra wrapped in pork, three kimchi, aged tongue with sudachi, Kobe beef chateaubriand and sirloin, sukiyaki-style thigh, meat sushi, ice cream and fresh chocolate, semi-private rooms with open ceilings, many overseas customers.

公式サイト: 焼肉 割烹 YP流 宗右衛門町本店、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町1-12.en: Official site: Yakiniku Kappou YPryu Souemoncho main shop, セントラルビル B1, Souemoncho 1-12, Chuo-ku, Osaka, "Japanese-style yakiniku that won't weigh on your stomach", long-fed heifers (Noto beef, Yamagata beef and others), washing sauce, salt and wasabi, the signature "flower staircase platter", about 2,000 parties a year for anniversaries, a "treasure chest with cake" only with the anniversary course, wagyu dashi chazuke and a soy-milk bun, meat butchered by craftsmen at the counter, private rooms from 5, Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00), Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–23:00, irregular closures, single dishes at the main shop only from 26 October 2026. Courses (tax included): meat omakase ¥5,500, Souemoncho course ¥7,700, Kobe beef course ¥10,000, anniversary course ¥10,000, premium anniversary course ¥12,000, clay-pot course ¥11,000 (nine grilled cuts: three tongue, three salt-grilled, three in sauce, plus wagyu sukiyaki), all-you-can-drink ¥2,000 more. Tabelog (shop-maintained): 2-hour limit, 100% cancellation fee from 2 days before, 32 seats (8 counter, tables, a semi-private room for 4, a private room for 5–8), private hire for 20–50, non-smoking, Wi-Fi, the entrance auto-locks so ring the intercom, closed 31 December and 1 January, opened 29 September 2017, popular with young people, couples and overseas travellers. Reviews (October 2026): Souemoncho course ¥7,700, seared yukhoe, three kinds of tongue, Yamagata, Omi, Kobe and Kagoshima beef, wagyu sukiyaki, shigureni, wakame soup, yuzu sherbet, butchering in front of you, plates paced to the diner, a lunch of 15 wagyu and salmon-roe bowls a day, and a report that the lunch meat was thin and overpriced.

公式サイト: 焼肉 割烹 YP流 西心斎橋店、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-1-13.en: Official site: Yakiniku Kappou YPryu Nishi-Shinsaibashi, 東邦ビル B1F, Nishi-Shinsaibashi 1-1-13, Chuo-ku, Osaka, "Japanese-style yakiniku that won't weigh on your stomach", long-fed heifers (Noto beef, Yamagata beef and others), washing sauce, salt and wasabi, the signature "flower staircase platter", a "treasure chest with cake" only with the anniversary course, this branch's fillet-cutlet sandwich, wagyu rice box, tongue yukhoe and sea-urchin and salmon-roe bowl, meat butchered by craftsmen at the counter, a private room for 6, "to make a place where young customers can look good", Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00), Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–23:00, irregular closures, cards and QR accepted. Courses (tax included): weekday-only introductory course ¥5,000, challenge course ¥7,000, heritage course ¥9,000, anniversary course ¥10,000, all-you-can-drink ¥2,000 more. FAQ: dinner is courses only (course guests can add grilled items), lunch is a limited wagyu rice box, dinner is basically by reservation, lunch takes no reservations, no service or cover charge, private hire for 20 or more, children if the private room is free. Tabelog (shop-maintained): 2-hour limit, 32 seats (6 counter, tables, semi-private, a private room for 6), non-smoking, the entrance auto-locks so ring the intercom, sandals and jerseys may be refused, opened 5 June 2022, the representative buys long-reared heifers at auction. Reviews (October 2026): challenge course ¥7,000, a six-cut staircase platter, grill the tongue well and the rest lightly, a smokeless roaster, extra grilled items, lunch rice boxes at ¥1,500 and ¥3,000, broth poured over in hitsumabushi style, and a report that the young part-time staff fell short.

公式サイト: 焼鳥 刻 -TOKI-、大阪市西区新町1丁目20-3 SUKISH.en: Official site: Yakitori Toki -TOKI-, Shinmachi 1-20-3, SUKISHA BLD 1F, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Yotsubashi Station, 7 min from Shinsaibashi Station; two seatings from 18:00 and 20:30; counter for 8 and a private room for 4; irregular closing days; grand opening 1 October 2025; the owner trained at a famous Kitashinchi restaurant, was born in Osaka and spent youth in Yamagata; mainly Yamagata and Hinai jidori; Kishu binchotan charcoal; Japanese and French techniques; the chef picks the vegetables at the market; a counter of 200-year-old hinoki and natural-stone walls; coffered ceiling. Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat, Sun and holidays 18:00–22:30, closed Thursdays; omakase course ¥14,300 (tax included); 10% service charge from 1 July 2026; cards accepted; 14 seats; non-smoking; no children under 12; late arrivals join the course mid-way; unrelated to the same-named shops in Higobashi and Namba. Reviews (October 2026): omakase of about 15 dishes at ¥15,730; pâté de campagne in a monaka; grilled-maitake consommé; chicken breast with shiso genovese; furisode (shoulder); gizzard; skin-on thigh and neck; wings smoked after grilling; truffle-cheese tsukune; chawanmushi; karasumi somen or spiced curry to finish; pumpkin cheesecake; wine and champagne pairings; a young grill master; an orchid for the first anniversary.

公式サイト: 生そば 大黒屋、大正5年創業、109年の歴史を経て2024年末にい.en: Official site: Namasoba Daikokuya, founded Taisho 5 (1916); closed quietly at the end of 2024 after 109 years; inheriting the former head chef, the cooking tools and the signboard, it reopened as the new Daikokuya on 12 December 2025; named after the god Daikokuten, whose statue it also inherited; 下京区東洞院通綾小路下る扇酒屋町287; 11:00–19:00 (last order 18:30); closed Monday; ten-zaru, zaru, nameko, imokake, tori-nanban, kitsune, nishin, curry-nanban, nabeyaki; seasonal sudachi soba, hamo ten-zaru, chilled kitsune, sansai soba, chicken soba. Tabelog: soba, udon; 3 min on foot from Shijo Stn exit 3; no reservations; 20 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome; cards, e-money and QR accepted; English menu. Reviews (May–October 2026, in English): ten-zaru ¥1,900; ō-zaru ¥1,400; okame (shippoku) ¥1,400; half tempura bowl ¥1,450; konoha-don; egg rice bowl; formerly in Pontocho and Daimaru; revived through crowdfunding; some find it a little pricey.

公式サイト: 祖父の湯木貞一は老舗日本料理店「吉兆」の創業者。茶懐石の流れを汲ん.en: Official site: the owner's grandfather 湯木貞一 (Yuki Sadaichi) founded the long-established Japanese restaurant Kitcho. The Honten opened in Kitashinchi to carry on the grandfather's devotion to authentic kaiseki in the tea-ceremony line, to tableware, space and hospitality; the stance of keeping tradition while trying new things came from the grandfather. The Honten has 6 counter seats and 3 private rooms; lunch 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 13:30), dinner 17:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed Sundays and holidays. Foods you dislike or are allergic to can be left out if you say so when booking or on the day.

公式サイト: 立ち呑み 大阪ふぐ太郎、阪急大阪梅田駅から徒歩1分、大阪市北区芝田.en: Official site: Tachinomi Osaka Fugutaro, 1 min on foot from Hankyu Osaka-umeda Station, 2F of the マルシェ芝田 building, Kita-ku, Osaka; domestic tiger fugu at a standing bar; only fully domestic tiger fugu of 1.2 kg or more, prepared in the shop; tessa from ¥528, tecchiri ¥968, fugu zosui ¥748; no courses; Mon, Wed, Fri 14:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30), Tue 16:00–22:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); last entry 30 minutes before last order; closed Thursdays; owner 島本 一樹 (from part-time work at a seafood restaurant to running it, manager of a fugu and crab specialist, going independent and a business failure, opening a fugu specialist, full backing on Reiwa no Tora in February 2025, opening this shop in September 2025 at 39); "fugu should not be a dish only for special days". Tabelog (shop-maintained): standing room for 18; non-smoking; cards accepted; about 30 sakes; homemade ponzu; opened 22 September 2025. Reviews (August–October 2026): tessa ¥480, a small tecchiri pot, fugu skin, kara-age, tempura, nigiri, chilled fin sake, all-you-can-drink sake, a friendly owner.

公式サイト: 紅爐餐廳 ホンルーサンテン、心斎橋の一角の本格台湾料理、店内は有名.en: Official site: Honru Santen, authentic Taiwanese cuisine on a corner of Shinsaibashi, celebrity autographs all over the walls, a long-established shop with many regulars, featured in the media, introduced on どやメシ紀行, the signature stone-pot hot pot, ホワイトビル 1F, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 2-7-12, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 10 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 5, 45 seats (50 if hired), Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00, Sun and holidays 17:00–21:30, closed Sundays (open Sundays and holidays in December), average ¥5,000–6,500, cards (VISA, MASTER), no smoking, Chinese spoken. The chef's career: graduated from Tsuji Culinary Institute in 2015, won the Minister of Health, Labour and Welfare award at the 2015 student competition (Chinese-cuisine winner), trained at the Sheraton in Taipei and at a Taiwanese seafood restaurant in Kaohsiung. Courses (tax included): stone-pot hot pot (two or more) ¥4,730 a person (three starters, noodles to finish), ¥5,610 and ¥6,050 courses (three or more), all-you-can-drink courses ¥6,500–7,500 (seven or more, cash only). À la carte: honey ham with yuba in buns ¥1,200, spring rolls (homemade oyster) ¥1,200, dried-radish omelette ¥1,000, squid balls ¥1,400, shijimi (homemade, marinated in soy sauce) ¥1,400, Taiwanese sausage ¥1,400, pineapple shrimp ¥1,600, shrimp chili ¥1,600, Hakka stir-fry ¥1,300, oysters in black bean ¥1,400, drunken chicken in Shaoxing ¥1,500, garlic pork ¥1,500. Reviews (September 2025–September 2026): the stone-pot broth, oyster spring rolls, dried-radish omelette, soy-marinated shijimi, pig's ear, regulars of 30 years, featured on TV, a friendly owner-chef, a Taiwanese-run restaurant.

公式サイト: 肉タレ屋 なんばBAL店、浪速区難波中2-8-96、南海難波駅・な.en: Official site: Niku Tare Ya Namba BAL, Nambanaka 2-8-96, Naniwa-ku; 5 min on foot from Nankai Namba and Namba Station; right by Namba Parks; all black wagyu is the house's own-ranch "Yamasan beef" (A4-and-above heifers fattened on the directly run Yamasan ranch in Izumi, Kagoshima); "the finest lean meat raised by a 110-year-old butcher"; towering potato salad ¥1,300; roast beef platter; negitoro rolls; seared meat sushi; sirloin steak; fillet steak; KANIKUJYU crab-and-beef box; the roast beef bowl won gold at a national donburi grand prix; rare steak bowl; Wa!!Gyu!!TKG!! is hugely popular with travellers from abroad; highball in a goldfish bowl; lunch 11:00–15:30, dinner 18:00–23:00; closed Tuesday; 75 seats; fully private rooms on the 4th floor (¥2,200 a room); non-smoking throughout; English, Chinese and Korean pages. Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): opened 16 September 2015; multilingual menu (English, Chinese, Korean); English-speaking staff; all-you-can-drink courses from ¥4,400; about 70 drinks. Hot Pepper: Niku Tare Ya Izumisano shop. Reviews (March–November 2026): roast beef bowl, outside skirt bowl, negitoro bowl, beef cutlet, potato salad; courses good value; one wished the meat thicker; one says the prices on the outside board look high; mobile ordering; one-drink minimum; celebrity autographs on the stairs.

公式サイト: 肉割烹 友百合 (ともゆり)、ライブ感のある割烹、全国から取り寄せ.en: Official site: Niku Kappo Tomoyuri, a kappo with a live feel; wagyu brought in from across Japan, as sashimi, seared, charcoal-grilled and simmered; champagne, wine and sake chosen by a sommelier; owner-chef 三井秀和; monthly omakase courses (Kobe beef course ¥33,000, special course ¥24,200, omakase course ¥17,600, tax included); courses start at 18:00 and 20:30; wine pairing, 6 glasses ¥10,000; Tomoyuri original pairing, 7 glasses ¥10,000; service charge extra; 12 counter seats and one table (semi-private for up to 6); 18:00–23:00; closed Sundays, holidays, Obon, New Year and Golden Week; 1F of the ぐらんぱれビル, 曽根崎新地 1-3-26, Kita-ku, Osaka; a sister shop, 北新地 焼肉友ゆり, opened on 13 October 2026. Tabelog (shop-maintained): reservation only; children's plate ¥5,500; 20 seats; 10% service charge; heated tobacco only in the private room; a katsu sandwich to take home; opened 22 April 2023. Reviews (December 2023–October 2026): beef cutlet sandwich; sea-urchin and yukke hand roll; charcoal grilling; kamameshi with a choice of toppings; the chef was formerly head chef at Tsuru Ton Tan; a joking, fun chef; large portions.
