公式サイト: 花郷 和牛鉄板焼と京料理、六本木店と祇園店。食べログ (店舗会員).en: Official site: Hanasato, wagyu teppanyaki and Kyoto cuisine, with a 六本木店 and a 祇園店. Tabelog (shop-maintained): Hanasato Roppongi, Roppongi 4-2-35, VORT六本木Dual’s 1F, 3 min from Roppongi Stn exit 6, across from the new Azabu Police Station; Mon–Fri 12:00–15:00 and 17:30–22:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–15:00 and 17:30–21:00; 10% service charge; 80 seats; private rooms; sunken kotatsu rooms; kappo and teppan counter; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; tell the shop about allergies when booking; opened 8 March 2012. Yonezawa beef teppanyaki and Kyoto cuisine; lunch courses ¥6,050 and ¥7,700. Reviews (March–October 2026): lunches such as a Yonezawa beef steak bowl ¥2,970; dinner ¥8,800–¥55,000; abalone and sirloin; garlic rice; beef-tendon soup with Kujo green onion; soft-shelled turtle soup; birthdays in private rooms; one diner found a fish dish over-sauced.

公式サイト: 蘭亭、【創作中華×世界のワイン】がコンセプト、各店の料理長とソムリ.en: Official site: Rantei; the concept is 'creative Chinese × wines of the world'; each shop's head cook and a sommelier test dishes together; the Rantei special sweet-and-sour pork goes with red or white wine; seasonal ingredients, ingredients rare in Japan, methods from the source; QSCH. Shops: 谷九本店, 本町店, 茶屋町店, 上一店, 南本町店, ルクアバルチカ店, 近鉄上本町店. Lucua Barchika shop: 梅田3-1-3, B2F of Lucua Osaka Barchika, Kita-ku, Osaka; every day 11:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closing days irregular; 34 table seats, 14 counter seats; shop-only dishes (black-vinegar braised-pork sweet-and-sour set, five-starter platter, afternoon tea set). À la carte (tax included, varies by shop): Rantei special sweet-and-sour pork (8 pieces) ¥1,870 (fried Kagoshima mochi-buta, sauce poured on afterwards, green onion); Taiwan ramen ¥1,320 (the signature since the first shop, a soup of minced pork fried with garlic and doubanjiang, then simmered); three-starter platter ¥1,980; large shrimp in mayonnaise sauce ¥1,870; crab fried rice with lettuce ¥1,650; black-vinegar sweet-and-sour pork ¥1,650; hot-and-sour soup ¥1,100; almond tofu ¥605. Lunch set meals: with white rice, pickles, soup and salad, rice and soup refilled free; the special sweet-and-sour pork set is by far the most popular; the Rantei set (sweet-and-sour pork, Taiwan ramen, mixed fried rice). Tabelog (shop member): Chinese, izakaya and ramen; 1 min on foot from JR Osaka Station; the main shop is on Tabelog's Top 100; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 48 seats; non-smoking; opened 23 April 2026; 8-dish course ¥4,000, with all-you-can-drink ¥5,500; afternoon tea ¥1,980. Reviews (September–October 2026): Taiwan ramen ¥1,430; thin Hong Kong-style noodles; plenty of chilli; fried chicken skin as the starter; mapo noodle set ¥1,580 with your choice of heat and numbing; mapo tofu set; fried gyoza and takana pickles; shrimp in mayonnaise; special fried rice; afternoon tea with panda buns.

公式サイト: 道頓堀てっぱんステーキ豊島家、道頓堀1-10-7 ぼんちビル2F、.en: Official site: Dotonbori Teppan Steak Toyoshimake, Dotonbori 1-10-7, ぼんちビル 2F; 5 min on foot from Osaka-Namba Station (Kintetsu, Hanshin), 4 min from Namba Station (Osaka Metro); lunch 12:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:30, reservations only), dinner 17:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); irregular closures; 26 seats; private hire possible; cards and PayPay accepted; same-day cancellations may be charged 100%. A4–A5 Miyazaki beef and Kobe beef; cooks with more than 20 years of experience; a 2 cm iron plate; no wine list, the sommelier suggests; pairing FOUR ¥4,500, SIX ¥6,000. Steak courses (tax included): Chateaubriand 120 g from ¥15,900, fillet 120 g from ¥13,900, two top wagyu brands' Chateaubriand compared, 100 g × 2, from ¥20,000 (soup, chef's small plate, the house mini wagyu burger, homemade chicken tsukune with egg yolk, lobster tail steamed in champagne with américaine sauce or sirloin yaki-shabu with ponzu, roasted vegetables, your choice of steak, fried rice of 八代目儀兵衛's original blended rice, today's dessert); Kobe beef course ¥38,000; Monthly Special omakase course from ¥17,500 (booked by the day before; teppan tonpeiyaki, the taste since opening; seasonal fish steamed in a wrap; Kobe beef chuck sukiyaki 60 g; Miyazaki A5 Chateaubriand 70 g). Lunch (irregular days, no booking needed): Miyazaki sirloin steak set ¥5,000, Miyazaki fillet steak course ¥7,000, fried rice instead of rice +¥800; dinner courses at lunch with booking 3 days ahead; kids plate ¥6,000; takeout (booked 3 days ahead): Philly cheese steak ¥1,900 (popular at Expo 2025 Osaka, Kansai), mini burger and mini shrimp tartar burger set ¥1,500. English site: Since 2005, the Toyoshima brothers; Seafood grill course ¥13,800. Tabelog (shop-maintained): Dotonbori Teppan Toyoshimake; a registered Kobe beef shop; a sommelier chef; weekday mini fillet steak course ¥8,500; reservations first; seat-only bookings get the steak course on the day; one-drink rule; water other than chasers is charged; cards for ¥20,000 or more (except solo diners); 24 seats; private rooms for up to 12; non-smoking; English menu; English-speaking staff; children welcome; opened 9 September 2009; Steak/Teppanyaki WEST 100 2024. Reviews (August 2024–September 2026): mini hamburger, champagne-steamed lobster, Chateaubriand, repeated flambé, called from a table to the counter for the flambé, the certificate for Miyakonojo wagyu, a view of Dotonbori from the window, tsukune dipped in egg, wagyu yaki-shabu, fried rice, in front of Harishige, many overseas guests, just under ¥20,000 with drinks.

公式サイト: 酒菜や (サカナヤ) いしもん 本店、北新地駅・西梅田駅から徒歩1.en: Official site: Sakanaya Ishimon main shop, 1 min on foot from Kitashinchi and Nishi-Umeda stations; a casual kappo where fresh fish, obanzai, tempura and more are enjoyed at fair prices, with sake chosen to match the food; each dish made with care, picturing the customer's smile; no regular closing day; Sun 15:00–22:00, Mon–Thu 17:00–23:30, Fri 17:00–24:00, Sat 16:00–23:00. Dishes (tax included): omakase sashimi assortment of seven kinds ¥1,200; new-season sanma salt-grilled ¥950; new-season sanma sashimi ¥950; ma-fugu milt (tempura or soy-grilled) ¥980; live hamo (blanched, seared or tempura) ¥1,500; salt tataki of autumn bonito ¥950. Takeaway: nigiri, regular 15 pieces ¥2,980, regular 20 pieces ¥3,980. Notice of a new shop, 'Ishimon in 2 Building'. Company name ishimon LLC; the brands are Ishimon and Sushi-dokoro Ishimon. Tabelog (shop member): Ishimon main shop, izakaya, seafood and sake bar, 梅田1-3-1, B2F of Osaka Station Front Building No. 1, Kita-ku, Osaka; 1 min on foot from Kitashinchi and Nishi-Umeda stations; hours as on the official site; closing days not fixed; reservations accepted; two-hour limit when busy; solo diners by phone (one hour); Mon–Thu, 60-minute seat-only bookings (no seat charge); cards and e-money accepted, no QR; 13 seats; e-cigarettes only; takeaway; opened 2 April 2013; about 20 sakes (Dassai, Kameizumi and others); sister shops Ishimon in 2 Building and Sushi-dokoro Ishimon. Reviews (June 2025 – October 2026): sashimi assortment (thick-cut; kue in it one day); bonito with salt; Bungo beef tataki with sea urchin and salmon roe; crab miso with cream cheese; uzaku; water eggplant; lotus root with sansho; sesame tofu; fried eggplant soaked in broth; eel spring rolls; shrimp tempura; a small braised-beef rice bowl; salt-grilled sanma; duck; about ¥7,000 for two; almost full at 5 pm; counter seats divided by tape; one diner found the small dishes better than the fish.

公式サイト: 野菜料理に日本酒・日本ワインをペアリングするレストラン、自然栽培・.en: Official website: a restaurant that pairs vegetable dishes with sake and Japanese wine; "lacto-ovo vegetarian" food from naturally and organically grown vegetables with dairy and eggs; the chef is 竹口, former owner of two sake specialty shops that were in Yotsuya-sanchome; about 150 Japanese wines in stock; non-alcoholic pairing (including post-fermented tea); Mon–Sat (holidays included) lunch 12:00–15:00 (except Wednesday) and dinner 17:00–23:00; reservation only; closed Sunday and over New Year; Wakaba 1-21-2, ベルビー四谷 1F; 10 min walk from Yotsuya Station. Tabelog: vegetable dishes, innovative, organic; 12 seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 8 March 2021; plant-based-only food on request when booking; a course with meat and seafood on Tuesdays; courses ¥8,000–25,000; vegetables from the contract farms sold one Saturday a month. Reviews (2024–2026): a whole rare taro; fritters of rice flour and sparkling water; sake in a five-sided cup.

公式サイト: 銀座いち分、銀座の片隅に夫婦二人で暖簾を掲げたカウンター9席の店、.en: Official site: Ginza Ichibun, a 9-seat counter in a corner of Ginza where a married couple hung a noren, opened in early summer 2017; in-house fish tanks, ice-temperature aging and low-temperature cooking with Japanese food culture; 小川武士; omakase course (5–7 snacks, 10–12 nigiri, soup, tamagoyaki, rolls, about 18 items in all) ¥28,600; rice quantity adjustable; no lunch; sake from ¥1,800; online booking only; no smoking; no overly casual clothes; junior-high age and up; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; two sittings at 18:00 and 20:15; closed Wed and Sun; Ginza 2-13-19, Ginza Alca Building 1F (7 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station). Tabelog: 9 seats (counter only); open on holidays. 2026 reviews: an unsigned wooden door, hairy crab with crab miso, three kinds of uni, miso-marinated salmon roe, smoked tuna, yuzu-scented chawanmushi, abalone, torigai, herring served only for about two weeks, omakase ¥25,300 (June), ¥28,600 (August).

公式サイト: 銀座鳥繁、昭和6年(1931)創業、初代 保立繁之助が妻・なかとと.en: Official site: Ginza Torishige, founded Showa 6 (1931); the founder, 保立繁之助, with the founder's wife, なか, pushed a street stall out from behind the Kabukiza to the Kojunsha's fuel store; the founder had been a kappō cook; set up a shop in Showa 14 and passed it to the second generation; at the present spot since Showa 33; a yakitori shop three generations old; "never cut a single corner"; the famous dry curry comes from a staff meal made with curry powder a customer brought as a gift; warm sake from a pure-silver kettle; 90th-anniversary course ¥8,600, aigamo loin course ¥9,500 (new prices from January 2025); dry curry & chicken soup ¥1,000; yakitori ¥600–850; wild fowl 11/15–2/15; weekdays 17:00–22:00, Sat 16:00–21:00; closed Sundays, holidays and fifth Saturdays; tell the shop about allergies when booking. Tabelog: 38 seats; cards and e-money accepted; phone bookings suspended, book online; the shop introduction calls it a family shop three generations old.

公式サイト: 香港海鮮飲茶樓 心斎橋本店、本格海鮮料理と香港飲茶、大阪市中央区東.en: Official site: Hong Kong Seafood Yum cha Ro, Shinsaibashi main shop, authentic seafood and Hong Kong dim sum, ロンスカール高吉ビル 2F, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-12-17, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 6 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station, 4 min from Nagahoribashi Station, on the second floor above a 7-Eleven, lunch 11:00–15:00, dinner 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30 weekdays, 22:00 weekends and holidays), occasional closures, step-free from the entrance so wheelchairs are fine, one hour at the partner car park with ¥5,000 spent. Dim sum made by a special-grade dim sum master (a Chinese national qualification, eight grades, at least fifteen years), more than twenty years of cooking, live fish bought direct from the market put into the shop's tank, Chinese-style sashimi with a special Chinese-style sauce, sesame and cashews, the traditional beauty tea 'Kowloon tea' with a tea-ceremony performance, dishes changed as far as possible for allergies or dislikes. Lunch: weekly sets ¥850–1,300, free rice and soup refills, dim sum course ¥1,950, house dim sum course ¥2,480, healthy course ¥3,590, xiaolongbao set ¥1,480, five-dim-sum set ¥1,750. Menu: live fish from ¥5,500, live abalone from ¥1,540, shrimp mayonnaise ¥1,520, crab and glass noodles with XO sauce in a clay pot ¥1,850, Peking duck (one roll) ¥660, sweet-and-sour pork ¥1,680, braised whole shark fin ¥8,800, whole braised abalone ¥5,500. Run by 會通株式会社 (also an Umeda shop and Ichiraku Onsen Hotel). Tabelog (shop-maintained): daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00, holidays dinner only, open year-round, service charge 3%, 110 seats, private rooms, non-smoking (smoking area outside), children and strollers welcome, courses with all-you-can-drink from ¥5,980, Chinese WEST 100 2021. Reviews (August–October 2026): a ¥1,000 set lunch, the same lunch at weekends, dim sum with homemade wrappers, shark fin soup, mildly spicy mapo tofu, seafood tofu, xiaolongbao, 11 dishes with 90 minutes of drinks for ¥6,980, a lift straight into the restaurant, Chinese staff, a report of a blunt answer, and one that the Tabelog 100 days are long gone.

公式サイト: 馬肉料理専門店ホース、おいしい馬肉で美容と健康、大阪市中央区東心斎.en: Official site: Banikuryori Senmon Ten Horse, delicious horse meat for beauty and health, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 2-3-12, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 10 min walk from Shinsaibashi subway station exit 6, last order 22:00, closed Sundays and holidays, 6 counter seats, 3 tables, 10–20 on 2F, non-smoking. Menu: two starters ¥1,000, 高根 (under the mane, rich in collagen) ¥800, horse sashimi ¥3,800, raw liver ¥3,800, sakura natto (winter-only straw-wrapped natto ordered from Kumamoto, with horse meat) ¥950, sakura yukke ¥900, saiboshi (smoked horse) ¥1,600, korikori ¥3,200, seared cut ¥3,800, yakiniku set ¥6,300 a person (two or more), horse steak ¥6,500, harihari hot pot of horse meat (a secret broth from horse tendon, Chinese noodles to finish) ¥5,000, courses for two or more: hot pot course ¥7,500, steak course ¥8,600, W course ¥10,500, draft beer ¥680. Tabelog (shop-maintained): Mon–Sat 17:00–21:30, closed Sundays and holidays, reservations accepted (cancel by the day before), cards accepted, 41 seats, 2F for private hire for 9 or more, sunken seating, non-smoking, English menu, children welcome, devoted to horse meat since 1982. Reviews (December 2025–October 2026): Kumamoto horse meat, a kind owner, many regulars, staff show how to eat the hot pot, three kinds of sashimi, saiboshi, steak, harihari hot pot, takikomi rice, noodles to finish, sakura yukke, 45 years of history, and one that the satisfaction did not match the price.

公式サイト: 魚河岸 宮武、京都中央卸売市場に隣接する島原の看板のない大人の隠れ.en: Official site: Uogashi Miyatake; a sign-less grown-up hideaway in Shimabara next to the Kyoto Central Wholesale Market; an open-kitchen izakaya; “seasonal fish dishes as close as possible to ryotei standard, served as an izakaya”; counter and chopping board at the same height; 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Sunday and holidays; reservations by phone (14:00–22:00); 10 counter seats; 24 tatami seats; main supplier 河市水産; 3 min on foot from JR Tambaguchi Station. Tabelog: 下京区西新屋敷下之町6-5 アンクル島原1F; lunch suspended; cards, e-money and QR accepted; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; junior-high age and up; opened 1 October 2012. Reviews (2025–2026, in English): courses at ¥6,000 and ¥9,900; akou; ojisan; yellowtail grilled with shio-koji; simmered kinmedai head; cod fry; omakase nigiri; marinated mackerel.

公式サイト: 鮨 天ぷら いわい、兵庫県芦屋市の「天ぷら&ワイン いわい」から始.en: Official site: Sushi Tempura Iwai began as 'Tempura & Wine Iwai' in Ashiya, Hyogo; one Michelin star two years running; later opened in Gion, Ginza, Hiroshima and elsewhere, some shops adding Edo-style sushi; the owner holds wine-sommelier and vegetable-sommelier qualifications, was born into a family that ran a Japanese restaurant and has long hotel experience; shops in Kitashinchi, Hiroshima, Gion, Kichijoji and Ginza. The Kitashinchi shop: 曽根崎新地 1-9-11 1F, Kita-ku, Osaka; lunch 11:30–14:00, dinner 17:00–23:00 (Sat, Sun and holidays 16:00–23:00); closing days not fixed; 10% service charge. Tabelog (shop-maintained): Kitashinchi Sushi Tempura Iwai Bettei; 2 min on foot from Kitashinchi Station; weekday-only lunch nigiri set ¥4,990, lunch omakase ¥6,990, premium omakase with tempura ¥9,990; 20 seats; private rooms for 2, 4 and 6; non-smoking; children allowed; opened 10 September 2023. Reviews (January–October 2026): a ¥10,000 course and a ¥6,990 course; appetizers, tempura, nigiri, a small ikura bowl, chawanmushi; the chef explains the dishes and eases nerves; rare sake and beer; the tempura is soft rather than crisp; if you are in a hurry, say so first.

公式サイト: 鮨いわもと、大阪梅田・北新地の寿司屋、大将 正木 美則、16歳から.en: Official site: Sushi Iwamoto, a sushi shop in Umeda-Kitashinchi, Osaka; head chef 正木美則 entered the culinary world at 16, worked at first-class hotels, ryokan and restaurants, starting with Kyoto kaiseki and training at top shops of sushi, teppan and meat kappo. Tabelog (shop member): Sushi Iwamoto, sushi, seafood and Japanese cuisine, 日宝堂島センタービル 1F, 1-3-9 堂島, Kita-ku, Osaka; 3 min from Kitashinchi Station; 4 min from Nishi-Umeda Station; dinner in two seatings (all start together at 18:00 and 20:30); lunch from 12:00 on Sundays and some Saturdays; closed Wednesdays and some holidays; reservation only; no service charge; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 8 seats at a single-plank hinoki counter; non-smoking; opened 27 April 2018; Tabelog Sushi WEST 100 2022; rice of red vinegar and salt only, no sugar; seasonal omakase ¥22,000; Saturday omakase sushi lunch of 15 items ¥12,000. Reviews (February–October 2026): many overseas guests; explanations in English; explanation cards and menus for foreign guests; a comment of a 10% service charge; clam soup; seared bonito with fresh wasabi; sea bream; a cream dish; sea-urchin bowl; abalone with liver sauce, sweet potato and rice-flour bread; chutoro and akami; Spanish mackerel; gari mixed with wakame; an extra-large toro-taku; served to suit a left-handed diner; a fan since the earlier meat-kappo restaurant; a comment that the head chef said little.

公式サイト: 鮨末吉 (一部・おまかせ鮨) とBAR末吉 (二部)、同じカウンタ.en: Official site: Sushi Sueyoshi (part one, omakase sushi) and BAR Sueyoshi (part two), at the same counter. Sushi dinner 17:00–22:00, lunch 12:00–14:00 (by reservation made by 17:00 the day before); the bar 22:00–04:00; closing days irregular. Omakase courses only (about 90 minutes): omakase sushi ¥8,800, with all-you-can-drink ¥11,000, with hairy-crab starter, sea-urchin nigiri and all-you-can-drink ¥15,400 (tax included). Fresh domestic hon-maguro bought direct from Toyosu's まぐろ大善, founded 400 years ago, compared from lean cuts to rare ones. Local fish sent direct by fishermen in Hokkaido, Nagasaki's Goto islands and elsewhere, made into Edomae sushi. A single-plank hinoki counter. Bar all-you-can-drink 60 minutes ¥3,000, 30-minute extension ¥1,500, 白州, 響 and 山崎 included. Roppongi 3-11-10, Coco Roppongi Building 1F. Instagram @roppongi_sueyoshi, @barsueyoshi. Tabelog (shop-maintained): 6 seats, counter only, opened 3 July 2026, daily 12:00–14:00 and 17:00–22:00, cards accepted, English-speaking staff.

公式サイト: 鮨森学、中京区木屋町通二条下る東生洲町489番地、京都舞鶴と全国か.en: Official site: Sushi Mori Gaku; 中京区木屋町通二条下る東生洲町489番地; seasonal fish chosen from Maizuru in Kyoto and across Japan; sushi and small dishes at the counter as an omakase course; a calm, bar-like room; an owner with more than 30 years of experience across Japanese cuisine; reservations only; lunch 12:00–14:00; dinner first seating 18:00–20:00, second 20:30–22:30 (all start together); closed Wednesday; cards accepted. Tabelog: 8 seats; service charge; e-money and QR accepted; BYO allowed; non-smoking; children welcome; opened 2 June 2024. Reviews (2025–2026, in English): about 17 dishes at dinner; straw-grilled bonito; mackerel seared with charcoal; squid with charcoal salt; anago in a bamboo steamer; wagyu shabu-shabu; the owner, Inoue.

公式サイトおよびメニューは日本語のみ。英語対応の記載なし。電話予約のみのため、日.en: The official site and menu are Japanese only. No mention of English. Phone booking only, so Japanese or an interpreter is needed.

公式サイトが1983年愛知県生まれ・フランス留学・2015年シェフ就任の林シェフ.en: The official site states that Chef Hayashi was born in Aichi in 1983, studied in France and became chef in 2015. nagoya-meshi confirms the 140-year-old Meiji-era house and wine cellar; WEB Otona no Nagoya confirms the manager, the upstairs private rooms used for anniversaries, game and Isshiki (Mikawa) hamo. Goto abalone and tiger prawns were not confirmed in any source and were removed.

公式サイトが『おこもみじ』(お好み焼き×もみじ饅頭)を木村屋の登録商標と明記。デ.en: The official site states that 'Okomomiji' (okonomiyaki × momiji manjū) is Kimuraya's registered trademark. The signature item with Danish cream cheese and the various flavours were confirmed on the oyakode blog.

公式サイトが『パスタとグルテンフリーのお菓子のお店』と明記し、グルテンフリーパス.en: The official site states 'a shop of pasta and gluten-free sweets', with a notice that the gluten-free pasta uses the same pot as wheat noodles so no allergy guarantee is possible. Nikkan KELLY introduced the December 2021 opening. Baked goods use rice flour and buckwheat flour and are sold online via BASE.

公式サイトが代表 大坪俊次・運営 株式会社ヒノボ・1回の仕込みで鶏ガラと豚骨13.en: The official site confirms representative Shunji Otsubo, operator Hinobo Inc., 130 kg of chicken bones and pork bones simmered on high heat for 8 hours in one batch, keeping umami seasonings to a minimum, safe for children too, and naturally brewed soy sauce. kyotopi (p7WqE) confirms the move from in front of Kintetsu Fushimi Station to Fushimi Inari, a spot on the shrine approach (Sandan Kaido), stone-pot tsukemen, house-made pastrami, and thick flat noodles with whole-grain flour.

公式サイトが創業約28年・県外からも来客、伊勢湾の魚介を提供と記載。メニューペー.en: The official site says the shop has been going about 28 years, draws customers from outside the prefecture and serves Ise Bay seafood. The menu page confirms a seafood bowl at ¥2,650 (salted salmon and an original sauce under the rice), a sashimi set (8 kinds of seasonal sashimi, the house best) and a wild kuruma prawn fry set.

公式サイトが国際薬膳調理師・名古屋辻学園調理師専門学校講師・化学調味料/白砂糖不.en: The official site confirms: an international medicinal-cuisine cook, an instructor at Nagoya Tsuji Gakuen culinary school, no MSG or white sugar, natural salt and kōji, medicinal-cooking classes by the 24 solar terms (five a year), and few seats. Search results confirm rice and soybean oil, raw sugar, house-made shio-kōji and shōyu-kōji, hon-mirin, and vegan / gluten-free / no-pungent-roots options. The owner's name could not be supported by the official site or search results and was removed. Gluten-free is stated as available, not as an absolute guarantee of safety for celiacs.

公式サイトが新天地本店(八丁堀近く)、『NO GYOZA, NO LIFE!』、.en: The official site confirms the Shintenchi main shop (near Hatchobori), 'NO GYOZA, NO LIFE!', the company's own gyoza factory, Carp gyoza with red wrappers (juicy filling and love for the Carp), and mapo tofu with plenty of sansho.

公式サイトが築約100年の古民家で伝統的建造物に選定、あなごめしと手作り甘味を確.en: The official site confirms an old house about 100 years old designated a traditional building, anagomeshi and handmade sweets. japan-stroll confirms the location near Takikoji and Fujidana Park, an interior that makes use of old beams, and handmade warabi-mochi with kuromitsu and kinako. The anago cooking method, cha-soba and half-portion set could not be supported and were removed.

公式サイトが銀山町近く、イタリアンベースの独創料理、店主選定ワイン、契約農家の有.en: The official site confirms a spot near Kanayama-cho, original Italian-based cooking, wines chosen by the owner, organic vegetables from contract farmers, whole roasted broccoli, beef steak, Iberico chorizo with dried figs, mussels, and a self-serve system for barrel wine.

公式サイトで瀬下努(1977年長野県生)・東京の調理師学校後オテル・ドゥ・ミクニ.en: The official site confirms Tsutomu Seshimo (born 1977 in Nagano Prefecture); after cooking school in Tokyo, 12 years at Hôtel de Mikuni; head chef in Izu and at Sankara in Yakushima; opened December 2016; the name means 'encounter'. Hitosara confirms a renovated 150-year-old house, 18 seats, and a garden of home-grown herbs and flowers.

公式サイトと osumituki より、1998年下鴨（左京区）開業、幻の岩倉ラ.en: The official site and osumituki confirm opening in 1998 in Shimogamo (Sakyo-ku), the lineage phantom Iwakura ramen → Yamasan ramen (later moved to Shiga), the philosophy 'people move by the heart', chicken (shank) and pork bone 7:3 with old hens, back fat, thin-sliced chāshū, Kyoto negi, a twice-brewed tare of Sawai soy sauce, Rairaiken medium-thin straight noodles, and fried rice scorched with egg and pork fat. An alternative spelling of the shop name, 'Kairaikian', is not in the sources and was removed.

公式サイトとTabelogで、近江町いちば館2階、朝の市場仕入れ、名物『海の宝石.en: The official site and Tabelog confirm: 2nd floor of Omicho Ichiba-kan; bought at the morning market; the famous 'jewel box of the sea' seafood hitsumabushi (three ways: sesame sauce → sea urchin and condiments → dashi chazuke); an all-crab course; blackthroat-seaperch dishes.

公式サイトとTabelogにより、2012年7月1日開業・築100年の京町家（東.en: The official site and Tabelog confirm opening on 1 July 2012 in a 100-year-old Kyoto townhouse (Shimoyanagi-cho, Higashiyama-ku, in a back alley of Miyagawacho, 24 seats in all), run by a woman owner who is Kyoto born and bred (healthy meals crafted by a genuine Kyoto woman chef). The signatures are 'Kyoto breakfast', soy-milk yuba porridge with rich soy milk and fresh yuba from a local tofu shop, grilled mackerel / salmon, dashimaki, an obanzai set, and pudding and pudding parfait. 'Pound cake made without butter' and 'ice cream with rabbit cookies' could not be confirmed in sources and were removed.

公式サイトとcorezoで、元魚屋の店主が長年の技術で素材の旨みを引き出す、近江.en: The official site and corezo confirm: an owner, a former fishmonger, who draws out the ingredients' flavour with long-practised skill; buys from Yamaka Suisan in Omicho Market; seafood bowls of tuna, crab, yellowtail, blackthroat seaperch, salmon roe and sea urchin (on plain Ishikawa Koshihikari, not vinegared rice); sashimi, jibuni, Kaga-vegetable tempura.

公式サイトとfood-japonで、店主平田賢太郎、2015年8月8日片町開業、.en: The official site and food-japon confirm: owner Hirata Kentaro; opened in Katamachi on 8 August 2015; the name means 'building a circle'; a branch in Kanazawa Station's Anto; 'drinkable dashi' of Rishiri kombu, several kinds of shaved fish, Ono soy sauce and Noto salt; house-made chikuwa, hanpen and burdock tempura; creations such as egg topped with salmon roe, fried pork, cod-roe oden and beef-tendon mapo.

公式サイトとsyokukiのレビューで、芳醇醤油・濃厚ゴマの2系統、低加水麺、四.en: The official site and syokuki reviews confirm the two lines (aromatic shoyu, rich sesame), low-hydration noodles, flavour changes with four kinds of sansho and ginseng vinegar, several shops including Yokohama, and the Singapore aubergine curry from the parent shop 'Himawari'. A link with yakitori and tsukemen shops could not be supported and was removed.

公式サイトとぐるなび・gorpで確認：浜の味処 天びん屋グループ(本店・一番街店.en: Confirmed on the official site, Gurunavi and gorp: the Hama no Ajidokoro Tenbinya group (main shop, Ichiban-gai shop, Amiyaki); the ama diver's kamameshi is a certified Toba local bento; a seafood bowl of six kinds plus sea urchin and salmon roe; Ise udon and tekone-zushi.

公式サイトとたびいろで、明治44年（1911）創業、『和菓子の基本は美味しい餡づ.en: The official site and Tabiiro confirm: founded Meiji 44 (1911); the creed 'the foundation of wagashi is making delicious bean paste'; the famous fukusa mochi and the classic Kanazawa souvenir brown-sugar fukusa mochi; gold-leaf azuki soft serve only at the main shop; Japanese chestnut Mont Blanc; the famous Kakiho (kinako and black sesame); the dry sweet wari-gori.

公式サイトとアレルギー系ブログ(dessa)で、2024年3月23日におりづるタ.en: The official site and an allergy blog (dessa) confirm Akushu Café's renewal on the 1st floor of Orizuru Tower on 23 March 2024, the Yamada Nishiki 'white-rice silk soft serve' (rice, beans, coconut milk), the use of Hiroshima fruit blemished by weather, and soft serve and puffed rice with no egg, dairy or wheat (with illustrated allergen labels).

公式サイトとエスパシオのプレスリリース（PR TIMES 000000113）が.en: The official site and Espacio's press release (PR TIMES 000000113) support head chef Nakanishi Kohei's career (about 9 years at La Rochelle → Michelin restaurants in France → 7 years at SUGALABO from 2015, La Liste 2020 world No. 1) and the serving of organic matcha from Ishikawa Seicha in Toyota as CUZEN MATCHA.

公式サイトとブログ・検索で確認：2013年12月30日創業、1階物販＋2階カフェ.en: Confirmed on the official site, blogs and searches: founded 30 December 2013; shop on the first floor and café on the second; house-roasted coffee, seafood curry and house-made waffles. Corrected: what architect 藤原徹平 designed is Hinoyama Lab (the Senkiraku project), opened in 2023, not the second floor of the main shop.

公式サイトとホットペッパーが、丸の内（中区）徒歩1分・シーアイマンション1Fの7.en: The official site and HotPepper confirm the 70-seat main shop on the 1st floor of a mansion block, 1 minute on foot in Marunouchi (Naka-ku); daily buying from Yanagibashi Market; soba made by hand every morning from Hokkaido buckwheat flour; spicy daikon from Shinshu; and Hanare, a 160-year-old separate building, by reservation only.

公式サイトとメニューで確認：鳥羽一番街3階・駅隣接、伊勢うどん、鳥羽産しらす釜玉.en: Confirmed on the official site and menu: third floor of Toba Ichiban-gai, next to the station; Ise udon, Toba whitebait kamatama udon, large shrimp tempura, oysters and fresh aosa (winter), sudachi (summer), akamoku seaweed, Matsusaka beef. Corrected あおさ to aosa.

公式サイトと伊勢志摩観光ナビで確認：昭和51年(1976)創業、鳥羽駅隣接の鳥羽.en: Confirmed on the official site and the Ise-Shima tourism navigator: founded 1976 (Shōwa 51); a classic coffee shop inside Toba Ichiban-gai next to Toba Station; famous for the Tobager (octopus, mayo and nut topping, about ¥780), local pasta and curry.

公式サイトと現地レポートによれば、ミネルヴァは鳥羽駅前・鳥羽一番街1階のジェラー.en: According to the official site and on-site reports, Minerva is a gelato shop on the first floor of Toba Ichiban-gai in front of Toba Station, with the slogan 'Delivered fresh from the factory' (made in Futami, Ise City). It uses milk from Okoppe, Hokkaido, and its signature is the Pearl Latte (milk gelato with pearl powder, said to be good for the skin). It has Ise-Shima local flavours such as Iwato salt, Ise tea and kinko sweet potato.

公式サイトと食べログによると、オーナーシェフ(鹿部戸)は20年以上フランス料理を.en: According to the official site and Tabelog, the owner-chef (Kabuto) trained in French cooking for over 20 years and serves reservation-only omakase courses fusing French cuisine and kaiseki in a remodelled old house in Shikemichi, Nagoya. Squid sōmen, spiny lobster gratin, sea bream chazuke and more are signatures. 24 seats in all, with private rooms for 4–20. Attentive touches such as the napkins are praised.

公式サイトと食べログによれば、三条坊はJR奈良駅直結のビエラ奈良1階で2010年.en: According to the official site and Tabelog, Sanjobo opened in October 2010 on the first floor of Viera Nara, connected to JR Nara Station, with about 29 seats. Curry udon, beef bowls and grated-yam udon of Nara's brand beef 'Yamato beef', and 'Stamina-ra udon', Nara's stamina ramen made as udon, are the specialities. Udon, soba and drinks.

公式サイトと鳥羽市観光協会で確認：名物ガンガン焼き(浦村産牡蠣・通年提供・2〜3.en: Confirmed on the official site and the Toba tourism association: the signature gangan-yaki (Uramura oysters, served all year, flash-frozen at −60 °C in February–March), Ise chicken, finest Matsusaka beef and a special miso sauce. Grade A4 is not in the sources, so changed to 'finest'.

公式サイトによると昭和元年（1926）西区新道で創業、3代目が継承。出汁は先代か.en: According to the official site, founded in Showa 1 (1926) in Shindo, Nishi-ku, now run by the third generation. The dashi is made from muro-bushi as handed down from the previous generation, and tamari soy sauce is used. Beef-tendon tsukimi kishimen and miso-nikomi udon are the signatures.

公式サイトに全品目のアレルゲン一覧ページが整備されており、原材料を事前に確認でき.en: The official site has an allergen list page for every product, so you can check the ingredients beforehand.

公式サイトは2003年西陣で夫婦開業、元経営コンサルタントの主人が岐阜の妻の実家.en: The official site records opening in 2003 in Nishijin as a married couple; the husband, a former management consultant, served 8 years as head chef at the soba shop of the wife's family in Gifu; the name comes from the painter Nicolas de Staël; contract-grown Hitachi Aki soba, low-oxygen storage at 7 °C, stone-milled 100% buckwheat every morning; a sommelier / SAKE DIPLOMA; and soba-mae such as karasumi and duck.

公式サイトは「ご予算・ご要望に合わせてコースをご用意」と記載しており、アレルギー.en: The official site says 'we prepare courses to suit your budget and wishes'; confirming allergies by phone when booking is recommended. English service unconfirmed.

公式サイトは「小麦粉・卵・乳製品・白砂糖を使わず、米粉を使った焼き菓子」の Ve.en: The official site states a Vegan & Gluten-free workshop of 'baked sweets made with rice flour, with no wheat flour, egg, dairy or white sugar'. Opened in December 2019 in Kamiyasu, Asaminami-ku (former site of a takoyaki shop). Open Wednesday–Saturday 10:00–16:00, closing when sold out.

公式サイトは『創業50余年 地元に愛される老舗』とうたう近江町市場の回転寿司。U.en: The official site bills it as 'a long-established shop loved locally for over 50 years': conveyor-belt sushi in Omicho Market. A U-shaped counter (about 20–25 seats). Reopened after renovation on 17 June 2024. The master buys and picks the fish personally every morning. Mainly local fish (white shrimp, sweet shrimp, kombu-cured fish and more). Orders on paper slips.

公式サイトは『祖父の代から受け継いだ出雲そば』と女将のブログを掲げる。しにせ探訪.en: The official site features 'Izumo soba handed down from grandfather's generation' and the okami's blog. A shinise-visit blog reports founding in 1919 (Taisho 8), a corner location at the Kannon-machi tram stop, the hand-making area to the right inside, sanmi soba (egg, grated yam, grated daikon) and the dog figurines lined up out front.

公式サイト・IDENTITY名古屋によると、四間道・堀川西岸の築約150年の米蔵.en: According to the official site and IDENTITY Nagoya, a renovated rice storehouse about 150 years old (Edo period) on the west bank of the Hori River in Shikemichi. Run directly by Sekiya Brewery, a Mikawa sake brewer. The philosophy is 'good brewing makes good sake'. Earthen walls and pillars are kept. 32 seats in the restaurant, 16 in the bar.

公式サイト・Jalan・Tabelog が、約140年の歴史をもつ湯田中温泉の源.en: The official site, Jalan and Tabelog confirm a ryokan with about 140 years of history in Yudanaka Onsen, with free-flowing hot-spring water (4 sources, 2 open-air baths), serving local kaiseki by the head chef. No gluten-free handling is published; only individual consultation in advance.

公式サイト・gorpのメニューページ・ヒトサラが、龍王を薬研堀（1-13、胡町・.en: The official site, gorp's menu page and Hitosara describe Ryuoh as a 'familiar Hiroshima Chinese restaurant' in Yagenbori (1-13, about 5 minutes on foot from the Ebisucho and Kanayama-cho tram stops), serving set meals, à la carte dishes and noodles and rice, open late Monday–Saturday 17:00–3:00, with ramen that has a good aftertaste. Specific individual menu names could not be confirmed in any source, so the description was generalised.

公式サイト・v-trip・食べログより、運営MASTERMIND社・エグゼクティ.en: The official site, v-trip and Tabelog confirm operation by MASTERMIND, executive chef Akira Mori, 'Japanese gyoza' finished with bonito dashi and Yamari country miso without Chinese seasonings, a refined taste with the garlic smell held back, local sourcing such as Kyoto mochi pork, Kujo negi and cabbage from 中嶋農園 in Fushimi (Kyoto Mayor's Prize), and a sauce of black-roasted shichimi and Chidori vinegar.

公式サイト・ヒトサラで、片町3階の金沢おでん・おばんざい酒場、車麩や赤巻き入りの.en: The official site and Hitosara confirm: a Kanazawa oden and obanzai tavern on a third floor in Katamachi; Kanazawa oden with kurumabu and akamaki; daily obanzai; tea-shochu highballs (green tea, jasmine, etc.); a counter that welcomes solo guests; late-night bar hours. Fried chicken and mapo tofu were not confirmed, so changed to general wording.

公式サイト・ブログで確認：2017年7月開店、昭和通りの元家具店を改装、シェフは.en: Confirmed on the official site and blogs: opened July 2017 in a converted former furniture shop on Shōwa-dōri; the chef trained in Canada and New York, then worked at a Nagano hotel; house-made focaccia of soy milk and mixed grains; game (venison, boar); deli plates; a sign saying 'babies' crying welcome'.

公式サイト・奈良ランチ・奈良グルメ図鑑で、三条町の築120年以上の町家を改装した.en: The official site, Nara Lunch and the Nara Gourmet Guide confirm a café in a renovated townhouse over 120 years old in Sanjo-cho. It uses local ingredients, such as stewed hamburgs of Yamato beef and Yamato pork, hamburgs in thick sauce, hojicha-smoked loin and lattes of Yagyū-grown Yamato tea, and welcomes families with tatami seating, deer motifs and a nursing room. The opening year could not be confirmed in any source.

公式サイト・食べログで2020年3月10日開業、名古屋市西区上名古屋、浄心駅徒歩.en: The official site and Tabelog confirm the opening on 10 March 2020, Kami-Nagoya, Nishi-ku, Nagoya, about 10 minutes on foot from Joshin Station, 16 seats (6 at the counter, 10 on sofas), house-roasted coffee and sandwiches on house-made focaccia / ciabatta, and baked goods sold at AEON Town Meisei. The owner is named only as 'the master'.

公式サイト・食べログ・なごなび・名古屋メシ等によれば、名古屋市中川区荒子のグルテ.en: According to the official site, Tabelog, Nagonavi, Nagoya Meshi and others, a gluten-free specialist café in Arako, Nakagawa-ku, Nagoya, with no wheat flour or white sugar, serving rice-flour bread, lunches and tarts. Run in cooperation with a pâtisserie (Firenze). The name COrPO means 'body' in Italian. The owner's or chef's personal name is not published.

公式サイト・食べログ・アットプレス各リリース・KYOTOLIFE・life-in.en: Putting together the official site, Tabelog, @Press releases, KYOTOLIFE, life-info, the Magewappa blog and Ludico Inc.'s releases: the parent is Ludico Inc. (representative 鳥井和機), which runs Ikariya Shokudo, ikariya523 and more. A specialist that buys raw rice such as non-glutinous rice from Shiga, mills it fresh in the workshop, and bakes gluten-free rice-flour baumkuchen. A limited-time stand at JR Kyoto Isetan on 29 March 2023 and online sales. The theory that it came from a rice-cracker maker could not be supported by primary Japanese information.

公式サイト・食べログ・名古屋情報通によれば、株式会社Mitsuki Styleの.en: According to the official site, Tabelog and Nagoya Jōhōtsū, a gluten-free takeaway specialist run by Mitsuki Moriyasu of Mitsuki Style Co. No wheat flour, using soy flour and rice flour, and widely featured in overseas media such as CNN, the BBC, Germany's Galileo and Hawaii's KHON2.

公式サイト等によると、鳥羽志摩農協（JA）と鳥羽磯部漁協（JF）が共同設立した鳥.en: According to the official site and others, a farm-and-sea direct market, rare even nationally, run by the Toba Marche LLP, set up jointly by the Toba-Shima agricultural co-op (JA) and the Toba-Isobe fisheries co-op (JF). About 2 minutes' walk from Toba Station. A direct-sales shop of about 310 m² and a local-produce restaurant under one roof. From 1 February 2025 it switched from an all-you-can-eat buffet to 'Toba meshi' of local ingredients (local-fish sashimi, one plate per person; tekone-zushi; local-fish carpaccio; kakiage, etc.). Red Pearl strawberry soft serve is its speciality.

公式サイト（about）で、創業者は大工の棟梁だった田中徳松、妻ヨシ、孫の修司と.en: The official site (about) confirms that the founder 田中徳松, a master carpenter, the founder's wife ヨシ, and the couple's grandson 修司 with 修司's wife 孝 made persimmon-leaf sushi the house speciality; the company was set up in 1973; and in 1979 it was presented to the Emperor and Empress Shōwa through the abbess of Chūgūji.

公式サイト（about）は2021年6月22日開業、ミシュランシェフとのタイアッ.en: The official site (about) confirms the opening on 22 June 2021, "Zeimi" from a tie-up with a Michelin-starred chef, and domestic real bracken starch. A round-up article records the TV appearance and the expansion to 12 shops nationwide.

公式サイト（cafebarreal.com）が名古屋・グルテンフリーカフェと標榜.en: The official site (cafebarreal.com) bills itself as a Nagoya gluten-free café. A Yahoo! Expert article introduces the singer-songwriter owner and the GF menu, reporting the opening on 13 September 2024 on Taiko-dori. ashiya-obentofesta lists the menu but cautions: 'We have not been able to confirm whether it is a fully gluten-free specialist.'

公式サイト（chinchikurin.com / okonomiyaki.chi.en: The official sites (chinchikurin.com / okonomiyaki.chinchikurin.com) state that this is 'the Chinchikurin head shop' on Yagenbori-dori, Naka-ku, Hiroshima; that Isono Seimen noodles are boiled thoroughly to bring out their sweetness and cooked in white soybean oil; the use of Otafuku sauce; the signature Chinchikurin-yaki (egg, squid tempura); menu items such as chuck and mentaiko cheese; and a stance of inheriting and developing Hiroshima's food culture.

公式サイト（en-kitchen.com / about-us）によると、代表の.en: According to the official site (en-kitchen.com / about-us), representative Chiaki studied French and Italian cooking at Tsuji, worked as assistant to a cooking expert, was active overseas (Canada, New York, Australia), then opened en-kitchen in Tokyo in 2010 and a vegetable café in Nagoya in 2016, incorporating in 2017. Tabelog notes 'having lived with food allergies since childhood', the background to the policy of no egg, milk or wheat flour.

公式サイト（gariber.org）とHOME広島の記事が、1984年創業・二代.en: The official site (gariber.org) and a HOME Hiroshima article support founding in 1984, the second generation, about 20 spices, a three-day beef curry made from stock, all-domestic ingredients and 10 counter seats. Tabelog's menu confirms the 'Gariber Special' (prawn, octopus, squid, bacon, mushroom, aubergine) and the 'Mountain Bounty Special' (bacon, aubergine, mushroom).

公式サイト（haruno-hana.com）は全商品が小麦・卵・乳不使用の米粉1.en: The official site (haruno-hana.com) says every product is 100% rice flour with no wheat, egg or dairy, and both lunch sets are gluten-free. Local media (chiku-san, goguynet, bagel-atsume) record its opening on 4 April 2025 in Kayaba, Chikusa-ku (the former site of Katsudon Arata) as Aichi's first rice-flour bagel specialist. komeko-palette's GF Nagoya guide names owner Eriko Kondo as a registered dietitian, and says domestic rice flour is blended with white millet flour and potato starch, using low-pesticide ingredients from local farmers.

公式サイト（jimdo）は1998年創業、西二階町、目の前で揚げて素早く提供する.en: The official site (jimdo) records: founded 1998; Nishi-Nikaimachi; a policy of frying in front of you and serving quickly; a kushikatsu set lunch. The ma8coro blog tells the story that the name comes from an Osaka shop called Moguraya (a favourite of the previous owner's partner), mentions rabbit-pattern plates, and a ¥800 lunch of 7 skewers. Tabelog confirms it as a kushiage shop in Nishi-Nikaimachi.

公式サイト（kdux600.gorp.jp）はわら天神前徒歩1分、当日使う分のみ.en: The official site (kdux600.gorp.jp) states 1 minute on foot from Waratenjin, stone-milling only what is used that day, spring water from Kyomi Pass for the noodles and dashi, and Kawachi duck dishes and duck hotpot. The Michelin Guide Kyoto lists it as a Bib Gourmand. Gurunavi lists three kinds: ni-hachi, 90% and 100%.

公式サイト（miyajimamikuniya.com/meals）より：宮島町3.en: From the official site (miyajimamikuniya.com/meals): Miyajima-cho 327, a guesthouse a few minutes on foot from Itsukushima Shrine. Dinner (18:30–20:30) is an original curry, 'with no animal ingredients used at all'. 'We can also do gluten-free, so please let us know in advance if you'd like it.' Breakfast (05:30–09:30) is self-service.

公式サイト（owst）confirms 堀川町5-9、金沢駅東口徒歩3分、白ミッ.en: The official site (owst) confirms 5-9 Horikawa-cho, 3 minutes' walk from Kanazawa Station east exit; white mix / red mix ¥748, kopchang ¥825, pork belly ¥528; a starter of heaped cabbage; house-made sauce; its place as a renowned shop tucked down a back alley.

公式サイト（owst）で、南町の立地、伝助穴子（漁獲の数％の希少穴子）を刺身・焼.en: The official site (owst) confirms: the Minami-cho location; Densuke conger eel (a rare eel, a few percent of the catch) served as sashimi, grilled and as hitsumabushi; Himeji lotus root and Himeji oden; local sake such as Tatsuriki and Yaegaki; a modern Japanese interior described as "another world".

公式サイト（owst）・ホットペッパー・食べログ・地図情報によれば、カバッチは2.en: According to the official site (owst), HotPepper, Tabelog and map information, Kabacchi is a Brazilian café that opened on 2 March 2026 on the 1st floor of the HP Marunouchi Building in Marunouchi, Nagoya. It promotes pesticide-free and low-pesticide vegetables direct from local farmers and no MSG, with a retro, cute interior easy to enter even for a woman alone. Picanha, moqueca and a beef-tongue curry lunch using tongue from the sister yakiniku shop are the signatures.

公式サイト（soba-kyoto.jp）は「毎日こころを込めて蕎麦を打っています.en: The official site (soba-kyoto.jp) says 'we make soba with our whole heart every day' and 'a small shop', with a monthly menu and blog posts on first, second and third dashi. The sobaudon page states ni-hachi (80% buckwheat, 20% wheat, varying by season), tempura zaru with two live kuruma prawns, and kamaage.

公式サイト（wix）が米粉80％以上・米粉100％グルテンフリー商品を明記。na.en: The official site (wix) states 80%+ rice flour and 100% rice-flour gluten-free products. nagoya-meshi.com introduces it as a bakery café in Takaoka and also confirms bread with no egg, milk or butter. Tabelog confirms 100% rice-flour bread and bagels. Note the sparse mention of contamination measures (celiac caution).

公式サイト：明治8年（1875）創業、お茶一筋約150年、二階町66、喫茶「存外.en: Official site: founded in 1875 (Meiji 8); about 150 years devoted to tea; Nikaimachi 66; the café "Zongai"; the green soft serve, loved for over 50 years. KissPress: matcha and wagashi set ¥500 (tax included); daily wagashi from local confectioners (Kineya and others); the green soft serve was developed jointly by several tea shops; choose your favourite tea bowl from around Japan. visit-himeji: choose a bowl and enjoy freshly whisked tea casually at table seats. The number of seats is not stated, so it is not given.

公式ブログ (bocca-del-vino.com): ランチ OPEN 12:.en: Official blog (bocca-del-vino.com): lunch opens 12:00, last order 15:00, closes 16:00; lunch à la carte; at least one dish per person; no café use for dessert or drinks only; dinner offers courses (booking required) and à la carte; no terrace or riverside platform; the Kamo and Takase rivers cannot be seen from inside; please no large luggage; strollers folded; no bicycle parking in front; 1F of a red-brick building, Kiyamachi south of Dango-bashi, Shimogyo-ku; phone booking recommended (up to two months ahead); no Auto Reserve; March 2021: six years of irregular closing days since the move; maritozzo for breakfast only. English dinner guide (updated March 2026): no English, Japanese menu only; no vegan service; no pizza; the chef cooks alone; guests in a hurry cannot be served; dinner last order 21:00, closing 22:00; table charge ¥550 (bread included); at least one dish per person; omakase ¥8,800 (book by the day before, groups only, same-day cancellation ¥4,400); tell allergies beforehand. Tabelog: Italian; 12 seats; dinner table charge ¥550; no smoking; smart casual; opened May 2015; lunch limited to Monday and Tuesday from late March 2025. Reviews (December 2024 – October 2026, in English): pasta lunch ¥1,800; antipasto plate ¥800; artichoke aglio e olio ¥2,500; roast venison; rum baba; Bib Gourmand.

公式ブログ ameblo.jp/gaten8。食べログ(店舗会員): 麺屋ガテン.en: Official blog ameblo.jp/gaten8. Tabelog (shop member): Menya Gaten Z, 1-1-5 Nipponbashi-nishi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; on Otaroad; 5 min walk from Nankai Namba and Ebisucho stations; last entry weekdays lunch 15:00 and dinner 21:30, weekends and holidays lunch 15:45 and dinner 22:00; open every day of the year (except New Year); no cards, e-money or QR; opened 24 October 2017. Reviews (February–June 2026): Taiwan MAZE soba ¥1,150; extra garlic and fat; thick flat noodles; minced meat, nira, nori, fish powder, egg yolk; black pepper, shichimi, Sichuan pepper, chili oil, vinegar and ramen sauce on the table; point card and gacha; MAZE soba (shoyu) 300 g noodles; amounts of noodles, vegetables, garlic and fat adjusted free; unlimited kimchi; curry maze-soba; restrained heat; mentaiko from the ¥100 gacha; counter only; cash ticket machine; about 10 minutes until served; strong garlic; soupless salt ramen with yuzu; a Namba shop too.

公式ブログ jouroku.blog.fc2.com。食べログ: 麺屋 丈六 な.en: Official blog jouroku.blog.fc2.com. Tabelog: Menya Joroku Namba, 6-16 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 6 min walk from subway Nippombashi Station exit 5; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–21:00; closed Wednesdays; on the first Sunday of each month 7:00–10:00 and 11:30–15:00 with no evening service; temporary closures on the blog; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 7 seats (counter); no smoking; Tabelog 3.73; Ramen Hyakumeiten 2017–2025; opened 21 December 2008 on the 2nd floor of Tempozan Marketplace, moved to Namba 23 December 2010, renamed 'Menya Joroku' 1 March 2015. October 2026 reviews: shrimp salt ramen (gentle depth of niboshi, sakura shrimp); anniversary-only garlic ramen; a soup that looks jet black but isn't salty; medium-thick noodles; chuka soba small; traditional Osaka ramen; chuka soba small ¥900; 4 min walk from NGK; a dark shoyu-coloured soup with black pepper; not as heavy as it looks; medium-thick straight noodles; thin-sliced chashu; leek; menma; one from Hokkaido found the shoyu strong; Takaida-style chuka soba; an almost black soup; seasoned egg; a narrow alley; a queue and a waiting area; haya-zushi ¥200 (wrapped in a Wakayama leaf); chuka soba regular ¥1,000.

公式ページ (moonandbackkyoto.com): Nishiki Ma.en: Official page (moonandbackkyoto.com): Nishiki Market Alley by MOON and BACK (錦市場アレイ), ブリーズビル 3F, 西魚屋町600, Nakagyo-ku; 12:00–23:00, open all year; ramen experience at 9:00, 10:00 and 11:00 (booking required); 80 seats; groups of 10–70; tableside-seared wagyu sukiyaki ramen ¥1,880 + tax; teriyaki chicken ramen; spicy tantan ramen (GF noodles possible, but the soup uses regular soy sauce and is not gluten-free); vegan curry ramen limited to the Nishiki shop; super big chicken leg ramen ¥2,680; paper hot pots (wagyu or seafood ¥3,880, tofu ¥3,280); kaiseki (standard, vegan or all gluten-free; Silver ¥8,000, Gold ¥10,000 + tax); every fried item in a rice-flour and potato-starch batter; separate fryers for vegetables and for meat and seafood; separate noodle boilers for wheat and rice-flour noodles; but not a gluten-free or vegan specialist, and prep space is shared; halal-friendly with halal-certified chicken (the shop is not halal-certified); bookings on TableCheck; about 1 min walk from Hankyu Karasuma Station. Company page: The Infinity Inc., president 福田竜也, founded September 2019, six shops.

公式ページ(nanbavim.biz-option.com): 「【公式】Glu.en: Official page (nanbavim.biz-option.com): '[Official] Gluten-Free Vegan OKONOMIYAKI Vim', with only a phone number and links to Instagram and HappyCow. FindMeGlutenFree: 1-3-13 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-4963-3034, reported as dedicated gluten-free. Reviews by diners with celiac disease (2026): a ground-floor counter and one table upstairs, about 6 seats; king oyster mushrooms, grilled pasta, okonomiyaki, pork-belly okonomiyaki, grilled scallops, karaage, fried tofu and rice balls, Kirin gluten-free beer; reservation essential (online booking needs a Japanese phone number); opens 17:00 and is full before opening; one says closed Thursdays; closed an hour early; no entry under 18; one dish and one drink per person; small portions and pricey; a sister shop nearby; reports conflict between all-vegetarian and serving meat and seafood.

公式ページ: CC：CARBON COPY (シーシー カーボンコピー)、キャノ.en: Official page: CC:CARBON COPY, on the 11th floor of Canopy by Hilton Osaka Umeda, Grand Green Osaka North building, Ohfuka-cho 6-38, Kita-ku, Osaka; breakfast 6:30–10:30, lunch 11:30–15:30 (L.O. 14:00), dinner 17:30–21:30 (L.O. 20:00; no dinner on Tuesdays and Wednesdays); breakfast ¥4,500 (13 and over), ¥2,250 (6–12); lunch sets from ¥5,800, dinner sets from ¥7,800, à la carte from ¥700; tax and service charge extra; 81 seats (67 in the room, 14 in a private room; ¥18,000 for private-room use by six or fewer); all seats non-smoking; children's tableware and chairs; step-free; food allergies handled (ask in advance); parking free for 2 hours with ¥10,000 spent; dishes from around the world made with Osaka ingredients in Japanese small-plate style; live cooking; an interior modelled on a famous Osaka market arcade and the rice bags of the old Osaka rice exchange. Tabelog (shop-maintained): 15% service charge; English menu; English-speaking staff; vegetarian options; smart casual; opened 6 September 2024. Reviews (June–October 2026): breakfast buffet, omelettes, yakisoba, curry; lunch ¥4,500; the view from evening into night; loud background music; extra orders were hard to place at dinner.
furi: ページ: CC：CARBON COPY (シーシー カーボンコピー)、キャノピーbyヒルトン
市北区大深町6-38 グラングリーン大阪 北館、

公式ページが2階の立地、宮島の大鳥居・瀬戸内海の眺望、名物の穴子・牡蠣料理、穴子.en: The official page confirms the 2nd-floor location, views of Miyajima's great torii and the Seto Inland Sea, signature anago and oyster dishes, anago shabu-shabu, okonomiyaki, rice bowls, udon and set meals.

公式ページが生牡蠣6種・焼牡蠣9種（計15種）、店主自ら生産者を訪ね納得した牡蠣.en: The official page confirms 6 kinds of raw oysters and 9 kinds of grilled oysters (15 in all), serving only oysters the owner has approved after visiting the producers in person, and lemon / spring-onion momiji-oroshi ponzu / Yamagata dashi / topped with ikura / mala / okonomiyaki-style and more. Tabelog and HotPepper confirm the opening on 20 January 2023, the Shintenchi / Hatchobori location, and oyster rice, gratin and dote nabe.

公式メニュー(2026年9月 ランチ/ディナーPDF): “MODERN SHO.en: Official menu (September 2026 lunch/dinner PDF): "MODERN SHOJIN"; every dish marked VG, many marked GF; allergens (wheat, walnut, buckwheat) shown per dish. Autumn-vegetable veggie meal stand ¥4,290 (VG/GF), autumn-vegetable soup curry ¥2,420, gut-health bibimbap ¥2,420, veggie-meat taco rice ¥2,200, vegan noodles ¥2,200 (marked wheat), kale and avocado mélange salad ¥2,200 (lunch) and more. visit-chiyoda: 11:00–22:00 (food LO 20:00 / drinks LO 21:00), café menu only 14:00–17:00, irregular holidays; Yurakucho 1-1-2, Tokyo Midtown Hibiya 2F, TEL 03-6831-4620.

公式メニューに価格の記載なし（読み取れた範囲では空欄）。マリネ液に醤油が入るか要.en: No price on the official menu (blank as far as could be read). Check whether the marinade contains soy sauce.

公式・ekieによると、広島の汁なし担担麺専門店。低加水麺にタレ・挽肉・ネギ・武.en: According to the official site and ekie, a Hiroshima brothless dandan noodle specialist. Low-hydration noodles with sauce, mince, spring onion and Musashibo sansho. First as is, then adjusted with four kinds of sansho, (ginseng) vinegar and house sauce. Mail-order sets too. Runs a collaboration shop at Hiroshima Station ekie with 'Kunimatsu', which led the boom.

公式・web-komachi・naganogourmetで確認：諏訪町の路地裏、.en: Confirmed on the official site, web-komachi and naganogourmet: in a back alley of Suwa-machi, marked by a blue door; about 10 seats (full with 6–7 people); house-made bread of Japanese wheat and Hoshino natural yeast; hand-made pudding; ingredients kind to the body; booking by Instagram DM recommended; Kurashi no Techo on the counter. Opened around 2011.

公式・ぐるなび・一休が丸の内の完全予約制鉄板焼き・A5黒毛和牛（サーロイン/フィ.en: The official site, Gurunavi and Ikyu confirm reservation-only teppanyaki in Marunouchi, A5 Kuroge wagyu (sirloin / fillet / chateaubriand), live abalone, spiny lobster and private rooms. A claim that the owner grows vegetables could not be supported and was removed.

公式・ホットペッパーによると、流川・銀山町の鉄板お好み焼き居酒屋。看板『くらはち.en: According to the official site and HotPepper, a teppan okonomiyaki izakaya in Nagarekawa / Kanayama-cho. The signature 'Kurahachi-yaki' uses crisp noodles custom-made by a noodle maker, topped with raw egg and cooked to the guest's liking. Plenty of toppings such as oysters, kimchi and avocado. (Pesticide-free vegetables could not be confirmed and were removed.)

公式・街画コム等によると、八丁堀・YMCA専門学校南側の黒基調のお好み焼店。手押.en: According to the official site, a local town-guide site and others, a black-toned okonomiyaki shop in Hatchobori, south of the YMCA college. The signature is meat-and-egg soba with extra-thin fresh noodles, pressed by hand. The super-spicy signature 'Goku-yaki' piles lots of chilli on habanero-kneaded noodles. Seared cheese too. Popular with local office workers.

公式・食べログによると、宮島表参道商店街の自家焙煎珈琲店。古民家風の建物で202.en: According to the official site and Tabelog, a house-roasting coffee shop on Miyajima's Omotesando shopping street. An old-house-style building, with the 2nd floor renovated in October 2024. Also sells roasted beans and handmade cakes. (Oyster pasta could not be confirmed and was removed.)

公式予約ページ (mog.foodre.jp): なんば駅からほど近いパンケーキ.en: Official booking page (mog.foodre.jp): a pancake specialist close to Namba Station; the house marshmallow pancakes; limited pancakes with seasonal fruit; for lunch, a break while shopping, dates or dinner with friends; the decoration changes with the seasons; limited-time fig and nut pancakes ¥1,760, pancake brunch set ¥1,750, açaí bowl set ¥1,800, croque-monsieur set ¥1,700, toasted marshmallow and chocolate pancakes ¥1,500; daily 9:30–21:00 (L.O. 20:20, pancakes 19:45); advance bookings online only (same day by phone); weekend and holiday seat bookings only from 18:00; no closing days; 34 seats; non-smoking throughout. careermap.jp: J.C.Factory Co. (Pancake Cafe Mog), representative director 松永 哲至 (Matsunaga Tetsuji), founded 20 December 2010, café and confectionery retail, 3 sites (shown: mog Namba and a product-development room). Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): opened 20 February 2013; weekdays 9:30–20:00, weekends and holidays 9:30–21:00; open year-round; multilingual menu (English, Korean); kids menu; wheelchair accessible. Reviews (June–October 2026): marshmallow, salted caramel and nut, peach, tiramisu and omelette pancakes; orders by QR code; some call them fluffy, others dense or thin; one saw cooked pancakes being thrown away (September).

公式会社概要（2001年5月設立・代表向井昭博・2004年ネット通販・2011年.en: Confirmed by the official company profile (founded May 2001; representative 向井昭博; online sales from 2004; Himeji Castle shop March 2011; a spirit of challenge that does not fear failure; Harima-nada) and searches (Harima White Pearl = virgin oysters that have never spawned, farmed at Ieshima, with little harshness or bitterness). The MAFF Kinki Regional Agricultural Administration Office inbound case-study URL is official but now returns 403, so its text could not be re-fetched.

公式店舗ページで、料理長は金澤忍、みつ川の味と技を継承、金沢では珍しい赤酢のシャ.en: The official shop page confirms: head chef Kanazawa Shinobu, carrying on the flavours and skill of Mitsukawa; red-vinegar sushi rice, rare in Kanazawa; buying from Omicho and Kanazawa Port; the famous blackthroat-seaperch hand roll; original local sake; Michelin Bib Gourmand 2016.

公式沿革・ホットペッパーより、1950年(昭和25)に屋台で創業、一乗寺の八坪店.en: The official history and HotPepper confirm founding in 1950 (Showa 25) as a street stall, settling in an eight-tsubo shop in Ichijoji, one source of Kyoto's chicken-paitan / back-fat ramen. With the creed 'no gimmicks, no cut corners', paitan of whole chicken and chicken feet + aged soy tare + back fat added after; the Kawaramachi Rokkaku shop is on the 1st floor of Rokkaku Kaikan.

公式（haru-nara.com）とcoolnaraで、代表は中林大樹、2011.en: The official site (haru-nara.com) and coolnara confirm: owner 中林大樹; opened October 2011; a Naramachi townhouse over 120 years old (tatami room facing the garden). Twice-ground hamburg on an iron plate with demi-glace, head-on fried shrimp you can eat whole, Yamato beef rice bowl, pudding of Uemura Bokujo milk, tartar sauce with Narazuke.

公式（kudzu.co.jp）およびintojapanwarakuで、井上天極堂.en: The official site (kudzu.co.jp) and intojapanwaraku confirm Inoue Tengyokudo, founded in 1870 (Meiji 3), makes Yoshino pure kuzu by the 'Yoshino-sarashi' method dating from the late Edo period. Kuzu mochi is made after ordering and served in about 10 minutes (cold outside, warm inside); also kuzu noodles, kuzu-yu and kuzu udon; the main shop is on the former site of Tōdaiji's west great gate.

公式（machishin）はまちづくり振興機構運営、大手門駐車場内・本町68、喫.en: The official site (machishin) confirms: run by the Urban Development Promotion Organization; inside the Otemon car park, Honmachi 68; café (coffee, cappuccino, etc.); a Yamazaki convenience corner; free wheelchair loans; Himeji Castle goods. The Himeji tourism site lists almond toast ¥458 and rice-koji amazake ¥356.

公式（owst）とホットペッパーが、昭和26年（1951年）創業・流川の老舗で創.en: The official site (owst) and HotPepper report an old Nagarekawa shop founded in Showa 26 (1951), 68 years in business, carrying on the previous generation's taste unchanged; soup simmered over 12 hours and a secret tare aged 3 weeks; over 20 side dishes (fried rice is popular); and its place as a finishing bowl until 3 a.m.

公式（owst）とモワ企画の告知が、2025年12月10日に本通4-1で開業、モ.en: The official site (owst) and a Mowa Kikaku announcement report: opened on 10 December 2025 at Hondori 4-1; run by Mowa Kikaku (a young company with several formats in and outside the prefecture); the Legend Dream Gyoza (Aichi pork, Aomori garlic, from about ¥109); unusual gyoza such as tom yum, mapo, coriander and cheese; 50,000 sold over 5 days at Osaka Craft Gyoza Fes 2026; low prices of ¥99–109 a gyoza and beer at ¥190-odd; and the motto 'filling the heart and the stomach'. The phrase 'safe, delicious, fast', winged gyoza and big chicken cutlet could not be confirmed in any source and were removed.

公式（owst）：兵庫県姫路市立町71、播磨うまいもん居酒屋、穴子（焼き1,08.en: Official site (owst): Tatemachi 71, Himeji, Hyogo; an izakaya of Harima local food; conger eel (grilled ¥1,080 / tempura ¥880 / chazuke ¥690); Himeji oden (ginger soy sauce); the homemade shrimp shumai (¥470) is popular. Tabelog: sourced from Murotsu and Boze ports and contract farmers; 20 seats. ma8coro: the chef-owner recommends the shumai. ameblo: covered in celebrity autographs.

公式（spirit.html）で『純粋に食を楽しむ』理念、愛知の香り米に赤酢2種.en: The official site (spirit.html) confirms the philosophy 'simply enjoying food', rice of Aichi fragrant rice with two red vinegars + white vinegar, and Yamako tuna. The Tabelog relocation page confirms the opening in Shinsakae on 1 June 2017 → move to Nishi-ku on 17 May 2022, Joshin Station, and a 2019 Michelin listing (Plate). Firm claims of Ise Bay / Mikawa Bay, karasumi hand rolls, Kuwana clams and piece counts could not be supported by sources and were generalised or removed.

公式（yukou-kiyo.com）が麺屋優光グループ2号店、仲間思想、店長名を.en: The official site (yukou-kiyo.com) confirms the Menya Yukou group's 2nd shop, the companion philosophy, the shop being named after its manager, noodles made every morning at the company's own noodle works, and chāshū simmered over 2 hours with the thickness chosen at the counter. kyoto.tips and search results confirm the opening on 1 October 2018 in Ichijoji, and that the No. 1 'Gift' is a shoyu ramen of short-neck clam and flying-fish dashi; the menu is Gift / Simple / Shirushi at ¥800 each.

公益社団法人姫路市まちづくり振興機構.en: Himeji City Urban Development Promotion Organization

六本木フュージョンビル.r: ろっぽんぎフュージョンビル

共用の炭火グリルを使用するオマカーセ店であり、グルテン含有食材（醤油ベースのたれ.en: An omakase restaurant using a shared charcoal grill, so contact with gluten-containing ingredients (soy-based sauces, miso and so on) cannot be ruled out.

共用フライヤーで唐揚げ・天ぷらと同じ油を使う。マキシマムの原材料にも要確認。.en: Shared fryer, same oil as karaage and tempura. Check the ingredients of the "Maximum" seasoning too.

共用フライヤーで唐揚げ等と揚げる。.en: Fried in a shared fryer with karaage and more.

共用フライヤーで天ぷら・唐揚げと同じ油。.en: Shared fryer, same oil as tempura and karaage.

共用フライヤーで小麦の揚げ物と共用。＋280円でドリンクバーセットに。.en: Shared fryer, used for wheat-coated fried food. A drink-bar set for +¥280.

共用フライヤーで小麦の衣物（フリット・唐揚げ）と同じ油。.en: Shared fryer, same oil as the wheat-coated items (fritto, karaage).

共用フライヤーで羊肉餃子等を揚げる可能性。.en: Possibly fried in a shared fryer with lamb gyoza and more.

共用フライヤー（唐揚げ・天ぷらと同じ油）。.en: Shared fryer (same oil as karaage and tempura).

兵庫県姫路市（姫路駅前地下街グランフェスタ6番街）.en: Himeji, Hyogo (Gran Festa 6-ban-gai, the underground mall in front of Himeji Station)

具はあさりのみ。スープ調味料のみ要確認。セット.en: The only topping is clams. Only the soup seasoning needs checking. Set

具は植物性だが衣に小麦と卵、揚げ油は海老・穴子と共用。.en: The ingredients are plant-based, but the batter has wheat and egg, and the frying oil is shared with shrimp and conger eel.

具材は無加工。クリアスープの調味料を確認。.en: Ingredients unprocessed. Check the clear soup's seasoning.

具材は素材のみ、スープ調味料が要確認点。.en: The ingredients are plain; the soup seasoning is the point to check.
