台湾料理 / 台湾ラーメン・担仔麺.en: Taiwanese food / Taiwan ramen, danzai noodles

台湾粥は干し椎茸・干し海老・肉のいずれかで炊くのが一般的。.en: Taiwanese congee is usually cooked with dried shiitake, dried shrimp or meat.

台湾薬膳料理.r: たいわんやくぜんりょうり

各350円。イカ天・そば・うどんは小麦そのもの。ねぎ・もち・コーン・大葉・こんに.en: ¥350 each. Squid tempura, soba and udon are wheat themselves. Spring onion, mochi, corn, shiso and konnyaku have no wheat in themselves, but the batter and sauce are wheat, so the whole is out.

各400円（税抜、2019年表示）。乳使用。コーンは小麦なのでカップ指定を。.en: ¥400 each (before tax, 2019 listing). Uses dairy. The cone is wheat, so ask for a cup.

各490円。清澄剤の有無を要確認。.en: ¥490 each. Check whether a fining agent is used.

各590円。カイケン シャルドネ／カベルネ各890円、おすすめ自然派ワイン各99.en: ¥590 each. Kaiken Chardonnay / Cabernet ¥890 each; recommended natural wines ¥990 each. Several bottles available, changing daily; you can ask about brands not on the menu.

各630円（税抜、2019年表示）。寒天・赤えんどう・黒蜜。.en: ¥630 each (before tax, 2019 listing). Kanten, red peas, kuromitsu.

各650円と貼り紙。カレールーは小麦粉、中華麺も小麦。.en: A notice says ¥650 each. Curry roux is wheat flour, and Chinese noodles are wheat too.

各770円。お茶自体は大麦不使用（麦茶ハイのみ別）。ベースの焼酎が麦焼酎なら大麦.en: ¥770 each. The teas themselves have no barley (except the barley-tea highball). Barley if the base shochu is barley shochu, so check the brand. Hige-cha = corn-silk tea.

各770円。ジン・ウォッカ・ラムの原料は蒸留されるが、銘柄を気にする人は確認を。.en: ¥770 each. The ingredients of gin, vodka and rum are distilled, but check if the brand matters to you.

各770円。ベースのスピリッツ原料を要確認。.en: ¥770 each. Check what the base spirit is made from.

各770円。魔王（芋）は1,650円。芋焼酎は米麹が普通だが銘柄の麹を要確認。.en: ¥770 each. 魔王 (sweet potato) is ¥1,650. Sweet-potato shochu normally uses rice koji, but check each brand's koji.

各790円。ワインの清澄剤に動物性原料が使われる銘柄がある。.en: ¥790 each. Some wines use animal-derived fining agents.

各800円〜。ソムリエ下堺真美によるセレクト。ランチプレート注文時は各500円。.en: From ¥800 each. Selected by sommelier Mami Shimosakai. ¥500 each when ordered with a lunch plate.

各890円。ジン・ウォッカの原料穀物は蒸留されるが、銘柄によっては要確認。.en: ¥890 each. The grains in gin and vodka are distilled, but check for some brands.

各フォーメニューにはハーフの生春巻き、揚げパン、追い野菜、小さなデザートが付きま.en: Every pho comes with a half portion of fresh spring rolls, fried bread, extra vegetables and a small dessert

各席に小麦不使用のしょうゆを置くなどアレルギーに配慮.en: considerate of allergies, e.g. wheat-free soy sauce at every seat

各店舗によって取り扱いメニュー、値段が異なりますので、お店備え付けのメニューにて.en: Menu items and prices differ by shop, so please check the menu provided in the shop"

各種＝銘柄未掲載。麦焼酎は九州の定番で、麦＝大麦。.en: Assorted = brands not listed. Barley shochu is a Kyushu staple, barley = barley.

合資会社宮治の公式サイトと食べログ口コミが、2024年7月開業、那古野・四間道の.en: The official site of Miyaji Limited Partnership and Tabelog reviews support: opened July 2024; a renovated old house in Nagono, Shikemichi; only 12 counter seats; whole female Mikawa red chickens butchered only for the bookings made; a ¥5,000 young-chef support course on Mondays and Thursdays only; and a finish of mushroom takikomi rice with ikura.

合資会社宮治（名古屋市西区那古野1-18-10）が50年にわたり営む和食グループ.en: One shop of a Japanese-food group run for 50 years by Miyaji Limited Partnership (1-18-10 Nagono, Nishi-ku, Nagoya). With the concept 'creating new value in Japanese food', the group runs five shops in the Nagono / Shikemichi area, including Yakitori Fugetsu, Kamo Ryori Fugetsu and Yakitori Goryo. Kamo Ryori Fugetsu occupies a space making use of a traditional Japanese house, with every seat in a fully private room overlooking a courtyard garden.

吉野の猟師さんから届く鹿肉、猪肉.en: venison and wild boar delivered by hunters in Yoshino

同じく店の表記は《GLUTEN FREE 〜そば粉100%〜》。卵・しらす使用で.en: The shop's label is again "GLUTEN FREE — 100% buckwheat flour". Uses egg and shirasu, so not vegan. Check for wheat contamination from the shared kitchen. Card from August 2016.

同じく蕎麦前盛り合わせに大麦。.en: Likewise barley in the soba-mae platter.

同じ厨房で通常のラーメン（小麦麺）や醤油を扱っているので、微量のコンタミネーショ.en: There's a check that, because the same kitchen handles regular ramen (wheat noodles) and soy sauce, trace contamination can't be avoided — is that OK?

同じ料理の持ち帰り。.en: The same dishes to take away.

同じ蒲焼＝小麦醤油。.en: The same kabayaki = wheat soy sauce.

同じ鉄板で小麦生地を焼くため接触あり。.en: The wheat batter is cooked on the same griddle, so there is contact.

同じ鍋で仕切るため、麻辣側の飛沫が反対側に入る。.en: The pot is divided in one vessel, so splashes from the mala side get into the other side.

同オンラインストアの価格。.en: Price from the same online store.

同上 — つゆが小麦と鰹だし。.en: Same as above — the broth is wheat and bonito dashi.

同上、シーユー・オイスターソース＝小麦の可能性大。.en: Same as above; see ew and oyster sauce = very likely wheat.

同上、ベース焼酎の原料未記載。.en: Same as above; the base shochu's ingredients aren't listed.

同上、ベース焼酎未記載。.en: Same as above; base shochu not listed.

同上、内容は未公開。.en: Same as above; contents not disclosed.

同上、卵入りが一般的。.en: Same as above; usually with egg.

同上、味噌の種類未記載。.en: Same as above; type of miso not listed.

同上、最上位のコース。.en: Same as above; the top course.

同上、麹の原料に注意。.en: Same as above; watch the koji ingredient.

同上。ちくわは小麦でんぷんを含む製品が多い。.en: Same as above. Many chikuwa contain wheat starch.

同上。でんぷん製か小麦製か要確認。.en: Same as above. Ask whether it is starch or wheat.

同上。カップかコーンかを選べる（コーン＝小麦）。.en: Same as above. Choose a cup or a cone (cone = wheat).

同上。原材料表示未確認。.en: Same as above. Ingredient label not confirmed.

同上。品目が増える分、醤油・出汁の使用箇所も増える。要確認。.en: Same as above. More items means more places where soy sauce and dashi are used. Check.

同上。四季折々の旬の食材を一つずつ揚げて出すコース。.en: Same as above. A course frying seasonal ingredients one at a time.

同上に天ぷら衣。.en: Same as above, plus tempura batter.

同上：上新粉＋十勝産こしあん。鉄板共用のため要確認。.en: Same as above: joshinko rice flour + Tokachi smooth bean paste. Shared griddle, so check.

同額390円が「チャージ.en: The same 390 yen is added for everyone as a "charge

名前のないラーメン屋.en: Namae no Nai Ramen-ya (the ramen shop with no name)
名前のないラーメン屋.r: なまえのないらーめんや

名古屋に蒙古タンメン中本がないため、その代替として「大陸タンメン」目当てに来る常.en: Because Nagoya has no Moko Tanmen Nakamoto, many regulars come for the Tairiku Tanmen as a substitute. The mapo tofu is mild by default and can be adjusted with the Sichuan pepper and other condiments on the table.

名古屋の「ころ」＝冷やしつゆ。麺・つゆとも小麦のまま。.en: Nagoya 'koro' = chilled broth. Noodles and broth both stay wheat.

名古屋の小倉あん。食パン＝小麦。バター使用の有無を要確認。.en: Nagoya ogura anko. Sliced bread = wheat. Ask whether butter is used.

名古屋の田楽は八丁味噌だれ。味噌には小麦を含む配合が多い。.en: Nagoya dengaku uses a Hatcho-miso sauce. Many miso blends contain wheat.

名古屋の豆味噌だれ。ちくわ・はんぺんなど魚肉練り種は小麦デンプン、仕込みにも醤油.en: Nagoya bean-miso sauce. Fish-paste items such as chikuwa and hanpen contain wheat starch, and soy sauce goes into the simmering too. Priced per piece (¥110 each) — the cheapest way to eat here.

名古屋の豆味噌汁。豆味噌は大豆のみのことが多いが合わせに麦味噌が入る場合がある。.en: Nagoya bean-miso soup. Bean miso is often soybeans only, but barley miso is sometimes blended in. The dashi is bonito.

名古屋の赤だしは豆味噌（大豆のみ）だが、だしと合わせ調味料に醤油が入ることがある.en: Nagoya akadashi is bean miso (soybeans only), but the dashi and blended seasonings sometimes include soy sauce. Bonito dashi, so not vegan.

名古屋の赤だしは豆味噌（大豆のみ）で麦味噌ではない。ただし合わせ味噌・だし・具に.en: Nagoya akadashi is bean miso (soybeans only), not barley miso. But blended miso, the dashi or the ingredients sometimes include soy sauce, so ask. Bonito dashi, so not vegan.

名古屋めしとmyplが、明治40年創業の材木商の蔵をリノベした堀川沿いのギャラリ.en: Nagoya Meshi and mypl support: a gallery café on the Hori River in a renovated storehouse of a timber merchant founded in Meiji 40; three independently designed galleries + café; pesticide-free vegetables from 嶺北 in Kochi and Aichi; natural wine with low sulphites; a quiche lunch limited to 5 a day; and the Bronze Award in the 2019 Aichi Salad Meal General Election.

名古屋めしの2記事で、倉田コーヒー直営、西区で約50年の自家焙煎、昭和50年頃創.en: Two Nagoya Meshi articles confirm: run directly by Kurata Coffee, about 50 years of in-house roasting in Nishi-ku, founded around Showa 50 (1975), Oukakaikan 1F, coffee warabi-mochi and coffee daifuku, glasses from Showa to early Heisei and a well-used wooden sugar pot, and a sweet handed out when leaving. A Tabelog review calls it 'the only coffee shop in this neighbourhood'.

名古屋めし等によると、浄心駅近く西区の3世代家族経営の食堂（厨房は夫婦、ホールは.en: According to Nagoya Meshi and others, a three-generation family canteen in Nishi-ku near Joshin Station (a couple in the kitchen, the daughter on the floor, a grandmother helping). The signature is a rugby-ball-sized omurice (finished with chūnō sauce, ¥650). A large menu of tonkatsu, hamburger steak, curry and more. An orange interior with yellow menu cards, and a tatami room at the back.

名古屋をグルテンフリーの街へ.r: なごやをぐるてんふりーのまちへ

名古屋コーチン手羽先唐揚げ.r: なごやこーちんてばさきからあげ

名古屋・丸の内のビジネス街に静かに構える鉄板料理の隠れ家。薄暗い路地を抜けた先に.en: A teppan hideaway set quietly in the Marunouchi business district of Nagoya. Past a dim alley, its counter and several private rooms are known to local regulars as a special space for business entertaining and anniversaries (about 1 minute on foot from Marunouchi Station).

名古屋・大須に上陸.r: なごや・おおすにじょうりく

名古屋人でも食べやすいタイプ.en: a type that's easy even for Nagoya people to eat
名古屋人でも食べやすいタイプ.r: なごやじんでもたべやすいたいぷ

名古屋単身ライフ・シャルの甘美なる日々・ホットペッパー等で、2017年営業開始、.en: Nagoya Tanshin Life, Sharu's Sweet Days, HotPepper and others confirm: opened in 2017, Nagoya's first authentic Nepalese restaurant, in Marunouchi, a large refined room at the top of a narrow staircase, the dal bhat set (free refills of rice and lentil curry), Newar samay baji, lamb-brain curry and more. Named to Tabelog Asia & Ethnic EAST Hyakumeiten (2022, 2024).

名古屋名物。もち入 +50円 / とり入 +150円 / 天ぷら入 +230円。.en: A Nagoya specialty. With mochi +¥50 / with chicken +¥150 / with tempura +¥230. Bean miso is soybeans only, but the noodles are wheat.

名古屋名物。パン粉＝小麦、味噌だれにも小麦の可能性。.en: A Nagoya specialty. Breadcrumbs = wheat, and the miso sauce may contain wheat too.

名古屋名物。太い小麦パスタ、あんにも小麦粉・ウスターソース。.en: A Nagoya specialty. Thick wheat pasta, and the ankake also has wheat flour and Worcestershire sauce.

名古屋名物。小麦のトースト＋小倉あん。バターの有無を要確認。.en: A Nagoya specialty. Wheat toast + ogura anko. Ask whether butter is used.

名古屋名物。豆味噌は大豆のみで麦味噌ではないが、麺が小麦で割下にも醤油。.en: A Nagoya specialty. Bean miso is soybeans only, not barley miso, but the noodles are wheat and the warishita has soy sauce too.

名古屋唯一のギリシャ料理店として2016年10月にオープン。ギリシャ人のオーナー.en: Opened in October 2016 as Nagoya's only Greek restaurant. A small house restaurant run by a Greek owner-chef and the chef's Japanese wife. In an old building a few minutes on foot from Sengencho Station, it creates a calm space.

名古屋城の金シャチにちなんで考案した「金シャチ煮込うどん」（¥2,420）は、エ.en: The 'Kinshachi nikomi udon' (¥2,420), created after Nagoya Castle's golden shachi, is a dish exclusive to this shop with a prawn tempura standing in for the golden shachi.

名古屋城公式サイト・busho-heart・名古屋観光情報等によれば、二の丸茶亭.en: According to the official Nagoya Castle site, busho-heart, Nagoya tourist information and others, Ninomaru Chatei is next to the scenic Ninomaru Garden (a daimyo garden of the Owari Tokugawa family, about 30,000 m², one of Japan's largest), run by the Nagoya Castle Promotion Association. Serves matcha, seasonal wagashi and gold-leaf matcha, and every day from 9:00 to 11:00 a limited number of Kinshachi Morning sets (Kinshachi toast with gold leaf). A replica of the golden tea kettle said to have been made by melting the war-damaged shachihoko is on display; a tea demonstration is held on the 8th of each month, and every Friday matcha is whisked with water from this kettle. 4travel calls it a quiet hidden gem.

名古屋市中区三の丸・名古屋能楽堂内（2022年3月開業）.en: Inside Nagoya Noh Theatre, Sannomaru, Naka-ku, Nagoya (opened March 2022)

名古屋市北区田幡（黒川エリア／本店）、丸の内店は2026年4月開業.en: Kita-ku, Nagoya (Kurokawa area / main shop); the Marunouchi shop opened in April 2026

名古屋市西区城西、浅間町駅周辺.en: Josai, Nishi-ku, Nagoya, around Sengencho Station

名古屋市西区新道（古民家風にリノベーションした空間）.en: Shindo, Nishi-ku, Nagoya (a space renovated in old-house style)

名古屋市西区樋の口町。シャトー西の丸ビル2階に構える完全予約・紹介制の隠れ家的焼.en: Hinokuchi-cho, Nishi-ku, Nagoya. A hideaway yakiniku restaurant on the 2nd floor of a Château-named building, by reservation and introduction only.

名古屋市西区浅間の旧美濃路沿いに位置する、昭和の雰囲気を残す大衆麺処。 浅間町駅.en: A Showa-era popular noodle shop on the old Minoji road in Sengen, Nishi-ku, Nagoya. About 5 minutes on foot from Sengencho Station, in a residential area near Nagoya Castle.

名古屋市西区浅間町（浅間町駅至近、2019年2月開業）.en: Sengen-cho, Nishi-ku, Nagoya (right by Sengencho Station, opened February 2019)

名古屋市西区那古野（四間道）。江戸・明治期の蔵と町家が連なる歴史的景観保存地区の.en: Nagono, Nishi-ku, Nagoya (Shikemichi). In a restored old house in a corner of the historic preservation district lined with Edo- and Meiji-period storehouses and townhouses.

名古屋情報通と一休レストランが、内藤勝博料理長=広東料理の世界大会で日本人初トッ.en: Nagoya Jōhōtsū and Ikyu Restaurant report head chef Katsuhiro Naito = the first Japanese in the top 10 at a world Cantonese cooking competition, Cantonese crispy pork, dim sum by a top-grade dim sum master, live fish from tanks, and use of local Aichi ingredients such as Nagoya Cochin and Okazaki Ohan. PR Times supports the 1 October 2025 opening and the location across the moat from Nagoya Castle.

名古屋情報通と食べログが、スパイスカレー『LIT COFFEE』から出発し約3年.en: Nagoya Jōhōtsū and Tabelog support: started from the spice-curry business 'LIT COFFEE', served ankake pasta from a food truck for about three years, opened the shop in Kami-Nagoya, Nishi-ku (near Joshin Station) on 12 January 2026; horse logo = an image of moving freely, matching the Year of the Horse opening; the signature fish plate; S 200 g / M 300 g / L 400 g and over 20 toppings. (2026 is the Year of the Horse; the original's 'Year of the Tiger' was wrong and was removed.)

名城公園駅から徒歩8分.en: 8 min walk from Meijo Koen Station
名城公園駅から徒歩8分.r: めいじょうこうえんえきからとほはっぷん

名物「大人のみたらし」は山椒と生七味を効かせた甘辛いタレが特徴で、起源は室町時代.en: The famous "grown-up mitarashi" features a sweet-savory sauce sharp with sansho and fresh shichimi, and is introduced as having origins going back to the Muromachi period.

名物のだし巻き玉子は卵の種類、だしの濃さ、トッピングを選んで自分好みに仕上げられ.en: The famous dashimaki tamago is finished to your taste by choosing the type of egg, the strength of the dashi and the toppings.

名物のだし巻き玉子（卵焼き）。 卵の種類・だしの濃さ（あっさり／甘め）・トッピン.en: The famous dashimaki tamago (rolled omelet). A dish you customize to taste by choosing the type of egg, the strength of the dashi (light / sweeter) and toppings; it is the shop's signature.

名物のハラペーニョトッピングやトルティーヤチップス等の中南米系サイドメニューがあ.en: There are Latin American sides such as the signature jalapeño topping and tortilla chips, so it's easy to ask the owner directly whether there are items vegetarians / vegans can eat (the owner gets by easily in English and Spanish).

名物の殻付かきは、潮流と森の恵みが育む宮城の豊かな海で育った牡蠣は、味が濃厚で身.en: The famous oysters in the shell are grown in Miyagi's rich sea, fed by currents and the bounty of the forests, and are rich in flavor with big meat. Miyagi is a famous oyster region with strict standards, and only good-quality oysters "for raw eating" that meet those standards are served.

名物は、自家製の干物。大振りの干物と共に、日本酒を.en: The specialty is house-made dried fish. With the big dried fish, sake

吟味した確かな食材と、手間を惜しまないおもてなしの心で綴る逸品.en: fine dishes woven from carefully chosen ingredients and a hospitality that spares no effort

吟醸のため醸造アルコール添加あり。.en: Ginjō, so brewer's alcohol is added.

吟醸は醸造アルコール添加あり（小麦ではなくサトウキビ由来が一般的）。.en: Ginjō has brewer's alcohol added (usually from sugar cane, not wheat).

含め煮は醤油・味醂・かつお出汁。.en: Simmered in soy sauce, mirin and bonito dashi.

吸い地は出汁＋薄口醤油が一般的。.en: A clear-soup base is usually dashi + light soy sauce.

呉のメロンパン公式サイト（kuremelon.com）と広島県ブランドショップT.en: The official Kure melon-bread site (kuremelon.com) and an article from Hiroshima Prefecture's brand shop TAU support founding in Showa 11, third-generation Ryuma Nakashio, a rugby-ball shape derived from makuwa melon, and a registered trademark.

呑ます鮨.en: "sushi that makes you want to drink"

呑んべいさんのお酒のあて.en: Drinkers' bites to go with sake

味と元気で勝負するお好み焼き屋.en: an okonomiyaki shop that competes on flavour and energy

味により乳・卵の有無が変わる。.en: Whether it has dairy or egg depends on the flavor.

味の天徳は神奈川（柿生本店）発祥の油そば専門チェーンで、株式会社天輝が運営する。.en: Aji no Tentoku is an abura-soba specialist chain originating in Kanagawa (Kakio main shop), run by Tenki Inc. In Kyoto it has Shijo-Kiyamachi and Gion shops; the Shijo-Kiyamachi shop is a small shop of about 8 counter seats in a busy area of Shimogyo-ku, right by Hankyu Kyoto-Kawaramachi Station.

味の強いものはそばの味を殺してしまう.en: strong flavours kill the taste of the soba

味は店をはじめた親父の頃から何も変えとらん.en: Nothing about the taste has changed since my old man started the shop (dialect)

味も居心地も両方大事.en: both the taste and the comfort matter

味よし麺よし心よし.en: good taste, good noodles, good heart

味をさっぱり整えたい時におすすめです。後半に加えることで、まろやかさと煮干しの香.en: Recommended for when you want to freshen the taste. Added in the second half, it brings out more mellowness and the aroma and savoriness of the niboshi

味をもう少し濃くしたい時や、キレ・パンチを加えたい時に。少しずつ加えながらお好み.en: For when you want the flavor a bit stronger, or want to add sharpness and punch. Add a little at a time and enjoy the balance you like

味付き乾物は醤油・みりんを含むことが多く、マヨネーズが添えられる。.en: Seasoned dried snacks often contain soy sauce and mirin, and come with mayonnaise.

味付けが塩かたれか要確認。同じ鉄板。.en: Ask whether seasoned with salt or sauce. Same griddle.

Wheat flour and sugar avoided as far as possible; sweets use barley flour and are gluten-free; the pound cake is 100% Kyushu barley flour.

姫路経済新聞・Kiss PRESS・Food Diversity・公式サイトより.en: From the Himeji Keizai Shimbun, Kiss PRESS, Food Diversity and the official site. A former izakaya owner opened on 21 March 2023 in Shirakuni-kitashinmachi. A fully vegan restaurant supervised by Tokyo's Saido. The signature "sai-men" are colourful noodles made from vegetables. Sweets are made by Ibuki of Okayama, free of animal ingredients and the 8 major allergens. The name comes from 菜 (vegetables), sai-men, Saido and sai (rhinoceros) (official).

姫路経済新聞・budou-chan: オーナー見満みなみは2012年に製菓学校卒.en: Himeji Keizai Shimbun and budou-chan: the owner, 見満みなみ, graduated from confectionery school in 2012, studied pastry and cooking in Germany and France for about 8 years, and on 1 October 2025 opened "Miinas", a gluten-free organic café, at Shikisai 638-1, Himeji (right by JR Yobe Station, Aoyama-kita Bldg). About 31 tsubo, 6 tables, 16 seats; everything available to take away. Serves bagels and burgers of 100% domestic organic rice flour. A pet-grooming salon (深山梨江) is attached, separated by a wall.

姫路経済新聞・tanosuで、2025年11月28日開業、店長 菅原早穂子、自家.en: The Himeji Keizai Shimbun and tanosu confirm: opened 28 November 2025; the manager; house-roasted, house-ground almond butter (Classic/Crunch); almond-milk soup; butter chicken curry with 18 spices, almond butter and almond dukkah.

姫路経済新聞：料理長・大庭拓哉（和食歴30年）、店長・松岡加奈子、2025年11.en: Himeji Keizai Shimbun: head chef 大庭拓哉 (30 years in Japanese cuisine); manager 松岡加奈子; opened 27 November 2025; in the Gran Festa basement; fish from the ports of Murotsu, Boze and Shikama; whole sea bream tempura, Himeji oden, live conger eel. KissPress: the name comes from the owner's surname, written in hiragana. Himeji Festa official site: Gran Festa 5-ban-gai, opened 27 November.

姫路駅直結の地下街グランフェスタ内にあり、雨の日でも濡れずにアクセスできる利便性.en: Inside Gran Festa, the underground mall connected to Himeji Station, so you can get there without getting wet on rainy days; popular with business people and travellers for the convenience.

季節に移ろい暦があるように.en: just as the seasons turn and the calendar moves on

季節のプリンは卵・乳を含む可能性。ぽりっと・米粉麺は植物性。.en: The seasonal pudding may contain egg and dairy. Poritto and the rice-flour noodles are plant-based.

季節の和菓子と選りすぐりの日本茶、抹茶。喫茶では季節の和菓子と薄茶のセットのほか.en: Seasonal Japanese sweets with selected Japanese teas and matcha. Besides sets of a seasonal sweet and thin tea, there's a 'whisk-your-own' matcha experience and a full tea seating (seasonal sweet, thick tea, dry sweets, thin tea), plus white shaved ice in summer. Takeaway thick-tea lattes too.

季節の商品。一晩かけて抽出したエルダーフラワーエキス、と店の説明。花・砂糖・炭酸.en: Seasonal. Elderflower extract steeped overnight, the shop says. Flowers, sugar and soda, with no animal ingredients. Ask about the house-made syrup's ingredients.

季節の小鉢 / 本日の鮮魚四点盛り / 特選黒毛和牛のすき焼き / ツナとアボカ.en: Seasonal small dish / four kinds of today's fresh fish / special Japanese black wagyu sukiyaki / taco-style tuna and avocado salad / shrimp tempura and corn fritter / shibazuke grated-daikon udon / warabi-mochi.

季節の有機野菜のせいろ蒸し.en: seasonal organic vegetables steamed in a seiro

季節の野菜と牛肉の個別陶板.en: individual ceramic plate of seasonal vegetables and beef

季節の野菜をたっぷり使い、20種類以上の食材を一皿に盛り込む『おばんざいランチ』.en: The 'obanzai lunch', with plenty of seasonal vegetables and over 20 ingredients on one plate. The 'low-salt lunch' with Hiroshima rice or brown rice, held to 2 g of salt or less, is also a signature.

季節の食材をふんだんに使用した特別コース。※要予約。11:30〜14:30。.en: A special course making generous use of seasonal ingredients. *Reservation required. 11:30–14:30.

季節の食材をふんだんに使用した贅沢なコース。18:00〜21:30、2〜4名様。.en: A luxurious course making generous use of seasonal ingredients. 18:00–21:30, 2–4 guests. The ¥13,200 course includes a cake with a message for birthdays and anniversaries.

季節の食材を活かしたフランス懐石おまかせコース。 烏賊を細麺状に仕立てた『烏賊の.en: A French-kaiseki omakase course built on seasonal ingredients. Memorable dishes lightly cross the line between French and Japanese, such as 'squid sōmen' with squid cut into fine noodles, spiny lobster gratin and sea bream chazuke.

季節の食材を生かした会席料理（¥3,800の「金城」から¥9,900の「福寿」ま.en: Kaiseki built on seasonal ingredients (from the ¥3,800 Kinjō to the ¥9,900 Fukuju). Starter, sashimi, grilled dish, seasonal dish and dessert, overseen by head chef Chikazawa, who is recognised as an Aichi Master Craftsman.

季節もの。2024年10月の店頭ボードに掲出。.en: Seasonal. Posted on the in-store board in October 2024.

季節や仕入れ状況で.en: depending on the season and sourcing

季節折々のおいしさを、くつろぎながら.en: each season's flavours, enjoyed at your ease

季節限定。カレーのとろみに小麦粉。.en: Seasonal. Wheat flour thickens the curry.

季節限定。価格は店内表示のみ。おでん出汁＝昆布・鰹節・醤油（小麦）。.en: Seasonal. Prices shown only in the shop. Oden broth = kombu, katsuobushi, soy sauce (wheat).

季節限定。牡蠣は北海道厚岸町産と店の掲示にある。つゆは小麦醤油。.en: Seasonal. The shop's notice says the oysters are from Akkeshi, Hokkaido. The broth is wheat soy sauce.

季節限定の「根付き天然せりそば」（鰹出汁の温つゆに天然の根付きせりと豚バラ肉）が.en: The seasonal "wild seri soba, roots and all" (wild seri with roots and pork belly in hot bonito-dashi broth) was judged to surpass the standard of a standing-soba shop.

季節限定（4月〜10月）。なすを揚げるため小麦の混入、つゆも小麦醤油。.en: Seasonal (April–October). The eggplant is fried, so wheat contamination, and the broth is wheat soy sauce too.

宇和島出身の夫婦が手掛ける.en: run by a couple from Uwajima

宇宙一のまぜそば.en: the best mazesoba in the universe

宇治金時ミルク.en: Uji matcha, sweet beans and milk

宇田川町 / 渋谷駅徒歩5分.en: Udagawacho / 5 min walk from Shibuya Station

守り続け、磨き続けてきた老舗の味.en: an old shop's taste, kept and polished over the years

安くてうまい、気軽に立ち寄れる街の中華立ち飲み屋として地元に根付いてきた。.en: Rooted locally as a cheap, tasty neighbourhood Chinese stand-up bar you can drop into easily.

安心して食べられる.en: you can eat with peace of mind

安政元年.en: the first year of the 安政 era

安曇野のジャズファンブログが、店主自作管理のJBLランサーからジャズが流れ、オー.en: An Azumino jazz fan's blog backs up an owner who plays jazz through JBL Lancer speakers the owner built and maintains, and who talks about audio and the history of Zenkoji. ekiten and Retty back up hand-made soba (Nagano buckwheat) along Nakamise and entrances on two sides.

安曇野市に本拠を置く信州の郷土食専門店。 長野・善光寺の仲見世通り（参道）に漬物.en: A Shinshu local-food specialist based in Azumino City. It has a tenant shop on Zenkoji's Nakamise-dori (the temple approach) inside the long-established pickle shop Takahashi Shoten. The main shop is in Swan Garden Azumino, famous for letting you grill the oyaki you buy at an irori hearth where a charcoal fire burns all year.

安藤啓示.en: RICHGARDEN's representative (name given in Japanese only)

完全なグルテンフリー専門店であるかどうかは確認が取れていません.en: it has not been confirmed whether it is a completely gluten-free specialist

完全な肉料理専門店のため、植物性食材のみのコースは提供されておらず、ヴィーガン対.en: A meat-only restaurant, so there is no plant-only course; vegan handling is impossible.

完全に独立した厨房で調理.en: cooked in a completely separate kitchen

完全グルテンフリー米粉パン専門店.en: a fully gluten-free rice-flour bread specialist

完全ヴィーガン。動物性原材料・乳製品・精製糖・うまみ調味料・アルコール調味料は不.en: Fully vegan. No animal ingredients, dairy, refined sugar, MSG or alcohol seasonings.

完全予約制かつ少人数対応の個室あり。食材は予約ごとに個別調達するスタイルで、事前.en: Reservations only, with private rooms for small groups. Ingredients are sourced individually per booking, making it easy to pass on detailed requests in advance.

完全予約制で少人数制のため、事前に食の制限を伝える余地がある。オーナーが素材を個.en: Reservation-only with small numbers, so there is room to explain dietary restrictions in advance. A small independent shop where the owner picks ingredients individually, so it may be flexible.

完全予約制のおまかせ懐石で、予約・来店ともに日本語対応が基本。英語メニューや英語.en: Reservation-only omakase kaiseki; booking and visiting are basically in Japanese. No information on an English menu or English-speaking staff.

完全予約制のため、事前にアレルギー・食材の希望を伝える機会が確保されている。少人.en: Reservations only, so there is a guaranteed chance to pass on allergies and ingredient requests in advance. Small (15 seats), so the chef can easily consider each guest's situation.

完全予約制の懐石料理店。英語メニューあり（訪日外国人向け対応）。靴を脱いで入店す.en: A reservation-only kaiseki restaurant. English menu available (for overseas visitors). Tatami rooms where you take your shoes off. Cards accepted and set up for overseas guests, but communication is mainly in Japanese.

完全予約制の高級イタリアン。日本語での事前コミュニケーション（アレルギー等の申告.en: An upscale reservation-only Italian. Advance communication in Japanese (declaring allergies and so on) is essential; no confirmed information on English service.

完全予約制の高級鉄板焼き店で、英語メニューや英語対応スタッフの情報は確認できず。.en: An upscale reservation-only teppanyaki; no information on an English menu or English-speaking staff could be found. Booking and visiting in Japanese seem to be assumed.

完全個室居酒屋.r: かんぜんこしついざかや

完全十割玄蕎麦 — つなぎ粉を一切使わず、国産玄蕎麦粉100%だけで打った蕎麦。.en: Pure 100% genso-ba — soba made only from 100% Japanese whole-buckwheat flour, with no binder flour at all. The owner stone-grinds heirloom whole buckwheat bought from contract farmers in Niigata and Nagano, and makes the noodles fresh after every order.

完全禁煙。個室あり（2〜4名・4〜6名・VIP 4〜8名）。テイクアウト・デリバ.en: Completely non-smoking. Private rooms (2–4, 4–6, VIP 4–8 people). Takeaway and delivery (Uber Eats) are available, so ingredients can be checked at home with a takeaway.

完全紹介制・会員制で、既存客からの紹介なしでは予約不可。日本語対応が前提の非常に.en: Introduction and membership only; cannot be booked without a referral from an existing guest. A very exclusive full-omakase restaurant that assumes Japanese.

完全紹介制・完全オマカーセのため、予約時に食の制約を細かく伝える機会があり、シェ.en: Being introduction-only and fully omakase, there is a chance to explain dietary restrictions in detail at booking, and the chef can consider individual handling.

完全菜食の店。クリームは植物性。ただしパンは食パン＝小麦。.en: A fully plant-based shop. The cream is plant-based. But the bread is shokupan = wheat.

官公式サイト(mu-sea.com)と伊勢志摩観光ナビ、食べログで確認：2013.en: Confirmed on the official site (mu-sea.com), the Ise-Shima tourism navigator and Tabelog: founded December 2013; the Toba Station branch opened on 7 March 2021; house-roasted coffee and spice-curry bread; a seaside roastery.

定休日（但し祝日の場合は翌日）」.en: closed (or the next day if a holiday)'

定番の酢味噌に麦味噌を使う場合＝小麦。醤油も同様。.en: If the standard vinegared miso uses barley miso = wheat. Same with soy sauce.

定番メニューがベジタリアンで、ヴィーガン対応もしてもらえます.en: the standard menu is vegetarian, and they can do vegan too

定食 ¥1,200。つけ醤油＝小麦。.en: Set meal ¥1,200. Dipping soy sauce = wheat.

定食 ¥1,300。つけ醤油＝小麦。.en: Set meal ¥1,300. Dipping soy sauce = wheat.

定食・ポークカツカレー・家庭料理.en: Set meals, pork-cutlet curry, home cooking

実家が魚屋兼仕出し業という食の環境で育ち、夫の病気を機に2000年に自身の店を開.en: Grew up around food in a family that ran a fish shop and catering business, and opening a shop in 2000 after a husband's illness was the starting point as a cooking expert.

実店舗はございません。通販をご利用ください。」.en: We have no physical shop. Please use mail order."

客席にも持ち込み禁止をご協力いただいております.en: we also ask that outside items not be brought to the tables

宮島かき氷処.r: みやじまかきごおりどころ

宮島の海で獲れた新鮮な穴子と牡蠣を、訪れる人にその場で味わってもらうこと。.en: Letting visitors taste, on the spot, fresh anago and oysters caught in the sea off Miyajima.

宮島クラフトコーラ「Musetta Cola」。スパイス・レモンのシロップ。原材.en: Miyajima craft cola 'Musetta Cola'. A syrup of spices and lemon. Ingredient label not confirmed.

宮島・厳島神社のすぐ近く、賑わう商店街から少し離れた静かな一角に建つ古民家を生か.en: An ocean-view café in an old house in a quiet corner a little away from the busy shopping street, right by Itsukushima Shrine on Miyajima. In a characterful space that keeps the old beams and pillars, antique furniture, sofas and refined tables are arranged, and every seat looks out on the great torii and the Seto Inland Sea. The 1st floor is the café, and the 2nd floor is run as 'private inn lente' with two rooms.

宮島・表参道商店街（清盛通り近く、厳島神社参道）.en: Miyajima, Omotesando shopping street (near Kiyomori-dori, the approach to Itsukushima Shrine)

宮島博多屋ブログとnohgakuで、表参道で唯一の宮島牡蠣生産者直営店であること.en: The Miyajima Hakataya blog and nohgaku confirm it is the only shop on Omotesando run directly by a Miyajima oyster producer, relatively cheap because run by the producer, grilled fresh at the front (plump), the recommendation to eat them whole with a toothpick and no seasoning, and a creamy, pleasantly salty taste.

宮島名物のお好み焼きともみじ饅頭を組み合わせた独自のおやつ『おこもみじ』を考案し.en: Devised 'Okomomiji', an original snack combining Miyajima's famous okonomiyaki and momiji manjū, and registered it as the shop's trademark.

宮島産の穴子と牡蠣を使った郷土料理。看板はあなごめしや焼き牡蠣などの穴子・牡蠣料.en: Local dishes using Miyajima anago and oysters. The signatures are anago and oyster dishes such as anagomeshi and grilled oysters.

宮崎の冷や汁は麦味噌が伝統＝大麦。焼き鯵・鰹だしも入る。.en: Miyazaki hiyajiru traditionally uses barley miso = barley. Also has grilled horse mackerel and bonito dashi.

宮崎の冷汁は焼き魚（主に鯵）と味噌が基本。麦味噌の場合、麦＝大麦は日本の表示義務.en: Miyazaki hiyajiru is basically grilled fish (mainly horse mackerel) and miso. If barley miso, barley isn't subject to Japan's mandatory labeling.

宮崎の甘口醤油で作る自家製醤油餡＝小麦。.en: House soy-sauce glaze made with Miyazaki's sweet soy sauce = wheat.

宮崎の甘口醤油（マルタニ醤油）を使用＝小麦。.en: Uses Miyazaki's sweet soy sauce (Marutani soy sauce) = wheat.

宮崎は麦味噌の産地であり、なめろうの味噌が麦味噌なら大麦＝グルテン。.en: Miyazaki is barley-miso country; if the namero's miso is barley miso, barley = gluten.

宮崎は麦味噌文化圏、味噌の種類を要確認。だしは鰹。.en: Miyazaki is barley-miso country; check the miso type. The dashi is bonito.

宮川町ほった.r: みやがわちょうほった

宮治グループ公式で運営会社・5店舗・四間道の隠れ家立地・『贅沢な大人のためのやき.en: The official Miyaji Group site confirms the operating company, 5 shops, a hideaway location in Shikemichi and the concept 'a yakitori shop for grown-ups who enjoy luxury'. nagoya-meshi confirms binchōtan grilling, Nagoya Cochin tataki, crisp / juicy skewers and a course with non-skewer dishes in between. Mikawa red chicken and a cheese starter could not be supported and were removed.

宮治グループ公式（miyaji-grp.net）で会社所在地・50年・5店舗・コ.en: The official Miyaji Group site (miyaji-grp.net) confirms the company address, 50 years, 5 shops and the concept. Gurunavi confirms 'Kawachi duck tataki = Fugetsu's signature', fully private rooms throughout and menu items such as duck shabu-shabu. Published sources do not explain the origin of the name Fugetsu.

宮治グループ直営.en: run directly by the Miyaji Group

家族経営（創業者一族が各店舗を分担）.en: Family business (the founding family shares the running of the branches)

家系ラーメン斎藤家.r: いえけいらーめんさいとうや

家系＝豚骨＋鶏がら、醤油ダレ、太麺。.en: Iekei = pork bones + chicken carcasses, soy-sauce tare, thick noodles.

家老屋敷跡.en: site of a chief retainer's residence

富士そばの生そばは小麦つなぎ、つゆは小豆島の醤油から作るかえし＋かつお出汁（公式.en: Fuji Soba's fresh soba has a wheat binder; the broth is kaeshi made from Shodoshima soy sauce + bonito dashi (per the official "our dedication to taste").

富士らーめんは浅草で有名なラーメン屋『与ろゐ屋』出身の方が開業されたお店.en: "Fuji Ramen was opened by someone from 'Yoroiya', a famous ramen shop in Asakusa"

寒い中体もあったまって美味しかった.en: it warmed me up in the cold and was delicious

寒くなった時の定番.en: the standard for when it gets cold

寒天・白玉（もち米粉）・餡は小麦不使用が一般的。求肥や煮豆の調味を要確認。.en: Kanten, shiratama (glutinous-rice flour) and bean paste usually have no wheat. Check the gyuhi and the seasoning of the simmered beans.

寒天＝海藻（ゼラチンではない）。赤えんどう豆・寒天・黒蜜のみ＝動物性なし・小麦な.en: Kanten = seaweed (not gelatin). Only red peas, kanten and kuromitsu = nothing animal, no wheat.

寛ぎの時間は、緑とともに.en: time to relax, together with the greenery

寺粥御膳は根菜の煮物や豆腐など植物性食材を中心とした構成と複数のレビューが報告し.en: Several reviews report that the temple porridge set is built mostly from plant ingredients such as simmered root vegetables and tofu.

寺粥御膳（¥1,500）—精進のお粥に根菜や豆腐料理などが添えられるセット。小布.en: The temple rice-porridge set (¥1,500): shojin porridge with root vegetables, tofu dishes and more. Obuse-chestnut kuri-tsuzuri (Mont Blanc), seasonal Japanese sweets and oshiruko are also popular.

寺院：善光寺大勧進（天台宗本坊）.en: Temple: Zenkoji Daikanjin (the Tendai head lodging)

対象ドリンクにビール・麦焼酎・ハイボールを含む。.en: The eligible drinks include beer, barley shochu and highballs.

寿司としゃぶしゃぶ･すき焼き食べ放題 HOT POT LAB 心斎橋難波店.en: Sushi to Shabushabu Sukiyaki Tabehoudai All you can eat HOT POT LAB Shinsaibashi namba ten

寿司屋の玉子焼きは味醂・薄口醤油・つなぎ粉を使うことが多い。要確認。.en: Sushi-shop tamagoyaki often uses mirin, light soy sauce and a binding flour. Ask.

寿司酢・醤油・薬味の調味に小麦。.en: Wheat in the sushi vinegar, soy sauce and condiments.

寿司飯は酢・砂糖・塩＝小麦不使用。つけ醤油が小麦。.en: Sushi rice is vinegar, sugar and salt = no wheat. The dipping soy sauce is wheat.

専用グルテンフリー調理器具・フライヤーの分離使用に関する情報は公式サイト・各種レ.en: Neither the official site nor any review mentions dedicated gluten-free utensils or separate fryers. Cross-contamination risk is thought high in a kitchen that uses a lot of pasta, semolina and wheat-batter fritto.

専用焼酎の原料未記載。.en: The dedicated shochu's ingredients not listed.

専門店であっても堅苦しくなく、気軽に楽しんでほしいという想いで営業している.en: Runs the shop so that people can enjoy it casually, without stiffness, even though it is a specialist

専門店として全焼き菓子が米粉ベースの小麦不使用で、グルテンフリーの土産・スイーツ.en: As a specialist, all baked goods are rice-flour based and wheat-free, and it is introduced in Kyoto GF guides as a gluten-free souvenir and sweet.

専門店とはいえ夫婦2人で営む店で、気軽に楽しんでほしいというのが店主たちの想い。.en: A specialist, yet a shop run by a married couple; the owners' wish is that people enjoy it casually.

小さなカウンター中心の小料理屋。英語メニューや英語対応スタッフの情報なし。日本語.en: A small counter-centred koryori restaurant. No information on an English menu or English-speaking staff. Communication is basically in Japanese.

小さなカウンター中心の店で英語メニューや英語対応の記載はなく、日本語での注文が基.en: A small counter-centred shop with no mention of an English menu or English service; ordering is basically in Japanese.

Only Ichikawa loved coffee enough to roast as a hobby from student days, was drawn to the joy of people enjoying coffee made by hand, and after 18 years of training at the famous Inoda Coffee went independent.

市川屋珈琲は、京都・東山の清水焼の窯元が集まっていた界隈に2015年に開いた喫茶.en: Ichikawaya Coffee is a coffee shop opened in 2015 in the Higashiyama, Kyoto neighbourhood where Kiyomizu-yaki kilns once gathered. The building was the Kiyomizu-yaki workshop and home of owner Yosuke Ichikawa's grandfather, where Ichikawa also lived. This roughly 200-year-old Kyoto townhouse once faced demolition, but out of the wish 'to keep this place', Ichikawa decided on a full renovation costing about four times a new build. Rebuilt by the Kyoto townhouse builders (京町家作事組), it was reborn as a large townhouse café looking onto a courtyard garden. In the Ichikawa family, both the grandfather and father were Kiyomizu-yaki potters, and the elder brother has also followed the path of ceramics. Only Ichikawa loved coffee, enough to roast as a hobby from student days, and after 18 years of training at the famous Inoda Coffee went independent and opened this shop.

店のカードに原材料が印刷されており「カカオマス・ココアパウダー・きび糖・豆乳・コ.en: The shop's card prints the ingredients: "cacao mass, cocoa powder, cane sugar, soy milk, coconut oil, egg, rapeseed oil, wheat flour" = uses wheat flour and egg. A real example to note: even at a macrobiotic-branded shop, the baked goods are wheat. Card from August 2016.

店のサイト (cd-itaru.jp): 大阪・三国のチーズ専門店 Cheese.en: Shop site (cd-itaru.jp): Cheese Dining ItaRu, a cheese restaurant in Mikuni, Osaka; the little-known world of cheese through cooking; classic cheese dishes at lunch, a wide range of cheeses at dinner; Idiazabal Basque cheesecake, Morbier-style rich cheesecake and Camembert de Normandie crème brûlée sold online; 新高3-7-14 1F, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 3 minutes on foot from Hankyu Mikuni Station; lunch 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00); dinner weekdays and Sunday 17:30–22:00, Friday–Saturday 17:30–22:30; closed Monday; 23 seats (20 at tables, 3 at the counter); private hire from 20; cards and e-money accepted; cancel by the day before; a cow at the entrance. Tabelog: a chef who was runner-up in the Cheese Art Fromager Competition 2023; QR payment accepted (PayPay, Alipay and others); no cover charge; non-smoking; Wi-Fi. Reviews (2024 to October 2026): raclette ¥1,900; cheese fondue; share set ¥3,630; stone-pot risotto with Kiki Dairy provolone from Shimane ¥1,540; pork and mushroom cream spaghetti ¥1,870; Galician pork cutlet; ItaRu baguette; prosciutto ¥920; sausage ¥730; mushroom ajillo ¥1,380; wagyu braised in red wine ¥2,200; crab tomato cream pasta; a quiet owner-chef running it alone.

店のサイト (fanfan-osaka.com): 中国料理 璠房 (ファンファ.en: Shop site (fanfan-osaka.com): Chinese Fan Fan (璠房), the main shop; run by Fan Fan Ltd., representative director 田中 敏文; graduated from the Abeno Tsuji cooking school, cooked at 南国酒家 and 泰南飯店 in Harajuku, Tokyo, then in July 1988, aged 25, founded Fan Fan with cooks from the Hotel Nikko Osaka (seniors from 南国酒家); the mapo tofu came from research about 20 years ago, with the shop's own seasonings and a near-authentic taste, served in a clay pot, rare at the time and spread by word of mouth; strongest in Sichuan and Cantonese cooking; the signature Sichuan chen mapo tofu; the shop's own fermented black-bean miso; in its 37th year; five-ingredient ankake fried noodles; shrimp dressed in mayonnaise; shrimp and seasonal vegetables in chili sauce; house black-bean miso 100 g ¥750; sweet bean sauce 190 g ¥1,080; 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:30; closed Sunday and the third Monday; 60 seats; all non-smoking; sister shop 煌彩酒家 璠房 in Higashi-Mikuni; 璠 means a beautiful jewel. Tabelog: Chinese Fan Fan; Chinese, Sichuan, dim sum; 宮原4-3-39 新大阪NKビル 1F, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; cards, e-money and QR accepted. Reviews (2025 to October 2026): Sichuan chen mapo tofu set ¥1,350; free rice refills; the first 30 or so can take fried rice as a refill; aprons; a queue before opening; EPARK; book dinner 1–2 weeks ahead; 2-hour limit; happy-hour draft beer ¥350; course with all-you-can-drink ¥6,800; twice-cooked pork; spring rolls; Shanghai crab-miso shumai; Nira Bakudan water dumplings; century egg; almond tofu; celebrity autographs; moved and renovated.

店のサイト (hou-en.jp): 大阪「新大阪/西中島」の老舗焼肉 朋苑 (.en: Shop site (hou-en.jp): Houen, a long-established yakiniku house in Shin-Osaka / Nishinakajima, Osaka; カジサンビル 1F, 西中島2-15-12, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 17:00–23:30 (last order 22:30); closed Sunday; lunch ended 31 March 2026; four-cut offal platter; top mino with carefully worked cutting; wine, sake, shochu and fruit liquors; semi-private room. Tabelog (shop member): yakiniku, offal; right by exit 2 of the south gate of Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station, 3 minutes from Hankyu Minamikata Station; closed over New Year; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 32 seats (6 at the counter, 26 at tables); private hire 20–50; non-smoking; founded 1994, 32 years; offal bought from a different supplier for each cut and cut in-house; lean meat and secret sauces; banquet with one drink ¥5,000; solo yakiniku with a light drink ¥2,300; Yakiniku WEST 100 in 2021 and 2024. Reviews (2023 to August 2026): thick-cut tongue, premium salt tongue, premium harami, salt-grilled harami, harami with green onion, tsurami, kalbi, marushin, hiuchi, white omasum sashimi, offal platter, course with all-you-can-drink ¥6,000; gas grills leave smoke on clothes; bags for coats.

店のサイト (lamptira-kissa.shopinfo.jp): Lamp.en: Shop site (lamptira-kissa.shopinfo.jp): Lamptira, a kissa of natural-yeast bread and simple sweets; 木川東1-11-15 長島ビル, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 11:30 to about 18:15 (last order 18:00), open to 19:00 if guests are still having tea; closed Wednesday plus days announced each month. Tabelog: Kissa Lamptila; café, bread, cakes; 10 minutes on foot from Hankyu Juso Station, 7 from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; no reservations; AMEX listed; 13 seats; non-smoking; one parking space; takeaway; opened 23 June 2010. Reviews (2023 to October 2026): bread ¥250–420 a piece; natural-yeast bread set (vegetables and soup) under ¥1,000; Hug Bread Plate; bagel plate; chicken ham mixed sandwich ¥930; focaccia with egg and bacon; winter-only toast sandwich of turnip and nori ¥740; cinnamon-sugar toast; scones; pudding ¥560; pumpkin pudding ¥550; Fairy’s Step lemon cake with yogurt ice cream ¥700; Black Cheesecake ¥900; strawberry roll cake ¥720; masala chai ¥600; Assam milk tea ¥630; a regular since before the name change; a note asking for quiet; cash only, per 2026 diners.

店のサイト (mdeli.jp): M&DELI、松阪牛専門店、中之島ビーフサン.en: Shop site (mdeli.jp): M&DELI, a Matsusaka beef specialist; the Nakanoshima beef sandwich, 100% Matsusaka beef, born at 'M Deli & Burger' in Nakanoshima, Osaka; 3.5 million sold; a buyer stationed in Mie buys whole Matsusaka cattle; marbled and lean slices layered and coated one by one into a beef katsu; a slightly sweet sauce with mustard; lightly toasted bread; JR Shin-Osaka Station, ASTY Shin-Osaka (inside the Shinkansen gates), 6:30–21:00; also a sales counter in ASTY Kyoto; Lighthouse Co., Ltd. Tabelog: M&DELI JR Shin-Osaka Station shop; sandwiches; take-away only; no cards; transport e-money and QR accepted. Reviews (2022 to October 2026): ¥1,450; half and regular sizes; a limited croquette sandwich; eaten on the Shinkansen; good even cold; opened 2010; the company also runs Matsusaka Beef Yakiniku M; some find it overpriced.

店のサイト (so-ya.co.jp): 西中島南方の焼肉・しゃぶしゃぶ専門店「.en: Shop site (so-ya.co.jp): Nikuya Kushihachi, a yakiniku and shabu-shabu specialist at Nishinakajima-Minamigata; about 40 years; the finest meat chosen by experienced eyes, bought in blocks and hand-cut in the shop; what matters is taste, not brand; only female cattle judged top grade, from all over Japan; shabu-shabu a signature; courses with both shabu-shabu and yakiniku on reservation; the omakase course recommended for first-timers; private rooms, tables and counter; English and Chinese pages. Tabelog: Nikuya Kushihachi Nishinakajima main shop; yakiniku, shabu-shabu, steak; 西中島3-21-4, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 1 minute on foot from exit 1 of Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; Mon–Fri 17:00–22:30 (last order 21:45), Sat and holidays 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday and one irregular day a month; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; appetiser ¥380; 100 seats (5 at the counter, 93 on sunken kotatsu); private rooms; smoking allowed. Reviews (2020 to September 2026): omakase course; yukhoe; heart sashimi; omasum sashimi; thick-cut tongue; chateaubriand; tenderloin; loin; harami; ribeye; kalbi; offal; cold noodles; weekday course with all-you-can-drink ¥8,000; thick salted tongue; premium harami; sirloin cap; tsurami; liver; tongue sashimi; rice with raw egg; second-floor sunken-kotatsu private rooms; a day when the owner grilled; some say the course is served slowly.

店のサイト (toriya-en.com): 新大阪・東淀川の焼き鳥店、紀州備長.en: Shop site (toriya-en.com): a yakitori shop in Shin-Osaka and Higashi-Yodogawa; Kishu binchotan; the owner fans the charcoal while judging each cut's moisture and fat; the omakase skewers, 7 or 10, with the owner particular about doneness and the order they come out; breast, gizzard, neck, liver, tsunagi, wing, quail egg, skin; sasami sashimi; liver pâté; limited-time Iwate duck loin over charcoal, and smoked prosciutto with fig; sake, wine and shochu chosen by the owner; 18:00–22:00; closed Wednesday; cash and credit cards; all seats non-smoking; reservations recommended. Tabelog: Toriya, En; yakitori, sake bar, izakaya; 1-3-12 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 2 minutes on foot from JR Higashi-Yodogawa Station; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 18:00–23:00; closed Wednesday; 18 seats (8 at the counter, 10 at tables); opened 1 March 2004. Reviews (2023 to October 2026): omakase 7 skewers ¥1,800, 10 skewers ¥2,700; chicken breast sashimi ¥870; liver sashimi ¥900; rare-grilled hen ¥680; fried cartilage ¥500; chicken-soup chazuke ¥700; grilled rice ball chazuke; young corn; cabbage appetiser ¥500; raw tsukune dropped after a TV feature; the owner trained at Ayamuya; hard to get in without a reservation.

店のサイト: 和食の店 青地、四季折々の旬の食材を使った美味しいお料理をアットホ.en: Shop site: Aochi, a Japanese restaurant; delicious dishes made with the ingredients of each season, enjoyed casually in a homely atmosphere; opened 12 March 2013; closed Tuesday and Wednesday since May 2022; 9 counter seats and two tables for four; on the north side of the second street east off Naniwa-suji, going north from the Nishi-Ohashi crossing; about 3 min on foot from Nishi-Ohashi Stn exit 2. Menu examples: Akashi wild sea bream sashimi; Chiba bonito sashimi or tataki; hamo seared, or blanched with plum; aori squid sashimi; hairy crab with sanbaizu vinegar; Kamo eggplant simmered with myoga; lotus-root manju; celery with miso-vinegar dressing; salt-grilled extra-thick asparagus; simmered rockfish; gindara saikyo-yaki; anago kabayaki; young ayu tempura or kara-age; Tajima chicken salt-grilled or kara-age; bite-size wagyu fillet katsu; natto zosui; anago rice; prices vary with the day's stock. Tabelog: Daiichi Goda Bldg 1F, Shinmachi 1-30-6, Nishi-ku, Osaka; Mon 17:00–22:30, Thu–Sun 17:00–23:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; closed over the New Year holidays; reservations accepted; cards (VISA, Master); no e-money or QR; 10% service charge; 16 seats (8 counter, 8 table); non-smoking; children welcome; BYO allowed; opened 12 March 2013. Reviews (January–October 2026): always full of regulars, some older; matsutake dobin-mushi; summer eggplant; shishamo; chicken; bamboo shoots simmered with wakame; kizushi; raw oysters; sashimi; mentaiko with a little karasumi; white sesame and celery salad; grilled duck with island garlic; zosui; natto zosui; reasonably priced seasonal tempura; plenty of sake; a phone call when a seat opened; both the chef and the owner pleasant; about ¥8,000–15,000 a person (Tabelog).

店のサイト: 大阪堀江 創作串揚げ 勝新、大阪市西区北堀江1-10-2 都市開発.en: Shop site: Osaka Horie creative kushiage KATSUSHIN, unit 101, Kitahorie 1-10-2, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 18:00–23:00 last entry, closes at 24:00; closed Sunday; ends when the day's ingredients sell out. Kushiage halfway between kushikatsu and tempura; vegetarian and gluten-free catered for; skewers for children; kushiage of seasonal produce bought at the market that day; omakase kushiage course (say when to stop; roughly 10, 15 or 20 skewers); 100% Tsuno rice oil from Wakayama Prefecture; wheat allergy and gluten-free catered for (tell the staff if you would like this). Tabelog: Horie Kushiage KATSUSHIN, 113 m from Yotsubashi Stn; Mon–Sat 18:00–01:00; closed Sunday; reservations accepted; cards (JCB, AMEX), QUICPay and QR accepted; 10 seats; non-smoking. Reviews (October 2025–September 2026): rice-flour batter and rice oil, light and not heavy; finished with a torch; omakase, stop when you like; courses of 10, 12, 13, 15 or 20 skewers; about ¥300 a skewer; salad and fried zucchini to start; angel shrimp, wagyu tenderloin, kisu with crab and mitsuba, lotus root with shiso and minced meat, potato with truffle butter, octopus with Brussels sprouts, Kawachi duck with porcini, whelk with maitake, firefly squid with bamboo shoot, nama-fu with vinegar miso and ikura, abalone with canola blossoms, roast beef wrapped around foie gras, eel chazuke, dessert skewers; sesame salt, dashi soy sauce, sauce, lemon; aosa dashi chazuke; one person runs the shop and it is always full, so booking is a must; a regular since the opening ten years ago; a chateaubriand skewer for the 10th anniversary; some found the batter hard and gritty.

店のサイト: 宇治香園 大阪心斎橋店、昭和21年に心斎橋筋に日本茶専門店を構え、.en: Shop site: Uji Koen Osaka Shinsaibashi shop; set up as a Japanese tea specialist on Shinsaibashi-suji in 1946 (Showa 21), with a tea room at the back; shop 12:00–19:00, takeout 12:00–18:30, tea room Fri, Sat, Sun and holidays only 14:00–17:00 (L.O. 16:30); closed over the New Year holidays; the tea room closed for renovation until 31 October and reopens on 1 November; a tea room serving Japanese tea brewed in a kyusu; takeout drinks and matcha soft serve; the tea-brewing class "Ichiwan Chakai" is suspended. Company information: Uji Koen Co., Ltd., founded in Keio 1 (1865); Kyoto head office and factory, and the Osaka Shinsaibashi shop. History: began as a tea peddler in Yamashiro, Kyoto; exported to the United States from about Meiji 11 (1878); the Osaka Shinsaibashi shop in Showa 21 (1946); a Japanese-tea tea room in Heisei 15 (2003); iF Design Award in Reiwa 3 (2021); 160th anniversary and Good Design Award in Reiwa 7 (2025). Tabelog (corporate member): Shinsaibashisuji 1-5-19, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min from Shinsaibashi Station Exit 6 along Shinsaibashi-suji towards Namba; no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 5 counter seats; non-smoking. Reviews (October 2021 to October 2025): rich matcha soft serve heaped with matcha powder (¥400 in December 2023, ¥500 in August 2025), a matcha-and-milk mix, matcha latte; in the tea room at the back, gyokuro brewed with an hourglass timer, with refills; hojicha; hojicha roll cake; matcha ice cream; hojicha and gyokuro tea bags; a bench at the shop front.

店のサイトは品名のみで価格・アレルゲンを公開していない。.en: The shop's site lists item names only, no prices or allergens.

店のブログ (ameblo、2012年まで更新): 祗園「秀蛸」、京都生まれのた.en: Shop blog (ameblo, updated until 2012): Gion Hide Tako, a takoyaki shop born in Kyoto, Gion main shop and Kiyamachi shop; a February 2012 post mentions "all members of the three Hide Tako shops". Tabelog: takoyaki; 清本町353-1 花見小路ビル 1F, Higashiyama-ku; 310 m from Gion-Shijo Stn; Mon–Sat 18:00–04:00 (L.O. 3:30); Sun and holidays 18:00–03:00 (L.O. 2:30); irregular closing days; no reservations; 13 seats; smoking allowed; no cards or QR; e-money accepted; take-out. Reviews (February 2025 – June 2026, in English): 17 kinds, 8 for ¥800; half-and-half +¥50; sauce, salt, pizza, demi-glace, seaweed kimchi, green onion with wasabi; beef tendon stew; gizzard; sake and champagne; a shop running 20 years; a young second-generation owner; half-outdoor seats cold on autumn nights; small beer glasses.

店のブログ: 「魚菜処 ほりばた」は此花店、豊中店、三国店の3店舗で約25年間居.en: Shop blog: 魚菜処 ほりばた ran izakaya in three shops, Konohana, Toyonaka and Mikuni, for about 25 years; in the COVID-19 years the owner turned to take-home recipes, frozen food by mail, and the ramen long wanted; using what was learned as a cook running izakaya, it reopened in March 2024 as 麺処 ほりばた; rice is Akita Komachi from Akita grown with organic fertiliser; a limited rich chicken-paitan shoyu ramen ¥950 (seasoned egg ¥1,050, special ¥1,250) from 5 October 2026; chilled ramen in summer only. Tabelog: Men Dokoro Horibata; ramen; 岩崎ビル 1F, 三国本町3-27-8, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 2 minutes on foot from Hankyu Mikuni Station; Mon–Sat and holidays 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–22:00; closed Sunday; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible. Reviews (May 2024 to April 2026): changed from izakaya to ramen shop on 7 March 2024; beef-bone shio ramen ¥850–890; Kogashi Niboshi shoyu ramen ¥850–890; homemade shio-koji; rare beef chashu; noodles from Saitama; thin or thick noodles; the owner runs it alone; formerly a Japanese-cuisine cook; ticket machine.

店のボードの表記そのまま「小麦粉不使用のチョコレートケーキ」。ただし同じ厨房でホ.en: The shop's board says, word for word, "chocolate cake made without wheat flour." But the same kitchen handles hot sandwiches, quiche and bread, so check for trace contamination. Probably contains egg and dairy.

店のメニューが「ドレッシングなし（ハーフ）380円」と明記。葉物のみでドレッシン.en: The shop's menu states 'no dressing (half) ¥380'. Just leaves, so without dressing there's no wheat and nothing animal. The regular version is ¥580.

店のロゴはキッチンカー時代から使い続けている馬のモチーフ。「自由に動き回る」イメ.en: The logo is a horse motif used since the food-truck days. It embodies the image of 'moving around freely', and local media described the timing of opening in the 2026 Year of the Horse as 'a lovely coincidence'.

店の一番人気。自家製タレは醤油＝小麦。塩の串もタレ串と同じ焼き台のため要注意。.en: The shop's most popular. The house sauce is soy sauce = wheat. Salt skewers go on the same grill as sauce skewers, so take care.

店の中央に胡麻油、芝麻醤、豆板醤、醤油など10種類以上の調味料が置かれ、客が自分.en: More than ten condiments such as sesame oil, sesame paste, doubanjiang and soy sauce sit in the middle of the shop, and each customer mixes a personal sauce (shared condiments and utensils).

店の中央に胡麻油や芝麻醤、豆板醤、醤油などの調味料が10種類以上置かれ、自分でオ.en: More than ten condiments such as sesame oil, sesame paste, doubanjiang and soy sauce are set in the middle of the shop so you can make your own original sauce (¥200 per person for two plates, refills free).

店の公式アレルゲン表で、この一品だけ小麦の表示がない（ごま・さば・大豆・豚肉のみ.en: On the shop's official allergen chart, this one dish alone has no wheat mark (only sesame, mackerel, soy, pork).

店の公式アレルゲン表で小麦・大麦とも「該当なし」、つゆは特製グルテンフリー辛汁。.en: The shop's official allergen chart marks both wheat and barley "not applicable"; the broth is a special gluten-free karajiru.

店の公式アレルゲン表：小麦.en: the shop's official allergen chart: wheat

店の公式サイトが「ヴィーガン」と明示。ただし自家製麺は小麦であり、グルテンフリー.en: The shop's official site states "vegan". But the house-made noodles are wheat, so not gluten-free.

店の公式サイトが「ヴィーガン」と明示。味噌の種類（麦味噌か米味噌か）は未公開、麺.en: The shop's official site states "vegan". The miso type (barley or rice) isn't published, but the noodles are wheat so the conclusion is the same.

店の公式サイトが「ヴィーガン」と明示。麺は小麦。.en: The shop's official site states "vegan". The noodles are wheat.

店の公式サイトは「完全グルテンフリー米粉パン専門店」を掲げ、国産米粉のみ・小麦・.en: The shop's official site bills itself as 'a fully gluten-free rice-flour bread specialist' and states domestic rice flour only, with no wheat or egg. Ingredients include seaweed salt from an Inland Sea island and Amami Oshima cane sugar. komeko-palette explains it as a fully wheat-free environment that fundamentally eliminates the risk of wheat contamination from production equipment and utensils. Opened in Toshimatsu, Saeki-ku in November 2022.

店の公式サイト・コラム（cafe-de-f.jp）とグルテンフリーガイド（emp.en: According to the shop's official site and column (cafe-de-f.jp) and a gluten-free guide (empacede), an owner from Iwate Prefecture and the owner's daughter opened it in spring 2024 in 春日, Bunkyo-ku. A homey café particular about Japanese rice flour, Iwate products (Iwaizumi yogurt, Morioka rice-flour cold noodles), no additives and low sugar; it caters to customers with gluten intolerance or celiac disease, but states that "not every item is gluten-free" and "we cannot fully accommodate allergies".

店の公式サイト（hiroshimayaki.biz）と広島経済新聞、オタフクソー.en: From the shop's official site (hiroshimayaki.biz), the Hiroshima Keizai Shimbun and an Otafuku Sauce column: founded 1970, owner Nakagawa Ken. Developed an okonomiyaki free of the 7 major allergens in 2013, gluten-free in 2015 and low-carb on 1 October 2017. The gluten-free type uses batter and noodles with no wheat flour or wheat-derived ingredients. All require reservations.

店の公式メニュー表で「.en: on the shop's official menu, under the heading "

店の公式メニュー表の「.en: the shop's official menu lists it under "

店の公式表記「小麦粉を使わず、野菜とスパイスの旨みで仕上げたグルテンフリーカリー.en: Based on the shop's official statement "a gluten-free curry finished with the savoriness of vegetables and spices, without wheat flour".

店の原材料表示：国産生姜をたっぷり、シナモン・クローブ・スターアニス・赤トウガラ.en: Shop's ingredient note: lots of domestic ginger, slowly simmered with cinnamon, cloves, star anise and red chilli. No grain and no animal ingredients. The iced version is carbonated.

店の品書き：つなぎ粉も打ち粉も一切使わない純粋な国産十割蕎麦。.en: The shop's menu: pure Japanese 100% buckwheat soba with no binder flour and no dusting flour at all.

店の商品ページが特定原材料「小麦」と明記。.en: The shop's product page states the specified allergen "wheat".

店の商品ページが特定原材料「小麦」と明記。Shop states 小麦..en: The shop's product page states the specified allergen "wheat". Shop states wheat.

店の商品ページが特定原材料「小麦」と明記（醤油由来）。.en: The shop's product page states the specified allergen "wheat" (from soy sauce).

店の商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし。.en: The shop's product page lists no specified allergens.

店の商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし。きなこは大豆。.en: No specified allergens on the shop's product page. Kinako is soy.

店の商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし。もち米とささげ豆のみ。.en: No specified allergens on the shop's product page. Just glutinous rice and black-eyed peas.

店の商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし。寒天・赤えんどう・黒みつのみの構成。.en: No specified allergens on the shop's product page. Just kanten, red peas and kuromitsu.

店の商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし。抹茶あんみつや季節のあんみつもあり。.en: No specified allergens on the shop's product page. Matcha anmitsu and seasonal anmitsu too.

店の商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし（みたらし等には「小麦」表示があるため、無表.en: No specified allergens on the shop's product page (mitarashi and others are labeled "wheat", so no label means something).

店の手書き注記：「材料が高くなっている為、値上げしました。すみません」。ケチャッ.en: The shop's handwritten note: "We've raised prices because ingredients have gotten more expensive. Sorry." The Worcestershire or demi-glace used in the ketchup rice is wheat; contains egg.

店の材料表記は「米茄子、大豆ミート、ソイチーズ、かぼちゃ、玉葱、人参、セロリ、豆.en: The shop's ingredient list is "Bei eggplant, soy meat, soy cheese, pumpkin, onion, carrot, celery, soy milk, cumin, nutmeg", with no wheat listed. No pasta dough; eggplant is used instead (course description: "eggplant standing in for pasta").

店の注意書き「1辛でも辛いです。個人差あり」「かなり辛いです！ご注意」。.en: The shop's warnings: 'Even level 1 is spicy. It varies by person' and 'Very spicy! Be careful.'

店の注記「(一例です)」。煮物・角煮・そぼろあんは醤油＝小麦、酢味噌は味噌の種類.en: Shop note: "(an example)". The simmered dishes, kakuni and soboro sauce are soy sauce = wheat; the vinegared miso depends on the type of miso. Phone reservation only, at least 3 business days ahead. Separate 5% service charge.

店の注記「ミニ抹茶だけのご注文はご遠慮ください」。2019年表示（税抜）。.en: Shop note: "Please don't order only a mini matcha." 2019 listing (before tax).

店の注記「メニュー内容はある日の一例となります」。3営業日前までの予約制。パスタ.en: Shop note: "The menu is an example from one day." Reservations at least 3 business days ahead. Pasta and baguette = wheat.

店の注記：「岩のり・わかめ・月見が乗っています。味玉は.en: The shop's note: "Topped with iwanori, wakame and a moon-viewing egg. The seasoned egg

店の注記：「豚骨で炊いた特製スパイスカレーです」。日本のカレーは小麦粉のルウが一.en: The shop's note: "A special spice curry cooked with pork bones". Japanese curry usually uses a wheat-flour roux, and this one is pork-bone based.

店の特定原材料表示＝そば・小麦・大豆・さば・やまいも。.en: The shop's specified-allergen labeling = buckwheat, wheat, soy, mackerel, yam.

店の看板おすすめ。塩か醤油ダレかを要確認。.en: The shop's top recommendation. Ask whether it's salt or soy sauce.

店の看板オススメ。やわらかジューシー。.en: The shop's top recommendation. Tender and juicy.

店の紹介文が「広島県産のレモンでつくった生搾りのサワー」と明記。ベース焼酎が麦焼.en: The shop's description states 'freshly squeezed sour made with Hiroshima lemons'. If the base shōchū is barley shōchū it's barley-derived, so check the brand. Price not published.

店の英文表記が SWEET BEANS WITH RICE FLOUR DUMP.en: The shop's English label states SWEET BEANS WITH RICE FLOUR DUMPLING AND CHEST NUT = the shiratama is rice flour, no wheat. Only azuki, sugar, chestnut and rice, with nothing animal. ¥1,000 in a 2026/03 review, ¥1,100 in 2025/11.

店の茶そばの特定原材料表示に小麦。.en: The shop's specified-allergen labeling for matcha soba lists wheat.

店の表示で茶そばに小麦。.en: The shop's labeling lists wheat in the matcha soba.

店の表記「卵・乳製品は一切未使用」でヴィーガン確定。小麦の有無は日替わりのため未.en: The shop states "no eggs or dairy at all", so confirmed vegan. Whether there's wheat isn't listed because it changes daily.

店の表記「国産鮮魚エソ100.en: the shop's label: "100% Japanese fresh lizardfish

店の表記どおり3杯目は「？」（当日のおまかせ）。.en: As the shop writes it, the third glass is '?' (the day's choice).

店の表記は「塩ベースの煮汁」で醤油の記載なし。.en: The shop describes a "salt-based simmering liquid", with no mention of soy sauce.

店の記載どおりパン付き＝小麦。フレンチのソースはブイヨン・ルウに小麦を使うことが.en: Comes with bread, as the shop states = wheat. French sauces often use wheat in the bouillon and roux. The shop states, 'Please be sure to tell us about allergies and other foods you cannot eat when booking' (also stating that same-day changes are not possible and that 'no fish at all' or 'no meat at all' cannot be accommodated).

店の説明「鶏肉をオリジナルの割り下で軽く煮込み、トロトロのこだわり卵で仕上げ」。.en: The shop says "chicken lightly simmered in our original warishita, finished with soft, runny special eggs". Warishita = soy sauce and mirin, so wheat. Uses egg. Set with karaage + mini salad ¥1,500.

店の説明が「塩と胡椒でシンプルに焼き上げた」＝小麦不使用の可能性が高い一皿。付合.en: The shop says "simply grilled with salt and pepper" = a dish very likely wheat-free. Check whether a sauce comes with it. Marked as recommended.

店の説明に「薄力粉は全粒粉へ」＝小麦の全粒粉使用。.en: The shop's description says "cake flour replaced with whole-wheat flour" = uses whole-wheat flour.

店の説明に「衣を付けてフリットした」とある＝小麦粉。.en: The shop's description says "coated and fried as a fritter" = wheat flour.

店の説明は「ピンク色の餅」＝道明寺系（米）と読めるが、関東の長命寺式桜餅は小麦粉.en: The shop's "pink mochi" reads as the Dōmyōji type (rice), but the Kanto Chōmeiji-style sakura-mochi uses a wheat-flour wrapper. Always check.

店の説明：JSA SAKE DIPLOMAでもある燗番が厳選。酒蔵を訪ねて仕入れ.en: Shop's description: chosen by the kanban (sake-warming master), who also holds the JSA SAKE DIPLOMA, and bought by visiting the breweries. Junmai sake is only rice and rice kōji, so gluten-free, but pairings with the food need checking separately.

店の説明：和風だしで炊いた旬のお野菜。和風だし＝かつお・白だしの可能性が高くヴィ.en: Shop's description: seasonal vegetables simmered in Japanese dashi. Japanese dashi = very likely bonito or shiro-dashi, so not vegan; with shiro-dashi or soy sauce, wheat as well. Also ask about gelatine.

店は「ヴィーガンとグルテンフリーを楽しめるコース」と表記。ただし2皿目の選択肢に.en: The shop calls it "a course where you can enjoy vegan and gluten-free". But the second-dish choices include chicken-breast ham, a pie-crust bake (pastry = wheat),

店は「小麦粉を使わず、野菜とスパイスの旨みで仕上げたグルテンフリーカリー」と自ら.en: The shop itself states "a gluten-free curry finished with the savoriness of vegetables and spices, without wheat flour". But this one dish alone uses miso, and the site doesn't say what type (whether barley miso).

店はこの欄に自ら《GLUTEN FREE 〜そば粉100%〜》と明記。ただし同じ.en: In this section the shop itself writes "GLUTEN FREE — 100% buckwheat flour". But its baked goods from the same kitchen list wheat flour among their ingredients (see the cakes below), so cross-contamination from shared equipment can't be avoided. If celiac, check directly with the shop. Also check what grain the "grain salad" uses. Card from August 2016.

店は動物性食材を一切使用しない100%ヴィーガン業態で、大豆ミートも使わずオリジ.en: The shop is a 100% vegan concept using no animal ingredients at all, and is said to use original bean-based patties rather than soy meat.

店サイト表記：ｱﾐｭｰｽﾞ／ｽｰﾌﾟ／ﾃﾘｰﾇ／メイン料理／パン／ﾃﾞｻﾞｰﾄ／.en: As on the shop's site: amuse / soup / terrine / main / bread / dessert / coffee / petits fours. Tabelog: 'a short course with terrine and a choice of fish or meat'. Bread comes as standard, and French sauces often use a wheat roux. 11:30–14:30, 2–4 guests.

店サイト表記：ｱﾐｭｰｽﾞ／ﾃﾘｰﾇ／ｵｰﾄﾞﾌﾞﾙ2品目／お魚料理／お肉料理／.en: As on the shop's site: amuse / terrine / second hors d'oeuvre / fish / meat / bread / rice / dessert / coffee / petits fours. 11:30–14:30, 2–4 guests.

店サイト：「当店は『OMAKASE』コースのみのご案内となります」。会員制・完全.en: Shop site: 'We offer only the OMAKASE course.' Members only, by introduction only; no entry under 18. 17:30–22:30, irregular closing days. The shop site says 'we accommodate allergies and disliked foods as far as possible', but 'we cannot accommodate on the day of the booking, so please consult us when booking'. If you want gluten handled, be sure to say so when booking.

店サイト：「揚げたてや最高の油・衣の状態に拘る為におまかせコース一本、一斉スター.en: Shop site: 'Because we are particular about freshly fried food and the best state of oil and batter, there is one omakase course only, in two seatings that start all at once.' Tempura batter = wheat. *Please tell us about allergies in advance (same-day ingredient changes are difficult). Dinner in two seatings, 17:30– / 20:30–.

店主さんご夫妻の2名体制.en: run by the owner couple, two people

店主さん曰く、お麩を乗せているのは「可愛いから.en: according to the owner, the fu goes on top "because it's cute

店主の武田香織さんは関東（神奈川県）出身。会社員をしながら調理師免許を取得し、大.en: Owner 武田香織 is from Kanagawa in the Kanto region. While working at a company, the owner qualified as a cook and trained for about two years at a French restaurant in Osaka. Moved by Miwa sōmen from Sakurai, the owner decided to move to Nara and in April 2019 opened a sōmen specialist in a renovated Naramachi townhouse. The signature is sea-bream-broth sōmen using the French technique fumet de poisson, with unusual variations such as tomato sōmen of wholemeal noodles.

店主の気まぐれメニュー／冷菜・前菜.en: the owner's whim menu / cold dishes and starters

店主の気まぐれメニュー／温菜.en: the owner's whim menu / hot dishes

店主の高齢により閉店予定だったが、餃子家龍などを展開する会社が事業を引き継ぎ.en: It was due to close because of the owner's advanced age, but the company behind Gyozaya Ryu and other shops took over the business

店主はカフェ商品開発時に食物アレルギーを研究し、3大アレルゲン不使用スイーツの製.en: The owner researched food allergies while developing café products, and the business began with making and selling sweets free of the three major allergens. Allergy handling is at the core of the business.

店主はグアテマラ出身で英語・スペイン語も通じやすく、店内に世界地図を掲げて旅行者.en: The owner is from Guatemala and gets by easily in English and Spanish, and chats with travellers using the world map in the shop, so even foreign students can drop in casually with basic Japanese greetings.

店主はスリランカの茶園生まれで、現地の紅茶文化を紅茶ファンに直接届けることをコン.en: The owner was born on a Sri Lankan tea estate; the concept is to bring the local tea culture straight to tea fans (tea certified by the Sri Lanka Tea Board, bought through the shortest possible distribution route).

店主は世代を超えて愛される地域の店を目指している――「幼い頃に親に連れられて来て.en: The owner aims for a local shop loved across generations: 'A child who came here with the family grows up and comes back bringing a family. I want it to be a shop rooted in the community and loved across generations like that.'

店主は人見知りが激しく愛想も無く無口ですが怒っているわけではございません。とても.en: The owner is very shy, unsmiling and quiet, but not angry. A very gentle soul.

店主は元スペイン料理店『Gentry』のオーナーシェフで、2021年3月に同店を.en: The owner is the former owner-chef of the Spanish restaurant 'Gentry', which closed in March 2021; Bocarroz opened in April the same year.

店主は全国のわらび餅を食べ歩き、ミシュランシェフとタイアップして「ぜいみ」を完成.en: The official site says the owner ate warabi mochi all over Japan and completed "Zeimi" in a tie-up with a Michelin-starred chef.

店主は埼玉の人気二郎系店「富士丸 東浦和店」と「D麺」で修行した。.en: The owner trained at the popular Saitama Jiro-style shops "Fujimaru Higashi-Urawa" and "D-men".

店主は大阪の有名店ラーメン人生.en: the owner is from the famous Osaka shop Ramen Jinsei

店主は浅草橋の専門店「串衛門」で食べた串揚げに感銘を受け、同店で修行を積んだ後に.en: The owner was moved by the kushiage eaten at "串衛門", a specialist in Asakusabashi, trained there, then went independent and opened in Nishi-Asakusa.

店主は米粉マイスター・五ツ星お米マイスターの有資格者で、グルテンフリーを明確に掲.en: The owner is a certified rice-flour meister and five-star rice meister, and clearly promotes gluten-free (

店主厳選のため内容日替わり、価格は店頭表示。.en: Contents change daily as chosen by the owner; prices posted in the shop.

店主自ら新潟県・長野県の契約農家から仕入れた在来種のみの玄そばを石臼で挽き、蕎麦.en: The owner stone-grinds heirloom whole buckwheat bought from contract farmers in Niigata and Nagano, and grows the spicy daikon served with the broth too.

店主自身の言葉によれば「私が学生の頃、べた焼き節ちゃんと言う名で母がやってました.en: In the owner's own words: 'When I was a student, my mother ran it under the name Betayaki Setsu-chan. My mother is Setsuko. Out of respect and gratitude to my mother, I took over the name Setsu-chan.' The owner says the shop opened on 27 July 2024.

店側は河内鴨について、脂の融点が低く（20℃以下で溶けるとされる）不飽和脂肪酸を.en: The shop explains that Kawachi duck fat has a low melting point (said to melt below 20 °C), is high in unsaturated fatty acids and does not sit heavy. Kawachi duck is known as a rare brand duck originating in Osaka.

店全体が100%プラントベースで動物性食材を扱わないため、ヴィーガンの交差接触リ.en: The whole shop is 100% plant-based and handles no animal ingredients, so the vegan cross-contact risk is low.

店全体が小麦粉を一切使わない100%グルテンフリー方針のため、店内に小麦を持ち込.en: The whole shop follows a 100% gluten-free policy with no wheat flour at all, so no wheat is brought into the kitchen. No dedicated fryer or strict celiac protocol is stated, so with severe celiac disease it's safest to check when you visit.

店公式のシェフ紹介（don-antonio.jp/profile）が、1960年.en: The shop's official chef profile (don-antonio.jp/profile) states: born in 1960 in Calabria, southern Italy; moved to Milan in 1963; culinary school in Milan in 1975; came to Japan in 1985; private chef to the Brazilian Embassy in 1989; opened the trattoria in Shirakabe in October 2009.

店内にはハイドンなどクラシックの楽曲が流れ、ヨーロッパの古城のような雰囲気をつく.en: Classical music such as Haydn plays in the shop, creating the atmosphere of an old European castle.

店内には卓上調味料がなく、スープや具材へのこだわりが徹底されています.en: There are no condiments on the tables; the attention to soup and toppings is thorough

店内には水引アートや繊細なバラン細工が飾られており、そのうちの一つは姫路城を模し.en: The interior is decorated with mizuhiki cord art and delicate baran cut-leaf work, one piece modelled on Himeji Castle. Traces of the owner's honed handiwork can be seen throughout.

店内に世界地図を掲げ、自国グアテマラを指し示すことで旅行者と対話する。『戦争にな.en: A world map hangs in the shop, and pointing out Guatemala on it opens conversations with travellers. 'Once it becomes war, it's too late. I want people who come to Hiroshima to become people who can judge whether one's own country is heading in the right direction,' the owner says, valuing passing on the memory of Hiroshima, the bombed city, and an understanding of the root causes of war.

店内の全てのメニューが小麦、卵、乳製品不使用.en: every item on the menu is free of wheat, egg and dairy

店内の商品はすべて小麦不使用.en: everything in the shop is wheat-free

店内はケーキやドリンクとともにCBDオイルなども扱い、都会の喧騒から離れてリラッ.en: The shop carries CBD oils along with cakes and drinks, and is designed as an oasis to relax away from the city bustle.

店名「OLMO」は、店側の説明ではイタリア語で「ケヤキ（欅）」を指す言葉とされ、.en: The name 'OLMO', by the shop's own explanation, is an Italian word for zelkova, and expresses a will toward food rooted in place: enjoying warm Italian food and natural wine around a zelkova table.

店名「カナック」はヒンディー語で金・小麦を意味し、収穫期の小麦のように控えめに輝.en: The name 'Kanak' means gold or wheat in Hindi, and carries the wish to shine modestly like wheat at harvest time.

店名『ボカロス』は、スペイン語で『ボカディージョ（サンドイッチ）』のボカと、米料.en: The name 'Bocarroz' is a coinage combining 'boca' from the Spanish bocadillo (sandwich) and 'arroz', meaning a rice dish.

店名『ボカロス（BOCARROZ）』はスペイン語のボカディージョ（サンドイッチ）.en: The name 'Bocarroz (BOCARROZ)' combines 'boca' from the Spanish bocadillo (sandwich) and 'arroz', meaning a rice dish.

店名に「全粒粉」＝小麦。バターの代わりにオリーブオイル。.en: "Whole-wheat" in the name = wheat. Olive oil instead of butter.

店名に「南蛮」とありますが、外国からの舶来文化を日本に紹介することが目標だった.en: The name has "nanban" in it, but the aim was to introduce to Japan culture brought in from abroad

店名の「カナック（Kanak）」はヒンディー語で「金（gold）」または「小麦（.en: The name 'Kanak' means 'gold' or 'wheat' in Hindi. Wheat, the raw material of naan — a staple in India — is a cultural presence on a par with rice in Japan. The name carries the wish 'to shine, yet stay modest, like wheat at harvest time'.

店名の「コメダイズ」は、メニューの主原料であるコメ、大豆を表現するとともに、空欄.en: The name "Komedaizu" expresses kome (rice) and daizu (soybeans), the main ingredients of the menu, while the blank "□" holds whatever customers feel during time spent in the shop — the name explained at opening.

店名の「マーガレット」（デイジー）はオーナーの好きな花に由来し、スプーンの上に花.en: The name "Marguerite" (a daisy) comes from the owner's favourite flower, with the image of a flower resting on a spoon.

店名の由来でもある「べた焼き」が看板。豚肉・脂かす・生卵・刻みネギをのせた京都な.en: The signature is 'betayaki', the source of the shop name. A Kyoto-style thin bake topped with pork, fat scraps, raw egg and chopped spring onion; griddle dishes such as grilled squid, potato cheese, chicken neck with plum paste and yuzu kosho, and tofu steak are also popular.

店名の由来は韓国語で「よく食べました」を意味する「잘 먹었어요」。定番のサムギョ.en: The name comes from "잘 먹었어요", Korean for "I ate well". Along with classic samgyeopsal and bibimbap and Korean drinks (makgeolli, Chamisul and more), it serves photogenic dishes such as social-media-worthy "oshi-color drinks".

店名は、芝居に憧れた初代・原田邦雄が東京の前衛劇団『築地小劇場』にちなんで名づけ.en: The name is said to come from the Tokyo avant-garde company 'Tsukiji Shogekijo', named by the first owner, who longed for the theatre.

店名は創業者である現マスターのお父さんと叔父さんが長野県の出身であったことから、.en: The name comes from Mt. Akaishi, because the founders, the current master's father and uncle, were from Nagano Prefecture.

店外の食券機で先に食券を購入するシステムを採用。夕方の口頭注文との使い分けがユニ.en: Meal tickets are bought first from the machine outside. The switch to verbal ordering in the evening is unusual.

店改め、三条烏丸店リニューアル.en: renamed from the slurp shop, renewed as the Sanjo Karasuma branch

店自らが掲示：「当店では魚介類・エビ・鶏肉・豚肉・醤油等の材料を使用しています」.en: The shop itself posts: "We use ingredients such as seafood, shrimp, chicken, pork and soy sauce". Soy sauce = wheat, Chinese noodles = wheat.

店自身の表記は上記のとおり。ただし衣の卵の有無と天つゆの出汁は未記載。.en: The shop's own wording is as above. But whether the batter has egg and what's in the dipping broth aren't listed.

店舗にて、調理器具を共有.en: in the shop, cooking utensils are shared

店舗により、一部メニューが異なります.en: Some menu items vary by shop

店舗により一部お取り扱いのない商品がございます.en: Some shops don't carry some items

店舗の全ての食品・ドリンクメニューが100%ヴィーガン（動物性食品不使用）で提供.en: Every food and drink item in the shop is served 100% vegan (no animal products).

店舗情報サイト(gorp)でJR広島駅エキエ内の立地、看板の福ちゃん焼き、広島産.en: A shop-information site (gorp) confirms the location inside ekie at JR Hiroshima Station, the signature Fukuchan-yaki, Hiroshima oyster okonomiyaki and oysters in butter-soy. Unconfirmed menu items such as sea urchin with spinach and wagyu were generalised or removed.

店舗毎にメニューが異なりますので、ぜひお気軽にお問い合わせください」.en: The menu differs by shop, so please feel free to ask"

店舗限定（公式記載）。中華麺は小麦。.en: This shop only (per the official site). Chinese noodles are wheat.

店表記：アイスクリーム状の冷菓です。アルコールとクルミを使用しています。乳・ナッ.en: Shop's wording: an ice-cream-like frozen dessert, made with alcohol and walnuts. Dairy, nuts.

店表記：コーヒーの香り付けをした、柔らかいミルクプリンのようなデザート。乳。.en: Shop's wording: a soft, milk-pudding-like dessert scented with coffee. Dairy.

店長で調理担当の佐藤一聖さんが海南鶏飯に対する強い思い入れを持ち、シンガポール料.en: Kazusei Sato, manager and cook, has a strong attachment to Hainanese chicken rice and started it based on experience at a Singaporean restaurant; Sato met Singaporean food while backpacking around the world, mainly in Southeast Asia, as a university student.

店長のヴェル・カルナモルティさんがスリランカから直接仕入れした紅茶を販売し、ラン.en: Manager Vel Karunamoorthy sells tea bought directly from Sri Lanka, and also serves authentic Sri Lankan food at lunch, tea time and dinner.

店長の川邊優太さんはソムリエ資格を持ち、水道橋駅から徒歩1分の地下1階でこのカジ.en: Store manager 川邊優太 holds a sommelier qualification and runs this casual French bistro on the first basement floor, a 1-minute walk from Suidobashi Station.

店長の平村さんは、子どもが卵や牛乳のアレルギーだと分かったことがきっかけで、グル.en: Manager Hiramura began self-teaching how to make gluten-free sweets and bread after learning a child was allergic to egg and milk.

店長やコックなど、スタッフ全員が私服で、トランスジェンダーを含め性別の枠にとらわ.en: All the staff, manager and cooks included, wear everyday clothes; colorful individuals unbound by gender categories, including transgender people, gather here, and the shop hopes visitors will encounter many ways of being gendered.

店頭ではカットしたピースのケーキのみの販売となります。.en: In the shop, only cut-piece cakes are sold.

日本語版ウィキペディアで慶安元年(1648)本陣創業、1776年以降藤井家が善光.en: Japanese Wikipedia confirms: founded as a honjin (official inn) in Keian 1 (1648); from 1776 the Fujii family held the Zenkoji-juku honjin alone; lodging for the Maeda clan on the clan's alternate-attendance journeys; guests included Inō Tadataka, Itō Hirobumi, Fukuzawa Yukichi and Shibusawa Eiichi; the 1925 building by 志田重左衛門, who rebuilt Zenkoji's Niōmon gate in 1918 (art deco reinforced-concrete exterior, sukiya-style interior); Nagano City's first registered tangible cultural property in 1997; in 2006 the 17th-generation 藤井大朝 turned it into THE FUJIYA GOHONJIN.
