皮＝小麦、餡は豚肉入り。.en: Wrapper = wheat; the filling contains pork.

皮＝小麦、鰻のタレも醤油。.en: Wrapper = wheat; the eel sauce is soy sauce too.

皿のガレットで味わうコース料理.en: a full course enjoyed on a single plate of galette

皿をパレットに見立て.en: treating the plate as a palette

皿をパレットに見立て、指で調理しながら食べるのがインド流.en: The Indian way: treat the plate as a palette and 'cook' with your fingers as you eat

盛り付けがとてもきれいで独創性があり.en: the presentation is beautiful and original

盛り合わせは一部たれ。.en: Some of the platter is with sauce.

盛合せには入れられない品。.en: An item that can't be included in the assortment.

監修シェフ（渡邉保之・中華そば きび）.en: supervising chef (Watanabe Yasuyuki, Chuka Soba Kibi)

目にも美しい和食ビーガン.en: Japanese vegan food that's beautiful to look at

看板ではグラノーラ、公式サイトの説明では雑穀米。どちらも麦類の可能性（押麦・もち.en: Granola on the sign, mixed-grain rice in the official site's description. Either may contain barley or oats (pressed barley, mochi barley, oats).

看板に「昼ランチ 各種ラーメン ライス サービスします」。サービスのライスは白飯.en: The sign reads 'Lunch: rice free with any ramen'. The free rice is plain white rice only, with no wheat and nothing animal-derived (the ramen itself is not OK). The free lunchtime rice is plain white rice.

看板の『まきさだラーメン』は、母体の創作中華店『京中華 牧定』でまかないとして出.en: The signature 'Makisada ramen' is the spring-onion soba once served as a staff meal at the parent creative-Chinese restaurant 'Kyo Chuka Makisada', rebuilt as ramen.

看板の『亮昌ぎょうざ』。鰹だしをベースにした合わせ和だしで上品に仕立てた京もち豚.en: The signature 'Sukemasa gyoza'. Minced Kyoto mochi pork refined with a blended Japanese dashi based on bonito, combined with fragrant Kujo negi, with a hint of miso from the old shop 'Yamari' as a hidden seasoning, wrapped in special chewy wrappers.

看板のまきさだラーメンは醤油ラーメンで、醤油（しょうゆ）ベースのタレを用いる。通.en: The signature Makisada ramen is a shoyu ramen using a soy-based tare. Regular soy sauce contains wheat, so it doesn't suit those avoiding gluten.

看板のウインナー珈琲は珈琲＋ホイップ生クリームで、乳製品を含みます。植物性ミルク.en: The signature Viennese coffee is coffee + whipped fresh cream, so it contains dairy. No mention of plant-milk substitutes or vegan handling could be confirmed. Check directly before visiting.

看板のカルニータスバーガーは豚肩肉をオレンジとスパイスで低温コンフィ風に火入れし.en: The signature carnitas burger is pork shoulder cooked confit-style at low temperature with orange and spices, also served as a rice bowl.

看板の季節のフルーツサンドは月替わりで旬の果物を使い、開店前から行列ができるほど.en: The signature seasonal fruit sandwich uses the fruit of the month and is so popular that a queue forms before opening. It is widely known as 'the fruit sandwich shop'.

看板の汁なし担々麺は『芳醇醤油』と『濃厚ゴマ』の2系統で、香り高さが評判。親店『.en: The signature brothless dandan noodles come in two lines, 'aromatic shoyu' and 'rich sesame', praised for their aroma. There are sides such as Singapore aubergine curry, inherited from the parent shop 'Himawari'.

看板の熟成醤油らぁ麺に加え、濃厚鶏白湯、自家製胡麻だれと香味油の胡麻担々、A5ラ.en: Besides the signature aged-soy ramen, it offers a wide range from rich chicken paitan and sesame tantan with house-made sesame sauce and aromatic oil to 'A5 wagyu ramen' topped with A5 wagyu roast beef. It also has a permanent 'vegan paitan ramen' and 'vegan tantan ramen' with no animal ingredients, catering for plant-based visitors.

看板は、月ごとに移ろう旬のフルーツをふんわりした食パンとコクのある生クリームで挟.en: The signature is the 'seasonal fruit sandwich': seasonal fruit that changes each month, between fluffy white bread and rich fresh cream. Carefully made, from choosing and cutting the fruit to the sweetness of the cream, it's so popular that a queue forms before opening. The coffee is roasted in-house daily on the shop's roaster and slowly brewed by flannel drip. There are three blends — Ichikawaya Blend, Seiji (celadon) Blend and Umamachi Blend — each served in Kiyomizu-yaki cups made by the father or brother. Even the cups are designed for each blend: the Ichikawaya Blend cup has a thin rim and thick base for ease of drinking and heat retention, and the Seiji Blend cup a wide mouth to lift the aroma. There are also items such as an egg sandwich and demi-glace omurice.

看板は「京のあさごはん」。焼き鮭か焼き鯖を選べる京の朝ごはんセット、地元の豆腐店.en: The signature is 'Kyoto breakfast'. A purely Japanese menu made with care from the morning: a Kyoto breakfast set with a choice of grilled salmon or grilled mackerel; soy-milk yuba porridge topped with plenty of rich soy milk and fresh yuba from a local tofu shop; and a dashimaki set starring a fluffy rolled omelette. At lunch the signature is a set of colourful obanzai, letting you taste Kyoto home cooking with care put into every dish, down to the dashimaki, soup, seasonal small dishes and pickles. In the afternoon, gentle sweets such as handmade pudding, pudding parfait and seasonal cakes are popular too.

看板は『熟成醤油らぁ麺』。国産鶏からていねいに引いた澄んだ鶏清湯に、鰹節・煮干し.en: The signature is 'aged-soy ramen'. A bowl of clear chicken broth carefully drawn from domestic chicken, layered with a Japanese dashi of bonito flakes, niboshi and kombu, with a mellow aged-soy kaeshi. Clear yet deep umami and the rich aroma of aged soy sauce are the essence.

看板はずばり『べた焼き』。たっぷりの刻み九条葱をのせるのがこの店の流儀で、油カス.en: The signature is simply 'betayaki'. Piling on plenty of chopped Kujo negi is this shop's way, and you can add toppings such as aburakasu, egg and kimchi. It comes out crisp, fragrant and light. For starters there are griddle dishes such as tecchan (offal) with vegetables, salt-grilled yam and thin-grilled beef.

看板はカルニータスバーガー。豚肩肉をオレンジとスパイスで低温コンフィ風にじっくり.en: The signature is the carnitas burger: pork shoulder slowly cooked confit-style at low temperature with orange and spices until tender and falling apart, also served as a rice bowl. Others include a bacon cheeseburger, double cheeseburger and BBQ cheeseburger. The buns are house-made brioche, the patties hand-chopped beef, and bacon, smoked brisket and the sauces are all made in the shop. House-made cola and ginger ale too.

看板はデンマーク産ナチュラルクリームチーズを使ったクリームチーズもみじ饅頭で、な.en: The signature is a cream-cheese momiji manjū made with Danish natural cream cheese; its smooth, rich flavour is popular and it often sells out. There is a wide range of others, such as smooth bean paste, coarse bean paste, custard cream, chocolate and rum-soaked raisin, and 'Okomomiji' (the shop's registered trademark), crossing Miyajima's famous okonomiyaki with momiji manjū, is a specialty too.

看板は一杯の中華そば。澄んだ黄金色のクリアな豚骨醤油スープで、豚骨の力強い旨味を.en: The signature is a bowl of chūka soba. A clear, golden pork-bone shoyu soup that lets you feel the powerful umami of pork bone while holding back the salt and soy, a bowl that isn't heavy even in the morning. The noodles are high-hydration, flat, medium-thick, with a springy bounce and smooth slurp. The chāshū is pork belly cut to order, so you can enjoy thin and thick slices.

看板は油そば。中太のちょい縮れ麺を醤油ベースのタレと植物油で和えたスープのない一.en: The signature is abura soba. A soupless bowl of medium-thick, slightly curly noodles tossed with a soy-based sauce and plant oil, topped with menma, spring onion, shredded nori and chāshū. The standard way to eat it is to change the flavour midway with vinegar and chilli oil — 'delicious twice'. Choose soy sauce or salt sauce.

看板は特製チャーシューラーメン。真っ黒に見える濃色の醤油スープ（鶏の旨味も効いた.en: The signature is the special chāshū ramen. A dark shoyu soup that looks jet black (brown, with chicken umami), thin-sliced chāshū arranged like petals, plenty of green onion, and thin straight noodles.

看板は鰹昆布水つけそば。北海道産がごめ昆布と土佐清水の鰹（宗田節）からとった昆布.en: The signature is bonito-kombu-water tsuke-soba: custom medium-thin noodles with whole-grain flour steeped in kombu water drawn from Hokkaido gagome kombu and Tosashimizu bonito (sōda-bushi), eaten with a dipping sauce of aged soy sauce and domestic duck fat. The regular aged-soy chūka soba (¥900–1,000) is a light, refined bowl of clear yet powerful soup drawn from domestic chicken, bonito and niboshi, scented with yuzu.

看板もなく蔦に覆われた外観で、知らないと店だと気づかずに通り過ぎてしまうほどの隠.en: Introduced as a hideaway with no sign and an ivy-covered front, so hidden that you'd walk past without knowing it's a shop.

看板デザートの固めの『サンデーレトロプリン』には、シナモンまたは八幡屋礒五郎の七.en: The signature firm 'Sunday Retro Pudding' can be topped with cinnamon or Yawataya Isogoro shichimi: an unexpected mix of sweet and spice.

看板メニュー。乳・卵（プリン）使用。パフェにコーンフレークが入る店が多く、入れば.en: The signature dish. Uses dairy and egg (pudding). Many shops put cornflakes in parfaits, which means wheat and malt. Check. 2019 listing (before tax).

看板メニュー「中黄金うな重」は、炭焼きうなぎと名古屋コーチン卵のだし巻き玉子を一.en: The signature unajū (中黄金) is popular as a dish combining charcoal-grilled eel and a rolled omelette of Nagoya Cochin eggs in one go.

看板メニュー「大名つづら」の中身は仕入れた食材によって毎日変わる。胡麻豆腐は手作.en: The contents of the signature "Daimyo Tsuzura" change daily with what is bought. The sesame tofu is handmade and praised as needing no sauce.

看板メニュー「絶望のスパゲッティ」は1994年、新宿新店舗開業時の新メニュー開発.en: The signature "Despair Spaghetti" was born in 1994 from new-menu development for the opening of a new Shinjuku shop. At first it didn't sell at all, but after media people tried it and raved, orders rose and it grew into the most popular dish, with queues.

看板メニューに豚肉・卵・中華そば・かつお出汁が使われ、同じ鉄板で肉や卵を焼くため.en: The signature dish uses pork, egg, Chinese noodles and bonito dashi, and meat and egg are cooked on the same griddle; no information on separate plant-only cooking could be found.

看板メニューの「おむすび御膳」（2,000円・税込）。 お櫃で炊きたてのご飯を用.en: The signature "omusubi set meal" (¥2,000 incl. tax). Freshly cooked rice comes in a wooden tub, and you shape your own onigiri with the shop's original mold, mixing and matching from seven fillings: a hands-on meal.

看板メニューのきりたんぽ鍋は、比内地鶏から取った出汁に野菜・まいたけ・しらたきと.en: The signature kiritanpo hot pot combines a Hinai-jidori stock with vegetables, maitake, shirataki and chewy "kiritanpo"; it is one of the Ministry of Agriculture's "100 Regional Dishes".

看板メニューは『熟成醤油』のかえしを用いる。一般的な醸造醤油は小麦を含むため、醤.en: The signature menu uses an 'aged soy' kaeshi. Ordinary brewed soy sauce contains wheat, so it's reasonable to judge on the assumption of wheat from the soy sauce.

看板メニューは約10品を盛り合わせた「Vegan Delight」プレート（タコ.en: The signature is the 'Vegan Delight' plate of about 10 items (tacos, soy-meat karaage, a hamburg, chili con carne, daikon mochi and more). Among sweets, a matcha chocolate cake using naturally grown matcha from the Yamato highlands, a dairy-free vegan Basque cheesecake and beautiful tarts are popular.

看板商品の『然』カステラは卵黄のみを使用し、卵・砂糖・小麦粉・牛乳・水飴で作られ.en: The signature "Zen" castella uses only egg yolks: a paper-baked castella made from eggs, sugar, wheat flour, milk and starch syrup.

看板商品のジャンボめろんぱんは通常のメロンパンより3倍長く生地を発酵させることに.en: The signature jumbo melon pan insists on fermenting the dough three times longer than an ordinary melon pan, and that method creates a texture crisp outside and fluffy inside.

真心むすびます.en: made with heartfelt sincerity (a pun on 'tying' rice balls)

真鯛とタコのチリトマトラーメン.en: sea bream and octopus chili-tomato ramen

真鯛又はスズキのポワレ.en: poêlé of sea bream or sea bass

着物姿のバリスタがラテアートを作るのが浅草らしい下町ならではの特徴で、2018年.en: A barista in kimono making latte art is a feature of Asakusa's shitamachi; since opening on August 24, 2018 it has always been a busy, popular café. In 2022 a second shop, "Pechka Sukemasa Coffee", also opened in Asakusa.

矢場とん公式沿革によると、1947年に鈴木義夫が『矢場のとんかつ』として創業（南.en: According to Yabaton's official history, founded in 1947 by Suzuki Yoshio as 'Yaba no Tonkatsu' (near a tram stop on Otsu-dori; the name comes from Yaba, today's Osu area). Incorporated in 1953; opened the Yaba-cho main shop in 1970 and became 'Yabaton'. About 30 shops nationwide, plus Thailand (2014) and Taiwan. Miso katsu was inspired by a customer dipping tonkatsu into a doteni pot. A stall at Nagoya Stadium for 27 years, 1972–96. The Kinshachi Yokocho shop is in the Yoshinao Zone.

知る人ぞ知る腕利き職人.en: "a skilled craftsman known to those in the know"

知ればもっと美味しくなる.en: the more you know, the tastier it gets

知多牛のシャトーブリアンを中心とした完全オマカセコース。シャトーブリアンの海苔巻.en: A full omakase course centred on Chita beef chateaubriand. The signature is chateaubriand rolled in nori (with spring onion and miso). One course uses about 500 g of meat, including rare cuts such as the pointe (a rare part of the fillet).

石川県唯一の五ツ星お米マイスター、米粉100.en: Ishikawa's only five-star rice meister, 100% rice flour

磯辺揚げの衣＝小麦、ちくわのつなぎにも澱粉。.en: Isobe-age batter = wheat; starch in the chikuwa binder too.

磯辺焼きは醤油ダレ＝小麦。.en: Isobe-yaki has a soy-sauce glaze = wheat.

祇園商店街振興組合: 甘泉堂、京菓子、東山区祇園町北側344-6、10:00〜2.en: Gion shopping street association: 甘泉堂, Kyoto sweets; 東山区祇園町北側344-6; 10:00–20:00; closed Sunday. Tabelog: wagashi; 祇園町344-6; about 8 min on foot from Gion-Shijo Station; Mon–Sat 10:30–19:00, closed Sunday; sometimes closes early; reservations taken; takeaway only; no cards, e-money or QR payments; Sweets Tabelog 100 2017, Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2018–2020 and 2022, Wagashi WEST Tabelog 100 2023 and 2026. Reviews (September–November 2026, in English): founded 1884; chestnut steamed yokan ¥2,000; mizu yokan ¥2,000 (ingredients adzuki beans, sugar, agar); steamed yokan (hojicha, kinako, matcha) ¥350; ring the bell and the owner comes out; down an alley; some find the service curt.

祇園花見小路本店.r: ぎおんはなみこうじほんてん

祖父の工房だった築200年の町家が取り壊されかけたとき、市川さんは『この場所を残.en: When the 200-year-old townhouse that had been the grandfather's workshop was about to be demolished, Ichikawa, out of the wish 'to keep this place', went ahead with a full renovation at about four times the cost of a new build.

神泉（渋谷区道玄坂、神泉駅・渋谷駅から徒歩圏内）.en: Shinsen (Dogenzaka, Shibuya-ku; walkable from Shinsen and Shibuya stations)

福々まんじゅうの原料は膨張剤以外は保存料などの添加物を一切使用せず、小麦と砂糖と.en: "Our Fukufuku manju are made simply from wheat, sugar and bean paste, with no preservatives or other additives apart from the raising agent" — signature bun is wheat-based and housemade.

福井ソースカツ丼と越前おろしそば。薄く大きなロース肉にきめ細かいパン粉をまとわせ.en: Fukui sauce katsudon and Echizen oroshi soba. The standard is to have them as a set: a thin, large pork-loin cutlet in fine breadcrumbs, dipped in rich Worcestershire sauce and laid on rice, together with a refreshing Echizen oroshi soba piled with bonito flakes, green onion and grated daikon.

福井出身者が試食して「本物の味」と太鼓判を押したと地元ブロガーが報告している。.en: A local blogger reports that people from Fukui tasted it and vouched for it as 'the real taste'.

福岡・博多の名門もつ鍋から暖簾分け（2007年開業）.en: A licensed offshoot of a renowned motsunabe house in Hakata, Fukuoka (opened 2007)

私しか作られんからね.en: "nobody but me can make it, you know"

秘伝のタレ＝小麦醤油。.en: The secret sauce = wheat soy sauce.

税サ別、サービス料500円/人。鉄板フレンチのおまかせ。2025年の食べログ投稿.en: Tax and service extra; service charge ¥500/person. Teppan-French omakase. A 2025 Tabelog post shows a deeply flavoured soup, fish on a corn base, abalone, a small hamburger, milt and more (the hamburger bun is wheat). Mention gluten when booking.

税サ別。牛肉づくし。焼くだけなら小麦なしだがソース・付合せに小麦が入りうる。20.en: Tax and service extra. All beef. Just grilled means no wheat, but sauces and sides may contain wheat. On the 2019 board there were two courses: 'all-beef course ¥15,000' and 'all-fish course ¥15,000'.

税サ込。2日前までの予約が必要、予約時間でのOPENになります、と板書。鉄板フレ.en: Tax and service included. Must be booked at least 2 days ahead, and opens at the booked time, says the board. It is teppan French, so dishes with bread and wheat flour are cooked on the same griddle — beware of cross-contact. A note says dinner courses are also available.

税サ込〜。お客様のご希望食材等のアレンジコースもご用意いたします。記念日・誕生日.en: Tax and service included, from. Custom courses with ingredients of your choice are also available. Please use us for special days like anniversaries and birthdays, says the board.

税込。おでん・タレ串・餃子を含むためグルテン回避は不可。滞在2時間、カウンター席.en: Tax included. Includes oden, sauce skewers and gyoza, so avoiding gluten is impossible. 2-hour stay, counter seats.

種から作る愛玉子.en: aiyu jelly made from the seeds

種のだしに醤油・麦由来調味料が含まれる可能性＝要確認。さけ・ごま・魚卵。.en: -kind dashi may include soy sauce or barley-derived seasonings = check. Salmon, sesame, fish roe.

金シャチ横丁公式が、名古屋城東門・宗春ゾーン内、市内3店に続く4店目、辛さ控えめ.en: The official Kinshachi Yokocho site describes it as being inside the Muneharu Zone by Nagoya Castle's east gate, the fourth shop after three in the city, mild enough for children through older people, and the owner's wish to carry Nagoya food culture and spread it to the world. 食べログ (公式情報): KHANA KHAJA Indian.Nepali A.en: Tabelog (official information): KHANA KHAJA Indian.Nepali Asian Dining & Bar, Ueno-Okachimachi branch, Ueno 6-1-6, Green Heights Building B1F; 1 min on foot from JR Okachimachi, Ueno-Okachimachi and Naka-Okachimachi Stations, 4 min from JR Ueno; daily 11:00–23:00 (lunch 11:00–16:00, dinner 16:00–23:00, L.O. 22:30); open all year; reservations taken; 26 seats; non-smoking; cards and e-money accepted; Wi-Fi; take-out; delivery within 1 km; English menu and staff; halal and vegan options; a Nepali chef using the same recipes since opening; butter chicken with a homemade spice blend; naan baked to order in a tandoor. Lunch (January 2025): curries from ¥900, Ladies' Set ¥1,100, cheese naan set ¥1,350. Reviews (February–September 2026): Ladies' Set raised to ¥1,200; one refill of naan or rice; mild spice; a basement restaurant; in February 2026 one diner said cash only.

食べログ (公式情報): Mille,、東上野1-10-4 岡島ビル 1F、JR.en: Tabelog (official information): Mille,, Higashi-Ueno 1-10-4, 岡島ビル 1F; 5 min on foot from JR Okachimachi, Naka-Okachimachi and Shin-Okachimachi Stations; lunch Tue–Fri 11:30–15:00, dinner Tue–Sat and holidays 18:00–22:00; closed Mondays and Sundays; reservations taken; no one under 20; table charge ¥600; 8 counter seats; non-smoking; corkage ¥5,500 per bottle; wine for sale; cards, transport IC and PayPay accepted; opened 1 May 2023; the chef, a certified sommelier, cooks alone; wine salons twice a month; Ozaki beef from Miyazaki. Menu (1 November 2026): seasonal omakase ¥11,000, with wine pairing ¥18,000 (Veneto in November, Piemonte in December); lunch omakase ¥7,800, with wine ¥12,000; caponata ¥900; pasta ¥2,400–3,200; peposo ¥3,600; Ozaki beef tagliata ¥6,800; wine by the glass from ¥1,200. Reviews (May 2025–May 2026): excellent pasta and bread; a lively, hectic room with one person running it; a fish dish that was too salty.

食べログ (公式情報): RÉJOUISSANCE、文京区湯島3-46-8 波岡.en: Tabelog (official information): RÉJOUISSANCE, Yushima 3-46-8, Bunkyō, 波岡ビル 1F; 1 min on foot from Yushima Station, 3 min from Ueno-Hirokoji and Ueno-Okachimachi, 5 min from JR Okachimachi; Thu–Sun 19:00–23:00; closed Mondays to Wednesdays; reservations only; late arrivals may miss part of the course; allergies only when booking (no same-day changes; severe cases may be refused); children 12 and over who can eat the adult course; no service charge; water ¥1,100; 6 counter seats; non-smoking; cards, transport IC, iD and QUICPay accepted; English- and Chinese-speaking staff; opened 1 April 2026; French for 'celebration'. Reviews (September–October 2026): reviews differ on chef Tsunenori Sakaguchi's training: per a September 2026 review, graduated from Ecole Tsuji Osaka, went to France, then after returning to Japan worked at Pierre Gagnaire Tokyo; per October 2026 reviews, about five years at the two-Michelin-star Pierre Gagnaire, then a traveling chef before opening; French cuisine with Japanese seasonal ingredients and dashi; hand-peeled shrimp and clam chowder with caviar; Beniharuka potato soup; kinmedai; Shiretoko beef; matsutake; wine pairing in Kimura glasses; about ¥30,000–40,000 a head.

Tabelog (official information): RÉJOUISSANCE, Yushima 3-46-8, Bunkyō, 波岡ビル 1F; 1 min on foot from Yushima Station, 3 min from Ueno-Hirokoji and Ueno-Okachimachi, 5 min from JR Okachimachi; Thu–Sun 19:00–23:00; closed Mondays to Wednesdays; reservations only; late arrivals may miss part of the course; allergies only when booking (no same-day changes; severe cases may be refused); children 12 and over who can eat the adult course; no service charge; water ¥1,100; 6 counter seats; non-smoking; cards, transport IC, iD and QUICPay accepted; English- and Chinese-speaking staff; opened 1 April 2026; French for 'celebration'. Reviews (September–October 2026): chef Tsunenori Sakaguchi trained in France and spent about five years at the two-Michelin-star Pierre Gagnaire, then worked as a traveling chef before opening; French cuisine with Japanese seasonal ingredients and dashi; hand-peeled shrimp and clam chowder with caviar; Beniharuka potato soup; kinmedai; Shiretoko beef; matsutake; wine pairing in Kimura glasses; about ¥30,000–40,000 a head.

食べログ (公式情報): sardexka、下谷1-6-7 竹内マンション 1F.en: Tabelog (official information): sardexka, Shitaya 1-6-7, 竹内マンション 1F; 5 min on foot from the JR Uguisudani South Exit and Iriya Station; Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat, Sun and holidays 18:30–23:00; closed Thursdays (and irregular days); reservations only (TableCheck, SMS, email, Instagram, Facebook); 8 seats (counter); non-smoking; no children; cards accepted; opened 23 May 2016; Tabelog Spanish 100 2024 and 2026. Menu (January 2026): omakase of about 10 dishes ¥9,000, about 9 dishes ¥7,000; lunch Wednesdays and Sundays (booking required). Website: Basque for 'fork'; Japanese seasonal ingredients with the aroma of Spain. Reviews (May–November 2026): a chef trained in the Basque Country; run by two people (a married couple, per a November review); piquillo peppers, pisto, octopus, sea bream, salmon, eggplant and pork-blood spring rolls; paella lunch course ¥8,800; courses start in order of arrival.

食べログ (公式情報): そば shin、上野2-12-4 VERTEX UEN.en: Tabelog (official information): Soba shin, Ueno 2-12-4, VERTEX UENO 1F; 2 min on foot from Ueno-Hirokoji Station, 4 min from Ueno-Okachimachi, 5 min from Okachimachi, 6 min from Ueno; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–22:00, Sat 11:00–20:30, Sun 11:00–19:30, holidays 11:00–20:00; no reservations; fully cashless; 11 seats (7 at the counter, 4 at a table); non-smoking; menus in English, Chinese and Korean; opened 7 July 2025; a new dipping-soba concept from the Ginza Japanese restaurant Kurahashi: 2:8 soba of domestic buckwheat, bonito dipping sauces, miso-marinated chashu. Menu (July 2026): sesame-vinegar seafood dipping soba ¥1,050, milk chicken-paitan cheese dipping soba ¥1,100, soy-milk tantan dipping soba ¥1,050, grilled miso dipping soba ¥1,000, mixed soba ¥950, zaru soba ¥850. Reviews (August–October 2026): meal tickets; chashu grilled on the spot; gut-health soba; mala dipping soba.

食べログ (公式情報): ほてい、下谷1-8-20、入谷駅・鶯谷駅、月〜土・祝前.en: Tabelog (official information): Hotei, Shitaya 1-8-20; Iriya and Uguisudani Stations; Mon–Sat and the days before and after a holiday 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed Sundays and holidays; reservations taken; no service or appetizer charge; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; 16 seats (counter and raised tatami area); second floor; non-smoking; izakaya, monkfish. Reviews (March–October 2026): monkfish hot pot and zōsui in winter; lunch set meals in the low ¥1,000s — pork kakuni ¥1,000, chicken kara-age ¥1,100, katsuo bowl ¥1,100, sashimi set (sea bream, tuna, marinated mackerel) ¥1,200, tuna bowl, sea-bream bowl, grilled fish, with miso soup and three pickles; in the evening sashimi, crab-miso tofu, a whole squid (liver sashimi, grilled legs), motsu stew; founded 1976; a calm interior like a kaiseki restaurant.

食べログ (公式情報): らぁめん千寿 御徒町店、上野4-2-5 美濃里ビル 1.en: Tabelog (official information): ramen senju, Okachimachi branch, Ueno 4-2-5, 美濃里ビル 1F; 1 min on foot from the JR Okachimachi North Exit and Exit A5 of Ueno-Hirokoji and Ueno-Okachimachi Stations; daily 11:00–21:00 (closes when the soup runs out; updates on the official Instagram); no reservations; 14 seats (counter); non-smoking; no cards, transport IC and QR accepted; no table charge; opened 1 September 2026; founded in Sapporo in 2002; Tabelog Ramen 100 Hokkaido 2024 and 2025; a miso soup stir-fried from over 30 ingredients; medium-thick curly noodles made for Senju. Menu (August 2026): miso ramen ¥1,100, bean sprouts and ginger ¥1,250, chashu ¥1,500, special ¥1,600; the same in salt and soy sauce. Reviews (October–November 2026): queues since opening, over an hour after a TV feature; lard keeps the soup hot; garlic and ginger; the Sapporo original is run by an owner who trained at Sumire; some find it milder than other famous shops.

食べログ (公式情報): クラフト バーガー&グリル ジロー、松が谷2-31-7.en: Tabelog (official information): Craft Burger & Grill Jiro, Matsugaya 2-31-7; 10 min on foot from Inaricho and Iriya Stations; Tue–Fri 11:00–15:30 and 18:00–22:00, Sat–Sun 11:00–16:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Mondays (Tuesday if Monday is a holiday); reservations taken; pets allowed; 15 seats (5 at the counter, 8 at tables, 2 on the terrace); non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; English menu; kids' menu; opened 13 December 2019; 100% beef patties; Edo Senju negi burger; greedy burger. Menu (November 2024): hamburger ¥1,200, avocado cheese ¥1,380, blue cheese ¥1,300, Edo Senju negi burger ¥1,380, greedy burger ¥1,680, rice burger ¥1,380, kids' burger ¥600. Reviews (March–October 2026): fries and mini salad included; drink +¥150 at lunch; roast beef for dogs ¥450; app coupons; used as an izakaya at night; wagyu Senju negi burger; teriyaki burger; the owner loves dogs.

食べログ (公式情報): タイスカイキッチン、上野2-12-11 堺屋 2F、上.en: Tabelog (official information): Thai Sky Kitchen, Ueno 2-12-11, 堺屋 2F; 2 min on foot from Ueno-Okachimachi and Ueno-Hirokoji Stations, 5 min from JR Ueno and Okachimachi; daily 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:30; no lunch menu on weekends and holidays; reservations taken; 20 seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; English menu and staff; take-out and delivery; a chef from Bangkok. Menu (January 2025): gai tod ¥1,480, soft-shell crab curry stir-fry ¥1,800, tom sep ¥1,580–1,780, stir-fried water spinach ¥1,350, fresh spring rolls ¥1,050. Reviews (May–October 2026): massaman curry ¥1,280, gapao rice, green curry, yum woon sen, coconut soup; a bright room with big windows; full on a Saturday at lunch; one diner found the seafood soup short on seafood.

食べログ (公式情報): チーズ谷、下谷2-3-1 杉浦ビル 1F、入谷駅2番出.en: Tabelog (official information): Cheese Ya, Shitaya 2-3-1, 杉浦ビル 1F; 1 min on foot from Exit 2 of Iriya Station, 6 min from the JR Uguisudani South Exit; Tue–Sat 12:00–15:00 (food L.O. 13:30) and 17:00–1:00 (L.O. 24:00), Sun and holidays 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; closed Mondays; reservations taken; 2-hour limit when busy; charge ¥400; 17 seats; terrace; separate smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 18 May 2020; a raclette and cheese-fondue specialist. Menu (February 2026): wagyu top-blade stone-grilled steak ¥3,300, mimolette cheese risotto ¥2,400, fish carpaccio ¥1,000, basic set from ¥1,600, homemade bacon and sausages +¥770, five seasonal vegetables +¥550, bread refill ¥50. Reviews (March–October 2026): courses with all-you-can-drink; the weekend 'King and Queen of Cheese' fondue lunch; a choice of three raclette cheeses; ajillo; Kamui pork; lamb meatloaf; curry risotto; orange wine.

食べログ (公式情報): デリー 上野店、文京区湯島3-42-2、上野広小路駅か.en: Tabelog (official information): DELHI Ueno, Yushima 3-42-2, Bunkyō; 2 min on foot from Ueno-Hirokoji Station, 4 min from Yushima, 7 min from JR Okachimachi; daily 11:50–21:30; 2–3 January 11:50–19:30; closed 31 December–1 January; no reservations; no cards or e-money; 15 seats (8 at the counter, 7 at tables); non-smoking; opened 28 February 1956; Tabelog Curry 100 2017–2026. Menu (February 2025): Delhi and Indian curry ¥1,230, Kashmir curry ¥1,350, korma ¥1,450, butter chicken ¥1,500, dry curry ¥1,350, strong dry curry ¥1,400. Reviews (October–November 2026): the famous Kashmir curry is very spicy with complex spices; silver bowls; fast service; queues of 10–20 at weekend lunch; tight seating; cash only; special curry set ¥2,200; Delhi curry ¥1,700 (November 2026); one calls it the predecessor of Bombay in Ebisu.

食べログ (公式情報): バトン、元浅草1-20-3 ポセイドンアームス 1F、.en: Tabelog (official information): BATON, Moto-Asakusa 1-20-3, ポセイドンアームス 1F; 5 min on foot from Inaricho Station and Exit A3 of Shin-Okachimachi, 10 min from JR Ueno; daily 10:00–18:00, lunch 11:00–15:00, café from 15:00 on buffet days; reservations taken; 16 seats (12 at tables, 4 at the counter); non-smoking; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; Wi-Fi; English menu; allergy information available; take-out and delivery. Menu (April 2026): Inochi pudding ¥430, rice-fed-egg pudding ¥430, café au lait, matcha, hojicha and others ¥460, black tea ¥480, chocolate and pistachio ¥510, egg-free milk pudding ¥340. Official website (renewed 2017): rich pudding with selected eggs and the finest vanilla beans; closed Saturdays, Sundays and holidays. Reviews (April–November 2026): fluffy pancakes, pancake set ¥1,320, egg tart with iced café au lait ¥700, keema curry; order by QR code and pay by phone; open on Sundays; slow service; opened March 2017.

食べログ (公式情報): プロースト東京 ソーセージ＆燻製バル 上野店、上野2-.en: Tabelog (official information): Prost Tokyo Sausage & Kunsei Bar, Ueno branch, Ueno 2-1-9, VOLT上野広小路 6F; 1 min on foot from Exit A3 of Ueno-Hirokoji Station; Mon–Fri and the day before a holiday 17:00–23:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 16:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:00, drinks L.O. 22:30); closing days not fixed; reservations taken (by phone 16:00–23:00); if full, the sister shop Prost Tokyo Akihabara (same menu); table charge ¥770 (none for courses); private rooms 10%; 50 seats; non-smoking; cards and QR accepted; opened 15 November 2016. Menu (June 2026): over 20 kinds of additive-free house sausages (Thüringer, weisswurst, salsiccia, Spanish habanero, shiso and more), in-house smoking, vegetables from the restaurant's own farm, Prost Farm, in Ibaraki; raclette grill. Reviews (September–November 2026): smoked umeshu ¥968, homemade smoked assortment ¥1,188, carpaccio ¥1,078, smoked tofu, affogato ¥583; in October 2026 one diner found it not especially good.

食べログ (公式情報): ホルモン青木 上野店、文京区湯島3-41-1 ルドーム.en: Tabelog (official information): Horumon Aoki, Ueno branch, Yushima 3-41-1, Bunkyō, ルドーム 1F; 2 min on foot from Ueno-Okachimachi Station; Mon–Fri 16:00–22:30, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); weekdays 16:00–18:00 highballs, chūhai and oolong-hai ¥110; reservations taken; 12 seats; non-smoking; cards and PayPay accepted. Tabelog (Akabane branch): a branch of the famous Horumon Aoki of Kameido, with branches also in Ueno and Shimokitazawa. Menu (October 2026): small intestine, uterus, cartilage ¥605; pork cheek in garlic soy ¥660; abomasum, heart ¥715; tongue base ¥825; house seared chashu ¥750; Aoki kalbi ¥1,430; fresh loin ¥1,375; beef tongue ¥1,595; green-onion salt tongue ¥1,705. Reviews (February–October 2026): both horumon and meat are good; ¥4,000–6,000 a head; smoky; few dishes besides meat and horumon.

食べログ (公式情報): 中国意境菜 白燕、元浅草2-7-10 オルタンシアIV.en: Tabelog (official information): 中国意境菜 白燕 (Chugoku Ikkyosai Bai En), Moto-Asakusa 2-7-10, オルタンシアIV 2F; 1 min on foot from Inaricho Station, 8 min from JR Ueno, 5 min from Shin-Okachimachi; closing days not fixed; reservations taken; 10% service charge; 23 seats (12 sofa, 6 in private rooms, 4 at the counter); non-smoking; cards accepted (no e-money or QR); BYO allowed; opened 8 September 2019; Tabelog Chinese TOKYO 100 in 2024 and 2026. san-tatsu (11 June 2023, 速志淳): owner-chef 白岩勝也, trained in Beijing, Hong Kong, Taiwan and elsewhere; food as medicine; dinner by course only (booking required; also available at lunch with a booking); weekday A lunch ¥1,300; the yodare-dori uses two house chilli oils, one for aroma and one for heat, with black vinegar, white vinegar and soy sauce; the medicinal soup changes with the 24 seasonal terms and no combination has been repeated since opening in 2019; a 'candy apple' of tea-smoked foie gras wrapped in hibiscus jelly; about 13 Shaoxing wines (glass from ¥600); no chemical seasonings. Savor Japan: Tue–Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–20:00, closed Mondays. Reviews (December 2025–October 2026): weekday yodare-dori lunch ¥1,400; yodare-dori and medicinal soup set ¥2,500; wonton noodle set ¥2,500; bottomless suanmeitang; a queue of about 10 even in the rain; Shanghai crab courses; osechi; lunch on the TRAIN SUITE Shikishima.

食べログ (公式情報): 博多 からくさや、東上野2-5-16 岩原ビル 1F、.en: Tabelog (official information): Hakata Karakusaya, Higashi-Ueno 2-5-16, 岩原ビル 1F; 5 min on foot from Inaricho and Shin-Okachimachi Stations, 10 min from JR Ueno; lunch daily 11:30–14:00 (until sold out); dinner Mon–Fri and the day before holidays 17:30–23:00, Sat 17:00–22:00, Sun and holidays 17:00–21:00; reservations taken; eating only (without drinking) not allowed at dinner; no children; 36 seats (tables); e-cigarettes only inside; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; an owner who ran a yatai in Hakata; soy sauce from Fukuoka. Menu (May 2026): motsunabe ¥1,850 (from one serving), grilled wagyu horumon ¥1,680, goma saba ¥1,190, vinegared offal ¥590, chicken nanban ¥990, grilled ramen ¥980, Hakata ramen ¥980 and more. Reviews (December 2025–July 2026): grilled ramen with Baby Star and raw egg, spicy miso mayo and pickled ginger; local office workers at lunch; one-drink minimum at night; two dishes per person; some say founded 2009 and here over 15 years, others that it descends from KENZO cafe in Ryogoku and moved.

食べログ (公式情報): 博多豚骨らぁ麺一絆 上野御徒町本店、上野6-4-18、.en: Tabelog (official information): Hakata Tonkotsu Ramen Ichiban, Ueno-Okachimachi main shop, Ueno 6-4-18; 1 min on foot from the JR Okachimachi North Exit; daily 11:00–2:00 (until sold out); reservations taken; 15 seats; non-smoking; no cards, e-money or QR; Wi-Fi; English menu and staff; opened 13 January 2023; 'world's first — the birthplace of clear tonkotsu ramen'. Menu (October 2026): plain tonkotsu ramen ¥650, tonkotsu ramen ¥800, special ¥1,000, tonkotsu vegetable ramen ¥1,000, clear tonkotsu vegetable ramen ¥1,200, special clear tonkotsu ramen ¥1,650; extra noodles, extra vegetables and rice ¥150 each; rare chashu ¥300; tamago kake gohan ¥350. Reviews (October 2026): after the ticket, an order sheet for noodle firmness and fat; rare chashu; stir-fried vegetables on a separate plate; free mentaiko on the table; a line of about 10; a counter made by the owner.

食べログ (公式情報): 多古久、上野2-11-8 長谷川ビル 1F、湯島駅2番.en: Tabelog (official information): Tako Kyuu, Ueno 2-11-8, 長谷川ビル 1F; 1 min on foot from Exit 2 of Yushima Station, 5 min from Ueno-Hirokoji, 7 min from JR Okachimachi and Ueno; Wed–Sun 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); closed Mondays and Tuesdays; reservations (phone Wed–Sun from 12:00, otherwise social-media DM); in winter (October–March) bookings for 18:00–19:00 or after 20:15; 1.5-hour limit in winter (2 hours otherwise); walk-ins if seats are free; appetizer ¥330; no cards, e-money or QR; 20 seats (14 at the counter, 6 at tables); non-smoking (smoking outside); take-out. Reviews (March–October 2026): oden from a large copper pot — daikon, egg, konnyaku, shirataki, grilled tofu, hanpen, whelk, kinchaku, negima, potato, baby octopus and oyster skewers; sashimi platter; marinated mackerel; saikyo-grilled black cod; cabbage with mentaiko; mozuku; homemade nukazuke; one diner called the staff quirky.

食べログ (公式情報): 大衆酒場 天ぷら宮、上野4-3-8 三浦ビル B1F、.en: Tabelog (official information): Taishu Sakaba Tempura Miya, Ueno 4-3-8, 三浦ビル B1F; 3 min on foot from JR Okachimachi Station, 2 min from Ueno-Okachimachi; Mon–Sat, holidays and the day before 11:30–22:00; Sun and the day after a holiday 11:30–21:30; break 16:00–17:00; reservations taken; 42 seats (8 at the counter, 34 at tables); private rooms; heated-tobacco-only smoking area; cards, e-money and QR accepted; English and Chinese menus and staff; kids' menu; opened 30 June 2025. Menu (October 2026): vegetable tempura platter ¥980, shrimp and vegetable ¥1,280, premium platter ¥1,680, signature assortment ¥2,980, chicken tempura (4 pieces) ¥1,980 and more; negi pork shabu-shabu ¥3,480 (booking required). Tempura Miya Co., Ltd. official site: 'the culmination of a tempura specialist', about 20 kinds of tempura, sushi, soba and small dishes; the company also runs Tendon & Rawsoba Tempura Miya (Ueno main shop and Ueno-ekimae shop), ミヤノ家 and Dashi & Rice Tenmusu Miya. Reviews (April–August 2026): tendon at lunch; zaru tendon ¥1,580; many overseas diners; very crisp batter; no oshibori, said one diner.

食べログ (公式情報): 寿し処 川、文京区湯島3-42-7 ATビル 1F、湯.en: Tabelog (official information): Sushi Dokoro Sen, Yushima 3-42-7, Bunkyō, ATビル 1F; 3 min on foot from Exit 2 of Yushima Station; Mon–Sat 17:00–2:00 (food L.O. 1:30); closed Sundays and the 1st and 3rd Wednesdays; reservations taken; 16 seats (8 at the counter, 2 tables for four); non-smoking; cards and PayPay accepted; English menu; children welcome; BYO allowed; authentic Edomae sushi carrying on the taste of the famous downtown shop Kanpachi; nigiri course ¥15,000; appetizers and nigiri course ¥17,000; à la carte too. Menu (April 2026): omakase sushi ¥5,000; late-night sets A and B ¥3,000. Reviews (January 2025–October 2026): shinko (about ¥4,000 extra), striped jack, sweet shrimp, kuruma prawn, ikura bowl, eel, homemade gari, a good sake list, a course adjusted on request; one diner found it too salty.

食べログ (公式情報): 小林酒店、立ち飲み、中京区新京極通四条上る中之町565.en: Tabelog (official information): 小林酒店, standing bar, 中京区新京極通四条上る中之町565-1, 88 m from Kyoto Kawaramachi Station; Mon–Thu 15:00–24:00, Fri–Sun 13:00–24:00; no reservations; 15 seats; no private rooms; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR payments accepted; opened 19 December 2023. Reviews (2025–2026, in English): canned craft beer, sake, wine, craft gin and cocktails chosen from the refrigerated cases; a standing counter outside and seats inside; fried spring rolls with mackerel and tomato ¥660, steamed chicken, a three-item platter; "Habakari-san" from Kyoto ¥1,200, "HINO" from Shiga ¥1,260; PayPay not accepted (April 2026).

食べログ (公式情報): 山鶏 ハナレ、文京区湯島3-38-10 ハニービル 7.en: Tabelog (official information): Yamadori Hanare, Yushima 3-38-10, Bunkyō, ハニービル 7F; 2 min on foot from Yushima Station, 3 min from Ueno-Okachimachi and Ueno-Hirokoji; Mon–Sat, the day before and after a holiday 17:00–24:00 (food L.O. 23:00, drinks L.O. 23:30); closed Sundays and holidays; reservations taken; 2-hour limit when busy; appetizer ¥694; 26 seats; semi-private rooms; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; Wi-Fi; rare chicken over charcoal; local sake. Reviews (December 2023–June 2026): Tottori Daisen chicken, Shiga Omi chicken, Kyoto Tamba black chicken, Nagano Sanada-maru; tsukune; tsukune with foie gras; white liver; seseri; gizzard; a big shiitake; tripe with spicy miso; yakitori course ¥4,950 (October 2024); courses with all-you-can-drink; one diner was sent here from the main shop; one found it rushed with many items sold out.

食べログ (公式情報): 春近 GABA SOBA Lab、池之端1-1-7 P.en: Tabelog (official information): Haruchika GABA SOBA Lab, Ikenohata 1-1-7, PROSビル 1F; 2 min on foot from Exit 1 of Yushima Station, 6 min from JR Okachimachi and Ueno-Hirokoji; Wed–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–23:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–22:00; closed Mondays and Tuesdays; reservations taken; 36 seats (counter 15, tables 16, private rooms 6); non-smoking (smoking allowed outside); cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 16 July 2025; 100% sprouted-buckwheat soba. Menu (May 2026): seiro ¥1,300; cold or hot soba ¥1,500; spicy grated daikon ¥1,500; walnut sauce ¥1,700; duck and green onion ¥2,700; large natural shrimp tempura soba ¥3,000; karasumi cheese soba ¥3,000; additive-free sea-urchin soba ¥3,500; soba dumplings ¥1,800; large +¥600 or +¥1,000. Reviews (April–October 2026): soba tofu; mekabu natto soba; tororo mekabu soba; a sushi-and-soba dinner course (grouper, abalone); sake recommended by the owner; seemingly family-run; an owner who explains each dish; a 30-minute wait for soba on a busy night; careless service, said one; a baseball broadcast on TV.

食べログ (公式情報): 梯酔好 (hasi bero)、東上野1-14-9、仲.en: Tabelog (official information): 梯酔好 (hasi bero), Higashi-Ueno 1-14-9; 5 min on foot from Naka-Okachimachi Station, 9 min from Ueno and Okachimachi; Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:30, Sat, Sun and holidays 15:00–23:30 (food L.O. 23:00, drinks L.O. 23:15); closed Thursdays; reservations taken; 9 counter seats (up to 15 standing); non-smoking; cards, transport IC and QR payments accepted; opened 13 September 2024; a natural-wine bistro by sommeliers and chefs who trained in the Blue Note group; look for the clock tower; Showa-retro interior; DJ events. Lunch (October 2026): gumbo ¥1,500, bacon and eggplant tomato pasta ¥1,450, butter chicken curry ¥1,150, massaman curry ¥1,150. Reviews (February–October 2026): no drink menu — tell the staff what you like and a wine is chosen; appetizer platter; fig butter; pasta of the day; a friendly owner; in February 2026 one diner found the service lacking.

食べログ (公式情報): 歳歳紅、湖南米粉の専門店、上野6-3-13 タイガービ.en: Tabelog (official information): Saisai Kou, a Hunan rice-noodle specialist, Ueno 6-3-13, タイガービル6 1F–2F; 1 min on foot from the JR Okachimachi North Exit, 2 min from Ueno-Okachimachi; daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); reservations taken; 14 seats (8 at the counter, 3 tables for two); non-smoking; no cards or e-money; QR payment (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay); take-out; Chinese menu and staff; opened 23 January 2025. Menu (February 2025): beef stew rice noodles ¥1,518, pork belly and chilli stir-fry ¥1,518, braised pork trotters ¥1,408 and more; wide or thin noodles; extra noodles ¥220. Reviews (September 2025–August 2026): order by QR code; soup or dry; can switch to rice; the cheapest ¥680 item comes with noodle refills; free toppings; mostly Chinese diners at night; slow service on some days.

食べログ (公式情報): 江戸天ぷら屋台 四文銭、上野3-28-6 大島6号館、.en: Tabelog (official information): Edo Tempura Yatai Yonmonsen, Ueno 3-28-6, 大島6号館; 1 min on foot from JR Okachimachi Station, 2 min from Ueno-Okachimachi; Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat and the days before and after a holiday 12:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); Sun and holidays 12:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed Wednesdays; reservations taken; no appetizer or seat charge; 14 seats; smoking only at heated-tobacco seats; cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 1 October 2020; a casual bar for tempura and creative Japanese dishes. Menu (October 2026): tempura from ¥90 a piece; shiso, shishito, pumpkin, lotus root ¥90; shrimp ¥400; vegetable assortment ¥530; seafood assortment ¥980. Reviews (March 2025–October 2026): reopened in February 2026 after a renovation; QR ordering and cashless payment; the owner seems to have changed, said one; 100% buckwheat soba; eel-liver skewers; maki rolls; deluxe tempura assortment ¥1,980; kombu-cured sea bream nigiri ¥460; curry soba and whale sashimi no longer served.

食べログ (公式情報): 海鮮・鮨 食べ放題 かに村 上野本店、上野3-28-6.en: Tabelog (official information): Seafood & Sushi All-You-Can-Eat Kanimura, Ueno main shop, Ueno 3-28-6, 第一大島ビル 1F; 1 min on foot from the JR Okachimachi North Exit and Exit A1 of Ueno-Hirokoji and Ueno-Okachimachi; daily 11:30–22:00 (last entry 20:00); open all year; buffet at lunch too; reservations taken; private room fee ¥3,000; ages 4–12 half price, under 4 free; 160 seats; non-smoking (smoking area outside); cards and QR accepted; menus and staff in English, Chinese and Korean; opened 5 March 2025. OZmall (May 2025): an affiliate of 銀座八芳; over 100 dishes all-you-can-eat from ¥5,980; tablet ordering. Compalyze (August 2026): FANG DREAM COMPANY, 16 shops in Tokyo and Chiba, including 銀座八芳, 銀座七芳, 銀座芳亭, 孫二娘 and 魚でん. Reviews (September–October 2026): renovated into a self-service buffet; 120 minutes ¥9,800 (campaign price ¥8,820); king crab course ¥12,420; snow crab, king crab, Shanghai crab, hairy crab, abalone, shellfish, sushi, wagyu yakiniku grilled by staff, Peking duck, Häagen-Dazs; one diner wished for a discount for non-drinkers.

食べログ (公式情報): 炭火焼 18、下谷1-6-9 ONE STAGE上野.en: Tabelog (official information): Sumibi Yaki 18, Shitaya 1-6-9, ONE STAGE上野 1F; 5 min on foot from the JR Uguisudani South Exit and Exit 2 of Iriya Station; Tue–Sun 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 17:00–22:45 (L.O. 22:15); closed Mondays and the third Thursday; reservations taken; appetizer charge ¥275; 14 seats; non-smoking (ashtray beside the shop); cards, e-money and QR accepted; Wi-Fi; opened 8 October 2022; local-chicken dishes and sake. Menu (September 2025): omakase 6-skewer set ¥3,520, negima ¥319, skewers from ¥242, tsukune ¥363. Reviews (October 2025–June 2026): yakitori rice bowl, oyakodon, half oyakodon with three kara-age ¥900, chicken nanban; lunch about ¥1,000 with miso soup and pickled daikon; open on Sundays; white liver; small portions and an odour in the oyakodon chicken, said some.

食べログ (公式情報): 炭火焼鳥 駿、文京区湯島3-45-3 小林市ビル 1F.en: Tabelog (official information): Sumibi Yakitori Shun, Yushima 3-45-3, Bunkyō, 小林市ビル 1F; 1 min on foot from Exit 2 of Yushima Station, 5 min from Ueno-Hirokoji and JR Okachimachi; Mon–Fri 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00), Sat 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Sundays; reservations taken; appetizer ¥324; 16 seats (8 at the counter, a table for 6, a curtained semi-private seat); smoking allowed; cards accepted; opened 7 May 2014; selected local sake and authentic shōchū. Menu (October 2022): Shun course ¥2,950, negima ¥240, wings ¥350, tsukune ¥240, gizzard ¥230, liver and heart ¥220, chicken tender with ume-shiso or wasabi ¥260. Reviews (May 2024–July 2026): run by a couple; grilled daikon, bamboo shoots, soft roe with ponzu, sashimi, wings, gizzards; skewers served one at a time; plenty of sake and shōchū; fully booked some nights; smoking allowed.

食べログ (公式情報): 点心すや、根岸1-3-20 UDBASE 101、JR.en: Tabelog (official information): Tenshin Suya, Negishi 1-3-20, UDBASE 101; 1 min on foot from the JR Uguisudani South Exit, 6 min from Iriya; Tue–Sat 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 21:30), Sun 13:00–20:00 (L.O. 18:30); closed Mondays (and some other days, announced on Instagram); reservations taken; bookings with children generally not accepted; ¥300 charge; 15 seats (5 at the counter, 10 at tables); semi-private rooms; non-smoking (ashtrays in front); cards, transport IC and QR accepted; no all-you-can-drink. Menu (October 2026): dim sum ¥680 each (pan-fried gyoza, shumai, xiaolongbao, shrimp wontons, cumin spring rolls, daikon mochi, sesame balls), braised beef cheek ¥2,880, yu-lin chicken ¥1,700, chilli shrimp ¥1,800, assorted appetizers ¥1,500. Reviews (July–November 2026): chewy homemade pan-fried gyoza, water dumplings, house citrus sours, natural wine, craft gin, alcohol-free sours, a stylish room, lu rou fan; one diner's expectations were too high.

食べログ (公式情報): 焼肉DINING 牛勢 上野店、上野2-12-9 金栄.en: Tabelog (official information): Yakiniku Dining Gyusei, Ueno branch, Ueno 2-12-9, 金栄ビル 2F; 3 min on foot from the JR Ueno Shinobazu Exit and Exit A3 of Ueno-Okachimachi and Ueno-Hirokoji; Mon–Fri and the day before a holiday 15:00–23:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); reservations taken (cancellation fees from 23:00 two days before); 88 seats; separate smoking; cards accepted (no e-money or QR); BYO allowed. Menu (February 2026): omakase platters of 6, 8 and 10 kinds ¥4,980, ¥6,980 and ¥9,980; kalbi ¥780; diamond-cut kalbi and outside skirt ¥1,280; black wagyu tenderloin ¥1,780; thick-cut premium tongue ¥2,580. Reviews (November 2025–September 2026): all-you-can-eat ¥4,620; with all-you-can-drink ¥5,940; tablet ordering; one free grill change; sauces and garlic on request; slow service when short-staffed; a clean, quiet room.

食べログ (公式情報): 純酒肴 吟、文京区湯島3-41-10 コスモビル 2F.en: Tabelog (official information): Junshukou Gin, Yushima 3-41-10, Bunkyō, コスモビル 2F; 2 min on foot from Exit A3 of Ueno-Hirokoji and Ueno-Okachimachi Stations, 3 min from Exit 2 of Yushima, 6 min from the JR Okachimachi North Exit; Mon–Sat 17:00–22:00; closed Sundays, holidays, Obon and New Year (and some other days); reservations taken; 16 seats; heated-tobacco smoking area; cards and QR accepted. Menu (2022): seared anago sashimi ¥850, natural kanpachi ¥950, bonito salt tataki ¥1,000, sashimi platter from ¥2,000, bonito shuto ¥500, heshiko ¥650. Reviews (November 2025–September 2026): daily sashimi, half-and-half orders possible; herring; sea bream cured in yuzu; kombu-cured fish; stone flounder; simmered sardines; simmered filefish with liver; namerō; chicken tempura with curry salt; Akkeshi oysters; Seiko crab; winter kue hot pot course ¥9,000; Nabeshima ¥1,500; the owner is from Saitama; in September 2026 one diner found the portions small and a 3% fee for non-cash payment.

食べログ (公式情報): 草原の家、東上野1-19-2、仲御徒町駅・御徒町駅から.en: Tabelog (official information): Sogen no Ie, Higashi-Ueno 1-19-2; 4 min on foot from Naka-Okachimachi and Okachimachi Stations, 7 min from Ueno; Mon, Wed–Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Tuesdays; reservations taken; appetizer charge ¥280; courses with all-you-can-drink at ¥2,980, ¥3,980 and ¥4,980 (3–20 people); take-out and delivery; 20 seats; non-smoking (smoking area outside); cards, transport IC and QR payments accepted; homemade Mongolian cooking, shumai and gyoza, lamb spare ribs. Lunch (October 2024): grilled lamb udon ¥780, lamb fried rice ¥880, beef or lamb shumai set ¥1,080 and more. Forbes JAPAN (中村正人, 26 June 2024): モンゴル焼売 at Higashi-Ueno 1-19-2 recently changed owners and was renamed 草原の家. Reviews (September 2025–October 2026): a ger-like interior, lamb shumai, lamb skewers, Golden Gobi (Mongolian beer), salty milk tea, camel-milk liquor, QR-code ordering; in September 2026 one diner found the flavours adjusted for Japan and the portions small.

食べログ (公式情報): 角打ち割烹 CONBU、文京区湯島3-43-11 阿部.en: Tabelog (official information): Kaku Uchi Kappou CONBU, Yushima 3-43-11, Bunkyō, 阿部ビル 1F; 3 min on foot from Yushima Station and Exit A3 of Ueno-Hirokoji, Ueno-Okachimachi and Naka-Okachimachi; Tue–Sat, holidays and the days before and after 17:00–3:00 (food L.O. 2:00, drinks L.O. 2:30); Sun 17:00–23:00; closed Mondays; reservations taken; cover charge ¥500; 16 places (6 at the counter, 2 tables for two, 6 standing outside); smoking allowed; cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 12 December 2025; same group as Alvino and AJILLO. Menu (December 2025): fresh oyster and seaweed spring roll ¥700, snow-crab miso cream croquette ¥650, yamato-imo tororo hot pot ¥1,300, three obanzai ¥600, white liver stewed in plum wine ¥900. Reviews (August–October 2026): signature dote-ni, seafood yukhoe, shellfish rice soup, miso cream udon; 10–15 sakes changing weekly; Arita and Kutani ware; hard to book; two staff; slow service when busy.

食べログ (公式情報): 鉄板ビストロ ラフ+たす、池之端1-6-19 高瀬ビル.en: Tabelog (official information): Teppan Bistro Rafutasu, Ikenohata 1-6-19, 高瀬ビル 1F; 5 min on foot from Exit 1 of Yushima Station, 12 min from the JR Ueno Park Exit; daily 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:00–22:30 (L.O. 20:30); irregular closing days; reservations taken; 10% service charge at dinner only; 12 seats (6 at the counter, 6 at tables); non-smoking; cards accepted (no e-money or QR); teppanyaki and selected wines. Reviews (November 2025–October 2026): a 180 g hamburg steak with demi-glace and rock salt; lunch courses (appetizers, fish, meat, garlic rice, rice bowl, curry); Saitama black-haired wagyu; yellowtail carpaccio; butter-soy squid; swordfish with anchovy sauce; wine pairing; weekend lunch fully booked; a quiet residential street; a warm chef.

食べログ (公式情報): 鳥恵 上野広小路店、文京区湯島3-40-8 栗田ビル.en: Tabelog (official information): Torie Ueno Hirokoji, Yushima 3-40-8, Bunkyō, 栗田ビル 1F; 1 min on foot from Exit A4 of Ueno-Okachimachi and Ueno-Hirokoji Stations, 3 min from Yushima and JR Okachimachi; Mon–Fri 17:30–22:30, Sat and holidays 17:00–22:30, Sun 17:00–22:00 (open Sundays from 17 May 2026); closed New Year, Golden Week, Obon; reservations taken; counter for junior-high age and up, with a course order required; small children only in private rooms (room fee ¥5,000); 20 seats (counter 10, private rooms for 4 and 6); non-smoking; cards and PayPay accepted; Tabelog Yakitori 100 2018, 2019, 2021, 2022 and EAST 2023–2025. Retty / ikyu: three shops close together — Yushima main shop, Ueno Hirokoji and Ueno Kuromon branch — each using slightly different chicken breeds. Reviews (September–October 2026): Torie course or omakase about ¥10,000; weekend 17:00 short course ¥8,000; seasonal starters and salads; seseri, gizzard, tsukune, Omi chicken breast; liver pâté; oyakodon and dessert to finish; wine; harder to book lately; one reviewer calls Ikebukuro the main branch.

食べログ (公式情報): Ａlvino、上野2-2-6、上野広小路駅・上野御徒町.en: Tabelog (official information): Alvino, Ueno 2-2-6; 2 min on foot from Exit A3 of Ueno-Hirokoji, Ueno-Okachimachi and Naka-Okachimachi Stations, 3 min from Yushima; Mon–Sat 17:00–4:00, Sun and holidays 17:00–23:30; closing days not fixed; reservations taken; 24 seats (2.5-hour limit when busy); 2nd floor for private groups of 8–20; smoking allowed; cards, e-money and QR accepted; take-out; opened 26 July 2016; sister shops AJILLO (Ueno, Nakano, Kanda Nishiguchi, Shimokitazawa), Bistronomie Avin, Kakuuchi Kappo CONBU, Gourmandise Alvino, Bar Buzz, Buzz Bee. Menu (2023): signature sea-urchin cream croquette (reservation required), potato salad with amber onions, assorted appetizers, Shōnai pork pâté en croûte, bagna cauda. Reviews (September–October 2026): crab-miso pasta, ajillo, seared wagyu carpaccio, pizza of the day; a wide wine list; attentive staff; a free bottle of wine for three reservation cards; one diner found the value average.

食べログ (店の公式情報): 新町 和けい、大阪市西区新町2-3-13 ライオン.en: Tabelog (official shop information): Shinmachi Wakei, Lions Mansion Yotsubashi 105, 2-3-13 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station Exit 1, 8 min from Yotsubashi Station Exit 2; daily 12:00–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 18:00–24:00; lunch closed if there are no reservations, dinner by reservation only (same-day bookings can be hard when the market is closed); closing days not fixed; tell the shop about allergies or disliked foods when booking; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 5% service charge and 5% private-room charge; 15 seats; one private room with a sunken kotatsu (4–8 people); private hire up to 20; opened 20 November 2017. Shop description: trained at a long-established Osaka restaurant, then head chef at the Michelin one-star Sōsaku Ryori Kawahara in the chef's home prefecture of Ehime before going independent; dashi of Rishiri kelp and honkarebushi bonito; seasonal fish and local vegetables; honest prices. Menu (updated August 2026): Wakei Gozen ¥1,600, with sashimi and tempura ¥2,500, three-tiered bento ¥3,500 (two a day), lunch kaiseki from ¥4,300, tempura kaiseki ¥6,500 and ¥8,000, omakase from ¥10,000, matsutake, Yamasan beef shabu-shabu course, pork shabu-shabu course, tetchiri (pufferfish hot pot) course; also runs a shabu-shabu specialty restaurant. Reviews (May 2023–September 2026): about 12 small dishes, two kinds of sashimi, tempura (thick-cut eggplant, Awaji onion, shrimp), seasonal rice, tempura of grilled eel, oboro tofu, Sumire kaiseki ¥4,500, a relaxed meal in the private room, a 90-year-old mother finished everything, one reviewer says the head chef comes from Kiccho, friendly and careful explanations.

食べログ (店舗の紹介): ミバショウ、カフェ・ジューススタンド・サンドイッチ、.en: Tabelog (shop's own introduction): Mibashou, café, juice stand, sandwiches; Ichigaya Honmura-chō 2-33, ART ICHIGAYA #02; 3 min walk from Ichigaya Station Exit 7, 9 min from Yotsuya Station; Mon–Fri 8:00–16:00, closed Saturday, Sunday and holidays; take-out only since December 2021; 4 counter seats; no cards or e-money, QR accepted; opened 15 April 2016; banana-juice specialty shop; ripe banana with no ice or sugar ¥350; premium with "Kan-nyuku-oh Gold Premium" ¥500; milk or unsweetened soy milk; add vegetables or fruit from +¥50; homemade hot sandwiches ¥390, soup ¥350; the daily menu is announced on Instagram and Twitter the day before. Reviews (2021–2025): at the back of an alley; hanging bananas mean it is open; ticket machine; stamp card; lines. Time Out Tokyo lists "ミバショウ 北千住マルイ".

食べログ (店舗の紹介): 灯火、焼き鳥・日本料理・鶏料理、六番町4-11 朝日.en: Tabelog (shop's introduction): Toka, yakitori, Japanese cuisine, chicken dishes; Rokubanchō 4-11, 朝日六番町マンション B1F; 3 min walk from Ichigaya Station, 4 min from Kōjimachi Station; Mon–Sat and holidays 17:30–23:30 (last order 22:30, last seating 22:00); closed Sundays and on irregular days; closes early if the yakitori sells out; seat availability updated daily on Instagram @touka.ichigaya; at least 2 drinks per person; no service charge; cards accepted; 15 seats (9 at the counter plus a semi-private box); non-smoking; hand-skewered yakitori and Japanese food on bonito dashi; Hinai jidori shio tsukune and takikomi gohan. Reviews (2025–2026): run by a couple; 8-skewer omakase course (14 dishes) ¥7,300; liver pâté; green curry; oyakodon; chicken-soup ramen; over 20 sakes from Tohoku; handwritten notes.

食べログ (店舗会員): 29104、焼肉・ホルモン・ラーメン、中央区博労町1-.en: Tabelog (shop member): 29104; yakiniku, offal, ramen; Bakuromachi 1-1-6, Chuo-ku; 6 min on foot from exit 1 of Matsuyamachi Stn, 8 min from exit 1 of Nagahoribashi Stn, 7 min from exit 3 of Sakaisuji-Hommachi Stn; daily 17:00–24:30 (food last order 23:30); irregular closures (5–6 days a month); seat charge ¥110 (free for primary-school children and under); courses with all-you-can-drink, 13 dishes ¥6,500 and 15 dishes ¥7,500 (4–18 people); reservations; private hire up to 20; cards, no e-money or QR; 28 seats (counter 2×6, tatami 4×4); non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; digital menu; opened 22 April 2026. Reviews (June–October 2026): sister of Horumon Nagaoka, black tongue ¥1,320, outside skirt ¥1,760, loin ¥1,078, tsurami ¥990, Chijira ¥440, raw omasum ¥748, heart sashimi, liver with ginger soy sauce or seaweed tsukudani, outside skirt topped with pickled ginger, dashi kotechan ¥748, green-onion tongue, akasen, lightly grilled loin, gukbap, bibimbap, cold ramen with olive oil; also comments about small portions, a light sauce and overhearing staff complain about work.

食べログ (店舗会員): AVAN 北新地、ダイニングバー・イタリアン・居酒屋、.en: Tabelog (shop member): AVAN Kitashinchi, dining bar, Italian and izakaya, 廣ビル 3F, 1-4-8 堂島, Kita-ku, Osaka; 5 min from Kitashinchi, Nishi-Umeda and Yodoyabashi stations; diagonally opposite the ANA Crowne Plaza; Mon–Sat and the day before and after a holiday 18:00–5:00 (last order food 4:00, drinks 5:00); holidays 18:00–24:00; also said to be open year-round; reservations accepted; same-day cancellation fee; groups of 10 or more two days ahead, private hire a week ahead; à la carte table charge ¥500 from 18:00 to 24:00, ¥1,000 from 24:00 to 5:00; cards and PayPay accepted; 60 seats (sofas, a VIP room for 20 with karaoke, a room for 6, counter of 4); private hire up to 50; smoking allowed; wheelchair accessible; opened 3 December 2014; an Italian place like a night lounge; all-you-can-eat of 14 original pizzas (¥4,500 weekdays, ¥5,000 weekends); all-you-can-eat domestic beef steak (¥5,000, ¥5,500). Invoice registration: J Co., Ltd. Reviews (April 2024–October 2026): two hams; potato salad; cut steak; aglio e olio; thin margherita and mentaiko-mayo pizza; spicy nuggets and fries; cheese pizza; colourful salad; hayashi rice at lunch; an Italian course with karaoke and all-you-can-drink ¥4,000 plus ¥1,000 for a private room; parties; two hours extended to three; a comment that young artists work there.

食べログ (店舗会員): AVOCADO HOUSE NAMBA、メキシコ料理・.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): AVOCADO HOUSE NAMBA, Mexican, bar and café, 難波日大ビル 1F, Namba 3-3-4, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 2 minutes from Namba Station exit 19; Mon–Fri 17:00–24:00, Sat–Sun 15:00–24:00; irregular closures and closed 1 January; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 52 seats (8 at the counter); non-smoking (smoking area outside after 22:00); children may be refused late at night; opened 5 November 2021. 'Premium Rich Avocado' chosen by oil content, chicken fajitas with flames, fruit cocktails, courses of 3 hours' drinks and all-you-can-eat tacos ¥4,000–5,000. Reviews (September–October 2026): avocado ¥913, avocado cheese gratin ¥1,298, Caesar salad ¥1,628, chicken fajitas ¥2,420, tacos ¥495–605, chili con carne ¥968, six habanero sauces, mild heat, many foreign guests and a lively room, mobile ordering.

Reviews (September 2025–October 2026): acai bowl ¥1,300, half size available; one order per person; ahi poke bowl; taco rice; garlic shrimp; waffles; open sandwiches; scrambled-egg toast; a vegan curry; fresh juice ¥500; many foreign customers; a workspace at the back.

食べログ (店舗会員): BAR RARITY (バー ラリティー)、バー、中央.en: Tabelog (shop member): BAR RARITY, bar, Bakuromachi 4-6-17, Chuo-ku, 第三丸米ビル B1F, about 3 min on foot from Shinsaibashi, Yotsubashi or Honmachi stations, Mon–Thu 18:00–1:00, Fri–Sat 18:00–2:00, holidays 18:00–24:00, closed Sundays (private hire negotiable), reservations accepted (same-day cancellation ¥3,000 a person; treated as cancelled 15 minutes late without contact), cards accepted, no e-money or QR, 27 seats (12 at the counter, tables of 7 and 8), smoking allowed (no cigars), English menu, free Wi-Fi, Bar Tabelog 100 2022. Reviews (April–October 2026): stairs down to the basement and a heavy single-slab wooden door, a long counter, gin and tonic, mojito, peach cocktail, Shine Muscat and champagne cocktail, pistachio and espresso cocktail, a range of whiskies, ¥700 cover, about ¥2,700 for two drinks, on busy nights one bartender cannot keep up.

食べログ (店舗会員): Bar マスダ、バー、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-3-11.en: Tabelog (corporate member): Bar マスダ, bar, Shinsaibashi-suji 2-3-11, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 7 min on foot from Namba Station exit 15-B; daily 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); reservations accepted (give time, party size, name and mobile number; cancelled if you are late without calling); cover ¥1,100 on floors 1 and 2, ¥2,200 on floor 3 (karaoke included); cards, e-money and QR (Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted; 40 seats (counter 10 on 1F, booths 10 on 2F, 20 on 3F); private rooms for 6–20; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; English menu; Wi-Fi; opened 9 June 1958. Shop introduction: since its founding in 1958 it has grown with the history of Souemoncho, 67th anniversary in 2025; an 8-metre single-plank counter; a plaster-finished bar; the third floor holds up to 20; original cocktails ('Masuda Original'); a wide choice of whisky; food to go with drinks such as Kagoshima black-pork prosciutto; a set of two original cocktails ¥5,500. Tabelog Bar 100, 2022. Reviews (July–October 2026): peanuts as the starter, a watermelon cocktail, Ardbeg Dolce, a Kanosuke tasting set, Enishi, Blue Blazer II, Nitro Fruit March, Wave Motion Moscow Mule, prosciutto and cheese assortment, raisin butter, about ¥1,500 a drink, a cocktail menu of hundreds, drinks made to your taste, the master and a manager.

食べログ (店舗会員): Bar 内藤、バー、日本橋人形町2-7-2 コスモVビ.en: Tabelog (shop member): Bar Naito; bar; コスモVビル B1F, Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-7-2; Tue–Sun 18:00–01:00; closed Monday; cover charge ¥880; reservations accepted; cards and e-money accepted, no QR; 14 seats (7 counter, 7 table); non-smoking; opened 10 February 2014; Tabelog Bar 100 2022. Reviews (February–August 2026): owner Naito trained at the famous OPA in Monzen-Nakacho; a basement with high ceilings; seasonal fruit cocktails; a Moscow mule with new ginger; a stirred Stinger; martinis; no fixed signature, drinks made to your taste; some say the master is reserved and service uneven; some say prices have risen; no phone signal.

食べログ (店舗会員): Bird (バード)、居酒屋・鶏料理・焼き鳥、大阪市中.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Bird, izakaya, chicken dishes and yakitori, 千日前セントラル第2ビル, 9-17 Namba-Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Nippombashi Stn, 1 min from Namba Grand Kagetsu; daily 17:00–24:00; open year-round; reservations accepted (even when online booking is full, there may be space by phone); starter ¥385; cards and PayPay accepted; 28 seats, parties up to 8; non-smoking; opened 20 August 2022; operated by enya-food.jp. Shop introduction (English translation): charcoal-grilled yakitori, the sweet-spicy Maple Chicken, creative vegetable dishes, drinks supervised by famous bars (a matcha and pineapple tea cocktail by Okamura of Bar Hana in Douyamacho), about 10 craft beers. Reviews (September–October 2026): weekday-only appetizer platter for two ¥2,750 (seat charge included; sliced thigh and breast, potato salad, Worcestershire-marinated quail egg, chicken skin with ponzu, heart, liver pâté, chicken-neck and vegetable curry, chicken sashimi, caprese with prosciutto); negima, shiso chicken neck, steamed tsukune; fried sweet potato with cream cheese; black-bean paste with cheese; seasonal fruit in white-miso dressing; jerk chicken; clay-pot rice with corn and chicken; Maru-F draft beer; a sister shop on the floor above; some say the counter is cramped; some nights many overseas guests.

食べログ (店舗会員): Bistro Vino、港区六本木6-6-9 ピラミデ.en: Tabelog (shop member): Bistro Vino, Roppongi 6-6-9, ピラミデビル 1F, 2 min walk from Roppongi Station; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:30 and 16:00–23:00 (drinks only 16:00–17:00), Sat 11:30–23:00, Sun and holidays 11:30–22:00; open all year except New Year; no table charge; 91 seats (33 on the terrace); private hire for 50 or more; non-smoking (smoking area); cards, e-money and QR accepted. Thanksgiving dinner ¥8,980 (21–29 November). Reviews (October 2025–October 2026): burgers, sandwiches and steaks at lunch, a wine bar at night; over 100 bottled wines; burrata with fruit and prosciutto; truffle hash browns; Gorgonzola gnocchi; oysters. Operated by Bistro Vino六本木株式会社.

食べログ (店舗会員): Burger Revolution Tokyo Win.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Burger Revolution Tokyo Wine & Bar Roppongi, Roppongi 5-9-22, シュアービル福鮨 1F; right out of Roppongi Stn exit 3, down Imoarai-zaka, next to Sukiya, across from Asahi Shrine; daily 12:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); open all year; 26 seats including standing; high tables only; no strollers; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; English menu; takeaway and delivery; opened 30 October 2020. A burger specialist of 100% black wagyu (no fillers) and halal-certified Kobe beef, with a sauce supervised by a Michelin three-star chef. Menu: hamburger ¥1,780, classic ¥2,080, cheese ¥2,060, avocado cheese ¥2,460, foie gras ¥4,080; upgrades to Tokyo beef, Kobe beef, halal black wagyu or halal Hokkaido wagyu; halal teriyaki rice burger ¥3,480. Reviews (March–October 2026): came after seeing it on TV; fries cost extra; truffle-salt fries and onion rings; staff show how to wrap the burger in paper; ¥500 off for signing up on LINE; one diner was told it closed at 14:00 on a Sunday.

食べログ (店舗会員): CORA COFFEE、カフェ、大阪市浪速区元町1-1.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): CORA COFFEE, café, Motomachi 1-11-8, Naniwa Ward, Osaka, Sakimoto Building 1F, 5 min walk from Namba Station, daily 8:00–19:00, open year-round, no reservations, cards, e-money and QR accepted, 28 seats, terrace, non-smoking, vegetarian options, breakfast, opened 6 June 2021. Reviews (September 2025–October 2026): carefully made coffee and additive-free bread of domestic wheat, a BLT hot sandwich packed with lettuce (20–30 minute wait on busy mornings), cute lattes, iced tea, Hachiju orange juice (also sold by the bottle), power outlets and Wi-Fi, order at the counter and be called by number, self-service water, a beach-house-like interior, an English menu (Tabelog), the menu outside not in Japanese, some days about 90% of customers from overseas, near Namba Yasaka Shrine.

食べログ (店舗会員): CRITTERS PIZZA、ピザ・イタリアン・ワイン.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): CRITTERS PIZZA, pizza, Italian and wine bar, Dai-5 Ace Building, Nishi-Shinsaibashi 1-8-22, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 minutes from Shinsaibashi and Yotsubashi stations; Mon–Fri 12:00–15:30 and 17:00–23:00 (happy hour 17:00–19:00), Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00; open year-round; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 36 seats; non-smoking (smoking area outside); English menu; vegetarian options shown; opened 5 November 2018. Pizza and Italian from Critters Burger, a Tabelog top-100 shop, in a room like a New York Italian restaurant, American and natural wines, homemade desserts, birthday plates. Reviews (January–September 2026): recommended plan of food only ¥3,300, lunch of salad with pizza or pasta under ¥2,000, Hokkaido mozzarella Margherita, buffalo mozzarella Margherita, clam and Parmigiano pizza, Wakayama shirasu pizza, scallop and spinach lemon cream pasta, Asian pasta with coriander, fried oysters, prosciutto and arugula salad, a wait at weekday lunch with mostly tourists, music a little loud.

食べログ (店舗会員): Cafe BOHEMIA 心斎橋、カフェ・イタリアン・.en: Tabelog (shop member): Cafe BOHEMIA Shinsaibashi; cafe, Italian, Turkish; Nishi-Shinsaibashi 1-10-10, Four Points Flex by Sheraton Osaka Shinsaibashi 1F; 196 m from Shinsaibashi Stn; daily 7:00–10:30 (last order 10:00) and 11:30–24:00 (last order 23:30); reservations; cards, e-money and QR; 71 seats (59 in the morning); sofa seats; live music; projector; listed as non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; wheelchair accessible; breakfast; vegetarian options; English menu; children welcome; opened 5 January 2018. Reviews (October 2025–October 2026): Turkish lamps, shrimp and coconut-milk curry, hummus, tandoori chicken, Caesar salad, pasta lunch, honey dessert pizza, dried-fruit parfait, gâteau chocolat, mint tea, kapao rice breakfast, gin cocktails and chorizo, belly-dance shows, guests smoking shisha inside; also comments that it is salty.

食べログ (店舗会員): Cafe&Bistro For Yu、イタリアン・ビス.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Cafe&Bistro For Yu, Italian, bistro and bar, Kita-Horie 1-9-9 1F, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 1 minute from Yotsubashi Station; Mon–Sat and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–23:00, Sun 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; reservations accepted; ¥300 amuse charge per person for dinner à la carte; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 22 seats (8 counter, 14 table); smoking near the entrance; pets allowed; opened 15 April 2023. French and Italian dishes by a chef trained at a high-end Tokyo restaurant; the signature Rossini of Takamori wagyu raised on Dassai sake lees with foie gras; weekday-only full course of 7 dishes ¥3,500; lunch of 8 dishes from ¥1,800. Reviews (September–October 2026): Italian lunch ¥1,800, French lunch ¥2,800, Basque cheesecake +¥300, sansho Bolognese with a free large size, bread refills, dining inside with dogs, a dog menu, message plates, one reviewer found the Rossini a little tough, one chef and two staff.

食べログ (店舗会員): DINING STAGE 佐海屋 (Sakaiya A.en: Tabelog (shop member): DINING STAGE Sakaiya (Sakaiya Asahi); izakaya, seafood, tempura; Nambanaka 1-10-4 (Naniwa-ku), 南海野村ビル B1F; across the road southwest of Takashimaya; 30 seconds from subway exit 6, 1 minute's walk from Nankai Namba Station; daily 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:00) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. food 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed over the New Year; reservations; two hours when busy; ¥500 appetizer charge at night; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 80 seats (12 at the counter, tables, a horigotatsu room for 15–20); private hire up to 50; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; particular about fish, sake and shochu. Shop introduction (machine-translated): seasonal ingredients, fresh fish from the central market, no fixed menu and it changes daily, 3–5 small dishes then homemade pasta or a main, 18-month aged Spanish ham, a counter and tables from a tree about 2,000 years old, three wines by the glass and ten by the bottle, a house lemon sour of Hiroshima lemons. Reviews (June 2025–July 2026): pasta lunch ¥1,500 (appetizer platter, the day's pasta, focaccia, drink), ¥1,400 in June 2025, tomato and pecorino pasta ¥800 extra, a pasta of beef tongue and venison braised in red wine, a queue from opening at lunch, sell-outs, a menu naming only the main ingredients, chilled corn soup, sea bream carpaccio with kombu, Spanish ham, fried horse mackerel with brown butter, eggplant with smoked mozzarella, shirasu and lemon cream pasta, pork shoulder with yuzu, mushroom gratin, pork belly risotto, a young cook.

食べログ (店舗会員): FREY's Famous Pizzeria、港区六本.en: Tabelog (shop member): FREY's Famous Pizzeria, Roppongi 4-5-15, 1F; Tue–Sat 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:00–21:00, Sun 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–21:00, holidays 11:30–15:00; closed Mondays (irregular closures in summer and over New Year); closes when the dough runs out; 16 seats (two tables for 4, counter 8 + 2); non-smoking; cards and iD accepted; Tabelog pizza 100 in 2017, 2018, 2019 and 2021. Reviews (May–October 2026): Neapolitan pizza from a wood-fired oven; margherita; marinara; bufala ¥1,600; cheese ¥2,000; Papa's ¥2,200; Sunny Side Up; lemonade ¥660; IPA ¥1,650; one says chef Yamaguchi came from SAVOY; many overseas guests; some found it ordinary.

食べログ (店舗会員): Grill & Bistro K、ビストロ、四谷1-7.en: Tabelog (shop member): Grill & Bistro K, bistro; 第3鹿倉ビル B1F room B, Yotsuya 1-7-10; 3 min walk from JR and Tokyo Metro Yotsuya Station; Mon and Wed–Fri 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 18:00–22:30 (last order 21:30), Sat, Sun and holidays 18:00–22:30; closed Tuesdays; 18 seats (8 at the counter, 10 at tables); hire for up to 20; non-smoking; cards accepted; no service charge; smart casual; children welcome; opened 11 October 2024; carefully chosen chicken, duck and beef steaks; the speciality European-style beef curry; wine recommended by the sommelier; prix-fixe course ¥7,000. Reviews (January 2025–October 2026): the chef is a sommelier, the owner runs it alone, asparagus cheese gratin, white liver, foie gras brûlée, charcoal-grilled jidori chicken, duck, Bolognese ¥1,500, European curry ¥1,800, dishes take time.

食べログ (店舗会員): HILLMAN、シンガポール料理・アジア・エスニック・.en: Tabelog (shop member): HILLMAN; Singaporean, Asian/ethnic and Chinese; Namba Sennichimae 15-16, オクバビル 2F; about 2 minutes' walk east of Nankai Namba Station; Mon–Fri 16:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:30), Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 16:30–23:00; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 100 seats; private rooms (for 6 and 8); private hire for 50 or more; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; takeaway; opened 6 October 2014. Reviews (August–October 2026): paper chicken from the Singapore original, with the paper and sauce sent from the original restaurant, ¥290 a piece; chili crab with fried and steamed mantou ¥130; black-pepper prawns; bak kut teh; laksa; sambal water spinach; steamed chicken with scallion sauce ¥750; cilantro salad; a weekend and holiday lunch course ¥2,200; all-you-can-drink courses; the entrance is on the Sen’nichi Jizōson-dōri side; some find the appetizer platter overpriced; the shop that was in Kitashinchi has closed.

Reviews (August–October 2026): Kagoshima black-wagyu fillet katsu roll; bonito or tuna and caviar tartare with a Yurinchi-sauce jelly; chawanmushi of Kadoma lotus root, surf clam and sea urchin; sweetfish-pâté bisque; cold noodles with hamo; sudachi; Akashi sawara or grouper with saffron sauce; fillet steak with summer truffle; Daikoku shimeji; Shine Muscat with stracciatella; clay-pot rice of lobster and matsutake; peach compote and homemade strawberry ice cream; French tea; wine pairing (two reds for one dish); produced by Yuka Hattori of U.KAI; generous portions.

食べログ (店舗会員): IL MERCATO ANGELO、イタリアン・パスタ.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): IL MERCATO ANGELO, Italian, pasta and pizza, Crysta Nagahori underground mall No. 7, Minamisenba 4-12, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Crysta Nagahori West Town at Yotsubashi Station; daily 11:00–16:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed over New Year and on Crysta Nagahori's closing days; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 67 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; menus in English, Chinese and Korean; a sommelier; 'mercato' is Italian for market; vegetables, European prosciutto, a 35 kg Parmigiano Reggiano; house wine by the amount; glass wine from ¥800, 13 kinds; 90-minute free-drinks courses; aged lamb chops; roast beef. Official site anjou.co.jp. Reviews (July–October 2026): Mercato lunch, Pranzo Angelo, lunch course ¥1,950 (lunch bookings are courses only), monthly pasta, porcini about ¥600 extra, cacio e pepe, penne with water eggplant and spicy tomato, burrata, prosciutto, a monthly all-you-can-eat prosciutto event, plenty of cheese, message plates, a birthday song on the accordion, the same group as Alcyon.

食べログ (店舗会員): Imakoko Kitchen Merrymomo、オ.en: Tabelog (shop member): Imakoko Kitchen Merrymomo; organic, vegetable dishes, izakaya; 6-8-8 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, Hanahara No. 8 Building, ground floor; 5 minutes on foot from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; Mon–Fri 7:30–22:00, Sat 11:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Sundays and holidays; dinner courses for two or more booked by the previous business day; cards, PayPay, d Barai and au PAY accepted, no e-money; 30 seats; a private room for four; smoking allowed; opened 1 April 2014; vegetarian options; summer menu (lemon ramen, veggie taco rice, soupless tantanmen, chilled chuka noodles, ¥1,280, ¥1,080 at lunch). Reviews (May 2020 to June 2026): macrobiotic; brown rice with red quinoa; miso soup; five daily small dishes; set A with a plant-based main ¥1,300; set B with a meat or fish main ¥1,300; set C brown-rice onigiri ¥1,100; A and C are vegan; a lentil vegetable curry with no animal products; soupless sesame tantanmen; veggie mapo tofu; veggie hamburger; dandelion coffee; soy-yogurt and rice-flour cheesecake; cakes without wheat or eggs; canned gluten meat for sale; the miso soup tastes of dashi; a knowledgeable owner; customers from other prefectures and abroad.

食べログ (店舗会員): Kotetsu、上野7-8-23 サットンプレイスホテ.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Kotetsu, Ueno 7-8-23, サットンプレイスホテル 1F, 2 min on foot from the JR Ueno Station Iriya exit; Mon–Fri 17:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00), Sat and the day before a holiday 17:00–22:00; closed Sundays (open Sunday and closed Monday when Monday is a holiday); no service or table charge; 13 seats (5 at the counter, two tables for 4); smoking allowed; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; English menu; opened 15 June 2019; over 30 wines chosen by a sommelier and craft beer; the speciality is stewed Kobe beef tendon (topped with cheese and a soft-boiled egg); ajillo; cheese platter; pizza and pasta; courses with all-you-can-drink: Kotetsu course of 11 dishes, 2 hours, ¥3,600 (usually ¥4,600), autumn 12 dishes ¥3,800, monthly 13 dishes, 2.5 hours, ¥4,800. Reviews (September 2024–September 2026): smoked duck; shrimp and octopus ajillo; prosciutto; Iberico pork salami; carrot râpé; two cheeses; sausage; peperoncino; all-you-can-drink courses at ¥3,700 (June 2025) and ¥3,500 (August 2025); smoking allowed, hard for those who dislike smoke; not luxurious but affordable; drinks ¥600; Camembert dip; the master both cooks and serves.

食べログ (店舗会員): LA FINESTRA (ラフィネストラ)、イタリアン.en: Tabelog (shop member): LA FINESTRA; Italian, pasta, game dishes; Shinmachi 1-33-8 (Nishi-ku), ISS Building 1F; 2 minutes' walk from exit 2 of Nishi-Ohashi Station; lunch 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:00); dinner weekdays 18:00–22:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 17:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); irregular closures; reservations; message plates by three days ahead; groups of 11 or more by phone; a lunch of ten appetizers and a main ¥2,500; omakase lunch course ¥3,500; weekday-only casual course ¥4,500 (with a drink); cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 30 seats (counter 6, tables 24); terrace; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; opened 15 November 2018; hand-made pasta that chef Hirano learned in Italy; game sourced from across Japan; charcoal grilling; Italian wine. Reviews (June–October 2026): an appetizer platter (carrot cake, cucumber jelly, ginger and basil mousse); pasta or a main; focaccia; coffee with a cookie or financier; lunch ¥2,000 (+¥200 to change the main); herb-crusted pork tenderloin; fig and prosciutto; squid-ink pasta; saffron risotto; some say the course had little explanation.
