食べログ (店舗会員): Moegi、お好み焼き、難波千日前7-2 河原ハイツ.en: Tabelog (shop member): Moegi, okonomiyaki, Namba Sennichimae 7-2, 河原ハイツ 1F, 5 min on foot from Namba and Nihonbashi stations, lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:15), dinner 18:00–24:00 (last order 23:00), closed Wednesdays, reservations accepted, cards, e-money and QR, 27 seats (9 at the counter, 18 at tables), private hire, non-smoking, takeaway, particular about vegetables and fish, vegetarian options, opened 20 September 2019. Reviews (May–October 2026): a back alley in Ura Namba, the signature negiyaki (dashi soy sauce instead of sauce), beef-tendon negiyaki ¥1,250, fluffy okonomiyaki full of cabbage, a dashi-flavoured batter, yakisoba with bonito and dashi, Kaga lotus root ¥600, horumon ¥1,450, tonpei-yaki ¥850, ume-shiso-salt yakisoba ¥1,200, a crepe of okonomiyaki batter (sweet bean paste and ice cream), a queue before opening, reservations take priority, many overseas customers.

食べログ (店舗会員): Oh！マイステーキ、ステーキ・焼肉・魚介、大阪市中央区.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Oh! My Steak, steak, yakiniku and seafood, ミヤプラザ心斎橋 B1F, Shinsaibashi-suji 1-3-29, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 minutes from Shinsaibashi Station exit 4A; downstairs beside the Ichiran entrance; daily 11:00–16:00 and 16:00–22:00; irregular closures; reservations accepted; 5% service charge at dinner; cards for ¥3,000 or more, e-money accepted, no QR payment; 30 seats (all at teppan counters); non-smoking; opened 10 August 2019. Teppanyaki steak of Kobe beef, wagyu and domestic beef; whole A5 Kobe beef purchased; lunch from ¥1,200, dinner from ¥2,360, anniversary course from ¥6,800, tasting course with drinks ¥7,800, steak full course ¥8,800. Reviews (June–October 2026): domestic lean 80 g lunch ¥1,200 (salad, grilled vegetables, oxtail soup), wagyu and domestic 130 g comparison lunch ¥2,500, garlic rice, wasabi and miso, rice refills charged, one reviewer found weekend prices above ¥1,200, many Japanese guests, a Kobe beef certificate.

食べログ (店舗会員): Osteria Pantera、イタリアン・パスタ・創.en: Tabelog (shop member): Osteria Pantera; Italian, pasta, creative cuisine; Shinsaibashisuji 1-3-10, Shinsaibashi 井上 Building 1F; 1 min on foot from exit 5 of Shinsaibashi Stn, 3 min from exit 7 of Nagahoribashi Stn; daily 10:30–23:30 (lunch 10:30–15:00, dinner 15:00–23:30); irregular closures; reservations (cancelled if no contact within 30 minutes); fresh-pasta lunch course from ¥2,000, weekday short course ¥3,800, Pantera course ¥5,000, special course with domestic beef fillet ¥7,200; over 50 wines; sommelier; cards, e-money and QR; 34 seats; non-smoking; Wi-Fi; outlets; children and strollers welcome; English menu and English-speaking staff; vegan and vegetarian options; takeaway; opening date 3 October 2025. Reviews (October 2026): reopened 26 September, from 8 am, four-cheese and honey focaccia, seasonal fruit with prosciutto and burrata ¥1,680, seared scallop carpaccio ¥1,280, shrimp and scallop gratin ¥2,000, domestic beef steak with porcini sauce ¥2,980, shrimp tomato cream ¥2,300, porcini cream, arrabbiata, lasagna, potatoes with truffle salt, affogato.

食べログ (店舗会員): PANAF' African Restaurant &.en: Tabelog (shop member): PANAF' African Restaurant & Club; African, buffet, dining bar; Nishi-Shinsaibashi 1-6-14, BIG STEP 7F; 3 min on foot from exit 8 of Shinsaibashi Stn and exit 5 of Yotsubashi Stn; Sun–Thu and holidays 11:00–23:00, Fri–Sat 11:00–22:30 and 22:30–5:00; closed over the New Year; buffet from 2 October (lunch ¥2,000 for 90 minutes, ¥2,500 with soft drinks; dinner ¥3,800 for 120 minutes, with soft drinks ¥4,500, alcohol ¥5,500, craft beer ¥6,500); beer-garden course on the terrace ¥5,000; live music daily; cards, e-money and QR; 200 seats; terrace; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; English menu and English-speaking staff; allergy labelling; vegan and vegetarian options; kids menu; opened 24 March 2026; dishes popular at the Expo. Reviews (October 2026): Kenyan kebab, chebu jen-style rice with beef and vegetables, tagine, mafe (beef stew with peanut butter), tomato stew of beans and meat, meatballs, fried shrimp wrapped in kataifi, fish fritters, kara-age, yogurt dessert, baobab and bissap juices; also comments on the reception queue, sour soups and dishes running out.

食べログ (店舗会員): Panyo 北新地、鉄板焼き・海鮮・ステーキ、大阪市北.en: Tabelog (shop member): Panyo Kitashinchi, teppanyaki, seafood and steak, Espas Kitashinchi 8 (basement), 1-7-21 曽根崎新地, Kita-ku, Osaka; 3 min from JR Kitashinchi Station; 5 min from Higashi-Umeda and Nishi-Umeda stations; Mon–Sat 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Sundays; reservations accepted; service charge 10%; private room fee ¥5,000; cards and e-money accepted, no QR; 19 seats (counter of 13, private room of 6); e-cigarettes only at all seats; opened 20 October 2021; the main meat grilled on the teppan or over charcoal; à la carte by the gram; Panyo Dinner of nine dishes with a mini Panyo burger, lobster and fillet steak ¥13,800; a trial course of corn soup, a choice of seafood and fillet or a rare black-wagyu cut ¥6,600; a lunch of fillet steak by weight from ¥2,980. Invoice registration: Libre Co., Ltd. Reviews (November 2023–August 2026): seared black-wagyu sushi with Hokkaido sea urchin; foie gras; Matsusaka beef; lobster; abalone; bamboo-charcoal hamburger; garlic rice and black curry (¥999 extra each); mango pudding; flambé; a ¥5,000 lunch course; a comment of surprise at the private room fee; good service from the manager; comments on the price.

食べログ (店舗会員): Pizza TOKIO STADIUM、イタリアン・居.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Pizza TOKIO STADIUM, Italian, izakaya, café; サンライズビル 1F, 1-6-3 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Shinsaibashi Stn, 5 from Yotsubashi Stn; Mon–Fri 12:00–23:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); open year-round; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 80 seats (29 table, 5 counter, 40 sofa, 14 terrace); private hire up to 100; e-cigarettes at all seats, cigarettes on the terrace only; children welcome with a kids menu; pets allowed; opened 19 December 2023. Shop introduction (English translation): authentic oven-baked pizza, pasta, appetizers, reasonable courses, original cocktails; sofas, terrace and a DJ booth. Reviews (May–September 2026): wood-fired pizza; quattro formaggi with honey; margherita with prosciutto; a thick, chewy crust; one diner found the char a little bitter; fettuccine carbonara; eggplant and bacon tomato pasta; fries; shisha (one diner could not get the charcoal changed); moved from a previous site; many overseas guests; birthday plates; pizzas come out fast; terrace seats.

食べログ (店舗会員): R2 SUPPER CLUB、港区六本木7-14-23.en: Tabelog (shop member): R2 SUPPER CLUB, Roppongi 7-14-23, ラウンドクロス六本木 1F; Mon–Sat and days before holidays 18:00–5:00 next day, Sun 18:00–24:00; open all year; 127 seats; basement private rooms (2–10) and a VIP floor; non-smoking; cards accepted; opened 26 November 2011; vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free and halal options listed. Shop text: vegan, vegetarian and halal options so overseas guests can feel at ease; a vegetarian plate; private hire at R1, three minutes' walk away. Party course ¥6,600; basement course ¥5,500. Reviews (February–October 2026): a DJ; yuzu mojito; Cobb salad; crab pasta; a dress code; no table charge; staff from overseas; busy with overseas guests late at night.

食べログ (店舗会員): RAKUSUI、中華料理・創作料理、大阪市北区曽根崎新.en: Tabelog (shop member): RAKUSUI, Chinese and creative cuisine, ゴアビル 1F, 1-9-8 曽根崎新地, Kita-ku, Osaka; 1 min on foot from JR Kitashinchi Station exit 11-43; Mon–Sat and the day before and after a holiday 18:00–22:30 (last order food 21:30, drinks 22:00); closed Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; ¥500 seat charge for à la carte orders only; strong perfume may be refused; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 16 seats; non-smoking; opened 10 March 2004; creative Chinese in Kitashinchi for 20 years; ten years of training at a hotel and a well-known Chinese restaurant; 'Gokawa' mapo tofu, named in the hope of surpassing Sichuan; the owner is from Hokkaido and a culinary author (47); a drinks list from its bar days; six-starter platter ¥2,000; classic light course ¥7,500; a course choosing three of seven dishes ¥8,800; Tabelog Chinese WEST 100 in 2021. Invoice registration: GF2Re Co., Ltd. (西天満). Reviews (June–October 2026): weekday lunch has started; Gokawa mapo tofu set ¥1,500 (free rice refills, crab salad and potato salad, Kitami onion soup); a ¥1,200 daily set; chunks of wagyu, tripe and beef tendon instead of mince; plenty of numbing Sichuan pepper; a sashimi-style Chinese salad like sushi; sweet and sour pork stuffed with cheese and plated like the solar system; Italian-style shrimp mayo with pistachio sauce; French-style chili shrimp; scallop ajillo; sweet potato and cheese spring rolls; stir-fried beef with green peppers; dan dan noodles; potato salad with XO sauce; a robot explains the dish concept; sells a house-made card game, Shuraba Karuta; featured on TV; an interior like a Western restaurant.

食べログ (店舗会員): RIO GRANDE GRILL 六本木、港区六本木6.en: Tabelog (shop member): RIO GRANDE GRILL Roppongi, Roppongi 6-6-9, ピラミデビル 1F, 1 min walk from Roppongi Station exit 1A (Hibiya line); Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–23:00, Sat 11:30–15:30 and 17:00–23:00, Sun 11:30–15:30 and 17:00–22:30; open every day except 1 January; a service charge may apply; 164 seats (108 inside, 56 on the terrace); non-smoking (smoking area on the building's 3rd floor); cards, e-money and QR accepted; vegetarian options. Courses: wagyu and 15 kinds of churrasco with salad and dessert buffet ¥6,690; lunch with 10 kinds of churrasco ¥4,819. Official site: four RIO GRANDE GRILL shops — Roppongi, Ebisu, Yokohama Bay Quarter, Ikspiari. Reviews (March–October 2026): at lunch, grilled chicken ¥1,550 or beef steak ¥1,900 with the salad bar; fried banana; homemade chilli sauce; better service at dinner; complaints about the buffet queue at busy times.

食べログ (店舗会員): ROCKS Cafe、カフェ・カレー、大阪市西区北堀江.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): ROCKS Cafe, café and curry, Kita-Horie 1-13-11, Nishi Ward, Osaka, 5 min walk from Yotsubashi Station, 10 min from Shinsaibashi Station, daily 9:00–23:00 (last order 22:30), closed over New Year, no reservations, cards, e-money and QR accepted, 50 seats, non-smoking, power outlets and Wi-Fi, vegetarian options, breakfast, opened 1 August 2020. Reviews (April 2025–July 2026): on the north side of Horie Park, opened at 9:30 one day, breakfast set with sugar-butter toast, many toasts, generously sized café lattes, hojicha latte ¥605, fruit tea ¥700 (one diner found it lukewarm and weak), yuzu tea, berry yogurt smoothie, affogato smoothie, affogato, café au lait, gâteau chocolat, caramel tart, a LINE stamp card, a Pilates studio upstairs, busy on weekend mornings.

食べログ (店舗会員): RYU、居酒屋・釜飯、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-2-3.en: Tabelog (shop member): RYU, izakaya and kamameshi, 谷安セジエムビル 1F, 1-2-3 曽根崎新地, Kita-ku, Osaka; 3 min from Kitashinchi Station; look for the large wall sign; Mon–Sat and the day before and after a holiday 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 18:00–22:00; closed Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 18 seats; a smoking area for heated tobacco only; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi; children and strollers welcome; opened 13 May 2024; seasonal small dishes and kamameshi; sake; a rich pudding; small-size kamameshi; a seasonal omakase course of seven items ¥8,000 (finishing with kamameshi or Awaji fresh pasta). Invoice registration: an individual, 松谷竜二郎. Reviews (May 2025–October 2026): weekday fresh-pasta lunch ¥1,200, large ¥100 extra; two daily choices; scallop and mentaiko cream; clam Genovese; beef tendon and komatsuna peperoncino; bacon and garlic-shoot tomato; chorizo and shishito tomato; green bean and shirasu basil cream; salad, cold soup and bread; Awaji Men-gyo fresh pasta; Saturday sometimes repeats Friday's menu; the kamameshi at night is good; reasonable for Kitashinchi; easy to visit alone; a red easel sign.

食べログ (店舗会員): SAKE NERD (サケナード)、居酒屋・創作料理・.en: Tabelog (shop member): SAKE NERD; izakaya, creative cuisine, sake bar; Saiwaicho 1-2-8 (Naniwa-ku), 82minatomachi 3F; 215 m from JR Namba Station; west side of Namba Hatch; weekdays and the days before and after holidays 17:00–24:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 15:00–24:00 (L.O. food 23:00, drinks 23:30); irregular closures (announced on Instagram); two-hour limit when busy at weekends; a course of five dishes and a glass of sake ¥3,100, seven dishes and a glass ¥4,000; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 29 seats (counter 17, large table 11); non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; English and Simplified Chinese menus; opened 1 July 2021; seasonal fish and vegetables from the central wholesale market; Kawachi duck from Matsubara; sake, shochu and fruit liqueurs from around Japan; a space walled in glass. Reviews (April–October 2026): Kawachi duck roast tataki ¥1,450; shrimp miso mayo ¥850; pork-belly chashu with soft-boiled egg ¥1,100; appetizer charge ¥450; truffle potato salad; grilled sea-urchin rice ball; choose your sake from the fridge; water served alongside; third floor with no elevator; some find it pricey.

食べログ (店舗会員): SEOUL90、韓国料理・居酒屋、大阪市中央区道頓堀1.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): SEOUL90, Korean, izakaya; 道頓堀だるまビル 2F, 1-6-8 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5–8 min walk from Namba Stn; daily 12:00–5:00 (L.O. 4:00); reservations accepted (two-hour limit Friday to Sunday evenings); dinner charge ¥390; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 60 seats; heated-tobacco smoking area; English and Korean menus; Korean-speaking staff; two-hour à la carte all-you-can-drink ¥1,490. Shop introduction (English translation): authentic Korean food and drink from afternoon to night; the Mukbang set (chicken, shrimp tempura, sotteok sotteok, cheese balls); pork bossam at lunch; Korean shochu; K-pop. Reviews (April–October 2026): soy- or spicy-marinated crab and shrimp bibimbap sets ¥1,580–1,680, soy-marinated salmon set ¥1,680, bossam set with cold noodles and yukhoe kimbap ¥5,368, tteokbokki, chicken, instant noodles, Chamisul and other soju, no draft beer, leftovers can be taken home, dark and loud, complaints of a missed order and cold staff, many young and Korean customers.

食べログ (店舗会員): SPIGOLA、港区六本木4-4-4 メゾン六本木1F.en: Tabelog (shop member): SPIGOLA, Roppongi 4-4-4, メゾン六本木 1F, 1 min walk from Roppongi Station exit 7 (Oedo line), 3 min from exit 4a (Hibiya line); Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–23:00, Sat 12:00–15:00 and 18:00–23:00; closed Sundays, holidays and over New Year; weekday lunch is a seasonal special until 30 November; dinner mainly an omakase of about ¥12,000, à la carte too; no service charge; 18 seats (counter 6, tables 8, terrace 4); private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted. Reviews (August 2024–June 2026): moved from Meguro, 10th anniversary in 2024; daily pasta ¥1,800, Genovese ¥2,200, with salad, Sayama black tea and dessert; karasumi pasta; at dinner, Yatsugatake vegetables, porcini, handmade pasta with sweetfish and uruka, homemade wild-boar prosciutto; sommelier Miura; dogs welcome; run by one person.

食べログ (店舗会員): SUGALABO V (スガラボヴィー)、フレンチ、大.en: Tabelog (corporate member): SUGALABO V (スガラボヴィー), French, Louis Vuitton Maison Osaka Midosuji 7F, Shinsaibashi-suji 2-8-16, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min on foot from Shinsaibashi Station; the entrance is separate from the Louis Vuitton store: a mirrored door on Yahata-suji, then the lift to 7F; Wed–Sun and holidays 17:00–23:00, closed Mon and Tue, some irregular closures; reservation only (some seats for Tabelog members; the person who booked must come; everyone starts together; latecomers or early leavers may miss part of the course; bookings may be declined for guests with many allergies); omakase course ¥50,000–70,000 (depending on the day's buying, tax included); service charge 10%; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 24 seats; semi-private seating; private hire for 20–50; non-smoking (smoking on the terrace); guests 12 and over have the same course as adults; smart casual recommended, no shorts or sandals; sommelier; opened 1 February 2020; the only Louis Vuitton collaboration restaurant in Japan; the cooking of 'SUGALABO', the innovative restaurant in Kamiyacho, Tokyo; furniture designed by Louis Vuitton. The Tabelog Award Bronze 2021–2026; French WEST Tabelog 100 in 2021, 2023 and 2025. Reviews (February 2024–October 2026): Menu V ¥55,000 and pairing ¥18,000 (May 2026); producers' names on the menu; ingredients shown and explained before each dish; SUGALABO curry to finish the savoury courses (regular or large); baked sweets to take home; once by introduction only, now booked through OMAKASE; chef Nagahama's last supper in February 2026; the food still delicious after the chef change (July and September 2026).

食べログ (店舗会員): SUSHIBAR 華美、居酒屋・寿司・ワインバー、大阪.en: Tabelog (shop member): SUSHIBAR Hanabi, izakaya, sushi and wine bar, 大深町3-1, 6F of Grand Front Osaka North Building (Umekita Floor), Kita-ku, Osaka; 1 min on foot from JR Osaka Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–23:00; reservations accepted; cards and e-money accepted, no QR; 17 seats (9 at the counter, 4 tables for two); over 200 shared seats on the floor; non-smoking (smoking rooms on each floor); authentic but playful sushi with wine; over 25 wines chosen by a sommelier; casual course of 7 dishes ¥3,500 (bluefin tuna and salmon sushi, two rolls, tempura, salt-grilled yellowtail collar, tofu ice cream), with all-you-can-drink ¥5,000; the day's grilled-fish course with all-you-can-drink ¥6,500; one of the Uoman group's restaurants (cfs-japan.com). Reviews (December 2025 – October 2026): ten pieces of sushi and miso soup ¥1,680; a set with mini udon or chawanmushi ¥1,980; seafood bowl with egg; lunch course (goma-pachi, squid with sea urchin, fried fugu, Saikyo-miso grilled sanma, sushi, red miso soup, chawanmushi, matcha ice cream); order from one piece; fried oysters; cold sake in wine glasses; one diner found the rice firm and the chawanmushi bland; quiet in the evening.

食べログ (店舗会員): SUZU CAFE 六本木、港区六本木3-10-1 相.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): SUZU CAFE Roppongi, Roppongi 3-10-1, 相鉄フレッサイン東京六本木 1F, 1 min from Roppongi Stn; daily 6:45–10:00 (breakfast), 11:00–22:00 (lunch 11:00–15:00, café 15:00–18:00, dinner 18:00–22:00); closed over New Year (breakfast still served); 68 seats; private room for 2–6 (¥2,200 for two hours); whole-venue hire for 30–80; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted. Antique sofas and chandeliers; the speciality is Dutch pancakes. Courses: lunch course ¥2,750; dinner steak course with all-you-can-drink ¥4,950; girls'-night plan ¥3,400. Reviews (September–October 2026): lunch comes with salad and drink bar; monthly fresh pasta ¥1,320, taco rice ¥1,320, hamburg steak ¥1,580, Healthy Plate ¥1,450, Dutch pancake ¥990, café latte ¥930; a retro pudding; QR ordering.

食べログ (店舗会員): Shangri-La's secret ROPPONG.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Shangri-La's secret ROPPONGI, Roppongi 4-11-11, 六本木GMビル 4F, 1 min from Roppongi Stn exit 7 (Oedo line); daily 12:00–15:00 and 18:00–23:00 (last entry 13:30 at weekday lunch, 21:30 at dinner); closed over New Year (29 December–4 January); one course per person; two-hour seating; no service charge; private-room fees (6 people ¥10,000, 8 ¥15,000, 14 ¥25,000); 42 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; cards, e-money and QR accepted; vegan and vegetarian options. A 'secret black soup' simmered from natural mushrooms; rare fresh mushrooms from across Japan; a Roppongi-only course of 16 mushrooms; a mala black soup too. Reviews (February 2025–November 2026): mushrooms from Yunnan; fried Yamabushitake skewer; 8–10 kinds of mushroom; Chinese tofu; shrimp dumplings; abalone; scallops; a choice of two meats; mushroom noodles; truffle egg rice; lunch course ¥7,480; dips of soy sauce, chili oil and sesame (shrimp-flavoured); fish sauce in the soy dip.

食べログ (店舗会員): Sudo、ピザ・イタリアン、中京区二条通麩屋町東入尾張.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sudo — pizza / Italian; Nijo-dori east of Fuyacho, Nakagyo-ku; 5 min on foot from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn; Tue–Sat and holidays 18:00–22:30, Sun 12:00–14:30 and 18:30–22:30; closed Monday (and some other days); reservation only; no vegan, vegetarian or gluten-free menu; service charge 5%; 9 counter seats; BYO allowed (corkage charged); school age and up; opened 10 November 2025; Italian cooking drawing on Japanese-cuisine experience; Italian-made pizza oven; about 100 wines; seasonal omakase ¥6,600, lunch ¥6,600, Christmas ¥11,000. Reviews (July–October 2026, English): bonito pizza, edamame genovese, chitarra, karasumi peperoncino, produced by etto, chef cooks alone, 2–3 hour course.

食べログ (店舗会員): TABLES CAFE、カフェ・パンケーキ・ケーキ、大.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): TABLES CAFE, café, pancakes and cakes, at the back of Cross Hotel Osaka 1F, Shinsaibashi-suji 2-5-15, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 minutes from Namba Station exit 14; daily 11:00–20:00 (L.O. food 19:00, drinks 19:30); open all year; reservations accepted; cards, transport IC, nanaco, iD, QUICPay, PayPay and Alipay accepted; 80 seats; a private room; whole-room hire up to 60; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; wheelchair accessible; menus in English, Chinese and Korean; TABLE plus S makes TABLES. Reviews (November 2025–October 2026): fluffy pancakes with cream cheese, bacon-egg-sausage pancakes the most popular, the Anno imo brûlée parfait, mille-feuille, pasta gratins, curry, gapao rice, chicken over rice, cakes, ordering by QR code, lunch sold out by 13:00 one day, the Horie TABLES closed at the end of July 2026, quiet inside the hotel.

食べログ (店舗会員): TERRACE & DINING ZERO、ビュッフェ.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): TERRACE & DINING ZERO, buffet; 3F Cross Hotel Osaka, 2-5-15 Shinsaibashi-suji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba Stn, 5 from Shinsaibashi Stn; Sat, Sun and holidays only, breakfast 7:00–10:30 (L.O. 10:00), lunch 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 13:30, buffet until 14:30); closed Monday to Friday; reservations accepted; allergy and seating requests cannot be met; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 128 seats; terrace; non-smoking (smoking room on the floor); wheelchair accessible; smart-casual dress code; opened 28 June 2019. Shop introduction (English translation): a calm room full of greenery; casual yet authentic dishes from selected ingredients; a wine-centred drink list; a seasonal lunch. Reviews (May–October 2026): choose a main or pasta, with starters and desserts from the buffet; salads in parfait glasses, soup curry, pizza, many desserts; coffee jelly with soft-serve; a drink bar with mixed juice; courses about ¥3,000–3,700; no time limit at lunch; doteyaki at the breakfast buffet; formerly open on Fridays too; one diner found ¥3,000 poor value; mostly women diners.

食べログ (店舗会員): THE BUTCHER、ハンバーガー・ステーキ・カフェ.en: Tabelog (shop member): THE BUTCHER, hamburgers, steak and café, Namba Sennichimae 10-13, スギモトビル 2F, right by Namba Station on every line, across from Namba Grand Kagetsu, daily 11:30–16:00 (last order 15:30) and 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:30), irregular closing days, no reservations, cards and PayPay, no service charge, 26 seats, non-smoking, takeaway, opened 12 May 2016, Hamburger Tabelog 100 2022, 2024 and 2026, a meat diner born from BURGERLION in Nishi-ku, protein burgers in lettuce instead of a bun, sister shops (Higobashi, Tamatsukuri, Sakai). Tabelog menu (read in English translation): burger ¥1,320, cheese ¥1,540, THE BUTCHER ¥2,585, protein burgers, vegetable burger ¥1,210, sides ¥550–¥825, steaks take 20–30 minutes. Reviews (August 2024–October 2026): charcoal-grilled patties, medium by default, salad and fries included, steep stairs, a queue at lunch, some days mostly Western customers.

食べログ (店舗会員): THE SUSHI りょうけん、港区六本木6-2-6.en: Tabelog (shop member): THE SUSHI Ryouken, Roppongi 6-2-6, GEMS六本木 B1F, 3 min walk from Roppongi Station; Mon–Sat, holidays and days before and after holidays 18:00–23:00 (two seatings, 18:00–20:00 and 20:30–22:30); Sun 17:00–23:00; 18 seats (counter 12, tables 6); private rooms for 4–6; non-smoking; cards accepted; a 10% service charge for overseas guests only, for multilingual service. Shop text: chef Yoko Kimoto (experience in Michelin-starred French cooking and abroad; domestic ingredients and less food waste; opened "IEN", then took up sushi). Courses: all-inclusive omakase with all-you-can-drink, 17 dishes, ¥14,190; also ¥10,890 and ¥12,890. Reviews (September–October 2026): opened December 2025; sushi rice mixed from red and rice vinegar in front of you; Sanriku wakame; monkfish-liver mousse; white peach, sweet shrimp and tomato somen; mussel and winter-melon saffron chawanmushi; ikura and apple rice bowl; uni-toro wrap (+¥2,000); English explanations; some say it aims at Instagram; complaints about the floor staff.

食べログ (店舗会員): TOLAH UMEDA、イタリアン・ダイニングバー・パ.en: Tabelog (shop member): TOLAH UMEDA, Italian, dining bar and pasta, Stage Nakadori Building 4F, 7-22 堂山町, Kita-ku, Osaka; 8 min on foot from the Umeda stations, 6 min from Nakazakicho Station; Mon–Fri 12:00–23:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closing days not fixed; reservations accepted; seats cannot be chosen; 20 or more by phone; no luggage storage; dinner seat-only bookings ¥400 (plus tax) for the starter; cards, transport IC cards and PayPay accepted; 45 seats (tables, counter, terrace); private rooms with sofas; 40 seated or 60 standing; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; vegetarian options; particular about vegetables; opened 22 September 2021; a resort-like space; seasonal dishes; standard plan ¥3,300; nine dishes with two hours of drinks ¥4,000; premium with ten starters and wine in the free-flow ¥5,000; message plates. Invoice registration: TOLAH Co., Ltd. (same address as the shop). Reviews (August–October 2026): starter platter; all-you-can-eat freshly baked focaccia; lunch with a choice of three pastas ¥1,870; ten starters (pumpkin in mustard, vegetable frittata, prosciutto, salmon carpaccio, sweet-potato salad, caprese, mortadella, marinated eggplant, mimolette and potato salad); wagyu and cheese meat pasta; fries with whipped butter; grilled young chicken with lemon butter sauce; gelato; porcini cream pasta; tuna and anchovy pasta; thin margherita; mushroom ajillo; cheese platter; birthday parties in the private room; big portions and cheap; comments that food is slow when busy; one comment that dessert came ten minutes before the end.

食べログ (店舗会員): TORIBAKA PREMIUM 六本木店、港区六本木.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): TORIBAKA PREMIUM Roppongi, Roppongi 5-1-10, カドガンビル B1F, 3 min from Roppongi Stn exit 3; Mon–Sat 17:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); closed Sundays, holidays and over New Year; ¥300 cover; 16 seats (8 at the counter, two tables of 4); smoking area for heated tobacco only; cards, e-money and QR accepted; English menu; reopened June 2026; oden in two broths, a rich chicken broth (Toripaitan) and a light dashi with usukuchi soy sauce; Miyazaki young chicken as chicken tempura (Toriten) and grilled dishes; whole-shop hire for up to 14 from about ¥100,000. Reviews (November 2025–September 2026): Toripaitan oden of tomato, avocado and French bread; daikon, seasoned egg, thick fried tofu, konnyaku; liver, wings; original sours; said to be linked to Esthe Pro Labo; a manager who was a magician; in February, one diner found it salty and the service curt.

食べログ (店舗会員): The WAREHOUSE、ダイニングバー・サラダ・ハ.en: Tabelog (shop member): The WAREHOUSE, dining bar, salad and hamburger, 2-1-31 Dojimahama, Kita-ku, Osaka; 3 min from Nishi-Umeda Station; 4 min from Higobashi Station; 5 min from Kitashinchi Station; 2 min from Watanabebashi Station; daily 7:00–11:00 (last order 10:30), 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00), 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); reservations accepted; service charge 10%, no cover; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 100 seats, 160 standing; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi; children and strollers welcome; live music; opened 28 June 2021; the hotel restaurant of Aloft Osaka Dojima (Marriott Bonvoy); a social scene for music lovers; lunch salad bar ¥1,600, with dessert ¥2,100, with a welcome drink ¥2,200; afternoon tea; craft burgers at night; a gluten-free menu is offered, but gluten-containing dishes are made in the same kitchen, contamination is possible, and it is not recommended for people with coeliac disease or severe allergies. Reviews (September–October 2026): salad bar ¥1,600 weekdays and ¥1,800 weekends for two hours; seasonal vegetables; fruit; over ten side dishes; bread; soup; detox drinks; coffee; roasted Brussels sprouts; cucumber and wakame; zucchini with plum; mango pudding; tacos; cheeseburger; kakuni burger; chicken curry at lunch; many staff from overseas; strong air conditioning; a comment that the plates were hot.

食べログ (店舗会員): To、居酒屋・創作料理、中京区御池高田町500 ポポラ.en: Tabelog (shop member): To — izakaya / creative; 1F, Nakagyo-ku; 3 min on foot from Karasuma-Oike Stn exit 1; Mon, Wed, Thu, Sun 8:00–12:30 and 17:00–23:00; Tue 8:00–12:30; Fri–Sat 8:00–12:30 and 17:00–24:00 (open on Tuesday holidays); 12 seats (single-plank counter of 8, tables); halal options; opened 14 January 2020; second shop of the popular Karasuma-Oike Italian fudo; starter of Kyoto duck liver pâté sandwiched in grilled yatsuhashi; Marsala pork kakuni; duck gyoza; fruit shira-ae; salsiccia mapo tofu; natto-mousse rice; natural wines; sake from small breweries. Reviews (August–October 2026, English): brioche crostini breakfast, fig and prosciutto, soft-boiled egg and ham, fried hamo, monaka, booking needed.

食べログ (店舗会員): Tsuchi、カフェ・スイーツ・コーヒースタンド、大阪.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Tsuchi, café, sweets and coffee stand, Hotel Royal Classic Osaka 1F, Namba 4-3-3, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 minute from Osaka-Namba Station; daily 9:00–17:00 (L.O. food 16:00, drinks 16:30); closed irregularly; reservations accepted (tables only, one food and one drink per person, no seat-only or drinks-only bookings, nine or more by phone); cards, transport IC, iD, QUICPay and PayPay accepted; 36 seats and 30 on the terrace; non-smoking; farm to table; Australian café culture; specialty coffee; vegetable-heavy brunch plates; homemade French toast; seasonal sweets. Reviews (August–October 2026): chicken plate with mushroom and tapenade cream sauce, avocado open sandwich, peach French toast, fig and salmon French toasts, peach parfait and smoothie, fig and hojicha parfait, fig mille-feuille, acai bowl, affogato, soy latte, ordering and paying by QR code, a 90-minute limit, many overseas customers.

食べログ (店舗会員): Washoku バル かめすけ、居酒屋、日本料理、創作.en: Tabelog (shop member): Washoku Bar Kamesuke; izakaya, Japanese cuisine, creative cuisine; 芳町ビル B1F, Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 1-5-5; 1 min from Ningyocho Station exit A6; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–23:00, Sat 17:30–22:00 (open if booked by the day before); closed Sundays and holidays; 12 seats; cards accepted; no e-money or QR; non-smoking; opened 4 October 2021; "Uniku" of wagyu ribeye; sake chosen by the owner; weekday lunch; courses with all-you-can-drink ¥6,500 and ¥7,500, food only ¥4,800. Menu (November 2025): monkfish liver with ponzu ¥880, persimmon and prosciutto shiraae ¥880, oyster ohitashi ¥880, burdock karaage ¥780, rare yellowtail cutlet ¥1,480, wagyu and sea urchin roll ¥2,200. Reviews (August 2025–October 2026): run single-handed; seasonal dishes; French-style plating; flavours gentle on the body; weekday lunch is a fish, meat or vegetable set with various small sides, ¥1,400 from 5 October 2026; lunch full before noon; a small lantern on the stairs down to the basement; sake by the glass or the gō.

食べログ (店舗会員): YAKITORI DINER THE HICKORY.en: Tabelog (shop member): YAKITORI DINER THE HICKORY BIRD Umeda ten, yakitori and izakaya, 1-8 万歳町, Kita-ku, Osaka; near Nakazakicho Station; Mon–Sat, holidays and the day before and after a holiday 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Sundays; cover ¥498; cards, QUICPay and PayPay accepted; 20 seats; semi-private rooms; a mezzanine for one group; non-smoking; English menu; photo menu; Southern American cuisine meets charcoal yakitori; Kyoto red chicken with original Cajun spices; American BBQ sauce; cornbread; Basque cheesecake; gins from around the world; a Western-film saloon interior; 14 dishes ¥4,500; 17 dishes ¥5,500; 14 dishes with two hours of 35 drinks ¥6,700. Reviews (August–October 2026): Cajun chicken; heart; rare cuts that sell out; grilled vegetables; chicken with blue cheese; tamago-kake-gohan in a teacup; a friendly owner; a narrow counter; a comment that staff put plates on the board after asking guests to keep it clear; online booking.

食べログ (店舗会員): YAKITORI 燃 es、港区六本木7-13-10.en: Tabelog (shop member): YAKITORI Moe es, Roppongi 7-13-10, 宮下ビル 1F, 3 min walk from Roppongi Station; Mon–Sat 18:00–23:00; closed Sundays; irregular holidays; 10% service charge; 16 seats (counter 12, private room for 4); non-smoking; no children; sommelier; reservations through OMAKASE only; opened 15 June 2021; The Tabelog Award Bronze 2025 and 2026; Tabelog yakitori 100 in 2022–2025. Shop text: chef Daisuke Numano (born 1981 in Tokyo; started at a yakitori shop in Tamachi; learned heat control at a referral-only French restaurant; ran the grill at "YAKITORI燃WEST" in Nishiazabu from 2014; restarted in Roppongi as "YAKITORI燃es" in 2022); liver rested in foil; ramen in a consommé of chicken bones and breast with homemade egg noodles. Reviews (June–October 2026): Himekko jidori from Ehime; courses ¥7,700, ¥8,000 and ¥15,000; chicken rillettes; beet soup; tsukune; nyumen and pudding; Japanese wines; book 2–3 weeks ahead; one says the founder is Toshiaki Abe.

食べログ (店舗会員): a la mode osaka、カフェ・スイーツ・バー.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): a la mode osaka, café, sweets, bar; B1F, 4-5 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Namba and Nippombashi Stns; daily 15:00–24:00; may close early when sweets sell out; open year-round; reservations accepted; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 24 seats; private rooms for 2–6; terrace; heated-tobacco smoking area; opened 16 July 2022. Shop introduction (English translation): a night café open until midnight; what it calls Japan's first 'Midnight Tea'; sweets handmade by a female pastry chef; a photogenic room; suited to oshi-katsu. Reviews (September 2024–February 2026): a neon sign; a turquoise and pink room; a proper bar; petit macarons; iced Ceylon tea; a fondant chocolate celebration plate; the reservation-only oshi-katsu plate course (your colour and message on the plate); cookie tins in nine colours; custom cakes; parfaits; strawberry milk; Mont Blanc; chocolate gâteau; shochu with hot water; light meals; QR-code ordering; one drink per person; seats fill with bookings; one diner found service slow; mostly women.

食べログ (店舗会員): absinthe org. Salad & Grill.en: Tabelog (shop member): absinthe org. Salad & Grill, dining bar and bistro, 梅田3-2-2, B1F of KITTE Osaka, Kita-ku, Osaka; directly connected to JR Osaka Station, 2 min on foot from Nishi-Umeda Station; daily 8:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed on the building's closing days; reservations accepted; lunch 90 minutes, dinner 2 hours; 18:00–21:00 one drink and one food item each; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 45 seats; non-smoking (use the building's smoking area); breakfast; allergy information shown; vegan and vegetarian options; menu in English, Chinese and Korean; English-speaking staff; takeaway; opened 31 July 2024; Mediterranean food with wine and cocktails; courses with two hours of all-you-can-drink ¥5,500, ¥7,500 and ¥8,000; a special bouillabaisse. Invoice registration: Cafe ABSINTHE Co., Ltd. (Kitahorie). Reviews (July–October 2026): breakfast plates; falafel salad (regular ¥1,100, three falafel fried after ordering, hummus, pickles, a spicy tahini dressing); falafel sandwich in pita; grilled-chicken lunch ¥1,500; vegan plate; vegan lunch with a chickpea dip; beef kebab; apple pie of a whole apple (the same as Absinthe Cafe in Yotsubashi); berry shaved ice ¥1,100; absinthe cocktails; international-student staff; order on a smartphone at night.

食べログ (店舗会員): cafe Mode、カフェ・イタリアン・ステーキ、大阪.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): cafe Mode, café, Italian, steak; 中澤唐木ビル 3F, 1-14-26 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Yotsubashi Stn exit 6; facing Horie Park; Tue–Sun and holidays 11:30–22:00 (food L.O. 21:30; also given as 11:00–22:00, to 23:30 for parties); lunch sets all day; closed Mondays (open on holidays); reservations accepted (mention allergies or dislikes when booking); no alcohol for drivers; private hire up to 120; cards accepted, no e-money or QR. Reviews (March–September 2026): a bright white room; big windows onto the park's greenery and cherry blossoms; order and pay first; avocado toast; French toast; pear cake; a gluten-free caramel pear tart; mille-feuille; birthday plates; an evening healthy set (pork shabu-shabu or simmered flounder); Kobe beef steak assiette set; filler-free hamburg; beef stew; Hayashi rice; pasta of the day; cold pasta; wine; dogs allowed inside; nearby parking ¥300 an hour.

食べログ (店舗会員): cafe brasserie ludique (カフェ.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): cafe brasserie ludique (カフェ ブラッスリー ルディック), Higashi-Ueno 4-15-7, 5 min on foot from Ueno and Inaricho stations; Tue–Fri 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:00) and 17:00–23:00, Sat 15:00–23:00; closed Sun, Mon and holidays; the listing also says dinner will be open every day from June; lunch cannot be booked; 1F standing counter for 5, 2F tables for 20; no table charge; non-smoking; cards and PayPay accepted; children welcome; takeout at dinner; opened 16 May 2023; sister restaurant of the hidden French gem Ludique in Asakusa; the signature is a duck bistro hamburg steak. Reviews (May 2024–October 2026): a master from the Asakusa restaurant; appetizer platter (pâté, ratatouille, liver mousse, ham, white-bean salad); truffle omelette; clams steamed in white wine; roast pork; venison and chicken hamburg steaks; creamy meat pasta; escargot; arancini; gratin; pizza; courses with all-you-can-drink at ¥4,000 and ¥6,000; one cook, so service is slow; weekday lunch roast pork ¥1,200 (free refills of rice, salad, quiche and more); mini dessert ¥300; one couple found the upstairs cramped and the food slow (October 2026).

食べログ (店舗会員): cafe&dinner encontre、カフェ・イタ.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): cafe&dinner encontre, café, Italian and bar, Modern Shinsaibashi Building 1F, Minami-Senba 4-12-24, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 minutes from Shinsaibashi and Yotsubashi stations; Tue–Sat and the days before and after holidays 11:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00), Mon, Sun and holidays 11:00–18:00 (L.O. 17:30); closed New Year's Day; reservations accepted (phone 10:00–21:00); cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 50 seats; separate smoking area; vegetarian options shown. Homemade pizza and pasta, all-you-can-drink courses, specialty coffee, the weekday-evening Primo set ¥2,800. Reviews (April–October 2026): herb-grilled domestic chicken plate, taco rice, bulgogi plate, quinoa and steamed-chicken salad bowl, whole-peach tart ¥1,200, grape tart, pudding, French toast, Basque cheesecake, full soon after opening at lunch, one burnt cheesecake, some say lunch service was inexperienced.

食べログ (店舗会員): capi、イノベーティブ、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-10.en: Tabelog (shop member): capi, innovative, 曽根崎新地1-10-2, 6F of the Kitashinchi PLACE building, Kita-ku, Osaka; 5 min on foot from Kitashinchi Station on the JR Tozai Line; two seatings Mon–Sat (starting 18:00 and 20:45, arrive ten minutes early); closed Sundays, holidays and some other days; reservation only; 10% service charge; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; non-smoking; a Michelin star four years in a row from 2022 (Kyoto and Osaka); innovative Italian by the owner-chef; world wines chosen by the sommelier, with pairings; seasonal omakase course ¥26,000; course with black-wagyu chateaubriand ¥31,000; with a cheesecake to take home ¥30,950; Tabelog Innovative 100, 2025. Reviews (May 2025 – August 2026): opened 2021; a chef from Ponte Vecchio; brioche (leftovers to take home); caviar with cauliflower and squid; horse mackerel and okra tart; bresaola; abalone, mozzarella and junsai; managatsuo; Kamo eggplant with summer truffle; Kyoto Nanatani duck; Bakuretsu Seafood (crab risotto); Shimonita onion with oyster; sea urchin and turnip; milt and cabbage pasta; about ¥50,000 with pairing; a birthday plate; Basque cheesecake to take away; sweetfish pasta; crab paella; some found the service casual.

食べログ (店舗会員): coucou!、東上野3-25-2 鈴木ビル 1F、上.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): coucou!, Higashi-Ueno 3-25-2, Suzuki Building 1F, 5 min on foot from Ueno and Inaricho stations; Tue–Fri 15:00–23:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 13:00–22:00; closed Mondays and irregular days (announced on Instagram and Facebook); 9 seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; ¥500 table charge; opened 6 January 2024; an owner-sommelier with long experience in French cooking chooses wines from France and around the world (mainly Burgundy, natural wines too); popular dishes carried over from an earlier French restaurant. Menu (January 2026): carrot râpé ¥600, stuffed tomato ¥1,050, lily bulb and silken tofu ¥650, mushroom soufflé omelette ¥1,200, beef cheek braised in red wine ¥1,900, Earl Grey crème brûlée ¥800 and more. Reviews (December 2025–October 2026): the owner runs it alone, so food takes time; no tea; wines suggested to match the food; Shine Muscat grapes as the starter; tomato stuffed with crab salad; chicken-liver mousse (cocoa) ¥1,050; glasses of wine ¥1,300 and ¥1,700; choose a bottle in the cellar (about ¥10,000); carrot râpé made with white carrots; venison banh mi.

食べログ (店舗会員): hanako 北堀江、そば・魚介・居酒屋、大阪市西区北.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): hanako Kitahorie, soba, seafood and izakaya, Kita-Horie 1-11-10, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 2 minutes from Yotsubashi Station; daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed New Year's Day; no reservations at lunch; cards, transport IC, iD and PayPay accepted; 22 seats (4 counter, 18 table); non-smoking; opened 1 October 2020. Soba of domestic buckwheat flour with Tanba black beans, fresh fish and sake; omakase courses of 8 dishes ¥5,500 and 7 dishes ¥4,500; Omi duck hot pot course ¥5,500. Reviews (July–November 2026): lunch set A of tempura zaru soba with jako and mentaiko clay-pot rice ¥1,200; large black-bean zaru soba 240 g ¥1,300; tororo ¥300; soba pudding ¥300; 100% buckwheat +¥300; yuzu-salt dipping soba, duck tsukune dipping soba, oyster dipping soba; clay-pot rice of sea bream, sawara or ayu (for two or more); soba-yu and black-bean tea; full at lunch.

食べログ (店舗会員): hubble、イタリアン・バル・居酒屋、大阪市中央区西.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): hubble, Italian, bar, izakaya; Crice Nikko 4F, 2-10-2 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Shinsaibashi Stn; daily 11:30–23:30 (food L.O. 22:00; lunch 11:30–15:00, café and dinner 15:00–23:30); irregular holidays; reservations accepted (courses 100% on the day, 50% the day before; no-show table bookings ¥4,000 a head); cards, e-money and QR accepted; 60 seats (about 50 sofa, 40 terrace); semi-private rooms ¥700 a head; smoking allowed; wheelchair accessible; opened 15 January 2022. Shop introduction (English translation): wagyu and handmade Italian; all-you-can-drink draft beer; private hire for 40–50; shisha; rooftop-terrace barbecue; a sister of Safari Shinsaibashi. Reviews (July 2025–July 2026): a multicultural café; taco rice; pizza; fries; spinach cream pasta; oyster and spinach cream pasta; prosciutto; apricot juice; a lawned rooftop terrace; a dog came along; a cooling system on summer nights; all-you-can-drink barbecue; complaints of salty food and slow drinks with few staff; some dislike the shisha smell.

食べログ (店舗会員): il luogo di TAKEUCHI、イタリアン・.en: Tabelog (shop member): il luogo di TAKEUCHI, Italian, meat dishes and pasta, MF Nishi-Umeda Building 1F, 5-1-26 Fukushima, Fukushima-ku, Osaka; JR Fukushima, Shin-Fukushima, Hanshin Fukushima, Nishi-Umeda and Watanabebashi stations; Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 18:00–22:30 (last order food 21:00, drinks 22:00); closed Sundays; also closed 9, 16 and 30 November; lunch reservations for four or more, by phone only; for dinner, a course is recommended for four or more; tell the restaurant about allergies in advance; lunch is cash only; dinner cover (coperto) ¥500; cards and PayPay accepted; 16 seats (counter 6, tables 10); a private room for about 8; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; sommelier; opened 7 May 2010; Tabelog Italian WEST 100 in 2021; in the Michelin Guide Kansai since 2014; sister shop ricuperare TAKEUCHI (Higobashi). takeuchi-italia.jp: owner-chef Keiji Takeuchi, born 1977, from Okayama Prefecture; office work, then culinary school; eight years of training at well-known Osaka restaurants including Trattoria Pino and PONTE VECCHIO (main shop); also in Italy; opened in Fukushima in 2010; the shops are il luogo di TAKEUCHI, TORERO TAKEUCHI and ricuperare TAKEUCHI. Reviews (June–October 2026): pasta lunch ¥1,100 (with bread, salad and soup); ¥1,700 with dessert and a drink; a queue before opening; course ¥7,700; mackerel with figs; charcoal-roasted red meat; lamb; pasta after the main; portions small to large; panna cotta espuma; the chef sees guests off.

食べログ (店舗会員): mane、イタリアン・イノベーティブ、中京区山本町44.en: Tabelog (shop member): mane — Italian / innovative; 440-1, Nakagyo-ku; 7 min on foot from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn; Tue–Sun 12:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Monday (open some Mondays); reservation only; no vegetarian or vegan; a seafood-only course possible; fish and wheat allergies cannot be handled; water (free-flow) ¥880 per person; 16 seats (12 counter, 1 table); children welcome; English menu; smart casual; opened 23 April 2024; lunch omakase ¥8,360, with black wagyu ¥10,560, chef's special ¥14,960. Reviews (January–October 2026, English): moved from Matsuiyamate, Kyotanabe (about 8 years); måne means moon; trained at Yonemura and Il Ghiottone; selected by Michelin; dinner ¥17,160; pairing ¥7,700; tiramisu.

食べログ (店舗会員): orange、港区赤坂9-7-1 東京ミッドタウン プ.en: Tabelog (shop member): orange, Akasaka 9-7-1, Tokyo Midtown Plaza 1F, 1 min walk from Roppongi Station exit 7 (Oedo line), 3 min from exit 8 (Hibiya line); Sun–Thu 11:00–23:00, Fri–Sat 11:00–2:00 next day; irregular holidays; 10% service charge after 22:00 (except courses); 130 seats (counter, sofas, terrace); private rooms for 4–8; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; vegetarian options. Shop text: a menu unbound by country or genre; weekday happy hour; French fries with black truffle. Share course with 2 hours of drinks ¥7,500. Reviews (October 2026): hamburger lunch ¥1,950; a ¥2,500 lunch set; a lunch with free-flow wine ¥6,000; pasta; gratin; low-temperature salmon; heaters on the terrace.

食べログ (店舗会員): tres、イタリアン・ダイニングバー・居酒屋、大阪市中.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): tres, Italian, dining bar, izakaya; アクロスビル 6F, 2-6-14 Shinsaibashi-suji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Stn exit 4-B, 5 from Namba Stn exit 14; Mon 17:00–5:00, Tue–Sun and holidays 12:00–5:00 (food L.O. 4:00, drinks L.O. 4:30); open year-round (from 17:00 on Mondays and the third Thursday); reservations accepted; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 100 seats (sofa seats for 12, couple seats, curtained semi-private rooms, a karaoke room, a VIP room for 20); separate smoking area; wheelchair accessible; opened 14 September 2013. Shop introduction (English translation): creative Italian with seasonal ingredients; candlelit private rooms; wagyu steak; the Burn Away cake; all-you-can-eat cheese of 20 kinds; tres Italian course with two hours of drinks ¥5,000 (appetizers, Caesar salad, wagyu sirloin-cap and top-sirloin steak). Reviews (December 2025–September 2026): fried white fish, beef-tendon garlic pilaf, a rich risotto, carbonara, vongole bianco, prosciutto bruschetta, avocado salad, meat sushi, all-you-can-eat ham and salami, birthday plates, a champagne tower, a DVD and sparkler show; one diner found the cake's cream melted; small portions and sold-out items; balloon decorations missed; less atmosphere by day.

食べログ (店舗会員): vegecafe＋α、カフェ・野菜料理・ジェラート、大.en: Tabelog (shop member): Vege Cafe + α; cafe, vegetable dishes, gelato; 6-9-20 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, ground floor; 7 minutes on foot from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; Tue–Sat 9:00–17:00, lunch 11:00–14:00 (until sold out); closed Sunday, Monday and holidays; reservations accepted; 90-minute limit at busy times; cards and e-money accepted; no service charge; 49 seats; smoking only on the terrace; pets on the terrace only; children welcome; Wi-Fi; English menu. The shop's introduction: organic vegetables grown on the rooftop; a gelato shop since July 2020; gelato suitable for vegans and people with allergies; prized three years running at a world gelato competition. Reviews (December 2025 to October 2026): prosciutto, lettuce and cheese sandwich on a Kiryu-yeast whole-grain roll ¥900; coffee set (+¥400); three natural-yeast breads ¥640; a vegan soup-curry plate (free of the 28 specified allergens, gluten-free) with rice-flour bread; Kago Gozen ¥1,350; fried horse mackerel with mustard tartar; Basque cheesecake; rice-flour cookie; a coffee float from the takeaway window; organic apple balsamic and mascarpone gelato.

食べログ (店舗会員): ↑↑↓↓←→←→BABA (Uramen)、居酒屋・焼.en: Tabelog (shop member): ↑↑↓↓←→←→BABA (Uramen), izakaya, yakitori, seafood; Nakagawa Building B1F, Yotsuya 1-8; 2 min walk from Yotsuya Station; Mon–Fri 15:00–24:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–24:00 (last orders food 23:00, drinks 23:30); 16 seats; smoking allowed; cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 27 October 2025; the theme is 'longevity and prosperity'; four signatures: Gozo Roppu ¥1,628, dashi-maki omelette ¥968, meat shumai ¥528, three-kind fresh fish ¥858; chicken nanban ¥979, nagaimo sansho fries ¥583, oyster mapo tofu ¥1,078; courses with 2 hours of drinks ¥5,000–6,000. Reviews (May–October 2026): an unsigned basement, a sister of Balkan upstairs, a pink door, chicken nanban with shibazuke tartar, sweet Kyushu sashimi soy sauce, happy hour until 18:00, message plates, about ¥4,000 per person.

食べログ (店舗会員): あっちち本舗 道頓堀店、たこ焼き・居酒屋・お好み焼き、.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Acchichi Honpo Dotonbori, takoyaki, izakaya and okonomiyaki, Souemoncho 7-19, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 10 minutes from Nippombashi Station; Sun–Fri and holidays 9:00 to 2:00 the next morning, Sat and the day before holidays 9:00 to 3:00; reservations accepted (seats not guaranteed, reservations get priority); no cards, e-money or QR; 40 seats (12 counter, 28 table, 12 terrace); non-smoking; children welcome; head east from the Glico sign at Ebisubashi, by Ichiran at the foot of the bridge; its commitments: an iron plate that takes skill instead of copper, a thin crisp outside and a soft inside, fresh, never-frozen octopus from the central market, dashi and a sauce made in its own factory in Higashi-Osaka; the most popular is soy-sauce mayo with free green onion. Reviews (August–October 2026): 8 pieces ¥800, one review counting 9, sauce-mayo, salt, ponzu, a takoyaki and drink set ¥1,200, meal tickets at the register, self-service, a cool eat-in room below, free soft drinks for preschool children, a queue in the evening, cash only, many overseas customers.

食べログ (店舗会員): あばらや、寿司・居酒屋・海鮮、難波千日前2-14、Na.en: Tabelog (shop member): Abara Ya, sushi, izakaya and seafood, Namba Sennichimae 2-14, 5 min on foot from Namba and Nihonbashi stations, Mon–Sat 16:00–23:00 (last order 22:30), closed Sundays and public holidays, reservations accepted (required for four or more; phone for private rooms), cards accepted, no e-money or QR, no table charge, 40 seats, tatami private rooms (8, 12, 20 people), non-smoking, particular about fish, sake and shochu. Reviews (July–October 2026): in a back alley east of Namba Grand Kagetsu, the famous saba sushi (battera), eaten without soy sauce, ten pieces even as a half, also to take away, ¥4,400 course (appetizers, four sashimi, chawanmushi, simmered fish, tempura, saba sushi), all-you-can-drink as an add-on, simmered sea-bream head, matsutake dobin-mushi, tekka maki, a regular on a 45th visit, three floors, said to date from 1955.

食べログ (店舗会員): うどん 花きり、うどん、西区南堀江1-22-18 ナイ.en: Tabelog (shop member): Udon Hanakiri, udon, Minami-Horie 1-22-18, Nishi-ku, ナイロンビル 1F, 350 m from Yotsubashi Station exit 5, 300 m from Nishi-Ohashi Station exit 4, daily 11:00–15:45 (last order 15:15) and 17:00–22:30 (last order 22:00), closed over the New Year, reservations accepted, cards and e-money, 83 seats (13 at the counter, 38 at tables, 32 on tatami), horigotatsu, non-smoking, children and strollers welcome, kids' menu, opened 1 May 2021 (also a note that it would open in June after the state of emergency). Reviews (March–October 2026): firm Sanuki-style noodles, up to 1.5 servings free, kakiage sudachi udon with soy sauce poured over, kakiage udon, cold udon with burdock tempura, chicken-tempura curry udon, beef-tendon curry udon, duck and chicken paitan udon, lunch until 14:00 with a choice of takikomi or mentaiko rice, ¥1,100–¥1,400, daily specials, tablet ordering, kushiage and oden too, a view that the curry lacked depth.

食べログ (店舗会員): えびな亭、イタリアン、パスタ、日本橋人形町3-12-1.en: Tabelog (shop member): Ebina Tei; Italian, pasta; スカイコート日本橋人形町第2 B1F, Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 3-12-1; 0 min from Ningyocho Station exit A4; Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri and Sat 11:30–14:30 and 17:30–23:00, Thu 17:30–23:00; closed Sunday; ¥550; 20 seats; cards (VISA, Master); PayPay; non-smoking; children welcome. Reviews (August–October 2026; photo captions read "a rice bowl full of vegetables and meat" and "complimentary coffee"): the owner is from Aomori; Aomori seafood, vegetables and meat; lunch pasta set ¥1,600; karasumi pasta; "Roma meshi" with Towada beef belly ¥1,500; cod milt and gorgonzola gratin; sea bream and karasumi peperoncino; charcoal-grilled pork or duck with grilled vegetables (half portions available); always busy, so book.

食べログ (店舗会員): おでんと、アジフライ。 バルチカ03、居酒屋・おでん、.en: Tabelog (shop member): Oden to Ajifurai, Barchika 03, izakaya and oden, 梅田3-2-123, 5F of Innogate Osaka, Kita-ku, Osaka; directly connected to the west exit of JR Osaka Station; Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30); Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–23:00, daytime drinking at weekends; reservations accepted (parties of three or fewer may be asked to move to the counter); cards, e-money and QR accepted; 20 seats (a counter of 12, a counter table of 8); non-smoking; opened 31 July 2024; oden in a golden Kansai-style dashi; thick fried horse mackerel from Sakai Port (Tottori); pop illustrations and neon; the main shop is the Honmachi main shop. Reviews (June–October 2026): fried horse mackerel ¥780 (June) and ¥380 (September); full and half portions; tartar, mentaiko tartar, salt and lemon, ponzu; fish-bone crackers; oden assortment ¥1,720; daikon, potato, beef tendon, soft-boiled egg, konnyaku, thick fried tofu, burdock tempura, sesame tofu, a pouch of condiments; beef dote-ni in miso ¥680; edamame starter; a wide range of shochu; ¥14,300 for four; full at 16:30 on a Sunday; many women among the customers.

食べログ (店舗会員): おでんとお蕎麦居酒屋 じんべえ 難波店、居酒屋・おでん.en: Tabelog (shop member): Oden to Osoba Izakaya Jinbee Namba branch; izakaya, oden, soba; Namba Sennichimae 1-8; 5 minutes' walk from Namba Station; Mon–Fri 17:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00), Sat 12:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00), Sun 12:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); irregular closures; appetizer charge ¥330; reservations; course cancellations by the day before; two hours when busy; a ten-dish course with 90-minute all-you-can-drink ¥5,000; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 69 seats (first floor counter round the oden pot and tables, second floor tatami and tables, up to 40); non-smoking (ashtray outside); takeaway; sashimi direct from its own wholesaler Uoya Ebizo; homemade fish-cake oden in Osaka dashi; soba to finish; rare Miyazaki shochu. Reviews (August–November 2026): oden (daikon, chikuwa, ganmodoki, thick fried tofu, egg, chicken wings, chicken skin, mochi); gyoza in oden broth; five-kind sashimi; katsuo tataki; chicken nanban; seseri with grilled negi; homemade red yuzu-pepper tempura; dashi-wari; shochu with soba-yu; mori soba; hanamaki soba; meat soba; QR ordering; happy hour; some find the soy flavor strong.

食べログ (店舗会員): おでんとメシ はなみ堂 (旧店名 魚匠)、上野7-2-.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Oden to Meshi Hanamidou (former name 魚匠), Ueno 7-2-5, ニューウエノ 2F-D, 1 min on foot from the JR Ueno Station central gate toward the Asakusa exit; Mon–Fri and the day before a holiday 16:00–23:30, Sat, Sun and holidays 14:00–23:30, irregular closing days; the oden starter is all-you-can-eat for ¥500; a special blended dashi made under the supervision of a long-established dashi wholesaler and a dashi sommelier; the ingredients are daikon, egg, konnyaku, hanpen, shirataki, shumai, fish cakes and chikuwa; à la carte all-you-can-drink (about 100 kinds) ¥1,078 with a coupon (draft beer +¥500, two dishes to be ordered, a ¥500 charge (in the English translation, "container fee"), +¥500 on Fri, Sat and the day before a holiday); 7-dish courses with all-you-can-drink ¥4,400 and ¥4,950; 129 seats; private rooms for 2 to over 30; sunken kotatsu; private hire up to 100; smoking area for heated tobacco only; cards and PayPay; children welcome; menus in English, Chinese and Korean; DAZN and horse-racing broadcasts; opened 15 October 2023. Reviews (May–October 2026): close to Ueno Station; calm in the private rooms; the oden is gently flavoured and soaked in dashi; daikon; grilled mackerel and carpaccio, yakitori, kara-age, fried oysters, a skewer platter, sashimi, agedashi tofu, fries, dashi-maki tamago; some diners come back many times; one said cigarettes could be smoked at the table (July 2026).

食べログ (店舗会員): おでんやden、おでん、四谷1-8 中川ビルB1F、J.en: Tabelog (shop member): Odenya den, oden, Nakagawa Building B1F, Yotsuya 1-8; 2 min walk from Yotsuya Station (JR, Namboku Line), 3 min from the Marunouchi Line; Mon–Fri 18:00–23:00; closed Sat, Sun and holidays, over New Year and 1–31 August; reservations taken; no otoshi charge; 15 seats (counter); smoking allowed; cards, e-money and QR accepted; takeaway; opened 24 February 1992; menu (updated 2010): daikon, chikuwabu, egg, konnyaku and others ¥200, beef tendon ¥400, pieces put in the pot after ordering (10–15 min), beef tongue ¥900. Reviews (November 2025–September 2026): U-shaped counter, gentle dashi, beef tongue, cherry tomatoes, Camembert, fried mochi, oysters, whelk, yuba, lemon ramen, okonomiyaki, ginger and mustard sauces, two cooks, hard to book, a wide sake list, the toilet on the third floor, ¥500 added to one bill.

食べログ (店舗会員): おでん料理 地酒 大阪・北新地 六根、おでん・日本料理.en: Tabelog (shop member): Oden Ryori Jizake Osaka Kitashinchi Rokken, oden, Japanese cuisine and izakaya, 1-6-24 曽根崎新地, Kita-ku, Osaka; 3 min on foot from JR Kitashinchi Station; Mon–Sat 17:00–24:00 (last order 22:30); closed Sundays; reservations accepted; completely non-smoking (e-cigarettes included); service charge ¥550 and starter ¥550 (courses include tax and service); cards and QR accepted, no e-money; 30 seats (a counter of 8 at the oden pot on the ground floor, five private rooms upstairs); children welcome; vegetarian options; a dashi of Hokkaido kombu with bonito and sardines in a golden ratio; seasonal vegetables and seafood; handmade fish cakes; Kyoto-style oden; local sake from across Japan; Rokken oden course with six oden ¥7,000; seasonal special course with seasonal sashimi ¥8,000. Invoice registration: Japan Foods Corporation Co., Ltd. (万歳町). Reviews (July–October 2026): oden served one bowl at a time; daikon with grated yam and bonito flakes; thick fried tofu; beef tendon; chikuwa; spicy konnyaku; rolled cabbage; local chicken; hanpen; a small dish such as mizuna salad first; to finish, 'kitsune', udon inside fried tofu; wasabi sorbet or fruit sorbet; Mutsu Hassen sake ¥1,800; business dinners and family meals in the upstairs private rooms; kind staff.

食べログ (店舗会員): おどりや 西中島店、居酒屋・海鮮・鍋、大阪市淀川区西中.en: Tabelog (shop member): Odoriya Nishinakajima ten; izakaya, seafood, hot pot; 5-7-19 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, ground floor; 5 minutes on foot from Shin-Osaka Station and Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; Mon–Sat 17:00–24:00 (food last order 23:00, drinks 23:30); open on holidays and the day before; closed Sunday; open from 5 January; reservations accepted; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 46 seats; semi-private seating; tatami and sunken seating; whole hire for 20–50; non-smoking. The shop's introduction: fresh fish bought every morning at the central market; five-kind sashimi platter (¥748 a head, ordered by almost 100%); hamo suki nabe; "Odoriya Course" ¥6,500, "Ichiba no Utage Course" ¥5,300 (tax included). Reviews (November 2025 to October 2026): the Odoriya five-kind sashimi platter; hot pot (shrimp, clams, sea bream, soft roe); a seafood maki roll to finish; grilled local fish; kara-age; fries; tsukune with raw egg; cheese tsukune; chanja with cream cheese; grilled lotus root; squid tempura; roast duck; iburi-gakko; turban shell baked in the shell; dried stingray fin; shrimp tempura; chicken nanban; about six sakes; a lemon sour with adjustable sourness; nigiri ¥250 a piece; edamame; cold cha soba; Taiwanese menchi katsu; a course changed for dietary restrictions; a homey atmosphere.

食べログ (店舗会員): おばんざい KURUMI、居酒屋・日本料理、大阪市北区.en: Tabelog (shop member): Obanzai KURUMI, izakaya and Japanese cuisine, 曽根崎新地1-5-8, 3F of the ピアースエイトビル, Kita-ku, Osaka; 5 min on foot from Kitashinchi Station; Mon–Fri 17:30–24:00 (last order food 23:00, drinks 23:30); closed Saturdays, Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 15 seats (9 at the counter, a semi-private room of 6); smoking allowed; takeaway; opened 24 March 2022; daily obanzai of seasonal ingredients; light courses and à la carte; potato salad and soy-marinated red shrimp; whiskies and wines from Japan and abroad; a hideaway of warm wood; KURUMI course of grilled fish, six obanzai and a choice of meat ¥6,050; five-kind obanzai bento ¥1,300 (same-day orders and delivery). Reviews (February–October 2026): over 20 obanzai; young sweetfish nanban; 'adult' potato salad; small wagyu hamburg; yodare chicken; spicy glass noodles; homemade beef jerky; fried young burdock; mozzarella ravioli; curry to finish; conger-eel nanban; braised beef tendon; goya champuru; tsukune simmered with winter melon; Saikyo-grilled black cod; homemade shumai; seafood gratin; simmered quail eggs; marinated conger eel; seven or eight sakes; full from 18:00 to 20:00, later is a good time to try; a young owner and female staff; a regular on a 36th visit; one diner found it about 20% dearer than expected.

食べログ (店舗会員): お出汁で食べる串かつと釜めしの専門店 ぎん庵 心斎橋、.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Odashi de Taberu Kushikatsu to Kamameshi no Senmonten Gin An Shinsaibashi, kushi-age, kamameshi and izakaya, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-9-13, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 30 m south of Crysta Nagahori south exit 5; 3 minutes from Nagahoribashi Station; Sun–Fri 17:00–23:30, Sat 16:30–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); reservations accepted; check that the booking is for the Shinsaibashi shop; two-hour limit when busy; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 28 seats (8 counter, 20 table); non-smoking (smoking space outside); menus in English, Chinese and Korean; opened 19 December 2017. Kushikatsu eaten with dashi, and kamameshi; Tenshi no Ebi, kuroge wagyu sirloin, Hokkaido scallops; 12-skewer course ¥4,500, ladies' course ¥4,500, special course ¥6,500. Reviews (March–October 2026): walk-ins often turned away; omakase of about 20 skewers that you can stop at any point; staff recommend dashi, salt or sauce; kamameshi of chicken, sea bream, eel, firefly squid, salmon with ikura or sanma, finished as ochazuke with dashi; 10 skewers, kamameshi and a drink about ¥5,100. Sister shops in Namba and Kyobashi too (gurunavi).

食べログ (店舗会員): お好み たまちゃん viva、お好み焼き・鉄板焼き・韓.en: Tabelog (shop member): Okonomi Tamachan Viva, okonomiyaki, teppanyaki and Korean food, Kitahorie 2-3-10, Nishi-ku, TSUJI Building 1F, 5 min on foot from Yotsubashi Station exit 4 or Nishi-Ohashi Station exit 3, daily 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30), no regular closing day, reservations accepted, cards and PayPay, 44 seats (4 at the counter, tables, 3 terrace tables where smoking and pets are allowed), non-smoking inside, private hire for 20–50, children and strollers welcome, takeaway, sommelier, opened 2 May 2012, Okonomiyaki Tabelog 100 2024 and 2025. Tabelog menu (posted by the shop, read in English translation): okonomiyaki from ¥935, Tamachan Deluxe ¥1,650, Fujita Special ¥2,310, yam and mentaiko fluffy bake with no wheat flour ¥1,210, yakisoba from ¥968, omusoba ¥1,760, horumon yaki ¥1,100, homemade steamed pork ¥308 a slice, kimchi ¥880, namul ¥770, sets from ¥6,600, grilled bread with ice cream ¥660, okonomiyaki take about 20 minutes to cook. TableCheck (LUCUA Osaka branch): began in 2008 as a small 7-tsubo shop in Horie; the omoni flavours of Tamachan's mother. Reviews (May–October 2026): the main branch, steamed pork wrapped in perilla leaves with kimchi and spicy miso, bossam, horumon, tonpei-yaki, Fujita Special, omusoba, terrace seats, celebrity signatures, booked through Tabelog even for one, cut into six pieces for a party of five.

食べログ (店舗会員): お好み焼き なお家 なんば店、お好み焼き・居酒屋・鉄板.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Okonomiyaki Naoya Nanba, okonomiyaki, izakaya, teppanyaki; 安本ビル, 1-8-18 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba and Kintetsu Nippombashi Stns; Mon–Fri and days around holidays 17:00–24:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–24:00; closing days may vary; reservations accepted (cancelled after 15 minutes; two-hour limit when busy); cards (including UnionPay), iD, QUICPay and PayPay accepted; 73 seats; non-smoking; opened 22 March 2025. Shop introduction (English translation): the third Okonomiyaki Naoya shop; authentic okonomiyaki by an owner who looked up to a grandfather who was a comedian; a fluffy batter, crisp with tenkasu, with care over the cabbage's origin and cut; the signature curry yakisoba. Reviews (May–October 2026): staff cook for you; pork mixed into the batter; tenkasu spread over the top; cheesy pork okonomiyaki; sweet yakisoba; negiyaki with ginger and soy sauce; tonpei-yaki; the Osaka set (okonomiyaki, yakisoba, negiyaki, tonpei-yaki); about ¥7,000 for three; raw egg on the curry yakisoba; the Awaza shop; one drink and one dish each; okonomiyaki can take a while.

食べログ (店舗会員): お好み焼き 門、お好み焼き・鉄板焼き・居酒屋、難波3-.en: Tabelog (shop member): Okonomiyaki Mon; okonomiyaki, teppanyaki, izakaya; Namba 3-1-33, 南中山ビル 3F; 5 minutes' walk from Namba Station; behind Bic Camera, next to Jiyuken in Sennichimae; Tue–Sun and holidays 18:00–23:00; generally closed Mondays; lunch sometimes suspended when busy; same-day bookings welcome; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; no service or table charge; 35 seats (counter 14, tables 21); semi-private rooms (2–6); smoking allowed; free Wi-Fi; power outlets; pets allowed; vegetarian options; opened 15 December 2015; a long-established shop frequented by celebrities. Reviews (August 2025–September 2026): butatama; mixed okonomiyaki with fried egg; Hiroshima-style; yam in the batter; beef-tendon negiyaki ¥1,350; pork and squid yakisoba ¥990; dashimaki ¥550; grilled squid; tonpei-yaki; kimchi; kara-age; potato salad; shochu-coffee highball; signed photos on the walls; dogs welcome; no griddle at the counter; some find the batter a little heavy.

食べログ (店舗会員): お好み焼き・鉄板焼 ぼんくら家 道頓堀店、お好み焼き・.en: Tabelog (shop member): Okonomiyaki Teppanyaki Bonkuraya Dotonbori branch; okonomiyaki, teppanyaki, izakaya; Dotonbori 1-5-9, 2F; 3 minutes' walk from Namba Walk exit B22; Mon 17:00–23:30, Tue–Sat 11:30–23:30 (L.O. 23:00), Sun 11:30–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); irregular closures; reservations; one drink per person; no service or table charge; cards and PayPay accepted; 87 seats; private hire for 50–87; non-smoking; takeaway; Uber Eats; the famous 'fluffy and melty' okonomiyaki; featured in the media, visited by celebrities and comedians; the Bonkuraya course of six dishes with 120-minute all-you-can-drink ¥4,500; courses with 90-minute all-you-can-drink from ¥3,500; a No. 1 popular dish with mentaiko mayo; authentic steak teppanyaki. Reviews (August–October 2026): Bonkura-yaki; Kasune-gi Mix-yaki; Mixed Bon-chan-yaki in the Akashi-yaki style; tonpei-yaki; pork okonomiyaki; pork yakisoba; beef-tendon sobameshi; Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki; horumon; up a narrow staircase to the second floor; a two-hour limit on Saturdays; friendly staff from overseas; some call the okonomiyaki ordinary.

食べログ (店舗会員): お好み焼だん、お好み焼き、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-3-.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Okonomiyaki Dan, okonomiyaki, 喜八ビル 3F, Shinsaibashi-suji 2-3-12, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 5 min walk from Namba Station, 8 min from Shinsaibashi Station, Mon–Sat 17:00–4:00 the next morning (last order 3:30), holidays 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:30), closed Sunday, reservations accepted, cards accepted, no e-money or QR, 23 seats, no private rooms, non-smoking, takeout and delivery, Okonomiyaki 100 2025. Reviews (August–October 2026): pork okonomiyaki ¥950 (¥400 more for a double), squid and pork okonomiyaki ¥1,250, mixed ¥1,550, mixed with scallops ¥2,100, pork modern-yaki and beef and egg modern-yaki ¥1,350 each, mixed yakisoba ¥1,550, yakisoba omelet ¥1,070, soy-flavoured Western-style grilled squid ¥1,070, salt-grilled squid ¥560, half chicken grilled with salt ¥700, soft drinks ¥250, the texture of the cabbage, a fluffy batter, a hint of dashi, a sweetish sauce, a teppan right in front of you, a roomy counter, some days fully booked, open until 4 a.m., popular with local drinkers, beware of street touts.

食べログ (店舗会員): お料理 夏雲、居酒屋・海鮮、大阪市北区芝田1-6-11.en: Tabelog (shop member): Oryori Nagumo, izakaya and seafood, 芝田1-6-11, 2F, Kita-ku, Osaka; 1 min on foot from Hankyu Osaka-Umeda Station, about 5 min from JR Osaka Station; daily 16:30–23:00 (last order 22:00); closing days not fixed; reservations through the Instagram booking form (24 hours); seat-only bookings pay a ¥400 starter (before tax), share and pair courses a ¥300 seat charge (before tax); no children; bags in a basket at the table; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 20 seats; three private rooms (up to 12); tatami; non-smoking; opened 7 August 2025; fresh Osaka seafood and seasonal produce from around Japan; selected sake, shochu and wine; share course ¥3,300 (three or more); pair course ¥4,180 (two); course with two hours of drinks including four sakes and ten shochu ¥6,000; easily confused with the sister shop 'Nagumo Higashidoori Main Store'; under the Hankyu Umeda tracks. Reviews (March–August 2026): shio-koji fried chicken; seasonal fruit (peach) and white sesame salad ¥900; fried eggplant in dashi ¥650; three-kind sashimi ¥1,100; toro-taku ¥900; shio-koji fried chicken (4 pieces) ¥850; sea-bream rice ¥1,450 (bonito flakes and egg ¥250); eel kamameshi ¥1,450; strawberry and Earl Grey tofu salad; bonito tataki; thick-cut sashimi; whitebait as the starter; no draft beer; a standing bar on the ground floor, tatami and private rooms upstairs; train noise; a hard-to-find entrance; often fully booked; another shop in Nakazakicho.

食べログ (店舗会員): かき氷・スイーツ・甘味処、下京区和泉屋町162 ノーノ.en: Tabelog (staff-maintained): kakigori, sweets, Japanese-sweets café; 下京区和泉屋町162 ノーノーイエス京都店; 5 min on foot from Gion-Shijo Stn (Keihan) exit 1 and Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Hankyu) exit 1B; Wed–Sun 13:00–20:30 (last order 20:00); closed Monday and Tuesday; seasonal opening from 29 April to 30 September 2026; reservations accepted; at least one item per person; shared tables; 14 places (two tables for four, 6 standing); non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; English and photo menus; children and strollers welcome; opened 15 May 2024. Shop text: fluffy kakigori of pure ice made from natural ice, a view of the Kamo River, four drinks and seasonal drinks with homemade syrups. Reviews (August 2025–September 2026, in English): kakigori about ¥2,000, peach and pink grapefruit, Kyoto sweet potato (Beni Haruka), tomato, cheese and basil, a leather coaster as a gift, at the back of a leather goods shop, yudofu ¥1,000 (February 2026).

食べログ (店舗会員): かっちゃん、上野6-12-13、JR上野駅不忍口から徒.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Kacchan, Ueno 6-12-13, 2 min on foot from the JR Ueno Station Shinobazu exit, under the elevated tracks between Ueno and Okachimachi, the sixth shop from Ueno Station (UNIQLO side); daily 11:00–21:45 (L.O. 21:30); open all year; no reservations; standing, about 20 people; non-smoking (smoking outside); cash only; opened 31 March 2010. Reviews (April–October 2026): ¥1,300 senbero with four dice — a sour is one die, a beer two; a freshly fried tempura assortment (shrimp, potato, pumpkin, eggplant, lotus root, carrot) or an oden set; 60-minute limit; one said ¥1,400; conger-eel tempura; a bite-size curry; the daily special was an oden assortment; highballs; ISAINA with soda; shikuwasa sour; ponzu sour; sake Mio; drinks on the light side; staff and neighbours lively and friendly.

食べログ (店舗会員): かっぽう庵 江上、日本料理・海鮮・寿司、大阪市北区堂島.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kappouan Egami, Japanese cuisine, seafood and sushi, Dojima Town Building 1F, 1-3-22 Dojimahama, Kita-ku, Osaka; 4 min from Oebashi and Kitashinchi stations; 5 min from Watanabebashi Station; Mon–Fri 18:00–22:30 (last order 22:00); Sat 18:00–22:30 (reservation only); closed Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; ¥500 a head; VISA only, no e-money or QR; 16 seats (counter of 8, private room for 8); smoking allowed; kaiseki of seasonal fresh fish and vegetables; sushi from a chef with sushi-craftsman experience; sake from many regions and domestic whisky highballs; business-dinner course of ten dishes ¥13,200; ultimate course of ten dishes ¥15,400; A5-grade beef sukiyaki hotpot course ¥15,400. Official site egami.cc. Reviews (October 2024–June 2026): lunch ended on 8 August 2025; the special nine-item lunch gozen ¥1,100–1,200 (grilled fish, two sashimi, fried dishes, meat, dashimaki, potato salad, obanzai, rice refills, yuzu sorbet); no entry without a booking; red-vinegar sushi; noresore; a small ayu dish; a shrimp cutlet burger; an izakaya-like counter and a ryotei-like private room; large portions; semi-private room.

食べログ (店舗会員): かに・ふぐ専門 蟹吉WEST なんば道頓堀、かに・ふぐ.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Kaniyoshi WEST, crab and fugu specialist, Nanba doutonbori; crab, fugu, Japanese cuisine; 2-4-5 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Namba Stn exit 25; daily 12:00–27:00 (food L.O. 25:00); open year-round; on weekday lunchtimes the sister shop 蟹吉PREMIUM, 30 seconds' walk away, is open; three shops in Namba, and a booking may be guided to another; reservations accepted; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 70 seats; one private room per floor; sunken seating; smoking allowed at all seats; opened 21 August 2013; snow crab from the Sea of Okhotsk; crab and fugu grilled on a shichirin in front of you. Courses: snow crab ¥12,100, snow crab and fugu ¥13,750, three great crabs ¥24,200, fugu ¥15,400, live fugu with milt ¥11,000, all-you-can-drink with fin sake and crab sake ¥2,750. Reviews (March–November 2026): crab sashimi, a dip of egg yolk and crab miso, sake poured into the crab shell, rice porridge, grilled milt, a fugu tank in front of the shop, private rooms with windows on the sightseeing boats, a lunch king crab and snow crab course ¥17,050; two diners say the crab was frozen; one found the crab tempura disappointing; in season, sometimes only slots after 20:30.

食べログ (店舗会員): かもふく、居酒屋・そば・鍋、大阪市中央区難波1-1-1.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Kamofuku, izakaya, soba and hot pot, エチゲンビル 1F–2F, Namba 1-1-18, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 minutes from Namba Station; head north through the arcade beside Round One in Sennichimae, and it is midway along the alley on the north side of Hozenji Yokocho, on the left; Tue–Sun 11:30–23:00, Mon 17:00–23:00 (reservations only), L.O. 22:00; reservations accepted (call even if online shows full); two people at the counter, three or more in a private room; no charge for hot pot or courses; tell the shop about dislikes or allergies in advance; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 52 seats; private rooms (2–20 people); non-smoking; Kyoto duck shipped direct from Kyoto; Kyoto duck hot pot, grilled shabu-shabu and sukiyaki; handmade soba; duck zosui; Kyoto duck hot pot course ¥6,710; courses with free drinks ¥7,500. Reviews (February–October 2026): grilled shabu-shabu of Kujo green onion and duck with ponzu or homemade sesame sauce, staff show you how to grill, duck tataki, duck prosciutto, duck chawanmushi, duck skewers, soba, zosui or thick somen to finish, lunch oyakodon, bukkake soba, a duck roast box with mini soba, courses only on Mondays, sake chosen by the owner, the 2nd floor shared with the okonomiyaki shop next door.

食べログ (店舗会員): きう、寿司・創作料理、下京区神明町230-2 2F、烏.en: Tabelog (corporate member): Kiu, sushi and creative, 下京区神明町230-2 2F, 5–6 min from Karasuma Stn; first sitting from 17:00 and second from 20:15 (each a private booking for 5–6); irregular closing days; mainly by referral, with new slots on Tabelog a few times a year; more than 15 minutes late counts as a cancellation; changes count as cancellations with a fee; please avoid perfume; 5 seats; cards accepted; service charge 10%; opened 3 July 2020; The Tabelog Award Silver 2022, 2023, 2025, 2026 and Bronze 2024; Sushi WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2022, 2025. Reviews (July–November 2026, in English): rice seasoned with white balsamic vinegar, Matsutake fried in crushed kaki no tane, hamo shabu-shabu, hairy crab with sea urchin and ginkgo, nodoguro, a rich sake list, a bright, characterful chef.

食べログ (店舗会員): きたしんち 弓場慎之佑、日本料理、大阪市北区曽根崎新地.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kitashinchi Yumiba Shinnosuke, Japanese cuisine, 曽根崎新地1-5-21, 7F of 松木興産ビル, Kita-ku, Osaka; 30 seconds on foot from exit 11-21 of Kitashinchi Station on the JR Tozai Line; Mon–Sat two seatings, from 18:00 and from 20:30; closed Sundays and holidays; reservation only; the person who booked must come; arriving late or leaving early may mean fewer dishes; whole-shop hire for 10–12 (children welcome); 10% service included in the course price; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 12 seats at a U-shaped counter; non-smoking; no perfume; menu in English, Chinese and Korean; Japanese food that does not tire you out to the last bite; the temperature of the dishes and the aroma of the ingredients; a ten-dish omakase of seasonal ingredients ¥19,360. Reviews (October 2023 – October 2026): in 2023 the chef and the chef's wife ran it together; trained at Ogurano and independent in 2021; in the thirties; selected by Michelin; a ¥16,000 course comes to just under ¥20,000 with tax and service; eggplant with sea urchin; Numajima eel and matsutake in a bowl; fried sweetfish with its liver and house Worcestershire sauce; charcoal-grilled eel with fig; braised Ozaki beef; Handa somen with abalone and sea urchin; Awaji sea bass and hamo; Miyagi bonito and Akashi sea bream; agu pork and Kawachi duck dumpling hotpot; blackthroat seaperch rice and corn rice; mango and passion-fruit pudding; bear meat; sake chosen by the owner; bento to order.

食べログ (店舗会員): ぎおん 阪川、日本料理、東山区祇園町南側570-199.en: Tabelog (corporate member): Gion Sakagawa, Japanese cuisine, 東山区祇園町南側570-199, 6 min from Gion-Shijo Stn exit 7; Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00 (entry 17:00–20:30); closed Sunday; 21 seats (a counter of 9, private rooms on both floors); seats where you can lower your legs; no word after 15 minutes counts as a cancellation; please avoid perfume; ask by phone about wanted ingredients such as crab or abalone; cards accepted; The Tabelog Award Bronze 2019–2026; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025.
