Reviews (October 2025 – September 2026, in English): à la carte as well as courses, market prices, a ¥22,000 course, hamo, turtle, Wakasa gurnard, many regulars, opened in the Heisei era.

食べログ (店舗会員): くらのあかり 人形町本店、居酒屋、牛タン、日本酒バー、.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kura no Akari, Ningyocho main shop; izakaya, beef tongue, sake bar; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-7-11; 1 min from Ningyocho Station exit A3; Mon–Fri and the day before a holiday 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00, Sat 17:00–22:00; closed Sundays and holidays; appetizer charge ¥550 (not for course bookings); 80 seats; private rooms; whole floors for hire; non-smoking (outdoor smoking area); vegan and vegetarian options listed; website kuranoakari.owst.jp. Menu (updated October 2026): aged extra-thick beef tongue grilled over charcoal (salt or miso) ¥2,695, beef tongue sashimi ¥1,078, beef tongue stew simmered 8 hours ¥1,078, Sanriku raw oysters ¥429, sashimi bought by the head chef at Tsukiji every morning, nearly 30 years since founding, courses ¥6,000–10,000 (2 hours all-you-can-drink). Reviews (October 2025–July 2026): three floors; newly renovated; smoked, grilled and stewed beef tongue; fried horse mackerel; clay-pot rice with anago and wasabi greens; weekday lunch is a ¥1,000 set with self-service, free refills of barley rice, miso soup and salad; one diner was sent here from a sister restaurant.

食べログ (店舗会員): ぐう、ラーメン・お好み焼き、大阪市天王寺区寺田町2-1.en: Tabelog (corporate member): Gu; ramen and okonomiyaki; 2-1-12 Teradacho, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 5 min west along Route 25 from the north exit of JR Loop Line Teradacho Station; Mon and Wed–Sat 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–21:30, Sun 18:00–21:30, closed Tuesday; reservations accepted; no cards or e-money; 20 seats (tables of 6 and 4, three raised-floor tables of 4); non-smoking; sake, shochu, wine; moved here from 2-5-7 Daido, Tennoji-ku. Reviews (April 2025–May 2026): ramen at lunch, Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki, side dishes and drinks at night, ramen at night too; shoyu, miso and shio; shoyu and miso come hearty (thick curly noodles, 200 g), the others with medium-thin noodles, 130 g; shoyu chashu ¥900, shio chashu ¥900 (September 2025); hearty shoyu chashu with egg ¥980 (April 2025); plenty of egg and green onion; extra noodles come with chashu too; free kimchi at lunch, rice and kimchi ¥200, rice dishes ¥380; hiyashi chuka; Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki with pork ¥870; ika-ten; homemade chashu (small) ¥500; macaroni salad ¥380; cheese spring rolls; stingray fin; large bottled beer ¥700; teppan dishes; pork-bone aroma and a sharp soy sauce; some liken the taste to the Akira style, some call it light; chewy thick noodles; plenty of chashu; okonomiyaki with lots of cabbage and crisp noodles; a very friendly couple runs the shop; many regulars; some say Saturday is dinner only, others give 16:30–21:30 on weekends and holidays; one says pay after eating, with cashless payment accepted.

食べログ (店舗会員): さかなのじんべえ なんば店、居酒屋・海鮮、千日前2-6.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sakana no Jinbee Namba branch; izakaya, seafood; Sennichimae 2-6-6; 2 minutes' walk from Kintetsu Nippombashi Station, 3 minutes from Nippombashi Station; Mon–Fri 15:00–23:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00 (L.O. food 22:00, drinks 22:30); irregular closures; reservations; an eight-dish course with 90-minute all-you-can-drink ¥5,000; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 100 seats (20 at the counter); counter on the first floor, tables on the second, tatami on the third; non-smoking; takeaway; opened 21 June 2019; fresh fish direct from the group's own wholesaler Uoya Ebizo; grilled squid; kushikatsu; Neapolitan pizza and pasta from the sister restaurant Allegro next door. Reviews (April–October 2026): a five-kind sashimi platter; grilled squid with mayonnaise and sweet-spicy sauce; kushikatsu; seafood gratin; dashimaki; chicken nanban; crab salad spaghetti; a weekday senbero of three drinks and a dish for ¥1,000; smartphone ordering; some praise the freshness and prices, others found the service curt or disliked how they were seated.

食べログ (店舗会員): しゃにむに 心斎橋本店 (SHANIMUNI)、居酒屋.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): SHANIMUNI Shinsaibashi main shop, izakaya, yakitori and eel, 五興ビル 1F, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-3-19, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 minutes from Nagahoribashi Station exit 7, 5 minutes from Shinsaibashi Station exit 6; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00, Mon–Sat and holidays 17:30–22:00 (L.O. food 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed Sunday, plus irregular days; same-day reservations accepted; confirm counter or private room; tell the shop about allergies or dislikes in advance; two-hour limit when busy; no preschool children; cancel two days ahead; appetiser ¥770 and 10% service; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 30 seats (9 counter, 4 private rooms); smoking only in private rooms, none at lunch; slowly grilled over carefully chosen binchotan; seasonal ingredients from around Japan; basic course ¥9,900, special kaiseki 'Kotobuki' ¥12,100, seasonal kaiseki 'Roku'. Reviews (February 2025–October 2026): sashimi, charcoal skewers, harami skewers, eel, sirloin cap, octopus simmered with daikon, potato salad, soft-roe tempura, temari sushi, oyakodon, wasanbon pudding, a ¥1,800 grilled-meat set at weekday lunch, a box of harami and kalbi on rice, rooibos tea instead of water, sunken private rooms behind the counter, a thoughtful, lovely owner.

食べログ (店舗会員): すし 礫、寿司・日本料理・海鮮、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sushi Sazara, sushi, Japanese cuisine and seafood, 日宝ラフォーレ北新地 2F, 1-6-4 曽根崎新地, Kita-ku, Osaka; 4 min on foot from Kitashinchi Station; Mon–Sat 18:00–23:00; closed Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; overseas guests must give a reachable phone number, email address, hotel name and hotel phone number; cards and QUICPay accepted, no QR; 8 seats; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; a space inspired by a tea room; sushi of selected ingredients from across Japan at just the right temperature; small dishes; over 15 sakes; sommelier-chosen wines; omakase course only, 18 items ¥17,600 (from August 2025). Invoice registration: an individual, 山本広孝. Reviews (January 2025–August 2026): a regular since before the chef went independent; a head chef with a Japanese-cuisine background; perfectly steamed abalone; grilled nodoguro; sake in a wine glass; red-vinegar rice; crab and abalone; matsutake and sea bream soup; anago; spinach and turnip soup; botan shrimp; marinated mackerel; grilled horse mackerel; abalone with liver sauce; Nara pickles; karasumi mochi; milt; Matsuba crab chawanmushi; swordtip squid; Spanish mackerel; saikyo-grilled fish; many foreign guests too; a comment that the nigiri seasonings were inconsistent; a quiet, careful head chef; a cheerful owner.

食べログ (店舗会員): すし匠 (Sushi Sho Yotsuya)、寿司、.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sushi Sho (Sushi Sho Yotsuya), sushi; 陽臨堂ビル 1F, Yotsuya 1-11; 4 min walk from Yotsuya Station; Mon, Wed, Fri 11:30–13:30 and 18:00–22:30, Tue, Thu, Sat 18:00–22:30; closed Sundays, Mondays that are holidays, Golden Week and New Year; reservations for the following month open on the 1st of each month; 14 seats (11 at the counter, 3 in a private tatami room); non-smoking; cards accepted (not at lunch); children welcome; Tabelog Award Bronze 2017, Silver 2018–2020 and 2026, Sushi TOKYO Tabelog 100 2021, 2022 and 2025. Reviews (March 2025–October 2026): small dishes and nigiri served in turn, about 28 items in 90 minutes, rice with red and white vinegar, extra ankimo with Nara pickles, ohagi, toro-taku, two kinds of uni, ¥40,000–60,000 per person, next booking a year to eighteen months ahead, booked through TableCheck and Omakase, chef Katsumata leaving Yotsuya, the third generation taking over from November according to one diner.

食べログ (店舗会員): すし堤、寿司・海鮮・居酒屋、Kumamoto の食材を.en: Tabelog (corporate member): Sushi Tsutsumi; sushi, seafood, izakaya; sushi using Kumamoto ingredients; 月虎51番館 3F, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 2-5-31, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min on foot from Nagahoribashi Station (Sakaisuji Line) and 5 min from Shinsaibashi Station (Midosuji Line); daily 18:00–2:00; closing days not fixed; reservations accepted (changes and cancellations by phone); tell the shop ahead if bringing children; cards accepted; no e-money or QR; 7 counter seats; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; opened 5 October 2022. Reviews (June 2024 to October 2026): an omakase built mainly on fish from Kumamoto and Amakusa by a chef from Kumamoto; ¥22,000 (August 2026); about two hours; à la carte also available; a hinoki counter and earthen walls; chilled chawanmushi (king crab; Kumamoto red eggplant); ayu confit; monkfish liver with Nara-zuke; three kinds of gari (napa cabbage, lotus root, ginger); Amakusa sea bream; marinated tuna; toro; three-year-aged toro; kohada; aori squid with sea urchin; kuruma shrimp; horse-meat nigiri with a slightly sweet soy sauce; anago; red miso soup; pudding-like tamago; sake chosen by the chef, who holds a sake diploma; one review says the chef came from a Michelin three-star restaurant; the chef alone in June 2024; sushi available late at night.

食べログ (店舗会員): すし居酒屋 しんご、居酒屋・寿司・海鮮、大阪市中央区東.en: Tabelog (corporate member): Sushi Izakaya Shingo; izakaya, sushi, seafood; Tamayacho Galaxy Bldg No. 3 1F, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 2-4-19, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min (300 m) from Nagahoribashi Station Exit 7; Mon–Sat and holidays 17:30–23:30 (L.O. food 23:00, drinks 23:15); closed Sunday; closing time may change with stock; reservations accepted; cards accepted; no e-money or QR; 16 seats (8 at the counter, one table for 8); private hire possible; smoking allowed; particular about fish and sake. Reviews (January 2022 to April 2026): opened 22 June 2021; the owner is Koji (not Shingo); reservations by DM on Instagram @sushi_shingo; a young chef who runs the place alone; looks unfriendly at first but is a good person; a quiet, samurai-like chef; small sign, hard to find; seafood bukkake sushi ¥1,280, shirako ponzu ¥900, wagyu yukhoe ¥1,380, raw shrimp ¥350, draft beer ¥550 (December 2023); potato salad with tobiko and smoked daikon; mentaiko tempura; drinkable chawanmushi; wagyu sukiyaki roll; seafood yukhoe; butter-grilled eel; anago; seared scallop; tuna topped with uni; toro-taku; an 8-dish course (September 2025); in winter a reservation-only hot pot of oysters, shirako and monkfish liver in yuzu miso (gout hot pot); on a Friday in September 2025 the place was full and some were turned away; only one table.

食べログ (店舗会員): すし柿﨑、寿司、日本橋人形町2-8-11 友高ビル 1.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sushi Kakizaki; sushi; 友高ビル 1F, Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-8-11; Mon–Sat 17:30–22:00; closed Sundays and holidays; cards accepted; no e-money or QR; 8 seats (counter); private hire up to 20; non-smoking; English menu; opened 3 February 2008; domestic wild bluefin from Toyosu (otoro, chutoro, akami); a tasting of bafun and murasaki uni; junmai sake for sushi; a hideaway with plaster walls; hospitality from the head chef and the owner; nigiri-only course ¥19,800, omakase ¥24,200, special course ¥26,400 (book 3 days ahead); website sushi-kakizaki.com. Reviews (August–October 2026; photo captions read "uni tasting", "akami", "chutoro", "otoro"): blue noren; L-shaped counter; soft simmered octopus; corn tofu; raw oysters with jalapeño Tabasco; three tunas and two uni; clam soup; scallop tamagoyaki; shari seasoned only with rice vinegar and salt; a story that the owner was once head of a hotel's sushi counter.

食べログ (店舗会員): すし秀 其ノ弐、寿司・魚介・日本酒バー、四谷三栄町12.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sushi Hide Sono Ni, sushi, seafood, sake bar; 竹田ビル 1F, Yotsuya Sanei-cho 12-4; 7 min walk from JR Yotsuya Station, 5 min from Akebonobashi, 6 min from Yotsuya-sanchome; Mon–Fri 11:30–13:30 and 17:30–22:30, Sat 17:30–22:30; closed Sundays and holidays; 15 seats; private room (4); tatami and sunken seating; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards, PayPay and Rakuten Pay accepted; Sushi Hide, 23 years in Yotsuya, renewed in November 2018; two omakase courses at dinner; courses ¥16,500, ¥19,800 and ¥25,000. Reviews (August 2023–July 2026): many appetizers and fewer nigiri, house shiokara, steamed abalone with whale bacon, Shimane donchicchi horse mackerel, young ayu, lunch of bara chirashi or nigiri ¥3,500, sake and wine, many apprentices, filming of the drama Ousama ni Sasagu Kusuriyubi.

食べログ (店舗会員): そば居酒屋るちん、居酒屋・そば・うなぎ、大阪市中央区東.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Soba Izakaya Ruchin, izakaya, soba and eel, B1F, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-13-23, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 minutes from Shinsaibashi Station, 5 minutes from Nagahoribashi Station; daily 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); reservations accepted (2–28 people); two-hour limit when busy; appetiser ¥550; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 40 seats; basement non-smoking, 2nd floor smoking allowed; English menu; opened 1 August 2011; official site rutin.co.jp. Stone-ground 80% and 100% buckwheat soba, creative soba dishes and sake, party course ¥6,800 (Ruchin Roll, soba-koji dressing, soba-dashi stew, soba-flour kara-age, seasonal soba, gluten-free soba sweets). Reviews (January–October 2026): Ruchin Roll, toro-taku inari, soba inari, soba cheese fry, eel shirayaki, 100% buckwheat +¥330, soba with Kujo green onion, sticky natto soba, sashimi, oden, dashimaki, shamo chicken prosciutto, sake in 90 ml, the 2nd-floor bar VALINO.

食べログ (店舗会員): たか野、港区六本木4-4-3 六本木協和ビル西館1F、.en: Tabelog (shop member): Takano, Roppongi 4-4-3, 六本木協和ビル西館 1F; Mon–Sat 18:00–23:00; closed Sundays; 19 seats; private hire possible; non-smoking; cards (JCB and AMEX only). Shop text: a kappo in a Roppongi back alley since 1996, drawing on training in Osaka and Kyoto and Niigata home cooking; obanzai, seasonal dishes and sake. Reviews (October 2023–May 2026): obanzai lined up on the counter; herring with eggplant; nikogori; winter fugu (sashimi, fried, shirako, fin sake); Kōbako crab; matsutake; sea-bream chazuke; fugu zosui; Niigata sake Tsurunoe Yukionna; one reviewer says the owner trained 15 years at Akasaka Tsuyama; from Niigata; fairly priced.

食べログ (店舗会員): たこやき座、たこ焼き・お好み焼き・焼きそば、難波千日前.en: Tabelog (shop member): Takoyaki Za; takoyaki, okonomiyaki, yakisoba; Namba Sennichimae 12-2; straight down Nankai Street from Namba Station (Takashimaya), diagonally in front of Namba Grand Kagetsu; Mon–Fri 10:00–24:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 9:00–24:00; reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 100 seats (on the 2nd and 3rd floors too); tatami seating; private hire up to 50; smoking allowed; takeaway; sake and shochu. Reviews (June–October 2026): soft, fluffy, gooey takoyaki; a dashi-rich batter; sauce, soy sauce, salt, garlic soy sauce, ponzu, salt mayo; a six-flavor tasting set; small order of nine; pork yakisoba; doteyaki; signatures of comedians and celebrities; cash only; friendly staff from overseas.

食べログ (店舗会員): たこやき王子 難波道頓堀店、居酒屋・串揚げ・お好み焼き.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Takoyaki Ouji Nanba doutonbori ten, izakaya, kushiage, okonomiyaki; Comrade Doton Building 3F, 1-6-15 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Namba Stn; daily 11:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); open year-round; reservations accepted; no service charge; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 80 seats; separate smoking area (no partition); children welcome. Reviews (October 2025–July 2026): sauce, green onion and mayo ¥484; sauce, green onion and mentaiko mayo ¥539; salt, green onion and mayo ¥484; ponzu, green onion and mayo ¥484; a dashi flavour; dote-yaki ¥451; bottled beer ¥792; shrimp, lotus root, quail egg and banana kushikatsu; drinks about ¥500 and no all-you-can-drink; usually easy to get in even when Dotonbori is crowded; a queue on a Sunday lunchtime; many young and overseas guests; some find the food average.

食べログ (店舗会員): たこ八 道頓堀総本店、たこ焼き・お好み焼き・鉄板焼き、.en: Tabelog (shop member): Tako Hachi Dotonbori main shop; takoyaki, okonomiyaki, teppanyaki; Dotonbori 1-5-10; 5 minutes' walk from exit 14 of Namba Station; daily 10:00–22:30 (L.O. 21:30); reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 57 seats (standing counter on the first floor, counter on the second, tables on the third); non-smoking; Wi-Fi; power outlets; children welcome; founded in 1979 (the heading says 1978); takoyaki with a special dashi, large octopus, tenkasu, pickled ginger and green onion, crisp outside and soft inside; over 90 dishes. Official site (takohachi.jp): the Dotonbori main shop; an appearance at an event in Kaohsiung, Taiwan. Reviews (August–October 2026): six takoyaki ¥650; negi-mayo; a comparison with akashiyaki; okonomiyaki; yakisoba; omusoba; domestic beef steak; a teppanyaki deluxe set; stairs up to the third floor; booking recommended; some say it beats the chain shops.

食べログ (店舗会員): たこ焼きとおでん 石橋 (旧店名 蛸焼とおでん くれ屋.en: Tabelog (shop member): Takoyaki to Oden Ishibashi (former name 蛸焼とおでん くれ屋); oden, takoyaki, izakaya; Kita-Horie 1-1-3 (Nishi-ku), 四ツ橋日生ビル別館 1F; 8 seconds' walk from exit 3 of Yotsubashi Station; daily 17:00–4:00 (L.O. 3:00); open all year; appetizer charge ¥418; reservations; courses with all-you-can-drink ¥4,700–¥5,000; up to 40 guests; cards and PayPay accepted; 30 seats (counter 4, tables, tatami, a loft for 2–8); terrace; smoking allowed; free Wi-Fi; opened 10 October 2013; asari clam dashi in every dish; homemade fish-cake oden. Reviews (June–September 2026): clam-dashi oden in platters of five or eight; clams; takoyaki (sauce ¥528, salt, dashi takoyaki); sashimi; sea grapes; quail eggs ¥440; draft beer ¥660; gari chuhai; summer sake; mega mugs; some say the oden is not soaked enough.

食べログ (店舗会員): たこ焼き酒場 ん、たこ焼き・お好み焼き・居酒屋、大阪市.en: Tabelog (shop member): Takoyaki Sakaba N, takoyaki, okonomiyaki and izakaya, 曽根崎新地1-5-31, 3F of JMビル, Kita-ku, Osaka; about 3 min on foot from Kitashinchi Station; Mon–Fri 18:00–3:00 (last order 2:00); Sat 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; whole-shop hire; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 14 seats (a counter of 6, two tables of 4); smoking allowed; opened 10 October 2023; takoyaki with a rich dashi; teppan dishes of seasonal ingredients; Japanese whisky at fair prices; a retro hideaway. Reviews (July 2024 – October 2026): takoyaki (with salt too); limited-time takoyaki; all-you-can-eat takoyaki cooked yourself at the table; okonomiyaki; buta-tama; negiyaki; akashiyaki; teppan beef thigh and tongue; stir-fried shrimp, scallop and asparagus; grilled vegetables (shiitake, Manganji pepper, lotus root); dashimaki; garlic rice; a soft-boiled quail egg as the starter; a snack-bar interior; stairs to the third floor; a friendly owner.

食べログ (店舗会員): たらば蟹&和牛フォー LUXE 道頓堀店、かに・アジア.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Taraba Kani & Wagyu Pho LUXE Dotonbori, crab, Asian, ethnic, yakiniku; ウィード21 3F, 1-10-7 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Namba Stn; daily 11:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); reservations accepted; cards (including UnionPay), transport IC and QR (including Alipay and WeChat Pay) accepted; 21 seats (13 counter, two tables for four); non-smoking; children welcome; English and Chinese picture menus; opened 8 July 2026. Shop introduction (English translation): authentic pho made the traditional way by a Vietnamese chef; taraba crab and A5 wagyu toppings; three bowls. Reviews (July–August 2026): premium taraba crab and wagyu pho ¥6,820 (1.5–2 crab legs, shrimp, clams, wagyu seared as served); a clear broth of beef bone, shellfish, shrimp and crab; flat rice-flour noodles (described as gluten-free); house chili oil; coriander can be left out; also cheaper pho, fried chicken, fresh spring rolls, a sukiyaki rice bowl; overseas families too; lift to 3F.

食べログ (店舗会員): たんや又兵衛 六本木本店、港区六本木3-13-8 斎藤.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Tanya Matabee Roppongi head shop, Roppongi 3-13-8, 斎藤ビル 2F, 3 min from Roppongi Stn; Mon–Sat 17:30–23:00, closed Sundays and holidays; 10% service charge; 16 seats; private room; tatami seating; non-smoking; cards accepted; children welcome. Shop text: 36 years of history (37 in another place); fresh, never-frozen black-wagyu tongue (Nama Tan) aged 30 days, using only the core (Tan Shin), about 300 g a tongue; recommended course of 9 items ¥23,590 (tongue, Sagari, beef sashimi). Reviews (August 2024–October 2026): raw tongue, tongue sashimi, thick grilled tongue, a skewer of three large pieces of tongue, miso-marinated tongue, beef sashimi, liver, shiitake and asparagus, congee to finish; a mention of a Ginza shop; a customer of over 30 years; in 2026 some diners spent ¥40,000–80,000 a person.

食べログ (店舗会員): つぼルー カレー鍋 心斎橋総本家、鍋、大阪市中央区心斎.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Tsuboru Curry Nabe Shinsaibashi head shop, hot pot, ニシモトビルヂング 3F, Shinsaibashi-suji 2-2-1, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 6 minutes from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); irregular closures (1–2 times a month); reservations accepted; seat charge ¥300 (not charged to domestic guests); cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 22 seats (4 counter, 18 table); curtained semi-private room for 4; smoking allowed; vegan and vegetarian options shown. A medicinal-style curry hot pot of 24 spices with plenty of vegetables and meat, daily small plates, courses with all-you-can-drink. Reviews (October 2025–October 2026): a hot pot of chicken, pork and beef, sweet-spicy wings, oyster and lamb toppings, A5 beef, finishes of udon, ramen, curry risotto or grilled cheese risotto, mega highball, a lively manager, one reviewer had lukewarm beef tongue. A woman owner from Hokkaido (tabiiro).

食べログ (店舗会員): てんぷら 味覚、港区六本木6-7-17、六本木駅3番出.en: Tabelog (shop member): Tempura Mikaku, Roppongi 6-7-17, 3 min walk from Roppongi Station exit 3; Mon–Fri and days before and after holidays 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 18:00–22:00 (food L.O. 20:30); closed Saturdays, Sundays and holidays; dinner reservations until 15:00 the day before; 30 seats (counter 9, tables 8, tatami room 8, small room 6); private hire up to 20; no smoking inside; cards, e-money and QR accepted; children welcome; BYO, takeout and delivery; vegetarian options. Notice: closed for renovation from 1 September; the planned mid-October reopening was delayed, now aiming for early December. Reviews (January 2025–August 2026): founded in Nihonbashi in 1931, moved to Roppongi about 30 years ago; tendon ¥1,300, salt tendon ¥1,500, omakase bowl ¥1,800; sesame and cottonseed oil; dinner courses and duck hot pot; queues at lunch.

食べログ (店舗会員): ときすし 本店、寿司・魚介・鍋、大阪市中央区難波千日前.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Tokisushi Honten, sushi, seafood and hot pot, Namba Sennichimae 4-21, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 8 minutes from Namba Station; daily 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:45) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:45); no regular holidays (may close at New Year and Obon); reservations accepted (no seat selection); no service charge; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 39 seats (9 counter, 10 table, 20 in the 2nd-floor tatami room); non-smoking; English and Korean menus; opened 2 September 2007; official site tokisushi.jp. Fresh, never-frozen tuna and seasonal fish, the signature 'Sushi Yaki', a fresh-fish platter, Kochi sake. Reviews (June–September 2026): limited seafood bara-chirashi ¥770 (with miso soup), sea bream bowl, 8-nigiri set ¥770, senbero set ¥1,000 (before tax), Sushi Yaki ¥1,650, toro tekka maki ¥1,320, bluefin chutoro 2 pieces ¥400, omakase mini course ¥3,300, wasabi soy applied with a brush, one reviewer was charged for pickled ginger, many tourists, the 1st floor full just after 11:00.

食べログ (店舗会員): とりノ蔵、居酒屋・焼き鳥・もつ鍋、四谷1-7-8 アク.en: Tabelog (shop member): Tori no Kura, izakaya, yakitori, motsunabe; Act World Building 2F B, Yotsuya 1-7-8; 1 min walk from Exit 2 of Tokyo Metro Yotsuya Station, 3 min from the Atre south exit of JR Yotsuya Station; daily 12:00–2:00; 80 seats, all in private rooms; smoking allowed; cards and PayPay accepted; opened 1 October 2024; free-range chicken skewered daily and grilled over binchotan; skewers ¥110; motsunabe ¥1,520; courses with 3 hours of drinks ¥4,000–5,000 (after discount). Reviews (June–September 2026): yakitori platter, tsukune, cartilage, gyoza, takana and mentaiko fried rice; order on the table tablet; Kyushu sake; one diner found the ¥5,000 course unlike its photos.

食べログ (店舗会員): とり澤 六本木、港区六本木4-1-19 ARUGA19.en: Tabelog (shop member): Tori Sawa Roppongi, Roppongi 4-1-19, ARUGA19 building 1F, 5 min walk from Roppongi Station exit 6 (Hibiya line); Mon–Sat in two seatings, 17:30–20:00 (arrive by about 18:00) and 20:30–23:00; closed Sundays and holidays; omakase course ¥12,000 (stop system, the bill depends on how much you eat); 11 seats (counter); private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards accepted; only guests of middle-school age or older who can eat as much as an adult; opened 26 September 2022; Tabelog yakitori EAST 100, 2025. Shop text: Kishu binchotan, Daisen chicken, seasonal vegetables, an omakase stop system, a black counter-only room. Reviews (August–October 2026): raw liver at your own risk, nearly raw chicken breast, aorta, sori, chōchin; to finish, yaki-onigiri, soboro rice, tamago-kake-gohan, chilled tantanmen or ramen; reasonably priced wine and sake; one diner found service ended at closing time despite the stop system; said to be Tori Sawa's second shop.

食べログ (店舗会員): とんかつ & 焼鳥 An 四谷、とんかつ・焼き鳥・居酒.en: Tabelog (shop member): Tonkatsu & Yakitori An Yotsuya, tonkatsu, yakitori, izakaya; Hotel Keihan Tokyo Yotsuya B1F, Yotsuya 1-24; 3 min walk from the Yotsuya exit of JR Yotsuya Station or subway Exit 3; daily 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); 51 seats; private rooms for up to 14; hire for 42 seated or 70 standing; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; English menu; wheelchair accessible; Fritz tonkatsu, skewers grilled by craftsmen, sake and shochu from across Japan. Reviews (April–October 2026): premium loin cutlet set ¥1,500, free large rice, a tonkatsu and soba set, a ¥6,000 all-you-can-drink course, pork shabu-shabu in soba broth, unlimited ribbon-sliced daikon, soba to finish, a sign announcing the revival of Akasaka Fritz, one diner naming Motoshiro Saito as supervisor, others finding the frying uneven and the cutlet lukewarm.

食べログ (店舗会員): なにわのお好み焼 じろー、お好み焼き・鉄板焼き・居酒屋.en: Tabelog (shop member): Naniwa no Okonomiyaki Jiro; okonomiyaki, teppanyaki, izakaya; 東三国2-32-14 モンテ新大阪 1F, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 3 minutes north on foot from exit 1 of Higashi-Mikuni Station on the Midosuji Line; 5 minutes by car from Shin-Osaka Station; open every day 11:30–24:00 (last order 23:30); may close 15:00–17:00; closed 31 December–3 January; reservations from ¥2,000 a head; 2-hour limit at weekends and other busy times; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; 44 seats (up to 50); two semi-private tables; non-smoking; affiliated paid parking; large buses welcome; also for Shinkansen travellers, travel-agency groups and lunch after Katsuo-ji Temple. Reviews (December 2025 to October 2026): cook it yourself or have the shop cook it; sweet, spicy, extra-spicy or soy-sauce sauce; the signature Jiro Jiro-yaki ¥1,380; Abeno Mix okonomiyaki ¥2,500–2,860; Jiro Special ¥2,673; pork modern-yaki ¥1,298; salt yakisoba ¥1,078; tonpei-yaki with cheese ¥913; salt-grilled squid legs ¥583; triple cheese; beef tendon and cheese; Yamato tororo-yaki; negiyaki; omusoba; wagyu and seafood teppanyaki; beef tendon stew; all-you-can-drink from lunchtime; photos and signatures of celebrities starting with former Prime Minister Abe; over 50 years.

食べログ (店舗会員): にしぶち飯店、中国料理、東山区上弁天町444-2、月〜.en: Tabelog (corporate member): Nishibuchi Hanten, Chinese, 東山区上弁天町444-2; Mon–Sat 18:00–21:00; closed Sundays and holidays; 10 counter seats; no cards; non-smoking; opened 25 April 2013; The Tabelog Award Silver 2019–2026; Chinese WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2024, 2026. Chef Kentaro Nishibuchi, from Joyo in Kyoto Prefecture, trained six years at Kakan, the Chinese restaurant of the Kyoto Brighton Hotel, and five years at the kappo Gion Sasaki, and opened near Yasaka Shrine in 2013. Reviews (September–October 2026, in English): shark fin, chicken wings stuffed with bird's nest with char siu and Gorgonzola, fried rice with grated daikon, hard to book, special events in Tokyo.

食べログ (店舗会員): ねぎ焼 やまもと 新大阪店、お好み焼き・焼きそば、大阪.en: Tabelog (shop member): Negiyaki Yamamoto Shin osaka ten; okonomiyaki, yakisoba; 5-16-1 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, inside the JR Tokai Shinkansen gates of Shin-Osaka Station, Osaka Noren Meguri; daily 10:00–21:30 (last order 21:00); cards, e-money and QR accepted; counter seats and food-court seats; non-smoking; takeaway; opened 29 September 2011. Reviews (August 2025 to October 2026): the negiyaki of Yamamoto in Juso; beef tendon negiyaki ¥1,350 (beef tendon, konnyaku, soy sauce); the original negiyaki grilled with salt and green onion; a special negiyaki only at this shop with pork belly, beef tendon and shrimp; grilled beef tendon; crisp outside and fluffy inside; some find it salty; take a seat before ordering; dishes other than negiyaki can take about 20 minutes; good with beer or a highball.

食べログ (店舗会員): ねぎ焼・お好み焼き 和、お好み焼き・その他・鉄板焼き、.en: Tabelog (shop member): Negiyaki Okonomiyaki Kazu; okonomiyaki, other, teppanyaki; 3-16-6 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, ground floor; 2 minutes on foot from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; Mon–Sat and holidays 15:00–23:00; closed Sunday; no reservations; no cards or e-money, PayPay and d Barai accepted; 16 seats; smoking allowed; negiyaki, okonomiyaki, yakisoba, omusoba, modern-yaki, sashimi, teppanyaki, skewers; the signature Suji Pon; homemade jaga-cheese. Reviews (2025 to June 2026): negiyaki heaped with green onion, with dashi soy sauce; beef-tendon negiyaki ¥1,050 (before tax); Daimyo negi and Daimyo soba ¥1,400 each; Daimyo yakisoba ¥1,300; black yakisoba with squid ink; tonpei-yaki with two eggs; pork and cabbage omelette; beef tendon stew ¥550; handmade hamburg steak ¥550; chicken heart salt-grilled, two for ¥500; draft beer ¥530; full of regulars; an entertaining owner.

食べログ (店舗会員): のぶちゃん、上野2-12-4 レインボータワービル 1.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Nobuchan, Ueno 2-12-4, レインボータワービル 1F, 3 min on foot from Ueno-Hirokoji and Ueno-Okachimachi stations; Mon 17:00–23:00, Tue–Thu 17:00–04:00, Fri 17:00–05:00, Sat 15:00–05:00, Sun 15:00–23:00; no regular closing day (may close over New Year); 31 seats (6 at the counter, 24 at tables); smoking allowed; cards, PayPay and Rakuten Pay accepted; opened 25 May 2021; yakitori from chicken slaughtered that morning, offal stew, Tetchan Karami Miso Yaki, kimchi, shochu with red Hoppy, Kinmiya; an Otsuka shop opening on 16 July; courses with all-you-can-drink ¥4,300 and ¥4,500; à la carte all-you-can-drink ¥2,500. Reviews (October 2021–April 2026): opened by someone who trained at Omi-chan in Oi Town (October 2021); Hoppy, kimchi, chive omelette, kara-age, liver, shiro, tongue, kashira; the beef offal stew is gently flavoured; a street with many touts; mistakes in the Japanese on the menu; a foreign diner was satisfied too; regulars keeping bottles; harami, negima; a menu mixing pork and chicken skewers; sesame-leaf kimchi; April 2026 prices (table charge ¥500, kakuteki ¥350, octopus with wasabi ¥380, beef offal stew ¥600, eggplant with grated daikon and ponzu ¥500, oolong tea ¥300); staff from elsewhere in Asia with varying Japanese; ordering through the Air REGE Order app.

食べログ (店舗会員): はし本、港区六本木4-4-11 第1六本木ヴィレッジビ.en: Tabelog (shop member): Hashimoto, Roppongi 4-4-11, 第1六本木ヴィレッジビル 1F, 2 min walk from Roppongi Station exit 7 (Oedo line); Tue–Fri 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00), Sat 18:00–22:00; closed Sundays and Mondays; occasional closures; 5% service charge and an appetizer charge; 18 seats (counter 6, three sunken-kotatsu tables for 4); private hire possible; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; registration number T6810522686872. Shop text: a wide range of drinks centred on sake; homemade drinking dishes; duck dishes and duck hot pot. Recommended duck hot-pot course ¥4,750. NTA qualified-invoice issuer register: registration number T6810522686872; name 橋本 洋一; registered 1 January 2026 (Reiwa 8). Reviews (October 2025–October 2026): founded 1978; the owner runs it alone; food takes time; a slightly rich soy-based duck hot pot and zosui; small portions sized to the group; about 15 sakes; a regular since 1986.

食べログ (店舗会員): はり重 グリル (ハリジュウ グリル)、洋食・ステーキ.en: Tabelog (shop member): Hariju Grill; yoshoku, steak, hamburg steak; Dotonbori 1-9-17; 3 minutes' walk from Namba Station; 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:00); closed Tuesdays (open on holidays, the day before holidays and in December); reservations; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 58 seats; non-smoking; takeaway; a yoshoku restaurant run by the kuroge wagyu specialist Hariju, founded in 1919; only kuroge wagyu heifers; steak and roast beef courses with a demi-glace simmered for a week in beef-tendon broth (strip loin ¥11,000, filet ¥12,100, both ¥13,200); beef cutlet, hamburg steak, beef stew. Reviews (August–October 2026): Lunch A (beef sauté, fried shrimp, ham, potato salad, onion soup or corn potage); Special Lunch (strip-loin steak and fried shrimp); tenderloin beef cutlet; tongue stew; hayashi rice; sukiyaki gozen; Matsukado bento; a retro room; price rises; some found the steak thin, tough or lukewarm, the beef stew tasting thawed, or the service lacking.

食べログ (店舗会員): ぱとぱと 梅田堂山店、イタリアン・パスタ・ピザ、大阪市.en: Tabelog (shop member): Pato Pato Umeda douyama ten, Italian, pasta and pizza, R&Eビル B1F, 1-2 堂山町, Kita-ku, Osaka; 3 min from Higashi-Umeda Station; daily 16:00–24:00 (last order food 23:00, drinks 23:30); reservations accepted; starter ¥480 à la carte; cards and QR accepted; 32 seats; 34 seated or 50 standing; heated tobacco only; free Wi-Fi; vegetarian options; the second shop of 'Pato Umeda', popular for duck and gin; Yamato duck from Nara; about 50 gins; Chicago pizza; an autumn course in October–November ¥4,500; a luxury course of Yamato duck yukhoe, Iberico rare cutlet, pasta and roast of A4 wagyu and duck loin ¥5,000; a weekday P course with all-you-can-drink ¥3,980; all-you-can-drink ¥1,200. Invoice registration: Adachi Group Co., Ltd. Reviews (July–October 2026): a basement entrance that looks like a dead end; wooden interior; QR ordering after the first drink; roasted duck breast (red wine sauce, truffle salt); duck loin sashimi with sudachi soy; duck tsukune with cheese; spicy duck skewers; duck sushi with ikura; black Chicago pizza with a charcoal crust; black wagyu roast beef; eel and butter dashimaki; scallops with yuzu sauce; bagna cauda fritters; appetizer platter; baked sweet potato with vanilla ice cream; No. 3 London Dry Gin; craft-gin ginger ale; a comment that portions were small and service cool; a young chef.

食べログ (店舗会員): ひがしやま 司、日本料理、東山区西町127 三条白川橋.en: Tabelog (corporate member): Higashiyama Tsukasa, Japanese cuisine, Nishimachi 127, Sanjo Shirakawabashi Bldg 2F, Higashiyama, 2 min from Higashiyama Stn on the Tozai Line; Tue–Sat one start at 18:00, lunch from 12:30 on Saturdays; closed Sunday and Monday (irregular, sometimes open); seasonal omakase course ¥30,250 (tax included); service charge 10%; 9 counter seats; whole-shop hire up to 20; no menu changes on the day; opened 1 November 2021; The Tabelog Award 2026 Bronze; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Owner Tsukasa Miyashita, born 1985 in Mie; Tsuji Culinary Institute; 6 years at Gion Maruyama, 10 at Gion Sasaki; opened in 2021 with Yuumei Hongo; "cuisine not served elsewhere", drawing on both ryotei and kappo experience. Reviews (July–October 2026): ayu spring rolls, dried Matsutake soup, sushi-rice porridge with sea urchin and turban shell, grilled warabi mochi, rice served many ways, one star in the Michelin Guide Kyoto Osaka 2026, the owner greets guests at the entrance, a lively counter.

食べログ (店舗会員): ひな鶏唐揚 新次郎、居酒屋・焼き鳥・水炊き、大阪市中央.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Hinadori Karaage Shinjirou, izakaya, yakitori, mizutaki; 1-18-20 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Stn exit 5; Tue–Sun and holidays 17:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:00, drinks L.O. 22:30); closed Mondays (the following Tuesday if Monday is a holiday); reservations accepted; starter ¥385; cards, PayPay and d Barai accepted, no e-money; 30 seats (8 counter, 6 tables); opened 16 June 2010. Reviews (July 2025–August 2026): the signature hinadori karaage, half a young chicken fried whole, takes 20–30 minutes, so order it first; yakitori (heart, fatty heart, thigh, breast, bonjiri, seseri, meat-stuffed lotus root, pork-wrapped asparagus, king oyster mushroom, makomo, quail egg, nagaimo, tomato); horse sashimi platter; cold tofu; chicken hot pot; courses need booking the day before; famous sakes ¥900–1,000 for 180 ml; children welcome; staff who remember regulars.

食べログ (店舗会員): まえだ家、魚介料理・居酒屋・鍋、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Maeda Ya, seafood, izakaya and hot pot, エイトビルヂング B1F, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-12-19, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station, daily 17:00–2:00 the next morning, open year-round, reservations accepted (2-hour stay, phone bookings take priority, 2–3 people may be at the counter, seat-only bookings get a platter for the party, you may be seated at the main shop or the annex depending on bookings), table charge ¥500 a person (included in courses), primary-school age and up pay the charge and order one drink, cards and PayPay accepted, 29 seats (12 counter, tables), private hire for 20–50, non-smoking (ashtray outside), Wi-Fi, opened 13 July 2017. Shop introduction (machine-translated): seafood and creative obanzai by a professional cook from a former fish shop, seasonal ingredients from the market every day, more than 30 sakes, awamori, about 10 wines from Italy and Sicily, an independent shop happy to take requests, sister shops まえだ家 別邸 (東心斎橋1-14-23 住吉ビル B1F) and JAZZ BERRY (北堀江1-9-18). Reviews (August–October 2026): the signature assorted sashimi (with salt or liver soy sauce too), a ¥6,500 course (salt-boiled peanuts, marinated bonito, fish in sweet vinegar, salad with cheese and prosciutto, sashimi, salt-grilled ayu, tempura of autumn eel and Senshu water eggplant, roast Itoshima venison, small sakura-shrimp and shirasu bowl, dessert), chilled chawanmushi, shrimp mayonnaise, bonito tataki, sake-steamed clams, rare tuna katsu, shrimp chili with egg, small salmon-roe bowl, fried rice, friendly staff, and one bill over ¥10,000 for three dishes and three drinks.

Reviews (May–October 2026): à la carte recommended, a menu with no prices shown, seasonal course ¥12,000, sake pairing, dobin-mushi of matsutake and hamo, crab miso, Chateaubriand, eel shirayaki and kabayaki, grilled rice balls, wasanbon ice cream, bone-cut hamo, ayu, wild eel, sake such as Nabeshima and Kuro Ryu, old Western classical music, used for business dinners.

Reviews (September 2025–October 2026): salmon rare katsu, seafood yukhoe, crab gratin, grilled tuna cheek, oden, horse sashimi in broth, a potato salad you mash yourself, hamo tempura, seafood kamameshi, crab-miso tofu as the starter, always full so book, friendly and quick staff, and a view that the sashimi platter and beer are small for the price.

Reviews (March–October 2026): a salt broth with the savour of pork, napa cabbage, cabbage and garlic; cloudy white; pork belly and cabbage stir-fried in lard; red chili paste in the middle; spice 0–5 (2 is standard); noodle firmness to choose; slightly flat, medium-thin straight noodles; Gifu ramen ¥950; half-fried-rice set ¥1,300, ¥1,450 with a spinach topping; Manpuku set (ramen, half fried rice, gyoza); order by QR code; bean sprouts and pickled mustard greens on the counter; full at 11:30 on a weekday, about a 10-minute wait; a kind owner; a Gifu native rated it a nostalgic taste.

食べログ (店舗会員): やまぐち、イタリアン・イノベーティブ、東山区祇園町南側.en: Tabelog (corporate member): Yamaguchi, Italian and innovative, 東山区祇園町南側570-185; Tue–Sat and the days before and after holidays; the counter in two sittings, 17:00–19:00 and 19:30–21:30; closed Sundays, Mondays and holidays; first-time guests by referral; from ¥46,000 per person (tax included, 10% service extra); 10 seats; renovated in April 2026 for the 15th anniversary (private rooms removed, the counter enlarged to 10 seats, a flat entrance so shoes stay on); children by arrangement; cards accepted; opened 2011; The Tabelog Award Gold 2020 and Silver; Italian WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025. Reviews (September–October 2026, in English): fig and foie gras brûlée, chilled sweet-shrimp capellini with bottarga, Ezo abalone steak with Matsutake risotto, a crab carbonara made without dairy, chestnut shaved ice, a cheerful chef full of jokes.
