Reviews (December 2025–October 2026): lunch about ¥1,000 with one free refill of naan or rice; plain or pumpkin naan; free onion achar on the table; chicken biryani; saag, keema, mutton; the chicken steak set; Indian-style yakisoba ¥700; the Hamacho shop has closed; mild spice.

食べログ (店舗会員): ウイスキー&ワイン シュン、串揚げ・ワインバー・日本料.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Whisky & Wine Shun, kushiage, wine bar, Japanese cuisine; Swissôtel Nankai Osaka 6F (hotel lobby floor), 5-1-60 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; dedicated escalator from the 3F gates of Namba Station; Wed–Fri 17:00–22:00, Sat–Sun 12:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed Mondays and Tuesdays; reservations accepted; prices plus tax and a 13% service charge; cards (including UnionPay), e-money and PayPay accepted; 35 seats. Reviews (April 2025–September 2026): formerly 'Wine & Dine SHUN', with wine-focused kushikatsu courses; creative seasonal skewers; explanations of the salts; shrimp, truffle rice, konjac, dashi kushikatsu; allergies and dislikes handled on the spot; from early 2026 no courses, a bar menu of kushikatsu and grills; shrimp ¥1,100; Brussels sprouts okonomiyaki-style ¥700; scallop ¥850; shishamo ¥600; cheese platter ¥2,800; clam chowder; mini katsu sandwich; whiskies such as Yamazaki and Hakushu; wine from ¥2,500.

食べログ (店舗会員): エンバシー・オブ・クラブ、海鮮・ビュッフェ、大阪市浪速.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Embassy of Crab, seafood and buffet, Namba-naka 2-11-50, Naniwa Ward, Osaka, Centara Grand Hotel Osaka 2F, 4 min walk from Namba Station, daily 11:30–22:00 (last order 21:30), open year-round, reservations accepted, service charge 15% (from January 2024), cards accepted, no e-money or QR, 139 seats, private rooms, non-smoking, kids menu, opened 1 July 2023. Shop introduction (English translation): a neon crab logo, set menus and courses of fresh seafood, a lunch buffet, seasonal dessert buffets on weekends and holidays, the bar counter for solo diners. Reviews (December 2024–October 2026): seasonal all-you-can-eat crab (boiled and grilled), sushi, roast beef, pâté en croûte, prosciutto, Thai dishes, strawberries, a New Year crab buffet ¥9,500, all-you-can-drink ¥2,500, pasta lunch with a dessert buffet, courses at ¥5,000 and ¥7,000, caprese, crab cream pasta, one diner found menu items missing, one skipped the buffet for à la carte, an interior shared with Suan Bua that does not feel typically Japanese.

食べログ (店舗会員): エンプレスルーム、中華料理・ダイニングバー・飲茶・点心.en: Tabelog (shop member): Empress Room; Chinese, dining bar, yum cha and dim sum; Namba 5-1-60, Swissotel Nankai Osaka 10F; directly connected from the third-floor gate of Nankai Namba Station by a dedicated escalator; Mon–Thu 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–21:00, Fri 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–21:30, Sat 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–21:30, Sun and holidays 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–21:00; open all year; a 13% service charge on tax-inclusive prices; all-you-can-eat yum cha lunch with dim sum carts (weekdays ¥5,800, weekends and holidays ¥6,500, 21–31 December ¥6,800); the only dim sum cart in Osaka; chef Leo, winner of many awards in Singapore; medicinal cuisine; Cantonese cuisine of tradition and innovation; private rooms; cards, e-money and QR accepted. Reviews (August–October 2026): steamed shrimp dumplings; xiaolongbao; pork with black bean sauce; buns shaped like pigs and penguins; lobster cold noodles about ¥4,500; scallop congee; private-room courses (abalone and chicken herbal soup, Hong Kong-style steamed sea bream, spare ribs with coffee sauce); service from staff from overseas; some say the taste is ordinary or the portions too large.

食べログ (店舗会員): オイスタースタンド 人形町、オイスターバー、中央区日本.en: Tabelog (shop member): Oyster Stand Ningyocho, oyster bar; M's Cross Ningyocho 4F, Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 1-19-5, Chuo-ku; 1 min from Ningyocho Station exits A5/A6; daily 12:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:15, drinks L.O. 22:45); 12 seats; can be hired for up to 20; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; non-smoking (smoking area in the building); website otto2008.com (株式会社otto). Menu (updated 6 October 2026, tax included): Moët & Chandon with 2 raw oysters ¥2,640, Cava with 2 ¥2,200, Chablis with 2 ¥2,310, beer or highball with 2 ¥1,980, raw oyster ¥770 each, grilled oyster ¥770 each, oyster linguine ¥1,760, oyster and spinach lasagna ¥1,650. On the 4th floor of Hashigo-ro (M's Cross Ningyocho). Reviews (February–September 2026): careful explanations of each origin; a diner could ask for Hokkaido oysters; dishes from the Korean restaurant next door can be ordered too (billed separately); pasta and lasagna full of oysters; a friendly owner; some found it empty and the oysters small and overpriced, others fresh and plump.

食べログ (店舗会員): オオサカチャオメン 難波千日前、居酒屋・飲茶・中華料理.en: Tabelog (shop member): Oosaka Chaomen Namba Sennichimae; izakaya, dim sum, Chinese; specialties are chaomen and shumai; Namba Sennichimae 3-12; 3 minutes' walk from Nankai Namba Station; behind NGK; Mon–Thu and the days before and after holidays 17:00–23:00, Fri, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00 (L.O. food 22:30); reservations; courses with two-hour all-you-can-drink ¥4,500 (nine dishes) and ¥5,000 (eleven dishes); food only ¥3,500; shumai refills ¥100 on courses; cards and PayPay accepted; 60 seats; three floors; private hire for 20–50; non-smoking; opened 7 December 2024; dim sum, steamed dishes, homemade mapo tofu, original sours made to pair with food. Reviews (August–September 2026): chaomen of thin noodles steamed and fried crisp on one side; shumai; xiaolongbao; steamed chicken with ginger sauce; steamed cabbage with homemade shrimp sauce; whelk in pepper sauce; tuna kimchi; a free, refillable wakame appetizer; smartphone ordering; praise for the service.

食べログ (店舗会員): オリヴァヴァ、イタリアン・ワインバー・パスタ、四谷1-.en: Tabelog (shop member): Oliva Vava, Italian, wine bar, pasta; Act World Building 3F, Yotsuya 1-7-18; 1 min walk from Exit 2 of Yotsuya Station (Namboku Line); weekday lunch 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and dinner 17:00–22:30 (last order 22:00); Sat, Sun and holidays lunch 11:30–14:30, café 14:00–17:00, dinner 17:00–21:00; closing days not fixed; ¥660 table charge at dinner; a private room for two costs ¥3,300; one drink per person minimum; 40 seats (6 at the counter, 34 at tables); private rooms for 2–24; cards and PayPay accepted; opened 11 November 2018; Italian appetizer plate 5 kinds ¥1,650, 10 kinds ¥3,080; pasta ¥1,800–2,200; vegetables from its own farm. Official site (unicoco.tokyo): à la carte at the adjoining Italian restaurant, Oliva Vava. Reviews (July–October 2026): third floor up stairs, no lift; lunch set A ¥1,650; karasumi pasta lunch ¥2,000; weekend and holiday course ¥3,850; staff ask about dislikes in advance; on the drinks plan you pour the wine at the table yourself.

食べログ (店舗会員): オーパス ワン、中華料理、大阪市中央区高津3-3-29.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Opus One, Chinese, Kozu 3-3-29, プレステージ高津 1F, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min on foot from Nipponbashi Station exit 8; Tue–Sun 12:00–14:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Monday and the third Tuesday of each month; reservations accepted; cards, QUICPay and QR (Alipay, WeChat Pay and others) accepted; 34 seats (26 at tables, 8 at the counter); private hire possible; non-smoking; takeout; Tabelog Chinese WEST 100 2021, 2023, 2024 and 2026. Courses (tax included): Lunch Course ¥5,500 (appetizers, 3 omakase dishes, a rice dish, dessert; 12:00–14:30, 90 minutes), Shiro Midori ¥8,690 (shark fin soup), Hekigyoku ¥12,540 (crab and abalone, 4 omakase dishes), Moegi ¥15,840 (braised shark fin), Mokuran ¥21,340 (crab, abalone, Ise lobster); a rice dish (one of zongzi, fried rice or soup noodles, per the Chinese-language Tabelog); allergies by consultation. Retty: a Cantonese restaurant where you eat watching the kitchen, flames rising and fresh fish being cooked; genre Chinese, Cantonese; a review posted March 2023 calls it a long-established Chinese restaurant in Kozu that put stone-bream sashimi on its menu decades ago, ahead of others, preparing it in front of guests. Reviews (September–October 2026): salad-style Chinese sea bream sashimi with coriander, clams marinated in Shaoxing wine, jellyfish and cucumber, bird's nest soup, braised shark fin, sweet-and-sour pork, kara-age, mapo tofu, fried rice, shrimp chili, crab, abalone; light, refined flavours; solo bookings now possible; one wish that the dishes had been explained; just past Kuromon Market.

食べログ (店舗会員): オー・ド・ヴィー、ダイニングバー・イタリアン・バル、大.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Eau-De-Vie, dining bar, Italian, bar; リップル宗右衛門町ビル 3F, 2-3-13 Shinsaibashi-suji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 7 min walk from Namba Stn exit 15-B; Mon–Thu 18:00–2:00, Fri–Sat 18:00–3:00; closed Sundays (open Sunday when Monday is a holiday); reservations accepted; ¥500 charge (with house-smoked nuts, not with courses); cards, e-money and QR accepted; 37 seats (11 counter, 16 sofa, 10 table); karaoke, darts; smoking allowed; opened 5 June 2012. Shop introduction (English translation): a dining bar of Italian and seasonal creative dishes, house-smoked foods, pasta, over 100 drinks including sommelier-chosen wine, the signature champagne hot pot (course ¥6,300), a course with all-you-can-drink ¥4,950. Reviews (April 2024–September 2026): a hot pot of abalone, oysters and clams cooked in a whole bottle of champagne (November–May), finished as an oyster cream stew; smoked platters, prosciutto with figs, red carbonara, aglio e olio with egg, pasta topped with a hamburg steak, ajillo, shime-saba, quiche; a darts tournament on Thursdays.

食べログ (店舗会員): カフェ シャルボン (CAFE CHARBON)、カフ.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): CAFE CHARBON, café, Italian and bar, Kitahorie 1-6-23, Nishi-ku, Osaka, 1 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exit 4, Sun–Thu and holidays 11:30–22:00 (food last order 21:00), Fri, Sat and nights before holidays 11:30–23:00 (food last order 22:00), lunch last order 14:30 then the café menu, irregular closures, reservations accepted (no café-only bookings at lunch and dinner time, groups by phone), no cover charge, cards, Suica and PayPay accepted, 65 seats, private hire up to 100 seated, non-smoking, Wi-Fi, a birthday dessert plate ¥1,500, opened 8 December 1999. Shop introduction (machine-translated): a stylish long-established café of the Shinsaibashi and Horie area, a renovated lumber warehouse with an 8-metre ceiling, candles at night, courses centred on Italian food, wedding after-parties and reunions. Reviews (September–October 2026): choose a main with free appetizers, salad bar and soup, hashed pork ¥1,000 with bread, three jams, pork kimchi on Thursdays, pasta, pizza, risotto, steak, a Smart Lunch Course ¥2,500, latte art, tiramisu, QR-code ordering, some weekend days booked out, and a report of being rushed at the till.

食べログ (店舗会員): カフェレストラン セリーナ ホテル日航大阪、カフェ・ビ.en: Tabelog (shop member): café restaurant SERENA, Hotel Nikko Osaka; café, buffet, cake; Nishi-Shinsaibashi 1-3-3, Hotel Nikko Osaka 2F; directly connected to Shinsaibashi Station; daily 6:45–21:00 (L.O. 20:30), Saturdays and the day before holidays to 21:30; breakfast 6:45–10:00; lunch buffet 11:30–14:30 (90 minutes); dinner buffet weekdays 17:30–20:30, weekends and holidays from 17:00 (120 minutes); à la carte 11:30–21:00; 15% service charge; Hokkaido Fair (1 September–30 November): weekday lunch ¥6,500, weekend and holiday lunch ¥6,800 (build your own seafood bowl), weekday dinner ¥8,900 (all-you-can-eat Shihoro kuroge wagyu sirloin); jingisukan, soup curry, pork rice bowls, a monthly regional ramen; head chef Hideki Makihara; a view of Midosuji; 101 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; Wi-Fi; parking; vegan and halal options listed. Reviews (December 2025–October 2026): roast beef from the live kitchen; Hakodate shio ramen; gratin of scallops and Inca no Mezame potatoes; steak; spare ribs; salmon sashimi; crab buffets; crispy bacon and eggs at breakfast; crème brûlée; all-you-can-drink alcohol ¥3,300; some say dishes were slow to be refilled or the mapo tofu not spicy.

食べログ (店舗会員): ガフーリオ (Gaffurio)、イタリアン・バル・パ.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Gaffurio, Italian, bar and pasta, セブンマンション 103, Sennichimae 2-3-1, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 minutes from Nippombashi Station exit 5; daily 11:30–14:15 and 18:00–22:15; can open from 16:30 by arrangement; closed irregularly; reservations accepted; automatically cancelled at 15 minutes late; please avoid strong perfume; no cover charge; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 26 seats (3 counter, 23 table); a private room for 4; northern Italian food by a chef recognised by the Milanese chef Aldo Russo; over 50 Italian wines; Italian ingredients; about 50 daily specials. Reviews (May 2025–October 2026): lunch courses A, B and C, B ¥1,800 (four appetisers or pasta, fish or meat main, two desserts, salad, drink), spear squid and mushroom oil pasta, sautéed wild yellowtail, flatfish, stuffed spear squid, duck, grilled Okutamba chicken, Nagasaki pork, bread and coffee refills, a loyalty card, the anniversary festival every year (26th in 2026), the owner Shibuya, and a walk-in table before noon even when same-day bookings were full.

食べログ (店舗会員): キエチュード、東上野3-35-1 鈴木ビル1F、稲荷町.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Quietude, Higashi-Ueno 3-35-1, 鈴木ビル 1F, 2 min on foot from Inaricho Station, 6 min from the JR Ueno Station Showa-dori exit; 12:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Wednesdays; dinner is a course only, with 10% service; 18 seats (6 at the counter, 12 at tables); non-smoking; cards accepted (no e-money or QR); children welcome (a kids' plate for about age 5, reserved by the day before); BYO allowed; online booking only via the official site; opened 10 May 2015; owner-chef Araki trained in Japan, France, Canada and Morocco; Christmas course ¥16,500 (23–26 December). Reviews (March–October 2026): Menu A ¥1,650 (one said ¥1,500 in June); Menu B ¥4,400 (¥4,800 in October); one drink each required; booking means Menu B; salad of Aichi shirasu and Kumamoto vegetables; herb-crumb chicken with special demi-glace and butter rice; roast sawara with black maitake; marinated sakura shrimp; Hokkaido pork with demi-glace and ratatouille; turtle soup; sweetfish with burnt butter; sautéed venison; tarte tatin; lemon soufflé; peach and pistachio; allergies by email when booking; the chef is from Kumamoto and trained at Hiramatsu and Esquisse (May 2026 review); one found dinner service very slow; run by the chef and the chef's wife; one paid by PayPay.

食べログ (店舗会員): グランフルーヴ、ケーキ、西区南堀江1-16-3、Yot.en: Tabelog (shop member): Grand Fleuve, cakes, Minami-Horie 1-16-3, Nishi-ku, 5 min on foot from Yotsubashi Station, 5 min from Namba Station exit 26C, Mon and Thu–Sun 11:00–22:30, closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays, no cards, e-money or QR, non-smoking, opened 4 January 2013. Reviews (November 2025–September 2026): Mont Blanc on a tart base, pistachio Mont Blanc, strawberry shortcake, strawberry cheese tart, raspberry mousse, Shine Muscat tart, summer-strawberry mille-feuille, the Horie Pudding featured on TV, moelleux chocolat ¥410, tigre ¥410, financier ¥302 (March 2026, with a notice of an April price rise), one seat outside.

食べログ (店舗会員): コジーナ邸 鶏白湯ラーメンと豪快な居酒屋料理＆鍋 本町.en: Tabelog (shop member): Cucina Tei (chicken paitan ramen, hearty izakaya food and hot pots, Honmachi-Awaza); izakaya, chanko, ramen; Awaza 1-15-19 (Nishi-ku), エイトハウスビル 2F; 5 minutes' walk from exits 22 and 23 of Hommachi Station; Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30), Sat 11:30–15:00; closed Sundays and holidays; evenings are private hire for one group a night (8–22 people); Saturday evenings for private courses only; courses with two-hour self-serve all-you-can-drink (all-you-can-eat kara-age and homemade chashu ¥4,500, chicken and vegetable paitan chanko ¥5,000, Gout Nabe of oysters, monkfish liver and milt ¥6,500); cancellation ¥1,000 per person (the course price on the day); the popular chicken paitan ramen at lunch; soup by a chef with Italian roots and a ramen artisan. Reviews (September 2025–August 2026): White Ramen ¥900; lunch set ¥1,000 (mini salad and three Italian vegetable dishes); chicken paitan of porcini, aromatic vegetables and olive oil; thin curly noodles; pink chashu and chicken ham; mizuna; green sauce ¥150; seasoned egg ¥150; anchovy mazesoba; cheese-fondue tsukemen; noodles from Menya Teigaku; low-temperature kara-age; cash-only ticket machine; Maximum the Hormone posters; featured on Kansai TV's Yo-idon; some say the soup was lukewarm, the chicken cold or the noodles stuck together.

食べログ (店舗会員): コプチャンち 心斎橋店、韓国料理・ホルモン・居酒屋、大.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Kopuchan Chi Shinsaibashi, Korean, offal, izakaya; LERIFA心斎橋ビル 1F, 1-2-7 Shinsaibashi-suji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Stn exit 5; Mon–Fri 10:00–15:00 and 16:00–24:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 10:00–24:00; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 48 seats; a heated-tobacco smoking area; children welcome; English, Chinese and Korean menus; Korean-speaking staff; opened 15 April 2022. Shop introduction (English translation): a kopchang (beef small intestine) specialist, grilled on a hot plate in a secret sauce, bokkeumbap to finish, beef samgyeopsal said to be found only here in Kansai. Reviews (June–September 2026): kopchang wrapped in perilla leaves, bossam, chanja, samgyeopsal with green chillies, seafood or offal sundubu jjigae, gyeran-jjim, seolleongtang lunch, chijimi, kimchi and namul, all-you-can-drink, K-pop, many young customers, a gacha spin for bills over ¥10,000.

食べログ (店舗会員): サムギョプサル ホブ、韓国料理、大阪市北区堂島1-5-.en: Tabelog (shop member): Samgyeopsal Hobu, Korean, Espas Kitashinchi 25 4F, 1-5-5 堂島, Kita-ku, Osaka; 5 min from Nishi-Umeda and Kitashinchi stations; 17:30–1:00; closed Sundays, holidays and irregular days; online bookings until 22:00 (later by phone); automatic cancellation at 15 minutes late without contact; service charge 5%; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 10 seats (counter of 6, table of 4); non-smoking; a new concept from the upscale Osaka tempura restaurant Numada; the owner, who loves samgyeopsal, found Hokkaido's 'Doro Buta' and micro herbs and opened in April 2026; Doro Buta with over 20 kinds of micro herbs; ten namul and soup; cold noodles and bibimbap to finish; white and rosé wines for pork; a course with 20 herbs ¥11,000. Reviews (July–September 2026): Tokachi free-range pork chuck and belly; perilla leaves; ssamjang; kimchi; namul (Manji peppers, carrot, zucchini, myoga, okra, celery and more); pork and clam chige; Hirado shiitake; Kumamoto Akaushi beef; cold noodles with whitebait and tomato; no garlic; the staff grill for you; a seven-herb set for two ¥11,000; a comment that it is the shop of Michelin-starred Mr Numata.

食べログ (店舗会員): サロン・ド・モンシェール 本店～心斎橋～、カフェ・ケー.en: Tabelog (shop member): Salon de Mon cher main shop (Shinsaibashi); café, cake; Nishi-Shinsaibashi 1-13-21; exit 16 of Shinsaibashi Station; daily 10:00–19:00 (L.O. 18:30); irregular closures; reservations; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) accepted, no e-money; 31 seats (eight in special rooms); non-smoking; children welcome; takeaway; opened 3 October 2013, reopened August 2020; Mon cher's only eat-in salon in Kansai; afternoon tea, fruit sandwiches, kakigori. Reviews (July–October 2026): Dojima Roll and egg sandwich set; a seasonal plate (Dojima Roll, cheesecake, macarons, Mont Blanc); afternoon tea on a silver stand; strawberry and pistachio kakigori ¥1,528; peach and Shine Muscat kakigori; strawberry parfait; classic chocolate cake; pasta; write your name and wait; waits of 30 minutes to an hour; one says the egg sandwich has changed.

食べログ (店舗会員): シュラスコ・イタリアン・ビュッフェ、中京区河原町通蛸薬.en: Tabelog (staff-maintained): churrasco, Italian, buffet; 中京区河原町通蛸薬師下る塩屋町321 ドン・キホーテ四条河原町店 6F; 2 min on foot from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn; Mon–Fri 16:00–23:30, Sat 12:00–23:00, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:30 (last order food 22:30, drinks 23:00); reservations accepted (same day too); one drink per person or free drinks; 2-hour sittings; premium all-you-can-eat ¥4,990; standard ¥3,990; Italian all-you-can-eat and drink ¥3,500; ¥500 more from 12 to 31 December; 100 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome; cards, PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay; no service or table charge; menus in English, traditional Chinese and Korean; opened 1 May 2025 (the shop text says May 2023); Asian/Ethnic WEST Tabelog 100 2026; operator site will-food.com. Reviews (October–November 2026, in English): a Brazilian chef, pineapple, pão de queijo, curry, salad bar, ¥500 more on Sundays, child prices, complaints of tough beef and clumsy carving, a skewer that hit a diner's neck, sauce containers left open.

食べログ (店舗会員): ジャルダン、ビストロ・ビュッフェ・カフェ、大阪市北区堂.en: Tabelog (shop member): Jardin, bistro, buffet and café, Four Seasons Hotel 1F, 2-4-32 Dojima, Kita-ku, Osaka; Watanabebashi Station; daily 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–21:30 (last order 21:00); two hours per table; dinner buffet only on Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; inquiries via the hotel's main number; service charge 15%; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 118 seats; terrace; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; English-speaking staff; breakfast; free Wi-Fi; vegetarian options; a French bistro with big windows; seasonal afternoon tea; dinner courses of seasonal ingredients; weekday lunch of the day (salad, soup, main, drink) ¥3,500; lunch three courses 'French gourmet journey' ¥6,200; a ¥7,800 course; Shine Muscat afternoon tea from September; allergies in advance. Reviews (August–October 2026): melon afternoon tea ¥6,160; cheaper after 14:00 on weekdays; a second-anniversary afternoon tea with a chef from Four Seasons Bangkok (melon maritozzo, matcha-peach-yuzu mousse, pecan mousse); a Lyon-themed lunch; brioche refills; free-flow; terrace seats; a comment that early on many staff spoke little Japanese; lively with children and photographers.

食べログ (店舗会員): スチーム Dim sum&Wine、港区六本木4-12.en: Tabelog (shop member): Steam Dim sum & Wine, Roppongi 4-12-2, 佐々木ビル B1F, 3 min walk from Roppongi Station; Mon–Fri 18:00–22:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–15:00 and 18:00–21:00; two-hour limit at dinner; lunch only as courses on weekends and holidays (book by 21:00 the day before); may close early with no bookings; ¥880 table charge; 20 seats; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards accepted; school-age children and older; no strollers because of steep stairs; sommelier. Shop text: dim sum with seasonal ingredients and Chinese, Japanese and Western techniques; wines chosen to go with dim sum (natural wines too). Lunch courses: nine dim sum with Chinese tea ¥4,900; with one drink ¥5,500; special course ¥7,500. Reviews (2020–October 2026): steamed pork spare ribs, yellow shumai, spring rolls, chive dumplings, dan dan noodles, steamed fish, yuba rolls, egg tart, seasonal creative dim sum; often full, so booking is needed; some found it average.

食べログ (店舗会員): ステーキ、東山区新門前通大和大路東入西之町232-6、.en: Tabelog (staff-maintained): steak; 東山区新門前通大和大路東入西之町232-6; 3 min on foot from Sanjo Keihan Stn; daily 11:30–13:00 and 17:00–22:00; reservations accepted; 10% service charge; cards (VISA, Master, JCB); no e-money or QR; 15 seats; private rooms; non-smoking; takeaway; Steak・Teppanyaki Tabelog 100 2022, WEST 2024 and 2025. Shop text: a long-established Gion restaurant, aged kuroge wagyu, teppanyaki. Reviews (March–October 2026, in English): Omi beef (A4, or A4–A5 depending on supply), lunch steak gozen ¥8,000, omakase course ¥18,000, garlic rice, soy-butter sauce, a change of owner (April 2026), a place loved by Hiroki Matsukata (September 2026), a narrow alley.

食べログ (店舗会員): ステーキハウス 野田 お初天神 梅田店、ステーキ・鉄板.en: Tabelog (shop member): Steak House Noda Ohatsutenjin Umeda Ten, steak, teppanyaki and seafood, KIYO BLD2 1F, 2-5-33 曽根崎, Kita-ku, Osaka; right by Ohatsu Tenjin; 5 min from Higashi-Umeda Station; Mon–Sat and holidays 17:00–22:00; closed Sundays; reservations accepted; service charge; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 10 seats (counter); private hire for 9–10; designated smoking area; smart casual; A5 black wagyu grilled on the teppan in front of you; the fillet and strip loin half-and-half is popular; a course with 180 g of black wagyu ¥9,900; an anniversary course with a message cake ¥13,200; a business course ¥14,850; you might see magic. Invoice registration: an individual, 野田博臣. Reviews (May 2022–August 2026): a round counter; prawns and mushrooms baked in foil; stir-fried bean sprouts; salad with salted kombu; grilled vegetables (thick fried tofu, pumpkin, potato, onion); abalone, scallops and squid on the teppan; steak on bread and shrimp crackers; bread grilled in the meat juices and butter; octopus crackers; flambé; the cheerful master's magic; many regulars; a comment that it was founded in 1975; cheap for teppanyaki.

食べログ (店舗会員): センバキッチン 南船場本店、イタリアン・ダイニングバー.en: Tabelog (shop member): Semba Kitchen Minami-Senba main shop; Italian, dining bar, izakaya; Minami-Senba 4-13-12, OM Building 1F; 5 minutes' walk from exit 3 of Shinsaibashi Station, 3 minutes from exit 13 of Crista Nagahori; Sun–Thu and holidays 15:00–23:00, Fri, Sat and the day before a holiday 15:00–24:00; table charge ¥330; courses with all-you-can-drink from ¥4,000; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 80 seats; standing parties up to 90; terrace; open kitchen; non-smoking; English menu; digital menu; opened 15 September 2010; charcoal-grilled meats such as Tokachi beef, tapas, pasta and pizza. Reviews (May–October 2026): anchovy potato salad; salmon carpaccio; trippa; rotisserie chicken; charcoal tandoori chicken; fresh pasta from Awaji Seimen (corn cacio e pepe, tarako butter); a ¥2,500 share course; QR ordering; some complaints of tough meat, overly soft pasta, a seat by the restroom and the service.

食べログ (店舗会員): ゼックスウエスト 炙り焼き＆寿司 アン、寿司・海鮮・日.en: Tabelog (shop member): XEX WEST aburiyaki & sushi An, sushi, seafood and Japanese cuisine, 梅田2-2-22, 7F of Herbis PLAZA ENT (west lifts), Kita-ku, Osaka; from the Hanshin Umeda west gate or the Nishi-Umeda north gate, 2 min on foot from the Sakurabashi exit of JR Osaka Station; 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:00), 17:30–23:00 (last order 21:30); closed when Herbis PLAZA ENT closes; dinner seat charge ¥580 and 10% service; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 22 seats; non-smoking; children welcome at lunch, primary-school age and up at dinner; at dinner no sleeveless tops, shorts or sandals (men). XEX WEST has Italian, Japanese and a bar on one floor (The BAR, Salvatore Cuomo Bros.). Japanese cuisine and Edo-mae sushi from seasonal ingredients and fish from nearby waters. Lunch: tempura set with a Shine Muscat dessert buffet ¥5,000; starters, 8 omakase nigiri and a toasting sake ¥4,800. Reviews (March–September 2026): dislikes asked first; sushi placed according to the hand you eat with; horse mackerel; monaka with whipped cream and red bean; five pieces of squid; a little cheaper than the Tokyo shop; tempura set and melon dessert buffet; fried eggplant; bonito tataki; hamo soup; soba to finish; shrimp and corn tempura; splashed with water from washing fish; counter sushi at fair prices; taro, edamame, pumpkin tofu, sea bream and bonito sashimi, winter melon and sea bream soup, matsutake tempura, charcoal-grilled wagyu, matsutake rice; just under ¥20,000 with drinks.

食べログ (店舗会員): タワンタイ (TAWANTHAI)、タイ料理・カレー・.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): TAWANTHAI, Thai, curry and dining bar, グラン・ビルド心斎橋 1F, Minami-Senba 2-6-21, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 5 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station, 7 min from Shinsaibashi Station, Mon–Sat 11:00–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00), closed Sunday, takeaway and Uber Eats until 21:00, reservations accepted (not for lunch or the terrace), cards, e-money, PayPay and Rakuten Pay accepted, 30 seats, sofa seats, open terrace, non-smoking (terrace too), children welcome, no pets, opened 5 December 1999. Shop introduction (machine-translated): authentic Thai food that is easy for Japanese diners, a menu with photos and descriptions, gapao rice, tom kha gai. Reviews (August–October 2026): khao man gai, tom yum noodles ¥1,050 (no coriander, heat adjusted with condiments), pad thai, gapao rice, shrimp spring rolls, green curry, minced-pork salad, minced-pork omelette, gai yang, pad kee mao, pad see ew, soft-shell crab in yellow curry, satay with peanut sauce, a curry-and-soup lunch set, busy at weekday noon, no PayPay when using a coupon.

食べログ (店舗会員): チェルピーナ邸 イタリア石窯料理と天然酵母ピザ 心斎橋.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Cher Pina, Italian stone-oven cuisine and natural-yeast pizza, Shinsaibashi・Minami-Senba; pizza, izakaya, Italian; B1F クリエイティブ心斎橋 (TUDOR on 1F), 4-4-8 Minami-Senba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Shinsaibashi Stn exit 3; Tue–Sun and holidays 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:30–23:00 (food L.O. 21:30); closed Mondays (may open for private hire); reservations accepted; cancellation fee on the day; starter ¥300 (free refills, none at lunch or with a course); cards, e-money and QR accepted; private hire for 25–40; opened 4 February 2014. Shop introduction (English translation): a casual Italian street izakaya with stone-oven pizza and fresh pasta; natural-yeast pizza dough ten years in the making (fluffy thick Milanese and crisp thin Roman styles; five Hokkaido flours, salt from Italy, natural yeast from Akita, a secret olive oil); a wine-loving chef trained in Rome's taverns; a dessert plate with a message ¥880. Reviews (September 2025–October 2026): banquet course with two hours of drinks ¥5,000 (grissini and pickles refilled, Italian salad, five appetizers, fries, a pizza such as Bismarck, pasta); lunch pasta set ¥1,200; beef-tendon meat-sauce pasta; an antique atmosphere; the entrance is on 1F with stairs down straight inside; some regret Tabasco on the table and no knives.

食べログ (店舗会員): テーブル36、イタリアン・ダイニングバー・洋菓子、大阪.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Table 36, Italian, dining bar and Western sweets, Swissotel Nankai Osaka 36F, Namba 5-1-60, Chuo-ku, Osaka; directly connected to Nankai Namba Station; views from 147 m up; breakfast 6:30–10:30; lunch weekdays 11:30–15:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–15:30; dinner 18:00–23:30 (Fri and Sat to 24:30); online booking 24 hours; cards accepted; 150 seats; a private room for 8–12; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; parking (2 hours free with ¥6,000 spent); open kitchen; weekday international lunch buffet ¥5,900 (autumn 2026: porcini risotto, sweet-potato and chestnut gratin, Filipino pork adobo, Thai green curry, lamb on weekdays and wagyu ribeye at weekends, chestnut, sweet-potato and pumpkin desserts); about 30 sweets; American à la carte and wagyu and tomahawk steaks at dinner; live music Fri–Sun; allergy information available. Reviews (July–October 2026): the window view, egg tarts, canelés, chocolate fondue, blueberry muffins, roast beef carved in front of you, cilantro, salsa, century egg, hummus and fruit at breakfast, free-flow drinks ¥4,400, a lift from the 6F lobby, a review saying staff were short.

食べログ (店舗会員): トッサ・ジ・クラッサン、居酒屋・海鮮・フレンチ、大阪市.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Tossa Ji Croissant, izakaya, seafood and French, Kitahorie 1-6-19, Nishi-ku, Osaka, 1 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exit 4, one street west of Yotsubashi-suji, Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:00), closed the 1st to 4th Sundays (open on a 5th Sunday), reservations accepted (lunch until 13:45, two people may be at the counter, private rooms by phone with a course for 5 or more), no cover charge, cards and PayPay accepted, 62 seats (8 at the 1F counter, 22 at tables, 32 on 2F), private rooms for 5–32, non-smoking, opened 6 January 2017. Shop introduction (machine-translated): seasonal Kochi ingredients turned Japanese-Western with French technique, bonito landed in Tosa that day straw-grilled to order, more than 20 Kochi sakes, many families with children on Sundays. Reviews (September–October 2026): an obanzai set comparing straw-grilled bonito and Tosa yellowtail ¥1,980, best eaten with salt, straw-grilling in front of you, small dishes, a raw egg, a Tosa yellowtail seafood bowl, namero, a lunch bottle of beer ¥800, courses with all-you-can-drink, sukiyaki, pasta, and a view that it is pricey for lunch but good.

食べログ (店舗会員): トレイントレイン、居酒屋・バル・ワインバー、中京区海老.en: Tabelog (shop member): Train Train — izakaya / bar / wine bar; 327 Ebiya-cho, Nakagyo-ku; 5 min on foot from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn; Tue–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–22:30, Sun 12:00–17:00 (café); closed Monday; 20 seats (4 at the counter); non-smoking; cards accepted; opened 2 February 2022; daily dishes from starters to mains (French, Italian, Japanese); about 200 wines, mainly French, about 10 by the glass. Reviews (June–October 2026, English): appetizer platter (meat and vegetables mixed on request), black Neapolitan (squid ink), gratin of salmon and Kamo eggplant, itoyori and mussels simmered, rare-fried sawara, braised pork belly with lentils, hashed beef, pudding.

食べログ (店舗会員): ハリマ・ケバブ・ビリヤニ、東上野3-36-7 1F、稲.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Halima Kebab Biryani, Higashi-Ueno 3-36-7, 1F, 205 m from Inaricho Station, near Ueno Mitsui Garden Hotel; daily 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); lunch reservations for courses only; 50 seats; non-smoking; cards accepted; children welcome; kids' menu; takeout; opened 9 June 2014; Curry Tabelog 100 2017–2020, Asian & Ethnic TOKYO Tabelog 100 2022–2024; sister shops Sabera Tikka Biryani, Anas Dosa Biryani, Halal Dosa Biryani. Menu (updated 2022): vegetarian biryani, vegetable curries, the dal uses butter. Reviews (October 2026): chicken biryani and lassi set ¥1,150 (with salad, soup and raita; one diner paid ¥1,250); large portions; a queue at lunch; a Muslim set of half mutton biryani and butter chicken; three curries with naan; one diner felt the staff's attitude was poor. A May 2024 review: a halal restaurant, no alcohol.

食べログ (店舗会員): ハワイアン食堂 HALE、大阪市中央区博労町1-8-1.en: Tabelog (corporate member): Hawaiian Shokudo HALE, Hakuromachi 1-8-12, Chuo-ku, Osaka, in the エスライズ堺筋本町 building, 5 min walk from Nagahoribashi and Sakaisuji-Hommachi Stns; no reservations; cards, transit IC, iD, QUICPay, PayPay accepted; no service charge; 20 seats (13 inside, 10 on the terrace); non-smoking; dogs allowed on the terrace; children welcome; English menu; takeout and delivery; opened 2 September 2019; Osaka's first custom poke specialist, over 10,000 combinations, a seasonal limited poke every month. Official site: Hawaiian Shokudo HALE (read ハワイアンショクドウハレ); weekdays 11:00–19:00 (L.O. 18:30), Saturday and holidays 11:00–16:00 (L.O. 15:30), closed Sunday; Uber Eats and smartphone pre-order; menu: Original poke bowl ¥1,150, Classic poke bowl ¥1,100, loco moco ¥1,170, mochiko chicken plate ¥1,080, garlic shrimp plate ¥1,400, açaí bowl ¥1,550, ahi poke ¥870, Kona coffee ¥820. Run by Hawaiisukiyane Co. (founded January 2025; also 3POKE OSAKA, SUNNY ISLAND SURF, Hawaiian 8 Market). Reviews (April 2025–June 2026): choose on an order sheet, 1 base, 2 mains, 4 sides, 1 sauce, 1 topping; extras cost more; multigrain rice, salad, half and half; tuna, salmon, roast beef, avocado, tomato, tobiko, egg yolk, edamame; sauce of soy sauce, sesame oil and garlic oil; garlic shrimp you can eat shells and all; mochiko chicken; loco moco; salads come with miso soup; weekday lunch can be full; few seats.

食べログ (店舗会員): バンコク、港区六本木3-8-8 六本木ＷＯＯビル2F、.en: Tabelog (shop member): Bangkok, Roppongi 3-8-8, Roppongi WOO building 2F, 2 min walk from Roppongi Station exit 5; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Sundays; 28 seats (tables); private hire for 20–50; non-smoking; cards accepted; children and strollers welcome; takeout; vegetarian options. Shop text: authentic flavours kept for more than 35 years by chefs of the Thai Embassy; courses such as the six-dish Light Course ¥3,000. Reviews (June–October 2026): lunch ¥1,100 (large ¥1,200) with soup, salad and dessert; half-and-half Gapao and green curry; a mini curry +¥200; lunch is cash only; Pad See Ew; at night soft-shell crab curry and Tom Yum Goong; staff from overseas who speak good Japanese.

食べログ (店舗会員): パフェと酒と、、、金魚、スイーツ・バー、大阪市中央区難.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Parfait to Sake to,,, Kingyo, sweets, bar; 法善寺サンヨービル B1F, 1-2-2 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Namba Stn; daily 14:00–2:00; reservations accepted; cards (including UnionPay) accepted, no e-money or QR; 30 seats; non-smoking; opened 18 December 2024. Reviews (July–October 2026): a night-parfait shop; ground-floor entrance down to the basement; stairs hung with goldfish lanterns; a big goldfish tank on the counter; about six parfaits; cassis Mont Blanc ¥2,400 (before tax) with whisky and cassis; melon and muscat bouquet parfait ¥2,400; cassis tea Mont Blanc; tarte tatin; cocktails, highballs, gin soda, hot lemon tea; nearly full by 20:00–21:00 on Friday nights; prices on the high side.

食べログ (店舗会員): ヒマラヤンビレッジ、ネパール料理、インドカレー、日本橋.en: Tabelog (shop member): Himalayan Village; Nepalese, Indian curry; HSビル B1F, Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 1-7-6; 30 seconds from Ningyocho Station exit A2; daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); open on holidays; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; no service charge; 28 seats; non-smoking (smoking area outside); private hire up to 50; opened 12 May 2008; freshly baked naan and curry by a Nepalese chef; Nepalese and Indian beers; all-you-can-eat-and-drink courses from ¥3,000. Reviews (July–October 2026): daily lunch ¥950 with two curries, naan and rice, free refills; dal bhat set ¥1,180 (bean curry, sautéed spinach, potatoes); mutton curry, keema, cheese naan; spice by level; 18th anniversary in May; a ¥4,000 evening course with three hours of drinks; one day half the customers were from overseas.

食べログ (店舗会員): ビストロ モンブレ (montbellet)、ビストロ.en: Tabelog (shop member): Bistro montbellet, bistro and dining bar, B1F, Yotsuya 1-8-14; in the basement of the beef-bowl chain's building as seen from the Yotsuya-mitsuke intersection; 2 min walk from Yotsuya Station; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 18:00–23:00 (last order 21:30); closed Sundays, generally open on holidays; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 seats; non-smoking; opened 23 April 2021. Reviews (July 2025–September 2026): weekly fish lunch ¥1,350–1,500 (sea bream or sea bass, porcini or beurre blanc), three starters with soup, bread or rice, dessert ¥400, ¥5,500 dinner course, snow-crab flan, paprika mousse, liver pâté, seafood gratin, Ezo venison, beef tongue in red wine, rum-raisin nougat glacé, quick, humorous explanations, a shy chef, about three tables, full by 11:45 at lunch.

食べログ (店舗会員): ビストロ・フレンチ・肉料理、中京区御幸町通錦小路下る大.en: Tabelog (staff-maintained): bistro, French, meat dishes; 中京区御幸町通錦小路下る大日町403; 1 min on foot from Kawaramachi Stn (Hankyu); Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–23:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–15:30 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–23:00; closed Wednesday and one irregular day a month; 23–25 December 2026 Christmas course only; reservations accepted (tell the shop about allergies in advance; cancellation fees apply); a cover charge at night except with a course; 21 seats; cards and PayPay accepted; non-smoking; children welcome, kids' menu; vegetarian options; casual French with Kyoto vegetables, meat and fresh fish; dinner course ¥5,200; Christmas course ¥11,000 (lobster thermidor). Reviews (April–July 2026, in English): a one-chef kitchen, curry before dessert, bread refills, lunches ¥2,200 and ¥3,500, a counter on the ground floor and tables upstairs, one diner found the kitchen dirty, one was told cash only.

食べログ (店舗会員): ビランチャ 梅田店、イタリアン・パスタ・ビアガーデン、.en: Tabelog (shop member): Bilancia Umeda, Italian, pasta and beer garden, NU Chayamachi 8F, 10-12 Chayamachi, Kita-ku, Osaka; right by the Hankyu Chayamachi exit; Mon–Thu, Sundays and holidays 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); Fri, Sat and the day before a holiday 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); follows NU Chayamachi's hours; reservations accepted; no split bills; lunch 90 minutes when busy; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 115 seats (60 on the terrace in fine weather); a private room for 8; non-smoking; an all-you-can-eat lunch of breads from popular bakeries across Japan (from ¥1,800); two hours of 45 dishes all you can eat (chicken ¥3,500, chicken and pork ¥4,000); all-you-can-drink ¥1,000, premium wine ¥1,500, craft beer ¥1,800; wood-fired pizza of homemade dough; renewed 10 August 2026. Invoice registration: Cosmic Diner Co., Ltd. (Nozaki-cho). Reviews (September–October 2026): the bread buffet with a chosen main, soup and drink bar; mentaiko cream pasta; burdock and bacon arrabbiata; grilled chicken; pan-seared sea bream; beef steak; sweet-potato croissant; corn bread; chocolate croissant; squid-ink mentaiko baguette; French toast; toasters; the 45-dish buffet; prosciutto; caprese; seafood marinade; pâté de campagne; fried chicken; ordering by smartphone; one comment that the bread was hard and seemed frozen.

食べログ (店舗会員): フランス料理 レ・セレブリテ ホテル日航大阪、大阪市中.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): French restaurant Les Celebrites, Hotel Nikko Osaka 3F, Nishi-Shinsaibashi 1-3-3, Chuo-ku, Osaka; directly connected to Shinsaibashi Station exit 8; Fri, Sun and holidays 11:30–14:30 and 17:30–21:00 (L.O. 20:30), Sat and the day before holidays to 21:30 (L.O. 21:00); closed Monday to Thursday (except holidays); reservations accepted; with a seat-only booking, the meal is chosen on the day; service charge 15%; cards, transport IC, WAON and QR payments accepted; 28 seats; a private room for 10–20; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; parking. Reviews (November 2024–September 2026): a long-established French restaurant open only on weekends and holidays, courses at ¥7,500, ¥10,000 and ¥13,000 (August 2025), a ¥10,000 Friday dinner (February 2026), a ¥32,000 executive course (March 2025), pâté en croûte, lobster bisque, wagyu fillet Rossini, bouillabaisse, two breads and butters, many dessert plates, as many petits fours as you like, and one July 2026 review that found the main-course meat tough.

食べログ (店舗会員): フーロン、中華料理、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-2-4 谷.en: Tabelog (shop member): Hu-Long, Chinese, 谷安セストビル 2F, 1-2-4 曽根崎新地, Kita-ku, Osaka; 3 min on foot from JR Kitashinchi Station exit 11-23; Mon 18:00–22:00; Tue–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–22:00; Sat 18:00–21:00; closed Sundays and holidays; occasional temporary closures; reservation only (no lunch bookings, lunch ends when sold out); call after 14:00 to book; 10% service charge at dinner only; cards and QR accepted, lunch cash and PayPay only; 13 seats (counter of 9, one table for 4); non-smoking; opened 20 May 2009; Tabelog Chinese WEST 100 in 2021, 2023 and 2024; modern Chinese; Shanghai crab yakisoba (ultra-thin Hong Kong noodles under a crab-miso sauce); Shaoxing wine aged 3–5 years in jars; an eight-dish course with Peking duck and braised shark fin ¥10,000 (plus tax); plate lunch ¥1,500; mapo tofu rice set ¥1,400. Invoice registration: an individual, 北村克治. Reviews (June–October 2026): plate lunch (soup, salad, sweet and sour pork, boiled dumplings, stir-fried seafood, sesame balls, almond jelly); a Friday-only noodle lunch; mapo tofu (numbing Sichuan pepper, chicken broth); Peking duck; ebi mayo; sweet and sour pork; Shanghai crab yakisoba; beef with green peppers; smaller portions on request; a comment that it is run by a man and a woman from China; one chef, so dishes come slowly.

食べログ (店舗会員): プティ ボヌール、東上野1-15-1、仲御徒町駅から徒.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Petit Bonheur, Higashi-Ueno 1-15-1, 2 min on foot from Naka-Okachimachi Station; Mon–Fri 11:45–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 18:00–23:00 (food L.O. 21:30), Sat 18:00–22:00; closed Sundays; hours may change; coperto 10%; 16 seats (4 at the counter, 12 at tables); non-smoking (smoking space); lunch cash and PayPay only; opened 8 March 2012; a French-cuisine chef with overseas training and experience at Michelin-starred restaurants; no chemical seasonings or additives; horse sashimi; natural and organic wines. Reviews (October 2025–August 2026): marinated mushrooms; horse tartare; Gorgonzola soufflé; karasumi peperoncino; lunch pasta sets ¥1,200 and ¥1,300 (with salad and a drink); horse sashimi and horse fillet with sweet soy and horseradish; white asparagus; amatriciana; bottles from about ¥3,000; sardine jelly; pâté de campagne; hachis parmentier; corn mousse; a hidden door like a wine shelf; one chef and one server; ortolana; gnocchi; one found the prosciutto underwhelming.

食べログ (店舗会員): プーサン、プリン・洋菓子・スイーツ、西区新町3-4-2.en: Tabelog (shop member): Poussin, pudding, Western sweets and sweets, Shinmachi 3-4-2, Nishi-ku, ミーネ新町館 1F, 3 min on foot from Nishi-Ohashi or Nishi-Nagahori Station, Mon–Sat 10:00–20:00 (until sold out), reservations taken 10:00–19:00, closed Sundays, public holidays and the first Tuesday of each month, takeaway specialist, cards, e-money and QR accepted, non-smoking, children welcome, opened 10 July 2008, Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2023 and 2026. Tabelog menu (posted by the shop, read in English translation): signature custard pudding ¥300, rich organic chocolate pudding ¥380, two-layer cheesecake and pudding ¥330, daily puddings ¥330 (black sesame, world honey, almond, salted caramel, rum raisin, kinako, royal milk tea, organic hojicha, organic coffee, brown sugar, organic soy milk and more), seasonal puddings, pistachio pudding ¥380, pistachio cream puff, Basque cheesecake and crème brûlée ¥500 each, pistachio gelato ¥600, kakigori ¥750, açaí bowl ¥980, mixed juice with pudding ¥450. Reviews (July 2024–October 2026): even more delicious custard pudding ¥300, Okinawa brown-sugar pudding ¥300, baked-apple pudding ¥350, ruby grapefruit pudding, kiwi kakigori ¥750, run by the owner couple, puddings held by phone or Instagram, prices raised in May 2026, pistachio sometimes sold out to reservations, two chairs in front of the shop, customers served one at a time.

食べログ (店舗会員): ベトナム酒場 ビアホイ、ベトナム料理・アジア・エスニッ.en: Tabelog (shop member): Vietnam Sakaba Bia Hoi, Vietnamese, Asian, ethnic and izakaya, 角田町2-15, B1F of 城口ビル, Kita-ku, Osaka; 10 min on foot from JR Osaka and Hankyu Umeda stations; on the EST side of Shin-Midosuji; Mon–Thu 11:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); Fri 11:30–23:00 (last order 22:00); Sat 11:00–23:00; Sun 11:00–22:00; open all year; reservations accepted; 12 or more by phone; cards, e-money and QR accepted (also Merpay, LINE Pay, WeChat Pay); no service charge; 82 seats (with a terrace); non-smoking; vegan and vegetarian options listed; opened 17 July 2001; authentic Vietnamese food by a Vietnamese chef; fresh spring rolls and pho; Vietnamese beer, wine, spirits and cocktails; all-you-can-eat che lunch; Ho Chi Minh course ¥3,500; Vietnam course with 90 minutes of drinks ¥4,800; Bia Hoi course ¥5,800. Reviews (May–October 2026): stir-fried water spinach; tom yum goong; shrimp and lettuce lemongrass fried rice; che; beef-tendon pho with a mini rice bowl for ¥100; bun cha; bun bo hue; banh mi and che buffet; smartphone ordering; free extra coriander; green papaya salad; banh xeo; stuffed squid; wild boar in fermented shrimp sauce; frog; lime-leaf fries; full with a queue at weekday lunch; a customer of over 20 years; some customers who seemed Vietnamese.

食べログ (店舗会員): 丑寅、立ち飲み、難波千日前15-19、地下鉄なんば駅か.en: Tabelog (shop member): Ushi Tora, standing bar, Namba Sennichimae 15-19, 5 min on foot from Namba Station (subway), 3 min from Nankai Namba Station, Mon–Fri 16:00–23:00, Sat–Sun 15:00–23:00, holidays 15:00–22:00, open all year, no reservations, no cards or e-money, 28 standing, smoking allowed, no minors, no soft drinks, no groups of three or more from October 2026, Tachinomi Tabelog 100 2025. Tabelog menu (read in English translation): kara-age with rakkyo tartar sauce ¥350, ginger tempura ¥180. Reviews (June 2024–October 2026): three-item assortment for one ¥500, obanzai laid out on the counter, sashimi platter, bluefin tuna, namero, grilled conger eel (shirayaki), uzaku, dashimaki, kara-age, mega Kaku highball ¥700, a wide sake list, the rule is not to linger, a short wait outside, mostly women on the staff.

食べログ (店舗会員): 世界のワイン博物館 グランフロント大阪店、イタリアン・.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sekai no Wine Hakubutsukan, Grand Front Osaka branch, Italian, bistro and wine bar, 大深町3-1, B1F of Grand Front Osaka Shops & Restaurants North Building, Kita-ku, Osaka; 1 min on foot from JR Osaka Station; daily 11:00–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30); lunch 11:00–14:30; closed with the building; reservations accepted; cancellation fees (10% from booking up to 100% three days before); 10% service charge; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 120 seats and a separate party room; private rooms; non-smoking (smoking room on the same floor); opened 26 April 2013; wines by the glass chosen by a senior sommelier; a dispenser that limits deterioration; chandeliers; weekday buffet lunch ¥2,200 (salad bar, starters, pizza, paella, desserts, a main from Italy, France, Germany, America or Spain); two-hour all-you-can-drink courses ¥4,500 and ¥5,000 (charcuterie, Caesar salad, Italian fried chicken, roast pork, Genovese). Run by the ZATO group (zato.co.jp). Reviews (July–October 2026): cordon bleu; cowboy steak; curry; paella; 90 minutes at the buffet; full of group bookings at 17:00; the kara-age in the course; white wine; the same courses as Sekai no Beer Hakubutsukan; quiet on a Saturday night; Belgian-style fries; pizza; pasta; steak lunch about ¥2,150; Riesling; Napa Chardonnay; sparkling wine with cherry-blossom petals; ajillo; cheese.

食べログ (店舗会員): 中国料理 喜羊門 上野店、上野2-12-1 セントラル.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Chinese restaurant Kiyomon Ueno, Ueno 2-12-1, セントラル21ビル 5F, 3 min on foot from the JR Ueno Station Shinobazu exit; daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:15); open all year; service charge (none on courses); course bills cash only; 90 seats; a room for 8; non-smoking; cards (UnionPay too), PayPay, Rakuten Pay, Alipay and WeChat Pay accepted; children welcome; English and Chinese menus with photos; opened 21 September 2018; recipes from a chef from Jilin; a carving performance at the table; wallpaper and chairs by a famous designer. Menu (2022): cold dishes ¥790–1,490 (celery and ginkgo, black-vinegar wood ear, garlic broccoli and cucumber, shredded potato, dried-tofu salad and more). Reviews (September 2025–October 2026): the charcoal-roast lamb leg is crisp outside, juicy inside and not gamey; big enough for 3–4; carved after the photo; sells out unless ordered when booking; lamb shoulder and ribs; tongue and heart; rabbit; sausages; meat pies; lunch of a weekly ¥900 set (liver stir-fry) or cumin lamb ¥1,300 (with salad, soup, almond tofu and a drink); lamb soup ¥1,200; grilling smoke gets into your clothes; a view over Ueno.

食べログ (店舗会員): 中国料理 大成閣 (タイセイカク)、中華料理・飲茶、大.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Chinese Taiseikaku, Chinese and dim sum, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-18-12, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 2 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 5 or 6, daily 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–22:00 (food last order 20:45), closed 30 December–2 January, takeaway (order by phone or fax), Uber Eats and Demae-can, bookings by the day before, private rooms with courses only, cards, e-money and PayPay accepted, about 1,500 seats (up to 400 on one floor), six floors, private rooms, tatami rooms, sofa seats, karaoke, non-smoking (smoking room on 2F), wheelchair accessible, Wi-Fi, partner car-park discount. Shop introduction (machine-translated): founded 1953, its 70th anniversary, featured on TV and in magazines, lunch, banquets, year-end and New Year parties, reunions, concerts, weddings, an online shop. Reviews (August–October 2026): lunch ¥1,000 (¥1,100 with tax) with refills of rice, soup, salad and pickles, free self-service congee and coffee, sweet-potato snacks, sweet-and-sour pork set ¥1,100, matsutake ramen and fried-rice set ¥2,310, tantanmen and boiled dumplings, crab fried rice ¥1,320, mapo tofu ¥1,100, chili prawns ¥1,980, seafood stir-fry ¥1,870, a Showa-modern atmosphere, coming since childhood, and a view of neither good nor bad.

食べログ (店舗会員): 中国料理 桃李 ホテル日航大阪、中華料理・飲茶、大阪市.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Chinese Tori, Hotel Nikko Osaka, Chinese, dim sum; Hotel Nikko Osaka 3F, 1-3-3 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; directly connected to Shinsaibashi Stn exit 8; Sun–Fri and holidays 11:30–14:30 and 17:30–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); Saturdays and days before holidays dinner to 21:30; weekend and holiday lunch in two sittings; reservations accepted (cancel by the day before); service charge 15%; cards (including UnionPay), e-money and QR (including Alipay and WeChat Pay) accepted; 72 seats (up to about 100); private rooms. Shop introduction (English translation): authentic Cantonese cuisine in a noble, modern space like a Chinese mansion; a head chef with 40 years of Chinese cooking who values 'food and medicine are one' and creates new dishes; team gold and individual cold-appetizer silver at the World Chinese Cuisine Competition; aged Shaoxing wine poured at the table from a jar or bottle. Reviews (February–October 2026): Peking duck carved at the table with a sweet miso; crab-roe shark fin soup; spring rolls; peppers stir-fried with meat; fried rice; almond tofu; lunch courses; a prix-fixe course; a dinner course choosing 5 of 15 dishes; a warm dim sum set ¥3,980 in February; gentle flavours; some find it ordinary for hotel prices; one diner mentions other locations.

食べログ (店舗会員): 中国酒家 朝陽閣 長堀店、中華料理・飲茶・餃子、大阪市.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Chinese restaurant Choyokaku Nagahori, Chinese, dim sum and gyoza, Crysta Nagahori underground shopping and gourmet zone, Minami-Senba 2, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 minute from Nagahoribashi Station, 5 minutes from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); irregular closures including building holidays; reservations accepted; cards and e-money accepted, no QR payment; 44 seats; semi-private room (up to 12); non-smoking; children welcome. Known for three dandan noodles, white, black and red; drink plans from ¥3,500. Reviews (August–October 2026): set meals under ¥1,000, fried rice set ¥950, kara-age set ¥990 with an egg-and-sauce dish, sweet and sour pork set, beef with green peppers set, B set, Choyokaku ramen, cold Chinese noodles, a light-drinking set ¥1,290, set meals even after 16:00, the white dandan noodles are sesame and miso, busy at noon but calmer after 12:30.

食べログ (店舗会員): 中華料理 梅香 地蔵横丁店、湯葉と豆腐の店「梅の花」プ.en: Tabelog (shop member): Chinese Meishan, Jizo Yokocho branch, 'produced by the yuba-and-tofu restaurant Ume no Hana'; Chinese, izakaya and ramen; 芝田1-1-3, 1F of Hankyu Sanbangai South Building, Kita-ku, Osaka; 34 m from Osaka-Umeda Station; daily 11:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); reservations accepted; no allergy requests; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 24 seats; non-smoking; opened 27 June 2025; Chinese food with tofu and yuba, as only the Ume no Hana group does it; at lunch sets of dandan noodles or fried rice, at night shrimp-chilli sets and dim sum; one soup and three dishes per set; happy hour (draft beer ¥308, highball ¥219); sister shop in Hankyu Sanbangai. Reviews (July–October 2026): formerly Shishirin; ramen and mini fried rice; ume-salt ramen; kara-age with chilli sauce; W main set ¥1,960 (mapo tofu and Yurinchi, with dim sum); shrimp-chilli set; ramen with four dim sum; mapo ramen ¥1,900; tofu salad; fried rice with Yurinchi; senbero set ¥1,000; grilled gyoza; yuba and fish-paste tempura ¥583; soy-milk shrimp mayonnaise ¥638; bite-size tofu shumai ¥528; ramen set ¥1,380; a cramped room; one diner was bothered by staff chatting; one felt the food was reheated from frozen.

食べログ (店舗会員): 中華料理 福香源、中華料理・居酒屋・ラーメン、大阪市淀.en: Tabelog (shop member): Chinese Fukukogen; Chinese, izakaya, ramen; 3-13-1 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; about 2 minutes on foot from Hankyu Minamikata Station and Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; Mon–Sat and holidays 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Sunday; reservations accepted; cards, transport IC cards and PayPay accepted; 70 seats (tables); non-smoking. Reviews (May 2024 to October 2026): opened March 2024; daily lunch ¥700–850; large rice free; mapo tofu with kara-age or ebi mayo; eight-treasure stir-fry; green pepper and beef stir-fry; sweet and sour pork; shrimp chili; chive and pork; shark-fin-sauce fried rice set ¥1,000; mapo knife-cut noodles ¥800; Taiwanese ramen with half fried rice; cold noodles; chicken shio ramen; steamed chicken with scallion oil ¥650; two-hour all-you-can-eat-and-drink of 58 dishes ¥3,630; mainly Sichuan; full to the 2nd floor at lunch.

食べログ (店舗会員): 中華料理 香満楼、中華料理・居酒屋・ラーメン、大阪府淀.en: Tabelog (shop member): Chinese Komandou; Chinese, izakaya, ramen; 6-4-17 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 5 minutes on foot from Shin-Osaka Station and Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; daily 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closing days not fixed; lunch set meals cannot be booked; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 48 seats (parties of 30–50 by reservation); smoking allowed; takeaway; opened 28 May 2019. The shop's introduction: authentic Chinese cooking by a Chinese chef with over ten years of experience; shrimp chili, mapo tofu, Peking duck, shark-fin soup. Plans (tax included): two-hour all-you-can-order buffet of 50 dishes with drinks ¥3,800, ¥3,500 at lunch, food only ¥3,000; under-3s free, primary-school age and up ¥1,500; a charge for food left over; courses for four or more from ¥3,980 (abalone, shark fin, Peking duck). Reviews (March 2025 to October 2026): staff from China and friendly; dishes arrive in about four minutes; daily lunch ¥800; shark-fin-sauce fried rice set ¥1,050; rice switched to fried rice, or a mini ramen added, for ¥100; hot and sour noodle soup; mapo hot pot set; green pepper and beef stir-fry set; tomato and egg stir-fry; roast pork; Taiwanese ramen; steamed chicken ¥450; Peking duck ¥1,980; quick-drink set ¥1,200; a line at lunch; no getting in on a Friday without a booking; smoking at the tables.

食べログ (店舗会員): 中華料理・飲茶、中京区河原町二条下ル一之船入町537-.en: Tabelog (staff-maintained): Chinese, dim sum; 中京区河原町二条下ル一之船入町537-50; 2 min on foot from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:30 (last order 13:00) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 20:30); closed Sunday; reservations for courses only (9 or more by phone, 15:00–17:00); 10% service charge, no cover charge; 32 seats; 7 private rooms (2–20 people); tatami and sunken seating; non-smoking; children from elementary school age; cards accepted; sommelier; Chinese WEST Tabelog 100 2021 and 2024. Shop text: a 100-year-old townhouse; food and medicine are one; the eight Chinese cuisines with Japanese and Western techniques; Kyoto seasonal ingredients; listed in the Michelin Guide; Funairi course, 7 dishes ¥11,000; Kongming course ¥14,850; sister shops Gohan Iido Sanjo and Gohan Gyoza. Reviews (August–October 2026, in English and Japanese): Chef Wei, founded 1996, a townhouse that was once a tea house, trained at Banchinro, organic vegetables from contracted farms, braised shark fin, shark fin soup, Peking duck, mango shaved ice, Shaoxing wine, the Takase River from the private rooms.

食べログ (店舗会員): 串かつ ひょうたん 本店、串揚げ・鉄板焼き・居酒屋、大.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Kushikatsu Hyotan Honten, kushiage, teppanyaki and izakaya, はつせビル 1F, Namba Sennichimae 11-25, Chuo-ku, Osaka; behind NGK; 3 minutes from Namba Walk exit B21 or Nannan Town exit E5; daily 11:30–24:00 (L.O. 23:00); open year-round; set meals at lunch only (11:30–16:00); reservations accepted; ¥300 charge; cards and e-money accepted, no QR payment; 140 seats; private rooms (2–30 people); smoking area for heated tobacco only; opened 6 April 2015. Kushikatsu with a carefully developed batter and frying oil, misuji gyukatsu, curry-flavoured 'tulip', tonpei-yaki, homemade crispy fried gyoza, over 50 drinks, 15-dish course ¥3,500, ¥5,000 with all-you-can-drink. Reviews (August–October 2026): 9-skewer lunch, dashimaki set meal ¥720 (before tax), lunches under ¥1,000, doteyaki, shishamo, cucumber with the seeds removed, free cabbage, light batter, skewers arrive together so order a few at a time, one reviewer was told cash only.

食べログ (店舗会員): 串カツ しろたや 道頓堀本店、串揚げ・居酒屋、大阪市中.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Kushi Katsu Shirotaya Dotonbori head shop, kushiage and izakaya, 中座くいだおれビル 3F, Dotonbori 1-7-21, Chuo-ku, Osaka, daily 12:00–16:00 (last order 15:30) and 17:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00), irregular closures, reservations accepted (few online slots at weekends, none on busy days such as long weekends), cards, e-money and QR accepted, 42 seats (mostly counter, tables), private hire 20–50, non-smoking, English menu, photo menu, children and strollers welcome, opened 19 July 2009. Shop introduction (machine-translated): the shop of the food fighter Giant Shirata, a secret batter like powder snow, a blend of animal and vegetable oil, a sauce you dip only once, Giant Takoyaki and Yukimi Daifuku kushikatsu, the "Shirotaya Ultimate Course" of almost everything to eat and drink ¥4,500, beer in a giant mug, an owner 195 cm tall. Official site: the Dotonbori head shop and the Nankai-dori shop, sauce in souvenir sizes. Reviews (September–October 2026): the owner working in the shop and posing for photos, a queue of 10–15 before opening, big skewers, lotus root, myoga, eggplant, asparagus, quail eggs, plump shrimp, dote-yaki, kimchi, Awaji octopus kara-age, a mention of rice oil, a view that the beef skewers are thin, a tourist-friendly atmosphere.

食べログ (店舗会員): 串カツ居酒屋 風太、串揚げ・居酒屋・日本料理、大阪市中.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Kushi Katsu Izakaya Futa, kushiage, izakaya, Japanese cuisine; 大㐂ビル 5F, 2-4-8 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba Stn; Mon–Sat and holidays 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); closed Sundays (open on long-weekend Sundays); irregular holidays; reservations accepted; starter ¥330; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 22 seats (6 counter, 16 table); smoking allowed; opened 5 March 2019. Reviews (June 2019–June 2026): a kushikatsu izakaya run by a cat-loving owner; cat goods and plush toys; shoes off at the entrance; a sunken counter; a light, non-greasy batter; a sweet sauce; assorted kushikatsu; paw-shaped kushikatsu; mitarashi dango kushikatsu; pudding as a dessert skewer; cat-stamped 'Nyan-yakko' tofu (a donation to a cat-rescue group); easy for solo diners.

食べログ (店舗会員): 串処 最上 心斎橋店 (もがみ)、串揚げ・居酒屋・日本.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kushi Dokoro Mogami Shinsaibashi branch; kushiage, izakaya, Japanese cuisine; Shinsaibashisuji 2-2-10, 新日本三ツ寺ビル 1F; 5 minutes' walk from exit 6 of Shinsaibashi Station; daily 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; open over the New Year; reservations (seat-only bookings expect 10 skewers or more); served until you say stop; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; 54 seats (counter 22, tables 32); non-smoking; Wi-Fi; wheelchair accessible; children welcome; kids menu; menus in English, Simplified Chinese and Korean; a taste since 1971; 36 kinds of kushikatsu fried by artisans. Reviews (October 2025–May 2026): the original shop, a pioneer of creative kushiage; courses only; 10 skewers ¥5,500 to 36 skewers ¥13,500; a 16-skewer abalone course ¥8,600; 15 skewers with all-you-can-drink ¥11,000; fried seaweed with ikura; medium-rare shrimp; beef; eel; pumpkin; flower oil; four sauces; branches in Kitashinchi and Sannomiya too; some say the service was too fast or the highball flat.

食べログ (店舗会員): 串揚げ タケナカ、串揚げ・日本料理、大阪市北区堂島1-.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kushiage Takenaka, kushiage and Japanese cuisine, 谷安ビル B01, 1-3-4 堂島, Kita-ku, Osaka; basement on Kitashinchi's Funadaiku Street; 5 min from Kitashinchi Station; 10 min from Hanshin Umeda Station; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 18:00–22:00; Sat 18:00–22:00; closed Sundays and holidays; no lunch bookings; tell the shop of dislikes or allergies in advance; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 10 counter seats; non-smoking; from junior-high age; opened 17 November 2015; a Japanese-and-French kushiage course; skewers without sauce; a Japanese dish and a Western plate; clay-pot rice; sommelier-chosen wine; monthly kushiage course of 15 items ¥6,820; full course of 16 items ¥9,680; special omakase of 19 items ¥11,880. Invoice registration: an individual, 竹中祐希. Reviews (June–October 2026): a regular of over 30 visits; a regular of ten years; consommé jelly with carrot mousse and sea urchin; truffle croquette; shrimp toast; a very thin batter; a different topping on each skewer; lunch ¥1,300 (appetizers, green salad, freshly fried skewers, rice, miso soup, chai); full by 11:40; warm service from the head chef and a female staff member; many solo women.

食べログ (店舗会員): 串揚げ 心平 梅田店、串揚げ・居酒屋・日本料理、大阪市.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kushiage Shinpei Umeda Ten, kushiage, izakaya and Japanese cuisine, 那由多ビル 1F, 11-14 堂山町, Kita-ku, Osaka; Tue–Sun and holidays 12:00–16:00 (last order 15:30) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Mondays (the next day when Monday is a holiday); cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 11 counter seats; heated tobacco only; playful creative kushiage by an owner from kaiseki cuisine; local Osaka ingredients and regional specialties; wine and sake; the 'Yoi' course of 12 with kuruma shrimp and A5 wagyu fillet ¥4,800; 'Tasogare' of 18 with foie gras ¥7,800; the 'Akatsuki' stop-system from about 10 skewers ¥4,500. Invoice registration: second Co., Ltd. Reviews (October–November 2026): opened 1 May 2026; sweet shrimp; A5 wagyu (salt or sauce); octopus with pickled ginger; doteyaki; eel rolls; croquettes; house ponzu, dashi soy, mustard-sesame sauce and salt; a sauce pot for each guest; Osaka vegetables; courses only; a comment of unease that prices were not shown; a comment that the portion was a little light; a 12-skewer lunch for ¥4,800.

食べログ (店舗会員): 串揚げPyon、港区六本木4-10-3 第V大栄ビル1.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Kushiage Pyon, Roppongi 4-10-3, 第V大栄ビル 1F, 1 min from Roppongi Stn exit 6 (Oedo line); Tue–Fri from 17:45 and from 20:30 (until 23:00); Sat also 12:30–15:00; closed Sundays and Mondays; reservation only; omakase only; 10% service charge; no cover; 8 counter seats; non-smoking; cards accepted; opened 7 September 2020. Shop text: aiming for the best kushiage in Tokyo; moved to Roppongi from the Hasegawa Minoru lab. Reviews (April 2024–October 2026): omakase ¥19,800 (¥17,600 in 2024); about ¥29,000 with extra skewers and the finish; Shine Muscat with prosciutto; steak shiitake; Arita beef tongue; kombu with roe and sea urchin; daikon consommé; curry or a hamo and jamón serrano noodle soup to finish; skewers re-laid for a left-handed guest; one diner found it unmemorable for the price.

食べログ (店舗会員): 串揚げ専門店 健串、串揚げ・居酒屋・魚介、大阪市中央区.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Kushiage Senmonten Kenkushi, kushiage, izakaya and seafood, Shimanouchi 1-12-17, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 minutes from Nagahoribashi Station; Tue–Sun and holidays 17:00–24:00; closed Mondays; irregular closures; reservations accepted; vegetable charge ¥330; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 28 seats (12 at the 1st-floor counter, smoking allowed; 10 at 2nd-floor tables, non-smoking; private room for 3–5); children welcome; opened 4 February 2020. Creative kushiage with techniques honed at a long-established restaurant; omakase of seasonal ingredients until you say stop, ¥110–570 a skewer; wine chosen by a sommelier and sake chosen by a sake specialist; tell the shop about dislikes and allergies in advance. Reviews (August–October 2026): vegetable sticks, asparagus, beef fillet, mentaiko-mayo bread, homemade mapo tofu, natto, shiitake with shrimp mince, taro, eel and ginger, swordfish, tomato and mozzarella, Angel shrimp, crab, penguin-shaped bread; three sauces and salt, ponzu, sesame mustard; about ¥7,000 a head for 15–18 skewers with drinks; full at 17:00 on a Sunday; one reviewer wished for a little less oil.

食べログ (店舗会員): 串揚厨房 Kanta、串揚げ・居酒屋・ダイニングバー、.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kushiage Chubo Kanta, kushiage, izakaya and dining bar, 敬明ビル別館 1F, 3-4-1 Dojima, Kita-ku, Osaka; 5 min from Kitashinchi and Nishi-Umeda stations; 6 min from JR Fukushima Station; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 (until sold out) and 18:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; private hire for 8 or more; no service charge; cards accepted, no e-money; 12 seats (counter of 8, table of 4); smoking allowed; opened 20 July 2003; light kushiage in 100% vegetable oil; Kagoshima Chami Ton pork; an omakase of eight skewers; party courses; a friendly owner. Reviews (June 2023–May 2026): omakase five skewers ¥900; whiting rolled with shiso; quail egg; asparagus; no double-dipping; tonkatsu set lunch ¥1,000; miso-katsu set ¥1,000; hire-katsu set; kara-age set ¥850; cabbage; potato salad; rice; clam miso soup or red miso soup; a small dish; ¥30 off for less rice; sightseers from nearby hotels.

食べログ (店舗会員): 久壷庵、しゃぶしゃぶ・日本料理、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Shabushabu Kyukoan, shabu-shabu, Japanese cuisine; オクソンビル 2F, 2-3-9 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba Stn; Mon–Sat and days around holidays 17:00–22:00; closed Sundays and holidays and over New Year; reservations accepted (call for 12 or more); service charge 10%; private room charge ¥6,050; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 28 seats; private rooms for 6–20; tatami and sunken seating; separate smoking area. Reviews (July 2018–March 2026): the same owner as the steakhouse Oxon on 1F; on the second floor of a building just west of Midosuji; an L-shaped counter; a tea room at the back; hina dolls; a ¥11,000 shabu-shabu course (seasonal starters, Kobe heifer sirloin, rare vegetables, shiitake, Yoshino kuzu, nama-fu, yuba, ponzu and sesame sauce, rice porridge, dessert); kombu broth; pork shabu-shabu; a long-established high-end restaurant.

食べログ (店舗会員): 人形町 なな福、日本料理、海鮮、居酒屋、日本橋人形町2.en: Tabelog (shop member): Ningyocho Nanafuku; Japanese cuisine, seafood, izakaya; 五十番ビル 1F, Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-6-11; 1 min from Ningyocho Station; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00, Sat 17:00–23:00; closed Sundays and holidays; seat charge ¥600 (for the starter); 17 seats (15 at lunch); cards, e-money and QR accepted; non-smoking; opened 1 June 2023; menu changes daily; sake chosen by a sake expert, wine by a sommelier; winter anko (monkfish) hot-pot course ¥11,800, Hon-ara hot-pot course ¥14,800; cooked in the same kitchen as allergens; may be unable to accommodate vegetarians, vegans or guests who cannot eat seafood including dashi. Menu (updated 20 October 2026): sashimi 5 kinds ¥1,880, 8 kinds ¥2,200, monkfish liver with ponzu ¥1,300, kinki grilled and simmered ¥2,380. Reviews (December 2024–October 2026): reservation-only lunch box with sashimi and a drink ¥2,000; nine side dishes; clay-pot rice; before a show at Meijiza; nearly full by 11:45; plenty of tempura; conger eel; tuna sashimi; the Fuku course with sweetfish, firefly squid, wagyu shabu-shabu and seasoned rice; one person serving the floor.

食べログ (店舗会員): 人形町 伊勢利、創作料理、フレンチ、日本橋人形町2-6.en: Tabelog (shop member): Ningyocho Iseri; creative, French; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-6-10; 3 min from Ningyocho Station; Mon–Sat and the days before and after holidays 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 12:30), 17:30–22:30 (L.O. 20:30); closed Sundays and holidays; same-day cancellation 100%; service charge 10%; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 20 seats; the 2nd floor can be hired for up to 14; non-smoking; opened 16 September 2015; about 50 wines chosen by a sommelier, sake too; baked goods from a sister shop; website iseritokyo.rwop.jp. Reviews (June–October 2026): a renovated old house; counter on the 1st floor, tables on the 2nd; steep stairs; only Japanese wine apart from Champagne; full course with wine pairing ¥16,000; lunch course ¥6,000; foie gras, duck, sea bream; a moon-viewing Mont Blanc salad; birthday plates; hospitality from the owner and sommelier.

食べログ (店舗会員): 人形町 梅田、うなぎ、日本料理、日本橋人形町3-4-2.en: Tabelog (shop member): Ningyocho Umeda; eel, Japanese cuisine; 梅田ビル, Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 3-4-2; 1 min from Ningyocho Station exit A5; Tue–Sun and holidays 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:00) and 17:00–21:30 (L.O. 20:30); closed Monday (open on a holiday Monday, then closed Tuesday); cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 20 seats (3 tables downstairs, 7 upstairs); non-smoking; children welcome; website unagi-umeda.jp; Edo techniques handed down from the first generation to the third; the eel-and-pickled-plum "Umeda-don"; a monthly sake. Menu (July 2026): special Umeda-don gozen ¥6,800, Koume-don ¥3,800, unaju gozen ¥4,400, ¥6,600 and ¥8,800, shirayaki or kabayaki ¥4,620, grilled liver ¥1,320, liver soup ¥880, eel course ¥14,300. Reviews (April–October 2026): renewed in February 2026 under the third generation; most say plum and eel go well together, some say not; Lake Hamana eel; outstanding liver soup; booking recommended; open on Sundays.

食べログ (店舗会員): 伊豆の味 そうだら、上野6-6-4 DUKEビル 2F.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Izu no Aji Soudara, Ueno 6-6-4, DUKE Building 2F, 3 min on foot from Okachimachi Station; Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00; closed Sundays and holidays; table charge ¥300; 17 seats (5 at the counter, two tables for 6); non-smoking; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; children welcome; opened 20 June 2022; Shizuoka ingredients and local sake; the speciality is Shizuoka oden (black-looking but a sweet, rich broth); beef tendon, black hanpen, daikon; local sakes such as Isojiman; Izu beef and venison; course ¥3,500. Menu (June 2025): oden ¥220 each (daikon prepared over 3 days, the rest over 2); mochi kinchaku ¥250; kuruma-fu ¥480; truffle-scented cabbage roll ¥480; platters of 3 ¥660, 5 ¥1,100, 7 ¥1,470; oden chazuke ¥690; the broth is tamari soy sauce and beef tendon. Reviews (October 2026): the owner runs it alone; seemed brusque at first but careful, and smiled on the way out; sashimi platter (octopus, bonito, ribbonfish, tuna, raw shirasu, kohada); fish powder and bonito flakes; beef tendon; kuruma-fu (one said about ¥450); oden chazuke; wasabi rice bowl; green-tea highball; sakura-shrimp kakiage; shirasu ajillo; pickled wasabi; fried black hanpen; dried kinmedai; seared Izu beef; mikan liqueur; with one person, food is slow when full.

食べログ (店舗会員): 個室 和食 矗々家 難波店、居酒屋・魚介・和食、大阪市.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Chikuchikuya Namba (private rooms, Japanese cuisine), izakaya, seafood and Japanese cuisine, Namba 3-7-11, Chuo-ku, Osaka; behind Marui; 1 minute from Namba Station exit 1; daily 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); reservations accepted; lunch bookings only for banquet courses of 4 or more (2 days ahead); cards, PayPay and d Barai accepted, no e-money; 64 seats; private rooms (6 to over 30 people); banquets up to 60 seated; no smoking at lunch, smoking allowed at dinner; children welcome. The head chef buys fish at the market every day; over 50 local sakes from around Japan; Kyoto-townhouse-style Japanese cuisine; omakase banquet courses ¥5,000, ¥6,000 and ¥7,000. Reviews (June–October 2026): Obanzai Jussai Gozen Ume ¥1,980, Take ¥2,380, Matsu ¥2,980; a gozen at ¥1,780; bottled beer ¥770; sashimi, tempura, dashi-maki, grilled fish; rice in small, medium or large; fish from Kizu Market; a queue of about ten before opening; shoes off at the counter; no toilet on the ground floor; one reviewer found smoking and non-smoking separated by floor.

食べログ (店舗会員): 個室 野菜巻き串と焼き鳥 博多巻きんしゃい 梅田茶屋町.en: Tabelog (shop member): Hakata Makinshai, Umeda Chayamachi branch (private rooms, vegetable-wrapped skewers and yakitori), izakaya, creative and kushiyaki, 茶屋町2-28, 5F of Central Chayamachi, Kita-ku, Osaka; 3 min on foot from Hankyu Osaka-Umeda Station; Mon–Fri 17:00–24:00 (last order food 23:00, drinks 23:30); Sat and Sun 12:00–24:00; open all year; hours may change with bookings; 26–30 December treated as the day before a holiday; phone 14:00–23:00; two-hour limit; bookings cancelled after 15 minutes' delay; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 80 seats; private rooms for 2–36; tatami; sunken seating; non-smoking; opened 10 March 2018; vegetable-wrapped skewers and Hakata specialities; fruit sours; irori dishes; courses with all-you-can-drink ¥4,000, ¥5,000 and ¥5,500 (coupon prices). Invoice registration: 株式会社炉暖 (Nishinari-ku). Reviews (August–November 2026): six vegetable rolls ¥2,100; ten kinds; lettuce roll; Hakata green onion; okra and grated yam; daikon oden; mini tomato with bacon and basil; potato; avocado and cheese; enoki; yakisoba; eggplant; shiso roll; soy-marinated quail eggs; Makinshai potato salad ¥680; salt-seared bonito ¥1,100; gourmet potatoes; salmon and ikura kamameshi ¥1,580; sudachi sour ¥700; goma-kanpachi; mentaiko; ordering by QR code or tablet; another table's order on the bill (refunded at once); voices carry from the next table.

食べログ (店舗会員): 個室ダイニング 神楽 難波店、居酒屋・海鮮・寿司、大阪.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Koshitsu Dining Kagura Nanba, izakaya, seafood, sushi; フェローズビル 2F, 1-5-20 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Namba Stn exit 14; daily 17:30–23:00 (food L.O. 22:00, drinks L.O. 22:30); reservations accepted; cards (including UnionPay) accepted, no e-money or QR; 120 seats; all private rooms for 2–60; smoking and non-smoking rooms. Shop introduction (English translation): seafood direct from the fishing port, nigiri sushi, black wagyu and brand meats, 30–40 sakes chosen by the owner; courses with two hours of drinks at ¥3,000 off: ¥6,000, ¥8,000, ¥10,000 (A3 wagyu teppanyaki, three-kind sashimi, whole sea bream sashimi, nigiri, grilled Tanba black chicken, Hiroshima fried oysters, cabbage rolls). Reviews (August 2024–August 2026): a golden lucky cat marks the entrance; reception on 1F is shared with other shops, lift upstairs; all-you-can-drink courses ¥5,000; higher courses with abalone and Ise lobster; octopus with wasabi, grilled kanpachi collar, mix-it-yourself potato salad; smoke from smoking rooms bothered one diner; slow drinks; open rooms and noisy; one diner found the menu differed from the listing.

食べログ (店舗会員): 備長炭と宮崎鶏専門 TORA鶏YA、焼き鳥・鶏料理・居.en: Tabelog (shop member): Binchotan charcoal and Miyazaki chicken specialist TORA鶏YA, yakitori, chicken dishes and izakaya, Ohatsu Tenjin Sando Building 1F, 2-5-23 Sonezaki, Kita-ku, Osaka; 1 min on foot from Ohatsu Tenjin (Tsuyu Tenjin shrine); 5 min from the Umeda stations; Mon–Fri and the day before a holiday 16:00–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30); Sat, Sun and holidays 15:00–23:00; closing days not fixed; 90 minutes when busy; bookings cancelled automatically at 15 minutes late; may refer guests to a related shop when full; six or more by course only; cancellation fee from 23:00 the day before; starter charge ¥420 plus tax; 10% extra over the New Year; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 60 seats; private rooms for 2–20; smoking allowed; opened 16 October 2020; Miyazaki free-range chicken over binchotan, the whole bird used; limited Jidokko; white liver; courses with two hours of drinks ¥4,500 and ¥5,000; a Hakata motsunabe course. Invoice registration: Five Dear Life Co., Ltd. (the same as Umeda Kani Shokudo). Reviews (August–October 2026): skewers one at a time; chicken sashimi; liver sashimi; heart; tsukune with grilled cheese; grilled corn with sauce; potato salad; kamameshi takes time; a lunch set with soba; the ground floor is a cramped, smoky counter; tables upstairs; one comment that a neighbouring group was loud; smoking allowed.

食べログ (店舗会員): 先斗町寿司よし乃、寿司・日本料理・海鮮、中京区石屋町1.en: Tabelog (shop member): Pontocho Sushi Yoshino — sushi / Japanese / seafood; 122-5, Nakagyo-ku; 5 min on foot from Sanjo Stn; Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 17:00–22:30; Sat–Sun 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–22:30; closed Wednesday; 17 seats (9 counter, 8 table); private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards accepted; opened 9 December 2021; moved from the 2nd floor of the building to the ground floor facing Pontocho; omakase sushi kaiseki ¥11,000 (book by the day before).
