Reviews (September 2025–October 2026, English): grilled sawara, saikyo-miso black cod, three vinegared dishes, surf clam, sea urchin, clam soup made to order, fried conger eel, yuzu sorbet, many overseas guests.

食べログ (店舗会員): 全席個室 九州うまいもん 酒兵衛 上野店、上野7-3-.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Sakebei Ueno, an all-private-room Kyushu-dishes izakaya, Ueno 7-3-2, TSD Building 4F-B, 1 min on foot from Ueno Station; Mon–Fri and the days before and after a holiday 13:00–24:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–24:00; seat-only bookings order two dishes and two drinks each; 2-hour limit on Fri, Sat and the day before a holiday; in December a 2-hour limit for everyone and a ¥500 year-end charge per person; 50 seats; private rooms with doors (2 to over 30); separate smoking area; cards only; opened 1 July 2024; banquet courses with 3-hour all-you-can-drink from ¥3,980. Course description (in Japanese): Kumamoto horse sashimi, Hakata's famous goma saba, Miyazaki's famous chicken nanban, plus Saga beef tongue served three ways — carpaccio, grilled on a net and on skewers; to finish, the head chef's special aromatic fried rice and today's dessert. Reviews (November 2024–February 2026): sashimi platter (about a 40-minute wait after the salad); meat sushi; roast beef; motsunabe; mentaiko salad; beef tongue carpaccio; thick horse sashimi; goma saba; chicken nanban; ordering by tablet; about 20 sakes; one said courses with all-you-can-drink start from ¥3,280 (February 2025); one found the seating cramped and the starter fish smelled off (December 2025); a meat-focused course of about ¥4,800 was served quickly (February 2026).

食べログ (店舗会員): 全席個室居酒屋 食べ放題 かなで 上野本店、上野4-8.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Kanade Ueno Honten, an all-private-room all-you-can-eat izakaya, Ueno 4-8-9 3F B, 2 min on foot from JR Ueno Station, 1 min from Keisei Ueno Station; daily 11:00–16:00 and 16:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); open all year; weekday lunch only by reservation for 4 or more; same-day bookings OK; 96 seats (all private rooms, 2–80 people); smoking area for heated tobacco only; cards, e-money and QR accepted; children of school age and up welcome (courses at the adult price); opened 1 July 2022; 150-item all-you-can-eat-and-drink course of tuna, sushi and charcoal yakitori (3 hours) ¥4,000; 140-item course of meat sushi, motsunabe and charcoal yakitori (2.5 hours) ¥3,500; 160-item course of tuna, yellowtail and beef tongue ¥5,000 (coupon prices); the tuna is described both as direct from Tsukiji Market and as direct from Toyosu. Reviews (September–October 2026): private rooms let you talk without minding others; edamame; smashed cucumber with seafood; seafood salad; five-kind sashimi; tempura; oden; black-wagyu skirt; duck and roast-beef meat sushi; chicken hot pot; kara-age; fried rice; cake; weak highballs; a hard-to-find entrance; you can't add orders until you finish the last ones; orders slow at busy weekend times.

食べログ (店舗会員): 八寸、日本料理、東山区祇園末吉町95、京阪祇園四条駅か.en: Tabelog (corporate member): Hassun, Japanese cuisine, 東山区祇園末吉町95, 5 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo Stn; lunch Tue–Sat 12:00–13:00, dinner Mon–Sat 18:00–21:00; closed Sunday; omakase kaiseki lunch ¥13,200, dinner ¥27,500 (tax included); 18 seats (12 at the counter, a 6-seat private room with a sunken floor); children welcome; The Tabelog Award Bronze and Silver; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025. Reviews (August–October 2026, photo captions in Japanese): yuba steamed with maitake and koutake mushrooms, duck loin, seared hamo, tuna and sea bream (the sea bream with sea-urchin soy sauce), the year's last Matsutake and hamo dobin-mushi, charcoal-grilled sawara with black Manganji pepper and miso, crab in vinegar, charcoal-grilled wild eel from Mie; an apprentice explains in English for overseas guests; even first-time guests are called by name.

食べログ (店舗会員): 六本木 かき心、港区六本木3-10-11 青木ビルB1.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Roppongi Kakishin, Roppongi 3-10-11, 青木ビル B1F, about 30 seconds from Roppongi Stn exit 5 (Oedo line); Mon–Sat 18:00–04:00, closed Sundays and holidays; 20 seats; private rooms (2, 4, 6); non-smoking; no cover charge; cards accepted; opened 1 June 2016. Shop text: aiming to be Tokyo's best oyster restaurant; the owner, from a long-established shop in Hiroshima, selects seasonal oysters and Matsusaka beef. Courses: omakase of 9 dishes ¥16,500; the 'ultimate fried oysters' with an oyster and Matsusaka-beef hot pot ¥14,300; fried oysters, two grilled oysters and an oyster dote-nabe ¥11,000. Reviews (September 2025–October 2026): raw oysters; fried oysters with salt and ponzu; oyster rice with shark-fin sauce; salt-grilled ayu; bluefin tuna; tenth anniversary; celebrity autographs; a whole cake for birthdays; a friendly owner; open until 4 am.

食べログ (店舗会員): 六本木きんめ鮨、港区六本木3-9-4 六本木ロイヤルビ.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Roppongi Kinme Sushi, Roppongi 3-9-4, 六本木ロイヤルビル B1F, 3 min from Roppongi Stn; daily 17:00–23:00 (drinks L.O. 22:30); closing days may vary; 8 counter seats; non-smoking; cards and e-money accepted, no QR; ¥2,000 charge for à la carte only; bookings from one person; from November, à la carte seats on weekdays after 20:00 by same-day phone call; English menu; opened 24 November 2025. Courses (two hours, about 15 dishes, then free refills of the blackboard nigiri): with all-you-can-drink of Yamazaki, Hakushu and sake ¥15,000; November weekend and holiday course with all-you-can-drink ¥10,000; food-only course with two shari, red and white, and aged fish ¥10,000. Reviews (September–October 2026): fish from Toyosu; aged toppings; red-vinegar shari; nigiri with a sweet glaze; oysters; sea-bream carpaccio; shark-fin chawanmushi; butter-soy inari; unusual sakes; some days the chef works alone.

食べログ (店舗会員): 冨田、日本料理、日本橋人形町2-6-11 五十番ビル.en: Tabelog (shop member): Tomita; Japanese cuisine; 五十番ビル 2F, Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-6-11; 2 min from Ningyocho Station exit A3, 5 min from Suitengumae Station exit 7; daily 12:00–14:30 and 18:00–22:30; irregular closing days; reservations only; same-day cancellations or changes in numbers charged 100% of the course; service charge 10%; cards accepted; no e-money or QR; 6 seats; private hire from 2 people; children welcome; opened 20 January 2025; chef Tomita trained at famous restaurants; sake chosen by a local liquor shop. Reviews (July–October 2026): the owner comes from 御料理 辻 in Azabu; a one-person operation, handling everything from cooking to serving; gentle, dashi-led seasoning that never tires you; a compact lunch course ¥12,100 (plus 10% service); weekday lunch set ¥3,000; clay-pot rice; clay-pot rice with tempura or fried hamo finished as dashi chazuke; you climb stairs to reach the shop.

食べログ (店舗会員): 出汁鍋&海鮮の店 門戸、しゃぶしゃぶ・居酒屋・ビュッフ.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Dashi Nabe & Seafood no Mise Mondo, shabu-shabu, izakaya, buffet; OCAT Mall 5F, 1-4-1 Minatomachi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from JR Namba Stn; daily 11:00–15:30 and 17:00–21:00, closed 15:30–17:00; closed on OCAT closing days, the third Wednesday, 31 December and 1 January; reservations accepted (phone 10:30–20:30); under-16s with a guardian; cards (including UnionPay), e-money and QR (including Alipay) accepted; opened 1 March 2016. Reviews (September 2025–October 2026): about ten broths such as soy, miso, special white miso, Taiwanese spicy, kombu and yuzu salt (two for a supplement); unlimited vegetables, mushrooms, tofu, Chinese noodles, rice, quail eggs, soft drinks and ice lollies; beef hot-pot set ¥1,380, large ¥1,780; motsunabe set; mushroom shabu-shabu; marony; all-you-can-eat dashi hot pot from ¥2,980; all-you-can-eat black wagyu; spacious and easy alone; one diner found the ponzu a little spicy.

食べログ (店舗会員): 利尻昆布ラーメン くろおび、港区六本木4-12-5 六.en: Tabelog (shop member): Rishiri Kombu Ramen Kuroobi, Roppongi 4-12-5, roppongi 144 building 1F, 2 min walk from Roppongi Station exit 7; Mon–Fri 11:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30), Sat and holidays 11:00–21:00, Sun 11:00–17:00; closed 15:00–17:00 on the third Thursday of each month; 14 seats (counter); non-smoking; no cards, e-money or QR; allergy information available; children welcome; takeout; opened 1 July 2025. Reviews (July 2025–October 2026): the Toranomon main shop merged into the Roppongi shop when its building was rebuilt; an additive-free Rishiri kombu broth; Kuroobi Ramen (shio) ¥1,300; belly and loin chashu; shrimp wontons; seasoned egg; thin straight noodles; a clear amber shoyu broth; kombu-water tsukemen; a winter-limited spicy "Kagutsuchi"; shiso gyoza; Ubushuna tea; hinoki chopsticks; preschool children eat free about twice a month; some wished the kombu flavour were stronger.

食べログ (店舗会員): 割烹 八彩 新大阪店、日本料理・海鮮、大阪市淀川区宮原.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kappou Hassai Shin osaka ten; Japanese cuisine, seafood; 2-13-1 Miyahara, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, Sun Palace ground floor; 2 minutes on foot from exit 4 of Higashi-Mikuni Station, 6 minutes from Shin-Osaka Station; Tue–Sun and holidays 17:00–22:00; weekend and holiday lunch 12:00–15:00 (last seating 13:00); closed Monday (call even on closed days); reservations accepted; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; no service charge; 20 seats (8 at the counter, 3 tables for four); private rooms for 4–20; non-smoking; opened 15 March 2016; seasonal kaiseki course of 8 dishes ¥7,800 (tax included); about 20 sakes and wines; seasonal small pots. Reviews (February to October 2026): a kaiseki that changes every month; mini kaiseki ¥5,800; finished in front of you; careful explanations of food and drink; a sake sommelier; sakura shrimp and spring cabbage; Akashi sea bream with irizake; small pot; clay-pot rice; leftovers made into onigiri; seen off until out of sight; a quiet residential area of Higashi-Mikuni.

食べログ (店舗会員): 創作料理・イノベーティブ、下京区高辻猪熊町367、阪急.en: Tabelog (staff-maintained): creative, innovative; 下京区高辻猪熊町367; 10 min on foot from Shijo-Omiya Stn (Hankyu); 17:00–24:30 (food last order 21:30); closed irregularly (Instagram); reservations accepted (tell the shop in advance about allergies, dislikes or a stay under two hours; avoid perfume); under-9s at one table only, arranged in advance; children's meals by arrangement; 20 seats (12 at the counter, 8 at tables); non-smoking (smoking spot outside); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; sommelier; BYO possible; opened 12 August 2021. Reviews (March–October 2026, in English): genre-free à la carte, Shimane horse mackerel, Kamo eggplant with mole, conger and gorgonzola spring rolls, charcoal-grilled sweet sea bream, Ezo venison, a fifth-anniversary course ¥15,000, karasumi made at the opening, alcohol-free pairings, homemade ginger ale, a courtyard, a remark that many guests are from overseas.

食べログ (店舗会員): 北新地 〆。、居酒屋・海鮮・ラーメン、大阪市北区曾根崎.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kitashinchi Shime., izakaya, seafood and ramen, 曾根崎新地1-3-19, 5F-E of the Kitashinchi Building, Kita-ku, Osaka; 5 min on foot from JR Kitashinchi Station, 3 min from Nishi-Umeda Station; Mon–Fri 17:00–1:00; Sat 17:00–23:00 (reservation only); closed Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; private rooms in principle for four or more; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 20 seats (6 at the counter, 8 at tables, a private room of 6); heated tobacco in a smoking space, cigarettes outside; opened 1 July 2023; seasonal seafood and sake; soba or ramen to finish; a rich clam ramen; sake, wine and fruit liqueurs from around Japan; 6-dish course ¥8,000; 7 dishes with horse sashimi ¥10,000; Nagasaki kue hotpot course ¥13,000 (Goto kue via the sister restaurant in Fukuoka); 120 minutes of drinks for ¥2,000 more. Reviews (December 2025 – September 2026): sashimi assortment for one ¥1,800 (Nagasaki sea snail, Kagoshima tuna and amberjack, Miyagi salmon, Kagawa scallop); Goto raw oysters ¥900; firefly squid in soy ¥700; clams steamed in sake ¥1,200; dried chicken wings ¥600; Hiroshima fried oyster ¥300; sakura menchi katsu ¥600; mochi tofu ¥400; potato salad ¥800; seared duck ¥1,200; dashimaki ¥800; mori soba ¥1,200; homemade tofu; uzaku; mackerel in miso; e-cigarettes allowed in private rooms; a duck mascot; reasonable for Kitashinchi.

食べログ (店舗会員): 北新地 おやじ最後の握り 極、寿司・海鮮・日本料理、大.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kitashinchi Oyaji Saigo no Nigiri Kiwami, sushi, seafood and Japanese cuisine, 二葉ビル 4F room 405, 1-3-1 堂島, Kita-ku, Osaka; 5 min from Kitashinchi Station; 10 min from Osaka Station; Mon–Sat and the day before and after a holiday 17:00–3:00 (last order 2:00); closed Sundays, holidays and some Saturdays; reservations accepted, same day too; not tied to a course; no simultaneous start; service charge 10%; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 12 counter seats (shoes off, on tatami); heated tobacco only; keep perfume light; opened 1 April 2026; the Ichigo Ichie course of 19 items ¥22,000 (chilled chawanmushi, sashimi of hamo, horse meat and kombu-cured white fish, young ayu tempura hand roll, ten nigiri in two parts, ankimo, uzaku, rolls, red miso soup, dessert). Reviews (September–October 2026): white sesame dressing of fig, chestnut and walnut; sashimi with irizake, umami salt and soy; fried mehikari hand roll in nori; cod milt chawanmushi; squid with caviar; Kochi striped jack; Osaka Bay flounder; Tokyo Bay kohada; marinated tuna; chutoro; sweet shrimp; sea urchin piled high; toro-taku and kanpyo rolls; extra wasabi on request; rock-like walls, running water and frogs; a comment that it has the same feel as a shop in Minami; a head chef with Kansai humour.

食べログ (店舗会員): 北新地 つきしろ、牛肉料理・焼肉・ステーキ、大阪市北区.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kitashinchi Tsukishiro, beef dishes, yakiniku and steak, Four Seasons Front 3F, 1-9-12 Sonezaki-Shinchi, Kita-ku, Osaka; 5 min on foot from Kitashinchi Station; Mon–Fri 11:30–13:50 (last order 13:20, no reservations) and 18:00–22:00 (reservations accepted); Sundays and holidays private bookings only; earlier or later times by arrangement; no service charge; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 14 seats (a counter of 6, two tables for 4); non-smoking (ashtray by the lift); opened 15 June 2021; black wagyu in many preparations; chateaubriand grilled over Kishu binchotan; freshly cooked rice at lunch; courses: Oborozuki, five dishes, ¥11,000; YOITUKI ¥13,200 (truffle-scented wagyu yukhoe, thin and thick beef tongue, strip-loin niku-dofu, chateaubriand, wagyu hand-rolled sushi, dessert); Kasumizuki ¥16,500. Reviews (July 2024–October 2026): sukiyaki set ¥1,500 (black-wagyu chuck rib, onsen egg, rice, cold tofu with whitebait, sake-lees soup); niku-dofu set ¥1,500; dashimaki set topped with meat; large rice ¥100; koji porridge; yukhoe with sea urchin and caviar and French bread; a queue before 11:30; full by 11:45; the entrance is hard to find; a regular on an eleventh visit.

食べログ (店舗会員): 北新地 ふか、餃子・イノベーティブ、大阪市北区堂島浜1.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kitashinchi Fuka, gyoza and innovative, Dojima Town Building B1F, 1-3-22 Dojimahama, Kita-ku, Osaka; 184 m from Oebashi Station; Mon–Sat in two seatings (17:30–19:30, 20:00–22:00); closed Sundays and holidays; reservation only (by the person dining); four or more and private hire by phone; children only with the adult course; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 8 counter seats; non-smoking; opened 8 May 2023; Tabelog Dumplings 100 2024; a course rebuilding gyoza from wrapper and filling; wrappers with vegetables and seaweed; Mangalica pork; Iga beef loin; wild Ezo abalone; always Kesennuma shark fin; over 100 kinds of gyoza; gyoza omakase course ¥17,000; with a wine, sake and Shaoxing pairing ¥27,000; pan-fried gyoza refills in the second seating; chef Yuuya Kusunoki. Official site fuka.works. Reviews (September–October 2026): no sign, a rusted knife sculpture at the entrance; a curved counter of 8; the owner greets guests and explains each dish on a card in an envelope; about 300 kinds of gyoza; flower gyoza of flower okra with Kada horse mackerel or sardine; a bowl gyoza with Masutomi Shoten shirasu; boiled and pan-fried gyoza; matsutake gyoza; carefully cooked rice; a sommelier's pairing; the owner Mr Yuya Kusunoki, whose parents ran a Chinese restaurant; the course with 1.5 glasses of Shaoxing ¥20,700.

食べログ (店舗会員): 北新地 串揚げ かな山、串揚げ・日本料理・とんかつ、大.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kitashinchi Kushiage Kanayama, kushiage, Japanese cuisine and tonkatsu, 曾根崎新地1-4-25, B1F, Kita-ku, Osaka; Kitashinchi Hondori; 5 min on foot from exit 11-5 of Kitashinchi Station on the JR Tozai Line; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Sundays; reservations accepted (the lunch kushiage course two days ahead); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 20 seats; private rooms for two and four; non-smoking; sommelier; opened 1 July 2019; fried in front of you at an open-kitchen counter; organic vegetables and domestic meat and seafood; omakase kushiage course (stop system) ¥8,800; ten-skewer course ¥9,900; with all-you-can-drink ¥10,000; sister shop Kushiage Haru Natsu Aki Fuyu. Reviews (June–October 2026): snow-room-aged pork loin and fillet katsu ¥1,700; special loin katsu ¥2,100–2,200; special fillet katsu of snow-room-aged pork (60 g × 2) ¥2,200; assorted minced cutlet, fillet and fried shrimp ¥1,980; foie-gras minced cutlet ¥2,400; fried shrimp +¥500; white or shiso rice (free refills); grated yam with wasabi; red miso soup; shibazuke; a crescent-shaped counter; nearly full at 13:00 at lunch; a ten-skewer dinner with all-you-can-drink ¥10,000 (vegetable platter, shrimp, swordfish, shiitake, eggplant, jako rice, ice cream); red and white grape juice; beef sirloin chazuke.

食べログ (店舗会員): 北新地 光隆、寿司・日本料理・海鮮、大阪市北区堂島1-.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kitashinchi Mitsutoki, sushi, Japanese cuisine and seafood, Nishiki Building 4F, 1-4-24 堂島, Kita-ku, Osaka; 5 min from Oebashi Station; 7 min from Kitashinchi Station; the building's entrance is on the Funadaikucho side only; Mon–Fri 18:00–2:00; Sat 18:00–23:00; closed Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; à la carte from 20:30; private hire for 8 or more; no service charge; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 16 seats (counter of 10, table of 6); smoking allowed (from 1 November 2026, cigarettes at tables only, e-cigarettes anywhere); fresh fish from markets across Japan; Japanese cuisine and sushi; local sake and wine; seasonal special course of 18 items ¥24,750 (with a small gift); seasonal sushi course of 11 items ¥16,500. Invoice registration: ＳＹＳＴＥＭ－ＦＡＣＴＯＲＹ株式会社 (same lot). Reviews (November 2024–October 2026): rice changed to suit each topping (white and red vinegar); sea urchin; torigai; eel (a Japanese review); the 'Tsuufuu Don' mini bowl of sea urchin, salmon roe and caviar; shirako bowl; thick rolls to take away; dishes alternating with sushi; smoking allowed; comments that prices are now reasonable, and that they are high.

食べログ (店舗会員): 北新地 黒猫、フレンチ・パスタ・洋食、大阪市北区曽根崎.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kitashinchi Kuroneko, French, pasta and yoshoku, エスパス北新地10 B1F, 1-9-11 曽根崎新地, Kita-ku, Osaka; 20 m east of Kitashinchi Station exit 11-41; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 12:00–14:30 and 18:00–22:00; closed Wednesdays and the first and third Tuesdays (reservations possible on closed days); one drink per person; no service charge; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 14 seats (a counter of 9, an L-shaped private counter room for 3–5); whole-shop hire up to 20; non-smoking; wheelchair users please ask; children welcome; market fish and seasonal ingredients; French at the core, also Italian, Japanese and Chinese; a free style that does not fit a mould; roast beef of Miyazaki black wagyu; dinner standard course ¥6,900, with a dessert plate ¥8,500, with the black-cat whole cake ¥8,900. Invoice registration: 株式会社ｉ　ＴＯ　ｉ (西宮市). Reviews (July 2024–October 2026): pumpkin potage with homemade popcorn; palette hors d'oeuvres; a zeppole like takoyaki; chawanmushi in a black-cat teapot; Ishikawa Spanish mackerel; sautéed bonito; Hungarian duck with black-vinegar sauce; foie gras steak; black wagyu and foie gras Rossini; autumn 'Japanese' parfait; baked cheesecake; weekday lunch course ¥6,000; weekend lunch course ¥5,300; wine by the glass ¥700–900; many black-cat figurines; anniversary message plates; two people cooking and serving; the main shop is in Fukushima.

食べログ (店舗会員): 南蛮食堂 東三国店、食堂・カレー、大阪市淀川区東三国4.en: Tabelog (shop member): Namban Shokudo Higashimikuni ten; cafeteria, curry; 4-16-16 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 2 minutes on foot from Higashi-Mikuni Station, 10 minutes from JR Shin-Osaka Station; Mon–Sat 11:00–22:00 (last order 21:40); closed Sunday; cards, e-money and QR (Alipay and WeChat Pay too) accepted; 16 seats (4 at the counter, 12 at tables); non-smoking; children welcome; takeaway; opened 1 September 2009. Reviews (May 2023 to August 2026): a chicken nanban set-meal specialist; choose breast or thigh; sweet vinegar and homemade tartar; chicken nanban set ¥1,300; mix of breast, thigh and kara-age ¥1,650; kara-age set of five ¥1,300; chicken katsu set; keema curry; curry topped with chicken nanban; large rice free; all-you-can-eat stir-fried takana on the table; onion and sesame dressings; Maximum seasoning on the table (also sold at ¥880); order by QR code on your phone; lines before noon; draft beer ¥550; one diner credits Miyazaki chicken.

食べログ (店舗会員): 味噌之達人 三国店、ラーメン・餃子、大阪市淀川区新高3.en: Tabelog (shop member): Miso no Tatsujin, Mikuni shop; ramen, gyoza; 新高3-4-26, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 5 minutes on foot from Hankyu Mikuni Station; daily 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:30–01:30 (last order 1:00); open year-round; no reservations; no cards; 12 seats; non-smoking 11:00–15:00, smoking allowed from 17:00; opened 19 November 2015; miso from Hokkaido's Iwata brewery; noodles flown in from Hokkaido; three sesames, white, black and gold, roasted in the shop, to grind yourself; a spicy miso ramen only at the Mikuni shop. Reviews (2024 to September 2026): grinding sesame in a mortar while you wait; Miso Tatsu ramen; corn butter miso ramen ¥1,100; ginger miso ramen; miso ramen with heat and numbing to choose ¥1,000; butter; corn; free garlic; Sichuan pepper and black pepper; curly yellow noodles; half fried rice; chashu rice bowl; half rice ¥250; gyoza; a big kara-age; the chef and a female staff member running it; aprons lent.

食べログ (店舗会員): 味雅軒、中華料理・バイキング・居酒屋、大阪市淀川区西中.en: Tabelog (shop member): Miyabi Ken; Chinese, buffet, izakaya; 5-8-5 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 5 minutes on foot from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station, 6 minutes from Shin-Osaka Station and Hankyu Minamikata Station; Mon–Sat 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–23:00; closed Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; cards, PayPay and d Barai accepted, no e-money; 90 seats; private rooms for 10–30; a tatami room for up to 25 on the 2nd floor; whole hire for 20–50; non-smoking; opened 8 July 2013. The shop's introduction: authentic Chinese cooking by a chef who was a head chef in China; mapo tofu, black vinegar pork, black vinegar shrimp popular with women; all-you-can-eat-and-drink ¥4,000 (tax included). Reviews (May 2025 to October 2026): mapo tofu (doubanjiang and tianmianjiang, Sichuan pepper); combinations of A and B; the gyoza got a little smaller; a daily service lunch; kara-age set with curry salt; shrimp chili set ¥950; lunch of mapo ramen with half a fried rice ¥830; all-you-can-eat-and-drink ¥3,850 (five dishes first: kara-age, sweet and sour pork, gyoza, mapo tofu, shrimp chili, then order; dessert of almond jelly or sesame balls); staff from China and Taiwan who speak Japanese, and staff from Myanmar too; seats on the 2nd floor; full on a Friday with delays and missed orders; black vinegar pork; chive and egg stir-fry; spicy stir-fried chicken; chicken wings; fried rice.

食べログ (店舗会員): 和フレンチバル村塾、バル・イタリアン・フレンチ、大阪市.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Wa French Baru Sonjuku, bar, Italian and French, YOTSUBASHI GTC BLDG 1F, Shinmachi 1-7-5, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 2 minutes from Yotsubashi Station, 4 minutes from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 17:30 to 3:00 the next morning (L.O. 2:30); open through Golden Week and Obon; lunch suspended; open all year (check New Year); reservations accepted; cards, e-money, PayPay and Rakuten Pay accepted; 37 seats (13 counter, 24 table); heated tobacco only until 23:00, smoking on the terrace; Kyoto cuisine and French by a chef from a long-established Kyoto hotel; a room modelled on a late-Edo townhouse. Reviews (June–October 2026): eight appetisers ¥1,590, beef sirloin in puff pastry ¥990, beef sirloin skewer ¥390, sea-urchin cream rice ¥1,390, Kyoto-style dashi omelette, chicken and egg gâteau, quiche, pâté and baguette, shrimp and avocado tartare with monaka, foie gras, pork sauté, keema curry, penne arrabbiata, prosciutto, a course with two hours of drinks ¥4,980, a one-coin glass of rosé sparkling, a cheerful owner, often busy so book.

食べログ (店舗会員): 和牛料理 要、牛料理・もつ鍋・ステーキ、大阪市中央区南.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Wagyu Ryori Kaname, beef dishes, motsunabe and steak, Minamikyuhojimachi 4-3-1, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 minutes from Shinsaibashi Station exit 3 and Honmachi Station exit 15; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:30), Mon–Sat 17:30–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); closed Sundays and holidays, Golden Week, Obon and New Year; reservations accepted; cards and PayPay accepted; 150 seats; fully private rooms (from 2 to over 30); tatami and sunken seating; non-smoking (smoking area outside); a renovated Showa townhouse; A5 female black wagyu stone grill; motsunabe; the Mahoroba course (black-wagyu stone-grilled steak 70 g and motsunabe) ¥4,730, also with 120 minutes of free drinks. Reviews (March 2024–October 2026): motsunabe in soy, miso or salt, seasonal shijimi motsunabe, ramen to finish, stone-grilled wagyu wrapped in green onion with sesame salt, clay-pot rice, corn rice, Tsurumi-bashi kimchi, stone-grilled bibimbap, the Kaname Gozen lunch at ¥2,000 limited to five a day, hamburg steak set ¥1,320, beef katsu, menchi katsu, ordering by tablet, popular for business meals.

食べログ (店舗会員): 和牛焼肉 炭治郎 六本木店、港区六本木7-14-11.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Wagyu Yakiniku Tanjiro Roppongi, Roppongi 7-14-11, No.12ニイクラビル 4F, 30 seconds from Roppongi Stn; daily 11:00–23:30 (food L.O. 22:30, drinks L.O. 23:00); open all year; 60 seats; private rooms for 2 to over 30; heated-tobacco smoking area; cards and QR accepted; no cover charge; menu and staff in English and Chinese; opened 17 April 2025. Two-hour all-you-can-eat: 37 items (Mon–Thu only) ¥3,980, 55 items ¥5,980, 65 items ¥7,980; all-you-can-drink +¥1,500. A4-or-better black wagyu from Kyushu. Gurunavi: also a 炭治郎 渋谷本店 (head shop). Reviews (March–September 2026): above Wendy's; an energetic manager; a big first platter of meat; thick-cut tongue, outside skirt, horumon; a cramped table for six; the limited tongue could not be held for a booking; one day the air conditioning was broken.

食べログ (店舗会員): 喜多郎寿し なんば店 (キタロウズシ)、寿司・海鮮・鍋.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kitaro Zushi Namba branch; sushi, seafood, hot pot; Namba Sennichimae 3-5; about 7 minutes' walk from Namba Station; daily 17:00–2:00 (L.O. 1:00, fried food 0:00); closed 31 December, 1 January and company holidays; reservations (write allergies in the request); two hours when busy; prices before tax; no desserts (cakes may be brought); cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 55 seats (19 at the first-floor counter, horigotatsu, a banquet hall and a private room for 10 upstairs); non-smoking; all sushi from ¥280, drinks from ¥550; fish from the Osaka central market and local markets; a stylish sushi bar in a renovated townhouse in Ura Namba; over 10 years; seasonal single-serving hot pots; a sister robata restaurant. Reviews (June–October 2026): negitoro, yellowtail, boiled shrimp, eel with cucumber; shrimp toast; grilled milt; shell oysters with ponzu ¥1,000; milt with ponzu ¥1,000; water eggplant; fig wrapped in prosciutto; chilled daikon; assorted tuna; tuna with grated yam; kanpyo and yam-burdock rolls; an opening in Thailand; small pieces; some items sell out.

食べログ (店舗会員): 喫茶ビクトリヤ (旧店名 ビクトリア カフェ)、カフェ.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kissa Victorya (former name Victoria Cafe); café, sweets, yoshoku; Namba 5-chome, NAMBA Nannan No. 1; a short walk from Kintetsu, Nankai and subway Namba stations; daily 9:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed on the third Thursday of odd-numbered months when the whole mall closes; reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 60 seats; sofa seats; non-smoking; private hire for 50 or more; breakfast; English menu; children welcome; founded 65 years ago in Minami, Osaka; the famous Napolitan, thick omelette sandwich, Osaka-born mixed juice, cream soda and pudding à la mode. Reviews (September–October 2026): the sign OSAKA NAMBA 1957; four-egg thick omelette sandwich ¥1,250 (¥1,100 at lunch); hamburg Napolitan; Dojima Roll; a seasonal chestnut roll; scones with clotted cream; matcha affogato; royal milk tea ¥920; order by QR code or smartphone; Wi-Fi and power outlets; by the Midosuji Line gates.

食べログ (店舗会員): 四ツ橋・新町 牡蠣と肉たらしビストロAKIRA、オイス.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Yotsubashi Shinmachi Kaki to Nikutarashi Bistro AKIRA, oyster bar, meat bar and bistro, 矢野園ビル 1F, Shinmachi 1-9-17, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 minutes from Yotsubashi Station; Mon–Fri 15:00–23:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:00, drinks L.O. 22:30); closed 31 December–5 January; reservations accepted; ¥500 appetiser for guests not on a course; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 36 seats (14 counter, 22 table); non-smoking (ashtray beside the entrance); pets only at the entrance counter; opened 25 October 2021. Five or more kinds of raw oyster from around Japan all year; raw, grilled, fried and in pasta; charcoal-grilled wagyu and game; fish sent direct from a fishing port at Miyakubo (Seto Inland Sea); oyster lover's course ¥6,600; course of oysters, crab, lobster, beef, duck and foie gras ¥5,500. Reviews (June–October 2026): raw oysters by origin ¥550–650 each; Nanao, Ofunato, Murotsu, Konagai; assorted raw oysters ¥2,500; fried oysters ¥550; fish and chips ¥1,580; Imabari fish carpaccio ¥1,200; charcoal-grilled kuroge wagyu steak (Awaji beef) ¥3,980; dog menu ¥600; staff explain the taste of each origin; some found it average or the wagyu disappointing (August–September 2026).

食べログ (店舗会員): 地焼うなぎ 法善寺山かづ、うなぎ・日本料理・海鮮、難波.en: Tabelog (shop member): Jiyaki Unagi Hozenji Yama Kazu; eel, Japanese cuisine, seafood; Namba 1-1-16; Hozenji Yokocho; 4 minutes' walk from Namba Station; daily 11:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); irregular closures; reservations; tables may become tatami when busy; 90-minute limit when busy; no takeaway; cards, PayPay and Alipay accepted; 50 seats; private rooms (2–8); non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome; opened 1 December 2022; a three-storey traditional townhouse; Kansai-style jiyaki of large seasonal eels grilled over binchotan without steaming; unaju and hitsumabushi; drinking snacks; sake to go with eel. Reviews (July–October 2026): crisp skin and plump flesh; unaju about ¥6,490; unagi don about ¥3,000 (with clear soup and chawanmushi); hitsumabushi; umaki, five pieces about ¥1,500; grilled liver; octopus sunomono; a sauce that is not too sweet; two kinds of sansho; a smoky ground floor; tatami rooms on the second and third floors; guidance in Chinese, English and Korean; some say the portions are small or the sansho weak.

食べログ (店舗会員): 地鶏焼とり 高や、焼き鳥・居酒屋・ダイニングバー、大阪.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Jidori Yakitori Takaya, yakitori, izakaya and dining bar, T'z Building 2F, 1-7-23 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min on foot from Shinsaibashi and Nagahoribashi Stations; Mon and Wed–Sun 17:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Tuesday; reservations accepted (a course for 6 or more); 500 yen charge; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 20 seats (10 counter, 10 table); whole-shop hire for 20–50; smoking allowed; opened 7 March 2006. Shop description: jidori grilled slowly over binchotan; skewers and a jidori sashimi platter; carefully chosen wine and sake; a calm Japanese room with the warmth of wood; omakase course of 10 items with 2-hour all-you-can-drink for 5,500 yen. Reviews (September 2025–July 2026): on the second floor, hard to tell from outside what kind of shop it is; chicken sashimi, tataki, negima, tsukune, heart, gizzard, neck, cartilage, breast, breast cheese fry, tamagoyaki, liver pâté, ginkgo, tomato-bacon, beef marushin, tongue, lamb, chicken soup, onigiri, zosui; a long shochu list; a friendly owner and staff; easy to book even on the day; some say everything is good but no single skewer stands out.

食べログ (店舗会員): 坐、焼き鳥、大阪市北区堂島1-5-36 Rich K..en: Tabelog (shop member): THE, yakitori, Rich K.BLDG 2F, 1-5-36 堂島, Kita-ku, Osaka; 4 min on foot from JR Kitashinchi Station; Mon–Fri and the day before and after a holiday 17:00–23:00 (last order food 21:30, drinks 22:30); Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00 (last order food 21:00, drinks 22:30); reservation only; children only with the adult course; elegant dress asked; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 9 counter seats; non-smoking; opened 13 March 2024; an omakase of rare Kozaka chicken from Kyotanba and seasonal ingredients, slowly charcoal-grilled; omakase course ¥13,800. Reviews (July–October 2026): Kozaka chicken thigh tataki; coarse-ground mince; neck; heart; liver; salad; shumai; ramen, chicken soba, clay-pot rice or mapo tofu to finish; chicken aged six days; no sashimi; a comment that it is the high-end shop of the Goichi group; a comment that the griller and owner were the same as at Ryoubou; a comment that the grillers came from Bird Oka in Nakameguro; a friendly head chef; a comment wanting a little more surprise for the price; a comment that the table was sticky.

食べログ (店舗会員): 大人居酒屋 ぽん、居酒屋・海鮮・創作料理、大阪市北区堂.en: Tabelog (shop member): Otona Izakaya Pon, izakaya, seafood and creative cuisine, 中通りレジャービル 102, 16-12 堂山町, Kita-ku, Osaka; 3 min on foot from Higashi-Umeda Station; Mon–Thu, Sun, holidays and the day after a holiday 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30); Fri, Sat and the day before a holiday 17:00–2:00 (last order 1:30); reservations accepted; cover charge ¥450; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 16 seats (a counter of 8, two tables for 4); smoking allowed; opened 11 April 2025; creative dishes of carefully chosen fresh fish; black-vinegar sweet and sour pork; Shaoxing-wine squid; 20 sakes from across Japan; a ¥4,000 course with sashimi and a choice of kamameshi; a ¥5,000 course with wagyu yukhoe and seasonal dishes; sake free-flow ¥2,500. Reviews (June–October 2026): sashimi platter (¥3,840 for three, with salmon roe); mackerel or sardine rolls with herbs (¥1,980 for two); black-vinegar sweet and sour pork (¥2,560 for two); three red shrimp ¥1,350; buri gari; shrimp in kadaif; mehikari tempura ¥1,360; peppers stuffed with meat miso ¥480; pork kakuni; sake-steamed clams; liver pâté and baguette; salmon and ikura kamameshi (takes time); shellfish-broth noodles ¥1,000; tomato chuhai with black pepper; comments that the counter is cramped and noisy; a comment that it is pricey for the portions; no closing day.

食べログ (店舗会員): 大和屋本店 (やまとやほんてん)、日本料理・ふぐ・かに.en: Tabelog (shop member): Yamatoya Honten (Yamatoya Honten); Japanese cuisine, fugu, crab; Shimanouchi 2-17-4; 3 min on foot from exit 6 of Nippombashi Stn; by the Dotonbori River; daily 11:00–16:30 (lunch last order 14:00) and 17:00–21:30 (last order 20:00); open all year; reservations (15 or more by phone); private rooms for two hours; Umai kaiseki ¥6,600 (thin-sliced sea bream, small wagyu sukiyaki hot pot), Ookini course ¥7,700 (Kobe beef aburi sushi), Tenkomori ¥13,200 (fugu, Kobe beef, Ise lobster); fully private rooms for 2–100; separate smoking area; BYO allowed; children's lunch sets; menus and staff in English, Chinese (traditional and simplified) and Korean; the Kansai season, Kobe beef in spring, sweetfish and conger eel in summer. Reviews (December 2024–July 2026): kue hot-pot kaiseki with zosui, hamo kaiseki ¥8,800, Kobe beef kaiseki, fugu course (sashimi, kara-age, teppanyaki), sashimi platter, flounder baked in paper, staying as a ryokan, company trips; also comments that service was rushed or ordinary and the abalone was like tokobushi.

食べログ (店舗会員): 大衆焼肉びりちゃん 難波・心斎橋店、焼肉・ホルモン・韓.en: Tabelog (shop member): Taishu Yakiniku Birichan Namba–Shinsaibashi branch; yakiniku, horumon, Korean; Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-13-23, 日宝イルストリートビル 4F; 4 minutes' walk from Nagahoribashi Station, 5 from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 12:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); open all year; reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 62 seats; fully private and semi-private rooms; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; dessert buffet; ¥1,500 all-you-can-eat-and-drink for children in third grade and below; opened 25 April 2024; sister of the popular Taishu Sakaba Birichan; all-you-can-eat-and-drink kuroge wagyu courses. Reviews (February–November 2026): a wooden box of wagyu (thick-cut tongue, salted tongue, melting kalbi and loin); nakaochi kalbi; outside skirt; pork belly; horumon; yaki-shabu kalbi; seared yukke sushi; seared tongue sushi; yukhoe with egg yolk; liver with fried garlic; stone-pot bibimbap; cold noodles; yukgaejang; a butcher's curry; ice cream; courses ¥5,500 and ¥6,000; soft drinks included; alcohol +¥1,100; lunch all-you-can-eat ¥2,500; some found the loin tough or the yaki-shabu all fat.

食べログ (店舗会員): 大衆牛串 空仙、居酒屋・肉料理・ホルモン、西区新町1-.en: Tabelog (shop member): Taishu Gyukushi Kusen; izakaya, meat dishes, offal; Shinmachi 1-8-8, Nishi-ku; 4 min on foot from Yotsubashi Stn, 6 min from Shinsaibashi Stn; Mon–Fri 16:00–22:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:30–22:00; closed the second Monday of each month and irregular days; reservations; all-you-can-drink; courses; happy hour; cards and PayPay, no e-money; 40 seats (14 at the counter); open terrace; smoking allowed; pets allowed; menus in English and Simplified Chinese; takeaway; vegetarian options; opened 25 April 2023; from the popular Fukushige Horumon; signatures are beef skewers, Imabari grilled chicken skin and dote-yaki. Reviews (April 2025–October 2026): outside skirt, liver, pork belly and white leek skewers, recommended grilled fresh liver, raw omasum, windpipe cartilage, egg horumon, beef motsunabe, chicken wings, chicken skin with ponzu, meatballs, macaroni salad, lightly pickled cucumber, tomato-vinegar sour, beer in frosted mugs, dogs welcome, vinyl curtains on rainy days, good value, friendly staff; also comments about fruit flies on the starter, small meat portions and staff not stopping loud customers.

食べログ (店舗会員): 大阪カオマンガイキッチン、タイ料理・カレー、難波中2-.en: Tabelog (shop member): Osaka Khao Man Gai Kitchen; Thai, curry; Nambanaka 2-4-14; 2 minutes' walk from Namba Station on each line; daily 11:30–14:45 and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); reservations (lunch reservations on weekdays only, courses by the day before); cards, e-money and QR accepted; no service charge; 46 seats (tables); a loft on the second floor; private hire for 20–50; non-smoking (smoking area); vegetarian menu; English menu; takeaway; delivery via Uber and others; opened 5 September 2013; 12th anniversary; a Thai chef; the famous khao man gai with homemade sauce; spice levels and other requests accommodated. Reviews (July–October 2026): khao man gai ¥1,200; fried khao man gai ¥1,180; half and half ¥1,250; pad thai ¥1,050; gapao rice; tom yum kung; bua loy; pay first at lunch; oolong tea or coffee included; self-service water and condiments; some say the flavors are sweet.

食べログ (店舗会員): 天ぷら たろじろう、天ぷら・海鮮・オイスターバー、大阪.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Tempura Taroujirou, tempura, seafood, oyster bar; 高橋ビル 1F, 1-8-20 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Namba and Nippombashi Stns; Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 17:00–24:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); closed Wednesdays; lunch L.O. 14:30; reservations accepted (call if more than 15 minutes late); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 23 seats (12 counter, 11 table); opened 22 August 2015. Shop introduction (English translation): a chef who honed skills at the renowned Daikichi in Sakai; attention to oil; seasonal fish and vegetables; fresh fish and shellfish as sashimi, grilled or tempura; staff who know sake. Reviews (January–October 2026): tempura from ¥100 a piece; a choice of sauces and salts; large red shrimp, pumpkin, mentaiko-and-shiso fish, squid legs, manganji pepper, goya, onion, soft-boiled egg; raw oysters (some from Hokkaido); oyster tempura; sanma sashimi; cod milt with ponzu; lunch tempura set; zaru soba set; Akaboshi beer; the Aioibashi shopping street; a regular of five years; often full at weekends; one diner found it average.

食べログ (店舗会員): 天駆、港区六本木7-14-16 六本木FSビル2F、日.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Amakakeru, Roppongi 7-14-16, 六本木FSビル 2F, 1 min from Roppongi Stn exit 4a (Hibiya line), 3 min from exit 7 (Oedo line); Mon–Fri 18:00–24:00 (food L.O. 23:00, drinks L.O. 23:30); closed weekends, holidays and over New Year; counter charge ¥500; 10% service charge; 10 seats; non-smoking (smoking spot at the entrance); cards accepted; please avoid strong perfume. The concept is 'more than an izakaya, less than kaiseki': creative Japanese à la carte; courses ¥6,600 and ¥12,100; closing dishes such as yakisoba, TKG and Gifu specialities. Reviews (December 2025–July 2026): Chef Sakai; straw-seared bonito with house onion soy sauce; rare-fried scallops; Hida beef ribeye sukiyaki in a sherry-based sauce; wild ayu from Gifu; Kansai-style eel; Hong Kong-style fried noodles; beef-tendon curry; sake and Japanese wine.

食べログ (店舗会員): 完全個室 肴 うたげ 上野駅前店、上野6-13-8 上.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Sakana Utage Ueno Ekimae, Ueno 6-13-8, 上野ソシアルビル 4F, 1 min on foot from JR Ueno Station; daily 11:00–24:00 (L.O. food 23:30, drinks 24:00); 2-hour limit on Fri, Sat, Sun and the day before a holiday; same-day cancellations charged 100% of a course or ¥1,000 a head for seats only; a table charge for seat-only bookings; 55 seats; private rooms for 2–30; separate smoking area; cards (UnionPay too) and e-money accepted; children welcome; English, Chinese and Korean menus and staff; opened 1 November 2022; creative dishes with seasonal ingredients; real kaiseki-style dishes at a casual Japanese izakaya. Reviews (August 2024–September 2026): private rooms let you talk without worrying about others; you can drink from midday; three-meat platter; Taiwanese-style motsunabe, not spicy and light; yakitori, sashimi, simmered fish, seared mackerel, Caesar salad, tsukune, teriyaki chicken; drinks come quickly; one said ordinary chain-restaurant taste; reports both that smoking was allowed in the private room (August 2025) and that it was non-smoking (January 2025); a ¥500 table charge and two dishes each (January 2026); the course's finish and dessert fell short of expectations.

食べログ (店舗会員): 完全個室居酒屋 九州さつき 六本木店、港区六本木3-1.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Kyushu Satsuki Roppongi, an izakaya of fully private rooms, Roppongi 3-11-10, Coco Roppongi Building 4F, 5 seconds from Roppongi Stn exit 5; daily 12:00–24:00, open all year; 100 seats; private rooms for 2 to over 30; smoking area (80 smoking seats); cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; English- and Chinese-speaking staff; children welcome; opened 19 August 2016; a whole cake for birthdays and after-parties. Menu: horse sashimi, motsunabe with mentaiko ¥1,575, satsuma-age ¥580, iron-pan gyoza ¥680, yakitori from ¥83 a skewer, assorted sashimi, courses with all-you-can-drink ¥3,828 and ¥4,400, about 40 shochu and sake. Gurunavi: also a 錦糸町店 branch. Reviews (February 2025–September 2026): a typical private-room izakaya; lots of fried food; noisy, with roll-curtain and shoji partitions; tablet ordering; smoking allowed; chicken and pork hot pots finished with rice porridge; one day with a power cut.

食べログ (店舗会員): 実伶、日本料理、中京区竹屋町通室町東入亀屋町143-2.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Mirei, Japanese cuisine, 中京区竹屋町通室町東入亀屋町143-2, about 3 min on foot from Marutamachi Stn; 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); two seatings (17:00–19:00, from 19:30); closed Wednesdays and about once more a month; reservation only; counter only, 9 seats; lunch bookings and private room ended; charge (with appetiser) ¥4,000 before tax; same-day cancellation ¥10,000 à la carte, ¥20,000 course; treated as cancelled after 20 minutes without word; counter for ages 20 and over; no overly casual dress; opened 8 May 2016; The Tabelog Award 2022 Bronze; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021; about 50 à la carte dishes daily; head chef Yuuzou Nakao. Reviews (January–October 2026, in English): order your favourites in the amount you like, Matsutake dobin-mushi, handmade soba, a young, approachable head chef, two seatings.

食べログ (店舗会員): 寿司 なかご 別邸、寿司・海鮮・居酒屋、大阪市中央区心.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Sushi Nakago Bettei, sushi, seafood and izakaya, SOPHIA NEXTビル 1F, Shinsaibashi-suji 1-3-2, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station, daily 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–22:30 (last order 21:30), closed over New Year, reservations accepted, starter ¥330 (tax included), cards, e-money and PayPay accepted, 34 seats, counter, sofa seats, couple seats, private rooms for 2, 4 and 6, private hire 20–50, non-smoking, children and strollers welcome, please avoid strong scents such as perfume or fabric softener, opened 7 November 2020, sister shops Sushi Nakago Shinsaibashi and Meat Kaiseki Kissaki. Shop introduction (machine-translated): a monochrome, modern Japanese designer space, "quality at a reasonable price", red-vinegar rice, fresh fish from the Japan Sea centred on Kanazawa. Reviews (September–October 2026): a lunch-only omakase casual course ¥2,800 (a small dish, the day's special, eight nigiri, red miso soup), the autumn "Shinogi" course ¥7,800 (isaki in sesame soy, tuna, chutoro, salted bonito tataki, squid, shima aji, butter-grilled oyster, grilled salmon, sawara, nameko red miso soup, eel hand roll), summer bonito carpaccio, phone calls outside, a report of being rushed at the end of a sitting, a shop in Umeda too.

食べログ (店舗会員): 寿司、中京区木屋町通四条上る二丁目下樵木町204-7、.en: Tabelog (staff-maintained): sushi; 中京区木屋町通四条上る二丁目下樵木町204-7; 5 min on foot from Kawaramachi, 8 min from Gion-Shijo; 12:00–15:00 (last order food 14:00, drinks 14:30) and 18:00–23:30 (last order 23:00); closed irregularly; reservations accepted (100% charge for same-day cancellation); limited lunch special sushi course ¥16,500 (15 items); special omakase ¥24,200; 10% service charge; no cards, e-money or QR; 15 seats (7 at the counter, 8 at tables); private room; wheelchair accessible; please avoid perfume; children only with the adult course; opened 11 April 2019. Shop text: rice of Ryuu no Hitomi cooked in a clay pot with a blend of three red vinegars; wild bluefin tuna; sake. Reviews (June 2025–October 2026, in English): an alley joining Pontocho and Kiyamachi, a white-wood counter, omakase small dishes and nigiri, a friendly chef, one diner found the red-vinegar rice too sweet (March 2026).

食べログ (店舗会員): 寿司としゃぶしゃぶ･すき焼き食べ放題 HOT POT.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): HOT POT LAB Shinsaibashi Namba (all-you-can-eat sushi and shabu-shabu or sukiyaki), shabu-shabu, sukiyaki, sushi; 大㐂ビル 2F, 2-4-8 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Namba Stn exit 25; daily 12:00–24:00 (food L.O. 23:00, drinks L.O. 23:30); reservations accepted (two-hour limit when busy); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 49 seats; private rooms; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; vegetarian options; children half price, preschoolers free; opened 10 June 2026; courses ¥5,500, ¥6,000 and ¥7,000 when booked online. Shop introduction (English translation): a stylish Japanese space that overturns the all-you-can-eat image; carefully chosen sushi and meat; two of ten broths; ten homemade sauces and thirty condiments; a vegetable buffet with every course. Reviews (October 2026): broths such as chicken salt, sukiyaki, mala, kombu, chicken paitan and sesame soy milk; ikura gunkan and medium-fatty tuna sushi; a 73-item all-you-can-eat ¥7,000 (regular ¥8,000); all-you-can-drink ¥1,500; a ¥6,000 lunch course; a crab hot pot course; no cash register.

食べログ (店舗会員): 小料理 才来天、日本料理・居酒屋・海鮮、大阪市北区堂島.en: Tabelog (shop member): Koryori Sairai Ten, Japanese cuisine, izakaya and seafood, 1-3-4 堂島 B1F, Kita-ku, Osaka; 5 min from Kitashinchi Station; Mon–Fri 17:00–4:00 (last order food 3:00, drinks 3:30); Sat 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; seat bookings come with a few starters (¥3,300–5,500 by season); appetizers only after 21:00; service charge 10%; corkage ¥5,000; cards and PayPay accepted; 16 seats (counter of 8, two tables for 4); heated tobacco until 21:00; opened 14 April 2025; Kagoshima black wagyu and seafood and vegetables direct from the regions; shochu, sake and whisky chosen by Kyushu-born cooks; seasonal omakase of 11 items ¥11,000. Invoice registration: 株式会社Ｙ二Ｘ. Reviews (August–November 2026): a young head chef in the 20s; from Kagoshima; trained in Kyoto; 27 years old; runs it alone so dishes come slowly; rock mozuku; salted tofu; simmered whelk; black edamame; shungiku and persimmon; three-day-aged kinmedai sashimi; squid with Tosa vinegar; matsutake dobin-mushi; saikyo black cod; roast duck; black wagyu tataki and cutlet; venison heart sashimi; chicken kara-age; baby squid stuffed with its liver; plenty of imo shochu; a visit from the chef's junior-high teacher; Koei-giku sake.

食べログ (店舗会員): 小籠包と本格中華 堀江ブルー、中華料理・ダイニングバー.en: Tabelog (shop member): Xiaolongbao and Authentic Chinese Horie Blue, Chinese, dining bar, xiaolongbao, Minami-Horie 1-5-26, Nishi-ku, キャナルテラス堀江 east wing 2F, 3 min on foot from JR Namba Station, weekdays 11:30–15:30 (last order 15:00) and 18:00–23:30 (last order 23:00), weekends and holidays 11:00–15:30 and 17:00–23:30, closed only 1–2 January, dinner table charge ¥330, ¥660 or ¥1,100, cards and PayPay, 72 seats, private rooms, standing parties of 150, non-smoking, night view, children welcome, closed for renovation 7–10 April 2025. Reviews (April–October 2026): riverside night view, blue lighting, couple seats, an assortment of eight Chinese appetizers, xiaolongbao, Chinese gozen lunch ¥2,189 (soup, salad bar, free Chinese tea, congee refills), Yang Guifei afternoon-tea lunch ¥2,700, afternoon tea added to the dim-sum lunch for ¥1,700, sweet-and-sour pork, shrimp fried rice, the dinner à la carte revamped, a report of a sticky floor, days when construction blocked the window view.

食べログ (店舗会員): 居酒屋、下京区河原町通松原上る清水町282、清水五条駅.en: Tabelog (staff-maintained): izakaya; 下京区河原町通松原上る清水町282; 10 min on foot from Kiyomizu-Gojo and Kyoto-Kawaramachi stations; daily 14:00–22:00 (food last order 21:00); closed irregularly; reservations accepted; an appetiser charge; 15 seats (6 at the counter, 3 tables); non-smoking (smoking spot outside); children welcome; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; opened 12 September 2024. Shop text: warm sake that warms you like a bath, seasonal sashimi and obanzai from the central market, simmered pork cartilage, over 30 sakes, afternoon drinking from 14:00. Reviews (March–October 2026, in English): a woman owner and staff (both from Manzara-tei), assorted snacks of eight kinds ¥1,500, ayu and cucumber spring rolls ¥1,200, strawberry and black-bean shira-ae, saba kizushi, firefly squid and udo tempura, herring with eggplant, keema curry, warm sake, listed in Japanese Sake dancyu 2026, the owner running everything alone.

食べログ (店舗会員): 居酒屋ひさ、居酒屋・串揚げ・イタリアン、大阪市中央区東.en: Tabelog (corporate member): Izakaya Hisa; izakaya, kushiage, Italian; Higashi-Shinsaibashi 2-5-6, Tsukushi Kaikan 102, Chuo-ku, Osaka; from Shinsaibashi Station Exit 6 go right along the Shinsaibashi-suji arcade, left onto Suo-cho street, right at the Kintetsu Taxi stand and about 10 m on; Mon–Sat 18:00–3:00 (L.O. 2:00), Sunday 18:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00); closing days not fixed (sometimes closed Sundays or the last day of a holiday run); reservations accepted; cards accepted (VISA, Master); table charge ¥324; 16 seats (4 counter, 12 table); private hire up to 20; smoking allowed; opened 1 April 2015; menu updated April 2016: kushikatsu beef, pork, chicken thigh ¥130, vegetables ¥100–200, shrimp and scallop ¥200, salmon ¥150, chef's assortment of 5 ¥600 or 10 ¥1,200, beef-tendon dote-yaki ¥400, dashi-rolled omelette ¥400, with mentaiko ¥450, salmon and avocado caprese ¥580, white leek marinade wrapped in prosciutto ¥380, shrimp ajillo ¥580. Shop site: Kushikatsu Bar HiSA (Izakaya Hisa); Osaka's famous kushikatsu fused with a bar; Shinsekai-style kushikatsu with Western dishes; daily desserts made by the owner, who has worked as a pastry chef; the background music is Hi-STANDARD; a melodic-hardcore page (albums and songs the owner recommends); no double-dipping in the sauce; open 18:00–27:00; closed Sunday (reservations by arrangement); courses with all-you-can-drink ¥2,500, ¥3,000 and ¥4,000 (120 minutes of drinks). Reviews (April 2022–August 2026): just south of Suo-cho street, ground floor of a tenant building; a square stainless-steel sauce tray; light kushikatsu in a slightly coarse batter; the salmon kushikatsu is good; two cherry tomatoes; shrimp ajillo; grilled avocado with mentaiko mayonnaise; dote-yaki; Hi-STANDARD playing; bass guitars and records; course with all-you-can-drink and 10 kushikatsu ¥3,000 (June 2026); ¥3,380 including the table charge (September 2023); two-hour limit; complaints about service and cleanliness in 2023; staff called friendly in 2024–2026; in January 2026 the manager served alone.

食べログ (店舗会員): 居酒屋・日本料理・ダイニングバー、下京区和泉屋町160.en: Tabelog (staff-maintained): izakaya, Japanese cuisine, dining bar; 下京区和泉屋町160 ランブラス館 1F; 7 min on foot from Keihan Shijo and Hankyu Kawaramachi stations; 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30); closed irregularly; reservations accepted (confirmed by a call from the shop); Kyo no Musubime course, 7 dishes ¥4,400; special course, 9 dishes ¥5,500; fresh sea urchin at cost (reservation required); service charge ¥330; 20 seats (25 standing); smoking allowed; cards, QUICPay, PayPay and Alipay accepted; English menu; opened 15 June 2015. Shop text: seasonal obanzai of Kyoto vegetables and fish, an open kitchen, Tamagawa sake from Kyoto's Kinoshita Sake Brewery. Reviews (February–November 2026, in English): scallop potato salad, assorted sashimi, mentaiko chicken wings, hamo sashimi, meat spring rolls with Saikyo-miso sauce, egg rice to finish, warabi mochi, friendly staff, two women in the kitchen.

食べログ (店舗会員): 山城辣妹子重慶火鍋 上野店、上野公園1-57-7 UE.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Sanseira Mei Shi Juukei Hinabe Ueno, Ueno-koen 1-57-7, UENO3153 3F, 1 min on foot from the JR Ueno Station Shinobazu exit and Tokyo Metro Ueno Station exit 7; daily 11:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); 140 seats; 4 private rooms (up to 10); non-smoking; no cards or e-money; PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay accepted; children welcome; English, Chinese and Korean menus and staff; opened 15 August 2024; authentic Chongqing hot pot; soups are mala, tonkotsu, tomato and mushroom; one-person lunch sets (pork ¥1,749, beef ¥1,859); all-you-can-eat sweets. Reviews (August–October 2026): few Japanese customers; two pots, mushroom and mala; even the mildest is quite spicy; lamb, beef, pork, shrimp balls; mix your own sauce at the sauce corner; sesame balls and other snacks; dogs allowed in; no explanation of how to eat; full on Friday night, booking recommended; a view over the station area.

食べログ (店舗会員): 川田、日本料理、日本橋人形町1-5-5 B1F、人形町.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kawada; Japanese cuisine; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 1-5-5 B1F; 2 min from Ningyocho Station exit A6; Mon–Fri 17:30–21:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–14:30 and 17:30–21:00; Sundays irregular; reservations only; the person who booked must come; bookings cancelled if more than 30 minutes late; about 2½ hours; omakase ¥39,000 (for 2); please avoid perfume; corkage charged; cards accepted; no e-money or QR; 7 seats; non-smoking; The Tabelog Award Bronze 2021, 2022, 2025 and 2026; Japanese cuisine TOKYO Tabelog 100 in 2021, 2023 and 2025; Rosanjin tableware. Reviews (April–October 2026): the owner, Haruji Kawada, has cooked alone since opening; the Kyo-mi lineage; sea-bream broth jelly with fresh sea urchin; taro stems in Yoshino kudzu; fig dengaku; bonito seared over straw in front of you; sweetfish tempura; hamo and junsai soup; matsutake rice and wagyu and matsutake sukiyaki; Ise lobster; clay-pot rice three ways; an off-menu dashi curry; warabi mochi kneaded in front of you; regulars who come every two months; little English spoken; opened February 2019.

食べログ (店舗会員): 店名の由来は、中華では油が大事なので、お客さんにもこの.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): the name comes from the idea that oil is essential in Chinese cooking, in the hope that customers will hold the shop as dear as that oil. The concept: to let many people eat Chinese food with an authentic taste at low prices.

食べログ (店舗会員): 御料理 はやし、日本料理、上京区梶井町448-61、出.en: Tabelog (corporate member): Oryori Hayashi, Japanese cuisine, 上京区梶井町448-61, 7 min from Demachiyanagi Stn; lunch 11:30–15:00 (last entry 13:00), dinner 17:30–21:30 (last entry 19:00); closed Wednesdays, some Thursdays and about twice a month; no changes after a booking is confirmed; 23 seats (a counter of 7 on the ground floor, three private rooms upstairs); no photos at the counter; call ahead about children; cards: JCB and AMEX only; 10% consumption tax on the total including the 10% service charge; The Tabelog Award Silver and Bronze; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025. Reviews (August–October 2026, in English): over 30 years in business, dishes are not explained, the course price changes the fish for sashimi and the grill, a shrimp dumpling soup, a cold rice porridge, sea bream collar, a quiet, tense counter.

食べログ (店舗会員): 心斎橋 鮨 おか崎、寿司、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-10.en: Tabelog (corporate member): Shinsaibashi Sushi Okazaki, sushi, Shinsaibashisuji 1-10-12, トレスビル 3F, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 2 min on foot from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–19:00 (last evening entry 19:00), Sunday lunch only, closed Wednesday, two longer breaks a month on dates not fixed, until sold out; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 20 seats (6 at the counter, 16 at tables); private hire possible; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; opened 7 December 2017. Menu (updated September 2026, tax included): Jō nigiri ¥3,850, special nigiri ¥5,500, chirashi sushi ¥3,300, conger-eel chirashi ¥3,300, deluxe chirashi ¥4,950, Sakura course ¥16,500, Hana course ¥22,000; to take home: rolled sushi, chirashi, conger-eel rolls, pressed sushi (conger eel, mackerel, horse mackerel, sea bream). Shop text: chefs with more than 30 years of experience at Fukki Sushi. Reviews (December 2021 to May 2026): a shop run by a married couple — the owner, the owner's wife, a long-time chef friend and a part-timer, four in all (March 2024); bright, spacious room; lunch nearly always full; warm mozuku, chawanmushi, aged otoro, Yura sea urchin, kohada, firefly squid, homemade karasumi, grilled shirako, kuruma shrimp; conger eel grilled with sauce and the tamago are the specialties; some found lunch a little expensive.

食べログ (店舗会員): 心斎橋イタリアンレストラン ルサンク、イタリアン・ダイ.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Shinsaibashi Italian Restaurant Le Cinq, Italian, dining bar and pasta, UNAGIDANI BLOCK B1F, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-19-15, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 minutes from Shinsaibashi Station exit 2; daily 17:00–1:00 (L.O. 24:00); reservations accepted; ¥550 charge; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 50 seats (6 counter, 35 table, 12 private room); smoking allowed; English menu; opened 11 January 2006; official site le-cinq.gorp.jp. Black wagyu steak, seafood, pasta, pizza, ajillo and risotto; courses with 60+ drinks all-you-can-drink ¥5,500–8,500. Reviews (August–October 2026): A5 wagyu top sirloin course ¥6,500, assorted appetisers, Caesar salad, prosciutto salad, shrimp tomato cream pasta, Genovese, tiramisu, seafood course, carbonara, a lounge-like room with high ceilings, private rooms.

食べログ (店舗会員): 心斎橋神楽、居酒屋・魚介・日本料理、大阪市中央区東心斎.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Shinsaibashi Kagura, izakaya, seafood and Japanese cuisine, マンション馬やど 1F, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-13-3, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 minutes from Nagahoribashi Station, 5 minutes from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); closed Sundays and holidays; Obon closure 11–16 August 2026; reservations accepted; ¥600 charge; fully private rooms ¥500 per person (before tax); cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 52 seats; private and semi-private rooms (up to 24); all non-smoking since 14 January 2025; opened 12 December 2012; official site kaguraosaka.com. Creative Japanese cooking on the idea of food as medicine, lettuce shabu-shabu, salted green peppers, Kagura course (2 hours of drinks) ¥11,500, banquet course ¥6,300, sushi cakes for celebrations. Reviews (November 2025–September 2026): the signature salted green peppers, live squid sashimi, sashimi platter, milk tofu, dashi omelette, tempura rice ball, seko crab, ginkgo, surf clam, miso-pickled mountain burdock, deep-fried nama-fu in dashi, Awa-odori chicken kara-age, Kagura hamburger, iburi-gakko, a fish tank at the entrance, used for business dinners.

食べログ (店舗会員): 恒雅、海鮮・日本料理・鍋、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-5-.en: Tabelog (shop member): Tsunemasa, seafood, Japanese cuisine and hotpot, ボーネールビル 2F, 1-5-32 Sonezaki-Shinchi, Kita-ku, Osaka; 3 min on foot from Kitashinchi Station (JR Tozai Line); 5 min from Higashi-Umeda and Nishi-Umeda stations; Mon–Fri 18:00–4:00 next morning (last order 3:00); Sat 18:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Sundays, holidays and over New Year; reservations accepted; two hours when busy; 10% charge after 22:00; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 30 seats (whole-shop hire up to 35); smoking allowed; opened 4 February 2013; fresh fish direct from Numajima fishing port on Awaji; a signature hotpot of natural yam direct from farmers; a space like a Kyoto townhouse; local sake from across Japan; natural-yam hotpot course ¥6,000; ¥6,000 course of sashimi, obanzai, tempura, simmered fish and Japanese beef roast; ¥8,000 course with grilled kinki and beef fillet cutlet; sister shops Kita-Shinchi Ono Meat Shop and Kita-Shinchi Ushinokami. Reviews (December 2025–October 2026): natural-yam hotpot (pork, head-on shrimp, oysters, chicken, clams, sawara); soba to finish; crab cream croquettes; natural yam with tuna; natural-yam somen with egg yolk; fried natural yam; natural yam on the teppan; three kinds of obanzai; five kinds of sashimi (akagai, flounder, amberjack, yellowtail, tuna); simmered Numajima fish; grilled Aomori kinki; Miyazaki beef cutlet; matsutake kamameshi; horse-meat yukhoe; miso-grilled pork shoulder; bamboo-steamed pork and river shrimp; kara-age; shoes off at the entrance; smoking allowed and the smell on clothes; kind staff; open late.

食べログ (店舗会員): 感情、港区六本木4-12-5 六本木144ビル3F、六.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kanjou, Roppongi 4-12-5, roppongi 144 building 3F, 2 min walk from Roppongi Station exit 7; daily in two seatings, 17:00–19:30 and 20:00–22:30; reservation only (online through OMAKASE); 10% service charge; 7 seats (counter); non-smoking; cards only (no cash); English-speaking staff; asks guests to avoid strong scents such as perfume and fabric softener; no sign outside; opened 22 November 2021; The Tabelog Award 2025 and 2026 Bronze; Tabelog Japanese cuisine TOKYO 100, 2023 and 2025. Shop text: an omakase course of soba handmade every morning and duck from about 20 suppliers grilled on a swordsmith's tamahagane iron plate; a strong wine list. Head chef Seina Ogata (born 1991 in Kumamoto; trained at Madame Toki, Margot et Bouchère and elsewhere; head chef from April 2026). Reviews (August–October 2026): a flow of soba, Japanese and Western dishes, duck, soba and a closing dish; duck that tastes almost like beef; airy soba-yu; duck hayashi; drink pairings; bookings through cancellation notices.

食べログ (店舗会員): 新京飯店、中華料理、大阪市淀川区西中島4-10-11.en: Tabelog (shop member): Shinkyo Hanten; Chinese; 4-10-11 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, ground floor; 355 m from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; daily 11:16–21:50 (food last order 21:30, drinks 21:35); open all year; closing days not fixed; e-money accepted; 17 seats. Reviews (July 2022 to September 2026): a "Peking cuisine" sign; lunch sets (champon and fried rice, ¥900 until 16:00, ¥950 after); harusai and fried rice ¥1,000; stir-fried vegetable set; gomoku soba and fried rice; Chinese-style katsudon under a thick sauce; katsudon and ramen ¥950; a sweetish mapo tofu; mapo noodles; chashu ramen; kara-age; ¥600 choi-ate small plates (chives and egg, pork with green-onion salt, bok choy and pork, spicy chicken stir-fry); beer sets from ¥770; omurice; curry; bento ¥400 and ¥500 outside the shop; delivery through Demaekan and others; quick food; light flavours.

食べログ (店舗会員): 日本料理 弁慶 ホテル日航大阪、日本料理・寿司、西心斎.en: Tabelog (shop member): Japanese Cuisine Benkei, Hotel Nikko Osaka; Japanese cuisine, sushi; Nishi-Shinsaibashi 1-3-3, Hotel Nikko Osaka 3F; directly connected to exit 8 of Shinsaibashi Stn; lunch 11:30–14:30, dinner 17:30–21:00 (last order 20:30), Saturdays and the day before holidays to 21:30 (last order 21:00); 15% service charge; reservations (cancel by the day before; sushi counter from primary-school age); weekday body support lunch ¥3,950, five-kind sashimi gozen ¥5,800, seasonal three-tier bento ¥6,800; cards, e-money and QR; 78 seats; counter of a 250-year-old single slab; private rooms for 8, 10 and up to 32 (5 or fewer: ¥5,500 at lunch, ¥11,000 at dinner); non-smoking; parking; breakfast; allergy information; vegan options; English menu; children and strollers welcome; opened 7 July 2015; dashi handed down by head chef Yoshida Masao for 35 years; private rooms overlooking the Midosuji ginkgo trees. Reviews (November 2024–September 2026): three-tier bento, tempura, Aoi kaiseki, sashimi, sushi course ¥16,000, kamameshi at the end of the summer kaiseki, rolled omelette at the Japanese breakfast, attentive staff; also a comment that plates were cleared too early.

食べログ (店舗会員): 日本料理 河久、日本料理・しゃぶしゃぶ・海鮮、大阪市北.en: Tabelog (shop member): Japanese cuisine Kawakyu, Japanese cuisine, shabu-shabu and seafood, 梅田1-1-3, 33F of Osaka Station Front Building No. 3, Kita-ku, Osaka; 142 m above ground; 2 min on foot from Kitashinchi Station on the JR Tozai Line; Tue–Sun 11:30–22:00 (last order food 20:30, drinks 21:30); lunch 11:30–15:30 (last order 14:00); open through the afternoon at weekends and on holidays; closed Mondays and 31 December–3 January; reservations accepted; cancellation fees (50% the day before, 100% on the day); 10% service charge (none at lunch tables); cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 230 seats; twelve private rooms with sunken kotatsu (5 to 50 people); completely non-smoking; from casual set meals to seasonal kaiseki; hamo in summer, fugu in winter; first-meal (okuizome) feasts; views from the Ikoma mountains in the east to the Akashi Strait in the west; banquet plans (five or more, two hours of drinks): Kawakyu kaiseki ¥9,922 (¥9,000 at weekends from 17:00), Ume kaiseki ¥12,100. Invoice registration: Top of Osaka Co., Ltd. (梅田1-1-3). Reviews (August–October 2026): makunouchi bento ¥1,980; Miyabi gozen; deluxe tempura gozen; salt-grilled ayu; the October Kawakyu kaiseki (pomegranate black vinegar, purple-sweet-potato tofu, sashimi, chestnut, fu, grilled sawara, tempura of shrimp and rockfish, a small squid with roe, sardine-dumpling soup, mushroom takikomi rice, fruit); night views from the private rooms; no split bills; hard tempura batter; tea refills; noise from clearing; small windows in a private room; some found the food average.

食べログ (店舗会員): 日本酒うなぎだに、居酒屋・うなぎ・日本酒バー、大阪市中.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Nihonshu Unagidani, izakaya, eel and sake bar, Shinsaibashi-suji 1-3-28, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 minutes from Shinsaibashi Station exits 5 and 6; Google Maps shows the building to the north; go down the alley behind the vending machines next to Ichiran and turn left at the end; dark at night, so watch your step. Daily 12:00–23:30 (food L.O. 22:30, drinks L.O. 23:00); open year-round; seat-only reservations; 1.5-hour limit when crowded; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 40 seats, mainly standing; non-smoking; opened 24 April 2015. Over 100 sakes always in stock; the signature 'U-maki', ordered by 90% of guests; unaju as a new specialty; course of about 60 sakes all-you-can-drink with sushi ¥9,900; course of about 50 drinks all-you-can-drink with dishes ¥6,600. Reviews (April–October 2026): sake chosen from the fridge, 90 cc; food ordered by QR code; tasting sets; daiginjo set ¥1,880; a glass of Saku ¥1,400; appetiser ¥440; grilled nagaimo with soy ¥650; unagi tamago ¥900; uzaku; chicken sashimi; horse-meat yukhoe; unaju about ¥3,000 at lunch, in 2/3 and 3/4 sizes; somen; duck breast; many foreign visitors in the area, but the shop is calm.

食べログ (店舗会員): 日本酒が永遠に飲める店 たまり場PON、居酒屋・日本酒.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Nihonshu ga Eien ni Nomeru Mise Tamariba PON, izakaya, sake bar, bar; 難波チャンプビル 4F, 1-4-3 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Osaka-Namba Stn; Tue–Sun 17:30–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); closed Mondays; reservations accepted (private hire from 20 people Sunday to Thursday, 30 on Friday and Saturday); pay when seated; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 56 seats; non-smoking; opened 2 October 2017; sake all-you-can-drink 90 minutes ¥2,750, unlimited time ¥3,000. Shop introduction (English translation): self-serve all-you-can-drink of about 150 sakes from across Japan (including rare limited editions); bring your own food or order delivery; on weekdays takoyaki makers and other cooking gear and games to borrow. Reviews (September 2025–July 2026): unlimited-time plan ¥3,850 (with beer, shochu, highballs and chūhai); single glasses ¥600; clams steamed in sake; dashimaki; regulars bring food in; you can step out and come back; complaints of slow restocking and few snacks.

食べログ (店舗会員): 旬菜 甘の井 (しゅんさいあまのい)、日本料理・鍋、大.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Shunsai Amanoi (しゅんさいあまのい), Japanese cuisine and hot pot, 心斎橋Ｍビル 9F, Nishi-Shinsaibashi 1-10-28, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 1 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station, 3 min from Yotsubashi Station, Mon–Sat 17:00–22:30, closed Sundays and holidays, reservation only (phone from 13:00), cancellations on the day or the day before charged 100% of the course, no cover charge, cards accepted, no e-money or QR, 50 seats (28 at tables, 22 on tatami), private rooms for 2–28, the whole floor can be hired, a heated-tobacco smoking area, children welcome, sister shop Rilegalo. Shop introduction (machine-translated): a hideaway in a condominium behind the Hotel Nikko, kaiseki and Kyoto duck hot pot in tatami rooms and at tables, duck raised in Kyotanba sent direct from a Kyoto duck farm, celebrities come incognito, a third hour of all-you-can-drink for ¥1,200. Reviews (September 2025–October 2026): duck hot pot course with all-you-can-drink ¥7,700, handmade soba to finish, duck tempura wrapped in green onion, a ten-dish special kaiseki, thick-cut sashimi, steamed kinmedai, wagyu yukhoe, matsutake tempura, Tamano Hikari junmai daiginjo, lighting adjusted for elderly guests, a report of thin walls between rooms, harder to book.

食べログ (店舗会員): 旬菜魚 藍、港区六本木4-4-3 六本木協和ビル西館1.en: Tabelog (shop member): Shunsai Gyo Ai, Roppongi 4-4-3, 六本木協和ビル西館 1F, 1 min walk from Roppongi Station exit 7 (Oedo line); Mon–Sat and days before and after holidays 11:30–13:30 (lunch by reservation at least one business day ahead) and 17:00–22:00 (23:00 per the shop note); takeaway 16:30–22:00; closed Sundays and holidays; ¥4,200 for appetizers and dessert (included in courses); 28 seats (counter 8, three tables for 4, two tatami rooms for 6); private hire up to 50; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted. Shop text: 500 g black abalone from Maizuru; alum-free Kitamurasaki sea urchin from Rishiri; hairy crab; soft-shelled turtle course ¥19,700 (book 4 days ahead). Reviews (2017–November 2025): opened around 1996; glutinous rice with karasumi; hassun; Kōbako crab; fugu and Seki mackerel; hamo; wild eel; horse sashimi; narwhal bacon; moon-bear hot pot; sea-bream rice; prices are not shown and some were surprised by the bill.

食べログ (店舗会員): 旬魚菜 磯一 新大阪店、居酒屋・海鮮・鍋、大阪市淀川区.en: Tabelog (shop member): Shun Gyo Sai Iso Ichi, Shin-Osaka shop; izakaya, seafood, hot pot; ニッセイ新大阪ビル 1F, 宮原3-4-30, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 2 minutes on foot from Shin-Osaka Station on the Midosuji Line, 7 from JR Shin-Osaka; daily 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–23:00, Fridays and days before holidays to 24:00; closed 31 December–2 January; no lunch reservations; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 86 seats; semi-private rooms; sunken kotatsu; non-smoking; opened 30 May 2009; morning-caught fish from ports nationwide; three signatures: wild nodoguro clay-pot rice, the Iso-mori platter and zukushi dishes; banquets up to 62. Reviews (2026): a group with Shin-Osaka, Yamada and Esaka; sister shop of Esaka; nodoguro kamameshi takes 40 minutes; sashimi platters; simmered kinmedai; katsuo tataki; sanma; matsutake dobin-mushi; crab; whale; gratin; avocado and cheese; course with all-you-can-drink about ¥5,000; lunch grilled fish set ¥1,180 (hokke and mackerel); fried shrimp and shrimp cream croquette set; free rice refills; one free raw egg; a pork miso soup full of vegetables; QR-code ordering; sake.

食べログ (店舗会員): 明陽軒、しゃぶしゃぶ・すき焼き、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Meiyo Ken, shabu-shabu, sukiyaki; 4-4 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 7 min walk from Namba Stn exit 14 and Shinsaibashi Stn exit 6, 5 from Nippombashi Stn exit 2; Mon–Sat 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed Sundays; reservations accepted (at most two course types per group); service charge 15%; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 35 seats; private rooms for 2–18; tatami and sunken seating; non-smoking. Shop introduction (English translation): a long-established Japanese restaurant of Soemoncho founded in 1928; the signature uni shabu (seafood bought daily in a special uni broth); sukiyaki with a secret sauce in a custom 18-karat gold pot; private rooms apart from the counter; sake from the Imanishi brewery; seafood uni shabu course ¥8,855. Reviews (November 2023–August 2026): uni broth blended with soy milk; sea bream and swordfish; uni rice porridge; a ¥10,000 course came to ¥11,000 a head (March 2025; three starters, mountain-vegetable tempura); sukiyaki cooked by a woman in kimono; seasonal grilled fish; vichyssoise; conger eel tempura; fried cod milt; seafood in cream sauce; cheese pudding; mizore-zake; private rooms looking over the Dotonbori river and its boats; hard to book.

食べログ (店舗会員): 星空キッチン nova、バル・イタリアン・ダイニングバ.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Hoshizora Kitchen nova, bar, Italian, dining bar; 1-19-2 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Stn exit 4 (the Daimaru and PARCO exits are nearest); Tue–Sun 18:00–5:00 (L.O. 4:00); closed Mondays; reservations accepted (two-hour limit when busy and on courses; cancelled after 15 minutes late); cards, e-money and QR accepted; 40 seats; private and semi-private rooms by reservation; opened 1 May 2019. Shop introduction (English translation): casual creative Italian and wine; reservation-only courses; a two-storey space said to be designed by the world-famous architect Tadao Ando, with a high-ceilinged long counter on 1F and hideaway sofa seats on 2F. Reviews (March–October 2026): appetizer platter (mackerel with a sauce of dried tomato, eggplant and white miso), fresh fish carpaccio, caprese, pickles, shrimp bread, Bolognese, carbonara, peperoncino, margherita, outside skirt steak, wine by the glass; narrow, steep stairs (one diner sprained an ankle); strict two-hour courses; friendly staff.

食べログ (店舗会員): 月夜に米の飯 武井、港区六本木3-9-3 第2ヴィレッ.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Tsukiyo ni Kome no Meshi Takei, Roppongi 3-9-3, 第2ヴィレッジビル B1F, 2 min from Roppongi crossing; Tue–Sun 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Mondays, with occasional irregular closures; 10% service charge; 18 seats; private rooms (2, 4, 6); tatami and sunken seating; non-smoking (smoking spot outside); cards accepted; opened 14 December 2021. The concept is smiles through food. Rice from around Japan cooked in a donabe. Seasonal special course, 8 dishes with donabe white rice, ¥13,200. Reviews (January–October 2026): a menu that changes monthly; clam chawanmushi, hassun, sawara, buri shabu, wagyu roast beef, ayu confit, Okinawa mozuku, dashimaki tamago, soy-milk pudding; a choice of four rices; leftovers made into onigiri; an unsigned door.

食べログ (店舗会員): 朋友雑穀食府 (パンユウザッコクショクフ)、中華・飲茶.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Panyu Zakkoku Shokufu (パンユウザッコクショクフ), Chinese, dim sum and skewers, 第２右田ビル 1F, Shimanouchi 2-6-16, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 6 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station, daily 11:00–2:00 the next morning (food last order 1:30), reservations accepted, cards and PayPay accepted, 33 seats (tables), private and semi-private rooms for 4–20, private hire 20–50, smoking allowed, menus in English, Chinese and Korean, English- and Chinese-speaking staff, photo menu, takeout. Shop introduction (machine-translated): a Chinese tavern of Xi'an and Sichuan cooking, grilled fish, skewers and hot pot, Xi'an biang biang noodles said to be the longest in Japan, spices and herbs from the owner's hometown in Sichuan, numbing and hot, featured on TV and elsewhere, a 14-dish banquet course with all-you-can-drink (¥5,000 Mon–Thu, ¥5,300 Fri–Sun, 25% off with a coupon). Reviews (August 2025–October 2026): biang biang noodles (spicy or not), tomato and egg noodles, a bowl about 50 cm across, spicy poached white fish, lamb skewers, spring rolls, hot-and-sour soup dumplings, a stir-fried pork lunch, frogs and crayfish, terracotta-warrior figures, authentic flavours, strong spices, all-you-can-drink ¥1,650, many delivery riders.

食べログ (店舗会員): 木山、日本料理、中京区絹屋町136 ヴェルドール御所.en: Tabelog (corporate member): Kiyama, Japanese cuisine, 中京区絹屋町136 ヴェルドール御所 1F, 5 min from Marutamachi Stn; lunch 12:00–13:00 (last entry), dinner 18:00–19:30 (last entry); irregular closing days; some days without the head chef; no bookings through third parties; no seat requests; please avoid perfume; 30 seats (a counter of 9 and private rooms); smart casual; children and babies welcome, with a kids' menu; cards accepted; service charge 10%; opened 25 April 2017; The Tabelog Award Gold 2021 and Silver; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025. The chef was born in Gifu in 1981, joined Wakuden at 19 and stayed 15 years, 10 of them as head chef, went independent in 2017 and won a Michelin star in 2018. Reviews (August–October 2026, in English): the meal begins with boiled well water, katsuobushi shaved in front of you and the first dashi, five kinds of closing rice dishes, Matsutake, watermelon at summer lunch, a ryotei in Beppu.

食べログ (店舗会員): 本家 大たこ 法善寺店、たこ焼き・お好み焼き・居酒屋、.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Honke Otako Hozenji, takoyaki, okonomiyaki and izakaya, Namba 1-1-6, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 minutes from Namba Station exit 14; daily 11:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:00), no afternoon break, open all year; reservations accepted; no same-day online changes; phone for 10 or more; no service or seat charge; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 70 seats (1F counter 4 and tables 17, 2F tables 10 and sunken seating 17, 3F tables up to 22); non-smoking; for konamon, Otako; its own sauce; a private room for up to 18 on 3F; courses: Dotonbori course (from 4, free drinks) ¥6,000, Hozenji course (from 2). Reviews (June–October 2026): takoyaki with big octopus, 6 to take away, okonomiyaki, negiyaki of pork and tendon (sauce or soy), yakisoba, horumon yakisoba, sobameshi, kushikatsu, offal stew, dashimaki, kara-age, seafood on the teppan, a queue on weekend evenings, a review of lukewarm takoyaki, calmer than the Dotonbori shop.
