食べログ (店舗会員): 本格中華・北京ダック専門店 北京カォヤーテン 上野店.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Honkaku Chuka Peking Duck Senmon Ten Peking Kaoyaten Ueno (the page title gives 北京烤鴨店), Ueno-koen 1-57, UENO3153 1F, 1 min on foot from the JR Ueno Station Shinobazu exit, Tokyo Metro Ueno Station exit 7 and Keisei Ueno Station; daily 11:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); open all year; 240 seats (up to 300 in the introduction); 5 private rooms (6–70 people; 6–40 in the introduction); non-smoking (smoking room); cards, e-money and QR accepted; children welcome; kids' menu; opened 1 December 2022 (the course text puts the 3rd anniversary on 5 December 2025); Beijing cooking plus Sichuan, Shanghai and Cantonese dishes; wood-fired Peking duck carved at the table by a chef trained at a famous Peking-duck restaurant in China; 140-dish 120-minute all-you-can-eat from ¥4,680; 10-dish courses from ¥2,980; 8 dishes with Peking duck and shark-fin shumai and 2-hour drinks ¥3,980; 12-dish 3rd-anniversary course ¥6,000. Reviews (September–November 2026): Peking duck, shark-fin shumai, seafood shumai, xiaolongbao, fried rice, mapo tofu, sea cucumber; two Peking duck rolls with a lunch under ¥2,000; popular with overseas tourists; one felt two restaurants were combined; in October one found the service curt and the food disappointing; on a Sunday lunchtime the roughly 100-seat room was full.

食べログ (店舗会員): 楽洛亭 本店 (ラクラクテイ)、焼肉、難波4-4-6、.en: Tabelog (shop member): Rakuraku Tei Honten; yakiniku; Namba 4-4-6; exits 9 and 10 of Namba Station on the Midosuji Line; daily 11:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); closed 30 December to 2 January; reservations (online bookings 11:00–13:45 on weekdays are à la carte only; set meals by phone); the second floor can be hired for 30–40; two-hour limit when busy; cards accepted; no e-money or QR; 68 seats; counter; families with children on the second floor only; separate smoking area; English and Simplified Chinese menus with photos; takeaway; in business for over 70 years; a secret sauce made fresh without additives; fresh wagyu and horumon prepared by hand. Reviews (August–October 2026): a sauce full of green onion; sansho; outside skirt; salted tongue; Volume Lunch A 160 g ¥1,430; Volume Lunch B 220 g ¥2,200; one rice refill; a six-cut 300 g platter; charcoal shichirin; smoky, clothes take on the smell; ashtrays on the tables; across from Marui; some say the seasoning is heavy, the cold noodles disappointing or the meat dear for its quality.

Reviews (August–October 2026): fried horse mackerel and fried oyster set ¥1,200, a starter of black-bean honey cream cheese ¥438, komatsuna and cream cheese with bonito soy ¥418, fresh mizuna kimchi ¥528, taro kara-age ¥638, three obanzai ¥858, five oden ¥1,078, Beautiful Skin Oden ¥265, oyakodon (salt and soy) ¥2,398, Umashio Teba ¥49 each, a dog-shaped monaka, many guests with dogs, kind staff.

Invoice registration: BECOME Co., Ltd. (same address as the shop). Reviews (December 2025–October 2026): one crab per person; each leg seasoned differently (kombu, dashi soy, tartar); Shaoxing-wine marinade; crab miso; seiko crab; hand-rolled sushi; crab soup noodles; crab curry rice; clay-pot crab rice; clam ramen; crab sake; Ise lobster; dessert; a tatami counter in sukiya style; a comment that the chef is Mr Ikeda, formerly head chef of Kanijenne; a comment of a 20-minute wait for latecomers at the simultaneous start.

食べログ (店舗会員): 汽素火、日本料理、天ぷら、そば、日本橋人形町1-5-1.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kisui; Japanese cuisine, tempura, soba; room 302, 日本橋芸者新道ビル, Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 1-5-10; 1 min from Ningyocho Station; Mon 17:00–23:00, Tue–Sun and holidays 12:00–14:30 and 17:30–23:00; irregular closing days; reservations only; allergies are hard to handle on the day; omakase ¥30,000; lunch short course ¥12,000 until 30 November; 10% service charge; 7 seats; English menu; no shorts, sandals or strong perfume; opened 20 May 2026; a counter like a tea room; seasonal flavours woven from salt, water and nigari. Reviews (August–October 2026): two cooks (Japanese dishes; tempura and soba); trained at famous restaurants; house tofu of only salt and nigari; squid salt; tempura of river fish delivered live from Iida; fig tempura; ju-wari soba; a tasting of clay-pot rices; soba pudding; the menu changes monthly; mostly satisfied diners, but one found it uneven and expensive.

食べログ (店舗会員): 法善寺 浅草、ふぐ・すっぽん・日本料理、大阪市中央区難.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Hozenji Asakusa, fugu, suppon, Japanese cuisine; 1-1-12 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Namba Stn; Sun–Fri and holidays 17:00–22:30, Sat 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:30; lunch by reservation the day before; irregular holidays; reservations accepted; no service or room charge; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 50 seats (all private rooms); tatami rooms; non-smoking (smoking area). Reviews (January–September 2026): three-year-old fugu, thick tecchiri, fried fugu, hamo sukiyaki with somen and porridge, hamo shabu-shabu, poached hamo with umeboshi, a two-person counter room overlooking Hozenji Yokocho, a long-established shop at the Yokocho entrance.

Reviews (December 2025–September 2026): the YOKOO set (beef cutlet, hamburg, fried shrimp); salad; rice; miso soup; cream croquettes; the famous katsu sandwich; sea bream or amadai with butter sauce; steak with garlic rice; omurice; appetizer platters; the 50th anniversary; carried on since a grandfather's day; lunch by reservation since the pandemic; white tablecloths; the master's smile.

Invoice registration: LIBERTY Co., Ltd. Reviews (June–October 2026): sashimi and tempura set ¥1,080 (8 tempura, 3 small dishes, fish miso soup, refills of rice and soup), sashimi boat, live Ise lobster, abalone, grilled hokke, shrimp mayo salad, grilled yam, grilled horumon, gyoza, a big bottle of sake on the ¥5,000 course, no English menu, mostly Japanese guests, a maze-like layout, smoking at the table.

Shop introduction (English translation): shrimp shabu-shabu (raw with soy sauce, then shabu-shabu in a miso broth, ramen to finish), sashimi platters, overflowing sushi, grilled shellfish. Reviews (August–October 2026): large red shrimp that can be eaten raw, broth enriched by the heads, miso and mala broths, crab and shrimp shabu-shabu with grilled crab miso, boat platters, sushi pizza, temari spoon sushi, grilled crab shell, eel skewers, hamo tempura, kushikatsu, crab cream croquettes, a view of Dotonbori; one diner was sent to the other shop and suggests calling ahead.

Creative Japanese cooking with seafood bought daily and seasonal vegetables, sake and shochu, live abalone, rock oysters, monkfish, tiger fugu, winter buri, matsutake, uni grilled rice balls, Hokkaido fresh octopus shabu-shabu. Reviews (February 2025–July 2026): a ¥6,000 course with all-you-can-drink (octopus shabu-shabu, udon to finish), sea-bream head simmered +¥1,800, the Senzen, Chizuru and Yuetsu courses, 'gout hot pot', buri shabu, salmon kizushi, butter-soy scallops, yellowtail skewers, goya tempura, tempura rice balls, some say the seats are cramped, smoking inside.

食べログ (店舗会員): 深夜食堂 しまながし、日本料理、大阪市北区堂島1-5-.en: Tabelog (shop member): Shinya Shokudo Shimanagashi, Japanese cuisine, Dojima Leisure Building 4F, 1-5-35 堂島, Kita-ku, Osaka; 5 min on foot from Kitashinchi Station; Tue–Sat 18:00–1:30; Sun 18:00–1:00; closed Mondays; operated by Hyperion Co., Ltd.; reservations accepted; starter charge ¥600; cards and QUICPay accepted, no QR; 11 seats (counter of 7, a private room for 4); heated tobacco only; wheelchair accessible; creative dishes beyond Japanese, Western and Chinese categories; the signature beef cutlet with house sauce; horumon curry rice of small intestine, vegetables and bonito dashi; sake and shochu. Reviews (September–October 2026): Yamagata-style dashi on cold tofu; red shrimp marinated in Shaoxing wine; chicken-neck yakisoba; green-pepper salad; nagaimo kimchi; zaru soba; fried rice; hamo in broth; toro-taku (a comment that it was hard); sweet-potato tempura; pork and cabbage stew; pork kimchi; sake-lees soup; tuna with egg yolk and soy; steamed eel; ordering by phone; the owner at the counter and two cooks in the kitchen; reasonable for Kitashinchi; comments that it suits a second stop.

The signature is the chunk steak (lean domestic wagyu, grilled over charcoal in four stages to medium-rare, salt and pepper only, more than ten condiments); four courses with all-you-can-drink from ¥6,500, and an Oita beef L-bone steak only in the ¥10,500 course. Tabelog Steak・Teppanyaki WEST 100 2025, Hot Restaurant 2025. Menu (updated 12 July 2026, tax included): Kamui beef uchihira ¥154 per 10g, Kagoshima black wagyu uchihira ¥176 per 10g, other limited cuts, green peppers ¥495, stew ¥550, heart sashimi ¥968, tomato salad ¥968 and more. Reviews (June–October 2026): the meat is shown before and after grilling, a lid-lifting show, a 2-hour limit, happy-hour highballs, a solo diner in September paid about ¥6,700 for 280g of black wagyu at ¥4,928 with two sides and drinks, reports that the staff had changed and prices crept up, tender lean meat, soba to finish.

食べログ (店舗会員): 瀧谷飯店、中華料理、大阪市西区新町1-14-39 日宝.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Takitani Hanten, Chinese, 日宝立売堀ビル 1F, Shinmachi 1-14-39, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 minutes from Honmachi Station exits 22 and 23; Tue, Wed, Thu and Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–22:00, Fri and Sun 17:30–22:00; closed Monday and the second Sunday; reservations accepted; the counter at busy times; cards and PayPay accepted; 30 seats (26 table, 4 counter); a semi-private room for up to 25; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi; authentic yet nostalgic Chinese by a chef with 30 years of experience; the prized mapo tofu; dandan noodles on Wednesdays only; daily blackboard specials; banquets with two hours of drinks from ¥5,500. Reviews (October 2025–September 2026): mapo tofu lunch ¥1,200 (large ¥1,450, free rice refills, soup and salad, mini almond tofu ¥100), mapo on Tue, Thu and Sat and dandan noodles on Wednesday, yodare chicken, Chinese-style sashimi (kanpachi, striped jack), shark-fin spring rolls, shrimp mayo, shrimp in chili sauce, shumai, lamb tongue stir-fried with chili, Dojima mapo tofu, jellyfish, yurinchi, shirasu fried rice, a ¥6,300 course with free drinks for ten, one review saying it is run by one person and another that the staff kept things moving.

食べログ (店舗会員): 炉端焼き一新 難波、炉端焼き・居酒屋・海鮮、大阪市中央.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Robata Yaki Isshin Nanba, robatayaki, izakaya, seafood; ニュー豊楽ビル 2F, 1-7-6 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Namba Stn exit 14; Mon–Fri 17:00–23:30, Sat, Sun and holidays 15:00–23:30; irregular holidays; reservations accepted (private rooms from four people); cards, e-money and QR accepted; 30 seats; private rooms; smoking allowed; opened 21 December 2022; seasonal robata course ¥6,600 (two hours of drinks, local sake +¥1,650). Shop introduction (English translation): fresh fish delivered daily from around Japan and skewers; charcoal grilling; select wagyu tenderloin and limited vegetable-wrapped skewers; drinks up to Japanese whisky; private rooms. Reviews (June–September 2026): straw grilling; bonito tataki with garlic salt (half portions possible); whole grilled mackerel ¥1,980; whole grilled squid; butter-soy grilled clams; botan shrimp; wild bluefin; toro; pork belly rolled with green onion and lettuce; whole grilled zucchini; chicken neck with ponzu; wagyu namerō; beef and tofu salad; conger eel tempura; fried kinme and water eggplant; charcoal yakisoba; dashimaki; grilled rice balls; a long sake list; smoking at every seat, cigarettes included.

食べログ (店舗会員): 炭と海鮮と串焼きと肴 とっとっと 難波千日前店、居酒屋.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Sumi to Kaisen to Kushiyaki to Sakana Totto Namba Sennichimae, izakaya, motsunabe and yakitori, 岸田ビル 3F, Namba 3-4-14, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 minutes from Namba Station exit 19; daily 12:00–15:00 and 16:00–24:00 (food L.O. 23:00, drinks L.O. 23:30); reservations accepted; 90-minute limit when busy; appetiser ¥440; 10% New Year surcharge from 4 December to 5 January; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 100 seats; non-smoking (smoking area inside); opened 10 June 2025. Hakata-style robata, morning-catch sashimi, vegetable-wrapped skewers, the signature Hakata mentaiko tororo motsunabe, courses with all-you-can-drink ¥4,500 and ¥5,500, Shusse Sour. Reviews (September–October 2026): salt-grilled salmon belly with ikura ¥858, Hakata mentaiko dashi omelette ¥880, fried skate wing ¥528, five sashimi, live octopus with salt and sesame oil, grilled kinmedai and ayu, nodoguro, hamachi yuzu carpaccio ¥748, ebi mayo ¥638, chikuwa tempura with cheese, pork and green onion rolls, meat-wrapped lettuce, shrimp chili, oden, cheese champon or zosui to finish, set meals only at midday, fortune-slip chopsticks, a bell for 'great fortune', always full, some find it pricey and loud.

食べログ (店舗会員): 炭火焼 鶏奈緒、上野7-5-5、上野駅から徒歩3分、月.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Sumibiyaki Torinao, Ueno 7-5-5, 3 min on foot from Ueno Station; Mon–Sat 18:00–24:00; closed Sundays and holidays (open on Saturday holidays, Golden Week, summer holidays and New Year); reservations until 19:30; courses booked by 22:00 the day before; table charge ¥300 a head; 16 seats (4 at the counter, 12 at tables); non-smoking; cash only; no children; please avoid loud conversation; opened 5 November 2008; the owner grills fresh chicken over charcoal while fanning it, and takes care over how and on what the skewers are threaded. Reviews (November 2021–September 2026): tsukune with salt only; food took over 40 minutes (May 2022); Miou chicken; chef's five-skewer platter; cha soba; chicken breast tasting (wasabi, homemade negi-miso, plum-shiso); tomato and chicken breast with wasabi; liver sashimi; tataki; Hoppy; fresh-squeezed sours; sake; a small shop run by the owner alone (July 2025); a quiet, gentle master; a certified Sapporo Beer shop (September 2026).

食べログ (店舗会員): 炭火焼き鳥 鴨尽、焼き鳥・居酒屋・鍋、大阪市中央区難波.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Sumibi Yakitori Kamojin, yakitori, izakaya and hot pot, Namba-Sennichimae 3-19, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 3 min walk from Nankai Namba Station, 17:00–2:00 the next morning (food last order 1:00, drinks 1:30), open on Wednesdays too from November 2026, reservations for two or more by the day before, phone after 15:00, table charge ¥385 (tax included), cards, e-money and QR accepted, 40 seats (1F to 3F), a private room for about 8 on 3F, non-smoking, children welcome, opened 30 July 2023. Shop introduction (machine-translated): Omi duck from Takashima, Shiga, and Yamato chicken raised by 雅chickfarm in Nara for the group, charcoal grilling and fermented dishes, three sister shops nearby. Reviews (September–October 2026): duck tataki (breast and thigh), duck sashimi, chicken sashimi platter, house condiments (garlic koji, yuzu, miso, wasabi, salt), duck with green onion, heart, gizzard, neck, quail eggs, charcoal-grilled edamame, caciocavallo, potato salad with three cheeses, duck kara-age, grilled rice balls, soba to finish, craft beer, Kamojin sour, many non-alcoholic drinks, a terrace seat, ordering by call bell, delays on a busy night, and a view that it is a little pricey for the portions.

食べログ (店舗会員): 炭火焼き鳥 鶏尽、焼き鳥・居酒屋、大阪市中央区難波千日.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Sumibi Yakitori Torijin, yakitori and izakaya, Namba-Sennichimae 2-21, Chuo-ku, Osaka, south of the Nankai-dori arcade, 3 min walk from Kintetsu Nippombashi Station, Mon–Fri and the days before and after holidays 17:00–2:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–2:00 (last order 1:30), open year-round, reservation calls from 15:00, starter ¥385 (tax included), cards, e-money and QR accepted, 60 seats (1F and 2F), counter, private rooms for 2, 4, 6 and 10, tatami, non-smoking (ashtrays outside), menus in English, Chinese (traditional and simplified) and Korean, vegetarian options, sister shops 鴨尽, Ojijin and Sumiyaki Shoten Yo Namba. Shop introduction (machine-translated): Nara's Yamato chicken over Kishu binchotan, 21 kinds of yakitori, each part with its own grilling and seasoning, olive oil and salted kelp too, chicken only with no beef or pork, the signature Torofuwa oyakodon (bonito and kelp dashi). Reviews (August–October 2026): Yamato chicken sashimi of five cuts ¥1,380 (¥1,518 in another review), special tsukune ¥350, back liver ¥340, liver ¥300, bonjiri ¥300, grilled Yoshida Farm cheese from Okayama ¥780, kara-age with grated daikon and ponzu ¥780, zaru tofu, yuba-wrapped century egg, the starter, juicy yakitori, and a view that it was average.

食べログ (店舗会員): 炭火焼肉 大歓 (Sumibi Yakiniku Da.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Sumibi Yakiniku Daikan, yakiniku, horumon and Korean, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-9-12, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 minutes from Nagahoribashi Station, 5 minutes from Shinsaibashi Station; Tue–Sun 17:00–24:00, closed Mondays (holidays too); for late nights, the nearby second shop (Mikyu-bashi branch, 17:00–3:00); reservations accepted, no seat choice (1F non-smoking, 2F and 3F smoking); please avoid same-day cancellations; courses limited to two hours from September 2026; courses with 120 minutes of free drinks ¥6,800 and ¥8,800 (4–20 people); cards, iD, QUICPay and PayPay accepted; 50 seats (6 at the counter, 44 at tables); a detached house; authentic charcoal yakiniku with a focus on homemade dishes; a shop run by a 'meat professional'; opened 5 October 2017. Reviews (August–October 2026): premium salted tongue, thick-cut tongue, green-onion salt tongue, harami, premium mino, ribeye, premium liver, yukke, many half portions, namul and kimchi platter just under ¥1,000, oxtail soup, cold noodles, full even at 20:00 on a weekday with walk-ins turned away, wine only by the half bottle, about ¥5,000–10,000 a head.

食べログ (店舗会員): 炭火焼肉CoCoRo 本店 (スミビヤキニクココロ)、.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sumibi Yakiniku CoCoRo Honten (Sumibi Yakiniku Kokoro); yakiniku, offal, Korean; Higashi-Shinsaibashi 2-3-9, 喜多原 Building 1F; 5 min on foot from Namba, Shinsaibashi and Nippombashi Stns; daily 17:30–5:00 (last orders food 4:15, drinks 4:30); open all year; reservations (pairs may be at the counter); two hours when busy; courses with two-hour all-you-can-drink (Ume 10 dishes ¥5,800, Matsu 12 dishes ¥6,300, Takumi 14 dishes ¥6,800, before tax); cards and PayPay, no e-money; 25 seats; smoking allowed; free Wi-Fi; wheelchair accessible; vegetarian options; opened 3 December 2009; run directly by a butcher shop; over 30 kinds of meat and offal, over 40 sides, over 50 drinks; at the counter the owner teaches how to grill; the restroom is checked every hour. Reviews (March–October 2026): green-onion salted tongue, 30-second kalbi with grated daikon ponzu, Sendai-style salted tongue with nozawana, thin tsurami, wagyu outside skirt, skirt sashimi, the yakiniku shop's egg on rice, cold noodles, shiitake, a monthly limited dish (celery in March), a sister shop on Europe-dori, children's tableware, lively service.

食べログ (店舗会員): 炭火焼鳥 いざ和 人形町店、焼き鳥、鶏料理、居酒屋、日.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sumibi Yakitori Izawa, Ningyocho branch; yakitori, chicken dishes, izakaya; SIL人形町 5F, Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-6-7; 1 min from Ningyocho Station exit A3; Mon–Fri and the day before a holiday 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–23:00, Sat 17:00–23:00; closed Sundays and holidays (open at Golden Week and Obon); 19 seats (9 counter, 10 table); cards and PayPay accepted; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; menus in English, Chinese and Korean; cannot take bookings from guests with severe allergies (including to seasonings); course cancellation fee 100% on the day or the day before, 50% two days before; opened 1 September 2025; omakase skewer course ¥6,200, Izawa course ¥7,200, premium course ¥8,200; sake chosen by the owner, who holds a sake sommelier qualification; a chef trained at well-known restaurants. Reviews (September–October 2026): chrysanthemum sake as an aperitif; dashi-maki tamago with sea urchin and salmon roe; furisode with house pickled-ginger miso; gizzard with shiso sauce; liver bought that day; chicken wings; tsukune with onion; grilled tempura of maitake and Annou sweet potato; eggplant cooked in chicken fat; grated daikon with free refills; a choice of chicken soboro rice, sansho keema curry or chicken ramen to finish; sake-lees ice cream; seen off with a flint striker; chicken hitsumabushi at lunch; at lunch the upselling felt a bit pushy to one diner.

食べログ (店舗会員): 炭火焼鳥 小鉄 西中島店、焼鳥・居酒屋・日本料理、大阪.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sumibi Yakitori Kotetsu Nishinakajima ten; yakitori, izakaya, Japanese cuisine; 6-3-32 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, ground floor; 7 minutes on foot from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station, Shin-Osaka Station and Hankyu Minamikata Station; Mon–Sat 17:30–24:00, closed Sunday; reservations accepted; cards accepted, no e-money; 20 seats (6 at the counter, 14 at tables); no private rooms; whole-shop hire possible; smoking allowed. The shop's introduction: Daisen jidori chicken grilled slowly over Kishu binchotan; a calm room with wooden doors and jazz; sasami with wasabi and a liver without any odour; finishing dishes of chicken soup simmered five hours; sake and shochu; all-you-can-drink ¥4,500; a winter-only small iron pot for one. Courses (with 90 minutes of drinks, tax included): kamameshi course ¥5,500, hot pot course ¥6,000, course of starters, hot pot and yakitori ¥7,000. Reviews (April 2019 to September 2026): opened about a year earlier (April 2019); a quiet chef (December 2019); booking essential; nearly full on weekdays, quiet on Saturdays; jazz; the owner-chef's wife and a young staff member; skewers served one at a time in order; neck, sasami, gizzard, heart, thigh, tsukune, tail, tsunagi, chicken sashimi, tataki, chicken namero, chicken skin with ponzu, cabbage with miso, broccoli and maitake tempura, chicken nanban, kamameshi in chicken soup, ramen, sashimi of the day's fish; smoking at every seat.

食べログ (店舗会員): 炭火焼鳥 木鶏 (Mokkei)、焼き鳥・水炊き、大阪.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Sumibi Yakitori Mokkei, yakitori and mizutaki, オーブナテビル B1F, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-8-14, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 minutes from Nagahoribashi Station exit 7, 5 minutes from Shinsaibashi Station exits 5 and 6; daily 17:00–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30, last entry 21:30); closed over New Year; reservation only; same-day cancellation ¥5,000 a person; a charge of ¥800 a person including tax (children too), included in courses; private rooms (2, 4 or 6 people, room charge ¥3,300); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 26 seats; non-smoking; opened 18 July 2017; Miyazaki Jitokko, Niwa Jidori and Awa Oidori aged one bird at a time at low temperature, broken down by hand and skewered, grilled slowly over Kishu binchotan; as much as possible by the shop's own hands; yakitori short course ¥6,500 (12 items), 7 Assorted Yakitori course ¥7,800 (16 items), golden chicken mizutaki course ¥6,800 (broth simmered four hours, homemade ponzu); golden TKG; online shop; Yakitori WEST 100 in 2023. Reviews (June–November 2026): 7 Assorted course ¥7,500; chicken-breast confit; vinegared offal with ponzu jelly; chicken ham with figs; chicken consommé; homemade tofu of Hokkaido Toyomasari; tsukune with a choice of tare, kumquat, cheese or truffle; TKG under gold leaf; chicken white soup; chicken sashimi platter; liver sashimi; a craftsman with 20 years of experience grills; down the stairs to the basement; a long wooden counter; jazz; well-cooked dishes swapped in for a diner who avoids raw food.

食べログ (店舗会員): 炭焼きと日本酒 らんぷ、居酒屋・寿司・日本酒バー、大阪.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sumiyaki to Nihonshu Ranpu, izakaya, sushi and sake bar, 本社浪速ビル 101, 11-19 Togano-cho, Kita-ku, Osaka; 5 min from Higashi-Umeda Station; 8 min from Hankyu Umeda Station; Tue–Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00 (last order food 22:15, drinks 22:30); closed Mondays and 31 December and 1 January; reservations accepted; charge and starter ¥440 (not with courses); cards and PayPay accepted; 50 seats (60 standing); private rooms; terrace; smoking allowed at all seats, so no entry under 20; opened 15 November 2017; black wagyu and Yamato chicken grilled over binchotan; meat sashimi; charcoal-grilled seafood; wagyu sushi; over 170 sakes (Juyondai, Aramasa, Jikon and others); all-you-can-drink; sake tastings; seasonal course with two hours of drinks ¥5,000 and the eight-dish Ranpu course ¥6,000; sashimi platter of fish, wagyu and Satsuma chicken ¥2,170. Invoice registration: Wonder Life Co., Ltd. Reviews (March–September 2026): a charcoal-grilled half-lettuce Caesar salad; meat sashimi; steak; buri daikon; cheese and crackers; meat sushi; sake flights; Dewazakura; a same-day course booking was possible; a comment that the cocktails were weak; premium sakes about ¥2,500.

食べログ (店舗会員): 炭焼きと焼き鳥 炭から隅まで 難波心斎橋店、焼き鳥・居.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Sumiyaki to Yakitori Sumi kara Sumi made Nanba-Shinsaibashi, yakitori and izakaya, 三ツ寺ギャラクシービル5号館 1F, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 2-6-19, Chuo-ku, Osaka, about 9 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 6 or Namba Station exit 25, daily 12:00–23:00 (last order 22:00), irregular closures, reservations accepted, table charge ¥500 a person (free with a course), no cards or e-money, PayPay accepted, 30 seats (8 counter, 11 table, 8 sofa), a private room for 8–12, private hire up to 25, heated tobacco only (no cigarettes from July 2026), Wi-Fi, opened 2 February 2023. Shop introduction (machine-translated): rare Kawachi duck by its own route from a supplier with 150 years of history, thick-cut toro beef tongue, duck roast, rare cutlet, duck shabu-shabu in ichiban dashi, private rooms. Reviews (August–October 2026): napa-cabbage kimchi ¥350, beef-tongue tsukimi hamburg ¥800, beef-tongue roast beef ¥850, black-wagyu katsu sandwich ¥2,200, three kinds of meat sushi ¥1,750, chicken thigh with sauce ¥650, wagyu hiuchi with peppers ¥1,200, charcoal potato salad, chicken-dashi omelette with shirasu, beef-tongue yukhoe kimbap, toro-taku kimbap, beef-tongue bolognese spring rolls, open straight through from noon, sister shop Black, a view that it is a bit pricey and cramped, booked out at weekends.

食べログ (店舗会員): 炭焼きイタリアン Black、イタリアン・ダイニングバ.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Sumiyaki Italian Black, Italian and dining bar, 三陽グリーンハイツ, Namba Sennichimae 5-30, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 minutes from Nankai Namba exit E8 or Nipponbashi Station exit 5; daily 12:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); irregular closures; reservations accepted; two-hour limit; ¥3,000 per person for same-day changes in numbers; ¥400 charge; cards (VISA, Master) and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 22 seats; non-smoking; BYO allowed; sommelier on staff; opened 28 November 2023. Charcoal-grilled Italian with sommelier-chosen wine, thick-cut toro beef tongue, Kawachi duck carpaccio, salmon rare cutlet with homemade tartare in a black crust, desserts by a pastry chef, weekday lunch omakase ¥3,000, dinner omakase ¥3,500, 7-dish plan ¥5,000. Reviews (August–October 2026): prosciutto, melon and mozzarella ¥1,300, salmon rare cutlet ¥1,200, beef-tongue Bolognese ¥1,800, assorted appetisers, oyster omelette, gorgonzola gnocchi, wagyu tagliata, a French toast made for drinking, beef tongue in red wine, about 12 pastas, dinner hard to book, tables close together, about 10% of guests from overseas.

食べログ (店舗会員): 炭焼キッチン Tenten、焼き鳥・鍋・居酒屋、大阪市.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Sumiyaki Kitchen Tenten, yakitori, hot pot and izakaya, トダビル 1F, Shinsaibashi-suji 1-4-3, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 minutes from Shinsaibashi Station exits 5 and 6; Mon–Fri 14:00–24:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); irregular closures; daytime drinking welcome; reservations accepted (the shop calls to confirm online bookings; note allergies and dislikes in the request); appetiser and service charge ¥440 (not for courses); cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 32 seats; sunken-kotatsu private rooms (8–12); semi-private rooms; smoking allowed. Hand-skewered yakitori grilled over Tosa binchotan, the signature tsukimi tsukune, local sake from around Japan, courses with 120 minutes of drinks from ¥3,500. Reviews (October 2024–October 2026): morning-processed Daisen chicken from Tottori, liver sashimi ¥781, charcoal chicken ajillo ¥1,243, five-skewer set ¥1,265, two tsukimi tsukune ¥572, sashimi of breast, liver and heart ¥1,200, fried burdock, fried wings, a Napolitan appetiser, smoking at every table, some say the course was average.

食べログ (店舗会員): 炭焼コの字酒場 醸亀げん、北上野1-5-9、上野駅入谷.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Sumiyaki Ko no Ji Sakaba Jokigen, Kita-Ueno 1-5-9, 6 min on foot from the Ueno Station Iriya exit, 8 min from Iriya Station; Mon and Thu–Sun and holidays 17:30–23:00 (L.O. food 21:30, drinks 22:30); closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays; reservations taken (phone from 13:00, also to check for a single seat); no table charge; 16 seats around a U-shaped counter; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted. Menu (April 2026): assorted charcoal-grilled local chicken (Kyoto Benishigure) ¥1,280; beef tendon oden style ¥750; potato salad with braised pork ¥720; sansho-simmered liver ¥600; chicken sashimi ¥600; chicken skin with ponzu ¥680; cartilage tsukune ¥700; fried clams ¥680; homemade atsuage ¥680; chilled tofu ¥500; iburi-gakko with cheese ¥580. Reviews (April 2025–October 2026): new seasonal dishes; the U counter makes conversation easy; the owner's choice of sake; run by two women; comfortable alone; a monthly clay-pot rice (onion and bacon, March 2026); over 20 sakes; two drinks per person minimum; a closing ramen; one English review says run by 'a couple' (September 2026); many regulars; along Showa Street toward Iriya.

食べログ (店舗会員): 炭焼笑店 陽 難波店、焼き鳥・もつ鍋・居酒屋、大阪市中.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Sumiyaki Shoten Yo Namba, yakitori, motsunabe and izakaya, 阪南ビル 1F, Namba Sennichimae 14-25, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 minutes from Namba Station; in the alley west of Doguya-suji; daily 15:00–2:30 (food L.O. 1:30, drinks L.O. 2:00); open year-round; reservations accepted (phone may have space when online is full); starter ¥385; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 35 seats; semi-private room for 6; smoking area; wheelchair accessible. Yamato chicken yakitori over Kishu binchotan, fresh fish from a contracted fishmonger, Yamato chicken mizutaki course ¥3,150 (¥4,950 with drinks), charcoal-grilled smoked motsunabe course ¥3,850 (¥5,650), sister shops nearby. Reviews (November 2025–October 2026): negima, tsukune, quail eggs, duck tsukune with egg yolk, grilled asparagus, rare skewers, low-temperature liver, firefly squid and canola with salt koji, the 'Adult Potato Salad' (blue cheese), many kinds of shochu, always full, one reviewer says it has become non-smoking, an Ed Sheeran autograph.

食べログ (店舗会員): 焼 塩美屋、居酒屋・日本酒バー・海鮮、大阪市中央区道頓.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Yaki Shiomiya, izakaya, sake bar, seafood; 道頓堀ビル 1F, 2-2-7 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; right by Namba Stn exit 25; Tue–Sat 17:00–24:00 (food L.O. 22:50), Sun and holidays 17:00–23:00 (also listed as Sunday from 16:00); closed Mondays; bento sales Tue–Thu 12:00–14:00; reservations accepted; no service or table charge; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; 25–27 seats (6 counter, tatami, private rooms for 6–8); opened 11 May 2006. Shop introduction (English translation): over 40 natural salts with seasonal seafood; fresh fish flown in daily from Matsuyama, Ehime; sashimi with salt, meat with Andes rock salt, vegetables with olive salt; charcoal-seared salted buri tataki; ten local sakes. Reviews (January–September 2026): staff explain which salt suits each dish; squid and bonito sashimi; a three-kind sashimi plate; corn and avocado tempura; dashimaki; kara-age; potato salad; cold tofu with shirasu; octopus on rock salt (one diner found it too salty); ochazuke; every 180 ml sake ¥1,000; fairly priced bottles; à la carte all-you-can-drink; the 20th anniversary; one diner left early because of a loud group.

食べログ (店舗会員): 焼きふぐ 優ふく 北新地店、ふぐ・うなぎ・かに、大阪市.en: Tabelog (shop member): Yaki Fugu Yufuku Kitashinchi ten, fugu, eel and crab, 新地萬年ビル 1F, 1-3-33 堂島, Kita-ku, Osaka; 245 m from Kitashinchi Station; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); Sat 11:30–14:00 and evening (by reservation); closed Sundays and holidays; lunch bookings for courses only; lunch cash only; ¥500 starter charge at dinner; cards accepted; 11 seats (counter of 5, one table); smoking at dinner, non-smoking at lunch; takeout; opened 6 July 2015; signature grilled fugu (Nagasaki fugu lightly seared, three sauces and shredded leek); tiger fugu sukiyaki; conger eel; eel; grilled-fugu course of six dishes ¥11,200 (tessa, grilled fugu, fugu kara-age, zosui); Yufuku course with grilled fugu and fugu sukiyaki (pasta to finish) ¥13,800; grilled fugu and tecchiri course ¥13,800; a Matsuba crab course; hire-zake. Invoice registration: Idea Plus Co., Ltd. Reviews (May–October 2026): grilled-fugu hitsumabushi ¥1,500; fugu tempura hitsumabushi; three small dishes, pickles, fugu bone soup; sometimes sold out; eel hitsumabushi ¥1,800; unaju; a lunch grilled-fugu course (yubiki, sashimi, kara-age, mini grilled-fugu bowl); a summer eel course (eel sashimi with ponzu, uzaku, shirayaki, tempura, kara-age, clay-pot eel rice); featured on TV; slow because the head chef works alone; a head chef who looks stern but is kind.

食べログ (店舗会員): 焼肉 きたん 法善寺 (焼肉 㐂舌)、焼肉、大阪市中央.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Yakiniku Kitan Houzenji (焼肉 㐂舌), yakiniku, Dotonbori 1-7-12, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 5 min walk from Namba Station, daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00, closed on some days, lunch bentos and seat-only lunches cannot be reserved, yakiniku courses must be booked by the day before, dinner can be booked the same day, a 2-hour limit when busy, 5% service charge at dinner, cards accepted, no e-money or QR, 40 seats, all in private rooms (for 2 up to 20–30), tatami rooms, sunken seating, non-smoking, English menu, sommelier, children and kids menu welcome, opened 3 April 2022, two shops: the Minami-Senba main shop and Hozenji. Shop introduction (machine-translated): a renovated 120-year-old Japanese restaurant, Hozenji Yokocho kept since the Edo period, "enjoying meat from various angles", aged meat and aged tongue, mainly Matsusaka beef and Miyazaki's Kirishima beef bought directly from producers, substitute dishes if allergies or dislikes are mentioned in advance. Reviews (September–October 2026): Hozenji course ¥11,550, Kitan lunch course ¥6,000, aged-tongue bento (regular) ¥1,650, about ten people queuing before opening, orders at the 1F register, private rooms on 2F, thick-cut aged tongue, wagyu harami, chateaubriand, sudachi cold noodles, a dessert chosen from seven, staff kept a birthday cake in the fridge, shoes set out on leaving, many overseas tourists.

食べログ (店舗会員): 焼肉 優駿、焼肉・ホルモン・居酒屋、大阪市中央区南船場.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Yakiniku Yushun, yakiniku, horumon and izakaya, 南船場センター 1F–2F, Minamisenba 4-14-1, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 minutes north from Crysta Nagahori exit 12 at Shinsaibashi Station, about 7 minutes from Honmachi Station; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); closed Wednesday; reservations accepted, by phone for the same day; cards (UnionPay too), PayPay and Alipay accepted; 48 seats; 2F tables for up to 35; non-smoking; sports viewing; free Wi-Fi; children and strollers welcome; carefully selected black wagyu; wagyu only for tongue and harami; a homemade sauce; fresh wagyu horumon. Reviews (April–October 2026): six slices of black-wagyu special salted tongue, tongue platter, tsurami, harami, chateaubriand, loin, thin-sliced rib core eaten with sesame salt, tongue sashimi, omasum sashimi with miso sauce, salted horumon platter, tail soup, cold noodles, what look like baseball players' signatures above the 1F counter, light sauces, booking recommended even on weekdays.

食べログ (店舗会員): 焼肉 六六六、焼肉・ホルモン・韓国料理、四谷2-11-.en: Tabelog (shop member): Yakiniku 666, yakiniku, offal, Korean; JLBグランエクリュ 1F, Yotsuya 2-11-15; 5 min walk from Exit 3 of Yotsuya-sanchome Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–14:30 and 17:00–23:30, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–14:30 and 17:00–23:00; closing days not fixed; 10% service charge; 28 seats (4 at the counter, 4 private rooms, one room for 8); cards accepted; about 90 Mikumanogyu and 7 Mansukagyu a year; focus on lean flavour; courses of 19 dishes ¥8,500, 23 dishes ¥11,000, 25 dishes ¥14,300, Shinra Bansho ¥22,000. Reviews (May–October 2026): one diner says the name is read 'Mutsumi', a golden cow statue, thick-cut tongue, meat sushi, seared tawara yukhoe with uni and ikura, a six-cut platter, sirloin mille-feuille, cold noodles, good meat but small portions for the price, little explanation from staff.

食べログ (店舗会員): 焼肉 無双武蔵、焼肉・ホルモン、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Yakiniku Musou Musashi, yakiniku and horumon, 三ツ寺ギャラクシービル5号館 1F, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 2-6-19, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 7 minutes from Nippombashi Station, 9 minutes from Namba Station; Mon–Sat and the day before or after a holiday 17:30 to 3:00 the next morning (L.O. 2:30); closed Sundays and holidays; nights that close at 23:00 are shown in the Instagram story highlights; book early online; no reservations starting at 19:00; a booking is cancelled 15 minutes after the time without notice; cancellation the day before ¥3,000 a person; charge ¥330 a person (tax included); cards and PayPay accepted; 22 seats (counter 2×3, tables 4×4); smoking allowed, so no one under 20; meat delivered straight from a long-established butcher; opened 10 September 2019. Reviews (April 2025–October 2026): a yakiniku restaurant run by a butcher, tongue platter for two ¥2,728, raw harami yukke ¥1,628, heart sashimi with grated yam, tongue sashimi, white omasum, liver, chige ramen, half-size cold noodles, a flat roaster, about ¥6,000–8,000 a head, girls' bars and host clubs all around.

食べログ (店舗会員): 焼肉 福家 (フクヤ)、焼肉・ホルモン・居酒屋、大阪市.en: Tabelog (shop member): 焼肉 福家 (Yakiniku Fukuya), yakiniku / offal / izakaya, Dotonbori 1-3-1, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 4 min on foot from Kintetsu Nippombashi Station, 7 min from Namba Station, Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30), closed Thursday, open straight through 28 December – 4 January, reservations accepted, cards accepted, no e-money or QR-code payments, 15 seats (6 at the counter, two tables for 4), whole-shop booking for up to 20, smoking allowed, average ¥8,000–9,999. Tabelog menu (updated March 2021): the famous salted tongue, thin slices of tongue seared quickly and wrapped round green onion and lemon, ¥1,980 (premium) / ¥1,100; outside skirt from ¥1,210, special premium ¥3,180, served last; mino tripe ¥1,100, special premium ¥1,430; black wagyu tetchan ¥990; wagyu offal such as heart and honeycomb tripe ¥880 each; red meat ¥2,750; tenderloin ¥3,300; chateaubriand ¥7,480; seasonal local grilled vegetables ¥440; kimchi ¥550; cold noodles ¥990; stone-grilled bibimbap ¥1,100; chuhai with whole seasonal fruit. Savor Japan (USEN): 焼肉福家 (Yakiniku Fukuya), Tue–Sun and holidays 17:00–24:00, closed Monday, cards accepted, smoking allowed, counter seats; photo captions: "carefully chosen black wagyu, starting with Imari beef", "the famous salted tongue", "special selected outside skirt", "special premium mino", "tetchan", "seasonal sake chosen by a sake sommelier to go with meat". Reviews (August 2022 – August 2026): Imari beef; a noodle appetizer first (warm noodles, cold noodles); the staff grill the first piece and the tongue; once the outside skirt comes, that is the last meat; rare cuts on the owner's recommendation; honeycomb tripe and mino are good; yukhoe; some found the lean cuts ordinary; the owner is friendly and fun; one diner came after seeing it on TV; said to be popular with Yoshimoto comedians; smoking at every seat; a small ice-cream cake for a birthday; onions and green onions from Osaka.

食べログ (店舗会員): 焼肉 肉どうし 裏難波店、焼肉・ホルモン・韓国料理、大.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Yakiniku Nikudoushi Ura-Namba branch, yakiniku, offal and Korean, 太星食器ビル別館 block B, Namba Sennichimae 14-6, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 minutes from Nankai Namba Station; daily 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00); irregular closures; reservations accepted (5 or more by phone); appetiser charged; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 51 seats; semi-private room for 6; non-smoking (no e-cigarettes either); opened 1 September 2021. A4-or-better kuroge wagyu chosen to suit the house sauce, signatures wagyu yukhoe and the 'Service Strip Loin', standard course ¥4,000, banquet course ¥6,000, drinks +¥1,000. Reviews (May–October 2026): sukiyaki-style sirloin grilled and placed on rice, 'Stamina Red and White' ¥2,280, salted tongue ¥1,580 (¥1,738 in August), raw heart ¥680, raw omasum ¥680, wagyu yukhoe ¥1,408, thick-cut salted tongue ¥2,178, salted wagyu skirt ¥1,980, assorted kimchi ¥748, namul ¥638, liver, choregi salad, beef-tendon soup, two sauces for lean and fatty cuts, energetic service.

食べログ (店舗会員): 焼肉Lab 難波店、焼肉・韓国料理・ホルモン、大阪市中.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Yakiniku Lab Namba, yakiniku, Korean and offal, 中野ビル 2F, Namba 3-7-22, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 minute from Namba Station exit 11; Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:00, drinks L.O. 22:30); reservations accepted; cards (VISA, Master) only, no e-money or QR payment; 43 seats; private rooms for 4–8; non-smoking; opened 1 May 2023; sister shop in Umeda. All-you-can-eat and drink of Kumamoto wagyu and kuroge wagyu from ¥5,500, A5 sirloin, thick-cut tongue, meat sushi, 100+ drinks, a 'meat cake' for anniversaries, Premium Kiwami course ¥15,000 reduced to ¥10,000 for the 3rd anniversary. Reviews (April–October 2026): meat sushi, yukhoe, thick-cut tongue, grilled shabu, premium kalbi, thick-cut liver, skirt, uni and ikura sushi, steak, QR-code ordering, heart sashimi sold out, chicken and heart sashimi tasting mostly of the sauce, one reviewer says it was on the 3rd floor.

食べログ (店舗会員): 焼肉マル 心斎橋本店、焼肉・ホルモン・韓国料理、大阪市.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Yakiniku Maru Shinsaibashi Honten, yakiniku, offal and Korean, 1F, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 2-1-27, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 minutes east along Europa-dori from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 12:00–5:00 next morning (L.O. 4:00); lunch 12:00–17:00, dinner 17:00–5:00; irregular closures; reservations accepted; cards, PayPay and au PAY accepted, no e-money; 30 seats; smoking allowed; opened 14 April 2008; operator ak-food-pro.co.jp. Fresh black wagyu and many kinds of offal including rare urute over charcoal; party courses ¥4,950, ¥6,050 and ¥8,250; drinks +¥1,980; daytime HAPPY TIME. Reviews (March–October 2026): Gochamaze yakiniku set ¥1,250; assorted set of tongue, skirt, short rib and horumon under ¥2,000 even with 1.5× or 2× meat; à la carte at lunch too; tongue sashimi, fresh omasum, green-onion salt tongue, yukhoe, heart sashimi, cold noodles; many foreign staff and guests.

食べログ (店舗会員): 焼肉・ホルモン、中京区北車屋町272-1、京阪三条駅か.en: Tabelog (staff-maintained): yakiniku, offal; 中京区北車屋町272-1; 3 min on foot from Sanjo Stn (Keihan); daily 15:00–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closing days vary; reservations accepted; 10% service charge; 18 seats (tables); private hire up to 50; cards, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY and Alipay accepted; Wagyu course 120 g ¥4,400 (three kinds of tongue, chateaubriand, outside skirt, strip loin grilled sukiyaki-style); premium wagyu course 180 g ¥5,500; shop text: wagyu tasted in small portions like sushi, satisfaction beyond the price. Reviews (September–October 2026, in English): yakiniku around a drum can, high chairs, assorted kimchi, bean-sprout namul, premium kalbi (salt and sauce), strip loin with egg yolk, rice ¥330, Kyoto Beer Matcha ¥990, umeshu soda ¥770, cheerful staff.

食べログ (店舗会員): 焼肉暁牛、焼肉・ホルモン、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町7-1.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Yakiniku Gyogyu, yakiniku, offal; 岩伸リバーサイド 2F, 7-12 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nippombashi Stn, 8 from Namba Stn; Mon–Fri and holidays 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30), Sat–Sun 11:00–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 17:00–24:00; irregular holidays; reservations accepted; no charge; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 44 seats; a private room for 6; heated-tobacco smoking area; opened 26 October 2022; special A5 wagyu all-you-can-eat ¥8,778 (tax included). Shop introduction (English translation): black wagyu in a calm room; recommends sea-urchin beef and harami; chef's-choice courses to budget. Reviews (February 2025–September 2026): run directly by a wagyu wholesaler; A5 wagyu all-you-can-eat ¥7,980 (before tax), about ¥9,700 with drinks; a tiered platter, thick-cut tongue, top outside skirt, rare lean cuts, fresh offal, lean yukhoe, kimchi, salad, rice, ice cream, chicken and pork too; special kalbi, special loin, cold noodles, namul; one diner found the meat-sushi rice hard and the lean cuts fatty (November 2025); Chinese-speaking staff; partitioned seats and sunken seating.

食べログ (店舗会員): 焼鳥 すぎはら、焼き鳥・すき焼き・居酒屋、大阪市北区堂.en: Tabelog (shop member): Yakitori Sugihara, yakitori, sukiyaki and izakaya, 三共梅田ビル 1F, 1-5 堂山町, Kita-ku, Osaka; 7 min from Higashi-Umeda and Nakazakicho stations; daily 18:00–5:00 (last order food 4:00, drinks 4:30); open year-round; reservations accepted; same-day cancellation fee, 100% for no-shows; 10% late-night charge after 22:00; seat charge with starter ¥440; cards, PayPay and Alipay accepted; 40 seats (counter of 20, tables of 20); sunken tatami seating; terrace; heated tobacco indoors; cigarettes allowed on the engawa seats; pets welcome; opened 22 August 2013; the trademarked 'zuke-tori' (chicken marinated in green onion and salt koji); the signature chicken sukiyaki ¥2,640; drink-inclusive courses: chicken sukiyaki ¥4,500, yakitori ¥5,000 (yakisoba to finish), Manzoku ¥5,500; sister shops kushikatsu-and-oden Ishikawa and charcoal-grill-and-kamameshi Nagashima. Invoice registration: 株式会社川添. Reviews (February–September 2026): the name has changed; bonjiri; seseri; negima with mustard; chicken sashimi under green onion (yuzu kosho and garlic); chicken yukhoe; duck sashimi; chicken nanban; kara-age with tartar; ponzu dishes; namul; beef loin rice bowl; salt yakisoba; served off the skewer; a three-hour yakitori course with 150 minutes of drinks ¥6,000; a comment that the skewers were small and the skin burnt; cheerful staff.

食べログ (店舗会員): 焼鳥 角寿々、焼き鳥、串焼き、居酒屋、日本橋人形町1-.en: Tabelog (shop member): Yakitori Kado Suzu; yakitori, kushiyaki, izakaya; unit 1A, 日本橋芸者新道ビル, Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 1-5-10; 1 min from Ningyocho Station exit A6; daily 17:00–23:00; service charge only 5%; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 20 seats (16 at the counter, a private room for 2–4, room fee ¥4,000 under four guests); non-smoking; opened 4 December 2025; courses of Kumamoto's local chicken Amakusa Daiou; Kado course ¥7,200, Suzu course ¥8,200; original cocktails on days the bartender is in; website kadosuzu.com. Reviews (September–October 2026): purple noren; black-toned modern Japanese interior; pickled-ginger skewer and refillable grated daikon; Amakusa Daiou thigh (salt and sauce); daki-mi; chochin on baguette; maru-hatsu with yuzu pepper; breast and egg yolk on rice to finish; milky chicken soup; tiramisu; Goku course ¥13,000; no cash; attentive staff.

食べログ (店舗会員): 焼鳥 鳥中前、焼き鳥、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-8-3.en: Tabelog (shop member): Yakitori Torinakamae, yakitori, 遅ビル 4F, 1-8-3 曽根崎新地, Kita-ku, Osaka; 3 min on foot from Kitashinchi Station; Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 16:00–23:00; bookings until 20:00 for the omakase only; à la carte bookings after 20:00 (seat charge ¥660 with a starter); cashless only (cards, e-money, PayPay); 14 counter seats; non-smoking; English menu and English-speaking staff; children welcome; opened 11 January 2023; featured in JAL's in-flight magazine; today's omakase of 14 items ¥5,500 (thigh tataki, a salad of chicken fat, shungiku and crisp skin, eight skewers, two vegetable skewers, yuzu daikon, chicken soup); special omakase of 15 items ¥7,700 (two special dishes and a finish of chicken soboro bowl or chicken-soup chazuke). Reviews (October 2026): a U-shaped counter; breast with wasabi; heart; gizzard; bonjiri; eggplant; shishito; quail egg; chicken harami chanja; chicken-soup chazuke with grilled rice balls; soboro bowl with egg yolk; Nagano sake; wine; highballs; staff check whether raw chicken is all right; full enough that booking is needed; up the stairs to the fourth floor.

食べログ (店舗会員): 焼鶏 輪、港区六本木4-5-14 アーバンビル1F、大.en: Tabelog (shop member): Yakitori Rin, Roppongi 4-5-14, アーバンビル 1F, 2 min walk from Roppongi Station exit 7 (Oedo line), 4 min from exit 6 (Hibiya line); Mon–Sat and days before and after holidays 18:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:00, drinks L.O. 22:30); closed Sundays and holidays; occasional closures; ¥600 appetizer charge and 10% service, or a ¥700 seat charge for à la carte; 12 seats (counter 6, tables, semi-private rooms for 2–8); private hire up to 20; non-smoking (smoking area at the entrance); cards accepted. Reviews (2023–July 2026): rare shochu and sake; a 10-dish course ¥4,500; chicken wings; chōchin; chicken sashimi; minced-chicken oyakodon; chicken zosui; homemade pudding; the master explains drink pairings.

食べログ (店舗会員): 焼鶏屋 勝商店、焼き鳥・鶏料理・ラーメン、大阪市北区曽.en: Tabelog (shop member): Yakitori Masaru Shoten, yakitori, chicken dishes and ramen, 曽根崎2-10-22, Kita-ku, Osaka; 1 min on foot from exit 4 of Higashi-Umeda Station toward Shin-Mido; Mon–Sat 17:30–5:00; Sundays last order 3:00; closed 24 December and 1 January, and some other days; reservations accepted; private-room charge ¥230 (included in courses); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 77 seats; private rooms (4–20 people); tatami; sunken seating; smoking allowed; opened 30 March 2012; renovated in July 2025 with more private rooms; chicken bought daily from a local poultry shop; grilled slowly over Tosa binchotan; dashimaki omelette. Reviews (May–September 2026): a course with all-you-can-drink draft beer about ¥4,000; chicken nanban; negima, gizzard, skin, seseri, knee cartilage; water eggplant; a chicken-bone ramen to finish (thin straight noodles and napa cabbage); the binchotan feast course with 90 minutes of drinks ¥4,500 (chicken tataki, dashimaki, seven skewers, butter-steamed Awaji onion, grilled vegetables, fried chicken, smoked quail eggs, pickled cucumber, chicken zosui); fried chicken with tartar; courses booked by phone; one diner found the drinks slow for lack of staff.

食べログ (店舗会員): 熟成刺身と旨い酒 ひとしお、居酒屋・海鮮・日本酒バー、.en: Tabelog (shop member): Jukusei Sashimi to Umai Sake Hitoshio — izakaya / seafood / sake bar; 1F, Nakagyo-ku; 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:15); closed Tuesday; starter ¥500 (not with courses; ¥1,500 on 1–3 January); 18 seats; counter rooms overlooking a courtyard; tables from 3 people; minors generally not admitted; opened 22 May 2018; signature tsukuri-mori (fresh fish from Maizuru, Iki, Kochi and elsewhere with aged sashimi); dashi of kombu soaked a day, simmered 4 hours and combined with bonito flakes; fried dashi-simmered daikon; nama-fu and nama-yuba; about 30 sake chosen by the owner; Kyoto set ¥7,700, eel kabayaki set ¥8,800, Kuroge wagyu set ¥9,900. Reviews (June 2023–August 2026, English): Camembert grilled with saikyo miso, sake half price on Thursdays, fried fish scales, milt, aged sashimi.

食べログ (店舗会員): 燻バール でく、居酒屋・バル・創作料理、大阪市淀川区西.en: Tabelog (shop member): Ibushi Bar Deku; izakaya, bar, creative; 3-13-5 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, 2nd floor; 3 minutes on foot from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station and Hankyu Minamikata Station; Mon–Thu and Sat 17:30–24:00, Fri 17:30–05:00; closed Sunday; same-day bookings until 15:00; a smoking venue, so no entry under 20; daily smoked otoshi ¥330 (tax included); cards, e-money and QR accepted; 20 seats; whole hire up to 20. Reviews (April 2025 to August 2026): smoked platter (nuts, pickled plum, salmon, quail eggs, pickles, duck, chicken ham, cheese, shishamo, Unzen ham), M size ¥1,680; truffle-scented smoked potato salad ¥550; spice kara-age ¥750; smoked-oil ajillo ¥1,100 with baguette; oysters in oil; black-wagyu tataki; raisin butter; karasumi peperoncino; all-you-can-drink courses from ¥5,000; Islay whisky; American wine; smoked sours; smoked-plum highball; booking recommended.

食べログ (店舗会員): 燻製スギヤ商店、居酒屋・すき焼き、大阪市中央区難波1-.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Kunsei Sugiya Shoten, izakaya and sukiyaki, Shinsaibashi European Building 4F, Namba 1-7-18, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 minutes from Namba Station exit 14; Tue–Thu, Sun and holidays 17:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:30), Fri–Sat 17:00–23:30 (food L.O. 23:00); closed Mondays and 30 December–4 January; reservations accepted (also by Instagram DM); two-hour limit when busy; appetiser ¥330; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 28 seats (counter only); non-smoking; no one under 20 admitted; menus in English, Chinese and Korean; opened 7 March 2019. Instant-smoked wagyu tenderloin, 16-hour smoked cheese, smoked sausage, plank-grilled dishes, smoked lemon sour, smoked sukiyaki course ¥6,000. Reviews (July–October 2026): smoked sukiyaki ¥2,160 (smoked raw egg and smoked tomato sorbet); smoked potato salad ¥690; assorted sashimi ¥1,480 (smoked soy sauce); instant-smoked wagyu tenderloin ¥2,700; seven-dish course ¥4,000; all-you-can-drink ¥1,500 plus ¥500 for smoked drinks; smoked takuan as the appetiser; no sign; take off your shoes and crouch to enter; order by QR code; some say many dishes are salty.

食べログ (店舗会員): 燻製バル モトカラ、バル・居酒屋・イタリアン、大阪市中.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Kunsei Bar Motokara, bar, izakaya, Italian; B1F, 7-11 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 10 min walk from Osaka-Namba Stn; entrance on the Dotonbori river side; Mon–Fri 16:00–23:00, Sat 12:00–15:00 and 15:30–23:00, Sun 12:00–18:00; irregular holidays; reservations accepted; ¥300 charge except with a course; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 48 seats (40 tables, 8 terrace); smoking on the terrace only. Shop introduction (English translation): aromatic smoked dishes, seasonings and drinks; creative menu; lunch and café; wood interior; terrace; a daytime course ¥2,000. Reviews (February 2025–May 2026): 12-kind smoked platter ¥850 (smoke released when the lid comes off), meat platter ¥2,800, whole smoked squid ¥950, pork and cabbage omelette ¥1,150, smoked duck, sausages, smoked egg, potato salad, a chijimi-style pizza, grilled vegetables with salt and yuzu pepper, smoky orange spritzer ¥800, smoked umeshu, a domestic-beef steak lunch, Cremia soft-serve; one diner found the meat tough; another felt it now caters to overseas visitors.

食べログ (店舗会員): 瓢嘻 六本木店、港区六本木6-7-7 MERCURY六.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Hyoki Roppongi, Roppongi 6-7-7, MERCURY六本木 1F–2F, 2 min from Roppongi Stn exit 3; Mon–Sat 12:00–15:00 and 18:00–23:00, Sun 12:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:30; 58 seats, all in private rooms (a large room for 28); cashless only, no cash; 10% service charge; one course per person; opened 6 May 2016. 'Dashi shabu' with dashi inherited from Kyoto, served as a seasonal kaiseki; vegan courses available and ingredients can be changed. Courses: pork dashi shabu ¥6,000, ¥8,000; wagyu and pork ¥10,500. Gurunavi: also 京都 瓢嘻 京橋店 and 京都 瓢嘻 西麻布店. Reviews (July–October 2026): a delicious broth; pork topped with green onion; seared mackerel sushi; matsutake dobin-mushi; udon to finish with curry powder; matcha pudding; attentive service; one diner found the meat thin.

食べログ (店舗会員): 生ラム肉専門店 らむ屋、ジンギスカン、千日前1-6-1.en: Tabelog (shop member): Nama Lamb Niku Senmon Ten Ramuya; jingisukan; Sennichimae 1-6-1, 山喜登会館 2F; 3 minutes' walk from Kintetsu Nippombashi Station; weekdays 17:00–5:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–5:00; open all year; reservations (online table bookings may be moved to the counter); no service or table charge; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 25 seats (counter 4, tables 21); smoking allowed; wheelchair accessible; power outlets; opened 14 February 2017; fresh lamb; lamb chops the most popular; lamb breast, tongue and heart in limited numbers; casual course ¥4,580; jingisukan gourmet course ¥6,280; Hokkaido-only Sapporo Classic. Reviews (March–September 2026): lamb chops, chuck eye roll, leg, mutton loin, neck, kalbi, tongue, liver, heart, sausage, lamb curry, tsukemen to finish; chilled, never frozen; no gamey smell; some worry about smoking; clothes take on the smell.

食べログ (店舗会員): 生産者直営 海鮮居酒屋 Rikusui、居酒屋・魚介・.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): producer-run Kaisen Izakaya Rikusui, izakaya, seafood and sushi, 戎橋NORTHビル 5F, Shinsaibashi-suji 2-3-15, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 minutes from Namba Station; daily 16:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 93 seats (6 counter, 76 table, 11 tatami); semi-private room; non-smoking; English menu; opened 14 November 2023. Ingredients straight from producers, sushi by skilled chefs, tempura and straw-grilling, order-style all-you-can-eat, abalone and bluefin all-you-can-eat course ¥6,050, ¥7,700 with drinks, free for ages 5 and under. Reviews (June–October 2026): early-bird prices about half before 18:00, ¥1,000 off for women, QR ordering, about 50 kinds of sushi, uni and ikura, snow crab and sushi ¥9,000, tecchiri and sushi ¥8,500, premium sushi ¥4,400, toro-taku roll, ¥5,000 party course; opinions split, with reports of orders not arriving, billing mistakes and fish not matching the photos.

食べログ (店舗会員): 由丸 人形町店、ラーメン、郷土料理、餃子、日本橋人形町.en: Tabelog (shop member): Yoshimaru, Ningyocho branch; ramen, regional cuisine, gyoza; 人形町センタービル 1F, Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 1-4-10; 1 min from Ningyocho Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–23:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–22:00; no reservations; 20 seats; cards, e-money and QR accepted; non-smoking; children welcome; takeaway. Menu (March 2026): everything-on-top ¥1,800, Karakamen (yuzu pepper) ¥1,010, kabosu tsukemen ¥970, black ramen ¥900, gyoza ¥495. Reviews (June–October 2026): free extra noodles if you come in during the 11 o'clock hour; thin noodles; choice of firmness and amount of oil; rich but not cloying tonkotsu; Hakata ramen ¥860; wonton noodles ¥950; a chain with a shop in Yaesu too; one diner found it lacking depth.

食べログ (店舗会員): 直心 (Washoku Dining Jikishin.en: Tabelog (shop member): Jikishin (Washoku Dining Jikishin), izakaya, seafood, sake bar; 第二鹿倉ビル B1F, Yotsuya 1-7; Mon–Fri 15:30–23:30, Sat–Sun 15:00–22:00; closing days not fixed; 42 seats; counter, tables, tatami and sunken seating; private rooms for 4 to 30+; smoking area for heated tobacco only; cards and QR accepted; BYO and takeaway; opened 1 July 2007; bluefin tuna, hairy crab, kinmedai, soft roe, monkfish liver from Yoichi; tuna collar as sashimi and grilled; Tokyo X pork shabu-shabu; over 60 sakes from across Japan; fish direct from Toyosu. Reviews (September 2025–October 2026): all-you-can-drink sake with one-sho bottles set three at a time on the table, courses ¥5,500–6,500, half-price sake days, soy-marinated egg yolk, mackerel prosciutto, Shine Muscat with white sesame, clay-pot rice, Hiroshima tsukemen and fish set meals at lunch.

食べログ (店舗会員): 真水無香、中華料理・ラーメン・居酒屋、大阪市淀川区西中.en: Tabelog (shop member): Shinsui Mukou; Chinese, ramen, izakaya; 4-8-4 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, ground floor; 3 minutes on foot from Hankyu Minamikata Station and the north exit of Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–14:00 and 17:00–22:30, Sat 17:00–22:30, Sun and holidays 17:00–21:30; open all year; no lunch on weekends and holidays; call ahead for eight or more; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 46 table seats; areas screened by curtains; whole hire for 20–50; separate smoking area. Reviews (2014 to October 2026): Shanghai cuisine; daily lunch sets (salad, soup, pickles, rice); Hainan chicken rice ¥980; soupless dandan noodles with fried rice and almond tofu ¥980; yurinchi; twice-cooked pork; stir-fried eggplant; drunken crab in autumn (book ahead); Shanghai-style beef and root-vegetable stew; garlic water spinach; sweet and sour pork; seafood crispy rice; xiao long bao; sesame balls; custard buns; a ¥6,600 course; a clean room; some customers order in Chinese.

食べログ (店舗会員): 知仙、港区六本木7-16-5、日比谷線六本木駅4B出口.en: Tabelog (shop member): Chisen, Roppongi 7-16-5, 2 min walk from Roppongi Station exit 4B (Hibiya line), 3 min from exit 7 (Oedo line); Tue–Sun 17:00–22:30; closed Mondays and the 1st, 3rd and 5th Sundays; 10% service charge; 24 seats (counter only); private hire up to 50; non-smoking; cards and PayPay accepted. Shop text: an interior modelled on a Kamakura Zen temple, made 45 years ago; natural maitake from mountains where bears live; sake and wine chosen by the owner, a sommelier with the SAKE DIPLOMA. Courses: seasonal course ¥9,000; Chisen set (11 skewers, rice, fruit) ¥9,000; chef's special course ¥13,000. Reviews (April–October 2026): omakase until you say stop; Tanba matsutake; snow crab; oysters; kombu with herring roe; water octopus; conger eel; sweetfish; shirako wrapped in yuba; konnyaku; cold nameko soba to finish; one says it has run for over 50 years; warm staff.

食べログ (店舗会員): 祇園 大季、日本料理・寿司・鍋、東山区清本町374-4.en: Tabelog (shop member): Gion Daiki — Japanese / sushi / nabe; 374-4, Higashiyama-ku; 5 min on foot from Gion-Shijo Stn; at the end of a narrow alley from the Mame Roku Building; Mon–Sat 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday (bookings of 6 or more by phone); overseas guests who cannot read Japanese order the omakase only; 100% cancellation charge from two days before; service charge 10%; 12 seats; private rooms for 2–18; smoking allowed at the counter; opened 28 May 2018; born 1975 in Kyoto Prefecture; sushi-chef father; trained at Yoshitora, Kappo Kamitome and Kōmei ARIAKE; ran Dai no Ki in Bangkok for 15 years; runs the shop with the father; fish direct from Maizuru port; meat from an old Shichijo Gozen butcher; sushi × kappo omakase ¥22,000 (+service). Reviews (December 2019–October 2026, English): foie gras chawanmushi, hairy crab, nodoguro, kue hot pot, Masayuki Tomimura.

食べログ (店舗会員): 祇園ゆやま、日本料理、東山区新橋通り花見小路東入 ルア.en: Tabelog (shop member): Gion Yuyama — Japanese; Shinbashi-dori east of Hanamikoji, Higashiyama-ku; Tue–Sun 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00; closed Monday; reservation only; cancellation 100% on the day, 80% the day before; no cards; 8 seats; sunken counter; tea-room-style private rooms (4 and 6); lunch course from ¥5,500, dinner from ¥15,000; Yasaka course ¥5,500, Shimizu plan ¥7,500, Hana course ¥15,000; seasonal ingredients the owner buys daily; organic Kyoto vegetables; wanmono. Reviews (December 2025–October 2026, English): Oma tuna, duck wrapped in yuba grilled on stones, figs with white-sesame sauce, hamo with plum in summer, staff who speak English and Chinese, cash only.

食べログ (店舗会員): 私房菜 吉田、港区六本木4-4-2 ヒルサイドパレス六.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sifon Choi Yoshida, Roppongi 4-4-2, ヒルサイドパレス六本木 1F, 5 min walk from Roppongi Station; Tue–Sat, holidays and days before and after holidays 17:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); closed Sundays and Mondays; two-hour limit when busy; order the signature fried pigeon by the day before; 5% service charge (no cover); 20 seats (counter 6, tables); private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; Tabelog Chinese TOKYO 100, 2026. Shop text: Pekichiki; Toshi's Rich xiao long bao, limited daily; drunken shrimp by reservation. Courses: "Gokigen", 10 dishes with shark fin, ¥22,000; an 8-dish course. Reviews (September–October 2026): opened November 2024 as Hayato's sister shop; owner-chef Hiroaki Yoshida (from Seifuro in Yokohama); mainly à la carte; Kirishima black-pork char siu; spring rolls; lemon fried rice; shrimp wonton noodles; almond tofu; wine and a sommelier.

食べログ (店舗会員): 稲荷町髙はし、東上野5-17-8 中銀第2東上野マンシ.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Inaricho Katahashi, Higashi-Ueno 5-17-8, 中銀第2東上野マンシオン 1F No. 101, 3 min on foot from Inaricho Station, 8 min from the Ueno Station Iriya exit; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed Sundays and holidays; 10% service charge; 19 seats (6 at the counter, 14 at tables); semi-private rooms; non-smoking (smoking outside); cards accepted (no e-money or QR); children may be asked not to come during business entertaining; meals after memorial services by arrangement; opened 20 March 2012; seasonal ingredients chosen at the market every morning (many direct from producers); October kaiseki ¥15,000 and ¥17,500 (9 dishes) and ¥22,000 (10 dishes); two-tier osechi ¥41,800; there is also a Kanda shop (tel. 03-5839-2863). Reviews (August 2025–October 2026): black vertical-lattice front; marinated bonito and sea bass donburi; a glass of beer at lunch; grilled fish, sashimi, small dishes, red miso soup and rice; cold soba with a fresh-fish Ryukyu donburi ¥2,000 (paid by PayPay); sesame-soy marinated donburi ¥1,900, chicken nanban ¥1,800, miso-simmered mackerel with sashimi ¥1,800; fried horse mackerel with sashimi ¥1,800; fried eggplant steeped in dashi; nukazuke pickles; a red-bean sweet; September kaiseki ¥22,000 (matsutake, sanma, abalone, wagyu); a friendly owner; ¥15,000 kaiseki came to about ¥46,000 for two (the sake was pricey).

食べログ (店舗会員): 空色COLOR、ダイニングバー・魚介・カフェ、大阪市中.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Sorairo Color, dining bar, seafood and café, Hakuromachi 4-3-1, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 minutes from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 11:30–23:30 (the details say Mon–Fri and Sat/holidays 11:30–23:00); open year-round; reservations accepted (not for café use); cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; no cover charge; 60 seats (sofas, a 10-seat counter, tatami); non-smoking; vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free options shown; official site sorairocolor.jp. Seafood delivered daily, an assorted sashimi platter, seasonal sake, handmade desserts by a pastry chef, shaved ice; winter hot-pot courses ¥3,000, ¥3,500 and ¥4,000 (all-you-can-drink +¥2,000). Reviews (August–October 2026): 12-vegetable steamer set ¥1,280, branded pork and vegetable steamer ¥1,680, bonito-salt, koji-yuzu mayo and salt-ponzu sauces, grilled fish set, seafood yukke set, white or multigrain rice, large free, ordering and paying by smartphone, a hard-to-find entrance, hamo tempura, mentaiko udon, some concerns about cleanliness, a hot terrace.

食べログ (店舗会員): 立喰酒場 金獅子 心斎橋パルコ店 (たちぐいさかば き.en: Tabelog (shop member): Tachigui Sakaba Kinjishi Shinsaibashi PARCO branch; izakaya, yakiniku, seafood; Shinsaibashisuji 1-8-3, Shinsaibashi PARCO B2F; 30 seconds' walk from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 11:00–23:00; closed 1 January; reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 40 seats; counter; standing bar; non-smoking (smoking area nearby); free Wi-Fi; takeaway; children welcome; opened 18 March 2021; the third shop; a daily-changing menu; local sake chosen by the owner; daytime drinking from 11:00. Reviews (June–October 2026): a ¥500 set of a drink and three snacks; fig butter baguette; loquat with prosciutto; meat sushi; wagyu; negitoro; pork tongue; marinated mackerel ¥100; seared wagyu with egg yolk; lunch from ¥880 (Super Ebi Soba with shumai, fried horse mackerel with shiba-zuke tartar); demi-katsu; pork steak; a chuka soba set; some say it is cramped, the portions small and the ramen salty.

食べログ (店舗会員): 純米酒専門 粋酔 上野店、東上野3-35-9 アドレ上.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Junmaishu Senmon Suisui Ueno, Higashi-Ueno 3-35-9, アドレ上野 1F, 129 m from Inaricho Station, 8 min along Asakusa-dori from the JR Ueno Station Asakusa exit, just before the red torii of Shitaya Shrine (not inside atré Ueno); Mon–Fri 17:00–22:30, Sat and the day before a holiday 17:00–22:00; closed Sundays and holidays; appetizer charge ¥550 (not with banquet courses); 38 seats (all tables); semi-private areas for 6–12 behind roll screens; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; children welcome; kids' menu; opened 23 October 2013; junmai sake from all 47 prefectures from Hokkaido to Okinawa; over 130 kinds (over 150 in another place) chosen by a sake-sommelier manager; fish from the morning market; autumn fresh-catch course with 150 minutes of all-you-can-drink ¥7,700 (usually ¥8,800); Mon–Thu 120-minute course ¥6,600; dislikes and allergies can be discussed by phone; there is also a shop in Nihonbashi. Reviews (May–October 2026): all-you-can-drink of 180 sakes ¥4,800 plus three snacks, about ¥8,000; bluefin tuna sashimi; quail eggs; 90-minute all-you-can-drink course ¥5,000; young-chicken kara-age; deep-fried tofu; an isshobin on every table; poured to the brim; one group waited over 30 minutes past the booking time and had no seat (cancellation fee ¥10,000 a head).

食べログ (店舗会員): 縁、中華料理、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-10-5 白亜ビル.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): En, Chinese; 白亜ビル B1F, 1-10-5 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 200 m and 2 min walk from Namba Stn exit 14; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 15:30–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); closed Wednesdays; lunch 11:00–14:00 by reservation the day before; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR (including Alipay and WeChat Pay) accepted; 54 seats (four round tables and a semi-private room); non-smoking; BYO allowed; English and Chinese menus and staff; opened 13 January 2025. Shop introduction (English translation): authentic Shanghai cuisine at reasonable prices; over 200 dishes adjusted to Japanese tastes; dishes ¥1,000–1,200; courses ¥3,500 and ¥5,000 with Peking duck. Reviews (March 2025–July 2026): a basement opposite the Shochikuza; a bar-like entrance; a room like the Shanghai concessions or Showa retro; two chefs from northeast China and one server; the rest of the Peking duck made into kara-age; sweet and sour pork, Yangzhou fried rice, takana ramen, boiled dumplings, hot and sour soup, shrimp with mayonnaise, beef with green peppers, mapo tofu, stir-fried bok choy, sea cucumber, yakisoba; formerly a French restaurant.

食べログ (店舗会員): 美健食道 三羊開泰、上野7-3-2 TSDビル 2F、.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Biken Shokudo Sanyokaitai, Ueno 7-3-2, TSD Building 2F, 1 min on foot from JR Ueno Station; daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); 66 seats; private rooms for 4–20; non-smoking (smoking area outside); cards, Suica and PayPay accepted; children welcome; opened 15 April 2022; Chinese and Taiwanese food for Japanese tastes; lamb dishes; medicinal hot pot; all-you-can-eat shabu-shabu; 2-hour medicinal hot pot and shabu-shabu all-you-can-eat course C ¥3,480 (usually ¥3,980); all-you-can-eat spicy beef-tendon hot pot ¥3,065 (30% off ¥4,378); 2-hour all-you-can-drink from ¥1,320. Reviews (July–September 2026): lamb offal soup hot pot (with thick vermicelli and spam); many Chinese customers at lunch; lots of fruit flies (July 2026); boiled dumplings; mapo tofu lunch (with salad bar and egg soup); lamb spine (Yangxiezi); bone-in lamb shank; all-you-can-eat vegetables, tofu and noodles; slow service and a forgotten order from short staffing (September 2026); friendly staff.

食べログ (店舗会員): 肉と炉端と釜めし くろ屋、居酒屋・炉端焼き・肉料理、大.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Niku to Robata to Kamameshi Kuroya, izakaya, robatayaki and meat dishes, 心斎橋尼伊ビル 1F, Nishi-Shinsaibashi 1-10-19, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 minutes from Shinsaibashi and Yotsubashi stations; Mon–Fri 17:00–23:30, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–16:00 and 17:00–23:30 (food L.O. 22:30, kamameshi and genshi-yaki 22:00); irregular closures; weekend lunch 120-minute all-you-can-drink ¥1,650 (2 dishes per person); reservations accepted; appetiser ¥350; cards, PayPay and Alipay accepted, no e-money; 41 seats; private room for 8; non-smoking (ashtray by the entrance); English, Chinese and Korean menus; English-speaking staff. Genshi-yaki, straw-grilling, kamameshi of domestic Koshihikari cooked in a bonito and kombu dashi. Reviews (August–October 2026): fatty sardine ¥850 (¥890 in October), extra-large shrimp with homemade tartare ¥1,490 (¥1,690 in October), straw-grilled beef skirt tataki ¥1,290, Chateaubriand skewers, salmon belly and ikura kamameshi ¥1,980 (¥2,190 in October), beef tail and green onion kamameshi ¥2,080, rare tuna cutlet, ankimo with ponzu jelly, smoked assortment, whole roasted onion, leftover kamameshi can be taken home as rice balls, some found the ¥5,500 course small.

食べログ (店舗会員): 肉と魚と酒 雄 心斎橋店、居酒屋・海鮮・焼き鳥、大阪市.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Niku to Sakana to Sake Yuu Shinsaibashi, izakaya, seafood, yakitori; New Nihon Mitsudera Building 1F, 2-2-10 Shinsaibashi-suji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Namba Stns; Mon–Sat 17:00–2:00 (L.O. 1:30); closed Sundays; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 61 seats (tatami, tables, 2F, basement private rooms); smoking allowed; courses with 2 hours of drinks from ¥5,000. Shop introduction (English translation): a hideaway in Minami; sake from across Japan, fresh fish, selected meat, Osaka specialities, authentic Chinese dishes; signature black-truffle gyoza. Reviews (September–October 2026): about 100 dishes, daily specials on a blackboard, six-kind sashimi platter ¥3,300, black-truffle gyoza ¥680, bluefin toro and takuan roll ¥900, black wagyu tataki ¥980, shrimp and mushroom ajillo ¥780, omurice ¥780, Peking duck ¥1,200–1,320, domestic eel (half) ¥1,800, 10 yakitori skewers ¥1,800, tempura ¥980, mapo tofu, dan dan noodles, yodare chicken, all-you-can-drink ¥1,980; nearly full after 23:00; smoking allowed; one diner found the busy staff hard to call.

食べログ (店舗会員): 肉と魚和バル八 心斎橋店、居酒屋・寿司・イタリアン、大.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Niku to Sakana Wa Baru Hachi Shinsaibashi, izakaya, sushi, Italian; 宝山心斎橋ビル 1F, 2-2-13 Shinsaibashi-suji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Namba Stn exit 14; daily 17:00–23:30; open year-round; reservations accepted (parties of two may be at the counter); starter ¥300 before tax; cards, Rakuten Pay and au PAY accepted, no e-money; 42 seats (counter, two private rooms for 7 and one for 10); sunken seating; smoking allowed; wheelchair accessible; opened 14 July 2022. Shop introduction (English translation): Japanese-Italian fusion; build-your-own ajillo; the chef's 'Ebi Paradiso'; sherry-vinegar sushi from ¥200; all-you-can-drink ¥1,480; nine-dish course with two hours of drinks ¥4,000. Reviews (May 2025–October 2026): mini sea-urchin cream risotto, pink potato salad with a soft-boiled egg, thick sashimi, Taiwanese minced cutlet, meat-wrapped vegetables, onion slices with bonito, wakasagi tempura, fried oysters, low-temperature outside skirt; from about 22:00 to 5:00 it becomes Shin'ya Ramen Hachi, with shoyu ramen ¥950 and a light yuzu chūka soba ¥980; one diner found the sake list short.

食べログ (店舗会員): 肉バル Muu、ステーキ・肉バル・鉄板焼き、東心斎橋1.en: Tabelog (shop member): Niku Bar Muu; steak, meat bar, teppanyaki; Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-13-23, 日宝イルストリート 1F; 3 minutes' walk from Shinsaibashi and Nagahoribashi stations; look for the red awning; Tue–Sun 12:00–24:00 (lunch L.O. 16:00, dinner 16:00–24:00 L.O. 23:00); closed Mondays; two hours when busy; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; 30 seats (counter 6, six tables for four); smoking allowed, so no one under 20; surprise steaks for anniversaries; thick Angus outside skirt and wagyu steak on the teppan; kuroge wagyu yukhoe seared in front of you; wine to go with meat; photos of mountains the owner has climbed. Reviews (September 2025–October 2026): steak by weight (tenderloin, sirloin cap, skirt); seared yukhoe; a meat tasting plate; anchovy potato salad; outside skirt steak lunch; beef tongue; oxtail soup set ¥1,200; sous-vide kuroge wagyu hamburg steak; secret menu items on social media; a popular owner; some found it cold inside or the chairs unsteady.

食べログ (店舗会員): 肉バルGAM 難波本店、肉バル・ステーキ、大阪市中央区.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Niku Bar GAM Namba Honten, meat bar and steak, 南進ビル 2F, Namba 4-6-3, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 minutes from Namba Station exit 12; Mon–Sat 17:00–1:00 (L.O. 24:00), Sun and the last day of long holidays 17:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); irregular closures; reservations accepted (online until 22:00 on the day, 3 groups a day); appetiser ¥440; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 60 seats; 3rd floor for private hire (up to 30); smoking allowed; opened 1 September 2015. Red meat and rare cuts, oyster-and-meat dishes, meat sushi, free salad with a steak order, courses with 200 drinks all-you-can-drink. Reviews (January–October 2026): all-you-can-drink ¥1,000 (January 2026), ¥1,500 (May 2026); conditions of three dishes per person (March), one steak per person (June), two dishes per person (October); meat sushi, top-blade sashimi, Niku-ra, horse sashimi, mushrooms and oil sardines, tataki; small portions; sukiyaki at lunch (May 2026); many foreign guests.

食べログ (店舗会員): 肉割烹 鋒 心斎橋、日本料理・寿司・居酒屋、大阪市中央.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Niku Kappo Kissaki Shinsaibashi, Japanese cuisine, sushi and izakaya, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-12-9 2F, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 minutes from Nagahoribashi Station, 5 minutes from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); irregular closures; same-day reservations accepted; appetiser ¥500; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 54 seats; private and semi-private rooms (2–8 people); heated tobacco in private rooms only; children welcome; opened 7 July 2021. Sushi and fresh fish on a base of Japanese cuisine and meat kaiseki, working with a sister sushi restaurant; selected wagyu and Yonezawa beef; fish direct from the port; niku sushi lunch ¥2,800, basic course ¥5,800, Shinogi course ¥8,800. Reviews (July–October 2026): beef-tendon stew, three sashimi, grilled wagyu lean meat and seven pieces of wagyu and fish sushi with red miso soup at lunch; on the Kissaki course, namero, sea eel and ito-kabocha clear soup, white omasum, liver sashimi, anago and turnip, charcoal-grilled sirloin; one reviewer calls it part of the Nakago group; small portions, long gaps between courses and cool service mentioned by some.

食べログ (店舗会員): 肉匠 牛虎 心斎橋店、焼肉・ホルモン・居酒屋、南船場3.en: Tabelog (shop member): Nikushou Gyuko Shinsaibashi branch; yakiniku, horumon, izakaya; Minami-Senba 3-4-22; 5 minutes' walk from Shinsaibashi Station, 1 minute from exit North 7 of Crysta Nagahori, behind the former Tokyu Hands; Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00), Sun 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); irregular closures; reservations recommended (online bookings confirmed by phone); Saiga courses with two-hour all-you-can-drink ¥7,000, ¥8,000 and ¥10,500 (a tasting of three outside-skirt cuts, vegetable-wrapped lean meat, Kurashita roast, special belly, rare cuts); cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; no service charge; 80 seats; private rooms (2–6); large rooms for 20 or more; smoking allowed except at lunch; Wi-Fi; safe, high-quality meat direct from its butcher shop. Reviews (August–October 2026): meat sushi; tongue sashimi; thick-cut tongue; sirloin; haneshita; omasum sashimi; top blade with grated daikon and ponzu; Juni-hitoe lunch ¥2,530 (thick-cut tongue with Ranou egg and dashi tororo, or kuroge wagyu top blade with yukke sauce); a five-rare-cuts lunch; outside skirt rice bowl; bread gozen; rice refills; coffee included; ice cream through the app; stairs down to the basement; a 25-minute wait; some say it was less impressive than the photos.

食べログ (店舗会員): 肉懐石 凜然、牛肉料理・ステーキ、四谷2-11-19.en: Tabelog (shop member): Niku Kaiseki Rinzen, beef dishes, steak; 大村ビル 1F, Yotsuya 2-11-19; 6 min walk from Yotsuya-sanchome Station, 7 min from Yotsuya Station; daily 12:00–14:30 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); reservation only; tell them about allergies in advance; children may order the course from the upper years of elementary school; 10% service charge; 14 seats; private rooms; non-smoking; cards accepted; Japanese cuisine of Kobe beef and 'Ota beef' heifers; seasonal seafood and mountain produce; Omakase Rinzen course ¥19,800 (¥22,000 with 2 hours of free-flow drinks); lunch ¥13,200. Reviews (August–October 2026): Tajima beef, yukhoe with Kaluga caviar, matsutake shinjo or clear soup, tongue wrapped in matsutake, Chateaubriand katsu sandwich, charcoal grilling, sukiyaki, matsutake rice, free-flow with champagne, Yamazaki and Hakushu, some found the lunch course small, the à la carte menu has gone.
