食べログ (店舗会員): 肉料理 神谷、すき焼き・しゃぶしゃぶ・ステーキ、大阪市.en: Tabelog (shop member): Niku Ryori Kanoya, sukiyaki, shabu-shabu and steak, 谷安ビル 2F, 1-3-4 堂島, Kita-ku, Osaka; 4 min from Keihan Oebashi Station; 5 min from Kitashinchi Station; Mon–Fri 17:00–24:00 (last order 22:00); Sat 17:00–23:00 (last order 21:00); closed Sundays and holidays; after 22:00 on weekdays book by phone; no service charge; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 18 seats (counter of 8, sunken-floor semi-private seats); smoking allowed; opened 29 October 2005; black wagyu 'Waiichi' direct from Tanifuji Farm; Kansai-style sukiyaki; a meat-loving owner; sukiyaki course and shabu-shabu course ¥12,800 each (appetizer, a meat dish, vegetables, udon, dessert). Tanifuji Farm is a wagyu company in Tokushima Prefecture (official site). Reviews (March 2023–July 2026): ham and onion; roast beef; sukiyaki; lettuce among the vegetables; thin udon to finish; ice cream; shabu-shabu with sesame sauce; a slightly restrained seasoning; fat that is not heavy; full on Saturdays; a twenty-year-old shop; the owner prepares the food.

食べログ (店舗会員): 肉食系酒場 片岡肉じろう、居酒屋・肉バル・ステーキ、大.en: Tabelog (shop member): Nikushokukei Sakaba Kataoka Nikujirou, izakaya, meat bar and steak, 梅田1-2-2, B1F of Osaka Station Front Building No. 2, Kita-ku, Osaka; 1 min on foot from JR Kitashinchi Station; Mon–Fri and the days before and after a holiday 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00, Saturdays and holidays 15:00–23:00, closed Sundays (on a long weekend ending in a Monday holiday it opens Sunday and closes Monday); reservations accepted; no charge; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 20 seats (7 at the counter, 4 tables); smoking allowed (not at lunch); opened 28 July 2023; a popular tavern of meat × Chinese × izakaya; charcoal grilling; knuckle steak and char siu W egg; authentic Chinese by a craftsman of twenty years. Reviews (September–October 2026): char siu W egg set ¥1,000 (thick pork-belly char siu, two fried eggs, cabbage, egg-drop soup, free rice refills); only three lunch dishes; sometimes sold out; knuckle steak set; beef-tendon curry; boiled gyoza ¥495; spring rolls ¥583; mapo tofu ¥968; knuckle steak 1.5 times ¥1,639; fried cartilage ¥528; bell peppers ¥319; pickled mustard greens ¥319; fillet steak; dote-yaki; afternoon draft beer ¥290; half-frozen beer; a sweet sauce; at night a meal without drinks is fine; featured on TV (Matsuko's Unknown World, Chachai-re Monday).

食べログ (店舗会員): 脇田屋、ホルモン・居酒屋・もつ鍋、大阪市北区西天満4-.en: Tabelog (shop member): Wakita Ya, horumon, izakaya and motsunabe, 4-15-1 Nishitenma, Kita-ku, Osaka; 5 min from Kitashinchi Station; 6 min from Higashi-Umeda Station; 11 min from Osaka Station; Mon–Sat and the day before and after a holiday 17:00–24:00 (last order food 23:00, drinks 23:30); closed Sundays, holidays and the 2nd and 4th Mondays; reservations accepted; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 15 seats; smoking allowed; free Wi-Fi; opened 6 June 2017; a hidden izakaya between Kitashinchi and Nishitenma; charcoal-grilled horumon, yakiton and yakitori; popular shochu. Reviews (September 2019–July 2025): wagyu horumon (small intestine) ¥908 (small ¥528), later ¥999; gatsu-shin; heart; shiro-maru; harami, tongue and koshira ¥588; chicken thigh tataki ¥999; chicken neck ¥488; beef tataki yukhoe ¥1,280; a light horumon stew; kimchi; rakkyo; a stamina rice bowl ¥600 at lunch; the owner's homemade sauces; small portions for one; busy with office workers after work; cheerful owner and staff.

食べログ (店舗会員): 芋洗坂の下、港区六本木6-7-17 小俣ビル2F、六本.en: Tabelog (shop member): Imoarai Zaka no Shita, Roppongi 6-7-17, 小俣ビル 2F, 3 min walk from Roppongi Station exit 3; daily 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; lunch walk-in on Wednesdays, Fridays and Saturdays, reservation required on Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays and Sundays; closed 29 November for a special holiday; ¥500 cover (plus tax); one drink per person at dinner; 14 seats (counter 8, semi-private 6); smoking area for heated tobacco only; cards, e-money and QR accepted; children welcome. Shop text: drinking dishes such as Tokachi herb-beef yukhoe; A5 Yamagata-beef sukiyaki in a small pot from 100 g; eggs offered at Ise Jingu; wagyu rare katsu; dashimaki in sukiyaki broth; small dishes ¥500–900. Course ¥9,900. Reviews (July–October 2026): choi-suki set ¥4,480 (à la carte ¥2,420); meringue-style egg; beef-toro potato salad ¥660; a friendly manager; many overseas guests; opened in 2025.

食べログ (店舗会員): 芙蓉苑、四川料理・中華料理・鍋、大阪市中央区島之内1-.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Fuyo En, Sichuan, Chinese, hot pot; 1F ビルドアップ長堀橋ビル, 1-18-8 Shimanouchi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; right beside Nagahoribashi Stn exit 3; daily 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); 1F until 22:00, 2F until 22:30; table bookings for 2 hours; reservations accepted; for hot pot, the sister Fuyo En Hot Pot Castle; one-drink policy; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 42 seats (counter 8, tables 24, a 2F private room for 10); non-smoking; opened 29 December 2015; Sichuan cuisine with chefs and ingredients gathered from the source. Reviews (December 2025–August 2026): mapo tofu set ¥1,000 (rice refills, two pieces of kara-age, soup, almond tofu, spice level to choose), stone-grilled mapo tofu ¥1,300, twice-cooked pork ¥1,600, shark-fin soup ¥1,200, beef and green peppers ¥1,100, salted stir-fried green beans ¥1,380, beef noodle soup ¥1,300, chicken stir-fried with peanuts and chilli, saliva chicken, dan dan noodles, cumin lamb, dried-tofu salad, stir-fried potatoes, candied sweet potato, a soup of blood and offal, Shaoxing wine; QR-code ordering; Chinese staff; taste and portions change with the chef; rice portions about half what they were.

食べログ (店舗会員): 花様 西梅田、日本料理・野菜料理・オーガニック、大阪市.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kayou Nishi umeda, Japanese cuisine, vegetable dishes and organic, 堂島NSビル 1F, 2-1-18 Dojima, Kita-ku, Osaka; 4 min from Nishi-Umeda Station exit 9; 5 min from Kitashinchi and Watanabebashi stations; daily 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30; Sunday lunch by course only) and 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); open year-round; reservations accepted; starter ¥330 (none with courses); cards and PayPay accepted; 40 seats; private rooms for 2 to over 30; non-smoking; gold sticker; over 100 kinds of Omi vegetables from the company's own farm in Moriyama, Shiga, and more than 300 local farmers; four trucks collect each morning; Omi beef bought whole; wild fish from Lake Biwa; farmer's vegetable kaiseki with all-you-can-eat Omi vegetable salad and an Omi chicken hotpot ¥4,000 (from ¥5,000); with an anniversary cake; with an Omi beef sukiyaki hotpot ¥4,500 (from ¥5,500). Invoice registration: Garden Co., Ltd. (Moriyama City). Reviews (August–September 2026): a raw vegetable salad in a flowerpot, dressed from a watering can; red konnyaku; Omi fu; tempura; seasoned rice; all-you-can-drink ¥1,500; an Omi vegetable obanzai lunch set of the day ¥1,210 (ginger pork with cabbage and komatsuna and the like); free refills of salad, rice (house brown rice and Omi rice) and miso soup; phone bookings only after 13:00; 3 min from the Kitashinchi underground mall.

食べログ (店舗会員): 花華 (Hanahana)、お好み焼き、東心斎橋1-1.en: Tabelog (shop member): Hanahana; okonomiyaki; Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-13-6; 3 min on foot from Nagahoribashi Stn; daily 11:00–14:00 and 17:00–23:00; reservations; cards, e-money and QR; 54 seats (floors 1–3); non-smoking; children welcome; vegetarian options; okonomiyaki with a batter fluffy inside and crisp outside; cheap, tasty and filling. Reviews (November 2025–September 2026): pork okonomiyaki and grilled squid yakisoba ¥1,090 each, modern-yaki, beef-tendon okonomiyaki, negiyaki, tonpei-yaki, squid and green-onion yaki, thick-noodle yakisoba, soy-sauce yakisoba, squid legs, beef offal, beef steak, chicken neck, wagyu saiboshi, a ¥1,200 drink set on weekdays until 20:00, all-you-can-drink course ¥4,290, lunch resumed in May 2026, celebrity signatures on the walls, tablet ordering; also comments that it is salty or a little pricey.

食べログ (店舗会員): 藤久 (ふじきゅう)、日本料理、大阪市中央区日本橋2-.en: Tabelog (corporate member): Fuji Kyuu (ふじきゅう), Japanese cuisine, Nipponbashi 2-7-28, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 3 min on foot from Nipponbashi Station on the Sennichimae subway line; daily 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:30–21:00 (L.O. 20:00); closing days not fixed; reservations accepted (no seat requests); minimum-spend notes for lunch and dinner (table seating); children only when the whole shop is booked; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 14 seats (counter on the ground floor; tatami and tables upstairs for up to 12); private hire possible; non-smoking. Shop text: 30 years in Nipponbashi, seasonal ingredients sent direct from the source, care from presentation to delicate flavours, about 10 sakes. Courses: lunch-only omakase ¥4,180; omakase ¥6,600, ¥9,900, ¥13,200. À la carte (updated November 2024): fugu, tuna sashimi and shabu-shabu, yellowtail, Matsuba crab and Seko crab, shiroguchi, sashimi platters, tempura, ayu, oysters, cod milt, shamo chicken, whale, aokubi duck, wild boar, beef, horse meat, pork shabu-shabu. Reviews (July 2017 to September 2026): a white wooden lattice door in a narrow alley; a November 2025 review found the entrance and ground-floor counter renovated; a quiet chef who trained at Kiccho (some say Ajikiccho); often runs the shop alone, so dishes can take time; in June 2025 apparently the chef's wife and a part-timer; sesame tofu, crab, shamo hot pot, sea-urchin somen, Ajimaimo, Seko crab, charcoal-grilled eel ¥10,000, bear meat, oyster tempura, oyakodon, tairagi sashimi; leftover sea-bream rice or bamboo-shoot rice wrapped to take home.

食べログ (店舗会員): 虎峰、港区六本木3-14-16 ペンタビル1F、大江戸.en: Tabelog (shop member): Koho, Roppongi 3-14-16, ペンタビル 1F, 5 min walk from Roppongi Station exit 5 (Oedo line), 8 min from exit 3 (Hibiya line); daily 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–22:00; 10% service charge; 14 seats (counter only); private hire up to 20; non-smoking; no children; please avoid perfume; cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 28 May 2026. Shop text: Cantonese technique with the excitement of Sichuan and global touches; executive chef Yuki Kaneko (Tsuji school, Heichinrou, SENSE, Series); wine and tea pairings. Courses: lunch omakase ¥9,800, Premium Course ¥25,800, Christmas ¥33,000. Reviews (September–October 2026): a 20-dish Signature Course ¥15,800; Peking duck with apple; three dim sum; chicken wings stuffed with foie gras; duck with black vinegar; shark-fin clay-pot rice; one reviewer says the head chef after the move is Kato Kazuaki.

食べログ (店舗会員): 蟹かに城、かに・ふぐ・鍋、大阪市中央区日本橋2-6-1.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Kani Kani Jo, crab, fugu and hot pot, Nippombashi 2-6-15, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 5 min walk from Nippombashi Station exit 5, winter (October–March) 16:00–23:30 (last order 22:30), summer (April–September) 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–22:00, 15:00–23:30 on December weekends and 24–30 December, 15:00–21:00 from 31 December to 3 January, open year-round, no eel in December and January, book on the official site, online bookings courses only, 2-hour limit, 10% service charge over New Year, cards and QR accepted, 46 seats, all private rooms (1F and 2F), non-smoking, opened 30 September 2024. Shop introduction (machine-translated): snow crab moults more than ten times over eight to ten years, live crab from the tank cooked two ways of your choice from sashimi, boiled or hot pot, a course of sashimi, crab miso, grilled crab, tempura and hot pot, crab sake of grilled crab legs steeped in hot sake. Reviews (September–October 2026): Hokkai course ¥7,900 (crab gratin ¥1,500, draft beer ¥680, crab jelly, tempura, rice porridge to finish, branded crabs too), Hokkai course ¥7,980 (crab jelly, sashimi, crab miso, tempura, crab hot pot, rice porridge, ice cream), a tank of crabs and fugu, summer hitsumabushi, calm private rooms, near Namba Grand Kagetsu.

食べログ (店舗会員): 裏なんばサカナエビス 難波千日前、居酒屋・寿司・魚介、.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Ura Nanba Sakana Ebisu Nanba Sennichimae, izakaya, sushi and seafood, 川西第1ビル 1F, Namba Sennichimae 14-17, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 minutes from Namba Station; Mon–Fri and the day before holidays 16:00–23:30, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:30 (food L.O. 23:00); reservations accepted; two-hour limit when busy; cards (VISA, Master) and PayPay accepted; 35 seats; e-cigarettes only; the sister shop of Sushi Ebisu in Ebisu, Tokyo and Sannomiya, Kobe; red-vinegar Edomae nigiri from ¥99; sake from ¥399 a half-go; the signature 'Shrimp and Crab Battle'; a party course with free drinks ¥5,000. Reviews (July–October 2026): appetiser ¥399, five-kind sashimi platter ¥1,319, potato salad ¥549, sweet shrimp fried with nori salt ¥549, Shrimp and Crab Battle ¥989, sea-bream chiri ¥439, aosa red-miso soup ¥329, yukke with sea urchin and salmon roe, horse-meat yukke, spear squid with sesame wasabi, sesame kanpachi, raw oysters, sake-steamed clams, happy hour, a wait until 20:00 without a booking on a Saturday night, an entrance that is easy to miss.

食べログ (店舗会員): 裏難波 路地裏酒場 とんぼ、居酒屋・焼き鳥・鶏料理、大.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Ura Namba Rojiura Sakaba Tonbo, izakaya, yakitori and chicken dishes, Sennichimae Central Building No. 4 1F, Namba Sennichimae 13-6, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 minutes from Namba Station; Mon–Fri 15:00–24:00, Sat 12:00–24:00, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00; two-hour limit when busy; appetiser ¥450; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 60 seats; non-smoking (smoking at the annex); Kaku highball ¥100 on weekdays 15:00–18:00; coupons for families with children; vegan options shown; 10-dish courses with all-you-can-drink ¥4,000 and ¥4,500. Reviews (June–October 2026): chicken sashimi of morning-slaughtered local chicken, binchotan yakitori, straw-grilled chicken thigh served rare, liver, potato salad with ikura and tobiko, chicken-wing gyoza, yukke sushi, egg brûlée, sweet shrimp yukhoe with heads, dashi omelette with mentaiko and ikura, shrimp shabu-shabu, stingray fin grilled on a shichirin, happy hour with every drink ¥300, one reviewer had a dish that never came. Sister shops: Bekkan, Ura and Hanare.

食べログ (店舗会員): 豚のしっぽと鶏のとさか なんば店、居酒屋・鶏料理・豚し.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Buta no Shippo to Tori no Tosaka Nanba, izakaya, chicken dishes, pork shabu-shabu; 上方ビル 1F, 1-7-11 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nippombashi Stn, 7 from Namba Stn; daily 17:00–5:00 (L.O. 4:00); closed only at New Year; reservations accepted; cards (VISA, Master) and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 44 seats (counter, booths, loft, tatami, an 8-person semi-private room); smoking allowed; wheelchair accessible; bone-in chicken thigh course with two hours of drinks ¥3,800. Shop introduction (English translation): homemade oden in white chicken broth; grilled bone-in chicken thigh; charcoal-grilled and shabu-shabu Agu pork from Ishigaki Island; tea-based shochu with house tea leaves; fresh-fruit sours. Reviews (October 2025–September 2026): pork tsukune; chicken sashimi and tataki; chicken nanban, large for the same price; grilled pork liver; shungiku salad; potato salad; starters of yudofu or sake-steamed clams; a corn-tea highball; strong drinks; a low-ceilinged loft; a colourful room.

食べログ (店舗会員): 象印食堂 大阪本店、食堂・日本料理・弁当、大阪市中央区.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Zojirushi Shokudo Osaka main shop, cafeteria, Japanese food and bento, なんばスカイオ 6F, Namba 5-1-60, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 minute from Nankai Namba Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–21:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–15:15 and 17:00–21:00; reservations accepted; food allergies cannot be accommodated because allergens cannot be fully removed in sourcing and cooking; cards, transport IC, Rakuten Edy, iD, QUICPay, PayPay, au PAY, Alipay and WeChat Pay accepted; 61 seats (tables only); non-smoking; children welcome (kids' menu for preschoolers only, no children's chairs); Namba Parks and Namba City parking; opened 17 October 2018; Zojirushi's rice restaurant, blended rice from a five-star rice meister cooked in 'Enbutaiki', seasonal side dishes, lunch and kaiseki, bento; 'Aki Hime' kaiseki with free drinks ¥8,900. Reviews (August–October 2026): numbered tickets and a QR code from about 10:30, a 60-minute limit, lunch from ¥2,300, salmon and chunky vegetables in black-vinegar sauce ¥2,300, three rices with free refills, sea bream, umeboshi and nori tsukudani, sea-bream chazuke, rice ice cream, egg ¥300, the craft beer 'Zou no Mai', queues on weekdays too.

食べログ (店舗会員): 近江牛 すき焼き しゃぶしゃぶ 都、すき焼き・しゃぶし.en: Tabelog (shop member): Omi-gyu Sukiyaki Shabushabu Miyako — sukiyaki / shabu-shabu / steak; 2F, Nakagyo-ku; 3 min on foot from Sanjo or Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn; 11:30–15:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 17:00–22:30 (L.O. 21:00); open all year; one course per person; 90-minute limit when busy; pork instead of beef for those who cannot eat beef; service charge: none; 20 seats (5 tables); children welcome; English and Traditional Chinese menus; opened 10 August 2024; sukiyaki made with cotton candy; A5 certified Omi beef (female cattle) and Kobe beef; sister shop Towa Gion-Shijo; sukiyaki course with meat sushi ¥8,800, Kobe beef ¥11,770, Miyako special course ¥17,600. Reviews (September–October 2026, English): lunch sukiyaki set 150 g ¥6,600, 200 g ¥8,140; eight-appetizer course ¥9,350; eggs from Oita; rice from Hachidaime Gihei; yaki-fu and nama-fu.

食べログ (店舗会員): 道頓堀 治兵衛 (じへい)、ふぐ・うなぎ・海鮮、道頓堀.en: Tabelog (shop member): Dotonbori Jihei; fugu, eel, seafood; Dotonbori 2-1-4; 2 minutes' walk from exit 25 of Namba Station; daily 11:30–22:30; reservations; seasonal courses up to 50% off (except Fridays and Saturdays in December and 2–3 January); autumn matsutake and fugu kaiseki: Cosmos ¥6,050, Ginkgo ¥7,150, Rodan ¥7,920; special courses with Ise lobster and wagyu; a 10% seat charge for private rooms on the 3rd–5th floors; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; seats with a view of the Dotonbori River. Reviews (April–October 2026): fugu sashimi à la carte ¥650; fugu hot pot for one ¥4,180; Ise lobster salad ¥3,080; fin sake (hot or chilled); tecchiri with milt; Arima-style simmered dish; zosui; summer conger eel and eel courses; one-person pots on solid fuel; a river view with passing cruise boats; restroom in the basement; some say the draft beer was stale or the ingredients not top-grade.

食べログ (店舗会員): 道頓堀 酒処 喜多蔵 (キタゾウ)、居酒屋・寿司・串焼.en: Tabelog (shop member): Dotonbori Sakedokoro Kitazo; izakaya, sushi, kushiyaki; Dotonbori 2-1-7, サン道頓堀ビル 2F; 30 m from the Dotonbori arcade; 3 minutes' walk from Namba Station; Tue–Sun and holidays 17:00–1:00; closed Mondays; reservations (phone even if online booking shows full); two hours when busy at weekends; groups including overseas tourists must phone before booking, and arriving without a call carries a ¥1,500 per person service charge and may be refused; courses with all-you-can-drink ¥5,000, Kura course ¥7,500, premium course ¥10,000; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 40 seats (counter 8, tables 20, tatami 12); private rooms with a view of the Dotonbori River; non-smoking; menus in English, Simplified Chinese and Korean; 20 years in Osaka; rare cuts of bluefin tuna; original fish skewers; sushi by artisans; 10–13 sakes chosen by the owner; Kita Kura Oden. Reviews (January–September 2026): thick-cut tuna sashimi; fish-liver sashimi; grilled tuna cheek; bamboo shoot and firefly squid tempura skewers; homemade roast beef; eel omelette; clam udon; toro maki, two for ¥550; seats with a river view; some found the grilled items slow.

食べログ (店舗会員): 達屋 なんば店 (TAZ-YA)、居酒屋・しゃぶしゃぶ.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): TAZ-YA Namba, izakaya and shabu-shabu, Namba-Sennichimae 1-8 2F, Chuo-ku, Osaka, Mon–Fri 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–23:00, Sat and Sun 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00, reservations accepted, the limited Jewel Box lunch bookable by the day before on weekdays and in limited numbers at weekends, a 2-hour dinner and 1-hour lunch limit when busy, starter ¥500 and private-room fee ¥500 a person (dinner only), cards and PayPay accepted, 34 seats on 2F, a 24-seat hall and private rooms for 4, 6 and 8 (a VIP room), private hire 24–30, non-smoking, opened 10 May 2023. Shop introduction (machine-translated): vegetables from the company's own farm, freshly shaved katsuobushi, Hokkaido free-range pork, a pot sauce of three-year-aged mirin, junmai sake, a hideaway izakaya for adults, farm days at the company's farm in Yao. Company site (kimiyu.co.jp): the most delicious meal is one eaten with a gentle mother and family. Reviews (October 2026): Jewel Box lunch ¥2,590 (sashimi, roast beef, kara-age, dashimaki, potato salad, obanzai, Ibusuki katsuobushi without limit, rice refills extra), a meat-wrapped lunch, a ¥3,800 course (fried simmered daikon, dashi shabu-shabu, soba to finish, salmon and tuna bowl), house tofu with katsuobushi shaved in front of you, jasmine-tea pudding, a gold private room, steep stairs, the sister shop BELLA BOCCA on 1F, a shop in Umeda too.

食べログ (店舗会員): 釜山式ナッコプセ専門店 ジョンナッチ (정낙지)、韓国.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Busan-shiki Nakkopuse Senmon Ten Jon-nacchi (정낙지), Korean, Kitahorie 1-13-21 1F, Nishi-ku, Osaka, 3 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exit 6, Tue–Sun 17:30–22:30 (last entry 21:30), closed Monday, reservations accepted (phone 16:00–22:00), cards, e-money and QR accepted, 28 seats, non-smoking, wheelchair accessible, children and strollers welcome, Korean menu, Korean-speaking staff, photo menu, opened 26 September 2023. Shop introduction (machine-translated): authentic nakkopse, plump octopus, offal and shrimp, bokkeumbap to finish, makgeolli and other Korean drinks. Reviews (July–October 2026): four spice levels, free refills of bean-sprout namul, seaweed and kimchi, naksamse, bokkeumbap with cheese to finish, ramen, minari chijimi, celery chijimi, kongguksu in summer, ordering by phone, a 90-minute limit, a small room so book, and praise for the sweet, tasty offal.

食べログ (店舗会員): 陣矢 東京油そば伝承館 上野の陣、上野7-10-4、上.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Jinya Tokyo Abura-soba Denshokan Ueno no Jin, Ueno 7-10-4, 1 min on foot from the Ueno Station Iriya exit (100 m to the left); daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:45); irregular closures (announced on Instagram); no reservations; 11 counter seats; non-smoking; no cards or e-money; takeout; opened 13 December 2016; healthy abura-soba; Kaikarou's special noodles and tare; over 20 toppings; finish 5 servings (1.5 kg) or 10 servings (3 kg) in 20 minutes for a gift certificate. Reviews (October 2025–October 2026): abura-soba ¥800 (May 2026), one said ¥900 (May 2026); two servings ¥1,000; 2.5 servings (375 g); spring Jinya set ¥1,100 (bean sprouts, fried onions, fish powder, cheese, special broth); a big bowl easy to mix; sesame-oil aroma; vinegar and chili oil; carbonara style; extra-spicy miso; the ticket machine is cash only; a quiet street with no queue; one male staff member running it alone (May 2026); asked the owner for recommendations (October 2026).

食べログ (店舗会員): 隆勝、ラーメン・つけ麺、大阪市淀川区東三国1-1-32.en: Tabelog (shop member): Ryusho; ramen, tsukemen; 1-1-32 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 1 minute from JR Higashi-Yodogawa Station; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 11:00–14:30 and 17:30–02:00; closed Wednesday; no reservations; no cards; 16 seats; smoking in a designated area at night only; coin parking nearby; opened 1 August 2014; rich seafood and pork-bone broth of pork bones (marrow bones and backbones), trotters, chicken bones, chicken feet, niboshi, katsuobushi, shiitake, kombu, vegetables and more, over a dozen ingredients for more than 15 hours; no artificial seasoning; no back fat. Reviews (2024 to October 2026): ticket machine inside (cash); PayPay accepted; pork tsukemen ¥1,000; large size ¥180; chicken paitan tsukemen ¥980; tsukemen with toppings on a separate plate ¥1,400; Sweet and Spicy tsukemen in four heat levels; mazesoba; thick straight whole-wheat noodles; diced chashu and onion in the dip; lemon halfway through; soup to dilute the dip at the end; kara-age; gyoza; fried rice; open late at night.

食べログ (店舗会員): 隠れ家ダイニング さーて、居酒屋・バル・ステーキ、四谷.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kakurega Dining Saate, izakaya, bar, steak; 山田ビル 2F, Yotsuya 1-7-15, at the mouth of Shinmichi-dōri; 1 min walk from Yotsuya Station; daily 11:00–23:30 (last order 23:00), Sundays only for bookings of 5 or more made by the day before; no cover charge; 45 seats; semi-private rooms divided by curtains; smoking allowed (non-smoking at lunch); no children at dinner; cards and QR accepted; beef steak ¥1,580, beef churrasco ¥1,480, roast beef ¥1,280; courses with 2 hours of drinks ¥3,000–4,500, 3-hour course ¥5,000 (after discount). Reviews (February–August 2026): steak, roast beef, churrasco, kara-age, ajillo, garlic toast, fried rice, Wild Plate, drinks courses, one diner found it empty on a Saturday night.

食べログ (店舗会員): 隠れ家焼肉 漱石、焼肉・ホルモン、大阪市中央区西心斎橋.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Soseki, hideaway yakiniku, yakiniku and offal, 1-9-20 Nishi-Shinsaibashi 2F, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min on foot from Shinsaibashi Station on the Midosuji Line; Mon–Sat, holidays and the days before and after holidays 18:00–2:00 (L.O. 1:30); Sunday 18:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00); closed only over the New Year; reservations accepted; 10% service and table charge; cards, PayPay, d Barai and au PAY accepted, no e-money; 8 seats; whole-shop hire for up to 20; smoking allowed; opened 17 November 2023. Shop description: a grown-up hideaway on the second floor of a building in Amerikamura; only domestic beef with little odour and fat, bought through the shop's own channels; tongue wrapped round Kujo green onion; a limited daily special outside skirt; offal eaten with plum and salt; unfermented kimchi made to order; omakase course of 11 items for 7,000 yen. Reviews (September–October 2026): 2F of Bamboo Alley; 8 counter seats; dim lighting; cold noodles with sudachi; sweet-potato brûlée with vanilla ice cream; a cat drawn in powdered sugar; cat figurines in the room; omasum sashimi; smoking allowed at every seat; good for a date.

食べログ (店舗会員): 隼、港区六本木4-4-2 ヒルサイドパレス六本木B1F.en: Tabelog (shop member): Hayato, Roppongi 4-4-2, ヒルサイドパレス六本木 B1F, 2 min walk from Roppongi Station exit 7; two seatings that start together, from 18:00 and from 21:00; reservations through OMAKASE; 10% service charge; 8 seats; non-smoking; cards accepted; opened 27 August 2018; The Tabelog Award Bronze 2022 and 2023, Silver 2024, 2025 and 2026; Tabelog Chinese TOKYO 100 in 2021, 2023, 2024 and 2026. Shop text: chef 吉田隼之 (born in Utsunomiya; worked at upscale Chinese restaurants in Tokyo and at SENSE, and helped open a restaurant on the Champs-Élysées in Paris); thick shark fin from slowly rehydrated dried fins. Reviews (July–October 2026): omakase ¥49,500; a course that changes every two months; hammerhead shark fin with collagen soup; matsutake-scented dim sum; straw-smoked bonito cutlet; noodles, fried rice and cream pasta to finish; drinks are expensive; a two-year wait for reservations.

食べログ (店舗会員): 青蓮院門跡前 月おか、日本料理、東山区粟田口三条坊町1.en: Tabelog (corporate member): Shorenin Monzeki Mae Tsukioka, Japanese cuisine, Awataguchi Sanjobo-cho 16-2, Higashiyama, 5 min from Higashiyama Stn; Mon and Thu–Sun and holidays 12:00–15:00 and 18:00–21:00; closed Tuesday, Wednesday and the last day of the month; shared start; omakase course lunch ¥15,000, evening ¥30,000 (tax included); a separate 5% service charge from 1 December; 8 counter seats on the first floor; a second-floor private room with a table for up to 12 (stairs only, shoes off); ages 12 and up; opened 14 April 2021; The Tabelog Award 2026 Bronze; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Owner Masanori Tsukioka, born 1976 in Hokkaido, trained from age 15 in Sapporo, influenced by the owner of Kusakui Nakahigashi, gathers vegetables and wild plants in Ohara and Miyama; 50-day aged beef from Sakaeya in Kusatsu. Reviews (August–October 2026): "a great restaurant that wins you over from the hassun", a world built down to the tableware and furnishings (a Japanese review), Ohara vegetables, white-miso soup, Akashi conger eel, 100% buckwheat soba, lunch fully booked.

食べログ (店舗会員): 飛牛、焼肉・ホルモン、大阪市北区堂島1-1-20 パー.en: Tabelog (shop member): Higyu, yakiniku and horumon, Pearl Plaza Building 5F, 1-1-20 Dojima, Kita-ku, Osaka; 3–5 min from Kitashinchi Station on the Tozai Line; Mon–Fri 18:00–4:00 (last order 3:00); Sat 18:00–1:00 (last order 0:30); closed Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; no service charge; cards and QUICPay accepted, no QR; 18 seats (counter of 8, private rooms up to 10); smoking allowed; Tabelog Yakiniku WEST 100 2025 and Grill WEST 100 2026; the black wagyu 'Daikokusen' found nowhere else; sirloin yaki-shabu; Sakeru Hire cut in front of you; sommelier-chosen wine; rice supervised by the eighth-generation Gihei of Kyoto; special black wagyu course of nine dishes ¥13,200; assorted course ¥8,800; wagyu fillet shabu-shabu ¥8,800. Invoice registration: HIGYU Co., Ltd. (same building). Reviews (July–October 2026): chateaubriand; thick tongue; liver; outside skirt and premium skirt; outside-skirt sashimi; yukhoe with egg yolk; kimchi and namul platters; garlic foil grill; half-size cold noodles; large cuts; at the east end of Kitashinchi's main street; pricey but satisfying; a comment that it is the high-end shop of a group with sister restaurants such as Satsuma.

食べログ (店舗会員): 食堂ペスカ、居酒屋・イタリアン・創作料理、難波千日前1.en: Tabelog (shop member): Shokudo Pesca, izakaya, Italian and creative, Namba Sennichimae 14-18, Doguya-suji alley, 4 min on foot from Namba Station (Midosuji Line, Nankai), daily 15:00–24:00, cards and PayPay, 32 seats (12 at the 1F counter, tables on 2F), private hire for 20–50, non-smoking, children welcome, particular about vegetables and fish, vegetarian options, particular about sake and wine, opened 8 April 2024. Reviews (September–October 2026): the sister restaurant is the Italian PESCA, a 1F counter at the open kitchen, tables on 2F, shrimp, shiso and myoga rolled in kadaif, seared spear squid with salt and sudachi, prosciutto with fruit and mascarpone, tripe in white miso, Hirata Farm tonkatsu, wagyu roast-beef sukiyaki, conger eel and karasumi pasta, natural wine, fully booked even on weekday evenings, small portions.

食べログ (店舗会員): 食堂ボンド、東上野5-17-8 1F、稲荷町駅から徒歩.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Shokudo Bond, Higashi-Ueno 5-17-8 1F, 3 min on foot from Inaricho Station, 5 min from the Ueno Station Iriya exit; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 17:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:45); closed Sundays; 14 seats (10 at the counter, one booth for 4); non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; children welcome; English menu and staff; takeout; opened 1 November 2025; creative pressed sushi and Edomae nigiri; wine chosen by a sommelier and a monthly sake; "Bond" is a place where people connect, in the spirit of ichigo ichie. Menu (October 2026): Aburi REMIX 10 pieces ¥4,000, pressed sushi 6 pieces ¥1,400, assorted sashimi ¥1,400, homemade cheese tofu ¥600, kara-age ¥880, kids' plate ¥1,200. Reviews (January–November 2026): torched pressed sushi; special nigiri 8 pieces ¥4,000; kara-age popular with children; English spoken, many overseas customers; tom-yum-flavoured shrimp; Toyosu fatty tuna; seafood rice bowl lunch ¥1,600 (red-vinegar sushi rice, fish-bone soup); one diner found nearly ¥2,000 for 6 pieces overpriced; Hon-Maguro Festival (standing, 30 minutes, ¥3,900).

食べログ (店舗会員): 飯田、日本料理、中京区姉小路富小路西入ル南側、毎日18.en: Tabelog (corporate member): Iida, Japanese cuisine, 中京区姉小路富小路西入ル南側; daily 18:00–20:00; reservation required; irregular closing days; no cards; 10 seats (6 at the counter, 4 in a tatami room); a private room for 4; non-smoking; The Tabelog Award Gold 2019–2026; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025. Reviews (March–October 2026, in English): hard to get in except through regulars, a building that was once a tea-utensil shop, tableware by Rosanjin and Eiraku, no photos of the food, eel Yawata-maki only in May, a hamo and ume soup, Matsutake, an owner who explains dishes in a friendly way.

食べログ (店舗会員): 餃子工房 ギョィィィィィィン、餃子・中華料理・居酒屋、.en: Tabelog (shop member): Gyoza Kobo Gyoiiiiiin!!; gyoza, Chinese, izakaya; 3-15-17 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 3 minutes on foot from Hankyu Minamikata Station or Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station on the Midosuji Line; Mon–Sat and holidays 17:00–01:00, Sun 17:00–23:00; closures not fixed, open over the New Year holidays; reservations by phone; no cards, e-money or QR payment; 18 seats; private rooms; private hire up to 20; smoking allowed; one-bite gyoza of domestic black pork and vegetables; pan-fried and boiled gyoza, six for ¥430; cheese and mala gyoza; chilled gyoza; garlic oil; two banquet courses (with all-you-can-drink). Reviews (June 2024 to August 2026): mala gyoza, shrimp gyoza, Chinese braised pork ¥680, xiaolongbao two for ¥500, chilled gyoza six for ¥500, mapo tofu, yodare-dori, a three-item snack plate (kimchi, namul and more), cabbage with salt sauce, draft beer ¥550, shochu with tea ¥500, a lemon sour with sorbet; on some days one person ran the shop alone; open late, good for a second stop; cash only.

食べログ (店舗会員): 魚と煮込みとわら焼きと ととと、居酒屋・海鮮・おでん、.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sakana to Nikomi to Warayaki to Tototo; izakaya, seafood, oden; Shinsaibashisuji 2-3-2, Queens Court Building main wing 101; 3 minutes' walk from Namba Station, 5 minutes from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 16:30–23:30 (L.O. food 22:30); closing days vary; reservations; omakase course ¥5,800 (Tue–Fri only), omakase premium course ¥8,800, seafood hot-pot course with a whole abalone ¥9,980, all-you-can-drink +¥2,800; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 21 seats; non-smoking (smoking area inside); English menu; takeaway; opened 17 July 2025; seasonal fish straw-grilled and charcoal-grilled, slow-simmered dishes, sashimi, sake. Reviews (May–October 2026): Tototo's second shop, with a sister shop in the same building; straw-grilled bonito with salt; bluefin tuna, amberjack, Mongolian squid, mikan sea bream, Shinshu salmon; daikon with yuzu miso, thick fried tofu, beef tendon, bone-in chicken simmered in white broth, a whole tomato in dashi, toroyuba; kamameshi; salmon-roe rice.

食べログ (店舗会員): 魚屋ひでぞう 別館、魚介料理・居酒屋・鍋、大阪市中央区.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Sakanaya Hidezou Bekkan, seafood, izakaya and hot pot, Namba Sennichimae 4-19 2F, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 minutes from Nankai Namba Station; Mon and Wed–Sat 17:00–23:00, Sun 15:00–23:00; closed Tuesday; reservations accepted; 2.5-hour limit; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; no service charge; 70 seats; no private rooms; non-smoking; a fish dealer with trading rights at the Eastern Market, supplying over 100 restaurants and fish shops; the annex of the hard-to-book Sakanaya Hidezou Namba; a bar on 4F; courses with free drinks. Reviews (August–October 2026): sashimi platters of 5 or 7 kinds, seared sawara, bluefin tuna, simmered kinmedai, grilled kanpachi collar, sanma, raw oysters, oysters with ponzu, octopus with ponzu, fried fugu, fried conger eel, corn tempura, kara-age, tuna Caesar salad, cream cheese, Manganji peppers, water eggplant, clam-dashi chazuke, Sapporo Lager Akaboshi, seats on 2F and 3F, a same-day call or an early hour may get you in, slow service on some days, about ¥3,000–6,000 a head.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨 からす 梅田店、寿司・海鮮・かに、大阪市北区堂山町.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sushi Karasu Umeda ten, sushi, seafood and crab, 布山ビル 1F, 12-14 堂山町, Kita-ku, Osaka; 5 min from the Umeda stations; Tue–Sun in two seatings (17:30–19:30, 20:00–22:00); closed Mondays; closed 31 December–4 January; automatic cancellation at 15 minutes late without notice; service charge 10%; cards, PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay accepted; 8 counter seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; rice cooked in a high-end rice cooker; black rice (squid ink) and red-vinegar rice; live squid; the 'Kiwami' course of live squid, 13 sushi and 8 dishes ¥12,100; with a three-sake pairing ¥14,300. Invoice registration: Five Dear Life Co., Ltd. (same as osaka_tora_toriya_ohatsutenjin and osaka_umeda_kani_shokudo). Reviews (October 2026): red rice for white fish, black rice for tuna and oily fish; live squid from the tank; squid legs with nuta; seared bonito; saikyo-miso sablefish; chawanmushi; a small bowl of uni, crab and ikura; Indian bluefin otoro; Akashi sea bream; Spanish mackerel; marinated mackerel; kawahagi with liver; kinmedai; scallop; swordtip squid; shrimp; eel; whale tongue; the 19-item 'Shizu' course ¥9,900 on days without squid; a comment that it is the Umeda branch of a Sushi Karasu popular in Juusan.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨 こるり、寿司・日本酒バー・ワインバー、四谷1-6-.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sushi Koruri, sushi, sake bar, wine bar; Komore Yotsuya 1F, Yotsuya 1-6-1; 3 min walk from Yotsuya Station; Tue 18:00–23:00, Wed–Fri 11:30–13:30 and 18:00–23:00, Sat 17:00–23:00 (Family Day every Saturday 17:00–19:00); closed Sundays and Mondays; no requests for specific ingredients or allergies; lunch may sell out without an advance order; no service charge; 10 seats (12 when booked out); non-smoking; cards accepted; English menu; sommelier; a craftsman with over 30 years' experience; sake and wine in small pours; about 200 bottled wines; small cobalt-blue glasses. Reviews (July 2024–March 2026): from an ¥8,000 nigiri course to a ¥30,000 full course (11 sakes), an ¥18,000 course, five stacked slices of chutoro, abalone with liver sauce, lunch only Wed–Fri with bara chirashi ¥3,000 and a tuna bowl ¥3,800, red-vinegar rice, a pudding-like tamagoyaki, said to belong to the Marugo group.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨 ししど、港区六本木3-8-2 WHARF104号、.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Sushi Shishido, Roppongi 3-8-2, WHARF 104, 4 min from Roppongi Stn (Oedo line), 6 min (Hibiya line); daily 18:00–05:00 next day (L.O. 4:00); closed 30 December–3 January; 10% seat charge for à la carte only; tell the shop about allergies when booking; 10 counter seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; children welcome; opened 9 August 2026. Shop text: Edomae sushi by a craftsman of 18 years who trained in Taiwan and Malaysia; about 20 sakes chosen by the chef. Courses: Sushi Shishido course of 16 dishes ¥30,000; special course of 19 dishes ¥50,000. Reviews (September–October 2026): matsutake and kue; sumi-ika; chutoro; grilled swordfish; sweet shrimp; a signature of salmon roe, sea urchin and caviar; white-fish meunière; otoro; Hokkaido natural bluefin tuna; a friendly chef; karaoke late at night; a chef said to have opened sushi shops abroad.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨 そら、寿司・日本料理・海鮮、大阪市北区堂島1-5-.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sushi Sora, sushi, Japanese cuisine and seafood, はつ根ビル 3F, 1-5-4 堂島, Kita-ku, Osaka; Nishi-Umeda Station; 4 min from Kitashinchi Station; daily 11:30–15:00 (last seating 13:30) and 18:00–22:00 (last seating 20:00); reservation only; about 90 minutes at lunch and 120 at dinner; cards, e-money and QR accepted (UnionPay, Alipay, LINE Pay and Kakaopay too); 17 seats (counter of 11, tables for 6); private rooms for 2–6; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children and strollers welcome; no strong perfume; opened 18 April 2022; Kansai techniques and ingredients beyond the Edomae frame; aged tuna; house-made ponzu, ume vinegar and desserts; sake pairing; Hoshi course ¥15,000; Sora Sea course ¥20,000; Full Moon course ¥25,000. Invoice registration: Fres Design Co., Ltd. (箕面市). Reviews (August–October 2026): a door code sent the day before; a pentagonal white-wood counter; Full Moon course (ten pieces and seasonal dishes); tuna, sea urchin and salmon roe hand roll; bluefin roll with sea urchin; swordtip squid with salt and lemon; fresh Pacific saury; red-vinegar gari; a welcome sushi; a ¥5,000 lunch; a new head chef; chopstick rests to choose; a Halloween tamagoyaki; a cat in nori on a birthday plate; a guest who followed from the previous shop.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨 とき、港区六本木3-9-4 ロイヤルビルB1F、六.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Sushi Toki, Roppongi 3-9-4, ロイヤルビル B1F, 1 min from Roppongi Stn exit 5; Mon–Sat 18:00–23:00, Wed–Sat 11:30–14:00; closed Sundays and holidays; reservation only; date changes cost 100% on the day, 50% the day before; 8 counter seats; non-smoking; cards accepted; opened 17 April 2025. Courses: OMAKASE ¥18,700; seasonal omakase short course (two groups a day) ¥12,100; chef's omakase ¥7,700; lunch of 9 nigiri and miso soup ¥4,400. Tell the shop about allergies when booking. Reviews (March–August 2026): Chef Yasuhiko; aged and carefully prepared nigiri; a hand roll of crab, sea urchin and tobiko (Toki hand roll); a gari roll of Donchicchi horse mackerel from Shimane; fish noodles with crab and shark fin; red-vinegar shari; a Doraemon fan.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨 五天五 OSAKA、寿司・日本料理・海鮮、大阪市北.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sushi Gotengo OSAKA, sushi, Japanese cuisine and seafood, 芝田2-2-8, 1F of 幸福相互ビル, Kita-ku, Osaka; 3 min on foot from JR Osaka Station, near the Grand Front North Building, next to the WINS Umeda B Building; Mon–Fri and the day before a holiday 17:00–23:30, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00, closed the day after a holiday; reservations accepted; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; no service charge; 20 seats (8 at the counter, 12 at tables); whole-shop hire up to 20; non-smoking; children welcome; menu in English and Chinese; opened 1 September 2025. Courses (tax included): 10 nigiri with red miso soup and dessert ¥7,700; a 15-nigiri course ¥11,000; the 'Kiwami' course of starters, three kinds of sashimi, a grilled dish and 10 nigiri ¥16,500. Shop's introduction: rice seasoned with a blend of seasonal vinegars, fish chosen with experience from running a high-end sushi restaurant, bought at the market every morning and served the same day, local sake from all over Japan. Reviews (October 2026): a back street in Umeda; flounder with engawa, aori squid, striped jack, domestic salmon, bluefin akami and chutoro, bonito, sawara, shime saba, kombu-cured botan shrimp, anago with Arima sansho, a seared scallop to finish; aged tuna; pickled ginger in cubes; Hokkaido milk gelato with homemade black syrup and kinako; nigiri made in front of you at the counter; a friendly chef; some days many customers from overseas.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨 利修、寿司・鍋・日本料理、大阪市西区新町1-27-.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Sushi Rishu; sushi, hot pot and Japanese cuisine; Shinmachi 1-27-16, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min from Nishi-Ohashi Stn, 4 min from Yotsubashi Stn; 17:30–23:30; closed Wednesdays and the 3rd and 4th Thursday of each month; reservations accepted (online bookings may be declined if phone bookings fill the seats); cards accepted; no e-money or QR; 10 seats (6 counter, a private room for 4); non-smoking; Wi-Fi; children of school age and up. Shop introduction: a head chef with 50 years of experience; sushi of domestic wild fish and seasonal ingredients; nigiri that stays beautifully shaped after it is made; the counter is 90 cm away; à la carte dishes such as sashimi platters, grilled and simmered dishes, plus courses; local sake matched to the seasonal seafood, some rare; a fugu course with fugu hot pot and a fugu platter, 5 items ¥11,000 (2–4 people). Reviews (October 2023–June 2026): you can order dish by dish instead of a course; 5-kind sashimi platter ¥3,500, surf clam ¥1,300, ark shell ¥1,200, dried swordfish ¥1,200, omakase nigiri 5 pieces ¥2,900 (September 2025); abalone liver sauce mixed into the sushi rice; monkfish liver; knife work on squid; toro-taku roll; a calm, friendly head chef; regulars who come every month; some days booked out two days ahead.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨 和恵、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-1-27 周防町ウィ.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Sushi Kazue, Suocho Wings Building 3F, 2-1-27 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min on foot from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Sat and holidays 17:00–19:00 and 19:30–21:30; closed Sunday; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 8 counter seats; non-smoking; opened 6 January 2026; note allergies in the remarks when booking. Shop description: a course of seafood from Sukumo, Kochi Prefecture; a woman head chef with 10 years of experience; omakase course of 15 items for 4,400 yen (appetizers, nigiri, ramen in seafood broth, dessert); 10–20 sakes chosen by the head chef. Reviews (January–October 2026): every 881 Group shop charges 4,400 yen for its course; the owner is from Kochi; the meal opens with a video about Kochi's seas; white-vinegar and red-vinegar rice to suit each topping, with red-vinegar rice for the marinated tuna; a mini ramen of fish-bone broth simmered 3–4 hours; almond tofu; extra nodoguro, white shrimp and sea urchin; a charcoal grill for eel since July 2026; Kazue, formerly of Sushi Chiharu, joined in January 2026; formerly named Sushi Asami; a drink order is required; sake 1,650 yen for 180 ml; occasional all-you-can-drink events announced on LINE; no cancellation fee even for no-shows; some say the room is cramped and the taste ordinary.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨 惣五郎、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-3-32 新地リバ.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Sushi Sogoro, Liberty Building 1F, 曽根崎新地 1-3-32, Kita-ku, Osaka; 2 min on foot from Kitashinchi Station; daily 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00; the phone may go unanswered during service, so book online; omakase ¥13,200, lunch ¥6,600 and ¥8,800 (tax included, changing monthly); extra charge over New Year; cards (VISA, Master); 7 counter seats (all with chairs); non-smoking; no children below junior-high age; go easy on perfume; ingredients bought every morning; rice cooked in a clay pot; opened 28 November 2013; Tabelog Sushi WEST 100, 2021. Reviews (June 2024–October 2026): red-vinegar rice; small nigiri; pumpkin potage; bonito with a corn sauce; ayu spring rolls; sanma sushi topped with ikura; hamo and eggplant in matsutake ankake; oyster nigiri; once a standing sushi bar, now seated; a friendly chef who likes a joke; one diner who felt rushed in December 2025 wrote in September 2026 that the service had improved.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨 邂逅、寿司、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-5-8 ピアー.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sushi Kaiko, sushi, 曽根崎新地1-5-8, 2F of the ピアースエイトビル, Kita-ku, Osaka; about 1 min on foot from Kitashinchi Station; Mon–Sat two seatings, from 18:00 and from 20:30; closed Sundays and holidays; reservation only; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; whole-shop hire; non-smoking (ashtray in the corridor); opened 30 September 2023; omakase only; small sushi on rice blending three red vinegars; Hokkaido sea urchin and tuna from many regions; junmai sake and wine; the logo by the calligrapher who wrote the title of 'Hibiki'; seasonal omakase course (12 nigiri, starters and more) ¥25,000 (tax included). Reviews (April–October 2026): sanma and eel; kinmedai with shiso sauce and sea grapes; seared kinki with purple sea urchin; lotus-root dumpling with crab sauce; chilled soup of horse mackerel and cucumber; new squid; shinko; kohada; kombu-cured sweet shrimp; clams from Mie; anago; tuna; homemade ikura; sea-urchin rice bowl; toro-taku with Ariake nori; a shrimp tamago made over two hours; bettara-zuke; bamboo shoots and bonito in spring; nodoguro with sea urchin; a red vinegar made for over 200 years; rice seasoned only with salt and vinegar; Hanshin Tigers players and sumo wrestlers among the guests; a quiet, kind chef.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨 龍馬、港区六本木7-13-8 六本木フュージョンビ.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sushi Ryuma, Roppongi 7-13-8, 六本木フュージョンビル 3F, 1 min walk from Roppongi Station exit 7 (Oedo line), 2 min from exit 4b (Hibiya line); Mon, Tue, Wed, Sat, Sun, holidays and days before and after holidays 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; Thu and Fri 17:00–23:00; 10% service charge; 22 seats (counter 9, private rooms for 6 and 8); non-smoking; children if they can eat the adult menu; BYO allowed; cards, e-money and QR accepted; vegan and vegetarian options listed. Course: Echizen crab and aged bluefin ¥110,000. Reviews (August–October 2026): Premium Sushi Course ¥28,600; matsutake dobin-mushi; kohada aged five days from Amakusa; aged hirame and shima-aji; kuruma prawn with sweet shrimp inside; squid with sea urchin underneath; purple sea-urchin gunkan; Asakusa-nori hand roll; an entertaining chef.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨×酒×肴 艶ノコク、港区六本木4-9-1 佐竹ビルB.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Sushi × Sake × Sakana Tsuyano Koku, Roppongi 4-9-1, 佐竹ビル B1F, 1 min from Roppongi Stn exit 6; Mon–Fri 11:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:30); daily 17:00–05:00 (food L.O. 4:00, drinks L.O. 4:30); cover charge ¥1,000 a person; private-room fee ¥1,000 (¥2,000 in all); karaoke ¥2,000 a person; 50 seats; private rooms for 2, 4, 6 or 8; smoking room for heated tobacco only; cards, e-money and QR accepted; children welcome; opened 22 November 2021. Over 300 sakes from 90 ml, three-sake tasting sets, all-you-can-drink. Edomae sushi with red-vinegar rice. Courses with all-you-can-drink ¥8,000, ¥10,000 and ¥16,000. Hitosara: listed as a sake dining bar under the same name, with the same address and phone number. Reviews (February–September 2026): fish from Toyosu; lunch resumed (seafood lunch, 10 a day, ¥1,980; special udon set ¥1,200; omurice ¥1,100); truffle omurice ¥1,300; sake all-you-can-drink of about 30 labels ¥5,000 a person; one dish per person must be ordered; across from Azabu Police Station; popular with celebrities; open until 5 am.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨おぎ堂、寿司、大阪市北区堂島1-5-35 堂島レジャ.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sushi Ogido, sushi, Dojima Leisure Building 2F, 1-5-35 堂島, Kita-ku, Osaka; 3 min on foot from Nishi-Umeda Station; 5 min from Kitashinchi Station; daily 18:00–21:00; closing days not fixed; reservations accepted; tell the shop of dislikes or allergies in advance; it may phone to confirm; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 6 seats at a hinoki counter; non-smoking; opened 17 April 2017; an omakase of about ten pieces of sushi of aged fish on red-vinegar rice and small dishes that suit sake; local sake and wine chosen by the head chef; a Tabelog-only course of ten pieces and seasonal seafood dishes ¥11,000. Reviews (August 2023–May 2026): tuna aged two weeks; seko crab; simmered anago; grilled barracuda; stick sushi; chawanmushi of new onion and crab; sea urchin; kohada; sardine; firefly squid; salmon roe; small nigiri; an extra toro-taku; open on Sundays when booked; book by the day before; the head chef works almost alone; private hire for up to four; drinks doubled the bill; a hard-to-find entrance, left from the lift; a diner from Hokkaido was satisfied.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨げん家 西中島、寿司・天ぷら・海鮮、大阪市淀川区木川.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sushi Genya Nishinakajima; sushi, tempura, seafood; 木川東 3-2-28, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 7 minutes on foot from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station and Hankyu Minamikata Station; Mon and Wed–Sun 18:00–23:30 (last order 23:00); closed Tuesday; calls before 16:00 answered by an AI; courses booked by the day before; cards, PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay accepted, no e-money; 22 seats (10 at the counter, 3 tables for four); whole hire up to 20; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; opened 11 December 2015; small rice of red vinegar at body temperature; tempura fried briefly at high heat; tempura dip of katsuobushi, saba-bushi and kombu with shio-koji; every plate one of a kind; over ten sakes; seasonal sushi and tempura course of 14 items ¥6,000 (tax included); seasonal sushi course of 12 items. Reviews (2024 to 2026): a deep-blue noren; sashimi; saikyo-grilled fish; tempura of red eggplant, angel shrimp and kisu; uzaku; five nigiri (chutoro, white fish, red shrimp, shima-aji, sea urchin); soft-roe tempura and ponzu; crab miso; firefly squid; a gari highball; an ¥8,000 course with all-you-can-drink; red shrimp swapped for sea bream for a dietary restriction; choose your own sake cup; about ¥7,000–8,000 a head.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨はじめ、港区六本木6-1-5 グッドワークビル1F、.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Sushi Hajime, Roppongi 6-1-5, グッドワークビル 1F, about 1 min from Roppongi Stn exit 3 (Hibiya and Oedo lines); Mon–Thu, Sun and holidays 18:00–01:00 (L.O. 0:30); Fri–Sat 18:00–03:00 (L.O. 2:30); 10% late-night charge after 22:00; 8 seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; English menu and English-speaking staff; opened 8 August 2024. Courses: 10 nigiri (with sea urchin), 2 small dishes and miso soup ¥7,700; with 90-minute all-you-can-drink sake and wine ¥11,000; with 60-minute all-you-can-drink without sake ¥9,900. Reviews (July–October 2026): a young chef from Saga, formerly of Sushi Ryuta in Roppongi; a ground floor facing Imoaraisaka; an 8-seat L-shaped counter with no kitchen; rice seasoned with a blend of rice vinegar and red vinegar; thick-cut toppings; natural hon-maguro from Shiogama; kasugo-dai (young sea bream); three sweet shrimp; sea-urchin gunkan; the Hajime roll; extra sardine ¥600, tekka maki ¥1,100; about half the guests from overseas.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨処 おりた、寿司・海鮮、大阪市北区堂島1-4-26.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sushi Dokoro Orita, sushi and seafood, 玉家ビル 3F, 1-4-26 堂島, Kita-ku, Osaka; 7 min from Kitashinchi Station; 10 min from Yodoyabashi Station; 5 min from Oebashi Station; Mon–Fri 17:00–3:00; Sat 17:00–23:00; closed Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; service charge 5%; cards and d Barai accepted; 10 counter seats; non-smoking; English menu; children welcome; takeout; opened 13 December 2023; seasonal fresh fish on red-vinegar rice; small dishes of Kansai dashi culture; local sake; a hinoki counter; 17-dish course ¥12,000; 16-dish special course ¥18,000. Invoice registration: an individual, 折田友吾. Reviews (September 2025–October 2026): open late; Uber Eats too; live shrimp from the tank; a salt-sprinkling performance; mentaiko with green chilli; a fugu starter; white fish; squid; akami; sea urchin in seawater; simmered anago; toro-taku; matsutake dobin-mushi; a milk pudding that wobbles; a cheerful head chef and staff; red-vinegar rice; a comment that the tuna and uni were ordinary for the price.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨割烹3、港区六本木3-8-7 チトセビル1F、日比谷.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sushi Kappou 3, Roppongi 3-8-7, チトセビル 1F, 5 min walk from Roppongi Station (Hibiya line), 7 min (Oedo line); daily 17:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:00, drinks L.O. 22:30); closed New Year, Obon and Golden Week, plus irregular closures; 10% service charge; 14 seats (counter 8, 2 private rooms for 4 and 6); private room charge ¥6,000 (3 or more); non-smoking; cards accepted; smart casual; registration number T7010401152275 (the same as 三宅輝). Shop text: sushi kaiseki comparing aged and live fish, with a choice of three 三宅輝 specialities. Courses: omakase (4 seasonal dishes and 13 nigiri) ¥8,800; Three course, 20 dishes, ¥15,400; with all-you-can-drink ¥18,800. Reviews (September–October 2026): Akkeshi oysters, abalone grilled with butter, Yamagata beef sukiyaki or shabu-shabu, crab chawanmushi, duck with orange, red-vinegar rice, choosing by QR code, a sister shop of 三宅輝, the rice reduced on request.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨和食 紅炉庵 なんば (旧店名 料理屋 紅炉庵)、和.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Sushi Washoku Kouroan Nanba (former name 料理屋 紅炉庵), Japanese cuisine, sushi and izakaya, ZAナンバビル 1F, Namba 4-3-21, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 1 min walk from Namba Station exit 12, Mon–Sat 11:30–15:30 and 17:00–23:00, Sun and holidays 11:30–15:30 and 17:00–22:30, closed over New Year, seat-only bookings have a 2-hour limit, a ¥600 cover charge and no allergy accommodation, cards and PayPay accepted, 42 seats (10 counter, seven tables for 4), a private room for 6, non-smoking, opened 30 June 2022. Edomae sushi, seasonal tempura, modern Japanese cuisine, three sake sommeliers, about 12 sakes, a four-sake all-you-can-drink, a Yoshino cedar highball, a nine-dish sushi and washoku course ¥6,000 before tax, in winter snow crab, winter yellowtail, milt, fugu and raw oysters. Run by Operation Factory (opefac.com). Reviews (September–October 2026): Hanakago lunch ¥2,790 on weekdays, triple-main lunch ¥2,390 on weekdays and ¥2,990 at weekends and holidays, salmon-roe and avocado monaka ¥200, yellowtail shabu-shabu in golden dashi, kamameshi, full even on weekdays, lunch bookings for two or more, a view that you pay for the atmosphere, and a report of slightly fishy sushi.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨結う紬、港区六本木4-5-11 ランド六本木ビルB1.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sushi Yuu Tsumugi, Roppongi 4-5-11, ランド六本木ビル B1F, 3 min walk from Roppongi Station exit 6 (Oedo line), 4 min from exit 4a (Hibiya line); Mon, Thu, Fri 17:30–19:30 and 20:00–22:00; Sat, Sun and holidays also 12:00–14:00; closed Tue and Wed (8 days off a month, plus other closures); fully reserved time slots; no service or cover charge; 14 seats (counter 10, 1 private room); non-smoking; cards accepted. Shop text: Edomae sushi by Kazuki Tahara, who trained at "Sushi Zai" and the Michelin-starred "Sushi Yu"; from 3 September 2026 a counter omakase (6 small dishes, 12 nigiri, 1 roll) ¥16,500, ¥19,800 with all-you-can-drink. Reviews (August–October 2026): abalone with liver sauce; a crab, sea urchin and caviar hand roll; the "pudding roll" of monkfish liver, cucumber and nara-zuke; small red-vinegar rice; hata aged one week; Boston tuna; eel rice bowl; free corkage; said to be produced by Sushi Yuu.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鯛之鯛 難波店、居酒屋・海鮮・炉端焼き、大阪市中央区心.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Tai no Tai Nanba ten, izakaya, seafood, robatayaki; アクロスビル B1F, 2-6-14 Shinsaibashi-suji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Namba Stn, 6 from Shinsaibashi Stn; Mon–Fri 17:00–23:30, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:30 (food L.O. 22:30, drinks L.O. 23:00); reservations accepted (cancel at least 3 days ahead; two-hour limit at all tables); cards, e-money and QR accepted; 80 seats; semi-private rooms divided by noren; heated tobacco allowed; opened 14 April 2023. Shop introduction (English translation): a popular shop relocated from elsewhere in Namba; fish and aged fish bought by staff who visit Amakusa, Akashi, Kochi and elsewhere; a space like an izakaya abroad; own-brand ikura shipped from Hokkaido; daytime drinking at weekends; sashimi platter ¥1,099; regional sake from ¥499; the manager's course ¥7,500 (ending with ikura and uni clay-pot rice); all-you-can-drink +¥1,500. Reviews (May 2025–October 2026): sashimi eaten with salt, aged white fish, sesame kanpachi, a small dish of mentaiko with sesame oil and green onion, a salad of Kajitani Farm leafy greens, snow crab and crab-miso cream croquettes, simmered fish, conger eel tempura, salmon and avocado poke, fried monkfish, tai-meshi, an ikura bowl finished with broth; a high-ceilinged basement; a counter round the central kitchen; lively; weak signal, so order over Wi-Fi; friendly staff.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鳥乃壱 上野本店、東上野2-15-9、JR上野駅から徒.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Tori no Ichi Ueno Honten, Higashi-Ueno 2-15-9, 5 min on foot from JR Ueno Station, 250 m from Keisei Ueno Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 16:00–23:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 16:00–23:00; open all year; table charge; 130 seats; private rooms for 2 to over 30; tatami room; sunken kotatsu seating; separate smoking area; cards, e-money and QR accepted; children welcome; opened 10 November 2023; a former French chef uses brand chickens from across Japan; courses: today's brand chicken with kamameshi ¥4,980, aged-soup mizutaki ¥5,980, premium ¥10,000, omakase with all-you-can-drink ¥7,000. Reviews (August–October 2026): weekday lunch yakitori bowl ¥1,000 (with chicken soup, pickles, cold tofu and a soft drink; grilled after ordering); a quiet spot a block in from Ameyoko; jidori thigh, wings, eggplant; a tasting of two brand chickens; shaliapin; offal and green onion ajillo; fried Aomori nagaimo; heard that a shop would open at Shinjuku West Exit (2025); à la carte all-you-can-drink ¥1,980; jidori sashimi, white liver, seared thigh (Hyuganatsu ponzu); chawanmushi as the starter; limited three-kind chicken sashimi; yukhoe; wing kara-age; jidori oyakodon; sweet Kyushu soy sauce; zosui.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鳥刺し酒場 スタンドくーま君R25、立ち飲み、大阪市北.en: Tabelog (shop member): Torisashi Sakaba Stand Kuma Kun R25, standing bar, 曽根崎2-7-12, 1F of 松浦レジャービル, Kita-ku, Osaka; on the Ohatsu Tenjin shopping street; 2 min on foot from exits 4, 6 and 7 of Higashi-Umeda Station; Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 16:00–23:00; Saturdays and holidays 14:00–23:00; Sundays 14:00–22:00; closed Wednesdays; closes when the chicken sashimi sells out; reservations accepted; starter charge ¥330; seats given away after 10 minutes' delay; cards, e-money and QR accepted; about 18 standing places; non-smoking; takeaway; Uber Eats; opened 1 October 2025; 'Satsuma Kiwami Sashi-dori' developed with local poultry farmers; signatures toro-momo tataki and kinu-mune sashimi. Reviews (August–October 2026): toro-momo tataki ¥1,078 (seared with a burner); kinu-mune sashimi ¥1,078; mature-hen thigh sashimi ¥528; liver sashimi; shirokawa ¥659; wing sashimi; limited cubed sashimi; lightly pickled cabbage; grated daikon; fried thigh ¥198 each; fries with truffle cream; egg onigiri ¥528; sea urchin and grated yam rice ¥549; marinated chicken bowl ¥748; chicken-bone and clam soup; Kuma Kun highball; yuzu-sansho sour; one hour of all-you-can-drink ¥980; ordering by QR code; a standing bar born from Kuma no Yakitori; a regular on a sixteenth visit; one diner found the value ordinary.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鳥匠 光ノ鳥、焼き鳥・居酒屋・釜飯、大阪市北区曽根崎2.en: Tabelog (shop member): Torisho Kohnotori, yakitori, izakaya and kamameshi, 曽根崎2-10-26, 1F of ステージ曽根崎, Kita-ku, Osaka; 3 min on foot from exit 4 of Higashi-Umeda Station; daily 16:00–24:00 (last order food 23:00, drinks 23:30); lunch from 11:00 (no skewers or grilled dishes); reservations accepted; whole-shop hire from 20 people; no service charge; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 20 table seats; smoking allowed; photo menu in English, Chinese and Korean; opened 1 May 2025; dishes of morning-slaughtered chicken; yakitori, fried chicken, sashimi, oyakodon, yakitori bowl; skewers from one; sake and wine from dry to sweet; Manpuku course ¥4,000; course with all-you-can-drink ¥5,000. Reviews (May–September 2026): skewers ¥308 each (heart, upper thigh, neck, breast, skin); bonjiri; tenderloin; tsukune with egg yolk; white leek; onion; four-kind chicken sashimi (sweet soy, sesame oil, salt); liver sashimi; thigh tataki with ponzu; grilled thigh with salsa; gizzard with chive kimchi; chicken-breast tempura; chicken nanban; Caesar salad; Kohnotori potato salad ¥528; Unzen ham; yakitori bowl; grilled rice balls; a white interior; at the end of the street from Ohatsu Tenjin to Shin-Midosuji.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鳥四季 上野駅前店、上野7-2-5 ニューウエノ 2F.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Tori Shiki Ueno Ekimae, Ueno 7-2-5, ニューウエノ 2F, 1 min on foot from the JR Ueno Station Asakusa exit (separate from the hotel entrance); Mon–Fri and the day before a holiday 16:00–23:30, Sat and Sun 14:00–23:30, holidays 14:00–23:00; no regular closing day (except building closure days); 2-hour limit when busy; 130 seats; private rooms for 2 to over 30 (with doors but not fully sealed); separate smoking area; cards and PayPay accepted; English, Chinese and Korean menus with photos; DAZN and horse-racing broadcasts; run by Japanese owners; opened 1 September 2018; charcoal-grilled jidori yakitori and fish direct from producers; low-temperature cooking; hot pots; banquet courses with all-you-can-drink from ¥3,500; the phone number is the same as Oden to Meshi Hanamidou's. Reviews (May–October 2026): many repeat visitors; close to the station; large portions; fast service; smoking allowed in private rooms; yakitori, sashimi, basashi, dashimaki tamago, tongue carpaccio, fried dishes; one diner could hear neighbouring voices even in a private room.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鳥義士、港区六本木6-2-35 ROPPONGI662.en: Tabelog (shop member): Tori Gishi, Roppongi 6-2-35, ROPPONGI662 2F, 30 seconds from Roppongi Station exit 3 (Hibiya line); Mon–Sat and days before and after holidays 18:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); closed Sundays and holidays; 5% service charge; 20 seats (counter 12, private room 8); smoking area for heated tobacco only; cards, e-money and QR accepted. Shop text: the speciality tsukune with rich egg yolk. Courses: jidori tasting course with 2.5 hours of drinks ¥9,300; food only ¥8,000. Reviews (August–September 2026): reopened 17 November 2025; charcoal-grilled jidori; appetizers (grated daikon with quail egg, pickles); salad; seven skewers; mini oyakodon; homemade collagen chicken soup; salted vanilla ice cream; the liver is praised; good value for Roppongi.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鳥魚 宗右衛門町店、居酒屋・海鮮・焼き鳥、大阪市中央区.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): Toriuo Souemonchou ten, izakaya, seafood, yakitori; 喜八ビル 4F, 2-3-12 Shinsaibashi-suji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba Stn, 5 from Shinsaibashi Stn; daily 18:00–24:00 (food L.O. 23:00, drinks 23:30); earlier hours by reservation; reservations accepted; ¥1,000 (service charge and a three-dish starter), plus 10% over New Year; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 36 seats; semi-private rooms; sunken seating (up to 12); smoking allowed; weekday course of 7 dishes with 90 minutes of drinks ¥5,000. Shop introduction (English translation): 15 years in business; sashimi of morning-slaughtered chicken; binchotan yakitori; creative chicken dishes; daily sashimi from the market; sake. Reviews (January 2024–July 2026): chicken sashimi platter, liver sashimi, raw tsukune wrapped in nori, Bakudan tsukune, a grilled-chicken platter in a bento box, yakitori rice bowl, thick-cut sashimi, grilled fish, grilled milt, giant clam, crab-miso gratin, tempura, kushikatsu, takoyaki, potato salad, homemade tofu as the starter, hot pot in winter; no chicken sashimi on market holidays; smoking at every seat; friendly staff.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鴨の助、そば・居酒屋・親子丼、四谷1-10 第二上野ビ.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kamo Nosuke, soba, izakaya, oyakodon; 第二上野ビル 1F, Yotsuya 1-10; 3 min walk from the Akasaka exit of JR Yotsuya Station and subway Exit 2; Mon–Fri 11:15–14:30 and 17:30–22:00, Sat–Sun the same (dinner last order 21:00), holidays lunch only; temporary closures on Instagram; oyakodon diners have a one-hour limit; no-shows are refused future bookings; ¥500 appetizer charge at night; 16 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; cards and e-money accepted, no QR; menus in English, Chinese and Korean; opened 26 March 2022; 'Oyakodon is a drink'; a 26 cm extra-large oyakodon for 5–6 people ¥5,000; a branch in Asakusabashi. Reviews (June 2025–October 2026): oyakodon ¥1,680, duck seiro ¥1,680, lemon, jalapeño vinegar, black shichimi, black pepper, a sign-up sheet outside, a 30-minute wait at weekend lunch, a duck-and-sake izakaya at night, roast duck loin, duck nanban soba.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鶏と○○、時々 魚。、居酒屋・焼き鳥・鍋、大阪市北区兎.en: Tabelog (shop member): Tori to Marumaru, Tokidoki Sakana., izakaya, yakitori and hotpot, 15-18 兎我野町, Kita-ku, Osaka; 5 min on foot from Higashi-Umeda Station; daily 12:00–1:00; reservation only; a tax-exempt business that cannot issue invoices; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 12 seats (counter 6, table 6); a private room for 6; private hire up to 20; designated smoking area; opened 9 June 2021; chicken dishes of Tokushima's Awaodori chicken and seasonal fresh fish; creative Japanese courses; a 14-dish yakitori course ¥4,400; a course with 90 minutes of drinks ¥5,000 (sweet-simmered chicken liver, sesame yellowtail, Awaodori thigh skewers, breast wrapped in skin, cucumber with Kaneyama miso, dish of the day, tsukune, the day's finish); a course with two hours of drinks ¥6,000. Reviews (October 2023–April 2026): run by the owner alone; a fully private room upstairs; bonito tataki; chicken wings; saikyo-grilled fish; sea bream chazuke; oyakodon to finish; a ¥3,500 yakitori lunch course; fish can be requested in advance; smoking was possible upstairs; steep stairs right inside the room's door.

食べログ (店舗会員): 鶏豚笑店～さっさ～、焼き鳥・鍋・居酒屋、大阪市北区堂山.en: Tabelog (shop member): Toributa Shoten Sassa, yakitori, hotpot and izakaya, H&I堂山ビル 1F, 10-17-1 堂山町, Kita-ku, Osaka; 6 min from Hankyu and Midosuji Line Umeda stations; 8 min from JR Osaka Station; 5 min from Nakazakicho Station; 7 min from Ogimachi Station; daily except Wednesday 18:00–1:00 (last order food 23:00, drinks 24:00); closed Wednesdays (open on holidays and the day before); reservations accepted; phone bookings may be seated at a table; cards and PayPay accepted; 17 seats (counter of 7, tables); smoking allowed; morning-fresh chicken prepared by the owner; Yoshiju pork and pork tongue; Imakiyaki tableware; courses from ¥2,500; Adult Sassa course with two hours of drinks ¥5,500. Reviews (August 2023–September 2026): even the starter is chicken; chicken sashimi platter; liver; tsukune with egg yolk; seseri; stuffed green peppers; breast with yuzu pepper; pork skewers; a chicken rice bowl to finish; simmered wings; sweet-spicy kara-age; chicken kamameshi; cream puff; at the back of Higashi-dori; a quiet hideaway; smoking allowed; a comment that with two staff the first drinks were slow.

食べログ (店舗会員): 黒毛和牛とタンとハラミ 焼肉ごりちゃん 心斎橋店、焼肉.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kuroge Wagyu to Tan to Harami Yakiniku Gorichan Shinsaibashi branch; yakiniku, horumon, Korean; Shinsaibashisuji 1-3-13, 茶茶心斎橋ビル 2F; 4 minutes' walk from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 17:00–7:00 (L.O. food 6:00, drinks 6:30); open all year; reservations taken 11:00–8:00; lunch ended on 27 June 2026; closed 29 June–15 July; reopened 16 July at 17:00; bookings cancelled automatically 15 minutes after the time; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; 50 seats; smoking allowed; Wi-Fi; power outlets; wheelchair accessible; BYO allowed; English and Korean menus and staff; opened 10 October 2023; the best-value yakiniku in Osaka; Gori Mori set; Gorichan's Forest; Kakigori-chan, only at Shinsaibashi. Reviews (July–November 2026): tongue, tsurami, heart, premium mino; Gorichan's Forest with green onion, shiso and sudachi; thick-cut tongue; salted tongue ¥1,600 a portion (previously ¥1,200); outside skirt; heart sashimi; omasum sashimi; salted fresh liver; Ultimate Horumon; sirloin truffle sukiyaki; liver and chives in garlic butter; tororo cold noodles; a lively owner; missed orders; some found the loin fatty.

食べログ (店舗会員): 黒毛和牛一頭買い焼肉 道頓堀みつる 総本店、焼肉・ステ.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Kuroge Wagyu Ittogai Yakiniku Dotonbori Mitsuru Sohonten, yakiniku, steak and izakaya, 柴田ビル 2F, Dotonbori 1-5-8, Chuo-ku, Osaka; on the Dotonbori river; 5 minutes from Namba Station exit 14; daily 11:00–1:00; irregular closures; reservations accepted; appetiser ¥385; a late-night charge of 15% of the food and drink bill for arrivals after 22:00; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 193 seats; private rooms (2 to over 30); non-smoking; renovated and reopened as the main shop on 1 August 2025, with meat carried to the table on a lane; whole-cow kuroge wagyu; sister shop in Uehommachi. Reviews (August–October 2026): special thick-cut liver ¥1,429, tongue sashimi ¥1,099, special wagyu tongue ¥1,759, skirt ¥989, negi-maki tongue, hon-misuji shabu-yaki, kuri, haneshita, kainomi, shinshin, meat sushi, tororo yukke bowl, tablet ordering, many foreign guests and staff, one reviewer found the tongue tough.

食べログ (店舗会員): 黒毛和牛焼肉 肉處 きっしゃん なんば店、焼肉・すき焼.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained): Kuroge Wagyu Yakiniku Nikudokoro Kisshan Namba, yakiniku, sukiyaki and shabu-shabu, Namba Dining Maison 8F (Takashimaya), Namba 5-1-18, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 minutes from Nankai Namba Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:30 (L.O. 15:00) and 17:00–23:00, Sat–Sun 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:00, drinks L.O. 22:30); closed when Takashimaya closes; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 51 seats (tables); private rooms for 2–24; non-smoking; smokeless roasters; children welcome; opened 2 March 2010. Founded 1995 and backed by a butcher in Osaka for 50 years; A5 kuroge wagyu (mostly female) from around Japan; Kisshan course ¥5,800, Takumi course ¥7,200; lunch of a 100% wagyu hamburger and yakiniku lunches. Reviews (July–October 2026): 150 g kuroge wagyu and skirt lunch, cold noodles and stone-grilled bibimbap half-and-half ¥1,680, horumon and lean-meat lunch, salted tongue, kalbi, skirt, maruchou, a basket and cloth for bags, a reviewer found service slow on a sukiyaki course when the room was full.

食べログ (店舗会員): 黒毛和牛焼肉善 難波心斎橋店、焼肉・しゃぶしゃぶ・すき.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained listing): ZEN Nanba Shinsaibashi (Kuroge Wagyu), yakiniku, shabu-shabu, sukiyaki; 戎橋Northビル 3F, 2-3-15 Shinsaibashi-suji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba Stn; Mon–Fri 17:00–1:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–1:00 (L.O. 24:00); reservations accepted; ¥330 starter for à la carte only; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 90 seats (all private rooms); non-smoking; children welcome; English menu; opened 1 September 2023. Shop introduction (English translation): A4-or-better black wagyu bought whole; all-you-can-eat yakiniku, sukiyaki and shabu-shabu; courses from ¥4,180; all-you-can-drink from ¥1,650; children ¥550 and ¥2,035. Reviews (July 2025–October 2026): sukiyaki course ¥5,830; yakiniku with drinks ¥5,500; salad, kimchi, dessert; no rice refills; beef tongue; outside skirt; ordering by phone; orders not put through or wrong drinks served; meat felt heavy or average; a coupon's '¥500 all-you-can-drink' turned out to mean ¥500 off; praise for the English-speaking manager and staff; many travellers.

食べログ (店舗会員): 龍旗信LEO、ラーメン・餃子・からあげ、大阪市淀川区西.en: Tabelog (shop member): Ryukishin LEO; ramen, gyoza, kara-age; 5-16-1 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, Arde Shin-Osaka on the 2nd floor of JR Shin-Osaka Station; daily 10:00–22:30; no cards or e-money, PayPay and Rakuten Pay accepted; 33 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome; opened 28 April 2017. Reviews (July 2024 to October 2026): ticket machine at the entrance; a shio ramen specialist born in Osaka; a broth of chicken bones, whole chickens, kombu and dried shiitake with a salt tare full of the umami of natural mussels; a clear golden broth; chicken shio ramen ¥1,350; chicken chashu; a lemon or citrus aroma; shio tonkotsu; tonkotsu ramen ¥1,250; cold seafood ramen ¥1,300; garlic-heavy tsukemen; medium-thick straight noodles; chewy; saltiness just right; some say too much chicken fat; quick food; some say it was better in the days of the Sakai main shop; staff from abroad.

食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): Anngon、ベトナム料理・アジア・エスニック.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): Anngon; Vietnamese, Asian, ethnic, izakaya; Minami-Semba 4-11-24, エミービル 2F; 4 min on foot from Yotsubashi Station exit 2; 2 min from Shinsaibashi Station north exit 12; lunch 11:00–16:00 (L.O. 15:00, no reservations); dinner Sun–Thu 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00), Fri–Sat 18:00–22:30 (L.O. 21:30); closed every Monday in October and November 2026 (open 2 and 23 November, closed 4 and 24 November instead); cards, e-money and QR accepted; 40 seats (tables); non-smoking; Wi-Fi; opened 12 April 1998. Shop text: authentic Vietnamese cooking by the Vietnamese chef Tam; local ingredients and traditional methods; Vietnamese fermented seasonings; every decoration from Vietnam; a space like a garden restaurant on the Mekong; fresh spring rolls, pho, street food. Courses (tax included): Vietnam course ¥3,500 (11 dishes), Anngon course ¥5,000 (13 dishes), all-you-can-drink can be added. Reviews (September–October 2026): pho and rice set ¥1,300 (nine kinds of pho, two kinds of rice, pickles and a sweet); Kakuni set meal ¥1,300; healthy lunch set ¥1,950 (fresh and fried spring rolls, chicken pho, green-papaya salad with shrimp crackers, coconut chè); pho of beef shank or braised beef tendon; bún bò Huế; mixed noodles; shrimp-salt rice; free coriander refills; shrimp and pork fresh spring rolls; stir-fried pork tongue; duck hot pot with taro and pork belly; goat; lotus tea; lychee-yogurt juice; draft beer ¥620; ordering by QR code; a narrow staircase; one view that it is tuned to Japanese tastes; one complaint that the soup was cleared too soon; 28 years in business; Uber Eats.

食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): CENTRE M (サントル エム)、イタリア.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): CENTRE M; Italian, pasta, café; Nishi-Shinsaibashi 2-2-4, Tokyu Stay Mercure Osaka Namba 2F; 5 min on foot from Namba Station exit 25; 7 min from Shinsaibashi Station exit 7; lunch from 11:30 (L.O. 14:00 on weekdays, 13:30 at weekends and holidays); afternoon tea and café 14:00–17:00 (L.O. 15:00); dinner 18:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); evening tea 18:00–21:00; closed briefly at 17:00; open all year; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; 70 seats; non-smoking (smoking area on the same floor); Wi-Fi; wheelchair accessible; opened 1 December 2022. Courses (tax included): weekday lunch from ¥2,900 (12 fresh pastas with noodles delivered every morning from Awaji Island, a buffet of the baker's breads and six deli salads, unlimited soft drinks); a 6-dish course ¥5,500; an anniversary course with the pastry chef's whole cake ¥7,000. Reviews (June–November 2026): fermented-butter croissants; pumpkin fettuccine with porcini cream; squid-ink pasta with sardines; autumn afternoon tea ¥6,000 (Shine Muscat and chestnut Mont Blanc, 12 items, mini parfait, free-flow tea); parfaits ¥2,500; at dinner starters, meat, pasta and salmon meunière, and a surprise cake; the ground-floor lobby full of overseas guests; smiling staff; a short queue at the buffet when busy.

食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): International Brasserie.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): International Brasserie Kunsei (formerly Innovative French KUNSEI); French, creative, yoshoku; Nambanaka 2-11-50, Centara Grand Hotel Osaka 33F; 4 min on foot from Namba Station; Mon, Thu–Sun and holidays lunch 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:00), dinner 17:30–22:30 (L.O. 21:30); wine bar 17:30–22:30; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; no children under 12; course prices include tax and service; 15% service charge; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 52 seats; private rooms (4–8 people, minimum charge); non-smoking; opened 1 July 2023. Shop text: a panorama of Osaka from the 33rd floor; modern bistro cooking of Western technique and Japan's seasonal produce; wine. Course: lunch LUMIÈRE ¥5,000 (20% off on weekdays at ¥4,000; ¥6,000 with one drink). Reviews (January 2025–October 2026): a new chef from May; classical French; butter and fresh cream; thick carpaccio; cold clam chowder with corn blancmange; chicken wrapped in beef fat with a foie-gras sauce, garam masala; potato churros; white asparagus and squid; vichyssoise or pumpkin potage with chorizo oil; salmon and lotus-root tartare; sea bream and shrimp in beurre blanc; sea bream wrapped in an herb crêpe; smoked duck with a foie-gras Madeira sauce; charcoal-grilled pork shoulder; black wagyu with wasabi sauce; smoked potatoes; smoked butter and bread; sorbet; a birthday message plate; an ¥8,000 lunch course with fish; the night view; one view that the course was slow and the service inattentive; oolong tea ¥1,400.

食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): Jon (ジョン)、韓国料理・焼肉・居酒屋、東.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): Jon, Korean, yakiniku and izakaya; Higashi-Shinsaibashi 2-3-29, Ripple Prologue 88 1F; 5 min on foot from Nipponbashi Station, 7 min from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Sat 17:00–4:00, Sundays and holidays 17:00–24:00; irregular closures; reservations accepted; smoking allowed; cards and QR (Rakuten Pay, Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted, no e-money; 48 table seats; private rooms (6, 8, 10–20 people); groups of 30–48; takeout; marked 'vegetarian options'; opened 24 May 2017; per the shop text, moved in May 2016; Asian/Ethnic WEST 100 2026. Menu (updated 21 May 2024, tax may be extra): Dak Hanmari ¥4,500 (soup of Korean ginseng, garlic, ginkgo, chestnut and herbal ingredients, finished as rice porridge), Samgyeopsal set ¥2,000 (from 2 people), Samgyetang ¥2,500, hot pots about ¥3,000, Chijimi ¥1,000–1,500, Bossam ¥2,500, Chige ¥1,000, oxtail soup ¥1,200, stone-grilled bibimbap ¥1,200, cold noodles ¥1,000, ramen ¥800. All-you-can-drink C course ¥6,600. Reviews (September–October 2026): Ttukbaegi Samgyetang ¥6,000 for 3–4 people, potato chijimi ¥1,850, free side dishes (potatoes, seaweed, daikon kimchi, greens, konjac, fish cake, black beans), thick-cut Samgyeopsal grilled on the teppan and wrapped in perilla leaves with kimchi, Sannakji, Yukgaejang, Bossam, Ganjang Gejang (not every day), come as four, one view that the Samgyeopsal is ordinary and pricey, formerly in Soemoncho, smoking allowed.
