食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): LOBBY CAFE FASCINO、カフェ・.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): LOBBY CAFE FASCINO; café, cake, buffet; Namba 5-1-18, Namba Dining Maison 7F; 5 min on foot from Namba Station; daily 10:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed when Osaka Takashimaya is closed; Christmas, New Year and Golden Week follow the weekend and holiday plan; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 100 seats; sofa seating; non-smoking; children welcome; takeout; breakfast; dessert buffet; opened 2 March 2010; a space like a hotel lounge. Reviews (November 2025–November 2026): Shine Muscat, peach and fig tarts; fig and chestnut tart; two kinds in half size; fruit tart and Mont Blanc; cheese tart; tea roll cake; strawberry shortcake; the Kahala Hotel's pancakes (Shimpancake), crêpe-like; salad lunch ¥2,500 (salad, soup, bread, drink, cake); omurice; mixed sandwich; open until 10 pm; a queue on Sunday afternoons; hotel-level prices; views that the salad was small and the cake thin; views that staff were short.

食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): Manryo Nipponbashi ten、.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): Manryo Nipponbashi ten; yakiniku, horumon, cold noodles; Nipponbashi 2-5-5; 3 min south on foot from Kintetsu Nippombashi Station exit 5, 7 min east from Namba Station exit E5; on the west side of Sakaisuji, opposite Teruteru and Tempos, near Kuromon Market; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 12:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); closed Wednesday; cancelled if 15 minutes late without contact; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 96 seats; first floor barrier-free; non-smoking; Wi-Fi; menus in English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and Korean; opened 11 January 2023. Shop text: open straight through from 12:00 to 24:00; a limited rare hamburger at lunch; the Nipponbashi-only Negi Shio Tan; all-you-can-drink ¥1,650 for 3 or more; passionate about wine. Reviews (December 2025–October 2026): whole A5 black-wagyu cattle bought; a thick iron plate; grill while rubbing on beef fat; a grilling manual; Maboroshi Karubi (sometimes sold out); premium-loin Shabu-yaki grilled 20 seconds and dipped in egg; Ichibo; premium outside skirt ¥1,850; thick-cut premium salted tongue ¥1,680; salted Tetchan ¥380; raw heart with tare; Yukhoe; thin kalbi and Tsurami eaten with grated daikon; vegetable sticks; seaweed soup with clams ¥380; free rice refills; stone-grilled bibimbap; first glass of white wine ¥100; black wagyu from Kyushu and Hyogo; diners who have also been to the Minami-Morimachi and Tenma shops; closing days differ by shop; lunch is quiet at evening prices; one view that there was no grill explanation and the service felt mechanical.

食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): Osaka Motsu-nabe PLay (.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): Osaka Motsu-nabe PLay; motsu-nabe, izakaya, grilled horumon; Shinsaibashi-suji 1-3-29, ミヤプラザ心斎橋 3F; 3 min on foot from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 17:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); on Sundays and holidays open only on days with online bookings; irregular closures; smoking allowed; table charge ¥350 (not on courses); cards, e-money and QR accepted; 23 seats (3 counter, 20 table); private hire up to 20; Wi-Fi; power outlets; English menu; takeout. Shop text: visited by celebrities and athletes; a special dashi of soy sauces chosen from around Japan; fresh, premium wagyu horumon and local vegetables; the popular 'Yubiki horumon with negi ponzu'. Reviews (January–October 2026): soy-sauce motsu-nabe and spicy motsu-nabe; a garlicky soy-sauce base; cabbage, garlic chives, bean sprouts, burdock, enoki, tofu; extra horumon and fried tofu; Yubiki horumon with negi ponzu; steamed pork; Chojyan; motsu Jigoku-yaki; honey tomatoes; champon noodles or udon to finish, then cheese risotto with grated cheese and Tabasco; course ¥6,500; autographs of PL Gakuen alumni, baseball players and comedians; smoking allowed; a regular on a 17th visit.

食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): Osaka Yakiniku Nandaimo.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): Osaka Yakiniku Nandaimon; yakiniku, Korean, izakaya; Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-8-15, 中正ビル 1F; 3 min on foot from Nagahoribashi Station, 7 min from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat 17:00–23:30; Sun and holidays 16:00–23:30 (L.O. food 22:30, drinks 23:00); closed Wednesday; reservations accepted; cancelled if 10 minutes late without contact; 2-hour limit when busy; cards, PayPay and Alipay accepted; 62 seats (8 counter, 6 tables, tatami with 4 tables for 6); smoking allowed; Wi-Fi; wheelchair accessible; opened 14 September 2019. Shop text: founded in 1964, a popular Shizuoka restaurant visited by gourmet celebrities including baseball and soccer players, now in Shinsaibashi; domestic black wagyu chosen by the owner; thick-cut beef-tongue steak limited to 10 a day. Reviews (July–October 2026): charcoal on shichirin; premium salted tongue; Negi tan shio; Tsurami; premium outside skirt; hanging-tender tendon; lean steak; loin; special ribeye; the day's recommended tenderloin and ichibo; herb salt; toro Yukhoe; raw-meat dishes; a choice of kimchi; special cold noodles; makgeolli; generous portions; pricey drinks; one view that it was too fatty; a diner who has been to other Nandaimon shops.

食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): Robata Tomotsuni Homura.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): Robata Tomotsuni Homura Nanba ten; izakaya, robatayaki, yakitori; Namba 3-4-13, 味わいばしビル 3F; 1 min on foot from Namba Station exits B15 and B17; daily 16:30–23:00; open all year; groups of 6 or more must book a course; 100% cancellation charge if 15 minutes late without contact; appetizer charge ¥550 (none with a course booking); cards, e-money and QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay and others) accepted; 80 seats; counter; private rooms for 2 to 30+; heated tobacco allowed at all seats; opened 11 March 2026. Shop text: robatayaki and yakitori focused on seasonal ingredients; handmade skewers; vegetable-wrapped skewers; slow-simmered motsuni; Japanese sake and shochu. Courses (tax included): seasonal vegetable course with all-you-can-drink ¥5,000 (7 dishes); charcoal-grill course, food only ¥6,000 (9 dishes: red-miso motsuni, today's sashimi, steamed seasonal vegetables and pork, rare ichibo skewers, clay-pot rice of minced chicken and four mushrooms), the most popular. Reviews (October–November 2026): red-miso motsuni as the appetizer; rare ichibo skewer with mustard; extra-large shrimp skewer; negima, sunagimo, seseri; chicken breast with wasabi; cartilage tsukune with egg; six-kind sashimi platter; seafood yukhoe; salmon tartare with Korean seaweed; mackerel wrapped in shiso; grilled mackerel; fried oysters; fist-sized kara-age; potato salad with soft-boiled egg; sweet potato with honey butter; a counter-only scallop carbonara spring roll; kamameshi that takes 30 minutes (mackerel and ginger; corn with butter and soy); leftovers made into onigiri to take home; staff who know Japanese sake; all-you-can-drink ¥2,500; views that it is on the pricey side; e-cigarettes allowed.

食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): Shizen to Oniku green (.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): Shizen to Oniku green (formerly Dining&Bar green); izakaya; Shinmachi 1-24-14 1F; 3 min on foot from Yotsubashi and Nishi-Ohashi Stations; daily 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30; charcoal grill, fried food and clay-pot rice 60 minutes before closing); sometimes closed for training (announced on Instagram); cancelled if 15 minutes late without contact; same-day cancellation ¥5,000 per person; appetizer charge ¥439 at dinner only; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 21 seats; dogs welcome; opened 15 September 2023. Shop text: proud of its charcoal grilling; A5 wagyu, fresh chicken, seasonal vegetables; the signature 'oyakodon you want to eat before you die'; courses with all-you-can-drink, 9 dishes ¥4,000, 11 dishes ¥5,000, 13 dishes ¥7,500. Reviews (February–November 2026): oyakodon ¥1,400 (large +¥100); runny egg over chicken; a rich dashi; lemon, pickles and dashi vinegar to change the taste; at lunch nearly only oyakodon and a full room; a kara-age set too; charcoal-grilled vegetables, chicken and beef tongue; mouthwatering chicken; fried taro; clay-pot rice with beef and burdock; Doraemon and Heidi plates; book tables ahead; a diner afraid of dogs was moved; one wish to be asked whether the oyakodon would be shared.

食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): Tonkatsu Shabushabu Ara.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): Tonkatsu Shabushabu Arata; tonkatsu, shabu-shabu, Japanese cuisine; Nipponbashi 1-19-6, W building 2F; 1 min on foot from Nipponbashi Station exit 5; daily 11:00–23:00; lunch L.O. 16:00, evening L.O. 22:00 for shabu-shabu and 22:30 for tonkatsu and drinks; please book by phone if possible (online booking fees are a burden); may be cancelled if 15 minutes late without contact; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 22 seats; non-smoking; Wi-Fi; children welcome; menus in English, Simplified Chinese and Korean; with photos; English-speaking staff; opened 9 May 2025. Shop text: a sister restaurant of the Tabelog 100 'New Babe'; tonkatsu and TOKYO X pork-belly shabu-shabu. Lunch only (tax included): Hayashi SPF rib-roast set ¥3,190; half roast and fillet ¥3,630; fried at low then high heat; eaten three ways with fig sauce, a sour curry sauce and egg soup; natural salt and mustard soy sauce too; add menchi katsu, shrimp tempura, chicken katsu or TOKYO X pork miso soup. Reviews (June 2025–October 2026): a sister of New Babe in Taniyon; Hire katsu set (small) ¥1,980; a pink cross-section; light batter; Spanish salt; cabbage or daikon salad; a choice of rice sizes; warabi mochi; ordering by QR code; self-service water; rice refills ¥220; TOKYO X shabu-shabu courses at night with ponzu, lettuce and mitsuba; English menu; one view that it was a little too red; one view that the pork was less sweet than expected.

食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): WAGYU Oukoku (Kobe Beef.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): WAGYU Oukoku (Kobe Beef wagyu House Wagyu Oukoku); yakiniku, horumon, izakaya; Shinsaibashi-suji 2-2-31; 5 min on foot from Shinsaibashi Station exit 6; Mon–Thu, Sun and holidays 11:30–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); Fri and Sat 11:30–3:00 (L.O. 2:30); open every day; 2-hour seating; bookings cancelled 15 minutes after the time; cards, e-money and QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay and others) accepted; 66 seats (17 tables); sofa seats; separate smoking space; Wi-Fi; private hire for 20–50; children welcome; menus in English, Simplified Chinese and Korean; with photos; digital menu; opened 1 December 2025. Shop text: Omi beef and Kobe beef, two of Japan's three great wagyu; a Kobe beef 'Tamatebako' opened with a smoke effect (four cuts); a platter of three Omi beef cuts; wine. Courses (tax included): Omi beef course ¥9,000, Kobe beef course ¥20,000, banquet course of 16 dishes ¥3,800 (¥5,500 with all-you-can-drink), all-you-can-drink +¥1,700. Reviews (October 2026): produced by a former Hanshin Tigers player; a display case of wagyu blocks on the ground floor; seats on the second floor; ordering by tablet; Omi beef Sudare-yaki; Matsusaka beef premium lean and premium kalbi; thick-cut tongue steak; premium salted tongue; outside skirt; horumon platter; omasum; seared Kobe beef Yukhoe; Matsusaka beef sushi; live abalone steak; large shrimp; scallops in butter; stone-grilled bibimbap; cold noodles; lunch Tamatebako ¥7,500; ¥15,620 for two; full of overseas guests on Halloween night; sake, highballs, wine.

食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): Yakiniku Kinashi、焼肉・ホルモ.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): Yakiniku Kinashi; yakiniku, horumon, izakaya; Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-19-5, ウィステリア心斎橋ビル 3F; 3 min on foot from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 17:00–2:00; same-day cancellations by phone at least 2 hours ahead; children under 12 by phone booking only; 1 hour 45 minutes when busy; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 28 seats; private hire for 20–50; smoking allowed; opened 3 March 2024. Shop text: carefully selected black wagyu at reasonable prices; a balance of fat and lean; shiny rice of a five-star rice meister's blend cooked in a clay pot; signatures thick-cut tongue and premium kalbi. Reviews (August–October 2026): special premium salted tongue, special premium outside skirt, premium loin, premium tripe, local chicken thigh, grilled raw liver, thick tongue and loin, ribeye, a platter of loin, fillet and flap, mixed horumon, heart sashimi, raw omasum, grilled Yukhoe, avocado kimchi, namul, kakuteki, mushroom namul, thick yam and roast sweet potato, green-chili dishes, Yukgaejang, cold noodles; beef fat for the grill; signatures on the walls; young staff; fast; fully booked; one order that never went through.

食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): orange、フレンチ・ワインバー・イタリアン.en: Tabelog (shop-maintained, English edition): orange; French, wine bar, Italian; Shinmachi 1-23-3, 誠和ビル 1F; 3 min on foot from Yotsubashi Station exit 2, 5 min from Shinsaibashi Station exit 3; Tue–Fri 18:00–24:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00); closed Monday (sometimes open on holidays); bookings for 2 or more; 5 or more by phone (easiest 14:00–17:00); 2½-hour seating; seat-only bookings order 1 drink and 1 dish each; same-day cancellation 100% for courses and ¥4,500 per person for seats; cards and PayPay accepted; 28 seats (4 counter, 24 table); non-smoking; opened 15 November 2005. Shop text: French food isn't just about wine; Maruefu from a Showa-era beer server poured four ways, one pour, two pours, three pours and mild; mainly French wines by the glass or bottle; all-you-can-drink plans from ¥6,500 (tax included). Reviews (July 2025–October 2026): scallop carpaccio, liver pâté in the meat appetizer plate, quiche, corn fritters, spring rolls, green bean and mushroom salad, gizzard confit with cream sauce, sea bass with cream sauce, pan-seared fish, rare-fried Norwegian salmon, duck, wagyu cheek braised in red wine, blue-cheese gratin, shrimp ajillo, three-cheese platter, a focaccia limited to 10 a day (kept for bookings), about four desserts not on the menu, peach compote, sparkling, white, orange and red wine by the glass; after a show at Orix Theater; one diner wondered whether the owner works alone; a regular who misses the two-person course.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): Fiore ~フィオーレ~、大阪市中央区心斎.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Fiore, 213bld 2F, 2-1-3 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; at the end of an alley one street back from Europe-dori; daily 18:00–1:00 (some days until 2:00; ask); irregular closing days; opened 29 April 2016; service charge ¥550 per person; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; no smoking; 14 seats (counter 6, tables 8); BYO allowed; à la carte too from 21:30; the speciality is Kawachi duck carpaccio. Reviews (March 2025 – September 2026): dinner is courses only; a bar from 21:30; squid-ink pasta; seasonal oysters; charcoal-grilled anago; hand-made squid-ink tagliolini; wagyu sirloin cap with truffle sauce; Fuji salmon; Kagoshima Kurobuta; beautiful presentation; the chef's stories are entertaining; one found the course a little pricey; budget ¥8,000–15,000.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): French Wine Bar UN、大阪市.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): French Wine Bar UN, Ikeda Kaikan Bldg 3F, 2-8-23 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Wed–Sun 17:00–3:00 next morning; closed Mondays and Tuesdays; opened 1 August 2021; charge ¥1,000 per person (with starter); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; no smoking; 16 seats; seasonal starters; roast duck breast; pâté de campagne; sharing sets; non-alcoholic grape juice served in a wine glass. Reviews (December 2025 – August 2026): 3rd floor of a building of bars and snack bars; seasonal fruit with prosciutto ¥1,210; today's carpaccio (yellowtail) ¥1,650; grilled vegetables from Nishi-ku, Kobe ¥1,650; today's gratin ¥1,320; roast beef ¥4,180 (black pepper and pumpkin sauces); squid-ink pasta ¥1,320; Basque cheesecake ¥880; crème brûlée; ¥3,000 course; sharing set from ¥6,600 for two; a wide wine list including rare labels.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): OPERA Namba、大阪市浪速区難波中1.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): OPERA Namba, Tamizu Bldg 1F, 1-4-21 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba Station; daily 17:30–23:30; irregular closing days; opened 8 October 2025; seat charge ¥300; 2-hour limit; no entry for junior-high age and under; no birthday plates; enter once everyone has arrived; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; no smoking; 17 seats (counter 10, 2 tables); 13 wines by the glass, about 30 by the bottle; pintxos and paella with seasonal Japanese ingredients. Reviews (August–October 2026): the Namba branch of OPERA in Hommachi; pintxos lined up on the counter (shiitake, shrimp and zucchini, vongole, asparagus and prosciutto, chicken, sardine in tomato sauce, shirasu and avocado); prosciutto and chorizo; cheese platter; seasonal seafood paella; grilled octopus leg; grilled marbled beef; cheese fries; bottles from ¥5,000; one says service is slow with one person working; always full.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): PALM Cafe&Creperie 堀江、.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): PALM Cafe & Creperie Horie, PAN1914 Bldg 1F, 1-9-14 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exits 4 and 6; Mon, Tue, Thu, Sun, holidays and days after holidays 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30), Wed 11:00–18:30, Fri, Sat and days before holidays 11:00–22:30; days may change; no drink-only bookings (a galette or crêpe per person); cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; no smoking inside (e-cigarettes after 17:30); smoking on the terrace; 20 seats (tables 8, counter 6, sofa 3, terrace 3); galettes of only buckwheat flour, water and salt; crêpes of French VIRON flour; banana juice; crêpes for dogs. Reviews (August–October 2026): a Nordic-style wooden interior; dogs welcome on the terrace; QR ordering; complète (ham, cheese, egg, tomato, avocado, Genovese) set ¥1,900; prosciutto galette; Échiré butter crêpe; chocolate crêpe; iced Americano ¥690; chewy batter; one found too much cream; one found drinks pricey; one couldn't find parking.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): Stand カテナッチョ (旧店名 肉寿司.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Stand Catenaccio (formerly Niku Sushi Italian Bar Kannuki Shinsaibashi), B1F, 1-19-11 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 18:00–3:00 next morning (L.O. 2:30); opened 12 July 2017; reopened after renovation as a standing bar; counter 8 and two tables for 4; private room for 5 or more; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; smoking allowed. Reviews (February–September 2026): renovated into a standing bar in September 2026; same cooks and staff as before; Japanese and Italian combined; starter platter (molokhia ohitashi, bagna càuda, chilled tofu with caviar, raisin-butter yatsuhashi); zucchini fritters in beer batter with bamboo-charcoal salt; lobster cream spring rolls with Grana Padano; duck carpaccio with balsamic; crab pasta; water aubergine; soup or ochazuke to finish; caramel pudding; meat sushi before the renovation (one says it's gone since); a small but good sake list.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): YAKINIKUEN 忍鬨 東心斎橋2号店、.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): YAKINIKUEN Ning Higashi-Shinsaibashi No. 2, APA Hotel Namba Shinsaibashi Higashi 1F, 1-7-10 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 4 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Wed, Fri–Sun and holidays 15:00–24:00, Thu 17:00–24:00 (food L.O. 23:00); irregular closing days; opened 12 April 2022; 90-minute limit; automatic cancellation at 10 minutes late; starter ¥300; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; no smoking; 20 seats (counter 12, 2 tables); children welcome; thick-cut leek-wrapped tongue; selected misuji exclusive to the No. 2 shop. Reviews (June–October 2026): a calm black-toned interior; smokeless roasters; the leek-wrapped tongue is wrapped in leek with garlic and ginger; Ning set ¥9,680 (11 cuts, 60 g each); tongue yukhoe ¥1,408; gimbap topped with yukhoe ¥1,408; yukhoe sushi; kimchi platter; gelato after the meal; one says one side of the grill didn't cook and the beer was frozen.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): mahoroba 鉄板 心斎橋、大阪市中央区.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): mahoroba Teppan Shinsaibashi, 1-7-23 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Nagahoribashi stations; daily 12:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); opened 6 April 2023; service charge; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; heated tobacco only; 16 seats (counter 6, 2 private rooms); children welcome (pushchairs to private rooms); sommelier; Kuroge wagyu; seasonal vegetables and seafood. Reviews (August–October 2026): more relaxed than expected; the chef explains ingredients and jokes; flames in front of you; steak with a choice of doneness and cut; with wasabi; ise-ebi, abalone and wagyu course about ¥24,000; lunch about ¥3,000–4,000; à la carte if there's room; a surprise anniversary cake.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): しゃぶ長、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-15-25.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Shabu Cho, 1-15-25 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon–Fri 11:30–13:30 and 17:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:00), Sat 17:30–23:00, holidays 17:30–22:00; closed Sundays; opened 1 November 1978; 16 counter seats; may direct you to another branch when full; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; children welcome (no children's chairs); English, Chinese and Korean menus; shabu-shabu and sukiyaki of A5 wagyu and premium pork; house ponzu and sesame sauce; the famous frozen sake. Reviews (April–September 2026): always a queue at lunch; hot pot for one; lunch sukiyaki from ¥1,400; 1.5× meat ¥2,000; large ¥2,400; a pot with udon, shirataki, bean sprouts, leek and onion, and thin-sliced meat on a separate plate; comes with rice, pickles, egg and oolong tea; free refills of rice and tea; the annex Shabu Cho Hanare (18 seats at an L-shaped counter, IH); one says cash only at lunch; one recommends the leaner cuts.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): カンジャンケジャン 渡 大阪心斎橋店、大阪市.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Kanjang Kejang Watari Osaka Shinsaibashi, ENT Nagahori Bldg 5F, 1-3-7 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; right by Nagahoribashi Station exit 6; daily 17:00–23:00; open every day of the year; opened 15 June 2025; all private and semi-private rooms; cards, e-money and QR accepted; heated tobacco only; 18 seats; 'luxury in the everyday'; raw blue swimming crab in shoyu, prepared Japanese-style; rare sakes. Reviews (September–October 2026): ¥6,980 course; ganjang gejang with rice, soup and namul; shoyu-marinated shrimp with lemon; japchae; jeon; nakopsae of octopus, shrimp, crab, scallop and offal; to finish, noodles with egg yolk, cheese and black pepper, or congee; shiso sorbet or ice cream; private rooms with sunken kotatsu; staff check how you're feeling before the raw crab; one found portions smaller than expected; one says an unannounced 2-hour limit meant being hurried out.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): ワインショップ&ダイナー FUJIMARU.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Wine Shop & Diner FUJIMARU Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Uehara Bldg 2F, 1-4-18 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station exit 7; 2F diner Tue–Sat and holidays 17:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:00); 1F wine shop 15:00–22:00; 1F standing bar 17:00–22:00; closed Sundays and Mondays; reservations for the 2nd floor only; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; no smoking; 18 seats (counter 6, tables 12); a group of wine shops and restaurants in Tokyo and Osaka; about 1,000 wines on the ground floor; upstairs, the long-established Portuguese restaurant Casa da Andorinha, moved from Hommachi (octopus salad, bacalhau croquettes, Alentejo style); Portuguese wine and Madeira; when full, guests are sent to the sister shop RAINDROP in Tanimachi-Yonchome. Reviews (July–September 2026): ¥5,500 course (starter platter, bacalhau croquettes, salad, Tamba chicken piri-piri, seafood cataplana, risotto to finish, freshly baked egg tart); octopus carpaccio; port wine; Minoh beer; bottles from downstairs for a corkage fee; help choosing wine; one wanted Vinho Verde; booking recommended.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 不純喫茶 アルテミス、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Fujun Kissa Artemis, Minami Bldg 2F, 2-25 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 375 m from Nippombashi Station; Mon–Fri 19:00–6:00 next morning, Sat, Sun and holidays 13:00–6:00 next morning (L.O. 5:30); open every day of the year; no reservations; cover charge ¥550; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; smoking allowed; 20 seats (counter 4, sofa seats, 2 private rooms). Reviews (February–July 2026): a Showa-retro night cafe; pudding; Macallan; terrine; banana split; pancakes and iced coffee; Napolitan topped with an omelette; zodiac fortune slips; a waiting board at the entrance on Saturday afternoons; occasional queues; quiet at 4 a.m.; one says staff asked for cash for bills under ¥5,000.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 九志焼亭 本店、大阪市中央区難波5-1-18.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Kushi Yaki Tei main shop, Takashimaya Osaka Namba Dining Maison 8F, 5-1-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Namba Station; daily 11:00–16:00 (L.O. 15:00) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closing days follow Dining Maison; reservations weekday evenings only; charge ¥300 per person; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; 20 seats (counter 6, tables 14); children welcome; opened 1 November 2017; official site; skewers of meat, fish and vegetables, seasonal creative dishes, teppanyaki. Reviews (December 2024 – July 2026): skewers grilled on the teppan and served on a plate; pork-wrapped asparagus; wagyu; salmon tartare; meat-wrapped enoki; shrimp paste; tsukune; chicken neck and asparagus; pork belly and leek; monthly limited skewers; omakase 9 skewers at lunch; Osaka-speciality course of 5 skewers, mini okonomiyaki and dashimaki; dashimaki set meal ¥1,800; seasonal 12-skewer course at night; dashimaki with grated daikon; tonpei-yaki heaped with katsuobushi; garlic rice; Amaou strawberry ice cream.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 和牛ステーキ しばらく、大阪市中央区東心斎橋.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Wagyu Steak Shibaraku, 1-4-23 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station exit 7; daily 11:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:00); irregular closing days; opened 16 December 2025; cancelled at 15 minutes late; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; no smoking; 20 seats (counter); English digital menu; children welcome; lean wagyu steak by chosen origin and cut, with rice chosen to match steak. Reviews (April–July 2026): lean 200 g ¥3,960 (incl. tax); pre-cut into bite-size pieces; tender and juicy; tasting with sirloin cap; freshly grated wasabi; comes with beef-tendon curry, kimchi and miso soup; free rice refills; good rice; many repeat visitors; one found the staff chat a bit much.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 嗜酒、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-3 GR.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): SHU SHU, GROOVE Shinsaibashi East 4F, 1-17-3 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 6; Mon–Wed, Sun and holidays 18:00–1:00 next morning (L.O. 23:00), Fri–Sat 18:00–3:30 next morning (L.O. 2:30); closed Thursdays; last-entry times apply; starter ¥550; non-alcoholic drinks for only one person per group; 2-hour limit when busy; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; 17 seats (counter 9, 2 tables); sakes that change every visit; Kagoshima chicken sashimi; seasonal ingredients; a warm wooden interior. Reviews (January–July 2026): creative small plates; taro manju of beef and burdock in nameko sauce; spring-cabbage and prosciutto croquettes; firefly squid in sweet vinegar; dried firefly squid; firefly-squid clay-pot rice; bluefin tuna and seared mackerel sashimi; fried fig; eel; horse meat; fried house curry bread (takeaway too); kasujiru; tomato chuhai; gin; cute tableware and sake cups; ordering the course when booking is good value.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 天carat、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-16-.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Ten carat, Nippo Suomachi Arden 1F, 1-16-7 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon–Sat and holidays 17:00–3:00 next morning (food L.O. 2:00), Sun 17:00–24:00; irregular closing days; opened 30 September 2023; same-day bookings until 90 minutes before closing; seat charge ¥330; cards, e-money and QR accepted; heated tobacco only; 13 counter seats; English, Chinese and Korean menus; English-speaking staff; 6 sakes. Reviews (August–October 2026): ¥4,400 course; toro-taku canapé; soft-boiled egg with shibazuke tartare; Camembert with honey; big prawn; a whole anago; autumn aubergine; Carat Roll ¥1,540 (salmon, sea bream and fish roe rolled with myoga and shiso); nikusui; juwari soba tsuke-soba; sweet-potato tempura with vanilla ice cream; sparkling sake Mio ¥1,210; served freshly fried and piping hot.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 天ぷら互生 心斎橋、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Tempura Gosei Shinsaibashi, No. 5 Ace Bldg 2F, 1-8-22 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 7 and Yotsubashi Station exit 5; daily 18:00–24:00; irregular closing days; reservations only; please avoid strong perfume or hair products; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; no smoking; 12 seats (counter 8, one table for 4); sommelier; English menu; official site. Reviews (June–October 2026): run by two people, one a sommelier; an L-shaped counter; starts with cold kuzu somen with sudachi; baby octopus; kamaage shirasu with sansho; mountain vegetables; clay-pot rice with sea urchin; Amakusa sweet-shrimp tempura (crisp heads); shiso wraps; scallop; vegetables; grated daikon; curry to finish too; an affordable wine and sake pairing; light tempura easy on the stomach; tableware by Shiga potters; budget ¥15,000–30,000.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 心斎橋の美味しい串カツ あげてんかっ！ 本店.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Shinsaibashi no Oishii Kushikatsu Agetenka! main shop, Fujieda Bldg 1F, 1-13-1 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; daily 17:00–2:00 next morning (L.O. 1:00); may direct you to a nearby group shop when full; starter ¥385; cards, e-money and QR accepted; smoking allowed; 13 seats; BYO allowed; English, Chinese and Korean menus; all-you-can-drink; a light, crisp 'saku-karai' batter; domestic wagyu; angel shrimp; house salmon tartare; frozen-lemon sour. Reviews (August–October 2026): fried in front of you; a light batter you could eat endlessly; wagyu; shrimp; kisu; Camembert; pork; onion; pickled ginger; marinated-tuna kushikatsu; oden; the owner's cheerful character; friendly staff; budget ¥4,000–8,000; one says an order didn't go through and the bill was wrong.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 月虹 (旧店名 鉄板ダイニング KAYA)、.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Gekko (formerly Teppan Dining KAYA), Minami Grand Kaikan 1F, 2-5-19 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 18:00–23:30; occasional irregular closures; opened 27 May 2017; reservations accepted; students may be refused even with a booking; children by arrangement; dress code (no sandals, sweatpants, tracksuits or work clothes); 6 counter seats and 4 table seats; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; heated tobacco only; house sauce and chewy yakisoba; A5 Saga beef fillet course; about 10 red wines. Reviews (June–October 2026): a counter around the teppan; the owner cooks in front of you; the signature Gekko-yaki (a fluffy batter of egg and cabbage with thick-cut pork); kimchi cheese ¥2,700; seafood yakisoba carbonara ¥2,500; seafood salt-grilled ¥2,000–2,400; stir-fried vegetables topped with abura-kasu ¥1,000; curry yakisoba; ikatama; stir-fried vegetables with soba; grilled asparagus; squid, salt bean sprouts and konnyaku; omelette; Kaku highball ¥750; glass of wine ¥1,000; one found it salty overall; budget ¥6,000–8,000.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 炭火焼き無限バーグ 無限、大阪市中央区難波千.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Sumibiyaki Mugen Burg Mugen, 14-3 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba Station; daily 11:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closes when the hamburg runs out; irregular closing days; weekday lunch 11:30–15:00; automatic cancellation at 15 minutes late; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; no smoking, but heavy charcoal smoke, so not recommended for high-school age and under; English-speaking staff; 18 seats (counter 10, 2 tables); all-you-can-eat charcoal-grilled hamburg, wanko-style; free refills of egg, salad, rice and condiments; all-you-can-drink. Reviews (September–October 2026): they keep coming until you show the 'I'm satisfied' card; once stopped, it can't be restarted; 30- or 60-minute courses; crisp outside, fluffy and juicy inside; bite-size; salt, wasabi, yuzu-kosho, grated-daikon ponzu, ketchup, chili oil, fiery sauce; egg on rice; one ate 20 in an hour; with two staff, gaps when busy.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 炭火焼鳥と鶏肴keshiki.、大阪市中央区.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Sumibi Yakitori to Toriate keshiki., Mikawa Bldg 1F, 1-14-19 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Nagahoribashi stations; Mon, Tue and Fri–Sun 18:00–5:00 next morning (L.O. 4:00); closed Wednesdays and Thursdays; opened 14 September 2019; 10 counter seats; bookings with Japanese mobile numbers only; some items unavailable depending on supply; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; smoking allowed; over 30 yakitori cuts including rare ones from Tamba chicken, Tokushima young chicken and Daisen Jidori; seasonings such as white-wine sauce, escargot butter and black-truffle oil; shochu and sake. Reviews (October 2025 – August 2026): the omakase is good value; vegetable skewers; garlic edamame; egg nyumen to finish; negima; tsukune; charcoal aroma; one found the duck tataki so-so; busy around 19:00, so book; good for a second stop at 1 a.m. too.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 蕎麦しゃぶ総本家 浪花そば なんばダイニング.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Soba Shabu Sohonke Naniwa Soba Namba Dining Maison, Namba Dining Maison 7F, 5-1-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Namba Station; Sun–Thu 11:00–21:30 (L.O. 21:00), Fri–Sat 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); hot-pot orders close earlier; open every day of the year; opened 2 March 2010; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; 18 seats; children welcome (kids' menu of soba and inari); house soba and dashi; the trademarked 'soba shabu'; courses from ¥5,000, with all-you-can-drink from ¥6,500. Reviews (September–October 2026): a chain of 4 shops in Osaka; meat tsuke-soba (chili oil) ¥1,300; thin with soba-yu at the end to drink as soup; cold sudachi soba ¥1,280; large ¥220; tempura set ¥500; ume tororo ¥1,080; fried aubergine and grated-daikon soba ¥1,050; inari ¥800; pressed shrimp sushi; oyakodon set; chicken-nanban soba; a gentle Kansai dashi; colourful chairs.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 鉄板dining 葉 -you-、大阪市中央.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Teppan Dining Yo, Nippo Bamboo Alley Bldg 1F, 1-9-20 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; opposite J Hotel; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 7; daily 18:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00); some days closes early; bookings 17:30–23:00; opened 5 December 2022; 18 seats (counter 8, tables 10); cards, e-money and QR accepted; smoking allowed; all-you-can-drink; listed as able to cater for vegans and vegetarians; teppan-grilled Chinese yam; negiyaki; shochu, wine and sake. Reviews (May 2023 – October 2026): a clean shop with a wooden interior; message cards on the tables; sweets on leaving; modan okonomiyaki of pork, oyster or mixed; Hiroshima style; teppan Chinese yam; cheese tonpei-yaki; salt sobameshi; shrimp mayo; shrimp toast; salt offal; gizzard; thick-cut beef tongue; oysters; tomato; English menu; one didn't care for the sauce; one person in the kitchen, so service is a little slow; reasonable prices.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 鉄板工房 Panyo、大阪市中央区道頓堀2-.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Teppan Kobo Panyo, Chiyonoya Bldg 1F, 2-4-10 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Namba Station exit 25; daily 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:00) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 20:30); reservations accepted; discuss allergies and preferences in advance; 12 seats (7 counter seats, 1 semi-private room); private-room fee ¥500 per person at lunch, ¥3,000 per room at dinner; cards and e-money accepted, no QR; budget dinner ¥8,000–9,999, lunch ¥3,000–3,999; wagyu, live shrimp, live abalone, selected wagyu or Matsusaka steak; Panyo Dinner (seared meat sushi, Panyo burger, domestic fillet steak; 9 dishes). Reviews (December 2025 – August 2026): a counter facing the teppan and a private room at the back; the Dotonbori River visible from the private room; seasonal grilled vegetables (turnip, pumpkin, leek); domestic beef fillet 80 g with salt, garlic and wasabi; Panyo-style garlic rice (+¥880, with chicken soup) or curry; meat upgraded to 100 g on the lunch course; fireworks and a message on a celebration dessert; on request, the meat sushi was cooked through properly.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 鉄板焼 神戸 ホテルモントレ グラスミア大阪.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Teppanyaki Kobe, Hotel Monterey Grasmere Osaka 22F, 1-2-3 Minatomachi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from JR Namba Station, connected to subway Namba Station; Wed–Mon and holidays 11:30–14:30 (food L.O. 13:30) and 17:30–22:00 (food L.O. 20:00); closed Tuesdays; course prices include tax and service; cannot cater for Rosaceae allergies; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; two counters of 6; special courses such as Yonezawa beef every two months. Reviews (June–October 2026): big 22nd-floor windows looking out to Kyocera Dome, Kobe, Rokko and the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge; lunch course; A5 beef steak lunch; at night the Maya and Rokko courses; live abalone with liver sauce; ise-ebi; scallop and shrimp; 4 seasonal vegetables; Kuroge wagyu sirloin cap, rib roast and fillet; 2 sauces and 3 salts; garlic rice or black curry (+¥500); red miso soup; dessert; one says lunch prices rose and the 80 g steak felt small; conversation with the chef.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 鉄板焼き 銀ひかり、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Teppanyaki Gin Hikari, Arashi Hotel 2F, 1-16-5 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:30); closed Thursdays; lunch by reservation the day before, currently suspended; 10% service charge at dinner only; cards, e-money and QR accepted; smoking allowed; 14 seats (counter 8, tables 6); BYO allowed; English and Chinese menus; seasonal seafood, A5 wagyu, Kyoto vegetables, ise-ebi and abalone courses. Reviews (July–September 2026): omakase courses ¥6,600 and ¥8,800; 5 seasonal starters (including fugu-skin jelly); 3 kinds of sashimi; a simmered dish or soup; flounder meunière on the teppan; wagyu steak flambéed in front of you, with wasabi and rock salt; garlic rice and miso soup; fruit or parfait; one says it's more affordable than before.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 隠 鳥魚、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-1-13.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Kakure Toriuo, Nippo Jumbo Bldg 1F No. 5–6, 2-1-13 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Namba stations; Mon–Sat 17:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); closed Sundays; opened 9 April 2018; reservations only; all private rooms (3 sunken-kotatsu rooms, 2 counter rooms); 16 seats; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; heated tobacco only; all-you-can-drink available; an unsigned hideaway; a course of small plates of fish from producers and seasonal vegetables. Reviews (October 2025 – October 2026): the entrance is hard to find; look for the red sign on the Yawata-suji side; a course of many small dishes; fresh fish; chicken dishes; konnyaku and fish roe; good with sake; two wanted a bit more food; budget ¥10,000–20,000.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 韓国料理コモネ、大阪市中央区千日前1-6-8.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Korean Komone, Matoba Bldg B1F, 1-6-8 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Namba and Nippombashi stations; 16:00–2:00 next morning (L.O. 1:00); closed Wednesdays; reopened 29 February 2024; reservations accepted; 16 seats; counter; smoking allowed; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; English and Korean menus; ganjang gejang; ebi kanjang; samgyetang; samgyeopsal; sundubu; nakopsae (for 2, by reservation); Korean drinks (bokbunja, raw makgeolli). Reviews (January 2025 – September 2026): run by two people; ganjang gejang large ¥5,500, small ¥2,700; ganjang saeu large ¥4,050, small ¥2,430; tofu and kimchi jjigae ¥1,200; cheese jeon ¥1,800; rice cake ¥1,300; chadolbagi ¥5,300; samgyetang ¥3,800; pig's trotters ¥1,500; makgeolli ¥1,700 a bottle; bottle keep; yangnyeom gejang comes with gloves; nearly full even at 23:30; one found it ordinary and a little pricey but with good service; one felt as reassured as coming home.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 鮨 けやき 心斎橋、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Sushi Keyaki Shinsaibashi, Bamboo Alley 2F, 1-9-20 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Yotsubashi stations; Tue 17:30–22:00, Wed–Sun and holidays 12:00–14:30 and 17:30–22:00 (food L.O. 14:00 and 21:30); closed Mondays; opened 29 November 2014; 8 counter seats; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, Diners) accepted, no e-money or QR; no smoking; fish bought every morning; sake, shochu and wine; official site. Reviews (October 2020 – April 2026): omakase course ¥20,000 (starter, 3 seasonal fish, grilled fish, a dish, chawanmushi, 10 nigiri, miso soup, seasonal fruit); premium sushi course ¥12,000; 3 tiers of dinner course; the lunch course is good value; each piece seasoned with salt, citrus or ume rather than shoyu; salt-crust tuna; kohada; bonito with salt; less rice on request; a 2nd-floor shop with a hard-to-find entrance.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 鮨 銀座おのでら 息子 なんば店、大阪市中央.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Sushi Ginza Onodera Musuko Namba, Namba Oriental Hotel 1F, 2-8-17 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Namba and Nippombashi stations; daily 11:30–22:30 (last entry 21:30, L.O. 22:00); opened 3 October 2025; bookings cancelled at 15 minutes late; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; 19 seats (counter 13, semi-private 6); children and pushchairs welcome; English, Chinese and Korean menus; tuna from the middleman Yama Ko; house kohada; simmered anago; the Sennichimae roll and Namba Mountain. Reviews (July–October 2026): order piece by piece on a tablet; choose size, amount of rice and wasabi; self-serve tea; red-vinegar rice; no shoyu on the table, each piece is finished before serving; isaki; hairy crab; seared scallop; 3 kinds of shrimp; ark shell; photo captions say 'jellyfish ponzu', 'nodoguro and seared surf clam', 'squid legs', 'yuzu sour'; toro-taku hand roll with narazuke; one found the tuna below expectations; budget ¥5,000–10,000.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 鳥焼酒場 暁、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-12-.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Toriyaki Sakaba Akatsuki, Eight Building 1F, 1-12-19 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 2; Mon, Tue, Thu and Fri 17:00–23:30, Sat, Sun and holidays 16:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); closed Wednesdays; opened 5 September 2023; entry refused if over 15 minutes late, with a cancellation fee; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; smoking allowed; 20 seats; private rooms; morning-slaughtered Kagoshima chicken sashimi; yakitori served off the skewer; sake from Fukui and Mie; premium '3M' shochu; courses. Reviews (September–October 2026): two streets east of Shinsaibashisuji; semi-private rooms partitioned with sudare blinds; chicken sashimi platter ¥1,980; liver sashimi; horse sashimi platter ¥2,180; grilled aged thigh ¥1,280; karaage ¥880; fried Chinese yam ¥680; fried octopus ¥780; leek-salt beef-tongue fried rice ¥980 (the owner's recommendation); cheese tsukune with egg yolk; chicken neck and asparagus stir-fried with lemon; thigh stir-fried with garlic salt; thigh and shiso tempura; tororo kombu and ume udon; truffle TKG; a big grilled rice ball.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 黒門すし酒場 花神総本店、大阪市中央区日本橋.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Kuromon Sushi Sakaba Kashin head shop, 1-21-1 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Kintetsu Nippombashi Station; daily 9:00–16:00; irregular closing days; moved to Kuromon Market's main street in April 2021; fish bought daily by the owner; plump oysters and fatty bluefin tuna; daytime drinking welcome; the 2nd floor can be hired from 2 people; no cards or e-money; PayPay, d-barai, Rakuten Pay and au PAY accepted; no smoking on the ground floor, smoking on the 2nd only; 18 seats; children welcome; takeaway. Reviews (November 2023 – January 2026): drinking from about 10 a.m.; 3 oysters raw or grilled ¥999 (October 2025); tekka maki under ¥700; scallops in large or small, cut by part; fugu with ponzu; 5-kind sashimi platter; seafood rice bowl topped with egg yolk; fried oysters; oden; bright but cramped on the ground floor; a cheerful, fun owner; courteous staff; an Umeda shop too.

食べログ (法人会員): 祇園 なん波、日本料理、東山区四条花見小路東入る祇園町.en: Tabelog (restaurant-managed): Gion Nanba; Japanese cuisine; 祇園町北側279-7, east of Shijo-Hanamikoji, Higashiyama-ku; 1 min walk from the Gion bus stop; lunch 12:00–13:30; dinner 17:30–20:00; closed Thursday; 2–4 January lunch from the ¥13,310 course; service charge 10%; bookings taken; children's dishes from ¥4,000 (booking required); 24 seats (6 counter, 10 at tables upstairs, tatami room, private rooms for 2–8); sunken kotatsu seating; no smoking; cards accepted; no e-money or QR. SavorJapan: lunch from 12:30 (L.O. 13:00); dinner from 17:30 (L.O. 20:00); closed Thursday; lunch average ¥6,000; sakizuke, simmered-dish soup, hassun, palate cleanser, mizumono, sweets with matcha. Retty: a kaiseki restaurant holding a Michelin star. Reviews (September 2024 – October 2026, in English): an alley near Yasaka Shrine; a Michelin star; lunch course ¥9,680; hamo and plum rice soup; dobin-mushi; sweetfish; bonito; somen with egg yolk; osechi every year; the owner, the proprietress and staff; the kotatsu warmed for a guest; dishes slow, with repeated apologies; not especially delicious for the star.

食べログ (英語版): Chinese Ryomon (チュウゴクリョウリ リュ.en: Tabelog (English edition): Chinese Ryomon, Chinese and ramen; Fushimimachi 2-2-6, 青山ビル B1F; right by Kitahama Station exit 6; Mon–Fri 11:00–13:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed Saturday and Sunday; reservations accepted; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 50 seats; tatami room; non-smoking; Chinese WEST 100 2021. Reviews (May 2025–October 2026): over 40 years of history; the basement of a retro building registered as a tangible cultural property; go in through Kitakousei's entrance and down the stairs behind the door on the right; you bump your head on the narrow stairs; full at lunch; 80% of lunch diners order the Tianjin curry fried rice (¥1,000, large ¥1,200, with the day's soup); curry-flavoured fried rice under fluffy egg, with Worcestershire or soy sauce added by some; it takes time, so the ¥1,100 daily lunch (two dishes, rice, soup) is sometimes suggested; Tianjin noodles, ankake yakisoba, champon with a slightly sweet sauce, ramen, mapo noodles; in the evening garlic-free gyoza, spring rolls, a salad of Mongolian squid and kaiware, steamed chicken with sesame miso, eggplant and meat-miso stir-fry, eggs with wood ear, mapo tofu, sweet-and-sour pork, group omakase ¥3,500, Shaoxing wine; a cheerful owner; a menu unchanged since opening; seen on TV.

食べログ (英語版): スパイスキング8848、博労町3-4-9、心斎橋駅北改札.en: Tabelog (English edition): Spice King 8848, Hakuromachi 3-4-9, 5 min on foot from Shinsaibashi Station north gate via the Shinsaibashi-suji arcade, 6 min from Hommachi Station; opened 15 May 2024; daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:30); cards, e-money and QR payments; designated smoking area; children welcome; vegetarian, halal and Hindu options. Menu (June 2024): spiced skewers, spiced boiled egg, chicken tikka rice bowl, jhol momo, pani puri, vegetable pakora, aloo jeera. A Japanese review (April 2026): about 50 m east of the sign on the Shinsaibashi-suji arcade, at the very back of a lane between buildings; the biryani set limited to 10 with lassi; plenty of chicken. English reviews (February–October 2026): A Lunch ¥900 (curry, naan or rice, salad, drink), free refills of plain naan, cheese naan +¥250, chicken biryani set ¥1,000, staff all from abroad and apparently a family business, the normal spice level was on the sweet side.

食べログ (英語版): タナカンチ、大阪市浪速区難波中3-7-2 寿司善サウスビ.en: Tabelog (English): タナカンチ (Tanaka Nchi), 寿司善サウスビル 1F, Nambanaka 3-7-2, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 5 minutes on foot from Namba Station on the Midosuji subway line, 7 minutes from Daikokucho Station; Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 11:30–14:30 and 18:00–24:00, weekends and holidays 18:00–24:00; closed Wednesday; changes posted on Instagram; happy hour 18:00–19:00 with draft beer, chuhai and Kaku highball at ¥300; reservations accepted (by phone for the same day after 18:00); one drink and one dish per person; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; 20 seats (8 counter, three 4-person tables); private hire up to 20; smoking allowed; menus in English, Chinese and Korean. Shop introduction: two kinds of spice curry made with Japanese dashi at lunch; home-style dishes and teppanyaki at night; obanzai from ¥300; shrimp bread, mapo tofu, fried rice; courses with all-you-can-drink ¥3,300 (2 people) and ¥5,500. Reviews (May–October 2026): 魔薬カレー (mapo, black in color, numbing from tofu and Sichuan pepper) and a curry of the day as a two-curry plate for ¥950; lassi set ¥1,100; large rice free; topped with fried vegetables; the curries change on Mondays and Thursdays (dried shrimp; zucchini and chicken keema; butter curry with gizzard; butter curry with chicken mince and mushrooms); gentler heat than the color suggests; "around here, go over ¥1,000 and customers won't come"; one lunch the shop was run by one person alone; in the evening bean sprout namul, boiled peanuts, chouchin-yaki gyoza, shrimp and broccoli with tartar, eggplant yukhoe, chicken skewers; booking recommended on Friday nights.

食べログ (英語版): 炉端とカツラ｡ @日本橋、大阪市浪速区難波中2-6-20.en: Tabelog (English): 炉端とカツラ｡ @日本橋 (Robata to Katsura. At Nipponbashi), Nambanaka 2-6-20 1F, Naniwa-ku, Osaka, 2 minutes on foot from the south exit of Nankai Namba Station and 5 minutes from Namba Station on the Midosuji subway line; Mon–Fri and the days before and after public holidays 15:00–23:30, weekends and holidays 13:00–23:30 (L.O. food 22:30, drinks 23:00); trading as Robata to Katsura from 8 October; reservations accepted (a table booking for two may be seated at the counter); one-drink minimum; no service charge; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 15 seats (7 counter, 2 tables); smoking allowed; menus in English, Chinese and Korean; English- and Korean-speaking staff. Shop introduction: sashimi of fresh fish delivered daily from around the country, straw-grilled and charcoal-grilled dishes, vegetable skewers wrapped in pork, whiskies such as Yamazaki and Chita, sake and wine, courses with all-you-can-drink ¥6,600–¥10,000 (4–8 people). Reviews (October 2026): all the staff wear wigs, afros or pilot hats; a welcome with drums; the signature beef cutlet has sauce poured over it generously at the table, ¥1,980; giant shrimp with chili mayo ¥1,580; aged red and fatty tuna from Nagasaki; wagyu chateaubriand ¥5,980; fig and cheese tempura ¥780; Ise lobster sashimi ¥11,000 with miso soup from the head (Ise lobster and hairy crab need a reservation); grilled zucchini ¥680; bonjiri (chicken tail) ¥800; it looks silly but the food is serious. June–July reviews give the shop's name as Isshin; a July review: the menu is almost the same as at the Higashi-Umeda shop.

食べログ confirms 片町（野町駅約797m）、15席（カウンター7席・小.en: Tabelog confirms Katamachi (about 797 m from Nomachi Station); 15 seats (7 counter, 1 raised tatami); a menu including premium salted tongue, wagyu rib-eye, skirt cuts and kimchi natto; a small, counter-centred offal yakiniku shop.

食べログ confirms 片町（野町駅約834m）、昭和レトロの懐かしい看板、.en: Tabelog confirms Katamachi (about 834 m from Nomachi Station), a nostalgic Shōwa-retro sign, hand-cut after ordering, wagyu skirt, pork belly, stewed tongue, fresh offal and seafood; Hot Pepper confirms a 20-year-old shop with a homey atmosphere.

食べログ(24017058)がフロント前の落ち着いた広い喫茶で、鳥羽湾ビュー・サ.en: Tabelog (24017058) confirms a calm, spacious coffee lounge in front of the front desk, with a view of Toba Bay and complimentary zenzai (the exact ¥500 could not be reconfirmed, so it was generalised). Todaya is a long-established inn founded in 1830 (Tenpō 1).

食べログ(34017538)で、店頭で焼く焼きガキとアナゴ竹輪、ビール・ハイボー.en: Tabelog (34017538) confirms grilled oysters and anago chikuwa grilled at the front, beer and highballs, a budget up to ¥999 and a casual 9:00–19:00 shop. Descriptions of a 2nd-floor café and terrace, white lanterns, being right by Toyokuni Shrine, lunch sets with sake and so on were removed: the source (blog.sanbikaki) does not mention Kijima Shoten, so a mix-up with another shop is very likely.

食べログ(店舗会員): BUTAKIN 上本町店、大阪市中央区東平2-5-5 盛.en: Tabelog (shop member): BUTAKIN Uehommachi, Morikawa Bldg 1F, 2-5-5 Higashibira, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Uehommachi Station; daily 11:00–21:30; cards (VISA, Master, Diners) and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 24 seats (counter 18, three tables for 2); no smoking; opened 16 February 2025. October 2026 reviews: Jiro style; choose vegetables, garlic and fat with the meal ticket; one couldn't add garlic at lunch; light on vegetables; the shoyu has grown sweeter; more shoyu than tonkotsu; chewy noodles; spicy fried garlic; garlic mayo; a rich sauce; small, large, extra-large; ticket machine at the entrance; counter and tables; large ramen 375 g ¥1,200, small 250 g, extra-large 500 g; a beginner-friendly atmosphere; best to avoid the lunch peak; back-fat rice bowl; thick, chewy noodles fragrant with wheat; small ramen ¥1,100; garlic mayo +¥100; thick pork; bean sprouts and cabbage.

食べログ(店舗会員): 福満屋、大阪市中央区徳井町2-2-14 大阪屋徳井ビル.en: Tabelog (staff-maintained): Fukumitsuya, 2-2-14 Tokuimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 1F; 3 min on foot from exit 4 of Tanimachi 4-chome Stn; Mon–Sat 18:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); closed Sundays and holidays, and over Golden Week, Obon and New Year; reservations accepted; private hire for 8 or more at ¥4,000 or more a head; cards accepted (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); no service charge; 13 seats (7 at the counter, 6 at tables); smoking allowed. Shop's description: 30 years as a Chinese chef; authentic Chinese food that brings out the ingredients' own flavour, at reasonable prices; mostly counter seats, easy to drop in alone; serving may take longer when busy. Reviews (February 2025–July 2026): a Chinese bistro; a bar-like room in black with a hand-painted dragon; the owner cooks and serves alone; evening drink set ¥1,100; trial set ¥1,600 (jellyfish, bang bang chicken, spring rolls, kara-age, grilled gyoza, sweet-and-sour pork, mini tantanmen); sweet-and-sour pork on fried spring-roll skins ¥1,180; mapo tofu piping hot in an iron pot; shrimp, scallop and cheese egg stir-fry; spicy beef and lettuce fried rice; seafood crispy fried noodles; draft beer ¥450; Shaoxing wine, sweet and dry; smoking allowed inside.

食べログ(店舗会員): 肉鍋亭、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-8-3 日宝笠屋町会館.en: Tabelog (shop member): Niku Nabe Tei, Nippo Kasayamachi Kaikan 1F, 2-8-3 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station, 6 min from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Fri 18:00–1:00 next morning, Sat, Sun and holidays 17:00–1:00 next morning; no closing day; closes when sold out; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 20 seats (tables 12, counter 8); opened 20 February 2021; Niku Nabe Tei Bettei on the 2nd floor. Reviews (August–October 2026): Hakata mentaiko and grated-yam hot pot; avocado yukhoe; the original long toro-taku roll; plenty of grated yam and mentaiko; featured on TV; reasonable all-you-can-drink; truffle-topped potato salad; raw oysters; cheese risotto to finish; Chinese yam as the starter; pork belly, chicken, fish balls, tofu; staff finish the hot pot; thick seasoned nori; 3 drinks for a little over ¥6,000 each; all-you-can-drink ¥1,500; calm; counter seats; got in on the day; the grated-yam hot pot is the speciality; good potato salad.

食べログ(店舗会員): 貝出汁中華そば カワチリバー、大阪市中央区南船場2-7-.en: Tabelog (shop member): Kaidashi Chuka Soba Kawachiriba, 2-7-1 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 337 m from Nagahoribashi; Mon–Sat and days before and after holidays 11:00–14:30; closed Sundays and holidays; lunch only; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; no smoking; opened 1 October 2021. Reviews (June–October 2026): cold pasta; shellfish-broth chuka soba salt set; a clear shellfish soup; smooth noodles; seasoned egg and menma; sansho on the table; clam tsukudani with rice; the clam shoyu is light and not strongly shellfishy; Yamatsu Tsujita shichimi; the shellfish salt tastes firmly of shellfish; refined shellfish umami; thin chashu; chewy noodles; noodle refills; one found the soup lukewarm; a calm atmosphere, many women diners; niku soba; clam shoyu ramen.

食べログ(店舗会員): 青藍、大阪市中央区中寺1-2-23 1F、谷町六丁目駅4.en: Tabelog (shop member): Seiran, 1F, 1-2-23 Nakadera, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 7 min walk from Tanimachi-Rokuchome Station exit 4; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 13:30) and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 20:45), Sat and holidays 11:30–14:30 and 17:30–22:00, Sun 11:30–14:30 and 17:30–21:30; about 7 irregular closing days a month, mainly Mondays (announced on Instagram); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 25 seats (counter 6, 3 tables with 12 seats, private room for 7); opened 29 April 2012; Tabelog Chinese WEST Hyakumeiten 2021, 2023, 2024 and 2026. Reviews (September–October 2026): Seiran lunch ¥2,300 (3 starters, soup, 2 dim sum, sweet-and-sour pork or seafood in chili sauce, free rice refills, dessert); superb sweet-and-sour pork; seafood lunch ¥1,800; steamed chicken with leek or sesame sauce; the rice a little disappointing; sign the list at the entrance before opening; a queue of about 10 groups; lunch is courses only; book dinner on Tabelog; ¥10,000 course; shrimp and whitebait; shumai; stir-fried squid; mapo tofu balancing heat and numbing; almond tofu; matcha sesame balls; Shaoxing wine tasting; jasmine tea; original dim sum; soft-shell crab in chili sauce; karaage with Mao Zedong sauce; black-vinegar sweet-and-sour pork; one found the tantanmen bitter.

食べログ(店舗会員): 魚肴 しま田、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-7-11 ほんまビ.en: Tabelog (shop member): Uosakana Shimada, Honma Bldg 3F, 2-7-11 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Namba stations; Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00; closed Sundays and holidays; arrange courses in advance; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 11 seats (counter 7, private room for 2–4); no smoking. Reviews (January 2025 – August 2026): a calm, clean, grown-up Japanese restaurant; a friendly taisho; seasonal ingredients; courses and à la carte; a private room at the back; simmered new burdock; salmon sake-lees soup; sashimi platter; shoyu-grilled shirako; fried oysters; fish dishes; the taisho is close at the counter; sees you off to the lift; dishes to go with sake; raw oysters; omakase; a taisho who trained at Asai; counter and raised tatami area; courses from ¥10,000; spear squid, tuna, hamo, Wakayama octopus; grilled broad beans; abalone; dobin-mushi; miso-grilled fish; no engawa that day.

食べログ(店舗会員): 鮓 木村 建介、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-5-14 シノハ.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sushi Kimura Kensuke, Shinohara Lapis Bldg 1F, 2-5-14 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 7 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 6; Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00; closed Sundays and holidays; service charge; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 12 seats. Reviews (January–October 2026): a 5th visit; good sea urchin; balance of quality, taste, presentation and price; the owner cooks alone, so order labour-intensive dishes early; chutoro is the best; courses and à la carte; 6-starter platter; about 5 kinds of sashimi; sweet shrimp from the tank; chutoro, eel, sea urchin; a modest owner; course with sashimi; nigiri-only course; small rice balls; seasonal ingredients; just an hour, lightly; omakase sized to appetite; distinctive rice with red and white vinegar; raw anago; ikura; Kansai-style omelette; house-made pudding.

食べログ(店舗会員): 鮓 羽室、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-6-19、心斎橋駅4B.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sushi Hamuro, 2-6-19 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 4B and Namba Station exit 14; Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); closed Sundays (open on holidays); occasional irregular closures; cards accepted; 6 seats; opened 31 March 2015. Reviews (September 2022 – May 2026): a hideaway with many regulars; Edomae sushi; red sea urchin; just a sign at the end of an alley; a master with 30 years' experience; sashimi platter; ark shell, chutoro, sea bream; crab, nodoguro, bonito tataki; sake chosen by the taisho; the best kohada; clear soup to finish; firefly squid; soft-shell crab; whitebait; grilled hamaguri; simmered sea-bream head; toro and takuan; small horse mackerel; a gentle master; add favourites to the omakase; sushi kaiseki; drinks on the pricey side; courses good value; hard to book; crab; fugu shirako.

食べログ(店舗会員): 鮨 一永、大阪市中央区千日前1-6-10 千寿ビル B1.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sushi Ichiei, Senju Bldg B1F, 1-6-10 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Kintetsu Nippombashi Station, 6 min from Namba Station; daily sittings 12:00–14:00, 17:00–19:00 and 19:30–21:30; irregular closing days; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; opened 12 October 2023; photos without shutter sound or flash. Reviews (September–October 2026): a 6th visit; one says Michelin Guide Kyoto-Osaka 2025 and 2026 Selected; sweet shrimp (as a sashimi sheet); eel and cucumber rice-paper roll; Amakusa kue shabu; sesame mackerel; ankimo; seared shabu of kinmedai from Abashiri; Peking-duck-style eel and cucumber; Chiba black abalone with liver sauce; smoked daikon roll; myoga and sesame roll; Biwa trout, ikura, striped jack; a 7-seat counter in a multi-tenant building; an owner with a craftsman's temperament; a friendly owner; bought direct from regions and fishermen and from Toyosu; blanched kinki; seared kinmedai; framed pictures; a hinoki counter; omakase ¥25,000; hamaguri soup; sweet shrimp with rock salt and sudachi; white fish, red fish, chutoro, squid, sea urchin; one says it's easy to book right now; another says it's full for a while.

食べログ(店舗会員): 鮨 響、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町2-23 グリーンハウスビ.en: Tabelog (shop member): Sushi Hibiki, Green House Bldg 1F, 2-23 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi, Nagahoribashi and Nippombashi stations; daily 17:30–22:00, two sittings starting together, 17:30–19:30 and 20:00–22:00; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 8 counter seats; opened 1 June 2025. Reviews (September–October 2026): 'proper sushi, casually'; 881 Group; entertainment sushi; 15-item omakase with all-you-can-drink ¥6,600; Tosa returning bonito; basic course ¥4,400; premium all-you-can-drink ¥7,700; sea bream; chawanmushi; autumn-salmon sandwich; no name at the entrance, just a QR-code sign; everyone joins in a call-and-response; one found 6 nigiri without chutoro underwhelming; ramen made from the sushi fish trimmings; the squid was best; kakigori for dessert; a warm atmosphere; chanko; cold sake in a kappa-shaped flask; reservations only; bonito tataki; cod sandwich; eel rice bowl; barracuda; yuan-yaki; tuna.

食べログ(店舗会員): 鶏そば 小箱、大阪市西区西本町3-1-7、阿波座駅から徒.en: Tabelog (shop member): Tori Soba Kobako, 3-1-7 Nishi-Hommachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Awaza Station; Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–23:00, Sat and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–21:00, Sun 11:30–15:00; irregular closing days; cards (VISA, Master), e-money and QR accepted; 7 seats; opened 22 June 2016. Reviews (September–October 2026): a 9th visit; limited jan-men ¥1,100 (extra heat ¥100, rice ¥100, seasoned egg ¥150); a thin shoyu-based chicken soup with nira, offal and beaten egg; slightly thick chewy noodles; like the real thing from Kochi; limited chashu maze-soba; cold tantanmen ¥1,000; Kobako-ppo ¥1,000; two bowls is fine; onion, leek, chicken breast, thigh chashu, meat miso, chili oil; rare chashu, 2 slices thigh chashu, seasoned egg, grated ginger, wasabi; kombu umami; cold thin straight noodles with tapioca starch; chicken soba with seasoned egg ¥900; lunch-only mini leek-salt chashu rice ¥150; shoyu rich in chicken fat; tori-paitan soba next time; counter only; ticket machine; a clear soup of chicken bones and shoyu; yuzu peel; medium-thin noodles; thigh and breast chashu; courteous service; light chicken soba (shoyu) ¥750; no wait at 20:00 on a weekday; a faintly sweet clear chicken shoyu; 3 kinds of chashu; limited-time price; large +¥150; near Super Hotel Awaza.

食べログ(店舗会員): 麺と無限の可能性 本町総本店、大阪市中央区博労町4-7-.en: Tabelog (shop member): Men to Mugen no Kanosei Hommachi head shop, Nova Kaneichi Hommachi Mido 1F, 4-7-1 Bakuromachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Hommachi Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00, Sat 11:00–23:00, Sun 11:00–22:00; morning ramen 8:00–11:00 (reservation only, via Tabelog or Instagram DM); a mid-day break, with all-day days announced on Instagram and Google; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 7 seats; no smoking; opened 10 March 2025. Reviews (August 2025 – October 2026): seasoned-egg maze-soba ¥1,150; spicy maze-soba ¥1,150 + seasoned egg ¥150; cold soupless Jiro ¥1,200; maze-soba ¥1,050; Jiro-style thick noodles; wheat flavour and chewiness; bean sprouts, fried garlic, onion, back fat, rare chashu; better with the table garlic; change the flavour with vinegar; rice to finish ¥50; tori paitan ¥950, light; scallop dashi and scallop meat; wavy egg noodles; big menma; moist chashu; about a 10-minute wait; a queue at the shop next door; some call it ordinary.

食べログ(店舗会員): 麺や おだしとにくと、大阪市中央区内本町2-3-8 ダイ.en: Tabelog (shop member): Menya Odashi to Niku to, Dia Palace Bldg Hommachi 1F, 2-3-8 Uchihommachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Sakaisuji-Hommachi and Tanimachi-Yonchome stations; Tue–Sat and holidays 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30); closed Mondays and Sundays (closed Tuesday when Monday is a holiday); no cards, e-money or QR; 14 seats; no smoking; opened 5 November 2024. Menu (August 2026): rich tori-paitan shoyu ¥900 (a triple soup of 3 kinds of chicken, Yamagata pork and Kuroge wagyu tendon; special water; a tare of 6 shoyu); the same in salt ¥900 (4 salts); sansho-spiced tori paitan ¥900 (house chili oil, garlic oil); chicken and shellfish shoyu ¥900 (light, chicken and shellfish dashi); seared chashu mayo rice bowl ¥300; seared Kuroge wagyu sushi ¥400; niboshi and cheese aedama ¥300; noodle refill ¥100. Reviews (August–October 2026): limited mouth-watering-chicken soy-milk cold tantanmen ¥1,200; seasoned egg ¥100; aroma of house chili oil; chewy flat noodles; nuts; fried onion; one says the soy milk is strong and it doesn't feel much like tantanmen; the tori paitan next to it smells as strong as tonkotsu; meat sushi seared in front of you; one day closed before last order; ticket machine; Choro is in the same building; shoyu ramen with shellfish umami, thin noodles and yuzu.

食べログ(店舗会員): 麺や ずずずいーと、大阪市中央区博労町1-1-7、松屋町.en: Tabelog (shop member): Menya Zuzuzuito, 1-1-7 Bakuromachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 371 m from Matsuyamachi Station; Tue–Fri 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–21:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–15:00; closed Mondays; temporary closures on Instagram; PayPay accepted, no cards or e-money; 10 seats (counter 6, two tables for 2); no smoking; opened 30 March 2026. Reviews (July–October 2026): salt wonton noodles ¥1,280; seasoned egg ¥150; a seafood soup of Ibuki iriko, premium mackerel flakes, ma-kombu and domestic dried shiitake with a special salt tare; fried leek and yuzu; house-made thin noodles of Hokkaido wheat; thick menma; chashu charcoal-grilled on a shichirin; 4 wontons; summer cold salt ¥1,200 (salt or shoyu, lemon vinegar); low-temperature rare chicken-breast and pork chashu; kombu tsukudani; a free-topping coupon for a LINE survey; salt ramen ¥950; soft menma; special shoyu; full on a Sunday afternoon; featured in Ramen Walker; special salt ¥1,380; charcoal-grilled chashu rice bowl ¥500; shellfish aroma oil; medium-thin noodles; pork belly, shoulder and leg, chicken thigh; along the Yokobori River; additive-free; shoyu wonton noodles; 2 kinds of shoyu; one rates the wontons among the best in Osaka; one found the shoyu underwhelming.

食べログ(店舗会員): 麺や佑、大阪市中央区南久宝寺町4-5-15 ニューライフ.en: Tabelog (shop member): Menya Yuu, New Life Midosuji Hommachi 101, 4-5-15 Minamikyuhojimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Hommachi Station, 8 min from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon–Sat 10:00–15:00 and 17:00–21:30, Sun 10:00–15:00 and 17:00–21:00 (enter by closing time); closed 13–15 August and 31 December – 3 January; PayPay and Rakuten Pay accepted, no cards or e-money; 11 counter seats; opened 3 March 2016. Reviews (February–October 2026): 10 waiting at 12:30 on a weekday; ticket machine; tsukemen regular or 500 g; chicken-fish-pork ramen and takana rice; now topped with bonito flakes; a depth hard to believe is additive-free; thick straight noodles; takana rice ¥90; noodle refills may have ended; niboshi-scented tsukemen; not heavy; ramen and tsukemen about equally popular; buy a ticket inside and wait; some say so-so; tori-paitan tsukemen with thick wavy noodles; black-vinegar tang; soup-wari; chicken-fish-pork chashu-men; a counter around the kitchen; slightly frothy soup; one says thin noodles; the fish is faint; plenty of leek; lively staff; celebrity autographs; one calls it Kanto-style.

食べログ(店舗会員): 麺や拓、大阪市西区北堀江3-5-2、西大橋駅から南西へ徒.en: Tabelog (shop member): Menya Taku, 3-5-2 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk south-west of Nishi-Ohashi Station, 5 min from Nishi-Nagahori Station exit 6; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Wednesdays; no cards; 12 counter seats; no smoking; parking vouchers; opened 7 July 2009; Tabelog Ramen OSAKA Hyakumeiten 2023, 2024 and 2025. Reviews (September–October 2026): 10th in Hyakumeiten 2025; before noon on a Sunday; ticket machine outside; full quickly; Japanese-style chicken & pork (extra meat) ¥1,250; chashu, egg, leek, chili threads, nori, bonito flakes; chicken and pork bones with Japanese dashi; slightly thick; thin straight noodles; thick chashu that seems seared; blow and the bonito flakes fly; Japanese-style chicken & pork ¥1,000; cheerful staff; aroma of bonito flakes; one says medium-thick straight noodles; soft-boiled egg; black shichimi; chicken & pork tsukemen; fragrant thick noodles; maze-soba; chashu rice bowl.

食べログ(店舗会員): 麺ファクトリー ジョーズ、大阪市中央区上本町西2-1-1.en: Tabelog (shop member): Men Factory Jaws, Kusumoto Bldg 1F, 2-1-11 Uehommachi-nishi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Tanimachi-Rokuchome Station exit 3; daily 11:00–15:30 and 17:30–22:30; no cards, e-money or QR; 20 seats (counter 6, two tables for 4, one for 6); no smoking; a stylish space; opened 21 July 2014; blog ameblo.jp/factory-jaws; Tabelog Ramen OSAKA Hyakumeiten 2023, 2024 and 2025. Reviews (August–October 2026): a 20th visit; rich tsukemen ¥1,200; ticket machine outside; large curry; full quickly; chewy medium-thick straight noodles; a pork and chicken base with sardine flakes and niboshi plus curry; spice aroma and faint heat; pork-loin and seared pork-belly chashu; soup-wari and rice for a soup-curry finish; menu: rich tsukemen (shoyu, curry), spicy rich tsukemen, maze-soba (shoyu, curry), ramen (shoyu, salt); large free; pepper and shichimi on the table; 3 staff; maze-soba ¥1,150; flat medium-thick noodles; chashu, soft-boiled egg, cheese, fried onion, nori, nira, leek; dashi rice to finish; thick chewy noodles; yuzu-kosho; fish powder; special rich tsukemen; house-made noodles; change the flavour with lemon; comes with small rice.

食べログ(店舗会員): 麺屋 やまひで 堺筋本町店、大阪市中央区久太郎町1-9-.en: Tabelog (shop member): Menya Yamahide Sakaisuji-Hommachi, Eight Bldg 1F, 1-9-2 Kyutaromachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station exit 6; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 18:00–2:00 next morning (L.O. 1:30), Sat 11:30–14:30; closed Sundays and holidays; announcements on Instagram; no cards, e-money or QR; counter seats; opened 15 April 2016. Reviews (June–October 2026): Taiwan maze-soba; a bright, friendly owner; clean inside; the spicy soup is lighter than it looks; seared chashu and menma; Taiwan maze-soba ¥900, regular or small; less garlic; rice to finish ¥50; leek, nira, garlic, chili and Taiwan mince; egg; thick chewy noodles; put the spoon in the empty bowl and set it on the counter for rice; often goes to the Nara shop too; rice to finish now costs extra; change the flavour with kombu vinegar; lighter than usual.

食べログ(店舗会員): 麺屋 九兵衛、大阪市中央区南本町2-4-15 南本町若林.en: Tabelog (shop member): Menya Kyubee, Minamihommachi Wakabayashi Bldg 1F, 2-4-15 Minamihommachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station exit 8; Mon–Thu 11:00–16:00, Fri 11:30–20:00; closed weekends and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR; 20 seats; no smoking; a stylish, calm space; opened 1 November 2021. Reviews (May–September 2026): izakaya menu from 15:00 on Fridays; bean-sprout namul; toro liver (low-temperature); chicken sashimi yukhoe; seared rare chashu; dashimaki; fried rice; salt ramen; leek chijimi; salt-grilled chicken breast; karaage; chuka soba and half fried rice set; plenty of chicken fat and shoyu aroma; chewy medium-thick noodles; rare chashu; one says the fried rice isn't fluffy; fresh chicken; toro liver ¥400; chicken sashimi ¥400; 2 karaage ¥150; highball ¥350; one found the salt seasoned-egg ramen with mini fried rice heavy on fat and salt; a clean shop; a confusing ticket machine; one says the karaage was pre-made and lukewarm, the soup lukewarm too; cold soba; kumquat; kombu and bonito dashi; chicken soboro; firm medium-thick noodles.

食べログ(店舗会員): 麺食堂 コハクドリ、大阪市中央区本町4-8-6、本町駅か.en: Tabelog (shop member): Men Shokudo Kohakudori, 4-8-6 Hommachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Hommachi Station; Mon–Sat and holidays 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–23:00, Sun 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; no cards, e-money or QR; 9 seats; no smoking; opened 5 June 2023. Reviews (December 2025 – October 2026): abura soba and maze-soba with plenty of chashu, with small rice; a clear-soup ramen; chashu rice bowl; one says it's the same group as Subarushinbashi in Sakaisuji-Hommachi; diners even at 22:00; a clear taste like a blend of 3 soups; jidori umami and a sharp shoyu; thin straight noodles; low-temperature chashu; soft menma; seared diced-chashu rice bowl with leek and shredded nori; salt shijimi ramen; shiso; light; salt shijimi ramen ¥880; medium-thick wavy noodles; special salt shijimi; 2 kinds of thick chashu; one found it sweetish and monotonous later on; made carefully, so it takes a little time.

食べログ(店舗情報): TAKAHASHIYA 銀座店、銀座4-12-1 VOR.en: Tabelog (shop info): TAKAHASHIYA Ginza, Ginza 4-12-1 VORT Ginza East II Building 4F, next to the Kabukiza stage door, opened August 14, 2021; Tue–Sun 11:30–16:00, 17:00–22:00, closed Mon; unadon set ¥5,800, live-killed eel set ¥8,800 (popular); blue eel, hazakake rice; an eel specialist based on the Mitsui group's "Ryotei 松野茶屋" and "Ginza Koju"; Michelin Guide Tokyo; tax included, no service charge; qualified invoice T5030001051893. 2026 reviews: the main shop is in Sugito, Saitama, founded in the early Meiji era; wild eel; 400 g blue eel from Mikawa-Isshiki; charcoal; Kanto and Kansai styles; fourth-generation kaiseki course; shirayaki with salt, wasabi and egg yolk.

食べログ(店舗提供の紹介文): 滋賀の名店「しのはら」が銀座へ、店主・篠原武将氏.en: Tabelog (shop-supplied introduction): the renowned "Shinohara" of Shiga comes to Ginza; owner Takemasa Shinohara restarted as "Ginza Shinohara" in October 2016; an L-shaped plain-wood counter, vessels such as Old Baccarat, omakase course only, shippō arrangements, a hassun of Shiga ingredients, changing monthly; trained at famous Kyoto restaurants (Sangencha) and elsewhere. The Tabelog Award Gold 2017–2026. 13 seats, dinner in two sittings at 17:00 and 20:30, lunch Tue, Thu, Sat at 12:00, closed Sun; omakase ¥35,000 (tax incl.), service charge extra. 2026 reviews: two Michelin stars, 10th anniversary of the shop and 20 years of Shinohara, many disciples gone independent, a Chōyō hassun, king crab, matsutake, many fu dishes.

食べログ(英)・ヒトサラで、香林坊の町家居酒屋、座敷と内庭、治部煮(鴨・麩・わさ.en: Tabelog (EN) and Hitosara confirm: a townhouse izakaya in Korinbo with tatami rooms and an inner garden; jibuni (duck, fu, wasabi) served cheaply as a single dish (rare in the city); Ishikawa seafood, Kaga vegetables and local sake.

食べログ/HAMONI/autoreserve等が東区泉・2018年1月11日開.en: Tabelog, HAMONI, autoreserve and others confirm Izumi, Higashi-ku; opened 11 January 2018; reservations only and must be accompanied by the introducer; address not public; photos and social-media posts prohibited; courses only. The wooden-box ingredient display and handmade chocolates are based on blog accounts.

食べログ: #にくといえばまつだ 大阪店、大阪市中央区博労町4-3-14 1F、.en: Tabelog: # Niku to ieba Matsuda Oosaka ten, Hakuromachi 4-3-14 1F, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk north from Shinsaibashi Stn exit 3, 7 min walk south from Honmachi Stn exit 13; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Wednesday and the 1st and 3rd Thursdays; reservations taken; cards accepted, no e-money or QR payment; 16 seats (counter 10, private room 6); non-smoking; sommelier on staff; English and Chinese menus; opened 30 August 2022. Shop's description: sister shop of Niku to ieba Matsuda in Nara; Nara's brand beef, Yamato beef; wagyu truffle yukke, Chateaubriand of beef tongue, and creative dishes such as pasta, beef stew and tacos; over 100 wines chosen by the sommelier; a tea-room-like Japanese-modern space with a full-flat counter and a private room; omakase courses ¥6,000 and ¥11,000; a wagyu sansho hot pot course ¥8,500, private room only. Reviews (September–October 2026): Chateaubriand tongue cut and grilled in front of you, outside skirt, sirloin, lean cuts, beef sashimi, kimchi, hamburg steak, katsu sandwich, garlic rice with Chateaubriand, croquette, cold-brewed Yamato tea; several say service is slow, and some tables get a two-hour limit before the next booking.

食べログ: 17MAP、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-3-7 ROYAL KITAGA.en: Tabelog: 17MAP, ROYAL KITAGAWA Bldg 1F, 2-3-7 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 8 seats (counter 6, one table for 2); Mon–Thu and days before holidays 19:00–3:00 next morning (L.O. 2:30), Fri–Sat 19:00–4:00 next morning (L.O. 3:30); closed Sundays and holidays; no smoking (smoking area outside); cards and e-money accepted; features: vegetables, vegan menu, vegetarian menu; shop introduction: tacos of the moment, burritos. Reviews (March 2025 – April 2026): a hidden bar 'AREA51' behind the kitchen (22:00–3:00); smallish burritos; a colourful, cute shop; one-drink minimum; well-filled tacos; tortillas; Mexican music; tequila; soft tacos (beef, chicken, pork, veg); all-you-can-eat taco events; takeaway.

食べログ: 365 サロンゴカフェ、カフェ、カレー、創作料理、日本橋人形町1-8.en: Tabelog: 365 Salongo Cafe, cafe, curry, creative; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 1-8-2, 1F, 3 min walk from Ningyocho and Suitengumae Stations; lunch Mon–Fri 11:00–14:00; evenings Tue, Thu and Fri 18:00–24:00, Wed 18:30–24:00, Sat and Sun 18:00–24:00; reservations accepted; private hire up to 20; no cards at lunch; 17 seats; non-smoking at lunch, smoking allowed in bar hours; website cafe-salongo.com; lunch bukkake rice (2 daily sides ¥700, 3 ¥750, 4 ¥800; 2020 menu). Reviews (September 2017–October 2025): much takeaway; green curry; Malaysian-style chicken stew; yellow curry; a 4-item lunch box ¥900 (June 2025); live music at night; moussaka; some found the sides under-seasoned.

食べログ: 39チキン 日本橋本店、大阪市中央区千日前1-2-8、日本橋駅から1.en: Tabelog: 39 Chicken Nippombashi main shop, 1-2-8 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 109 m from Nippombashi Station; daily 12:00–2:00 next morning (L.O. 1:30); no reservations (no phone bookings); cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; 8 seats; takeaway; delivery.
