Reviews (2018 – November 2025): Korean fried chicken; fried to order; bone-in or boneless; the shop says aged 24 hours with 12 medicinal ingredients; yangnyeom; shoyu; half & half ¥1,950 (November 2025); 4-kind set; pickled radish and aurora sauce; cheese balls; tteok and sausage skewers; Korean steamed egg in a stone pot; one found it a little pricey for takeaway; a second shop exists.

食べログ: 512 CAFE＆SWEETS、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-1-24 2.en: Tabelog: 512 CAFE & SWEETS, 2F, 2-1-24 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 378 m from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 9:00–17:00; open every day of the year; opened 16 July 2020; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; no smoking; 10 seats; children welcome; takeaway; official site. Reviews (June–October 2026): a pancake shop; order by QR on your phone; self-serve water; fluffy, wobbly pancakes with a caramelised top and custard inside; whipped cream; vanilla ice cream; berry sauce; bittersweet caramel sauce; matcha pancakes ¥1,800 (before tax); matcha custard and mascarpone; peach and mascarpone; summer chocolate mint about ¥2,600; 512 lunch plate of French toast with bacon and eggs; house lemonade; eggs from Kannan Farm in Hyogo in the batter; served in about 10 minutes; quiet at weekday lunch; the tables for 2 nearly full at holiday lunch; one gives hours as 10:00–17:00 (L.O. 16:00).

食べログ: 5坪 六本木店、港区六本木3-8-10 じゃるだんビル4F、18:0.en: Tabelog: Go Tsubo Roppongi, Roppongi 3-8-10, じゃるだんビル 4F; from 18:00; hours and closing days may change; no cards, e-money or QR; 14 counter seats; smoking allowed. Reviews (March–September 2026): oysters raw, steamed or grilled at about ¥250 each (¥230 in March); Akkeshi oysters; uni butter toast; baked potato with cod roe; avocado with cod roe; smoked daikon with cream cheese; nagaimo kimchi; steamed mussels; thick-cut bacon; the owner runs it alone; closes when the oysters run out; tell them how many oysters when booking; cash only; no water glasses (buy from the vending machine downstairs); a window looking onto a cemetery.

食べログ: 8ppy麻辣湯、大阪市浪速区難波中2-10-70 なんばパークス 6.en: Tabelog: 8ppy Malatang, Namba Parks 6F, 2-10-70 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 215 m from Namba; daily 11:00–21:30; cards (AMEX), e-money and QR accepted; no smoking. Reviews (July–September 2026): could eat it every day; a regular for years; molokhia, white wood-ear, king oyster mushroom, tomato, coriander; thick sweet-potato noodles; heat 2; 7 items for ¥1,500; choose your heat; flavour changers on the table; order by filling in a form at the table; the total is hard to read in the small print; a medicinal-herb flavour; here since before the boom; garlic, black vinegar, Sichuan-pepper oil; smallish portions; full of young women; glass noodles; cramped like a standing soba bar; about ¥1,500; pork-shabu rice; mochi.

食べログ: A kyoto、鉄板焼き・日本料理、下京区斎藤町140-6 1F、阪.en: Tabelog: A kyoto, teppanyaki and Japanese cuisine; 下京区斎藤町140-6 1F; 2 min on foot from Hankyu Kyoto Kawaramachi and Keihan Gion-Shijo Stations; 11:30–14:30 and 17:30–22:00; closed Tuesday (and irregularly, announced on Instagram); reservations taken; service charge; 12 counter seats; terrace; English menu and English-speaking staff; cards and QUICPay accepted; opened 9 January 2026. Opening article (6 January 2026, in English): ORI Corporation (Taito-ku, Tokyo); a Kyoto machiya more than 100 years old; A kyoto on the ground floor and the tea-and-gin café-bar B kyoto upstairs; black wagyu and Kyoto vegetables; the course changes on the 1st of odd-numbered months. Reviews (August–November 2026, in English): lunch omakase of 8 dishes ¥8,000, omakase of 10 dishes ¥12,000, a view of the Kamo River, black wagyu tenderloin 80 g, miso-and-yogurt gelato.

食べログ: AMBER、大阪市西区北堀江2-4-20 ハイフォレスト1、四ツ橋・.en: Tabelog: AMBER, High Forest 1, 2-4-20 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Yotsubashi and Nishi-Ohashi stations, 11 from Shinsaibashi Station; Tue–Sun and holidays 11:30–15:30 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:30–23:00 (L.O. food 22:00); closed Mondays (Tuesday if Monday is a holiday); irregular closures (Instagram highlights); cards, e-money and QR accepted; 20 seats (tables). Reviews (September–October 2026): bright and warm; at lunch pasta with potage, bread and salad (swordfish and spinach tomato sauce); courses and à la carte at night (braised beef cheek, sea-urchin cream pasta, Kuroge wagyu, sirloin-cap steak, crab risotto, baguette with fig butter, house tiramisu); birthday plates; friendly staff; good for lunch with children; always full, book ahead; a sister cafe; one found portions small for 4 to share.

食べログ: ANNIE's Diner、大阪市中央区南船場3-2-28 NIPP.en: Tabelog: ANNIE's Diner, NIPPO Taiyo Bldg 2F, Minami-Senba 3-2-28, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min from Shinsaibashi Stn Exit 7; Mon–Fri 11:00–14:30 and 17:00–23:00, Sat 11:00–18:00 (L.O. 17:30); closed Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 12 seats (counter 8, table 4); smoking allowed (non-smoking at lunch); opened 7 February 2024. Reviews (June 2025–October 2026): retro American interior; hamburg steak with your choice of weight, sauce and rice amount, with rice, soup, salad and potatoes for about ¥1,000; taco rice; a monthly special (chashu and fried-egg set, eel torotama hamburg, arrabbiata cheese hamburg); 200 g hamburg ¥1,400; Mexican potato salad ¥500; rice ¥250; chicken, beef and pork tacos; beef burrito; chili con carne cheese quesadilla (guacamole and salsa); Buffalo wings (blue-cheese and yogurt dip); melt garlic rice; "Maximum The Burg" with hot cheese poured over on a teppan; chocolate banana split; Corona beer; weekday lunch is full by noon with a line.

食べログ: AOI(エーオーアイ)、銀座2-11-9 三和産工ビル1F、東銀座駅.en: Tabelog: AOI, Ginza 2-11-9, 三和産工 Building 1F, 3 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station exit A2; 21 seats; weekdays 11:00–23:00, weekends and holidays 11:00–22:00; closed at New Year; cards, IC and QR accepted; shop introduction: fluffy hamburg steak with plenty of onions, 28 years running. 2026 reviews: opened 1999; chef Iwai (English spelling), who trained at a high-end French restaurant in Roppongi; Japanese beef and onions sautéed for hours; a secret Japanese-style sauce; a garlicky sauce; grated daikon and ponzu; doubles; order by touch panel; seats close together; ¥1,000–2,000.

食べログ: ASIYANA (アシヤナ)、インド料理・インドカレー、浪速区元町1.en: Tabelog: ASIYANA; Indian, Indian curry; Motomachi 1-4-22 (Naniwa-ku); right by exit 28 of Namba Station; daily 11:00–16:00 (L.O. 15:30) and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); takeaway until 22:30, delivery until 22:00; closed only 31 December and 1 January; reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 30 table seats; non-smoking (smoking area outside); children welcome; kids menu; takeaway; Uber Eats, DiDi Food and Demae-can; lunch from ¥880 with nine choices; dinner curry sets from ¥1,250; sets for two, courses and all-you-can-eat; a healthy curry made with little oil; a bean dal at weekends and holidays; choose your spice level. Reviews (February–September 2026): service lunch ¥930; chicken curry naan-rice set ¥980; ladies set ¥1,150 (sesame naan); special lunch (tandoori chicken, samosas); biryani; chicken masala ¥1,180; plain naan ¥380; spice levels 1 to 100; lassi with homemade yogurt; staff from India; about 20 years in business; some say the portions are small.

食べログ: AUN COFFEE ROASTERS、カフェ・ケーキ・パン、浪速区.en: Tabelog: AUN COFFEE ROASTERS; cafe, cake, bread; Motomachi 2-10-2, Naniwa-ku, クレアーレ元町 1F; 5 min on foot from JR Namba Stn; daily 9:00–19:00; no reservations; cards, e-money and PayPay; 40 seats; counter; terrace; non-smoking; outlets; free Wi-Fi; wheelchair accessible; pets allowed; takeaway; breakfast; vegan and vegetarian options; English menu; staff who speak English and Korean; opened 14 June 2025. Official site: the AUN COFFEE Shitennoji main shop is in front of the east gate; the owner is a barista and pastry chef; coffee paired with sweets; a menu everyone, Muslim guests included, can enjoy. Reviews (June–September 2026): behind Namba Yasaka Shrine, many overseas guests, hand-drip chosen to your taste, a card describing the beans, Peru and Guatemala ¥900 each, latte, matcha milk, croissant sandwich with prosciutto, mozzarella and orange peel ¥900, smoked salmon ¥950, fig and prosciutto, tiramisu ¥700, berry cheesecake ¥700, carrot cake, mango dessert; also comments that it is a little pricey.

食べログ: AWA SUSHI 泡鮨、大阪市中央区南船場2-6-7 Cuvée.en: Tabelog: AWA SUSHI, Cuvée J2 Hôtel Osaka, 2-6-7 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min from Nagahoribashi Station via the Crysta Nagahori north lift 4; daily 17:00–22:30 (last entry 20:30, everyone starts together); lunch for private hire only; cards, transit IC, iD and QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted; no service charge; 10 counter seats. Reviews (April–September 2026): a champagne and sushi restaurant; reservations; omakase (several dishes and 10–12 nigiri, soup, seasonal dessert); abalone steamed 6 hours with liver sauce (a little rice at the end); surf clam; anago; sea urchin; chutoro; aged preparations; fried young ayu; kamochi ayu; dobin-mushi; a pairing of one glass for every 2–3 dishes from over 200 champagnes; a different producer each month; courteous service; for anniversaries; one found the grilled fish watery.

食べログ: Arbre village(アーブルヴィラージュ、旧店名 レストラン.en: Tabelog: Arbre village (formerly Restaurant Kimuraya), Ginza 4-5-7, Ginza Kimuraya 4F, right by Ginza Station exit A9; 32 seats (tables only); daily 11:00–15:00, 17:00–20:00; closed December 31 and January 1; currently courses only, no à la carte; official site ginzakimuraya.jp. Shop introduction: French by a chef who was head chef of the late "Maxim's de Paris"; Ginza Kimuraya's house bread; overlooking Chuo-dori. 2026 reviews: a course of starter, fish, meat and dessert; two baskets of Kimuraya bread (about four kinds), leftovers in a takeaway bag; it used to be all-you-can-eat; 4F requires a booking; walk through the shop from the entrance to the elevator; window seats look down on Ginza; ¥6,000–8,000 at lunch.

食べログ: Au pas camarade、鉄板焼き、ワインバー、フレンチ、日本.en: Tabelog: Au pas camarade, teppanyaki, wine bar, French; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-8-8, Marion Port 101; 3 min walk from Ningyocho Station exit A3, 5 min from Suitengumae Station exit 7; Mon 17:00–22:00, Tue–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Sundays and holidays; reservations for dinner only; mention allergies when booking; cards accepted; 10% service charge; 11 seats (7 at the counter, a private room with sunken kotatsu); non-smoking; Japanese-French creative omakase; courses ¥12,100 and ¥18,150; 4–5 wines by the glass chosen by a sommelier; opened 18 May 2019. Reviews (August 2025–August 2026): lunch black-wagyu steamed rice ¥2,000; teppan yakisoba with squid-liver sauce ¥1,200; mini curry ¥500; Tuesday–Wednesday set of rice balls, beef soup and steamed vegetables ¥1,800; lunch is cooked by two people, so there is a wait; one diner was told lunch is cash only; there seems to be a sister restaurant in Ginza.

食べログ: B STORE 1st 炭火焼きパスタとワイン、イタリアン・イノベー.en: Tabelog: B STORE 1st, charcoal-grilled pasta and wine; Italian, innovative; 斎藤町140-25, Shimogyo-ku; 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Station (cross the Shijo Ohashi bridge and turn left onto Kiyamachi-dori); Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday, Sunday and holidays 12:00–15:30 and 17:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); Friday dinner only; closed Wednesday; 26 seats; kawadoko terrace (1 May–15 October, terrace lunch only in May, June, September and October); non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; English menu; cards and QR accepted; opened 19 September 2022; pasta-choice lunch set ¥1,950; sister shop B STORE 2nd; a 100-year-old machiya; a chef who trained in Italy; "neo izakaya" style at night; vegetarian options. Reviews (September 2025–August 2026, in English): charcoal-grilled chicken confit lemon carbonara, chilled genovese, dessert +¥500, Gorgonzola pizza, charcoal-grilled A5 wagyu.

食べログ: B portland coffee roastery (ビー ポート.en: Tabelog: B portland coffee roastery, café, 1F サクラブルービル, 4-8-3 Minami-Senba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 10 min walk from Shinsaibashi Stn; daily 9:00–20:00; no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; non-smoking; opened 3 December 2019. Reviews (June 2025–October 2026): iced coffee (blend) ¥500; a NOVO MARK II roaster (said to be the first in Japan); choose green beans and have the beans roasted on the spot; espresso drinks, Americano, hazelnut latte, café au lait, El Salvador, cold brew; breakfast set ¥800 (thick toast, bacon, fried egg, potage, salad); donuts, crème brûlée, coffee soft-serve; a terrace and bench; few seats and much takeaway.

食べログ: BAGUS GOLKA(バグース ゴルカ)、銀座8-10-17 銀座.en: Tabelog: BAGUS GOLKA, Ginza 8-10-17, Ginza Southern Building 4F–6F, 4 minutes from JR Shinbashi Station Ginza exit and Ginza Station exit A3; 133 seats (fully private rooms); daily 18:00–5:00; 10% service charge after 22:00 depending on the plan; opened September 1, 2014; official site bagus-99.com. 2026 reviews: every room a private karaoke room; 3 hours of all-you-can-drink about ¥6,000; entering by 19:30, a course with 3 hours of all-you-can-sing and all-you-can-drink about ¥8,000; pricier late at night; chestnut mousse and shrimp amuse; bonito tataki carpaccio with truffle-ponzu jelly; persimmon, jamón serrano and ricotta salad; pizza; drinks ordered by phone.

食べログ: BANCO、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-9-26 はり重大宝寺店1F、心.en: Tabelog: BANCO, Harijyu Daihoji Shop 1F, 1-9-26 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk west of Shinsaibashi Station; daily 12:00–2:00 next morning; cards and e-money accepted; smoking allowed; 20 seats; terrace seats. Reviews (June 2023 – July 2026): north side of Amemura, on Daikokubashi-suji; double espresso; espresso ¥363, doppio ¥440, cappuccino doppio ¥583 (2024); house tiramisu; panini; doria; desserts about ¥500; beer from midday; plenty of alcohol; widely spaced tables; the ease of being left alone; smoking allowed inside; no toilet, staff point you to one nearby; one found the interior getting cluttered; PayPay accepted.

食べログ: BAR暖炉 人形町、バー、パブ、日本橋人形町2-11-4 三ツ矢ビル.en: Tabelog: BAR Danro Ningyocho, bar, pub; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-11-4, 1F; 2 min walk from Ningyocho Station exit A1; Mon–Sat and the days before and after holidays 18:00–3:00, holidays 18:00–24:00; closed Sunday; reservations accepted; 10% service charge, no table charge; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 17 seats (7 at the counter, 10 at tables); smoking allowed; opened 11 March 2008; taco rice on cauliflower rice; fish and chips. Reviews (January 2017–May 2026): a hideaway at the end of an alley; a friendly master; whisky in Baccarat glasses; cocktails about ¥1,000; an English menu; open late; tables for small groups too.

食べログ: BEar Terrace、銀座7-7-12 銀座STEPS 4F、新.en: Tabelog: BEar Terrace, Ginza 7-7-12, Ginza STEPS 4F, 3 minutes from Shinbashi Station; 8 seats; weekdays 18:30–5:00, closed weekends and holidays; cards, IC and QR accepted; bistro & bar. 2026 reviews: a back lane of Ginza 7-chome, about 4 counter seats and a terrace, a private terrace room with sofas, Margherita and Bolognese (about ¥2,400), cheese grated on until you say stop, music, ¥2,000–5,000.

食べログ: Bar La Copita、新橋2-20-15 新橋駅前ビル一号館B.en: Tabelog: Bar La Copita, Shinbashi 2-20-15, Shimbashi Ekimae Building 1, B1F, 1 minute from Shinbashi Station; 16 seats; weekdays 17:00–23:30, Sat 16:00–22:00, closed Sundays and holidays; charge ¥400 (tax incl.); opened March 18, 2015; cards and PayPay accepted. Shop introduction: a cheerful owner; the recommendation is shrimp ajillo; wine by the glass from ¥550. Reviews (2024–2026): Spanish beer, jamón, oil sardines, marinated sardines, warm potato salad, mushroom ajillo, sausages, fries, nuts and olives, ¥2,000–4,000.

食べログ: Bar 凛ト、バー、中京区先斗町四条上ル柏屋町173-2 B1F、祇.en: Tabelog: Bar 凛ト, bar; 中京区先斗町四条上ル柏屋町173-2 B1F; 1 min on foot from Gion-Shijo Station exit 4 and Kawaramachi Station exit 1A; daily 17:00–2:00, closed only on 1 January; reservations taken; 20 seats (9 at the counter); private room (6 people); smoking allowed; cards and QR payments accepted; free Wi-Fi; views and night views. Reviews (2025–2026, in English): a white noren and lantern on Pontocho, stairs down, a counter with a window onto the Kamo River, "Nise Denki Bran" from Tomihiko Morimi's novels, cocktails with a house tea liqueur, cocktails about ¥1,600, a bartender fluent in English, a sister bar of Nostalgia.

食べログ: Bella Locanda Italiana、レストラン、大阪市淀川.en: Tabelog: Bella Locanda Italiana; restaurant; 1-7-31 Nishimiyahara, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, in the Holiday Inn & Suites Shin-Osaka; 10 minutes on foot from exit 4 of Shin-Osaka Station (Midosuji Line); daily 11:30–21:30 (last order 21:00); reservations accepted; cards and e-money accepted, no QR; 60 seats; whole hire for 20 to over 50; non-smoking; parking (vehicles up to 1.5 m tall); wheelchair accessible; Wi-Fi; English menu; English-speaking staff; sommelier; children welcome; kids' menu; vegetarian and vegan options; breakfast; takeaway; hotel restaurant; opened 22 December 2025. Plans (tax included): half-buffet lunch with all-you-can-eat vegetables and pizza and a drink bar ¥2,000; Christmas lunch buffet ¥3,000; dinner buffet of roast beef and sweets ¥5,500 (21–26 December). Reviews (June to October 2026): free shuttle bus; afternoon tea ¥5,500 (grape, chestnut); melty tiramisu; made by hand in the hotel kitchen; cake set ¥1,300; Italian course with all-you-can-drink ¥6,000; T-bone steak; a lunch shown on TV; salad bar; chili con carne with soy meat; some found few guests and small portions.

食べログ: Bella Locanda Italiana、大阪市淀川区西宮原1-.en: Tabelog: Bella Locanda Italiana, 西宮原 1-7-31, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, in the Holiday Inn & Suites Shin-Osaka; 10 min from Exit 4 of Shin-Osaka Station (Midosuji Line); daily 11:30–21:30 (last order 21:00); reservations accepted; cards and e-money accepted, no QR payment; 60 seats; private hire available; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; parking (vehicles up to 1.5 m high); children welcome; kids menu; English menu and English-speaking staff; sommelier; takeaway; marked as having vegan and vegetarian options; opened 22 December 2025. The restaurant's introduction: a lunch buffet full of vegetables, seasonal afternoon tea, authentic Italian food, cakes and baked goods to take away, a party plan with T-bone steak. Plans (tax included): half-buffet lunch with a main of your choice ¥2,000; Christmas lunch buffet ¥3,000 and dinner buffet ¥5,500 (21–26 December). Hotel site (under maintenance on 1 November 2026): operated by CREAL HOTELS Inc. Reviews (June to October 2026): vegetable buffet, pizza, bread, chilli con carne with soy meat, pasta, melty tiramisu, grape and chestnut afternoon teas ¥5,500, cake set ¥1,300, T-bone steak course ¥6,000, a free shuttle bus, everything handmade in the hotel kitchen, no preservatives, a woman chef; one diner found it like a business-hotel lobby café.

食べログ: Bistro Sifflet、大阪市西区新町1-14-43、本町駅.en: Tabelog: Bistro Sifflet, 1-14-43 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Hommachi Station (Yotsubashi Line), 6 min from Yotsubashi Station, 7 min from Nishi-Ohashi Station; Mon and Wed 18:00–24:00; Tue, Thu, Fri 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–24:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–14:30 and 18:00–24:00; dinner last order 22:30; no fixed closing days; reservations accepted; please avoid strong perfume; allergies may not be accommodated; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 20 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair access; sommelier on staff; opened 2 March 2018. Shop description: hearty dishes with organic vegetables from partner farms, and natural wine; tasting course ¥7,700, prix fixe ¥5,500, à la carte too. Reviews (November 2025–October 2026): run by one person, relaxed pace; a seven-glass pairing ¥4,400; Niçoise salad; marinated asparagus; Mita pork simmered with white beans in Madeira sauce; US Prime skirt steak with fries; kombu-cured salmon; sous-vide pork tenderloin; Mita pork pâté en croûte; pan-seared yellowtail with tomato sauce; hamburg steak; chilled pumpkin soup; peach compote (+¥300); cheesecake; lunch ¥2,100–4,400; bread refills; next to the Orix Theater; nearly full by 12:00 on a Saturday.

食べログ: Bliss(ぶりす)、新橋1-11-2 I/O 1F、新橋駅3番出口.en: Tabelog: Bliss, Shinbashi 1-11-2, I/O 1F, 1 minute from Shinbashi Station exit 3; 20 seats (8 counter, 12 table); weekdays, days before and after holidays 17:30–23:00, Sat by reservation, closed Sundays and holidays; opened August 8, 2022; official site planbuildingtech-group.com; cards, IC and PayPay accepted. Courses: Hitachi-beef hamburg steak and garlic rice with simmered squid ¥5,800, wagyu steak ¥7,000, Bliss course ¥9,800 (8 dishes). October 2026 reviews: smoked duck with black-tea sauce; sweet potato with Gorgonzola sauce; roast beef; ajillo-style mushroom stew with baguette; special hamburg steak of Hitachi beef and 梅里 pork (demi-glace and cheese); steak with rock salt, onion sauce or kabosu pepper; risotto-style omelet with black truffle and Parmigiano; a good wine list; the owner grills in front of you.

食べログ: Boeuf 彩、洋食、日本橋人形町1-1-6 松和人形町ビル B1F.en: Tabelog: Boeuf Aya, yoshoku; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 1-1-6, B1F, 4 min walk from Ningyocho Station; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–23:00; closed Sat, Sun and holidays; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 19 seats; smoking allowed; wine; opened 20 August 2013; website boeuf-aya.com. Reviews (November 2025–October 2026): lunch sets A, B and C all ¥1,300 with salad, soup and rice, large rice free; set B is hamburg steak, shrimp fry, crab cream croquette and Neapolitan pasta; the hamburg sauce changes weekly (tomato, demi-glace, pepper, Japanese grated daikon); cooked to order; full of office workers at lunch; some said it is pricey for the portion and turnover is slow.

食べログ: Bon、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-10-7 ギャラリー香ビル5F、06-.en: Tabelog: Bon, Gallery Kaori Bldg 5F, 1-10-7 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6212-7760; reservations accepted; daily 11:30–19:00 (L.O. 18:30); QR (PayPay) accepted; 15 seats; site kdtp400.gorp.jp. Reviews (2011–2026): up the lift to the 5th floor, the bustle of Dotonbori feels far away; a quiet, calm space; a half-cheese, half-chocolate cake set; diagonally opposite Shochikuza; a gallery on the ground floor and paintings inside too; for meeting before a show; mixed juice; one member of staff; in December 2025 the home-made pudding was good and the staff kind; in August 2026 iced tea and matcha milk for ¥600–700; one found it unfriendly.

食べログ: CADRAN、銀座5-8-1 銀座プレイス7F、銀座駅A4出口直結、.en: Tabelog: CADRAN, Ginza 5-8-1, Ginza Place 7F, directly connected to Ginza Station exit A4; 90 seats (8 counter, 26 terrace), 2 private rooms; weekdays 11:30–15:00, 17:00–23:00, Sat 11:30–23:00, Sundays and holidays 11:30–22:00; some closed days in August; opened November 28, 2023; operator zetton.co.jp. Shop introduction: modern French overlooking Ginza; seasonal ingredients; courses and à la carte; open terrace. October 2026 reviews: Ginza Mitsukoshi and the clock tower from the terrace; lunch course ¥5,500; slow when busy; light seasoning, mostly white fish; conger-eel tempura; grilled fish; meat dishes; beautiful plating and tableware; birthday cake.

食べログ: CARNE asaeda、大阪市西区新町1-2-5、四ツ橋駅から北へ.en: Tabelog: CARNE asaeda, Shinmachi 1-2-5, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min on foot north of Yotsubashi Stn, 6 min from Shinsaibashi Stn; Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, public holidays and the days before and after 18:00–23:00 (L.O. food 22:00, drinks 22:30); Sat 15:00–23:00; Sun 15:00–22:00 (L.O. food 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed Wednesday; reservations accepted; for guests who drink alcohol only; no children, to prevent passive smoking (heated-tobacco smoking area); no cards or e-money, PayPay and Rakuten Pay accepted; service charge ¥200; 20 seats (30 standing); private hire up to 20; English menu; Tabelog Asian/Ethnic WEST Top 100 2026; opened 22 June 2021. Shop introduction: lean beef and lamb steaks; signature carne asada; tortillas with house salsa and chili con carne; Latin music; tequila; guacamole, nachos, quesadillas; drinks from ¥400, steaks from ¥3,000, courses from ¥6,000. Reviews (September–October 2026): a glass-fronted shop with a big sign and cacti; rare lean carne asada with tortillas; chili con carne; jalapeño pickles; mashed potato; salsa; spiced beans with sansho; spicy takuan; shibire chicken in a sansho sauce; ethnic salad; chili-cheese quesadilla; pulled-chicken nachos; spiced gizzards; michelada; cardamom shochu; salt potato salad; a red-meat and lamb steak course with all-you-can-drink ¥7,000 and a curry to finish; a comment that the menu is short; nights when it is fully booked.

食べログ: CASABLANCA NAMBA RIVERSIDE、大阪市中央区西.en: Tabelog: CASABLANCA NAMBA RIVERSIDE, S-Front Dotonbori 1F, 2-6-7 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 050-5570-2869; reservations accepted (mention allergies, vegan or vegetarian requests, or wanting the terrace with a dog when booking); daily 7:00–24:00 (food L.O. 23:00, drinks L.O. 23:30); cards, e-money (iD, QUICPay) and QR payment accepted; 52 seats (terrace 24); no smoking; English menu and English-speaking staff; opened 10 July 2025. Shop's description: authentic Middle Eastern and Mediterranean food, a vegan menu too, plenty of vegetarian, gluten-free and vegan dishes, house-roasted coffee. 2026 reviews (August–October): falafel pita sandwich; grilled-chicken shawarma; house-made fries; river view; English breakfast; bacon-and-egg croissant; domestic-corn tartine (rye bread, grilled corn, hummus, avocado, tomato, marinated onion; vegan); caffè latte; lunch even before 16:00; a foreign atmosphere.

食べログ: CHEONGANG 韓国料理、韓国料理、大阪市淀川区西三国2-3-7.en: Tabelog: CHEONGANG Korean, Korean, 2-3-7 Nishimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 7 min from Hankyu Mikuni Station; Mon and Wed–Sun 11:00–22:00; closed Tuesday; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR (incl. PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted; 17 seats; smoking area for heated tobacco only; children welcome; opened 13 October 2024. Reviews (March 2025 to September 2026): on the corner of the shopping street; full before noon; order by QR code; lunch until 15:00; sundubu (chicken thigh, offal, pork kimchi, seafood), spice level 1 to 5; raw egg; three side dishes and rice; ramen sundubu with offal ¥1,350; cold noodles, bulgogi, bibimbap; samgyeopsal brought to the table grilled; at night a kimchi platter, bossam, stir-fried offal, sotteok sotteok, "Bomb Gyeran-jjim", dakhanmari, kimchi cheese jeon, spicy octopus and samgyeopsal ¥1,680 each, seafood jeon, japchae, jumeokbap to finish, makgeolli; dinner sometimes fully booked.

食べログ: CHIKAPPA 谷4店、大阪市中央区常磐町1-3-18 谷4ビル.en: Tabelog: CHIKAPPA Tani 4, Tani 4 Bldg 1F, 1-3-18 Tokiwamachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 241 m from Tanimachi-Yonchome Station; daily 11:00–14:30 and 18:00–23:00; opened 14 May 2025; cards, PayPay and Rakuten Pay accepted; children welcome. Reviews (October 2025 – October 2026): Hakata tonkotsu; white tonkotsu; black tonkotsu with black mayu; RED; thin straight noodles (soft to bari-kata); wood-ear; leek; nori; thick, tender chashu; unlimited takana and red pickled ginger on the table; half fried rice and 2-karaage set; fried rice; lively service; one found it bland and the karaage oily.

食べログ: COFFEE & BAR gg KURAMAE エキュート上野店、上.en: Tabelog: COFFEE & BAR gg KURAMAE ecute Ueno, Ueno 7-1-1, inside the JR Ueno Station ticket gates, 3F; daily 9:00–21:00; no reservations; 10 seats; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB), transport IC and PayPay accepted; opened 24 April 2025. Reviews (August–October 2026): the station branch of a popular Kuramae café; bear-shaped bottles (you can take them home); iced café latte ¥700; orange tea ¥720; cheesecake; matcha latte (bear bottle) ¥830; café latte ¥700; milk tea ¥720; few seats, sometimes a wait; bear goods; Earl Grey; honey-butter toast on Pelican bread; affogato; one said the scones were reheated rather than freshly baked; a drink in the bear container about ¥850 (glass about ¥1,200); staff rinse the container for you.

食べログ: COLAVOLTA、大阪市天王寺区生玉前町4-20 レナジア四天王寺.en: Tabelog: COLAVOLTA, Renazia Shitennoji 1F, 4-20 Ikutamamaemachi, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk south from Tanimachi-Kyuchome Station exit 5; Sun, Mon and holidays 18:30–0:30 next morning (L.O. 0:00), Tue 11:45–14:30 and 18:30–0:30, Wed–Thu 11:45–14:30 and 18:30–1:30 (L.O. 1:00), Fri–Sat 11:45–14:30 and 18:30–2:30 (L.O. 2:00); daily opening on Instagram; 20% late-night surcharge from 22:00; no cards; PayPay and Alipay accepted; 34 seats (counter 9, tables 24). Reviews (January–October 2026): tomato ramen made with 8 tomatoes; curry ramen; keema-curry ramen (thin or thick noodles); tsukemen (choose a dipping soup, such as a rich spicy one; a limited mushroom tsukemen with balsamic); summer cold salt-lemon ramen; evening set ¥1,000 (keema-curry ramen and seared chashu rice bowl); winged pan-fried gyoza; karaage with tartare; grilled salted tomato with garlic chips; fries with a choice of salt; butter-shoyu potatoes; fried rice; private-hire party course (2-hour all-you-can-drink ¥3,980); coupons; one found the dipping soup salty.

食べログ: COLONY by EQI、カフェ・パンケーキ・ケーキ、大阪市中央区.en: Tabelog: COLONY by EQI, café, pancakes and cake, オーシャンドライブ314 1F, Nishi-Shinsaibashi 2-12-14, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 6 minutes from Shinsaibashi and Yotsubashi stations; daily 11:00–23:00; open year-round (may vary at New Year); reservations accepted; cash only (no cards, e-money or QR payment); 45 seats (5 counter, 2 box seats); terrace; non-smoking; English menu; opened 30 June 2017; official site colonybyeqi.com. A sweets and brunch café by pastry chefs and cooks. Reviews (November 2025–September 2026): white soufflé pancakes ¥1,480, +¥200 for lots of strawberries, rich chocolate pancakes ¥1,880, matcha tiramisu pancakes, pure-white rare-cheese parfait, strawberry and pistachio parfait, strawberry shortcake, mille-feuille, tart, tomato and cheese omurice ¥1,390, many foreign guests, English-speaking staff, one reviewer noticed a restroom smell.

食べログ: CRUZ BURGERS & CRAFT BEERS、ハンバーガー・.en: Tabelog: CRUZ BURGERS & CRAFT BEERS, hamburgers, beer bar, dining bar; 小椋ビル 1F, Yotsuya Sanei-cho 15-6; 5 min walk from Yotsuya Station; Mon and Thu–Sun 11:30–15:30 (last order 15:00) and 17:30–21:00 (last order 20:30); closed Tue and Wed; reservations from 17:30; one dish and one drink per person; 120-minute limit; no strollers; 20 seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; Hamburger Tabelog 100 2017, 2018, 2019, 2021, 2026; hand-cut domestic beef patties grilled on lava stone; long-fermented French-style buns; house-smoked bacon; Noble Bacon Cheese ¥2,380; teriyaki cheese egg ¥1,980; BBQ pulled-pork plate ¥2,480 (dinner only); five Japanese American-style craft beers. Reviews (October 2026): weekday lunch set ¥1,680, steak-like patties, lines since a YouTube feature, pulled pork recommended by Nobuyuki Sakuma.

食べログ: Cafe Morning Box(旧店名 コーヒーポート大阪スタンド.en: Tabelog: Cafe Morning Box (formerly Coffee Port Osaka Stand), HOTEL MORNING BOX 1F, 1-10-3 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6243-0777; no reservations; daily 8:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); cards and QR (PayPay, d-barai) accepted, no e-money; 33 seats (1F 7 tables; 2F counter 5, tables 14, sofas 4); no smoking; opened 7 July 2020. Shop's description: specialty coffee in a hotel lobby; spend ¥600 or more to use the hotel lounge (power outlets); organic and vegan deli lunch plates; additive-free baked goods by an artisan (changing daily); the carrot cake is popular. 2026 reviews (July–October): weekend-only peach and black-tea rice-flour French toast (mascarpone, caramel sauce; bookable in the afternoon); vegan baked goods and meals; seasonal carrot cake (cinnamon); banana caramel salt muffin; rice-flour canelé; hojicha latte; eggs Benedict ¥1,800 (one likened it to ham and eggs); two floors; people working on laptops; a calm atmosphere by Nagahoribashi Station.

食べログ: Cafe NooNe、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-14-14 T.Kビル.en: Tabelog: Cafe NooNe, T.K Bldg 1F, 1-14-14 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Nagahoribashi stations; daily 11:00–20:00; opened 31 May 2021; no reservations; cards and e-money accepted, no QR; no smoking; 20 table seats; terrace seats. Reviews (March–July 2026): a stylish Korean-style cafe; claim a seat first, then choose from the case; Dubai chocolate mochi ¥740 (springy outside, pistachio and crunchy texture inside; check Instagram stories for sold-out days); Dubai cookie ¥920; brûlée cheesecake with ice cream ¥980; pumpkin Basque cheesecake ¥820; brownie cheesecake; blueberry cheesecake; strawberry-matcha shortcake ¥900; Earl Grey shortcake; bear sablé ¥400; iced coffee ¥550; orange and grapefruit ades; on Uber Eats too; an Amemura shop too; one found service slow; one found a cookie a little stale.

食べログ: Cafe＆Dining ballo ballo 銀座店(カフェアンド.en: Tabelog: Cafe & Dining ballo ballo Ginza, Ginza-nishi 3-1, Chuo-ku, Ginza Inz 1, 2F, directly connected to Ginza Station exit C9; 85 seats; Mon and Tue 11:30–15:00, 17:00–22:30, Wed–Fri until 23:00, Sat and days before holidays 11:30–23:00, Sundays and holidays 11:30–22:30; closed when Ginza Inz is; opened November 15, 2012; particular about fish; allergen labeling; operator sld-inc.com. Shop introduction: melting cheese dishes; chewy oven-baked pizza; soft sofa seats and semi-private rooms. October 2026 reviews: generous pizza and salad; ajillo full of ingredients; fluffy omurice (choice of two sauces; weekday-only ¥1,380 with soup, salad and a drink); aged-cheese Bolognese (thick noodles); cheese grated on until you say stop; birthday plates; order by QR code; PayPay accepted.

食べログ: Café Hapje、大阪市西区北堀江1-1-25 1F、四ツ橋駅3.en: Tabelog: Café Hapje, 1F, 1-1-25 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exit 3; daily 10:00–18:00 (food L.O. 17:30); no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; 13 seats; children and pushchairs welcome; takeaway; power and Wi-Fi; opened 15 May 2016; Brussels waffles baked with Belgian ingredients; an unsweetened batter with Belgian butter; official site. Reviews (July–October 2026): photo captions say 'Brussels waffle (¥600)', 'Americano (¥540)', '(¥100 off as a set)'; baked to order; crisp and light rather than chewy; icing sugar; cold sweet-potato brûlée waffle ¥1,400; espresso shake ¥600; waffle with pudding and vanilla ice cream; choice of chocolate; seasonal fruit; an butter; caffè latte; one found the cream below expectations.

食べログ: Caveau SenTir par Shinya Tasaki、銀座.en: Tabelog: Caveau SenTir par Shinya Tasaki, Ginza 6-16-11, Ginza 山本 Building B1F, 5 minutes from Higashi-Ginza and Tsukiji-shijo stations; 12 seats (8 counter, 4 table); irregular hours; reservations only; prices before tax, no service charge; cards, IC and QR accepted; opened March 21, 2026; dress code smart casual; asks guests to avoid strong perfume. Shop introduction: produced by Shinya Tasaki, honorary president of the Japan Sommelier Association; courses of seasonal ingredients and French technique, paired with wine and original drinks. Lunch courses ¥6,600 and ¥13,200. 2026 reviews: on the former site of Le Jardin des Saveurs; a half-moon counter; wine by the glass from ¥500 (imported directly by Santir); walk-in lunch ¥3,300; chef Ryota Tochigi (English spelling); quail and foie gras mousse; seafood soup risotto; Amagi shamo braised in vin jaune; Fuji no Suke tartare and rillettes; coq au vin; mirabelle tartlet.

食べログ: DONDON (お好みハウス ドンドン)、お好み焼き・鉄板焼き・居酒.en: Tabelog: DONDON (お好みハウス ドンドン), okonomiyaki, teppanyaki and izakaya, 6-3-32 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, 第２新大阪ビル 1F; 7 min from Shin-Osaka Station, 7 min from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station and Hankyu Minamikata Station; Mon–Sat 17:00–02:00, closed Sunday; reservations by phone after 16:30; whole-shop parties of 13 to 19; cards, PayPay and d Barai accepted, no e-money; 19 seats (7 at the counter, 3 tables of 4); smoking allowed; wheelchair accessible; English menu; takeaway and delivery; opening date 1 May 1982. The shop's introduction: established 46 years, fluffy okonomiyaki made with several kinds of nagaimo and spices, domestic ingredients, an original sauce, body-friendly ingredients. Remarks: additive-free Hamamatsu gyoza made with a patented garlic that leaves no smell. Reviews (December 2025 to October 2026): run by a couple; the owner grills the okonomiyaki in the back and they arrive piping hot; pork and octopus, pork kimchi, beef tendon and green onion, omelette yakisoba, salt yakisoba, squid with butter, king oyster mushroom with butter, suji-yaki, sweet sauce with mustard, a batter tasting of dashi; almost full at 23:30; a "Medical Menu" on the wall.

食べログ: Dos Tios、銀座8-7-11 ソワレド銀座第二弥生ビルB1F、.en: Tabelog: Dos Tios, Ginza 8-7-11, Soiree de Ginza 第二弥生 Building B1F, 4–5 minutes from Shinbashi Station; 16 seats (counter, tables, semi-private); weekdays 18:00–2:30, closed weekends and holidays; 10% service charge and ¥1,000 charge after 20:30; opened February 1, 2023; cards and IC accepted. 2026 reviews: a quiet basement Spanish bar in Ginza 8-chome among clubs and bars; carpaccio, ajillo, steak, salad, almonds; affordable, plentiful Spanish wine; about ¥10,000 with a three-glass wine pairing; rum tasting; a friendly master.

食べログ: Drape 東京會舘(ドレープ)、千代田区有楽町1-5-2 東宝日比.en: Tabelog: Drape Tokyo Kaikan, Yurakucho 1-5-2, Chiyoda-ku, 東宝 Hibiya Promenade Building 2F, directly connected to Hibiya Station exit A5; 52 seats (including 12 counter); daily 11:00–21:00 (lunch L.O. 14:30, dinner L.O. 20:00); 2-hour limit when busy; service charge; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; opened March 16, 2023. 2026 reviews: run by Tokyo Kaikan; the famous marron chantilly; daily cake (chestnut) with black tea; weekend lunch course (a salad-style hors d'oeuvre with herring, pork fillet in Marsala sauce, a dessert platter); drinks including plenty of non-alcoholic ones; an open space with big windows.

食べログ: ENOTECA GARBINO、銀座3-3-12 銀座ビルディングB.en: Tabelog: ENOTECA GARBINO, Ginza 3-3-12, Ginza Building B1F, 1 minute from Ginza Station exit C8; weekdays 11:30–14:30, 18:00–22:00 (bar 22:00–23:00), Sat 11:30–14:30, 18:00–22:00, holidays and days before holidays until 23:30, closed Sun; bar menu only after 20:30; no lunch reservations; ¥400 table charge at dinner; opened June 21, 2021; official site garbino-ginza.com. Shop introduction: Kumamoto black wagyu "和王"; "佐助 pork" direct from Kuji Farm in Iwate; seafood direct from fishermen; seasonal vegetables; over 100 Italian and French wines (10 by the glass); a private room for up to 16. 2026 reviews: sea-bass carpaccio; mortadella and 佐助 pork; fried scallop topped with caviar; truffle pasta; red-wine braise; reopened after renovation; salad and orecchiette at lunch; courses must be decided in advance.

食べログ: ESPRIT C. KEI GINZA(エスプリ セー ケイ ギンザ.en: Tabelog: ESPRIT C. KEI GINZA, Ginza 7-8-17, Toraya Ginza Building 11F; 30 seats (12 counter, 12 table, 1 private room); Tue–Sat and holidays 17:30–23:00, closed Sun and Mon; 12% service charge; opened April 20, 2024; official site maisonkei.jp. Shop introduction: a collaboration between Kei Kobayashi (English spelling), a Michelin three-star chef in France, and 500-year-old Toraya; "a laboratory of gastronomy"; build your own course from the à la carte; crystal caviar. October 2026 reviews: a big open kitchen; olive oil and shiso sorbet; muscat, cheese and prosciutto; a pie of cheese petals; Toraya monaka with caviar and snow crab; tomato and cream sorbet; clams with anchovy; Ezo venison; abalone with bamboo charcoal; chawanmushi full of matsutake; matsutake spring rolls; fried lobster; financier of Toraya bean paste; omakase too.

食べログ: El Rincon (エルリンコン)、スペイン料理、下京区神明町72.en: Tabelog: El Rincon; Spanish; 神明町724, Shimogyo-ku; 4 min walk from exit 19 of Hankyu Karasuma Stn; Wed–Sun 17:00–23:00; closed Monday and Tuesday; bookings taken (seats may be free by phone even when online shows full); 20 seats (two tables of 4, counter of 4); private rooms for 2 and 4; semi-private room up to 6; no smoking; children welcome; English menu; cards and PayPay; opened 1 May 2018. Reviews (May 2021 – October 2026, in English): lunch in 2021 (Barcelona lunch course ¥1,800, Tamba chicken paella lunch ¥1,300, Friday to Sunday only); paella; pasta paella; octopus ajillo; jamón; lamb, pork and beef from the charcoal grill; cheese platter; carpaccio; cava; cave-like half-basement private rooms; run by one person in 2022; in September 2026 the cook seemed uninterested and staff chatter was bothersome; in October 2026 the paella was too salty.

食べログ: FUKUSHIMA COFFEE&Cafe de Rope、大阪市浪.en: Tabelog: FUKUSHIMA COFFEE&Cafe de Rope, Nishi-Namba Grand Bldg, 1-4-18 Inari, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 445 m from JR Namba Stn; Tue–Sat and public holidays 8:00–16:00; closed Sunday and Monday, and over long holidays such as the summer break and Golden Week; cards, transport IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay and QR payments; 20 seats; counter; terrace; non-smoking (terrace and e-cigarettes included); wheelchair accessible; Wi-Fi; children welcome but not noisy ones; coin parking nearby; opened 13 October 1988. Company site: the roaster and in-house-roasting café Cafe de Rope run by Fukushima Coffee Co.; roasters from several makers on display, test roasting possible; a takeaway coffee stand; sells coffee beans, coffee bags and café-au-lait base; head office (café department, Cafe de Rope) at Nishi-Namba Grand Bldg 1F, 1-4-18 Inari; representative 福島建三; Japan sole agent for DIEDRICH. Reviews (February 2024–February 2026): there used to be lunch delivery, rice dishes, salads and cold noodles, now only toast and sandwiches; the owner makes them right after the order; a FUJI ROYAL roaster; ¥250 to take away, ¥300 to sit in; boiled egg ¥50; half a banana ¥50; hot dog ¥200; egg and cheese toast ¥400; mixed juice ¥550; mixed cheese toast ¥450; tamagoyaki sandwich ¥400; hot coffee ¥350; roomy seating at the back; power outlets at the counter; one diner has come since before getting married.

食べログ: Firmamento、イタリアン、シェフは1990年生まれ、Kana.en: Tabelog: Firmamento, Italian; the chef was born in 1990 and comes from Kanagawa; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-7-13, Reiforia Ningyocho 3F; 2 min walk from Ningyocho Station exit A3, 4 min from Suitengumae Station exit 7; Mon–Sat and holidays 19:00–23:00; closed Sunday; irregular closures; 10% service charge; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 8 seats (counter); non-smoking; opened 4 September 2025; website firmamento.tokyo; Firmamento means "sky" in Italian; Japanese ingredients and seasons through Italian cooking. Reviews (November 2025–September 2026): chef Yuya Daisako (also written Taisako and Oisako) trained at ICARO, GUCCI Osteria Tokyo and Ryugin; sommelier Katsuya Kuwahara; the course is about ¥25,000 (formerly about ¥22,000); panelle of aged Tokushima squid, abalone suppli, Rishiri sea-urchin sformato, eel risotto, pappardelle with soft-shell turtle and matsutake; wine pairing; the menu changes about every two months; some said many dishes repeated, and one found an odour in the suckling pig.

食べログ: Flip up! (フリップアップ)、パン・ベーグル・サンドイッチ、.en: Tabelog: Flip up!, bread, bagels and sandwiches, 中京区押小路通室町東入ル蛸薬師町292-2, 4 min on foot from Karasuma-Oike Stn; Mon–Sat 7:00–18:00, Sun 7:00–16:00, until sold out; no seats (takeaway only); reservations accepted; cards, transport IC and PayPay accepted; Bread Tabelog 100 2017–2019; Bread WEST Tabelog 100 2020, 2022, 2026. Reviews (October–November 2026, in English): a small shop going for 22 years, domestic and imported wheat with its own natural yeast, more than ten kinds of bagel, a heart-shaped cream bun ¥150, sold out by lunchtime.

食べログ: Furutoshi、銀座4-9-2 ソラリア西鉄ホテル銀座2F、東銀.en: Tabelog: Furutoshi, Ginza 4-9-2, Solaria Nishitetsu Hotel Ginza 2F, 3 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station; 48 seats; weekdays 7:00–10:00, 11:30–15:00, 17:30–22:00, Sat lunch until 17:00, Sundays and holidays dinner until 21:00; open every day (following the hotel); course L.O. 13:30 at lunch, 20:30 at dinner; opened September 22, 2011; official site furutoshi-ginza.com. Shop introduction: over 20 years in Nishi-Azabu and Ginza; grown-up casual Italian with safe, reliable ingredients; all-you-can-drink with sparkling wine or draft beer; a luxurious double-main course. 2026 reviews: Standard Plan A (6 dishes, choose pasta and main); potato soup with grissini; 5 starters (sakura-shrimp quiche, terrine, mackerel, dried-fruit bruschetta, Shine Muscat with mozzarella and prosciutto); sweet-potato potage; house focaccia; smoked yellowtail; generous portions; tasty vegetables; casual atmosphere.

食べログ: G.L.B(グリーン・ライフ・ビギニング)、大阪市西区北堀江1-9-.en: Tabelog: G.L.B (Green Life Beginning), Oceans Bldg 1F, 1-9-15 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka, 06-6536-2236; no reservations; daily 10:00–19:30, open every day of the year; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; no cover charge; 29 seats (counter 5, tables 12, sofas 12); no smoking; opened 1 August 2017; dogs allowed on the terrace and near the entrance inside. Shop's description: a salad specialist committed to additive-free and vegan food; vegetables bought in daily from around the country; all house-made dressings additive-free and vegan (no white sugar, eggs, dairy, honey or animal products); MCT oil in the coconut dressing; gluten-free lemon cake (domestic lemons, pistachio); vegan chocolate-chip cookies; plant-based lattes with soy, oat or almond milk; roast-beef 'ANGE'; avocado 'IRIS'; eco-friendly containers. 2026 reviews (April–August): sofa seats; takeaway available; breakfast plate (salad, eggs, sausage, prosciutto, 2 kinds of bread, soy-milk soup); self-service, order at the counter; gapao rice and herb-chicken bowl (multigrain rice); Miranda salad (salmon and boiled egg) with coconut-lemon oil dressing; a 28-ingredient plate; dogs welcome.

食べログ: GINZA BRIO(ギンザ ブリオ)、銀座7-6-10 アソルティ.en: Tabelog: GINZA BRIO, Ginza 7-6-10, Assorti Ginza Hanatsubaki-dori Building 7F; 31 seats (6 in a fully private room, 18 table, 7 counter); weekdays 17:30–22:00, closed weekends and holidays; opened October 1, 2021; official site ginzabrio.com. Shop introduction: French-style yōshoku to go with wine, by a French chef; courses and à la carte. 2026 reviews: Chita highball; charcoal-grilled Hitachi-beef fillet; light Italian-style dishes as a second stop; a calm grown-up space; friendly staff; beautiful tableware and plating; small portions; wish the dishes were explained more.

食べログ: GINZA FUJIMARU(フレンチ鉄板)、銀座4-10-1 銀座.en: Tabelog: GINZA FUJIMARU (French teppan), Ginza 4-10-1, Ginza AZA Building 6F, 2 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station exit A2; 8 counter seats; lunch 12:00–15:00 (last entry 13:00), dinner 18:00–22:30 (last entry 20:00); reservations only; closed 1st and 3rd Tuesdays and Wednesdays; 10% service charge; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; opened October 10, 2019; 7th anniversary. Shop introduction: French food by chef Fujimaru, particular about sauces. 2026 reviews: the menu changes about every two months; Saga-beef prosciutto with churros and summer truffle; eel and foie gras in black-truffle sauce; corn mousse with uni; abalone in saffron sauce; black-wagyu fillet; to finish, house European-style curry with butter rice (frozen curry sauce to take home ¥1,500); house-roasted cold-brew coffee; a menu with your name on it.

食べログ: GINZA TAPPO(ギンザ タッポ)、銀座8-7-16 YAD.en: Tabelog: GINZA TAPPO, Ginza 8-7-16, YAD GINZA8 Building 6F; 16 seats (3 counter, 7 table, 6 private room); Mon 18:00–23:00, Tue–Fri 11:45–14:00, 18:00–23:00, Sat and holidays 17:00–22:00 (open if booked by 14:00 that day), closed Sun; opened June 4, 2021. Shop introduction: TAPPO is Italian for cork; over 200 wines, mainly Tuscan; an owner who loves Chianti Classico; recommended course ¥6,000 (3 starters, a small pasta, a meat dish). 2026 reviews: weekday lunch of a big salad (house dressing and pickles) and pasta, a small dessert; lampredotto and spinach penne ¥1,400; iced coffee +¥100; about four pastas and risottos; wine by the glass chosen to your taste; regulars from when it was on Corridor-gai; a private-hire space next door.

食べログ: GOOD CHEESE GOOD PIZZA 日比谷、千代田区有楽町.en: Tabelog: GOOD CHEESE GOOD PIZZA Hibiya, Yurakucho 1-1-2, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo Midtown Hibiya 2F, 2 minutes from Hibiya Station; 106 seats (56 inside, 10 counter, 40 terrace); Mon–Wed 11:00–15:30, 17:00–22:30, Thu and Fri 11:00–14:30, 17:00–22:30, weekends and holidays 11:00–22:30; opened March 29, 2018; allergen labeling. Shop introduction: a workshop making cheese from freshly drawn milk; mozzarella, ricotta, burrata; seasonal starters and mains; terrace. October 2026 reviews: pizza and a cheese platter; carpaccio; garlicky tomato pizza; friendly staff; a bit pricey with drinks.

食べログ: GOPAN銀座、有楽町1-2-4(ファミリーマートから入る)、6席、.en: Tabelog: GOPAN Ginza, Yurakucho 1-2-4 (enter through the FamilyMart); 6 seats; Mon, Wed, Thu, Fri 11:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–15:00, closed weekends and holidays; cards, IC and PayPay accepted. Reviews: "gohan" (rice) and "pan" (bread); sandwich bread (set with mini salad and potatoes); daily rice bowl; curry on Wednesdays (in 2024 keema ¥680 + soft-boiled egg ¥100); pulled pork; in 2026 taco rice ¥780; banana frappé ¥450, blend coffee ¥350 (¥100 off if you bring your sleeve).

食べログ: GREEN BAR 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-7-4、20席.en: Tabelog: GREEN BAR Shinsaibashi, 2-7-4 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 20 seats; daily 11:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); closed only on 1 January; no smoking; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; features: vegetables, healthy, vegetarian menu; opened 14 November 2014. 2023–2026 reviews: run by Urban Research; matcha crêpe ¥700 (shiratama); caffè latte; hojicha latte; green smoothie of komatsuna, apple and banana; seasonal peach smoothie; run single-handed, so sometimes a wait; a hideaway-like eat-in space; one found the till service curt; smoothies of fresh vegetables and fruit; bagels; the inside is small, better for takeaway.

食べログ: GUFO、大阪市西区北堀江1-11-9 U+ビル 1F、四ツ橋駅から.en: Tabelog: GUFO, U+ Bldg 1F, 1-11-9 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 162 m from Yotsubashi Station; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 12:00–18:00; closed Wednesdays; cards (JCB, AMEX) and e-money accepted, no QR; no smoking; 6 seats; children and pushchairs welcome; takeaway; opened 29 April 2016; official site. October 2026 reviews: a light soft-serve full of fine air; milk ¥420; Japanese chestnut ¥540; hazelnut cup ¥520; daily gelato ¥420 (salted vanilla, dried fig and cheese, pumpkin, hojicha, Earl Grey chocolate); one says the portion is generous enough to share; an interior of wood and white tile; short queues form quickly at weekends; photo captions say 'Japanese-chestnut soft-serve', 'pumpkin and pistachio', 'today's ice cream', 'Earl Grey chocolate ¥420'.

食べログ: Gion Duck Noodles 難波店、大阪市中央区千日前2-4.en: Tabelog: Gion Duck Noodles Namba, Sennichimae Bldg, 2-4-10 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 11:00–22:00; closed Wednesdays; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted. 2026 reviews (August–October): a popular shop from Gion, Kyoto; Kishu duck soup; light and rich versions; the salt (clear broth) is amber; budo sansho; house-made noodles blended with German rye; duck breast and leg chashu, choose the number of slices; seasoned egg; Namba-only duck skewers (budo sansho, yuzu, black shichimi); GION DUCK BEER; free refills of Kyoto hojicha; the menu uses emoji; staff explain carefully; tsukemen with sauces of Kishu mikan or cherry; Madeira-wine sauce; flat rye noodles; pink sprouts and edible flowers; one review gives lunch 11:00–16:00 and dinner 18:00–22:00, no cash.

食べログ: Giovanni、銀座8-15-2 銀座パークビル1F、築地市場駅・.en: Tabelog: Giovanni, Ginza 8-15-2, Ginza Park Building 1F, 5 minutes from Tsukiji-shijo and Shiodome stations; 6 counter seats; Mon–Sat 19:00–23:00, closed Sun; cards accepted; chef Yohei Tateno runs it alone. 2026 reviews: trained about three and a half years in Sicily, Italy; opened in Musashi-Koyama in 2019; after moving to Ginza closed for a while, then came back in a back lane of Ginza 8-chome; no sign, a painting marks the spot; Italian food with seasonal Japanese ingredients; omakase ¥77,000 (wine pairing; soft-shell-turtle ravioli from Lake Hamana; torta fritta with prosciutto; cold capellini with caviar; botan shrimp; 万葉 beef tataki; squid-ink risotto; Kobe pork; shrimp pasta; passion-fruit panna cotta); non-alcoholic pairing available; almost always full with regulars.

食べログ: Gluten-Free Healthy Cafe SEREN Pec.en: Tabelog: Gluten-Free Healthy Cafe SEREN Peche Shinsaibashi, Osaka Fukutani Bldg 1F, 2-4-20 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 070-2424-3975; reservations accepted; Mon and Wed–Sun 7:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed Tuesdays; changes for events (Instagram opening calendar); cards (VISA, Master) accepted, no e-money or QR; 20 seats; opened 3 April 2022. Shop's description: a health-minded cafe, gluten-free, additive-free and without white sugar; rice-flour craft burgers and nourishing sweets by day; casual French-style dinner at night. Reviews (April 2025 – February 2026): lemon cake and cheesecake to take away; gluten-free curry; introduced as recipes devised by a physical therapist; fermented-vegetable Buddha bowl; kinako chocolate cake; brown-rice-flour chiffon cake ¥700; oat-milk coffee ¥650; curry with well-balanced spices; rice with quinoa; gluten-free desserts.

食べログ: Guruatsu STAND、松が谷3-8-4、稲荷町駅から徒歩10.en: Tabelog: Guruatsu STAND, Matsugaya 3-8-4; 10 min on foot from Inaricho Station, 15 min from JR Ueno; Wed and Fri 11:30–16:00, closed other days; take-out only; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; vegetable-focused; vegetarian options. Reviews (May 2017–July 2026): tofu and soy-milk muffins and scones; chocolate banana muffin ¥340; matcha and chestnut; beet and white chocolate tofu muffin; soy-milk zunda; salted banana scone; organic vegetable box ¥880; no butter, margarine, eggs, milk, white sugar or preservatives (2018); whole-wheat flour (2018); in 2017 one reviewer called it a gluten-free scone and muffin shop; a chewy, mochi-like texture; popular items sell out by noon; another branch with eat-in closer to Ueno; also sells at the Aoyama Farmers Market.

食べログ: Gyokotsuya 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町4-10 大京.en: Tabelog: Gyokotsuya Dotonbori, Daikyo Bldg 2F, 4-10 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-7777-6068; 16 seats (tables 12, counter 4); Mon and Wed–Sun and holidays 18:00–1:00 next morning (L.O. 0:30); closed Tuesdays; no smoking; cards and e-money accepted; opening date 20 July 2026. October 2026 reviews: one says it opened 12 September; the third shop of 'Gyokotsuya', a members-only ramen shop from Fukuoka, with no membership needed in Ginza and Dotonbori; 2nd floor of a building with luxury-brand shops; fish-bone ramen, fish-bone tsukemen, spicy fish-bone ramen, spicy fish-bone tsukemen; hot pots and sides; rich sea-bream paitan soup; chewy noodles; fried sakura shrimp; grilled rice balls; overseas staff; some ask whether it's worth ¥1,450, one found the soup thin; a modern Japanese space of black and vermilion lattice; 'the sixth taste'; evening-only medicinal hot pot and grilled liver; spicy fish-bone tsukemen ¥1,550; small rice and a flask of dashi; 5 min walk from Nippombashi Station; risotto-style with the leftover soup.

食べログ: G麺、居酒屋・うどん、中京区木屋町通四条上ル下樵町202-1 1F、.en: Tabelog: G Men, izakaya, udon; 下樵町202-1 1F, north of Shijo on Kiyamachi-dori, Nakagyo-ku; every day 19:00–7:00; reservations accepted; 14 seats (counter and tables); smoking allowed; no cards, e-money or QR; homemade noodles and special dashi for the udon; 28 kinds of teppanyaki. Reviews (July 2024–October 2026, in English): curry udon, tempura curry ¥900 (July 2024), egg-drop udon, katsudon, curry ramen, open from late night to early morning, ordering by QR code.

食べログ: HATENA、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-2、06-4704-81.en: Tabelog: HATENA, 1-17-2 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-4704-8107; reservations accepted; daily 17:30–2:00 next morning; open every day of the year; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 100 seats; private hire for 20–50; opened 2 December 2000. 2026 reviews (August–October): a toast with Singha beer; kor moo yang (charcoal-grilled pork jowl); yum woon sen (seafood and glass noodles, lots of vegetables); the last stop of a bar crawl; hot-pot pho; mango pudding and coconut ice cream; fresh spring rolls; stir-fried water spinach; pad thai; spicy even when meant to be mild; sweet milk tea; a short wait when full; prawn crackers; chai; one thinks prices rose a little and portions shrank; gai yang (spicy fish-sauce dip); ground floor counter and tables, 2nd floor large tables; sharing among 2–3 recommended; one wished there were khao man gai.

食べログ: HESTIA GINZA、銀座7-7-7 銀座777ビル2F、新橋駅.en: Tabelog: HESTIA GINZA, Ginza 7-7-7, Ginza 777 Building 2F, 5 minutes from Shinbashi Station Ginza exit and Ginza Station exit A2; 44 seats; six private rooms for 2–8 (semi-private 10%, fully private 20% room charge); Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00, 17:00–23:00, Sun 11:30–15:00, closed on holidays; discuss allergies or disliked foods in advance; opened June 1, 2022; official site hestia-ginza.com. Shop introduction: a medicinal detox soup of luxury mushrooms; A5 Omi beef; wine. 2026 reviews: detox with a mushroom hot pot; felt good the next day; a stylish room; kind staff; lunch from ¥2,000 (cold pasta with seasonal vegetables, mushroom soup, salad, dessert); some say the course is lacking for the price, but the Shinshu-beef rib-roast steak was memorable.

食べログ: HOME STYLE バル 1416、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-13-.en: Tabelog: HOME STYLE Bar 1416, Marine Bldg 1F, 1-13-5 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6281-0107; reservations accepted; Mon–Fri 12:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 18:00–2:00 next morning (L.O. 1:30), Sat, Sun and holidays 18:00–2:00 next morning; open every day of the year; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 21 seats. Shop's description: 'tasty and cheap' standing-bar prices; gluten-free dishes at reasonable prices; for health-minded diners, gluten-free okonomiyaki, ramen and pasta recommended; wines chosen by the owner and seasonal sake; vegan menu. Reviews (April 2023 – December 2025): karaage and egg; sold out at lunch; fried rice; stir-fried offal; nanban; all-you-can-drink ¥980 an hour; karaage and dashimaki set meal ¥800 (large rice free); roast beef; risotto; edamame; chicken dishes and oden; beef tetchan and karaage set meal ¥800; smoking at all seats; oden (daikon, aubergine, egg); fried rice with oden dashi poured over.

食べログ: HUNTER、ビストロ、中京区東洞院通夷川下ル壺屋町533-2、丸太.en: Tabelog: HUNTER, bistro; 壺屋町533-2, south of 夷川 on 東洞院通, Nakagyo-ku; 4 min walk from Marutamachi Station; Monday–Wednesday and Friday–Sunday 18:00–22:00; closed Thursday and the third Wednesday; 20 seats; cards accepted, no e-money; non-smoking; opened 27 March 2017; Steak/Teppanyaki WEST Tabelog 100 2024. Reviews (November 2025–July 2026, in English): homemade ham, rillettes, charcoal-grilled Ezo venison, duck, lamb, no prices on the menu, weekend-only lunch course, mango curry, orange wine.

食べログ: Hola！ Ginza7(オラギンザシエテ)、銀座7-2-11 菊村.en: Tabelog: Hola! Ginza7, Ginza 7-2-11, 菊村 Building 1F, 4 minutes from JR Shinbashi Station Ginza exit; 60 seats (smoking allowed at all seats); Mon–Thu 11:30–15:00, 17:00–23:00, Fri until 4:00, weekends and holidays open all day; closed at New Year; opened June 30, 2012. Shop introduction: angel-shrimp paella, pinchos, jamón, tapas, draft cider, party plans with all-you-can-drink. 2026 reviews: paella and salad lunch set; ajillo; paella; tapas; a decanter of sangria; paella with ingredients of your choice (about 20 minutes); tip-based table magic; complaints about smoking inside; some say it's pricey.

食べログ: Honeysuckle Rose (ハニーサックルローズ)、大阪市中.en: Tabelog: Honeysuckle Rose, 2-3-19 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 212 m from Nagahoribashi Station; Tue–Thu 11:30–15:00; closed Mondays, Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; no reservations; 20 seats; smoking allowed; official site. Reviews (2023 – February 2026): open 3 days a week, Tuesday to Thursday (February 2026); lunch is a single daily 'Suikazura lunch', ¥1,100 or ¥1,300 with a drink; mains such as Japanese-style hamburg (grated daikon and shiso, ponzu); small dishes (vegetable tempura, simmered dishes, coleslaw, omelette); white or multigrain rice; soup; yuzu tea; café au lait; add a mini parfait or cake; a dim room of antique furniture and stained glass; one was given hot water in winter; drinks sometimes unavailable when busy.

食べログ: Hortensia Bistro、ビストロ・フレンチ・ワインバー、大.en: Tabelog: Hortensia Bistro, bistro, French and wine bar, 4-15-12 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, シオザキビル 1F; 2 min from Exit 5 of Higashimikuni Station, 10 min from Shin-Osaka; Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–14:30 and 17:30–22:30; Wednesday dinner only (book by phone); closed Monday; five or more by phone; a booking lapses after 30 minutes without notice; preschool children at lunch only; one drink each (¥1,000 seat charge otherwise); cards and PayPay accepted; 20 seats (8 on sofas, 8 at tables, 4 at the counter); open terrace; non-smoking; wheelchair access. Reviews (October 2023 to September 2026): a bistro known for game; lunch course ¥3,000 (assorted appetisers, turnip or cauliflower soup, hamburg steak, pork loin, fried sea bream, duck confit, assorted desserts, coffee); a canelé for those who book; fish-and-meat lunch course ¥5,500 (low-temperature Aomori pork); "Menu Hortensia" ¥8,800 (truffled potato salad, asparagus sauvage with rillettes, white asparagus with prosciutto and onsen egg, chicken consommé, ayu, Kagoshima badger with foie gras, Spanish mountain quail, rice-flour canelé); rabbit wrapped around shrimp; Earl Grey crème brûlée; wine; French osechi; weekend lunches fully booked; careful explanations.

食べログ: Howlin’(ハウリン)、銀座6-5-12 新堀ギタービル2F、銀.en: Tabelog: Howlin', Ginza 6-5-12, 新堀ギター Building 2F, 3 minutes from Ginza Station exit C3; 22 seats (mostly counter); Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00, lunch by course reservation only, closed Sundays and holidays; otoshi ¥500; opened November 11, 2020, reopened after renovation in May 2026; cards, IC and QR accepted; Tabelog's facilities list "vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free options". Shop introduction: fluffy omelets of free-range eggs, Tosa Akaushi, about 25 Moldovan and Italian wines at all times. 2026 reviews: organic eggs from Kuro Fuji Farm, no-till brown rice from Fujisaki Farm, fresh pasta from Awaji Noodle Company, carrot soup, organic salad, soufflé omelet, corn quiche, beef carpaccio, low-temperature roast pork, shrimp ajillo, a spicy curry, Napolitan.

食べログ: IBAIA、銀座3-12-5 ファーストビル1F、東銀座駅(浅草線).en: Tabelog: IBAIA, Ginza 3-12-5, First Building 1F, 2 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station (Asakusa line); 17 seats; Tue–Sun 17:00–22:00, closed Mon; table charge ¥1,500; cards and d-barai accepted; ¥6,000–8,000. 2026 reviews: a meat bistro in a Higashi-Ginza back lane, mostly counter, T-bone by reservation, fillet, fish and vegetable dishes, 8 starters, 3 mains and 2 desserts, house wine, a focused menu, ¥8,000–15,000.

食べログ: IKR51、大阪市中央区南船場3-11-27 日宝シルバービル1F、.en: Tabelog: IKR51, Nippo Silver Bldg 1F, 3-11-27 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min north of Midosuji Line Shinsaibashi Station exit 1, right at the Doutor corner; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30), Sat–Sun 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closes when sold out; irregular closing days; no reservations; no cards or e-money; 17 seats; opened 17 January 2012, renewed 6 October 2020. October 2026 reviews: the tsukemen is in a class of its own; harmony of noodles and soup; top of one diner's tsukemen ranking; oyster shoyu ramen (oyster extract); the soup was lukewarm; softish noodles; fast service; many overseas diners; special tsukemen and chashu rice bowl (rich seafood dipping soup, chewy thick noodles, plenty of moist rare chashu, seasoned egg and menma); late-night ramen; English signage; seafood rice bowls too; jet-black shoyu ramen (not as salty as its colour; shoyu depth with garlic umami); chuka soba with shellfish dashi stronger than the chicken; chashu with the sweetness of pork; firm menma; a rich creamy tori paitan that seems to include vegetables; hamaguri-dashi ramen large with mini chicken-tataki rice bowl ¥1,710; one finds it a bit pricey; a menu aimed at overseas visitors.

食べログ: INOLTRE、銀座5-4-15 西五ビル5F、銀座駅から徒歩1分(.en: Tabelog: INOLTRE, Ginza 5-4-15, 西五 Building 5F, 1 minute from Ginza Station (turn at the Hermès corner on Harumi-dori); 19 seats; Tue–Fri 11:30–14:00, 18:00–23:00, Mon and Sat dinner only, closed Sundays and holidays; opened July 4, 2017; seat charge ¥500; cards and d-barai accepted. Shop introduction (English): owner Haru Naruse does the cooking; charmed wine lovers at the previous shop, "Vini Italiano Osei"; seasonal à la carte with Japanese ingredients; about 250 wines, mainly Italian. 2026 reviews: a one-sheet menu, prosciutto sliced in front of you, risotto made to your liking, Toyama firefly-squid pasta, venison and wild-boar pasta, lunch beef and mushroom spaghettini ¥1,500 (with salad and bread), ¥10,000–15,000 at night.

食べログ: Ino Cantonese 日本橋 たかせ、中華料理、海鮮、中国料理.en: Tabelog: Ino Cantonese Nihonbashi Takase, Chinese, seafood; Chinese TOKYO 100 2023, 2024 and 2026; Nihonbashi-Horidomecho 1-8-11, Ningyocho Square 1F, 3 min walk from Ningyocho Station; Mon, Thu and Fri 17:30–22:30, Sat and Sun 12:00–15:00 and 17:30–22:30; closed Tue and Wed; reservations accepted; bookings may be declined for many allergies or dislikes; cards accepted; 10% service charge; 18 seats (8 at the counter, 3 tables, a private room); the independent shop of Kenichi Takase, first head chef of SENSE at the Mandarin Oriental Tokyo for 7 years; the course changes every two months. Reviews (April 2025–October 2026): opened August 2022; weekend lunch omakase ¥9,680; standard dinner ¥14,300; autumn special course ¥25,800; signature shrimp with mango mayonnaise; steamed dim sum; Hong Kong-style steamed fish; Chinese tea; one says it has a Michelin star; one called it ordinary hotel Chinese.

食べログ: J BOWL 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-18-14 ミドウ心.en: Tabelog: J BOWL Shinsaibashi, Mido Shinsaibashi Bldg 1F, 1-18-14 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 5; Mon 19:00–23:00, Tue–Sun and holidays 19:00–4:00 next morning; irregular closing days; an açaí bowl and Greek yogurt shop; seating layout changes between day and night; 14 seats; cards, e-money and QR accepted; separate smoking; children and pets welcome; takeaway and delivery; listed as able to cater for vegans. Reviews (April–August 2026): rich açaí with lots of fruit and honey; about ¥1,680, a bit pricey; toppings of honey, granola, kiwi, coconut, nuts, pineapple, mango; nut bowl; mini orange and lemon bowls; Greek yogurt with comb honey; hojicha float; peach tea; a bar-like interior with sofas; two call it the best açaí bowl ever; one says on a second visit it was smaller and the mango unripe; one says it was closed at the booked time and staff made it to take away.

食べログ: JOINT BURGER 銀座(ジョイントバーガー)、銀座7-5-1.en: Tabelog: JOINT BURGER Ginza, Ginza 7-5-16, 秀芳 Building B1F; 28 seats (6 counter, 22 table); Mon–Sat 12:00–22:00, Sundays and holidays 12:00–21:00; opened August 4, 2023. 2026 reviews: juicy burgers; crisp fries; affordable for Ginza; no cigarette smell; pay online; a bar-like basement in a nightlife street; quick service; no forks or knives; bacon cheeseburger with a 100% beef patty; Heineken.

食べログ: KAMINARI BURGERS、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-18-2.en: Tabelog: KAMINARI BURGERS, 2F, 1-18-2 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 13:00–22:00; opens early when ready; closes when sold out; closures on Instagram; no reservations; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; no smoking; 10 seats (counter 2, tables 8); English menu; children welcome; opened 20 September 2022; official site. Reviews (January–August 2026): patties of Kuroge wagyu and domestic branded pork; thick and juicy; fragrant buns; restrained sauce; pickles; KAMINARI burger Comple; classic burger; recommended triple patty; B set ¥2,500 (fries and drink); crisp fries; coleslaw; one says it's big, so wrap it in paper and bite in; a monthly lottery, bring a losing ticket for a free fried egg.

食べログ: KAMUKURA 御堂筋店、大阪市中央区難波1-7-14、なんば駅か.en: Tabelog: KAMUKURA Midosuji, 1-7-14 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 108 m from Namba Station; Mon–Thu and Sun 10:00–23:00, Fri, Sat and days before holidays 10:00–7:00 next morning; reservations accepted; counter; opened 21 January 2025; official site kamukura.co.jp. 2026 reviews (September–October): hot-and-sour noodles with fried rice and karaage set; amid weekend queues, the only place with no wait (the front door is heavy); limited hot-and-sour noodles with a big chili; napa cabbage, pork belly and chashu; a pork-and-vegetable soup, not tonkotsu; cold KAMUKURA; Oishii Ramen ¥820; half fried rice and gyoza set ¥1,370; nira and chili self-serve; the black-vinegar hot-and-sour noodles were sold out; sweetness of napa cabbage; medium-thin straight noodles; thick chashu.

食べログ: KANEGURA、居酒屋・鍋、下京区柳馬場通仏光寺下ル万里小路町18.en: Tabelog: KANEGURA, izakaya and hot pot; 下京区柳馬場通仏光寺下ル万里小路町187; about 6 min on foot from Shijo Station exit 5; 16:00–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30); last entry 21:30; courses from 18:00; closed Tuesday; two-hour limit; one drink per person (¥500 seat charge if no drink is ordered); 22 seats (6 counter, 4 tables for 4); non-smoking; cards and PayPay accepted; opened 19 November 2021; Izakaya WEST Tabelog 100 2025 and 2026. foodle.pro post (22 August 2024): 伖 (Kanegura), said to mean a storehouse for gold, silver and treasure; named from radicals of the surnames of its instigators, 伊藤氏 and 抜木氏; 伊藤氏 is the head chef of にくの匠 三芳; the specialty is a nikunabe of layered meat, thin-sliced sirloin, a 100% beef hamburg steak. Reviews (October–November 2026, in English): nikunabe, yukhoe, beef tongue, courses with all-you-can-drink ¥6,500 and ¥7,500, single portions available, many guests from abroad.

食べログ: KATACHI CAFE (カタチ カフェ)、大阪市中央区南船場3-.en: Tabelog: KATACHI CAFE, Aragaya Bldg 1F, Minami-Senba 3-2-25, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min from Shinsaibashi Stn Exit 1; daily 10:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); reservations accepted; cards, iD, QUICPay and QR accepted; 12 seats; non-smoking inside, smoking allowed outdoors; terrace; pets allowed; children welcome; English menu; opened 5 November 2018. Reviews (July–October 2026): light- and medium-roast coffee, iced Americano ¥350, iced tea ¥450, black-sesame cheesecake, thick toast with smoked salmon and cream cheese (drink set ¥1,350), pizza set, canelé, vanilla ice cream named after the French bulldog mascot Buru-mi, brand-name bags and wallets also on sale, pay at the counter first and then take a seat, open until 10 pm.

食べログ: KENZO ESTATE WINERY 銀座店、銀座5-9-16 G.en: Tabelog: KENZO ESTATE WINERY Ginza, Ginza 5-9-16, GINZA A5 1F and B1F, 1 minute from Ginza Station exit A5; 16 seats, private room; Mon, Tue, Sat and holidays 12:00–23:00, Wed–Fri 12:00–2:00, closed Sun; opened October 5, 2018; only KENZO ESTATE wines (no beer or soft drinks); no-show fee ¥11,000 per person; cards accepted. 2026 reviews: near GINZA SIX; Asatsuyu, Murasaki Suzu, Yui (English spellings); pairings with food; courses and à la carte; a calm space; ¥8,000–40,000.

食べログ: KIZAHASHI、日本料理、下京区東塩小路町570 THE THO.en: Tabelog: KIZAHASHI, Japanese cuisine; 下京区東塩小路町570 THE THOUSAND KYOTO 2F; about 2 min on foot east from the JR Kyoto Station central exit (underground passage exit 5); breakfast 7:00–10:00, lunch 11:30–14:30, dinner 17:30–20:00; closed Tuesday (except holidays); reservations taken; 100% cancellation fee from two days before; 15% service charge (from 1 April 2025); 60 seats; private rooms (2–8 people, up to 12); non-smoking (smoking room outside); wheelchair accessible; cards, e-money and QR payments accepted; parking for 50 cars. Reviews (July–October 2026, in English): seasonal courses (the autumn course "Kaze", matsutake and autumn-salmon soup, hoba-yaki, mushroom rice); a ¥10,000 course; sommelier pairings; refillable seasoned rice; sandals sometimes not allowed; hotel Japanese cuisine.

食べログ: KOTAN THE KITCHEN、大阪市中央区千日前1丁目 なんば.en: Tabelog: KOTAN THE KITCHEN, Namba Walk 3-bangai, 1-chome Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 30 counter seats and 7 tables for 4; daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed on Namba Walk closing days; no smoking (Namba Walk smoking area); cards and e-money accepted; opened 29 July 2023; official ramen-kotan.co.jp. 2026 reviews (June–October): miso ramen and tenshinhan set; a tenshinhan unlike the usual Chinese kind; miso ramen and mini fried rice; KOTAN ramen (shoyu) and mini fried rice; chashu-and-egg set meal (pickles and miso soup); KOTAN ramen miso ¥820; gyoza set meal ¥500; lemon sour ¥380; stir-fried meat and vegetables set meal; reimen; a new form of KOTAN Ramen, founded 1968; limited spicy reimen (pork-belly chashu, smoked egg, napa-cabbage kimchi, bean sprouts, leek); in front of Plaza 1 at Nippombashi Station.

食べログ: KOTOWARI、日本料理・居酒屋・カフェ、中京区松ケ枝町463、京.en: Tabelog: KOTOWARI, Japanese cuisine, izakaya, café; 松ケ枝町463, Nakagyo-ku; 5 min walk from Keihan Sanjo and Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae stations; lunch 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30), café 15:00–17:00, dinner 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closing days not fixed; reservations accepted; tell the shop about allergies; dinner courses and the birthday plate (¥1,100) need booking 2 days ahead; 20 seats (5 counter, 12 table, 2–4 tatami); non-smoking; Wi-Fi; cards, transport IC cards and QR accepted; opened 12 March 2021; leather goods on sale and bag-repair consultations in the shop; the lunch three-kind rice-bowl plate; cheesecake seared in front of you. Reviews (May–October 2026, in English): three mini rice bowls plate ¥2,200, sashimi, tempura, dashimaki, white or multigrain rice, a kids' lunch, Dubai chocolate mochi, run by the bag-repair shop Akashiya near Kyoto Station, the owner cooking alone.

食べログ: KU RO BE、銀座6-8-6 木の実ビル3F、銀座駅から徒歩2分.en: Tabelog: KU RO BE, Ginza 6-8-6, 木の実 Building 3F, 2 minutes from Ginza Station; 18 seats, a private room with a mural (4–6); Mon–Thu 18:00–23:00, Fri until 23:30, Sat and holidays 18:00–22:00, closed Sun; opened April 27, 2011; cards accepted. 2026 reviews: a wine bistro loved by regulars for 15 years; a U-shaped counter and open kitchen; wines chosen by the wine chef; snacks from ¥500; five-dish omakase; the famous uni peperoncino; carpaccio; baby corn and bonito; black-tea pudding; highballs from a kept whisky bottle; blackboard menu; about ¥10,000.

食べログ: L&L Bar&Restaurant、ダイニングバー・ヨーロッパ料理.en: Tabelog: L&L Bar&Restaurant, dining bar, European and pasta, 宝泉ビル 1F, Nishi-Shinsaibashi 2-16-13, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 minutes from Namba Station (Yotsubashi Line); opposite 100 Yen Lawson; daily 8:00–5:00; open year-round; reservations accepted; no cover charge; cards and QR payment accepted, no e-money; 95 seats; a basement space for private hire (20–40); smoking allowed; breakfast served; vegetarian options shown. Reviews (2017–2026): a foreign owner, Israeli cooking, hummus with pita ¥880 (before tax), lamb by an Israeli chef, homemade-dough pizza, a vegetarian set, chicken schnitzel, rare lamb chops, spare ribs, jerk chicken, shisha, breakfast bread, cheesecake, a ¥500 curry lunch (2017), crowded with foreign guests before COVID.

食べログ: L'appartamento di NAOKI、イタリアン、イノベー.en: Tabelog: L'appartamento di NAOKI, Italian, innovative; Italian TOKYO 100 2023 and 2025; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-10-11, KYOE PLAZA Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 4F; Wed–Sat, holidays and the days before and after holidays 19:00–23:59, Sun 12:00–15:30 and 19:00–23:59; closed Mon and Tue; reservations accepted; bookings may be declined if allergies prevent the course; 10% service charge; cards and PayPay accepted; 6 seats; non-smoking; website naokiyokoe.com. Reviews (May–October 2026): after 10 years in Azabu-Juban, moved to Ningyocho in 2021; wood-fired cooking; chef Naoki Yokoe; everyone starts at 19:00; prix fixe ¥19,800; about 10 dishes; choose the meat main; pasta in small servings of several kinds; smoked ice cream; kombucha pairing; one says 8 counter seats; no children.

食べログ: LA PIAZZETTA(ラ・ピアツェッタ)、銀座6-10-1 GI.en: Tabelog: LA PIAZZETTA, Ginza 6-10-1, GINZA SIX 6F, 255 m from Ginza Station; daily 11:00–21:00; opened August 25, 2021; official site eataly.co.jp. 2026 reviews: inside EATALY GINZA; choose one of three restaurants at the entrance (LA PIAZZETTA APERITIVO AND WINE BAR, LA PASTA e LA PIZZA, LA GRIGLIA); the counter if alone; gin and tonic and gimlet with Miyazaki hebesu; sautéed-chicken burger with hebesu; seafood salad; Italian beer; layered desserts; affordable for GINZA SIX.

食べログ: LAZUR、銀座3-13-19 華立ビル1F・2F、東銀座駅から徒歩.en: Tabelog: LAZUR, Ginza 3-13-19, 華立 Building 1F–2F, 3 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station; 17 seats; Mon–Sat and holidays 17:00–23:00, closed Sun; opened June 2, 2025; cards, IC and QR (including Alipay and WeChat Pay) accepted; ¥2,000–3,000. 2026 reviews: Tunisian food, rare in Japan, run by a Tunisian married couple; a terrace at the 1F entrance, 2F like a standing bar; LAZUR classic course ¥4,800 (chicken and vegetable couscous, tuna brik, salad, dessert); harissa, hummus, houria salad (sardines), moussaka; Tunisian beer "Celtia", Casablanca, Cédratine, fig brandy; the owner explains how to eat each dish and serves Tunisian liquor on the house.

食べログ: LINK、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-13-19 NT BLD. 1F、.en: Tabelog: LINK, NT BLD. 1F, 1-13-19 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; east from Shinsaibashi Station exits 5 and 6, left at the FamilyMart corner for about 20 m; also 5 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; daily 10:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); cash only; fully non-smoking including e-cigarettes from October 2025; 17 seats (tables 12, counter 5); takeaway; coffee beans from around the world for sale (orders also by web, phone and fax); official site. Reviews (February–October 2026): house roasted; brewed cup by cup; the feel of a Showa kissaten and mid-century America; jazz; Mandheling; Mocha; strong blend; baked cheesecake; coffee jelly; you can ask the owner for a recommendation; one called the taste ordinary, found the washing-up noisy and was told stays are limited to 60 minutes.

食べログ: LOBOS 銀座(ロボス)、銀座4-9-6 三原橋ビル1F、東銀座駅.en: Tabelog: LOBOS Ginza, Ginza 4-9-6, 三原橋 Building 1F, 1 minute from Higashi-Ginza Station exit A2; 54 seats, private rooms (2–8); Mon–Thu and Sat 11:30–14:30, 17:00–23:00, Fri until 23:30, Sundays and holidays until 22:30; cards accepted; operator site crospiration.jp. Shop introduction: a back lane between Ginza Mitsukoshi and the Kabukiza; a red-toned interior; cushioned sofa seats and a loft private room; courses with all-you-can-drink sparkling wine. October 2026 reviews: a five-dish lunch course; lunch full with bookings; seafood paella with shrimp, crab and mussels, with lemon; shrimp ajillo with baguette; balsamic salad; plenty of non-alcoholic drinks; a low ceiling; friendly, efficient staff.

食べログ: LaVASARA 銀座本店、銀座2-2-14 マロニエゲート銀座1.en: Tabelog: LaVASARA Ginza Honten, Ginza 2-2-14, Marronnier Gate Ginza 1, 11F; 63 seats; daily 11:00–23:00; closed New Year's Day; 10% service charge after 17:00; opened May 9, 2025; particular about vegetables, vegetarian menu available. Shop introduction: an open space with a good view; children welcome; LaVASARA café & Grill. October 2026 reviews: burrata and prosciutto salad; grilled vegetables; Bolognese; chocolate terrine; a squid-ink pasta lunch set (free-flowing soft drinks); pizza and pasta lunch; order by QR code; Margherita; many foreign customers; mixed opinions on seasoning and prices.
