食べログ: cocorono bakery (ココロノ ベーカリー)、パン、大阪.en: Tabelog: cocorono bakery, bread, 西中島ビル 101, 4-2-3 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 3 min from Exit 1 of Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; Wed 11:00–17:00, Thu–Sat 7:30–17:00, Sun 7:30–14:00; closed Monday and Tuesday; cash only; non-smoking; children welcome; takeout; opened 4 December 2014; website and blog. Reviews (July 2025 to October 2026): a small shop with up to about 20 people at the till at midday; cheap; oil sardine and mushroom tomato pizza ¥270; green-onion miso bacon ¥260; spicy sausage and cheese ¥280; chunky bacon fromage ¥260; smoked cheese and bacon ¥250; croque monsieur; sausage and egg-salad pie; baked curry bread; smoked-egg green curry bread; stuffed pepper bread; mentaiko and shiso bread; the "adult cream bun" (bitter chocolate custard and rum-soaked griotte cherries) ¥200; special cream bun ¥230; melon bread ¥200; almond croissant; brown-sugar cream-cheese mélange; baguette; olive rustic; rye peanut anpan; a mountain-shaped loaf; some sell out by evening.

食べログ: conoji、大阪市西区新町2-18-19 三洋ハイツ 101、西長.en: Tabelog: conoji, Sanyo Heights 101, 2-18-19 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nishi-Nagahori Station and Nishi-Ohashi Station exit 1; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 (L.O. food 14:00) and 18:00–23:00 (L.O. food 22:00); closed Wednesdays and over New Year; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 20 seats (counter 14, 3 tables). Reviews (July–October 2026): a U-shaped counter; a calm, stylish shop; at lunch a platter of about 6 starters, bread and a pasta from 2 daily choices (paccheri with minced chicken and aubergine ragù; tagliatelle with meat sauce; pasta with pecorino, black pepper and garlic); about ¥2,000 with tiramisu and cappuccino; at night summer-truffle cream, clams and mussels in tomato and more; chicken-shaped water jugs; one found the explanations hard to hear.

食べログ: d'or、フレンチ、東山区博多町63-2、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分.en: Tabelog: d'or, French; 博多町63-2, Higashiyama-ku; 5 min walk from Keihan Gion-Shijo Station; every day 14:00–23:00; closing days not fixed; reservations accepted; 8 seats; table seats on the second floor (booking required); separate smoking area; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; opened 19 May 2021. Reviews (December 2025–September 2026, in English): a chef from a pastry background, a crêpe station at the counter, charcuterie, duck ham, spring rolls, venison, blue-cheese galette, Calpis fermented-butter crêpe, citron crêpe, canelé, house caramel ice cream, champagne by the glass, bookings on TableCheck.

食べログ: fiveran (ファイブラン)、パン・カフェ、中京区役行者町377.en: Tabelog: fiveran, bakery and café, 中京区役行者町377, about 5 min on foot from Karasuma-Oike Stn; daily 9:00–18:00; no regular closing day from 4 December 2025; no reservations; 19 seats (16 at tables, 3 at the counter); no cards, PayPay accepted; opened 2 November 2015; Bread Tabelog 100 2019; Bread WEST Tabelog 100 2020, 2022, 2026. Reviews (October 2026, in English): salt bread ¥149, croissant ¥280, croque monsieur, chili dog, truffle salt bread, queues, eat-in, outlets in Osaka too.

食べログ: fudo、イタリアン・創作・ワインバー、中京区御池大東町590 加納.en: Tabelog: fudo, Italian, creative and wine bar, 中京区御池大東町590, 加納ビル B1F, 4 min on foot from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn; Mon, Wed and Sun 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); Fri and Sat 17:00–24:00; Thursday shows only a last order of 23:00; closed Tuesdays (open on holidays); reservations accepted, same-day too; 19 seats; cards accepted; opened 1 June 2017; Italian WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (September–October 2026, in English): fudo means 'climate', Japanese ingredients with Italian technique, foie gras with fresh yatsuhashi and Saikyo miso, sea-bream broth pasta with karasumi, sweetfish risotto, Japanese wines.

食べログ: gelamu. 心斎橋、大阪市中央区南船場2-6-29 鴨川ビル10.en: Tabelog: gelamu. Shinsaibashi, Kamogawa Bldg 101, 2-6-29 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 251 m from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Wed, Fri–Sun, holidays and days before and after holidays 12:00–22:00; closed Thursdays (may change); no reservations; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR (PayPay, d-barai, au PAY, Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted; 10 seats; terrace; dogs allowed inside; takeaway and delivery; children and pushchairs welcome; opened 12 July 2025. Reviews (July–October 2026): open until 22:00, handy for dessert after dinner; mango; caffè latte; Latte Noir; pistachio; matcha; Earl Grey; strawberry; walnut; DUO, 2 flavours in a cone; Earl Grey Blanc ¥1,300 (bergamot aroma); matcha affogato; no tasting; a clean, elegant frontage and interior.

食べログ: hikari-yurari、イタリアン・ワインバー、中京区押小路通麩.en: Tabelog: hikari-yurari, Italian, wine bar; ヴァインオークトゥエルブ B1F, 橘町611-1, east of Fuyacho on Oshikoji-dori, Nakagyo-ku; 5 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Station; Monday, Wednesday–Sunday and holidays 18:00–23:00 (L.O. food 22:00, drinks 22:30; last entry 22:00); closed Tuesday and every other Monday; reservation only; ¥7,000 a head if a smaller party is not notified by the day before; same-day cancellations billed through a law firm; ¥600 cover (plus tax); 10 seats (counter only); non-smoking; cards accepted; Italian WEST Tabelog 100 2021 and 2023. Reviews (July 2024–October 2026, in English): 22 years in business, 12 at this site (2024), a single chef, jazz, assorted prosciutto, pâté, an adult potato salad, cheese, mushroom consommé ¥660, Shogoin-turnip soup, not for non-drinkers.

食べログ: huit、ビストロ、ワインバー、日本酒バー、日本橋人形町2-10-1.en: Tabelog: huit, bistro, wine bar, sake bar; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-10-11, KYOE PLAZA 5F, 2 min walk from Ningyocho Station exit A2; Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–23:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–21:00; usually closed Tuesday; announcements on Instagram; about 90 minutes at lunch and 2 hours at dinner; reservations accepted; ¥500 after 15:00 for those not drinking alcohol; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 20 seats; wheelchair accessible; opened 8 August 2022; natural wine, junmai sake and vegetables from partner farms. Reviews (February 2024–October 2026): food-only course ¥3,800 (6 dishes and homemade bread, at least 2 drinks); party plan ¥7,000; one-plate lunch ¥1,400; the homemade bread is popular; the master is a sommelier; some found the portions small.

食べログ: italy_zoo、大阪市中央区南船場1-7-8 ダイアパレス順慶町.en: Tabelog: italy_zoo, Dia Palace Junkeimachi 1F, 1-7-8 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 6 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Wed, Sat and Sun 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 13:30) and 18:00–22:30 (L.O. 21:00), Fri 18:00–22:30; closed Thursdays; irregular closures (Instagram or Google calendar); starter and coperto ¥400 at night; cards and PayPay accepted; 12 seats. Reviews (December 2024 – October 2026): a cafe-like space at the back of the ground floor; antique furniture and dried flowers; animals hidden all over the shop; weekday lunch A set ¥1,300 (salad plate with about 7 vegetable starters and mini soup, pasta); B set ¥1,800; lunch course ¥3,200 (main, dessert, drink; one-drink minimum); spaghettini with house sausage and mushrooms in tomato sauce; linguine with shrimp and zucchini; amatriciana with house ricotta; Chami pork; at night a course of about 11 dishes (chicken consommé, salami and house ham platter, kuruma prawn, hairy crab, hamaguri sformato like chawanmushi, salad with whey dressing, peach cappellini, surf-clam risotto, straw-seared wagyu rump); dessert extra; one found portions small; careful explanations.

食べログ: kurs、パン、中京区西大黒町334 コーポラス二条1F、二条城前駅.en: Tabelog: kurs, bakery; 中京区西大黒町334 コーポラス二条1F; 430 m from Nijojo-mae Station; from 7:00 (the day's opening time on Instagram); closed Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR. Reviews (2026, in English): house sourdough levain; croissants; pain de mie featured on TV; chicken and gorgonzola ¥500; BLT ¥650; croque madame ¥550; fig fruit sandwich ¥1,000; sausage bread ¥600; queues; cash only; began as an event stall and opened the shop at the end of 2019.

食べログ: mill pour (Mill Pour Coffee、ミルポア)、.en: Tabelog: mill pour (Mill Pour Coffee), Cypress Shinsaibashi 1F, 3-6-1 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Nagahoribashi stations; weekdays 9:00–18:00 (L.O. 17:30); weekends and holidays given as 9:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30), but the same page notes weekends and holidays shortened to 9:00–18:00 too; open every day except New Year; no cards; e-money and QR (PayPay, d-barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY) accepted; 10 seats (terrace 8 outside, counter 2 inside); smoking on the terrace, not inside; English menu; pets allowed; children welcome; takeaway; official site. Reviews (January–August 2026): a hot, strong long black; black cold brew (M) ¥750, some bitterness, clean, hardly any acidity; iced Americano; iced caffè latte; hot dogs; beans for sale too; a small sign; benches under an awning facing the road; one minded smoke from people smoking outside.

食べログ: motti.cafe、大阪市浪速区難波中3-7-8 難波リーガルハウ.en: Tabelog: motti.cafe, Namba Regal House, 3-7-8 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 405 m from Namba; daily 9:00–18:00, Fridays until 20:00; irregular closing days (check Instagram); no reservations; cards (VISA, Master, JCB), iD and QR (PayPay, d-barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY) accepted; 11 seats (counter 3, tables for 2); no smoking; opened 20 January 2023. Reviews (August 2025 – August 2026): a small, bright all-white cafe; rounded tables and chairs; white-chocolate cheese terrine; chocolate terrine; brownie; at a lemon fair, lemon cake ¥890 (with honey) and Aid Lemon ¥800; strawberry-milk soda; royal milk tea; café au lait; seasonal fruit menus; messages written on request; one found the seats a bit cramped; one waited about 15 minutes outside.

食べログ: musi-vege+cafe なんばCITY店 (ムシベジプラスカフ.en: Tabelog: musi-vege+cafe Namba CITY branch; café, vegetable dishes; Namba 5-1-60, Namba CITY main building 1F; 5 minutes' walk from Nankai Namba Station; daily 11:00–22:00; closed when Namba CITY closes; no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 68 seats; sofa seats; non-smoking; takeaway; opened 14 April 2021. Reviews (September–October 2026): steamed vegetables, multigrain rice and soy-milk miso soup with every set; shrimp mayo with chili; yangnyeom chicken; grated-daikon Tatsuta fried chicken; black-vinegar chicken with eggplant and zucchini; pork loin and maitake with balsamic; two mains ¥1,518; tororo multigrain rice; a yuzu squash and cheesecake set; open straight through; easy for solo diners; some say the side dishes are ordinary or a sofa was dirty.

食べログ: no 29、大阪市西区新町1-31-6、西大橋駅から徒歩5分、精肉販.en: Tabelog: no 29, 1-31-6 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station; butcher counter 11:30–20:00; lunch 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 13:30); dinner reservations only, kappo courses (first sitting 18:00–20:00, second 20:30–22:30); irregular closing days; 10% service charge at dinner; cards and PayPay accepted; 8 seats; private room for 8. Reviews (March 2024 – October 2026): a counter behind a heavy door at the back of a butcher's shop; a yakiniku kaiseki; starters; smoked yukhoe and ikura rice; grilled liver; sukiyaki; yakiniku (loin, tongue, leg, intestine, skirt); some courses include all-you-can-eat meat; careful explanations; at lunch skirt 150 g (¥1,580), ichibo 150 g ¥1,980, lean steak, with salad; free refills of rice and soup; extra sauces ¥150 (grated-daikon ponzu and more); one was bothered by the lunchtime service.

食べログ: nöjd ICE CREAM、大阪市西区南堀江2-1-15 スプラン.en: Tabelog: nöjd ICE CREAM, Splendid Horie unit 1, 2-1-15 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station; Mon and Wed–Sun 11:00–18:00 (L.O. 17:30); closed Tuesdays; phone reservations accepted; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR accepted; 10 table seats; no smoking; wheelchair accessible; pets allowed; English menu; takeaway; allergen labelling and vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free options; opened 13 September 2024; official site. Shop introduction: Swedish for 'content'; ingredients and methods kind to the body; lunch too. Reviews (June–October 2026): about 14 flavours; tasting allowed; 1 scoop ¥640, 2 scoops ¥790, 3 minis ¥840; matcha and salted black-cocoa cookie; pistachio and caramel walnut; strawberry and berries; caramel banana with oat milk; corn and caramel popcorn; mango and cardamom sorbet; peach and Earl Grey sorbet (one found the spice weak); quiche-plate lunch with dessert plate ¥1,950 (rich soup, dill salad); chicken-rice plate; Friday–Saturday 8:00–11:00 morning plate ¥1,190 (rice-flour bread or pancakes, Tanba vegetables, soft-boiled egg, Greek yogurt, hand-made juice); carrot cake; pound cake; hojicha latte; in a building set back a little from the main road.

食べログ: oasis GRILL & ITALIAN(オアシス グリル＆イタリ.en: Tabelog: oasis GRILL & ITALIAN, Ginza 1-4-8 1F; 72 seats (2-hour limit when busy); Mon–Thu 18:00–2:00, Fri until 3:00, Sat 18:00–23:00, closed Sundays and holidays; summer break August 8–16; no lunch; opened November 19, 1999. Shop introduction: a whole Nordic-style old house; every booking is a private or semi-private room; 若姫 beef; angel shrimp; grilled dishes. 2026 reviews: hard to find at the end of a lane; the basement private room had a low ceiling and was hot; courses with all-you-can-drink; a 3-hour all-you-can-drink course ¥12,100; customized drinks; generous portions; staff tell you how long dishes will take; flexible about changes in numbers for large groups.

食べログ: on your side、ビストロ、肉料理、ワインバー、日本橋人形町.en: Tabelog: on your side, bistro, meat dishes, wine bar; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-10-11 2F, 1 min walk from Ningyocho Station exit A1; Mon 18:00–22:00; Tue–Sat and the days before and after a holiday 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Sundays and holidays; no lunch on Mondays; reservations accepted; ¥500 charge at night; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 16 seats; non-smoking; opened 30 November 2021; lunch sets ¥1,500, ¥1,800 and ¥2,000; lunch courses ¥3,000 and ¥4,000; dinner courses ¥6,500, ¥8,000 and ¥9,000; glass wines and over 30 bottles. Reviews (November 2023–August 2026): weekly lunches; salad, bread, pasta, fish and meat; a stamp card for dessert; pâté, trippa, oyster gratin; a drink order expected at night; some found the salad bland, the poêlé soggy, and the iced coffee served with the meal.

食べログ: orca 銀座醸造所(オルカ、旧店名 ブリューインバー & ナチュー.en: Tabelog: orca Ginza Brewery (formerly Brew in Bar & Nature), Ginza 8-11-12, 正金 Building B1, 6 minutes from Ginza Station, 7 from Shinbashi Station; 33 seats (5 counter, 12 sofa, 16 table); weekdays 16:00–23:00, Sat and holidays 14:00–22:00, Sun 13:00–21:00; official site brewinbar.com. Shop introduction: a brewery restaurant that inherited the space of a long-established bar founded in 1985; freshly brewed beer; New Zealand grass-fed beef. 2026 reviews: about 10 house-brewed craft beers; brewery tours; a three-beer flight ¥2,200; fries (small) ¥900; plenty of starters; many foreign customers; a remark that the wagyu was sold out and the NZ beef sinewy.

食べログ: otto. coffee and sweets、大阪市中央区南船場3.en: Tabelog: otto. coffee and sweets, K's Bldg Shinsaibashi 1F, 3-6-18 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Crysta Nagahori north exit 10; daily 9:00–19:30; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; no smoking; 12 seats (counter 6, tables 6); opened 19 March 2022. Reviews (June–October 2026): terrace-like seats facing the Shinsaibashisuji shopping street (air-conditioned); a bright white-toned shop; firm, eggy pudding with bittersweet caramel; pudding with vanilla ice cream or Mont Blanc cream; Halloween sweet-potato-ice-cream pudding ¥780; purple-potato Mont Blanc mille-feuille (mochi and custard); sweet-potato tart; sugar-butter crêpe; soufflé cheesecake; tacos and Corona; coffee from 2 beans; hojicha latte; Earl Grey ¥550; brunch; dog cookies +¥250; drinks from about ¥500; one says efficient even run single-handed.

食べログ: over the over (オーバー ザ オーバー)、大阪市浪速区.en: Tabelog: over the over, Kunieda Bldg 2F, 2-8-86 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nankai Namba Station; Mon–Sat 18:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00); closed Sundays; reservations accepted (phone after 12:00); table charge ¥550; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), e-money and QR (PayPay, Rakuten Pay) accepted; no smoking; 19 seats; private hire for 20–50; BYO allowed; takeaway; vegetarian menu; opened 16 April 2018. Reviews (May–October 2026): ¥8,000 course and anniversary course; a charcoal-batter corn dog (spiced meat inside); yellowtail carpaccio; charcoal-grilled sawara; sweet-potato soup with stracciatella; sansho bolognese; charcoal-grilled Kyoto Hiyoshi pork; black fig with canelé; à la carte crab-miso toast, porcini omelette, grilled-vegetable salad, pork sauté; non-alcoholic gin and tonic; birthday plates; sofa seats first-come even with a booking.

食べログ: patisserie accueil (パティスリー アクイユ)、大.en: Tabelog: patisserie accueil, 102, 1-17-18 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station exit 4, 5 from Yotsubashi Station; Wed–Sun 11:00–19:00; closed Mondays and Tuesdays; cakes can be reserved by phone, eat-in can't; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 4 counter seats; no smoking; takeaway; children welcome; opened 13 June 2014; official site. October 2026 reviews: a case of seasonal cakes; mostly light, airy mousse cakes; Écrin ¥700 (strawberry and mascarpone mousse with passion fruit inside, wrapped in strawberry chocolate); chestnut roll cake ¥680 (Hokkaido fresh cream and chestnut cream); Japanese-chestnut Mont Blanc; muscat mousse cake; chocolate soufflé ¥680; kouign-amann; café au lait ¥600; cappuccino; tea; one recommends going right after opening; one felt the till service could be better.

食べログ: ramen agein、大阪市中央区高麗橋1-6-3 エグザビル 1.en: Tabelog: ramen agein, Exa Bldg 1F, 1-6-3 Koraibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Kitahama Station exit 4; Tue–Sun and holidays 10:00–14:00 (hours differ weekdays and weekends/holidays); closed Mondays (Tuesday if a holiday); closes early when sold out; temporary closures; an opening calendar on social media at month-end (Instagram @ramen_again_osaka, X @Ramen_again); no cards, e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; opened 12 September 2024. Reviews (February 2025 – October 2026): already open at 9:55; spicy miso ramen ¥1,380 (branded pork and scallop soup, house miso tare); freshly grilled chashu; change the flavour with spicy powder; 5 waiting before the 11:00 opening; Kuroge wagyu 'kamadama niku niku' 150 g ¥1,000 (not on the machine, on a menu in a file); a little rice; flat chewy noodles; finish with raw egg and shoyu; salt ramen (pork base, thin noodles); yuzu-kosho; app stamps; one says weekdays 10–14, weekends 11–14; one found the shoyu ramen ¥1,100 sourish; firm noodles; chashu rice bowl (branded pork and special egg) ¥350; the miso ramen has straight noodles; one says open Friday nights too; spicy shoyu ramen; the shoyu is sharp with fragrant soup; seared-chashu aroma; shoyu ramen with seasoned egg ¥150; clean umami but lacking depth and character, one says; counter only; one suspects the queue is due to slow turnover.

食べログ: salmon atelier Hus(サーモンアトリエ・フース)、千.en: Tabelog: salmon atelier Hus, Uchisaiwaicho 1-7-1, Chiyoda-ku, Hibiya OKUROJI; 11 seats (7 inside, 4 terrace); Mon–Sat 11:30–14:30, 17:00–23:00, Sundays and holidays until 22:00; irregular holidays; opened April 12, 2023. Shop introduction: a specialist in salmon from Arctic Norway; Italian, French and Japanese styles; unusual Norwegian beers; cocktails; sake. October 2026 reviews: lunch (¥1,500 before tax, with salad and soup, drinks ¥200): harako-meshi, salmon pasta (flat noodles), salmon steak, a limited curry; seasonal Norwegian beer (rosé); vinho verde; few seats, so book.

食べログ: toiru cafe、大阪市中央区博労町3-6-8、心斎橋駅から徒歩.en: Tabelog: toiru cafe, Bakuromachi 3-6-8, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; 8:00–20:00 (food last order 19:30); reservations accepted; cards, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay and Alipay accepted; 20 seats; non-smoking; pets allowed; takeout; menus in English, Traditional Chinese and Korean; children and strollers welcome; wheelchair accessible; opened 27 November 2025. Hot Pepper: Mon and Wed–Sun 8:00–20:00, closed Tuesdays, soft serve until 19:30 on Mondays, a special menu for dogs. Reviews (August–September 2026): soft serve with a dog's face, 12 dog breeds and 2 cats, Yorkshire terrier chocolate and Pomeranian vanilla ¥690 each, soft serve ¥750 and scone ¥450, cup or cone, ordering at a self-service touch panel, rich milk flavour, the look varies, full on a Sunday.

食べログ: vege eats、大阪市中央区博労町1-5-15、堺筋本町駅から徒.en: Tabelog: vege eats, 1-5-15 Hakurocho, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station; Mon–Fri 9:00–19:00; closed Saturdays, Sundays, holidays, Obon and New Year; reservations accepted; cards (VISA, Master), PayPay, d Barai; no e-money; 10 seats; non-smoking; opened 11 October 2021. Shop description: a salad and sandwich specialist; vegetables bought direct from farmers, some grown in-house; salad bar; homemade sweets and drinks; eat-in and terrace seats. Reviews (July 2025–October 2026): fill-a-cup salad bar, S ¥550 and L ¥880, +¥150 if the lid will not close, one bread included; breakfast until 10:30 with a drink; drink add-on ¥120; lettuce grown indoors by pesticide-free hydroponics; leafy greens, tomatoes, broccoli, edamame, seaweed, kinpira, okara salad, sweet-potato salad, potato salad with shibazuke, carrot rapée, caponata, multigrain rice, oatmeal, pasta, salad chicken, roast ham, boiled eggs, crab-stick seafood salad; rice-flour muffins and steamed breads (called gluten-free by reviewers), pound cake, garlic French bread; tuna salad sandwich; cold-brew coffee; crowded with nearby office workers from 12:00; much takeout; picnics in Utsubo Park.

食べログ: И、銀座7-11-14 GINZAカムイビル2F、銀座駅から徒歩5〜.en: Tabelog: И (enu), Ginza 7-11-14, GINZA Kamui Building 2F, 5–6 minutes from Ginza Station; 8 counter seats; Mon, Tue, Sat and holidays 17:30–23:00, Wed–Fri 17:30–2:30; opened May 8, 2026; cards accepted. 2026 reviews: the third shop of the Daikanyama TACUBO group; à la carte Italian (courses too); TACUBO's dessert shop on 1F; chilled corn soup topped with uni; drinks from around ¥3,000; ¥30,000–50,000; prices aimed at inbound visitors.

食べログ: あいだや２、上野6-7-19 NKTビル 1F、仲御徒町駅・上野御徒.en: Tabelog: aidayatsu, Ueno 6-7-19, NKT Building 1F, 5 min on foot from Naka-Okachimachi and Ueno-Okachimachi stations; Mon, Wed, Thu, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed Tuesdays and Fridays; no reservations; cards, transport IC, PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay and more accepted; 20 seats (8 at the counter, 3 tables); signatures shrimp wonton noodles, kombu-water tsukemen, a creamy seasoned egg and wagyu sukiyaki rice; a seafood soup of katsuobushi and saba-bushi; aromatic chashu; hand-wrapped shrimp wontons; a sister shop of Ramen Koike, Chuka Soba Nishino and King Seimen, in a different style from the nearby tsukemen shop Aidaya. Reviews (April–October 2026): shrimp wonton noodles regular 130 g ¥1,330, large 180 g ¥1,430, with seasoned egg ¥1,480; cash and cashless at the ticket machine outside; whole shrimp in the wontons; smoky chashu; firm low-hydration noodles; the kombu-water tsukemen is light; one found the seafood too strong; one thought the previous visit was better.

食べログ: あかよろし、大阪市東成区東小橋3-17-4、鶴橋駅から徒歩3分、月・.en: Tabelog: Akayoroshi, 3-17-4 Higashi-Obase, Higashinari-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Tsuruhashi Station; Mon–Tue 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:30, Fri–Sat 17:00–2:00 next morning, Sun 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00; closed Wednesdays and Thursdays; cards, transit IC and QR accepted; opened 28 October 2022. Reviews (October 2025 – September 2026): a small shop down an alley; run single-handed; Ganso Chuka Soba ¥890 (a clear shoyu soup of Tosa Hachikin chicken, little oil, thin smooth noodles, wood-ear, leek, menma, cabbage, soft-boiled egg, melting chashu); Akayoroshi soba ¥1,200 (plenty of vegetables, strong garlic, rice to finish risotto-style); tomato ramen; sesame ramen; offal ramen with nira, egg and ginger; summer hiyashi chuka ¥980 (20 a day; sesame sauce and mustard, diced chashu, cucumber, shredded omelette, red pickled ginger); big platters of obanzai at night; oden; sake; set of 2 obanzai, beer and ramen; fried rice; counter and tables.

食べログ: あきしの、銀座4-3-5 ハトリビルB1F、銀座駅から76m、14席.en: Tabelog: Akishino, Ginza 4-3-5, ハトリ Building B1F, 76 m from Ginza Station; 14 seats (6 counter, 8 table); reservations accepted; cards: JCB, AMEX, Diners; no e-money or QR; no smoking; review budget ¥8,000–9,999. Reviews (2022–2026): run by a married couple, many regulars, customers of 10+ years, dobin-mushi (matsutake), sashimi platter, corn shinjo, heshiko, pickles, crab-shell gratin, shrimp shumai, an omakase of pike conger, clear soup and sashimi, Inaniwa udon, sudachi and kabosu highballs.

食べログ: あたり屋、そば、そば WEST 百名店 2025、大阪市淀川区東三国.en: Tabelog: Atari Ya, soba, Tabelog Soba WEST 100 2025, 5-11-22 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 347 m from Higashi-Mikuni Station; Mon and Wed–Sun 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Tuesday; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 21 seats; non-smoking; children welcome; no parking (the partner parking tickets have ended); renovated and reopened 22 November 2013; site atariyasoba.com. Reviews (August–October 2026): a calm shop in a residential area; thin 2:8 soba with a light sweetness; dip of natural kombu and three-year-aged katsuobushi; condiments and dip in tin vessels; soba-yu; zaru soba ¥1,000; tempura zaru ¥2,500 (ayu, shrimp, zucchini, pumpkin, sweet potato, shishito, burdock); hamo tsuke soba ¥2,500; duck-breast zaru; kamo nanban with meatballs; small plates of hamachi sashimi, fresh yuba, spare ribs, small sea bream tempura, kara-age, dashimaki and simmered sardines; sake; full at weekend lunch.

食べログ: あづま家、中華料理・ラーメン・担々麺、大阪市淀川区西中島4-2-12.en: Tabelog: Azuma Ke; Chinese, ramen, tantanmen; 4-2-12 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, CS Building 2nd floor; 97 m from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; Mon–Fri 11:20–14:30 and 18:00–22:00; closed Saturdays, Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; cash only; 30 seats; tatami room; whole hire possible. Reviews (November 2020 to September 2026): one block west of the north exit of Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station, on the 2nd floor; full of office workers at lunch with quick turnover; daily lunch with a mini ramen and rice (Sichuan mapo tofu with stir-fried vegetables, twice-cooked pork with yurinchi, stamina pork loin with shrimp tempura ¥1,050); five-vegetable soup noodles with mini fried rice ¥950; mapo rice bowl set (spice 1–4); curry fried rice set; vegetable tantanmen; miso ramen; hot and sour noodles; jajangmyeon; five-ingredient fried rice ¥800; chive gyoza ¥300; vegetable gyoza ¥350; homemade chili oil; a 2020 diner says no chemical seasonings; cloth hand towels; light flavours.

食べログ: あづま軒、中華料理、ラーメン、餃子、日本橋人形町2-3-8、人形町駅.en: Tabelog: Azuma Ken, Chinese, ramen, gyoza; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-3-8, 2 min walk from Ningyocho Station; Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:00) and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed Sat, Sun and holidays; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 24 seats; all non-smoking at lunch, at night the first floor non-smoking and the second floor smoking. Reviews (March 2025–October 2026): about 77 years old; town Chinese; queues before opening; no shared tables; chuka-don ¥850; stir-fried meat and vegetables ¥800; pork with garlic chives ¥800; kara-age ¥750 (set ¥950); sauce yakisoba ¥950; wonton noodles ¥850; tantanmen; bean-sprout noodles; 10–20 minutes for food to arrive; office-worker drinking parties upstairs at night; cash only.

食べログ: あらた、お好み焼き・鉄板焼き、南区西九条院町24-4、JR京都駅八条.en: Tabelog: Arata, okonomiyaki, teppanyaki; 西九条院町24-4, Minami-ku; 6 min walk from the Hachijo exit of JR Kyoto Station; Monday–Saturday 17:00–21:45, closed Sunday; reservations accepted; 50 seats; tatami room; non-smoking; no cards, e-money or QR; Okonomiyaki Tabelog 100 2018, 2019, 2022–2025; plenty of horumon dishes; agi-filled Arata okonomiyaki ¥900, agi yakisoba ¥1,510, a homemade spicy sauce, "Aka" with shochu ¥420 (shop text). Reviews (September–October 2026, in English): Arata-yaki, horumon mix, salt-grilled hoso, mino, Mambo-yaki, Danjiri-yaki, garlic rice, Bakudan, 90-minute seating, cash only, full house.

食べログ: いとう、フレンチ、東山区古門前通石橋町307、東山駅から344m、火.en: Tabelog: いとう, French; 東山区古門前通石橋町307; 344 m from Higashiyama Station; Tue–Fri 12:00–13:30 and 17:00–22:00, Sat–Sun 11:30–13:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Monday; reservation only; 10 seats; non-smoking; cards accepted; particular about wine and fish; French WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023 and 2025. Shop introduction (English translation): classic French courses by owner-chef Ito, a platter of Kyoto seasonal vegetables, domestic Southdown lamb, wines mainly from Burgundy. Reviews (2023–2026, in English): run alone by owner-chef Tsutomu Ito for 22–23 years; an omakase built after asking preferences by phone; ancient rice with sea urchin and truffle; a plate of Kyoto vegetables; no bread; dessert ordered separately; lighter sauces for guests who don't drink wine.

食べログ: うどん・そば処 勝衛門、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町7-10、06-621.en: Tabelog: Udon & Soba Katsuemon, 7-10 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6211-5670; no reservations; Mon, Tue, Thu and Sun 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–3:00 next morning, Fri–Sat 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–6:00 next morning; closed Wednesdays; 10 seats. Reviews (June 2024 – February 2026): udon from ¥500; sea-urchin cream udon ¥1,200 (rice and cheese into the leftovers for risotto); late-night udon and soba in Minami's nightlife district; one says it's station-stand quality at double the price; open until 3 a.m.; reasonable; cheerful staff, easy to go in alone; oden too; ticket machine, but orders by voice too; kakiage udon ¥650 served in about a minute; many people from nearby shops; gentle Kansai dashi; udon, soba, katsudon; a katsudon neither too sweet nor too salty; udon with good bite; next to a club, busy late at night but quiet earlier.

食べログ: うどん・日本料理、東山区花見小路四条下ル二筋目西入ル小松町555-1.en: Tabelog: udon, Japanese cuisine; 花見小路四条下ル二筋目西入ル小松町555-1, Higashiyama-ku; 3 min walk from Exit 6 of Keihan Gion-Shijo Stn; Monday–Saturday 12:30–15:00 and 17:30–19:00 (last order 18:40); Sunday and holidays 12:30–15:30; closed irregularly; no reservations; 14 seats (three tables for 4, one for 2; single diners at a table for 4); cash only; non-smoking; a no-mobile-phone sign on the tables (photos allowed); wheelchair accessible. Reviews (April–November 2026, in English): negi udon ¥1,500; Kujo negi; ginger; kitsune udon; cold natto udon; oyako-don; kinugasa-don; Michelin listing; the TV show 'Jinsei Saikō Restaurant'; decorations with maiko names; no shared tables; queues of over an hour; a back alley behind Kennin-ji.

食べログ: うどん処 SOU 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-7-11 日宝ロ.en: Tabelog: Udon Dokoro SOU Shinsaibashi, Nippo Royal Bldg 3F, 2-7-11 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Namba stations; Tue–Sun 20:00–5:00 next morning (L.O. 4:30); closed Mondays; reservations accepted; cover charge ¥300; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 seats (counter 8, one table for 4); Sanuki udon focused on dashi, until 5 a.m. Reviews (March–September 2026): medicinal hot-pot course (a mountain of vegetables, house Chinese-style soup, chicken, pork and beef, egg dip, udon to finish); 3rd floor of the Nippo Royal Bldg; a calm bar-like space; mentaiko cream udon ¥1,380; kamatama; karaage; karaoke; cold pork-shabu udon ¥1,180; kombu and sea-bream dashi; hand-made Sanuki udon; smoking at all seats; free karaoke; sports on screens; plenty of snacks; ume udon (a big umeboshi and lots of wakame); good dashi.

食べログ: うどん工房 天空、うどん・天ぷら、大阪市淀川区東三国4-17-7 メ.en: Tabelog: Udon Kobo Tenku, udon and tempura, 4-17-7 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, メゾンハヤシ 1F; 3 min from Higashimikuni Station (Midosuji Line); Mon, Wed and Thu 11:00–14:30 and 17:30–20:00 (evenings until sold out), Tue, Fri, Sat and holidays 11:00–14:30, closed Sunday; no reservations; no cards, PayPay and Rakuten Pay accepted; 20 seats (counter and a tatami room at the back); non-smoking; children welcome; three children's menus (from ¥500); opened 22 March 2019. The shop's introduction: the "Nama Shoyu Udon" of the famous Osaka restaurant Umeda Hagakure; green onion, grated daikon, sudachi, a chosen soy sauce; the predecessor's teaching that "udon is like sashimi"; homemade noodles. Reviews (March to October 2026): a shop of a Hagakure disciple; cold Nama Shoyu Udon ¥900; the owner squeezes the sudachi and pours the soy; long, firm noodles; bukkake udon set ¥1,250 (chikuwa, pumpkin and egg tempura); bukkake tempura udon ¥1,300; meat and fried-eggplant oroshi bukkake; curry udon ¥1,200; cold curry tsukemen; sukiyaki kamatama udon ¥1,250; chilled kitsune udon ¥900; three-tempura set ¥300; "Manpuku" of kayaku rice and tempura ¥450; outstanding kayaku rice; oden; full at lunch with a line outside.

食べログ: うれしい居酒屋 酒歌、大阪市西区新町2-19-20 大阪屋西長堀ビル.en: Tabelog: Ureshii Izakaya Saka Song, Osakaya Nishi-Nagahori Bldg 1F, 2-19-20 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 291 m from Nishi-Ohashi; Mon–Sat 18:00–2:00 next morning; closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; smoking allowed; 15 seats (counter 9, tatami 6). Reviews (July 2023 – June 2026): a small izakaya at the back of a building; walls covered in stickers and posters; a friendly owner; first-timers made welcome; cheap small plates, so you can try lots even alone; yum woon sen with plenty of coriander; khao soi (shrimp, coconut soup, fried noodles, rice into the leftover soup); Chicken Hero; takuan and cream cheese; tuna with grated yam; salted snap peas; salt-grilled yagen cartilage; mushrooms grilled in anchovy butter; corn tempura; cash only.

食べログ: うを卯、大阪市西区北堀江2丁目3-13 レスポワール北堀江１F、西大.en: Tabelog: Uwo U, Les Poir Kita-Horie 1F, 2-3-13 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 2 min south of Nishi-Ohashi Station exit 3; Mon–Sat and holidays 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–20:30; closed Sundays; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 10 counter seats. Reviews (2014 – October 2026): an eel restaurant founded 1946; Kanto style (steamed, then grilled over Kishu binchotan); the sauce kept since the founding; grilled to order; unadon ¥1,800 (July 2026); jumbo unaju ¥3,600; Gomori-ju (eel and grilled liver) ¥2,200; Wakayama sansho; weekday Kimagure lunch (chicken-katsu rice bowl small ¥700, regular ¥900; kara-age ¥900); charcoal-grilled chicken set meal; busy around Doyo no Ushi; run by two people; Instagram @uou_horie_unagi.

食べログ: おいしい酒と料理 なかよし 日本橋店、大阪市中央区千日前2-3-1.en: Tabelog: Oishii Sake to Ryori Nakayoshi Nippombashi, Seven Bldg 1F, 2-3-1 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Kintetsu Nippombashi Station; Tue–Sun and holidays 17:00–23:30 (food L.O. 23:00); closed Mondays; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; smoking allowed; 17 seats (counter 6, tables 8); seasonal fish bought at market by the owner; over 40 sakes in a dedicated fridge; over 80 shochu; over 15 umeshu. Reviews (February–September 2026): sashimi platter (5 or 7 kinds: tuna, yellowtail, sea bream, salmon, marinated mackerel, octopus, squid); dashimaki on a hot iron plate with dashi poured over; house zaru tofu; shirasu with grated daikon and ponzu; fried hatahata; asparagus or aonori-and-onion tempura; pressed mackerel sushi; anglerfish liver with narazuke; crab miso; simmered wakame and bamboo shoots; beef cutlet; run by two people; dishes take a little time; one found many sakes sold out.

食べログ: おかる、お好み焼き・焼きそば・明石焼き、大阪市中央区千日前1-9-1.en: Tabelog: Okaru, okonomiyaki, yakisoba and akashiyaki, Sennichimae 1-9-19, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 4 min walk from Nihonbashi Station exit 2 or Namba Station exit 15A, 12:00–14:30, 17:00–21:30, closed Thursday, no reservations, no cards, e-money or QR, 50 seats (tables), non-smoking, children welcome, Okonomiyaki 100 in 2018 and 2019. Shop introduction (machine-translated): semi-private teppan tables, a lady speaking Osaka dialect, okonomiyaki with pictures drawn in mayonnaise, the previous owner ordered stainless-steel spatulas from a hardware shop on Doguya-suji (aluminium before that), a press-and-steam way of cooking. Menu (updated 2016): pork, meat (minced), squid, shrimp, octopus, oysters in winter, a special with two fillings of your choice, modern-yaki, yakisoba and yaki udon, salt-grilled squid, yakitori, kushikatsu, akashiyaki, rice balls, nori chazuke, a set (rice, pickles, miso soup), sherbets. Reviews (June–October 2026): staff cook at the table, steamed under a lid, fluffy and full of egg, yam, a sweetish sauce and a thinner sauce on the table, mayonnaise pictures of Osaka Castle, Tsutenkaku, Hello Kitty, Myakumyaku and 'Osaka', special ¥1,600, squid ¥1,000, bottled cola and orange ¥300, Dotonbori yakisoba with thick noodles tasting of dashi and soy, akashiyaki, cash only, a queue before opening, a 50-minute wait on a Saturday evening, many overseas guests, 'ookini'.

食べログ: おそば 照庵 銀座、銀座7-2-12、60席(カウンター8、2階30.en: Tabelog: Osoba Shoan Ginza, Ginza 7-2-12; 60 seats (8 counter, 30 on 2F, a private room for 6, a tatami room for 8, sunken kotatsu); Mon–Fri 17:30–2:30, closed weekends and holidays; 15% service charge; particular about sake and shochu; all-you-can-drink by asking the manager after 16:00; opened November 7, 2011. 2026 reviews: open until late; soba; tendon; squid tempura; oden; bonito with ginger; squid sashimi; corn tempura; beef tofu; vinegared tuna; seiro (some days no black seiro); Nabeshima; an L-shaped 8-seat counter and 2F; a handmade copper oden pot; dashimaki ¥1,200; tsukune ¥440; warm service; a small late-night charge; comes twice a month for the seiro and black seiro.

食べログ: おでん すみ吉、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-3-3 オー・エム・ホテル日.en: Tabelog: Oden Sumiyoshi, Hotel Nikko Osaka Bldg B2F, 1-3-3 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 148 m from Shinsaibashi; Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri and days before and after holidays 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:30, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–22:30; closed Wednesdays; 10% service charge (none at lunch); cards, e-money and QR accepted; 17 seats; opened 15 September 2019; official site. Reviews (December 2025 – August 2026): one says it follows on from Takokichi, which closed in 2019; 3 dashi matched to the ingredients; the special creative oden potato ball; potato with butter; Kuroge wagyu shabu-shabu-style oden; special creative oden 'secret daikon' (white-miso dashi and pork belly); octopus; atsuage; konnyaku; red-pickled-ginger tempura; whale koro; egg; dashimaki; seasonal starters and sashimi; seasonal tempura; clay-pot rice to finish; house Yukimi Daifuku; lunch seasonal tempura gozen ¥2,480; Tosa sake; house ginger ale; private rooms; one found portions modest; courteous service.

食べログ: おでんのハチマル、大阪市中央区日本橋1-23-33、近鉄日本橋駅から.en: Tabelog: Oden no Hachimal, 1-23-33 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Kintetsu Nippombashi Station; daily 18:00–1:00 next morning; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 9 seats (counter 7, tables 2); no smoking (ashtray outside). Reviews (April–August 2026): a sister shop of the fish-cake maker Hachimal Kamaboko; a gentle Osaka oden dashi you could drink; 5-item platter (daikon, beef tendon, egg, atsuage, mochi kinchaku); yuba; corn; duck; leek kinchaku; shirataki; sea bream with salt and lemon; shiitake; takoyaki; shumai floating in dashi with black pepper; freshly fried fish cakes (with wood-ear and more); dashimaki wrapped in a cherry leaf; ginger tempura; corn tempura; firefly squid in shoyu; hiyashi chuka or chazuke to finish; seasonal sake; apple-vinegar sour; smartphone ordering (one says an order never arrived); calm and clean; fine alone.

食べログ: おでん割烹 叶哉、おでん・居酒屋、下京区木屋町通仏光寺上ル天王町15.en: Tabelog: おでん割烹 叶哉, oden and izakaya; 下京区木屋町通仏光寺上ル天王町157-727; 5 min on foot from Hankyu Kyoto Kawaramachi Station; Mon–Sat and holidays 16:00–23:00; closed Sunday (and irregularly); reservations taken (TableCheck); bookings cancelled automatically after 30 minutes' unannounced delay; otoshi charge ¥700; 19 seats (13 counter); private rooms (4 and 6); smoking area for heated tobacco only; cards, e-money and QR payments accepted; opened 25 April 2024. Reviews (2025–2026, in English): moved from Gion; course ¥9,000; sashimi; white fish simmered with vegetables; tender simmered octopus; egg topped with salmon roe; winter yellowtail; dashimaki; saikyo-yaki; duck with celeriac; dashi-wari; matsutake somen and matsutake rice; Showa-era pop songs.

食べログ: おにぎり三昧 ちゅん太郎、大阪市中央区南船場4-10-21 日宝エコ.en: Tabelog: Onigiri Zanmai Chuntaro, Nippo Eco Bldg 1F, Minami-Senba 4-10-21, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min from Yotsubashi Stn Exit 1-a, 4 min from Shinsaibashi Stn Exit 3; daily 18:00–24:00; irregular closures; reservations accepted; cards accepted; no e-money or QR; 15 seats (counter 7, tables 8); non-smoking (ashtray outside); children and strollers welcome; opened 11 February 2021. Shop's introduction: an onigiri specialist with seasonal fish, meat and vegetable dishes, food to go with drinks and onigiri to finish, non-drinkers welcome, hard to find at the back of the building but solo diners welcome. Reviews (April 2025–September 2026): organic Koshihikari from Okayama; egg-yolk miso, mentaiko butter, house tuna mayo, cream-cheese miso, okaka, ume, tenmusu; a sticky "nebaneba" soup, soup with big clams, Senba soup; firefly squid, dashimaki, fried chicken, mackerel grilled with miso, white miso with dried persimmon, agedashi tofu, oden, sashimi platter; organic, pesticide-free ingredients; run alone by a young man; the one plate (three small onigiri) only when the owner has time; courses by advance reservation; in April 2025 a limited onigiri lunch 13:00–15:00 (one plate ¥1,500 or a pork kakuni set).

食べログ: おにぎり屋 シチロカ、日本料理、おにぎり、日本橋人形町3-5-6 榎.en: Tabelog: Onigiri-ya Shichiroca; Japanese cuisine, onigiri; 榎本ビル 1F, Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 3-5-6; 2 min from Ningyocho Station exit A5; Mon–Fri 7:30–14:00 (takeaway only 10:00–11:00); closed Sundays and holidays; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; 2 seats; non-smoking; opened 9 September 2014; fluffy rice cooked in a pot; a focus on "ingredients" and "homemade"; website shichiroca.net. Reviews (December 2023–June 2026): large, fluffy onigiri; Akita Komachi from Ogata village; Ariake nori; salmon in shio-koji; house-made tuna mayo without canned tuna; smoked takuan with cheese; Nanko plum; simmered clams; miso soup of three misos; one review gives Saturday 9:00–14:00 too; morning sets; mostly takeaway.

食べログ: おはら、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-9-5 日宝三ツ寺会館 1F、心斎橋.en: Tabelog: Ohara, Nippo Mitsudera Kaikan 1F, 2-9-5 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 8 min south-west of Shinsaibashi; Mon–Sat 18:30–1:00 next morning (L.O. 0:30); closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 seats (two tables for 4, counter 4); smoking allowed. Reviews (October 2023 – September 2026): Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki in Amemura; squid legs; pork kimchi; beef tendon with ponzu; tetchan kimchi; salt yakisoba; draught beer in frozen mugs in summer; visited for years; known to those in the know; one says the owner is hard to talk to at first but kind; plenty of cabbage; teppan kimchi; very cheap; one calls it Osaka's best Hiroshima-yaki; extra leek; teppan-grilled octopus; bone-in sausage; one found the owner curt; squid, octopus, scallop; konnyaku; lots of kimchi; thin-noodle yakisoba; off-menu items; soba, meat and egg double; crisp noodles and a spicy sauce; beef tendon with ponzu; the owner alone cooks, serves and takes payment.

食べログ: お好み オモニ 宗右衛門町店、お好み焼き・焼きそば、大阪市中央区心斎.en: Tabelog: Okonomi Omoni Souemonchou ten, okonomiyaki and yakisoba; リップル宗右衛門町ビル 1F, 2-3-13 Shinsaibashi-suji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Namba Stn; Mon–Wed 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–24:00, Thu–Sun 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–2:00; no reservations; cards (JCB, AMEX) and QR accepted, no e-money; smoking allowed. Reviews (April 2024–June 2026): the main shop in Tsuruhashi, plus Soemoncho and Grand Front; Soemoncho a little pricier than the main shop; a regular says the taste varies as the grillers change; Omoni-yaki, plenty of egg, cabbage-heavy and fluffy; about 30 toppings including kimchi; ABCDE-yaki ¥1,650 (pork, shrimp, mochi, egg, cheese); thick-noodle yakisoba (sauce or squid and salt, small or large); tonpei-yaki, grilled squid, a foil-baked dish; celebrity autographs and photos; full by about 19:00 on a Friday in April 2026; smoking allowed.

食べログ: お好み 鉄板 居酒屋 DON、お好み焼き・居酒屋・鉄板焼き、大阪市中.en: Tabelog: Okonomi Teppan Izakaya DON, okonomiyaki, izakaya and teppanyaki, Namba 3-2-33, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 minutes from Namba Station, between 551 Horai and Bic Camera; Wed, Thu, Sun and holidays 11:00–21:00 (food L.O. 20:30), Fri–Sat 11:00–22:00 (food L.O. 21:30); closed Mondays and Tuesdays, plus irregular closures; reservations from 2 people (one drink and one dish each when booked); no service or cover charge; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 75 seats (37 on the 2nd floor, 38 on the 3rd); heated tobacco only in a smoking area; vegetarian options shown. Reviews (February 2025–August 2026): DON Special okonomiyaki, butatama ¥900, horumon yakisoba, seared negi-pork ¥980, four-cheese okonomiyaki, shrimp and cheese, suji-kimchi-tama, negiyaki, omu-tama, butter-grilled scallops and mushrooms, winter oyster okonomiyaki, shrimp garlic butter, Toyama sake, comedians' autographs, the owner speaks English, many Japanese guests and fair prices, one reviewer found little filling.

食べログ: お好み焼き・もんじゃ焼き・居酒屋、中京区河原町通六角西入ル松ケ枝町4.en: Tabelog: okonomiyaki, monjayaki, izakaya; 3F, 464 Matsugaecho, Rokkaku-dori west of Kawaramachi, Nakagyo Ward; 5 min walk from Sanjo, Kawaramachi and Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stns; daily 11:30–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); closed irregularly; reservations accepted; 44 seats; tatami room; private hire for 20–50; smoking allowed; cards and PayPay accepted; vegetarian options listed; opening day 4 March 2000; 20 years on Kawaramachi; authentic monjayaki, rare in Kyoto; fluffy batter. Reviews (May–October 2026, English): monjayaki ¥850 (squid, mentaiko, Baby Star; beef tendon and green onion; mentaiko-mochi-cheese); okonomiyaki mix ¥1,199; yakisoba; negiyaki with beef tendon ¥902; ikatama ¥891; third floor with no lift; one says founded 27 years ago; the name is the previous owner's nickname; one says dishes seem pre-made or frozen; portions on the small side.

食べログ: お好み焼き・鉄板焼き、東山区東大路安井北門通月見町13、京阪祇園四条.en: Tabelog: okonomiyaki, teppanyaki; 東大路安井北門通月見町13, Higashiyama-ku; from Exit 6 of Keihan Gion-Shijo Stn south along Higashioji-dori, opposite the Tsukimicho post office, 8 min walk; Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Sunday 12:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); Friday, Saturday 12:00–3:00 (last order 2:00); closed Monday and the 1st and 3rd Tuesday; reservations accepted; two-hour limit; 12 counter seats; non-smoking; no cards, e-money or QR; Okonomiyaki Tabelog 100 2018, 2019, 2022–2025. Reviews (2025–2026, in English): founded 1984; negiyaki (pork ¥800, mix, egg +¥100); betayaki mix ¥1,000; special dashimaki ¥650 (green onion and pickled ginger); potato salad ¥500; tonpeiyaki; beef tendon; the owner's homemade simmered whelk; a counter with many regulars; cash only.

食べログ: お結び屋TARITARI、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町1-28 三ッ寺ギャ.en: Tabelog: Omusubi Ya TARITARI, Mitsudera Galaxy Bldg No. 8 1F, 1-28 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 5 min walk from Kintetsu Nippombashi and Nagahoribashi stations; Mon, Tue, Fri–Sun and holidays 18:00–7:00 next morning (food L.O. 6:00), Wed 18:00–23:00; closed Thursdays; opened 9 January 2025; starter ¥330; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; 14 seats (counter 7, tables 7); children and pushchairs welcome; takeaway; official site. Reviews (February–October 2026): fish the owner catches weekly in Wakayama and Maizuru; rice from Niigata and Hiroshima; Oita shoyu; sashimi platter; thick-cut sashimi; seafood rice bowl; rice balls; today's miso soup; tonjiru; a photo caption says 'the extra-large fried horse mackerel is the top pick'; grilled yellowtail collar; marinated mackerel; hot pot for one; tamago kake gohan; friendly staff; one says closed Wednesdays and open until 23:00 on Thursdays.

食べログ: お茶と晴ル、甘味処・かき氷、東山区祇園町南側570-125、祇園四条.en: Tabelog: お茶と晴ル (ocha to haru), Japanese sweets and kakigori; 東山区祇園町南側570-125; 4 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn; 12:30–17:00; closed Wednesday; bookings taken; 12 seats; private room; no cards, e-money or QR; opened 1 May 2024. Reviews (August 2025–October 2026, in English): Uji matcha kakigori ¥1,600 (spring-water ice, azuki, three shiratama, matcha syrup and condensed milk on the side), warabi mochi and drink set ¥1,700 (¥1,750 with matcha or matcha latte), zenzai, hojicha ¥800, a counter of 5 and a table, a small waiting garden at the entrance, a building said to be 90 years old.

食べログ: お酒と食事 うり、日本料理・おでん、下京区足袋屋町317-15、京都.en: Tabelog: お酒と食事 うり, Japanese cuisine and oden; 下京区足袋屋町317-15; 282 m from Kyoto Kawaramachi Station; Tue–Sun 17:00–22:00; closed Monday; reservations taken; no service charge or otoshi charge; 11 seats (4 counter); non-smoking; cards accepted; opened 20 November 2018; former head chef of Nikomi Suzuya. Reviews (2024–2026, in English): a hideaway at the end of a narrow alley; five-dish omakase ¥6,600; saba sushi; duck roast; ebi-mame; tokobushi; Awaji hamo; Akashi sea bream; Kamo eggplant agedashi ¥980; summer vegetable tempura ¥1,280; oyster tempura and oyster rice; the head chef alone in the kitchen; seats and the toilet upstairs.

食べログ: お食事処 今ちゃん、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-1-13 大阪屋ジャンボ.en: Tabelog: Oshokuji Dokoro Imachan, Osakaya Jumbo Bldg 1F, 2-1-13 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 10 min walk from Nagahoribashi and Nippombashi stations; Mon–Sat 18:00–2:00 next morning, Sun and holidays 18:00–24:00; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money or QR; about 8 counter seats; opened 24 August 2009. Reviews (July 2017 – February 2026): natto yaki; pork kimchi; itawasa sautéed in butter; firefly squid with vinegared miso; mixed salad; edamame sautéed in butter; gyoza; order a little at a time, as ordering too much at once gets you scolded; at the back of Jumbo Yokocho; run single-handed; nikujaga; a calm atmosphere; the neon of Jumbo Yokocho; renovated; the owner unchanged; a hard-to-find entrance; a friendly owner; cheap dishes like Showa-era home cooking; strong highballs; a warm atmosphere; all hand-made; cured mackerel; karaage; chikuzen-ni; Showa set; diners naturally help one another; the owner runs it single-handed; the green-tea highball is 70% shochu; nostalgic flavours; enjoyable alone.

食べログ: お魚処 藁ヤキ炭ヒデ、居酒屋・海鮮・創作料理、大阪市淀川区東三国4-.en: Tabelog: Osakana Dokoro Warayaki Sumi Hide, izakaya, seafood and creative, 4-16-12 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 2 min from Higashi-Mikuni Station; Mon and Wed (and days before and after holidays) 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–22:00, Tue and Thu 17:00–22:00, Fri and Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00; closed Sunday and holidays; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; cover charge; 27 seats; non-smoking; children welcome; all-you-can-drink courses; opened 18 September 2024. Reviews (August–October 2026): katsuo seared over straw in front of the counter, thick and rare inside, with salt and sudachi; one diner says the katsuo is from Miyagi; lunch ¥1,650, a choice of straw-seared fish (katsuo, buri, hamachi), fried dishes or simmered fish, with four obanzai, rice, miso soup and a small dessert (catalana); full after 12:00, so book; at night the sashimi of the day (buri), scallops, duck, kara-age, fried octopus, octopus carpaccio, ganmo, chicken skin, mozuku; plenty of sake; about ¥5,000–7,000 a head at night; a friendly master; hard to see inside from the street.

食べログ: かき小屋ランドリー、大阪市中央区日本橋2-7-25、日本橋駅から徒歩.en: Tabelog: Kaki Goya Laundry, 2-7-25 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nippombashi Station; Mon–Sat 17:00–24:00, Sun and holidays 15:00–24:00; L.O. 23:30; closes when sold out; irregular closing days; phone bookings from 15:00; cards, e-money, PayPay and Alipay accepted; smoking allowed; 14 seats. Reviews (June–October 2026): down a narrow street off the main road, on the edge of Ura-Namba; fresh raw oysters all year; a tasting of 3; raw oysters from Senpoushi and Konbumori; Sakoshi oysters in the set; all-you-can-eat steamed oysters (seasonings such as Lemosco, sesame oil and ponzu); shells into the bucket at your feet; oyster bucket (onion, tomato, bacon); fried oysters; butter shoyu; gratin; ajillo with baguette; cream croquettes; risotto to finish (carbonara-style, tomato, basil); kind staff.

食べログ: かき氷・ソフトクリーム・うどん、東山区白糸町569-10、清水五条駅.en: Tabelog: kakigori, soft serve, udon; 白糸町569-10, Higashiyama-ku; 12 min walk from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn, 6 min from Kiyomizu-dera; daily 10:00–21:30 (may change irregularly); no reservations; 12 seats; smoking allowed; cards (VISA, Master), transport IC cards and iD; Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2022, 2023, 2026. Reviews (March–October 2026, in English): Gojo-zaka; Uji Kintoki kakigori ¥1,200; matcha kakigori with shiratama; hojicha soft serve ¥700; matcha soft serve ¥800; matcha ice cream ¥700; jumbo kitsune udon ¥1,200–1,300; wagyu udon (udon from Kochi, beef from Ginza Yoshizawa); upstairs seats and a courtyard; a note of ¥200 extra for the air-conditioned room; an owner passionate about matcha.

食べログ: かすうどん うのたけ、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-9-5 日宝三ツ寺会館.en: Tabelog: Kasu Udon Unotake, Nippo Mitsudera Kaikan 2F, 2-9-5 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 8 seats; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 18:00–1:00 next morning; closed Wednesdays; closes when sold out; cards accepted; no smoking. 2026 reviews (June–October): a long-standing kasu udon shop in a multi-tenant building in Amemura; visited for over 10 years; prices from a few hundred yen up to over ¥1,000; the umami of the kasu and a clear, clean soup; after drinking; well-judged noodle firmness; crunchy fried beef offal (abura-kasu) and leek; kasu udon with ume and tororo kombu; due to move by June 2027 because the building is being renovated; the pink sign of Mitsudera Kaikan; a graffiti-covered corridor; the 8 counter seats full of young diners; 80s–90s hard rock (Guns N' Roses, Van Halen); spicy at the back; prices raised.

食べログ: かす中華そば かすうどん しばいけ、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-4-19.en: Tabelog: Kasu Chuka Soba Kasu Udon Shibaike, Tamayacho Galaxy 3 B1F, 2-4-19 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Mon–Sat 22:00–7:00 next morning; closed Sundays, holidays and third Mondays; no cards, e-money or QR payment; smoking allowed. 2026 reviews (June–September): rich kasu chuka soba; opens at 10 p.m.; doesn't sit heavy the next morning; easy on the body; kasu chuka soba recommended over the udon (May 2022); meat kasu udon and a small beer; kasu made from beef intestine; kasu udon late at night; hard to find; popular even early in the morning; nira-and-egg kasu udon; beef kasu udon; near Nagahoribashi Station; meat kasu udon with umeboshi added; pour the soup over niboshi rice; udon about ¥1,000; thinnish noodles.

食べログ: かっちゃんラーメン、大阪市中央区北久宝寺町2-1-2、堺筋本町駅10.en: Tabelog: Kacchan Ramen, 2-1-2 Kita-Kyuhojimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min on foot from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Stn exit 10; daily 11:00–24:30 (L.O. 24:00); no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 24 seats; non-smoking; opened 12 August 2026. Operator (ALL WIN Co., Ltd.) news: "Sakaisuji-Hommachi Kacchan Ramen" grand opening 12 August 2026; a chuka soba shop that goes against the times and picks the classic over the trend, built on shoyu, shio and miso; the town chuka soba shop of childhood; Showa chuka soba; house-made noodles focused on wheat flavour and smoothness; a clear, light broth; gyoza made by hand from the filling up; fried rice made with carefully chosen eggs; fast, tasty, filling. The store list also includes CoCo Ichibanya, Ramen Daisensou and others. Reviews (August–October 2026): chuka soba ¥980, shio ramen ¥980, flavored egg ¥120, miso ramen, garlic ramen; a small fried rice free with any ramen; all-you-can-eat fried rice for ¥380; refills in about 2 minutes; some ate 4–5 servings; chicken bones and chicken oil, a hint of shellfish, sweetish Kyushu soy sauce, thin straight noodles; chashu thin and small but tender per one diner, thick with some fat per another; evening sides from 16:00 (fried horse mackerel, menchi katsu, thick ham cutlet, cream croquettes, croquettes, red sausages, liver and garlic stir-fry); kara-age, kimchi on its own, garlicky gyoza; ticket machine, cash only; on the table: spicy miso, garlic vinegar, fried-rice sauce, chili oil, gyoza sauce, ramen pepper; YouTubers have filmed here; one harsh review found the fried rice bland and the garlic ramen not hot; one diner says the site was earlier a ramen shop of the same company.

食べログ: かつ丼千代松豪仁、大阪市西区新町1-8-24 角屋四ツ橋ビル 1F、.en: Tabelog: Katsu-don Chiyomatsu Hideto, Shinmachi 1-8-24, Nishi-ku, Osaka, building 1F; 5 min from Yotsubashi Stn (288 m); daily 11:00–15:00; closed 29 December–4 January; no reservations; cards (VISA, Master, JCB) and PayPay; no e-money; 14 seats (counter 8, tables 6); non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; a step at the entrance (staff help); English, Simplified Chinese and Korean menus; order by QR code; takeaway; opened 20 September 2025; corporate-member listing. Shop text: extra-thick katsu-don by a former sumo wrestler; a 5 cm pork cutlet laid on soft, runny egg; change the taste with yuzu pepper, ponzu and mustard; Hoegaarden. Reviews (December 2025–September 2026): on a former ramen shop site; run by a former sumo wrestler, with a life-size panel; a sister shop of the Sennichimae extra-thick tonkatsu shop (renamed from Chiyomatsu to Osaka Tonkatsu); thick pork marinated in a special liquid and cooked at low temperature; regular 200 g ¥1,500, jo 300 g ¥2,000, and a larger special; pork miso soup included; not simmered in egg, so the cutlet stays crisp; ponzu, mustard, yuzu pepper, rock salt, sauce; some found it ham-like, salty, or the pork miso soup thin.

食べログ: かつ兵衛、カツ丼、大阪市淀川区東三国4-17-7、東三国駅から201.en: Tabelog: Katsu Bei, katsu-don, 4-17-7 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 201 m from Higashimikuni Station; Mon–Wed 11:00–14:00 and 17:00–21:00, Thu–Sat 11:00–14:00, closed Sunday; no reservations; cash only; 12 seats (counter); non-smoking. Reviews (November 2024 to October 2026): run alone by the owner; 10–11 counter seats; ticket machine; lines at lunch; katsu-don ¥900, oroshi katsu-don ¥900, sauce katsu-don ¥900, curry katsu-don ¥970, with red miso soup; large rice ¥50, double egg ¥50, double katsu ¥450; a thick loin cutlet fried to order and cut in eight, topped with egg simmered in dashi; the sauce katsu-don comes with cabbage and an onsen egg; a card about the pork, "What's Amazing Here!"; takuan; Southern All Stars playing; some say evenings end at 19:00; sometimes opens before 11:00.

食べログ: かつ好、とんかつ、日本橋人形町3-4-11、人形町駅から徒歩2分、月.en: Tabelog: Katsu Yoshi; tonkatsu; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 3-4-11; 2 min from Ningyocho Station; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–20:30; closed Sunday; reservations accepted; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR; 19 seats (7 at the 1st-floor counter, 12 at 2nd-floor tables); non-smoking; an old house; opened 1 November 2016; Tonkatsu Tabelog 100 in 2018, 2019, 2021, 2022, 2024 and 2026; website katuyoshi.com. Menu (August 2023): loin katsu 110 g from ¥1,705, fillet katsu 110 g from ¥1,925, special 250 g ¥4,015 and ¥4,290, shabu-maki katsu, soft-shell-turtle curry ¥660. Reviews (October 2026): loin and fillet at the same price; rice and pickles ¥330 (large portion and refills free); miso soup ¥275; no set meals, order separately; course A ¥4,950 (onion salad, croquette, simmered fillet, tonkatsu, turtle curry, matcha ice cream); salt, plum salt, sauce, wasabi soy; a line before opening; booking recommended; one diner found the batter heavy.

食べログ: かね正、うなぎ、東山区大和大路通四条上ル2丁目常盤町155-2、祇園.en: Tabelog: かね正 (Kane Sho), eel; 東山区大和大路通四条上ル2丁目常盤町155-2; 3 min on foot from Gion-Shijo Station; 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed Thursday and Sunday; reservations for dinner only; 14 seats (6 counter, 8 table); non-smoking; no cards, e-money or QR payments; no service or cover charge. Reviews (2025–2026, in English): founded 1866 (Keio era); said to be the birthplace of the kinshi-don; Michelin Bib Gourmand; grilled Kansai-style without steaming; kinshi-don ¥2,700; unaju; mamushi-don; eel ochazuke (with real tea); evening omakase (simmered liver, shirayaki, dashimaki, eel omelette); liver soup; run by two people; the entrance is hard to find.

食べログ: がんばれ ホウライ、大阪市西区南堀江2-11-20、桜川駅から409.en: Tabelog: Ganbare Hourai, 2-11-20 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 409 m from Sakuragawa Station; Mon 17:00–21:00, Tue–Sun 17:00–24:00; irregular closing days; no cards or e-money; QR accepted; smoking area. Reviews (October 2025 – July 2026): opposite Takadaibashi Park; a cafe-like interior; one says open all day; salt or shoyu tori-paitan ramen (comes with a seasoned egg); half size ¥800; thick house chashu; chopped onion and fried garlic; menma topping ¥200; tantanmen; Taiwan maze-soba; small fried rice ¥350; gyoza; Chama Mayo Don; plenty of drinks and à la carte; ashtrays at counter and tables; takeaway too.

食べログ: きたん 韻、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-7-12 1F(法善寺)、050-.en: Tabelog: Kitan In, 1F, 1-7-12 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka (Hozenji), 050-5890-1734; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sat 19:00–21:30; closed Wednesdays, Sundays and irregular days; budget ¥20,000–30,000; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 10% service charge; 10 seats; opened 15 April 2022; Hyakumeiten (Yakiniku WEST 2023 and 2025, Grill WEST 2024 and 2026). 2026 reviews (June–September): yakiniku and meat dishes of aged Matsusaka and Miyazaki beef; Hozenji Yokocho; a 10-seat counter; reservations only, booked out half a year ahead; everyone starts together at 19:00; omakase course ¥19,800; wagyu bought direct from producers; at the end, as much yakiniku as you like; wine pairing; aged meat; yukhoe; meat kappo; a shop of the group's owner; a soup of only wagyu bones and water, with the saltiness of hamaguri; Manyo beef; aged tuna; dishes that change with the season; closing meat grilled by the chef; booked two months ahead.

食べログ: きのこの里、大阪市中央区南船場4-10-20 グランドメゾン西心斎橋.en: Tabelog: Kinoko no Sato, Grand Maison Nishi-Shinsaibashi 1F, 4-10-20 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 6 min walk from Shinsaibashi, Yotsubashi and Hommachi stations; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 17:00–22:30, Sat, Sun and holidays 17:00–22:30; L.O. food 21:00, drinks 22:00; closed over New Year and irregular days; weekday lunch is soup curry only; creative mushroom dishes at night (no soup curry); some days a course at lunch (Instagram); cards accepted; 16 seats (counter 8, tables 8). Reviews (September–October 2026): Bamboo course (sashimi of various mushrooms, shiitake dobin-mushi, grilled, tempura, mushroom hot pot, risotto from the hot pot, course-only ice cream); à la carte mushroom hot pot; maitake tempura; grilled shiitake; fried shiitake; mushroom sake and gin; staff explain the mushrooms and how to eat them; gentle seasoning; one says booking is essential; one found the tempura soggy.

食べログ: きよ田、銀座6-3-15、銀座駅C2出口から徒歩5分、9席、月〜土1.en: Tabelog: Kiyota, Ginza 6-3-15, 5 minutes' walk from Ginza Station exit C2; 9 seats; Mon–Sat 12:00–14:00, 18:00–22:00, closed Sundays and holidays; cards: JCB, AMEX, Diners; budget ¥50,000–60,000 at night, ¥30,000–40,000 at lunch. Shop introduction: fourth-generation Norihiko Yoshizawa (born 1976 in Kyoto; 15+ years at Kiyota; learned everything from fish selection to nigiri from Kimura). 2026 reviews: founded 1963, first generation Shigezo Fujimoto (English spelling only); "Kiyota of tuna"; Oma tuna, Hagi red uni, kohada, kombu-cured flounder, seared kama-toro, conger eel, uni rolls, abalone zosui; regulars and inbound visitors.

食べログ: きりん寺 アメ村店、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-6-17、06-6484.en: Tabelog: Kirinji Amemura, 1-6-17 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6484-6068; no reservations; daily 11:30–16:30 and 18:00–22:00; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking; run by the Suzume group. 2026 reviews (April–September): crowded even after 15:00; overseas tour groups too; light, tasty abura soba; abura soba at ¥850 is cheap; before a gig at BIG CAT; hand over the meal ticket, served in 5 minutes; chewy noodles with vinegar and chili oil; a free soft-boiled egg with the password (August 2026); more affordable than a ramen shop; kimchi topping; good for abura-soba beginners; the egg topping recommended; plenty of vinegar and two rounds of chili oil; a wall covered in celebrity photos; adjust with vinegar, chili oil, spicy miso and garlic on the table; sometimes a long wait.

食べログ: きりん寺 裏なんば店、大阪市中央区日本橋2-5-8、近鉄日本橋駅から.en: Tabelog: Kirinji Ura-Namba, 2-5-8 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 237 m from Kintetsu Nippombashi Station; daily 11:30–20:00; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking; opened 16 June 2021. Reviews (June 2025 – September 2026): abura soba; karaage and TKG set; chili oil; should have gone large; the catchphrase says you're hooked after 3 bowls, this was the 5th; vinegar and chili oil; 4 min walk from Nippombashi Station; abura soba with soft-boiled egg and karaage; medium-thick wavy noodles; soft-boiled egg, menma, chashu, nori, white sesame; ticket machine; soft-boiled egg version ¥950; one says saying 'Kirinji' when handing over the ticket got a soft-boiled egg added; the Sennichimae shop had a queue, the Ura-Namba shop had seats at once; not as heavy as it looks.

食べログ: ぎゅっこ志 なんばラーメン一座店、大阪市中央区難波3-2-18 エデ.en: Tabelog: Gyukkoshi Namba Ramen Ichiza, Edion Namba main store 9F, 3-2-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 10 seats; daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); no cards or e-money; QR payment accepted; no smoking (smoking room on 9F); opened 24 December 2025; site namba-ramen-ichiza.com. 2026 reviews (July–October): golden-niboshi-scented ¥1,080 and seasoned egg ¥200 (¥250 on the menu); niboshi in beef-bone soup; thin straight noodles; a little light overall; roast-beef chashu; summer-only cold wagyu gozen ¥1,480; hooked on the clear soup; noodle thickness and firmness just right; free noodle refills until 21:00; black beef-bone curry with rice; beef-bone paitan with seasoned egg and large rice ¥1,550; a Minotaur decoration; the owner's cheerful voice; special rich beef-bone paitan ¥1,000; cloudy soup with beefy umami; creamy, not too heavy; slightly flat noodles; pea shoots, baby corn, red-cabbage sprouts.

食べログ: ぎをん 福志、日本料理、東山区祇園町南側570-120、祇園四条駅か.en: Tabelog: Gion Fukushi, Japanese cuisine, 東山区祇園町南側570-120, about 10 min on foot from Gion-Shijo Stn; reservation only; everyone starts at 18:00; closed Sundays and irregularly; prices revised from 1 October; 100% cancellation fee from 5 days before; 7 counter seats; private hire up to 8; junior-high age and up; cards accepted; service 10%; opened 1 December 2017; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2023. Reviews (November 2024–September 2026, in English): owner Takuji Fukushi is from Aomori, staff fluent in English, tableware and dashi, many overseas guests.

食べログ: ぎをん鮨尚充、寿司、東山区祇園町南側570-239、花見小路通「祇園.en: Tabelog: ぎをん鮨尚充 (Gion Sushi Takamitsu), sushi; 東山区祇園町南側570-239; next to 祇園 徳山 on Hanamikoji; 10 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn; Mon–Sat and holidays 12:00–15:00, 18:00–20:30 and 21:00–23:30; closed Sunday; reservation only (booked through OMAKASE, course fee paid in advance, extras on the day by cash or card); 10 seats; non-smoking; opened 10 February 2025. Review (April 2026, in Japanese): a Kyoto branch, by noren-wake, of a famous Nakameguro restaurant; shijimi soup; Nagasaki oysters; white squid; kohada; white shrimp; bafun sea urchin; salt-grilled kinmedai with yamawasabi; tuna steak; iburi-gakko with mascarpone; Nachikatsuura tuna; chutoro and otoro; toro-taku with caviar; shirako; ankimo; warm somen; tamagoyaki; a VIP-style send-off at the end. English reviews (December 2025–October 2026): chef Jun Kamekawa; a tequila toast; Louis Vuitton cases.

食べログ: くいしんぼ、大阪市西区南堀江1-1-20、四つ橋駅から徒歩1分、心斎.en: Tabelog: Kuishinbo, 1-1-20 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Yotsubashi Station, 8 from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon–Fri 12:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00), Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:00); irregular closing days (check Instagram); no reservations on weekends and holidays; 10% service charge; no cards, e-money or QR. Reviews (June–October 2026): near Amemura; okonomiyaki with a fluffy, creamy batter (pork ¥900); Kuishinbo yakisoba ¥1,500 (pork, squid, shrimp, octopus); seafood okonomiyaki; pork modan-yaki; yakisoba in a squid-and-pork omelette (chewy noodles); offal; negiyaki; takoyaki grilled at the entrance, takeaway too; rice or oolong tea +¥100 at lunch; oolong tea ¥250; highball; bottled beer; about 10 counter seats at the teppan and one table; TV showing Koshien and Hanshin games; easy alone; queues before opening; cash only.

食べログ: くるみ製菓店、大阪市西区新町1-16-5 1F、四ツ橋駅から徒歩5分.en: Tabelog: Kurumi Seikaten, 1-16-5 Shinmachi 1F, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min on foot from Yotsubashi Stn; daily 10:00–19:00; eat-in by reservation only (3 counter seats); cards, PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay accepted; no e-money; non-smoking; BYO allowed; takeout; opened 18 July 2025. Shop site: “safe and secure” sweets made with generous fine fermented butter, almonds and honey and as few additives as possible; the signature items are the “shell cake” and the “top-grade madeleine”; an interior where customers can see the staff at work and the oven; aims to be “the world's most loved baked-goods shop”; open every day of the year; top-grade madeleine box (6) ¥2,100, shell cake box (10) ¥3,990. Legal notice: 株式会社ミクリエーション, business operator 染川優輝, 橋口ビル 1F, 1-16-5 Shinmachi. Reviews (July–October 2026): a madeleine specialist; the smell of fermented butter; one freshly baked piece free with a purchase; fermented butter, French butter, Takachiho butter, carrot, chocolate, walnut and Gorgonzola; Calpis fermented-butter sablé ¥350; soft serve with seasonal sauces (peach, fig, lemon); firm pudding with soft serve; reservations hard to get; a bench outside; lines; one review calls it a sister shop of Chihiro, another says the son of a former influencer runs it.

食べログ: ぐり虎 大阪なんばスカイオ店、大阪市中央区難波5-1-60 なんばス.en: Tabelog: Guriko Osaka Namba Skyo, Namba Skyo 2F, 5-1-60 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 11:00–23:00; cards and e-money accepted, no QR; opened 1 September 2024. October 2026 reviews: drawn by the grilled sukiyaki rice; QR ordering at the counter; wonton chicken-salt raa-men and seared wagyu sukiyaki rice; shamo and jidori chicken; salt; clear seafood umami; the shoyu raa-men has firm, tasty noodles; connected directly to Namba Station; introduced as listed in the Michelin Guide; a spacious shop; special chicken-salt raa-men (clear broth of shamo and whole chicken, yuzu, rare and smoked chashu); no reservations, so go at quiet times; limited rich tonkotsu-seafood; Kuroge wagyu grilled sukiyaki rice; chicken-skin gyoza; Setouchi oyster gyoza; meat tsukemen (3 kinds of chashu); spicy ramen with minced meat and nira.

食べログ: こうてい麺 大ちゃん、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-1-3、カウンターのみ.en: Tabelog: Koteimen Daichan, 2-1-3 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; counter only; Mon–Sat 18:00–6:00 next morning (closes when sold out); closed Sundays; smoking allowed; listed as accepting cards (AMEX). Reviews (September 2025 – September 2026): one called the salt ramen ordinary; a hidden favourite in Shinsaibashi; a late-night last stop; a light clear salt; the chashu rice bowl sweet like eel sauce; gyoza with the sweetness of cabbage; hard to find down an alley; Daichan in both Namba and Shinsaibashi; first visit in 20 years; chicken bones and a gentle salt tare; slightly wavy medium-thick noodles; butter; seasoned egg; mizuna and leek; one found the shoyu ramen lacking character; media stickers; one says cash only (September 2026).

食べログ: ここだけ、大阪市大正区三軒家東1-18-2、大正から151m、月〜金.en: Tabelog: Kokodake, 1-18-2 Sangenya-higashi, Taisho-ku, Osaka; 151 m from Taisho; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:30, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 16:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); closed the day after holidays; no cards, e-money or QR; opened 24 September 2024. Reviews (October 2024 – October 2026): beef-tendon noodles ¥1,000; extra vegetables and garlic; spicy nira ¥300; extra beef tendon ¥450; G-style beef tendon; a light tonkotsu shoyu; thick chewy noodles; pepper, ramen sauce, kombu-niboshi vinegar, chili oil and red pickled ginger on the table; soupless 300 g; changed to Red; Negi Fire (hot onion oil poured for a flaming show, filming allowed); lighter than it looks; collagen from the beef tendon; right by Taisho Station; Jiro style; beef tendon instead of chashu; Kansai-style; on the former site of Ramen Mendorobo; 200 g for ¥1,000; call for vegetables, garlic and back fat; set with mini curry; sweet-savoury shoyu beef tendon and back fat; high-hydration slippery, chewy noodles; a mild soup; red pickled ginger to change the flavour; good for Jiro-style beginners.

食べログ: こだわり炭火焼鳥 ふらふら、焼鳥・居酒屋、大阪市淀川区西中島4-5-.en: Tabelog: Kodawari Sumibi Yakitori Furafura, yakitori and izakaya, 4-5-22 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, 第３新大阪ビル 1F; 3 min from Exit 1 of Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station (Midosuji Line), 4 min from Minamikata Station (Hankyu Kyoto Line); Mon–Fri 11:30–13:30 and 17:30–23:00, Sat 17:30–22:30, closed Sun and holidays; reservations accepted; appetiser charge ¥500; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 18 seats (10 at the counter, 8 on tatami); whole-shop hire up to 20; smoking allowed; menus in English, Chinese and Korean; opened 1 September 2003. The shop's introduction: dishes made with care by the chef using skills honed in hotels; yakitori of morning-fresh chicken from Fukuchiyama, marinated kara-age, chicken tataki, handmade tofu from soy milk, pasta to finish, sake poured into masu. Sets: the "Horo-yoi Set" of a starter, five omakase skewers and one drink ¥1,490; the eight-dish "Furafura" course ¥2,980. Reviews (December 2025 to September 2026): the Horo-yoi Set at ¥1,200–1,300, a starter that changes daily, negima packed along the whole skewer, liver, segimo, gizzard, heart, seseri, skin, tsukune, breast; at lunch a yakitori rice bowl ¥600–700, chicken steak gozen ¥850, kara-age rice bowl ¥800, chicken katsu gozen ¥990; the counter almost full just after noon; the handmade tofu is a specialty; one diner heard the chef was once an Italian cook.

食べログ: こりょうり たか屋、日本料理、下京区七条通烏丸西入西境町165 GE.en: Tabelog: Koryouri Takaya; Japanese cuisine; 七条通烏丸西入西境町165 GEM7 1F, Shimogyo-ku; about 5 min walk from Kyoto Stn; Mon–Thu 12:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:00) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); Fri and Sat 17:00–22:00; Saturday in two seatings, 17:00–19:30 and 20:00–22:30; closed Sunday; lunch small-plate meal ¥2,970; dinner course ¥11,550 (tax included); no service charge; 9 counter seats; no smoking; take-out; cards accepted; no e-money or QR; opened 18 March 2016. Reviews (April–September 2026, in English and Japanese): listed in the 2025 Michelin Guide; U-shaped counter of 9; no background music; all start together at weekends; simmered herring and autumn eggplant; crab chawanmushi; straw-grilled chutoro; hamo with plum; hamo and matsutake spring rolls or small hot pot; mackerel sushi wrapped in nori; firefly-squid namerou; wagyu simmered with flower pepper; sweetfish rice; sukiyaki; cheesecake; generous portions; an English-speaking staff member; one diner found the food and sake average.

食べログ: こ玄、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-9-12 大心ビル 1F、クリスタ長堀.en: Tabelog: Kogen, Daishin Bldg 1F, 1-9-12 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; right by Crysta Nagahori south stairs 4 and 5; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Nagahoribashi stations; Mon–Sat 18:00–1:00 next morning; closed Sundays and holidays; service and cover charge listed in the original as 'none'; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; smoking allowed; 12 seats; opened 17 September 2019. Reviews (November 2025 – September 2026): a one-person shop; quick cooking; mouth-watering chicken ¥450; shrimp in chili sauce ¥790 (before tax); seafood stir-fry of squid, scallop and shrimp ¥850; boiled gyoza 6 for ¥450 (weekly, but nearly always on); sweet-and-sour chicken with lettuce ¥690; tantanmen; fried rice; black-vinegar sweet-and-sour pork; spicy stir-fried squid and bok choy; stir-fried greens; green pepper and beef stir-fry; sweetish mapo tofu; drinks about ¥500; alone, 2–3 dishes; one has been 8 times; the shutter is always half down; one says the owner smoked with the extractor fan off when no diners were in.

食べログ: ごはん処 矢尾定、食堂・日本料理・寿司、下京区新町綾小路上ル四条町3.en: Tabelog: Gohan Dokoro Yaosada, eatery, Japanese cuisine, sushi; 四条町361, north of Ayanokoji on Shinmachi, Shimogyo-ku; 5 min walk from Karasuma and Shijo stations; 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–20:00; closed Wednesday and the 2nd and 4th Tuesday; reservations accepted; 59 seats (1F counter 5, tables 24; 2F tatami 30); the 2F tatami room can be hired; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; no cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; takeaway bento; founded 1909; Kyoto cuisine and bento; Teishoku Tabelog 100 2021. Reviews (May–October 2026, in English): daily set meal, hokke set, salt-grilled mackerel set, guji set, sanma set, simmered mackerel, beef shigureni, the Gion Matsuri limited Oofune ¥2,600 (Saikyo-miso fish, simmered vegetables, chirashi sushi), Kyoto-cuisine bento, many local customers.

食べログ: ごま中華 喜界星、大阪市中央区北浜1-3-2 北浜アークビル 1F、.en: Tabelog: Goma Chuka Kikai Boshi, Kitahama Ark Bldg 1F, 1-3-2 Kitahama, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Sakaisuji Line Kitahama Station, 1 min from Keihan Kitahama Station; next to the FamilyMart right outside exit 30; Tue–Fri and days before holidays 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 18:00–22:00, Sat 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–22:00, Sun 11:30–15:00 (lunch only), holidays 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Mondays; cards accepted; official site. Reviews (2023 – October 2026): tantanmen of rare Kikaijima sesame; Blend and Aroma 100% (meat miso and chili oil on the side, freshly ground sesame); weekend-and-holiday Three-Star lunch set (half tantanmen, mapo tofu, steamed-chicken salad, almond tofu); tantanmen with 2 dim sum; weekly lunch Singapore chicken rice ¥1,400 (jasmine rice, refills of barley rice, a fiery green-chili paste, soup, pickles, salad, dessert); QR ordering; queues from before noon; booking recommended at weekends; steamed chicken with leek sauce; dim sum; house chili oil; courses; craft lemon squash; an owner with a warm smile; attentive service.

食べログ: さかなやのmaru寿司 新大阪店、寿司・居酒屋・海鮮、大阪市淀川区西.en: Tabelog: Sakanaya no Maru Zushi Shin-Osaka Ten, sushi, izakaya and seafood, Alde Shin-Osaka, JR Shin-Osaka Station 2F, 5-16-1 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; directly connected to the station; daily 10:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed when Alde Shin-Osaka closes; reservations accepted (by phone too); cards accepted; no e-money; 40 seats (8 at the counter, 32 at tables); non-smoking; wheelchair access; children welcome; takeout. Shop text: run directly by a fresh-fish shop; seasonal fish at reasonable prices; from one piece; value sets; handmade by craftsmen; good before the Shinkansen. Reviews (June–October 2026): nigiri lunch (8 pieces and a thick roll, shellfish miso soup, small simmered fish) ¥1,210; lunches from ¥1,540; special assortment set ¥1,980; eel, conger eel, sea bream, ikura, raw shirasu gunkan, shiny fish, white fish, uni, tekka maki; simmered sea bream; Okinawa mozuku about ¥300; chawanmushi; tempura; sashimi; seafood bowl; "Horoyoi" set; Mogura sweet-potato shochu with soda; sushi can be slow when busy; some prefer conveyor-belt sushi; takeout too.

食べログ: さか本、日本料理、東山区祇園末吉町大和大路東入ル EFビル 1F、祇.en: Tabelog: Sakamoto, Japanese cuisine; EF Building 1F, east of Yamato-oji in Gion Sueyoshi-cho, Higashiyama-ku; 251 m from Gion-Shijo Station; every day 12:00–14:00 and 17:00–22:00; closing days not fixed; reservation only; 12 seats (6 counter, 6 table); private hire possible; non-smoking; cards accepted; a view of the Shirakawa. Official site: Kyoto Gion, kappo Sakamoto. Reviews (June 2021–June 2026, in English): founded October 1977, along the Shirakawa, yuba, white sesame tofu with fuki-no-tō miso, bamboo shoots, sansho flowers, Fushimi sake, a sake pairing, some find it expensive, the entrance is hard to find.
