食べログ: みなみ、鉄板焼き・魚介、大阪市中央区難波5-1-60 スイスホテル南.en: Tabelog: Minami, teppanyaki and seafood, Swissotel Nankai Osaka 10F, Namba 5-1-60, Chuo-ku, Osaka; directly connected to Nankai Namba Station (escalator from the 3F gates); Mon–Thu 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–21:00, Fri and the day before holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–21:30, Sat 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–21:30, Sun and holidays 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–21:00; reservations accepted; listed prices include a 13% service charge; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 35 seats (counter only); non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; hotel parking. Top kuroge wagyu, fresh seafood and seasonal vegetables at a counter facing a Japanese garden, with kaiseki-style starters. ikyu: two-hour limit from the booking time, 100% fee for same-day cancellation. Reviews (February 2024–October 2026): Chef course ¥21,000 (Senshu vegetable salad with salmon carpaccio, live Ezo abalone, shrimp and squid, kuroge wagyu tenderloin and strip loin, garlic rice, flambéed fruit and cheesecake), weekday lunch of 80 g Japanese F1 strip loin, three salts, scallops, soup, ingredients changed for an allergy, walk-ins possible on the day, staff who speak English and Chinese, one reviewer said most staff were foreign and Japanese was hard to get across (October 2024).

食べログ: みな都、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-15-25 リッツビル 1F、心斎橋.en: Tabelog: Minato, Ritz Bldg 1F, 1-15-25 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Nagahoribashi stations; Tue–Sat 17:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed Sundays and Mondays; opened 1 October 1999; starter ¥500 (none with courses); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; no smoking; 15 seats (counter 7, 2 tables); primary-school age and up; no sandals or shorts; loud voices and strong fragrances please refrain; first-visit discount for registering on LINE; proud of its dashi; sashimi of fish, crab, sea urchin, abalone, Yamagata beef, whale and horse; Rosanjin-style tableware; 4 courses and about 70 à la carte dishes; over 12 sakes. Reviews (August 2023 – June 2026): Kumamoto horse sashimi; abalone liver; steamed abalone; crab miso and crab; grilled sesame tofu; salt-grilled ayu; white fish fried with its scales; aubergine and yuba in ginger sauce; lotus-root manju; tempura rice ball; sea-bream chazuke with sesame sauce; warm duck soba; no prices shown for à la carte; one says about ¥16,000 per person.

食べログ: みな麺 なんばウォーク店、大阪市中央区難波2丁目 なんばウォーク1番.en: Tabelog: Minamen Namba Walk, 1-bangai Kita-dori, Namba Walk, 2-chome Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 14 seats; daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); 2026 closing days 1/1, 1/21, 3/18, 5/20, 7/15, 9/16, 11/18 (third Wednesday of odd months, second Wednesday in March); until 18:00 on 12/31 and 20:00 on 1/2; no smoking (use the facility's smoking area); cards and e-money accepted; opened 14 April 2023. Shop introduction: the first shop of the next brand from the queue-famous 'Jinrui Mina Menrui'; shoyu ramen made only from 'water and shoyu', without dashi. 2026 reviews (September–October): ice-cold noodles ¥970 (thin straight noodles, 3 slices chicken breast, chili oil, bonito soup); seared chashu rice bowl ¥330; special shoyu ramen; an explosion of umami in a clear soup; low-temperature chashu; pay at the entrance; clear shoyu ramen ¥990; free rice refills; with the special or premium topping a half noodle refill is free; whole-wheat noodles; rare chashu; chicken chashu; one says the bowl is only about half full.

食べログ: むかいの 五八、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-6-23 清水町会館 3F、.en: Tabelog: Mukaino Gohachi, Shimizumachi Kaikan 3F, 1-6-23 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; from 18:00; irregular closing days; reservations only (same-day bookings OK; seat-only bookings not accepted); yakitori course ¥3,500; drinks ¥400–700; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 counter seats; opened 1 October 2020. Reviews (April–September 2026): a hideaway in a quiet corner of the building; simple seasoning that lets the ingredients speak; an owner easy to talk to; cheese and quail-egg tsukune; grilled rice balls; the sign is hard to see; turn left out of the lift; course only; grilled at the pace you eat; potato salad; reasonably priced drinks; cooked on a teppan for each group; on full days one person runs it, so drinks are slow; large portions; Gohachi in the building opposite; yakitori grilled on a teppan; 3 sauces and salt; about ¥4,000 each; from 2 people (unconfirmed, one says).

食べログ: むろまち 加地、日本料理・居酒屋、下京区松原通新町東入中野之町185.en: Tabelog: むろまち 加地, Japanese cuisine and izakaya; 下京区松原通新町東入中野之町185 1F; 5–10 min on foot from Gojo Station; 18:00–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Thursday; reservations taken (online via Instagram); 9 counter seats; non-smoking (smoking area outside); cards accepted; opened 18 August 2011; The Tabelog Award 2019 and 2020 Bronze. Reviews (2024–2026, in English): two seatings at 18:00 and 20:15; hassun; sashimi platter and saba sushi; simmered octopus; roast beef; "adult" potato salad with karasumi; hamo tempura; dashimaki; clay-pot rice (leftovers made into onigiri); an 8-dish course or à la carte; sake (Katsukoma, Hanamura, Akabu, Sharaku and others); about ¥10,000–15,000 a head.

食べログ: めっせ熊 新大阪店、お好み焼き・焼きそば、お好み焼き百名店 2018.en: Tabelog: Messe Kuma Shin-Osaka Ten, okonomiyaki and yakisoba, Tabelog Okonomiyaki 100 2018 and 2019, inside 味の小路, JR Central Shin-Osaka Station 1F, 5-16-1 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; about 1 min from the central exit of Shin-Osaka Station, outside the ticket gates; daily 11:00–23:00 (last order food 22:10, drinks 22:30); closed only at New Year; no reservations; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 90 seats (6 at the counter); non-smoking; children welcome; takeout; smart-casual dress requested. Reviews (April 2024 to October 2026): lines at lunch and weekends; easier around 17:00 or after 21:00; the signature "negi-oko" piled with finely chopped green onion, with sweet-spicy beef tendon and konnyaku, sauce or soy; mochi as a topping; weekday lunch (11:00–16:00) "Set Kuma" of okonomiyaki, negiyaki, yakisoba and a fried egg ¥1,280 (¥1,400 with rice and miso soup per another review); negiyaki set ¥1,050; grilled squid, beef tendon, skewers, horumon; mayonnaise, sauce and aonori on the table; just one sauce now; shops in the Kanto region too; tables have a teppan but dishes are cooked in the kitchen.

食べログ: もとじま、そば、日本料理、日本橋人形町3-1-5 半沢ビル 1F、人.en: Tabelog: Motojima, soba, Japanese cuisine; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 3-1-5, 1F, about 250 m from Ningyocho Station; Mon–Fri 11:30–13:30 and 17:00–22:00; closed Sat, Sun and holidays; weekend banquets on request; reservations accepted; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; no service charge; 16 seats; private hire up to 20; children welcome; opened 24 September 2008; local sake chosen by a sake master and domestic stone-ground ju-wari soba. Reviews (July 2025–September 2026): mori soba ¥700; tempura soba ¥1,200; curry nanban ¥1,000; tororo soba, ume-oroshi soba, wild-vegetable soba; mini curry ¥300; extruded round ju-wari soba with strong chew; a strong bonito sauce; queues before noon at lunch; Toyosu fish and sake at night; duck and mushrooms stir-fried in soba sauce; some found it hurried with no oshibori.

食べログ: ももてる、居酒屋・焼酎バー・創作料理、下京区綾小路堺町西入ル綾材木町.en: Tabelog: ももてる (Momoteru), izakaya, shochu bar and creative cuisine; 下京区綾小路堺町西入ル綾材木町197; 293 m from Karasuma Station; Mon–Sat 18:30–23:00; closed Sunday; reservations taken (groups of four or more often not possible); no cards or e-money; QR accepted; 11 counter seats; smoking allowed. Reviews (2024–2026, in English): the owner, Momoko; handwritten menu; potato salads in changing flavours (salmon roe and shiso, blue cheese); kitsune cheese; young-corn spring rolls; komatsuna with walnut dressing; anchovy cabbage; tonteki; breaded swordfish; scallops with Inaniwa udon; chive omelette; sanma Arima-yaki; beef tendon with shishito; egg sandwich; keema curry; many regulars and a warm atmosphere; only two burners.

食べログ: もんじゃ 麦、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-1 コスミビル 2F、心.en: Tabelog: Monja Mugi, Cosmi Bldg 2F, 1-17-1 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station, 5 from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Thu 17:00–2:00 next morning, Fri–Sat 17:00–5:00 next morning, Sun 17:00–24:00; irregular closing days; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 16 seats; private hire up to 20; smoking allowed. Reviews (February 2025 – September 2026): monja based on the taste of Tsukishima, Tokyo; a batter rich in dashi; Mugi Special; Mentai Mochi Cheese; Mentaiko; Yuzu Kosho; gratin; Komtang, Chicken Ramen and Shin Ramyeon monja; toppings of chikuwa, corn, Baby Star and egg yolk; tonpei-yaki; okonomiyaki; yakisoba; avocado sashimi; cucumber; staff cook it in front of you; a lively atmosphere.

食べログ: やき亭ぼーの、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-3-5 日宝ファインプラザビル.en: Tabelog: Yakitei Bono, Nippo Fine Plaza Bldg 1F, 2-3-5 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6211-5933; reservations accepted; Mon–Sat 18:00–23:00 (closes when sold out); closed Sundays (open on a Sunday before a holiday); irregular closing days (twice a month); no cards or e-money; QR accepted; 14 seats (counter 8, tables). Reviews (2025–2026): superb duck sashimi, comparing cuts; ¥5,500 course; yakitori; potato salad; grilled vegetables; the highball is weak but there are many Japanese whiskies; a hideaway on the ground floor of a multi-tenant building north of Dotonbori; charcoal yakitori of Yamato chicken and duck; 5 kinds of duck sashimi and 5 yakitori for ¥3,300; dashimaki; chicken liver; Kawachi duck, Yamato chicken, Yamagata pork; raw duck liver; chicken sashimi limited, book in advance; wine; a kind owner; the owner runs it single-handed; negima and skin; still superb in August 2026, one says; Kawachi duck and yakitori on skewers; fresh chicken sashimi.

食べログ: やさいの王様 日比谷シャンテ店、千代田区有楽町1-2-2 日比谷シャ.en: Tabelog: Yasai no Ousama Hibiya Chanter, Yurakucho 1-2-2, Chiyoda-ku, Hibiya Chanter main building B2F, 3 minutes from Hibiya Station; 46 seats; daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed when Hibiya Chanter is; reservations only for 11:00 on weekdays; no service charge or cover; no smoking; children welcome; healthy menu; opened December 7, 2017; official site yasai-no-ohsama.com. Shop introduction: creative dishes of carefully chosen seasonal vegetables and ingredients from all over Japan; an open, leafy space. October 2026 reviews: Yasai no Ousama set ¥2,260 (six-grain sweet-potato rice, seasonal miso soup, honey-mustard potato salad with lotus root, meat or fish, glass salad, mini dessert); full right after opening on weekdays; demi-glace hamburg steak; meat sets; healthy, not too heavy; some say the lighting is dim.

食べログ: やまもと菓子店、ケーキ・チョコレート、大阪市西区新町1-21-3 小.en: Tabelog: YAMAMOTO KASHITEN, cakes and chocolate, Kobayashi Bldg 1F, Shinmachi 1-21-3, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 4 min from Yotsubashi Station exit 2, 5 min from Nishi-Ohashi Station; Tue–Sat 17:00–20:00, hours not fixed and it closes when sold out; closed Sunday and Monday, with occasional unannounced closures; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; takeaway only; non-smoking; children welcome; Tabelog Sweets WEST 100 in 2023 and 2026. Reviews (February 2024–October 2026): a shop of grown-up cakes that opens in the evening; opened in 2011; no sign; the owner runs it alone; one group inside at a time, others wait outside; photos of the showcase only; it opens when ready, at 17:25 on some days; announcements on Instagram; popular cakes sell out early; chocolate Mont Blanc with Amarena cherries and almond eau-de-vie ¥860–880; tart of figs poached in Madeira wine with Parmigiano ¥860–880; chocolate cake with pistachio cream and blue cheese ¥780; éclair ¥350; Tahitian vanilla and anise pudding ¥340; shortcake with Nagano Purple and Marc de Champagne; Saturday-only quiche ¥540 (July 2025); cash only; ice packs matched to the travel time home; some say the owner is taciturn and the service curt.

食べログ: ゆうすけ、うどん・カレーうどん、うどん WEST 百名店 2024、.en: Tabelog: Yusuke, udon and curry udon, Tabelog Udon WEST 100 2024, 3-15-3 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; about 2 min from Hankyu Minamikata Station, about 4 min from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; Tue–Sat 11:30–14:30 and 18:00–20:30; closed Sunday and Monday; no reservations; cash only; 9 counter seats; non-smoking; children welcome; opened 17 April 2014. Reviews (December 2024 to October 2026): a line, with meal tickets bought from the machine while waiting; parasols along the railway; extra-thick flat fresh noodles boiled 15 minutes or more, chewy and firm; regular about 400 g, large about 600 g (¥200), mini 200 g; chicken tempura bukkake (cold) ¥1,100, raw soy sauce an option; chicken tempura curry udon ¥1,130–1,150 (three pieces of chicken tempura, beef, tenkasu); squid tempura bukkake ¥1,100; vegetable tempura bukkake ¥1,250 (sweet potato, pumpkin, eggplant, shishito, maitake); the cook makes noodles, tempura and broth single-handed; on a Saturday night the line was cut at 19:10; waits of 30–60 minutes.

食べログ: ゆで太郎 銀座5丁目店、銀座5-14-9、東銀座駅A4出口徒歩3分、.en: Tabelog: Yude Taro Ginza 5-chome, Ginza 5-14-9, 3 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station exit A4; open 24 hours, every day; no reservations; counter seats; fine alone. 2026 reviews: a 128th visit at 5:50 a.m.; the usual half soba ¥290; mini katsudon set ¥850; foreign staff are polite but an older male staffer was rude; freshly fried tempura; house-made noodles; seasonal vegetable tempura; kakiage soba served within 5 minutes; onion-heavy kakiage; close to a one-coin price.

食べログ: よこちょう、居酒屋・魚介料理、左京区二条通川端東入ル難波町210、神.en: Tabelog: よこちょう (Yokocho), izakaya and seafood; 左京区二条通川端東入ル難波町210; about 10 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn; Mon–Sat 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday; 60 seats; non-smoking; no cards, e-money or QR; 2-hour limit; izakaya WEST Tabelog 100 2026. Reviews (September 2023–November 2026, in English): the assorted sashimi platter (ordered when booking; one reviewer says one per person is a booking condition), a whiteboard menu, orders written with paper and pencil, different menus on the 1st and 2nd floors, simmered chicken liver, potato salad, saba sushi from one piece, hairy crab ¥8,500, soft-shelled turtle zosui.

食べログ: よもだそば 銀座店、銀座4-3-2 銀座白亜ビル1F、松屋通り沿い、.en: Tabelog: Yomoda Soba Ginza, Ginza 4-3-2, 銀座白亜 Building 1F, on Matsuya-dori; 14 seats (counter); daily 7:00–22:30; opened April 28, 2012; official site yomoda-soba.com. October 2026 reviews: Yomoda curry ¥720 (spicy and soupy, with a hint of tomato); burdock-tempura soba ¥620 (sweetish, gentle broth); big kakiage soba with half curry; weekly shimeji and maitake tempura soba; inari; ticket machine and served right away; crowded with foreign tourists; complaints that the soba went soft and the tempura soggy; one customer understood it opened at 10:00.

食べログ: らぁめん しゅき、大阪市東成区東小橋3-14-10、鶴橋駅から徒歩2.en: Tabelog: Raa-men Shuki, 3-14-10 Higashi-Obase, Higashinari-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Tsuruhashi Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–0:30 next morning, Sat–Sun 11:00–0:30 next morning; cards, e-money and QR (including Alipay and WeChat Pay) accepted; 11 seats (counter 7, one table for 4); opened 10 June 2020. Reviews (August 2025 – October 2026): tori-paitan shoyu and salt; rich yet clean; the light salt ramen is clear-tasting; special shoyu ramen; the shoyu tsukemen is sharp and salty; one rates it among the top 3 tsukemen in Japan; seasonal cold editions (autumn sanma and mushroom cold ramen ¥1,580: dashi of Rausu kombu, sanma flakes and dried shiitake; fried enoki, maitake tempura, simmered shimeji and shiitake, chicken chashu, shredded white leek, mitsuba, yuzu); seasoned egg ¥150; raw egg; nori; salt-tare chicken starter with bottled beer; free kimchi; a short queue at lunch.

食べログ: らぁ麺 はやし田 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-10-1 道頓堀観.en: Tabelog: Raa-men Hayashida Dotonbori, Dotonbori Kanko Bldg B1F, 1-10-1 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 16 seats (counter); daily 11:00–23:00; no reservations; opened 11 February 2022; official site ramenings.com. 2026 reviews: under the Glico sign; summer-only yuzu-scented cold ramen ¥950 (yuzu jelly); the kamatama is discontinued; a soup of duck and 'Daisendori' chicken; special tsukemen ¥1,250, large +¥150, red-yolk oyakodon ¥350; a clear soup; a brand of INGS Co. (Shinjuku), its first franchise in Kansai; shoyu ramen ¥900 (pork-shoulder and chicken-breast chashu, menma, leek); special shoyu ¥1,200 (firm thin whole-wheat noodles, a 'Maximum Koitama' seasoned egg, chicken chashu); TKG; tori paitan (like a potage); ticket machine; cold ramen with oyakodon ¥400; rare chashu; a kind owner; light; avoiding the lunchtime queue; maze-soba and an egg with truffle sauce.

食べログ: らぁ麺 喜希、ラーメン・つけ麺、大阪市淀川区西中島5-8-7、新大阪.en: Tabelog: Ramen Yoshiki, ramen and tsukemen, 5-8-7 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 5–6 min from the south exit of Shin-Osaka Station, 5–7 min from the north exit of Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station, 7–9 min from the JR Shin-Osaka east exit and Hankyu Minamikata Station; Mon 18:30–23:00, Tue–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 18:30–23:00, closed Sat and Sun; no reservations; no cards; e-money and QR accepted; 13 seats; designated smoking area (no smoking at all 11:30–14:00); opened 9 December 2013. Reviews (May 2024 to September 2026): Premium tonkotsu ¥850 (back fat, four slices of chashu, egg, wood ear, menma, bean sprouts, green onion, sesame, thin or thick noodles); rice ¥50 at lunch; tonkotsu shoyu ¥850 (five slices of chashu); daily special ramen ¥650, large ¥100 more (pork-bone shoyu, Yatai tonkotsu shio, Hakata tonkotsu, niboshi, sweet beef-bone shoyu); ago dashi ramen with clams ¥800; Wakayama tonkotsu shoyu ¥800; spicy miso; clam tsukemen; extra noodles ¥100; seats upstairs on the second floor too; run by one person; a kind owner; Michael Jackson playing.

食べログ: らぁ麺 晴れルヤ、大阪市浪速区大国町1-1-13 藤元ビル 1F、大.en: Tabelog: Raa-men Hareruya, Fujimoto Bldg 1F, 1-1-13 Daikokucho, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; right by Daikokucho Station exit 5; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 18:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:15), Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–22:30; opened 22 November 2024; e-money and QR (PayPay) accepted, no cards; 12 seats (counter 8, one table for 4). Reviews (January 2025 – October 2026): rich, frothy tori-paitan ramen; the special adds seared chashu, steamed chicken, seasoned egg and red onion; tori-paitan miso (simmered-egg miso ramen ¥1,300, minced meat and chili threads); back-fat shoyu ramen with thin menma tips; maze-soba ¥1,250 (with seared-chashu rice); special garlic maze-soba; half black fried rice; friendly staff; one found the soup lukewarm.

食べログ: らぁ麺や 続、大阪市浪速区難波中2-1-12、なんば駅から228m、.en: Tabelog: Raa-men ya Tsuzuku, 2-1-12 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 228 m from Namba Station; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 11:30–22:00; closed Wednesdays; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking; opened 18 May 2022. Reviews (July–October 2026): tsukemen ¥980; even 450 g of noodles went down lightly; changed from the previous tsukemen shop; one calls the tsukemen characterless; chashu-men large (2 portions of noodles); counter only; ticket machine outside; self-serve water; a lightish soup strong in seafood umami; medium-thick straight noodles; the chashu is good too; leek; tsukemen double with extra leek; flat noodles with wheat flavour; a light shoyu-based dipping soup; soup-wari; with the large size there isn't enough dipping soup; one found the fishiness and bitterness strong.

食べログ: らーめん Stand R&R 3号店、ラーメン・つけ麺、大阪市淀川区.en: Tabelog: Ramen Stand R&R 3 Gou Ten, ramen and tsukemen, 4-1-43 Shintaka, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 239 m from Mikuni Station; Mon–Thu and Sun 11:00–16:00 and 17:00–24:00, Fri–Sat 11:00–16:00 and 17:00–02:00; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 10 counter seats; non-smoking; opened 14 October 2022. Reviews (January to October 2026): on Route 176; a partner car park; a free seasoned egg with a student ID; points card; ticket machine; rich chicken paitan (chicken and vegetables, thick) with flat wavy noodles and chopped onion ¥990, with seasoned egg ¥1,090; super rich ¥1,090; extra-rich kake ramen ¥990; light chicken-salt ramen with yuzu; choice of chashu; weekday sets ¥990 (A: ramen and half fried rice; B: ramen, two kara-age and rice); great egg fried rice; on the counter orange vinegar, black pepper, garlic chili, black shichimi, sesame pepper, extra ramen tare and spicy chives; bottled beer; a young staff member running the evening alone.

食べログ: らーめん あじどの、大阪市中央区千日前1-4-10、9席、月〜金17.en: Tabelog: Ramen Ajidono, 1-4-10 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 9 seats; Mon–Fri 17:00–5:00 next morning, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–5:00 next morning; L.O. 4:40; no cards or e-money; QR payment accepted; smoking allowed (ashtray on request at lunch); opened 8 August 2011; meal-ticket system. Reviews (December 2022 – September 2026): seasoned-egg ramen ¥1,000 (firm noodles, light, fewer noodles); Yokohama iekei leaning Kansai; rich tonkotsu shoyu; extra-thick wavy noodles; a small ticket machine outside; leek ramen; a sharp shoyu; smallish amounts of soup and noodles; ramen ¥950 (strong, firm, extra); salty but smooth; black nori; doubanjiang, vinegar, sesame, garlic, pepper and pickles on the table; nori and spinach; slightly wavy noodles; beer.

食べログ: らーめん ときまる、大阪市天王寺区小橋町13-4 天王寺ビル 1F、.en: Tabelog: Ramen Tokimaru, Tennoji Bldg 1F, 13-4 Obasecho, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 6 min walk from Kintetsu Osaka-Uehommachi and subway Tsuruhashi stations; Mon–Sat 11:00–14:30 and 19:00–23:00; closed Sundays; lunch only on holidays; closes when the soup runs out; reservations accepted; no cards or e-money; 7 counter seats; opened 11 December 2016; official tokimaru.com. Reviews (May 2023 – July 2026): half-price shoyu ramen for the anniversary; LINE stamp card; extra vegetables; gyoza; light shoyu; burdock, cabbage, bean sprouts, leek; paid with PayPay (2023); on Sennichimae-dori; Tokimaru shoyu ramen ¥780; flat medium-thick whole-wheat noodles; a triple soup of bonito, kombu and pork bones; pork-belly and loin chashu; soft-simmered burdock; summer-only okra; Chinese yam, kimchi and tofu summer cold noodles; mushroom miso ramen; spicy miso kimchi ramen; nibotton; one found the niboshi strong and salty; tsukemen 100 g ¥900; tonkotsu seafood strong in bonito; the tonkotsu shoyu mildly spicy; tsukemen 1.5 portions.

食べログ: らーめん なんぞ屋、大阪市生野区桃谷2-6-16、近鉄鶴橋駅東口から.en: Tabelog: Ramen Nanzoya, 2-6-16 Momodani, Ikuno-ku, Osaka; 6 min walk from Kintetsu Tsuruhashi Station east exit; Mon and Wed–Sun 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:45) and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed Tuesdays; no cards, e-money or QR; 11 seats (counter 5, one table for 2, one for 4); opened 4 October 2015. Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): built on a chicken-and-pork paitan; chicken & pork ramen; chicken & pork with fish; spicy chicken & pork; chicken & pork curry ramen ¥1,000 (choose heat); curry tsukemen; garlicky chicken & pork garlic ramen; chicken & pork vegetable ramen ¥1,060; light shoyu ramen with bean sprouts; house-made medium-thick noodles; tender chashu; superb menma; chashu rice bowl; one bowl per person; run by two people; one found the chicken and pork weak in the spicy version; a milky, mellow soup.

食べログ: らーめん ぴ!、ラーメン・つけ麺、大阪市淀川区西中島3-16-6 三.en: Tabelog: Ramen Pi!, ramen and tsukemen, 三勝ビル 1F, 3-16-6 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; right by the Hankyu Minamikata east gate; Mon–Thu 11:30–15:30 and 17:30–01:00, Fri 11:30–15:30 and 17:30–02:00, Sat 11:30–02:00, Sun and holidays 11:30–21:00; open all year; no reservations; 8 counter seats; non-smoking; children welcome; opened 8 August 2020; the shop text lists "Jidori White" (a rich Tamba Kurodori soup with vegetable purée), "Jidori Gold" (salt), "Jidori Black" (soy), tsukemen and a chashu rice bowl. Reviews (October 2023 to October 2026): from September 2026 the name changed to "French Chicken Noodles" and the menu centres on chicken paitan; "Classic" ¥1,300; "Maree", chicken paitan with shellfish broth, ¥1,350; special topping ¥450; basil sauce, mustard and lemon on the rim; rare chashu; cheese risotto set ¥550 (raclette melted with a torch); small rice ¥150; Pi! White ¥1,050 and tsukemen still in October 2026; cashless payment at the ticket machine; no alcohol; a regular who liked the old salt and soy bowls was disappointed.

食べログ: らーめん まぜそば あらし 東心斎橋店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-5-.en: Tabelog: Ramen Mazesoba Arashi Higashi-Shinsaibashi, 2-5-16 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; listed as daily 12:00–7:00 next morning (L.O. 6:30); no smoking; listed as accepting cards and QR payment; opened 1 October 2026. October 2026 reviews: moved about 180–200 m west within Higashi-Shinsaibashi; signature maze-soba small 100 g (oil + salt tare ¥1,000), 200 g ¥1,200; 4.25 mm thick flat wavy noodles; braised-pork chashu, leek, mizuna, egg yolk, fish powder, shredded nori; chicken fat and salt with the aroma of shrimp and scallop; house-made whole-wheat noodles supervised by Hayashi Seimenjo; Taiwan maze-soba, curry Taiwan and salt Taiwan ¥1,200 each; toppings (diced chashu ¥400, seasoned egg ¥150, egg yolk ¥100 and more); large 300 g +¥100, extra 400 g +¥200, small 100 g −¥200; Menya Arashi of Nagoya; ordering by QR code; clumsy right after opening; 2nd-floor seating; one listing gives hours 12:00–19:00 (L.O. 18:30); cash only; shichimi and kombu vinegar on the table; Instagram @n.arashi0803.

食べログ: らーめん やまふじ 新大阪本店、ラーメン・つけ麺・油そば・まぜそば、.en: Tabelog: Ramen Yamafuji Shin'osaka honten, ramen, tsukemen, abura-soba and mazesoba, 西宮原 2-6-16, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, 新大阪コーポビアネーズ 1F; 712 m from Mikuni Station; Mon and Wed 11:30–16:00, Tue, Thu and Fri 11:30–21:00, Sat and holidays 11:30–15:00, closed Sunday; no reservations; cash only; 12 seats; non-smoking; opened 20 December 2019. Reviews (April 2025 to September 2026): hard to find at the back of an apartment-building entrance; 8 counter seats and 2 tables; ticket machine; Yamafuji Ramen ¥950; a seafood and pork-bone shoyu of pork bones, chicken carcasses, niboshi and kombu; light on oil; thin straight or medium-thick curly noodles; bamboo shoots; white miso ramen (slightly sweet, with yuzu) ¥950–1,000; the special has two kinds of chashu, egg, menma, a spicy paste and citrus peel; Ichikara ramen ¥980; seafood tsukemen; mazesoba; self-service rice, refillable, ¥50–100; a tsukudani of the broth kombu and niboshi furikake; staff-meal rice bowl; some remember the shop before it moved; the concept is ramen that goes with rice.

食べログ: らーめん 佐々舟、ラーメン、日本橋人形町2-22-6 佐々舟ビル 1.en: Tabelog: Ramen Sasafune, ramen; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-22-6, Sasafune Bldg 1F, 2 min walk from Ningyocho Station exit A1; Mon–Fri 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–22:00, Sat 11:00–14:00; closed Sunday, irregular on holidays and other days; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money or QR; 15 seats; smoking allowed; English menu; takeaway; website sasafune-ningyocho.com; opened 31 October 2020. Reviews (February 2025–October 2026): run by an elderly couple; shio, shoyu and miso; thin curly noodles; homemade wontons; ramen ¥850; special wonton ramen ¥1,100; miso chashu ¥1,200; free rice with umeboshi with ramen; sake and snacks at night; a signed photo of Tomio Umezawa; some found the portion small.

食べログ: らーめん 兆、大阪市中央区平野町2-5-14、淀屋橋駅から徒歩約6分.en: Tabelog: Ramen Cho, 2-5-14 Hiranomachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 6 min walk from Yodoyabashi Station, 5 from Kitahama Station; Mon–Sat 11:00–23:00; closed Sundays and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR; 22 seats (ground-floor counter 4, 2nd-floor tables 18). Reviews (May–August 2026): a yellow 'garlic ramen' sign and a clear vinyl entrance; ramen ¥750 (light; asked whether to add garlic; garlic pieces at the bottom of the bowl); ramen set meal with rice and daikon pickles ¥900; jjigae ramen; miso ramen; seasoned egg; nostalgic chashu with strong shoyu; one found the garlic weaker than expected; one wished the soup had more depth; a bowl after drinking.

食べログ: らーめん 吉山商店 なんばラーメン一座店、大阪市中央区難波3-2-1.en: Tabelog: Ramen Yoshiyama Shoten Namba Ramen Ichiza, Edion Namba main store 9F, 3-2-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6536-8440; no reservations; daily 11:00–22:30; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; no smoking; opened 7 June 2019; official yosiyama-shouten.com. 2026 reviews (February–October): roasted-sesame miso ramen ¥1,150; leek chashu mayo rice bowl ¥400; Sapporo-style wavy noodles; thick chashu; rich seafood roasted-sesame miso ¥1,030 (nori, menma, leek, half a seasoned egg); limited cold abura soba ¥950 and leek-meat rice bowl ¥350; roasted-sesame miso premium pork-belly chashu-men; yellow medium-thick wavy noodles; wood-ear; piping-hot soup; the aroma of sesame; a strong miso yet a light finish; a soup with seafood; one found the miso too strong.

食べログ: らーめん 四恩 堀江店、大阪市西区北堀江1-6-4、四ツ橋駅から19.en: Tabelog: Ramen Shion Horie, 1-6-4 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 19 m from Yotsubashi Station; Mon–Thu 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–20:30, Fri–Sat 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; 7 seats (counter); no smoking; opened 29 September 2021. Reviews (August–October 2026): limited cold genmaicha salt ramen ¥1,050; seasoned egg ¥150; mini rice ¥100 (shredded nori and wasabi, for chazuke); house-made noodles; white leek; menma; broccoli; chicken chashu; 'Chocotto Izakaya' from 18:00 on Fridays and Saturdays; cold yuzu salt ¥1,050; aemen ¥400 (thin noodles, diced chashu, nori, onion, fish powder, sauce); kombu vinegar; cherry tomato; rice crackers; medium-thick straight noodles; the chicken shoyu ramen is well balanced; no cashless payment; a straight chicken soup with no citrus or aroma oil; slightly flat thin high-hydration noodles; ticket machine.

食べログ: らーめん 天道、大阪市中央区日本橋1-19-7、050-3569-5.en: Tabelog: Ramen Tendo, 1-19-7 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 050-3569-5080; no reservations; Tue–Sun 11:30–22:00; closed Mondays; no cards or e-money; QR (PayPay) accepted; 11 seats (counter only); no smoking; opened 28 July 2014. 2026 reviews (July–September): tsukemen; aonori; tori-paitan hiyashi chuka (extra-large ¥1,080; one diner came 3 days running); seafood tori-paitan ramen with seasoned-egg rice bowl (light, thin noodles, easy to eat late at night); tori-paitan ramen (gentle flavour); chashu rice; noodle refills; melting chashu; tsukemen noodles up to 300 g extra free; free mustard; a nostalgic taste from student days.

食べログ: らーめん 桐麺 天王寺店、大阪市阿倍野区阿倍野筋3-5-23、阿倍野.en: Tabelog: Ramen Kirimen Tennoji, 3-5-23 Abenosuji, Abeno-ku, Osaka; 66 m from Abeno; Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:45); closed Thursdays; e-money accepted, no cards or QR; opened 14 September 2026. October 2026 reviews: the Tennoji branch of Kirimen; the signature Kiri-tama (house-made flat noodles with a special salt tare over a raw egg, mixed kamatama-style); Kiri-tama cold (photo); same price up to 1.5 portions; first try the noodles alone; rich tsukemen (1.5 portions free, chashu and menma in the dipping soup); Kiri-don (photo; rice with chashu, menma and leek); Kiri-tama cold and Kiri-don set ¥1,480; one found the chashu topping fatty; one felt the egg and tare didn't mix well; buy at the ticket machine, then queue; a small shop, about a 15-minute wait; counter seats.

食べログ: らーめん 極 本店、大阪市阿倍野区旭町1-1-26 ウエムラあべのビ.en: Tabelog: Ramen Kiwami main shop, Uemura Abeno Bldg 1F, 1-1-26 Asahimachi, Abeno-ku, Osaka; about 5 min from Tennoji Station and Dobutsuen-mae Station; daily 11:00–22:00; irregular closing days; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; 9 counter seats. Reviews (September–October 2026): the main shop of a tonkotsu ramen known for its Char-rice; ticket machine outside; Manpuku Set (ramen and small Char-rice); three tonkotsu, Shiro, Kuro (black garlic oil) and Aka; extra back fat free; wood-ear; about 5 slices of chashu; light and low in salt, closer to Mokkosu than Hakata; a free half noodle refill on weekdays until 15:00; black pepper, sansho, sesame, chili and 3 sauces for rice on the table; free toppings of red pickled ginger, spicy takana, grated garlic, fried onion and mayonnaise; Char-rice is a lightly seasoned fried rice topped with a fluffy omelette; kind staff; chashu chuka soba ¥1,300 with thick noodles and seasoned menma.

食べログ: らーめん 賛平、大阪市天王寺区舟橋町18-2、鶴橋駅から119m、月.en: Tabelog: Ramen Sanpei, 18-2 Funahashicho, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 119 m from Tsuruhashi Station; Mon–Thu and Sun 11:00–1:00 next morning, Fri–Sat 11:00–3:00 next morning; no cards, e-money or QR; counter only; opened 29 April 2016. October 2026 reviews: Sanpei ramen ¥900 (as written in a photo); a creamy tonkotsu-and-chicken paitan; lighter than it looks; mixing in chopped Aomori garlic gives punch; slightly wavy chewy noodles; noodle firmness; thick, tender chashu; chashu-men ¥1,300; small rice ¥150; ramen and rice set; seasoned egg; red pickled ginger and pepper on the table; about a 20-minute wait at Sunday lunch; full even after 15:00; a collaboration ramen limited to 50 bowls ¥1,500.

食べログ: らーめん 醤 大丸心斎橋店、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-7-1 大丸心斎.en: Tabelog: Ramen Hishio Daimaru Shinsaibashi, Daimaru Shinsaibashi B2F, 1-7-1 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6226-7872; no reservations; daily 11:00–20:00; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; no smoking; opened 20 September 2022. 2026 reviews (June–August): limited vegetable-laden tonkotsu curry tsukemen in collaboration with Yoshimoto Curry (5–25 August); tonkotsu ramen 'full-belly' set (tenshinhan, karaage); wood-ear and red pickled ginger; many overseas diners; Jankara set (2 'Jankara' karaage and rice); Hishio ramen (mildly spicy, napa cabbage and nira, pork umami, a secret tare of over 30 years); tenshinhan; the famous Jankara; born in Sakai; leek ramen ¥970 (lots of white leek, light shoyu, very salty); a basement-2 food hall.

食べログ: らーめんセンター トミオ、大阪市生野区生野西2-1-27、寺田町から.en: Tabelog: Ramen Center Tomio, 2-1-27 Ikuno-nishi, Ikuno-ku, Osaka; 151 m from Teradacho; daily 11:00–23:00; irregular closing days (announced on social media); no cards; e-money and QR accepted; 12 counter seats; opened 18 January 2020. Reviews (September 2024 – October 2026): a niboshi chuka soba specialist; the smell of niboshi on entering; Tomio niboshi soba ¥1,200; rich niboshi chuka soba (cement-coloured soup); niboshi tsukemen ¥1,000 (naruto, onion, menma, chashu, soup-wari); summer Ibuki iriko cold edition ¥1,150–1,250 (Ibuki iriko, mackerel flakes and more, kombu water, salt tare, dashi ice, Morioka noodles, chicken chashu, vinegared sardine, pickled cherry tomato, radish sprouts, menma, egg, iriko cement paste); 2-week limited Shodoshima iriko cold ramen (rich cement soup, thick flat noodles, nori, onion); meat shumai; egg on rice with special shoyu; furikake and kombu tsukudani on the table; the ticket machine is gone, order by QR at the seat or verbally; one found the shumai too soft; one found the tsukemen noodles bland.

食べログ: らーめん一八 日本橋店、大阪市中央区日本橋2-8-15、近鉄日本橋駅.en: Tabelog: Ramen Kazuya Nippombashi, 2-8-15 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 311 m from Kintetsu Nippombashi Station; Mon, Wed–Sun and holidays 11:00–5:00 next morning; closed Tuesdays (also New Year and temporary closures); no cards, e-money or QR; no cover charge; 8 seats (counter); opened 10 April 2009; meal-ticket system. Reviews (September 2025 – September 2026): small ramen ¥100 off; noodles that soak up the rich soup; chashu; ramen ¥800; noodle refill ¥180; vinegar, pepper and chili oil on the table; one group waiting at 10 p.m. on a weekday; self-serve water; many overseas tourists too; 8–9 counter seats; everything-on; near Otaroad; at 2 a.m. after missing the last train; a rich, thick soup; spicy leek ramen; tsukemen (extra-thick noodles, chashu, menma, seasoned egg, shredded white leek); a rich dipping soup of chicken bones, pork bones and vegetables; goes with beer; an old-style ramen shop.

食べログ: らーめん古潭 なんばCITY店、大阪市中央区難波5-1-60 なんば.en: Tabelog: Ramen Kotan Namba CITY, Namba CITY main building B2F, 5-1-60 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6644-2519; no reservations; daily 11:00–21:30; closed third Thursday of each month; no cards; e-money and QR payment accepted; 55 seats; no smoking; official ramen-kotan.co.jp. 2026 reviews (July–October): a chain on basement 2 of Namba CITY's main building; busy at weekend lunch; discount with the Minapita card (10% off); a simple flavour; open all day, handy for a late lunch; clean and fast; reimen and cold tantanmen; overseas diners and staff; Ramen Kotan with fried rice set; big chashu; one minded the oil smell of the fried rice; wide spacing at the counter; Kotan for the first time in 15 years; vegetable-laden Nanan-men with fried rice; a nostalgic soup; shoyu tonkotsu with julienned carrot and crisp bean sprouts; straight noodles thicker than the usual medium-thick; sesame on the table; salt flavour too; the fried rice slightly scorched.

食べログ: らーめん喜六、大阪市浪速区日本橋5-10-6、恵美須町駅から275m.en: Tabelog: Ramen Kiroku, 5-10-6 Nippombashi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 275 m from Ebisucho Station; Tue 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–22:00, Wed and Fri 11:30–16:30 and 17:00–22:00, Sat 12:00–16:30 and 17:00–22:00, Sun 11:30–16:30 and 18:00–22:00; closed Mondays and Thursdays; no cards, e-money or QR; 11 counter seats. Reviews (March 2025 – June 2026): on Sakaisuji, just before the Nippombashi 4-chome crossing; old-style neighbourhood ramen; shoyu ramen from ¥630; salt too; a chicken and pork-bone soup (cloudy, no back fat); medium-thick straight noodles; 2 slices chashu; leek; menma; vegetable ramen ¥780; ramen set with rice ball or rice ¥700 (hand-made rice ball with chashu, takuan); ramen (large) / fried rice set (shoyu) ¥1,000; half fried rice set ¥800; fluffy fried rice; sometimes opens late.

食べログ: らーめん砦 大阪京町堀店、大阪市西区京町堀1-10-10、四つ橋線肥.en: Tabelog: Ramen Toride Osaka Kyomachibori, 1-10-10 Kyomachibori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; about 5 min walk from Yotsubashi Line Higobashi Station exit 7, about 10 from Yodoyabashi; daily 11:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:30), holidays 11:30–22:00; irregular closing days; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 18 seats (counter 14, one table for 4); opened 1 June 2017. Reviews (June 2025 – October 2026): the limited niboshi ramen is gentle; chashu and chicken-breast chashu; menma; leek; hamaguri paitan ramen; edible even without appetite; like clam chowder; light and easy; Toride set ¥1,100; noodle refill with a LINE coupon; Dunk Rice for a risotto finish; a shellfish paitan unlike Toride in Shibuya; shellfish umami; Toride rice-bowl set (Toride ramen, seasoned egg, hamaguri rice bowl); rich but a clean finish; thin noodles; a calm interior; aroma of burnt leek; the cold version has thick chashu; milky-white shellfish soup; rare chashu; radish sprouts; shredded nori.

食べログ: らーめん製作所 奏、大阪市浪速区稲荷1-7-30、JR難波駅南口から.en: Tabelog: Ramen Seisakujo Kanade, 1-7-30 Inari, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from JR Namba Station south exit; Mon and Wed–Fri 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:45) and 17:15–21:00 (L.O. 20:30), Tue 11:00–15:00, Sat 10:30–15:00; closed Sundays; latest information on Google and social media; opened 10 June 2011; d-barai accepted. Reviews (August–October 2026): shoyu ramen and rice; one found the seafood fishy; good firm noodles; 2 kinds of chashu, pork and chicken; shoyu chashu-men; seafood shoyu and seafood tori paitan; maze-soba too; chicken-and-seafood shoyu ramen; chicken umami and sweetness tightened by seafood; thin noodles; Kanade shoyu ramen ¥1,050; seared chashu rice bowl ¥450; garlic for punch; the most popular, chicken Kanade ramen ¥1,000; a triple soup of tori paitan, seafood and shoyu; rich but not cloying; slightly sweet; medium-thin low-hydration noodles; big fatty chashu; regulars go for the limited editions; counter seats only; ticket machine; lighter than it looks.

食べログ: らーめん豊樹、ラーメン、日本橋人形町3-3-13 CICビル 1F、.en: Tabelog: Ramen Toyoki, ramen; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 3-3-13, CIC Bldg 1F; 2 min walk from Ningyocho Station exit A5; open until 26:00 (opening time and closing days not listed); no cards or e-money, PayPay accepted; 13 seats (counter and an outside table for four); smoking only at the outside table; no reservations; opened 12 May 2016. Reviews (February 2024–October 2026): shoyu, shio, miso, tonkotsu shoyu, tonkotsu shio, tantanmen, tsukemen, abura soba, vegetable ramen; tantanmen ¥1,080 (sesame, mild heat, no numbing, slightly tangy, medium-thin curly noodles); dry tantanmen; chilled tantanmen ¥1,080; tonkotsu shoyu ¥980 (grated ginger); A set (half rice and 3 gyoza) ¥250; run by a couple; the owner is from China; prices about 20% above opening; busy late at night; some found the noodle portion small.

食べログ: らーめん香澄 阿波座本店、大阪市西区京町堀2-12-13、阿波座駅1.en: Tabelog: Ramen Kasumi Awaza main shop, 2-12-13 Kyomachibori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; about 5 min walk from Awaza Station exit 1; Mon–Wed, holidays and days before holidays 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–23:00, Thu 8:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00, Fri 8:00–15:00 and 18:00–23:00, Sat 9:00–15:00 and 18:00–23:00, Sun 9:00–23:00 continuous; open every day of the year; cards, e-money and QR (including Alipay and WeChat Pay) accepted; 7 counter seats; opened 7 May 2012; Tabelog Ramen Hyakumeiten 2017–2025. Reviews (September–October 2026): seasoned-egg niboshi ramen; slightly thick wavy noodles; many order maze-soba with rice; waiting chairs outside; ticket machine inside; special niboshi chuka soba ¥1,250; self-serve water; paper aprons; niboshi mellowed by back fat; medium-thick wavy noodles; light chashu; special niboshi maze-soba ¥1,300; strong niboshi on a shoyu base; ichimi; wide wavy noodles from Menya Teigaku, a long-established Kyoto noodle maker; block and rare chashu; white and green leek; menma; seasoned egg; a queue of 5–6 even late at night; no wait after rain; a Nakazakicho shop too; niboshi ramen ¥950; a gentle shoyu base with a bittersweet niboshi finish; one likens it to Yamagata ramen.

食べログ: りょうりや 御旅屋、日本料理、下京区天満町456-2、阪急河原町駅か.en: Tabelog: りょうりや 御旅屋 (Ryoriya Otaya), Japanese cuisine; 下京区天満町456-2; 8 min on foot from Hankyu Kawaramachi Station, 7 min from Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojo Station; Tue–Sun 17:00–22:00; lunch 12:00–14:00 on Saturday and Sunday only (book by the day before); closed Monday and irregularly twice a month; reservations taken (17:00–19:00 is easiest); otoshi ¥700; 16 seats; private rooms (2–6 people); non-smoking; cards accepted; opened 25 August 2011; Bib Gourmand eight years running; sister shop Ryoriya Toki (by the Takase River at Takatsuji, owner Harada); cleans the Takase River and releases fireflies in May. Reviews (2025–2026, in English): the owner has roots in Toyama; the name comes from the Kaga domain's rest-house; omakase of 8 dishes ¥8,800; a salad of 20 ingredients; heshiko sauce; hamo and matsutake pot; sanma; cod milt with ponzu; yuba and egg rice bowl; sake from Kyoto and Toyama.

食べログ: れんげラーメン、大阪市天王寺区上本町6-3-31 うえほんまちハイハ.en: Tabelog: Renge Ramen, Uehommachi Haihai Town B1F, 6-3-31 Uehommachi, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Kintetsu Uehommachi and Tanimachi-Kyuchome stations; Mon–Thu and Sat 11:15–14:30, Fri 11:15–14:30 and 18:00–20:20; closed Sundays, holidays and days before holidays; no cards, e-money or QR. Reviews (September 2018 – September 2026): a long-running shop in Haihai Town; 9 counter seats; run by two people; a gentle Kumamoto-style tonkotsu; Renge ramen ¥800 (free up to 1.5 portions); Renge soup, miso, tonkotsu; tashi-dama; set with sarameshi ¥1,000 (lightly seasoned mixed rice); half fried rice set; spicy pickled ginger; soft high-hydration noodles (one says still soft even when ordered firm); tender chashu; a friendly owner.

食べログ: ろばた 銀座本店(呂者堂)、銀座6-4-17 銀座出井ビル201、銀.en: Tabelog: Robata Ginza Honten (呂者堂), Ginza 6-4-17, Ginza 出井 Building 201, 3 minutes from Ginza Station exits C2/C3; 17 seats; daily 17:00–23:00; irregular holidays; opened September 9, 2023; the famous spiny lobster and à la carte; cards accepted. 2026 reviews: about 10 counter seats around the robata hearth, fish grilled over charcoal, explanations of the ingredients, spiny lobster, toasty grilled dishes, for business entertaining and anniversaries, ¥10,000–20,000.

食べログ: ろばた 風炉式、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-13-10 大宝共栄ビル 3.en: Tabelog: Robata Furoshiki, Daiho Kyoei Bldg 3F, 1-13-10 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 18:00–5:30 next morning (L.O. food 4:30, drinks 5:00); closed Wednesdays; cards, iD, QUICPay and QR accepted; 20 seats (counter 12, two tables for 4); opened 12 March 2023; official site. Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): shirasu with grated daikon as the starter; sashimi platter (tuna, hamachi, squid, swordfish, sea bream); salt-grilled sanma with grated daikon and ponzu; grilled-vegetable platter; Chinese yam grilled with butter shoyu; spear squid and sea urchin; charcoal-grilled sirloin cap; straw-grilled; meat-wrapped zucchini with Kaneyama miso; dashimaki with mentaiko and grilled anago; several kamameshi; lightly pickled cucumber; water aubergine and tomato pickles; pasta; omurice; plenty of drinks; smoking allowed at tables; one says the sashimi took a while; late-night Minami crowd; a stylish interior when the lift doors open.

食べログ: わかい、ラーメン、日本橋堀留町1-7-16、人形町駅から徒歩3分、月.en: Tabelog: Wakai, ramen; Nihonbashi-Horidomecho 1-7-16, 3 min walk from Ningyocho Station; Mon 11:00–15:00; Tue–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–22:00; 1st and 4th Saturdays 11:00–14:00; closed 2nd and 3rd Saturdays, Sundays and holidays; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 30 seats (10 at the counter, two tables for 4, tatami); a private room for 8; smoking allowed (depending on the time); miso ramen ¥900. Reviews (February 2023–October 2026): a three-generation family of grandmother, mother and son; Sapporo-style miso ramen; bean sprouts and minced pork stir-fried in a wok; medium-thick curly yellow egg noodles; seaweed stems ¥100; chashu, corn and butter; mini fried rice ¥200; one regular says lunch always ends at 13:30; celebrity autographs; it has appeared in a film; some found the toppings sparse.

食べログ: わびすけ 難波本店、大阪市中央区難波4-8-3、なんば駅から徒歩3分.en: Tabelog: Wabisuke Namba main shop, 4-8-3 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba Station, 80 m from Osaka-Namba; Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30, ends when sold out) and 17:30–23:30 (L.O. 23:00), Sun 17:30–23:30; reservations accepted; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; 12 counter seats; opened 1 August 2020. Reviews (August 2020 – October 2026): a counter izakaya in Ura-Namba; obanzai platter of 5 (always 6); thick ham cutlet; highball; mentaiko and aosa spaghetti salad; chikuwa tempura with shibazuke tartare; rice ball and tonjiru set; squid-leg tempura with aosa mayo; dashimaki; nikusui; red shrimp with vinegared miso; fried horse mackerel; white fish with yukari and bonito flakes; niku-dofu; grilled tongue; Hachijojima shochu; queues at lunch; a friendly master and staff; the famous dashimaki; Kuro Kirishima with soda; meat dashimaki set meal ¥900 (main, 4 daily obanzai, pickles, tonjiru); a 30-minute wait; about 20 people at 11:45 on a Sunday, 40-minute wait; party size and order checked while queuing; 6 mains; a little sashimi; rice refills; no wait at night; wagyu omelette; 8 people at 11:10 on a Saturday; a set with beer instead of rice; karaage beer set meal ¥900; 10 people 10 minutes before opening.

食べログ: わんぱく、八重洲2-8-10 松岡八重洲ビル1F、立ち食いそば・うど.en: Tabelog: Wanpaku, Yaesu 2-8-10 松岡八重洲 Building 1F; standing soba and udon, standing counter only; no cards, e-money or QR; no photos inside; hours not listed. 2026 reviews: no sign — a noren and a shop dog (retriever); a quiet owner; kake soba ¥340, kakiage ¥130, kisu tempura ¥130, egg ¥70 (April); shungiku, burdock tempura, squid tempura, croquette soba, curry soba, onigiri; the tempura is fried ahead; the broth is strong, typical of Tokyo standing soba.

食べログ: ゑにしな、鶏料理・居酒屋・焼肉、大阪市淀川区西中島3-21-18 1.en: Tabelog: Enishina, chicken dishes, izakaya and yakiniku, 3-21-18 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, 1F; 2 min from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station (Midosuji Line), 5 min from Hankyu Minamikata Station; Mon, Tue, Thu, Sun and holidays 17:00–01:00, Fri, Sat and the day before a holiday 17:00–03:00, closed Wednesday, other closing days not fixed; reservations accepted; cover charge ¥290; cards, e-money and QR payments accepted; 16 seats (8 at the counter, plus terrace seats); whole-shop hire up to 20; smoking allowed; English menu. The shop's introduction: a Showa-retro chicken yakiniku restaurant with 8 counter seats; a homemade miso sauce based on the famous chicken miso grill of Mie; an all-you-can-drink course of a chicken platter, chicken sashimi, fried chicken wings, cold noodles and dessert with draft beer ¥3,780. Reviews (November 2021 to August 2026): opened in September 2021 as a counter yakiniku restaurant (on the former site of the sukiyaki restaurant Mitsumaru), later turned to chicken; a miso sauce worked out by studying the taste of a Matsusaka restaurant; salt or miso; young chicken, old hen, heart, liver, bonjiri, seseri, harami; every cut ¥550; big portions; unlimited cabbage; cold noodles, seaweed soup, sorbet; PSB on draft; smoking at the seat; alone late at night.

食べログ: ゑび真、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-8-33、月11:30〜14:30、.en: Tabelog: Ebishin, 2-8-33 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Mon 11:30–14:30, Tue–Thu 12:00–14:40 and 18:00–22:50, Fri–Sat 12:30–14:40 and 18:30–23:45, Sun 12:30–14:40 and 18:30–23:30; no cards or e-money; QR payment accepted; opened 12 April 2023. Reviews (December 2024 – October 2025): rich lobster ramen; Japanese and English menu; heat 0.5; creamy like tonkotsu; plenty of vegetables; burdock chips; lobster topping ¥4,200, normally from ¥1,100; tuna set meal (with crab-miso soup) ¥1,550; wavy noodles; ¥1,600 is on the high side; tsukemen and tuna rice bowl; no ticket machine, pay afterwards; one found the ramen soup lacking depth; lobster tsukemen ¥1,000; heat 0–4; tuna cutlet set meal; thick wavy noodles.

食べログ: アグー専門店 白いとんかつ花ひらく 四ツ橋店、大阪市西区新町2-17.en: Tabelog: Aguu Senmon Ten Shiroi Tonkatsu Hana Hiraku Yotsubashi ten, GATE80 Shinsaibashi WEST III, 2-17-5 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station Exit 1, 6 min from Nishi-Nagahori Station Exit 1, 8 min from Awaza Station Exit 2; Mon, Thu–Sun and holidays 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–23:00, closed Tue and Wed; from 1 November 2026 reserved courses only, from 18:30, up to 7 guests a day, next month's bookings taken from the 20th to the end of each month; same-day bookings and private hire by phone; children who cannot eat a course are asked not to come; no strong scents; BYO allowed; no cards; PayPay, Rakuten Pay, au PAY accepted; 7 seats (counter); non-smoking; opened 1 November 2025. Shop site: the shop of pork-specialist cook Gotton (a social-media recipe account); more than 100 domestic brand pigs; tonkatsu fried slowly at low temperature; counter of a single slab of hinoki cypress; opened 31 October 2025; Nakano Junichi (born and raised in Osaka, ate the way through Japan's rare brand pigs and fell for Agu, cooking based on Japanese cuisine). Reviews (November 2025–October 2026): moved from Fuse; 14–15 kinds of Agu from Okinawa, Ishigaki and elsewhere, aged 14 days or more; white tonkatsu fried below 130°C; Chateaubriand, loin, mille-feuille, chuck eye roll; shabu-shabu with three sauces (duck broth, garlic-chive soy sauce, Arima sansho ponzu); dashi omelette, homemade pickles, mozuku miso soup, black curry simmered 30 hours from Agu bones, white-miso pudding; tonkatsu gozen ¥2,750, katsu curry with black curry ¥1,500, Agu steak 300 g ¥3,000, shabu-shabu and tonkatsu course ¥4,800; 110,000 followers.

食べログ: アップトゥーユーコーヒー、松が谷2-31-11 1F、稲荷町駅から5.en: Tabelog: UP TO YOU COFFEE, Matsugaya 2-31-11 1F; 517 m from Inaricho Station; daily 10:00–18:00; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 seats; non-smoking. Reviews (June–October 2026): an owner and staff who trained in Australia; an owner known for latte art; third place at a world competition in the US; Papua New Guinea hand drip ¥850; flat white; café latte with a choice of beans; the double-ristretto 'Magic' ¥700; banana bread; salad sandwich; take-away +¥30; cash only; one iced coffee too strong and partly warm; one cake reheated from frozen.

食べログ: アマラントス、銀座5-6-7 SANWAすずらんビル9F、銀座駅A1.en: Tabelog: Amarantos, Ginza 5-6-7, SANWA Suzuran Building 9F, 3 minutes from Ginza Station exit A1; 20 seats; weekdays and holidays 18:00–23:00, weekends 12:00–15:00, 18:00–23:00; 10% service charge; cards and IC accepted; budget ¥40,000–50,000. Chef profile (English): owner-chef Shintaro Miyazaki studied Western pastry as a pâtissier, went to France, trained at Le Bourguignon, Au Goût du Jour and others, was sous-chef at Raison Bleu, came back to Japan in 2007; desserts by two chefs from pastry backgrounds. 2026 reviews: moved to Ginza; an island-style open kitchen; playful plating; tableware by Sara Linda Japan and ILAKÉ; chiffon cake to take home; ¥40,000–60,000.

食べログ: アラスケバブ、上野4-7-8、JR上野駅広小路口から徒歩2分、京成上.en: Tabelog: Aras Kebab, Ueno 4-7-8, 2 min on foot from the JR Ueno Station Hirokoji exit, 1 min from Keisei Ueno and Ueno-Hirokoji stations; Mon, Tue, Thu 8:30–23:30, Wed 8:30–22:00, Fri 8:30–24:00, Sat 8:00–24:00, Sun 8:00–23:00; no reservations; cash only; non-smoking. Reviews (November 2025–October 2026): a kebab shop in Ameyoko; benches to sit on; doner kebab; tomatoes no longer included; pistachio baklava; bright, friendly staff; choice of spice level; chicken-and-beef mixed kebab salad; indoor and outdoor seats; large +¥200; chicken kebab with cheese ¥700; no restroom; one said smoking was allowed at the seats; jalapeños +¥100; draft beer ¥500; shawarma; water ¥100.

食べログ: アルチザナル (boulangerie Artisan'Halles.en: Tabelog: Artisan'Halles (boulangerie Artisan'Halles), bread and café, 上京区今出川通寺町東入ル一真町89, 5 min on foot from Demachiyanagi Stn; Mon, Tue and Fri–Sun 9:00–19:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday; takeout only since May 2025; reservations accepted; no cards; opened 14 August 2012; Bread WEST Tabelog 100 2020, 2022, 2026. Reviews (September–October 2026, in English): an inconspicuous brick-and-door front, cinnamon rolls, danishes, hard breads, little left by early afternoon, cash only.

食べログ: アルバロンガ、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-19-15 Unagidani.en: Tabelog: ALBALONGA, Unagidani Block 2F, 1-19-15 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Tue–Sat 11:00–15:00 (L.O. food 13:30) and 17:30–22:00 (L.O. food 20:30); closed Sundays and Mondays; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 19 seats; official site. Reviews (September–October 2026): a popular Italian restaurant on the 2nd floor; lunch course ¥5,200 with one drink (starter platter with bread and olive oil; the signature chilled cappellini of snow crab and fruit tomato; a main of Mochi pork or hamo fritto; dessert platter); dinner course (long prawns, cutlet, pasta of hamo and karasumi); Sardinian Vermentino; delicate, careful seasoning; one found the baguette hard; book for lunch.

食べログ: アロセリア ラ パンサ、銀座1-15-8 銀座耀ビル1F、銀座一丁目.en: Tabelog: Arrocería La Panza, Ginza 1-15-8, 銀座耀 Building 1F, 3 minutes from Ginza-itchome Station; 27 seats; Tue–Thu 17:00–22:30, Fri 11:45–14:30, 17:00–22:30, weekends and holidays 11:45–14:45, 17:00–22:00, closed Mon; opened January 21, 2017; official site vandk.jp. Shop introduction: listed in the Michelin Guide Tokyo eight years running; 15+ paellas; the name means "full belly". October 2026 reviews: duck and porcini paella; lobster paella; angel-shrimp caldo; beef-tongue ajillo; grilled spear squid; goat-cheese salad; cod aioli and seasonal-vegetable gratin; 10-dish course ¥11,000; portions adjusted to the number of people; cramped seats; many birthday customers; described as a Bib Gourmand eight years running.

食べログ: アン ファス、フレンチ、ビストロ、フレンチ TOKYO 百名店202.en: Tabelog: EN FACE, French, bistro; French TOKYO 100 2023 and 2025; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-11-9; no business hours listed; reservation only; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 10 seats; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; opened 19 August 2019. Reviews (October 2025–October 2026): chef Kameyama cooks alone, after 5 years at a bistro in Paris; very large portions; freshly sliced Savoie prosciutto with seasonal fruit ¥3,000; snow crab and celeriac mousse with shellfish jelly ¥4,900; scallop gratin ¥4,900; roast duck breast ¥5,900; charcuterie; pâté de grand-mère; foie gras terrine; roast Ezo venison; bread from Éclat de Jour; takeaway possible; booked up to a year ahead; one review says it has had the Bib Gourmand several times.

食べログ: アンティカ オステリア ダル スペッロ、大阪市中央区難波4-7-5.en: Tabelog: ANTICA OSTERIA DAL SPELLO, Koei Bldg 1F, 4-7-5 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba Station exit 13; Mon, Wed, Fri–Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 (food L.O. 14:30) and 18:00–22:30 (food L.O. 21:30), Thu 12:00–14:00; closed Tuesdays and 1st and 3rd Wednesdays; opened 9 June 2018; reservations accepted; cash only; no service or cover charge; no smoking; 10 seats (counter 4, 2 tables); particular about wine; official site. Reviews (January–July 2026): a sister shop of SPELLO in Sakaisuji-Hommachi; chewy hand-made pasta; carpaccio; seafood and seasonal vegetables; meat dishes; over 30 Italian wines; lunch ¥1,800; lunch course by reservation ¥2,500, ¥4,800 with drinks (starters with crab, onion and corn soup, onion focaccia, oyster and bottarga pasta, poêléed sea bream, coconut tiramisu); Shogoin turnip soup; oyster pasta; roast chicken; one person in the kitchen, so service is unhurried; tables close together; one found it good value but ordinary in taste.

食べログ: イタメシOliva、イタリアン・バル・居酒屋、中京区下樵木町202-.en: Tabelog: イタメシOliva, Italian, bar and izakaya; 中京区下樵木町202-4-1 先斗町たばこやビル 3F; about 3 min on foot from Kawaramachi Station; Mon, Tue and Fri–Sun 17:00–24:00, Thu 19:00–24:00; closed Wednesday; phone reservations; same-day no-shows charged ¥1,000 per person; at least one dish and one drink per person; 120-minute limit when busy; 12 seats; non-smoking; cards and e-money accepted; English menu; prices shown before tax; opened 2 August 2017. Shop introduction (English translation): fresh fish and seasonal ingredients from Wakasa in Obama, Fukui; risotto of Wakasa rice; alley no. 15 of Pontocho. Reviews (2024–2026, in English): the owner is from Obama; peperoncino; squid-ink risotto; fried meat-stuffed olives; oyster gratin; lamb steak; panna cotta; about ¥14,000 for two with a bottle of wine.

食べログ: イタメシヤ フジ、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-6-10 リップル周防町.en: Tabelog: Itameshiya Fuji, リップル周防町 1F, 1-6-10 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min on foot from Nagahoribashi Station, 6 min from Shinsaibashi Station; Tue–Thu 17:00–23:00, Fri 17:00–24:00, Sat–Sun 15:00–24:00; closed Mondays; reservations accepted; no service charge; cards, transport IC, iD, QUICPay, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay and au PAY accepted; 16 seats (counter 10, one private room for 6); non-smoking (smoking area outside); children welcome; opened 27 January 2020. Shop's introduction: beef, pork and lamb grilled over charcoal, crisp and fluffy pizza, 18 selected wines. Reviews (September 2023 – October 2026): the Fuji platter of 8 appetizers, smoked chicken wings smoked in front of you, a charcoal-grilled platter of 3 (Angus outside skirt, beef tongue), pizza stretched and baked to order (Margherita; sakura shrimp and bamboo shoots), aglio e olio, cold tomato cappellini, cold squid and sudachi pasta, horse mackerel and mitsuba pasta, abalone risotto with liver soy sauce, eggplant Bolognese, acqua pazza, venison, figs with prosciutto and mascarpone, a roast beef course; happy hour until 18:00 with a wine decanter at ¥400; all-you-can-drink available; even with the master working alone there was no long wait, and prices are reasonable.

食べログ: イタリアン、中京区下丸屋町416 ヒルトン京都1F、市役所前駅から徒.en: Tabelog: Italian; 中京区下丸屋町416 ヒルトン京都 1F; 2 min on foot from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn; daily 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:30); reservations accepted; prices include tax and service; 64 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome, kids' menu; cards accepted (UnionPay too); English menu and English-speaking staff; parking; chef Mariangela Ruggero (named 'Ambassador of UNESCO World Heritage Italian Cuisine' by the Italian government); recipes handed down from a grandmother; naturally leavened pizza from a wood-fired oven; handmade pasta; seasonal local ingredients. Reviews (November 2025–September 2026, in English): lunch course about ¥4,500; dinner course ¥7,500; Southern Italian antipasti; cavatelli with Kyotanba pork ragù; Omi beef Bolognese; tiramisu; 1 kg bistecca; T-bone steak; Margherita; free refills of bread and olive oil.

食べログ: イタリアン、東山区大和大路四条上ル常盤町158-2、京阪四条駅から徒.en: Tabelog: Italian; 東山区大和大路四条上ル常盤町158-2; 3 min walk from Keihan Shijo Stn; listed as Tue–Thu 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 13:00) and 18:00–24:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed Monday (open on holidays); bookings taken; 16 seats (4 tables for 4); non-smoking; cards; Northern Italian cooking, courses only. Reviews (2019–2026, in English): Piedmontese cooking; chef Nagata, trained under Cesare Giaccone; service by the chef's wife, long at Tawaraya; tajarin, agnolotti dal plin, bagna cauda, tripe salad, pheasant, Ezo deer, Barbaresco.

食べログ: イタリアン、東山区川端通四条上る弁財天町4-4 1F、祇園四条駅から.en: Tabelog: Italian; 川端通四条上る弁財天町4-4, Higashiyama-ku, 1F; 3 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn; 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–22:30 (last orders food 21:30, drinks 22:00); closed Wednesday; seat-only reservations (120 minutes, last order at 90, no seat requests); 10% service charge at dinner only (from 2 June 2025); 40 seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; listed as offering vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free and halal options; the fourth shop after Minami Aoyama, Tokyo Midtown and Yokohama; a Stefano Ferrara wood-fired oven imported from Naples. Reviews (December 2025–October 2026, in English): Chicory, Margherita, Quattro Formaggi with honey, seasonal vegetable fritto, carpaccio, risotto, gnocchi with lemon cream, Bolognese, panna cotta, many overseas guests, a complaint about the surprise plate.

食べログ: イタリアンダイニングDONA 有楽町店、千代田区有楽町2-7-1 有.en: Tabelog: Italian Dining DONA Yurakucho, Yurakucho 2-7-1, Chiyoda-ku, Yurakucho ITOCiA B1F; 71 seats; daily 11:00–22:30; closed when ITOCiA is; opened October 12, 2007; operator towafood-net.co.jp. Shop introduction: chewy house fresh pasta delivered direct to the shops; plenty of Japanese vegetables; affordable wine and small plates; prosciutto. 2026 reviews: lunch comes with salad or soup and a drink (pumpkin potage); tarako with squid, shiso and nori ¥1,150; mushroom and shiso with soy sauce, made spicier; uni and asparagus in tomato sauce with tiramisu; wine and starter set ¥1,000 (tomato and mozzarella, pâté, salmon); a checked interior; some mention dust by the windows.

食べログ: イタリアンバル ストーリア、イタリアン、大阪市淀川区西中島4-7-8.en: Tabelog: Italian Bar Storia, Italian, 4-7-8 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, サンコープラザ 2F; 3 min from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station (Midosuji Line); Mon–Fri 12:00–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 18:00–01:00, Sat 18:00–01:00, closed Sunday; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 14 seats (8 at the counter, 6 at tables); smoking allowed; Wi-Fi; takeaway; all-you-can-drink; opened 1 October 2015. Reviews (May 2024 to October 2026): lunch pasta ¥900 (large free); mentaiko and mushroom cream; chilled seafood tomato pasta with bonito flakes; a glass of wine at lunch ¥600; at night three starters (curried soybeans), thin-crust Margherita, roast black wagyu, anchovy pizza, shrimp and mushroom Genovese, salad, quiche, oysters escargot-style, butter pumpkin potage, spare ribs; a wide drinks list; ask the master for suggestions; the owner halved a salad on request; smoking allowed; PayPay accepted.

食べログ: イタリアンバル食堂チャコ、大阪市浪速区難波中3-9-7、南海なんば駅.en: Tabelog: Italian Bar Shokudo Chako, Nambanaka 3-9-7, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 6 min walk from Nankai Namba Stn; Mon, Wed–Fri 17:00–23:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00 (open straight through); L.O. food 22:00, drinks 22:30; closed Tuesday; weekday lunch only for private-hire bookings; reservations accepted (normally up to 4 people); one-drink minimum at dinner; about 2 hours 20 minutes when busy; cover charge ¥450 (not charged with a course); cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 18 seats (counter 10, tables 8); non-smoking (smoking area outside); children welcome; guests asked to avoid strong perfume; allergen ingredients can be left out, but complete removal and freedom from cross-contamination are not guaranteed; opened 26 August 2024. Menu (updated 16 October 2026): foie gras terrine and prosciutto bruschetta ¥880, sea urchin and potato cream ¥1,600, A4 Kuroge Wagyu roast steak 200 g ¥3,200, Aomori mussels steamed in white wine ¥1,200 (risotto ¥700), fresh pasta from Awaji Noodles, Wagyu Bolognese ¥1,480, courses with free-flow drinks ¥5,500 and ¥6,600. Reviews (November 2025–October 2026): risotto after the mussels, risotto from the acqua pazza broth, seasonal blackboard specials, burrata with melon, whole roast onion, the Rossini only from the second visit, order meat dishes early because they take time, lively, kind female staff.

食べログ: イタリアン・イノベーティブ、東山区祇園町北側266 井澤ビル 5F、.en: Tabelog: Italian, innovative; 5F, 266 Gion north of Shijo, Higashiyama Ward; 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn; lunch starts 12:00 (12:00–15:00, Tue–Sun and holidays); dinner starts at 18:00 or 19:00 (to 22:00, Tue–Sat and holidays); no dinner on Sunday; closed Monday; reservation only; give allergies and dislikes when booking (none can be handled on the day); lunch ¥7,500, with pairing ¥12,700 (non-alcoholic ¥9,900); dinner ¥15,730; service charge 5% at lunch, 10% at dinner; 9 counter seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 25 April 2023. Reviews (November 2025–October 2026, English): vegetable-led creative courses; the chef is also a sommelier; pasta by the 10 g; focaccia to take away; à la carte on only two days every two months; some say the pairing pours are 50 cc.

食べログ: イタリアン・ステーキ・ダイニングバー、中京区錦小路室町西入る天神山町.en: Tabelog: Italian, steak, dining bar; 中京区錦小路室町西入る天神山町277 K−an 1F; 3 min on foot from exit 24 of Shijo / Karasuma stations; Mon–Sat 18:00–22:00 (last entry 20:30); closed Sunday, some irregular closures; reservation only (only for guests ordering a meat main); parties of three or more take a course; no under-15s; foreign nationals book online; the owner works alone and may not answer the phone; 16 seats (6 at the counter, 10 at tables); cards and Rakuten Pay accepted; dry-aged black wagyu from Sakaeya in Shiga grilled over binchotan; natural wine; organic vegetables from the owner's family home (Shiga); homemade natural-yeast bread of Hokkaido wheat. Reviews (March–October 2026, in English): ¥6,800 course; three-cut tasting; cake salé, firefly squid, caprese, meat and cheese spring rolls, onion bread, fermented butter and sheep cheese pasta, meatball pasta, affogato; expect waits with one person working.

食べログ: イタリアン・ステーキ・パスタ、中京区伊勢屋町362、阪急河原町駅から.en: Tabelog: Italian, steak, pasta; 中京区伊勢屋町362; about 5 min on foot from Kawaramachi Stn (Hankyu); daily 9:00–11:00 (last order 10:30), 11:30–17:00 (only part of the à la carte menu from 14:00 to 17:00) and 17:30–22:30 (last order food 21:00, drinks 22:30); reservations accepted; under-10s at lunch only; dogs on the terrace only; 10% service charge; 56 seats (20 on the terrace, 8 at the counter, 28 at tables); non-smoking; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; vegetarian options; opened 1 September 2020. Shop text: a chef who was executive chef at hotels, herbs from the shop's own garden, no additives. Official site (in English): Italian cooking with Kyoto's seasonal ingredients, aperitivo, cocktails, wine, breakfast, la dolce vita. Reviews (August–October 2026, in English): breakfast course ¥3,850, pancakes, granola, handmade ravioli, spinach pasta, tomato and sea urchin pasta, cheese risotto, duck breast, staff from abroad serving in English, the owner's dog, terrace seats.

食べログ: イタリアン・パスタ、東山区下馬町491 アースコート清水 1F、馬町.en: Tabelog: Italian, pasta; 1F, 491 Shimobamacho, Higashiyama Ward; 4 min walk from the Umamachi bus stop, 15 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn; Tue–Fri 17:00–22:00; Sat–Sun 12:00–14:30 and 17:00–22:00; last lunch seating 13:00, last dinner seating 21:00; lunch by reservation made by the day before; closed Monday (open on holidays) and irregularly; no service charge; 14 seats; non-smoking; cards and transport IC cards accepted; opened 12 October 2023; Emilia-Romagna handmade pasta by a chef who trained at Antica Moka; no seafood served. Reviews (2025–October 2026, English and Japanese): lunch set ¥2,750; lunch course with two pastas ¥5,500; tagliatelle, bigoli, tortellini in brodo, tigelle, gnocco fritto, tiramisu; third anniversary.

食べログ: イタリアン・パスタ・バル、中京区油屋町145 洋燈館 1F、14:0.en: Tabelog: Italian, pasta, bar; 洋燈館 1F, Nakagyo-ku; 14:00–16:30 and 18:00–24:30 (last orders); closed Wednesday; one longer break a month; bookings taken (13 or more by phone); 40 seats; private room (4); private hire 20–50; no smoking; children and strollers welcome; sommelier; vegetarian options; cards accepted; no e-money; opened 20 October 2014. Reviews (April 2017; May–October 2026, in English): like a southern-Italian tavern; an owner-chef trained in Italy; ex-Antico in Ichijoji; a female owner; treccia caprese; carpaccio with house colatura; house karasumi; sardine and pine-nut spaghetti; lemon pasta; pistachio fusilli; meatball orecchiette; cutlets; aqua pazza; ¥6,000 sharing course; wine by the decanter.

食べログ: イタリアン・パスタ・ピザ、中京区堺町錦小路上ル菊屋町531 O-ZO.en: Tabelog: Italian, pasta, pizza; 中京区堺町錦小路上ル菊屋町531 O-ZONEビル 1F; Tue–Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Monday, some irregular closures; reservations accepted; 30 seats (6 at the counter, 24 at tables); non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; cards, e-money and QR accepted; the owner, from Wakayama, uses fish and vegetables from home and Kyoto vegetables; the sea-urchin cream pasta is popular; Wakayama craft beer. Reviews (May–October 2026, in English): north of Nishiki Market, at the back of a building and hard to spot; lunch ¥2,000 (assorted appetisers or grilled vegetables, pasta or pizza, a drink); shrimp and arugula cream, clam aglio e olio, Margherita, quattro formaggi, cassata; seems to be run by a couple (August 2026); some find it on the salty side.

食べログ: イタリアン・ピザ・ステーキ、下京区市之町239-1 招徳ビル 2F、.en: Tabelog: Italian, pizza, steak; 市之町239-1, Shimogyo-ku, 招徳ビル 2F; 2 min walk from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn; 18:00–24:00; closed Thursday; reservations accepted; 40 seats; private hire for 20–50; smoking allowed; cards, e-money and QR accepted; vegetarian options; pizza baked in a 500 °C oven; thin Barilla No. 3 spaghetti; chili and sansho spaghetti; wine ¥700 every Friday; free-flow courses from ¥5,000. Reviews (2024–2026, in English): blue walls and sofas, antipasto platter, tortilla, mussels, steak, shirasu and Kujo-negi pasta, one drink per person.

食べログ: イタリアン・ピザ・パスタ、中京区油小路通二条下る二条油小路町284.en: Tabelog: Italian, pizza, pasta; 284 Nijo-Aburanokoji-cho, Aburanokoji-dori Nijo-sagaru, Nakagyo-ku, 1F; every day 11:30–14:30 and 17:30–21:30; open all year; bookings taken; cancellation fees (50% two days before, 70% the day before, 100% on the day); 15% service charge (listed prices include tax and service); 105 seats (99 at tables including 18 on the terrace, one private room for 6; room fee lunch ¥12,700, dinner ¥19,000); no smoking (smoking area in the hotel); parking for 23 cars (two hours free with ¥8,000 spent); children welcome, kids' menu; dress casual; opened 3 November 2020; Italian WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (October 2024 – October 2026, in English): lunch course about ¥6,000 and a four-glass pairing ¥4,000; casarecce from an Awaji noodle maker with beef ragù; round tiramisu; Divertito ¥19,000; Quattro Formaggi pizza ¥4,800; Tanba chestnut Mont Blanc; afternoon tea; semi-buffet breakfast.

食べログ: イタリア料理 小西屋、大阪市西区新町1-23-9 2F、西大橋駅・四.en: Tabelog: Italian Ryori Konishiya, Shinmachi 1-23-9 2F, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min on foot from Nishi-Ohashi and Yotsubashi Stns; Mon and Wed–Sun 18:00–22:00, closed Tuesday; lunch suspended from April 2026; open days announced on social media; seasonal omakase courses ¥6,500, ¥8,000 and ¥10,000; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 16 seats (6 counter, 10 table); private hire up to 20; non-smoking (smoking area outside); children welcome; rooibos tea instead of water; opened 23 September 2016. Shop introduction: fresh fish, organic vegetables and meat sent directly from Tango, the owner's home region; a daily menu that changes with what comes in; wines chosen by the owner; anniversary surprises. Reviews (August 2025–October 2026): tenth anniversary; a kitchen run by one chef; carpaccio of four fish; chilled pasta (smoked salmon, shrimp, shirasu, grilled eggplant, tomato purée; pesto with myoga); clam pasta; meat sauce; chicken gratin; pizza; wild boar; prosciutto and cheese; rock oysters; sea urchin; a ¥6,500 course (heart-shaped mousse, tuna with pickles, garlic toast, pasta with bottarga, grilled shimaaji, panna cotta with pineapple sorbet and Shine Muscat grapes); an assortment of Tanba vegetables; always full; second floor up a narrow staircase; a repeat diner who played with the owner's daughter; a pizza made that was not on the menu.

食べログ: イチャドル韓豚丼、韓国料理・食堂、大阪市淀川区西中島5-8-29 チ.en: Tabelog: Ichadoru Korean Buta-don, Korean and set-meal restaurant, 5-8-29 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, チサンマンション第3新大阪 1F; 5 min from Hankyu Minamikata Station, 6 min (500 m) from Shin-Osaka; Mon–Fri and the days before and after a holiday 11:00–21:00, closed Sat, Sun and holidays; over the New Year open until Friday 26 December and again from Monday 5 January; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR payment; 13 seats (counter); non-smoking; children welcome; menus in English, Chinese (simplified) and Korean; takeaway and delivery; allergy information available; opened 11 November 2025. The shop's introduction: Ichadol, Korea's number-one yakiniku chain, brings Japan's first Korean pork rice bowl to Nishinakajima; homemade gochujang; for those who dislike heat, soy-sauce stir-fry bowls and sets; recommended: pork stir-fried with gochujang; a sundubu jjigae set (spicy) with seven side dishes and Korean seaweed; a set of pork stir-fry and teppan japchae (spicy). Reviews (March to October 2026): soy-sauce pork bowl and gochujang bowl ¥700 with miso soup and kimchi; sets ¥1,000 with seven small side dishes (rolled omelette, hijiki, glass noodles, kimchi, greens, konjac, bean-sprout namul), Korean seaweed and miso soup; large rice on request; sundubu and japchae sold out soon after noon; limited-time cold noodles with a rice ball; meal-ticket machine; PayPay accepted; half-basement; the toilet is outside the shop; a friendly owner; many overseas diners.

食べログ: イルピアット、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-6-30 清水町ビル1F、長堀.en: Tabelog: Il Piatto, Shimizumachi Bldg 1F, 1-6-30 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station exit 7; Mon, Wed–Sat and days before holidays 17:00–1:00 next morning, Sun and holidays 17:00–22:00; closed Tuesdays; booking recommended; seat charge ¥200 per person (¥250 for online bookings); cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; no smoking (ashtray at the entrance); private hire for 8–10; opened 28 July 2004; official site. Reviews (2021 – October 2026): the famous starter platter (over 10 items); roast duck; risotto to finish; cod roe grilled with herb butter; pasta loaded with cheese; a large counter extended into the next unit; a lively atmosphere; one found the freshly grated Genovese light on basil with firm noodles; four-cheese pizza; roast Kuroge wagyu; wines off the list if you state your taste; limited fresh-porcini peperoncino; seafood bouillabaisse and squid-ink pasta in big portions; seats a little cramped; attentive staff; anchovy and garlic pizza; a send-off; hard to find; good value.

食べログ: イル・バロッコ 有楽町店、千代田区有楽町2-1-16、84席、毎日1.en: Tabelog: Il Barocco Yurakucho, Yurakucho 2-1-16, Chiyoda-ku; 84 seats; daily 11:00–22:00; irregular holidays; opened December 9, 2009; operator giraud.co.jp. October 2026 reviews: sparkling wine half price at happy hour; Parmesan served separately on request; lamb and plum in a red-wine braising sauce; snack-size Margherita; pasta and a drink ¥1,800; garlicky dishes; a wide range of wine; ¥2,000–4,000.

食べログ: イワシトルネード、大阪市中央区北浜東5-4 コーシン北浜 B1F、北.en: Tabelog: Iwashi Tornado, Koshin Kitahama B1F, 5-4 Kitahama-higashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 353 m from Kitahama Station; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 19:00–23:00, Sun 11:30–14:30; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; children welcome. Reviews (January–October 2026): a hidden basement spot in the office district; ramen at lunch, the bar BULLSEYE at night; a counter lined with whisky; the menu changes weekly, check Instagram; order verbally, no ticket machine; shellfish-dashi salt ramen with mixed rice ¥1,200; leftover soup over the rice, chazuke-style; curry-flavoured tori-paitan ramen ¥1,100; Heartland beer ¥700; cold clear salt broth of seafood dashi (cold or hot, shoyu too); slightly wavy medium-thick noodles; chicken breast; grilled pork; shredded nori; onion; radish sprouts; the deep, clear umami of the cold shellfish-dashi ramen; nira and ginger oil; cold grated-yam ramen ¥1,100 (flat medium-thick noodles, grated yam, chicken breast, grilled gizzard, red onion, radish sprouts; one disliked the finishing powder); cold ume-kombu edition (gizzard confit, chicken thigh, fish powder); shrimp-miso paitan ramen ¥1,200 with a curry note; a free seasoned egg for the first anniversary; some days run single-handed; 10–15 minutes until served.

食べログ: インドカレー・カレー・バー、旧店名 カフェ&バー 大丈夫、中京区式部.en: Tabelog: Indian curry, curry, bar; former name Café & Bar Daijoubu; ふじ会館 2F, Nakagyo-ku; every day 12:00–15:30 and 18:00–22:00; closed irregularly; bookings taken; private hire for 10 or more; no cards; 16 seats; smoking allowed; opened 12 September 2015; original spice curries based on Indian cooking, handmade daily; a blend with Japanese curry; a bar as well. Reviews (November 2024 – November 2025, in English): Daijoubu spice curry (chicken) ¥1,080; beef-tendon korma; vegetable keema with lemon cream; butter curry; limited chicken keema plate ¥1,150–1,200; chicken tikka, 2 pieces ¥550; quail-egg achaar; miso cream cheese; a DJ booth; the owner runs it alone; irregular closing days on Instagram.

食べログ: インド料理・インドカレー、下京区寺町通高辻下ル京極町515-4 山本.en: Tabelog: Indian, Indian curry; 山本ビル 1F, Teramachi-dori Takatsuji-sagaru, Shimogyo-ku; every day 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; bookings taken; 63 seats (28 on the ground floor, 35 upstairs); private hire for 20 to over 50; no smoking; children welcome; takeaway; cards and PayPay accepted; no e-money; vegetarian options; a chef with over 15 years at a five-star hotel in India; herbs and spices imported directly from India; Curry WEST Tabelog 100 2020. Reviews (March 2025 – July 2026, in English): lunch ¥1,100, special lunch ¥1,450, C lunch about ¥1,000 (with a glass of wine); free naan refills; spiced carrot-and-tomato soup; 25 curries; butter chicken; spinach and mutton; keema; chickpea; lentil; tandoori chicken; biryani; a guest of 20 years.

食べログ: インド料理・カレー、中京区天神山町271、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩5分、月.en: Tabelog: Indian, curry; 中京区天神山町271; 5 min on foot from Karasuma Stn (Hankyu); Mon, Tue, Fri, Sat 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–20:00; Sun 11:30–15:30; closed Wednesday and Thursday; no reservations; 8 counter seats; non-smoking; cards and PayPay accepted; takeaway; English menu; do not park bicycles in neighbouring shops' or offices' bicycle spaces; opened 31 July 2020; Asian/Ethnic WEST Tabelog 100 2026. Reviews (September–November 2026, in English): chicken biryani, mutton biryani, sea bream dashi chicken biryani, a limited shirasu and fresh-nori biryani, two-kind platters, achaar and mapo tofu, mutton keema, spice highball, weekend chai and a one-drink rule, a queue at opening, a narrow one-way street, pop-ups in Tokyo.
