食べログ: イーパンツァイタナカ、中華、左京区田中里ノ内町26、元田中駅から徒歩.en: Tabelog: Yi Pan Tsai Tanaka, Chinese, 左京区田中里ノ内町26, 5 min on foot from Mototanaka Stn; Mon, Sat and Sun lunch at 12:00 only and dinner starting 17:00, 18:00 or 19:00; Tue, Thu and Fri dinner only; closed Wednesdays and irregularly (opening days on Instagram); reservation only; 10 seats; cards accepted; opened 10 December 2020; Chinese WEST Tabelog 100 2024, 2026. Reviews (August–October 2026, in English): a chef and madam trained in hotel Chinese cooking, a six-dish course ¥9,000 before tax, dim sum and noodles as add-ons, Matsutake xiaolongbao, mapo tofu, TableCheck bookings a month ahead that fill at once.

食べログ: ウェンディーズ・ファーストキッチン 日比谷シャンテ前店、千代田区有楽.en: Tabelog: Wendy's First Kitchen Hibiya Chanter-mae, Yurakucho 1-6-1, Chiyoda-ku; 80 seats; daily 7:30–22:00; opened November 18, 2016. October 2026 reviews: spicy chicken burger; fries (choose a flavor); iced coffee; ¥1,300 for a set; a bit pricier than other fast food; lots of seats; good service; right next to the main entrance of Midtown Hibiya.

食べログ: ウエストウッドベーカーズ、大阪市西区南堀江1-16-9、四ツ橋駅・な.en: Tabelog: WEST WOOD BAKERS, 1-16-9 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; from Yotsubashi and Namba stations; daily 9:00–16:00; open every day of the year; doughnuts on weekends and holidays only; no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; 18 seats; English menu; children welcome; opened 8 May 2013; official site. Reviews (September–October 2026): an American bakery cafe; 20–60 minutes' wait at weekends; parasols lent to those queuing; bacon-and-egg pancakes ¥1,250; iced caffè latte ¥500; croque madame breakfast set on house natural-yeast bread ¥1,485; avocado mozzarella cheeseburger; truffle fries (one didn't care for them); rocket, prosciutto and strawberry salad; French toast with vanilla ice cream; order 2 burgers and staff will cut them; weekend doughnuts about ¥300–400; English-speaking staff; no queue at 9:00 on a weekday.

食べログ: ウニラーメン専門店 uniRA、ラーメン、荒木町3-3 2F、水〜金.en: Tabelog: Uni Ramen Senmonten uniRA, ramen; Arakichō 3-3 2F; Wed–Fri 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–21:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–15:30; closed Monday and Tuesday (reservations only); reservations through the official LINE account (link on Instagram); reserved guests have priority; bowls made 4 at a time; PayPay accepted; no cards or e-money; 20 seats; non-smoking; opened 6 June 2024. Reviews (2025–2026): uni ramen standard ¥1,650; black (rock seaweed, oysters); large size; cheese; uni miso; squid-ink rice to finish; yellow curly noodles; over 100 rums; the owner alone; some find the uni flavour strong, others weak.

食べログ: エッセンス テラスダイニングバー、銀座3-11-8 第六丸嘉ビル1F.en: Tabelog: essence Terrace Dining BAR, Ginza 3-11-8, 第六丸嘉 Building 1F, 1 minute from Higashi-Ginza Station exit A7; 27 seats (terrace seats); weekdays 11:00–14:30, 17:00–23:00, Sat 11:00–14:30, 17:00–22:00, closed Sun (open Sunday and closed Monday if Monday is a holiday); cards and PayPay accepted; official site essence-ginza.co.jp. Shop introduction: a chef versed in traditional yōshoku; yōshoku-based cooking unbound by genre; charcoal grilling for the mains; a terrace. 2026 reviews: beef-tendon soup with the pasta lunch, kimchi cream pasta, pasta topped with hamburg steak to finish a course, retro pudding, birthday plates, ¥1,000–2,000 at lunch, ¥6,000–8,000 at night.

食べログ: エピナール、東上野5-23-2 かしわせビル1F、JR上野駅入谷口か.en: Tabelog: Epinard, Higashi-Ueno 5-23-2, かしわせビル 1F, 7 min on foot from the JR Ueno Station Iriya exit; Mon–Sat 11:00–14:00 and 17:00–20:30 (L.O. 20:00); closed Sundays and the third Wednesday; reservations taken; 20 seats (5 at the counter, 15 at tables, 4 on the terrace); non-smoking; cards accepted (no e-money or QR). Reviews (May 2022–March 2026): a fresh-pasta restaurant; opened 11 May 2009; carbonara; shrimp and mushroom cream pasta with a mini salad; half salad ¥450; salmon with tobiko mayonnaise; sardine and mushroom Japanese-style pasta ¥1,100; glass of wine ¥440; a strong sake and shochu list; summer chilled pasta; Italian-style omurice ¥1,300 (price rise from May); lunch A seafood cream pasta ¥1,150; a friendly owner; potato salad and simmered vegetables; arrabbiata.

食べログ: エルナージ、スペイン料理・居酒屋、大阪市淀川区野中北1-4-20、阪.en: Tabelog: EL NAGUE, Spanish and izakaya, 1-4-20 Nonakakita, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 10 min from Hankyu Mikuni and Kanzakigawa stations, 15 min from Juso, 20 min from Shin-Osaka; Tue–Sat 11:30–14:00 (food last order 13:30) and 17:30–22:00 (food last order 21:30); closed Sunday and Monday (events and live music); reservations accepted; cards, WAON, QUICPay and PayPay accepted; 18 seats (counter, tables, private room); up to 32; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children, strollers and pets welcome; parking for two; opened 28 July 2010. Shop text: retro Spanish cooking in a Japanese-Western former post office built 90 years ago; fresh seafood from the fishing port; the top pick is the seafood paella; the "Barcelona Course" of seven dishes with two hours of drinks; live events including jazz. Reviews (March 2024 to September 2026): lunch is three paella sets only; seafood paella ¥1,400 (January 2025); mixed seafood and chicken with salad ¥1,280 (September 2026); at night an appetiser platter (quiche, potato salad), gambas al ajillo with bread, grilled Iberico pork, homemade sausage, squid-ink paella, shrimp cream pasta, fish of the day (sawara a la bilbaína), carpaccio, jamón and cheese; a ¥3,000 course with all-you-can-drink ¥1,500; about ¥8,000 for two; the master runs it alone; orders by smartphone; mimosa in the garden; full at 19:00 on a weekday.

食べログ: エルベ、銀座3-13-17 山田ビル1F、東銀座駅から徒歩1分・マガ.en: Tabelog: Elbe, Ginza 3-13-17, Yamada Building 1F, 1 minute from Higashi-Ginza Station, behind Magazine House; 26 seats (6 counter); Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 11:30–15:00, 17:30–21:30, Sat evenings only, closed Wed, Sun and holidays; cards and IC accepted. 2026 reviews: beef stew made with sake instead of red wine, in a clay pot; the beef-and-tongue "mix"; plenty of meat even in the small pot; tofu salad at lunch (tofu, edamame, hijiki, carrot); stewed hamburg steak; bread and cabbage; at night cottage cheese, prosciutto, potatoes with grainy mustard, peach-and-cheese caprese; kabuki actors and women in kimono among the customers.

食べログ: エル・チャテオ 銀座店、銀座3-2-12 銀座T8ビル1〜2F、銀座.en: Tabelog: EL CHATEO Ginza, Ginza 3-2-12, Ginza T8 Building 1F–2F, 1 minute from Ginza Station; 78 seats (counter, sofa, tables); weekdays 11:00–15:00, 17:00–23:00, weekends and holidays 11:00–15:00, 16:00–23:00; ¥550 dinner charge (not for courses or party plans); opened April 3, 1996; official site juraku.com. Shop introduction: the traditional Spanish home cooking of "VIDRIO"; paella that twice won a world contest in Spain; dishes from ¥500; courses from ¥6,600 with 8 dishes including seafood paella and 2 hours of all-you-can-drink. October 2026 reviews: duck breast and truffled-mushroom paella; lunch set of paella, tapas platter and a drink; seafood and squid-ink paella (with mayonnaise sauce); a lunch course with steak ¥3,850; full with bookings; sometimes a 10-minute wait.

食べログ: エンボカ 京都 (en boca Kyoto)、ピザ・野菜料理・肉料.en: Tabelog: en boca Kyoto, pizza, vegetable and meat dishes, 中京区西洞院六角下ル池須町406, 7 min on foot from Karasuma Stn; Mon, Thu and Fri 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); Sat and Sun 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00); closed Tuesday and Wednesday; reservations accepted (same-day cancellation ¥3,000); without a booking, call first; one drink per person at dinner; 6 counter seats and 27 at tables; private hire 20–50; cards, transport IC and PayPay accepted; opened 12 December 2010; Pizza Tabelog 100 2017–2019, 2021, 2023, 2025. Reviews (August–October 2026, in English): main shop in Karuizawa, a renovated machiya, a wood-fired oven, lotus-root pizza, oven-roasted vegetables, half-and-half.

食べログ: オステリア ダ アダ、銀座6-4-3 GICROS 4F、60席(テ.en: Tabelog: osteria da Ada, Ginza 6-4-3, GICROS 4F; 60 seats (5 tables with 16 seats, the rest standing); daily 11:30–15:30, 17:30–23:00; standing only at lunch; the standing counter can't be booked; private room minimum ¥75,000; opened November 16, 2019; operator miki-international.co.jp. October 2026 reviews: wine by the glass ¥300–900; counter starters ¥300–450; pasta ¥1,500; bonito and sweet-shrimp carpaccio; seafood platter; clams steamed in white wine; prosciutto; colorful vegetable starters; lemon pasta; tiramisu; full at 19:00 on Saturday; also a shop in Shinjuku.

食べログ: オステリア ミオ・バール、銀座3-11-8 第6丸嘉ビル2F、東銀座.en: Tabelog: Osteria Mio Bar, Ginza 3-11-8, 第六丸嘉 Building 2F, 2 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station; 36 seats (semi-private rooms); weekdays 11:30–14:30, 17:30–22:30, Sat and holidays 11:30–15:30, 17:30–22:00, closed Sun; closed October 24 and 26, 2026; cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened May 13, 2013; 13th anniversary. Shop introduction: sommelier-chosen wines and Italian home cooking; organic vegetables delivered weekly from Miyazaki; this month's recommended course (8 starters, porcini risotto, roast Ezo venison). 2026 reviews: pasta lunch ¥1,500–1,600 (with 5 starters and coffee), arrabbiata, Ezo-venison ragù, seafood peperoncino; at night the course has fresh-fish carpaccio, marinated vegetables, house pickles, frittata, house pâté, gratin.

食べログ: オステリア・イル・カント・デル・マッジョ、イタリアン、中京区堺町通蛸.en: Tabelog: オステリア・イル・カント・デル・マッジョ (OSTERIA IL CANTO DEL MAGGIO), Italian; 中京区堺町通蛸薬師下ル菊屋町512-2; about 7 min on foot from Hankyu Karasuma and subway Shijo Stations; Mon, Tue and Fri–Sun 18:00–22:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday; reservations taken; 14 seats (one table for 2, three for 4); non-smoking; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); particular about wine; opened 27 April 2011; Italian WEST Tabelog 100 2021. Reviews (2024–2026, in English): Tuscan cooking; bistecca (1 kg on the bone, 500 g off the bone, minimum); beef fillet from 150 g; crostini; minestrone; wild boar pappardelle; peposo; apple tart; bread and water charged; classical records.

食べログ: オソラカフェ (OSORACAFE)、カフェ、カフェ WEST 百名.en: Tabelog: OSORACAFE, café, Tabelog Cafe WEST 100 2025, 3-18-8 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 1 min from Nishinakajima-Minamigata and Hankyu Minamikata stations, 12 min from Shin-Osaka Station; daily 10:00–16:30 (last order 16:00); irregular days off posted on the website, Instagram and Facebook; reservations on the website; cards and PayPay accepted; non-smoking; children welcome; takeout; no photos of the menu; opened 26 January 2016. Reviews (September–October 2026): formerly a fruit shop; fig plate with a drink ¥3,800; pears and grapes; Earl Grey parfait; Halloween parfait (persimmon, fig, grapes, black sesame ice cream); house rusks and granola; Premium Maboroshi Kinsyu peach toast (cheese ¥500); peach juice ¥999; "Momo Momo Momo" smoothie ¥999; premium iced coffee ¥680; royal milk tea; weekday breakfast; a little fruit on the house; careful explanations of the varieties; prices on the high side; many guests reserve; few seats and narrow aisles.

食べログ: オテルドゥオガワ、居酒屋、下京区西木屋町通四条下る船頭町230、祇園.en: Tabelog: Hotel De Ogawa, izakaya, 下京区西木屋町通四条下る船頭町230, 177 m from Gion-Shijo Stn; Tue–Sun 14:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Monday; no reservations; no groups; 8 counter seats; no cards; Izakaya WEST Tabelog 100 2025, 2026. Reviews (May–October 2026, in English): a sister of Shokudo Ogawa, on a hotel's ground floor with no sign, no reservations and no queue, opened May 2024, Hiroto Haeo who trained seven years under Shintaro Ogawa, bone-in fried chicken, dashimaki, jako fried rice, karasumi mochi, a blackboard menu without prices.

食べログ: オムライス&cafe STYLE、オムライス・カフェ・ハンバーグ、大.en: Tabelog: Omurice & cafe STYLE, omurice, cafe and hamburg steak, 4-15-2 Kikaihigashi, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 15 min walk from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; Thu–Tue 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30, last entry 21:20); closed Wednesday; may close early when sold out; no reservations; no cards or e-money, PayPay accepted; 11 seats (7 at the counter, two tables for 2); non-smoking, smoking area outside; children welcome; takeout; opened 23 April 2015; shop text: fluffy, creamy omurice with care over the sauces; the most popular is the bacon tomato cream fluffy omurice (cheese and fresh cream). Reviews (February 2025 to October 2026): a shop in a residential area; the owner runs it alone; plates come in 5–10 minutes; fluffy, creamy egg over ketchup chicken rice; demi-glace, tomato and cream sauces; lunch of demi-glace omurice with a crab cream croquette, salad and soup ¥980, large ¥200; daily special (cheese-filled egg with demi-glace) ¥980; shrimp and cream cheese with tomato sauce; seaweed soup; curry too.

食べログ: オラ タコス バー、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-1 コスミビル 1.en: Tabelog: Ola Tacos-bar, Cosmi Bldg 1F, 1-17-1 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; from Shinsaibashi Station exit 6, at the FamilyMart corner, look for the neon 'Tacos'; Tue–Thu 18:30–1:00 next morning, Fri–Sat 18:30–3:00 next morning, Sun 18:30–24:00 (food L.O. 23:00); closed Mondays; opened 5 April 2001; about 20 seats; terrace; cards accepted, no e-money; smoking allowed; listed as able to cater for vegetarians; hand-made tortillas; about 30 salsas; tequila and mezcal bought direct from Mexico; official site. Reviews (October 2025 – September 2026): chorizo tacos; braised pork-sparerib tacos ¥880; refried-bean and pulled-pork tacos; cheese tacos; chicken tacos; garlic-mushroom quesadilla (half ¥880); shrimp and avocado cocktail ¥1,320; habanero sauce; tequila soda; non-alcoholic Virgin Chi Chi and cranberry cooler ¥600; dishes may run out late; booking recommended.

食べログ: カサブランカ、居酒屋・海鮮・洋食、大阪市淀川区東三国2-24-15、.en: Tabelog: Casablanca; izakaya, seafood, yoshoku; 東三国2-24-15, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; about 4 minutes on foot from exit 1 of Higashi-Mikuni Station on the Midosuji Line; Mon, Tue and Fri–Sun 17:30–22:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday; no lunch; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money or QR; 25 seats (5 at the counter, 20 at tables); private hire up to 20; non-smoking; children welcome; takeaway; opened 8 May 1994. Reviews (2023 to July 2026): run by a couple; the owner's family runs a fish shop; fish from the market; sashimi platters from three kinds at ¥900 up to nine; simmered whelk and turban shell; simmered sardines; fried horse mackerel; raw oysters; firefly squid; fugu milt; fried fugu; sea urchin; clams; eel; crab cream croquette ¥450; kara-age, three pieces ¥500; bite-sized pork fillet cutlets; beef cutlet; roast beef; abalone-liver gratin; kasu-jiru with Kizakiyama sake lees; seasonal grilled vegetables, lotus root, corn, asparagus; dry curry to finish ¥1,000; Aramasa, Jikon, Juyondai, aged Moriizou; sesame tofu appetiser; looks like a kissaten from outside.

食べログ: カドヤ食堂 クリスタ長堀店、大阪市中央区南船場2 クリスタ長堀B1F.en: Tabelog: Kadoya Shokudo Crysta Nagahori, Crysta Nagahori B1F, 2 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 114 m from Nagahoribashi Station; daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); cards, e-money and QR accepted; 28 seats (counter); no smoking; opened 1 April 2020. October 2026 reviews: a tangy tsukemen; strong soup; not as moving as the main shop but good; superb seasoned egg; in without waiting, no time limit; tsukesoba; glossy noodles; a branch of a famous shop; order verbally; melting pig's trotters (salt, garlic, doubanjiang); chewy high-hydration noodles; a slightly sweet shoyu dipping soup; plenty of chashu; large size; takes about 15 minutes; wheat flavour; soup-wari; tsukesoba ¥1,550; chashu mayo ¥300; one says the noodles are softer and thinner than at the main shop.

食べログ: カドヤ食堂 総本店、大阪市西区新町4-16-13 キャピタル西長堀.en: Tabelog: Kadoya Shokudo head shop, Capital Nishi-Nagahori 1F, 4-16-13 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nishi-Nagahori Station exit 4-A; Mon and Thu–Sun 10:00–15:00; closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays; no cards, e-money or QR; 14 seats (counter 6, two tables for 4); no smoking; opened 6 November 2001, renewed 30 June 2010; Tabelog Ramen WEST Hyakumeiten 2018–2022, OSAKA Hyakumeiten 2023–2025. October 2026 reviews: a 55th visit; Nagoya Cochin chicken rice, weekends and holidays only, 10–15 a day; aroma of burdock; chuka soba; tsukemen extra-large ¥2,680; regular 200 g, large 300 g (+¥700), extra-large 400 g (+¥800), with more in the dipping soup too; hand-made wonton salt; hand-made medium-thick noodles; 16 people at 12:05 on a weekday, seated 12:44; tsukesoba regular ¥1,880; Nagoya Cochin seasoned egg ¥350; strong Cochin umami; shoyu with vinegar tang and chili; smooth house-made medium-thick noodles; 40 people at 13:30 on a Sunday, a 2-hour wait; golden-gleaming noodles; Ramen Walker Hall of Fame; sunshade umbrellas; a 30-minute wait; hand-made wonton noodles; chashu, wontons, seasoned egg, menma, leek, nori, naruto.

食べログ: カフェ コロンビア、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-11-15 1F・B1F.en: Tabelog: Cafe Colombia, 1F and B1F, 1-11-15 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 218 m from Nagahoribashi Station; daily 11:00–20:00 (L.O. 19:30); no cards, e-money or QR; smoking allowed; 16 seats; takeaway. Reviews (January–June 2026): a simple white-toned cafe; big windows; easy alone; upstairs, a shop of the bag brand BAG'n'NOUN; Colombian coffee ¥600; frothy Colombian mocha latte; affogato; spiced hot chocolate; iced Earl Grey; cream chiffon cake ¥450; rare cheesecake with lemon and berry sauce; cash only; e-cigarettes allowed (one says up to 3 per person); Wi-Fi; entrances from both Nagahori-dori and the street north of Unagidani; friendly staff.

食べログ: カフェ デ コラソン (cafe de corazon)、カフェ、上.en: Tabelog: カフェ デ コラソン (cafe de corazon), café; 上京区革堂町593-15; 604 m from Imadegawa Station; Mon–Sat 10:00–17:00; closed Sunday and the third Monday; no seat reservations (cakes can be held); payment changed to cash only; 8 counter seats; non-smoking; parking for one car; takeaway; opened 12 June 2012; Cafe WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Official site (cafe-de-corazon.com): a shop of house-roasted coffee and handmade sweets; an online shop for beans and sweets. Reviews (2026, in English): owner Katsushi Kawaguchi trained at Cafe Bach in Minami-Senju and served as its manager; the owner's wife is a pastry chef; about 20 beans; hand-picked; cheesecake ¥450; seasonal tarts and parfaits; coffee from ¥930; a second shop, Nino, in Nijo.

食べログ: カフェ ベル、上野公園12-49 国際子ども図書館内 1F、鶯谷駅か.en: Tabelog: Cafe Bell, Ueno Park 12-49, inside the International Library of Children's Literature 1F; 448 m from Uguisudani Station; Tue–Sun 9:30–17:00; closed Mondays, the third Wednesday and public holidays; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 10 seats (tables); terrace; non-smoking. Reviews (November 2025–October 2026): curry rice ¥550; Napolitan is the house speciality; omurice curry; hamburg curry; value set ¥700 (fried white fish and twice-cooked pork in a bento box); daily special ¥800; coffee ¥400 (iced ¥450; ¥300 and ¥320 until early in the year); drinks ¥150 with lunch; cake set ¥650; shaved ice; soft-serve; meal tickets cash only; called by number; nearly full at lunch; curry sells out early.

食べログ: カフェ、下京区河原町通七条上ル住吉町352、七条駅から320m、月〜.en: Tabelog: café; 河原町通七条上ル住吉町352, Shimogyo-ku; 320 m from Shichijo Stn; Monday–Friday 8:00–16:00, Saturday and Sunday 8:00–17:00; reservations accepted; 31 seats (14 at tables, 7 at the counter, 10 on the terrace, no smoking on the terrace either); cards (JCB, AMEX), e-money and QR; Cafe WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (July–October 2026, in English): the café of the tea-caddy maker Kaikado; a registered tangible cultural property; a converted streetcar depot; Kaikado cheesecake set (cheese from the Nasu highlands) ¥2,050; Karaki Mochi with seasonal tea ¥1,700; cold brew ¥1,150; iced coffee ¥950; café au lait; matcha latte; an toast; a set served in a tea caddy; closes early.

食べログ: カフェ・ケーキ、東山区八坂鳥居前東入円山町604 長楽館、祇園四条駅.en: Tabelog: café, cakes; 八坂鳥居前東入円山町604, Higashiyama-ku, Chourakukan; 10 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn; daily 11:00–18:30 (last order 18:00); closed irregularly; café seats first come (some days have reserved slots); afternoon tea by reservation (two or more, 12:00–18:00); 10% service charge; 100 seats; private rooms for a fee; non-smoking (outdoor smoking area); cards accepted; parking for 10 cars; Cafe WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (January–November 2026, in English): a 1909 Western-style mansion, the guest house of a businessman who succeeded in tobacco; described both as a Kyoto city tangible cultural property and as a national important cultural property; afternoon tea ¥6,500; Herend china; fig parfait; shine muscat tart; millefeuille; beef fillet katsu sandwich; galette des rois; limited items selling out.

食べログ: カフェ・ケーキ・かき氷、左京区岡崎法勝寺町25番地、法勝寺町バス停、.en: Tabelog: café, cakes, kakigori; 岡崎法勝寺町25, Sakyo-ku; Hosshoji-cho bus stop, 7 min walk from Keage Stn; Wednesday–Sunday 10:00–18:00 (until sold out); closed Monday and Tuesday; no reservations; 16 seats (tatami 6–8, tables 8–10); no cards, e-money or QR; non-smoking; Cafe Tabelog 100 2022; Cafe WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (June–November 2026, in English): order downstairs, then go up to the tea room; pay on leaving; from about May to September only kakigori is served inside and cakes are takeaway; pudding kakigori ¥1,400; matcha, mango, peach, strawberry; warm hojicha; donut-shaped tiramisu; Japanese chestnut Mont Blanc; about ¥600; no photography inside; one group at a time; wait outside.

食べログ: カフェ・スイーツ、左京区吉永町270-3、京阪三条駅11番出口から徒.en: Tabelog: café, sweets; 左京区吉永町270-3; about 6 min walk from exit 11 of Keihan Sanjo Stn, about 7 min from exit 2 of Jingu-Marutamachi Stn; 12:00–19:00 (L.O. 18:00); closed Tuesday; temporary closures on Instagram; no reservations; 16 seats (tables); non-smoking; cards (AMEX) and QR; takeaway; no photos except of the food; opened 12 September 2014; Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2018–2020, Cafe Tabelog 100 2021 and 2022, Cafe WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (May–October 2026, in English): Amazon cacao and banana ¥1,600, grapes and cream cheese ¥1,400, amanatsu and yomogi, nashi and osmanthus, anmitsu, passion-fruit uirou, roll cake ¥1,200, blend coffee ¥550.

食べログ: カフェ・パブ・ケーキ、左京区浄土寺上南田町36 2F、浄土寺・銀閣寺.en: Tabelog: café, pub, cakes; 浄土寺上南田町36, Sakyo-ku, 2F; 3 min walk from the Jodoji and Ginkakuji-mae bus stops; Monday, Wednesday–Sunday 12:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); closed Tuesday; no reservations; 35 seats; no cards, e-money or QR; non-smoking; no parking (the city car park 50 m north is free after 17:00); Cafe Tabelog 100 2021, 2022; Cafe WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (June–November 2026, in English): 2nd floor of an ivy-covered Western-style house, a different shop on the ground floor; said to be designed by Vories; scone set ¥1,650; cake set ¥1,350 (pear tart, cherry chocolate cake); lunch of hamburg steak or shrimp gratin; tea by the pot; jazz from a JBL Paragon; record shelves; Wedgwood and Royal Copenhagen china; video recording inside not allowed; waits at weekends.

食べログ: カフェ・甘味処、旧店名 せせらぎ すへら、東山区弁財天町17 スフェ.en: Tabelog: café, Japanese sweets café; former name せせらぎ すへら; 東山区弁財天町17 スフェラ・ビル; about 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo and Sanjo Stns; 12:00–19:00 (L.O. 18:30); closed Wednesday; changes for events posted on Instagram; no seat reservations; Shogetsu wagashi reserved by phone, Friday–Sunday only; no service charge or table charge; 30 seats (tables, sunken kotatsu, sofas, terrace); smoking on the terrace and outside; cards and PayPay; invoice T9130001053604. Official site (ricordi-sfera.com): Sfera's original furniture, tableware and home accessories. Reviews (May–October 2026, in English): Shogetsu set ¥1,500, Kōgetsu set ¥1,800, organic lavender pudding, tart of the day, Kyoto Brewing Ichigo Ichie ¥1,200, pets allowed (in a cart or bag).

食べログ: カフェ・甘味処・和菓子、東山区祇園町南側570-210、祇園四条駅か.en: Tabelog: café, kanmidokoro, wagashi, 東山区祇園町南側570-210, 158 m from Gion-Shijo Stn; Tue–Sun 11:00–18:00; closed Monday; no reservations; 16 seats (10 at tables, 6 at the counter); non-smoking; cards and QR accepted; opened 8 November 2012; tea, coffee, fresh juices and sparkling water with wagashi; Cafe Tabelog 100 2021, 2022; Cafe WEST Tabelog 100 2025; Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2019, 2020. Kagizen Yoshifusa official site (checked for batch 15): also runs ZEN CAFE and ZENBI. Reviews (February–October 2026, in English): kuzumochi ¥1,200, kuzukiri ¥1,200, zenzai ¥1,200, jo-namagashi ¥1,000, chestnut kinton, fruit sandwiches (sold out around 11:45), persimmon juice, a ticket machine, paying 30 minutes before closing, opposite ZENBI.

食べログ: カポ・クラッセ、大阪市中央区南船場1-17-5 2F、長堀橋駅から2.en: Tabelog: CAPO CLASSE, 2F, 1-17-5 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 205 m from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–23:00; closed Sundays; online reservations; cards accepted (one says cash only at lunch); 16 seats. Reviews (November 2025 – October 2026): an Italian restaurant up the stairs on the 2nd floor; run single-handed, and efficiently; always busy at lunch; A lunch ¥1,200 (today's starter platter, e.g. Spanish omelette, potato salad, chicken breast; house bread; pasta with tomato, oil or cream sauce); tuna and mushroom cream sauce; shirasu and okra cabbage oil sauce; coffee ¥100; Italian dried pasta cooked firm; à la carte and courses at night; blue-cheese caprese.

食べログ: カリトロ三国、たこ焼き、大阪市淀川区西三国3-4-7、阪急三国駅から.en: Tabelog: Karitoro Mikuni; takoyaki; 西三国3-4-7, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 3 minutes on foot from Hankyu Mikuni Station toward the shopping street; daily 11:00–23:30; phone orders 20 minutes ahead; no cards or e-money; 2 seats; non-smoking. Reviews (2014 to April 2026): crisp outside, runny inside; konnyaku in the batter; six for ¥480; eight for ¥520 (2018); sauce, salt, soy sauce, ponzu or dashi soy sauce; extra green onion free; nothing made ahead; about 20 minutes from order; the owner adds extras; regulars who eat it with salt; diners mention shops in Juso and Umeda too.

食べログ: カルバドール、バー、中京区妙満寺前町446 若林ビル 2F、京都市役.en: Tabelog: Calvador, bar, 中京区妙満寺前町446 若林ビル 2F, 313 m from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn; Mon, Tue and Fri–Sun 19:00–23:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday; reservations accepted; 8 counter seats; smoking allowed; charge ¥1,000; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and Rakuten Pay accepted; opened 28 April 2004; Bar Tabelog 100 2022. Reviews (February–May 2026, in English): a Calvados specialist, over 500 kinds, master Takayama, Jack Rose, aged single casks, chocolate made with Assemblage Kakimoto, a second floor with no sign, hard to book.

食べログ: カレー、下京区西木屋町四条上ル真町455、阪急河原町駅から徒歩2分、.en: Tabelog: curry, 下京区西木屋町四条上ル真町455, 2 min on foot from Kawaramachi Stn (Hankyu); Tue–Sun 11:30–14:00 and 16:30–23:00; closed Monday (open on Mondays that are public holidays); no reservations; 12 seats (counter and tables); cards accepted (JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR; non-smoking; a sommelier on hand; wine. Reviews (April 2024–August 2026, in English): run by a couple; second floor of a building, entered by an outside staircase; vegetable curry ¥1,400 (about ten kinds of vegetables, raw, pickled and fried); small shrimp curry ¥1,400; seasonal soup (corn) ¥600; beef curry; European-style curry; pickled cabbage and yam; a signed photo of Katsuo Ohno; a building with tree roots growing out of it.

食べログ: カレー、左京区東大路通丸太町上ル東側聖護院西町12、熊野神社前バス停.en: Tabelog: curry; 左京区東大路通丸太町上ル東側聖護院西町12; 100 m north of the Kumano-jinja-mae bus stop; Mon–Thu 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:50) and 17:30–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); Sun and holidays 11:00–16:00 (L.O. 15:45); closed Friday and Saturday; no reservations; 8 seats (counter only); non-smoking; no cards, e-money or QR; takeaway; Curry WEST Tabelog 100 2023, 2024, 2026. Reviews (2024–2026, in English): founded 1975; opposite Kyoto University Hospital; beef (sweet, medium, spicy), chicken and vegetable curries; turmeric rice; katsu curry ¥1,200; curry ¥950; queues; no photography inside.

食べログ: カレーや デッカオ、大阪市中央区南船場3-8-5 南船場ビル 2F、.en: Tabelog: Curry Ya Dekkao, Minamisenba Bldg 2F, 3-8-5 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon, Wed, Fri, Sat and holidays 11:30–15:30 (L.O. 15:00), Tue and Thu 11:30–15:30 and 18:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); closed Sundays; no cards; PayPay accepted; 13 seats (counter 9, one table for 4). Reviews (September–October 2026): 2nd floor up a hard-to-spot entrance; Sri Lankan curry adapted for Japanese palates; Dekkao special ¥1,300 (chicken and a daily curry); mini ¥1,250 (3 side dishes); greedy Dekkao special ¥1,650 (chicken, 2 daily curries, 4 sides); 4–5 daily curries (komatsuna and pork keema, coconut tuna, clam and tomato, spicy squid +¥100, a vinegared pork dish); one chicken drumette in the chicken curry; sides (coconut furikake, stir-fried aubergine, tomato salad, coconut mizuna); try each first, then mix it all; smiling staff; a queue before opening.

食べログ: カレー屋 みーやん、大阪市中央区難波4-8-11、近鉄大阪難波駅8番.en: Tabelog: Curry Ya Miyan, 4-8-11 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Kintetsu Osaka-Namba Station exit 8 and Namba Station exit 13; Fri–Sun 11:30–15:00 (ends when sold out); no cards, e-money or QR; 13 seats (counter 8, tables 5). Reviews (March 2025 – August 2026): weekend-only combination curry; 3 kinds ¥1,300; beef-pork and spring-cabbage keema; new-potato and new-onion potage; pork green keema; grilled cheese +¥100; gentle yet deep; may underwhelm heat lovers; spinach potage; beef-pork tomato keema; a pop-up curry in borrowed premises, Fri, Sat and Sun only; the main shop is Rakurakuza; seasonal ingredients; Chinese-yam achar; one item sold out, so charged ¥1,200; a kind owner; behind Shochikuza; scallop potage; beef-pork-shrimp tomato keema; beef-pork citrus keema; corn potage; grilled corn ¥200; mix it all together; not hot; sweetness and depth; nori potage; beef-pork red-miso keema.

食べログ: カンティーナ シチリアーナ トゥット イル マーレ 銀座4丁目、銀座.en: Tabelog: Cantina Siciliana Tutto Il Mare Ginza 4-chome, Ginza 4-13-3 2F (22 seats on 2F, 26 on 3F); from Higashi-Ginza Station exit 3, go along Kobikicho-dori to a pink house; 48 seats; daily 11:30–15:00, 17:00–22:30; closed at New Year; coperto ¥400 at dinner only; cards and PayPay accepted; opened September 20, 2013. Shop introduction: Sicilian food behind the Kabukiza; famous for rich red-shrimp sauce with house busiate, and Trapani's seafood couscous; the main shop is listed as a Michelin Bib Gourmand. October 2026 reviews: 3F booked out with all-you-can-drink (Peroni on draft); a two-pasta course; traditional Sicilian pasta and focaccia at lunch; orange cake; bistecca with potatoes; complaints of cramped, noisy seats, slow service and a one-drink rule with soft drinks around ¥800.

食べログ: カンティーナ ヴィニエトゥッティ、築地2-12-16 イースト銀座び.en: Tabelog: CANTINA VINI TUTTI, Tsukiji 2-12-16, East Ginza Building 1F, 3 minutes from Tsukiji Station; 21 seats; weekdays 11:30–14:30, 17:00–23:00, Sundays and holidays 17:00–23:00, closed Sat, irregular holidays at night; opened September 22, 2013; cards, IC and d-barai accepted. 2026 reviews: nicknamed "Tutti"; a wooden front with a red noren; sofa seats along the wall; lunch with a weekly pasta; house Bolognese and avocado lasagna ¥1,300 (with salad); pay cash at the table at lunch; à la carte centred on pasta; ¥1,000–2,000 at lunch, ¥4,000–6,000 at night.

食べログ: キッチン たか、洋食・ハンバーグ・オムライス、荒木町3-1、四谷三丁.en: Tabelog: Kitchen Taka, yoshoku, hamburg steak, omurice; Arakichō 3-1; 4 min walk from Yotsuya-sanchome Station Exit 4; Mon–Fri 11:00–16:30, Sat 11:00–15:00; closed Sundays and holidays, New Year and Obon; some dishes limited; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 6 counter seats; non-smoking; no preschool children; opened 1 September 2011; yoshoku cooked to order, with rice, miso soup and salad. Reviews (2026): hamburg steak with fried egg ¥1,700; pork sauté ¥1,700; lemon-garlic sauce ¥1,750; shrimp pilaf ¥1,750; omurice ¥1,750; tomato beef; two people who seem to be a couple; a request to eat quietly; some find the service unfriendly.

食べログ: キッチンべる、港区新橋2-19-6 新和ビルB1F、24席(カウンタ.en: Tabelog: Kitchen Belle, Shinbashi 2-19-6, Minato-ku, 新和 Building B1F; 24 seats (7 counter, 4 tables); Mon–Sat 11:00–14:30, 17:00–22:30, closed Sun. 2026 reviews: a yōshoku restaurant run by a married couple; 1–2 minutes from JR Shinbashi Station Ginza exit; omurice, hamburg steak, Napolitan, fried oysters, mix and match freely; on-hamburg ¥1,400; omurice with hamburg steak ¥1,300; hamburg steak with crab cream croquette ¥1,300; Napolitan with chicken cutlet; dry curry with ham cutlet; menchi-katsu; fried pike conger; comes with miso soup; big portions; for when the shop upstairs has a queue.

食べログ: ギンザ カンセイ、銀座7-12-1 藤高ビル2・3F、銀座駅B3・B.en: Tabelog: GINZA Kansei, Ginza 7-12-1, 藤高 Building 2F–3F, 5 minutes from Ginza Station exits B3/B5 and Higashi-Ginza Station; 14 seats, a fully private room; Mon–Sat 12:00–15:00, 18:00–22:00, closed Sun; opened April 1, 1990; cards accepted. Chef profile (English): Mikiyasu Sakata, over 40 years of French cooking, a Ministry of Agriculture "Ryori Masters" chef, cultural ambassador for Iwate and Miyagi, dedicated to Japanese ingredients. 2026 reviews: opened in Aoyama in 1990 and moved to Ginza; vegetable-centered, not heavy courses; white asparagus and shirasu salad; truffle pâté; foie gras with truffle; whipped butter with six herbs; chef's omakase ¥33,880 (tax incl.).

食べログ: クセが強い麺屋 れいわ、大阪市中央区博労町4-7-1、本町駅から36.en: Tabelog: Kuse ga Tsuyoi Menya Reiwa, 4-7-1 Bakuromachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 364 m from Hommachi Station; Tue–Sat 12:00–14:00 and 19:00–23:00 (lunch sometimes skipped); closed Sundays and Mondays; no cards, e-money or QR; 9 counter seats. Reviews (March–October 2026): a shop full of JoJo figures; the owner serves in character, draining the noodles with flourishes and lines; every ramen ¥2,000 (noodle refills and toppings free, such as cheese and nori); miso tonkotsu (rich and creamy); coriander ramen; maze-soba ¥1,500 (tomato maze-soba with free rice, cheese and kimchi); a ¥1,000 lottery with no blanks; one group at a time, about an hour per group; no reservations, 1–2 hours' wait; cash only; in September 2026 no lunch, open from 19:00 until sold out.

食べログ: クレープリー・アルション、大阪市中央区難波1-4-18、50席(5名.en: Tabelog: Creperie Alcyon, 1-4-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 50 seats (no bookings for 5 or more); Mon–Fri 11:30–21:30, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–21:30; L.O. 20:30; lunch 11:30–15:00 (Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–17:00); cafe and takeaway until 20:30; no cards, e-money or QR payment; no smoking; features: vegetables, healthy, vegetarian menu; Tabelog Sweets WEST Hyakumeiten 2023 and 2026; French wheat flour, Échiré butter and salt. 2025–2026 reviews: avocado and roast-pork quiche; milk-jam crêpe set ¥1,480; today's starter ¥770; Échiré butter and sugar crêpe; about a 10-minute wait for takeaway; crisp outside and chewy inside; sweet-potato crème brûlée; crêperie lunch ¥2,200 (today's galette on the blackboard: beef stew, mashed potato and cheese); cash only; salad set; steep stairs; tandoori-chicken galette; Mont Blanc.

食べログ: グッチオステリアダマッシモボットゥーラ トウキョウ、銀座6-6-12.en: Tabelog: Gucci Osteria da Massimo Bottura Tokyo, Ginza 6-6-12, Gucci Namiki 4F, 5 minutes from Ginza and Higashi-Ginza stations; 48 seats (40 main, 8 in a private room; room charge ¥25,000); Wed–Sun lunch 11:30–15:00, dinner 18:00–22:00 (bar from 17:00), closed Mon and Tue; 12% service charge; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; opened August 2, 2021. Shop introduction: the third in the world after Florence and Beverly Hills; head chef Rafaela De Vita, appointed in 2025. 2026 reviews: the menu changes about every three months; caprese-style macaron; cannolo with prosciutto and cheese cream; grissini; truffled cauliflower gratin; bread of Hokkaido wheat; squid-ink cacciucco; tricolor ravioli; beef cheek in red wine; a non-alcoholic pairing including a hojicha cocktail; lunch ¥12,000 (tax incl., service extra).

食べログ: グラマシー テーブル、銀座5-9-5、銀座駅・東銀座駅から徒歩1分、.en: Tabelog: GRAMERCY TABLE, Ginza 5-9-5, 1 minute from Ginza and Higashi-Ginza stations; 20 seats; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00, 18:00–21:00, closed Sun; at night a 10% service charge and ¥540 charge; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) accepted; opened October 30, 2012. 2026 reviews: a hideaway bistro down a lane; black-toned with big windows and an open kitchen, like a New York townhouse; truffle omurice (limited to 5 on Saturdays); salad and bread; burgers too; staff who remember regulars; some reviews of ¥30,000–40,000 at night; ¥1,000–5,000 at lunch.

食べログ: グリル南風、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-7-4、地下鉄なんば駅25番出口.en: Tabelog: Grill Nanpu, 2-7-4 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk north from subway Namba Station exit 25 across the Dotonbori River; Mon–Sat 12:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30), Sun 12:00–14:00; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 20 seats; no smoking; counter seats. Reviews (July–October 2026): a long-established Western-style diner near Amemura; read 'Nanpu'; a retro atmosphere; local regulars; tonkatsu ¥1,600 (salad, curry-flavoured bean sprouts, yakisoba-like spaghetti); a batter fried crisp at high heat; hamburg steak ¥1,600 and rice ¥250 (spaghetti, fried egg, bacon); Familia lunch ¥1,100 (bite-size katsu, fried shrimp, omelette); comes with mini somen; counter on the ground floor, tables on the 2nd; weekday lunch is good value; a proper demi-glace; ¥1,000 with rice and somen; head-on fried shrimp; 74 years since founding; crab cream croquettes; easy to visit alone.

食べログ: ケバブバー、港区六本木6-2-35 ROPPONGI662 1F、営.en: Tabelog: Kebab Bar, Roppongi 6-2-35, ROPPONGI662 1F; no hours listed; no cards (e-money and QR accepted); 5 seats. Reviews (2022–January 2026): chicken kebab; large kebab sandwich ¥800; kebab rice bowl ¥800 (large +¥100); kebab curry; original, spicy or mixed sauce; lots of cabbage; many takeout customers at lunch; cash and PayPay; loud music; some found too much mayonnaise-like sauce.

食べログ: コリス、洋食、東山区松原通大和大路東入2丁目轆轤町101、清水道バス.en: Tabelog: Korisu, yoshoku, 東山区松原通大和大路東入2丁目轆轤町101, 3 min on foot from the Kiyomizu-michi bus stop; Mon and Wed–Sun 11:30–19:00; closed Tuesday; closed every year 25 January–25 February; bookings open at the end of each month for the next; 12 seats; private hire up to 20; no cards, e-money or QR; bringing wine generally not allowed; sommelier; Yoshoku Tabelog 100 2020, 2023; Yoshoku WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (July–November 2026, in English): a taste carried on from the previous generation, a mother and her daughters, macaroni gratin, hamburg steak with a fry, pumpkin soup, a phone line that won't connect for bookings.

食べログ: コーヒーショップ エリカ、大阪市中央区難波2-1-14 なんばウォー.en: Tabelog: Coffee Shop Erika, Namba 2-1-14, inside Namba Walk, Chuo Ward, Osaka; 1 minute on foot from Kintetsu Namba Station and subway Namba Station; daily 7:00–22:00; no reservations; no cards; no e-money; QR code payments accepted; 20 seats; separated smoking (8 non-smoking seats added); counter; breakfast served. Namba Walk shop page: Coffee Shop Erika, 1-bangai, café, 7:00–22:00; a coffee stand serving freshly ground coffee to drop into between work and shopping; a horseshoe counter that suits coffee; toast and hot dogs too; right by the ticket gate of subway Midosuji Line Namba Station; counter 21 seats, table 1 seat; smoking allowed; in-shop Wi-Fi; cashless OK. Reviews (October 2024 to October 2026): in front of the Midosuji Line Namba Station ticket gate, beside the escalator to Kintetsu Osaka-Namba Station; Showa retro; order and pay first; smoking allowed at every seat (some say it changed from separated smoking to full smoking, and that under-18s cannot enter); morning 7:00–11:00, a set of mini sandwiches, boiled egg and drink ¥470 (April 2025, January 2026), ¥500 in July 2026; hot dog morning with curry-flavoured cabbage and sausage ¥500; cheese toast set ¥500; mixed sandwich set ¥700; toast sandwich set ¥750; pasta set choosing from 6 kinds ¥1,000; coffee ¥450; iced coffee ¥400; iced café latte ¥450; pancakes in October 2026; some paid with a transport IC card; some call it cheap enough to surprise even Nagoya, some find the cigarette smoke hard, and some found the coffee lukewarm.

食べログ: コーヒー＆ベーカリー アルル、パン・サンドイッチ、大阪市淀川区東三国.en: Tabelog: Coffee & Bakery Aruru, bread and sandwiches, 4-17-8 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, グランヴィー新大阪 103; about 5 min from Exit 5 of Higashimikuni Station (Midosuji Line); Mon–Fri 7:30–20:00, Sat and holidays 7:30–18:00, closed Sunday; no reservations; cash only; 16 seats; non-smoking; takeaway; opened 4 August 2022. Reviews (November 2023 to October 2026): a green, plant-covered front; levain breads; pain de Lodève of just water and wheat at 90% hydration ¥250; baguette ¥250; cheese and dried-fruit loaf ¥690; half a cheese levain ¥580; Lodève pizza ¥350; roast-chicken sandwich ¥420; French toast ¥300; rum raisin ¥350; almond croissant ¥350; salt bread ¥150; cream bread ¥260; egg pizza ¥270; egg sandwich ¥230; melon bread; tartines at breakfast; house-roasted coffee ¥500; iced latte ¥450; one drink each to eat in; a toaster; in the evening a ¥500 set of soup, bruschetta and all-you-can-eat bread; wine by the glass (3 red, 1 orange, 3 white); shochu; one diner found the coffee lukewarm.

食べログ: サイゼリヤ 銀座インズ店、中央区銀座西3-1 銀座インズ1 2F、毎.en: Tabelog: Saizeriya Ginza Inz, Ginza-nishi 3-1, Chuo-ku, Ginza Inz 1, 2F; daily 11:00–23:15; opened November 17, 2011. 2026 reviews: Milanese doria, squid-ink pasta, hamburg steak, draft beer and a decanter of white wine for just over ¥5,000 for three, spaghetti with tarako sauce and shredded nori, Margherita, spicy chicken, small-shrimp salad, focaccia; complaints that the escargots are oily and the squid ink bland; about 20 minutes with 10 groups waiting; people from all over the world.

食べログ: サラマンジェ ド イザシ ワキサカ、銀座7-2-8 TAKAYA-G.en: Tabelog: SALLE À MANGER de Hisashi WAKISAKA, Ginza 7-2-8, TAKAYA-GINZA Building B1F, 4 minutes from Ginza Station; 20 seats; Mon–Sat 11:30–13:30, 18:00–23:00, closed Sun; table charge ¥500; cards and d-barai accepted. Shop introduction (English): chef Hisashi Wakisaka; authentic regional cooking based on the classics; additive-free; Lyon's "tarte praline" (raw almonds peeled one by one, with a red sugar coating). 2026 reviews: moved from Toranomon to Ginza; Lyonnaise cooking; soupe de poisson; salade lyonnaise; boudin noir; quenelles; flounder Dugléré; Japanese-beef bavette; muscat tart; à la carte arranged as a course; another dish instead of the cake; a regular of 11 visits; ¥8,000–15,000.

食べログ: ザ・グラン銀座 ギャラリー、銀座6-10-1 GINZA SIX 1.en: Tabelog: The Grand Ginza Gallery, Ginza 6-10-1, GINZA SIX 13F; daily 11:00–16:00, 17:00–22:00. 2026 reviews: Napoleon pie (flaky pastry, fresh cream, custard, strawberries) with milk tea; easy to get into even on a weekend evening; spacious and relaxing even with children; a Champagne toast; wish there were non-alcoholic beer; also used as a wedding venue and banquet hall; buffet; the fish dish on the course is good.

食べログ: ザ・パントリー 丸の内(The Pantry)、千代田区丸の内3-3.en: Tabelog: The Pantry Marunouchi, Marunouchi 3-3-1, Chiyoda-ku, Shin-Tokyo Building 1F, 5 minutes from JR Yurakucho and Hibiya stations; 30 seats; weekdays 11:00–20:00, with a separate listing of 11:00–18:00 (no days given); closed Saturdays and New Year; official site thepantry.jp; particular about vegetables, vegetarian menu available. 2026 reviews: hamburger set 150 g (with soup and salad) ¥1,880, Jr. size ¥1,580; the day's burger was teriyaki; avocado, tomato and lettuce; light buns; teriyaki sandwich ¥1,380 (four pieces and fries); in front of the International Forum; quiet on weekday evenings.

食べログ: シナモロールカフェ 大阪なんば戎橋店、カフェ、大阪市中央区難波1-5.en: Tabelog: Cinnamoroll Cafe Osaka Namba Ebisubashi Store, café; 1-5-14 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Mon–Fri 11:00–21:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 10:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:15); reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted. Reviews (March–September 2026): one of three Cinnamoroll Cafes in Japan; goods shop on 1F; café on 2F, walk-ins welcome but queues on holidays; bookings ¥1,000 per person for a 3F room and a limited novelty; blue curry with star-shaped cheese; shortcake ¥1,500; Cinnamorattecino ¥800; latte; two-layer soda topped with a Cinnamoroll-face ice cream; blue lemon drink; Cinnamoroll and milk ice drink ¥990; café au lait; Cinnamoroll even in the toilets; some say the taste is ordinary; many overseas visitors and families.

食べログ: シャナブール銀座、銀座7-6-2 石井ビルB1F、28席(カウンター.en: Tabelog: Shanabool GINZA, Ginza 7-6-2, 石井 Building B1F; 28 seats (8 counter, 20 table); weekdays 17:00–3:00, Sat 17:00–2:00, closed Sundays, holidays and December 31–January 5; opened July 1, 2013. Shop introduction: proper cocktails and restaurant-quality food; a calm interior of reclaimed wood; seasonal recommendations and sommelier-chosen wine. Reviews: cocktails made to any request; a fresh La France pear cocktail; milt and meat dishes; omakase fruit cocktails (non-alcoholic too); mezcal and soda; a back bar up to the ceiling; lively with young customers late at night.

食べログ: ジェラート・アイスクリーム・カフェ・スイーツ、下京区木屋町通四条下ル.en: Tabelog: gelato, ice cream, café, sweets; 木屋町通四条下ル斉藤町134, Shimogyo-ku; 4 min walk from Gion-Shijo and Kyoto Kawaramachi Stns; daily 13:00–22:00 (eat-in last order 21:30); no reservations; 12 seats; 36 seats on the Kamo River platform from May to October; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; the gelato shop of BABBI, the Italian wafer brand with a 70-year history; uses its wafer pastes; Japanese flavours such as matcha and black sesame. Walkerplus (February 2020): first in Japan; two-flavour gelato ¥660; single ¥550; 11:00–22:00 (at the time). Reviews (2024–2026, in English): pistachio, hazelnut, ricotta and fig, triple ¥1,620, single ¥990 on the platform, wet towels at the counter, outlet goods.

食べログ: ジビエ料理・イタリアン・イノベーティブ、東山区祇園町北側279-3、.en: Tabelog: game, Italian, innovative; 祇園町北側279-3, Higashiyama-ku; 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn; Monday–Saturday 17:00–23:30 (last entry 21:00); closed Sunday; closures vary by season; lunch for 2 or more by reservation; reservation only; treated as cancelled after 15 minutes without contact; please avoid strong perfume; 5% service charge; 15 seats; non-smoking; cards accepted. Reviews (September 2025–July 2026, in English): chef Futa Kanda (born 1989, from Miyama town); after four dishes, all you can order from about 30 dishes; course ¥28,000 or ¥32,340 with tax; venison, wild boar, bear, pheasant, duck; botan-nabe; sansho hot pot; Miyama wild vegetables; house bread; a wine cellar; works with hunters and also wholesales; a report of slow service and a cold room.

食べログ: ジャッジョーロ銀座、銀座7-10-5 ジ オーブ ルミナスB1F、銀.en: Tabelog: GIAGGIOLO GINZA, Ginza 7-10-5, The ORB Luminous B1F, 5 minutes from Ginza Station exit A3 and Higashi-Ginza Station; 20 seats; Tue–Sat 11:30–14:30, 17:30–21:30, closed Sun and Mon; opened July 6, 2007; cards accepted. 2026 reviews: the famous organic-vegetable "15-herb salad" (named for Santa Maria Novella); large and everything-on; takeaway; gentle flavors that make the most of stock and ingredients; a maternity course; non-alcoholic sparkling and wine; a starter of herb salad and prosciutto; ¥10,000–15,000 at night.

食べログ: ジュー ドゥ マルシェ、フレンチ、四谷坂町12-11 BITEN 1.en: Tabelog: Jour de Marche, French; Yotsuya Sakamachi 12-11, BITEN 1F; 3 min walk from Akebonobashi Station Exit A4, 8 min from Yotsuya-sanchome Station Exit 4; lunch 12:00–15:00 (Tue, Fri, Sat, Sun), dinner 18:00–23:00 (last order 20:00); closed Wednesday and the second Tuesday; reservation only; lunch booked 3 days ahead; omakase course only, dislikes and allergies asked in advance; up to 2 groups a day; dogs up to about 8 kg on the fourth Sunday and the following Monday; cards and PayPay accepted; no service charge; 8 seats. Reviews (2024–2026): the owner-chef handles the food and wine alone; black-rice risotto; pie in pastry; foie-gras macarons; Aomori duck; wine pairings; good non-alcoholic drinks.

食べログ: スイーツ カフェ キョウト ケイゾー (Sweets Cafe KY.en: Tabelog: スイーツ カフェ キョウト ケイゾー (Sweets Cafe KYOTO KEIZO), café and cakes; 中京区御供町293; 6 min on foot from Nijojo-mae Station; daily 8:30–17:30; no reservations; cards (AMEX); QR payments; non-smoking (smoking area outside); terrace; children welcome; opened 24 March 2016; Cafe WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Walkerplus (14 March 2020): "KEIZO", known for its Mont Blanc with a 10-minute shelf life, opened the bakery KYOTO KEIZO BAKERY パンとパティシエ (中京区聚楽廻南町1). Reviews (2026, in English): a machiya in the 三条会 shopping arcade; the 10-minute Mont Blanc (meringue baked three hours at low temperature); matcha Mont Blanc ¥1,680; Japanese-chestnut Mont Blanc; fig parfait; gapao rice; a queue of over 30 minutes (November 2026).

食べログ: スイーツ・カフェ・洋菓子、下京区木屋町通松原上る二丁目和泉屋町170.en: Tabelog: sweets, café, Western sweets; 木屋町通松原上る二丁目和泉屋町170-1, Shimogyo-ku; 5 min walk from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn; daily 10:00–18:00 (last order 17:00); closed irregularly; numbered tickets from 9:00 each morning (order, not a time); takeaway from 11:00; reservations accepted (by phone for 1 person or 10 or more; tables held one hour; cancelled after 15 minutes' lateness); 34 seats (6 counter, 28 table); non-smoking; cards, transport IC cards and PayPay; Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2026; Mont Blanc of 1 mm Japanese-chestnut strands. Reviews (August–November 2026, in English): opened October 2019; Kinshi Mont Blanc 'Sa' of Kyotanba chestnuts only, ¥3,080 (40 a day); 'Tsumugi' with a drink ¥1,800; chestnut mochi ¥1,980; seasonal fruit parfaits; piped in front of you; dashi as a palate cleanser; a river view from the 2nd floor.

食べログ: スコッチバー ノア、文京区湯島3-46-2 2F、湯島駅から徒歩1分.en: Tabelog: Scotch Bar Noah, Yushima 3-46-2, Bunkyō, 2F; 1 min on foot from Yushima Station; daily 17:00–24:00; closed 1–3 January; reservations taken; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; smoking allowed. Reviews (May 2018–April 2026): a long-established Yushima bar, over 50 years; an owner who trained in Ginza; 82 in 2022 and 86 in April 2026, planning to work until 90; Scotch, especially cask strength; homemade dried fruit; stories of Ueno and Japanese whisky; strictly classic recommendations.

食べログ: スタイリッシュグリル Tyu、大阪市中央区博労町3-3-13、心斎橋.en: Tabelog: Stylish Grill Tyu, 3-3-13 Bakuromachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 8 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 11:00–15:30 (L.O. 15:00); closed Wednesdays; PayPay only (no cards or e-money); 7 seats. Reviews (January 2025 – September 2026): in Semba's textile district; queues at weekday lunch; coarse-ground hamburg seared on the teppan; Japanese or Western (demi-glace) sauce; wasabi and grated daikon; shiso grated daikon; cheese; bacon; mushrooms; house tomato sauce ¥1,300; hamburg set ¥1,350; +70 g; egg on rice with Oita Ran-oh eggs +¥100; hamburg and pork set ¥2,000; free refills of rice and ginger beef-tendon soup; chicken dishes and limited specials too; friendly staff; before opening or after 14:00 recommended.

食べログ: スタンド ソバ サンカク 南船場店、大阪市中央区博労町4-7-5 T.en: Tabelog: Stand Soba Sankaku Minami senba ten, TS Bldg 1F, 4-7-5 Bakuromachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min (310 m) from Yotsubashi Stn exit 1-a, 5 min from Honmachi Stn exit 21 or Shinsaibashi Stn exit 3; Mon and Sun 19:00–3:00; Tue–Thu 11:30–15:00 and 19:00–3:00; Fri 11:30–15:00 and 19:00–5:00; Sat 12:00–15:00 and 19:00–5:00; reservations accepted; private hire up to 20; cards, PayPay and au PAY; no e-money; no service charge; 14 seats (counter 8, three tables for 2, joined for 4–5); 20 standing; ashtray outside, smoking allowed from midnight; no children at night; opened 18 November 2021. Shop introduction: 100% buckwheat soba with seasonal sake, warm soba in katsuobushi broth, daily specials, oden, fried loach, sake from all over Japan. Reviews (August 2024–October 2026): large mori soba ¥1,200 with lotus-root kinpira and hijiki-and-shiso rice; horumon soba ¥1,100; pork and green onion soba ¥1,200; chicken-and-egg soba in thickened ginger broth ¥1,100; bukkake with grated daikon, ume and shirasu ¥1,380; bukkake with grated wasabi ¥1,280; a tororo-and-nori daily special; thick, firm, fragrant soba; rich bonito dipping sauce; thick soba-yu; seaweed, curry and matcha salts; one drink per person at night; dashimaki, tuna sashimi, crab miso, grilled eggplant with butter, grilled salmon, mozuku tempura; a rock-style interior; one diner says the former shops in Awaza, Fukushima and Ura-Namba are gone and the owner has changed.

食べログ: スタンド ビアとら、バル・ビアバー・タコス、大阪市淀川区東三国1-2.en: Tabelog: Stand Beer Tora, bar, beer bar and tacos, 1-24-8 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 2 min from Exit 4 of Higashimikuni Station (Midosuji Line), 6 min from JR Higashiyodogawa Station, 10 min from Shin-Osaka Station; Mon, Tue, Fri and Sat 17:30–23:00, Sun 17:30–21:00, closed Wed and Thu; reservations by phone only (no online booking); cards, QUICPay and QR accepted; 16 seats (6 at the counter, two tables for 4, one for 2); non-smoking; children welcome; Wi-Fi; sports on screen; opened 7 November 2023. The shop's introduction: draft Pilsner Urquell poured by a certified tapster, craft gin, fermented ginger ale, "Tacopy" of taco mince on pepper, the signature "Popper", smoked dishes. Reviews (June 2024 to September 2026): the owner, Daisuke; the pour learned from the staff of the Czech pavilion at the Expo; Mirko; Pilsner Urquell large ¥1,300; Popper of jalapeño, cheese and bacon (one each); smoked mackerel; smoked fish cake; schnitzel; canola-flower ohitashi; hayashi without rice; fresh fish with green onion; fried new potatoes; yaki udon; five sausages ¥680; grilled tomato and shirasu garlic bruschetta; chashu egg; figs with cream cheese; Masahiro's Okinawa gin; no cover charge; few seats, so book.

食べログ: スター ラーメン、ラーメン、大阪市淀川区東三国6-1-35、東三国駅.en: Tabelog: Star Ramen, ramen, 6-1-35 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 419 m from Higashi-Mikuni Station; Fri, Sat, Sun 7:00–14:00; closed Monday to Thursday; no reservations; no cards or e-money, PayPay accepted; 7 seats (5 at the counter); non-smoking; children welcome; kids menu; takeout; opened 8 May 2022. Reviews (April to October 2026): a morning-ramen shop about 5 min north of Higashi-Mikuni Station; the owner, a woman, runs it alone; photos of food only; blow your nose in the restroom; no firm-noodle requests; self-service water; "Akira Star" ¥900 (thin straight noodles 140 g, 100 g at the same price, light soy, plenty of bean sprouts and Kujo green onions, two slices of pork belly and one of shoulder); some call the broth soy tonkotsu, others a peppery chicken broth; Akira Star SP and DX; the star-shaped soft-boiled "Egg Star" ¥200; limited niboshi ramen ¥1,300 announced on social media; tamari-soy chuka soba with premium horumon; chashu rice bowl ¥500; bottled beer ¥650; Toy Story figures on the ceiling.

食べログ: ステーキ 鉄板焼き Teppan&grill R 心斎橋、大阪市西区.en: Tabelog: Steak Teppanyaki Teppan&grill R Shinsaibashi, Yotsubashi GTC Bldg 2F, 1-7-5 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exit 2; lunch 12:30–17:00 (courses only, 2 or more, online booking 3 days ahead); dinner 18:00–23:30 (food L.O. 21:30); closed Mondays plus two consecutive days a month; reservations take priority; counter for course orders only; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 10% for private rooms, counter hire and New Year; 14 seats (counter 10, sofa private room for up to 5); no smoking; English and Chinese menus; children's course by coupon; opened 16 June 2014; official site. Reviews (December 2024 – May 2026): courses priced by the seafood; starters such as roast beef; sashimi of itoyori or fatty sea bream (white shoyu and ginger); lobster with Américaine sauce; abalone grilled in front of you; flambéed with whisky; the top course has chateaubriand (salt only); garlic rice; white-miso fish soup; dessert; meat and seafood shown on a big platter before cooking; order abalone and get the decorated shell; plenty of wine.

食べログ: ストライク軒 中之島フェスティバルプラザ店、大阪市北区中之島3-2-.en: Tabelog: Strike Ken Nakanoshima Festival Plaza, Nakanoshima Festival Tower West B1F, 3-2-4 Nakanoshima, Kita-ku, Osaka; 106 m from Watanabebashi; daily 11:00–21:00; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; opened 16 June 2025. Reviews (June 2025 – October 2026): a new branch of a popular Tenjimbashi-suji 6-chome shop; Nakanoshima Straight (shoyu, medium-thick straight noodles, wheat aroma, big chashu, thin menma; also with leek); Nakanoshima Curve (a Sapporo-style miso ramen with a tare blended in Sapporo, egg noodles, a little stronger than Straight); Kamisori Drop (a special salt tare, egg, a mound of leek, like a warm hiyashi chuka); garlic ¥80; karaage and karaage-rice set; highball set; LINE coupons; a clean shop; courteous service; one felt the noodles and soup didn't match.

食べログ: スパイスカフェ ディワリ 京都店、インド料理・インドカレー・カフェ、.en: Tabelog: SPICE CAFE DIWALI Kyoto, Indian, Indian curry, café; Mina Kyoto 7F, 大黒町58, south of Sanjo on Kawaramachi-dori, Nakagyo-ku; every day 11:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); reservations accepted; 46 seats; private hire for 20–50; non-smoking; Wi-Fi; takeaway; English menu and English-speaking staff; cards and PayPay accepted; vegetarian options; spices imported directly from India; all-you-can-eat and all-you-can-drink plans. Reviews (July 2024–October 2026, in English): chicken and mutton biryani (about 20 minutes), cheese naan, keema, vegetable curry, lassi, chai, chocolate naan, Maharaja Parfait, chicken fried rice ¥880, fried chicken ¥715.

食べログ: スパイスカレー食堂 四谷本店、カレー・スリランカ料理・南アジア料理、.en: Tabelog: Spice Curry Shokudo Yotsuya honten, curry, Sri Lankan, South Asian; サンサーラ四谷 1F, Yotsuya 2-9-15; 5 min walk from Yotsuya Station; daily 8:00–20:00 (last order 19:30); until sold out; open year-round; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 9 seats (counter 4+5); non-smoking; breakfast; vegetarian options. Reviews (August 2024–November 2026): black chicken curry ¥1,300, parippu, green bean and potato curry, pickled purple cabbage, carrot and coriander sambols, papadam, mix it all together, said to be made without wheat flour and with little oil, a vegetarian curry, ticket machine, from 8 am, spiced tea.

食べログ: スパゲティながい、パスタ、四谷1-8 中川ビル2F、南北線四ツ谷駅か.en: Tabelog: Spaghetti Nagai, pasta; Nakagawa Building 2F, Yotsuya 1-8; 2 min walk from Yotsuya Station (Namboku Line), 3 min from JR and the Marunouchi Line; Mon–Sat and holidays 11:30–20:00, sometimes closing early; closed Sundays (occasional openings); no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 16 seats (6 at the counter, 10 at tables); non-smoking. Reviews (June 2025–October 2026): the Hashiya lineage, second floor with no sign, cod roe and squid (with shiso), cod roe and sea urchin, egg and bacon (soy-sauce flavour), seafood in tomato sauce, meat sauce with tuna, clams and basil in garlic, ¥1,300–1,500, large portions, mini salad ¥300, one cook, bookshelves, open straight through, a line at lunch.

食べログ: スペインレストラン 銀座エスペロ、銀座5-6-10 B1F、銀座駅徒.en: Tabelog: Spanish restaurant Ginza Espero, Ginza 5-6-10 B1F, 1 minute from Ginza Station; 50 seats; weekdays 11:30–15:00, 17:00–22:30, Sat 11:30–16:00, 17:00–22:30, Sundays and holidays 11:30–16:00, 17:00–22:00; no time limit; opened March 30, 2020 (renovation); official site ginza-espero.com. Shop introduction: authentic Spanish food in Ginza for over 60 years; renovated in 2020; a double award at the international fideuà contest in Spain on June 4, 2014; award-winning paella by a chef who is an official judge. October 2026 reviews: a ¥1,600 lunch with a choice (shrimp and mushroom pasta, hamburg steak with prosciutto); queues even on weekdays; paella sold out; salty salad; tomato and anchovy salad; mushroom ajillo; Spanish omelet a little salty; stuffed spear squid with uni sauce; squid-ink paella; crab crêpe.

食べログ: スマイル キッチン ヒマラヤン バル 裏難波店、ネパール料理・カレー.en: Tabelog: Smile Kitchen Himalayan Bal Ura-Namba, Nepalese and curry, JBGビル 1F, Namba Sennichimae 7-15, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 minutes from Nankai Namba Station south exit; daily 11:00–5:00 (L.O. 3:00); closing days may vary; reservations accepted (smokers please call ahead); no service or cover charge; cards (AMEX only), no e-money or QR payment; 28 seats; members-only private room upstairs; vegetarian options shown; opened 7 January 2021. Reviews (June 2024–September 2026): all-you-can-eat and drink ¥3,300, cheese naan curry set ¥1,050, kebab curry set ¥850, biryani plate, dal bhat, vegetable pakora, momo 6 pieces ¥600, vegetable chow mein ¥750, chicken sekuwa, all-you-can-eat naan set, spice level of your choice, reports of now being open 24 hours, some staff hard to communicate with in Japanese, the owner and four staff, a second shop planned.

食べログ: スマート珈琲店、喫茶店・洋食・パンケーキ、中京区寺町通三条上ル天性寺.en: Tabelog: Smart Coffee, kissaten, western food and pancakes, 中京区寺町通三条上ル天性寺前町537, 2 min on foot from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn; daily 8:00–19:00; no reservations; 38 seats; non-smoking; cards: AMEX only; Kissaten Tabelog 100 2021, 2022, 2026. Reviews (October–November 2026, in English): founded 1932, a café on 1F and western-style lunch on 2F, hotcakes, French toast, firm pudding, mixed sandwich, queues, beans to take home.

食べログ: スリランカ料理 ラサハラ、スリランカ料理・カレー、食べログ カレー.en: Tabelog: RASA HALA (Sri Lankan cuisine), Sri Lankan and curry, Tabelog Curry WEST 100 2019, 4-17-6 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 150 m west of Exit 5 of Higashimikuni Station (Midosuji Line), 2 min on foot; Tue–Sat 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–22:00, Sun 11:00–14:00, closed Monday (from July 2026); special events on Poya (full-moon) days; daily specials and days off on Facebook; reservations accepted; no cards or e-money, PayPay accepted; 18 seats (two tables for 4, three for 2, 4 at the counter); hire up to 20; non-smoking; spice adjusted and a children's curry with notice; opened 5 December 2011. Reviews (May to November 2026): a chef from Sri Lanka; Special Ceylon Plate ¥1,500 (basmati rice, five sides, egg, three curries of meat, beans and vegetables); meat from chicken, pork, mutton or pork keema; a mild Veggie Plate; bone-in mutton biryani ¥1,500; chicken biryani ¥1,400; coriander sambol; fried rice; Kal Dothul; chai; a friendly chef; the meat curries are on the hot side.

食べログ: スンドゥブ食堂 駿、大阪市西区新町1-33-15 アップルビル 1F.en: Tabelog: Sundubu Shokudo Toshi, Apple Bldg 1F, 1-33-15 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 2 min on foot from Nishi-Ohashi Stn exit 2, 5 min from Yotsubashi Stn; daily 11:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00, takeout L.O. also 23:00); reservations accepted (online); cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 17 seats (9 counter, 8 table); non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; takeout; menu with photos; opened 16 September 2025. Shop introduction: authentic Korean flavours, casually; a choice of 8 kinds of sundubu; set meals at lunch, Korean dishes such as bossam and chijimi at night; takeout too; Korean soju, makgeolli, highballs. Reviews (October 2025–September 2026): homemade tofu made every morning; broth of Kuroge wagyu bones and tail; homemade tategi; spice levels 0 to 8; over 20 toppings; lunch with rice (large free, or swap for ramen or glass noodles), raw egg, Korean seaweed, kimchi and namul for ¥1,000, ¥1,550 with horumon and clams; at night beef and horumon sundubu ¥1,450, Kirishima black pork sundubu ¥1,550, natto or okra topping ¥100, kimchi chijimi ¥1,210, chive chijimi, mozzarella chijimi, sukiyaki-style bulgogi, kimbap, stone-grilled cheese bibimbap, wagyu yukhoe, ganjang saeu and yangnyeom saeu, shaved ice, draft beer ¥550; vinegar on the table to change the flavour; full of office workers at lunch; open straight through between lunch and dinner; stamp card; the main shop is in Yuzato and this is the second, with a third in Kutarou-cho; the name is read "Toshi", not "Shun".

食べログ: セクションドール、インド料理・鶏料理、左京区岡崎西天王町84-1 M.en: Tabelog: Section D'or, Indian, chicken dishes; M&M's APARTMENT 1F, 岡崎西天王町84-1, Sakyo-ku; 4 min walk from the Higashiyama-Nijo and Kumano-jinja-mae city bus stops; Monday and Wednesday–Sunday 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed Tuesday; reservations accepted; 8 seats (4 tables); non-smoking; no cards, e-money or QR; opened 1 April 2011; Asian/Ethnic WEST Tabelog 100 2026. Reviews (May–October 2026): the only menu item is tandoori chicken, ¥2,700, a one-plate dish with colourful grilled vegetables, served about 10 minutes after ordering, the chicken very tender and refined, go in the mood for light Italian, oolong tea, cash only.

食べログ: セント・サワイオリオンズ、銀座7-3-13 ニューギンザビル10F、.en: Tabelog: Saint Sawai Orions, Ginza 7-3-13, New Ginza Building 10F, 3 minutes from Ginza Station; 49 seats (8 counter, about 40 sofa); weekdays 13:00–18:00 café time (one-drink minimum), 18:00–23:00 dinner (two-order minimum, L.O. 22:00), closed weekends and holidays; 10% service charge; from November 1, smoking allowed all day and no under-20s (until then no smoking during café time, smoking allowed after 18:00); official site orions.tokyo. Shop introduction: founded 1972; the traditional flavors of world-renowned bartender Sawai; "special roast beef of select wagyu" since the founding; the pâtissier's "pudding parfait"; whisky and about 150 cocktails; the atmosphere of a 1950s European restaurant bar. 2026 reviews: iced coffee ¥1,200; cakes from the affiliated cake shop on 1F can be brought in free until 17:00; charge ¥1,650; pudding ¥2,200; live piano; founded in 1972 by the legendary bartender Sawai; roast beef; spaghetti Vivalentino; pudding finished in front of you.

食べログ: セージ アンド フェンネル、銀座8-2-14 竜王ビル2F、新橋駅5.en: Tabelog: sage & fennel, Ginza 8-2-14, 竜王 Building 2F, 3 minutes from Shinbashi Station exit 5; 16 seats; Sun–Thu 17:00–23:00, Sat 11:00–14:30, closed Fri; cards accepted; shop introduction: courses with big platters of lobster and wagyu, with all-you-can-drink sparkling wine. Reviews (2025–2026): deli plate, bagna cauda, roast duck breast (arugula and berries), lunch of starter, salad, main, pasta and dessert, light with plenty of vegetables, girls'-night omakase course booked through OZmall, ¥3,000–10,000.

食べログ: ソローノ、ピザ・イタリアン、中京区新町姉小路東入ル町頭町90-3、烏.en: Tabelog: Solono, pizza and Italian, 中京区新町姉小路東入ル町頭町90-3, 282 m from Karasuma-Oike Stn; Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–21:30; closed Thursday; reservations accepted; no service charge (one drink each at dinner); 28 seats (counter 6, tables 12, upstairs 10); non-smoking; cards accepted; opened 11 February 2012; Pizza Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (September–October 2026, in English): wood-fired Neapolitan pizza ¥1,900–2,500, Margherita, mushroom, gorgonzola, a spicy basil oil, a ¥110 box for leftovers.

食べログ: タイニートリア 本店 ティー&サムシングラブリー、その他、日本橋人形.en: Tabelog: Tinytria Honten Tea & Something Lovely, other; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-20-2, 1F, 3 min walk from Ningyocho Station exit A1; Wed–Sun 11:00–17:30; closed Mon and Tue (open on holidays); reservation only; cards and QR accepted; 12 seats (8 at tables, 4 at the counter); non-smoking; takeaway; opened 2 February 2016; website tinytoria.com. Time Out Tokyo (15 February 2022): a tea salon on Amazake Yokocho like the English countryside; vintage tableware and objects bought by the owner, 慶本佐知子; Taylors of Harrogate teas; casual afternoon tea; the address then given as 2-20-5, 1F. Reviews (January 2018–October 2026): cream tea set ¥880 (2018); scones, crumpets, lemon curd, banana bread, carrot cake, Victoria sponge; afternoon tea booked months ahead; featured on Matsuko’s World; dogs allowed on the terrace.

食べログ: タイ料理・創作料理・居酒屋、下京区木屋町通松原上ル美濃屋町173-1.en: Tabelog: Thai, creative, izakaya; 木屋町通松原上ル美濃屋町173-1, Shimogyo-ku; 6 min walk from Exit 1 of Hankyu Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn; Monday, Tuesday, Thursday–Sunday 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Wednesday; no reservations; 56 seats (ground floor: 8 at the counter, 12 at a sunken irori table; upstairs: 36 seats and 3 private rooms; 30 on the summer platform); smoking allowed; cards accepted; vegetarian options. Reviews (August 2025–September 2026, in English): Thai food in a townhouse; by the Kamo River; ¥800 charge on the platform; gapao lunch; tom yum kung; green curry; pad Thai; khao soi; tom kha gai; yum woon sen; mild spice, with Thai heat available; a Japanese owner and a Thai cook.

食べログ: タイ料理・東南アジア料理・エスニック、中京区上大阪町528 遊里香ビ.en: Tabelog: Thai, Southeast Asian, ethnic; 中京区上大阪町528 遊里香ビル 3F; 3 min on foot from Keihan Sanjo Stn; Tue–Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Monday; reservations accepted (cancelled after 30 minutes without contact; two-hour limit when busy); 23 seats (5 at the counter, 18 at tables); private hire for 20–50; non-smoking; Wi-Fi; cards and PayPay accepted; English menu; takeaway; vegetarian options; opened 2 June 2025; tom yum kung hot pot, gapao, seafood curry, Thai beer. Reviews (May–November 2026, in English): lunch sets (salad, soup, shrimp chips, mini dessert); khao man gai ¥1,100; pad thai; green curry; tom yum ramen; po pia tod; rad na ¥1,210; sup nor mai ¥1,100; busy at lunch.

食べログ: タイ料理専門店 TAI THAI なんば本店、大阪市浪速区難波中2-.en: Tabelog: Thai restaurant TAI THAI Namba main shop, U-I Bldg 1F, 2-6-15 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka, 050-5868-6983; reservations accepted (recommended at night; may close early); Mon and Wed–Fri 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30), Tue 17:00–22:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–22:00; 43 seats; opened 29 April 2001; official taithai.jp. Shop's description: certified by the Thai Ministry of Commerce; Thai chefs; over 100 dishes; som tam pu pla ra; caters for vegetarian and halal diners too; weekday courses with all-you-can-drink. 2026 reviews (July–October): poo pad pong curry (rich crab flavour); jasmine rice; glass-noodle salad (spicy); coconut mango ice cream; khao man gai ¥1,280 (Isan-style house sauce); gai pad med mamuang; stir-fried water spinach ¥1,380; pad see ew; tom yum goong ¥1,680; laksa; pad thai lunch ¥1,100 (with spring roll, chicken, salad, soup); coriander only on request; Japanese menu with photos; warm desserts; sticky-rice sweets.

食べログ: タコたこ、たこ焼き、大阪市淀川区宮原2-13-14、東三国駅から12.en: Tabelog: Tako Tako; takoyaki; 2-13-14 Miyahara, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 124 m from Higashi-Mikuni Station; daily 11:00–23:00; no cards or e-money, QR accepted; 9 counter seats; non-smoking; takeaway. Reviews (2018 to 2026): right by the south exit of Higashi-Mikuni Station; on the side road of Shin-Midosuji; about 30 years old (some say over 40); small takoyaki, crisp outside and soft inside, 10 for ¥700; a thin, light line of mayonnaise; extra bonito flakes on request; shiso-yaki; shiroyaki; akashiyaki (takes time); grilled squid ¥300 (two for ¥500); Kaku highball ¥550; a takeaway line in the evening; celebrity signatures on the wall; a shop aiko went to before debuting; the owner sweating over the griddle.

食べログ: タコタコキング 本店のちょっと西店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-8-28.en: Tabelog: TAKOTAKO KING Honten no Chotto Nishi Ten, 1F, 2-8-28 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 18:00–3:00 next morning; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; smoking allowed; 20 seats; takeaway; official site. Reviews (August–October 2026): teppan tables on the 2nd floor; a toy train; an octopus-shaped smoke machine; salt-garlic takoyaki; sauce; fried takoyaki (salt, shoyu, sauce); 2 each of 4 kinds; a set of 16; cheese tororo-yaki; Chinese-yam special; mixed-seafood special; modan-yaki; grilled squid legs; dried-squid tempura; extra-large kara-age; cheese corn; king oyster butter; honey cream cheese; omurice; lively even at 1 a.m.; one says in October a new staff member couldn't get the teppan hot.

食べログ: ダイニングバー・イタリアン・バル、中京区河原町三条上ル下丸屋町406.en: Tabelog: dining bar, Italian, bar; 中京区河原町三条上ル下丸屋町406 グリントランドビル B1F; 1 min on foot from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn; daily 17:00–2:00 (food last order 23:00, drinks 1:59); closed only on 1 January; reservations accepted; ¥330 (service and charge field); 32 seats (8 at the counter, 10 at tables, 14 on sofas); smoking allowed; Wi-Fi; cards accepted; a shop expressing the charm of the good old days in space, service and drinks; omurice recommended; seasonal fruit cocktails; old bottles; vintage glasses; 'Uchoten Kazoku'; vegetarian options. Reviews (July 2025–October 2026, in English): a sacred place for Tomihiko Morimi fans; Gisei Denki Bran, Akadama, Benten; a message book; a signed card; postcards; martinis; smoked duck; anchovy-butter canapés; weak signal underground.

食べログ: ダイニングバー・ビアガーデン・肉料理、東山区西之町216-2 大西ビ.en: Tabelog: dining bar, beer garden, meat dishes; 東山区西之町216-2 大西ビル 4F B; 3 min walk from Keihan Sanjo Stn, 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn; Mon–Sat 12:00–16:00 and 16:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00), Sun and holidays 12:00–16:00 and 16:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); summer 16:00–24:00, winter 16:00–22:00; closed irregularly; bookings via TableCheck or phone (same day by phone only); rooftop terrace seat charge ¥500 a head (except course bookings); 13 seats (5 counter, 2 tables); designated smoking area; cards, e-money and QR; opened 26 February 2018; menu (English version, updated September 2026): rooftop beer garden, Halloween BBQ course ¥5,500, Happy Roast Beef ¥1,400, chicken-wing gyoza ¥550, BIG sausages ¥900, kara-age ¥800, atsuage with Kujo green onion ¥550, potato salad ¥550, cheese omelette ¥880. Reviews (December 2024–August 2026, in English): NIKU bowl ¥1,950 (extra meat), Kyo Tamago hamburg ¥1,200, French toast ¥1,480, rooftop kotatsu and meat hot pot in winter, Afternoon Tea BBQ ¥5,500, a friendly owner.

食べログ: ダイニングバー・洋食・バー、中京区材木町183-1 先斗町三条下ル2.en: Tabelog: dining bar, yoshoku, bar; 中京区材木町183-1 先斗町三条下ル2番西側 先斗町92ビル 3F; 5 min on foot from Sanjo Stn (Keihan); Tue 17:30–24:00; Wed–Sat and holidays 12:00–15:00 and 17:30–24:00; Sun 12:00–15:00 and 17:30–1:00; closed Monday; reservations accepted; 3.25% fee for e-money; 24 seats (8 at the counter, 12 at tables); cards, e-money and QR accepted. Reviews (August 2025–October 2026, in English): run by a married couple, about 35 years, lunch course ¥1,890–3,000 (three appetisers, quiche, ratatouille, soup, salad, hamburg steak, steak, chicken sauté), about ten dishes at dinner with beef tongue stew +¥500, yuba-wrapped shrimp cream croquettes, craft beer, flavoured coffee, a remark that the husband's service was unfriendly (October 2025).

食べログ: ダンケ 心斎橋、喫茶店・カフェ・洋菓子、心斎橋筋1-2-22 2F、.en: Tabelog: Danke Shinsaibashi; kissaten, cafe, Western sweets; Shinsaibashisuji 1-2-22, 2F; 11:30–23:30 (L.O. 23:00, from 1 November 2021); closed only on New Year's Day; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 35 seats (6 at the counter, 29 at tables); counter seats non-smoking; children welcome; takeaway available; opened 1 November 2010; Kissaten Tabelog 100 in 2022 and 2026. Tabelog matome (July 2026): on the second floor of a building along Unagidani-higashi-dori, 2 min from Shinsaibashi station; a heavy wooden door; Butter Blend Coffee made by a unique blending method in which butter soaks into the beans during roasting; brewed carefully to order; the cake set is popular; cash only. Reviews (September–October 2026): Butter Blend Coffee ¥700; Strong and Schwarz use two to three times the beans; paper drip, one cup at a time; a counter of a single slab of 200-year-old Yoshino cedar; Wedgwood and Okura cups; you can choose your cup; chiffon cake ¥950; cheesecake set ¥1,400; a cheesecake from feu in Ashiya; a pork shabu-shabu sandwich; fig and strained-yogurt toast; e-cigarette seats at the back; open late; many overseas customers.

食べログ: チキン南蛮専門店 なみ一セヴン、大阪市中央区難波千日前7-4、なんば.en: Tabelog: Chicken Nanban Senmon Ten Namiichi Seven, 7-4 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 278 m from Namba Station; Mon, Tue and Fri 10:30–15:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 10:30–17:00; closed Wednesdays and Thursdays; online reservations; no cards; e-money and QR accepted; 16 seats. Reviews (May–September 2026): a chicken-nanban-only shop in Ura-Namba; ¥1,700; 3 sauces, sweet vinegar, lemon basil and mala; 2 sauces with the large (+¥600); free refills of clay-pot rice, black-pepper pasta, pickles and tartare; miso soup and salad; ¥100 off for following on Instagram; served in about 5 minutes; sometimes a wait at Sunday lunch; run by two people; it used to be about ¥1,000.

食べログ: チャイニーズ食堂菜々、飲茶・点心・餃子・ラーメン、大阪市福島区福島6.en: Tabelog: Chinese Shokudo Nana, dim sum, dumplings and ramen, 6-17-6 Fukushima 1F, Fukushima-ku, Osaka; 6 min on foot from JR Osaka Station, 7 min from JR Fukushima Station; daily 11:30–14:00 and 17:00 to about 24:00 (last order 22:30); closed one or two days a month, not fixed; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money or QR; 26 seats (counter and tables); smoking allowed; BYO allowed; takeout; sports viewing. Reviews (December 2025–September 2026): mapo tofu set ¥1,000 (large rice, no refills, egg soup, salad); a daily set of dan dan noodles, half fried rice and almond jelly ¥1,000; chilled dan dan noodles and fried rice; a mapo ramen set; mild heat but plenty of Sichuan pepper; liver with garlic chives; shelves of manga; the sound of the wok; opposite the Daiwa Roynet Hotel; the owner cooking alone; busy at lunch, perhaps because smoking is allowed.

食べログ: チョウシ屋、銀座3-11-6、東銀座駅A7出口から徒歩2分、テイクア.en: Tabelog: Choshiya, Ginza 3-11-6, 2 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station exit A7; takeaway only; Tue–Fri 11:00–14:00, 16:00–18:00, closes when sold out; closed Sat, Sun, Mon and holidays. TV Tokyo (2022): a butcher founded in Showa 2; freshly fried croquettes. Zatsuneta: a butcher set up in 1927 by 阿部清六, a cook at the yōshoku restaurant "長楽軒". 2026 reviews: in the lane behind "Ginza Haru-chan Ramen"; croquette, ham cutlet or cutlet in a koppe bun or sliced bread; croquette bun and ham-cutlet bun ¥430 each; croquette alone ¥270; extra sauce made after you order; cut in half on request.

食べログ: ツケメン ロッキー、大阪市中央区谷町1-3-19、天満橋から126m.en: Tabelog: Tsukemen Rocky, 1-3-19 Tanimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 126 m from Tenmabashi; daily 11:00–21:00; no cards or e-money; QR (PayPay, Rakuten Pay) accepted; opened 11 February 2022. Reviews (August–October 2026): a rich seafood-tonkotsu dipping soup; chashu in the dipping soup too; thick chewy noodles; tsukemen ¥1,000; chashu ¥350 (grilled and cut thick); large ¥100 (formerly free); special tsukemen (2 slices chashu, 2 sheets nori, seasoned egg); spicy tsukemen (Kara); leek topping; yuzu shichimi on the table; soup-wari; ticket machine; tell staff for PayPay; two say the dipping soup cools quickly; a sister shop exists; one says for tsukemen in Tenmabashi, it's this one; one likens it to Ramen Jet.

食べログ: テンダーロイン(TENDERLOIN)、銀座8-10-8 銀座8丁目.en: Tabelog: TENDERLOIN, Ginza 8-10-8, Ginza 8-chome 10-ban Building B1F, opposite Don Quijote, 3 minutes from Shinbashi Station; 28 seats; weekdays 11:30–16:00, 18:00–6:00, weekends and holidays 11:30–16:00, 16:00–23:00; opened November 11, 2023; official site tenderloin.j-silver.co.jp. October 2026 reviews: 1-pound (450 g) steak ¥2,200 (served in three pieces, medium rare, onion sauce); 400 g hamburg steak with rice ¥2,200; ribeye; chicken; toppings; the wagyu steak is tender; small sides; the large rice is small; open until 6 a.m.

食べログ: ディッシュカリー＆レリッシュ、大阪市中央区南船場1-6-16、火〜土.en: Tabelog: Dish curry & relish, 1-6-16 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Tue–Sat 11:30–16:00 and 16:30–21:00 (until sold out); closed Sundays and Mondays; events and temporary closures; no cards, e-money or QR; 7 seats. Reviews (January–July 2026): a one-person counter; open from lunch to evening; 3-curry platter ¥1,500 (fried egg and 3 pickles); dry keema (numbing like Sichuan pepper); squid legs and basil; potato curry; dry keema curry with turmeric rice; burnt-garlic chicken; menu changes weekly (Instagram); well-balanced spices.

食べログ: デリチュース エキマルシェ新大阪店、ケーキ・洋菓子、大阪市淀川区西中.en: Tabelog: Delicious, Ekimarche Shin-Osaka shop; cakes, Western sweets; Ekimarche Shin-Osaka, 西中島5-16-1, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; daily 9:00–21:30; take-away; cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 14 December 2017. Reviews (2019 to October 2026): inside the ticket gates of Shin-Osaka Station; a temporary shop near platforms 3 and 4 during the Ekimarche renovation, reopened July 2026; the signature cheesecake 'Delicious', between rare and baked, with Brie de Meaux, lemon, apricot jam and a cookie base; a cut ¥520–550; whole cakes sometimes sold out by midday at weekends; September's limited apple soufflé cheesecake; cream puffs, roll cakes, financiers, madeleines; spoons ¥10; ice packs free for up to two hours; a whole cake keeps three days; the main shop in Minoh.
