食べログ: トラットリア チェーロ、イタリアン・牛料理・パスタ、イタリアン WE.en: Tabelog: Trattoria Cielo, Italian, beef dishes and pasta, Tabelog Italian WEST 100 2021, 2023 and 2025, 6-3-13 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 7 min from JR Shin-Osaka Station, 8 min from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; Wed–Sun 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–21:30; closed Monday and Tuesday; no lunch reservations; dinner reservations (100% charge for same-day group cancellations); takeout; cards and e-money accepted; ¥300 charge at night; 89 seats; terrace; private room for 20–30; non-smoking (smoking allowed on the terrace); children at lunch only, elementary school and up; no sandals, running shirts, tank tops or shorts. Reviews (September–October 2026): a southern Italian trattoria; lunch ¥1,300 with appetisers (a platter of about nine items with the day's soup, among others) and one of six mains (pasta, gratin, risotto), bread, three desserts and a drink; large ¥200; a line before opening but quick turnover; okra and tuna with anchovy butter; tuna and cauliflower in anchovy oil; gratin of spicy tomato, minced meat and broccoli; at night crostini with smoked egg yolk and black truffle, marinated clams, rigatoni with autumn eggplant and gorgonzola, spaghetti with sanma and fresh tomato; house wine by the decanter; white wine ¥550.

食べログ: トラットリア ドン ジョヴァンニ、イタリアン・ヨーロッパ料理・洋食、.en: Tabelog: Trattoria Don Giovanni, Italian, European, yoshoku; 第43東京ビル 3F, Yotsuya 1-7-27, on Shinmichi-dōri; 2 min walk from Yotsuya Station; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:30, closed Sundays; 20 seats (counter, sofas); private hire possible; non-smoking; opened 1 April 2014; run by a chef who trained at Michelin-starred restaurants in Italy and famous restaurants in Tokyo. Reviews (August 2025–October 2026): one-plate lunch ¥1,000 (appetizer, salad, bread, the day's thin pasta, main); large pasta +¥200; coffee or tea +¥100; lunch course ¥1,500 (blue crab in tomato cream, tiramisu); stairs up to the third floor; many solo diners; busy on weekdays.

食べログ: トラットリア バール ジョルノ、大阪市西区北堀江1-16-17 アメ.en: Tabelog: Trattoria Bar Giorno, Amenity Kita-Horie 1F, 1-16-17 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; about 2 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station, about 4 from Yotsubashi; dinner Tue–Sun 17:30–22:00 (quiet around 18:00); lunch Wed, Thu and Sun 12:00–13:30 (until sold out); closed Mondays (sometimes open on holidays); coperto ¥330 at night (Italian salami, grissini, nuts; not for courses); cards and PayPay accepted; 20 seats (counter 12, tables 8). Reviews (March–September 2026): about 17 years since opening; a calm, grown-up trattoria; detailed notices on the tables and menu; a minimum order per person at night; dishes slow when busy; careful pasta; wine chosen with the staff (bottles from about ¥4,000); fresh-fish carpaccio; ajillo; gratin; motsu nikomi; steamed vegetables; seafood pasta; steak; duck; Sangen pork; Ibérico pork (not every day); courses from ¥6,000; lunch pasta ¥1,300–1,600 with salad, baguette and Italian omelette (anchovy, potato and broccoli in oil sauce; tagliatelle of Mizuho pork belly and Brussels sprouts in tomato sauce).

食べログ: トラットリア・バッフォ、銀座3-12-5 B1F、東銀座駅から徒歩3.en: Tabelog: Trattoria Baffo, Ginza 3-12-5 B1F, 3 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station; 36 seats; Tue–Sun 11:30–14:00, 17:30–21:30, closed Mon; cards accepted (VISA, JCB, AMEX), no e-money or QR; separate smoking area; particular about fish; official site baffo-96.com. 2026 reviews: the famous sea-bream collar (smoky aroma and salt); pizza as thin as a gyoza wrapper (caviar and porcini; white fish and arugula); salmon and conger-eel mille-feuille; several complimentary breads; baba; peach compote; attentive service; hard to book; the all-you-can-drink is beer and wine only, and soft drinks may be brought in; ¥6,000–15,000.

食べログ: トラノコ (TORANOKO)、カフェ・プリン、三栄町6-14 寿ビ.en: Tabelog: TORANOKO, café, pudding; 寿ビル 1F, Sanei-cho 6-14; 7 min walk from Yotsuya-sanchome Station, 10 min from Yotsuya Station; daily 10:30–18:00; closing days not fixed; weekday reservations only (weekends and holidays only when first on the waiting list); one drink per person, 90 minutes; 10 seats (a counter of 6, two tables for two); non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; takeaway; opened 22 October 2017. Reviews (January 2025–October 2026): a large direct-fire roaster in the shop, sacks of green beans, choose by smelling beans after saying what you like, hot coffee of the day ¥590, iced café latte ¥730, Toranoko Blend 200 g ¥1,980, the firm, not-too-sweet 'Tamago Tappurin', Basque cheesecake, a cheerful owner, regulars at the counter.

食べログ: トレボン、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-9-5 日宝三津寺ビル1F、毎日1.en: Tabelog: Trebon, Nippo Mitsudera Bldg 1F, 2-9-5 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 17:00–23:00; no cards, e-money or QR; 10 seats; smoking allowed; counter. Reviews (January–September 2026): a favourite in Amemura; heart; cartilage; grilled lettuce; tonpei-yaki; grilled squid legs; tofu; pickles; booked 2 seats by phone for a second stop; a friendly owner; the teppan right in front; heart ¥500; leek modan ¥1,400; pork and egg ¥1,000; yakisoba ¥1,000; no reservations, got in only 2 times out of 5; staff recommend the heart; a long-established teppanyaki; counter only; lively even at 18:00 on a weekday; popular with locals; yakisoba with aonori and red pickled ginger; grilled meat with plenty of leek; the smell of sauce clings to clothes; first time in 10 years; no reservations, cash only, irregular closing days; phone to check; magic seasoning; Moroccan green beans; konnyaku with ponzu; the grilled lettuce strongly seasoned; cartilage and skin with salt; cabbage tonpei-yaki; off-menu kasu and cabbage stir-fry; tofu; Chinese yam; okonomiyaki; 17:00–22:00.

食べログ: トロワフレーシュ、銀座8-2-8 銀座高本ビル2F(ホテル ザ セレ.en: Tabelog: TROIS FLÈCHES, Ginza 8-2-8, Ginza 高本 Building 2F (at the end of the lane beside Hotel The Celestine Ginza), 4 minutes from Shinbashi Station; 18 seats; Mon–Sat 17:00–22:00, closed Sundays and holidays; opened July 25, 2011; cards and d-barai accepted; ¥30,000–40,000. 2026 reviews: a wide range of daily starters (raw oysters, bonito, ayu, abalone, porcini, milt, turnip); oven-roasted steak where you choose cut and grams (fillet, sirloin, striploin, rump cap, aged heifer); egg-yolk sauce; pudding; fig brûlée; non-alcoholic sparkling; for business entertaining; regulars of 18 and 8 visits; ¥30,000–80,000.

食べログ: トントン拍子、お好み焼き、大阪市淀川区西宮原1-5-6、新大阪駅から.en: Tabelog: Tonton Byoshi, okonomiyaki, 西宮原 1-5-6, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, 559 m from Shin-Osaka Station; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–22:30, closed Sat and Sun; no reservations; no cards; e-money accepted; no QR payment; 20 seats; designated smoking area. Reviews (January 2024 to October 2026): a long-established okonomiyaki house; at lunch only the daily set, ¥950 (from April 2026; ¥900 from April 2025, ¥800 before), with salad, rice, miso soup, two small side dishes and yogurt; a yakisoba lunch ¥1,000 (about 15 minutes); pork belly, teriyaki hamburg steak, roast pork cutlet with a soft fried egg, tonpei-yaki, kara-age, white-sauce omurice, Tianjin rice; older women run lunch; shared tables; at night fluffy okonomiyaki, pork okonomiyaki, egg fried rice; on a Friday night the tables were all reserved.

食べログ: ドイツ居酒屋 JSレネップ(ジェーエスレネップ)、千代田区有楽町2-.en: Tabelog: German izakaya JS Renep, Yurakucho 2-1-8, Chiyoda-ku, under the JR tracks on the Bic Camera side, 2 minutes from Yurakucho, Ginza and Hibiya stations; 90 seats (tables only); Mon 16:00–22:30, Tue–Thu until 23:15, Fri and days before holidays until 23:30, Sat 12:00–23:00, Sundays and holidays 12:00–22:30 (closing times vary). Shop introduction: long-established German food; DLG gold-medal ham and sausages; beer-braised dishes and Eisbein; five German draft beers; courses and à la carte. October 2026 reviews: Weizen and dark beer; German potatoes; sausages; German bread; Bitburger; ceramic steins; white and herb sausages with Schweinshaxe; marinated sardines; starter platter; a welcome-party course.

食べログ: ニューベイブ 難波店、大阪市浪速区難波中1-14-12、なんば駅から.en: Tabelog: New Babe Namba, 1-14-12 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Namba Station; Mon–Thu 11:00–20:00 (L.O. 19:30), Fri–Sun and holidays 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); no service charge; cards, transit IC, e-money and QR accepted; 18 seats. Reviews (June 2025 – October 2026): thick, tender tonkatsu; loin set meal ¥2,800 (over 2 cm); fillet (regular) ¥3,200; extra fillet ¥1,000; half set meals; Dream Assorted Set Meal of tonkatsu and garlicky pork ginger-yaki; rice in a wooden ohitsu; refills of rice, cabbage and pork miso soup; a range of sauces and condiments; katsu sandwich; up to an hour's wait at lunch; book on Tabelog; staff explain kindly; one found prices a little high; one had hygiene concerns such as glove use at the counter (October 2026).

食べログ: ニューヨークのラーメン屋 アメリカ村本店、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-7.en: Tabelog: New York no Ramen-ya America-mura main shop, 1-7-2 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6243-0666; no reservations; Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–23:00, Sat–Sun 11:30–23:00; cards, e-money (transit IC, iD) and QR (PayPay) accepted; 12 seats; opened 19 November 2024. 2026 reviews (April–June): 'suppin ramen', a plain base to which you add the toppings you like, over a trillion combinations; once still locked past opening time; Ari Red; soft-boiled egg and rare chashu; sukiyaki ramen (sweet-sour, rich tonkotsu); cheese chashu rice bowl; the standard double chashu (block and thin-sliced chashu, boiled egg, rich creamy soup); one found it slightly salty; chewy noodles; suppin ¥550; fried scallops ¥280; rare chashu ¥100; red New York-style interior.

食べログ: ヌガ(Le Nougat)、銀座6-12-2 東京銀座ビル1F、東銀.en: Tabelog: Le Nougat, Ginza 6-12-2, Tokyo Ginza Building 1F, 3 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station exit A1; 44 seats; weekdays 17:30–24:00, Sat 12:00–16:00, 17:00–24:00, Sundays and holidays 12:00–16:00, 17:00–23:00; open every day except New Year; 10% service charge; cards and PayPay accepted; opened January 15, 2008; live music. October 2026 reviews: antique-style, like a Paris street corner; high ceilings and an elephant ornament on 2F; many foreign customers; queue from before 17:00, full in 30 minutes; à la carte; blackboard specials (carrot râpée, mushroom and watercress salad, horse-meat tartare, cassoulet (a full one serves 4), rabbit saddle with mustard sauce, herb omurice with Okukuji eggs, even venison and bear); bouillabaisse; sautéed Spanish mackerel; 24-month-aged prosciutto; salade niçoise; Ezo-venison loin in pastry; hearty portions; also described as a Michelin Bib Gourmand.

食べログ: ヌードルヤ MEーCHAーKUーCHA、大阪市西区新町3-9-9、西.en: Tabelog: Noodleya ME-CHA-KU-CHA, 3-9-9 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; about 8 min from Nishi-Nagahori Station; Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00; closed Sundays and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 counter seats. Reviews (April 2025 – September 2026): run single-handed; tom yum noodles ¥990 (creamy, sour and spicy, lots of coriander, straight noodles); porcini salt ramen; tantanmen; sudachi shoyu ramen; tsukemen; daily rice dishes (chicken teriyaki bowl, chashu bowl, green curry); one says no chemical seasonings; the ticket machine takes coins and old ¥1,000 notes; drinks offered to those queuing; sometimes closes without notice.

食べログ: ハンバーグ・洋食・弁当、中京区両替町夷川通室町東入ル巴町80 パルマ.en: Tabelog: hamburg steak, yoshoku, bento; 両替町夷川通室町東入ル巴町80, Nakagyo-ku, パルマビル 1F; 3 min walk from Marutamachi Stn; lunch 11:30–14:00, dinner 17:00–20:30; closed Monday and the third Tuesday; no reservations; 20 seats (2 counter, 18 table); non-smoking; cards, QUICPay and PayPay; Yoshoku WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews (August–October 2026, in English): tongue-stew hamburg steak ¥2,200; teppan hamburg steak M 200 g ¥1,500; the Ultimate Set Meal (three kinds of beef tongue); fried shrimp; omurice; ketchup spaghetti; queues of 10–16 at lunch; ordering by QR code in the queue; a report that the demi-glace changed; featured on TV and in a manga.

食べログ: ハードロマンチッカー、大阪市中央区難波1-7-15 江戸安ビル1F、.en: Tabelog: Hard Romanticker, Edoyasu Bldg 1F, 1-7-15 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from the Namba stations; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 18:00–2:00 next morning (L.O. 1:30); closed Wednesdays (may vary); no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 20 seats; heated-tobacco-only smoking area; Tachinomi Hyakumeiten 2025; opened 9 December 2024; official page (peraichi). Reviews (August–October 2026): a sister shop of Oishi Stand; about 8 at the counter and 3 tables; small dishes and fried food; rare Ezo venison steak; a hamburger limited to 3 a day; good value; cream cheese (faintly sweet, with crackers); just off Midosuji near Namba HIPS; no sign, so Instagram says 'please find us'; full inside, regulars made room; ume sour; Shine Muscat and prosciutto shira-ae; komatsuna ohitashi; house-made satsuma-age (cheese, corn, edamame; fried to order); many women diners; orange wine; blue cheese.

食べログ: バッファローマン、ステーキ、大阪市東淀川区東中島1-11-7、JR.en: Tabelog: Buffalo Man; steak; 1-11-7 Higashinakajima, Higashiyodogawa-ku, Osaka; 4 minutes on foot from the east exit of JR Shin-Osaka Station; Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat and Sun 19:00–22:00 (food last order 21:30); closed Monday and Thursday; reservations accepted; cash only; 11 seats; opened 11 December 2011. Reviews (2019 to 2026): a residential street; a counter and a table at the back; steak grilled and sliced, on a hot stone plate over bean sprouts and cabbage; sweet sauce, ponzu and rock salt; free rice refills; the Buffalo Man regular steak ¥2,100 (about 200 g, a July 2026 diner guessed); the large about 280–300 g; double steak rice set ¥4,100; rice and miso soup ¥400; green onion natto; nearly full on a weekday night; a review recommending it to anyone missing American steakhouses.

食べログ: バラの木、洋食、大阪市淀川区東三国4-16-15 クイーンハイツ、東.en: Tabelog: Bara no Ki; yoshoku; 4-16-15 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 130 m from Higashi-Mikuni Station; Mon–Sat 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–22:00; closed Sunday; cash only at lunch; cards and e-money accepted; 20 seats; non-smoking. Reviews (October 2023 to September 2026): reopened in July 2024 after a closure and renovation; the Bara no Ki lunch of a small hamburg steak and fried shrimp ¥1,000; tonkatsu lunch with demi-glace; ginger pork; katsu curry; fillet cutlet lunch; Neapolitan; large rice free; self-service miso soup with free refills; in the evening an appetizer trio ¥800, fries, Sanriku fried oysters ¥1,000, shrimp and shirasu ajillo ¥900, Iwate pork sausages, garlic toast, prosciutto, Kagoshima chicken kara-age rice set ¥1,200, Peroni, Kaku highball; modest portions; quiet background music.

食べログ: バル DAKEジャナイ中華 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-14-.en: Tabelog: Bar DAKE Janai Chuka Shinsaibashi, Kawamura Bldg 1F, 1-14-21 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 050-5590-3436; reservations accepted (courses by the day before); Mon–Sat 16:00–2:00 next morning (L.O. 1:00); closed Sundays and holidays; cards and QR (PayPay, d-barai, au PAY) accepted, no e-money; 28 seats (including terrace); opened 11 November 2022. 2025–2026 reviews: you choose your own table-charge starter; quick turnover, easy to get in without booking; fluffy freshly steamed shumai; mapo tofu; generous fried rice; gyoza; shrimp mayo; found while looking for somewhere to smoke; friendly staff who use first names even on first meeting; events; a creative-Chinese bar; a casual atmosphere; the light dishes taste good even at the end of a bar crawl.

食べログ: バル・イタリアン・ビアバー、中京区柳馬場六角下ル井筒屋町400-1.en: Tabelog: bar, Italian, beer bar; 中京区柳馬場六角下ル井筒屋町400-1 プラネシア六角柳馬場 3F; 5 min on foot from Karasuma Oike Stn; daily 17:00–24:00 (food last order 23:00, drinks 23:30); irregular closures; reservations accepted; courses with all-you-can-drink (e.g. 9 dishes + 120 min for ¥4,400); no service or table charge; 44 seats (8 at the counter, 36 at tables); private hire for 20 to 50+; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; about 120 Belgian beers; mussels steamed in white wine, beef-cheek carbonnade, waterzooi. Reviews (August 2025–September 2026, in English): banquet courses; mussels (also as pasta or risotto); ajillo, Bismarck pizza, carbonara, thick-cut fries; Czech and German beers too; a steep stair up to the 3rd floor; one guest found the tables cramped (September 2026).

食べログ: バル・居酒屋・イタリアン、下京区綾小路通富小路西入ル塩屋町66、毎日.en: Tabelog: bar, izakaya, Italian; Ayanokoji-dori Tominokoji-nishi-iru, Shimogyo-ku; every day 17:00–2:00 (last order food 1:00, drinks 1:30); closed irregularly; bookings taken; 35 seats (tables and counter); private hire for 20–50; no smoking; children welcome; vegetarian options; cards (VISA, Master, AMEX, UnionPay) and PayPay. Reviews (May–October 2026, in English): raw oysters (several regions, with ikura and uni or meat and uni); grilled oysters; fried oysters (shibazuke tartar); oyster tempura; oyster carbonara; shrimp ajillo; rare salmon katsu; soft-shell crab tomato-cream pasta; tequila bell; about ¥4,500; loud music some nights.

食べログ: バル＆タパス セロナ、千代田区有楽町1-1-2 東京ミッドタウン日比.en: Tabelog: Bar & Tapas Celona, Yurakucho 1-1-2, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo Midtown Hibiya B1F HIBIYA FOOD HALL, directly connected to Hibiya Station, 5 minutes from Ginza Station; 38 seats; Mon–Thu and weekends 11:00–22:30, Fri 11:00–23:00; closed when the complex is; cards, IC and QR accepted; opened March 29, 2018; official create-restaurants.co.jp. 2026 reviews: "senbero" set ¥1,000 (one drink of sparkling, red or white wine or a highball, plus two chef's-choice pinchos); eggplant picadillo; jamón with carrot râpée; vegetables and cheese; duck pinchos; toasted baguette; wine by the glass ¥390; no otoshi or charge; mostly self-service; easy to visit alone.

食べログ: バンカレッラ ジョイア、京橋3-3-12 山京ビル2F(1階は油そば.en: Tabelog: Bancarella Gioia, Kyobashi 3-3-12, 山京 Building 2F (abura soba on 1F); 24 seats (6 counter, 18 table); lunch weekdays 11:00–14:00; dinner Tue–Thu 17:00–22:30, Fri until 23:00, Sat and holidays 17:00–22:00; closed Sun; opened March 14, 2011. 2026 reviews: lunch is only a stewed-hamburg-steak plate; five-starter platter; sausages; crisp-skinned chicken; roast onion; trippa; potato and anchovy gratin; thick-cut Spanish-mackerel carpaccio; pasta; generous pours of wine; friendly staff; booking recommended; the toilet is outside on an upper floor; no basket for bags at the wall seats.

食べログ: バール・エ・リストランテ・タブリエ、銀座3-3-6 銀座モリタビル6.en: Tabelog: Bar Le e Ristorante Tablier, Ginza 3-3-6, Ginza Morita Building 6F, 2 minutes from Ginza Station exit A9 and Ginza-itchome Station exit 5; 30 seats (26 table, 4 counter); a private room for 4 (10% room charge) and semi-private window seats; weekdays 11:30–15:00, 17:30–22:30, Sat and holidays 12:00–15:30, 17:30–22:00, closed Sun; coperto ¥550; ratings and reviews reset because of a move. Shop introduction: grill and Italian; A5 Yamagata beef; snow-crab pasta; black-truffle carbonara; porcini; grilled angel shrimp and lamb; vegetable bagna cauda; wine by the glass from ¥850. September 2026 reviews: a ¥5,000 course limited to three groups a day (a sparkling toast, caviar carpaccio, snow crab in tomato cream, porcini and prosciutto peperoncino, grilled Yamagata beef); allergies checked when booking; lunch course about ¥4,000; uni pasta.

食べログ: バー・ダイニングバー・イタリアン、中京区木屋町通 ヨシキビル1F、阪.en: Tabelog: bar, dining bar, Italian; 中京区木屋町通 ヨシキビル 1F; 3 min on foot from Kawaramachi Stn (Hankyu); 18:00–3:00 the next morning; closed Wednesday; reservations accepted; can be hired for up to 20; a ¥500 a person charge; 19 seats (11 at the counter, 8 at tables); heated tobacco only; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; English menu; opened 7 July 2006. Shop text: mixology with fresh fruit, liquid nitrogen, espuma and smoke machines. Reviews (May 2023–July 2026, in English): melon mojito, kiwi, pear, mascarpone, a liquid-nitrogen mojito, chocolate mint, smoked cocktails, cocktails made to your taste, about ¥1,000–2,000 a glass, strong but can be made lighter, a sofa at the back, easy-to-talk-to bartenders.

食べログ: バー・日本酒バー・ダイニングバー、中京区木屋町三条下ル石屋町122-.en: Tabelog: bar, sake bar, dining bar; 122-4, Kiyamachi south of Sanjo, Nakagyo Ward; about 3 min walk from Sanjo Stn; Mon–Fri 18:00–1:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 16:00–1:00 (L.O. 0:30); closed irregularly; reservations accepted; 14 seats (6 at the counter, 8 at tables); ¥1,000 charge per person; non-smoking (ashtray at the entrance); cards and e-money accepted; near the Pontocho Kaburenjo; 60–70 sakes at all times (chilled, warmed, nigori, sparkling, aged); local sake from Kyoto, Shiga and around Japan. Reviews (August 2023–August 2026, English): Kyoto and Shiga three-sake tasting ¥2,000; grilled heshiko ¥800; oden; clams steamed in sake; soba to finish; the master chooses to your taste; one says it had been open 11 years (2023).

食べログ: パシオン・エ・ナチュール アルデ新大阪駅店、ダイニングバー・ワインバ.en: Tabelog: Passion et Nature Arde Shin-Osaka Eki Ten, dining bar, wine bar and Italian, Alde Shin-Osaka, 5-16-1 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; right by the subway Shin-Osaka middle gate (Exit 5); daily 10:30–22:30 (last order food 21:30, drinks 22:00); closed when the facility closes; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 34 seats; sofa seats; non-smoking; children welcome (a wine-led shop); sommelier; English menu. Shop site: an Italian bar of natural wine and meat; about 250 natural wines, all genuine ("honmamon") ones the staff chose after visiting the makers; shoulder-loin steak, margherita, appetiser platter, the beef-cutlet sandwich is a must, fresh salads, various lunches, takeout. Reviews (August–October 2026): a small shop at the far end of Alde; Japanese wines too; appetiser platter, carpaccio, cheese penne, risotto, pizza, pasta, outside skirt; lunch until 16:30 but may end early when sold out; the "Passion A" mixed lunch (hamburg steak, fried shrimp, rice) ¥1,330; beef cutlet and fried shrimp; hamburg steak and steak; hamburg steak, fried shrimp, corn cream croquette and roast beef; fully booked in the evening; a quick stop before the Shinkansen; some find it a little pricey.

食べログ: パティスリー らねっと、大阪市西区新町1-22-19、西大橋駅から徒.en: Tabelog: Patisserie RAINETTE, 1-22-19 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 4 min on foot from Nishi-Ohashi Stn; Mon–Sat and holidays 10:30–18:00 (until sold out); closed Sunday; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money or QR; 13 seats; smoking area; takeout; opened 1 March 2007. Shop site (無添加スイーツ パティスリーらねっと, additive-free sweets): a café and cake shop in Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, open since 2007, with the motto of making sweets gentle on body and mind. The online store sells black-soybean kinako macarons (farm-direct egg whites, Hokkaido buttercream), cheese marble brownies (Australian cream cheese, Belgian chocolate), a dacquoise roll, caramel pound cake, four kinds of macaron (no colouring or preservatives), assorted baked goods and homemade orange jam. Business operator named in the legal notice: 湯川律子. Reviews (November 2023 – September 2026): a woman owner handles the cakes, café and lunch alone; fruit roll finished to order; cream puffs and pies filled with custard after ordering; apple pie; roll cake with fresh chocolate cream; lemon milk pudding; caramel cheesecake; strawberry tart; soufflé; gratin lunch ¥950 (May 2026); buckwheat-flour pizza ¥890 (June 2024); reasonable prices; cash only; a stop on the way back from the Orix Theater.

食べログ: パティスリー タツヒト サトイ、ケーキ・パン・カフェ、左京区北白川追.en: Tabelog: Patisserie TATSUHITO SATOI, cakes, bread, café; Eフラット北白川 1F, 北白川追分町2, Sakyo-ku; 15 min walk from Keihan Demachiyanagi Station; about 2 min walk east from the Kyoto University Faculty of Agriculture city bus stop; every day 8:00–17:00 (kakigori and parfaits 11:00–16:00); occasional temporary closures; no reservations; 9 seats; no cards or e-money, PayPay and au PAY accepted; non-smoking; opened 15 April 2016; the shop of Satoi, a staff member who supported Ajiki Yuji from the start; Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2023 and 2026. Reviews (August–October 2026, in English): Earl Grey mousse, peach tart ¥640, cheese tart, roll cake, curry bread, baguette, kakigori (pistachio-muscat, caramel mocha ¥1,300), iced latte ¥440, homemade lemonade, former sous-chef at Sweets Garden Yuji Ajiki in Yokohama.

食べログ: パパミラノ 東京国際フォーラム店、千代田区丸の内3-5-1 東京国際.en: Tabelog: Papa Milano Tokyo International Forum, Marunouchi 3-5-1, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo International Forum B1F; 60 seats; daily 11:00–22:00; operator Dynac (dynacjapan.com). 2026 reviews: green salad ¥748; ajillo of shrimp, king oyster mushroom and dried tomato (2 slices of baguette) ¥1,078; shrimp and avocado Genovese cream ¥1,628; half-and-half pizza ¥1,738; seafood doria; cold pasta with espuma; lasagna; fried chicken; Italian omelet; tomato spaghetti with eggplant and stracciatella; order by QR code (paper menus too); a queue before opening on performance days.

食べログ: パプリカ食堂 Vegan、大阪市西区新町1-9-9 アリビオ新町1F.en: Tabelog: Paprika Shokudo Vegan, Alivio Shinmachi 1F, 1-9-9 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka, 06-6599-9788; reservations accepted; 11:30–15:00 (food L.O. 14:00, drinks 14:30) and 17:30–21:30 (L.O. 21:00) except Wednesdays and irregular days (announced on Instagram); cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 41 seats (counter 2, hall 25, deck 14); no smoking; opened 17 February 2014; Instagram @paprika_vegan; natural food with organic vegetables; organic wine and smoothies. Reviews (December 2025 – August 2026): popular, so book; the most popular is the soy-meat karaage set meal (fried in good rapeseed oil, with house-made Japanese-style sauce, organic soy-milk mayo and organic sesame); organic salad; low-salt miso soup; pesticide-free brown rice; ordering by QR code; vegan-cheese hamburg steak; soy-meat cheese hamburg lunch plate; goods sold at the front; terrace seats; with a vegan friend; with a vegetarian friend from Australia after 10 years; many overseas diners.

食べログ: パン・サンドイッチ、中京区東洞院通三条下ル三文字町200 ミックナカ.en: Tabelog: bread, sandwiches; 東洞院通三条下ル三文字町200, Nakagyo-ku, ミックナカムラビル 1F; 305 m from Karasuma Oike Stn; Tuesday–Saturday 11:00–19:00; closed Sunday and Monday; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; Bread WEST Tabelog 100 2022, 2026. Reviews (August–October 2026): a cosy little shop near Rokkakudo; five-bean French bread ¥220 (¥216 in a September review); bacon and cheese French bread ¥240; reviews in English: croque monsieur ¥280, camembert cream ¥220, beef cutlet sandwich ¥370, French anpan ¥140; mostly savoury breads; a small shop full with 2–3 people; cheap.

食べログ: パン・サンドイッチ・ベーグル、上京区今出川通寺町西入大原口町212.en: Tabelog: bread, sandwiches, bagels; 上京区今出川通寺町西入大原口町212 カーサビアンカビル 1F; 5 min on foot from Imadegawa Stn, 8 min from Demachiyanagi Stn; 7:00–19:00; closed Tuesday; no reservations; takeaway only; no cards, e-money or QR; non-smoking; Bread WEST Tabelog 100 2026. Reviews (June 2025–October 2026, in English): Bacon Spice ¥324 (the best-seller), croissant ¥248, pain au chocolat ¥259, Furano melon-cream bun ¥216, butter roll ¥118, potato-butter French bread ¥248, pain aux fruits ¥669, hard breads, sesame baguette, much sold out by early afternoon, cash only, a red awning.

食べログ: パン・スイーツ・ベーグル、上京区河原町通荒神口下ル上生洲町229-1.en: Tabelog: bread, sweets, bagels; 河原町通荒神口下ル上生洲町229-1, Kamigyo-ku; about 10 min walk from Exit 1 of Jingu-Marutamachi Stn; Tuesday–Saturday 11:00–20:00; closed Sunday, Monday and August; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money or QR; Bread WEST Tabelog 100 2020, 2022, 2026. Reviews (April–November 2026, in English): the owner bakes alone in a wood-fired clay oven; walnut bread ¥90; raisin and orange bread ¥90; whole-wheat sesame chocolate bread ¥160; red-bean bun ¥220; Sunrise ¥250; chocolate croissant ¥250; orange croissant ¥250; loaves sliced to your preferred number; sells out early; a long break in August.

食べログ: パーラー３０５、ビストロ、ワインバー、日本橋富沢町2-1、人形町駅か.en: Tabelog: Parlor 305, bistro, wine bar; Nihonbashi-Tomizawacho 2-1, about 160 m from Ningyocho Station; Tue and Thu 17:00–23:00, Fri 18:00–23:00, Sun 12:00–22:00; closed Mon, Wed and Sat; reservations accepted; no cards; e-money and PayPay accepted; 20 seats; non-smoking; opened 1 September 2013; website parlour305.com (would not open on 2 November 2026). Reviews (April–October 2026): run by a female owner alone; formerly a clothing shop; counter on the first floor, tables up a spiral staircase; nostalgic Heisei decor such as Tamagotchi, and J-pop; bookings by Instagram DM; 3-hour limit; generous glasses of wine; prosciutto tartine, tripe braised with lemon, onion gratin soup, gratin, crème d'ange; some said the menu is small.

食べログ: ビアバー・パブ・バル、旧店名 BEER PUB ICHI-YA、中京.en: Tabelog: beer bar, pub, bar; former name BEER PUB ICHI-YA; 中京区御幸町通蛸薬師下る船屋町384 Casa INO's 1F; 3 min walk north from exit 9 of Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn; Mon, Wed, Thu, Fri 17:00–22:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–22:00; closed Tuesday (open on holiday Tuesdays); bookings taken (10 or more by phone); 43 seats; non-smoking (smoking area outside); cards, e-money and QR; English menu and English-speaking staff; vegetarian options; opened 8 August 2016; menu (English version, updated October 2026): olives ¥440, smoked nuts ¥440, sauerkraut ¥550, Kyoto yuba potato salad ¥660, caprese ¥1,210, baccalà croquettes ¥500, zeppole ¥500, black-soybean edamame ¥550, spare ribs stewed in Ichijoji beer ¥1,320, octopus in red wine ¥1,430, wagyu tagliata ¥1,800. Reviews (November 2025–October 2026, in English): Ichijoji Brewery craft beer; renovated in 2026 with an Italian menu; tasting set ¥2,500; panna cotta; some find the high chairs uncomfortable.

食べログ: ビストロ オザミ、銀座6-10-1 GINZA SIX 6F、銀座駅.en: Tabelog: Bistro Ozami, Ginza 6-10-1, GINZA SIX 6F, 2 minutes from Ginza Station exit A3; 40 seats; daily 11:00–23:00 (lunch L.O. 14:30; dinner from 17:00, L.O. 21:00, 20:30 on Sundays and holidays); open every day; book by 15:00 the day before; opened April 20, 2017; official site auxamis.com/bistro. Shop introduction: traditional bistro food from over 100 years in Paris; about 200 wines, mainly French, from a stock of 40,000 bottles; a Paris-bistro-style interior; events with free-flowing Champagne and pairing dinners. 2026 reviews: choose from a prix-fixe; mussels; jelly; meat; chocolate; the duck was the best; got in without booking at Saturday lunch; affordable for Ginza; some say long gaps between dishes stretched it to three hours.

食べログ: ビストロ ヴォージュ、銀座5-4-15 西五ビル7F(銀座6-4-1.en: Tabelog: Bistro Vosges, Ginza 5-4-15, 西五 Building 7F (moved from Ginza 6-4-16, Hanatsubaki Building 2F), 3 minutes from Ginza Station; 20 seats (4 counter); Mon–Sat 18:00–21:00, closed Sun; service charge. Reviews: a long-established bistro; the famous foie gras salad (a big piece of foie gras on bread); cod and milt risotto; mussels; tuna and avocado tartare; carpaccio; wagyu steak; a generous peperoncino; takeaway available; about ¥3,000 a dish and about ¥14,000 per person, which some find expensive.

食べログ: ビストロ・カシュカシュ、銀座8-6-19 渡辺ビル1F、新橋駅から3.en: Tabelog: Bistro Cache Cashe, Ginza 8-6-19, 渡辺 Building 1F, 310 m from Shinbashi Station; 14 seats (4 counter, five tables for 2); Mon 18:00–21:00, Tue–Fri 12:00–13:00, 18:00–21:00, Sat 18:00–20:00 (irregular), closed Sundays and holidays; table charge ¥500; opened August 18, 1998; cards accepted. 2026 reviews: a bistro in a lane off Shusse Kaido; regulars of 10+ years; cauliflower mousse, venison, truffle risotto, crab miso, uni and caviar pasta, braised beef; course ¥12,000; busy on weekday evenings, quiet on Saturdays.

食べログ: ビストロ・ステーキ、上京区伊勢屋町393-3 ポガンビル2F、神宮丸.en: Tabelog: bistro, steak; 上京区伊勢屋町393-3 ポガンビル 2F; 5 min on foot from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn, 1 min from the Kawaramachi Marutamachi bus stop; Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 18:00–23:00; Sat and holidays 17:00–23:00; last order 21:00; closed Wednesday and Sunday; reservations accepted; cash only; 10 seats (6 at tables, 4 at the counter); takeaway by reservation since March 2020; opened 20 February 2013; opened by Shigeno Makoto, formerly chef at the Roppongi wine bar Shozui. Reviews (April 2025–September 2026, in English): choose origin, cut and weight from the meat shown; about ¥3,000 per 100 g; cooked the French way and eaten with salt; fries; Yamagata Keisan black wagyu ribeye; burrata ¥2,700; duck confit ¥2,800; pâté ¥1,800; charcuterie salad; the chef speaks fluent French; steep stairs.

食べログ: ビストロ・フレンチ・ワインバー、下京区鍵屋町218 YUGEN Ky.en: Tabelog: bistro, French, wine bar; YUGEN Kyoto shijo 1F, Shimogyo Ward; about 6 min walk from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn; daily 7:30–10:30 (L.O. 10:00), 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:00, buffet until 14:30), 17:00–22:00 (L.O. food 21:00, drinks 22:00); reservations accepted (please don't phone on fully booked days); no birthday plates at lunch; ¥500 charge at dinner only; dinner courses require one drink; 50 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; cards, e-money and QR accepted; vegetarian options listed; French regional cooking and wine on the hotel's ground floor; chef with over 20 years' experience. Reviews (August–October 2026, English): lunch buffet with a choice of main (Bolognese, carbonara, crab tomato cream +¥300, steak, onion gratin soup); vegetable-led; Kyoto white miso; nama-fu dengaku; mussels; prosciutto; Basque cheesecake; 90-minute limit; booking needed.

食べログ: ビストロ＆バー ヴィスコ、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-4-23、長堀橋駅.en: Tabelog: Bistro & Bar VISCO, 1-4-23 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon, Thu and Sun 17:00–23:00, Fri–Sat 17:00–2:00 next morning; closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays; cover charge ¥450; cards and e-money accepted, no QR; 11 counter seats. Reviews (October 2025 – October 2026): just south of Nagahori-dori; a narrow entrance easy to miss; 21st anniversary in 2026; à la carte of seasonal ingredients; starter of pumpkin soup (chilled in summer) and pâté; starter platter; carpaccio; marinated fish; caprese; quiche of the day; foie-gras omelette; sautéed shirako; prosciutto; karasumi; cutlet; porcini pasta; chewy galette; state your taste and get 2 wines to choose from (Muscadet, Chablis); friendly staff; good for a second stop too; book ahead.

食べログ: ビヤホールライオン 銀座七丁目店、銀座7-9-20 銀座ライオンビル.en: Tabelog: Beer Hall Lion Ginza 7-chome, Ginza 7-9-20, Ginza Lion Building 1F, 3 minutes from Ginza Station; Sun–Thu 11:30–22:00, Fri, Sat and days before holidays 11:30–22:30; open every day; 10% New Year charge 12/31–1/3; no service charge; no reservations (all-you-can-drink courses at the 2F "Beer Restaurant Ginza Lion Ginza 7-chome"); opened April 8, 1934; official site ginzalion.jp. October 2026 reviews: a registered tangible cultural property and a sightseeing spot "you can drink in"; an extra-large Black Label stein (three glasses' worth); the famous currywurst; founded 1934 (Showa 9); designed by Eizo Sugawara; Japan's oldest beer hall, which escaped war damage; heavy arches and scratch tiles; an Art Deco space; a glass mosaic of the barley harvest; green mosaic pillars shaped like barley; prices have gone up; omu-hayashi at the 2F beer restaurant; "Ginza roast beef" cooked in an infrared roaster from 13:30 on weekdays and 12:30 on weekends and holidays; a queue of about 20 at 18:30 on a Friday; fish & chips; fried oysters; many overseas visitors; a tiled smoking area.

食べログ: ピッコロ なんばウォーク店、カレー・オムライス、大阪市中央区難波2.en: Tabelog: Piccolo Namba Walk, curry and omurice, Niji no Machi 1-9, Namba 2, Chuo-ku, Osaka, right by Kintetsu Namba Station and the subway Midosuji Line Namba Station, 10:30–22:00, closed on irregular days and New Year's Day, no reservations, no cards, e-money or QR, 8 counter seats, non-smoking, takeout available. The Piccolo Curry site (the food company ミツヤ食品工業; head office Shinsaibashisuji 2-3-16, Chuo-ku, Osaka; factory in Higashi-Osaka): the shops are Namba Walk (Namba Walk 1-9, 11:00–22:00, last order 21:30), Whity Umeda, Hankyu Kappa Yokocho, JR Osaka Station and Nishinomiya Hankyu, each selling curry to take away and retort curries (you can also eat in). A curry specialist that opened in the Umeda underground mall over 40 years ago, introduced as the "King of Curry" in L Magazine and elsewhere. Piccolo beef curry is thirty-odd spices with fruit, vegetables and beef, simmered for hours and finished with chutney and fresh cream. Reviews (2026): three kinds, Piccolo sauce curry, spicy curry and Piccolo hayashi; the W sauce with two on one plate; katsu curry ¥1,100; omurice (11:00–15:00) with tomato sauce ¥800, curry sauce ¥950 or hayashi sauce ¥1,050; fukujinzuke free, rakkyo ¥110; fast service; the walkway runs right behind the seats; some diners also go to the Umeda shop; one says prices are about 30% higher than before.

食べログ: ピッツェリア ダ ティグレ、大阪市西区新町1-18-13、西大橋駅2.en: Tabelog: Pizzeria da Tigre, 1-18-13 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station exit 2, 5 from Yotsubashi; Wed and Fri–Sun 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–21:00, Thu 11:30–14:30; closed Mondays and Tuesdays; no cards, e-money or QR; 13 counter seats. Reviews (April–October 2026): Neapolitan pizza only; wood-fired oven; meal tickets; no reservations; cash only; run single-handed; dough stretched and baked in front of you; done in minutes; margherita ¥1,000; marinara; Ricotta e Cipolla ¥1,500; served uncut with a note on how to eat it; cola ¥300; lots of takeaway; queues at weekend lunch; right after opening is the time to go.

食べログ: ファンサパロット、大阪市中央区日本橋1丁目17-23、06-6631.en: Tabelog: Fansa Parrot, 1-17-23 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6631-6872; reservations accepted; Mon and Wed–Sun 11:00–14:00 and 16:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed Tuesdays; cards and e-money accepted; 24 seats (ground floor counter 8 and tables 4, 2nd floor tables 12; private hire up to 15). Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): a similar Thai restaurant two doors down; a corner shop; the smile of a Thai male staff member; larb sen; yum woon sen; D lunch (green curry, Thai noodles, boiled egg and vegetable salad) ¥1,100; C set (gapao rice, vegetable salad, braised pork soup) ¥1,100; just before the entrance to Kuromon Market; run by Thai people, Thai heard all around; tom yum goong; green curry; Thai omelette; prices a little high; lunch sets recommended; slow when busy; a Thai Select restaurant; poo pad pong curry suspended; shrimp fried rice; Singha beer; heat not toned down for Japanese palates; many Thai diners too; prices raised.

食べログ: フルーツカフェ pomp、カフェ、かき氷、日本橋人形町2-21-4.en: Tabelog: Fruit Cafe pomp, cafe, kakigori; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-21-4, 1F; 2 min walk from Ningyocho Station exit A1; Mon–Fri and the days before and after holidays 13:30–19:30, Sat, Sun and holidays 13:00–18:30; changes posted on Instagram and X; reservations by email or Instagram DM; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 14 counter seats; opened 29 July 2019; the Okayama white peach menu is popular; featured on ZIP!. Reviews (July–September 2026): white peach milk kakigori (small) ¥2,200, the large with a whole peach; Earl Grey white peach kakigori ¥1,980; peach chai kakigori; Shine Muscat; a parfait topped with a whole Shimizu Hakuto peach (vanilla ice cream, granola, acai); a two-peach parfait with a drink about ¥4,900; on the pricey side; weekday afternoons sometimes possible without a reservation.

食べログ: フレッシュネスバーガー 汐留シティセンター店、港区東新橋1-5-2.en: Tabelog: FRESHNESS BURGER Shiodome City Center, Higashi-Shinbashi 1-5-2, Minato-ku, Shiodome City Center 1F; weekdays 8:00–21:00, closed weekends and holidays; opened October 9, 2018. 2026 reviews: fries and beer at happy hour (Hokkaido potatoes sold out); black-wagyu burger; classic avocado cheeseburger set ¥1,322 (with an app coupon); food-court seats hard to find at 13:00; mostly two-seat tables; garden salad burger; fried lotus root and potatoes; rosehip tea.

食べログ: フレンチ、中京区富小路通蛸薬師下ル高宮町585 若葉ビル 2F、四条.en: Tabelog: French; 富小路通蛸薬師下ル高宮町585, Nakagyo-ku, 若葉ビル 2F; 6 min walk from Shijo, Karasuma and Kyoto Kawaramachi Stns; no lift; 12:00–15:00 (last order 12:30) and 18:00–22:00 (last order 19:00); late arrivals count as cancellations; closed irregularly; reservation only; allergies in advance (no same-day requests; seafood, dairy, wheat and almond allergies and vegetarians cannot be accommodated); one drink per person; 8% service charge on courses; 8 seats (tables only); non-smoking; cards and e-money; owner-chef Takuya Sawahara; the name means bringing light. Reviews (January 2025–September 2026, in English): dinner course ¥14,700; 6-glass wine pairing ¥10,800; lunch ¥7,200 and ¥12,000; unlimited bread; trained at famous Kyoto restaurants and a two-star French restaurant; the chef cooks alone; the madam; diners sometimes asked to lower their voices; everyone starts together.

食べログ: フレンチ、中京区玉植町235-2、火 18:00〜22:00 (料理.en: Tabelog: French; 中京区玉植町235-2; Tue 18:00–22:00 (food last order 19:30); Wed–Sat 12:00–14:30 (last order 13:00) and 18:00–22:00 (last order 19:30); closed Sunday and Monday; reservation only; 38 seats (14 at the counter, 8 at tables, private rooms); private rooms for 2–8; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted. Reviews (December 2025–October 2026, in English): Chef Alexey Moko (from Versailles, with experience at Taillevent and London hotels), a Michelin star soon after opening, lunch ¥9,000 and dinner ¥22,000, fish and meat aged in-house, fermentation, game, homemade sourdough, wine pairing six glasses ¥15,000, Prestige three glasses ¥15,000, caviar and truffle supplements, a townhouse with a courtyard and storehouse, a kids' menu, many guests from overseas.

食べログ: フレンチ・創作料理、中京区東洞院二条上ル壺屋町512-2、地下鉄丸太.en: Tabelog: French, innovative; 中京区東洞院二条上ル壺屋町512-2; 4 min on foot from Marutamachi Stn (subway); lunch 12:00–15:00 (food last order 13:00), dinner 18:00–22:00 (food last order 19:00); closed Monday (open on holidays); reservation only; 10% service charge; 12 seats; private hire for 6 or more; cards, e-money and QR accepted; English menu and English-speaking staff; the chef is also an herb coordinator; sommelier wine pairings; non-alcoholic aroma pairings by herb distillation. Reviews (February–October 2026, in English): a renovated machiya; Damask-rose scented water; Shinshu salmon with caviar; Yamato tachibana; hamo; tuna tartare; oyster flan; foie gras terrine; higuma bear; fugu jelly; cheese platter; baked sweets; lunch with four pairings a little over ¥12,000.

食べログ: フレンチ・水炊き・ワインバー、下京区木屋町四条南団栗上ル斉藤町140.en: Tabelog: French, mizutaki, wine bar; 木屋町四条南団栗上ル斉藤町140-16, Shimogyo-ku; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn, 3 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn; Monday–Saturday 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Sunday and the 2nd and 4th Monday; no reservations for individuals on Friday and Saturday (Tabelog English page); table charge ¥1,100 per person; 10% service charge; 19 seats (6 at the counter, 13 at tables); private room for 3–8; heated tobacco only, in the private room and on the riverside platform; cards and e-money, no QR; French WEST Tabelog 100 2021; November courses: A course ¥9,350, Petit Gourmandises ¥16,500, Harmonie Gourmande ¥23,000. Reviews (December 2025–October 2026, in English): riverside platform over the Kamo River, view of the Minami-za, shoes off at the entrance, the owner-sommelier, second wines of famous châteaux, winter mizutaki (Miyama chicken), black wagyu carpaccio, Kyoto pork Rossini, a diner who has come for about 25 years.

食べログ: フレンチ・洋食、上京区寺町通今出川下ル真如堂前町105、出町柳駅から.en: Tabelog: French, yoshoku; 寺町通今出川下ル真如堂前町105, Kamigyo-ku; 7 min walk west along Imadegawa-dori from Demachiyanagi Stn; 11:30–15:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 20:00); closed Wednesday and two weekends a month; reservations accepted (online bookings cannot choose seats; any balance after points paid in cash); service charge 7% at lunch, 10% at dinner; 34 seats (8 counter, 10 table, a 16-seat detached private room); non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master) and PayPay; French WEST Tabelog 100 2021; a vegetable-led French full course in a Kyoto townhouse; yoshoku too on Sundays, Mondays and Tuesdays; dogs allowed. Reviews (March–October 2026, in English): vegetable terrine; lunch ¥3,520 and about ¥5,500; pan-seared sea bass; pork steak; wine; yoshoku from October (tongue stew, shrimp fry); reports of a noisy room and a chef cold to first-timers.

食べログ: ブイヤベースのお店 プチポワソン、ビストロ・フレンチ、下京区高倉通仏.en: Tabelog: ブイヤベースのお店 プチポワソン (Petit Poisson), bistro and French; 下京区高倉通仏光寺上ル西前町374-1; 5 min on foot from Hankyu Karasuma and Shijo Stations; lunch 11:30–15:00 (Thu–Sun); dinner 17:00–22:30 (Tue–Sun, food L.O. 20:00); closed Monday and some Tuesdays and Wednesdays; reservations taken; à la carte booked on the day only; no service charge; one drink per person at dinner; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 13 seats (7 at the counter, 6 at a sunken kotatsu); non-smoking; English menu; opened 25 October 2020. Shop's efforts: bouillabaisse made from fish trimmings that would be discarded. Reviews (2026, in English): lunch bouillabaisse set ¥3,600; starter platter (duck, tofu, quiche, carrot râpée, pâté); sea bream bouillabaisse; HANAKAGO focaccia; canelé to take away; chef trained at a starred restaurant in Nice; Gault&Millau POP.

食べログ: ブラーチェ・エ・ヴィーノ・ジジーノ、銀座3-11-6 鈴木ビル2F、.en: Tabelog: Brace e Vino Gigino, Ginza 3-11-6, 鈴木 Building 2F, 1 minute from Higashi-Ginza Station exit A7; 16 seats; Tue–Fri 17:00–22:00 (L.O.), weekends 16:00–22:00, closed Mon and irregular Tuesdays; otoshi ¥300; opened September 25, 2012; a charcoal-grill Italian izakaya, sister shop of "Termini" on 1F; cards and PayPay accepted. 2026 reviews: charcoal-grilled meat platter, grilled vegetables, sea-bream carpaccio, charcoal-grilled wagyu with truffle, choosing wine in the basement cellar, for wine drinkers, a regular of 16 visits, ¥4,000–10,000.

食べログ: プティオザミ、銀座1-4-9 銀座オザミビル1F・2F、銀座一丁目駅.en: Tabelog: Petit Oza Mi, Ginza 1-4-9, Ginza Oza Mi Building 1F–2F, 1 minute from Ginza-itchome Station exit 6; 20 seats; Tue–Fri 11:30–15:00, 17:30–22:00, Sat 11:30–15:30, 17:00–22:00, Sundays and holidays until 21:00, closed Mon; opened March 21, 2016; 10% service charge in bar hours only; cards and PayPay accepted. Shop introduction (English): the casual sister of "Ginza Oza Mi des Vins", now in its 29th year; lunch courses from about ¥2,950; wine by the glass, carafe and bottle. 2026 reviews: roast-beef salad lunch; a course of four starters, poached fish, braised beef cheek and pudding; foie gras hamburg steak; booking recommended; ¥2,000–8,000.

食べログ: ベジョータ マス、スペインバル・ヨーロッパ料理、大阪市淀川区西中島5.en: Tabelog: Bellota Mas, Spanish bar and European, 新なにわ大食堂 2F, 5-15-5 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 30 seconds from Exit 4 of Shin-Osaka Station; daily 10:00–23:00; no reservations; cards accepted; 30 places (6 counter, 7 high counter, 14 low tables, 8–10 standing); non-smoking; opened 30 March 2016; shop text: a cheap, fast, delicious standing Spanish bar inside Shin-Osaka Station; tapas from ¥90; jamón ¥390; wine from ¥390; beer ¥390; highball ¥190; the famous roast chicken. Reviews (September 2025 to October 2026): "Kobore" cava poured until it overflows; the house-brand GYOKURO jamón (with a certificate); roast chicken with crisp skin, juicy (half size, spicy sauce); herb-confit gizzards; anchovy-mayonnaise egg; marinated mushrooms; shrimp ajillo; pinchos of seafood, jamón with mozzarella, smoked salmon; cheese platter; katsuo tataki; kawahagi carpaccio; sangria; happy-hour highballs ¥190; right by the subway gate; busy at weekends.

食べログ: ベトナムカフェ＆ビア ngon ca phe、ベトナム料理・カフェ・.en: Tabelog: Vietnam Cafe & Beer ngon ca phe, Vietnamese, café and sandwiches, 新大阪阪急ビル 3F, 1-1-1 Miyahara, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 1 min from the Shinkansen central exit of JR Shin-Osaka Station; daily 6:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); may not seat guests 6:30–10:30 at times; open all year; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 78 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children and babies welcome; Wi-Fi; takeout; allergy information available; opened 2 March 2021. Shop site: "ngon" means delicious in Vietnamese; banh mi and pho by a Vietnamese chef; coffee brewed with a Vietnamese filter; breakfast of a Japanese tray (pickles from the company's own farm) or an ethnic breakfast set; yogurt coffee; salt coffee; Uber Eats; online booking. Reviews (May–October 2026): breakfast banh mi and pho set ¥1,680 (self-service salad, drinks and mini desserts); pho and mini curry set ¥1,500; mini pho set; fried catfish banh mi; Saigon Special beer; an evening value set (pho, fresh spring rolls, tapioca); Vietnamese iced coffee; cilantro served on the side; handy before the Shinkansen.

食べログ: ペザント四番町、定食・食堂、四番町4-13 井上ビル B1F、市ケ谷.en: Tabelog: Peasant Yonbancho, set meals, diner; Yonbanchō 4-13, 井上ビル B1F; 241 m from Ichigaya Station; Mon–Sat 12:00–18:00, closed Sundays and holidays; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 18 seats; non-smoking. Reviews (2026): an old-style basement set-meal diner; the sign reads "Bancho Shokudo"; Yonbancho set ¥850 (chicken katsu and ginger pork, rice, miso soup, raw egg, small side, pickles); recommended set (tuna cubes and chicken katsu) ¥850; hayashi rice ¥750; katsu curry ¥820; hamburg steak set ¥820; fried oyster set ¥950; a queue on the stairs around 1 p.m.; cash only.

食べログ: ホット クロス 南堀江店、大阪市西区南堀江2-2-11 GATO D.en: Tabelog: Hot Cross Minami-Horie, GATO D.M Minami-Horie, 2-2-11 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 405 m from Nishi-Ohashi Station; Mon and Wed–Sun 8:00–19:30; closed Tuesdays (open on holidays, closed the next day); closed over New Year; no reservations; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR accepted; 16 seats; no smoking; takeaway; official site. Reviews (July 2025 – September 2026): a bakery cafe known for curry bread; crisp minced-meat curry bread (like a menchi-katsu inside); egg curry bread; curry cabbage dog; curry lunch; bacon baguette; pizza bread; mixed nuts ¥268; cheese fromage ¥328; anpan; sandwiches and a morning menu; eat-in requires a drink order; one says the coffee is good too; a Kita-Horie shop too; one says prices have risen.

食べログ: ホルモンらーめん 8910 千日前店、大阪市中央区千日前1-8-16.en: Tabelog: Horumon Ramen 8910 Sennichimae, 1-8-16 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; open 24 hours; irregular closing days; no cards, e-money or QR payment; no smoking; opened 8 October 2022; site 8910.sunlar333-pinoko.com. 2026 reviews (August–October): offal ramen and kalbi rice bowl (salt); the feel of a place where risotto or porridge from the soup is recommended; rich soup without off-smells; piping hot; the Sennichimae shopping arcade; the main shop is in Shimoshinjo, Higashiyodogawa-ku; not a big shop and often quiet; seems thin at first but is just right; choice of red or white (red is popular); bubbling in a clay pot; tender offal; like a hot pot for one; opens early in the morning; heat and fluffy offal; 24 hours; corn topping; after drinking.

食べログ: ホルモンラーメン 8910 ヨーロッパ通店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-.en: Tabelog: Horumon Ramen 8910 Europe-dori, Ookini Kinikini Bldg 1F, 1-16-17 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; open 24 hours; no smoking; e-money accepted; no cards or QR payment; opened 1 April 2023. Reviews (March 2025 – October 2026): limited spicy offal maze-soba ¥1,280 (large at the same price); thick wavy noodles; offal like at a yakiniku restaurant; fried onion; shoyu ramen ¥1,050 (faint sweetness); one said it tastes like instant; spicy kalbi ramen ¥990 (thin noodles, smallish portion); set meals on Saturdays too; one likened it to ramen abroad; the overseas staff are polite; one found the beef-bone paitan lacking; adjust with pepper and shichimi; 8 a.m.; hotter than expected, so an egg was added.

食べログ: ホルモン・ジビエ 明星、大阪市中央区千日前1-2-9 ST千日前ビル.en: Tabelog: Horumon & Gibier Myojo, ST Sennichimae Bldg 1F, 1-2-9 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 116 m from Nippombashi; Mon and Wed–Fri 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00), Sat–Sun 15:00–23:00; closed Tuesdays; check Instagram for opening; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; standing for 16; opened 23 August 2022; Tabelog Tachinomi Hyakumeiten 2025. Reviews (September 2023 – October 2026): kangaroo with shungiku namul; no gamey smell to the kangaroo; horse liver safe to eat raw; seared loin yukhoe with egg; more kinds of liver the earlier you go; grilled liver; beef-tongue sashimi; cheek sashimi; venison thigh; wild boar; Matsusaka beef liver; bottled beer; chuhai where you pour your own soda; return empty bottles to the crate yourself; smallish portions; curry at weekends; camel (tenderloin), arrivals announced on Instagram; a queue right after opening; sea-lion sashimi with ginger; badger hot pot in winter; pig's uterus; often full and items sell out; quiet on rainy days; small intestine; lemon sauce; teriyaki heart; pheasant thigh; salt and yuzu-kosho; Nishinari offal; Akaboshi; beef tongue with plenty of leek; garlic small intestine; tsukami; Miyazaki and Matsusaka beef offal; about 100 m north of Gyokusei Ya; a vinyl-curtain entrance; U-shaped counter; videos of 80s–90s kayokyoku; sweet-potato shochu with water ¥500; offal stew ¥480; Matsusaka garlic small intestine ¥580; Miyazaki loin yukhoe ¥980; kangaroo tenderloin ¥720; one says prices weren't marked as pre-tax; plastic cups.

食べログ: ボア・ド・ブローニュ、千代田区日比谷公園1-2 松本楼3F、霞ケ関駅.en: Tabelog: Bois de Boulogne, Hibiya-koen 1-2, Chiyoda-ku, Matsumotoro 3F, near Kasumigaseki and Hibiya stations; Mon–Thu and weekends 11:00–15:30, 17:00–22:00, Fri until 21:30; official site matsumotoro.co.jp. 2026 reviews: on 3F of the historic Matsumotoro in Hibiya Park; the park's greenery through big windows; prix-fixe lunch ¥6,000 (amuse, three breads, soup or starter, main, dessert, coffee); "Forest and Island lunch course" ¥8,000 (chicken pot-au-feu; complaints about the jinenjo ice cream); crêpes Suzette; good for anniversaries.

食べログ: ボタ、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-8-20、長堀橋駅から徒歩3分、月・木.en: Tabelog: Buttah, 1-8-20 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon and Thu–Sun 12:00–15:30 (L.O.) and from 18:00, Tue 12:00–15:30; closed Wednesdays; phone to check after 21:30; no cards, e-money or QR; 16 seats (counter 4, two tables for 2, one for 4, raised area 4); official site. Reviews (November 2025 – October 2026): an old wooden house down an alley; bare bulbs; cute illustrations; Asian knick-knacks; daily curries (aubergine keema, butter chicken, keema, shrimp coconut, pumpkin butter, squid green curry, vegetable coconut); 2-curry combination; on Sundays a 3-curry plate ¥1,380 (saffron or turmeric rice, dal, pickles); about ¥1,550–1,750 with fried egg and chai; achar; raita; iced cardamom chai; heat can be increased; not too hot, easy to eat; cash only.

食べログ: マイアミパティオ 新橋駅前店、港区新橋2-6-2 新橋アイマークビル.en: Tabelog: Miami Patio Shimbashi Ekimae, Shinbashi 2-6-2, Minato-ku, Shinbashi I-Mark Building 1F; 56 seats; daily 11:00–24:00; no service charge; separate smoking area (smoking at all seats at dinner); official site miami-garden.jp. 2026 reviews: daily pasta (sakura shrimp) with salad and coffee ¥1,200; sets with a starter and drink; lots of salad; easy to sit and relax even after lunch; friendly staff; complaints of cigarette smell even at lunch; restrained flavors.

食べログ: マイアミ・ヴィッラ 有楽町イトシアプラザ店、千代田区有楽町2-7-1.en: Tabelog: Miami Villa Yurakucho ITOCiA Plaza, Yurakucho 2-7-1, Chiyoda-ku, Yurakucho ITOCiA 1F, 1 minute from JR Yurakucho Station central exit; 60 seats (terrace seats); Mon–Thu and Sun 9:00–21:00, Fri and Sat 9:00–22:00; official site miami-garden.jp. 2026 reviews: lunch set with salad and coffee about ¥1,500; Japanese-style pasta (on the salty side, close to soup pasta); takana and bacon with soy sauce; tomato and mozzarella pasta; Margherita; spinach and bacon salad; nearly full even at weekday lunch; 90-minute limit; ordinary taste; service split between efficient and unfriendly.

食べログ: マイティルゥ、大阪市中央区高津3-2-20、日本橋駅から徒歩5分、火.en: Tabelog: Mighty Luu, 3-2-20 Kozu, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nippombashi Station; Tue–Sun 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–23:00; closed Mondays; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 18 seats; smoking area. Reviews (February 2025 – June 2026): curry at lunch, a bar at night; chicken curry ¥880 (regular; small, regular, large); slow-simmered tender chicken; a light spice curry with tomato tang; can be made milder; lentil curry; lentil and spinach curry; salmon and potato curry; combinations A, B and C (B is chicken curry with hamburg); hamburg topping; lunch last order 14:30; near the National Bunraku Theatre; one minded a tobacco smell at lunch.

食べログ: マキノマキ、居酒屋・焼き鳥・串焼き、大阪市淀川区西中島4-7-1 チ.en: Tabelog: Makino Maki; izakaya, yakitori, kushiyaki; チサンマンション新大阪 102, 西中島4-7-1, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 3 minutes on foot from Nishinakajima-Minamigata and Hankyu Minamikata stations; opposite Yakiniku Hyakuban; Mon–Fri 17:00–01:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 16:00–01:00; closures not fixed; reservations accepted; cards and e-money accepted, no QR; 26 seats (6 at the counter, 16 at tables); private hire 20–50; smoking allowed (accommodated on request); Wi-Fi; power outlets. Reviews (2023 to October 2026): Hakata vegetable-roll skewers over charcoal; fist-sized lettuce rolls; Hakata green onion, shiso, pea-shoot and tomato rolls; egg and bacon; shiitake with butter and soy; skewers from ¥495, one at a time; tsukune with egg yolk ¥385; heart; chicken neck; sesame kanpachi; grilled mentaiko ¥380; fried yam; chicken nanban; potato salad; tofu appetiser; kamameshi or grilled onigiri to finish; grilled ramen; all-you-can-drink ¥1,100 (no beer); course with all-you-can-drink ¥3,500; draft beer ¥418; sweet-potato shochu; so lively you need to book; young staff.

食べログ: マトリキッチン、銀座3-10-14 東銀1ビル2F、東銀座駅から徒歩.en: Tabelog: Matri Kitchen, Ginza 3-10-14, 東銀1 Building 2F, 5 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station; 20 seats; Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat, Sun 11:30–22:00, closed Thu; cards, IC and d-barai accepted; ¥2,000–3,000. 2026 reviews: Russian food; weekday lunch set ¥1,300 (with a drink; mains such as beef stroganoff, salad, borscht); freshly made pelmeni; Russian tea with jam; cheerful women staff who seem Russian; a queue before opening.

食べログ: マリアージュフレール 銀座本店、銀座5-6-6 すずらん通り、銀座駅.en: Tabelog: Mariage Frères Ginza main shop, Ginza 5-6-6, Suzuran-dori, 2 minutes from Ginza Station exit A1; 37 seats; daily 11:30–20:00; reservations accepted; official site mariagefreres.co.jp. 2026 reviews: brighter since moving from another spot in Ginza; tea served in pots; white tea and flavored teas; about four autumn teas; tea-flavored cakes (choose from four, ¥1,980); a very large iced tea; recommends leaves to suit your taste or milk; a 45-minute wait on busy days, none at 13:30 on a weekday; the air conditioning is strong but was adjusted on request.

食べログ: マリーＤ、カレー、中京区新京極四条上ル東入ル中之町577、京都河原町.en: Tabelog: マリーＤ, curry; 中京区新京極四条上ル東入ル中之町577, 115 m from Kyoto Kawaramachi Station; 12:00–15:30 and 17:00–20:00; closed Tuesday; reservations taken; 14 seats; non-smoking; no cards, e-money or QR payments; no photography. Reviews (2024–2026, in English): a stone-paved alley, Yanagikoji; European-style curry; saffron rice; Lunch Set A ¥1,500 (September 2026); Curry Course A ¥1,900 (June 2025); spring vegetable curry with shrimp and scallops ¥1,350; seafood curry; caramel banana pudding; a shop that has been there for 35 years.

食べログ: マルコナ、銀座8-7-7 中央林ビル2F、新橋駅から徒歩3〜4分、1.en: Tabelog: Marcona, Ginza 8-7-7, 中央林 Building 2F, 3–4 minutes from Shinbashi Station; 18 seats; Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00, Sat reservations only, closed Sundays and holidays; opened August 9, 2005; cards accepted. 2026 reviews: Spanish food in a bar-like atmosphere; the owner cooks each order; jamón; seafood paella topped with shrimp; ajillo; starter platter; raisins on the vine with cheese; before concerts at Sumitomo Life Hall; ¥6,000–10,000.

食べログ: ミルクスタンド 御徒町店、上野5 JR御徒町駅北口改札前、月〜木11.en: Tabelog: Milk Stand, Okachimachi branch, Ueno 5, in front of the JR Okachimachi North Exit ticket gate; Mon–Thu 11:25–14:40, Fri 11:25–13:40, Sat–Sun 9:45–18:00, closed public holidays; no reservations; standing counter, 4 spaces; non-smoking; no cards, e-money accepted. 乗りものニュース (6 March 2023, 古橋龍一): 大沢牛乳, which runs the ミルクショップ酪 on the Akihabara Station Sōbu Line platform; its president, 大沢一彦; regional milks since around 2000, from about 15 dairies (酪王牛乳 of Fukushima, Kazusa milk of Chiba, 飛騨牛乳 of Gifu, Sunflower milk of Kōchi); 大沢牛乳's milk stand at Okachimachi Station is popular with tourists from China and Korea. Reviews (August 2024–September 2026): Azumino milk ¥180, warmed Kazusa milk ¥160, Sunflower milk, pasteurized coffee milk, drinking yogurt; drink on the spot and return the bottle; often opens around noon.

食べログ: ムムリク (mumurik)、イタリアン・バル、中京区麩屋町蛸薬師下.en: Tabelog: ムムリク (mumurik), Italian and bar; 中京区麩屋町蛸薬師下ル梅屋町488 1F; 5 min on foot from Hankyu Kawaramachi Station; lunch 12:00–14:30, dinner 17:00–22:00 (Fri–Sat to 22:30, last food order 21:30); closed Tuesday; no lunch on the 1st, 3rd and 5th Wednesdays; reservations taken; at dinner at least one drink and one dish each, pasta alone not accepted; 14 seats (8 table, 6 counter); non-smoking; cards and PayPay accepted; opened 5 December 2011. Reviews (2026, in English): near Nishiki Market; appetizer platter; liver pâté; prosciutto; figs with mascarpone; Naruto-kintoki fries; lily bulb; white asparagus; balsamic-braised spare ribs; sea bream carpaccio; ajillo; pasta; lunch sets A and B; a large wine list.

食べログ: メッゼ堀江 トルコカフェ&レストラン、大阪市西区北堀江1-9-14.en: Tabelog: Mezze Horie Turkish Cafe & Restaurant, Pan1914 Bldg 2F, 1-9-14 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka, 06-6543-1233; reservations accepted; lunch 11:30–15:00, dinner 17:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); closed Wednesdays; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 24 seats (3 tables for 4, counter 6, 3 terrace tables for 2); smoking on the terrace only; opened 26 April 2024; official mezzehorie.com. Shop's description: Mediterranean food by a chef from Turkey; halal ingredients in line with Islamic law; for halal and vegetarian diners too; plenty of spices and vegetables; charcoal-grilled kebabs; Turkish desserts. 2026 reviews (August–October): chicken kebab lunch set ¥1,200 (salad, bean and tomato soup, butter rice); an owner-chef with good Japanese; rice refills available; course ¥4,500 (starter platter with hummus, soup, Turkish bread, chicken, lamb and köfte kebabs, Turkish ice cream, baklava and Turkish pudding, Turkish chai); chickpea croquettes; marinated seafood; many overseas diners; a friendly chef; Turkish beer and red wine; the same tomato soup as eaten in Turkey.

食べログ: メリプリンチペッサ 銀座店(旧店名 パッチョ)、銀座1-6-10 銀.en: Tabelog: Meri Principessa Ginza (formerly Paccio), Ginza 1-6-10, Ginza 上一 Building 3F, 1 minute from Ginza-itchome Station; 90 seats (70 table, 10 high table, 10 private room); weekdays 11:30–14:30, 17:30–22:00, weekends and holidays 12:00–15:00, 17:30–22:00; irregular holidays; after 20:00 use the outside elevator; opened July 16, 2012. Shop introduction: Italian with Hiroshima ingredients; "Anchor to the table"; courses of seasonal vegetables, fresh fish and meat with all-you-can-drink; natural wines; interior in Bingo kasuri. October 2026 reviews: on 1F the Hiroshima showroom shop "TAU"; a ¥3,500 lunch course (pizza or pasta, steamed oysters, coffee or tea); people come for the oysters; hard to book on weekends; a course served on big platters to share (caprese of Hiroshima mandarins and mozzarella); course with all-you-can-drink ¥7,700, with sparkling ¥6,600; full even on weekdays.

食べログ: モジャカレー 新大阪本店、カレー、食べログ カレー WEST 百名店.en: Tabelog: Moja Curry Shin osaka honten, curry, Tabelog Curry WEST 100 in 2023, 2024 and 2026, 5-16-1 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, JR Shin-Osaka Station 1F, Aji no Koji; daily 11:00–14:30 and 17:00–20:00; no reservations (takeaway can be booked); no cards or e-money, PayPay accepted; 7 seats (counter); non-smoking; children welcome; takeaway. The shop's introduction: Mojya Curry of its own spices and a slow-cooked roux, depth within the heat, toppings to suit. Reviews (October 2026): negi beef curry ¥1,200–1,300, BIG hamburg-steak curry ¥1,400, choose the spice level and rice amount, served in about a minute, a smooth, fairly runny sauce, sweet with heat that comes later, a curry created by a chef from Bangladesh, "Moja" means "delicious" in Bengali, celebrity autographs on the wall, fukujinzuke on the counter, self-service water, a cramped counter.

食べログ: モヒーニ 四谷店、カフェ・ケーキ、若葉1-4、四ツ谷駅・四谷三丁目駅.en: Tabelog: MOHINI Yotsuya, café and cakes; Wakaba 1-4; 7 min walk from Yotsuya Station and Yotsuya-sanchome Station; Tue–Sun 12:00–19:00, closed Monday; reservations taken; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 seats (six 2-seat tables); non-smoking; moved from Akebonobashi in October 2013. Reviews (2023–2026): a house down a residential alley; a tea specialty shop run by the owner alone; tea by the pot, about 3 cups; Mohini ¥630, Safari Kenya ¥630, Uva ¥680, Earl Grey, cardamom chai, royal milk tea; scones with clotted cream and homemade apple jam ¥450, baked cheesecake, seasonal tarts; about 140 teas sold by the leaf; described as certified by the Japan Tea Association.

食べログ: モージョー、バル・イタリアン・カフェ、大阪市中央区南船場4-10-2.en: Tabelog: MoeJoe, bar, Italian and café, Satsuki Building B1F, Minami-Senba 4-10-29, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 minutes from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon–Fri 11:30–23:00 (lunch 11:30–17:00, café 14:00–23:00, dinner 18:00–23:00, L.O. 22:30), Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–18:00; irregular closures; call to book dinner; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 26 seats; semi-private room for 6; smoking allowed; pancakes discontinued. A5 kuroge wagyu and rare cuts, about 50 cocktails, a monthly seasonal menu, all-you-can-drink courses, the signature 'secret' French toast. Reviews (March 2024–August 2026): lunch sets about ¥1,000 with soup, salad and a drink, 'Serious' kara-age, nikujaga and kara-age, shrimp kara-age with shrimp mayo, hamburg set ¥1,100, pink tartar, Oreo croffle, tiramisu croffle, the Satisfaction course, a steep staircase with no handrail, smoking inside.

食べログ: ヤマガタ サンダンデロ、銀座1-5-10 銀座ファーストファイブビル.en: Tabelog: YAMAGATA San-Dan-Delo, Ginza 1-5-10, Ginza First Five Building 2F; 32 seats; Tue–Sun 11:30–15:00, 18:00–22:00, closed Mondays (open on holidays) and at New Year; opened April 30, 2009; official site sandandelo.theshop.jp. Shop introduction: the Ginza shop of Yamagata's Al-chè-cciano (Arkecciano in the English shop introduction); Shonai seafood and Yamagata mountain produce; vegetables and fruit from growers. 2026 reviews: chef Okuda's (English spelling) gentle flavors; pasta from research into yuderon (English spelling); ayu pasta; plenty of non-alcoholic cocktails; Yamagata vegetables and meat; full at opening on weekends; booking essential.

食べログ: ユーミン、大阪市天王寺区空堀町6-1、玉造から227m、毎日11:0.en: Tabelog: Yuming, 6-1 Karahoricho, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 227 m from Tamatsukuri; daily 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed 1st and 3rd Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; 6 counter seats; smoking area inside; opened 15 June 2012. Reviews (2019 – July 2026): a neighbourhood Chinese diner one block south of Nagahori-dori; run by two people; TV; 15 noodle dishes (ramen, tanmen, gomoku noodles, champon, yakisoba, tsukemen); gyoza; chukadon; fried rice; sets and daily specials; champon (medium-thin straight noodles, a piping-hot rich chicken-bone shoyu soup, pork, shrimp, cabbage, bean sprouts, carrot, onion, leek); half fried rice + champon set ¥1,000; service set (champon and half fried rice) ¥750; gomoku ramen (chicken-bone salt); Kyushu ramen with half fried rice set ¥800 (some days curry fried rice); fried rice ¥600–700 (roast pork, sausage, bacon); 5 gyoza hand-made from the skins up ¥350, gingery; karaage ¥400; yakisoba with a rich sauce; order verbally, pay afterwards; pepper, chili oil and gyoza sauce on the table.

食べログ: ヨーロッパ料理・バル・イタリアン、下京区桝屋町460 河道屋倖松庵ビ.en: Tabelog: European, bar, Italian; 河道屋倖松庵ビル 1F, Shimogyo-ku; every day 18:00 to about 23:00 (last order about 22:00); closed irregularly; bookings taken; 20 seats; no smoking; children welcome; English menu; cards, iD, QUICPay and QR accepted. Reviews (March 2022 – May 2026, in English): smoked mackerel and egg potato salad; quiche; prosciutto; chicken neck in white-wine butter; shrimp and scallop ajillo ¥1,100; potage; amatriciana with house pancetta; squid-ink pescatore; bolognese; half-size lasagna; quattro formaggi; glass wine, two reds and two whites at ¥700; the appetiser assortment must be booked.

食べログ: ラ ニュイ ブランシュ、銀座7-2-8 東建ビルB1F、銀座駅から徒.en: Tabelog: La Nuit Blanche, Ginza 7-2-8, 東建 Building B1F, 4 minutes from Ginza Station, 5 from Shinbashi Station; 12 seats; Mon–Sat 18:00–2:00, closed Sun; reservations required; opened June 1, 2008; entry may be refused if you smell strongly of perfume, fabric softener, hand cream or cigarettes; cards accepted. 2026 reviews: an owner who knows wine well; by the glass, young vintages and new producers; by the bottle, plenty of 1990s Burgundy; Alsace and Rhône; Haba (English spelling), who speaks French; trippa, pasta, white-truffle risotto; ¥15,000–30,000.

食べログ: ラッキー酒場、立ち飲み、大阪市淀川区西中島4-8-1、西中島南方駅か.en: Tabelog: Lucky Sakaba, standing bar, 4-8-1 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 128 m from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; Tue–Sat 17:30–23:00, closed Sun and Mon; reservations accepted; cash only; 18 seats; smoking allowed. Reviews (September 2024 to October 2026): west of Minamikata Station along the tracks, a red front; about ten tables and ten counter seats; no under-18s because of smoking; choose your appetiser from about ten; the menu changes a little every time; sashimi (kinmedai, yellowtail, tuna, sea bream, ishidai, tachiuo, whelk, octopus, red and sweet shrimp, katsuo tataki, mochi katsuo); rare beef tongue with salt and green onion; rare tongue skewers; mino; Gurensu; harami on garlic rice; Niku-sui Daikon; green-onion tempura; hamo tempura; lettuce fried rice; celery kimchi; daikon mapo gratin; Mapo Malony; Ganjang Gejang; uni carbonara; cheap shochu and highballs; about ¥1,000 a dish; two people just under ¥9,000; book at weekends; order by smartphone.

食べログ: ラッフルズ カリー、台東4-29-10 第二さたけビル 1F、仲御徒.en: Tabelog: raffles curry, Taitō 4-29-10, 第二さたけビル 1F; 3 min on foot from Naka-Okachimachi Station, 4 min from Shin-Okachimachi and Ueno-Okachimachi, 5 min from JR Okachimachi; Mon, Wed, Thu, Fri 11:45–16:00 and 18:00–21:30, Tue 11:45–14:00 and 18:00–21:30, Sat 11:45–16:00; closed Sundays and holidays; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 7 counter seats; non-smoking; take-out; Tabelog Curry TOKYO 100 2023, 2024 and 2026. Reviews (October–November 2026): the most popular chicken curry ¥950, vegetable chicken curry ¥950, vegetable keema, mutton curry, two-curry plates ¥1,500–1,600, assorted ¥1,800; mild, not very spicy; a short queue at weekday lunch; in November 2026 it was closed during posted hours with no notice; one diner found the kitchen not clean.

食べログ: ラム・ジェネレーション 西中島店、ジンギスカン・焼肉・居酒屋、大阪市.en: Tabelog: Ram Generation Nishinakajima Ten, jingisukan, yakiniku and izakaya, 4-2-8 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 2 min from the north exit of Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station, 5 min from Hankyu Minamikata Station; Mon–Sat and days before holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:15); irregular days off; reservations accepted (sometimes a two-hour limit); cards and PayPay accepted; 35 seats; private rooms for up to 5 (¥2,000, free for members); non-smoking; children welcome (no children's cutlery); opened 24 November 2020; site hitsuziya.com. Operator site (羊屋総本舗): all lamb is Australian grass-fed, including Roaring Forties lamb; custom thick iron plates; staff grill the lamb chops; sister shop ラム・ストーリーは突然に (Fukushima). Reviews (June–October 2026): thick-cut tongue, chuck eye roll, sirloin, shoulder, rump, kalbi, heart, boneless lamb chops, red wieners, lamb horumon; no gamey smell; vegetables grilled in the lamb fat; salt and wasabi as well as sauce; standard course with all-you-can-drink ¥5,500; a ¥6,970 course; kimchi, salad, "Unmotivated Yakisoba", mini lamb curry, dessert; lunch lamb set (rice and kimchi); hot inside in summer.

食べログ: ラム＆ウイスキー、バー、中京区木屋町三条下ル材木町188-3 光ビル.en: Tabelog: ラム＆ウイスキー (Rum and Whisky), bar; 中京区木屋町三条下ル材木町188-3 光ビル4F; 283 m from Sanjo Station; Mon and Thu–Sun 19:00–2:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; reservations taken; ¥500 charge; 10 seats (8 at the counter, one table for two); smoking allowed; cards accepted (JCB, AMEX, Diners); official site rumlovers.net; opened 30 May 2009. Reviews (2018–2026, in English): a rum specialist bar; shelves full of rum; the owner's recommendations; Rhum J.M Single Barrel; Ardbeg Uigeadail; Captain Morgan; seasonal fruit daiquiri; quiet enough to read a book.

食べログ: ランビアンス ドゥース、東上野2-12-2 岩本ビル1F、仲御徒町駅.en: Tabelog: L'ambiance douce, Higashi-Ueno 2-12-2, 岩本ビル 1F; 3 min on foot from Naka-Okachimachi Station, 5 min from Ueno Station (Hibiya Line) and the JR Okachimachi North Exit; Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat 11:30–14:30 (food L.O. 13:30) and 18:00–22:30 (food L.O. 20:00, drinks L.O. 22:00); Thursday dinner only; closed Mondays and Sundays; bookings by phone (easiest to reach after 14:30); lunch bookings on Saturdays and public holidays only, by phone; groups of five or more by phone only; dinner ¥500 per person (bread and service); at least one drink per person at dinner; no children under junior-high age at dinner; 19 seats (16 at tables, 3 at the counter); non-smoking; cards and PayPay accepted; opened 1 November 2017. Reviews (May 2025–October 2026): a bistro run by one person; all four lunches ¥1,650 with salad and bread; about 10 people queuing before opening; steak haché, grilled pork chuck eye roll, braised pork shank, pork belly with sauerkraut, charcuterie, course dinners with self-service all-you-can-drink.

食べログ: ラ・ゴロセッタ、大阪市中央区南船場2-8-13、心斎橋・長堀橋駅から.en: Tabelog: La Golosetta, 2-8-13 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; walk from Shinsaibashi and Nagahoribashi stations; Tue–Fri and Sun 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–21:00, Sat 18:00–21:00; closed Mondays; cards (VISA, JCB) accepted; 18 seats (ground-floor counter 6, 2nd-floor tables 12). Reviews (June 2023 – October 2026): a cute detached house; an Italian wood-fired oven at the back; pizza stained glass; baked in a few minutes; a chewy, fragrant crust with twisted edges; at lunch from a little over ¥1,000 with salad (watercress and more); about 12 kinds including 2 daily; margherita ¥1,200; diavola ¥1,300 (marinara with spicy salami, chili, garlic; heat adjustable); capricciosa; quattro formaggi; bianca of porcini and smoked mozzarella; anchovy; buffalo mozzarella; bases margherita, marinara (no cheese) and bianca (no tomato); marinated octopus; salami; tiramisu ¥500; beer ¥500; wine; busy after 12:00; one found the salad dressing on the salty side.

食べログ: ラ・セヌ(La Scene)、千代田区内幸町1-5-2 メルキュール.en: Tabelog: La Scene, Uchisaiwaicho 1-5-2, Chiyoda-ku, Mercure Tokyo Hibiya B1F; 77 seats (private and semi-private rooms, sofa seats and more); breakfast 7:00–11:00, lunch 11:30–L.O. 13:30, tea time 13:30–17:30, dinner 17:30–21:30, bar 11:30–22:30; open every day; opened December 19, 2023; particular about vegetables and fish; breakfast available; allergen labeling; vegetarian menu available. 2026 reviews: weekend-only lunch set (one drink, choice of four starters, a main of fish, meat or pasta, free bread refills); seasonal tarts; mango-strawberry tea; truffle fries; from Shinbashi Station exit 7 you can get there underground without getting wet; a bright space with natural light; hotel-style service.

食べログ: ラ・プティ・メルスリー ルミネ有楽町店、千代田区有楽町2-5-1 ル.en: Tabelog: la petite mercerie Lumine Yurakucho, Yurakucho 2-5-1, Chiyoda-ku, Lumine Yurakucho, Lumine 1, 4F; 30 seats; daily 11:00–21:00; closed when Lumine Yurakucho is; opened October 28, 2011; official site la-petite-mercerie.jp. 2026 reviews: raspberry soda; afternoon tea even in the evening without booking; Mercerie afternoon tea (choose your cake; a limited Shine Muscat shortcake); Mélusine shortcake with Japanese strawberries; cheesecake; thick-cut bacon and pumpkin doria; bread at lunch; attentive service.

食べログ: ラ・ボーテ、鍋・イタリアン・ダイニングバー、四谷2-3-19 四谷大.en: Tabelog: La Beaute, hot pot, Italian, dining bar; 四谷大新ビル 2F, Yotsuya 2-3-19; 3 min walk from Exit 2 of Yotsuya Station (Namboku Line), 5 min from the JR Yotsuya exit; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00, Sat and holidays 17:00–23:00; closed Sundays; lunch bookings only for 4 or more or for the lunch hot-pot course; 20 seats (6 at the counter, tables); private hire for 20; non-smoking; cards accepted; the Italian herbal 'Anti-Aging Nabe' with tomato and basil soups; at least 12 vegetables. Reviews (January 2025–May 2026): run by the owner alone, herbal two-soup lunch ¥900–1,000, 14-grain rice, a beauty hot pot of soft-shell turtle and chicken bone, a curry-and-salt detox hot pot, risotto or porridge to finish, homemade ice cream from over 300 recipes, herbal sake.

食べログ: ラ・メゾン・ド・ビィ、銀座5-5-12 HULIC&New GINZ.en: Tabelog: La Maison de Bi, Ginza 5-5-12, HULIC & New GINZA MIYUKI5 9F, 5 minutes from Ginza Station; 20 seats, private rooms (2 and 4); Tue–Fri 12:00–20:00, weekends and holidays 11:00–20:00, closed Mon; 10% service charge after 18:00; cards and IC accepted; organic afternoon tea from ¥15,000. Reviews (2025–2026): sweets beyond additive-free; a parfait of Amazon cacao and Balangon bananas; Shine Muscat parfait; light-roast coffee from Kenya and Geisha; hojicha financiers; lunch and dinner courses; a chef who started as a pâtissier.

食べログ: ラーメン EBI パチ、大阪市中央区日本橋2-12-23、近鉄日本橋.en: Tabelog: Ramen EBI Pachi, 2-12-23 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 275 m from Kintetsu Nippombashi Station; daily 11:00–14:30 and 17:30–22:00; irregular closing days; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking; counter seats; opened 29 April 2022. Reviews (February–October 2026): many tourists; pay afterwards; Kiwami Kuromon shoyu ramen ¥1,350; choice of chashu: thick-cut pork belly, pork shoulder or beef fat; chicken bones and pork bones with shrimp and scallop; a tare blending several shoyu; one says the shoyu is strong and the shrimp hard to taste; medium-thin noodles of Mie's Ayahikari wheat; big wontons; near Kuromon Market; special shrimp salt; self-serve water; counter only; a clear soup; found closed several times; shrimp flavour; on Kuromon's Nippombashi 2-chome street; a vinyl noren; shrimp salt ¥950; light and gentle; special shrimp salt ¥1,350; sweet-shrimp extract; medium-thin wavy noodles; bean sprouts; yuzu; menu (shrimp salt, shrimp shoyu, Kuromon shoyu, Kuromon tori paitan, Kuromon spicy tori paitan, shrimp miso); pepper, shichimi, sesame and vinegar on the table; 9 counter seats; the owner and one staff member.

食べログ: ラーメン フクロウ、大阪市天王寺区舟橋町15-24、鶴橋から181m.en: Tabelog: Ramen Fukurou, 15-24 Funahashicho, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 181 m from Tsuruhashi; daily 11:00–14:00 and 18:00–22:00; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; opened 1 November 2019. Reviews (2021–2026): Jiro style with emulsified tonkotsu; slightly sweet, not too salty; one calls it the best Jiro style in Kansai; the second brand of Menya Fukuhara in Higashinari; soup made with a Robot-Coupe; medium-thick flat straight noodles, smooth rather than chewy; tender chashu; mini 150 g ¥1,000, 200 g ¥1,100, 250 g +¥100, 300 g +¥150; miso ramen ¥1,050; soupless; tsukemen; summer hiyashi chuka; extra slice of chashu +¥200; spicy meat miso +¥200; quail eggs; raw egg; extra vegetables on a separate plate +¥150; toppings chosen on the touch-panel ticket machine, no calls; cash only from 30 January 2026; queues of 10–20 at opening; a narrow pavement busy with bicycles, so queue without blocking the entrance; a clean shop; one says extra vegetables dilute the soup; one says taste and serving time vary by staff; vinegar, fish powder, pepper and chili on the table.

食べログ: ラーメン 大志、ラーメン、下京区河原町通松原上ル清水町281-1、阪.en: Tabelog: ラーメン 大志 (Ramen Taishi), ramen; 下京区河原町通松原上ル清水町281-1; 5 min on foot from Hankyu Kawaramachi and Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojo Stations; daily 11:00–22:30; closing days vary; no reservations; cards accepted; 12 seats (8 at the counter, a table for 4); non-smoking; English and Chinese menus; English-speaking staff; opened 1 November 2025. Reviews (2025–2026, in English): back-fat pork-bone shoyu ramen ¥930; thin straight noodles; seasoned egg ¥150; grilled gyoza ¥400; rice ¥250; small bottled beer ¥550; mazesoba ¥950; shio ramen too; ticket machine.
