食べログ: ラーメン 横綱 NAMBAなんなん店、大阪市中央区難波5 なんなんタ.en: Tabelog: Ramen Yokozuna NAMBA Nannan, NAMBA Nannan B1F, Nannan Town 11, 5 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6616-9827; no reservations; daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:45); cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 35 seats; no smoking; opened 19 June 2017; official 4527.com. 2026 reviews (August–September): a small ramen and menma to finish off daytime drinking; unlimited leek; one wished the soup had more depth; choice of noodle firmness and fast service; quick-drink set (draught beer with chashu, menma, seasoned egg, leek and kimchi platter) plus ramen ¥1,380; right by the subway Namba Station ticket gates; at the far end of Nannan Town; one calls it ordinary; chashu-men; ramen and fried rice set ¥1,220; just the right richness.

食べログ: ラーメン 男塾!! 日本橋店、大阪市浪速区日本橋4-15-23、なん.en: Tabelog: Ramen Otokojuku!! Nippombashi, 4-15-23 Nippombashi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 387 m from Namba Station; daily 11:00–22:30; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking; opened 7 November 2017. Reviews (January–September 2026): Jiro style on Otaroad; Jukucho ramen with medium noodles; a punchy soup; regretted asking for fewer vegetables; the garlic is very hot; soupless with grated cheese; one member of staff, so a wait; 20–30 minutes' wait on Sundays; call for vegetables, fat and garlic; garlic can be swapped for ginger; fewer noodles and more vegetables recommended for women; kombu salt on the bean sprouts is superb; thick chashu; recommended for Jiro-style beginners too; soupless miso Jukucho ramen ¥1,060; lots of garlic; spicy Jukucho ramen (regular) ¥1,100; extra vegetables, fat and garlic free; one found the seating instructions curt.

食べログ: ラーメン、中京区式部町259 舟木ビル 1F、毎日11:00〜15:.en: Tabelog: ramen; 舟木ビル 1F, Nakagyo-ku; every day 11:00–15:00 and 16:00–21:00; no bookings; cards and QR accepted; no e-money; counter; no smoking; opened 1 July 2023. Reviews (October 2023 – August 2026, in English): from Shindaita, Tokyo; green curry ramen ¥1,200 (¥1,700 in July 2026); tom yum kung ramen ¥1,200; laksa ramen ¥1,300; cold versions too; coriander ¥200; seasoned egg ¥200; chicken chashu ¥250; chashu rice bowl ¥600; cheese risotto to finish; medium-thick curly noodles; ticket machine; the entrance is hard to find.

食べログ: ラーメンすりぃ はなれ、大阪市西区江戸堀1-16-31、肥後橋駅から.en: Tabelog: Ramen ThreE HANARE, 1-16-31 Edobori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Higobashi Station; Mon–Fri 7:00–11:00, 11:15–15:00 and 17:30–23:00, Sat and holidays 11:15–15:00; closed Sundays; cards (VISA, Master), transit IC, iD and QR (including Alipay and WeChat Pay) accepted; 10 counter seats; opened 15 October 2025. October 2026 reviews: a light seafood soup of shellfish, scallop and dried goods; medium-thin straight low-hydration noodles; low-temperature chicken, skin-on grilled chicken and rare pork-loin chashu; chenpi, shichimi and sansho on the table; special B topping; the roast-pork rice bowl with sesame oil; morning ramen ¥650 (shoyu, shellfish, chicken shoyu) with free egg-on-rice or natto rice; register on LINE and get a free bowl after 3; shellfish and Kyoto bonito chuka soba; rich tonkotsu shoyu ramen; creamy pork-salt ramen with shellfish soup and a small chashu-mayo rice; a stylish interior; kind staff; queues; one found the morning bowl a little salty.

食べログ: ラーメンつけ麺 笑福 大阪西中島店、ラーメン・つけ麺、大阪市淀川区西.en: Tabelog: Ramen Tsukemen Shofuku Oosaka Nishinakajima Ten, ramen and tsukemen, 三信南方ビルII 1F, 1-13-13 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 1 min from Minamikata and Nishinakajima-Minamigata stations; daily 11:00–24:00 (until sold out); open all year; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 counter seats; non-smoking; children welcome; opened 30 November 2009. Reviews (May to October 2026): Jiro style; choose the amount of noodles, vegetables, garlic, fat and katsuobushi; extras set at the ticket machine; ramen (200 g noodles, two slices of pork) ¥950; pork ramen ¥1,200; miso ramen; smaller noodles come with a soft-boiled egg; the vegetables are mostly bean sprouts; katsuobushi on top is unusual; "Katsuo Baka Mashi" was gone by September 2026; some say taste and portion change with who is cooking; water in a big mug.

食べログ: ラーメンまこと屋 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-6-16(御堂筋.en: Tabelog: Ramen Makotoya Shinsaibashi, 2-6-16 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka (third shop east of Mitsu-dera from Midosuji); 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; 18 seats (counter); open 24 hours; no reservations; opened 27 November 2011. 2026 reviews: beef-bone ramen for when you want something other than miso, shoyu or salt; the aroma and sweetness of beef; red spicy-miso beef paitan with fried rice; red bowls; soft-boiled egg, chashu, wood-ear, bean sprouts, leek and a special spicy sauce; a stimulating heat; ticket machine; Morioka reimen ¥1,010; the queue is for the malatang shop next door; a rich, smooth beef-bone soup; not too heavy; thin noodles; tender chashu; a bowl after drinking; choice of noodle firmness; white sesame, raw garlic, red pickled ginger and garlic chips on the table; rich but not cloying.

食べログ: ラーメンスタンド メン ボックス、大阪市中央区久太郎町1-9-6 1.en: Tabelog: Ramen Stand MEN BOX, 1F, 1-9-6 Kyutaromachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station exit 6; Mon–Sat 11:00–14:30 and 18:00–22:00; closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; 15 seats (counter 7, two tables for 2, one for 4); no smoking; opened 20 November 2019. Reviews (September–October 2026): chicken-pork salt ramen large ¥1,100; spicy nira on the table; chicken-pork shoyu ramen ¥1,000; chewy, smooth noodles; balance of chicken and pork umami with shoyu; thin-sliced chashu; 80% full at 13:30 on a Friday; a good staff vibe; hip-hop playing; one found it a little salty; house-made straight noodles; 2 slices chashu; menma; chopped white leek; mitsuba; lively, courteous service; choose rice size at lunch for ¥100; pickled garlic and mayonnaise; chicken salt and chicken shoyu; maze-soba; busy with local office workers; devil's garlic.

食べログ: ラーメン・まぜそば SiO Style、大阪市阿倍野区阿倍野筋1-6.en: Tabelog: Ramen & Mazesoba SiO Style, Via Abeno Walk 1F, 1-6-1 Abenosuji, Abeno-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from JR Tennoji Station south exit, 3 from subway Tennoji Station exit 12; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:30–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); closed Wednesdays; no reservations; no cards or e-money; QR (PayPay, Rakuten Pay, au PAY) accepted; 19 seats; opened 16 April 2021. Reviews (September–October 2026): Asari SiO ramen (a creamy soup of pork bones, chicken and clams; gentle salt; thin straight noodles; radish sprouts; chopped onion); the special adds pink rare chashu, thick grilled chashu and seasoned egg; many order the SiO lemon maze-soba; summer cold kama-tama; karaage set; salts from around the world and black pepper on the table; a slice of rare chashu for following on Instagram; one found it oily with little clam flavour; another found it light and gentle; hand over the meal ticket; about 10 minutes' wait at lunch; easy to visit alone.

食べログ: ラーメン・ダイニングバー、中京区河原町六角東入山崎町258-24、京.en: Tabelog: ramen, dining bar; 河原町六角東入山崎町258-24, Nakagyo-ku; 4 min walk from Exit 6 of Keihan Sanjo Stn; Monday 18:00–24:00; Tuesday–Friday 0:00–6:00 and 18:00–24:00; Saturday, Sunday 0:00–6:00, 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–24:00; reservations accepted; 19 seats; non-smoking (ashtrays outside); cards, e-money and QR accepted. Reviews (March–September 2026, in English): Kyokara Men with a spice level you choose (5 is about Shin Ramyun); Chinese or konjac noodles; garlic; cilantro; egg; tomato; gyoza; shiso gyoza; cartilage; fried rice ¥715; open until dawn; a report of a wrong order.

食べログ: ラーメン人生JET600、大阪市東成区東小橋1-3-2、JR玉造駅か.en: Tabelog: Ramen Jinsei JET600, 1-3-2 Higashi-Obase, Higashinari-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from JR Tamatsukuri Station; daily 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed over New Year; no cards, e-money or QR; 17 seats (counter 9, two tables for 4); ashtray outside; opened 18 July 2011. Reviews (July–October 2026): a shop of Ramen Jinsei JET in Fukushima-ku; a popular shop with queues; tori soba of ultra-rich tori paitan from chicken bones and old hens boiled over 10 hours, deepened with seafood; special shoyu; house-made medium-thick straight noodles of domestic wheat; thin chashu; menma; naruto; white leek; mitsuba; seasoned egg; shoyu ramen (special ¥1,400 with 4 slices chashu and seasoned egg); Aburi Buta Soba ¥950; curry ramen; limited Royal Pork chashu-men ¥1,700 (Kirishima pork); Royal Pork back-fat noodles; summer zaru soba; pork rice; bottled beer ¥600; ticket machine at the entrance; one felt the shoyu wasn't worth the price.

食べログ: ラーメン坐 裕冬、ラーメン・油そば・まぜそば、大阪市淀川区西中島5-.en: Tabelog: Ramenza Yuto; ramen, abura soba, mazesoba; 5-8-26 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 359 m from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; daily 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:40) and 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); cash only; 20 seats (tables only); non-smoking; opened 22 June 2021. Reviews (December 2021 to October 2026): ticket machine at the entrance; choose noodle weight, thick or thin noodles, vegetables (bean sprouts and cabbage), back fat and sauce; garlic on request; cayenne pepper and vinegar on the table; niboshi ramen with seasoned egg ¥1,070; mini chashu rice bowl ¥400; niboshi and bonito ramen ¥990; tonkotsu ramen ¥1,040; shoyu abura soba ¥990; shio abura soba; raw egg ¥80; rice ¥100; the 10th of each month is Yuto Day; full of office workers at lunch; the same taste as a closed shop in Abeno Lucias; some find the niboshi powdery.

食べログ: ラーメン河縁、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町3-5、24時間営業、禁煙、カー.en: Tabelog: Ramen Kawaberi, 3-5 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka; open 24 hours; no smoking; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; opened 6 December 2025. 2026 reviews (April–September): tonkotsu ramen ¥980 (3 slices chashu and soft-boiled egg); free noodle refills (limited period); near Nippombashi Station; tables and counter; the miso ramen is a miso version of the tonkotsu; ticket machine; set menus; on the former site of Daikichi Ramen; free kimchi with an order; tsukemen (medium-thin straight noodles; one wished the dipping soup were stronger); special ramen and karaage set ¥1,400; leek ramen ¥1,080; pan-fried gyoza ¥450; fried rice ¥600; chashu rice bowl ¥600; rich but not heavy; lots of leek; 4:30 a.m.; Sichuan ramen (spicy and creamy); special ramen about ¥1,000 (seasoned egg, chashu, bean sprouts, wood-ear); fluffy fried rice with chashu.

食べログ: ラーメン荘 歴史を刻め 日本橋店、大阪市浪速区日本橋5-14-20、.en: Tabelog: Ramen So Rekishi o Kizame Nippombashi, 5-14-20 Nippombashi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 81 m from Ebisucho Station; Mon–Sat 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–23:00; closed Sundays; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; opened 28 January 2024. Reviews (July–October 2026): 40–50 waiting at 18:00, about an hour; 300 g with everything extra; the heat and flavour of the soup; staff check you can manage the noodle amount; soupless; considerate to those queuing; easy for beginners; 200 g with less garlic, vegetables and fat; soupless 200 g with extra garlic; one says the last in line is around 21:40; about 15 people, 40 minutes; buy tickets while queuing; 150 g with no fat, less garlic, extra vegetables; lively staff calls; the soup too strong to finish; about 20 people even at 14:00 in the rain; thick noodles; a mountain of bean sprouts; a rich shoyu-based pork soup; sweetness of back fat; over 50 waiting at the 11:00 opening; double pork, cheese, egg; 400 g; a no-leftovers rule; the noodle pot cleaned often; crisp bean sprouts.

食べログ: ラーメン薩摩、大阪市中央区道頓堀一丁目東5-26 道頓堀ビル1F、0.en: Tabelog: Ramen Satsuma, Dotonbori Bldg 1F, 5-26 Dotonbori 1-chome Higashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6213-7775; no reservations; Mon–Thu and Sun 11:00–4:00 next morning, Fri–Sat 24 hours; no cards, e-money or QR; 10 seats (a table for 4); no smoking; opened 28 June 2012. 2026 reviews (August–October): chashu-men; came for the chashu; large ramen (with garlic) ¥1,380; kimchi ¥400; thin noodles and a rich, mellow soup; ramen ¥1,100; medium-thin straight noodles; light shoyu tonkotsu; asked about garlic when ordering; powerful garlic; thick moist chashu; recalls Satsumakko in Dotonbori; one says it's poor value; fried rice; open even at 4 a.m.

食べログ: ラーメン虎と龍 日本橋店、大阪市中央区高津3-2-33、近鉄日本橋か.en: Tabelog: Ramen Tora to Ryu Nippombashi, 3-2-33 Kozu, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 352 m from Kintetsu Nippombashi; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sat 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00, Sun 11:00–15:00; closed Wednesdays; QR accepted, no cards or e-money; smoking allowed; opened 7 July 2010. Reviews (January–June 2026): lunch service; ticket machine; rich tonkotsu Hakuryu ¥900; lunch rice ¥150; extra-thin straight noodles, firm; shoyu-based tonkotsu; slightly oily; just-right saltiness; red pickled ginger, spicy takana, ground sesame; 13 counter seats; run single-handed; the owner changed in August 2025 and so did the hours; white, red and black; Hakata-style White Tiger; Kurume tonkotsu; chashu, wood-ear, leek; red spicy miso; garlicky gyoza; Kuro Ryu with rice and karaage set; fast service; tonkotsu with black mayu; thin fatty chashu; noodle refills.

食べログ: ラーメン長山、根岸1-3-21、JR鶯谷駅南口から徒歩3分、火〜土1.en: Tabelog: Ramen Nagayama, Negishi 1-3-21; 3 min on foot from the JR Uguisudani South Exit; Tue–Sat 11:00–23:50, Sun 11:00–22:00; closed Mondays; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 counter seats; smoking allowed (no smoking 12:00–13:00); opened 15 December 2007. Reviews (September–November 2026): a thick, creamy chicken-paitan and pork-bone broth; ramen ¥950; seasoned-egg chashu ramen ¥1,350; miso, shoyu, tsukemen; free large size (tsukemen up to 400 g); thick or thin noodles; shichimi, pepper, chilli miso, garlic and doubanjiang on the counter; one person running the shop at night; one diner found the broth average.

食べログ: ラーメン革命、大阪市中央区南船場1-15-5、長堀橋駅から356m、.en: Tabelog: Ramen Kakumei, 1-15-5 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 356 m from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Sat 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30), Sun 11:00–15:00; opened 5 February 2024; no cards, e-money or QR; 24 seats (counter 6, tables 18); children welcome; Instagram. Reviews (July 2025 – September 2026): 5 aged-shoyu ramen (normal, bonito, yuzu ¥900, back fat (back-fat seasoned egg ¥1,020), black); a soup of chicken bones and seafood; iekei tonkotsu; rich back fat; rich tantanmen; seasonal limited editions (cold ago-dashi ramen ¥950 with duck chashu, summer 2026); frothy shrimp ramen; medium-thick straight noodles; black pepper, shichimi, special shoyu and spicy nira on the table; chashu rice bowl; stamp card; lively, efficient staff; one says light even with back fat.

食べログ: ラール・エ・ラ・マニエール、銀座3-4-17 オプティカB1F(無印.en: Tabelog: L'art et la Manière, Ginza 3-4-17, Optica B1F (behind MUJI, opposite MUJI HOTEL GINZA), 3 minutes from Ginza-itchome Station; 20 seats; Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 17:30–23:00, Wed, weekends and holidays 11:30–15:00, 18:00–23:00 (the shop introduction says closed Sun and Mon, with irregular holidays); opened September 1, 2009; cards, IC and QR accepted. Chef profile (English): chef Koshikubota, after MAZ (Central) and L'Arpège, took over in October 2023. 2026 reviews: 17 years in Ginza; a crêpe with sweet soybean espuma; ojo masa and Roquefort; bonito; persimmon and foie gras; beef tongue and Comté; scale-grilled ayu; venison; Menu Saison ¥19,800–20,000; a change of sommelier; ¥20,000–40,000.

食べログ: ラー麺 ずんどう屋 宗右衛門町店、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町7-16、な.en: Tabelog: Ramen Zundouya Soemoncho, 7-16 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 342 m from Namba Station; Mon 0:00–7:00 and 9:00–24:00, Tue–Sun 24 hours; reservations accepted; opened 22 November 2022; official site zundouya.com. 2025–2026 reviews: the air conditioning broke; leek ramen with wavy noodles ¥980 and bean sprouts ¥110; cold seasoned-egg grated-daikon large ¥1,200; seasoned egg with small fried rice set; Motoaji at half price for the anniversary festival; thin noodles, light, firm; noodle refills; free takana; red pickled ginger and sesame on the table; careful even when busy; handy late at night; gyoza; unlimited takana; garlic on the table; back-fat soup; fried rice; overseas staff; grated garlic and red pickled ginger; plump boiled gyoza; morning ramen in Soemoncho at 6 a.m.; free noodle-refill offer; spicy noodles.

食べログ: ラー麺 ずんどう屋 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-5-7 セーナ.en: Tabelog: Ramen Zundouya Shinsaibashi, Sena Bldg 1F, 1-5-7 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 32 seats (counter 17, 3 tables, booth seats); open 24 hours (lunch 11:00–16:00; on the monthly maintenance day 11:00–3:00 next morning); open every day of the year; listed as smoking allowed; cards accepted; opened 8 April 2011; official zundouya.com. 2026 reviews (August–October): ramen at 8 a.m.; terrace seats; seasoned-egg ramen; extra back fat, firm noodles; rich, heavy tonkotsu; thin firm noodles; garlic, red pickled ginger and pepper on the table; fluffy fried rice; open late; ticket machine at the entrance; garlic fried rice recommended; one says it was non-smoking (September); lunch is sets only, with seasoned egg; vegetable ramen with small fried rice ¥1,400; thin or wavy noodles; back fat light, regular, rich or super rich; firmness soft, regular, firm or very firm; born in Himeji.

食べログ: ラー麺 ずんどう屋 難波えびす橋店、大阪市中央区難波1-6-8 難波.en: Tabelog: Ramen Zundouya Namba Ebisubashi, Namba Monzo Bldg 1F, 1-6-8 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 163 m from Namba Station; open 24 hours; no reservations; opened 18 November 2021; official site zundouya.com. 2026 reviews: counter and tables; cold ramen and half fried rice; fried rice and spicy takana; rich but not heavy tonkotsu; choice of back fat and noodle firmness; thin noodles; HOT and bean sprouts; noodle refills; busy with young diners even at 10 p.m.; rich Himeji-born tonkotsu; house-made noodles; creamy from back fat yet mellow; wavy noodles; easy late at night; seasoned-egg ramen large ¥1,070, double wood-ear ¥220; thin or wavy noodles; back fat (light, regular, rich, extra rich); noodle firmness (soft to very firm); per the official site, pork bones are boiled on high heat for about 10 hours.

食べログ: ラー麺ずんどう屋 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町7-6、なんば駅か.en: Tabelog: Ramen Zundouya Dotonbori, 7-6 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 277 m from Namba Station; open 24 hours; no reservations; opened 31 October 2025; official site zundouya.com. Reviews (October 2025 – September 2026): a new branch of a chain headquartered in Himeji; Motoaji ramen ¥860 (tonkotsu shoyu with back fat); extra-thin straight noodles 2.00 mm; pork-belly chashu, leek, nori; menu (chashu ¥1,400, seasoned egg ¥980, leek ¥980, HOT ¥930, everything-on ¥1,360, vegetables ¥1,060, butter corn and more); noodle refill ¥150; back fat in four levels (light, regular, rich, extra rich); choice of thin or wavy noodles; pepper, red pickled ginger, garlic, chili oil, sesame and takana on the table; 106 shops in Japan and 4 in Shanghai; everything-on chashu and the festival set (gyoza and karaage); Soemoncho, east of Ebisubashi; Himeji tonkotsu adjusted for Kansai, faintly sweet; rich but not heavy late at night; firm noodles and a large sheet of nori; cold grated-daikon ramen ¥960 bought at the ticket machine with a transit IC card; upstairs dining room.

食べログ: ラー麺マン、大阪市中央区平野町1-4-6、北浜駅から465m、営業時.en: Tabelog: Ramen Man, 1-4-6 Hiranomachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 465 m from Kitahama; no opening hours listed; no cards, e-money or QR; smoking allowed; 15 seats (3 tables, 4–5 at the counter). Reviews (May 2024 – March 2026): the feel of an old-style Chinese restaurant; run single-handed; Ramen Man (tonkotsu shoyu with sliced and coarse-ground chili; chopped garlic optional; bean sprouts; leek); chashu-men (8–9 small slices of pork-belly chashu; heat 2 or 3); Ramen Man set meal with rice and kimchi ¥1,000; lunchtime shoyu ramen set meal ¥800; miso chashu; Korean ramen; gyoza; medium-thin wavy noodles; some surprised that smoking is allowed inside.

食べログ: リストランテクロディーノ(ristorante KURODINO)、.en: Tabelog: ristorante KURODINO, Ginza 3-4-17, Ginza Optica 6F; 24 seats, private room; Mon–Sat 18:00–23:30, closed Sundays, holidays and 1st and 3rd Mondays; 10% service charge; opened June 14, 2011; official site kurodino.com. Shop introduction: owner Keisuke Kuroda, chef Kouichi Maruyama (English spellings); over 500 bottles and about 20 by the glass; pairings; non-alcoholic cocktails; handmade pasta; course ¥12,000 (MENU GIURIA). 2026 reviews: conger-eel carpione with stewed summer vegetables and salsa verde; fregnacce with veal ragù; roast Kyoto duck with passion-fruit sauce; turnip-greens soup; pistachio pasta; adapts to your tastes; careful explanations of food and wine; business entertaining in the private room.

食べログ: リュストル、港区六本木7-13-10 トーマスビルB1F、日比谷線六.en: Tabelog: Lustre, Roppongi 7-13-10, トーマスビル B1F, 2 min walk from Roppongi Station exit 4b (Hibiya line) or exit 7 (Oedo line); Tue 18:00–22:30 (food L.O. 20:00); Wed–Sat 12:00–15:00 (L.O. 13:00) and 18:00–22:30; closed Sundays and Mondays; holidays follow the weekday; 10% service charge; 18 seats (counter 6, private rooms of 8 and 4; ¥22,000 to use a room with fewer than 4); non-smoking; cards accepted. Shop text: chef Karasawa (cooking since 2003, trained at Ginza Le Can and Esquisse; umami of kombu and fish sauce); sommelier Kudo (Tour d'Argent Tokyo, Apicius); Lladró decor and chandeliers. Reviews (February–September 2026): lunch course ¥7,700 and pairing ¥6,600; dinner course ¥22,000; "umami French"; kataifi scallop with Kanzuri sauce; Ezo abalone beignet; managatsuo with beurre blanc; Sisteron lamb; a kombu-based non-alcoholic pairing; expensive wine; one says the chef's hometown is Niigata; opened autumn 2025.

食べログ: リロ コーヒー ロースターズ、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-10-28 心.en: Tabelog: LiLo Coffee Roasters, Shinsaibashi M Bldg 1F, 1-10-28 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon and Wed–Sun 11:00–23:00, Tue 11:00–20:00; no reservations; no cards or e-money; QR accepted; smoking on the terrace only; 18 seats; takeaway; opened 8 August 2014; about 20 coffees from light to dark roast; baristas choose to suit your taste; beans, equipment and original goods for sale; official site. Reviews (April–August 2026): careful explanations of the beans; a berry-like Ethiopian; light-roast Colombian with Geisha ¥1,700; infused coffee (one found it so-so); caffè mocha; hot chai latte; a message card on the cup; colourful bean cards; queues on Saturday afternoons.

食べログ: ル カフェ ヴィー (LE CAFE V)、カフェ・バー・チョコレー.en: Tabelog: LE CAFE V, café, bar and chocolate, Louis Vuitton Maison Osaka Midosuji 7F, Shinsaibashi-suji 2-8-16, Chuo-ku, Osaka, daily 11:00–20:00 (last order 19:00), no reservations, 10% service charge, cards accepted, no e-money or QR, counter, sofa seating and an open terrace, non-smoking, opened 1 February 2020. Reviews (June–October 2026): a lift from an entrance separate from the store, monogram latte art, mille-feuille made to order ¥3,500, iced V Café latte ¥2,000, chocolate, vanilla and hazelnut gateaux, Yame matcha tiramisu, chocolate tart, milk tea, special lunch course ¥20,000 with a ¥14,000 pairing, seafood gratin, pasta, takeaway chocolates reserved through TableCheck, friendly staff, high prices.

食べログ: ル スーリール ダンジュ、新橋1-10-2 植田ビル4F、新橋駅から.en: Tabelog: Le Sourire d'Ange, Shinbashi 1-10-2, 植田 Building 4F, 1 minute from Shinbashi Station; 11 seats; weekdays and holidays 18:00–23:00, closed weekends; lunch only when 4 or more book the ¥11,000 course; charge ¥900; cards accepted (including UnionPay). Reviews (2024–2026): the owner-chef (from Kyushu) runs it alone; an hors d'oeuvre course (prosciutto with pear, paprika mousse with snow crab, foie gras terrine, whelk and mushrooms, ris de veau); generous portions, adjustable; in February 2026, 5 à la carte dishes and 2 drinks for ¥6,600; karasumi pasta; "the miracle of Shinbashi".

食べログ: ル・ピノー 北堀江本店 (LE PINEAU)、大阪市西区北堀江2-.en: Tabelog: Le Pineau Kita-Horie main store (LE PINEAU), Maison de L Kitahorie 1F, Kita-Horie 2-4-12, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min from Nishi-Ohashi Stn, 7 min from Yotsubashi Stn; daily 9:00–20:00; closed New Year's Day; no reservations; one drink per person in the café; cards, transport IC, iD, PayPay, d Barai and au PAY accepted; 9 seats; non-smoking; children welcome; takeout; Tabelog Sweets WEST Top 100 in 2020, 2022, 2023 and 2026. Official site: a shop born in Osaka; Kita-Horie main store, Tamatsukuri, Umeda Hanshin and Umekita Green Place. Reviews (2023–October 2026): Mont Blanc (with chopped chestnut; a seasonal pumpkin Mont Blanc too), classic chocolat, Gâteau Fraise, strawberry tart on pie crust, soufflé fromage and soufflé chocolat, cream puffs, fig shortcake, the "Kuro" chocolate cake, berry panna cotta, Iyo-orange rare cheesecake, Sunao pudding, chocolate cookie (bitter, 60% cacao) ¥270, morning sets of avocado or tuna-and-cheese toast, chai, lines at Halloween and Christmas, 32nd anniversary in April 2023, fair prices and generous sizes.

食べログ: ル・ボヌール、銀座6-3-9 Sun-mi高松3F、銀座駅徒歩3分、.en: Tabelog: Le Bonheur, Ginza 6-3-9, Sun-mi 高松 3F, 3 minutes from Ginza Station; 52 seats; tatami rooms; weekdays 11:00–14:30, 17:00–21:30, weekends and holidays 11:00–15:00, 17:00–20:30; open every day except New Year; children welcome; official site takamatsu-inc.co.jp. Shop introduction: proper French with seasonal ingredients; traditional nouvelle cuisine made modern; a chef with long experience; carefully chosen luxury ingredients; dinner courses from ¥11,000 (anniversary and steak courses); lunch courses from ¥3,850; a 10-story restaurant building, "Sun-mi Honten", with a concierge on 1F to guide you. Reviews: almost all private rooms, suited to business talks and family introductions; classic French of abalone, lobster, foie gras and wagyu; white-fish croquette amuse (2022); at lunch in March 2026, pricey but worth it for the quality.

食べログ: レ セゾン、千代田区内幸町1-1-1 帝国ホテル東京 本館中2F、日.en: Tabelog: Les Saisons, Uchisaiwaicho 1-1-1, Chiyoda-ku, Imperial Hotel Tokyo main building mezzanine 2F, 3 minutes from Hibiya Station; 94 seats; daily lunch 11:30–14:30, dinner 17:30–22:00; open every day; 15% service charge. October 2026 reviews: seasonal breakfast ¥6,700; the famous autumn-only mushroom soup; blue lobster; a five-dish lunch course; a course with Champagne and three glasses of white and red about ¥39,000; creative French with Japanese ingredients; careful explanations of ingredients; the chef comes to greet you; generous portions; 10% off with an Imperial Club card or a stay; dinner gets full.

食べログ: レスカモトゥール バー (L'ESCAMOTEUR BAR)、バー、.en: Tabelog: レスカモトゥール バー (L'ESCAMOTEUR BAR), bar; 斎藤町138番地9, 2F, south of Shijo on 西石垣通, Shimogyo-ku; 5 min walk from Kyoto Kawaramachi Station; Tuesday–Sunday 19:00–1:00; closed Monday; no reservations; 12 seats; smoking allowed; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR accepted; opened 14 February 2015. Reviews (January 2024–February 2026, in English): a magic bar; the owner is Christoph, a professional magician; STAGE MAGIC cocktails (ALCHEMY, FIRE, SMOKE, BANG); ¥2,000–2,500 a drink, service included; many guests and staff from overseas; a queue before opening.

食べログ: レストラン ブラス、港区新橋1-5-5 国際善隣會館B1F、新橋駅1.en: Tabelog: Restaurant Brass, Shinbashi 1-5-5, Minato-ku, 国際善隣會館 B1F, 1 minute from Shinbashi Station exit 1; 40 seats (semi-private rooms); Mon–Fri 17:00–5:00, weekends and holidays groups of 15+ only; charge. Reviews (2025–2026): a Western-style izakaya in Shinbashi and Ginza since 1964; a haven for office workers; potato salad; red octopus-shaped sausages; demi-glace hamburg steak; thick ginger pork; pork steak; curry pizza; Napolitan; fluffy egg sandwich; recommendations marked ☆; a big basement room; spinach sautéed in butter; cheerful staff; good for a second round too.

食べログ: レストラン早川(ハヤカワ)、銀座4-10-7、東銀座駅から徒歩1分、.en: Tabelog: Restaurant Hayakawa, Ginza 4-10-7, 1 minute from Higashi-Ginza Station; Mon–Thu 11:30–15:00, 18:00–20:00, Fri 11:30–15:00, closed weekends and holidays; 12 seats. aumo: a long-established yōshoku restaurant founded in Showa 11 (1936); food samples; a black rotary phone inside. 2026 reviews: opposite the Kabukiza; four tables and a counter; shared tables; pork sauté ¥1,200, large +¥200; ginger-pork set ¥1,300 (ketchup spaghetti, miso soup with fried tofu); tonkatsu ¥1,300; katsu curry (smallish); miso soup ¥100; cash only; run by a married couple (the husband in the kitchen and a woman on the floor).

食べログ: レストラン＆バー バルクト、イタリアン・カフェ・ピザ、大阪市中央区宗.en: Tabelog: restaurant & bar BARKT, Italian, café and pizza, Holiday Inn Osaka 1F, Soemoncho 5-15, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 minutes from Namba Station, 3 minutes from Nipponbashi; daily 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 17:00–23:30 (food L.O. 22:30, drinks L.O. 23:00, courses until 20:30); open year-round; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 88 seats (60 inside, 28 on the terrace); private rooms for 6–8; couple seats; smoking allowed on the terrace; vegetarian options shown. Shimane wagyu lunch with sommelier-chosen wine and sake pairings; Italian dinner. Reviews (July–October 2026): anniversary course (five appetisers, rare salmon katsu, pasta, roast domestic beef fillet with Madeira sauce, cake with sparklers), fresh-pasta amatriciana lunch ¥1,500, funghi ¥1,500, seasonal fruit with buffalo mozzarella, Caesar salad, Margherita, Genovese with wild shrimp and potato, bisque, beef shoulder steak, one reviewer found the pasta short on sauce. The Holiday Inn Osaka Namba's restaurant (ikyu).

食べログ: レ・コパン ドゥ ドミニク・ブシェ、銀座5-1-8 銀座MSビルB1.en: Tabelog: Les Copains de Dominique Bouchet, Ginza 5-1-8, Ginza MS Building B1F, 3 minutes from Ginza Station exits C2/C3; 26 seats (tables only); daily 11:30–15:00, 18:00–23:00 (last entry 20:00); closed all of August and at New Year; opened June 27, 2016; official site lescopains.jp. Shop introduction: bistronomy carrying on the techniques of Michelin-starred French cooking; Dominique Bouchet's culinary philosophy; open kitchen. 2026 reviews: prix-fixe where you can choose both fish and meat; Tosa bonito with mustard; chestnut and truffle soup; sea bream with beef sauce; French staff and the sommelier choose wine; good for celebrations; French Restaurant Week ¥6,000 lunch (shrimp and basil beignets, swordfish, chicken and mushroom pie, pear tart); pâté; bouillabaisse; part of the Dominique Bouchet group.

食べログ: レ・フレール・アオキ、銀座3-12-6 1F、東銀座駅から徒歩5分、.en: Tabelog: LES FRÈRES AOKI, Ginza 3-12-6 1F, 5 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station; 10 seats; Tue–Fri 12:00–14:30, 18:30–22:30, weekends lunch and dinner (shorter), holidays dinner only, closed Mon; opened September 7, 2021; cards accepted. Chef profile (English): owner-chef Makoto Aoki, born 1969 in Tokyo; trained at the family's "Ginza Sushi Aoki" and at "L'Oiseau"; went to France in 1995; ran "Restaurant Makoto Aoki" in Paris for 13 years from 2006; opened behind the Kabukiza in September 2021; French wines changing monthly. 2026 reviews: tastes of Paris, cucumber soup, pâté de volaille, cod fritters, beef-tongue brick, girolle risotto, Amami fish with squid ink, Tokachi Ezo venison, chausson; weekday petit lunch course ¥5,000; half glasses from ¥1,250; a regular of 21 visits; some say it's noisy inside.

食べログ: ロオジエ(L’OSIER)、銀座7-5-5、銀座駅から徒歩7分、34.en: Tabelog: L'OSIER, Ginza 7-5-5, 7 minutes from Ginza Station; 34 seats; private rooms (¥11,000 at lunch, ¥22,000 at dinner; ¥55,000 for 2–4); Tue–Sat 11:30–15:00, 17:30–22:00; closed Sun, Mon, some holidays, mid-August and New Year; 15% service charge; cards and QR accepted; parking for 10 cars. Shop introduction: run by Shiseido, on this site since 1973; interior by Pierre-Yves Rochon; executive chef Olivier Chaignon since 2013. 2026 reviews: hairy crab and caviar with turnip mousse; pen shell and geoduck; scale-grilled ayu; roast pigeon (buckwheat flour, leg confit); cheese; persimmon crêpe flambé; the mignardise trolley; a black-truffle course; Grand Cru by the glass; a fish dish with three sauces; the chocolate trolley; 7–8 Champagnes; service that knows regulars' tastes; on the other hand, complaints that many plates were cold and that some staff were cold.

食べログ: ロシア料理 ROGOVSKI 銀座、銀座5-7-10 イグジットメル.en: Tabelog: Russian Restaurant ROGOVSKI Ginza, Ginza 5-7-10, EXITMELSA 7F, 1 minute from Ginza Station exit A2; 76 seats (all tables); weekdays 11:00–16:00, 17:00–22:00, weekends and holidays 11:00–22:00; open almost every day (one day each in February and August, and New Year); 5% service charge (not for lunch courses); December–February courses by reservation only; 2-hour limit when busy; opened September 18, 2015; official site rogovski.co.jp. Booking note: cannot accommodate allergies to dairy, green onions, wheat, mushrooms, eggs or pork. Shop introduction: founded 1951, Japan's first Russian restaurant, 75 years this year; court cuisine and regional dishes of Ukraine, Georgia and Uzbekistan; wines from Georgia, Russia, Moldova, Romania and Bulgaria. October 2026 reviews: Katyusha course (6 starters: pickled herring, beet vinegret, marinated mushrooms…; pirozhki; main; dessert; Russian tea); borscht; Ginza course (caviar, vegetable pirozhki, mushroom and chicken pot pie, striploin); beef stroganoff; generous portions.

食べログ: ローマイヤレストラン 銀座店、銀座5-9-17 銀座あづまビル2F、.en: Tabelog: Romaier Restaurant Ginza, Ginza 5-9-17, Ginza Azuma Building 2F, 2 minutes from Ginza Station exit A5; 30 seats, private room (5–6); Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00, 17:30–22:00, closed Sundays, holidays and New Year; no service charge; cards and PayPay accepted; opened March 22, 2019; official site lohmeyer.co.jp. Shop introduction: founded 1925; the famous roast beef; German beer and sommelier-chosen wines; black-wagyu roast-beef lunch ¥5,000 (by reservation); Christmas course ¥9,800. 2026 reviews: lunch from ¥1,300; demi-glace hamburg steak ¥1,500 (with rice, consommé, salad and a drink); weekly red-wine-braised hamburg steak ¥1,400; daily hamburg steak ¥1,400; fresh-fish carpaccio and sausages in the all-you-can-drink course; Schweinshaxe.

食べログ: ワインと串揚げ こぱん 先斗町店、串揚げ・居酒屋・ワインバー、中京区.en: Tabelog: ワインと串揚げ こぱん 先斗町店 (Wine to Kushikatsu Kopan, Pontocho), kushiage, izakaya and wine bar; 中京区木屋町三条下ル材木町180-1 1F; 3 min on foot from exit 6 of Keihan Sanjo Station; Mon and Thu–Sun 17:00–22:00 (last entry 21:00); closed Tuesday and Wednesday; reservations taken; omakase 12 skewers ¥4,620, 16 skewers ¥6,160; special beef fillet skewer ¥638 extra each; seat charge ¥550 (vegetable platter and dessert included); cards and e-money accepted; 20 seats; non-smoking; children welcome; opened 30 July 2004. Safari group site: creative kushiage specialist; Kyoto ingredients; wine chosen by a sommelier; Naha and Pontocho shops. Reviews (2026, in English): skewers change monthly; yuba; braised pork; truffle; jazz; reasonably priced wine.

食べログ: ワルダー、パン・サンドイッチ、中京区麩屋町六角下ル坂井町452 ハイ.en: Tabelog: Warder, bread and sandwiches, 中京区麩屋町六角下ル坂井町452, ハイマート・ふや町 1F, 8 min on foot from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn; Mon, Tue and Fri–Sun 9:00–19:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday; takeaway only; reservations accepted; cards, transport IC, iD and QUICPay accepted; opened 5 February 2007; Bread Tabelog 100 2017, 2018; Bread WEST Tabelog 100 2020, 2022, 2026. Reviews (September–November 2026, in English): Kyoto Dashi Bread (two per person), baked curry bread with Navin's curry, Shiba-zuke French bread, chestnut pie, an-butter sandwich, handwritten labels.

食べログ: ヴァンピックル 銀座(vinpicoeur)、銀座4-3-4 銀座居.en: Tabelog: vinpicoeur Ginza, Ginza 4-3-4, 銀座居酒店 Building 2F; 24 seats; Mon and Thu 17:00–23:00, Fri 17:00–23:30, weekends and holidays 15:30–23:00, closed Tue, Wed and irregularly; official site auxamis.com. Shop introduction: charcoal grilling and fine wine; an Alsace wine-by-the-glass fair in October; a Burgundy fair. 2026 reviews: casual French; the sommelier's remarks are fun; a duck or lamb main; meat and vegetable skewers; rice porridge to finish; five-starter platter; grilled Camembert skewer; shiitake; charcoal-grilled venison; mostly counter; quality unchanged for 20 years.

食べログ: ヴァン・ド・レーヴ、銀座1-20-1 オーキッド銀座ビル1F、宝町駅.en: Tabelog: Vin de Rêve, Ginza 1-20-1, Orchid Ginza Building 1F, 4 minutes from Takaracho Station exit A1, 5 from Ginza-itchome Station; 20 seats; weekdays 17:30–24:00, Sat 17:30–23:00, closed Sundays and holidays; opened March 3, 2006; cards and d-barai accepted. 2026 reviews: a 20th-anniversary menu; the usual onion tart and crunchy salad; cheese platter; vegetable platter; Ezo venison; uni risotto; pâté en croûte; wine by the glass (Alsace Riesling, Burgundy, Pomerol); smaller pours on request; the owner's particular tastes; a master who loves Showa baseball; ¥4,000–20,000.

食べログ: ヴェーナ、イタリアン、中京区鏡屋町46-3、丸太町駅から徒歩約6分、.en: Tabelog: Vena, Italian, 中京区鏡屋町46-3, about 6 min on foot from Marutamachi Stn; lunch last entry 12:00–13:00 (Mon, Tue, Sat, Sun and holidays only); dinner last entry 17:30–21:00; closed Wednesday; reservation only; bookable on Pocket Concierge; lunch course ¥12,000, dinner course ¥24,000 (tax and service included); 26 seats (counter of 10 on 1F, two private rooms for up to 8 on 2F); cards accepted; Italian WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025. Reviews (December 2025–September 2026, in English): chef Daiki Hayakawa from Il Ghiottone and sommelier Yoji Ikemoto, 'what if there were a state called Kyoto in Italy', a century-old townhouse, one Michelin star, pairings.

食べログ: ヴォーク (VOURKE)、カフェ、大阪市浪速区難波中3-6-3 T.en: Tabelog: VOURKE, café, T4 BUILDING 1F, Nambanaka 3-6-3, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 341 m from Namba Station; daily 10:00–20:00; open all year; no reservations; cards (VISA, Master) and PayPay accepted; non-smoking. Reviews (August–October 2026): homemade tiramisu, a seasonal peach tiramisu, beignets with tiramisu cream, a fig beignet ¥1,350, an-butter, pudding with ice cream, brownie, pancakes, croque monsieur ¥1,000, today's coffee ¥650, latte art, order and pay at the register first, shared tables when full, full on Saturdays after 14:00, a wooden deck at the entrance, pets allowed on the terrace, a review calling it the second shop of HOOD by Vargas in Nakatsu.

食べログ: ヴレ ド ヴレ シェ ヒロ (vrai de vrai CHEZ H.en: Tabelog: vrai de vrai Chez Hiro (vrai de vrai CHEZ HIRO), French, マッセノース四ツ橋ビル 1F, Shinmachi 1-24-8, Nishi-ku, Osaka, 4–5 min walk west from Yotsubashi Station exit 2, Tue–Sun 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 18:00–23:00 (last order 21:30), closed Monday (the next day if a holiday), reservations accepted, cards, e-money and QR accepted, 36 seats, two private rooms for 4, non-smoking, takeout, moved to Shinmachi in 2003, French WEST 100 2021. Reviews (May 2025–October 2026): courses listed on Ikyu at ¥3,800 and ¥5,300 for lunch and ¥7,700, ¥11,000 and ¥16,500 for dinner, a lunch with a choice of starter, main and dessert, generous portions, lobster terrine, young bluefin tuna tartare, seafood sauté in soup, a choice of four meats (Ezo venison, lamb and others), meat sauce with pilaf, strawberry mille-feuille, baguette refills, a wine cellar, a half-circle sofa, well-timed service, reports of salty food, and one that it was not worth the price.

食べログ: 一㐂、銀座5-4-15 西五ビル4F、銀座駅から徒歩1分、20席・個.en: Tabelog: Ichiki, Ginza 5-4-15, 西五 Building 4F, 1 minute from Ginza Station; 20 seats, private rooms (2–8); daily 12:00–14:30 (last entry 13:30), 17:00–23:00 (last entry 21:00); 10% service charge; cards accepted. 2026 reviews: lunch omakase ¥11,000 (chu-toro, squid, amberjack, kinki, kombu-cured sea bream, akami, bonito, surf clam, salmon roe, the Ichiki roll, uni, seared toro, botan shrimp, conger eel, kanpyō roll, tamago, akadashi, Shine Muscat jelly); dinner omakase ¥18,000; matsutake, hairy crab and tilefish in autumn; accommodates fish you dislike; many overseas visitors; some say the one floor staffer can't keep up.

食べログ: 一夢庵 麵、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-3-32 サンプラザ123寿楽ビ.en: Tabelog: Ichimuan Men, Sun Plaza 123 Juraku Bldg 1F, 2-3-32 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6484-3923; Mon–Sat 22:00–7:30 next morning; closed Sundays; no cards; opened 26 November 2021. 2026 reviews (January–October): late-night ramen; rich tonkotsu shoyu with a clean finish; the sweetness of tonkotsu with Kyoto's aged shoyu 'Okko'; moist chashu, soft-boiled egg, leek; wood-ear; crisp chashu; tsukemen recommended too; you want to drink all the soup; run single-handed, so service is curt; served one-handed; fried rice in large only; chashu rice bowl; sweet, spicy, savoury maze-soba; chewy noodles; rich tonkotsu shoyu ramen at ¥1,300 is pricey; medium-thick straight noodles; about 8 counter seats; open until 7:30 a.m.

食べログ: 一番ラーメン、ラーメン、大阪市東淀川区東中島1丁目19-14、新大阪.en: Tabelog: Ichiban Ramen, ramen, 東中島 1-19-14, Higashiyodogawa-ku, Osaka, 249 m from Shin-Osaka Station; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–21:00, Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00, closed Sunday; reservations accepted; cash only; smoking allowed; takeaway. Reviews (June 2025 to July 2026): a neighbourhood Chinese diner; big, garlicky kara-age (a half order for two or three), with salt and pepper; spicy gyoza, liver and garlic chives, sweet and sour pork, stamina grill, garlic fried rice, Tianjin rice, stir-fried vegetables, kimchi, potato salad; shoyu ramen ¥900 (two slices of chashu, bean sprouts, nori, menma, green onion, a slightly sweet broth); beef-bone shio ramen with slightly thick curly noodles; chashu ramen; sara udon with a white sauce; pasta salad with beer; nine dishes for four ¥8,900; run by four women; friendly women staff; the owner recommends the half order; busy when the Shinkansen is delayed; almost full by 18:00.

食べログ: 一番麻辣烫 日本橋店、大阪市中央区日本橋1-3-17 日本橋エンビィ.en: Tabelog: Ichiban Malatang Nippombashi, Nippombashi Envy Bldg, 1-3-17 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 20 seats; daily 11:00–24:00; cards and QR payment accepted. 2026 reviews (July–October): beef-bone soup; rich even at heat 0, like a ramen soup; chili oil on the side; free drink; spice aromas and deep umami; fresh ingredients; a clean shop; came back within a week; a distinctive smell inside; a little over ¥1,000; heat level 1 builds slowly; a few minutes from Nippombashi Station; no queue, so able to choose calmly; unusual soups too; original paitan soup; broccoli recommended; 3rd of 19 shops; heat level 3; free drink over ¥1,000.

食べログ: 一蘭 なんば御堂筋店、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-4-2 グルカスシティ.en: Tabelog: Ichiran Namba Midosuji, Grukas City Bldg 2F, 2-4-2 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba Station exit 14; 25 seats (flavour-concentration counter); daily 9:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:45); open every day of the year; opened 8 August 2019; official site ichiran.com. 2026 reviews: a '100% tonkotsu-free' shop; a soup developed from beef bones and more, so people who cannot eat pork or pork bones can enjoy it too; Arita-ware lacquer-box-style bowls and partitioned counter; creamy like tonkotsu; one said it lacks the punch of real tonkotsu; sweet-savoury beef (Gyu Yaro) instead of pork chashu; chicken base; the red secret sauce; matcha pudding; tonkotsu-free ramen ¥1,280 (¥1,820 with a salted boiled egg and extra Gyu Yaro); no queue right after the 9 a.m. opening on weekdays; notices of 80-minute waits and QR queueing; waits of over 30 minutes; many overseas visitors; noodle firmness chosen on the order sheet; extra garlic.

食べログ: 一蘭 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-3-29 ミヤプラザ心斎橋1.en: Tabelog: Ichiran Shinsaibashi, Miya Plaza Shinsaibashi 1F, 1-3-29 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 050-1808-2625; no reservations; daily 10:00–6:00 next morning (food L.O. 5:45); open every day of the year; cards and e-money accepted; 40 flavour-concentration counter seats; opened 15 December 2017; official ichiran.com. 2026 reviews (August–September): ramen ¥1,290 at night prices; soft-boiled salted egg ¥180; extra garlic ¥180; the secret sauce at 10× is very hot; low-hydration thin noodles and rich tonkotsu; choose richness and firmness; heat 6; open late on Saturdays; a queue of tourists and Japanese at midnight after the last train; fast turnover; a fast-pass-like system that lets you in without waiting late at night; ticket machine → seat → eat → leave; partitioned flavour-concentration counter; partitions that can't be removed; queue managed smoothly even with a 40-minute wait; order sheet; natural tonkotsu ramen; firm; a mellow, creamy soup without off-smell.

食べログ: 一蘭 道頓堀店別館、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-4-16、なんば駅14番出.en: Tabelog: Ichiran Dotonbori Annex, 1-4-16 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba Station exit 14; 82 seats (flavour-concentration counter 30, tables 52); open 24 hours every day of the year; no reservations; no smoking; cards and e-money accepted; allergen information available; opened 16 April 2015; official ichiran.com. Official: flavour-concentration counter 24 hours, tables 8:00–23:00; seats and hours may change at short notice. 2026 reviews: crowded even after 8 a.m.; natural tonkotsu ramen ¥1,180; soft-boiled salted egg ¥160; order sheet (richness, garlic, leek, red secret sauce, noodle firmness); a model of Hakata tonkotsu; extra-thin noodles; light and not greasy; tonkotsu without porky smell; noodle refill ¥210; a 10-minute wait even at 2 a.m.; up to an hour's wait in October; tickets and order sheets from the machine while queuing; tables on the 3rd floor; up to 5 children free per adult; mini size; souvenirs on sale.

食べログ: 一轍、大阪市西区京町堀1-12-23、本町駅28番出口から西へ徒歩7.en: Tabelog: Ittetsu, 1-12-23 Kyomachibori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 7 min walk west from Hommachi Station exit 28; Nishi-Semba Park; 476 m from Higobashi; Mon and Wed 11:30–14:30, Tue, Thu and Fri 11:30–14:30 and 18:00–21:30; closed weekends and holidays; closes when sold out; no cards, e-money or QR; 14 counter seats; opened 12 July 2010. Reviews (February 2025 – October 2026): ramen heaped with chili ¥950; soft-boiled egg ¥50; restrained heat; niboshi ramen; menma; niboshi ramen (niboshi and tonkotsu shoyu); seafood ramen (bonito-flake and tonkotsu shoyu); sea-bream soba (sea bream and tonkotsu salt); chuka soba; No. 1 most popular is niboshi; medium-thin noodles; nori, menma, white leek, radish sprouts, 2 slices chashu and half a soft-boiled egg for ¥900; the seafood ramen is rich and creamy; plum seafood salt ramen with free wasabi; a 10-year regular; lent an umbrella in the rain; founded 2010; the owner recommends the seafood ramen shoyu; in front of Nishi-Semba Park; down a lane; counter only; stylish chairs; touch-panel ordering; check evening hours; the bill comes with the food; pay at the machine at the back; niboshi ramen large with mentaiko rice; refined and sweetish.

食べログ: 万菓堂 心斎橋店、和菓子、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-3-19、毎日10.en: Tabelog: Manka Do Shinsaibashi, Japanese sweets; 2-3-19 Shinsaibashi-suji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 10:00–22:00; no reservations; cards and QR accepted, no e-money. Reviews (July 2025–October 2026): mitarashi mochi pie (crisp pastry with mochi, mitarashi sauce and red bean paste, warmed for you) ¥300 (July 2025), ¥320 (January 2026), about ¥350–380 (April 2026); a long-established shop behind the Glico sign at the end of the Shinsaibashi-suji arcade; benches inside but no eating in; mitarashi mochi keeps three days; best warmed in a microwave or toaster; one diner says the mitarashi flavour takes a while to arrive.

食べログ: 三国そば、そば・うどん・おにぎり、大阪市淀川区西三国4丁目8-19-.en: Tabelog: Mikuni Soba, soba, udon and onigiri, 4-8-19-112 Nishimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 2 min from Hankyu Mikuni Station; Tue–Sat 6:00–9:00 and 11:00–15:00; closed Sunday and Monday, plus a few days at New Year and Obon; no reservations; cash only; no cover charge; 16 standing places; non-smoking; takeout; kombu tsukudani ¥300 per 100 g. Shop text: devoted to dashi, natural kombu and several kinds of bonito, seasoned with low-salt light soy sauce and mirin, no added salt, slowly warmed and rested; curry made as hot or sweet as you like; seasonal dishes; featured on a local TV programme. Reviews (July 2024 to October 2026): a line before 6:00; meat soba and beef udon ¥600 (onion, fried tofu, tororo kombu); wakame and fried-tofu soba with an onigiri ¥630; zaru soba ¥450 (large ¥120, quail egg in the dip); tempura soba; stamina soba; curry soba and curry udon; onigiri ¥100; since a change of management it no longer opens in the evening; closed 29 October to 4 November 2026.

食べログ: 三田製麺所 なんば店、大阪市中央区千日前2-11-3 樋口建物1F、.en: Tabelog: Mita Seimenjo Namba, Higuchi Tatemono 1F, 2-11-3 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 54 seats (counter 24, tables 30); daily 10:00–3:00 next morning (food L.O. 2:30); no smoking; cards and e-money accepted; opened 21 July 2012; official mita-seimen.jp. 2026 reviews (August–October): limited niboshi chuka soba ¥1,100 and extra niboshi ¥200; salty, strong niboshi; softish thick noodles; cold spicy tantanmen (soy-milk soup) ¥1,150; ordering by QR code; mizuna, menma, chicken, egg yolk, nuts; Sichuan pepper; cold sea-bream salt tsukemen with everything ¥1,340 (500 g noodles); a chain; busy at lunch; self-serve water; black-bonito tsukemen; a strong dipping soup; soup thinned with broth at the end; limited menu right after opening; noodles free up to 500 g; bonito-flake salt and garlic shichimi; limited niboshi tsukemen; near Amza.

食べログ: 三笠会館 本店、銀座5-5-17、銀座駅から40m、毎日11:00〜.en: Tabelog: Mikasa Kaikan main shop, Ginza 5-5-17, 40 m from Ginza Station; daily 11:00–22:00 (as a building); official site mikasakaikan.co.jp. 2026 reviews: curry at the 1F Italian bar (also said to be famous for karaage); on Namiki-dori; 80 seats by the windows on the mezzanine; pasta lunch ¥2,500 (bread, a dish, pasta, two desserts, coffee); new Awaji Island onions and clams with lemon oil; strawberry shaved ice with condensed milk at the shaved-ice counter 「氷処 三笠」; teppanyaki on 7F (lean meat grilled in front of you, Hokkaido pumpkin soup, garlic rice); a calm Showa atmosphere.

食べログ: 三谷 (ミタニ)、寿司、四谷1-22-1、JR四ツ谷駅から徒歩4分、.en: Tabelog: Mitani, sushi; Yotsuya 1-22-1; 4 min walk from JR Yotsuya Station, 5 min from the Marunouchi and Namboku Lines; Wed–Sun 18:00–22:30 (last order 22:00); closed Mondays and Tuesdays; no lunch; reservation only, no new reservations accepted; 6 seats (counter only); private hire for up to 6; non-smoking; cards accepted; Tabelog Award Silver 2017, 2018 and 2025, Gold 2019–2024 and 2026; Sushi TOKYO Tabelog 100 2021, 2022 and 2025. Reviews (November 2024–October 2026): a wine or sake paired with each dish, a non-alcoholic pairing of cold-brewed Yame tea, Yoichi uni, Awaji sea bream, Nakatsugawa caviar, anago to finish, a one- to two-year wait for bookings, ¥60,000 to over ¥100,000 per person.

食べログ: 上方レインボー、大阪市天王寺区勝山4-6-3、JR桃谷駅南口から徒歩.en: Tabelog: Kamigata Rainbow, 4-6-3 Katsuyama, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from JR Momodani Station south exit; Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Thursdays; temporary closures announced on social media; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 6 seats; opened 24 February 2020. Reviews (November 2025 – October 2026): Shoyu Animal ¥1,600 (the rich umami and sweetness of a meat soup); iriko shoyu ¥1,000; salt ramen ¥1,000; Antoki no Shio ¥1,600 (tangy red onion); Neo Shio Ramen Apple; curry ramen (seafood dashi and beef fat); house-made thick flat noodles (fettuccine-like); limited tsukemen (Aka Buta DDX with autumn-pear tsukemen ¥1,600; Kurobuta and eel-dashi wasabi tsukemen ¥1,400; fig and octopus summer salt tsukemen ¥1,600; tantan tsukemen); tori paitan now and then; Aka Buta DDX 2 slices of chashu ¥500; Ajitama Arokana ¥200; Kurobuta rice ¥400; Rainbow wonton; large ¥200 (free some days); tablet ordering; staff suggest trying the noodles first with salt and lemon; one found the eel tsukemen a little fishy; doesn't look like a ramen shop from outside.

食べログ: 上野精養軒 松屋銀座店、銀座3-6-1 松屋銀座本店8F、銀座駅直結.en: Tabelog: Ueno Seiyoken Matsuya Ginza, Ginza 3-6-1, Matsuya Ginza main store 8F, connected to Ginza Station, 3 minutes; 50 seats; Mon–Sat 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00), Sundays and last days of consecutive holidays 11:00–21:30 (L.O. 20:30); irregular holidays (following Matsuya Ginza); children welcome, children's menu, baby chairs, strollers welcome; official site seiyoken.co.jp. 2026 reviews: the Ginza shop of a pioneer of French cooking in Japan, founded 1872; crab cream croquettes with a thick coating; retort beef stew ¥1,080 (takeaway); demi-glace beef hamburg steak (thick and coarse-ground, broccoli, carrot, potato); a small entrance but spacious, comfortable seats; couldn't book online even though it showed availability.

食べログ: 世界一暇なラーメン屋、大阪市北区中之島3-3-23 中之島ダイビル.en: Tabelog: Sekaiichi Himana Ramen Ya, Nakanoshima Daibiru 2F, 3-3-23 Nakanoshima, Kita-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Keihan Watanabebashi Station, 8 from Higobashi Station; daily 11:00–22:00; closed over New Year; no cards, e-money or QR; 42 seats; opened 11 February 2014; official site. October 2026 reviews: a sister shop of Jinrui Mina Menrui; a stylish, spacious room on the 2nd floor of an office building; Mr. Children songs and music videos; queues at lunch but fast turnover; smartphone ordering at each table (menus only in the waiting area); Witch's Red ¥957 (sweetish shoyu with shellfish umami, chewy medium-thick whole-wheat noodles, thin-sliced chashu); seasoned egg ¥105; a light bonito-dashi ramen; 5 gyoza ¥200; one found it heavy by the end; kind staff; open all day.

食べログ: 両忘、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-10-17 心斎橋ロヂビル 1F、心斎.en: Tabelog: Ryobo, Shinsaibashi Roji Bldg 1F, 1-10-17 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 7 and Yotsubashi Station; Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00, Sat 12:00–23:00, Sun and holidays 12:00–22:00; irregular closing days; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 10 counter seats; private hire possible (up to 20); opened 29 April 2023. Reviews (July 2024 – October 2026): Tabelog Yakitori WEST Hyakumeiten 2025; course only ¥13,200; dislikes asked first; Kumano jidori (Mie) and Date chicken (Fukushima); starters include smoked thigh tataki, breast tataki, Senshu fruit tomatoes, grilled aubergine, liver pâté with baguette, donko shiitake; skewers of negima, heart, neck, tsukune with mustard, kinkan with liver, gizzard, thigh, furisode, ume-shiso roll; to finish, 2 kinds of clay-pot rice (chicken soboro; lotus root, hiratake and green pepper; corn in July) with refills; pickles, small dishes, soup; house lemon sour; L-shaped counter; one found the heart tasted burnt; at the end of a passage; a calm atmosphere.

食べログ: 中国四川 旬菜 酒肆 楽山、大阪市中央区北浜3-5-19 淀屋橋ホワ.en: Tabelog: China Sichuan Shunsai Shushi Rakusan, Yodoyabashi White Bldg B1F, 3-5-19 Kitahama, Chuo-ku, Osaka; right by Yodoyabashi Station exit 8; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:45) and 18:00–21:30 (L.O. 21:00); closed weekends and holidays; closed the evening of 2 November for renovation; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 21 seats; private hire up to 20. Reviews (January–October 2026): mapo tofu or tantanmen at lunch (6:4, mapo slightly ahead); a queue from 11:00; quick turnover; house chili oil and numbing Sichuan pepper; mapo tofu with minced meat and douchi; yunbai rou; twice-cooked pork; spicy stir-fried shrimp and cashews; big prawns in chili sauce; chicken breast and zucchini stir-fried with chili; pork fillet stir-fried with douchi; black-vinegar sweet-and-sour pork; Hong Kong shumai; spring rolls; century egg; Shaoxing wine tasting; Heartland beer; a dim basement in an old building; counter and tables; full with bookings at night; fine for drinking alone too.

食べログ: 中国料理 孫悟空、大阪市中央区南船場1-13-15 長堀三栄ビル1F.en: Tabelog: Chinese cuisine Son Goku, Nagahori San'ei Bldg 1F, 1-13-15 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; no opening hours listed; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking weekdays 11:00–13:00. Reviews (January–October 2026): a queue after noon on weekdays; shrimp and egg rice bowl ¥800–880 (fluffy egg with Tianjin-style sauce, fried shrimp); beef and egg rice bowl ¥800; seafood and egg rice bowl ¥800; champon with thick sauce ¥880; shoyu yakisoba; sara udon; daily specials (mapo tofu and others); salt, pepper, vinegar, sauce and shoyu on the table; opens 11:30; one says closed Sundays, holidays and Mondays; after price rises the menu and prices may differ a little.

食べログ: 中国菜 Yin Yang、大阪市中央区博労町4-3-14 8Rビル.en: Tabelog: Chinese Sai Yin Yang, 8R Bldg 2F, Hakuromachi 4-3-14, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Shinsaibashi Stn; Tue–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–22:30, Mon and Sat 17:30–22:30 (last order 21:50); closed Sunday; lunch cannot be reserved and is cash or PayPay only; one drink per person; cards, PayPay and Rakuten Pay accepted; 17 seats (counter 7, tables 10); non-smoking; English menu; opened 6 April 2024. Shop's description: gently seasoned Chinese cooking with Cantonese touches, domestic fresh fish and seasonal vegetables bought at the market, natural wine and Shaoxing wine; popular dishes are the assorted appetizers, mapo tofu, tom yum fried rice and a Cantonese-style fresh-fish carpaccio. Reviews (January 2025–October 2026): the second shop of Tokuchaina; on the 2nd floor up the stairs at the back of a building behind the W Osaka; a stylish white-themed room; five-kind appetizer platter, mapo tofu with fermented black beans, squid stir-fried with black beans, black-vinegar sweet and sour pork, shrimp chili, ebi mayo, yurinchi, shrimp dumplings, chicken and water chestnut shumai, oyster shumai, char siu wrapped in a crêpe, spring rolls, noodle soup with green onion and char siu, almond tofu; lunch was the weekly-special Chinese noodles with four small side dishes for ¥1,200; dishes come out slowly.

食べログ: 中華そば うえまち、大阪市中央区上町A番22号、谷町六丁目駅7番出口.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Uemachi, A-22 Uemachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Tanimachi-Rokuchome Station exit 7; Tue–Sun 11:00–14:30 and 18:00–21:00; closed Mondays (holidays too); some days no evening service when ingredients run out; closes when sold out; temporary closures on X; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; opened 17 December 2012; Tabelog Ramen WEST Hyakumeiten 2018–2022, OSAKA Hyakumeiten 2023–2025. Reviews (March–October 2026): a 63rd visit; tsukemen; a dipping soup balancing sweet, spicy and sour; chewy noodles; melting chashu; the best of the Kadoya line; house-made noodles; shoyu umami with tang and faint heat; 5 people at 13:00 on a weekday, 10 minutes; 11 people at 12:15 on a Sunday, 24 minutes; cash only; tsukemen ¥1,450; glossy flat whole-wheat noodles; 3 kinds of chashu; white leek; menma; in the Kadoya Shokudo tradition but its own; shoyu chuka soba; a sharp shoyu and clear soup; limited chicken-pork and maze-soba; 6 people before 13:00 on a weekday, 30-minute wait; the shoyu ramen a little salty; one says it may move soon.

食べログ: 中華そば しゅき、大阪市天王寺区大道4-10-6、寺田町から105m.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Shuki, 4-10-6 Daido, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 105 m from Teradacho; daily 11:00–24:00; no cards, e-money or QR (one says PayPay worked); opened 12 April 2026. Reviews (September–October 2026): affiliated with Raa-men Shuki in Tsuruhashi; reopened after refitting from Menji Shuki; chashu chuka soba ¥930 (a regular shoyu, thin noodles, overflowing thin-sliced chashu, shredded white leek); spicy mala jan-men ¥1,200 (thick chewy noodles, bean sprouts, chashu, chili, egg yolk; add garlic); cold tantanmen ¥1,200 (thin noodles, spicy meat miso, bok choy, bean sprouts); white-sesame soy-milk cold tantan soba ¥1,380; cold leek edition; noodle refill ¥110 (free for students); gyoza sets; half fried rice ¥530 at lunch; counter only; a few groups waiting even on weekdays; order verbally, pay on leaving.

食べログ: 中華そば なんば楼、大阪市浪速区難波中1-18-14、なんば駅から1.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Nanbaro, 1-18-14 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 111 m from Namba Station; daily 11:00–23:00; no reservations; cards, transit IC, PayPay and au PAY accepted; opened 1 June 2025. Reviews (June 2025 – October 2026): run by Yoshinoya Holdings; signature clear tonkotsu broth; niboshi paitan ramen ¥900; special clear tonkotsu ¥1,200; light, with chewy thick wavy noodles (July 2025); with the menu revision of 17 September 2026, back-fat chuka soba with rice ¥880 and tsukemen discontinued; savoury-spicy soba ¥1,000 and 5× heat ¥500; chan-kei clear tonkotsu; clear and smooth; medium-thin flat straight noodles; 6–7 slices chashu; thin menma; a perk for following on Instagram; free toppings such as garlic or yuzu-kosho; clear tonkotsu noodles ¥1,000; bottled beer ¥500; snack platter ¥500; one found it salty; a bright yellow sign; close to Nankai Namba Station; change the flavour with table condiments; follow the shop's guide to changing the flavour.

食べログ: 中華そば アサヒ製麺 なんばラーメン一座店、大阪市中央区難波3-2-.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Asahi Seimen Namba Ramen Ichiza, Namba Ramen Ichiza, 3-2-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 11:00–21:30; no cards, e-money or QR payment; listed as smoking allowed; opened 23 June 2022; site ramen-ichiza.edion.com. 2026 reviews (June–October): spicy ramen ¥1,150 (with seasoned egg, nira); shoyu ramen ¥980 plus fried rice set ¥400 (light with deep shoyu, thin wavy noodles); shoyu-based tonkotsu; for a hangover; the favourite at Ichiza; Edion's ramen street; one found it rich and greasy; a sweet shoyu aroma; Yoshimoto comedians' autographs; ramen on the 9th floor after the 7th-floor toy department; children's chairs; minced-meat ramen with small rice; curry ramen (big pieces of meat, lots of fat).

食べログ: 中華そば ココカラサキゑ、ラーメン、食べログ ラーメン OSAKA.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Kokokara Sakie, ramen, Tabelog Ramen OSAKA 100 2023, 2024 and 2025, 西宮原 1-7-39, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 10 min from Shin-Osaka Station (JR and Midosuji Line); Wed–Sun 11:30–14:30 and 18:00–21:00, closed Mon and Tue; no reservations; cash only; counter; non-smoking; opened 9 June 2018. Reviews (September to October 2026): opened in 2018 by a former manager of Chuka Soba Mutahiro; marudori shoyu (Hinai chicken) ¥1,100, with flavoured egg ¥1,250, large noodles ¥150, Kujo green onion ¥200; the special has two slices of rare chashu, egg, meat wontons, menma and green onion; a clear broth of Hinai and Men-suke chicken with chicken oil; on "Chicken Day" a dashi of Rishiri kombu and shiitake too; medium-thin straight noodles from Menya Teigaku in Kyoto; rare pork-shoulder chashu, chicken chashu too; special salt seafood ramen; oil soba; squid and niboshi; a cold dried-squid ramen; morning ramen by lottery on the second Sunday of each month, sanma and Hinai chicken ¥1,400; chashu rice bowl ¥480; Sapporo Lager with a small plate of menma; ticket machine at the entrance; write your name when busy; the owner makes each bowl; one diner has been 155 times; some find the noodles lacking.

食べログ: 中華そば トライ、大阪市天王寺区大道1-7-11、天王寺から522m.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Try, 1-7-11 Daido, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 522 m from Tennoji; Mon–Sat 19:00–3:00 next morning (L.O. 2:30); closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; opened 1 May 2016. Reviews (March–October 2026): 19:00 until 3 a.m.; Takaida-style chuka soba; after drinking; self-serve drinks; chuka soba ¥700; seasoned egg ¥150; canned beer ¥400; the owner runs it single-handed; chashu-men (regular) ¥900; strong shoyu; medium-thick to thick noodles; leek cut in big pieces; a cheerful owner; on Tanimachi-suji, 6–7 min walk from Tennoji Station; a local ramen of Osaka and Higashi-Osaka; strong shoyu and thick noodles; thick straight noodles; one found the soup lukewarm and the chashu tough and smelly; one says not as strong as it looks; rice balls on the counter; plenty of chashu.

食べログ: 中華そば ニューまるちゃん、大阪市中央区道修町4-7-7 新横堀ビル.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba New Maruchan, Shin-Yokobori Bldg 2F, 4-7-7 Doshomachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Higobashi Station, 5 from Yodoyabashi Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:30); closed weekends and holidays; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money or QR. Reviews (March–October 2026): back-fat ramen; all-you-can-eat mentaiko and eggs; a Japanese-style shoyu; a bar at night, ramen at lunch; no photos on the ticket machine; back-fat maze-soba (raw egg) ¥950; +¥250 for unlimited rice and mentaiko; raw egg, furikake, nori; garlic none, a little or regular; slightly thick, slightly wavy noodles; self-service; a faintly sweet soup; mentaiko rice; very satisfying for ¥1,000; next to Inakura; a retro pop sign; an urban interior; counter at the back; 2 tables; a big TV; ramen sauce, apple vinegar, ramen pepper, pickled garlic and shichimi on the table; chuka soba; spicy chuka soba; rich pork-fat ramen; pork-fat maze-soba; Jiro style; Stanira soba (nira, chili, raw egg, ginger, garlic); softish Chinese noodles; plenty of chashu; bean sprouts; nori; a generous owner; soft noodles; the all-you-can-eat alone can be ordered; chuka soba ¥750; unlimited mentaiko TKG ¥250; like Kyushu's sweet shoyu; straight noodles.

食べログ: 中華そば 二誠、大阪市西区立売堀3-8-5、阿波座駅2番出口から15.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Nisei, 3-8-5 Itachibori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 150 m from Awaza Station exit 2; Mon–Sat and holidays 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 seats. Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): a miso specialist run by the shop behind Ramen Kasumi; miso chuka soba (¥900 in 2025); seasoned-egg miso ¥1,050; special Nisei spicy miso ¥1,250 (Nagano white miso and Mie red miso with Sichuan pepper, chenpi and Shaoxing wine for a numbing heat); rich seafood miso; spicy shoyu maze-soba; monthly limited editions (rich black miso, meat abura soba, shrimp bukkake kamatama, ¥1,000 each); flat medium-thick wavy noodles; small rice ¥100 with soup poured over; first bottled beer ¥100 with edamame; one says the miso is thinner and the service curter than at opening; some hours run single-handed.

食べログ: 中華そば 山下、ラーメン、四谷2-3-6 パルム四谷1F、四ツ谷駅か.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Yamashita, ramen; パルム四谷 1F, Yotsuya 2-3-6; 6 min walk from Yotsuya Station, 7 min from Yotsuya-sanchome; Mon–Fri 11:00–14:45; closed Sat and Sun (Saturdays closed for now from 15 July 2025); no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 30 seats (tables); non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome; opened 9 May 2022; at lunch it borrows a yakiniku, horumon and motsunabe restaurant. Reviews (April–October 2026): niboshi chuka soba ¥800, with seasoned egg ¥950, rich niboshi soba ¥1,000 (special ¥1,350), four kinds of niboshi with kombu and shiitake, a chicken-and-pork paitan, straight medium-thick noodles, zosui rice, chashu bowl, barley tea in a beer mug, a newcomer prize at the TRY Ramen Award, said to be a branch of Ningyocho Yamashita, one diner found orders served out of turn.

食べログ: 中華そば 福笑門、大阪市天王寺区上本町5-7-18 西川ビル1F、大.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Fukuemon, Nishikawa Bldg 1F, 5-7-18 Uehommachi, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Osaka-Uehommachi Station exit 11, 2 min from Tanimachi-Kyuchome Station exit 8; Mon–Sat 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Sundays; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR accepted; 15 seats (counter 10, one table); semi-private room; no smoking; power outlets; opened 11 June 2016. Reviews (February–October 2026): red neon; graffiti windows; condiments on the table; a menu like a neighbourhood Chinese diner; shoyu ramen and gyoza set ¥1,200; asked about leek and noodle firmness; a Kyoto-like chicken-bone and pork shoyu; medium-thin straight noodles; chashu, menma, leek; thin-skinned gyoza; many regulars; beer set; small karaage; zaru soba; yuzu chuhai; fatty chashu; half fried rice set; extra bean sprouts and leek; a gentle chicken and seafood soup; 3 slices chashu; low-hydration noodles; fried rice fragrant with shoyu; soupless tantanmen and pan-fried gyoza set; extra bean sprouts and leek free at lunch; Fukuemon large everything-on ¥1,200; courteous service; bottled Sapporo Lager; shoyu with extra back fat; a seasoned egg for LINE friends; grated garlic on the table; ultra-tasty back-fat ramen; thin noodles.

食べログ: 中華そば 辻、大阪市中央区釣鐘町1-1-1、天満橋駅④出口から徒歩1.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Tsuji, 1-1-1 Tsurigane-cho, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Tenmabashi Station exit 4; daily 11:00–14:15 and 17:30–21:15; closed the third Tuesday evening of each month; occasional closures; cards, e-money and QR (including Alipay and WeChat Pay) accepted; 11 seats (counter 7, two tables for 2); opened 11 April 2023. Reviews (May–October 2026): register at the touch panel outside, meal ticket inside; popular on social media, so queues; in after about 25 minutes; a spicy chuka soba where chili is the star; beef-offal chuka soba large; a punch rare in Kansai; comparisons with Mongolian Tanmen Nakamoto; the limited Bachiro (extra bean sprouts ¥1,100, a different brand of noodles, dark shoyu, lots of chashu); Bachiro with extra quail eggs; Bachiro with extra offal; TKG with Ryu no Tamago eggs; meat-taku rice bowl ¥550; bacchi-bachi beef-offal chuka soba; summer cold tantan maze-soba (the special has quail eggs and kimchi); special hot-and-sour jan-men ¥1,800; one called the chili and raw-garlic shoyu ramen ordinary; egg yolk; garlic on the table; one was reminded of Mokkosu, which serves thin straight noodles; one found the pork cooking and fat inconsistent.

食べログ: 中華そば 鯵右衛門、大阪市生野区鶴橋2-14-10、鶴橋駅から徒歩4.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Ajiemon, 2-14-10 Tsuruhashi, Ikuno-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Tsuruhashi Station; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sat 7:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30), Sun 11:00–15:00; closed Wednesdays; no cards, e-money or QR; 7 counter seats; opened 15 March 2026. Reviews (July–October 2026): Tsuruhashi shopping street; horse mackerel from the Tsuruhashi market; fresh horse-mackerel shoyu ¥980 (a creamy, mellow aji dashi); aji niboshi salt ¥930; aji niboshi shoyu ¥900 (sharp shoyu, little oil); limited aji ramen ¥980 (rich and cloudy); Tsuruhashi 2-chome black tsukemen ¥1,250 (aji niboshi and aji-katsu, Shimane twice-brewed shoyu, Rausu kombu, Mongolian rock salt, yuzu-kosho; 200 g, free up to 300 g; now evenings only); house-made medium-thick noodles of Miyake Seifun flour from Ikuno; Kagoshima Sanmi pork chashu; menma; naruto; aji meshi ¥350–380 (wasabi); fried horse mackerel fried to order; TKG; seasoned egg +¥180; chashu +¥300; large +¥150; now opens at 7 a.m.; the menu changes often, check social media; cash only.

食べログ: 中華そばふじい なんば店、大阪市中央区難波1-3-14、06-628.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Fujii Namba, 1-3-14 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6282-7301; 22 seats; Mon, Wed, Thu, Sun and holidays 11:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00), Fri, Sat and days before holidays 11:00–3:00 next morning (L.O. 2:30); closed Tuesdays; no reservations (same-day queue system at the shop, called by phone or email); may close early when busy; cards and QR payment accepted; no smoking; opened 11 April 2013. Official (ra-men.co): 'the nostalgic taste of Showa'; Shimbashi and Shin-Nakano (Tokyo), Ashiharabashi, Namba (closed Tuesdays) and Noda-Hanshin (Osaka). 2025–2026 reviews: a text message an hour after joining the queue; ticket machine; nira soba from 1 July 2026; slotted soup spoons; free egg; firm noodles; garlic powder; the fried rice is the best; cooking visible from the counter; extra leek; vinegar; a 90-minute wait on a holiday; ramen, karaage and fried rice set ¥1,100; a sharp shoyu like Onomichi ramen; 45 groups waiting at 11:30 on a Saturday, about 50 minutes via LINE; little back fat, light; an 80-minute wait; some call it ordinary; one felt ignored by staff; a one-group wait on a rainy evening.

食べログ: 中華ダイニング 隆勝、中華料理・つけ麺・ラーメン、大阪市淀川区西宮原.en: Tabelog: Chuka Dining Ryusho, Chinese, tsukemen and ramen, 西宮原 2-6-16, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, 新大阪コーポビアネーズ 1F; 697 m from Mikuni Station; Mon–Sat and holidays 11:30–14:30 and 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:30), closed Sunday; reservations accepted; cards (JCB, AMEX) and e-money accepted, no QR; non-smoking. Reviews (January 2025 to October 2026): began as a tsukemen shop and grew into fuller Chinese food with many staff from the home region; lunch sets ¥930–1,100 (egg soup, pickles, dessert, free rice refills); kara-age set of four ¥1,000; shrimp mayo set; yodare chicken set ¥930; daily specials (pork with green peppers, Sichuan-style horumon); the egg fried rice set sometimes sold out; mapo mazesoba ¥1,100; sesame tantanmen; soupless tantanmen; spicy mazesoba; chicken-salt ramen with kara-age ¥1,000; in the evening a two-dish set with a drink ¥1,380; all-you-can-eat-and-drink ¥3,880; yurinchi; beef fried rice; shrimp and egg stir-fry; green-onion chashu; the ticket machine takes no new notes; a line at lunch; one diner calls it a smoking restaurant.

食べログ: 中華バル JAM、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-18-2 アマキビル 中1.en: Tabelog: Chuka Bar JAM, Amaki Bldg mezzanine 1F, 1-18-2 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Nagahoribashi stations; Mon–Sat 18:00–1:00 next morning, Sun and holidays 18:00–24:00 (food L.O. 23:00); last entry 24:00 (22:00 on holidays); irregular closing days (check Instagram); may close early if no diners; charge ¥300 and one-drink minimum; no entry under 20; heated tobacco only; 9 seats (counter 5, one table); cards and QR accepted, no e-money. Reviews (April 2025 – July 2026): a Chinese bar in a converted snack bar; mapo tofu ¥1,200; beef-tendon mapo tofu; seafood yakisoba with thick sauce; chashu and lettuce fried rice; shrimp in chili sauce; shrimp mayo; mouth-watering chicken ¥980; grilled shumai of Jinan mochi pork 2 for ¥500; black-vinegar sweet-and-sour pork of Hiraboku Kinka pork ¥1,680; bamboo shoots and firefly squid in Shaoxing wine; Shaoxing-wine 'Dragon' highball; baijiu jasmine highball; the owner studies hard, sourcing and visiting famous restaurants; a warm personality.

食べログ: 中華レストラン味一、大阪市天王寺区下味原町1-20、地下鉄・JR鶴橋.en: Tabelog: Chinese Restaurant Ajiichi, 1-20 Shimoajiharacho, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from subway and JR Tsuruhashi stations; Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri and Sun 11:00–21:00; closed Wednesdays and Saturdays; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 32 seats; private hire; smoking allowed. Reviews (April–August 2026): a neighbourhood Chinese diner founded 1985; special sauce yakisoba ¥1,000 with roots in Imazato yakisoba (thick noodles, pork, cabbage, onion, green pepper, large and small shrimp, squid, fried egg, shredded nori); the popular B lunch ¥1,080 (sweet-and-sour pork, karaage, crab omelette, rice, soup); A lunch (sweet-and-sour pork, mapo tofu, shrimp tempura, chashu); crab fried rice ¥800; gyoza ¥370; gomoku noodles; green pepper and pork stir-fry; red counter on the ground floor, tables upstairs; order verbally; one disliked the tempura-like karaage batter; one found portions smallish; gyoza sauce, chili oil, sauce and pepper on the table.

食べログ: 中華料理 とんとん、大阪市西区江戸堀1-21-5 江戸堀コーポ 1F.en: Tabelog: Chinese Ryori Tonton, Edobori Kopo 1F, 1-21-5 Edobori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min on foot from Higobashi Stn on the Yotsubashi Line (338 m); Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–21:00, Sat 11:30–14:00; closed Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; private hire possible; no cards, e-money or QR; 15 seats; smoking allowed; genres Chinese and ramen. Reviews (April 2025–September 2026): the owner cooks alone; Kendo Kobayashi featured it on TV as a local Chinese restaurant; one diner came the day after a TV feature; 3 counter seats and tables for 4 ×3 and for 2 ×1; an ashtray on each table; the service set of curry champon with a small fried rice ¥950; the soup is chicken broth and soy sauce with a blended spicy curry powder; bean sprouts, garlic chives, cabbage, carrot, onion and pork; thin straight noodles; the fried rice is moist and light; Yumen with a small fried rice ¥950; Tianjin noodles and fried rice set ¥1,050; champon; Tanmen; ramen and fried rice set; a daily set; sweet and sour pork set meal; gyoza in the evening only, house-made, full of vegetables with a peppery filling; Tianjin rice; eight-treasure stir-fry; simmered chicken; bottled beer; busy at lunch, quiet just before closing.

食べログ: 中華料理・飲茶、東山区白川筋知恩院橋上ル西側556、知恩院前バス停・.en: Tabelog: Chinese, dim sum; 白川筋知恩院橋上ル西側556, Higashiyama-ku; Chion-in-mae bus stop, Higashiyama Stn; Monday, Tuesday, Thursday–Sunday 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–21:30 (last order 20:30); closed Wednesday and on some other days; reservations accepted; 10% charge in the tatami rooms only; 37 seats; private rooms with sunken kotatsu; private hire for 20–50; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master); Chinese WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2024, 2026; opened 1955; Kyoto-style Cantonese cooking that holds back on strong spices; Shaoxing wine from China and Taiwan; handmade spring rolls; bento to take away. Reviews (2026, in English): Morikou bento ¥1,400 (sweet-and-sour pork, crab omelette, roast pork, spring rolls, shrimp tempura); sweet-and-sour pork ¥1,300; mapo tofu; shark-fin soup; Peking duck; a peacock painting; lunch full right at opening; some find it oily.

食べログ: 中華旬彩 森本、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-4-14 燕京ビルB1F、0.en: Tabelog: Chuka Shunsai Morimoto, Enkyo Bldg B1F, 1-4-14 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 050-5589-2665 (reservations), 06-6252-6022; no reservations at lunch; bookings cancelled if 15 minutes late without notice; daily 11:30–15:00 (last entry 14:30) and 18:00–22:00 (food L.O. 21:00, drinks L.O. 21:30); cards and QR payment accepted, no e-money; 48 seats (small groups may share a table for 6); no smoking; opened 24 June 2015; Hyakumeiten (Chinese WEST 2021, 2023, 2024); site media-up.jp/morimoto. 2026 reviews (February–October): mouth-watering chicken is the most popular (heaped coriander, spicy sauce with lots of sesame); coriander can be swapped for leek; queues at lunch; no queue after 14:00; fluffy egg soup; almond tofu; rice refills available; clay-pot mapo tofu (set meal too); spicy chicken; water spinach; xiaolongbao; draught beer ¥950; bean-sprout fried noodles (yellow nira); rich tantanmen; ¥2,000 each for two sharing one beer.

食べログ: 中華蕎麦 神山 HONMACHI、大阪市中央区南本町3-2-21、本.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Shinzan HONMACHI, 3-2-21 Minamihommachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Hommachi Station, 5 min from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed weekends; no cards, e-money or QR; 15 counter seats; no smoking; opened 8 June 2026. Reviews (June–October 2026): kombu-water tsukemen; 2 kinds of wontons; special kombu-water tsukemen; hand-rubbed abura soba; half rice; grilled flying-fish seafood shoyu; house-made high-hydration hand-rubbed flat noodles; shrimp and meat wontons; rare chashu; soft-boiled egg; smooth whole-wheat noodles with sea salt; flat wavy noodles; strong seafood shoyu; shoulder-loin chashu; opened in June; a facade like a Japanese restaurant; ticket machine outside; counter only; kombu-water tsukemen ¥920; moshio seaweed salt; paper aprons; seared chashu rice bowl; a rich yet gentle soup; clear salt; hand-rubbed wavy noodles; big rare chashu; shoyu-based dipping soup.

食べログ: 中華蕎麦 葛、大阪市西区阿波座1-12-21 喜多ビル 1F、本町駅.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Kuzu, Kita Bldg 1F, 1-12-21 Awaza, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Hommachi Station exit 23; 11:00 (around 10:45)–16:00; closed Fridays; New Year closure announced; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; 9 seats; opened 25 August 2015; Tabelog Ramen OSAKA Hyakumeiten 2023, 2024 and 2025. Reviews (June 2025 – October 2026): dashi soba ¥690 (¥550 at opening); a slightly thick shoyu soup of chicken and bonito flakes; tare of dark and twice-brewed shoyu from Hozan in Aichi; a frothy, creamy mouthfeel; house-made medium-thick straight noodles; moist chashu; pepper and yuzu-kosho on the table; about 7 waiting at weekday lunch, 15 minutes; cold noodles and roast-pork rice bowl set under ¥1,000; espuma style; special topping +¥150 for extra chashu and seasoned egg; served in about 5 minutes; first in line at 10:30 on a holiday; 3 waiting chairs outside; about 5 waiting even after 14:00 on a Saturday; plenty of noodles; creamy but not heavy; about 8 waiting at 12:30; rice dishes sold out; bonito flakes at the bottom; smoky seasoned egg and chashu.

食べログ: 中華食堂 月ノ光、中華料理・バル・gyoza、四谷三栄町25-33.en: Tabelog: Chuka Shokudo Tsuki No Hikari, Chinese, bar, gyoza; Yotsuya Sanei-chō 25-33, 坊ビル 1F; 4 min walk from Yotsuya-sanchome Station, 8 min from Akebonobashi Station, 9 min from Yotsuya Station; Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00, closed Sundays and holidays; evenings by reservation only (private hire from 5 people); no cards, e-money or QR; no service charge, no cover charge; 16 seats (6 at the counter, plus tables); non-smoking; opened 14 August 2017; tantanmen and set meals at lunch, handmade gyoza, Chinese dishes and drinks in the evening.
