Reviews (2022–2026): run by the owner alone; tantanmen that isn't spicy; dry tantanmen ¥900 (¥50 off for half noodles); chilled tantanmen; mala tantanmen; chili oil, Sichuan pepper, vinegar and pepper on the table; yurinchi set meal; ¥4,500 course with free-flow drinks; cash only.

食べログ: 中華食堂ノロマツ、大阪市天王寺区上本町6-3-31 ハイハイタウン.en: Tabelog: Chuka Shokudo Noromatsu, Haihai Town B1F, 6-3-31 Uehommachi, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; directly connected to Osaka-Uehommachi Station; daily 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closing days vary; reservations accepted; cards, transit IC, iD, QUICPay and PayPay accepted; 18 seats (10 counter seats, two tables for four); non-smoking; children welcome; take-out; delivery; English-speaking staff; photo menu; opened 15 July 2026. Shop text: the taste of Toyonaka's Noromatsu Hanten in Haihai Town; the signature yakimeshi is "fast" and "delicious"; yakisoba with a soy-based Chinese-style sauce and noodles made for yakisoba; chuka soba with a soy-based broth and thin straight noodles, recommended as a set with yakimeshi. Goguynet Tennoji-Abeno (16 June 2026): the second shop of the popular Toyonaka machi-chuka Noromatsu Hanten, which supervises it. (20 July 2026): yakimeshi and yakisoba are the specialties; also tenshinhan, sweet and sour pork, gyoza. Kansai Kaiten (15 July 2026): supervised by Noromatsu Hanten; the two specialties are yakimeshi and yakisoba; chuka soba, miso ramen, stamina ramen, tenshinhan, mapo rice bowl, gyoza. Blog (15 July 2026, pre-opening reception): a franchise shop supervised by Noromatsu Hanten at Hankyu Okamachi Station; from 15 to 17 July a yakisoba and fried-rice set at ¥500; the yakimeshi is the loose, separate-grain kind with a garlic flavour; the chuka soba is a clear soy broth from chicken bones and pork, with medium-thin straight noodles. Reviews (July–October 2026): order by QR code; yakisoba and mini yakimeshi set ¥1,188; chuka soba and garlic yakimeshi ¥1,298; large and extra-large sizes; free refills of egg soup; the yakisoba is thin noodles, add vinegar halfway; the chuka soba is gentle, slightly sweet and old-fashioned; the omurice started as a staff meal; gyoza ¥308; nira-tama ¥638; a medium bottle of Aka boshi ¥638; full at Saturday lunch with a short wait; a line outside in the evening.

食べログ: 中華麺食堂 亀吉、大阪市中央区内本町2-3-8 ダイアパレスビル 1.en: Tabelog: Chuka Men Shokudo Kameyoshi, Dia Palace Bldg 1F, 2-3-8 Uchihommachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 7 min walk from Tanimachi-Yonchome Station, 8 min from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station; Tue–Sat 11:30–15:00; closed Sundays, Mondays and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; no smoking; opened 21 October 2011. Reviews (October 2025 – October 2026): summer menu; kote-shiro (shoyu) ramen; half-and-half ramen and fried rice; many kinds of ramen and fried rice; black-egg fried rice; always a queue; occasional closures; large fried rice half set ¥1,400; salt scallop; the fried rice comes first; one was told to return the dishes; the tantanmen has a faint aroma of Sichuan pepper; plenty of minced meat; comes with white rice; spicy miso ramen and half fried rice; omu fried rice ¥1,100; on the lardy side; seafood gomoku fried rice ¥1,300, nearly 500 g; white smoke from the wok inside; more dishes after 13:00; a 20-minute wait for the black-egg fried rice; dark shoyu and big chashu.

食べログ: 串カツさくら 南海難波店、大阪市中央区難波3-1-18、06-663.en: Tabelog: Kushikatsu Sakura Nankai Namba, 3-1-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6630-8039; reservations accepted (not on Friday nights, weekends, holidays or busy periods: first come, first served); Mon–Fri 11:30–22:30, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–22:30; open every day of the year (L.O. 30 minutes before closing); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 50 seats (counter 9, tables 29, sunken kotatsu 12); no smoking; opened 11 April 2012. Shop's description: kushikatsu with rice flour in the batter to absorb less oil; 100% vegetable oil changed daily; an ultra-thin coating; the original rice-flour skewers. 2026 reviews (September–October): big skewers; always a queue; narrow seats by the 2nd-floor aisle; beer and kushikatsu slow; 2nd floor at 11:00 right after opening; the top-5 popular skewers; simmered beef tendon and cabbage; quail eggs go well with light shoyu; chicken; fresh shrimp; the beef (medium-rare) is sinewy; the pork dry; the rice-flour batter light and crisp; choose special sauce, roasted salt or white shoyu; doteyaki; kisu; onion; shishito; red pickled ginger; asparagus; fried on the ground floor, so no oil smell upstairs; no heaviness the next day; tulip (chicken wing); one found some a little over-fried.

食べログ: 串揚げなかや人形町、串揚げ、日本酒バー、海鮮、日本橋人形町2-10-.en: Tabelog: Kushiage Nakaya Ningyocho, kushiage, sake bar, seafood; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-10-7, 2F, 3 min walk from Ningyocho Station; Mon–Sat 17:30–22:30, Sun 17:00–21:30; irregular closures; reservations accepted; mention allergies when booking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 20 seats; private room; non-smoking; opened 27 May 2017; a sister restaurant of Kushiemon in Yanagibashi; a thin batter and 10 house sauces; omakase on the stop system (¥620 appetiser plus the skewers); another shop in Kodenmacho. Reviews (June–October 2026): courses about ¥6,000 and about ¥8,000; shrimp wrapped in shiso, swordfish, asparagus wrapped in meat, wagyu with zucchini, blanched conger eel; fried bread to finish (cocoa or kinako); sake and wine; ordering by smartphone; one found the bill high; one said the staff, working alone, looked stretched.

食べログ: 串揚げ・居酒屋、中京区木屋町三条下ル材木町140番地 河きたビル1F.en: Tabelog: kushiage, izakaya; 1F, 140, Kiyamachi south of Sanjo, Nakagyo Ward; 175 m from Sanjo Stn; 18:00–4:00 (L.O. 3:30); closed Thursday; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 seats; counter; smoking allowed; seafood and meat skewers; sake, shochu, wine, cocktails. Reviews (December 2021–March 2026, English): a narrow lane at the north end of Pontocho, in front of the Kaburenjo; the owner is a former boxer; light, thin batter; shrimp with tartar sauce, asparagus, fillet cutlet, ham and potato, kombu; pickles and oden as the starter; many regulars; a friendly owner.

食べログ: 串揚家 でらじろう、串揚げ、居酒屋、日本橋人形町1-16-12 寺村.en: Tabelog: Kushiageya Derajiro, kushiage, izakaya; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 1-16-12, 1F, 2 min walk from Ningyocho Station exit A2 and Suitengumae Station exit 6; Mon–Fri 16:00–23:30, Sat and holidays 16:00–23:00; closed Sunday; reservations accepted; private hire; cards accepted, no e-money; 30 seats; smoking allowed (mention it when booking if you mind); kushiage of carefully chosen ingredients and local sake; omakase 10-skewer set ¥1,200 (2018 menu, before tax); skewers about ¥90–¥300; Nagoya dote-ni. Reviews (July 2025–September 2026): about 12 years; edamame and peanuts as the starter; light batter; garlic menchi; cheese tsukune; pork-and-cheese mille-feuille; fried river shrimp; Akashi-yaki; kamameshi to finish; cheap; the owner's smile; smoking everywhere leaves smoke and oil smell on clothes; some found the potato salad ordinary.

食べログ: 串焼BISTRO 福みみ 銀座5、銀座5-10-9 銀座YKビルB1.en: Tabelog: Kushiyaki BISTRO Fukumimi Ginza 5, Ginza 5-10-9 Ginza YK Building B1F; daily 16:30–23:15; 56 seats (semi-private sunken kotatsu); cashless only; seat charge ¥660; 10% late-night charge after 22:00; 2-hour limit; shoes off; qualified invoice T1040001010233. FindMeGlutenFree: 32 reviews, 13 safety ratings, GF menu (skewers, salads), "staff responded in English and found dishes safe even for celiac".

食べログ: 串焼き・居酒屋・魚介料理、中京区裏寺町607-18、阪急「河原町」駅.en: Tabelog: kushiyaki, izakaya, seafood; 中京区裏寺町607-18; about 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn; Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat 16:00–22:30, Sun 15:00–22:00; closed Thursday and irregularly; bookings taken; 2nd-floor tatami room (5–8 people) can be booked; 16 seats (8 counter, 8 tatami); smoking allowed; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; English menu; opened 12 November 2020; menu (English version, updated May 2026): mackerel (kombu-cured) ¥420, seasonal pork roll ¥350, shishamo with roe ¥280, salmon belly ¥300, kuruma prawn ¥420, oyster (sudachi ponzu) ¥420, spicy cod roe ¥330, Kyotanba highland pork steak ¥350, sashimi, smoked-mackerel macaroni salad ¥580, chikuwa tempura ¥600, chicken-breast chashu ¥750, salted kara-age ¥750, seafood namero ¥880, tatami-iwashi ¥400, egg-yolk rice ¥500, shijimi soup ¥380, homemade pickled sour ¥650. Invoice register: 木村 高行 (individual). Reviews (December 2025–October 2026, in English): pork rolls with Kujo green onion, shiso and lettuce; Kinmiya homemade pickled sour; myoga sour; no yakitori; smoking allowed at the seats.

食べログ: 丸十、焼肉、六番町4-11 朝日六番町マンション B1F、JR市ケ谷.en: Tabelog: Maruju, yakiniku; Rokubanchō 4-11, 朝日六番町マンション B1F; from JR Ichigaya Station go straight along Nittere-dōri, cross the light at the top of the hill, basement of the building; no hours listed; no cards, e-money or QR; 20 seats; smoking allowed; shochu and wine. Reviews (2022–2026): Showa-style tare kalbi, liver, salted tongue, salted loin, flap meat, kalbi, cold noodles; heifer beef; regulars and their introductions only, no new reservations; rules on ordering and where to rest your chopsticks; run by a couple, with the proprietress handling the dining room alone; reservations by 18:00, closes at 21:00; under ¥10,000 a head.

食べログ: 九州らーめん亀王 難波NGK前店、大阪市中央区難波千日前10-13、.en: Tabelog: Kyushu Ramen Kiou Namba NGK-mae, 10-13 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-4397-6545; reservations accepted; daily 11:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); closed New Year's Day; no cards or e-money; QR accepted; 28 seats (two tables for 4, one for 8); opened 2 April 2010; official kiou.co.jp. 2026 reviews (January–September): burnt back-fat tonkotsu shoyu (extra-large; extra meat, noodles and vegetables); garlic; chewy thick noodles; an introduction to Jiro style; tomato ramen (3 heat levels; level 2 milder than Shin Ramyun); tomato tsukemen; tomato ramen ¥890; asked your noodle firmness; medium-thin noodles; inbound tourists and nearby office workers; Kiou ramen with half fried rice and a noodle refill (firm is like kona-otoshi); cold abura soba ¥890 and half fried rice ¥490 ordered on a tablet; a sweetish, strong shoyu tare; the Kiou ramen is a rich tonkotsu mellowed for Kansai; creamy with no off-smell; extra-thin straight noodles.

食べログ: 九条まんてん、大阪市西区九条1-11-17、中央線九条駅から徒歩3分.en: Tabelog: Kujo Manten, 1-11-17 Kujo, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Chuo Line Kujo Station; Tue, Wed and Fri 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–21:00, Thu 11:00–15:00, Sat–Sun 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–21:00; closed Mondays; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 seats (counter 5, tables); opened 24 June 2023. Reviews (July–September 2026): weekend-only cold hamo and sudachi ¥1,200 (announced by SMS); pay first; hamo dashi; sudachi first on the spoon; ice in the soup; chatting with the owner; cold salt ramen ¥1,200 (medium-thick straight noodles, rare chashu, chicken chashu, chopped onion, half a seasoned egg, tomato ice, menma, leek, yuzu); tomato strength adjusted after feedback; usually run single-handed, so slow when busy; clear-broth soup and carefully chosen noodles; shoyu ramen with egg on rice (branded egg 'Musou Maru'); jidori umami and delicate seafood dashi; pink rare chashu; firm straight noodles; cash only; the cold salt is limited and sells out; salt ramen and rice bowl; a little hard to find; Tajima chicken; Tamba black chicken; real kombu; Kyoto Teigaku vacuum mixer.

食べログ: 二代目憲 hirayama、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-4-6 さよかビ.en: Tabelog: Nidaime Norihirayama, Sayoka Building 2F, 2-4-6 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min on foot from Exit 7 of Nagahoribashi Station, 8 min from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon–Sat 18:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); closed Sundays and on a Monday after a public holiday; closes when sold out; reservations accepted (courses for 2 or more, by the day before); cards accepted; no e-money or QR; appetizer ¥300; 18 seats; smoking allowed. Shop's introduction: authentic Tosa cooking by an owner from Kochi; whole fresh bonito bought by the owner and straw-grilled in front of you; closed on days without good bonito; thick or thin cut, with salt, wasabi or sauce; Kochi ingredients such as Utsubo, Tougoro and Chambara-gai; seasonally sunfish, bear and sea turtle; Kochi sake and shochu (Dabada Hiburi, Suigei); 4 counter seats and 3 tables; private hire up to 20. Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): the thick-cut salt tataki is the best; people from Kochi call it the best in Osaka; white shrimp tempura, red beef tataki, grilled eel (shirayaki), straw-grilled mentaiko, Tosa maki, firefly squid, fried oysters, deep-fried eel, steak, tea soba mixed with egg yolk, honey sweet potato ice cream; large portions; smoking allowed; one diner would have liked the ponzu on the side.

食べログ: 二条城ふる田、日本料理、中京区押小路通小川西入ル古城町371、二条城.en: Tabelog: Nijojo Furuta, Japanese cuisine, 中京区押小路通小川西入ル古城町371, about 3 min on foot from Nijojo-mae Stn exit 2; lunch 12:00–14:30; dinner 17:00–20:30 (last entry); closed irregularly; reservation only; bookable via Instagram and Facebook; basic omakase from ¥20,000; special course with chosen ingredients from ¥30,000 (market price); service 10%; groups of 6 or more take the whole room; preschool children generally not admitted; cards and PayPay accepted; opened 27 April 2016; The Tabelog Award Bronze 2018–2023; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023. Reviews (July 2025–June 2026, in English): a six-seat counter, an owner who runs it alone, training at Yukimura, Wakuden and Gion Okada, charcoal, takikomi rice, and a view that drinks are pricey.

食べログ: 五右衛門 ウイング新橋店、港区新橋2丁目 東口地下街1号、JR新橋駅.en: Tabelog: Goemon Wing Shimbashi, Shinbashi 2-chome, Minato-ku, East Exit Underground Mall No. 1, right by JR Shinbashi Station Karasumori exit; 20 seats; weekdays 11:00–22:00, weekends 11:00–21:00; no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; official site www.yomenya-goemon.com. 2026 reviews: mentaiko and takana, karasumi peperoncino, pork-shabu pasta, eggplant and mozzarella carbonara meat sauce with a soft-boiled egg, autumn-only mushroom peperoncino, the regular portion is smallish, busy until closing, a short queue at lunch but turnover is quick, ¥1,000–2,000.

食べログ: 五右衛門 日比谷店、千代田区有楽町1-6-1 第2日比谷ビル2F、日.en: Tabelog: Goemon Hibiya, Yurakucho 1-6-1, Chiyoda-ku, 第2日比谷 Building 2F, 2 minutes from Hibiya Station; 30 seats; weekdays 11:30–21:30, weekends and holidays 11:30–22:00; cards, IC and PayPay accepted; opened September 21, 2012; official site yomenya-goemon.com. 2026 reviews: Hakata-style pasta with mentaiko, spicy takana, shirasu and raw egg ¥1,130; tarako pasta (with soup); vegetable peperoncino; order by the QR code on the table; pasta eaten with chopsticks; lunch sets with a drink or dessert; about 20 minutes until served; a queue just after 13:00 on weekdays.

食べログ: 五條家、串揚げ、大阪市淀川区西中島7-3-3 末広ハイツ101、JR.en: Tabelog: Gojo Ya, kushiage, 7-3-3 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, 末広ハイツ 101; 10 min from JR Shin-Osaka Station, 6 min from the subway Shin-Osaka Station; Mon–Fri 17:30–22:00, closed Sat, Sun and holidays; reservations accepted; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; seat charge ¥300; 12 seats (counter only); smoking allowed. Reviews (June 2020 to January 2026): south of Exit 7 of the Midosuji Line, on an alley corner, a white noren and a kushikatsu lantern, a sliding door, a U-shaped counter, run by a veteran couple; once had lines for its lunchtime pork-cutlet sets, now evenings only; omakase only, until you say "stop"; a trial 10 skewers ¥2,500; four sauces, chosen by where you lay the skewer; beef, shrimp, eel and tofu, chicken breast and yam, kisu and mitsuba, satoimo dengaku, okra with bacon and cheese, shimeji wrapped in meat, scallop, conger eel, quail egg, squid with sea-urchin sauce, kelp with roe, pork, negima, mochi with cheese; sorbet and a chocolate skewer for dessert; booking by phone recommended; the skewers are small.

食べログ: 京中華 牧定、中華、中京区高倉二条下る瓦町565-5、京都市役所前駅.en: Tabelog: Kyoto Chuka Makisada, Chinese, 中京区高倉二条下る瓦町565-5, 5 min on foot from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae or Karasuma-Oike Stn; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 18:00–21:00; closed Wednesday; reservation only; 8 counter seats; smoking allowed in the garden; no cards; opened 7 November 2022; Chinese WEST Tabelog 100 2024, 2026. Reviews (January–October 2026, in English): run by young brothers, everyone starting at 18:00, omakase ¥19,800–22,000, Ise lobster, shark fin, Peking duck with seasonal fruit, the next booking six to nine months away, the father's ramen shop.

食べログ: 京料理 藤本、日本料理、中京区新町通御池下ル神明町72 エリタージュ.en: Tabelog: 京料理 藤本 (Kyo Ryori Fujimoto), Japanese cuisine; 中京区新町通御池下ル神明町72 エリタージュ新町1F; 266 m from Karasuma-Oike Station; reservations through the official site; no cards; 13 seats; non-smoking; opened 2 July 2018. Official site: dinner 18:00–22:00 (Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun); lunch 12:00–14:00 (Tue, Fri, Sun); closed Wednesday and public holidays; evening omakase ¥14,300; white-wood counter; moved in July 2018; a Michelin star after the move. Michelin Guide: the family were vegetable wholesalers, familiar with the market from childhood; went to the market with a mentor and learned to judge ingredients; cash only. Reviews (2025–2026, in English): run by a married couple; the owner, Fujimoto, is from Kyoto and trained at places including Shuhaku; independent in 2008; abalone simmered in sake; sesame tofu; hamo and matsutake; homemade karasumi; dessert cart; lunch courses ¥5,000–10,000.

食べログ: 京菓子司 松寿軒、和菓子・どら焼き、東山区松原通大和大路西入弓矢町1.en: Tabelog: Kyogashi Tsukasa 松寿軒, wagashi, dorayaki; 弓矢町19-12, west of Yamato-oji on Matsubara-dori, Higashiyama-ku; 6 min walk from Kiyomizu-Gojo Station; reservations take priority (items may be sold out for walk-ins); currently closed all day for renovation, but phone reservations are possible; fresh jō-namagashi must be ordered by the day before; no cards, e-money or QR; non-smoking; founded 1932; supplier to Kenninji, also to Kodaiji; Gion teahouses; Japanese sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2023 and 2026, Sweets WEST 2018–2020 and 2022, Sweets 2017. Reviews (February–November 2026, in English): Mikasa (a small dorayaki) ¥180, monaka filled after ordering ¥180, seasonal jō-namagashi ¥300–360, botamochi ¥200, warabi mochi ¥350, doyō-mochi, opens at 11:00, one review gives the founding as 1927.

食べログ: 京都 いとおかし、食堂、下京区高辻通油小路東入永養寺町224、大宮駅.en: Tabelog: 京都 いとおかし (Kyoto Itookashi), set-meal restaurant; 下京区高辻通油小路東入永養寺町224; 605 m from Omiya Station; Mon–Sat 7:00–14:30; closed Sunday; reservations by TableCheck only; breakfast at the counter only (there are also tables and seats upstairs); no service or cover charge; cards and PayPay accepted; English menu; smoking allowed; opened 2 August 2025. Reviews (October 2026, in English): set meals of thick grilled salted salmon (three seasonings to choose from); Kyoto grilled salmon set ¥2,500; pot-cooked Natsuhonoka rice from Kagoshima (free refills); clam soup; dashi poured over at the end; student set at 7:00 ¥1,000; sesame mackerel; amberjack sashimi; eel; raw oysters; tamago kake gohan; 50-minute limit; the old tiled kitchen of a machiya.

食べログ: 京都 ネーゼ、イタリアン、中京区三条木屋町上ル三軒目 三条木屋町ビル.en: Tabelog: 京都 ネーゼ, Italian; 中京区三条木屋町上ル三軒目 三条木屋町ビルⅡ 3F; 3 min on foot from Keihan Sanjo Station; Mon–Sat 18:00–23:00; closed Sunday and irregularly; reservations taken; 16 seats (8 counter, 8 table); non-smoking; cards accepted; opened 20 August 2007; mainly à la carte; a course with a reservation by the day before (¥6,000; from ¥8,800 in another field); the chef's blog (Ameba); Italian WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023 and 2025. Shop introduction (English translation): chef Hiroshi Mori, formerly of Santa Maria Novella Tisaneria; the menu changes almost daily; smoked chicken offal; prosciutto you can slice yourself. Reviews (2024–2026, in English): run by a couple; carbonara with five Yamada Farm egg yolks; cold sea-urchin capellini; baguette from Akane BAKERY.

食べログ: 京鴨ひつまぶし かもしぎん、居酒屋・おでん・しゃぶしゃぶ、中京区富小.en: Tabelog: Kyogamo Hitsumabushi Kamoshigin, izakaya, oden, shabu-shabu; 富小路西大文字町610, Nakagyo-ku; about 2 min walk from exit 12 of Hankyu Karasuma and Kyoto Kawaramachi stations; lunch 12:00–14:00 (Monday to 14:30; 30 servings; no reservations); dinner 18:00–21:30 (Sunday to 21:00; food L.O. 20:15); holidays lunch only; irregular closing days (Instagram); at night a starter and one drink per person; under-15s not admitted at night; cash only; 20 seats; private rooms; non-smoking; opened 30 April 2023; domestic and Kyoto ingredients; hitsumabushi of 京鴨, a brand duck from Uji; obanzai of Tango seafood and Kyoto vegetables; Oni Niku Mori hitsumabushi (a Mezamashi TV Kyoto-area winning menu); all-you-can-drink courses incl. Peking duck. Reviews (May–November 2026, in English): hitsumabushi eaten three ways, with rich egg ¥2,560, cold soba, some complaints about service.

食べログ: 人 8888、居酒屋、日本料理、日本酒バー、日本橋人形町2-11-4.en: Tabelog: Hito 8888, izakaya, Japanese cuisine, sake bar; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-11-4, 2 min walk from Ningyocho Station exit A2 and Suitengumae Station exit 7, right by Amazake Yokocho; Mon–Sat 16:00–23:00; closed Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; 2.5-hour limit when busy; ¥710 table charge; cards and transport IC accepted; 10 seats (3 at the counter, 7 at tables); smoking allowed; opened 2 July 2018. Reviews (January 2024–October 2026): run by the owner alone; regulars help with serving; a renovated old house; pick sake from the fridge and it's poured into a tokkuri; sashimi from Toyosu; fried yuba with crab cream; dashimaki; carbonara; some say the name is read "Quattro Eight"; some found the simmered collar overcooked or the drinks pricey.

食べログ: 人形町 田酔、日本料理、日本酒バー、居酒屋、日本橋人形町1-7-6.en: Tabelog: Ningyocho Densui; Japanese cuisine, sake bar, izakaya; HSビル 2F, Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 1-7-6; 1 min from Ningyocho Station exit A2; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00, Sat 11:30–14:00 and 16:00–22:00; closed Sundays and holidays, New Year and 11–13 August; evening bookings prioritised for sake drinkers; the Jimbocho shop when full; no service or cover charge; cards accepted; no e-money or QR; 18 seats (4 counter, 14 table); opened 18 September 2009; website densui.net. Reviews (July–October 2026): drunk on the blessings of the rice fields; sake from all over Japan; Densui hassun; sashimi; beef and porcini cream croquette; abalone with liver sauce; dashimaki; saikyo-grilled black cod; black-truffle clay-pot rice; the owner alone in the kitchen; leftover rice made into rice balls; free rice refills on lunch sets; some found portions small; founding years of 2001 and 2010 also given; shops in Otemachi and Jimbocho too.

食べログ: 人形町 鮨 なかむら、寿司、日本橋人形町1-16-2 1F、昼は予約.en: Tabelog: Ningyocho Sushi Nakamura, sushi; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 1-16-2 1F; lunch by reservation only, dinner from 18:00; closed Monday; cards and e-money accepted, no QR; 8 counter seats; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; opened 16 February 2023. Reviews (June 2025–October 2026): chef Takahiro Nakamura; 43 years of experience; friendly and fun to talk to; lunch courses from ¥10,000, dinner from ¥20,000; seasonal small dishes, then about 9 nigiri starting with fatty tuna; rice seasoned with red and white vinegar; Amela tomato with cream cheese; Wajima aoyagi; fugu; returning bonito from Kesennuma; sea urchin; anago; tamagoyaki of fish paste and yam; unusual sakes; high quality for the price.

食べログ: 人形町らーめん いなせ、ラーメン、日本橋人形町2-2-3 堀口ビル.en: Tabelog: Ningyocho Ramen Inase, ramen; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-2-3, 1F, 2 min walk from Ningyocho Station; Mon–Thu, Sat and holidays 11:00–2:30, Fri 11:00–4:00, Sun 11:00–23:00 (the remarks say Sat and Sun 11:00–2:30, Mon 11:00–23:00); open every day of the year; no reservations; no cards, e-money and QR accepted; 15 seats; non-smoking inside; small plates for children. Reviews (April 2025–October 2026): a lighter iekei-style tonkotsu shoyu; spinach and nori; ramen ¥600 (up from ¥550); medium ¥700; the most popular, negi ramen ¥750; ajitama chashu ramen ¥950; Ningyocho ramen ¥1,000; kaedama of thin noodles ¥150; extra soup ¥50; a three-snack set ¥380; draft beer ¥300; busy late at night too; some wanted more punch.

食べログ: 人形町今半 銀座店、銀座6-8-7 交詢ビル5F、銀座駅A2出口から.en: Tabelog: Ningyocho Imahan Ginza, Ginza 6-8-7, Kojun Building 5F, 5 minutes from Ginza Station exit A2; 38 seats; private rooms for 2 and 4 (room charge), tatami room; daily 11:30–15:00, 17:00–22:00 (food L.O. 20:30); 12% service charge (all day); children's menu; official site imahan.com; Sukiyaki & Shabu-shabu Top 100 2024. 2026 reviews: a course in a private room starting with starters and sashimi; melting sukiyaki; premium sukiyaki set (120 g beef and rice); the sauce is a little salty; experienced servers; take off your shoes (slippers if barefoot); many overseas visitors too; after booking, checked carefully by email how severe a fish allergy was; a children's bento; a gift from the shop for a child with a birthday coming up.

食べログ: 人情麺家 牛骨王、大阪市中央区南船場1-12-27 幸福相互ビル 1.en: Tabelog: Ninjo Menya Gyukotsu Ou, Kofuku Sogo Bldg 1F, 1-12-27 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 278 m from Nagahoribashi; daily 11:30–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); PayPay accepted, no cards or e-money; 9 seats; no smoking (ashtray outside); opened 6 June 2016. Reviews (May–October 2026): the recommended salt beef-bone ramen; a flavour like no other; chewy noodles like Hong Kong wonton noodles; fragrant fried garlic; the owner runs the counter shop single-handed; richer than tonkotsu; tender beef tendon instead of chashu; thin noodles; red pickled ginger and sesame; an overseas diner asked for a handshake; warm service and a send-off; a gentle flavour; paitan ramen; free noodle refills; limited cold noodles (seasoned egg, pork shabu, aosa, nori, leek, lemon); ticket machine; many overseas diners; a soup without off-smells or bitterness; stew-like meat for chashu; straight noodles; noodle refill or rice free at lunch.

食べログ: 人類みなウチのラーメン、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-14-18、080-.en: Tabelog: Jinrui Mina Uchi no Ramen, 1-14-18 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 080-3441-6891; reservations accepted; daily 11:00–22:30; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; opened 27 October 2025. 2026 reviews (June–August): other diners even around 11 p.m.; drank every drop of the regular shellfish-broth ramen; the recommended miso ramen tastes like Tadokoro Shoten; limited cold ramen ¥1,280 (Japanese dashi, cold thick wavy noodles, thin-sliced rare chashu, leek, shiso, radish sprouts, menma, seasoned egg); one was happy the miso returned after the renovation; one called the shellfish broth ordinary and the mentaiko rice out of a tube; cheap-looking decor; one won't return because of the silent service.

食べログ: 人類みな辛さが全て、大阪市阿倍野区阿倍野筋1-2-30 HOOP B.en: Tabelog: Jinrui Mina Karasa ga Subete, HOOP B1F food hall, 1-2-30 Abenosuji, Abeno-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Abeno Station; daily 11:00–23:00 (the shop's account gave 11:00–21:30 as of September 2026); cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 12 February 2023; official site. Reviews (August 2023 – October 2026): the spicy shop of the Jinrui Mina Menrui group; Jinrui Mina Karasa ga Subete 50 (jjigae-soup ramen, chili, chili oil, lots of minced meat, medium-thick noodles, thick chashu) ¥1,100; 30 (shoyu-based spicy soupless) ¥1,000; yukgaejang ramen (one likens it to Mongolian Tanmen Nakamoto); chashu ramen 50; heat none, 1–4, Over and END (+¥200); staff say END is recommended only to those who've eaten Over; one says 2 is already very hot and 1 enough; chashu and soft-boiled-egg toppings; pork rice bowl ¥350; collect with a buzzer in the food hall.

食べログ: 人類みな麺類 つけ麺専門店、つけ麺、大阪市淀川区西中島3-17-5.en: Tabelog: Jinrui Mina Menrui Tsukemen Senmon Ten, tsukemen, 3-17-5 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, リバーボール 1F; 48 m from Minamikata Station; daily 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; no reservations; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; 9 counter seats and one table for 4; non-smoking; opened 27 April 2025. Reviews (October 2026): a tsukemen-only shop; opened in 2025 in Nishinakajima-Minamigata and Kyoto; seafood and pork-bone dips in a clay pot kept hot over solid fuel; "Honten" (soy, a little sweet and sour, lots of white negi), "Micro" (garlic), "Macro" (citrus and chili, the most popular); thick whole-wheat noodles about a metre long, cut with scissors; 200 g, 300 g and 400 g at the same price; "Simple" is half an egg and two pieces of rolled chashu; low-temperature rare chashu too; Micro Simple 300 g ¥980; Macro Simple with rare chashu ¥1,080; Macro Regular 300 g ¥1,300; mini pork rice bowl with mayonnaise; Hoegaarden; buy a ticket, then queue outside; some found the noodles very hard, some the pot too hot.

食べログ: 人類みな麺類、ラーメン、ラーメン WEST 百名店 2017〜202.en: Tabelog: Jinrui Mina Menrui, ramen, Tabelog Ramen WEST 100 2017–2022, Ramen OSAKA 100 2023–2025, 1-12-15 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 0 min from Hankyu Minamikata Station, 1 min from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; Mon–Thu 10:00–03:00, Fri 10:00–04:00, Sat 9:00–04:00, Sun 9:00–03:00; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 26 seats; non-smoking; children welcome; opened 12 April 2012; operator unchi-co.com. Reviews (October–November 2026): under renovation and running from a temporary shop about a minute away; the staff are doing the renovation in-house, due to finish in December or next year; lines (about 10 people at 11:00, over 20 after 22:30); order by QR code through LINE; Mr.Children playing; soy-sauce ramen on a broth of asari and shijimi clams and bonito; a gentle sweetness; "Genten" is the richer soy, "Macro" brings the shellfish forward with light soy sauce; slightly thick straight noodles; melting thick-cut chashu, or thin slices; soft-boiled egg; thick menma; Macro with sliced chashu ¥950; thick-cut chashu with egg ¥1,400, the most popular; extra noodles; gyoza; a café-bar nearby gives half off with the receipt; some find the sweetness not to their taste.

食べログ: 今西軒、和菓子、下京区烏丸五条西入ル一筋目下ル横諏訪町312、五条駅.en: Tabelog: Imanishi Ken, wagashi, 下京区烏丸五条西入ル一筋目下ル横諏訪町312, 1–2 min on foot from Gojo Stn exit 4; from 9:30 until sold out; closed Tuesdays and the 1st, 3rd and 5th Mondays (Mondays and Tuesdays in July and August); from 8:00 during the equinox weeks; reservations until 14:00; no cards; temporarily closed in 1995 and reopened in 2002; Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2020, 2022; Japanese sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2023, 2026. Reviews (September–October 2026, in English): three kinds of ohagi — kinako, koshian, tsubuan — ¥240 each, a queue of 15–20 before opening, kinako sells out first.

食べログ: 伊勢田 (ISEDA)、大阪市西区新町1-9-14 丸勝ビル 1F、.en: Tabelog: ISEDA (伊勢田), 丸勝ビル 1F, 1-9-14 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min on foot from Nishi-Ohashi and Yotsubashi Stns; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 17:30–24:00 (L.O. 23:00), Wed 17:30–23:00 (L.O. food 22:00, drinks 22:30); irregular closures; reservations accepted; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money; 18 seats; smoking at all seats; up to 2 children; no strollers; opened April 2021 (remarks), moved from 2-3-3 Kitahorie. Menu (updated April 2026, tax included): kushikatsu (pork ¥170, beef ¥220, shrimp ¥300, scallop ¥280, Camembert ¥230, vegetables ¥130, red pickled ginger ¥150); horumon skewers ¥200–250; grilled liver ¥700; beef tataki yukhoe ¥890; dote-yaki ¥590; konjac steak ¥580; Chiri-tori teppan hot pot ¥2,980; finisher ¥480; cold kimchi noodles ¥890; kushikatsu set ¥1,800; grilled horumon set ¥1,900; special course ¥7,000. Reviews (April 2025 – September 2026): light, crisp batter; shared sauce with no double-dipping (2025); by April 2026 the sauce is poured over the plate; 10-piece kushikatsu assortment ¥1,690; cash only under ¥5,000; ¥330 table charge; sweet-spicy hot pot of horumon and vegetables, spice adjustable; ramen to finish; risotto with extra cheese; grilled liver with sesame oil and salt; busy on event days because it is near the Orix Theater; a pleasant owner; many regulars, yet a warm welcome; weak ventilation.

食べログ: 伊吹珈琲店 黒門市場、喫茶店、大阪市中央区日本橋1丁目22-31 黒.en: Tabelog: Ibuki Coffee Ten Kuromon Ichiba, kissaten, inside Kuromon Market, Nipponbashi 1-22-31, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 151 m from Kintetsu Nippombashi Station; daily 7:00–18:30 (food L.O. 18:00); closed only on 1 January; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; non-smoking; breakfast served; online shop open 24 hours. Official site: Ibuki Coffee Ten, house-roasted coffee beans, drip bags, bottled liquid coffee. Reviews (April–October 2026): a retro Showa interior, classical music, hot coffee ¥590 dark-roasted with a strong bitterness, sugar cubes, iced drinks made sweet or unsweet on request, morning set A (egg toast) and set C (morning sandwich), egg toast set ¥660, thick-cut toast, chestnut cake ¥660, cream sodas, about eight tables for four at the back, an English menu, a review saying it began as a branch of Marufuku Coffee, overseas visitors and locals.

食べログ: 伊太そば、港区東新橋1-8-2 カレッタ汐留B2F(汐留横丁)、汐留.en: Tabelog: Ita Soba, Higashi-Shinbashi 1-8-2, Minato-ku, Caretta Shiodome B2F (Shiodome Yokocho), 1 minute from Shiodome Station; weekdays 11:00–14:30, 17:00–22:00, weekends and holidays 11:00–17:00; 250 seats (food court); reservations accepted; opened February 20, 2026; favy.jp. 2026 reviews: an Italian restaurant in Narashino, Chiba, turned into a ramen shop in a TV revival project by Sakagami (of Gindaco); moved to Caretta Shiodome in February 2026; tonkotsu carbonara ramen (creamy tonkotsu with egg yolk, cheese and black pepper, prosciutto, thin, slightly firm noodles; add rice for a risotto finish); lunch set ¥1,350; the special has three slices of chashu and triple cheese; tonkotsu Genovese (basil-scented tonkotsu); the tonkotsu ramen is refined; hiyashi chuka; cold noodles with Shine Muscat or Nagano Purple on ultra-thin Asakusa Kaikaro noodles; porcini mazesoba about ¥1,300; at night "Ita Bar" with pizza and sake; sit anywhere; mobile ordering; no cash.

食べログ: 伝承油そば こぶたのはな、大阪市中央区高麗橋2-3-2、北浜から26.en: Tabelog: Densho Abura Soba Kobuta no Hana, 2-3-2 Koraibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 269 m from Kitahama; Mon–Sat 10:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00, holidays 10:30–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; 14 seats (counter 6, two tables for 4); opened 9 May 2018. Reviews (October 2024 – October 2026): densho abura soba ¥890; large ¥150; garlic partway through; one found the large a little small; chicken leek salt soba; rice; pepper, fried garlic, sesame; shrimp-salt abura soba; chili oil and vinegar; rare chashu; large portions; Nippo Koraibashi Bldg 1F; ticket machine cash only; rice sold out; chicken-leek abura soba non-spicy ¥960; densho abura soba slightly spicy ¥890; soft-boiled egg ¥200; quick-drink set ¥1,300 (seasoned menma, minced-meat cutlet); draught beer ¥550; vinegar, sesame and garlic chips on the table; a note on the wall says mix well from the bottom; thin-sliced chashu; lots of shredded white leek; busy at lunch, wait outside; shared tables; leek soba; small but clean and bright; a moderately rich sauce on smooth wavy noodles; spicy leek.

食べログ: 佛蘭西料理 銀座 誠(フランスリョウリ ギンザ マコト)、銀座7-6.en: Tabelog: French Ryori Ginza Makoto, Ginza 7-6-4, Ginza HIT Building B1F; Mon–Fri 18:00–23:00, Sat 18:00–21:30, closed Sun; official site ginzamakoto.jimdo.com. Reviews: opened September 2015, one street behind Namiki-dori; a calm wood-grain room of about 20 seats (a counter at the back, a private room); French you can order à la carte; pigeon and quail pâté; flounder carpaccio with paprika sauce; duck steak (July 2026); veal and lentils in blue-cheese sauce; game; wine pairing; the chef, Makoto (the spelling in an English review), formerly of Apicius (2023).

食べログ: 作ノ作 千日前本店、大阪市中央区難波1-1-1、11席(カウンターの.en: Tabelog: Sakunosaku Sennichimae main shop, 1-1-1 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 11 seats (counter only); Mon–Thu 5:00–2:30 next morning, Fri 5:00–24:00, Sat–Sun 24 hours; no cards; smoking allowed; official osaka-ramen.com. Shop introduction: Osaka's pride, the original Naniwa tonkotsu; besides tonkotsu, shoyu, salt, miso and tsukemen; chashu-men with chashu spilling over the bowl. 2026 reviews: ticket machine in front; L-shaped counter; Naniwa tonkotsu ¥1,080 (¥1,250 with spicy miso); one free noodle refill; 2 slices chashu, 2 of naruto, menma, leek; light Osaka tonkotsu; thin straight noodles; spicy miso hot enough to feel on the scalp; chashu-men ¥2,200; gyoza ¥100 with ramen; one says the gyoza is better; faintly sweet tonkotsu; red pickled ginger, ground sesame and garlic on the table; cold yuzu-lemon ramen ¥1,380 (gingery salt); shrimp-miso abura soba; snack set; tantan tsukemen; one found prices high; a bowl after drinking.

食べログ: 佳肴岡もと、日本料理、東山区常盤町470-4、Umacho バス停か.en: Tabelog: Kakou Okamoto, Japanese cuisine, 東山区常盤町470-4, 2 min on foot from the Umacho bus stop, 15 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn; Tue–Sun 18:00–22:00; closed Mondays and the last Sunday of the month; reservations accepted; 8 seats; private hire up to 20; cards accepted; no charge; opened 3 December 2013; The Tabelog Award 2021 Bronze; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021. Reviews (February 2025–July 2026, in English): owner Ryota Okamoto trained at HANA Kiccho and Akiyama, one omakase, dashi, shark-fin noodles, karasumi, sake pairing, a couple's hospitality.

食べログ: 俵コロッケ四ツ谷さくらい、コロッケ・カレー・弁当、四谷1-22-13.en: Tabelog: Tawara Croquette Yotsuya Sakurai, croquettes, curry, bento; Yotsuya 1-22-13; 3 min walk from Yotsuya Station; Mon–Sat 10:30 until sold out (takeaway only) and 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:30, eat-in); Saturdays by reservation; closed Sundays and holidays; 9 seats; non-smoking; no cards, e-money or QR. Reviews (March 2020–July 2026): opened August 2018, run by the owner alone, bento by day, evening sets ¥1,380–1,740, black wagyu potato croquette, red snow crab cream croquette, seasonal croquettes, fried oysters, clam miso soup, an omakase course, sake and wine.

食べログ: 俵屋旅館、旅館・日本料理、中京区麩屋町通姉小路上ル中白山町278、京.en: Tabelog: Tawaraya Ryokan — ryokan / Japanese; Fuyacho-dori north of Aneyakoji, Nakagyo-ku; about 5 min on foot from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn; check-in 15:00, check-out 11:00; open all year; cards accepted; private rooms; drinks may be brought in (no corkage); bento can be arranged ahead or on the day of a stay (no pickup on Tuesdays). Reviews (April 2023–August 2026, English): one of Kyoto's three great ryokan; warabi mochi and tea on arrival; breakfast yudofu; dinner from 18:30; breakfast from 8:00, Japanese or Western; ayu; duck hot pot; New Year osechi and white-miso zōni; some say the food falls short of expectations.

食べログ: 俺たちのカレー家、大阪市中央区難波千日前14-13、南海なんば駅から.en: Tabelog: Oretachi no Curry Ya, 14-13 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nankai Namba Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–16:30 and 17:30–22:30, Sat 11:00–22:00, Sun 11:00–21:45; open every day of the year; no reservations; no cards; e-money and QR accepted; 10 seats (counter); no smoking; opened 4 April 2016. Reviews (March–September 2026): cheese curry with falling-apart meat; a roux that isn't too sweet; seats a little cramped; katsu curry ¥930; like a nostalgic European-style curry; gentle heat after the sweetness; freshly fried katsu; pickles on the table; ticket machine, quick turnover; a counter shop on Nansan-dori; large katsu curry with sausage ¥1,400; a sweetish, thick roux; many overseas diners; chili sauce; large chicken curry with cheese; mild even at medium heat; English on the table sauces; fried-shrimp curry with soft-boiled egg; 10 seats at an L-shaped counter, 2 staff; the ticket machine linked to the kitchen; the fried shrimp not covered in roux; Osaka-style curry rice; toppings (tonkatsu, chicken katsu, soft-boiled egg, cheese, Kujo leek, spinach, sausage).

食べログ: 個室 炭火焼肉 有田牛 本店、銀座8-2-15 明興ビル2F、コリド.en: Tabelog: Sumibi Yakiniku Arita Gyu main shop, Ginza 8-2-15, 明興 Building 2F, on Corridor-gai midway between Shinbashi and Yurakucho stations, 3 minutes from Shinbashi Station; weekdays 17:00–23:00, Sat 17:00–22:00, closed Sundays and holidays; every seat in a fully private room; smoking at the table allowed; courses require booking; cancellation fee; when booking, note whether it's your first visit and any allergies or disliked foods; opened September 4, 2017; official site platinumfish.jp. Shop introduction: gold at the 2025 World Steak Challenge; black wagyu endorsed by Michelin chefs; the most popular scallion-wrapped tongue eaten with dashi; cold noodles; fresh offal; choose packed meat (à la carte only). 2026 reviews: scallion-wrapped tongue like inari; smoking allowed in private rooms; rare sake not on the menu can sometimes be ordered; charcoal not too fierce, so you can grill slowly; reasonable with all-you-can-drink; good for entertaining.

食べログ: 個室居酒屋 和ノ音 京都駅前店、居酒屋・焼き鳥・魚介、下京区東塩小路.en: Tabelog: 個室居酒屋 和ノ音 京都駅前店 (Wanone, Kyoto Ekimae), izakaya, yakitori and seafood; 下京区東塩小路町736; 3 min on foot from Kyoto Station; Mon–Fri 16:00–24:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–24:00 (food L.O. 23:00, drinks L.O. 23:30); reservations taken; cards (VISA, Master); 100 seats; private rooms (2 to 30+ people); smoking allowed; terrace; English menu; all-you-can-drink. Reviews (October 2026, in English): Shiki no Kaze course of 8 dishes with 2 hours of all-you-can-drink ¥6,500 (offer ¥5,500); sashimi platter; three delicacies; cream cheese in Saikyo miso; offal stew; Tochio fried tofu; red-shrimp shabu-shabu; wagyu gunkan; hegi soba; ordering by QR code.

食べログ: 個室焼肉匠、焼肉・すき焼き・寿司、大阪市淀川区西中島4-8-30 サ.en: Tabelog: Private Rooms Yakiniku Takumi; yakiniku, sukiyaki, sushi; サンライズビル 102, 西中島4-8-30, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 5 minutes on foot from Nishinakajima-Minamigata and Hankyu Minamikata stations; Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00; closures not fixed; 2-hour limit; cards and PayPay; 34 seats; private rooms for 2 to 30; non-smoking; Wi-Fi; opened 9 June 2016. A shop of the Takumi group (takumi.farm). Reviews (2023 to October 2026): Oita wagyu; charcoal shichirin; the signature seared yukhoe wrapped in egg yolk on rice; charcoal-grilled horumon with yuzu; steamed horumon; four kinds of tongue; negi-shio tongue; platters labelled by cut; omasum; sukiyaki kalbi; rice cooked in a pot, about 15 minutes; wagyu courses; Saturday lunch course ¥3,850; small rooms divided by sliding doors; children's tableware; diners say every Takumi shop is good.

食べログ: 備長炭やきとり SASAYA 心斎橋本店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-1.en: Tabelog: Binchotan Yakitori SASAYA Shinsaibashi main shop, 1-13-9 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 18:00–5:00 next morning (L.O. food 4:00, drinks 4:30); table-charge starter ¥418; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 17 seats (counter 7, tables 10); smoking allowed; official site. Reviews (April–September 2026): Kishu binchotan; morning-slaughtered chicken; served off the skewer on a plate; neck with leek; heart; bonjiri; chicken sashimi; liver and heart tataki with sesame on Kutani-style plates; seasonal duck in wasabi yukhoe style; edamame; sake; a counter good for conversation; only 2 tables, so book; one called it ordinary; open until 5 a.m., good for a first stop or the last.

食べログ: 元祖 ニンニクラーメン 寺田町、大阪市天王寺区大道4-10-4、寺田.en: Tabelog: Ganso Ninniku Ramen Teradacho, 4-10-4 Daido, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 109 m from Teradacho; Mon–Thu 18:00–2:00 next morning, Fri–Sat 18:00–3:00 next morning; closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; smoking allowed. Reviews (April–October 2026): in front of Teradacho Station; a yellow awning with red lettering; red lanterns; a red noren; evenings only; nearly full even after 22:00; the garlic ramen (photo) with lots of chopped garlic in a light tonkotsu soup; smooth wavy medium-thick noodles; miso chashu ramen ¥1,100; chashu ramen ¥1,100; kimchi ramen ¥900; boiled egg; noodle refill ¥300; gyoza ¥300; small rice ¥150 (with kimchi); cucumber kimchi (oi kimchi); a 'no-noodle set meal' of chashu, bean sprouts, kimchi, rice and soup; one wanted more garlic; one says it now closes at 23:00 (April 2026); warm service.

食べログ: 元祖ぶっち切り寿司 魚心 南 難波店、寿司・魚介・うなぎ、大阪市中央.en: Tabelog: Ganso Bucchigiri Zushi Uoshin Minami Namba, sushi, seafood and eel, Sennichimae 1-7-9 1F, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 minutes from Namba and Nipponbashi stations; daily 11:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); reservations accepted (sometimes not, depending on the day); 10% service charge from 27 December to 3 January; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 61 seats; non-smoking; official site ajibil.com. The original 'bucchigiri' sushi with toppings about three times the usual size. Reviews (July–October 2026): Bucchigiri lunch set ¥1,000 (with red miso soup), premium sushi set ¥1,800, seafood chirashi (red-vinegar rice, large +¥100), bluefin otoro ¥1,980, anago ¥780, layered kisu nigiri ¥680, toro salmon ¥880, whelk ¥780, seared octopus ¥880, scallop ¥880, uni, engawa, kensaki squid, overflowing ikura, huge anago and eel, many foreigners in the area, some say the value is only average. Sister shops: the Umeda main shop and Shinsaibashi (gurunavi).

食べログ: 元祖大阪梅田ミックスジュース エキマルシェ新大阪ソトエ店、ジュースス.en: Tabelog: Ganso Osaka Umeda Mix Juice, Ekimarche Shin-Osaka Sotoe shop; juice stand; JR Central Shin-Osaka Station 3F, 西中島5-16-1, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; daily 9:00–21:30; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; opened 12 June 2023. Reviews (2026): the Umeda main shop was founded in 1969; outside the ticket gates of Shin-Osaka Station; many stop before the Shinkansen; S ¥250, M ¥370, a mega size too; the sweetness and acidity of banana and mandarin; finely crushed ice; thick enough for the straw to stand; seasonal blueberry, peach and white grape; lids from M up; the blender spun for each pour; cups filled to the brim.

食べログ: 元長、東上野4-10-7 東ビル 1F、JR上野駅入谷口から徒歩3分.en: Tabelog: Motocho, Higashi-Ueno 4-10-7, 東ビル 1F, 3 min on foot from the JR Ueno Station Iriya exit; Mon–Fri and holidays 6:00–21:00; closed Saturdays and Sundays; 13 seats; non-smoking; no cards; transport IC accepted. Reviews (July–October 2026): croquette soba ¥610; squid tempura soba ¥650 plus shungiku tempura ¥150; service set (shrimp tempura and kakiage don) ¥880; a kind owner; noodles made daily in the second-floor noodle workshop; chilled tempura soba ¥610; zaru set ¥800 (choose tempura don, curry or chicken bowl); kakiage soba ¥560; boiled and fried after you order; a dark broth; the owner alone; daily set (chikuwa tempura soba and salmon rice); raw egg; soba set (warm soba and curry) ¥750; very thin house-made soba; tempura soba ¥640 with mini curry ¥330 for ¥970; a spicy black-roux curry; nasu tempura soba ¥570; featured on a TBS morning programme; shungiku tempura sold out after lunch; one said it isn't the cleanest; one found the noodles a bit soft.

食べログ: 先斗町 あさり、居酒屋・もつ鍋・日本料理、中京区鍋屋町213 2F、.en: Tabelog: Pontocho Asari, izakaya, motsu-nabe, Japanese cuisine; 鍋屋町213 2F, Nakagyo-ku; about 1 min walk north from Shijo on Pontocho; Monday–Friday 15:00–2:00, Saturday and Sunday 12:00–2:00, open all year; bookings for two are seated at the counter; 78 seats; private rooms; private hire for 20–50; smoking allowed for heated tobacco only; cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 1 May 2022; Kyoto vegetables, obanzai with yuba and nama-fu, local sake from Kyoto and Shiga; all-you-can-drink obanzai and nigiri sushi course ¥6,000; vegetarian options. Reviews (January 2025–September 2026, in English): fresh yuba, motsu-nabe (pork, offal, clams, soy-sauce base), zosui, all-you-can-drink Kyoto obanzai 10-dish course ¥5,000, 10% service charge at night, private room in an annex, many tourists.

食べログ: 先斗町薬膳カレー、カレー・薬膳・バル、中京区下樵木町203-5 sa.en: Tabelog: 先斗町薬膳カレー (Pontocho Yakuzen Curry), curry, medicinal food, bar; 中京区下樵木町203-5 sakizo立誠校前ビル 1F; 264 m from Gion-Shijo Station; 11:30–24:00; closed Tuesday (and irregularly); reservations taken; 7 seats; smoking allowed (non-smoking at lunch only); no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; no charge; BYO allowed; takeaway; particular about vegetables; vegetarian options; opened 1 June 2015; a specialist in yakuzen curry. Reviews (2022–2026, in English): 38 spices; no additives; rice flour; vegetable curry without oil or wheat flour; yakuzen beef curry ¥800; curries from ¥700; chicken tikka; shrimp and avocado stir-fry; apple bacon ¥500; the owner alone; weak phone signal; spice salt.

食べログ: 八仙楼、大阪市西成区萩之茶屋1-4-1 太陽ビル 1F、南海・JR新.en: Tabelog: Hassen Ro, Taiyo Bldg 1F, 1-4-1 Haginochaya, Nishinari-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nankai and JR Shin-Imamiya stations; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 11:00–24:00; closed Wednesdays; no cards; 13 seats; opened 10 December 2015. Reviews (August–October 2026): late-night ramen; nearly full at 23:00; medium bottle of Asahi Super Dry; salt tonkotsu ramen; one says every ramen is good; in at 22:00; chuka soba; tender chashu; the recommended Tenryu ramen (rich tonkotsu shoyu, melting chashu); counter only and nearly full; the last stop after drinking; the tonkotsu ramen is rich; noodle refills available; three people before 23:00 on a Sunday; 3 plates of gyoza; used as an izakaya too; the standard ramen with plenty of back fat; tonkotsu umami and sweet fat; not as heavy as it looks; 2 thick slices of pork-belly chashu; lots of chopped leek; crowded with inbound visitors; ramen and fried rice set ¥1,150; large portions; the salt tonkotsu is light; the fried rice a little salty; one says it isn't aimed at tourists; the miso ramen is rich; gyoza.

食べログ: 六文そば 人形町店、そば、うどん、立ち食いそば、日本橋人形町1-10.en: Tabelog: Rokumon Soba Ningyocho branch, soba, udon, standing soba; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 1-10-5, 1F, 1 min walk from Ningyocho Station exit A2; Mon–Fri 6:30–15:00; closed Sat, Sun and holidays; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; standing counter (5 seats); non-smoking. Reviews (January–October 2026): queues from the morning; quick turnover; squid tempura soba ¥350; squid-tentacle soba ¥330; sausage soba ¥290; burdock and onion tempura soba ¥360; croquette and kakiage soba ¥450; squid tempura ¥150 each; a sweet-savory bonito broth; the soba is on the soft side; kakiage sometimes sold out; cash only.

食べログ: 六文銭、ラーメン、大阪市淀川区西宮原1丁目8-1 ロイヤルハイツ1F.en: Tabelog: Rokumonsen, ramen, 西宮原 1-8-1, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, ロイヤルハイツ 1F; 5–7 min from the north exit of Shin-Osaka Station (Midosuji Line), 7–9 min from the JR Shinkansen gates, 9–11 min from the east gates; the hours table says Mon–Fri 10:45–21:00, Sat 10:45–15:00, closed Sunday, while the note says Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and from 18:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–21:00, closed 31 December to 3 January; no reservations; no cards; e-money accepted; no QR payment; 15 seats; non-smoking; takeaway; children welcome. Reviews (January to September 2026): founded in 1982, now run by the second generation; shoyu, shio, miso and tonkotsu; shoyu ramen ¥850; thin straight noodles, chashu, menma, bean sprouts, green onion, spicy miso; half-chan ramen ¥1,100–1,200, the half fried rice nearly a full portion; miso ramen with mini fried rice ¥1,080; rice-ball set ¥1,000; mini Tianjin rice set; a line at lunch; food comes fast; chatty staff; red uniforms and sign.

食べログ: 六本木 ちょっと、港区六本木4-10-8 パーレットビル2F、六本木.en: Tabelog: Roppongi Chotto, Roppongi 4-10-8, パーレットビル 2F, 74 m from Roppongi crossing; Mon–Fri 18:15–23:30, Sat 18:30–22:30, holidays 18:15–22:30; closed Sundays; hours may change; no cards, e-money or QR; 20 seats; smoking allowed; no children. Reviews (June 2024–May 2026): a Showa-style izakaya run by a couple; a long menu; daily specials; homemade gyoza ¥800, fried mehikari ¥800, mixed butter ¥800, grilled rice ball ¥300, small draft beer ¥400; shirako with ponzu, satsuma-age, eel-liver skewers, spicy konnyaku; a homemade coffee liqueur for regulars; booking recommended; cash only.

食べログ: 六雁、銀座5-5-19 銀座ポニーグループビル6F・7F、銀座駅B5.en: Tabelog: Mutsukari, Ginza 5-5-19, Ginza Pony Group Building 6F–7F, 1 minute from Ginza Station exit B5; 46 seats (9 counter, 6F tables, a private room for 6 under a double-height ceiling, 7F tables); Mon–Sat 17:30–23:00 (L.O. 20:00), closed Sundays and holidays; 10% service charge; no under-12s; opened June 1, 2004; official site mutsukari.com; The Tabelog Award 2017 and 2018 Bronze. Shop introduction: head chef Yoshihisa Akiyama's "new Edomae Tokyo style"; a "super kappō"; open kitchens over three floors; a seasonal nikogori of 10 vegetables. 2026 reviews: stone paving and the scent of incense; service at just the right distance; sesame tofu; conger eel; somen with uni and junsai; charcoal-grilled ayu; beef shabu rolled in yuba; corn rice and akadashi; the famous shaved ice; sake from a woman sommelier; autumn bonito; matsutake; pork shoulder loin; mushroom rice and noppe soup; pumpkin shaved ice.

食べログ: 兼定、港区六本木4-4-6 谷口ビル1F、月〜土17:30〜21:0.en: Tabelog: Kanesada, Roppongi 4-4-6, 谷口ビル 1F; Mon–Sat 17:30–21:00; closed Sundays and holidays; subject to change; 10 seats; private hire possible; non-smoking; cards accepted (no e-money or QR). Reviews (2016–December 2025): in Roppongi for 30–40+ years; the owner trained at Kyubey; small nigiri on firm rice; the signature horse-mackerel box sushi; inari to finish; wakame and gari; grilled nodoguro; mehikari; kawahagi liver; ikura and sea urchin; sake from Aomori; wasabi-wari; one reviewer says it was run by siblings and is now run by the apprentice Ken.

食べログ: 出入橋きんつば屋、和菓子・甘味処、大阪市北区堂島3-4-10、Rou.en: Tabelog: Deiribashi Kintsuba Ya, Japanese sweets and sweets café, 3-4-10 Dojima, Kita-ku, Osaka; just west of the Shin-Ideiribashi East crossing where Route 2 meets the Hanshin Expressway; Autobacs as a landmark; 5 min from Nishi-Umeda and Kitashinchi stations; a large 'Kintsuba-ya' sign on the wall; exit 6-19 from the underground mall; Mon–Fri 10:00–18:00; Sat 10:00–17:00; closed Sundays; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 18 table seats; non-smoking; Tabelog Japanese sweets WEST 100 in 2023 and 2026, Sweets WEST 100 in 2022. Reviews (September–October 2026): small kintsuba; a chewy thin skin and gently sweet chunky red beans; freshly made, eat the same day; boxes of 10 (¥1,000–1,100) up to 30; single pieces too; warm in a toaster; abekawa mochi with plenty of soybean flour; isobe-maki; zenzai to eat in; everything but kintsuba sold out by evening; cash only; told to come when in Osaka.

食べログ: 出町ふたば、和菓子・大福、上京区出町通今出川上ル青龍町236、出町柳.en: Tabelog: Demachi Futaba, Japanese sweets and daifuku, 上京区出町通今出川上ル青龍町236, 7 min on foot from Demachiyanagi Stn; Mon and Thu–Sun 8:30–17:30; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; takeaway only; eat on the day of purchase; no cards, e-money or QR; Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2018, 2019, 2020, 2022; Japanese sweets and sweets cafés WEST Tabelog 100 2023, 2026. Reviews (November 2025–October 2026, in English): the famous mame mochi, kuri mochi, kuromame daifuku, early-morning queues for the chestnut Mont Blanc, some items can be reserved by phone.

食べログ: 別邸 たけ井 なんばラーメン一座店、大阪市中央区難波3-2-18 エ.en: Tabelog: Bettei Takei Namba Ramen Ichiza, Edion Namba main store 9F, 3-2-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 11:00–21:30 (L.O. 21:00); irregular closing days; no cards or e-money; QR payment accepted; no smoking; opened 7 June 2019; official menya-takei.com. 2024–2026 reviews: rich chuka soba ¥1,150 and fried rice ¥500 (a strong seafood-tonkotsu soup, slightly firm thick flat noodles, neither salty nor greasy); rich seasoned-egg chuka soba ¥1,240 with spicy topping ¥150 ×2; chicken-and-pork rice ¥450; the favourite at Ramen Ichiza; open all day; the light chicken-tonkotsu tsukemen ¥1,280 had noodles lacking bite; the main shop is in Kyoto; rich chicken-tonkotsu tsukemen ¥1,200; one called the seasoned-egg rich chicken-tonkotsu tsukemen ¥1,540 simply good; special; the dipping soup reheated; large 450 g; the 9th floor is bright and quiet; like a Kansai version of 'Noroshi'; small 330 g ¥1,220; thick chewy noodles.

食べログ: 割烹 市川、日本料理、中京区夷町572、烏丸御池駅から徒歩約7分・丸.en: Tabelog: Kappou Ichikawa; Japanese cuisine; 夷町572, Nakagyo-ku; about 7 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn, about 8 min from Marutamachi Stn; 17:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Thursday; bookings taken; 16 seats; private room for 8; no smoking; no children; cards accepted (JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money; no service charge listed; a Facebook page; opened 3 February 2018. Reviews (February 2023 – September 2026, in English): a long à la carte list; a menu without prices; about ¥25,000–31,000 for two; an ¥11,000 course (2023); squid topped with bafun uni; toro; shime saba; amadai; seared hamo; grilled guji; sweetfish; corn tempura; firefly squid tempura; fried sardines or horse mackerel with house tartar; agedashi Kamo eggplant; whelk with asparagus; soft-shell turtle egg soup and hot pot; kinmedai simmered in sake lees; mackerel sushi; rock oyster; potato salad; beef with flower pepper; soba and warabi mochi to finish; many regulars; the owner trained at places including "Tan Kuma Kitaten" (as the English translation gives it); in the Michelin Guide in 2026; private rooms can be noisy next door.

食べログ: 割烹 魚先、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-15-11 日宝周防町エレガンス.en: Tabelog: Kappo Uosaki, Nippo Suomachi Elegance Bldg 1F, 1-15-11 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 6, 5 min from Nagahoribashi; cards accepted, no e-money; 16 seats (counter 6, tables 10); budget ¥10,000–14,999; no opening hours listed. Reviews (October 2025 – June 2026): no menu, courses only; a series of small dishes; fragrant grilled dishes; fugu or duck hot pot to finish; matsutake, clams and pork added; hot-pot dashi poured over matsutake rice; a famous kappo in Minami; gentle flavours; plenty of sake and shochu; grilled firefly squid; a calm atmosphere; omakase only; dislikes checked first; about 20 small plates; local sake a little pricey; dishes served in small bowls; beautiful presentation; full almost every day, booking essential; a little strongly seasoned overall; sake recommendations; grilled in front of you; smoking allowed.

食べログ: 割烹かむい、銀座5-9-5 チアーズ銀座9F B、東銀座駅から徒歩2.en: Tabelog: Kappō Kamui, Ginza 5-9-5, Cheers Ginza 9F B, 2 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station; 12 seats (tables); Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00, closed Sun; opened September 30, 2025; cards accepted; budget ¥30,000–40,000. October 2026 reviews: a private room at the back of Yakiniku Kamui; projection mapping and music; "Kamui" black wagyu from the company's own ranch on Iki, Nagasaki (antibiotic-free); OMAKASE course ¥35,000; beef tongue and uni chawanmushi with black truffle; two sittings at 17:00 and 20:00; reservations only.

食べログ: 割烹たいら、日本料理、下京区仏光寺通柳馬場西入ル東前町401、四条駅.en: Tabelog: Kappou Taira — Japanese; Bukkoji-dori, Shimogyo-ku; about 6 min on foot from Shijo Stn; Tue–Sun 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–23:00; closed Monday; 8 seats (counter); non-smoking; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners). Reviews (April 2023–August 2026, English): white-wood counter in a machiya, white noren and no sign, lunch omakase ¥6,600, lunch course ¥8,000, Chef Taira, former head chef of Senka in Gion, minced tuna with fu, amadai, Biwa trout, wakasagi, wine-pairing events with sake and wine, fish broth.

食べログ: 創作フレンチLemone、大阪市中央区南船場2-2-28 順慶ビル.en: Tabelog: Sosaku French Lemone, Junkei Bldg 1F, 2-2-28 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station exit 2A; Mon, Tue, Sat, Sun and holidays 17:00–1:00 next morning, Wed–Fri 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–1:00 next morning; L.O. 0:30; sometimes closed Mondays (Instagram stories); e-cigarettes only until 22:00, cigarettes allowed after; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 14 seats (counter 8, one table for 6). Reviews (July–September 2026): executive course (foie-gras mousse; 3 starters; scallop and turnip nage; crab and daikon consommé royale; potage; lobster and foie-gras fricassée with black truffle and white port sauce; roast Hokkaido Ezo venison with raspberry and red-wine sauce; duck-magret pilaf; dessert); à la carte roast duck with bigarade sauce; seafood pilaf; consommé daikon; oyster ajillo; half-cooked tuna; sole mousse with caviar; house balsamic; a chef who is also a sommelier; one found the seasoning strong and salty; one found service slow.

食べログ: 創作中華 縁、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-18-2 山本ビルB1F、月〜.en: Tabelog: Sosaku Chuka En, Yamamoto Bldg B1F, 1-18-2 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Mon–Sat 18:00–24:00; closed Sundays and holidays; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 12 seats (counter only); Hyakumeiten (Chinese WEST 2021 and 2023). 2026 reviews (June–October): soft-shell crab in chili sauce; zha cai; one calls the course the most authentic Chinese in Japan; Chaozhou-style amberjack sashimi; the tantanmen is ordinary; mapo tofu with shirako; phone bookings hard to get, got in by calling at 17:30; authentic mapo tofu with fragrant, numbing Sichuan pepper; gentle chicken-broth noodles (clear soup); full when phoned at 22:00; counter only, many regulars; mapo tofu and fluffy egg with shrimp; prices on the high side; dim and stylish; close to the kitchen, so hot; superb squid; about ¥10,000 with drinks; a Hyakumeiten creative-Chinese restaurant; a basement hideaway; Chinese-style amberjack sashimi; special shrimp mayo.

食べログ: 創作串カツ 坊也哲、大阪市中央区南船場3-9-6 NIPPO心斎橋ビ.en: Tabelog: Sosaku Kushikatsu Bouya Tetsu, NIPPO Shinsaibashi Bldg 1F, Minami-Senba 3-9-6, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min from Exit 1 of Shinsaibashi and Nagahoribashi Stns; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); closed Wednesday; reservations and same-day walk-ins both welcome; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 13 seats (counter 7, tables of 4 and 2); designated area for heated tobacco only; school-age children and up welcome; opened 22 March 2023; sauces made from vegetable trimmings left over from prep (shop's information). Reviews (September–October 2026): courses of 8, 12 or 15 skewers, or omakase until you stop; the ¥3,980 12-skewer course includes a glass of wine: shrimp wrapped in shiso, wagyu, squid and okra with sea-urchin sauce, taro fried in rice-cracker crumbs, pike conger with plum sauce, Manganji pepper stuffed with meat, octopus and cheese wrapped in yuba (dipped in broth), asparagus, pork tenderloin with mustard sauce, broad-bean tofu, angel shrimp, Spanish mackerel; Kirin Ichiban Shibori draft ¥620; fried two at a time; many seasonal ingredients; some say it's ordinary kushikatsu despite the "creative" name.

食べログ: 創作和食 Jampa、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-10-31 ASUKA.en: Tabelog: Sosaku Washoku Jampa, ASUKA Amemura BLD 7F, 2-10-31 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Yotsubashi stations; opposite BIG STEP in Amemura; from the sign on the north side of the building, go round the narrow alley on the south side and take the lift to the 7th floor; Mon–Sat and holidays 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); closed Sundays; about a 2½-hour limit when busy; mention allergies in advance; cards and PayPay accepted; 14 seats (counter 6, semi-private tables 8; private room for 4 or more); opened 18 February 2017; official jampa.co.jp. Reviews (November 2025 – September 2026): September omakase; seasonal starters; warm dish of hamo and matsutake; red-vinegar sushi in the style of tuna toro and takuan; Saga beef roast beef; Western-style seafood; abalone gratin; small Kuroge wagyu hot pot with simmered egg; white rice; clay-pot rice; Japanese ultra-smooth pudding; ayu; abalone sautéed in butter; wagyu; à la carte from 20:00; sake and wine pairing; rice-bran oil in the pudding; course ¥11,000; all-you-can-drink ¥5,000; easy to get lost, so phone when nearby; roast beef on achar; ¥8,800 course; snapping-turtle hot pot added; roe-laden ayu; a 10-item starter platter; hamo and onion dashi; roast beef of lean and misuji; hamo wrapped in lettuce, ethnic-style; fried abalone and gizzard; bitter melon and green pepper; prawn crackers; Kuroge wagyu mille-feuille cutlet.

食べログ: 創作料理、東山区音羽町325、清水五条駅から228m、15:00〜2.en: Tabelog: creative cuisine, 東山区音羽町325, 228 m from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn; 15:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed irregularly (2–3 days a week, posted on Instagram); reservations accepted; ¥1,000 a person for the appetiser and service; 8 counter seats; non-smoking (smoking area outside); cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 19 December 2023; Izakaya WEST Tabelog 100 2026. Reviews (May–October 2026, in English): booked on TableCheck; green tiles; wagyu-cheek dote-ni skewer ¥900 (Hatcho miso); water eggplant with homemade karasumi ¥1,300; rare buri katsu with chive sauce and grated daikon ¥2,300; spring rolls; croquette potato salad; seafood gratin; staff-meal hayashi rice; hojicha Basque cheesecake; wines chosen by the sommelier; two staff.

食べログ: 創作料理・肉料理・居酒屋、下京区市之町240-1 河原町アペックスビ.en: Tabelog: creative cuisine, meat dishes, izakaya; 市之町240-1, Shimogyo-ku, 河原町アペックスビルⅡ B1F; 4 min walk from Hankyu Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn; daily 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); reservations accepted; 12 seats (6 at the counter, two tatami tables for 3); groups of up to 4; private hire for 8–20; non-smoking; cards, PayPay and WeChat Pay; over 20 sakes; seasonal one-soup opener ¥1,650. Reviews (July–November 2026, in English): the 40-year-old owner trained at a ryokan in Fukui and a kaiseki restaurant in Pontocho and cooks alone; assorted sashimi, botan shrimp, foie gras with kombu-cured sea bream, wagyu cheek, abalone and winter melon, eel, oden, matsutake clay-pot rice, staff-meal pasta, charcoal smoke, a menu that changes monthly.

食べログ: 加藤牛肉店 銀座、銀座6-4-15 トニービル1F、銀座駅C2出口か.en: Tabelog: Kato Gyuniku Ten Ginza, Ginza 6-4-15, Tony Building 1F, 3 minutes from Ginza Station exit C2; 14 seats; Mon–Sat and holidays 17:00–23:00, closed Sun; cards, IC and QR accepted; fresh, unaged beef. 2026 reviews: Yamagata-beef steak platter course (house corned beef and bread, a Yamagata-beef starter, seasonal soup, three-cut platter), hamburg steak, truffle-oil potatoes, marbled wagyu, a bottle of Bordeaux, corkage charged, ¥20,000–30,000.

食べログ: 勝盛、そば、大阪市淀川区西中島3丁目9-7、Midosuji 線 西.en: Tabelog: Masamori, soba, 3-9-7 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 3 min from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station (Midosuji Line); Mon–Sat 11:00–14:00, closed Sun and holidays; no reservations; cash only; 20 seats; non-smoking. Reviews (February 2025 to October 2026): a little hard to find behind the APA Hotel; full of office workers at lunch; shared tables; a tatami room upstairs; fast turnover; the "Ume" rice-bowl set (mini tempura bowl) ¥960; the "Take" set (mini katsu-don and kitsune soba) ¥960; katsu-don with udon ¥960; katsu-don with mini soba ¥940; katsu-don with zaru soba; inari with bukkake udon ¥850; kara-age bento with wakame soba ¥980; zaru soba ¥750; chilled tanuki soba ¥860; meat soba with inari; a slightly sweet soy broth; sweet fried tofu; big portions; three in the kitchen and four on the floor.

食べログ: 北島亭、フレンチ、四谷三栄町15-2 JHCビル1F、四ツ谷駅から徒.en: Tabelog: Kitajima Tei, French; JHCビル 1F, Yotsuya Sanei-cho 15-2; 5 min walk from Yotsuya Station; Mon and Thu–Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 (food last order 12:30) and 18:00–22:00 (food last order 19:00); closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays; 10% service charge; 12 seats; non-smoking; cards accepted; Tabelog Award Bronze 2017–2020 and 2026; French TOKYO Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025; chef Motoyuki Kitajima. Reviews (August–October 2026): courses of three dishes ¥16,940 and four dishes ¥18,150 (unchanged for 12 years, one diner says), chilled cucumber soup, sea urchin with consommé jelly, a charlotte-style salad of red snow crab and asparagus, foie gras poêlé with corn galette, flounder in a potato crust, roast Zao duck, black-tea pudding, six petits fours, large portions, a yellow awning, some found the finishing rough.

食べログ: 北浜 ニカク食堂、大阪市中央区高麗橋1-3-2、北浜駅から高麗橋経由.en: Tabelog: Kitahama Nikaku Shokudo, 1-3-2 Koraibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Kitahama Station via Koraibashi; Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–0:30 next morning, Sat and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed Sundays; cards (VISA, Master), transit IC and iD accepted, no QR; 13 counter seats. Reviews (March–October 2026): seasoned-egg Niigata back-fat niboshi chuka soba ¥1,140 with chashu and egg rice bowl ¥500; a clear pork broth with niboshi shoyu; plenty of back fat; chopped onion; iwanori; thick wavy low-hydration noodles; big shoulder-loin chashu; one says it was salty some days; rare in Osaka; chuka soba relaxation; Niigata ramen; reopened on 2 March 2026 with a new name and menu, formerly 'Niboshi Chuka Soba Kourai no Hishou'; chuka soba (regular) ¥890; light and rich versions; pork-belly chashu; white leek; menma; naruto; a tonkotsu-based seafood shoyu; thick wavy noodles from Kyoto's Menya Teigaku; grilled-shoyu egg ¥150.

食べログ: 千日前 やすだや 本店、大阪市中央区千日前1-9-8 大ざわビル、1.en: Tabelog: Sennichimae Yasudaya main shop, Ozawa Bldg, 1-9-8 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 18 seats (counter 8, tables 10); Mon, Wed, Thu, Sun and holidays 16:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30), Fri, Sat and days before holidays 16:00–3:00 next morning (L.O. 2:00); closed Tuesdays; smoking allowed; cards accepted (VISA, JCB); opened 1 October 2013; Sennichimae Yasudaya's first shop in June 2011; official yasuda-ya.jp; 'A man who bet everything on gyoza! Bite-size gyoza made by a Naniwa craftsman'. 2026 reviews (September–October): bite-size gyoza; 4 servings of pan-fried gyoza; squid gyoza; shrimp gyoza; leek and chashu platter; plenty of vinegar; shandy gaff ¥600; garlic gyoza ¥500 (¥450 per another diner); potato-cheese gyoza ¥500; the vegetable gyoza did not suit one diner; inattentive staff; narrow tables; opposite Amza; draught beer ¥600; plump shrimp gyoza ¥550 (with salt); light salt egg rice ¥990; multilingual menu; many overseas diners; fast service.

食べログ: 千登利亭、寿司・日本料理、東山区団栗通大和大路西入ル六軒町203、京.en: Tabelog: 千登利亭 (Chidori Tei), sushi and Japanese cuisine; 東山区団栗通大和大路西入ル六軒町203; 2 min on foot from Keihan Gion-Shijo Station exit 1; 11:00–17:00; closed Thursday; reservations taken; 14 seats (4 counter, three tables for 2, one table for 4); non-smoking; no cards, e-money or QR payments; English menu; takeaway. Reviews (2026, in English): the "Wakasa" Kyoto sushi set ¥2,730 (saba sushi, live conger-eel box sushi, Kyoto chirashi, rolls, clear soup), changed to steamed sushi in winter for ¥3,200; saba sushi 6 pieces ¥2,520; young sea bream sushi 6 pieces ¥1,900; isobe maki ¥1,360; summer hamo sushi 6 pieces ¥6,000; ayu sushi; 8-piece nigiri ¥3,600; chawanmushi; Kyoto Sushi Noren Association.

食べログ: 南船場Nat's食堂、大阪市中央区南船場3-1-7 日宝東心斎橋ビル.en: Tabelog: Minamisenba Nat's Shokudo, Minami-Senba 3-1-7, Chuo-ku, Osaka, building 1F; about 6 min north of Shinsaibashi Stn exits 1 and 2; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–22:30, Sat 17:30–22:30 (L.O. food 21:30, drinks 22:00); closed Sundays and public holidays; table reservations only for full meals; a ¥1,000 charge at dinner when you only eat; no cards, e-money or QR; 15 seats (counter 7, two tables of 4); no smoking at lunch, smoking allowed at night; private hire up to 20; opened 22 April 2013; corporate-member listing. Shop text: fresh fish delivered daily, vegetables bought direct from the market, rice milled each time, carefully made sauces, wine and sake to match the food. Reviews (March 2025–October 2026): an inconspicuous yoshoku restaurant at the back of a building; a sign asking "Have you ever eaten a truly delicious hamburg steak!"; daily lunch ¥1,000–1,100 (hamburg steak with fried shrimp, cream croquette, beef cutlet, bite-sized pork cutlet, white-fish fry or chicken-wing kara-age); Nat's hamburg steak ¥1,000 on a hot skillet, cooked to order, with a choice of demi-glace, beef-tendon curry sauce or special grated-daikon ponzu; the curry sauce is a European-style curry simmered for a week that won a 2013 award; hamburg steak and Angus beef cutlet ¥1,280; omurice; tonteki set; soup of the day (corn chowder, pumpkin, potato); from April 2025 a large serving or refill of rice is ¥100; heavy metal as background music; one diner found it short of what the sign promised.

食べログ: 博多 一風堂 堀江店、大阪市西区南堀江1-1-12、06-6537-.en: Tabelog: Hakata Ippudo Horie, 1-1-12 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka, 06-6537-6255; no reservations; daily 11:00–23:00; open every day of the year; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and e-money accepted; 39 seats (counter 21, tables 18); official ippudo.com. 2026 reviews (July–October): diners and staff almost all from overseas, like a shop abroad; meat-miso thick-noodle tsukemen (red spicy oil); queues at lunch, quiet at night; well-trained service; Shiromaru and Akamaru; shoyu tonkotsu ¥950 (Horie-only; back fat, aroma of nira, slightly thick noodles) and Hakata fried rice (small) ¥430; limited tantan tsukemen ¥1,090; Akamaru Shinaji ¥980 and noodle refill ¥150; bean sprouts, takana and red pickled ginger ordered on the touch panel.

食べログ: 原始炭焼 いろり家 東銀座店、銀座3-11-11 銀座参番館2 B1.en: Tabelog: Genshi Sumiyaki Iroriya Higashi-Ginza, Ginza 3-11-11, 銀座参番館 2 B1F, 1 minute from Higashi-Ginza Station exit A7; 43 seats (private rooms for 6 and 8, sunken kotatsu, counter); Mon–Fri 18:00–3:00, weekends and holidays 17:00–23:00; irregular holidays; closed at New Year; smoking allowed; official site iroriya.tokyo. Shop introduction: indirect lighting; fresh, carefully chosen ingredients; the signature "senjō-meshi", warm rice heaped with salmon roe; open until 3 a.m. on weekdays. 2026 reviews: full; the staff's energetic shout at the toast; thick grilled shiitake; the senjō-meshi performance, salmon roe piled high in front of you, with drums; sashimi and simmered eggplant; sometimes noisy with groups; steep stairs.

食べログ: 友愛亭、大阪市浪速区日本橋4-12-1 旭日旅行ビル 1F、恵美須町.en: Tabelog: Yuai Tei, Kyokujitsu Ryoko Bldg 1F, 4-12-1 Nippombashi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Ebisucho Station exit 1B; Tue–Sun 11:00–17:30 (L.O. 17:00); closed Mondays; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 15 seats (counter 7, two tables for 4); no smoking; opened 1 June 2014; Tabelog Ramen OSAKA Hyakumeiten 2023, 2024 and 2025. Reviews (May–October 2026): Right Straight and chashu rice bowl; a regular found the chashu too fatty; 3 waiting after 16:00; price rise; Right Straight ¥1,050; Unchained Custom +¥100 (garlic, nira kimchi, habanero); chewy noodles; lean and fat in the chashu; white rice; a shoyu ramen specialist; toppings of menma, chashu, butter, soft-boiled egg, garlic; a deep soup; thin noodles with bite; menu: Right Straight, Razor Punch, Heavy, Left Hook, Naniwa Joe, Takai da Cross; a blend of dark and light shoyu; a mellow shoyu that isn't salty; thick, tender chashu; with chashu ¥1,300; open 11:00–17:30; rice ¥200 for soup rice.

食べログ: 古潭 なんばウォーク中央店、大阪市中央区難波1丁目 なんばウォーク虹.en: Tabelog: Kotan Namba Walk Chuo, Niji-no-Machi 2-bangai Minami-dori, Namba Walk, 1-chome Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 33 seats; daily 11:00–21:30; closed third Tuesday; no smoking; cards and e-money accepted; official ramen-kotan.co.jp. Shop introduction: a bright Asian-style shop; ramen with gyoza, prawn tempura or spring-roll sets. 2025–2026 reviews: visited for decades; pork-belly Kotan ¥950; seasoned egg ¥120 (half used to come included); spicy reimen ¥980 and kimchi; lots of sesame; Kotan shoyu ramen; served in 2 minutes; app coupon for a fresh-vegetable topping; cold ramen (salad chicken and kimchi); the salt is a light yet rich white soup with bean sprouts, carrot, leek, chashu and thin noodles; fluffy fried rice; gyoza; lunch set (small ramen, small fried rice, vegetable croquette); wonton noodles; a floor manager speaking Osaka dialect; the day Hanshin won the pennant.

食べログ: 台湾まぜそば・台湾ラーメン 薫、大阪市浪速区日本橋4-15-11、日.en: Tabelog: Taiwanese Maze-soba Taiwan Ramen Kun, 4-15-11 Nippombashi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; on the Otaroad side of Den Den Town in Nippombashi; daily 11:00–21:00; open every day of the year; no cards, e-money or QR; 18 seats (ground-floor counter 8; 2nd-floor counter 6 and tables 4). Reviews (September 2024 – June 2026): Taiwan ramen ¥750 (shoyu soup with mildly spicy minced meat, thinnish noodles, adjustable heat, extra-hot too); Taiwan maze-soba (minced meat, onion, leek, menma, peanuts; staff suggest rice at the end); gentle tonkotsu ramen; set with roast-pork rice bowl; large free; fried onion and vinegar on the table; the ticket machine doesn't take new notes or old ¥500 coins, so ask staff for change.

食べログ: 台湾タロイモスイーツ専門店 連珍、中華菓子、日本橋人形町2-10-1.en: Tabelog: Taiwan taro sweets specialty shop Renchin, Chinese sweets; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-10-11 1F; 2 min walk from Ningyocho Station; daily 11:00–18:00; irregular closures; reservations by phone or DM; cards, transport IC and PayPay accepted; 4 seats (benches inside and outside); non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome; takeaway; opened 11 December 2021; MARUFOODS. Reviews (April–October 2026): a branch of a shop in Keelung, Taiwan, over 100 years old; in Japan, Ningyocho and Takadanobaba; taro milk ¥680; taro pudding ¥450; roll cake ¥900; douhua ¥900; taro sweets with purple rice or coconut; cream puffs; egg tarts; zongzi; lovely packaging; prices creeping up; some found the baked sweets short on taro flavour.

食べログ: 台湾屋台新台北、台湾料理・ラーメン・バー、四谷坂町9-7、曙橋駅から.en: Tabelog: Taiwan Yatai Shintaipei, Taiwanese, ramen, bar; Yotsuya Sakamachi 9-7; 5 min walk from Akebonobashi Station, 8 min from Ichigaya and Yotsuya Stations; Mon–Fri 11:00–14:00 and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Saturday, Sunday and holidays (reservations accepted); no cards, e-money or QR; no service charge; 25 seats; smoking allowed. Reviews (2024–2026): run by a couple; chuka soba ¥1,000 (thin straight noodles, curly noodles also available); chuka soba raved about by the head of 一条流がんこラーメン総本家; Taiwanese beef noodles ¥1,250 (mild heat, made spicier on request); Taiwan yakisoba ¥1,200; dan dan noodles; chilled Chinese noodles ¥1,300; fried rice ¥1,000; lu rou fan; gyoza; Taiwanese sausage; Shaoxing wine; courses with free-flow drinks.

食べログ: 台湾料理 営業中 東三国店、台湾料理・中華料理・ラーメン、大阪市淀川.en: Tabelog: Taiwanese Eigyochu Higashimikuni ten, Taiwanese, Chinese and ramen, 4-1-21 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; about 1 min from Exit 5 of Higashimikuni Station; daily 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); lunch sets cash or PayPay only; cards (VISA, Master) for à la carte and courses; reservations accepted; 82 seats (tables, private and semi-private rooms); up to 100; smoking at dinner; opened 22 March 2024. Reviews (May 2025 to October 2026): at the foot of the station stairs; lunch sets about ¥950 with free refills of rice and soup; five-ingredient fried noodles set ¥950; mapo noodles ¥780; mapo tofu set; Taiwanese ramen and fried rice set; five-ingredient ankake fried noodles; Hachibao-sai set; shrimp chili set; fried rice set; self-service coffee after the meal; mapo tofu and liver-and-chives set ¥1,280; a drink, grilled gyoza and a snack ¥1,180; all-you-can-drink ¥3,580; all-you-can-eat including fried rice; Taiwanese-style kara-age; steamed chicken; almond tofu; one diner was bothered by cigarette smoke.

食べログ: 吉そば 銀座本店(よしそば)、銀座3-9-2、立ち食いとカウンター4.en: Tabelog: Yoshi Soba Ginza main shop, Ginza 3-9-2; standing and 4 counter seats; Mon 7:00–24:00, Tue–Fri 24 hours, Sat 0:00–20:00, Sundays and holidays 7:00–20:00; official site yoshisoba.jp. 2026 reviews: eggplant-tempura soba ¥650, kakiage soba ¥600, shrimp tendon and soba set, shungiku tempura often sold out, choice of soba types, silk-flat udon, ticket machine but cards accepted, chairs at the back, large portion free, customers from before 6 a.m.

食べログ: 吉祥寺武蔵家 なんばラーメン一座 龍店、大阪市中央区難波3-2-18.en: Tabelog: Kichijoji Musashiya Namba Ramen Ichiza Ryu, Edion Namba main store 9F, 3-2-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 32 seats (counter 12, tables 20); daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); no smoking (smoking room available); cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; opened 20 November 2023; shop introduction: a long-standing iekei shop with 25 years in Kichijoji, a rich soup using large amounts of domestic pork bones and chicken bones. 2026 reviews (August–October): limited Musajiro ¥1,300 (noodles 200 g, large 300 g; vegetables, back fat, garlic); spicy-egg chashu rice bowl set ¥400; a lightish tonkotsu shoyu; soft, chewy thick noodles; cold tonkotsu ¥1,100 and mini fried rice ¥400; seasoned-egg ramen regular with nori and small rice ¥1,250; founded in Kichijoji on 13 May 1999; hand over the meal ticket; large rice free; spinach and nori; garlic and ginger on the table; sweetish fried rice; asked your preferences; 2 thin slices of chashu; thick firm noodles.
