食べログ: 呑喜屋むね、食堂・居酒屋、中京区堺町通夷川上る絹屋町127-5、丸太.en: Tabelog: 呑喜屋むね (Nonkiya Mune), diner and izakaya; 中京区堺町通夷川上る絹屋町127-5; 386 m from Marutamachi Stn; Mon–Sat 17:30–22:00; closed Sunday; bookings taken; 12 seats; designated smoking area; cards (JCB, AMEX), e-money and QR; Diner Tabelog 100 2026. Reviews (February–October 2026, in English): assorted sashimi ¥2,750, kinki, natural hirame, dobin-mushi, tempura, beef cutlet, crab cream croquette, chicken-wing kara-age, stir-fried lettuce, tai-shabu, sea urchin rice ball, the owner and the owner's mother, a Michelin sticker.

食べログ: 周記 蘭州牛肉面 難波本店、大阪市浪速区難波中3-16-12、大国町.en: Tabelog: Shuki Lanzhou Beef Noodles Namba main shop, 3-16-12 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Daikokucho Station exit 1, 8 from Nankai Namba Station exit 5; daily 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:40) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); open every day of the year; no cards or e-money; 42 seats (smoking 28, non-smoking 14). Reviews (May 2018 – June 2026): at the Motomachi 3-chome crossing; opened in April 2018 in a former bakery; hand-pulled Lanzhou beef noodles (beef-bone and spice soup, chili oil, coriander); 8 noodle thicknesses; egg topping; A set ¥1,200 (small plates of tofu, shredded omelette, potato salad and more); hot-and-sour glass noodles; lamb skewers (from 2); cumin lamb stir-fry set meal ¥980; beef and green-pepper stir-fry set meal; fried bread; japchae; shiratama with bean paste; QR ordering; one says it's better with vinegar added.

食べログ: 味 ふくしま、日本料理、東山区祇園町南側570、祇園四条駅から徒歩約.en: Tabelog: Aji Fukushima, Japanese cuisine, 東山区祇園町南側570, about 7–8 min on foot from Gion-Shijo Stn; Mon 17:30–20:00, Tue–Sat 11:30–13:00; closed Sundays and the last Monday of the month; reservation only; no cards at lunch; service charge at night only; 21 seats (counter 9, two sunken-kotatsu private rooms); smoking room inside; opened 2 April 2013; The Tabelog Award Bronze 2017–2020; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023. Reviews (December 2025–May 2026, in English): kaiseki started by a Gion teahouse, a renovated machiya, lunch omakase ¥7,150, a Michelin star, a chat with a geiko.

食べログ: 味の源 麻辣湯、大阪市浪速区元町2-8-11、南海なんば駅から徒歩1.en: Tabelog: Ajinomoto Malatang, 2-8-11 Motomachi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 10 min walk from Nankai Namba Station; daily 11:00–23:00; irregular closing days; no cards; e-money PayPay only. Reviews (November 2025 – October 2026): between Namba and Daikokucho; rarely a queue; choose ingredients from the case (individually packed at fixed prices: napa cabbage, bok choy, komatsuna, lettuce, okra, lotus root, wood-ear, enoki, egg tofu, quail eggs, fish cakes, beef and more); noodles from instant noodles, thin or thick Chinese noodles, egg noodles or glass noodles; a rich sesame soup; numbing and heat chosen separately; black vinegar on the table; rice; buns; bottled beer ¥600; paper aprons; pay afterwards; about ¥1,200–1,700 each.

食べログ: 味千拉麺 船場店、大阪市中央区船場中央1-3-2 船場センタービル2.en: Tabelog: Ajisen Ramen Senba, Semba Center Bldg No. 2 B2F, 1-3-2 Semba-chuo, Chuo-ku, Osaka; directly connected to Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–16:00; closed weekends and holidays (sometimes open Saturdays); cards (JCB, AMEX) and QR accepted; 30 seats (counter 10, tables 20). Reviews (September–October 2026): a Kumamoto ramen chain (founded 1968); about 3 shops in Osaka; Ajisen ramen ¥950 (tonkotsu, garlic chips); spicy tonkotsu; miso ramen; taipien ¥1,100 (Kumamoto glass-noodle soup with shrimp, pork, squid, napa cabbage, wood-ear, carrot and a fried boiled egg); lunch set with takana rice; daily chicken-tonkotsu set; half fried rice ¥450; Thai bamee; fried garlic on the table; one found prices a little high; discount coupons on some days.

食べログ: 味噌ヌードル 麹、大阪市中央区平野町2-5-14 FUKUビル 1F.en: Tabelog: Miso Noodle Koji, FUKU Bldg 1F, 2-5-14 Hiranomachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 457 m from Kitahama; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30), Sat 11:00–15:00; closed Sundays and holidays; Obon and New Year announced on social media; cards (including UnionPay) and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 15 counter seats; opened 7 April 2020. Reviews (October 2021 – October 2026): miso ramen large ¥1,200; thick noodles; 'Wasan Sansho' miso ramen ¥1,100; buy a ticket first, then queue; sansho aroma; spicy miso ramen ¥1,050 with 5 heat levels; medium-thick wavy noodles; onion and leek; miso ramen ¥900 (2023); non-woven aprons; a gritty miso soup; affiliated with Tsukemen Ide; say the heat level when handing over the ticket; special miso ramen ¥1,500 (2025); red onion; menma; chashu miso; burnt-garlic miso; up to heat 3 free; the same ichimi and business card as Ide; tonkotsu base; shredded white leek with yuzu peel; thick wavy whole-wheat noodles; the ticket machine takes cash, e-payment and cards; special 'Wasan Sansho' miso ramen about ¥1,600.

食べログ: 味噌ラーメン越、大阪市西区江戸堀1-23-31、肥後橋駅から徒歩4分.en: Tabelog: Miso Ramen Etsu, 1-23-31 Edobori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Higobashi Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 18:00–21:30, Sat 11:00–15:00; closed Sundays and holidays; cards and QR (including Alipay and WeChat Pay) accepted, no e-money; 18 seats (ground-floor counter 8; 2nd-floor tables and counter 4). Reviews (August–October 2026): a proper miso ramen, rare around here; large free; ticket machine for cash and PayPay; a rich, slightly sweet miso soup with a thin layer of oil; chewy medium-thick wavy noodles; thick chashu; seasoned-egg miso ramen ¥1,150; soft-boiled seasoned egg; egg on rice; opened February 2026; one says it's linked to Miso Noodle Koji of the Tsukemen Ide brand; one found it lukewarm and ordinary; a clean shop.

食べログ: 味園、中華料理、大阪市淀川区新高1-5-3、三国駅から456m、月〜.en: Tabelog: Misono; Chinese; 新高1-5-3, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 456 m from Mikuni Station; Mon–Sat 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–21:00; closed Sunday; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 16 seats; smoking allowed. Reviews (2022 to October 2026): a long-established neighbourhood Chinese place just off Route 176; run by one person; katsudon with ankake ¥650 (2022); mapo katsudon ¥750–900; Chinese set (sweet and sour pork, shrimp tempura, omelette) ¥950; Misono set (stir-fried vegetables, kara-age, omelette) ¥900–950; yakisoba and kara-age set ¥850; sweet and sour pork set ¥800; tonkatsu set ¥700; stamina set ¥700; liver and garlic chives set; service lunch ¥600; chuka-don, tenshinhan and yakisoba ¥550 each; fried rice (medium) ¥500; miso ramen ¥700; ankake noodles; tenshinhan and ramen set ¥800; shrimp in ketchup sauce; gyoza; daily bento; fast service; packed with office workers at lunch.

食べログ: 味悟空 三国店、中華料理、大阪市淀川区西宮原3-2-23、東三国駅か.en: Tabelog: Aji Goku Mikuni ten, Chinese, 西宮原 3-2-23, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 502 m from Higashimikuni Station; Mon–Sat 11:00–23:30, Sun and holidays 11:00–23:00; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money and QR accepted; 6 counter seats and tables; smoking allowed; takeaway; site ajigoku.com. Reviews (December 2023 to September 2026): a red front; a Showa-era neighbourhood Chinese diner; shared tables at lunch; daily set ¥900 (grilled pork with rolled omelette, kara-age and so on); set meals ¥1,000, ¥950 at weekday lunch; sweet and sour pork; stir-fried vegetables; Happo ramen with rice ¥930; fried rice set ¥1,200 (two kara-age, cabbage, ramen); Chinese rice bowl ¥800 with soup; six kara-age ¥900; gyoza set ¥850 (kara-age, kimchi, draft beer); katsu curry ¥930; Chili Rice set; omurice; curry; fried noodles; big portions; the fried rice divides opinion; smoking allowed even at lunch; PayPay accepted; another shop by Higashiyodogawa Station.

食べログ: 味満ん、港区六本木3-8-8 ＷＯＯビル1F、六本木駅から10分、1.en: Tabelog: Ajiman, Roppongi 3-8-8, WOO building 1F, 10 min from Roppongi Station; 18:00–24:00; closed in July and August; open every day from September to March; closed Sundays from April to June; subject to change, so check first; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 seats; private rooms (2–20); tatami seating; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; The Tabelog Award Silver 2019, 2020, 2022, 2026 and Bronze 2021, 2023, 2024, 2025. Reviews (2025–July 2026): founded 1981; referral only, no new bookings; cash only; thick-cut fugu sashimi; liver dipping sauce; house kabosu ponzu; grilled shirako; kara-age; hot pot; zosui; hirezake; family-run; about ¥50,000 a head with drinks at night.

食べログ: 和dining 清乃 スパワールド店、大阪市浪速区恵美須東3-4-2.en: Tabelog: Wa Dining Seino Spa World, 3-4-24 Ebisu-higashi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 189 m from Dobutsuen-mae Station; daily 11:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); inside Spa World, paid on leaving the facility; opened 1 July 2023; cards, e-money and QR accepted; children welcome. Reviews (August 2025 – August 2026): a shop of the famous Wakayama ramen Seino; 3rd-floor food zone; Seino Wakayama ramen (tonkotsu shoyu, somewhat thick with strong shoyu, thin straight noodles, rare chashu); Hokkaido-style salt ramen (leek and napa cabbage); butter topping; summer cold ume and shiso ramen; winter black oyster ramen; gyoza; karaage; beer; a bowl after the bath; one says the main shop is better.

食べログ: 和sai、大阪市天王寺区生玉町5-26、谷町九丁目駅3番出口から徒歩.en: Tabelog: Wasai, 5-26 Ikutamamachi, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Tanimachi-Kyuchome Station exit 3; Mon and Thu–Sun 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:00) and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays; cards and PayPay accepted; 20 seats (counter 8, tables 12). Reviews (September–October 2026): a renovated house on a quiet street; at lunch grilled-fish or simmered-fish set meal ¥1,650 (the day's fish, e.g. houbou, with small dishes and pickles, free rice refills); at night a ¥5,500 course (starters such as whale; sashimi of several tunas and sea bream; sudachi dobin-mushi; a whole fish grilled or simmered (threadfin bream); eel and mushroom tempura; ayu clay-pot rice; nyumen; red miso soup); a sashimi and sukiyaki course; careful cooking, so it takes time.

食べログ: 和かろん専門店 和果、大阪市西区北堀江1-11-6、四ツ橋駅6番出口.en: Tabelog: Wacaron Senmon Ten Waka, 1-11-6 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exit 6; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 11:00–18:00; closed Wednesdays; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; no smoking; 4 counter seats; takeaway; opened 10 September 2020; official site. Reviews (May–October 2026): a photo caption says 'Wacaron (fresh dorayaki) blueberry cheese cream (¥480 incl. tax)'; thick cream in thin, soft dorayaki pancakes; handed over frozen, ready to eat after a short walk; custard; matcha with azuki; hojicha with azuki; sweet potato; mitarashi roll (dango wrapped in a pancake) ¥580; bean paste and mochi roll ¥400; roast sweet-potato roll; at an event, an Anno-potato mitarashi roll ¥900; one came back to buy more; one found the sauce sparse; a bench at the entrance to eat on; no display case, choose from the menu.

食べログ: 和ベーカリーぱんどら屋、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-9-37、大阪難波駅.en: Tabelog: Wabekari Pandoraya, 2-9-37 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 419 m from Osaka-Namba Station; Tue–Sun and holidays 10:00–20:00; closed Mondays and the day after holidays; opened 18 September 2024; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 15 seats. Reviews (August 2025 – September 2026): an Amemura bakery; concept: bread to go with Japanese tea; a tasting of today's tea; ¥200 off Japanese tea ordered with bread; bread sold on the ground floor, eat-in upstairs (Japanese feel, cushions, power, Wi-Fi); puppy bread ¥330 (custard head, chocolate or hojicha body); weekend-only Shiba-dog bread ¥330; a pink puppy apparently with strawberry jam; dango danish ¥300; mitarashi-dango bread; salt croissant; strawberry croissant; matcha croissant; matcha danish; melon bread with a face; 3-colour Pandora melon bread; four-leaf-shaped Kyoto matcha anpan; yakisoba bread topped with a fried quail egg; honey-mustard chicken sandwich ¥490; peach tea; upstairs, claim a seat before ordering.

食べログ: 和レー屋 南船場ゴヤクラ、大阪市中央区南船場1-7-8 ダイアパレス.en: Tabelog: Wareya Minamisemba Goyakura, Dia Palace Junkeimachi 103, 1-7-8 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 6 min walk from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station exit 3; Mon, Tue and Fri 11:30 to about 15:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00 to about 15:00; closed Wednesdays and Thursdays; no cards, e-money or QR; smoking allowed; 16 seats (counter 8, two tables for 4). Reviews (September–October 2026): a one-person shop; a heavy door; wait for the staff to come and take your order; a Japanese-style dashi curry called 'Ware'; Special Beef Ware ¥1,500; miso-flavoured Beef & Pork Mara; tomato Goyakura keema; Japanese-style chicken keema with daikon; fiery chicken keema; Beef & Spicy Chicken Keema ¥900; off-menu combinations too; 4 pickles (carrot, daikon and onion achar; fukujinzuke); sometimes a 10-minute wait for the rice to cook.

食べログ: 和味 大場、港区六本木6-1-5 福島KDYビルB1、六本木駅3番出.en: Tabelog: Wami Oba, Roppongi 6-1-5, 福島KDYビル B1, 30 seconds from Roppongi Stn exit 3; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); closed weekends and holidays; 19 seats; smoking area; cards accepted (an October 2026 review says cash only). Shop text: always busy with regulars; the chef's care in food and drink; shochu from barley, rice, sweet potato, buckwheat, shiso and brown sugar, and awamori; rare shochu at times. Reviews (March–October 2026): negitoro yukke ¥1,500–1,550, negitoro set ¥1,550, toro-taku natto ¥1,400–1,450, salt-grilled mackerel ¥1,400, three-colour bowl; generous rice; about ¥250 of price rises in two years; lunch queues down the stairs; at night sashimi platters, egg dishes, ebi mayo; oolong tea is the only soft drink.

食べログ: 和彩たか、居酒屋・海鮮・日本料理、中京区鍋屋町209-3 木屋町岡本.en: Tabelog: 和彩たか, izakaya, seafood and Japanese cuisine; 中京区鍋屋町209-3 木屋町岡本ビル 1F; 3 min on foot from Hankyu Kawaramachi Station; 16:00–1:00 (last order 0:30); closed Tuesday (open on a Tuesday before a public holiday); reservations taken; an appetizer is served (changes each time); 18 seats; smoking allowed; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; particular about sake, shochu and fish; all-you-can-drink available. Reviews (2024–2026, in English): white-shrimp kara-age, buri shabu, Himi udon, a buri shabu course ¥5,000 plus all-you-can-drink ¥2,000 (January 2026), a quick-drink set, hamo carpaccio, yuba tofu, nama-fu dengaku, crab cream croquette, some find the menu small and the portions small.

食べログ: 和牛焼肉 千、銀座7-8-10 FUKUHARA GINZA B1F.en: Tabelog: Wagyu Yakiniku Sen, Ginza 7-8-10, FUKUHARA GINZA B1F; 22 seats (counter, semi-private and private rooms); Mon–Sat 17:30–24:00, closed Sun; 10% service charge, plus 10% for private rooms; opened August 29, 2026. Shop introduction: the name comes from choosing from thousands of cattle; heifers of the 但馬 line (Omi beef, Kobe beef); kuro-tan, kuro-harami. 2026 reviews: visited a week after opening; ¥9,900 course (a comparison of three kuro-tan cuts, Omi-beef carpaccio seared in front of you, sauce-grilled, Tokyo-yaki); ¥22,000 premium course (yaki-suki of Omi and Kobe beef, truffle, caviar, French and Chinese techniques); a black-toned interior; 1864 鮨 善 on the same floor; the owner also runs the mitarashi-dango shop "柊".

食べログ: 和菓子、中京区堺町通丸太町下ル橘町83、丸太町駅から徒歩5分、毎日9.en: Tabelog: wagashi; 堺町通丸太町下ル橘町83, Nakagyo-ku; 5 min walk from Marutamachi Stn; daily 9:30–15:00; reservations accepted (the large, ¥1,200, must be booked by the day before; the small, ¥1,000, is sold in limited numbers on the day); takeaway only; no cards, e-money or QR; parking for 1–2 cars; Japanese sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2023, 2026. Reviews (April–October 2026, in English): miso matsukaze only; wheat flour, sugar, white (Saikyo) miso and sesame, no egg; keeps about 3 days; cut ends for home use ¥300; founded in the Shoo era; about 360 years; one of Kyoto's three famous matsukaze; an elderly woman in the tatami room at the back.

食べログ: 和韓料理スンドゥブ専門店じゅろく なんば別邸、大阪市中央区千日前1-.en: Tabelog: Wakan Ryori Sundubu Senmonten Juroku Namba Bettei, Namba Walk underground mall, 1-5-12 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 050-5872-5498; reservations accepted; daily 11:00–22:00 (food L.O. 21:15); closed third Wednesday of odd months and 1 January; cards, transit IC, iD and QR payment accepted; 17 seats (counter 9, two tables for 4); private hire up to 20; no smoking; no cover charge. The shop recommends the Japanese-Korean special sundubu set meal, the Namba-only special Korean-style sundubu ramen (chewy noodles) and aged-pork tonteki. 2026 reviews (June–October): heat 1–4, 2 is standard; a strong flavour with sweetness; rice and 3 small side dishes; with ramen, rice is +¥100; lychee sorbet to finish; ticket machine; the noodles seem like boiled dried noodles; roast-pork sundubu (5 slices of fatty roast pork, 4 clams, minced meat, plenty of tofu); bean-sprout namul, greens, kimchi; Japanese-Korean reimen (simmered beef, seri, kombu-pickled daikon, shiso, myoga); a kind manager; reservation easy to get; once an order didn't go through and was late; grilled-cheese sundubu ramen; recently seen on TV; about a year since opening.

食べログ: 和風カフェ はらいそ、大阪市中央区博労町3-3-14 2階、本町駅・.en: Tabelog: Wafu Cafe Haraiso, Bakuromachi 3-3-14 2F, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 8 min walk from Honmachi and Shinsaibashi stations; Mon–Fri 12:00–19:00, closed Saturdays, Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money or QR; 15 seats; smoking allowed (non-smoking 11:00–15:00). Reviews (April 2018 – August 2026): steep stairs to the 2nd floor, a Chinese restaurant on the ground floor, Showa-retro, dim and quiet, antique furniture, a black telephone, many women dining alone, the only menu is the daily Inaka set meal, one or two brown-rice onigiri (¥800 / ¥850, January 2025), mains such as tofu minced cutlet, tofu hamburg, and tofu-and-vegetable croquettes, four small dishes on a bamboo leaf, chilled tofu, miso soup, onigiri without nori, after-meal drink ¥50; a February 2025 diner found no animal products; a September 2023 diner saw the owner running the shop single-handedly; per an August 2026 diner, last order 15:30; cash only.

食べログ: 和食晴ル、居酒屋、下京区神明町230-2、地下鉄四条駅・阪急烏丸駅か.en: Tabelog: Washoku Haru, izakaya; 神明町230-2, Shimogyo-ku; 3 min walk from Shijo Station (subway) and Karasuma Station (Hankyu); Tuesday–Sunday 18:00–22:00 (Friday L.O. food 21:10, drinks 21:25); closed Monday; no lunch; 11 seats (counter only); high-school age and up; non-smoking; cash only; two seatings with a changeover at 20:00; bookings only through TableCheck (phone on the day only); opened 16 June 2015; Izakaya WEST Tabelog 100 2025 and 2026. Reviews (July–October 2026, in English): potato salad, sashimi platter, conger-eel sashimi, sea-bream sansho mochi ¥2,200, duck menchi katsu ¥2,000, crab salt yakisoba, saba sushi, an owner who trained at Wakuden, a blackboard menu.

食べログ: 唯一無二のらぁ麺専門店 イ袋ワシづかみ、大阪市天王寺区四天王寺2-2.en: Tabelog: Yuitsu Muni no Raa-men Senmonten Ibukuro Washizukami, 2-2-7 Shitennoji, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Tanimachi Line Shitennoji-mae Yuhigaoka Station, 10 min from Kintetsu Uehommachi, 15 min from Tennoji; daily 11:00–15:30 (L.O. 15:00) and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); no cards, e-money or QR; 8 seats (counter 4, one table for 4); opened 21 February 2022; Tabelog Ramen OSAKA Hyakumeiten 2024 and 2025. Reviews (August–October 2026): cold maze-soba of karasumi, leek and niboshi, with a warm egg sauce partway; salt ramen of beef tendon, hamaguri and niboshi; shared tables; rich shoyu ramen with seasoned egg; medium-thick wavy noodles; aosa; salted kombu and egg rice; Inazuma maze-soba (large); white rice; slightly spicy; chewy noodles; a 10-minute wait outside; Inazuma chuka soba; chili, sansho, black pepper; sweet shoyu with back fat; pay first; order by number; one says 3 counter seats and one table for 4; wonton and seasoned-egg shoyu ramen ¥1,250; light with niboshi umami; flat medium-thick wavy noodles; back-fat topping; rich shoyu chashu; strong garlic; change the flavour with fish powder; a little far from the station.

食べログ: 啐啄 つか本、日本料理、東山区祇園町南側570-120、月・火・木〜.en: Tabelog: Sottaku Tsukamoto, Japanese cuisine, 東山区祇園町南側570-120; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Wednesday; not accepting new reservations; 8 counter seats; no cards, e-money or QR; non-smoking; moved in June 2008 from Nabeyacho 210-3 2F in Pontocho; no photography; The Tabelog Award Silver 2019–2023, Gold 2024–2026; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025. Reviews (July 2025 – October 2026, in English): guests invited by regulars, a policy of no photos and no publishing of the dishes, the balance of acidity in the sauces and dressings, pressed mackerel sushi, a Matsutake and hamo soup.

食べログ: 喜蕎麦司 きし元、ラーメン、大阪市淀川区西中島4-11-24 第1ユ.en: Tabelog: kixisoba kishimoto, ramen, 4-11-24 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, 第1ユーリハイツ 1F; 299 m from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; Mon–Thu, Sat and Sun 11:00–16:00, closed Friday (temporary closures on its social media); no reservations; no cards, transport IC cards and PayPay accepted; 7 seats (counter); non-smoking; opened 12 November 2019. Reviews (June to October 2026): the owner trained at Chuka Soba Kuzu; reopened on 29 May 2026 after about three years closed; ticket machine at the entrance; Dashi Soba ¥690 (extra noodles ¥150); Awai Soba ¥770; egg noodles ¥380; toppings; a chicken and honkarebushi broth with two Hozan soy sauces; a frothy, creamy "espuma"; a little chicken fat and roasted garlic; homemade noodles, 1.5 servings; smoked chashu; green onion; chopped onion; yuzu kosho; the Awai Soba is shrimp and white tamari; limited shio; tonkotsu about ¥880; seasoned-egg roast-pork rice bowl (basil sauce); mini chashu rice bowl; smoked seasoned egg; full at lunch, sometimes a short wait.

食べログ: 喫茶 檸檬の、喫茶店・カレー、大阪市淀川区西中島3-11-10 新三.en: Tabelog: Kissa Lemon-no, kissaten and curry, 3-11-10 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, 新三宝ビル 1F; 154 m from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; daily 9:30–20:30; phone reservations accepted; cards (VISA, Master) and PayPay, no e-money; 14 seats; non-smoking; breakfast served; takeaway; children welcome; strollers welcome. Official site: Kissa Lemon-no Shin-Osaka, a shop of baked curry and lemon cake; COFFEE, CURRY, SWEETS. Reviews (July 2025 to October 2026): order and pay at the counter first; a terrace seat; Kashmir curry with coconut milk and nuts (sweet, then spicy) as a set with salad and a drink; today's hamburg steak set ¥1,300; salad bowls; pasta; breakfast from 10:00, a drink with toast and a boiled egg; bacon-and-egg toast; lemon cake (also to take away); lemon tart; cheesecake; Basque cheesecake; pudding; strawberry shortcake; iced café latte ¥540; black sesame latte; cold-brew iced coffee; many young women customers; one diner thought it part of the neel group.

食べログ: 喫茶ことり、大阪市西区南堀江4-10-5 石村ビル1F、汐見橋駅から.en: Tabelog: Kissa Kotori, 石村ビル 1F, 4-10-5 Minamihorie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 412 m from Shiomibashi Station; Mon, Wed, Thu, Fri 8:30–19:00 (L.O. 18:30), Sat, Sun and holidays 8:30–18:30 (L.O. 18:00); closed Tuesday and other irregular days; breakfast 8:30–11:00, lunch from 11:30 for the rest of the day; drink set +¥100 from 11:30 to 14:30; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 17 seats with a counter; non-smoking. Reviews (August 2017 – October 2026): about 5 min walk from Nishi-Nagahori Station; a retro, cute interior; chairs like old school chairs; light from a small window on the park side; breakfast buttered-toast set (with drink and boiled egg) from ¥500, nori-cheese toast ¥600 (March 2025), French toast with maple syrup and cinnamon; mushroom omurice ¥850 (October 2026; ¥800 in 2021–2024), chicken rice with shimeji and sausage, with salad; chicken curry; daily plate ¥950 (December 2025; ¥900 in December 2024): teriyaki pork rolled around vegetables, shiso-cheese chicken-breast fry, hamburg steak with grated daikon, menchi katsu and so on, with potato salad, small side dishes, miso soup and salad; pumpkin pudding (October 2026); homemade cookies; hassaku lemonade; cash only; full at lunch at times; run by two women (September 2020); one diner found the baked-goods area cluttered (July 2026).

食べログ: 喫茶サンチョ、喫茶店・カフェ・洋食、大阪市淀川区西中島5-16-1.en: Tabelog: Kissa Sancho; kissa, café, yoshoku; JR Central Shin-Osaka Station 1F, Aji no Koji, 西中島5-16-1, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; daily 7:20–21:00; no reservations; no cards or e-money, PayPay accepted; 40 seats; smoking allowed; breakfast. Reviews (2025 to November 2026): outside the ticket gates, down the escalator to the 1st floor; a Showa-retro kissa; smoking at every seat; seated in order of arrival; morning set C ¥750; sandwich of tuna, cucumber and lettuce with fruit; lunch with coffee; demi-glace hamburg steak; ginger pork set; free rice refills; ¥50 off without a drink; Baumkuchen set ¥850 (burnt Baumkuchen with whipped cream); coffee ¥650; fruit mitsumame; warabi mochi; 100% fruit mixed juice; café au lait; full at lunch, with some turned away.

食べログ: 喫茶シロイヌ、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-9-23 Dビル西心斎橋2-1.en: Tabelog: Kissa Shiroinu, D Bldg Nishi-Shinsaibashi 2-103, 1-9-23 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; no reservations; Tue–Sat 11:30–15:30 (L.O. 15:00) and 20:00–1:30 next morning (L.O. 1:00), Sun 11:30–15:30 and 20:00–23:30; closed Mondays and irregular days; cards and QR (PayPay) accepted, no e-money; 10 seats; opened 17 March 2023. 2026 reviews (February–September): cheap; very good curry; the owner works quietly; after drinking; yakisoba sold out, so curry tsukemen; shoyu ramen and mini curry set ¥1,100 (depth from fish powder, gentle flavour); night-only back-fat shoyu ramen; a notice about the carefully chosen flour; teppan TKG; a serious ramen shop found in Amemura; the owner, formerly of a rock bar, is self-taught in noodle-making; a rich but not heavy soup; chashu; shoyu ramen ¥770 (strong niboshi).

食べログ: 喫茶店、中京区堺町通錦小路上る菊屋町531、烏丸駅から333m、毎日.en: Tabelog: kissa; 531, Sakaimachi-dori north of Nishiki, Nakagyo Ward; 333 m from Karasuma Stn; daily 7:30–20:00; 14 seats; no cards or e-money, QR accepted; smoking of heated tobacco only. Reviews (April 2024–June 2026): near Nishiki Market; a Showa-era coffee shop; morning A set ¥650; shrimp-fry sandwich; mixed sandwich; daily lunch (ginger pork, teriyaki chicken, tonkatsu); miso soup; pudding; the owner running it alone (August 2024); morning and evening menus too (May 2026).

食べログ: 嘉門、千代田区内幸町1-1-1 帝国ホテル東京本館17F、日比谷駅徒.en: Tabelog: Kamon, Uchisaiwaicho 1-1-1, Chiyoda-ku, Imperial Hotel Tokyo main building 17F, 5 minutes from Hibiya and Ginza stations; 71 seats (including 20 in the dessert corner); daily 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:00), 17:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); 15% service charge; wheelchair accessible; night views; official site imperialhotel.co.jp. October 2026 reviews: where the French restaurant "Fontainebleau" was 32 years ago; spiny lobster, black abalone, Miyagi wagyu fillet; special courses; meat and vegetables grilled one party at a time; dessert in a separate room, away from the meat smell; garlic rice; back for a daughter's birthday at the restaurant where the family first ate on the wedding day; ¥15,000–20,000 at lunch, ¥40,000–50,000 at dinner.

食べログ: 四ッ谷haraku-chi、居酒屋、四谷1-11 BELL ALLE.en: Tabelog: Yotsuya haraku-chi, izakaya; BELL ALLEY 1F, Yotsuya 1-11; 7 min walk from Yotsuya Station; Mon–Sat 18:00–22:00 (last order); closing days not fixed; 20 seats; non-smoking; private hire up to 20; children welcome; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted. Reviews (January 2024–September 2026): Fukushima food and sake, an owner from Date City, the name said to mean a full stomach in Fukushima dialect, fried mehikari, ika-ninjin, Fukushima gyoza, Date chicken steak, horse sashimi with spicy miso, anglerfish soup, soba in a Date chicken meatball dipping soup to finish, a choice of sake cups, busy on weekdays, one diner in February 2025 found the welcome cold.

食べログ: 四天王 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-7-1、日本橋駅から330m.en: Tabelog: Shitenno Dotonbori, 1-7-1 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 330 m from Nippombashi Station; 32 seats; hours on the official site; open every day of the year; children welcome; opened 5 March 2021. 2026 reviews: shoyu ramen with seasoned egg; miso ramen with half fried rice; many overseas diners; open 24 hours in the very middle of Dotonbori; near Kinryu; miso ramen and karaage set; mildly spicy and addictive with garlic added; expected Yamaguchi style but the menu is long, shoyu, miso and more; the 2nd floor is roomy too; chashu; a rich tori-paitan base that is surprisingly clean; leek and bean sprouts; the miso is salty and suits late nights; ticket machine; thin straight noodles; onion, nira and chili; grated garlic and sesame; ramen and fried rice set ¥1,200 is reasonable.

食べログ: 四季自然喰処たちばな 新大阪本店、居酒屋・海鮮・ふぐ、大阪市淀川区宮.en: Tabelog: Shiki Shizen Kuidokoro Tachibana, Shin-Osaka main shop; izakaya, seafood, fugu; ニッセイ新大阪ビル 2F, 宮原3-4-30, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 2 minutes on foot from exit 4 of Shin-Osaka Station; reachable without getting wet; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed over New Year; reservations accepted; private rooms ¥1,000 per group; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; 200 seats; tatami room up to 120; non-smoking. Reviews (2025 to October 2026): the signature homemade tofu; warm zaru tofu with dashi; chilled tofu, rice and soup refillable; sashimi and zaru tofu set ¥1,454–1,600; dashimaki and tempura set (with mentaiko and chilled tofu); simmered fish set; grilled pork belly and crab cream croquette; Colorful gozen; yuba and shrimp tempura udon; the Matsukado set; at night appetisers, sea bream and salmon sashimi, tempura, pork shabu-shabu, Osaka water eggplant, roast beef; course with 2-hour all-you-can-drink ¥5,000; another shop in Umeda.

食べログ: 四川らーめん 宗右衛門町本店、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町1-21、13席.en: Tabelog: Sichuan Ramen Soemoncho main shop, 1-21 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 13 seats (ground-floor counter 6, 2nd-floor counter 6, 2nd-floor table for 6); Mon 0:00–7:00, Tue 21:00–24:00, Wed–Fri 0:00–7:00 and 21:00–24:00, Sat–Sun 0:00–9:00 and 21:00–24:00; no cards, e-money or QR payment; no smoking; opened 9 December 2025. 2026 reviews (September–October): shoyu ramen after drinking (strong shoyu, crunchy bean sprouts, chashu); down an alley, hard to find; the door is hard to open and close; Sichuan ramen ¥1,000 (crunchy greens, somen-thin noodles); just the right heat; nostalgic fried rice; open late; you can change the flavour; opened in a back alley at the end of last year; house-made thin noodles; garlic and lemon juice; kimchi fried rice; a day when opening prep was late and there was no Sichuan ramen; black shoyu ramen; garlic and pepper fried rice.

食べログ: 四川式担々麺 だるま 船場店、大阪市中央区船場中央3-3-9 船場セ.en: Tabelog: Sichuan-style Tantanmen Daruma Semba, Semba Center Bldg No. 9 B2F, 3-3-9 Semba-chuo, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 187 m from Hommachi Station; Mon–Sat 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Sundays; e-money and QR accepted, no cards; opened 1 March 2024. Reviews (June–October 2026): hot-and-sour noodles are the usual order; quick turnover even when full; not too hot, with tang and numbing; half fried rice; lychee; visits weekly; soupless tantanmen with rice; slightly firm noodles; mapo rice bowl; 4 kinds of tantanmen with choice of heat; white-sesame tantanmen (new flavour) ¥950; half fried rice ¥50; a seasoned egg for following on Instagram; hot even at mild; pan-fried gyoza; kind staff; quiet on Saturdays; set rice dishes ¥50; rich sesame and Sichuan spices; minced meat.

食べログ: 四川料理と酒Yuan (ゆえん)、四川料理・中華料理・居酒屋、下京区.en: Tabelog: 四川料理と酒Yuan (Yuan), Sichuan, Chinese and izakaya; 下京区麩屋町通高辻下る鍵屋町219 鍵屋小路会館 E号, 10 m south of the Fuyacho-Takatsuji crossing on the west side, at the back of the 1st floor of the Kagiya Koji Kaikan; 10 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn; Tue–Sat 17:30–23:00 (last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30), Sun 17:30–21:30; closed Monday; 10% service charge after 22:00; bookings taken; 19 seats (counter 6, tables 2×4, private room 5); non-smoking; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; BYO allowed; opened 21 January 2026. Gurunavi: inside the Kagiya Koji Kaikan, 6 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn; Tue–Sun, closed Monday; 19 seats. Review (September 2026, in Japanese): assorted appetizers (for two) ¥3,200 (spicy jellyfish, saliva chicken of Kyoto red jidori, Sichuan-style potato salad, octopus with salt, lemon and sansho, zha cai and green onion in chili oil, century egg with white tofu dressing); Yuan-style Sichuan chili shrimp ¥1,900; mapo tofu ¥1,600; special black-vinegar pork ¥3,200; crab-sauce fried rice ¥1,800; Sō (Shaoxing wine soda) ¥900; sansho beer ¥1,300; counter right in front of the kitchen; a door with an upside-down 福. English reviews (January–October 2026): chef Keiichi Hara, trained at famous restaurants and in China.

食べログ: 四川辣麺 西中島店、担々麺・ラーメン、大阪市淀川区西中島3-13-8.en: Tabelog: Sichuan Ramen Nishinakajima ten, tantanmen and ramen, 3-13-8 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 2–3 min from the north exit of Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station (Midosuji Line), 3–4 min from Hankyu Minamikata Station; Mon–Wed 11:30–14:30 and 18:30–02:00, Thu–Sat 11:30–14:30 and 18:30–03:00, Sun 11:30–14:30 and 18:30–01:00; open all year; no reservations; no cards or e-money, PayPay accepted; 28 seats; smoking allowed. The shop's introduction: authentic Sichuan food made casual; a menu in Chinese characters with Japanese explanations; flavours suited to Japanese tastes. Reviews (August to October 2026): tantanmen in an original or a new flavour; light and mildly spicy; medium-thin wavy noodles; pork-belly chashu; the new "Sichuan Street Style" flavour is creamy sesame; mapo noodles ¥1,250 (three spice levels, rice to finish); mapo rice; hot and sour noodles; Yurinchi; Sichuan pepper, chili oil, pickles, ground sesame, fried garlic and lychee vinegar on the table; free rice or frozen lychee for following on Instagram; 60% full even at 21:00; one diner felt rushed at lunch; a fan from the Hankyu Sanbangai shop.

食べログ: 四川食房 福龍、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町1-5 幸成ビル1F、20席(.en: Tabelog: Sichuan Shokubo Fukuryu, Kosei Bldg 1F, 1-5 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 20 seats (counter 11, tables 10); daily 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); no smoking; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; Tabelog Chinese WEST Hyakumeiten 2021; official tantanmen.com; sister shop of Barchica 03. 2025–2026 reviews: welcomed warmly even just before last order; the scallop fried rice ¥1,000 seen on TV; tables full with reservations, so seated at the counter; yu lin chicken; leek ramen to finish; Akaboshi beer ¥750, pan-fried gyoza ¥500, seafood (shrimp and squid) salt stir-fry ¥1,800; run by three people; always full; a shop by a disciple of Chen Kenmin (Uber Eats); the tantanmen is the most popular and mild; mapo tofu; soupless tantanmen; the scallop fried rice is a little salty; shrimp fried rice; with a dish you can add a mini mapo rice or half fried rice (scallop, shrimp, crab, vegetables).

食べログ: 堀江カフェ オー ウィ ウィ、大阪市西区南堀江1-15-17 101.en: Tabelog: Horie Cafe Oh!oui oui, 101, 1-15-17 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Yotsubashi and Sakuragawa stations; weekdays 10:00–23:00, Sun and holidays 10:00–19:00; irregular closing days; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking; 20 seats; pets allowed; takeaway. Reviews (April 2025 – October 2026): specialty coffee divided into dark and fruity; Ethiopia, Burundi, Indonesia; about ¥999 a cup; choose for you if you state your taste; careful explanations of light roasts; choose your cup and saucer; what doesn't fit is served separately; decorations out front; sometimes people waiting for the morning opening; orders slow when busy; dogs allowed, and with wooden floors small dogs need a mat.

食べログ: 塩そば 時空 OSAKA、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-9-19 ミトオリ.en: Tabelog: Shio Soba Jikuu OSAKA, Mitori Art Bldg 1F, 1-9-19 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Nagahoribashi stations; Mon 10:30–15:00 and 18:00–22:00, Tue, Wed, Thu and Sun 10:30–15:00 and 18:00–21:30, Fri–Sat 10:30–15:00 and 18:00–22:30; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 seats; no smoking; opened 27 April 2026. Reviews (May–October 2026): the Osaka branch of a famous Tokyo shop; weekend-only special ura-shoyu soba ¥1,480; light shoyu with a faint seafood aroma; thin noodles from Takai-do Seimen; chicken tsukune with cartilage; 4 kinds of chashu (low-temperature chicken, belly, braised pork, low-temperature pork); one says it opened 5 May; a branch of a Tokyo Hyakumeiten; special salt soba ¥1,480; seasoned egg ¥180; low-temperature Daisendori chashu; radish sprouts; gingery tsukune; 8 counter seats; clear soup; chicken umami; one says the salt is restrained; square-cut noodles; yuzu tsukune; chashu rice bowl set; ticket machine; cramped when busy; the Tokyo main shop is in the Michelin Guide; queues; another says the salt is firm; one says medium-thick straight noodles; a radio playing; service a little slow.

食べログ: 壁の穴 日比谷シャンテ店、千代田区有楽町1-2-2 日比谷シャンテB.en: Tabelog: Kabe no Ana Hibiya Chanter, Yurakucho 1-2-2, Chiyoda-ku, Hibiya Chanter B2F, 1 minute from Hibiya Station; 37 seats; daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed 12/31 and 1/1; 12/30 and 1/2–1/3 11:00–20:00; no service charge; allergen labeling; wheelchair accessible. 2026 reviews: Shibuya is the main shop; tarako spaghetti with crisp nori; mentai carbonara; mentaiko cream; mentaiko, squid and natto spaghetti (starter set); every shop has a wide range of toppings; you can drink from noon; the salad is good too; a free drink for following on Instagram; slightly pricey; quick turnover even with a queue; the clam and shimeji spaghetti changed to clams and assorted mushrooms.

食べログ: 壱賢家 日本橋店、大阪市中央区日本橋1-6-5、予約不可、毎日11:.en: Tabelog: Ikkenya Nippombashi, 1-6-5 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; no reservations; daily 11:00–3:00 next morning; no cards or e-money; QR accepted; counter seats; opened 25 March 2024. 2026 reviews (April–September): iekei ramen; counter only and clean; two staff serving efficiently; a balance for everyone; 2 min walk from Nippombashi Station; Yokohama iekei; choose firm, strong and more at the ticket machine; change the flavour with onion, pepper and sesame; chashu-men with quail eggs and nori; strong but not heavy; tsukemen (firm, springy noodles; a strong dipping soup); open late; tonkotsu and thick noodles; spinach and chashu; chili oil and garlic; open until 3 a.m.; one says it seems to franchise independently.

食べログ: 壺味、たこ焼き・お好み焼き、中京区錦大宮町152、大宮駅から115m.en: Tabelog: 壺味 (Tsubomi), takoyaki and okonomiyaki; 中京区錦大宮町152; 115 m from Omiya Station; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 17:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:00, drinks L.O. 22:30); closed Wednesday; reservations taken; no cards, e-money or QR; no service or cover charge; 8 seats (standing room for about 5); private hire up to 20; smoking allowed. Reviews (2026, in English): signature negiyaki ¥1,500 (three Kujo green onions, cut by the mother after ordering, 40 min to an hour to grill); mixed okonomiyaki ¥1,200; takoyaki 8 for ¥500; takoyaki with garlic; garlic-grilled octopus; wagyu steak; pork kimchi; a Showa-era shop run by the owner and the owner's mother; the owner talks with foreign guests in English; hot inside in summer.

食べログ: 多満喜、大阪市中央区南船場3-1-7 日宝東心斎橋ビル １F、心斎橋.en: Tabelog: Tamaki, Nippo Higashi-Shinsaibashi Bldg 1F, 3-1-7 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 6 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; a tall, narrow sign; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:30), Sat 17:30–23:00; closed Sundays and holidays (open on Saturday holidays); cover charge ¥500 (not for courses); cards accepted; smoking allowed; 13 seats. Reviews (July 2025 – October 2026): a monthly course with sake pairing for about ¥5,000; a fish hot pot as the main (kinmedai shabu-shabu, sea-bream shabu-shabu, abalone shabu-shabu, conger-eel sukiyaki with beaten egg, whale harihari nabe); ikura chawanmushi; 3 kinds of sashimi (kinmedai, katsuo, isaki and others); grilled and steamed dishes; zosui, udon or Chinese noodles to finish; sakes such as Zao, Sasaichi and Kinran; dislikes accommodated if mentioned when booking; course price rise from October 2026; a daily lunch of about ¥1,000 on weekdays.

食べログ: 夢屋、お好み焼き・焼きそば・居酒屋、左京区川端通二条通上ル孫橋町1、.en: Tabelog: 夢屋 (Yume Ya), okonomiyaki, yakisoba and izakaya; 左京区川端通二条通上ル孫橋町1; 3 min on foot from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Station, 5 min from Keihan Sanjo Station; 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:30); closed Wednesday; closes when sold out; reservations taken; 45 seats; sofa seats and tatami; can be hired for 20–50 people; non-smoking; no cards, e-money or QR payments; Okonomiyaki Tabelog 100 2018, 2019, 2022, 2023 and 2024. Reviews (2026, in English): red lanterns; Yume-yaki with a yam-rich batter ¥1,480; Super Yume-yaki (potato and cheese); Fukafuka ¥1,480; Yume negi ¥1,300; jaga cheese ¥950; garlic yaki ¥750; thin-noodle salt yakisoba; tonpei; "muroaji-bushi" from Iyo; celebrity signatures; regulars since student days.

食べログ: 夢彩庵 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-7-11 ほんまビル2F、.en: Tabelog: Musaian Shinsaibashi, Honma Bldg 2F, 2-7-11 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 12 seats; Sun–Thu, holidays, and days before and after holidays 0:00–5:00, Fri–Sat 20:00–5:00; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR payment; no smoking; opened 1 December 2023. Reviews (March 2025 – June 2026): first visit since the name change; truffle tsukemen; a refined place suited to a date; light tsukemen; noodles reheated (atsumori); soup thinned with broth at the end; truffle egg-on-rice; a rich clam (shijimi) soup; clam paste; rich seafood tsukemen; smooth noodles; opens at midnight; prices on the high side; produced by a charismatic figure of the Shinshu ramen world; clam cream sauce; queues; after drinking.

食べログ: 大屋、たこ焼き・焼きそば、大阪市淀川区宮原5-2-17、東三国駅5番.en: Tabelog: Daiya, takoyaki and yakisoba, 宮原 5-2-17, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 1 min from Exit 5 of Higashimikuni Station; daily 18:00–23:00; no reservations; no cards or e-money, PayPay accepted; 4 seats (counter); smoking allowed; takeaway; opened 22 November 2010. Reviews (July 2024 to September 2026): run by a couple; a kind older couple; closed on rainy days; outdoor counters and about four tables; electric blankets and cushions in winter; takoyaki a little bigger than golf balls, crisp outside and creamy inside; sauce and mayonnaise, dashi soy, ponzu, curry, garlic pepper mayonnaise; spicy horumon; horumon yakisoba; oden; curry udon; six takoyaki, spicy horumon and two beers ¥1,650; stage actors' autographs; the cast of "The Prince of Tennis"; recommended by a railway YouTuber; some days still preparing at opening time.

食べログ: 大島ラーメン 銀座店、銀座8-10-16、月〜金11:00〜翌3:3.en: Tabelog: Ōshima Ramen Ginza, Ginza 8-10-16; Mon–Fri 11:00–3:30, Sat 11:00–21:00, closed Sun and holidays; 17 counter seats; takeaway available. 2026 reviews: miso ramen (bean sprouts, corn, menma, chashu, boiled egg, medium-thick straight noodles), "Oni" (spicy miso), gyoza with grated daikon and mustard, half fried rice, lunch miso ramen and gyoza set ¥1,100, miso ramen and half fried rice set ¥1,000, bean sprouts as otoshi. Payment: Tabelog says cards and PayPay accepted; a September review says cash only.

食べログ: 大松屋 銀座本店、銀座5-6-13 西五番街ビル7F、銀座駅から10.en: Tabelog: Omatsuya Ginza main shop, Ginza 5-6-13, 西五番街 Building 7F, 105 m from Ginza Station; Mon–Sat 11:40–13:40, 17:00–21:30, closed Sundays and holidays; official site ginza.omatsuya.jp; note: "moved from Eldor Building 2F, Ginza 6-5-8, Chuo-ku". Reviews (2025–2026): vegetable skewers grilled at the hearth in front of you; beautiful sashimi; the atmosphere of a hot-spring inn; step out of the elevator from an old back-street building into another world; six snacks on the course; attentive owner and staff; separate smoking area; Yamagata cooking; cold sake from a bamboo tube poured from high; green pepper, konnyaku, taro, tsukune, hatahata, beef grilled on a magnolia leaf; Yamagata ita soba; good for entertaining.

食べログ: 大極殿本舗 六角店、甘味処・和菓子、中京区六角通高倉東入ル南側堀之上.en: Tabelog: Daigokuden Honpo Rokkaku shop, sweets café and wagashi, 中京区六角通高倉東入ル南側堀之上町120, 5 min on foot from Karasuma Stn; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 10:00–18:00; closed Wednesday; no reservations; when full, names are taken in order; 22 seats (16 at tables, 6 on tatami); cards accepted; children welcome; a Kohaku Nagashi syrup that changes every month; Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2018–2020, 2022; Japanese sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2023, 2026. Reviews (September–November 2026, in English): founded 1885, the shop that brought castella to Kyoto, a tea room and small garden at the back of a late-Edo machiya, Kohaku Nagashi, soft warabi mochi, Aioi zenzai, shaved ice, waits on holidays.

食べログ: 大衆ビストロ Galetto (旧店名 大衆ビストロ 匠)、ビストロ.en: Tabelog: Taishu Bistro Galetto (former name: Taishu Bistro Takumi); bistro, Italian, meat bar; 花原第一ビル 101, 西中島6-8-9, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 6 minutes on foot from exit 1 of Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station, 8 from Hankyu Minamikata; Mon–Wed, Fri, Sat and holidays 18:00–23:00; Thursday also lunch 12:00–14:00; also listed as closed Sunday; cards and PayPay; 90 seats (40 in the restaurant, 50 in the banquet room); private hire; non-smoking (ashtray at the entrance). Reviews (2024 to September 2026): a Takumi group shop; Oita wagyu; courses with all-you-can-drink from ¥4,000; ¥5,000 with no time limit; ¥6,000; about five red and five white wines plus sparkling; sangria; seasonal potage; appetisers of roast duck, prosciutto and salami; carpaccio torched at the table; thin-sliced meat sashimi; wagyu and sea urchin bistro sushi; Oita wagyu potato salad; bagna cauda; mussels in wine with risotto; braised tuna; beef stew; venison; red-meat steak; ajillo; pound cake; monthly recommendations on LINE.

食べログ: 大衆食堂スタンド そのだ、大阪市中央区谷町6-3-7、谷町六丁目駅か.en: Tabelog: Taishu Shokudo Stand Sonoda, 6-3-7 Tanimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min on foot from Tanimachi 6-chome Stn; daily 11:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; smoking allowed (non-smoking 11:00–14:00); Tabelog Izakaya 100 2021; opened 11 May 2016. Time Out (December 2024): a popular shop that has now expanded to Tokyo and Fukuoka, but the main shop is on the Karahori shopping street in Tanimachi, Osaka; signature chashu egg set meal ¥880; chashu egg can be ordered on its own; chuka soba ¥968; napolitan ¥858; lamb skewer ¥180; meat tofu ¥715; menchi katsu ¥418. Reviews (December 2024–October 2026): lunch set meals around ¥1,000 with free refills of rice (and miso soup and pickles); mapo tofu (Sichuan-style, spicy); yurinchi; yakisoba; signature menchi katsu ¥550; chashu egg ¥726; Kagoshima premium chashu egg; signature meat tofu ¥748; anchovy and boiled-egg potato salad ¥528; beef skirt tataki ¥759; chicken nanban; kara-age; croquettes; spicy fries; edamame peperoncino; celery pickled in nam pla; celery and bean-sprout namul; garland chrysanthemum namul; menma; chuka soba ¥990 (seafood soy broth with flat noodles, chashu and clams; many order it to finish); Kohaku Ebisu draft ¥528; Baisu sour; sudachi sour; the new Pattaya sour; lemon sour ¥528; highball ¥528; full of office workers from noon; some drink at lunch; one diner says it was once a butcher's; one diner found the staff unresponsive (September 2026); one diner says it seems to be a sister shop of Taifuu Hanten nearby.

食べログ: 大連閣、大阪市西区九条3-4-2、九条駅から西九条方面へ約700m、.en: Tabelog: Dairen Kaku, 3-4-2 Kujo, Nishi-ku, Osaka; about 700 m from Kujo Station towards Nishi-Kujo, turn right where the shopping street breaks; open if the red noren is out; hard to find the first time; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–19:00, Sun 11:30–14:00; no cards, e-money or QR; 7 counter seats. Reviews (October 2020 – October 2026): one says about 60 years since founding; run by two people; ramen ¥500 (light, with black pepper and garlic oil; thin noodles; bean sprouts; leek; menma; thick chashu); gyoza rolled and wrapped after ordering (10 bite-size, crisp on the bottom); house chili oil; yakisoba ¥550 (the sauce made first, then tossed with boiled noodles; vegetables, meat, shrimp); fried rice ¥550 (pork, shrimp, leek, red pickled ginger); wonton noodles; chukadon; roast pork; hiyashi chuka ¥700 (jellyfish, canned mandarins, mustard not from a tube); large bottled beer ¥600; cash only; one says 11:30–20:00 with irregular closing days in August 2026.

食べログ: 大阪わぎゅうらぁめん、大阪市中央区日本橋1-3-13、06-6282.en: Tabelog: Osaka Wagyu Raa-men, 1-3-13 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6282-7091; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sat 18:00–23:00; closed Wednesdays and Sundays; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; counter seats. July 2026 review (1): opened 29 June; a new format from 'Ganso 5cm Katsu Don Osaka Tonkatsu' in Dotonbori; on the former site of Men no Hiromiya; Osaka wagyu raa-men 100 g ¥3,900, 250 g ¥6,900, 450 g ¥10,900; a not-very-thick shoyu soup of chicken bones and ago (flying fish) (gentle seafood and faint sweetness); medium-thin wavy noodles from Taiyo Seimenjo; seasoned beef flank; how it is served: ago dashi with gold leaf, grilled ago cut with scissors, ground in a mortar and added to finish, and the wagyu cooked to taste on an iron plate over solid fuel.

食べログ: 大阪アメリカ村 甲賀流 本店、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-18-4 甲賀.en: Tabelog: Osaka Amerikamura Koga Ryu main shop, Koga Ryu Bldg 1F, 2-18-4 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; opposite Amerikamura's Triangle Park; 2 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exit 5; Sun–Fri 10:30–20:30, Sat and days before holidays 10:30–21:30; founded 1974; no reservations; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; no smoking; 20 seats (eat-in space); takeaway; children welcome; official site. October 2026 reviews: small, 10 to a serving; a dashi-rich, fluffy, molten batter; big pieces of octopus; sauce-mayo ¥600; leek sauce ¥700; leek and ponzu; shoyu mayo; aonori and katsuobushi; can be eaten upstairs; fun to eat in Triangle Park; one heard it was the first shop to put mayonnaise on takoyaki; one was recommended it by a local; about 9 shops.

食べログ: 大阪家、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-東5-18 わんわんビル1F、予約不可.en: Tabelog: Osakaya, Wanwan Bldg 1F, 5-18 Dotonbori 1-chome Higashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; no reservations; daily 10:00–24:00; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking; counter seats; opened 19 April 2026. October 2026 reviews: 7 people waiting at 13:30 on a Saturday; choose noodle firmness, strength and amount of oil (regular, regular, more); glad that good iekei is spreading in Kansai; one says it is a direct line of the famous Tokyo shop Daikiya; tsukemen (large) ¥1,150 (hot or cold noodles; mildly spicy pork-and-chicken shoyu dipping soup, smoked chashu, seasoned egg, menma, spinach, nori); smoked chashu-men with rice ¥1,300; unlimited garlic; unlimited rice for ¥100 (self-serve rice bar with spicy 'Ura Kappa' sauce, garlic, mayonnaise); one found it salty; queues of 10–20; rich tonkotsu with sharp shoyu; the spicy ramen is very salty.

食べログ: 大阪焼肉 ヒロミヤ、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町6-25 日宝富士センター.en: Tabelog: Osaka Yakiniku Hiromiya, Nippo Fuji Center Bldg, 6-25 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from the Namba stations; Mon–Sat and holidays 18:00–2:00 next morning; closed Sundays (negotiable) and irregular days; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 5 seats (6 standing); smoking allowed; English menu. Reviews (March 2019 – July 2026): 5 counter seats in a narrow alley; a new owner from April 2025; fresh senmai; salted tongue, premium loin, skirt, tetchan; yakiniku you can drop into alone is rare in Higashi-Shinsaibashi; premium loin, belly and cheek; booking recommended; half portions of salted tongue, cheek, premium loin and kalbi; the meat quality has gone up; off-menu ajillo, grilled rice balls and miso pasta; liver; kalbi; fried rice and reimen to finish; a 6th person fits but it's very close; casual.

食べログ: 大阪焼肉 松屋 新大阪店、焼肉・ホルモン、大阪市淀川区西中島5-16.en: Tabelog: Osaka Yakiniku Matsuya Shin-Osaka Ten, yakiniku and horumon, Alde Shin-Osaka, JR Central Shin-Osaka Station 2F, 5-16-1 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; right by Shin-Osaka Station; daily 10:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); lunch 10:00–17:00; no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 36 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome; takeout; opened 10 January 2020. Shop site (Matsuya Group): this Shin-Osaka Station shop is the only Osaka Yakiniku Matsuya; cooking on a stone plate makes the meat fragrant and tender; yakiniku bento too; 32 seats. Reviews (September–October 2026): no grill at the table, the meat comes sizzling on a stone or iron plate; said to be the shop that spread the name "harami"; Original Harami thick and tender in a sweet, light sauce over onion, carrot, okra and corn, with doubanjiang; Original Harami lunch 140 g ¥1,628; harami and Shin-Osaka Horumon lunch ¥1,280 plus tax; "Man's" lunch with 1.5 times the meat; free rice refills; horumon 150 g; salted tongue 80 g with grated daikon; harami 180 g.

食べログ: 大阪王将 心斎橋 アメリカ村店、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-8-18、0.en: Tabelog: Osaka Ohsho Shinsaibashi America-mura, 1-8-18 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6281-1539; reservations accepted; Mon–Thu and Sun 9:00–0:30 next morning, Fri–Sat 9:00–1:30 next morning; no cards or e-money; QR (PayPay) accepted; 30 seats; operated by hirofoodservice.com. 2026 reviews (May–October): reimen and fried rice after exercise; the sweet-and-sour pork set meal is ordinary, should have had gyoza; talk of the old relationship with the other Ohsho of the same name; the ramen is strongly flavoured; tianjin fried rice with sauce; a wide menu; large portions; 5 groups even at 10 p.m.; glass-fronted, bright inside; TOKYO juicy fried rice and gyoza; many overseas tourists; beer set and shrimp in chili sauce.

食べログ: 大阪王将 道頓堀本店、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-6-13、なんば駅から2.en: Tabelog: Osaka Ohsho Dotonbori main shop, 1-6-13 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 243 m from Namba Station; 189 seats; daily 11:00–22:30; no reservations; takeaway available; children welcome; opened 7 December 2012; official site osaka-ohsho.com. 2026 reviews: twice-cooked pork set meal with gyoza ¥1,320; seats on the 2nd floor; ordering and paying by touch panel; quick service; lots of chashu in the gyoza set's fried rice; gyoza, mapo tofu, pepper beef; the back seats on the 2nd floor look over the Dotonbori River; the new shredded-pork (rousu) fried rice gyoza set ¥1,200; went in without knowing it was the main shop; gyoza set meal and karaage; juicy gyoza good even without dipping sauce; hiyashi chuka; one was disappointed by the service at the main shop; one said ¥700 gyoza is expensive.

食べログ: 大阪鉄板焼き 神戸牛ステーキ Zin 難波店、大阪市中央区道頓堀2-.en: Tabelog: Osaka Teppanyaki Kobe Beef Steak Zin Namba, Fruit Tower Bldg 8F, 2-1-1 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from subway Namba Station exit 25; daily 12:00–15:00 (L.O. food 14:00, drinks 14:30) and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. food 22:00, drinks 22:30); reservations accepted (children in the evening go to a private room); 5% New Year rate 15 Dec – 4 Jan; cards, QUICPay, PayPay and Alipay accepted; 14 seats (semi-private available); no smoking; English menu and English-speaking staff; teppanyaki of Kobe, Matsusaka and wagyu beef; a counter with a night view. Reviews (April–September 2026): a head chef trained in hotels; some dishes at over 40% food cost; poêléed sea bass and fried horse mackerel; chefs from the St. Regis Osaka and the Ritz; Anniversary OMAKASE course ¥16,000 (Kuroge wagyu fillet, a sparkling toast); seared wagyu sushi; Kuroge wagyu at 58 °C with summer vegetables; teppan-fried Nagasaki maru-aji with pickle tartare; wagyu boiled gyoza; Kuroge wagyu skirt; sea bass with shiso Genovese; ginger granita; a rice blend from Gihei (8th generation); red miso soup; a 13-dish course with Kuroge wagyu, Matsusaka or Kobe beef; Dotonbori's night view; 8th floor above Yoshinoya; 14-dish Kuroge wagyu sirloin OMAKASE ¥12,000 with 5-glass wine pairing ¥4,400; full of overseas diners; one found it a little salty; garlic rice; kind staff.

食べログ: 大阪鶏白湯 らぁ麺 みやこ なんば本店(正式名は大阪鶏白湯らぁ麺 み.en: Tabelog: Osaka Tori Paitan Raa-men Miyako Namba main shop (official name given as Osaka Tori Paitan Raa-men Miyako Namba Honten), Edion Namba main store 9F, 3-2-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6606-9385; no reservations; daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; POPUP Ramen may carry a service charge; 39 seats; children's menu, pushchairs welcome. 2026 reviews (June–October): Miyako raa-men ¥930 (light tori-paitan shoyu with back fat and pepper, thin wavy noodles); seasoned egg ¥150; seared chashu mayo rice bowl set ¥430; spicy miso raa-men ¥970 with mini fried rice set ¥400 (stir in the garlicky spicy miso to change the flavour); tori-paitan salt raa-men (citrus like yuzu, surprisingly rich); meat special (3 kinds of house-made chashu); rich; special karaage set meal +¥550; one says it recalls Tenkaippin; in summer cold tantanmen and hiyashi chuka ¥1,100 (shoyu or sesame dressing); busy 15 minutes after opening; counter and tables.

食べログ: 大阪麦風 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-14-24、06-624.en: Tabelog: Osaka Mugifu Shinsaibashi, 1-14-24 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6245-7628; no reservations; daily 11:30–6:00 next morning; no cards; 17 seats (counter 12, terrace 5); no smoking; opened 19 May 2008. 2026 reviews (August–October): a junky last stop after drinking; abura soba with garlic, minced meat and leek; no ticket machine, order and pay on leaving; a tonkotsu-shoyu specialist; black tonkotsu shoyu (black mayu) ¥1,000; everything-on ¥1,590; noodle refill ¥220; no porky smell; a street-stall atmosphere; back-fat ramen; thin straight noodles, firm; the black tonkotsu is rich but not heavy; two spoons of garlic for a strong, punchy flavour; atmosphere and menu aimed at overseas diners; a famous shop known for over 15 years; counter only; everything-on (chashu, boiled egg, leek, nori).

食べログ: 大養軒、中華料理・オムライス・餃子、大阪市淀川区東三国4-12-3、.en: Tabelog: Daiyou Ken, Chinese, omurice and gyoza, 4-12-3 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; about 7 min from Higashi-Mikuni Station; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 16:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Wednesday; no reservations; cash only; 22 seats (5 at the counter, four tables for 4); non-smoking; children welcome; takeout; coin parking next door. Reviews (April–October 2026): a local Chinese diner; about half the customers order omurice; wok-fried ketchup chicken rice with pork in a thin omelette, with egg soup ¥780, large ¥180 extra; large ¥960; omurice with half ramen (light, salty chicken broth) ¥1,120; eight gyoza a plate; big meatballs in sweet-and-sour sauce; kara-age set; liver and garlic chives; cold noodles, champon, katsudon, miso ramen, yakiniku bento; kaiware salad, macaroni salad with raisins, three pickles and soup; draft beer, gyoza and omurice for ¥1,800; a short line at noon; one diner found the shop and the Japanese-style toilet old.

食べログ: 天ぷら やぐち、天ぷら、天ぷら百名店2025、日本橋人形町2-9-7.en: Tabelog: Tempura Yaguchi, tempura; Tabelog Tempura 100 2025; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-9-7, Oedo Access 2 1F; 5 min walk from Ningyocho Station exit A3 or Suitengumae Station exit 7; Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–21:00; closed Thursday; omakase at lunch and dinner; reservations by phone only; cards accepted; no service charge; 8 counter seats; non-smoking; from junior-high age; opened 1 July 2020; the lunch tendon has ended. Reviews (May 2025–August 2026): the owner trained about 22 years under Tetsuya Saotome at Mikawa Zezankyo; the shop name is Yaguchi but reviews also give Taniguchi; one says it has a Michelin star; an omakase of about 17–20 pieces; shrimp, sumi-ika, aori-ika, red eggplant, clams, sea urchin wrapped in shiso, anago, kakiage tendon; the chef's personality and conversation; some found pieces over-fried or the beer lukewarm.

食べログ: 天ぷら 天月、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-7-11 日宝ロイヤルビル1F.en: Tabelog: Tempura Amatsuki, Nippo Royal Bldg 1F, 2-7-11 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba Station exit 14 and Shinsaibashi Station exit 5; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 18:00–23:00 (tempura L.O. 22:00); closed Wednesdays; reservations accepted; table-charge starter ¥550 (sashimi platter); cards accepted, no e-money; 14 seats (counter 8, one table for 6); opened 22 January 2020; tempura from ¥275; plenty of local sake. Reviews (November 2025 – September 2026): sashimi; thick pumpkin; head-on shrimp; a friendly owner; no heaviness the next day; a long narrow 'eel's bed' of a shop; party seats at the back; Chinese yam with plum paste; ayu, shrimp, anago; not oily; well-timed service; maitake; shiitake; tendon with egg to finish; wine.

食べログ: 天ぷら 心斎橋 一哲、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-5-3 宝栄ビル 1F.en: Tabelog: Tempura Shinsaibashi Ittetsu, Hoei Bldg 1F, 1-5-3 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Midosuji Line Shinsaibashi Station exit 6; Wed–Thu 17:30–22:00, Fri–Sun and holidays 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–22:00; closed Mondays and Tuesdays (the next day if a holiday); 10% service charge; same-day cancellation fee; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 12 seats (counter 8, tables 4); opened 20 November 2018. Reviews (August–October 2026): a sister shop; lunch course ¥10,000; shrimp; kakigori for dessert; the second shop of Tempura Osakaya Kusatetsu in Fukushima; lunch course ¥7,700 (with one drink); the day's ingredients shown first; 3 salts and tentsuyu, with a recommendation for each; starts with 2 shrimp; 4 choices to finish, such as tendon or curry; kakigori and dandelion coffee; live Nagasaki shrimp; A5 Kuroge wagyu fillet; sea urchin from Nemuro and elsewhere; young ayu; house activated water; shrimp heads; kakigori of house ice frozen over 2 days; matsutake as tempura or dobin-mushi; scallop and ginkgo; freshly cooked rice with ikura; Beni Haruka sweet potato; careful explanations; a birthday dessert.

食べログ: 天ぷら 悦、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-7-22、心斎橋駅・長堀橋駅から.en: Tabelog: Tempura Etsu, 1-7-22 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Nagahoribashi stations; Mon–Sat 17:00–22:00; closed Sundays and holidays (sometimes open with advance booking); occasional irregular closures; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; no smoking; 7 seats; BYO allowed. Reviews (November 2025 – August 2026): east of Minami Primary School; counter only; booking essential; dinner course ¥12,100 (incl. tax); starts with sashimi (steamed abalone with liver sauce, snow-crab sashimi, picked crab); a female crab packed into its shell and fried whole; shrimp tempura in a light batter; seasonal vegetables; a fresh salad partway through; tendon or tempura chazuke to finish; rare sake and wine; the owner's character; summer limited lunch tempura gozen ¥1,650 (¥1,980 with shrimp) with ayu sashimi and grated yam.

食べログ: 天ぷら 銀座おのでら 東銀座店、銀座5-14-14 サンリット銀座ビ.en: Tabelog: TEMPURA GINZA ONODERA Higashi-Ginza, Ginza 5-14-14, Sunlit Ginza Building III 4F; 13 seats; weekdays 12:00–15:00 (last entry 13:00), 18:00–22:00, weekends and holidays 11:30–15:00, 18:00–22:00; 10% service charge; opened February 1, 2019; official site onodera-group.com. Shop introduction: 100% taihaku sesame oil; ingredients from all over Japan chosen by the head chef; the sommelier's Champagne. 2026 reviews: samples of uni and beef tongue; accommodating to foreign customers; finish with tendon; the Botan course (chawanmushi in shrimp dashi, sweet potato); chilled snow-crab chawanmushi; choose four seasonal vegetables; live shrimp and conger eel; uni tempura wrapped in shiso; bonito sashimi; fruit-tomato jelly; wagyu steak; attentive service.

食べログ: 天ぷら 阿部 銀座本店、銀座4-3-7 スバルビルB1F、2009年.en: Tabelog: Tempura Abe Ginza main shop, Ginza 4-3-7 Subaru Building B1F, opened April 10, 2009; 17 seats (13 counter, 4 table); weekdays 11:30–14:00, 17:00–21:00, weekends and holidays 11:30–15:00, 17:00–21:00; closed only on New Year's Eve and New Year's Day; ¥1,100 otoshi at night; shop description "a tempura craftsman with 30 years' experience at Nadaman"; weekday-only kakiage rice bowl. 2026 reviews: Michelin Bib Gourmand, Tempura Top 100, tempura set ¥3,300, shrimp tendon ¥1,000–1,500, ¥8,000 course at night.

食べログ: 天ぷら･うどん･とんかつ かえで、大阪市西区新町2-16-2 阪田ビ.en: Tabelog: Tempura Udon Tonkatsu Kaede, Sakata Bldg 1F, 2-16-2 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station; Mon–Thu 11:00–15:00, Fri–Sat 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed Sundays; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; heated tobacco only inside; 19 seats (counter 4, tables 11, semi-private 4). Reviews (August–October 2026): opened 18 August 2026; a clean modern Japanese shop; busy with office workers at lunch; Kaede Irodori Mamezara Gozen from ¥1,500 (kake or zaru) to ¥1,800 (curry udon and others); udon from 7 (kake, zaru, kamatama, meat, sudachi, curry, kamaage); tempura, 2 each of 3 kinds (shrimp, squid, chikuwa, chicken, corn, kakiage, aji fry and others); daily small dishes; cold tofu; pickles; à la carte udon; cheap tempura (squid legs, maitake); rice balls; beer; one was squeezed onto a small table.

食べログ: 天下一品 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区南船場3-11-2、心斎橋から183.en: Tabelog: Tenkaippin Shinsaibashi, 3-11-2 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 183 m from Shinsaibashi; daily 11:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); cards and QR accepted, no e-money; 14 counter seats and 18 table seats; no smoking; opened 23 August 2026. October 2026 reviews: kotteri with thick noodles and free extra leek; Butayama under renovation, so Tenkaippin instead; piping-hot noodles; a new shop on the Shinsaibashi shopping street; add spicy miso; seasoned-egg ramen (kotteri MAX) with half fried rice and gyoza set meal; one says MAX is sludgy and regular would have been better; clean and tidy; tablet ordering; kotteri regular ¥920 and kimchi fried rice set ¥460; firm noodles; chicken-bone and vegetable shoyu; slightly salty; kotteri, kotteri MAX, assari, yatai flavour, miso, salt; pepper, salt, spicy miso, chili oil, ramen sauce and gyoza sauce on the table; Tenkaippin Festival 2026; large size with a free voucher.

食べログ: 天吉、港区六本木7-13-2 アーバンビル2F、大江戸線六本木駅から.en: Tabelog: Ten Kichi, Roppongi 7-13-2, アーバンビル 2F, 3 min walk from Roppongi Station (Oedo line), 6 min (Hibiya line); Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Saturdays and Sundays; subject to change; no cards, e-money or QR; 18 seats (counter 6, three tables seating 12); smoking allowed. Reviews (October 2025–October 2026): lunch set meals ¥1,000 with rice, miso soup, natto, nori and pickles; mixed fry (shrimp, cutlet, ham cutlet); tonkatsu; pork sauté; salted mackerel; katsudon set ¥1,200; big portions; cash only; run by an elderly couple (the wife cooks, the husband serves); service takes time.

食べログ: 天地人 千日前店、大阪市中央区千日前1-6-14、カウンター10席、.en: Tabelog: Tenchijin Sennichimae, 1-6-14 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 10 counter seats; daily 11:30–4:00 next morning; no reservations; no cards or e-money; QR payment accepted; no smoking; opened 6 August 2016; official fukuchan.co.jp/tenchijin. 2025–2026 reviews: late-night ramen; one person deftly making 4 bowls; a wide range; spicy miso; not heavy; black mayu (burnt garlic oil) on white tonkotsu; seasoned-egg ramen; pork rice bowl; abura soba (3 big slices of chashu, chopped leek, toasted nori, chili oil and vinegar); listed as opening 11:30 but was open at 11; a soup kind to a hangover; inbound tourists over Golden Week; Motoaji is a standard tonkotsu; niku soba ¥880 (light, thin straight noodles, pork, dried leek, onion, grated daikon); cashless at the ticket machine out front; overseas staff.

食べログ: 天地人らーめん 2号店、大阪市浪速区難波中1-18-12、なんば駅か.en: Tabelog: Tenchijin Ramen No. 2, 1-18-12 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 116 m from Namba Station; hours listed only as '11:00–'; no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 16 seats (counter only); no smoking; opened 22 March 2019. Reviews (November 2023 – October 2026): right beside Nankai Namba Station; seasoned-egg ramen just under ¥1,000; creamy yet surprisingly light tonkotsu; lots of crisp leek; lunchtime tsukemen with free large size and yuzu-kosho; tonkotsu shoyu with top-class value; pork rice bowl (the pork starts frying when you buy the ticket); eel rice bowl too; touch-panel ticket machine at the entrance; original-taste ramen and pork rice bowl set ¥1,280; asked noodle firmness; a little light but with tonkotsu umami and dashi depth; red pickled ginger on the table; abura soba ¥1,000 from the machine (3 slices chashu, slivered white onion, sesame, chili oil and vinegar); the spicy meat maze-soba sold out; mostly tonkotsu-based ramen; medium-thick noodles; one found it a little salty.

食べログ: 天蓬八戒、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-14-24、06-6732-839.en: Tabelog: Tianpeng Bajie, 1-14-24 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6732-8392; no reservations; Mon–Fri 12:00–1:20 next morning, Sat–Sun 11:00–1:20 next morning; no cards, e-money or QR; 20 seats (counter 10, two tables for 5); no smoking; opened 15 December 2025. 2026 reviews (January–July): a Taiwanese pork-chop noodle (paigu mian) specialist; mixed noodles too; paigu noodles and lu rou fan; nori and menma make it lean Japanese; ¥1,280 seemed pricey but the pork chops are big, 6 pieces; deluxe paigu noodles ¥1,500; Ximending-style paigu; lighter than it looks; one says the shoyu ramen falls flat without the chili oil, garlic and vinegar on the table; first Japanese branch of a popular Taipei shop; all staff Taiwanese; crispy paigu noodles (creamy, rich soup; medium-thick flat noodles; crisp outside, tender inside); gan ban mian (soupless, gets more addictive the more you mix); black vinegar and chili oil on the table; crispy backbone noodles ¥1,500 (shrimp and daikon broth, mildly spicy, medium-thin straight noodles, 3 pork chops, seasoned egg, menma, leek, daikon, bean sprouts).

食べログ: 太田鮨、寿司、日本橋人形町1-5-2、人形町駅から徒歩3分、月18:.en: Tabelog: Ota Zushi, sushi, Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 1-5-2, 3 min walk from Ningyocho Station; Mon 18:00–22:00, Tue–Fri 11:00–about 13:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Sat, Sun and holidays; dinner by reservation only; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); 9 seats; tatami area; private hire up to 20; non-smoking. Reviews (July–October 2026): established 1955; the building dates from 1927 and escaped the air raids; second generation; three staff — the owner, the owner's son and the owner's sister; lunch is served in rounds; rice size chosen from five levels; no chopsticks, eaten by hand; lunch for one ¥4,600 (raised from ¥4,000 in April 2026), 1.5 servings ¥6,900; a second layer of tuna under the tuna; ikura gunkan, scallop with sweet sauce, tamagoyaki; the roll chosen from tekka, kappa, ume-shiso or kanpyo; queues before opening; lunch cash only; some found it too big to eat easily.

食べログ: 太鼓寿し、寿司・海鮮・居酒屋、大阪市淀川区西中島4-7-10 ローズ.en: Tabelog: Taiko Zushi, sushi, seafood and izakaya, 4-7-10 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, ローズコーポ 1F; 5 min west of Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station and Hankyu Minamikata Station; Mon–Sat 17:00–24:00, closed Sun and holidays; closed for Obon (13–17 August) and New Year (30 December–4 January); reservations accepted; cash only; 20 seats (two tables at the back); all seats non-smoking from April 2025. Reviews (July 2024 to September 2026): prices per piece (September 2025: egg ¥82, seared horse mackerel and yellowtail ¥110, conger eel ¥165, shrimp, tuna and mackerel ¥220, flounder fin, red clam and salmon roe ¥275, eel ¥330, sea urchin ¥385); prices rose a little; mackerel, sweet shrimp and sprouted green onion are good; fatty tuna with takuan roll; yamagobo roll; grilled turban shell; butter-grilled scallop and asparagus; tempura; shrimp tempura; chawanmushi; firefly squid; grilled fish; sake; shochu; the chef, the chef's brother and the staff are friendly; a tatami room at the back; about ¥5,000 a head; full in the evening; some say smoking was still possible in 2026.

食べログ: 好、大阪市中央区材木町2-10、松屋町駅から約5分、月〜土 11:0.en: Tabelog: Hao, 2-10 Zaimokucho, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 5 min from Matsuyamachi Station; Mon–Sat 11:00–21:00; closed Sundays; cash only; 8 seats. Reviews (August–October 2026): an old-style ramen shop under a new owner; busy even after lunchtime; chashu-men ¥1,200–1,300 (about 5 thick, tender slices of chashu; salt, shoyu or miso); miso ramen with plenty of vegetables; Harapeko Kizuna-men ¥1,100 (mixed noodles with chopped chashu and leek, with ginger soup; mix from the bottom, add vinegar and chili oil); stamina ramen; summer-only leek and chashu hiyashi chuka ¥1,000 (mayonnaise can be left off); special gyoza ¥400; small rice with kimchi; chashu rice bowl; chashu to take away; garlic, spicy miso, vinegar and chili oil on the table; thin soft noodles; one found the soup lukewarm.

食べログ: 好呷、大阪市中央区島之内2-6-33、月〜金 11:30〜14:30.en: Tabelog: Ho ja, 2-6-33 Shimanouchi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:30 and 17:30–21:30, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–21:30; open every day of the year; no cards; e-money and PayPay accepted; 10 seats; smoking allowed. Reviews (September 2022 – October 2026): on the edge of Shimanouchi on Suomachi-dori; decor like a Taiwanese primary-school canteen; aluminium lunch boxes; a menu like a notebook; a big ji pai of flattened chicken breast (salt-pepper or sweet special sauce); bento of rice (large free) with cabbage, bean sprouts, atsuage and boiled egg; lu rou fan; steamed chicken and lu rou bento ¥1,230; fried squid; Taiwanese kara-age on long skewers; thigh kara-age set; radish cake; fried king oyster mushrooms; salt-pepper broccoli ¥400; Taiwanese-style yakitori; tapioca milk tea; Taiwanese apple soda ¥390; Dong Ding oolong ¥380; order by QR at the table; takeaway and delivery too; cute table mats; one says the name means 'delicious' in Taiwanese.

食べログ: 好麺 たまらん、大阪市大正区三軒家西1-4-20、大正から233m、.en: Tabelog: Konomen Tamaran, 1-4-20 Sangenya-nishi, Taisho-ku, Osaka; 233 m from Taisho; Tue–Sun 11:30–14:00 and 18:30–23:00; closed Mondays; no cards; 9 seats; opened 16 June 2015. Reviews (April 2024 – October 2026): firm noodles; extra garlic and vegetables; garlic a bit weak; ordinary chashu; Jiro style; spicy miso; crisp vegetables; a little greasy towards the end; extra vegetables available; large free; ramen ¥990; extra vegetables free; light yet good; a kind owner; Taiwan maze-soba; everything-on; night Jiro; garlic a must; restrained Jiro character; courteous staff; from around ¥900; toppings free up to a point; a light, gentle soup for Jiro style; the sign says large vegetables free but the ticket machine has extra vegetables at ¥120; one says it opened at 12:00 though 11:30 was listed; a mountain of back fat; vegetables boiled for just seconds; thick, easy noodles; about 6 counter seats.

食べログ: 媛 故郷味の旅、居酒屋・郷土料理・唐揚げ、大阪市淀川区西中島4-8-.en: Tabelog: Hime Kokyo Aji no Tabi; izakaya, regional cuisine, kara-age; メゾンリーフ 1F, 西中島4-8-15, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 5 minutes on foot from Hankyu Minamikata or Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; Mon–Thu, Sat and days after holidays 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00, Fridays and days before holidays to 24:00; closed Sunday and holidays; reservations accepted; appetiser ¥495 (included in course bookings); cards, e-money and PayPay; 70 seats; non-smoking; Wi-Fi. Reviews (2025 to October 2026): three shops near Nishinakajima (this one, Hime Imabari Yakitori no Tabi, Hime 3), this the first; Ehime regional food; senzanki (Imabari fried chicken) in big thigh pieces; ponzu, sesame sauce, sesame salt; white and spicy red; 15 pieces ¥1,309; Nanyo tai-meshi set ¥990; small senzanki set ¥950; Hime bento ¥750; chashu and egg rice bowl; jakoten; simmered sea bream; sea bream chazuke; fried horse mackerel; cabbage with lemon and anchovy; highballs and chu-hi ¥299 when you order senzanki; all-you-can-drink without a course; chestnut shochu; Pon juice; free refills of rice and miso soup; many regulars.

食べログ: 季節料理 いちい、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-7-10(法善寺横丁)、05.en: Tabelog: Kisetsu Ryori Ichii, 1-7-10 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka (Hozenji Yokocho), 050-5872-4561; reservations accepted; daily 17:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); irregular closing days; counter only, preschool children please refrain; cards accepted, no e-money; 10 seats; booking site yoyaku-ichii.com. 2026 reviews (September–October): full before 19:00; an omakase course of 10 dishes; hamaguri oden and Tajima chicken oden; depth of dashi; the owner runs it single-handed; whale and sardines; online booking; an oden and sake shop; good for the price; sake by omakase too; one person working, so it takes a little time; a friendly owner; omakase ¥6,000; a quiet counter; cooked in front of you; 10-dish course ¥6,000; the umami of traditional dashi; a wide sake selection.

食べログ: 宇治園 喫茶去 心斎橋店、甘味処・カフェ・喫茶店、大阪市中央区心斎橋.en: Tabelog: Ujien Kissako Shinsaibashi, Japanese sweets café, café and kissa, Shinsaibashi-suji 1-4-20 1F/2F, Chuo-ku, Osaka; right by Shinsaibashi Station exit 6, opposite the Daimaru main building; 2nd-floor café daily 11:00–19:45 (L.O. 19:00); 1st-floor tea shop and health-tea shop 10:30–21:00; open year-round; no seat-only reservations (only afternoon tea and the matcha experience can be booked); cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 45 seats; non-smoking; staff speak English, Chinese and Korean; allergy information available; official site uji-en.co.jp. Japanese tea and matcha sweets from a long-established tea shop, freshly piped Mont Blanc, Uji matcha experience with wagashi ¥1,320. Reviews (July 2025–October 2026): chestnut and matcha Mont Blanc ¥1,320, Mont Blanc and imo-anmitsu set ¥1,540, hojicha parfait, matcha mini parfait, Uji milk kintoki ¥1,320, matcha ice-cream waffle, takeaway hojicha ice Mont Blanc ¥900, matcha soft serve, warm hojicha instead of water, about a 30-minute wait at weekends, many foreign guests, some say prices went up or the sweets are too sweet.

食べログ: 安徽牛肉板面、大阪市中央区島之内2-10-9、営業時間の記載なし、カ.en: Tabelog: Anhui Beef Banmian, 2-10-9 Shimanouchi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; no opening hours listed; no cards or e-money; QR accepted. Reviews (October 2024 – October 2026): opens 10:00 and stays open all day (October 2024); full at lunch, tables shared; sausage topping; 90% of diners Chinese and the menu in Chinese; staff explain how to order; cheap small dishes; medium heat is restrained; liangpi (garlicky, flat soft noodles); the signature beef banmian (red chilies but not hot; a light beef-bone soup like dashi); beef lamian ¥880; noodles thin, medium or thick; heat adjustable too.

食べログ: 宝来、中華料理・ラーメン、若葉2-5、四谷三丁目駅から徒歩7分、四ツ.en: Tabelog: Horai, Chinese, ramen; Wakaba 2-5; 7 min walk from Yotsuya-sanchome Station, 10 min from Yotsuya Station; Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 11:00–13:30; closed Wed, Sat, Sun and holidays; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 seats (counter); non-smoking. Reviews (February–September 2026): family-run, near Suga Shrine, a U-shaped counter, 'special' bowls with back fat, special wonton noodles ¥950, special chashu wonton noodles ¥1,150, takana wonton, miso chashu, large +¥50, jumbo shumai ¥100 each, wonton soup ¥200, five-ingredient fried rice ¥850, a line of 3–5 at noon, order by voice.

食べログ: 宝楽、中華料理、大阪市淀川区東三国5-6-2、Midosuji Li.en: Tabelog: Houraku; Chinese; 5-6-2 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 2 minutes on foot from the north exit of Higashi-Mikuni Station on the Midosuji Line; Mon–Fri and Sun 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–21:30, Sat 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–21:30; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money or QR payment; 2 seats; smoking allowed; Demae-can. Reviews (2017 to October 2026): daily lunch ¥750–850 (a main such as pork kimchi or stir-fried meat and peppers, with kara-age, shumai, a meatball, salad, soup and free rice refills); Men's set ¥1,030–1,200 (pork with garlic chives, roast pork, kara-age, spring rolls, shumai, kimchi); sweet and sour pork set ¥1,300; Horoyoi Set (a drink, kara-age, shumai, roast pork and kimchi plus one dish from shrimp chili, liver with garlic chives, sweet and sour pork, mapo tofu and more); fried rice and ramen set; gyoza full of vegetables; shrimp chili bento; bento sold at the front; mostly delivery; Uber Eats; 4–5 staff; a Showa-era neighbourhood Chinese feel; fast service; smoking allowed inside; cash only.

食べログ: 宮崎麺屋 からから 東心斎橋店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-7-8、06.en: Tabelog: Miyazaki Menya Karakara Higashi-Shinsaibashi, 2-7-8 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6484-6132; 23 seats; open 24 hours, closed only over New Year; no reservations; no cards or e-money; QR payment accepted; no smoking; opened 22 May 2011.
