Shop introduction: within 10 min walk of Shinsaibashi and Namba stations; for spice lovers the signature 'karamen', for the mild-minded 'miso ramen'. 2026 reviews (September–October): heat levels 30, 50, 100; konnyaku noodles; fluffy egg in a bright red bowl; nira; minced meat; umami, not just heat; Hokkaido Hyakunen miso ramen; ground and 2nd floors; cool inside; tender pork topping; the omurice is popular; Soemoncho at 2 a.m.; a little rough outside.

食べログ: 家系らーめん 斗星家、大阪市浪速区恵美須東1-7-4、恵美須町駅から.en: Tabelog: Iekei Ramen Toboshiya, 1-7-4 Ebisu-higashi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 312 m from Ebisucho Station; Tue and Thu–Sun 12:00–15:00 and 16:00–20:00; closed Mondays and Wednesdays; irregular closing days (check Instagram); opened 4 August 2023; no cards, e-money or QR. Reviews (September–October 2026): near Tsutenkaku; sometimes a queue; ticket machine; ramen regular ¥900; choose noodle firmness, strength and oil; house-made short medium-thick noodles (slightly thin for iekei); big chashu; extra nori +¥200; seasoned egg +¥130; unlimited rice for ¥200; Ura Kappa cucumber pickles free; Jiro style too; about 10 counter seats; three friendly staff; one found it salty, another not too salty.

食べログ: 家系ラーメン 船場家、大阪市天王寺区味原町4-8、鶴橋から398m、.en: Tabelog: Iekei Ramen Senba Ya, 4-8 Ajiharacho, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 398 m from Tsuruhashi; daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); cards, e-money and QR accepted; 8 counter seats; opened 31 May 2025. Reviews (August–October 2026): a soup of pork bones and chicken bones; a mild shoyu; short medium-thick noodles from Inoue Seimen; smoked oven-roasted pork-leg chashu and chopped chashu; komatsuna; leek; nori; pork-belly chashu only on 24–25 October; chashu ramen ¥1,100; Jo Ramen ¥1,000 (adds one slice of chashu, 2 sheets of nori and half a seasoned egg); at lunch 100 g or 150 g of rice free, no refills; switch to spinach ¥50; chopped onion ¥100; rice 200 g ¥100; doubanjiang, garlic, ginger, vinegar, sesame, ramen pepper, pickled cucumber and furikake on the table; choose noodle firmness, strength and oil; cheerful, courteous service; a send-off; queues at weekends; a creamy rich soup; one likens it to Rokukaku-ya; one says maybe the best iekei in Osaka; one says on a second visit the soup was thin and the chashu dry; ticket machine.

食べログ: 家系ラーメン 那須家、大阪市中央区日本橋2-3-18、近鉄日本橋駅9.en: Tabelog: Iekei Ramen Nasuya, 2-3-18 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 3 min walk from Kintetsu Nippombashi Station exit 9; Mon 10:45–15:00 and 18:00–21:30, Tue–Sun 10:45–15:00 and 18:00–22:30 (L.O. 10 minutes before); open every day of the year; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking; counter seats. Reviews (August–October 2026): one says the owner trained at Men Master Takenaka in Tokyo; noodles from Suzuki Seimen; house-made soup; firm noodles with a strong wheat flavour; a gentle soup with restrained shoyu and salt; opened in summer 2026 by an owner trained in the Kanto region; ticket machine; ramen regular ¥900, seasoned egg ¥150, small rice ¥100; fair prices in a market with tourist pricing; a dark soup; a little fat and bitterness; firm saltiness; 2 slices chashu, moist with a seared aroma; short, chewy medium-thick noodles; spinach; large ¥1,100, chashu ¥400, spinach ¥200; firm, strong, extra chicken fat; an energetic owner; one says rice at ¥200 is pricey; wrap rice in nori; a quiet part of Kuromon Market; a clean shop; surprisingly light with the salt kept down.

食べログ: 家系ラーメン 頂㐂家 阪急三国店、ラーメン・つけ麺・担々麺、大阪市淀.en: Tabelog: Iekei Ramen Itadakiya Hankyu Mikuni Ten, ramen, tsukemen and tantanmen, 3-29-12 Mikunihonmachi, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 89 m from Mikuni Station; daily 11:00–23:00; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; non-smoking; opened 29 March 2024. Reviews (March to October 2026): right in front of Hankyu Mikuni Station; about 31 seats (7 at the counter, six tables for 4); meal tickets; cash only; soy or salt; thick or thin noodles; short, thick, curly noodles; order firm, rich or extra oil; plenty of salt, depth and oil; deluxe ramen (extra seasoned egg, two slices of chashu, two sheets of nori) ¥1,150; negi ramen ¥1,000; tantanmen; free rice; ginger, garlic, pepper and doubanjiang on the counter; menma ¥150; bottled beer ¥600; a beer set with gyoza (bean sprouts and kara-age); energetic staff; one diner calls it an ordinary chain shop; coin parking to the north.

食べログ: 家系ラーメン 頂喜家 長堀橋店、大阪市中央区島之内1-19-15、長.en: Tabelog: Iekei Ramen Itadakiya Nagahoribashi, 1-19-15 Shimanouchi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 20 m from Nagahoribashi Station; daily 11:00–22:30; no cards or e-money; QR accepted (PayPay, d-barai, Rakuten Pay); no smoking; opened 4 September 2020. Reviews (February–October 2026): Jiro style at an iekei shop; a mountain of bean sprouts and garlic; piping-hot noodles; so much that soup was left; iekei Jiro ¥1,150 and soft-boiled egg ¥150; firm, strong; chicken fat not adjustable; chopped garlic; diced back fat; thick wavy noodles; on the salty side; creamy iekei; leek ramen ¥1,000; large rice ¥250; can be made lighter; thick noodles; rich tonkotsu shoyu; big chashu; spinach and nori; a steady stream of diners at night; plenty of table condiments; kind staff.

食べログ: 富喜製麺研究所 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-8-29、火〜日2.en: Tabelog: Fuki Seimen Kenkyujo Shinsaibashi, 2-8-29 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Tue–Sun 21:00–6:00 next morning; closed Mondays; smoking allowed; cards and QR payment accepted; opened 27 June 2025; official fuuki-noodle-lab.jp (ramen, tsukemen and maze-soba in Kumamoto, Tokyo and Osaka). 2026 reviews (May–July): bonito-kombu-water tsukemen ¥1,100, large +¥150; mobile ordering; flat whole-wheat noodles sitting in kombu water; a sweetish dipping soup strong in bonito shoyu; sudachi; listed as closed Sundays (July); 3 a.m.; the Guilty Jiro is popular; chuka soba; chewy noodles; run directly by a long-established Kumamoto noodle maker; the first Osaka shop, in Fukai, closed 24 May 2026; rice dishes and sides too; Summer Ramen 2026.

食べログ: 寺cafe & Live 茶庭、大阪市西区南堀江1-14-23、四ツ.en: Tabelog: Tera cafe & Live Chaniva, 1-14-23 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 6 min walk from Yotsubashi Station; in a corner of Banpukuji; Thu–Fri 12:00–17:30 (L.O. 17:00), Sat 11:00–17:00; days may change; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking; 20 seats; terrace; children and pets welcome; kids' menu; opened 1 April 2017; original wagashi by a pastry chef; official site. Reviews (November 2025 – October 2026): a Jodo Shinshu temple of about 400 years; a well-kept garden through the windows; today's sweets set ¥1,650 (caramel and almond cheesecake); seasonal wagashi set (bean paste, chestnut, ice cream, chrysanthemum-shaped monaka); matcha about ¥1,400; matcha latte; hojicha latte; coffee ¥550; iced caffè latte ¥700; in summer, plum-syrup kakigori topped with an umeboshi; a photo of the 'menu (kakigori)'; one found drinks pricey; cash only.

食べログ: 寿しや傳、寿司、大阪市淀川区東三国1-1-18、JR 東淀川駅西口か.en: Tabelog: Sushi Ya Tsutau, sushi, 1-1-18 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 3 min from the west exit of JR Higashi-Yodogawa Station, 5 min from Higashi-Mikuni Station, 10 min from the north exit of Shin-Osaka Station; Mon–Sat two seatings, 18:00–20:15 (last order 20:00) and 20:30–22:45 (last order 22:30); closed Sunday; reservation only; courses ¥11,000 (8 nigiri, 3 small dishes, soup, dessert; up to 4 guests a seating), ¥16,500 (9 nigiri, 6 small dishes) and ¥22,000 (10 nigiri, 6 small dishes); cards, e-money and QR accepted; 8 seats; non-smoking (smoking area outside); sunken counter; opened 4 July 2024. Shop site: owner 土屋 泰輔; trained from age 22; living abroad brought a new appreciation of Japanese cuisine and a wish to share it regardless of nationality; 18:00–23:30 (last order 23:00); closed Sunday, some other days off; draft beer ¥900, Hakushu or Yamazaki ¥1,200 and more. Reviews (February to August 2026): a young chef who trained three years at Sanshin and two at Ikegami; red-vinegar rice, slightly firm, cooked in a gas pot with the water adjusted to the weather; squid, marinated lean tuna, mackerel, simmered clam, uni, anago, cherry salmon, shrimp, triggerfish, chu-toro, grilled tachiuo, chawanmushi; each piece explained; reasonable for the area.

食べログ: 寿し吉、大阪市中央区南船場2-9-3、クリスタ長堀の北4・北5出口か.en: Tabelog: Sushi Yoshi, Minami-Senba 2-9-3, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 3 min walk north from Crysta Nagahori exits North 4 and North 5 (Nagahoribashi and Shinsaibashi Stns); 6 min from Honmachi and Sakaisuji-Honmachi Stns; Mon–Sat 12:00–13:30 (L.O. 13:00) and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 20:30); closed Sundays, public holidays, and the days before and after a holiday; also closed on Mondays that fall on a holiday; reservations accepted (by phone, even 5 minutes ahead on the day); bookings from numbers other than Japanese mobile phones may not be confirmed; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 6 seats (counter); non-smoking; coin parking next door; menus in English, Chinese (traditional and simplified) and Korean; staff speaking English, Chinese and Korean; opened 2 April 2014; Instagram (minamisenba_sushiyoshi). Reviews (2018 – September 2026): creative sushi; at lunch 10 pieces of nigiri for ¥5,000 (called Gourmet Nigiri in an English review) or an omakase for ¥12,500 (April 2026); dinner courses ¥12,000 and ¥16,000 (February 2024); foie gras nigiri, mozzarella nigiri, water eggplant or grilled eggplant with sea urchin, sweet shrimp with liver sauce, Senshu squid with red-vinegar rice, kombu-cured anago, lean tuna, fatty tuna, horse mackerel, grilled anago, kanpyo roll, tamago with foie gras, squid and shrimp, seko-gani crab, sea-urchin chawanmushi, red miso soup; one person runs lunch (June 2025); a friendly taisho with entertaining stories; one diner found the sweet soy sauce too strong; small nigiri; a diner who went to Sushi Yoshi in Tsuruhashi 20 years ago found the menu almost the same (July 2022).

食べログ: 寿司 天ぷら 明 難波 心斎橋店 (寿司×天ぷら 明)、居酒屋・寿司.en: Tabelog: Sushi × Tempura Akira Namba Shinsaibashi, izakaya, sushi and tempura, Nanchi Building 1F, Sennichimae 1-5-16, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 5 minutes on foot from Namba and Nippombashi stations on every line, 12:00–16:00 (last order food 15:00, drinks 15:30) and 17:00–23:30 (last order food 22:30, drinks 23:00), closed on irregular days, reservations taken, appetizer charge ¥350 per person, cards, QUICPay, PayPay and Alipay accepted, 20 seats, non-smoking (smoking spot in front of the shop), English menu and English-speaking staff, opened 5 September 2022. Fresh fish straight from the market, sushi on a house blend of red-vinegar rice, ordered from one piece; the specialities are the seafood overflow sushi topped with ikura and the rare salmon tempura with ikura tartare; the all-you-can-eat sushi course is limited to three groups a day, booked by phone only. Tabelog menu (updated 4 October 2026): seafood overflow sushi ¥2,180, assorted sashimi ¥1,180 per serving (from two), nigiri ¥150–480 a piece, tempura omakase 5 kinds ¥930 or 7 kinds ¥1,350, rare salmon tempura ¥1,480, the signature Akira seafood yukhoe ¥1,280, homemade sea-bream broth white ramen ¥980, courses ¥4,000 (11 dishes) and ¥5,000 (13 dishes), all-you-can-drink +¥1,000. Reviews (January 2023 to October 2026): fish bought at the market every morning, red-vinegar rice, seafood overflow sushi (¥1,958 in May 2024), 60-minute all-you-can-eat sushi ¥4,000 (March 2025), ¥5,000 with all-you-can-drink (June 2026), many young and overseas customers, nearly full even on a weekday, a cook with experience at well-known restaurants (January 2023), a friendly young owner (March 2025, July 2026); one diner's reservation had not gone through and the hamachi seemed less than fresh (October 2026).

食べログ: 寿司 赤酢 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-3-2 クイーンズコー.en: Tabelog: Sushi Akazu Shinsaibashi, Queens Court Bldg main building 2F, 2-3-2 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; reservations only; daily 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–22:30; two evening sittings (first 18:00–20:00, second entering 20:30–22:30, everyone starting together); irregular closing days; service charge; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 8 seats (counter only); udon or curry rice for children; a sister shop in Namba; opened 18 May 2020; seasonal omakase course ¥17,600. Reviews (October 2025 – October 2026): many overseas diners; red-vinegar rice and fresh toppings; the counter and the sushi chef's skill; omakase (seiko crab, raw oysters, ankimo, eel, chutoro, otoro, abalone, risotto, shirako chawanmushi, nodoguro, kuruma prawn, bafun uni, anago, toro-taku, miso soup, pudding); a friendly taisho; abalone-liver-sauce risotto (truffle, Parmesan); firm rice made without sugar; divides opinion; just off the shopping street.

食べログ: 寿司、下京区御幸町通仏光寺下ル橘町442、毎日17:30〜23:00.en: Tabelog: sushi; Gokomachi-dori Bukkoji-sagaru, Shimogyo-ku; every day 17:30–23:00; closed irregularly; bookings taken (parties of 7 or more confirm by phone); 10 seats; private hire possible; no smoking; children by prior consultation; cards accepted (UnionPay too); no e-money or QR; opened 11 January 2025. Reviews (January 2025 – September 2026, in English): a townhouse of 100 years (200+ in another review) restored by sukiya craftsmen; a garden, a bar counter, a large private room; a head chef in the twenties; fluent English; fond of "Tomidokoro" in Shimbashi; Edomae; red-vinegar rice; about four small dishes and 14 nigiri; ¥22,000 rising to ¥28,000; sake such as Aramasa around ¥1,000; ties to Toyosu wholesalers; many overseas guests.

食べログ: 寿司、下京区美濃屋町174-1 プレゼンスビル 1F、河原町松原バス.en: Tabelog: sushi; 美濃屋町174-1, Shimogyo-ku, プレゼンスビル 1F; about 2 min walk from the Kawaramachi-Matsubara bus stop, about 10 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn; Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday 18:00–21:00 (last order 20:30); Saturday, Sunday and holidays 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–21:00; closed Wednesday; reservations accepted; 8 counter seats; a private-room counter for 4; non-smoking (smoking spot outside); cards accepted. Reviews (2016–2025, in English): run by a couple (2016); Edomae sushi; omakase ¥15,000 (June 2025); lunch courses about ¥6,000–7,000 (2022–2023); hairy crab, firefly squid, simmered octopus, moroko and homemade karasumi; by the Takase River; a friendly head chef.

食べログ: 寿司、中京区新京極通四条上ル中之町565、阪急「河原町」駅から徒歩約.en: Tabelog: sushi; 中京区新京極通四条上ル中之町565; about 5 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn; Tue–Sun 11:00–20:00 (L.O. 19:45); closed Monday; no reservations; 20 seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; takeaway; sake and shochu. Blog 日本全国食べ歩き (visited 13 February 2026): an old shop representing steamed sushi, Kyoto's winter speciality; no official site found; often introduced as founded in Meiji 35 (1902); steamed sushi in winter, hamo box sushi in summer; steamed sushi roughly October to March; a steamer at the shopfront; right by exit 9 of Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn; mushi-zushi ¥1,600 before tax. Reviews (2024–2026, in English): founded in the Meiji era, over 120 years; steamed sushi (shredded egg, conger eel, shiitake, bamboo shoot, kanpyo); inari-zushi ¥840; saba-zushi; Kyoto sushi (box, roll, mackerel) ¥1,650; Kyo no Shiki ¥2,100; Kurama; mini maki ¥550; kappa and shinko rolls; anago-cucumber roll ¥1,600; single pieces can be ordered.

食べログ: 寿司、中京区鍋屋町210 先斗町24番路地奥、京都河原町駅1A出口か.en: Tabelog: sushi; 鍋屋町210, Nakagyo-ku, end of Pontocho alley No. 24; 2 min walk from Exit 1A of Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn, 4 min from Exit 4 of Gion-Shijo Stn; 11:00–15:00 (lunch by reservation) and 17:00–23:00; closed Wednesday (bookings can be discussed); 12 seats; private rooms for 2–8; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards accepted; omakase 12 pieces (15 dishes) ¥16,500; special 16 pieces (19 dishes) ¥22,000; seafood chosen by the owner from around Japan and the Kyoto brand beef 'Kyo no Niku'. TableCheck: a sushi kappo down an alley in Pontocho. Reviews (2023–2026, in English): ¥9,900 omakase, hassun, clam soup, red-vinegar rice, decorations with geisha names, entered from the Pontocho side, a friendly head chef.

食べログ: 寿司、東山区林下町434 EXIT祇園 1F、火〜日 18:00〜2.en: Tabelog: sushi; EXIT祇園 1F, Higashiyama-ku; Tue–Sun 18:00–23:00; closed Monday; reservation only; two-hour seating; 15 minutes late counts as a cancellation; a smaller party on the day is charged for the booked number; omakase only, no changes to ingredients or cooking; allergies and religious restrictions to be raised in advance, not on the day; no service charge or cover (10% over the New Year); 8 counter seats; no smoking; BYO allowed; children only if they can eat the adult course; cards accepted; opened 26 March 2024. Reviews (November 2024 – October 2026, in English): sister of Sushi no Kura in Sapporo; Hokkaido ingredients; red vinegar in Kyoto, rice vinegar in Sapporo; omakase ¥22,000–24,000; eel and crab course ¥33,000; about seven small dishes; herring roe with cream cheese; hairy-crab cream; seared nodoguro; Hokkaido uni; hand rolls; fish-bone miso soup; the chef speaks English.

食べログ: 寿司・海鮮・日本料理、東山区三吉町332-6、三条駅から徒歩5分、2.en: Tabelog: sushi, seafood, Japanese cuisine; 332-6, Higashiyama Ward; 5 min walk from Sanjo Stn; two sittings (from 17:00 and from 19:30, about 2 hours); closed Sunday and the second and fourth Mondays; reservation only; bookings for the month after next open at the start of the month; cancellation fees 50% three days before, 80% two days before, 100% the day before and on the day; card only (no cash); service charge included in the course price; 8 counter seats (single slab); waiting room upstairs; private hire; non-smoking; opened 11 January 2019; the sushi of Gion Sasaki; chef Kazuya Nomura; Kyoto dashi and Edomae; rice with red and white vinegar. Reviews (April 2025–October 2026, English): on the Shirakawa; the chef is from Toyama; marinated tuna; abalone with a liver risotto; chawanmushi; a bright, friendly room; one diner found it a little salty.

食べログ: 寿司割烹 ふじい、寿司・海鮮・和食、大阪市淀川区西中島3-3-9 1.en: Tabelog: Sushi Kappou Fujii, sushi, seafood and Japanese, 1F, 3-3-9 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 3 min from Nishinakajima-Minamigata and Minamikata stations; Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat 17:00–23:00; closed Wednesday, Sunday and holidays; reservation only; a single ¥25,000 course; everyone starts together at 18:00; late arrivals may miss dishes; book and cancel by 22:00 the day before; cash and cards; 8 counter seats; non-smoking; no children; no strong perfume; bookings may be declined for extensive allergies; no phone calls inside; do not photograph other guests or staff; avoid revealing clothes; opened 20 June 2023. Reviews (September–October 2026): a starter of hairy crab, ikura and tuna; nodoguro soup; an uni tasting (Hokkaido, Rishiri, Ehime and others); yellowtail, akagai, kohada marinated four days, eel wrapped in Lake Hamana aonori, shima-aji from Amakusa, toro, sanma, simmered clam from Kujukuri, marinated yellowfin, nodoguro, anago; rice at three temperatures (warm, body temperature, slightly cool) and a soy sauce for each topping; abalone steamed six hours with liver sauce; charcoal-grilled mehikari; a toro-taku bowl to finish; draft beer ¥800, Taketsuru highball ¥900, sake from ¥800; the chef is friendly and knows fish well.

食べログ: 寿司赤酢 大阪なんば PREMIUM、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町5-8.en: Tabelog: Sushi Akazu Osaka Namba PREMIUM, 8F, 5-8 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Namba and Nippombashi stations; daily 18:00–22:30 (first sitting 18:00–20:00, second 20:30–22:30); irregular closing days; reservations accepted; families with children not ordering the course are directed to the sister shop Sushi Akazu Shinsaibashi; corkage ¥5,000 per bottle; cards accepted (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), no e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; opened 2 February 2025. Reviews (August–October 2026): red-vinegar rice; 8 counter seats on the 8th floor; omakase of small dishes and nigiri; jade aubergine and Chinese yam; simmered octopus; seared Mie sawara; grilled eel without sauce, crisp skin; kamatoro, otoro, marinated lean tuna; steamed abalone with liver sauce; ikura chawanmushi; spear squid; baby squid; Hokkaido sea urchin with caviar; anago; miso soup of fish trimmings; toro-taku hand roll with iburigakko; an omelette like dessert; one finds the sushi chefs friendly; for anniversaries and dates; omakase ¥19,800; a single-plank hinoki counter; Namba's night view; firm rice with red vinegar aged 10 years; some toppings with white vinegar; wild bluefin tuna; extra liver sauce; red miso soup; Akashi sea bream; herring; barracuda; yellowtail; sweet shrimp.

食べログ: 寿司長、寿司、荒木町3 1F、四谷三丁目駅から徒歩3分、月〜金12:.en: Tabelog: Sushi Cho, sushi; Arakichō 3, 1F; 3 min walk from Yotsuya-sanchome Station; Mon–Fri 12:00–14:00 and 17:00–22:30, closed Saturdays, Sundays and holidays; reservations taken; cards accepted; 16 seats (8 at the counter, 8 at tables); private room; non-smoking; children welcome. Reviews (2026): lunch from about 11:30; chirashi-don ¥800 and tekka-don ¥900 (large +¥100); thick-cut tuna; seasonal miso soup; single-slab counter; many regulars; a friendly head chef and a young cook.

食べログ: 寿限無 担々麺、担々麺、ラーメン、日本橋堀留町1-8-15、人形町駅.en: Tabelog: Jugemu Tantan-men, tantanmen, ramen; Nihonbashi-Horidomecho 1-8-15, 2 min walk from Ningyocho Station exit A5; Mon–Fri 11:00–16:00 and 17:30–23:00, Sat and holidays 11:00–16:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed Sunday; no cards, e-money or QR; 16 seats (6 at the counter, 5 tables for two); smoking allowed; opened 3 October 2017. Reviews (July–October 2026): house-roasted sesame and chili oil; choose spice level and noodle firmness; thin straight noodles; paiko tantanmen ¥1,250; dry tantanmen ¥1,100 (thick noodles, Sichuan pepper); hot-and-sour noodles ¥1,000; Saturday and holiday tantanmen and shumai set ¥1,150; free rice; diners say it resembles Hashigo; nearly full of office workers at weekday lunch.

食べログ: 小料理 たく庵、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-8-14 オーブナテ 5F、.en: Tabelog: Koryori Takuan, Obunate 5F, 1-8-14 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Sat 18:00–24:00; closed Sundays; cards AMEX only (earlier noted as cash only); no e-money or QR; smoking allowed; 18 seats (counter 6, three tables for 4); particular about sake and shochu. Reviews (January–September 2026): hard to find on a 5th floor but often full; good opening small dish and dashi; sashimi platter (seared amberjack, kombu-cured sea bream, Akashi octopus, itoyori, anago, squid, shirasu); rare chicken tempura with house kombu salt; corn tempura; blanched anago; fried anago and autumn aubergine; shirasu and shiso spring rolls with sake-lees and mushroom sauce; straw-grilled chicken; green peppers stuffed with meat miso; pork-wrapped Manganji peppers; grilled eel liver; wagyu tataki; salt rice ball cooked in an iron pot; shirako or oyster ponzu in winter; sake all-you-can-drink course events too.

食べログ: 小松庵総本家 銀座、銀座5-7-6 i liv 14F、銀座駅A2出.en: Tabelog: Komatsu An Sohonke Ginza, Ginza 5-7-6, i liv 14F, right by Ginza Station exit A2; 40 seats (8 private room, 4 counter, 26 table); weekdays 11:00–16:00, 17:00–22:00, weekends and holidays 11:00–22:00; irregular holidays; private rooms carry a 15% service charge and a ¥10,120 room charge; opened August 1, 2019; official site ginza.komatuan.com. Shop introduction: sister shop of a long-established soba shop founded in Taisho 11 (1922); 100% buckwheat soba made by craftsmen from only buckwheat flour and natural water; choice of two sobas; Tokyo soba tasting course, 9 dishes ¥13,000; Tokyo soba lunch course, 6 dishes ¥8,000; course prices revised in August 2025. 2026 reviews: 100% buckwheat soba; comparing origins and seasonings; dashimaki tamago; coarse sobagaki; cream cheese pickled in soba miso; a quiet shop with no background music; some say there's little besides soba.

食べログ: 小洞天、大阪市中央区千日前1-6-10 千寿ビル1F、11席(カウン.en: Tabelog: Shodoten, Senju Bldg 1F, 1-6-10 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 11 seats (counter only); Mon–Sat 18:00–24:00; closed Sundays and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR payment; smoking allowed. Reviews (January 2025 – October 2026): a ramen and gyoza shop founded in 1971; a clear light salt ramen; gyoza hand-made by the owner; a 141st visit; 55 years in business; the last stop after drinking; before COVID a husband-and-wife team ran it, and now the owner is training young staff; the wontons sometimes sell out; chashu-men ¥1,200 (¥950 in January 2025); 8 gyoza ¥400; clear chicken-bone soup with a yellow tare and sesame; bean sprouts and leek; wonton chashu-men; wonton noodles ¥1,100; thin straight noodles; salt kaeshi; chicken bones; gyoza that have been in the media.

食べログ: 小澤牧場 牛○、港区新橋1-13-3 新橋ガード下横丁、新橋駅徒歩1.en: Tabelog: Ozawa Bokujo Ushimaru, Shinbashi 1-13-3, Minato-ku, Shinbashi Gado-shita Yokocho, 1 minute from Shinbashi Station; hours not listed; smoking allowed. Reviews (2024–2026): energetic staff; quick service; tasty food; wish there were more sweet-potato shochu; the map location may be off; a popular-tavern atmosphere; cramped seats; endless green peppers; the clutter of the narrow room up the stairs is part of the charm; meat, fish and vegetables, with hearty meat dishes standing out; noodles and rice bowls too; in May 2026, beef-bone ramen and yakisoba after midnight.

食べログ: 小皿kitchen cocoro、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-17.en: Tabelog: Kozara kitchen cocoro, Sanyo Bldg 1F, 1-17-17 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Tue–Sun 11:30–15:00 (lunch) and 17:00–23:00 (dinner); closed Mondays; smoking at all seats; 20 seats; cards, e-money and QR accepted (card receipts by email); listed as able to cater for vegetarians; takeaway and delivery; freshly made chicken-liver pâté ¥350; house oil sardines ¥350; raw oysters direct from producers in winter; shochu and whisky by the bottle. Reviews (September 2025 – April 2026): a red lantern; starter ¥400 at night; chicken-shoyu chuka soba (chicken chashu, thin menma); about 6 lunch choices; young-chicken kara-age set meal ¥800; mille-feuille beef cutlet with grated daikon and ponzu ¥1,200; moo shu pork ¥900; large rice free; iced coffee ¥100; raw oysters; cheap with lots of choice.

食べログ: 小籠包・バル・居酒屋、中京区式部町259-1 舟木ビル 1F、11:.en: Tabelog: xiaolongbao, bar, izakaya; 舟木ビル 1F, Nakagyo-ku; 11:00–20:30; closed Tuesday; bookings by phone only; 10 seats (five tables for two); no smoking; children and strollers welcome; PayPay only (no cards or e-money); takeaway and delivery; English menu; opened 18 January 2022; handmade pan-fried xiaolongbao wrapped to order; chicken stock and fresh pork; three good-value sets; a retro Shanghai interior. Reviews (April 2025 – September 2026, in English): pork shengjian and green-skinned shrimp ones; black vinegar; Manpuku set ¥1,780; scallion-oil mixed noodles ¥580; red-oil wontons; dried tofu salad; white-peach oolong tea; ordering by smartphone.

食べログ: 小諸そば 歌舞伎店、銀座4-11-7、東銀座駅から161m、平日7:.en: Tabelog: Komoro Soba Kabuki, Ginza 4-11-7, 161 m from Higashi-Ginza Station; weekdays 7:00–20:00, Sat 7:30–17:00, Sun 8:00–17:00; no reservations; looks like standing soba but has seats. 2026 reviews: pork soba; all the scallions you want; conger-eel tempura fried fresh; cold tanuki soba ¥500; ticket machine; tendon set with cold soba; standing and seated; quick even when busy; cheap for the location; firm cold soba with tenkasu.

食べログ: 小諸そば 銀座7丁目店、銀座7-10-13、平日7:30〜20:00.en: Tabelog: Komoro Soba Ginza 7-chome, Ginza 7-10-13; weekdays 7:30–20:00, weekends and holidays 10:00–17:00; no reservations; official site k-mitsuwa.co.jp. 2026 reviews: a standing-soba chain; shoulder-loin katsudon set ¥820 (choose zaru or kake); ticket machine; oyakodon ¥640 (yuzu shichimi, scallions on the table, umeboshi); about 3 minutes from order; busy at lunch with tradespeople and office workers; tendon set with three shrimp; firm soba; Sichuan-style cold chuka soba (lots of cucumber) ¥500; tickets with transit IC.

食べログ: 尾道中華そば 大福、大阪市中央区上汐1-6-5 汐庵 106、谷町六.en: Tabelog: Onomichi Chuka Soba Daifuku, Shioan 106, 1-6-5 Ueshio, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 467 m from Tanimachi-Rokuchome Station; Mon, Tue and Fri–Sun 11:30–14:30 and 17:30–22:30, Wed 11:30–14:30; closed Thursdays; no cards, e-money or QR; counter; opened 12 November 2025. Reviews (November 2025 – October 2026): a gentle flavour; seasoned egg; egg on rice; very good service; hard to find; meal tickets; chashu-men large; lighter than it looks; chuka soba set (chuka soba, rice, egg) ¥1,000 with free rice refills; raw egg or seasoned egg; extra back fat with a service voucher; firm medium-thin straight noodles; chicken-bone shoyu; tang; back fat; thin-sliced pork chashu; menma; the shop's recommended aogappa rice (mayonnaise); menu: chashu-men set, chuka soba set, chashu-men, chuka soba, yakisoba; pepper, shichimi, spicy miso, mayonnaise, red pickled ginger and aogappa on the table; 13 counter seats; the owner and two staff; cheerful service; nearly full even after 13:00; flat noodles; piping-hot soup; chuhai and a snack platter at night; gyoza; a warning that the soup is hot; a sweet, sharp shoyu; garlic chili.

食べログ: 尾道文化ラーメン、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-3-12 トリル心斎橋、0.en: Tabelog: Onomichi Bunka Ramen, Trill Shinsaibashi, 1-3-12 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6241-3866; no reservations; daily 11:30–2:00 next morning; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 seats (counter only); smoking allowed; opened 15 July 2011. 2026 reviews (May–August): choose Onomichi ramen or tonkotsu; the tonkotsu is mild; good chashu; ticket machine; the feel of an old-style Chinese restaurant; shoyu ramen and gyoza; the owner asks your noodle firmness; smooth noodles; light shoyu with back fat; change the flavour with pepper; full of overseas tourists at lunch; tourists pay cash directly rather than at the machine; shoyu-tonkotsu blend; lots of leek; strongly seasoned menma; fragrant, moist fried rice; salt ramen; light and deeply nourishing; Friday Road Show on the TV; Onomichi ramen and a noodle refill; sweet chashu; umami of shoyu and niboshi; mildly spicy.

食べログ: 居酒屋 十兵衛、大阪市中央区南船場3-8-1、堺筋本町駅から徒歩5分.en: Tabelog: Izakaya Jubei, Minami-Senba 3-8-1, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Stn, 7 min from Shinsaibashi Stn; Mon–Fri 11:00–14:30 and 18:00–23:00 (L.O. food 22:00, drinks 22:30), Sat 11:00–14:30; closed Sundays and public holidays; reservations accepted; groups of 12 or more by arrangement; private hire up to 20; all-you-can-drink; cards accepted (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR; 20 seats; no smoking at lunch only; opened 21 January 2016; corporate-member listing. Shop site: a cheap, good izakaya in Hommachi, Shinsaibashi and Minami-Senba; yakitori (brand-name gaina chicken), kushikatsu and oden as the three mainstays; banquets; all-you-can-drink; the whole menu available to take away; bento sold at the shop front at lunch. Reviews (July 2025–October 2026): always a line at weekday lunch; grilled chicken thigh set ¥850; crisp skin, on cabbage; double and triple too; two of 12 sauces (stamina, salt, spicy, spicy curry, wasabi soy, sweet miso, green onion, ginger, shichimi with yuzu pepper); mixed set; tonkatsu set; chicken katsu; pork thigh; one free raw egg; free refills of rice and miso soup; tamago kake gohan; takeaway chicken-katsu bento ¥600 (with miso soup); the owner alone at night; a long L-shaped counter and two tables of 4 at the back; yakitori (heart, harami, negima, yagen cartilage, seseri); whole grilled chicken thigh; sliced onion; addictive cabbage; kimchi; fried eggplant; horumon with ponzu; plain salt yakisoba; local sake; one diner had to ask twice for the egg at a busy lunch.

食べログ: 居酒屋、下京区高辻通り御幸町西入ル茶磨屋町233 アネックス2番館.en: Tabelog: izakaya; アネックス2番館 1F, Takatsuji-dori, Shimogyo-ku; Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 16:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed irregularly; inbound guests book through the front desk of a nearby hotel; no bookings from overseas guests (nor bookings made through a Japanese person); no minors; first visits are served a soup and two dishes even on a seats-only booking; no prices on the à la carte menu; tell allergies when booking; 14 seats (10 counter, one table of 4); no smoking; cards accepted; opened 28 March 2023; Izakaya WEST Tabelog 100 2025 and 2026; Hot Restaurant 2026. Retty: Takatsuji Kasui (read Takatsuji Kasui); formerly Kasui in Pontocho; one soup and two dishes; donabe rice; egg tofu topped with sea urchin; eel sushi; dashi omelette; PayPay accepted; Instagram takatsuji_kasui. Reviews (March 2023 – October 2026, in English): one soup and two dishes ¥3,000; a soup bowl with shrimp dumpling; leftover donabe rice made into onigiri; sake kept at −5 °C; a master in a bow tie; prices not written; the water smells of chlorine.

食べログ: 居酒屋、中京区壬生坊城町47 2F、四条大宮駅から343m、火〜土.en: Tabelog: izakaya; 壬生坊城町47, Nakagyo-ku, 2F; 343 m from Shijo-Omiya Stn; Tuesday–Saturday 17:00–23:00; closed Sunday and Monday (irregular closures in summer and winter); reservations accepted; 14 seats (counter and tables); non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; Izakaya WEST Tabelog 100 2026. Reviews (March–October 2026, in English): a 2nd-floor shop whose name comes from '2F'; the cook works alone; salt-seared bonito, assorted sashimi, mehikari, simmered whelk, fried aji and sawara with homemade tartar, young-ayu tempura, salt-fried chicken thighs, potato salad with smoked daikon and nagaimo, sudachi somen, jako fried rice; about ¥1,500 a dish; slow service; a report of unfriendly staff.

食べログ: 居酒屋、中京区道祐町135-1 三条食彩ろぉじ、月・水〜金 17:0.en: Tabelog: izakaya; 中京区道祐町135-1 三条食彩ろぉじ; Mon and Wed–Fri 17:00–23:00, Sat 15:00–23:00, Sun 15:00–22:00; closed Tuesday; reservations accepted (DMs not answered during opening hours); no table charge; 16 seats (6 at the counter, 10 at tables); private hire up to 20; non-smoking (smoking area outside); cards and PayPay accepted. Reviews (January–August 2026, in English): young staff; a sister shop, SAUNA; seafood-overflow rolls; mentaiko roll; katsuo tataki; squid sashimi; edamame tempura; salmon rare cutlet; cream cheese dip; hamo and matsutake tempura; shirako in winter; yellowtail hot pot; cheesecake of the day; Amaou strawberry sour; smartphone ordering; counter on the ground floor, tables upstairs; one guest found it noisy with regulars (August 2026).

食べログ: 居酒屋、左京区孫橋町9、三条駅から徒歩5分、月〜土 17:00〜23.en: Tabelog: izakaya, 左京区孫橋町9, 5 min on foot from Sanjo Stn; Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Sunday and on Mondays that are public holidays; reservations accepted (not for the counter); 41 seats (11 at the counter, 30 on the raised tatami); two private rooms; smoking allowed; no cards, e-money or QR; Izakaya Tabelog 100 2021, 2022; Izakaya WEST Tabelog 100 2024, 2025. Reviews (September–November 2026, in English): founded 1934, on the present site from 1949; duck loin roast, shime saba, kumiage yuba, oden (octopus, rolled cabbage), simmered taro, eel; a menu without prices; a queue before opening; the owner hangs the noren; tables booked for 17:00 or 19:00.

食べログ: 居酒屋・すき焼き・しゃぶしゃぶ、下京区斎藤町123 ラクアス木屋町.en: Tabelog: izakaya, sukiyaki, shabu-shabu; 斎藤町123, Shimogyo-ku, ラクアス木屋町 1F; within 1 min of Exit 1B of Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn, 2 min from Exit 3 of Gion-Shijo Stn; on Kiyamachi-dori between the Kamo and Takase rivers; lunch 11:30–14:30; dinner Monday–Friday 17:00–22:00, Saturday, Sunday and holidays 16:00–22:00; evening-only starter charge ¥800; a service charge on 1–3 January; reservations accepted; 41 seats (9 at the counter, 20 at tables, 12 at sunken kotatsu tables); semi-private rooms; private hire for 20–50; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; cards, e-money and PayPay; vegetarian options; Kyoto duck and Kyoto vegetables; Fushimi sake and Tanba wine; courses with free-flow drinks ¥6,500, ¥8,500 and ¥10,500. Reviews (May–October 2026, in English): duck seiro soba, Kujo-negi tempura, five Kyoto-duck skewers, dashimaki of Kyoto-duck eggs, duck sukiyaki, duck shabu-shabu, low-temperature duck, items selling out early in the evening.

食べログ: 居酒屋・ステーキ・日本料理、中京区寺町通錦小路上ル円福寺前町283.en: Tabelog: izakaya, steak, Japanese cuisine; 寺町通錦小路上ル円福寺前町283, Nakagyo-ku, WITH YOU building B1F; 3 min walk from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn; west side of Teramachi north of Nishiki; look for the meat-print noren; 11:30–16:00 (last order 15:00) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:15); closed New Year's Day; reservations accepted (seat requests may not be met); all-you-can-eat starter ¥330 (not with lunch or courses); 136 seats; private rooms; smoking room; wheelchair accessible; cards, e-money, PayPay and au PAY; vegetarian options; steak grilled on the teppan and in a stone oven; homemade steamed tofu. Gurunavi: Ichiba Koji AEON Mall Kitaoji shop. Reviews (August–October 2026, in English): lunch of eight obanzai and wagyu steak; free refills of tofu, multigrain rice and miso soup; also a Katsuragawa shop; ordering by barcode; open kitchen; chicken nanban served cold; some find it salty.

食べログ: 居酒屋・バー・ダイニングバー、中京区河原町通三条下ルBAL北通り東入.en: Tabelog: izakaya, bar, dining bar; 佐野ビル 3F, east off Kawaramachi south of Sanjo along the BAL north street, Nakagyo-ku; every day 17:30–4:30 (last order food 3:30, drinks 4:15); open over the New Year (1–3 January last order 24:00, closing 1:00); phone bookings 10:00–3:00; private hire for 11 or more; 16 seats (6 counter, 10 table); smoking allowed; cards and QR accepted; no e-money; all-you-can-drink and courses. Reviews (January 2024 – September 2026, in English): duck confit ¥1,100; quiche; swordfish with vermouth sauce; chicken-tender carpaccio with mentaiko sauce; yuba and sesame tofu; raw horse ruibe; roast Ezo venison; conger-eel ajillo; crab pasta; the owner runs it alone.

食べログ: 居酒屋・串揚げ・洋食、中京区占出山町310-20、烏丸駅・四条駅から.en: Tabelog: izakaya, kushiage, yoshoku; 中京区占出山町310-20; 2 min on foot from Karasuma or Shijo Stn; Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00; closed Sunday (in November closed on the 1st, 8th, 15th, 23rd and 29th, open Sunday the 22nd); reservations accepted (by phone for 5 or more or when full online); one drink per guest; 26 seats (12 at the counter, a private room for up to 6, a semi-private room); non-smoking; cards accepted; reopened under a new name after 14 years at Shijo Teramachi; seasonal creative kushiage and Japanese and Western dishes; courses and à la carte. Reviews (August–October 2026, in English): ¥6,800 course; a course of 8 skewers with seasonal dishes; yam and hamo; crab-miso dip; seared tuna; vegetable platter with bagna cauda; a bite of curry to finish; a renovated townhouse; down an alley; full by 19:00.

食べログ: 居酒屋・寿司・日本酒バー、中京区東木屋町通四条上る鍋屋町122、阪急.en: Tabelog: izakaya, sushi, sake bar; 東木屋町通四条上る鍋屋町122, Nakagyo-ku; 3 min walk from Exits 1 and 2 of Hankyu Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn; Monday, Tuesday, Thursday 17:30–23:00; Friday 17:15–24:00; Saturday 17:15–1:00; Sunday 17:15–23:00; closed Wednesday; reservations accepted (contact early because of purchasing; orders stop when ingredients run out; ingredients and menu change daily; ask in advance for requests); groups of 1–4; ¥500 per person; smoking allowed; no cards, e-money or QR; 20 seats (6 at the counter, 14 at tables). Reviews (2024–2026, in English): run by a couple; rice blended with white and red vinegar; sushi from one piece; 6- and 10-piece sets; oyster namero; kimchi lotus root; black-cooked firefly squid; a wall of anime stickers; hard to find at the end of an alley; cash only; smoking allowed.

食べログ: 居酒屋・日本料理、下京区神明町241-1、烏丸駅から193m、月〜土.en: Tabelog: izakaya, Japanese cuisine; 下京区神明町241-1; 193 m from Karasuma Stn; Mon–Sat 17:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed Sunday and holidays; bookings taken; 30 seats; counter seating; non-smoking; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); Izakaya Tabelog 100 2022, Izakaya WEST Tabelog 100 2024 and 2026. Reviews (November 2025–October 2026, in English, some in Japanese): Takakura-dori by Ayakoji; nearly always full, booking needed; duck manju, lotus-root manju, hamo tempura, flathead (コチ), eggplant and herring, squid legs in Saikyo miso ¥780, sashimi platter, grilled natural eel, dobin-mushi, 黒龍, Juyondai, about ¥7,000 a head.

食べログ: 居酒屋・日本料理、下京区綾小路通足袋屋町317-11、月水木金日 1.en: Tabelog: izakaya and Japanese cuisine; 綾小路通足袋屋町317-11, Shimogyo-ku; Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and Sunday 13:00–21:00; closed Tuesday and Saturday; reservations accepted (none by proxy; during opening hours, calls only about free seats and same-day bookings); 16 seats (8 at the counter, two tables for 4–5 upstairs); children upstairs only; non-smoking; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; Izakaya WEST Tabelog 100 2024, 2025, 2026. Retty: according to reviews, the shop of someone who came from 食堂おがわ. Reviews (2024–2026, in English): a menu without prices, hamo, sea urchin with eggplant, shime saba, saury, maguro namero, kabura-mushi, chicken wings (from one piece), dashimaki, oden, curry, fried rice, katsu sandwich, sake chosen by the house, opening at 13:00 from September 2026, 10th anniversary in December 2026, at the end of an alley.

食べログ: 居酒屋・海鮮・寿司、中京区紙屋町674-5、河原町駅から徒歩3分、毎.en: Tabelog: izakaya, seafood, sushi; 中京区紙屋町674-5; 3 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn; daily 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); open all year; bookings taken (seat-only bookings need an order of ¥6,000 or more); table charge ¥330; ¥550 charge from 26 December to 5 January; usually a two-hour limit (1 h 30 when busy); 56 seats (16 on the 1st floor, 40 on the 2nd); private rooms; non-smoking; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; vegetarian options; invoice T9120001167719; menu (English version, updated February 2025): dashimaki topped with ikura ¥968, Sushi Dogs, two-colour nama-fu dengaku ¥638, sesame tofu ¥638, yuba sashimi ¥748, Kyoto yudofu ¥858, Kyoto-vegetable tempura platter ¥1,078, tempura from ¥300. NTA corporate-number site: 株式会社ＣＲＯＷＮ (Sakai, Osaka). Gurunavi: 個室居酒屋 だいあん 河原町木屋町, centred on Kyoto cuisine, seats overlooking the Takase River, semi-private rooms. Reviews (September 2025–November 2026, in English): all-you-can-eat shrimp shabu-shabu ¥5,980 (¥4,980 in September 2025), shrimp good enough to eat raw, broth from the shrimp heads, ramen to finish, orders until 60 minutes.

食べログ: 居酒屋・海鮮・郷土料理、中京区木屋町通四条上ル2-下樵木町202-3.en: Tabelog: izakaya, seafood, regional cooking; Kiyamachi-dori Shijo-agaru, Nakagyo-ku; every day 17:00–22:30 (last order food 21:15, drinks 22:00); bookings by phone 12:00–22:00 — arrivals 17:00–17:30 any time, 17:30–18:00 if seats allow, none after 18:00; a 2.5-hour limit when busy; appetiser and service charge ¥500; 20 seats (8 counter, two tables of 4, one of 5); no smoking; cards accepted; no e-money or QR. Reviews (September 2024 – July 2026, in English): obanzai; round-eggplant dengaku; Saikyo-grilled black cod; nama-fu dengaku; yuba sashimi; Awaji octopus; mackerel pressed sushi; cod-milt tempura; crab gratin; fried shrimp-taro; heshiko; sake in a teacup; the owner in a kappogi apron.

食べログ: 居酒屋・海鮮・鉄板焼き、下京区大寿町400、阪急京都河原町駅11番出.en: Tabelog: izakaya, seafood, teppanyaki; 大寿町400, Shimogyo-ku; 2 min walk from Exit 11 of Hankyu Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn; in an alley behind Fujii Daimaru; daily 18:00–24:00; dining bookings until 21:00; closed irregularly; reservations accepted; 38 seats (ground floor: 11 at the counter, 2 tables, a private room for 4–5; upstairs: 20 at tables); non-smoking (smoking area); cards, e-money and PayPay; wheelchair accessible; vegetarian options; an adult hideaway in a renovated townhouse; straw-grilled fresh fish and teppanyaki; seasonal sake (Kyoto sakes such as Shōtendōji and Hōryō); Manzoku course of 7 dishes ¥5,000. TableCheck: straw-grilled seafood and teppanyaki. Reviews (May–October 2026, in English): straw-grilled platter, warm potato salad, shrimp mayo with corn, fried corn, fried oysters, oden, beef carpaccio, a call bell upstairs, some say service is slow, many overseas customers.

食べログ: 居酒屋・焼き鳥・鶏料理、中京区御幸町通錦小路下ル大日町403-2 詩.en: Tabelog: izakaya, yakitori, chicken dishes; 中京区御幸町通錦小路下ル大日町403-2 詩の小路プラスビル 2F; 5 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn; Mon–Thu and Sun 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30), Fri–Sat 17:00–3:00 (L.O. 2:30); closes when the chicken runs out; closed irregularly; two-hour limit at weekends, the day before holidays, holidays and 28 December–3 January; chicken sashimi not served at present; table charge ¥380 including tax; 13 seats; smoking allowed; cards, iD and QUICPay; invoice register: 山本 明生 (individual); menu (English version, updated August 2025): skewers from ¥250, chef's five-skewer platter ¥1,200, basashi ¥1,480 per cut, kara-age, yurinchi and chicken nanban ¥750. Reviews (November 2024–August 2026, in English): steep stairs, 8–9 counter seats and one table, kamameshi, bright service, smoking allowed at all seats.

食べログ: 居酒屋・焼鳥・鳥料理、東山区知恩院前石橋町306-6、知恩院前バス停.en: Tabelog: izakaya, yakitori and chicken dishes; 知恩院前石橋町306-6, Higashiyama-ku; right by the Chion-in-mae bus stop; Monday, Thursday–Sunday and holidays 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Tuesday and Wednesday; lunch 12:00–14:00 once a month; reservations accepted; cooking single-handed, so service can be slow when busy; ¥1,000 starter charge; 20 seats (10 at the counter, 10 at tables upstairs); private room for up to 10; non-smoking; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; Izakaya WEST Tabelog 100 2024, 2025, 2026. En Primeur Club: 2024 Michelin Bib Gourmand. Reviews (2025–2026, in English): Omi jidori chicken, thigh tataki, white liver skewers, back liver, chōchin, bonjiri, wings, old hen, shijimi miso soup, obanzai, karasumi egg rice, nyumen, sake chosen by the house, ¥8,000–15,000 a head, two-hour seatings.

食べログ: 居酒屋・餃子・中華料理、東山区大和大路通四条下ル大和町13 芝本ビル.en: Tabelog: izakaya, gyoza, Chinese; 東山区大和大路通四条下ル大和町13 芝本ビル 1F; 6 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn; daily 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closing days vary; bookings taken (after 10 minutes the next guest takes priority); 18 seats; non-smoking; Wi-Fi; cards; smart casual; opened 25 April 2025; invoice T1120901030677 (株式会社ｅｎｅｎ); menu (English version, updated December 2025): gyoza, 6 pieces (garlic ¥600, ginger ¥600, Rāzū ¥800, ume-shiso ¥800), Sichuan mapo tofu ¥1,200, saliva chicken ¥900, shrimp mayo ¥1,200, yodare katsuo ¥1,200, Sichuan mapo noodles ¥1,300, salted fried rice ¥1,100, Tanba chestnut ice cream ¥400. Reviews (October 2025–November 2026, in English): many overseas guests, ordering by QR code, mala soup at lunch, mapo noodle set, yuzu and ponkan beers.

食べログ: 屯舎 火鍋＆麻辣湯、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-8-3、長堀橋駅から徒歩.en: Tabelog: Tonsha Hot Pot & Malatang, 1-8-3 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; daily 11:30–22:00; cards, PayPay and WeChat Pay accepted, no e-money; 46 seats (ground floor counter 6 and two tables for 4; 2nd floor three tables for 4, two tables for 6, private room for 8); smoking allowed; opened 8 January 2019. Reviews (November 2025 – September 2026): reachable from Crysta Nagahori; never had to wait; garlic; knife-cut noodles and shrimp balls; greens, lettuce, potato, sausage; malatang heat 2 ¥1,270 (thick sweet-potato noodles, winter melon, king oyster mushroom, Chinese yam, white wood-ear); more numbing than hot; up to 2 kinds of noodles; leek and coriander free; mobile ordering; about ¥1,500 even ordering a lot; tomato malatang; even heat 1 is properly hot; over 40 ingredients and 5 heat levels; not priced by weight; glass noodles 80 g; spinach, pumpkin, quail eggs; sesame sauce; hot-pot courses at night; the 2nd floor takes large groups.

食べログ: 山ぎん、銀座8-7-16、新橋駅から302m、20席(カウンター10.en: Tabelog: Yamagin, Ginza 8-7-16, 302 m from Shinbashi Station; 20 seats (10 counter, tables); weekdays 11:30–13:30, 18:00–23:00, closed weekends and holidays; cards accepted. 2026 reviews: a ryōtei-style entrance, Showa atmosphere, vegetable curry ¥1,000 (reportedly cash only), beef-stew set, hamburg steak and steak, complimentary barley tea, traditional obanzai at night (simmered dishes, eggplant nibitashi), horse sashimi, chicken, grilled sablefish, smoking allowed.

食べログ: 山三亭、大阪市西区新町1-5-7 四ツ橋ビルディング B1F、四ツ橋.en: Tabelog: Yamasan Tei, Yotsubashi Building B1F, 1-5-7 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; left out of the Yotsubashi Station exit 2 gate and up the stairs; 124 m from Yotsubashi Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–21:00, Sat 11:00–15:00 (Saturday evenings by reservation for 2 or more only); closed Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 16 seats; separate smoking; opened 22 May 2023; Instagram. Shop introduction: authentic Sichuan; signatures mapo tofu and mouth-watering chicken; every lunch ¥1,000, add 2 karaage for ¥200; two dinner courses with 90-minute all-you-can-drink. Reviews (July–October 2026): mapo-tofu set meal (heavy on Sichuan pepper, hot and numbing; one couldn't finish it for the heat); fried-rice set meal (with 2 yu lin chicken); set meals at night too; two-dish set meal ¥1,500 (mapo tofu, yu lin chicken, pickles, free soup refills, one free rice refill); small soupless tantanmen ¥500; Hong Kong-sauce steamed chicken ¥300; spicy shrimp mayo (small) ¥500; century-egg tofu with sesame sauce; shrimp omelette; sweet-and-sour pork; shrimp in chili sauce; spring rolls; shumai; xiaolongbao; run single-handed, so ordering and serving take a little time.

食べログ: 山中製麺所 本町店、大阪市中央区久太郎町2-6-7、堺筋本町駅から2.en: Tabelog: Yamanaka Seimensho Hommachi, 2-6-7 Kyutaromachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 286 m from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station; Mon–Sat 11:00–22:00; closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; 20 counter seats; no smoking; opened 3 October 2011. Reviews (July–September 2026): meal tickets at the entrance; tonkotsu ramen ¥890; soft-boiled egg ¥100; fried rice ¥400, a large portion; thin noodles and a rich soup; the red pickled ginger is back; much is sold out at night; the shoyu ramen is refreshed with yuzu; plenty of chopped onion; house-made slightly flat chewy noodles; choose firmness; pork rice bowl; unlimited ginger; bari-kata recommended; the shoyu a little sweet; prefers the tonkotsu shoyu; the spicy ramen, 10 a day, sells out before noon; spicy miso ramen ¥1,100, rich tonkotsu with spicy miso; noodle refill ¥100; mega fried rice; wood-ear topping; light gyoza; many office workers, quick turnover; dim lighting.

食べログ: 山小屋、ステーキ・鉄板焼き・ハンバーグ、大阪市淀川区西中島3-19-.en: Tabelog: Yama Goya, steak, teppanyaki and hamburg steak, 3-19-7 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, 第一ユヤマビル 1F; 1 min from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station (Midosuji Line), 3 min from Hankyu Minamikata Station; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–22:00, closed Sun and holidays; reservations accepted; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners), no e-money or QR; 18 seats; smoking allowed. The shop's introduction: a calm wooden room, an open-kitchen counter, good steak at fair prices. Reviews (September 2025 to September 2026): daily lunch ¥1,000 (with rice and miso soup: menchi katsu with demi-glace, a small filet cutlet with meatballs, chicken steak, hamburg steak simmered in ketchup); steak lunch ¥1,500 (salad, lemon herb butter); filet steak with ponzu; curry; a salad with apple and orange; run by an older couple; a bearded master; one diner calls it a 50-year-old yoshoku house; food comes quickly.

食べログ: 山形田、銀座3-8-15 アパ銀座中央ビルB1F、30席、平日11:.en: Tabelog: Yamagatada, Ginza 3-8-15, APA Ginza Chuo Building B1F; 30 seats; weekdays 11:00–14:30, 17:00–22:00, weekends 11:00–14:00; irregular holidays; cards: JCB, AMEX. October 2026 reviews: Zao cold jidori soba ¥1,000 (large +¥200), tempura ¥200, mountain-vegetable soba, kakiage, simmered dried herring ¥820, bottled beer ¥780, a woman owner from Yamagata, celebrity autographs, queues at lunch, thick, rustic Yamagata soba.

食べログ: 山桜、大阪市中央区難波千日前13-5、なんば駅から徒歩2分、月・火・.en: Tabelog: Yamazakura, 13-5 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Namba Station; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sat 18:00–22:00 (course L.O. 20:30, food 21:30); closed Wednesdays and Sundays (plus monthly closing days); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 16 seats (counter 10, sunken kotatsu 6); private rooms for 2, 4 and 6; opened 1 July 2014. Reviews (September 2025 – September 2026): a basement in Ura-Namba; courses by reservation; ikura with yuba; seared sawara; Indian tuna (lean, chutoro, marinated); nodoguro; Hokkaido hairy crab; kohada; squid; sea urchin; Toyama white shrimp; barracuda; kinmedai; anago; omelette; red miso soup; fruit dessert; red or white vinegar rice to suit the topping; small rice balls; kabosu used often; over 30 sakes matched to taste; easy-to-talk-to staff and courteous service; about ¥15,000–30,000 each.

食べログ: 山玄茶、日本料理、東山区祇園町北側347-96、祇園四条駅から徒歩1.en: Tabelog: Sangencha, Japanese cuisine, 東山区祇園町北側347-96, 12 min from Gion-Shijo Stn; Mon and Thu–Sun lunch 12:00–14:30 (last order 13:00) and dinner 18:00–21:30 (last order 19:30); Wednesday dinner only; closed Tuesdays and the second Wednesday; reservation required; 26 seats (10 at the counter); private rooms; children welcome with a kids' menu; non-smoking; cards accepted; ¥500 charge; takeaway; opened 8 February 2008; The Tabelog Award Bronze 2019–2026; Japanese cuisine WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025. Reviews (February–September 2026, in English): the spirit of Zen and the tea ceremony, refills of rice from Shiga, mizu-yokan, somen in an ice bowl, warm hospitality from the chef and apprentices, many regulars.

食べログ: 山系無双 烈火 パナンテ京阪天満橋店、大阪市中央区天満橋京町1-1.en: Tabelog: Yamakei Musou Rekka Panante Keihan Tenmabashi, Panante Keihan Tenmabashi, 1-1 Tenmabashi-kyomachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; right by Keihan Tenmabashi Station; daily 11:00–23:00; cards, PayPay and Rakuten Pay accepted, no e-money; 21 counter seats; takeaway; opened 21 March 2017; official site. Reviews (June 2025 – October 2026): Yamagata ramen, rare in Kansai; Yamagata Hippa ramen ¥950 (thick chewy noodles, leek, shredded nori, egg yolk, chashu, canned mackerel, minced natto, spicy miso, chicken soup at the bottom, ume-kombu vinegar for the closing rice); the fiery maze-soba Rekka; Rekka ramen (heat 2) ¥950; Yamagata Torichuka (sweetish chicken soup, big pieces of chicken, tenkasu, mitsuba, nori, medium-thick wavy noodles, spicy miso on the side); Yonezawa ramen (light, thin flat wavy noodles); Yamagata spicy miso ramen ¥930 (bonito-flake dashi); summer cold soba; karaage; one says the EPARK time booking didn't work; a free topping with a JAF card; busy at lunch.

食べログ: 岡本商店 はなれ (旧店名 麺屋きょうすけ)、大阪市中央区谷町2-1.en: Tabelog: Okamoto Shoten Hanare (formerly Menya Kyosuke), Fair Stage Otemae Bldg B1F, 2-1-22 Tanimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Tenmabashi Station, 7 from Tanimachi-Yonchome Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–23:00, Sat and holidays 11:00–18:00, Sun 11:00–16:00; irregular closing days; ramen at lunch, all-you-can-eat-and-drink izakaya at night; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; 15 counter seats; smoking allowed; opened 19 August 2013. Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): a branch of the shop near Kitahama; free mini rice bowl from 13:30; lots of chashu; one calls the ramen ordinary; basement on Tanimachi-suji; one found the spicy seafood ramen ¥950 (choose your heat) strong without tasting of seafood; tori-paitan shoyu tsukemen (medium-thick straight, chicken fat); set F ¥1,000 (chicken-stew ramen with mini rice bowl or a fried dish); grilled chashu mayo rice bowl; bean sprouts; follow on Instagram for a free ¥100 topping; chicken-stew ramen ¥950 with chashu and egg; lively, kind staff; set D is seafood shoyu ramen with chicken curry rice; karaage; a long menu.

食べログ: 岡本商店 北浜店、大阪市中央区平野町2-3-12、北浜から425m、.en: Tabelog: Okamoto Shoten Kitahama, 2-3-12 Hiranomachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 425 m from Kitahama; Mon–Sat 11:00–14:30; closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; 15 seats (counter 7, tables 8); opened 6 April 2020. Reviews (October 2024 – October 2026): 4 waiting just after 11:00; a free mini rice bowl if you come before 11:30; ramen and chashu rice bowl; an inconspicuous basement spot; tsukemen large 300 g ¥1,000 (2024); extra leek free (2024); full at 11:15; chicken-stew ramen ¥900; sweetness of chicken fat; thin or medium-thick noodles; seared or rare chashu; seasoned egg; firm menma; not heavy afterwards; chicken shoyu; chicken seafood; tsukemen; shoyu ramen and karaage rice bowl; clean; kind staff; rich tori paitan; everything-on +¥300 for 2 kinds of chashu, seasoned egg, nori and leek; limited almond tofu; after 13:30 a free almond tofu or black coffee; the chicken-seafood ramen ¥900 isn't too heavy.

食べログ: 岩手屋、居酒屋、日本橋人形町2-10-7、月〜金17:00〜22:0.en: Tabelog: Iwateya, izakaya; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-10-7; Mon–Fri 17:00–22:00; closed Sat, Sun and holidays; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money or QR; 11 seats; counter; smoking allowed; sake and shochu; broadcast on "Onna Sakaba Hourouki", 9 August 2019. Reviews (December 2023–January 2026): over 60 years; the founder came from Iwate; the third-generation granddaughter runs the room alone, with the proprietress's husband handling buying and prep; 11 seats at an L-shaped counter; oden; about 14 kinds of sashimi; nikogori; vinegared octopus; yam tempura; grilled thick tofu with natto sells out early; no prices shown, but cheap; hot sake; Iwate sake; many regulars, yet kind to first-timers; cash only.

食べログ: 川北商店 新大阪店、焼き鳥・居酒屋、大阪市淀川区西中島5-15-5、.en: Tabelog: Kawakita Shoten Shin-Osaka Ten, yakitori and izakaya, 5-15-5 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; inside 新なにわ大食堂 at Shin-Osaka Station; daily 10:00–23:00 (last order 21:45); no reservations; AMEX, e-money and QR accepted; counter seats; non-smoking; opened 20 October 2021. Reviews (August–October 2026): just outside the subway exit; next to Sakanaya Stand Fuji; happy hour 11:00–18:00 with drinks ¥290; the signature "Kawakita Mince" (coarse chicken mince with cartilage, salt or sauce), five for ¥590; Ooyama chicken thigh, thigh with green onion, chicken skin, liver and onion skewers; five-skewer platter ¥790; crispy chicken skin, also to take home; Ooyama chicken kara-age; three-kind sashimi platter ¥880; "Infinite Green Peppers" ¥390; beef-tendon croquette; lunch of chicken nanban with egg on rice or a mini soboro bowl and chicken soup, about ¥1,100; a KITTE shop too; one diner found the skewers uneven when busy.

食べログ: 川名、大阪市中央区難波1-1-8、なんば駅から230m、月〜土18:.en: Tabelog: Kawana, 1-1-8 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 230 m from Namba Station; Mon–Sat 18:00–1:00 next morning; closed Sundays; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR accepted; 16 seats; no smoking; counter. Reviews (September 2024 – June 2026): 2nd floor in a narrow alley near Hozenji's Mizukake Fudo; a warm interior rich in wood; scorch marks from the 2002 fire remain on the counter; rum neat; gin and tonic; a short list is part of the charm; an easy-to-talk-to master; dried fruit; quiet despite being near Hozenji Yokocho; a hideaway up the stairs on the left; records playing; roomy seats; seat charge about ¥1,000; a fruit cocktail of crushed grapefruit with vodka and cranberry; a non-smoking bar; stairs barely wide enough for one; an inconspicuous sign; a second door; counter and a table for 4 at the back; about half the guests tourists; a short cocktail with yogurt liqueur; nuts and dried fruit; a reasonable bill; mind the steep stairs; two Bowmores and a cocktail; dried orange; 6 drinks for two at ¥7,500; a classic bar; conversation with the master.

食べログ: 布目の里、大阪市西区新町1-34-20 ノーブルスクエア新町 1F、.en: Tabelog: Nunome no Sato, Noble Square Shinmachi 1F, 1-34-20 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; about 360 m from Nishi-Ohashi Station; no hours listed; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money or QR; 18 seats (6 at the counter, three tables for 4); non-smoking; private hire possible; website nunomenosato.net (did not connect on 30 October 2026). Reviews (October 2022–October 2026): set meals of vegetables from Yamazoe Village (Nara) and fish shipped direct from Wakayama; ginger pork set, pork steak set (green-onion sauce), Juhosai set (oyster sauce) ¥1,200, simmered fish set ¥1,100, sautéed fish set, grilled fish set, ginger chicken breast, stir-fried vegetable set, vegetable curry, ajillo set, daily special, omakase; ¥100 more in the evening; rice mixed with hijiki, grains or seasonal vegetables, salad, two small side dishes; full by 12:10 on weekdays; the master does all the cooking alone; the staff are kind too; vegetables sold at the door and inside; punch cards; cash only.

食べログ: 帆洲、大阪市西区北堀江1-6-4 アビテ四ツ橋、四ツ橋駅4番出口から.en: Tabelog: Hanshu, Habite Yotsubashi, 1-6-4 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 50 m south of Yotsubashi Station exit 4; Mon–Wed and Fri 11:00–14:00 and 17:00–22:50, Thu and Sat 17:00–22:50; closed Sundays; holidays evenings only (irregular); last entry 21:00–21:30; L.O. 22:25; no Thursday lunch since 2025; book online or by phone; cards and QR (PayPay, Alipay and others) accepted; 20 seats; private rooms for 2–8. Reviews (June–September 2026): a big shrimp sign; courses of 10 or 15 skewers (can change partway); seasonal anago, shrimp, squid, tomato and cheese, sausage, shiso chicken breast, pork, beef, wings, a dashi takoyaki skewer, a dessert skewer; kisu; omakase creative kushiage; sauce, ponzu, rock salt, ketchup, mustard and lemon on the table; served at your eating pace; at lunch, A set with a big prawn and fillet katsu ¥1,200; loin katsu set meal ¥1,200 (rice, miso soup, cold tofu, pickles); limited service lunch ¥800; a quiet, modern shop.

食べログ: 希家 上野店、東上野3-39-7 長春堂ビル 1F、日比谷線上野駅か.en: Tabelog: Nozomiya Ueno, Higashi-Ueno 3-39-7, 長春堂ビル 1F, 2 min on foot from Ueno Station (Hibiya Line), 4 min from the JR Ueno Station Asakusa and Hirokoji exits; daily 11:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:45); open all year; no reservations; no cards or e-money; 12 seats; smoking allowed (non-smoking 11:00–14:00); uses domestic pork bones and chicken carcasses, and asks your noodle firmness, chicken oil and flavour strength when you order. Reviews (December 2025–October 2026): free large size at weekday lunch; one bowl of rice free (one said refills cost ¥100); shio ramen ¥900; spinach and three sheets of nori; one said the soup isn't made in the shop; the noodles could be chewier; cabbage and bean sprouts; one had also been to a Nozomiya in Ota Ward; meat festival (five chashu); too little soup; a smell from the restroom; stains on a rice bowl; ramen ¥900.

食べログ: 希望新風 谷町七丁目店、大阪市中央区谷町7-3-4 新谷町第三ビル.en: Tabelog: Kibou Shinpuu Tanimachi 7-chome, Shin-Tanimachi No. 3 Bldg 1F, 7-3-4 Tanimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 354 m from Tanimachi-Rokuchome Station; Tue–Wed 11:30–14:00, Thu–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–22:00, Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 16:00–19:00; closed Mondays and Saturdays; closed over New Year, part of Golden Week and Obon, and irregular days; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 16 seats (counter 8, tables 8). Reviews (March–September 2026): at the Tanimachi 7-chome crossing; abura soba (black, red, white, pink); chuka soba; chicken sesame soba; thick chewy noodles with menma and chashu; weekday lunch, noodles plus one of karaage, fried rice or rice for ¥990 (cash); on Sundays and holidays black abura soba ¥680 (usually ¥850); large maze-soba with half mixed fried rice ¥1,030; kimchi and takana free; chili oil and vinegar on the table; one found the fried rice and karaage so-so; friendly service.

食べログ: 幸梅軒 (Koubai Ken)、中華料理・ラーメン・餃子、船場中央.en: Tabelog: Koubai Ken; Chinese, ramen, gyoza; Senba Chuo 4-1, Senba Center Building No. 10 B1F; directly connected to Honmachi Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–21:30, Sat 11:00–15:00, closed Sundays; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 38 seats; smoking allowed. Reviews (July–October 2026): a local machi-chuka restaurant; sara udon ¥900 and champon are the signatures; champon set ¥1,180 (half fried rice, macaroni salad); small fried rice add-on ¥350; sweet, moist fried rice; daily set meal ¥950; kara-age set ¥980; yakisoba ¥900; miso ramen; gyoza; sweet and sour pork; liver and garlic chives; queues of office workers at lunch, drinkers in the evening; shared tables; some find the kara-age and sweet and sour pork tough; warm service from someone who seemed to be the owner.

食べログ: 弐箱、大阪市中央区難波千日前6-12 旭光荘 1F、なんば駅・日本橋.en: Tabelog: Futahako, Kyokkoso 1F, 6-12 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; from Namba and Nippombashi stations; daily 18:00–2:00 next morning; irregular closing days; no cards; smoking allowed; 13 seats (counter); official site; the taste of Senshu; 'kashimin-yaki' of a thin batter with cabbage, kashiwa (chicken) and minced beef fat; the second shop of Hako. Reviews (September 2024 – November 2025): a Kishiwada speciality; lighter than okonomiyaki; original kashimin-yaki ¥650; leek ¥980; cheese curry; mochi cheese; cheese tomato; Western-style modan with noodles ¥1,200; uso-yaki of udon, soba and offal ¥1,300; crêpe-batter salad ¥600; squid skewer ¥480; salt-grilled chicken neck ¥600; cucumber ¥350; yakisoba ¥900; yaki udon; natto sobameshi ¥980; simmered beef tendon; ponzu highball; busy even after 21:00.

食べログ: 彩華 大阪上六店、大阪市天王寺区上本町5-3-18、大阪上本町駅・谷.en: Tabelog: Saika Osaka Ueroku, 5-3-18 Uehommachi, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Osaka-Uehommachi Station and Tanimachi-Kyuchome Station exit 11; daily 11:30–24:00; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; smoking area. Reviews (September–October 2026): Saika ramen from Tenri, Nara; Saika ramen ¥900 (small with egg ¥1,000); a shoyu base with house rajan and garlic; stir-fried pork belly, napa cabbage and nira; thin wavy noodles; extra vegetables +¥300 (not offered at directly run shops); extra leek; menma; half fried rice set ¥1,100; half rice set at lunch; mini fried rice ¥400; gyoza with miso sauce; small-shrimp tempura; tenshinhan; garlic on the table; one recommends the noodles firm; quick, friendly staff; one says the garlic smell lasts until the next day.

食べログ: 御所東 うなしげ、うなぎ、上京区新烏丸頭町180 グラスド御所、神宮.en: Tabelog: Gosho Higashi Unashige — eel; Kamigyo-ku; 7 min on foot from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn; Tue–Sat 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed Sunday and Monday; bookings preferably via Instagram; cards and QR accepted; non-smoking; opened 1 March 2022. Reviews (December 2024–October 2026, English): Kanto style, steamed then grilled; steamed after ordering, so about 30 minutes; unaju ¥5,200, large (1.5 eels); kabayaki ¥4,000; uzaku ¥1,400; grilled liver ¥800; chawanmushi with eel; nikogori; a central counter in a machiya-style room; trained at Unakiku.

食べログ: 御料理 心馬、日本料理、日本橋人形町2-10-11 KYOE PLA.en: Tabelog: Oryori Kokoroba, Japanese cuisine; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-10-11, KYOE PLAZA 3F, 2 min walk from Ningyocho Station exit A2; daily 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–22:00; irregular closures; reservation only; 10% service charge; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 6 counter seats; non-smoking; opened 20 August 2022; the owner alone cooks and serves; a tea-room-style counter of Kiso hinoki and cedar; ingredients from Toyosu; 10–15 sakes; evening courses ¥13,000, ¥18,000 and ¥24,000; sake pairing ¥550 a cup. Reviews (November 2025–September 2026): lunch oyakodon course ¥4,950 (Daisendori chicken); ichiban dashi; anago chawanmushi; hamo clear soup; wagyu with noodles; some say it has a Michelin star; some found the portions small; some days only 1–2 parties.

食べログ: 循誠、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-19-15 UNAGIDANI BLO.en: Tabelog: Junsei, UNAGIDANI BLOCK 1F and 2F, 1-19-15 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 2; Tue–Sun and holidays, reservations only, lunch from 12:00 and dinner from 18:00; closed Mondays (private hire possible); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; opened 2 August 2019; official site. Reviews (March–September 2026): formerly named Karato; an intercom at a hidden door; shoes off on the 2nd floor; a modern Japanese tatami space; 8–10 counter seats; special omakase course ¥22,000, decided by the day's ingredients; starters (caviar and karasumi, lotus-root chips, kensaki squid, shiso); aged-wagyu tartare with house bread; bone-in kara-age of Daisen chicken with honey and red-wine-vinegar gastrique; fish marinated in aged Shaoxing wine; 48-month Ibérico bellota ham carved in front of you; corn soup; house hand-stretched pasta; sea-urchin brioche; pheasant soup; mahata finished over charcoal; chateaubriand and tuna soup; European-style beef curry topped with a Kobe-pork cutlet; dessert from 5 (Mont Blanc; vegetable dessert of celeriac mousse and burdock caramel); pear, melon and peach juices; tell staff about dislikes in advance; careful explanations.

食べログ: 心斎橋東 焼とりporc、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-18-1 BEST.en: Tabelog: Shinsaibashi Higashi Yakitori porc, BEST PLAZA B1F, 1-18-1 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; at the crossing of Unagidani Minami-dori and Sankyubashi-suji; daily 17:00–23:00; irregular closing days; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 13 seats (counter 4, tables 11); opened 21 December 2017. Reviews (June–October 2026): a basement hideaway; a Namba shop too; big, juicy skewers; from 2 skewers; seasoning left to the shop; neck; liver; tsukune; big shiitake; shishito; sashimi platter with shoyu, ponzu and condiments; beef dishes; kara-age on a bamboo leaf; a chicken-and-egg rice bowl in dashi to finish; pickles brought as a palate cleanser without asking; sake in clear ochoko; ume-suisho; all-you-can-drink courses; order by smartphone; kind staff who explain carefully; book at busy times.

食べログ: 恩結び -on-、おにぎり、大阪市淀川区東三国1-20-2、東三国駅.en: Tabelog: Omusubi - on -, onigiri, 1-20-2 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 3 min from Exit 4 of Higashimikuni Station, 4 min from the west exit of JR Higashiyodogawa Station; Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri and Sat 8:00–20:00, Sun 9:00–15:00, closed Wednesday; reservations through the official LINE until the day before, same day by phone; no cards or e-money, PayPay accepted; 14 seats; pets on the terrace; non-smoking; children welcome; Wi-Fi; takeaway and delivery; particular about vegetables; breakfast; marked as having vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free options; opened 11 January 2024. The shop's introduction: opened in January 2024 by an owner who trained at a popular shop in Otsuka, Tokyo; shaped after you order; fluffy rice with air between large grains; filling from the first bite to the last; mostly domestic, additive-free and handmade; choose your toppings. Reviews (September 2025 to October 2026): omusubi 150 g and komusubi 100 g (¥100 less); 34 fillings; Shiga Koshihikari rice, Ariake nori, Okinawa salt; multigrain rice too; salmon, sujiko, salmon mayonnaise, minced meat with soy-cured egg yolk, spicy cod roe with takana, shrimp mayo with cream cheese and shiso, salmon with salmon roe, tuna kakuni, cod roe with cream cheese, green onion with salmon roe, sesame kombu ¥330, honey plum, negi toro ¥480; a set of miso soup on shellfish dashi with dashimaki and takuan; meat soup; somen ¥330; dashi chazuke ¥150 extra; a gluten-free cake set; open from 8:00; alcohol too; warm hospitality from the owner.

食べログ: 悠楽、焼肉・ホルモン、大阪市淀川区西中島4-8-30 山よしビル 1.en: Tabelog: Yuraku, yakiniku and offal, 4-8-30 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, 山よしビル 1F; 2–3 min from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; Mon–Fri 11:30–13:30 and 18:00–24:00, Sat and Sun 18:00–24:00; closing days not fixed; reservations accepted; cash only; 20 seats (6 at the counter, tables); smoking allowed; Wi-Fi; two TVs for sports. The shop's introduction: yakiniku of Omi beef, one of Japan's three great wagyu; the popular Jou Harami; good-value lunches. Reviews (December 2024 to October 2026): a set-meal shop at lunch (its sign reads "Yakiniku Yuraku"); tonjiru and kara-age set ¥890–1,000; spicy kara-age set ¥950; kara-age with tartar; tonjiru and fried horse mackerel set; tonjiru instead of miso soup ¥50 extra; free rice refills; dashimaki; salad; a small side; a tonjiru bowl bigger than the rice bowl, full of pork and vegetables; a line at lunch; three women running it; at night a ¥5,000 course with all-you-can-drink (tongue to kalbi, offal, kimchi, rice); harami; a smoky room; some say lunch is irregular.

食べログ: 悦来閣、大阪市天王寺区悲田院町4-24、天王寺から182m、月〜土.en: Tabelog: Etsurai Kaku, 4-24 Hidenincho, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 182 m from Tennoji; Mon–Sat 11:00–14:00 and 17:00–23:00; closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; 34 seats (counter 6, four tables for 6, one for 4); no smoking 11:00–14:00, separate smoking otherwise. Reviews (May–August 2026): a piping-hot miso ramen with plenty of vegetables and sesame-oil aroma; gentle gyoza light on garlic; spacious seats; reasonable prices; green pepper and pork stir-fry ¥1,280; yu lin chicken ¥1,000; vegetable congee large ¥900; draught beer ¥500; pork, glass noodles and vegetables in oyster sauce set meal ¥900 (egg soup, cold tofu, kimchi); 8 daily set meals at ¥900; shrimp and aubergine in thick sauce; one found the rice a little dry; Ura-Tennoji beyond the Hanwa shopping street; fried rice; hot-and-sour soup that's big even in small (tomato, wood-ear, tofu); diners heading home from work; kind service.

食べログ: 情熱のぶた、大阪市西区立売堀4-9-10 プレミアムAWAZA、阿波.en: Tabelog: Jonetsu no Buta, Premium AWAZA, 4-9-10 Itachibori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 117 m from Awaza Station; Tue–Sun 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Mondays; no cards, e-money or QR; counter; no smoking; opened 28 February 2023. Reviews (September–October 2026): summer-only hiyashi chuka with pork-cartilage chashu; the standard rich tsukemen ¥1,050; the maze-soba is good too; a punch different from ramen; the owner's character and the staff's cheerful atmosphere; one predicts it will become a Hyakumeiten; white rice with maze-soba; seafood tonkotsu ramen ¥970; seasoned egg ¥150; full at 18:30 on a rainy Tuesday; ticket machine; round bowls; a rich, creamy soup; medium-thick straight noodles; rice with ramen, meat and egg yolk; chashu, seasoned egg, wood-ear, nori, lots of leek; special tsukemen; 3 slices chashu; a dipping soup strong in tonkotsu; one called it ordinary.

食べログ: 慈雨 (JIU)、ダイニングバー・創作料理・ワインバー、四谷3-2-.en: Tabelog: JIU, dining bar, creative cuisine, wine bar; Yotsuya 3-2-7 2F; 3 min walk from Yotsuya-sanchome Station Exit 4; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 18:00–24:00; closed Wednesday (and two Tuesdays a month, announced on Instagram); reservations taken; private room from 5 people; cover (appetizer charge) ¥550; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 11 seats; non-smoking; opened 20 April 2024; seasonal vegetable obanzai; natural wines chosen by the owner; Georgian orange wine. Reviews (2025–2026): run by the owner alone; vegetable obanzai, 5 kinds; meatball and Chinese-cabbage soup; shungiku and bacon frittata; prawn toast; a steep staircase; easy to visit alone.

食べログ: 成都館、東上野3-14-4 長谷川ビル 1F、稲荷町駅から徒歩3分、.en: Tabelog: Seito Kan, Higashi-Ueno 3-14-4, 長谷川ビル 1F, 3 min on foot from Inaricho Station; Mon–Sat 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); closed Sundays; 8 seats; non-smoking all day; cards, e-money and QR accepted; school-age children welcome; takeout; vacuum-frozen dishes to take home; the second shop of a popular Sichuan restaurant in Ueno, with Chengdu dishes and creative Chinese food not served at the original; weekly lunch; all-you-can-eat-and-drink of the whole menu ¥4,480; 2-hour all-you-can-drink ¥2,300. Reviews (October 2025–October 2026): saliva chicken is the speciality (garlic, sweet-spicy, umami); Sichuan spicy chicken; mapo tofu (sweet bean sauce and fermented black beans, Sichuan pepper, rice refills); seafood and egg stir-fry set ¥900; Chengdu-style spicy pork liver stir-fry ¥980; Sichuan bang bang chicken; green-pepper beef; dumplings; mao cai ¥1,100 (sausage, shrimp, tofu, shimeji, vermicelli, spam, potato, chikuwa, wood ear); queues at lunch; three tables, up to 8 people.

食べログ: 手作り餃子 橋郷館、居酒屋・餃子・中華料理、大阪市淀川区木川西2-1.en: Tabelog: Tezukuri Gyoza Hashizato Kan; izakaya, gyoza, Chinese; 木川西2-1-14, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; about 13 minutes on foot from Juso Station, 15 from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; bus 93 from Osaka Station to the 木川西2丁目 stop; Mon and Wed–Sun 11:00–22:00; closed Tuesday; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 19 seats (7 at the counter, 12 at tables); private hire up to 20; non-smoking, smoking area outside; wheelchair accessible; opened 16 July 2022. Reviews (December 2023 to June 2026): run by a couple; choose fried, steamed or boiled; pork and cabbage, pork and green onion, pork and shiitake, pork and lotus root, pork and garlic, pork and cilantro, pork and cheese, garlic chives and shrimp, scallop, myoga, mapo-tofu gyoza, seasonal bamboo shoot; chewy skins; aged black vinegar; lunch sets ¥780 (six or ten gyoza, Liu Mama's mapo tofu, shredded potato stir-fry, green pepper and pork, nagaimo stir-fry); boiled gyoza set ¥1,000; Quick Drink Set ¥1,000 (saliva chicken, gyoza, beer); zhajiangmian; tomato and egg stir-fry ¥650; shrimp and broccoli; century-egg tofu; all-you-can-drink; fruit sours; Shaoxing wine; homemade plum drink.

食べログ: 手打ち麺 やす田、ラーメン、大阪市東淀川区東中島1-21-2 新大阪.en: Tabelog: Teuchi Men Yasuda; ramen; 1-21-2 Higashinakajima, Higashiyodogawa-ku, Osaka, unit 106; 4 minutes on foot from the east exit of JR Shin-Osaka Station; Tue–Sun 11:30–14:30 (until sold out); closed Monday; irregular holidays too; often closed temporarily; cash only; 7 counter seats; non-smoking (ashtray at the entrance); English menu; opened 13 September 2011; no tsukemen; run by the owner alone since March 2019, with the table seats closed; Tabelog Ramen 100 (WEST 2017–2022, OSAKA 2023–2025). Reviews (June 2025 to November 2026): shio ramen ¥900; the shio ramen broth is a clear type rich with fish stock; the noodles are extra-thick and curly; katsuo rice ¥200, with the rice far below the bonito flakes; kombu rice; chashu rice bowl; shoyu ramen; extra chashu ¥1,200; order verbally and pay after; no large size; the owner works alone and efficiently; hot inside; several diners found it temporarily closed.

食べログ: 担々麺くろおに、大阪市北区西天満3-11-3 老松小路D、なにわ橋か.en: Tabelog: Tantan-men Kuro Oni, Oimatsu Koji D, 3-11-3 Nishitenma, Kita-ku, Osaka; 297 m from Naniwabashi; Mon–Sat 11:00–22:00, Sun 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; cards (AMEX) and PayPay accepted, no e-money; opened 5 April 2018. Reviews (2020 – August 2026): a renovated old house; hard to find down a narrow alley, easy to mistake for a home; soupless black-sesame tantanmen (an almost black sesame paste, minced meat, chewy flat noodles, pasta-like presentation, choose heat, rice to finish); white-sesame tantanmen (chicken-based soup); cold white-sesame tantanmen on summer weekday evenings and weekends (chili oil, Sichuan pepper); small size; steamed-chicken topping; mouth-watering chicken; bite-size gyoza; Horo Yoi set and plenty of drinks; one found the soup weak; a calm atmosphere.

食べログ: 担々麺屋 オッソちゃん、大阪市阿倍野区松崎町2-3-20、大阪阿部野.en: Tabelog: Tantan-men Ya Osso Chan, 2-3-20 Matsuzakicho, Abeno-ku, Osaka; 265 m from Osaka-Abenobashi; Mon–Sat 11:00 until sold out (also given as until 15:00); closed Sundays; irregular closures (announced on Instagram); changes on event days; no cards, e-money or QR. Reviews (May–October 2026): known on social media; full within 5 minutes of the 11:00 opening; tom yum tantanmen ¥1,200 (¥1,100 at lunch); hot, numbing, sour and a little sweet; strong Sichuan pepper; supple thin noodles; meat miso; large noodles; ¥1,660 with coriander, seasoned egg and onion toppings; whiteboard specials (spicy leek, shredded pig's trotters, khao man gai); jasmine rice; fragrant chili oil and many flavour-changing condiments, with side plates; hand over menu chips slotted into an order board; staff explain for first-timers; about 8 counter seats and a table by the entrance; may be too hot for those who don't like heat.

食べログ: 拉麺 にわ鶏、ラーメン、大阪市淀川区西中島3-10-13、西中島南方.en: Tabelog: Chicken Ramen Niwatori; ramen; 3-10-13 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 226 m from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; Mon–Sat 18:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money and QR accepted; non-smoking; opened 8 June 2023.
