Reviews (December 2024 to August 2026): a little way down an alley; a sign saying it is a ramen shop where you can drink; chicken bone ramen of frothy, creamy chicken paitan ¥1,000; chicken-breast chashu; medium-thin noodles; chicken shoyu ramen ¥950 (medium-thick wavy noodles, pepper); chicken paitan curry ramen ¥1,050; extra noodles ¥230; chicken rice ¥450; kara-age and chicken-skin gyoza ¥150 each; croquette ¥250; minced cutlet; chicken tataki; chicken ham with yuzu pepper; bottled beer ¥650; pickled ginger, yuzu pepper, black pepper; pay after; the owner and a part-time staff member; customers from overseas too.

食べログ: 挽肉屋 神徳、銀座3-11-16 VORT銀座イースト1F、東銀座駅.en: Tabelog: Hikinikuya Jintoku, Ginza 3-11-16, VORT Ginza East 1F, 1 minute from Higashi-Ginza Station (Asakusa line); 20 seats (counter and two tables for 2); daily 11:30–16:00, 18:00–21:00; closed at Obon and New Year; opened April 15, 2022; cards (VISA, Master), IC and QR accepted; a calm Japanese interior. October 2026 reviews: freshly grilled hamburg steaks — 100% beef, a beef-pork-lamb blend, fish (sometimes sold out) — with salt, sauce or mustard; rice bowls; hamburg steak eaten with dashi; free refills of rice and miso soup; a two-kind set ¥1,850.

食べログ: 支那そば屋 こうや、ラーメン・中華料理・居酒屋、四谷1-23 上野K.en: Tabelog: China Soba-ya Koya, ramen, Chinese, izakaya; 上野KGビル 1F, Yotsuya 1-23; 4 min walk from Yotsuya Station; Mon 11:30–21:30, Tue–Fri 11:30–22:00, Sat 11:30–21:00; closed Sundays; holidays posted on X (@yotsuya_koya); bookings for 3 or more until 19:00; ¥250 seat fee for online bookings; 60 seats (10 at the counter, 50 at tables); non-smoking; no cards or e-money, PayPay accepted; children welcome. Reviews (July–October 2026): founded 1983, moved a short way after an eviction, wonton noodles ¥1,250, seasoned egg ¥150, vegetable-heaped tantanmen ¥1,300, a super-spicy noodle, plate wontons, assorted simmered dishes, stir-fried horumon, Shaoxing wine, a gentle broth, some found wontons undercooked.

食べログ: 支那麺 はしご 本店、銀座6-3-5 第二ソワレ・ド・ビル1F、24.en: Tabelog: Shina-men Hashigo main shop, Ginza 6-3-5, Dai-ni Soiree de Building 1F; 24 seats; weekdays 11:00–5:00, weekends and holidays 11:00–21:00; cash only; in August 2009 the main shop on B1F of the Ginza Toshiba Building was merged into this one. 2026 reviews: dandanmen (tantanmen), paigu dandanmen, aromas of sesame, yuzu and curry, thin noodles, tantanmen with thick-cut pork ¥1,200, fried spare ribs, gyoza, zha cai; order after sitting down.

食べログ: 文福、居酒屋、ふぐ、おでん、日本橋人形町2-6-12 渡辺ビル 2F.en: Tabelog: Bunbuku; izakaya, fugu, oden; 渡辺ビル 2F–3F, Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-6-12; 3 min from Ningyocho Station; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00; closed Sat, Sun and holidays; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; non-smoking; children welcome; vegetarian options listed. Reviews (February 2025–April 2026): a long-established Ningyocho izakaya; lunch on the 3rd floor: sashimi set, mixed fry set ¥1,050, grilled salmon, conger-eel tempura ¥1,150, each with clay-pot rice (one refill), miso soup, a small side and chawanmushi; at night sashimi platters, oden in a clear broth, homemade hanpen, ankimo, tempura; a friendly owner and staff; some days Showa-era songs playing.

食べログ: 料太、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-15 丸清ビル 4F B、心斎橋.en: Tabelog: Ryota, Marusei Bldg 4F B, 1-17-15 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 1 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; 18:00–24:00; irregular closing days (check Tabelog online booking); may close when ingredients run out; takeaway available; table-charge starter (included in courses); heated tobacco only; cards (including UnionPay) accepted, no e-money or QR; 6–8 seats; private hire for 6 or more; opened 23 April 2024. Reviews (July–October 2026): 7-dish course with all-you-can-drink ¥11,000; simmered mizuna and beef; octopus and winter melon; mozuku in vinegar; sashimi of tuna, seared barracuda, squid, sea urchin, crab meat with crab miso, horse sashimi; lotus-root manju in kuzu sauce; Saikyo-grilled flounder; tempura of hamo, corn and okra; clay-pot rice with ayu, corn and edamame; house dessert; leftover rice made into rice balls; same-day booking; kamameshi; Kyoto vegetables; open Sunday nights; the owner runs it single-handed; firm-fleshed tuna; fresh sea urchin; well-grilled steak; shows you the ingredient packaging; round taro manju; shirako; abalone with liver sauce; the entrance is a little hard to find; plenty of sake.

食べログ: 料理店オクノ、大阪市浪速区難波中1-16-4、南海なんば駅から徒歩3.en: Tabelog: Ryori Ten Okuno, Nambanaka 1-16-4, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 3 min from Nankai Namba Stn; daily 12:00–14:30 and 17:00–23:30; irregular closures; lunch by reservation only, omakase of 5 dishes ¥3,500 or 8 dishes ¥5,000; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 17 seats (counter 5, tables of 4 ×3); non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; sommelier on staff; opened 13 September 2023. Shop's introduction: playful Italian from an open kitchen, Italian regional cooking with Japanese, Chinese and ethnic ideas, handmade pasta with sauces that change with the season (Ezo deer, porcini), natural wines chosen by sommelier staff, a daily-changing menu, omakase courses. Reviews (June 2025–October 2026): foie gras omelet, carpaccio, crisp-skinned Spanish mackerel, lamb hamburg, beef cheek braised in red wine, baked cheese stuffed with mushrooms and wild boar, fish and pesto pasta, truffle and pork pasta, homemade ricotta and prosciutto, wine by the decanter, one chef cooking with 20–30 minutes between dishes, a regular since the previous owner.

食べログ: 新大阪 海鮮食堂 おーうえすと、居酒屋・海鮮・日本料理、大阪市東淀川.en: Tabelog: Shin-Osaka Kaisen Shokudo O-west; izakaya, seafood, Japanese; アネシス新大阪 1F, 東中島1-20-2, Higashiyodogawa-ku, Osaka; 2 minutes on foot from the JR Shin-Osaka east exit; daily 11:30–24:00 (last order 23:00); reservations accepted; same-day cancellation 100% for courses, ¥4,000 a head for seats only; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 72 seats (30 on sunken kotatsu); smoking allowed (all seats non-smoking 11:30–13:00); opened 1 June 2016. Gurunavi: the signature Soten cured-mackerel sashimi. Reviews (October 2025 to October 2026): thick-cut sashimi platters; lunch from three choices ¥1,100; seafood bowl with sweet soy sauce, large size free; grilled shellfish; sanma three ways; seafood salad with ikura; assorted tempura; eel sushi; kara-age; smoked potato salad; all-you-can-drink with sashimi; daytime drinking; no call button; lively; smoking allowed.

食べログ: 新大阪昼呑み酒場 SAKE ヤシマ、居酒屋・日本酒バー、大阪市淀川区.en: Tabelog: Shin Osaka Hirunomi Sakaba SAKE Yashima, izakaya and sake bar, 7-9-15 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; Mon and Sat 12:00–18:00, Wed, Thu and Fri 12:00–21:30, closed Tue and Sun; reservations accepted; cards (AMEX), e-money and QR accepted; 18 seats; non-smoking; private hire available; opened 6 January 2021. The shop's introduction: a daytime sake place a short walk from Shin-Osaka Station, healthy lunches and spice curry, warm sake from noon, over 50 sakes to go with the side dishes. Reviews (March to October 2026): about 3 min from Exit 7 of the Midosuji Line; 90 ml, 60 ml or 45 ml; daily set ¥1,000; deluxe gozen of two daily dishes, half a spice curry and brown rice ¥1,300; stuffed peppers, hamburg steak, a curry of lotus root and beans, simmered white-fish head; Hirunomi Set with two sakes ¥1,500; mackerel green curry and a lotus-root-and-bean dry keema; chicken tempura; the chef's pasta on Thursdays, sanma pasta; Omi beef tendon and red konnyaku unohana; Kitajima sake; warm sake chosen by the owner; tables on the second floor; sake events; two staff, so lunch takes time; a big sake-bottle sign.

食べログ: 新橋ニューともちん、新橋駅前ビルB1F、平日8:00〜17:00、祝.en: Tabelog: Shimbashi New Tomochin, Shimbashi Ekimae Building B1F; weekdays 8:00–17:00, holidays 10:00–16:00, closed weekends; a notice that regular hours with a 9:30 opening resume from October 28; cash only; 6 seats; opened September 29, 2023; note: "4th shop of Koenji's 'Tomochin Ramen'". October 2026 reviews: chuka soba ¥850, wakame ¥100, rice free (refills OK), standing counter.

食べログ: 新町あだち、大阪市西区新町3-8-10 エステムコート大阪新町 1F.en: Tabelog: Shinmachi Adachi, エステムコート大阪新町 1F, 3-8-10 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nishi-Nagahori Station Exit 1, 7 min from Awaza Station; lunch Wednesday and Saturday only, everyone starting at 12:00; Tuesday, Thursday and Friday private hire for four or more; dinner Monday–Saturday, first seating 18:00 or 19:00, second 20:30; closed Sundays, holidays and the 1st of each month (menu and tableware change); reservations accepted; allergies and dislikes in the booking request field; no ingredient changes on the day; late arrivals may get fewer dishes; cancellation 50% the day before, 100% on the day; service charge 5% at lunch, 10% at dinner; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 7 counter seats; non-smoking; private hire available; opened 28 February 2020. Shop text: seasonal menus and tableware changed monthly; the chef adds personal twists to dishes learned in training; in the Michelin Guide within a year of opening; the sake-loving owner stocks junmai daiginjo and rare labels such as Jikon as well as seasonal releases. Shop website: seven seats a day; "because we were born and raised in Japan, we want guests to touch the culture and customs handed down from long ago"; entry at 18:00, 19:00 or 20:30, with no turnover; omakase course ¥16,500 (appetizer, a small starter, soup, sashimi, hassun, a substantial dish, a single dish, fried dish, rice, sweet); the menu card deliberately lists only the ingredients; the tableware changes monthly too; sake vessels include Old Baccarat; the clay-pot rice is a blend made for the shop; lunch ¥9,900; closed Sundays and holidays. TableCheck: lunch kaiseki ¥9,900 (8 dishes); dinner kaiseki ¥16,500 (10 dishes); ¥9,900 (8 dishes) at the 20:30 seating only; December ¥19,800 at dinner and ¥12,100 at lunch (snow crab and other seasonal ingredients); give details of allergies and dislikes, as same-day requests may not be possible. Michelin Guide: an owner who loves traditional Japanese culture and weaves New Year, Setsubun and the Doll Festival into the menu. Reviews (May–October 2026): Adachi is the owner; a counter decorated with tea-ceremony utensils; everyone starts together; the Boys' Day festival in May, a Tanabata hassun in July, chrysanthemums for the Double Ninth in September, moon viewing in October; purple sea urchin; steamed abalone rice with liver sauce; red sea urchin, Akashi sea bream, needle squid; salt-grilled ayu; hamo tempura; Miyazaki beef with matsutake; Kagoshima beef with mushroom sauce; clay-pot rice; chirimen sansho; leftover rice made into rice balls to take home; a dashimaki on the house when a diner went back for more rice; sake by the glass; a choice of glass or ceramic sake cups; a lively, fun chef and apprentices; delicate flavours, like being in Kyoto.

食べログ: 新町カリー、大阪市西区新町2-11-12 1F、西大橋駅から282m.en: Tabelog: Shimmachi Curry, 1F, 2-11-12 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 282 m from Nishi-Ohashi; Mon–Sat 11:00–16:00; closed Sundays; irregular closing days; no cards, e-money or QR; 10 seats (counter about 7, one table for 4). Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): opened around August 2025, first anniversary in 2026; a small shop with a green awning; run by two people who remember faces; dashi spice curries; a base of chicken stock with Shodoshima shoyu, or bonito-flake Japanese dashi with soy milk; keema of chicken and pork, or fish (cod); sides (gizzard achar, salmon achar); (chicken stock & Shodoshima shoyu) fish keema + sides (¥1,450); surume squid & clam-dashi Thai curry (¥200); house egg masala (¥200); coriander; shrimp curry Thu–Sat; limited San Gen pork and squid; spicy chicken plate; truffle crackers with house cream cheese; potato salad; cash only.

食べログ: 新町蕎麦切り てるてる、そば・居酒屋、西区新町1-31-3 ダイヤパ.en: Tabelog: Shinmachi Sobakiri Teruteru, soba and izakaya, Shinmachi 1-31-3, Nishi-ku, ダイヤパレス四ツ橋 1F, 162 m from Nishi-Ohashi Station, Thu–Sat 18:00–22:00, Sun 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–22:00, closed Monday to Wednesday, until sold out, reservations only for the 18:00 opening, cards and QR, non-smoking, no small children. Reviews (January–October 2026): run by a couple, on 新町南通り, small bottle of Yebisu ¥700, itawasa ¥480 (with wasabi and sea-urchin miso), spicy grated daikon with jako ¥480, 高千代 dry junmai unfiltered draft sake ¥1,600, firefly squid okizuke ¥480, mori soba 100% buckwheat ¥950, mori soba 80/20 ¥950, five kinds of soba (seiro, coarse-ground seiro, coarse-ground inaka, sarashina, grilled buckwheat), duck dipping soba, dashimaki, sobagaki, a queue before opening for Sunday lunch, no rice bowls, jazz playing.

食べログ: 新鮮処ととろ、大阪市西区新町2-17-10、西大橋駅1番出口から徒歩.en: Tabelog: Shinsen Dokoro Totoro, 2-17-10 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station Exit 1, 7 min from Nishi-Nagahori Station Exit 1; daily 18:00–22:30 (closing time approximate; closes early when ingredients run out); reopened on Tuesday 20 October after hospitalization and recovery; temporarily closed Tuesday 27 October; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money or QR; otoshi served; 17 seats (all tables since a September 2018 renovation); private use up to 20; smoking allowed, so under-20s cannot enter; Osaka City premium gift certificates accepted until 15 January 2027. Shop website: 有限会社アイランド・フィールド; hours 18:00–22:30 (closing time approximate); last order 22:00 (horse-meat dishes 21:30); no regular closing day (temporary closures); cash only; a two-dish otoshi ¥550 to start; horse meat from Kumamoto, jidori from Miyazaki, winter oysters from Kurahashi-jima (Hiroshima), rock oysters from Oki (Shimane), fish direct from Onagawa port (Miyagi), Yawatahama (Ehime) and elsewhere; rare regional sake from small breweries, changed each season. Horse sashimi: tongue, barahimo and futaego ¥1,500 each, raw liver ¥2,600 (reservation priority), lean ¥1,700, tategami ¥1,500, sakura-toro rice bowl ¥1,600, platters of 3 kinds ¥3,500, 4 kinds ¥4,000, 5 kinds ¥4,600; ordered on the day it takes 40 minutes to an hour. Jidori specialty: salt-grilled thigh ¥900. Fried fugu ¥990, fugu skin, whale bacon, salt-grilled yellowtail collar, shrimp tempura, chicken kara-age, grilled miso (with buckwheat groats). From 28 October 2026 the autumn–winter specialty, the monkfish hot pot loaded with liver: ¥5,700 a person, or ¥7,000 a person as a set with a horse sashimi platter, both from two servings; the set needs booking by the day before; the head cook can only fillet so many monkfish, so it sells out. Summer: live hamo and onion Awaji hot pot; spring: moray eel from Kochi. Ozeki junmai daiginjo kuradashi nama genshu, poured at only 100 shops in Japan (May 2026); regional sake by the 90 ml glass or the 1-gō katakuchi flask. Closed late August to 10 October 2025 for staff illness, in spring 2026 for surgery and recovery, and from 1 July 2026 for illness and recovery, reopening 20 October. Reviews (December 2021 – March 2026): the monkfish hot pot loaded with liver is rich; follow the house way and put in half without lighting the burner; udon and zosui to finish; more liver broth added when the pot runs low; a soy sauce made for horse sashimi; booked a month ahead; walk-ins were being turned away; signed photos of celebrities; Haruma Miura visited three times; run by an elderly couple; a warm, motherly atmosphere; table seats only, but fine alone; no cards; about ¥8,000–10,000 a person.

食べログ: 日夏屋、大阪市浪速区難波中3-16-11、大国町から426m、毎日1.en: Tabelog: Hinatsuya, 3-16-11 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 426 m from Daikokucho; daily 11:00–23:00; no cards, e-money or QR; opened 14 June 2025. Reviews (June 2025 – October 2026): vegetable ramen ¥1,000, heaped with mostly cabbage; a free noodle refill or rice; ticket machine; light tonkotsu and thin noodles; free rice; a black bowl; a creamy, slightly frothy white soup; thin straight noodles; seared fatty chashu; soft-boiled egg; leek; nori; free rice and kimchi; wrap rice in soup-soaked nori; 5 quail eggs; onion, kimchi, one noodle refill and rice free; doubanjiang, garlic, pepper; one prefers it to Mugen Ramen next door; tonkotsu ramen ¥850; light strength; some saltiness; fried rice; karaage set meal; open late; many overseas staff and diners; courteous service; not greasy, salt restrained.

食べログ: 日本ばし やぶ久 銀座店、銀座3-3-6 銀座モリタビルB1F、30.en: Tabelog: Nihonbashi Yabu Kyu Ginza, Ginza 3-3-6, Ginza Morita Building B1F; 30 seats, private rooms; Tue–Sat 11:00–15:00, 17:00–22:00, Sundays and holidays until 21:30, closed Mon; opened March 4, 2019; official site yabukyu.com. Shop introduction: soba and sake for over 120 years. 2026 reviews: an apron for the curry nanban; black-pork curry bowl set ¥2,200; buckwheat tea; karasumi with daikon; itawasa; curry soba to finish; seasonal vegetable platter; courses for entertaining in private rooms; 2-hour limit; some say the staff are loud; also the Nihonbashi main shop.

食べログ: 日本料理、下京区中居町112-1、京都駅より徒歩5分、東本願寺のお堀.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; 中居町112-1, Shimogyo-ku; 5 min walk from Kyoto Stn, facing the moat of Higashi Hongan-ji, behind Shichijo-dori; lunch 12:00–14:00, dinner 18:00–21:00; closed irregularly; reservation only; 5% service charge, no table charge; 16 seats (8-seat counter, private rooms for 2–8); non-smoking; cards accepted; kaiseki in a 100-year-old renovated townhouse; Kyoto cuisine with French; organic soy sauce, salt and mirin; signature seasonal salad; vegetarian menus cannot be accommodated because of the course format; head chef Shohei Noguchi. Reviews (August 2025–October 2026, in English): from Fukushima; to France in 2010; a Michelin-starred French restaurant in Osaka; sushi training at Fuku Sushi Mori; the 2019 star was under the previous chef; a chef born in 1990; young staff; corn blancmange; Miwa somen; hamo; Kumamoto conger uzaku; ayu kamameshi; lunch prices up from October; complaints about value.

食べログ: 日本料理、下京区寺町仏光寺上ル中之町582、毎日12:00〜14:3.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; Teramachi north of Bukkoji, Shimogyo-ku; every day 12:00–14:30 and 18:00–21:30 (dinner 18:00–18:30 on days before and after public holidays); closed irregularly; bookings taken; 20 seats (8 counter, two sunken-seat tatami rooms for up to 12); no smoking; children only from middle school, ordering the same course as adults; dress: fine unless overly casual; cards accepted; no e-money or QR. Reviews (March–October 2026, in English): lunch courses ¥6,600 and ¥8,800; special lunch kaiseki; dinner ¥13,500 (private room ¥1,500); Kyoto cuisine with many meat dishes; roast beef; grilled oxtail; beef cheek in white miso; sea-bream kamameshi; the proprietress's attentive care.

食べログ: 日本料理、中京区押小路通高倉東入竹屋町150、月〜土 12:00〜1.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; Oshikoji-dori Takakura-higashi-iru, Nakagyo-ku; Mon–Sat 12:00–14:30 (last order 12:00) and 18:00–23:00 (last order 20:00); Sunday also breakfast 9:00–10:30; time needed: dinner 2.5–3 hours, lunch 2 hours or more, breakfast 1 hour or more; closed irregularly; closed 29–30 December (31st osechi pickup only); reservation only, by phone or DM; cancellation fees (30% from 7 days before, 50% the day before, 100% on the day or with no contact); no basic service charge (10% if someone does not order food); 7 seats (counter only); private hire from 5; smoking only in the garden; shoes off; only one red and one white wine, so bring your own (fee); children from primary school (preschoolers allowed if the room is booked by 4 or more adults); cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 6 June 2015; Tabelog Award Bronze 2017–2020. Reviews (January–August 2026, in English): omakase ¥9,900; six-sake pairing ¥3,520; Sunday breakfast ¥4,950 (clay-pot rice and miso soup refills); 6 seats at an L-shaped counter; the owner alone from cooking to drinks; born and raised in Kyoto; 11th year; bear-meat hot pot; hojicha ice cream.

食べログ: 日本料理、中京区蛸薬師通新京極西入ル東側町498、阪急河原町駅から徒.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; 中京区蛸薬師通新京極西入ル東側町498; 4 min on foot from Kawaramachi Stn (Hankyu); 18:00–23:00; closed Wednesday and Sunday; reservations accepted; 11 seats (counter); no cards, e-money or QR; non-smoking. Reviews (March 2025–July 2026, in English): family-run, a couple at the counter, a wall menu without prices, egg tofu, kizushi, anago (grilled or blanched), anago don, hamo, uzaku, grilled guji, grilled shirako, roast duck with Worcestershire sauce, fried small taro, about ¥6,000–7,000 a head, an article by a former DANCHU editor-in-chief, Waraku web, a KBS programme.

食べログ: 日本料理、中京区車屋町通御池上ル塗師屋町333-2、烏丸御池駅から徒.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; north of Oike, Nakagyo Ward; 3 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn; all guests start together at 18:00; closed Sunday and Monday; reservation only; tell the restaurant about allergies and dislikes in advance; contact Tuesday–Saturday 12:00–17:00; 8 seats (up to 6 bookable online); non-smoking; cards and e-money accepted. Reviews (February 2025–August 2026, English): opened September 2022; renovated townhouse; evening course ¥20,000; rice porridge (eel tsukudani, clams, female snow crab (Koppe)); Densuke conger eel; firefly squid (Hyogo, later Toyama); lily bulb with karasumi; saba sushi; conger eel sushi; clay-pot rice with six accompaniments; a wait of a year and a half to two years for bookings; cancellation slots on TableCheck; the chef runs it alone.

食べログ: 日本料理、中京区鍋屋町212-3 先斗町25番路地、阪急京都河原町駅.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; 鍋屋町212-3, Nakagyo-ku, Pontocho alley No. 25; 2 min walk from Hankyu Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn, 4 min from Gion-Shijo Stn; course from 18:00, à la carte from 21:00 (closing time not fixed); reservations accepted; 8 seats; no cards, e-money or QR; non-smoking. Reviews (2025–2026, in English): a young owner runs it alone; trained at a famous Osaka restaurant; said to have been listed in the Michelin Guide a year after opening; course ¥12,000; abalone rice porridge; clay-pot rice with refills; peanut rice; umaki; sesame vinegar; karasumi mochi; fugu; beef cutlet; Iso Curry; rare sakes; children welcome; look for the alley number.

食べログ: 日本料理、南区東九条西山王町15-2、京都駅八条口から5分、Dail.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; 南区東九条西山王町15-2; 5 min from Kyoto Stn Hachijo exit; two doors from Daily Yamazaki (Google Maps shows the wrong spot); Mon–Sat 17:30–23:00; closed Sunday; reservations accepted; appetiser about ¥900 (varies by season); 12 seats; no cards, e-money or QR; non-smoking; opened 18 April 2013. Reviews (June–October 2026, in English): an à la carte counter, assorted sashimi (shima-aji, isaki, sea urchin, Biwa trout, toro), hamo, ayu grilled in front of you, white shrimp and lily-bulb tempura, simmered kinmedai, duck and truffle noodles, mackerel sushi, nama-fu dengaku, a mark for dishes suited to solo diners, many regulars, three to five tries to book, the okami's attentiveness, about ¥9,000–15,000 a head.

食べログ: 日本料理、左京区新丸太町41-1、京阪三条駅から徒歩4分、市役所前駅.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; 左京区新丸太町41-1; 4 min on foot from Keihan Sanjo Stn, 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn; Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00 (last entry 21:30); closed Sunday (open on holidays); reservations accepted; seat-only bookings choose dishes on the day; no seat-only bookings for guests from overseas; no preschool children; 8 counter seats; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; BYO possible; cards accepted; opened 21 July 2021; near Chomyo-ji, known for its gate with Niō statues by Unkei; charcoal grilling and tempura; Murazawa beef from Southern Nagano; sake tasting flights. Reviews (October 2025–August 2026, in English): three starters then à la carte; straw-grilled yellowtail; crab and yellow-leek spring rolls; sea bream grilled with scales; shirako; uzaku; red miso soup; ayu; hamo; run by two people; no prices shown, and one guest paid about ¥10,000 more than expected (May 2026).

食べログ: 日本料理、東山区八坂新地末吉町78、祇園四条から徒歩約5分、月〜土.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; 八坂新地末吉町78, Higashiyama-ku; about 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo; Monday–Saturday 11:30–13:30 and 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday; reservations accepted; 10 seats; private room (sunken table for 4, divided by sliding doors); non-smoking; cards accepted. Reviews (January 2025–September 2026, in English): lunch set ¥2,500 (¥1,600 in 2016); dashimaki grilled in front of you; skewer-grilled fish; sake-lees soup; chirimen-sansho; rice refills; extras from the evening menu; karasumi; kabura-mushi; crab; a friendly head chef; said to be of the Tankuma lineage; booking needed.

食べログ: 日本料理、東山区大和大路通四条上ル常磐町149-1 幕間ビル2F、京.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; 東山区大和大路通四条上ル常磐町149-1 幕間ビル 2F; about 2 min on foot from Gion-Shijo Stn (Keihan); no hours given; reservations accepted; 14 seats (8 at the counter, 6 at tables); smoking only at the counter; no cards, e-money or QR; opened 28 October 2010. Reviews (March 2023–April 2026, in English): a woman owner and a male member of staff, an owner who used to work in an office, featured on Kazuhiko Ota's programme, opposite the Minami-za, a handwritten menu, omakase sashimi, hamo, dobin-mushi, kombu-cured fish, roast beef with sea urchin, tempura, Toyo Bijin, Tatenokawa, 14th anniversary (October 2025), cash only.

食べログ: 日本料理、東山区末吉町88 サカタビル1階、河原町駅から8分、昼11.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; 東山区末吉町88 サカタビル 1F; 8 min from Kawaramachi Stn; lunch from 11:30 and dinner from 17:00 (about two hours for lunch, three for dinner); closed Thursday; reservation only (from two people); lunch ¥6,500; service included; no cards, e-money or QR; dress code; 9 seats (counter); non-smoking. Reviews (May 2024–July 2026, in English): kaiseki in Gion for about 30 years, the owner Mr. Oogami, a menu that changes monthly, beautiful tableware, a TV programme with Hayashi Osamu (January 2019), lunch course ¥6,500–7,000, everyone starting at once, kamameshi wrapped in leaves as rice balls to take home, a chef who looks stern but is friendly and funny, an apprentice, bottled Asahi, a half bottle of Chablis.

食べログ: 日本料理、東山区祇園町北側347-108 楽宴小路内、祇園四条駅から.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; inside Rakuen-koji alley, Gion, Higashiyama Ward; about 7 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn, about 3 min from the Gion bus stop; Mon–Sat 11:30–13:00 (lunch is a course booked by the day before) and 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday; may close early; reservations accepted; 8 counter seats; non-smoking; cards accepted. Reviews (October 2025–October 2026, English): opened 2018; the owner is from Kagawa and trained at Takada Hassho in Gifu; the name means seasonal food just as it is; straw-seared bonito; Akashi sawara; Awaji mackerel and conger eel; kuruma-shrimp shinjo; salt-grilled Onaga; Saikyo-miso grilled fish; saba sushi; Omi beef tenderloin; omakase and à la carte; described as Michelin-listed; one diner was troubled by food waste.

食べログ: 日本料理、東山区祇園町北側347-93、祇園四条駅9番出口から徒歩4.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; 東山区祇園町北側347-93; 4 min on foot from exit 9 of Gion-Shijo Stn; Mon–Sat and holidays 12:00–14:00 (lunch by reservation only) and 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday; 21 seats (11 at the counter; private rooms and a tatami room upstairs, room fee ¥1,000); private hire possible; non-smoking; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; seasonal fish and vegetables over charcoal and in a brick oven; sake, shochu, wine; à la carte from January 2026; for à la carte parties of four or more, appetisers and sashimi are prepared ahead. Reviews (May 2025–October 2026, in English): owner Naoto Umetsu went independent after heading the kitchen at Kappou Nakagawa; the owner is from Kumamoto, hence horse sashimi; omakase of about 10 dishes ¥11,500 (May 2025); Kamigamo vegetables, young ayu, matsutake soup, fried conger eel, charcoal-grilled wagyu fillet, chirimenjako rice, three-shellfish platter, karasumi mochi, grilled shirako, honmoroko, mackerel sushi; many regulars; one guest found it cold to outsiders and the food average (October 2025).

食べログ: 日本料理、東山区祇園町南側570-6、月〜土 17:00〜24:00.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine; 東山区祇園町南側570-6; Mon–Sat 17:00–24:00; closed Sunday and holidays; reservations accepted (from two months ahead); 5% service charge; 25 seats; private room (8 people); non-smoking; cards accepted. Reviews (July 2025–July 2026, in English): Hanamikoji, à la carte and omakase, hairy crab, vinegared squid, miso-marinated bonito, nodoguro, hamo, sesame tofu, sashimi, raw oysters, vinegared sweet shrimp, grilled fugu shirako, fried fugu, whale with mizuna, steamed anago sushi, mackerel sushi, chirimen to take home, corn tempura, rice porridge to finish, slow service at year-end, a remark that it is in the Michelin Guide, ¥20,000–30,000 a head.

食べログ: 日本料理・ふぐ・海鮮、東山区弁財天町15 スペース新橋 2F、月〜土.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine, fugu, seafood; スペース新橋 2F, Higashiyama-ku; Mon–Sat 18:00–22:30; closed Sunday; lunch by reservation by the day before; bookings taken (fee for same-day cancellation; seats-only bookings cancelled after 15 minutes late); 10% room charge for a private room used by four or fewer; 18 seats (10 counter, 8 table); private room (table on tatami, 4–8); smoking allowed (no smoking at lunch only); cards accepted; no e-money or QR; seafood from Wakasa Bay (Wakasa guji, fugu, Echizen crab); wagyu, wild boar, duck; tables with a view of the Kamo River. Reviews (July 2023 – September 2026, in English): mostly à la carte; four or five ways to cook each ingredient; Echizen red snow crab; Obama botan shrimp; shime saba; whale; milt; bear meat; kasujiru; kabura with Hatcho miso; daily specials on a blackboard; three people: the owner, a young assistant and a part-timer.

食べログ: 日本料理・居酒屋、中京区三条木屋町石屋町121 先斗町松嶋屋ビル B.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine, izakaya; B1F, 121, Sanjo Kiyamachi, Nakagyo Ward; 3 min walk from Sanjo Stn; 16:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); open year-round; reservations accepted; 34 seats (8 at the counter, 6 on a raised tatami area, 20 at tables); private hire up to 23; heated-tobacco smoking area outside; cards and QR accepted; fish delivered daily from Akashi port; 40 local sakes and 30 shochu from around Japan; Tanba wine; the signature is grilled Akashi anago. Reviews (March 2025–August 2026, English): a hidden basement spot; over 30 years; the chef took over from the previous owner; Akashi octopus; sea bream simmered in soy; dashi omelette; croquettes with black beans; kabura-mushi; one diner had dishes arrive at once and go cold.

食べログ: 日本料理・居酒屋、中京区二条寺町西入丁子屋町694-3、京都市役所前.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine, izakaya; 694-3, Nijo-dori west of Teramachi, Nakagyo Ward; 3 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn; Tue–Sat 17:00–23:00 (last entry 21:00, L.O. 22:00); Sun 17:00–21:30 (last entry 20:00); closed Monday and two consecutive days a month; phone 12:00–16:00; no service charge or cover; 22 seats (10 at the counter, private rooms); non-smoking; cards accepted; opened 18 August 2015; the name means changing constantly in order to stay the same. Reviews (November 2025–November 2026, English): no prices on the menu; about ¥15,000–20,000 a head; karasumi mochi and crab cream croquettes are the signatures; charcoal-grilled fish; hairy crab; beef cutlet sandwich to take away; one heard the previous owner opened a Kyoto restaurant in Milan the year before; one found the service slow.

食べログ: 日本料理・居酒屋、中京区四条通先斗上ル鍋屋町209-6 21番路地.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine, izakaya; 21番路地 1F, Pontocho north of Shijo, Nakagyo-ku; every day 17:30–22:30 (last order 22:00); closed irregularly; bookings taken; bookings cancelled automatically if more than 15 minutes late without notice; table charge ¥1,000 (with an appetiser); 18 seats (6 counter, 12 table); no smoking; children and strollers welcome; cards accepted; no e-money or QR. For overseas guests: no English menu; foreign guests are offered a course only, ¥7,500 (tax included), four dishes recommended by the owner (appetiser platter, chicken and root-vegetable soup, original fish tempura, miso-grilled fish; changes with the season); the owner cannot explain the dishes in English. Reviews (February–October 2026, in English): hassun; obanzai in threes and fives; dashimaki; yuba sashimi; fried nama-fu salad; beef and Kujo leek simmered in white miso; conger eel and lotus root clear soup; a wide sake list; 25th anniversary (autumn 2026).

食べログ: 日本料理・居酒屋、中京区材木町181-2 ニュー京都ビル1F、17:.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine, izakaya; 中京区材木町181-2 ニュー京都ビル 1F; 17:00–23:00; closed Monday and some Sundays; reservations accepted; 11 seats (6 at the counter, 1 table); non-smoking; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); opened 24 January 2013. Reviews (September 2025–October 2026, in English): a cheerful owner with a Kyoto accent, obanzai laid out on the counter, shima-aji and yuba sashimi, shinoda-maki, fried ebi-imo, sea bream with turnip ¥980, herring with eggplant ¥880, kamo eggplant simmered with grated daikon ¥1,080, shrimp tsukune with plum sauce ¥580, Mibu greens, nama-fu, shrimp cream rice to finish, bookings at 17:30 or 20:30, many guests from abroad, a TV crew (October 2026).

食べログ: 日本料理・居酒屋、東山区四条花見小路上1筋目東入 ギオンプラザビル5.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine, izakaya; 東山区四条花見小路上1筋目東入 ギオンプラザビル 5F; 5 min on foot from Gion-Shijo Stn; Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00); closed Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted (changes and cancellations by phone; treated as cancelled 30 minutes late); otoshi ¥770; 18 seats (6 at the counter, 12 at tables); non-smoking; cards and PayPay accepted; loved by locals in Gion for 50 years; seasonal fish and obanzai; over 50 dishes changing daily; about 8 local sakes; Kyoto duck aburi, grilled eel skewers, sweetfish, hamo. Reviews (February 2025–September 2026, in English): a Showa-era building down a narrow alley; hamo and yuba, beef tataki, sanma, matsutake dobin-mushi, firefly-squid tempura; no prices on the menu; one guest was bothered by the chef correcting staff in front of diners (June 2025); children welcome.

食べログ: 日本料理・海鮮、東山区祇園町南側570番地6、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine, seafood; 570-6 in south Gion, Higashiyama Ward; 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn; 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed some Sundays and public holidays; reservations accepted; same-day cancellation charged at 100% of the course; please avoid perfume and strong scents; 10% service charge; omakase courses ¥20,000, ¥25,000 and ¥30,000 (before tax and service); 20 seats (10 at the 1F counter, a table for 6, a 2F private room for 4); smoking allowed in the private room; cards accepted; a sake sommelier and a wine sommelier; a bar salon on the 2F. Reviews (May 2024–May 2026, English): game (wild boar, badger, bear hot pot, deer, green sea turtle, suppon); Akashi sea bream; Matsuba crab; a handwritten à la carte menu; katsu sandwich to take away; reopened after renovation in March 2026; some say the lively chef makes the room loud.

食べログ: 日本料理・釜飯、中京区先斗町通三条下ル材木町188、河原町駅から8分.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine, kamameshi; 中京区先斗町通三条下ル材木町188; 8 min from Kawaramachi Stn; 17:00–22:00; closed Monday; reservations accepted (no entry without one, October 2025); dress code; no service charge; 28 seats (10 at the counter, 4 on a raised floor, private rooms upstairs); cards (VISA, JCB, AMEX, Diners); a second shop across the street; the kamameshi is delicious. Reviews (September 2025–June 2026, in English): fried guji, Yawata-maki, dashimaki, duck manjū, vegetable ankake, dengaku, grilled shirako, sea urchin with fresh yuba, fried small taro, fried shrimp, firefly squid nuta, hamo tempura, a matsutake and hamo pot, oyster or anago kamameshi, brown-sugar sorbet, the tatami room upstairs, 20:00 easier to book at weekends.

食べログ: 日本料理・魚介料理、上京区信富町315-4、神宮丸太町駅・市役所前駅.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine, seafood; 上京区信富町315-4; 10 min on foot from Jingu-Marutamachi or Shiyakusho-mae Stn; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 17:30–22:00 (last entry 19:00, no second sitting; same-day bookings by 18:00); closed Wednesday and twice a month irregularly; reservation only; Tabelog bookings cannot choose seats; no bookings without a Japanese phone number; 10% service charge; 7 counter seats; private rooms for 2–3; non-smoking; cards and PayPay accepted; seasonal seafood, Kyoto vegetables and Tanba black wagyu, as courses or à la carte. Reviews (March 2022–October 2025, in English): owner Shuichi Takahashi gained experience at kappo in Gion and opened in 2021; said to have worked at Umetsu (August 2024); a couple's shop; hon-moroko, sweetfish with roe, white-miso hot pot, grilled fugu, shirako, clams, saba sushi; one guest found it a little expensive (February 2024).

食べログ: 日本料理・魚介料理、東山区元吉町59-1、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月.en: Tabelog: Japanese cuisine, seafood; 東山区元吉町59-1; 5 min on foot from Gion-Shijo Stn; Mon–Sat and holidays 11:30–13:30 (last entry) and 18:00–21:00; closed Sunday; reservations accepted; 16 seats (a counter and two 4-seat tables in a raised area); private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards and PayPay accepted; owner Ichirou Nakatani, a chef of over 30 years, trained at a renowned Kyoto restaurant; fish from Awaji and Wakasa, Kyoto vegetables direct from farmers, care down to the kombu. Reviews (September 2025–September 2026, in English): at the end of a narrow alley near Tatsumi Bridge; courses of ¥9,000 and ¥13,000 (lunch), omakase ¥14,300 and ¥17,600; hassun; mackerel sushi (also to take away); leftover clay-pot rice made into onigiri; roe-laden sweetfish from Takashima; matsutake soup; the family runs a pottery shop; staff explain in English.

食べログ: 日本橋 さか一、大阪市中央区島之内2-11-3、日本橋駅・長堀橋駅6.en: Tabelog: Nihonbashi Sakaichi, 2-11-3 Shimanouchi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nippombashi Station and Nagahoribashi Station exit 6; Mon, Wed and Fri 9:30–14:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 7:00–13:30 (continuous); closed Tuesdays and Thursdays (open on holidays) plus irregular days (announced on X and Instagram); the ticket machine does not take ¥5,000 or ¥10,000 notes; no cards, e-money or QR; 6 seats (counter only); opened 20 September 2022; Tabelog 3.64. Reviews (September–October 2026): weekend morning ramen; SNS-only specials (Tachiuo paitan tsukemen with noodles coated in raw egg ¥1,600, crab and scallop salt ¥1,600 with crab miso ¥250, rich niboshi soba ¥1,200 with 70% Himi niboshi, niboshi and scallop salt with fresh aonori ¥1,400, XO maze-soba); cement-coloured soup; niboshi without harshness; rice to finish ¥100; the main is special shoyu; special shoyu ¥1,600; seasoned-egg shoyu; shoyu; medium-thick flat whole-wheat noodles from Menya Teikaku; chashu of pork shoulder, pork belly, chicken thigh and chicken breast; low-temperature chicken breast and hung-roasted pork belly; a chicken and seafood soup; no table condiments; the owner and one staff member; one praises the owner's service; a queue outside at 8 a.m.

食べログ: 日本橋 古樹軒、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-7-1 大丸心斎橋店B2F、.en: Tabelog: Nihonbashi Kojuken, Daimaru Shinsaibashi B2F, 1-7-1 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 050-3555-1132; no reservations; daily 11:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:00); closed when Daimaru Shinsaibashi is; cards and QR payment accepted, no e-money; no smoking; wheelchair accessible; opened 20 September 2019. 2026 reviews (May–October): with price rises, nearly ¥3,000 at lunch; No. 1 most popular, the shark-fin soup rice set ¥3,180, and la zi ji; No. 2, the mapo tofu set (numbing Sichuan pepper); Hirai-style tantanmen (heavy sesame with Sichuan pepper and heat); often seen on Kansai TV; shark-fin rice set and tom yum goong set; self-service, crowded with tourists at weekends; collect with a buzzer; the premium braised whole shark-fin set (¥3,180 incl. tax) with ramen.

食べログ: 日本橋 蕎ノ字、天ぷら、The Tabelog Award 2019.en: Tabelog: Nihonbashi Sonoji, tempura; The Tabelog Award Bronze 2019–2022 and Silver 2023–2026; Tempura 100 2022, 2023 and 2025; Soba 100 2017; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-22-11, 1F, 3 min walk from Ningyocho Station; daily 12:00–14:00 and 18:30–21:00; irregular closures; omakase only, all starting together; cancellations 50% from 3 days before, 100% from the day before; please avoid perfume for guests with soba allergies; cards accepted; 5% service charge; 9 seats; non-smoking; opened 30 October 2016; website sonoji.info. Reviews (2026): owner Toshiyuki Suzuki taught himself tempura, opened Sonoji in Shizuoka in 2000 and moved to Nihonbashi in 2016; finishes with soba; sakura-shrimp kakiage soba; soba grains; two shrimp and heads; sea urchin; anago; matsutake; new soba from Nikko; Kato makes the soba; hard to book; ¥40,000–¥50,000 a head.

食べログ: 日本酒BAR 四季、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-5-30 オックス周防町.en: Tabelog: Sake Bar Shiki, Ox Suomachi Bldg 2F, 2-5-30 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon–Sat 18:00–24:00 (food L.O. 23:30, last entry 23:00; phone if late); closed Sundays and holidays; opened 2 September 2015; charge ¥300; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; 10 counter seats; sashimi platter from ¥1,500 per person to budget (book by the day before); mostly local sake from Tohoku; seasonal fish bought daily; sake beginners welcome. Reviews (January–September 2026): state your taste and get several to try; a Rashomon tasting; bonito paired with sake; red shrimp marinated in sake; Senshu water-aubergine sashimi; squid legs grilled with liver mayo; wagyu sukiyaki-style; black-truffle cream soup; squid-ink yakisoba-style Okinawa soba; tamago kake gohan; events such as fruit nights and brewery visits; 11th anniversary.

食べログ: 日本酒と肴 いち陽、居酒屋・魚介料理、下京区綾材木町199 1F、烏.en: Tabelog: 日本酒と肴 いち陽 (Nihonshu to Sakana Ichiyo), izakaya and seafood; 下京区綾材木町199 1F; 297 m from Karasuma Station; daily 17:00–24:00; irregular closures; reservations taken; cards accepted; 20 seats; opened 1 August 2023. Reviews (2025–2026, in English): a large sake selection (two A4 pages); tastings offered once you say what you like; Aramasa, Hanayuki, Jikon, Ibi unfiltered unpasteurised genshu; assorted sashimi; namero; simmered sawara; teppai; dashimaki; mehikari kara-age; Tochio fried tofu; matsutake dobin-mushi; most dishes under ¥1,000; ¥1,000 lunch set.

食べログ: 日比谷松本楼、千代田区日比谷公園1-2、日比谷駅A14出口・霞ケ関駅.en: Tabelog: Hibiya Matsumoto-ro, Hibiya-koen 1-2, Chiyoda-ku, 2 minutes from Hibiya Station exit A14 and Kasumigaseki Station exit B2; 120 seats; 1F yōshoku grill & garden terrace 11:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:00); 3F French restaurant Bois de Boulogne (lunch 11:00–16:00, dinner 17:00–22:00); closed at New Year; 10% service charge (3F only); dinner bookings for 1F only; official site matsumotoro.co.jp. October 2026 reviews: 3F prix-fixe (cèpe blancmange, pumpkin and apple potage, lobster américaine); discontinued Wedgwood plates; only one table on the open-deck terrace can be booked; a 30-minute wait during a park event; paid special seats; the outdoor seats are pleasant; omurice with shrimp and scallops in tomato sauce ¥1,850; banquet plan with all-you-can-drink ¥8,500; sweet Showa-style European curry; poulet, cake and coffee set ¥2,800; choose the omurice sauce and hamburg steak, fried shrimp or crab cream croquette; seated 12 people together.

食べログ: 旬の料理とおばんざい つぼみ、日本料理、東山区祇園町南側 第3万治ビ.en: Tabelog: Shun no Ryouri to Obanzai Tsubomi; Japanese cuisine; 第3万治ビル 2F, Gion-machi Minamigawa, Higashiyama-ku; down Hanamikoji from Shijo, three buildings north of the Kaburenjo; open the lattice in the alley and take the lift to the second floor; Tue–Sun 17:30–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); closed Monday (sometimes also two Sundays a month for a two-day break); lunch (booking only, 20 servings) suspended; seating charge (obanzai platter) ¥2,200; bookings taken; guests with strong perfume may be refused; 20 seats (counters of 12 and 8); smoking allowed; cards, e-money and QR accepted; Facebook and Hitosara pages. Reviews (February 2023 – July 2026, in English): a friendly owner; two sunken U-shaped counters; obanzai platter; fluffy dashimaki; umaki; okra and shrimp-paste tempura; hamo or octopus tempura; fried sakura shrimp and small flatfish; soft-stewed octopus; fried namafu in broth; horse sashimi; salt-grilled Kyoto red chicken; smoked duck breast; chorizo; meat udon; many regulars; open late.

食べログ: 旬゛喫茶 フツウニフルウツ、大阪市中央区南船場1-15-12 堺筋倶.en: Tabelog: Jun Kissa Futsuni Fruits, Sakaisuji Club building 2F, 1-15-12 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 6 min walk from Sakaisuji-Hommachi or Nagahoribashi Stn (Osaka Metro); daily 11:00–16:00; closing days not fixed; reservations accepted (after booking a seat, items can also be reserved by Instagram message; no same-day bookings); one-hour limit when busy; cashless only; 14 seats; non-smoking; opened 22 February 2024. Shop site (Pan to Espresso to Co.): Jun Kissa Futsuni Fruits listed under other shops (directly run), Sakaisuji Club 2F, 11:00–16:00, closing days not fixed. Menu: fruit sandwich from ¥1,400, Candle mou ¥700, baked goods from ¥350, hand-drip coffee ¥700, tea ¥600, cream soda from ¥850, Japanese mikan juice ¥600, Japanese apple juice ¥600; manga free to read. Reviews (April–August 2026): a building put up as a bank in 1931, Pan to Espresso to on the ground floor, order and pay at the entrance, shelves of manga, many clocks, seasonal fruit sandwiches (fig, orange and kiwi with cream cheese ¥1,400; white peach with Earl Grey cream ¥1,600; American cherry with chocolate cream), Strawberry Milk ¥700, bread from downstairs can be brought up and re-warmed in a toaster, reservations recommended; one diner says cash or PayPay only, another found the peach disappointing and smelled oil from the kitchen below.

食べログ: 旬彩 つむぎ、居酒屋、大阪市淀川区西中島4-5-20、西中島南方駅か.en: Tabelog: Shunsai Tsumugi; izakaya; 西中島4-5-20, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 215 m from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; Mon–Sat 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30); closed Sunday; reservations accepted; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 24 seats; non-smoking. Reviews (2022 to October 2026): a woman owner cooks alone; assorted small dishes of five, six or nine kinds (nine ¥1,500): burdock, mentaiko, liver, komatsuna, small eggplant, chashu, simmered squid, marinated horse mackerel, potato salad; sashimi platter of five ¥1,300; firefly squid sashimi; kinki, akou or kinmedai simmered in soy; overnight-dried kinmedai; salt-grilled ayu; grilled conger eel; mackerel pressed sushi; thin rolls; Miyazaki beef steak; duck and eggplant; chicken liver; sweet potato and corn tempura; kintoki greens and yuba in broth; hijiki rice; homemade ice cream; sake chosen by the owner; full with regulars and bookings; featured on TV.

食べログ: 旬菜ダイニング らかんか、大阪市中央区南船場2-7-1、長堀橋駅から.en: Tabelog: Shunsai Dining Rakan Ka, Minami-Senba 2-7-1, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 337 m from Nagahoribashi Stn; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 18:30–23:00; closed Saturday, Sunday, public holidays and over the New Year; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR accepted, no e-money; 12 seats; counter seating; no private rooms; whole-shop booking possible; genres: creative, Japanese, organic. Reviews (May 2023 – September 2026): a shop in a narrow alley, roomier inside than it looks from outside; at lunch a daily set with a choice of fish or meat, two small side dishes, miso soup, brown rice and fruit (mandarin, watermelon, banana); ¥1,000 in 2026 (¥900 in 2024, and an April 2026 review gives ¥900 for the omakase set); herb-and-breadcrumb-crusted salmon, butter-grilled salmon, saikyo-miso grilled Spanish mackerel, mackerel grilled with basil, chicken and vegetable tomato stew, beef stew, mapo tofu, white fish steamed in foil; a daily health tea (mugwort, persimmon leaf, barley); brown rice advertised as the best in Osaka; gentle seasoning; busy with office workers before noon; takeaway available; takeout through Uber during the pandemic; set meals in the evening too (4 side dishes ¥1,650, 8 side dishes ¥2,200, July 2024); a diner back in January 2026 after five or six years found the master and partner unchanged; the owner specializes in astrology (July 2024 review). The official site racanca.com does not resolve (30 October 2026).

食べログ: 旬蕾、日本料理、日本橋人形町2-24-5 日本橋人形町澤井ビル 1F.en: Tabelog: Shunrai, Japanese cuisine; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-24-5, 1F; Mon–Fri 16:00–22:00; closed Sat and Sun; reservations accepted; cards and e-money accepted, no QR; 12 seats (8 at the counter, a private room for 4); non-smoking; particular about sake and shochu; opened 14 January 2020. Reviews (December 2023–October 2026): run by two women; the proprietress asks your taste and chooses the sake; omakase pairing; kombu-cured flounder and sea bream; kombu-cured chicken and chicken sashimi; sea bream and wild-vegetable spring rolls; maitake fritters; lotus-root kara-age; small oyster hot pot; oyster nyumen; shumai recommended by regulars; namazake and aged sake; plenty of shochu; the private room suits business dinners; some found service brusque when busy.

食べログ: 旭川塩らーめん すがわら 人形町店、ラーメン、日本橋人形町3-3-1.en: Tabelog: Asahikawa Shio Ramen Sugawara, Ningyocho branch; ramen; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 3-3-10; daily 11:00–22:00; no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 26 November 2024. Reviews (August–October 2026; a photo caption reads "ume shio ramen"): the main shop is in Asahikawa; a clear salt broth; light yet deep in flavour; thin straight noodles; low-temperature chashu; four soups — salt, soy sauce, miso, white miso; ume shio ramen ¥1,000, miso ramen ¥900, special shoyu ¥1,120; egg fried rice; tororo kombu free; order at your seat and pay first; some found the service curt, and one found the miso ramen and gyoza underwhelming.

食べログ: 明月庵 ぎんざ 田中屋 松屋店、銀座3-6-1 松屋銀座本店8F、銀.en: Tabelog: Meigetsuan Ginza Tanakaya Matsuya, Ginza 3-6-1, Matsuya Ginza main store 8F, directly connected to Ginza Station exit A13; 60 seats (34 table; private rooms for 2, 4 and 6); Mon–Sat 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00), Sun 11:00–21:30 (L.O. 20:30); children welcome; official site soba-tanakaya.com. Shop introduction: founded 1956; Edomae soba kept true by stone-ground buckwheat flour and the balance of water; tempura of seasonal fish and vegetables fried in taihaku sesame oil; sake snacks; "soba + one dish". September 2026 reviews: small-shrimp tempura seiro (choose nori, katsuobushi or both); mushroom and pork tsuke soba ¥2,079; shrimp and shimeji tempura soba with Suigei; ask if you want to start with salt; iso-jako (hot soba with aosa and chirimen jako); anmitsu; about half full just after 11:30.

食べログ: 明月庵 ぎんざ 田中屋 銀座本店、銀座6-6-19(ソニー通りとみゆ.en: Tabelog: Meigetsuan Ginza Tanakaya Honten, Ginza 6-6-19 (near the corner of Sony-dori and Miyuki-dori), 3 minutes from Ginza Station exit B9; 80 seats (private room for 4); daily 11:30–21:00 (L.O. 20:20); children welcome; official site soba-tanakaya.com; a notice "temporarily closed from August 8". Shop introduction: founded 1956; Edomae soba kept true by stone-ground buckwheat flour and the balance of water; tempura of seasonal fish and vegetables fried in taihaku sesame oil; sake snacks; "soba + one dish". 2026 reviews (September, October): tables and private rooms on two floors; a calm, grown-up clientele; hot soba with good broth; tendon crisp and not oily; yuzu shichimi; start with tempura and sake and finish with zaru soba; autumn bonito, ginkgo, ayu; shochu cut with soba water; Ginza prices; quick service.

食べログ: 昭和双子焼き (旧店名 双子のり巻き)、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-6-.en: Tabelog: Showa Futago Yaki (formerly Futago Norimaki), 2-6-1 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 10 min walk from Nagahoribashi and Shinsaibashi stations; Mon–Fri 19:00–2:00 next morning, Sat, Sun and holidays 17:00–2:00 next morning (L.O. 1:30); open every day of the year; starter ¥250; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; smoking allowed; 8 seats (counter, standing); pets allowed; takeaway; English and Korean menus; picture menu; oden, skewers, Korean food, sake and whisky in a Showa-izakaya atmosphere. Reviews (June 2024 – August 2026): like a Korean street stall; gimbap is the main draw, in many kinds; ordered a half and got a whole roll; sundae platter; bulgogi; jeon; Korean oden; Korean beer and Chamisul; leftovers can be taken away; one found prices much higher than in Korea; friendly staff.

食べログ: 昴 新大阪店、ラーメン・つけ麺、大阪市淀川区西中島3-23-9、西中.en: Tabelog: Subaru Shin osaka ten, ramen and tsukemen, 3-23-9 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 2 min from Exit 1 of Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station, 7 min from Shin-Osaka Station; daily 11:00–24:00, until sold out, open all year; no reservations; cash only; 26 seats (counter); smoking area (weekdays from 14:00, all day on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays); opened 3 December 2013; its site is menyasubaru.com (not reachable on 1 November 2026). Reviews (February 2025 to October 2026): iekei-style tonkotsu shoyu; thick or thin noodles, firmness, strength and chicken oil to order; one bowl of rice free (the second ¥150); tonkotsu shio with seasoned egg ¥980; tsukemen in a seafood and pork-bone dip with thick noodles, regular 350 g and large 550 g free, up to 750 g free per one diner; Super Rich Seafood Tsukemen SP ¥1,180; sets with half fried rice, gyoza and kara-age; busy at lunch; some wonder whether it is a chain.

食べログ: 時喰み、銀座3-11-6 鈴木ビル2F、東銀座駅から徒歩3分、10席.en: Tabelog: Tokihami, Ginza 3-11-6, 鈴木 Building 2F, 3 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station; 10 seats (5 counter, 2 tables); Mon–Sat 18:00–23:00, closed Sundays and holidays; opened April 8, 2019; Japanese food and wine, à la carte only; owner-chef Junya Kudo (from Ginza Kudo); has a sister shop; cards, e-money and QR accepted. 2026 reviews: grilled sesame tofu, foie gras monaka, cream croquettes, potato salad, fig and grape with mascarpone, dishes for sharing, same-day booking almost impossible, drinks a bit pricey.

食べログ: 時屋、つけ麺、食べログ ラーメン WEST 百名店 2019〜202.en: Tabelog: Toki Ya, tsukemen, Tabelog Ramen WEST 100 2019–2022 and Ramen OSAKA 100 2023–2025, 5-1-4 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, 1F; about 4 min from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station, 6 min from Hankyu Minamikata Station, about 8 min from JR Shin-Osaka Station; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:50 and 18:00–22:20, Sat and Sun 11:30–22:20; no reservations; cash only; 15 seats (7 at the counter, 8 at tables); non-smoking; children welcome; opened 10 March 2009; most social posts are for the whole group. Reviews (October to November 2026): buy a ticket first and then queue; the line moves fast; pork tsukemen in a very rich dip of pork bone and seafood with braised pork; Toki Ya Special Pork Tsukemen ¥1,550; pork spicy tsukemen (spice level 2) ¥1,150; chicken tsukemen with a lighter, slightly tangy dip; smooth medium-thick noodles; dip only lightly; a guide to how to eat it; seared chashu, soft-boiled egg, kaiware; rice at the end for the leftover dip; bottled beer; the Tenma shop has closed.

食べログ: 有明そば、銀座3-12-6、東銀座駅から222m、29席(テーブル2.en: Tabelog: Ariake Soba, Ginza 3-12-6, 222 m from Higashi-Ginza Station; 29 seats (20 table, 9 counter); 11:30–14:00, from 17:00; closed weekends and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR. 2026 reviews: two daily sets (¥1,200), tempura set "Ariake" ¥1,200 (shrimp, kisu, shishito), choice of soba, udon or miso soup, menchi-katsu set, tendon ¥1,050, kitsune udon ¥650; at night unohana as otoshi, octopus and tuna sashimi, shishamo, nira-tama, yakitori, beef tofu.

食べログ: 朝挽豚専門店 ぶった 三国駅前店、ホルモン・豚料理・ラーメン、大阪市.en: Tabelog: Asabiki Buta Senmon Ten Butta, Mikuni Ekimae branch; offal, pork dishes, ramen; 西三国3-4-9, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; about 1 minute on foot from the north exit of Hankyu Mikuni Station; Mon, Wed–Sun and holidays 18:00–24:00 (last order food 23:00, drinks 23:30); closed Tuesday; may close when ingredients run out; phone reservations from 16:30; no cards, e-money or QR; 18 seats (14 at tables, 4 at the counter); smoking allowed, so no minors. Reviews (2013 to September 2026): at the entrance to Santiful Mikuni; a counter behind plastic sheeting; pork offal from mouth to tail; liver with salt, heart, kashira, harami, tanshira, teppou, lips, throat, tsukune with egg yolk; skewers ¥170–250; omakase five skewers ¥770; roast pork from ¥90; braised pork belly, two pieces ¥600; simmered pig trotters; kara-age; potato salad; black edamame; horse sashimi; miso and spicy miso ramen to finish (choose heat and numbing); Hoppy; a kind owner; wrestling autographs; Hanshin Tigers.

食べログ: 未来軒、大阪市中央区瓦町2-4-10、堺筋本町から467m、月〜土.en: Tabelog: Mirai Ken, 2-4-10 Kawaramachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 467 m from Sakaisuji-Hommachi; Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 16 October 2025. Reviews (April–October 2026): lively at night; pork and bean-sprout stir-fry; mapo tofu; half tantanmen; under ¥2,500 with 2 lemon sours; the tantanmen is rich without being too hot; one calls it authentic Chinese flavour; limited cold tantanmen with chewy noodles; half fried rice set; cold rich spicy tantanmen ¥1,200 with wavy noodles; one wished it were hotter; tantanmen Moto-Aji ¥950; plenty of meat miso; bean sprouts and greens; can't stop drinking the soup; Shin-Aji; miso; shoyu tanmen; hot-and-sour tanmen; one learned it's a sister shop of the Chinese restaurant Koyouju in Hommachi; a neon sign; the entrance set back from the street; 3 groups waiting at 11:40; 5 counter seats, five tables for 4, three for 2; outdoor terrace seats; a distinctive aroma; very thin noodles.

食べログ: 本家月餅家直正、和菓子、中京区木屋町通三条上ル上大阪町530、三条駅.en: Tabelog: Honke Gepaikeya Naomasa, wagashi, 中京区木屋町通三条上ル上大阪町530, 155 m from Sanjo Stn; Mon, Tue and Fri–Sun 10:30–18:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday; takeaway only; reservations accepted; no cards; Sweets Tabelog 100 2017; Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2018–2020, 2022; Japanese sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2023, 2026. Reviews (August–September 2026, in English): an old shop said to date from 1804, warabi mochi filled with smooth bean paste at ¥940 for three, ready from 12:30, sold out to reservations, book by phone or the day before, eat the same day, friendly staff.

食べログ: 本格炉端焼き人夢叶思ひとむかし、大阪市中央区難波千日前14-26、な.en: Tabelog: Honkaku Robatayaki Hitomukashi, 14-26 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:30–23:00, Sat–Sun 7:00–11:00, 11:00–14:30 and 17:30–23:00; no reservations at lunch; 5% service charge at night; cards and QR (including Alipay and WeChat Pay) accepted, no e-money; opened 1 November 2012. Reviews (August 2024 – October 2026): the famous Bakudan don ¥1,800 (¥1,400 in 2024; ikura, tuna, negitoro, sea bream, takuan, shiso, nori, wasabi, sesame-sauce sashimi, small dishes, grated yam, miso soup, white or multigrain rice); three stages, dashi shoyu → sesame-sauce sashimi → grated yam; Gobu Gobu don ¥1,800 (Wakayama shirasu, half raw and half boiled); Senshu anago tendon ¥1,700; bluefin tuna bowl; sanma set meal; large free; weekend breakfast; anago nigiri at night; a sashimi platter under a smoking lid; potato salad; nut salad; shirako mapo tofu; Manganji peppers; gratin; grilled rice balls; queues at lunch; a waiting board; perks for registering on LINE; courteous service.

食べログ: 本町製麺所 中華そば工房、大阪市中央区船場中央1-3-2 船場センタ.en: Tabelog: Hommachi Seimensho Chuka Soba Kobo, Semba Center Bldg No. 2 B2F (moved), 1-3-2 Semba-chuo, Chuo-ku, Osaka; just outside the Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station gate; Mon–Sat 11:00–19:00; closed Sundays and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR; 23 seats (counter 9, tables 14); no smoking; opened 26 November 2020. Reviews (September–October 2026): cold kiwi ramen ¥1,300; cold rooibos tea; a light cold soup; flat medium-thick noodles; kiwi, seasoned egg, chicken-breast chashu, seared pork chashu, mitsuba, almonds; chuka soba prime (extra chashu and seasoned egg); chose round noodles; additive-free, clean taste; deep umami; juicy chashu; no wait at 13:30 on a weekday; a clear soup with shoyu aroma and sansho; flat or round noodles; rare chashu; long menma; citrus aroma; house-made chewy noodles; change the flavour with black pepper and sansho; chuka soba ¥1,050; the shoyu a little strong; often a notice of closing because the noodles ran out; ticket machine at the entrance; the soupless chuka soba is mixed with egg; sudachi.

食べログ: 札幌らーめん獅子王 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-3-21 NI.en: Tabelog: Sapporo Ramen Shishio Shinsaibashi, NIPPO Tamayacho Kaikan 1F, 2-3-21 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 14 seats (counter); Mon, Tue and Sun 18:00–6:00 next morning (L.O. 5:30), Wed–Thu 18:00–8:00 next morning (L.O. 7:30), Fri, Sat and days before holidays 18:00–14:00 next day (L.O. 13:30); closed 1st and 3rd Wednesdays for cleaning; no smoking; cards and e-money accepted; opened 20 May 2016. Shop introduction: wild yet mild; a soup of pork bones and chicken (wings) simmered for a long time; chopped onion; thickened with grated potato; medium-thick high-hydration wavy noodles. 2026 reviews (September–October): ticket machine at the entrance; a short wait when full; rich, wavy noodles; shiitake vinegar; a strong Sapporo-style miso; faint heat; medium-thick noodles; piping hot under lard; corn and garlic; roast chashu, menma, leek, corn; 2 a.m.; miso ramen with soft-boiled egg; the spicy items aren't very spicy; near Kintetsu-Nippombashi Station; miso ramen ¥1,170; seasoned egg ¥160.

食べログ: 札幌熟成味噌らーめん 匠神、ラーメン、四谷1-8-5 小川ビル1F、.en: Tabelog: Sapporo Jukusei Miso Ramen Takumi Kami, ramen; 小川ビル 1F, Yotsuya 1-8-5; 3 min walk from Yotsuya Station; no reservations; 19 seats (four tables for four, three at the counter); separate smoking area; opened 6 December 2021; no business hours listed. Reviews (April–September 2026): Sapporo aged miso, a soup kept hot by lard, medium-thick curly noodles, stir-fried vegetables, miso ramen about ¥850, seasoned-egg miso ¥950, miso butter corn ¥950, spicy green-onion miso ¥990, mapo miso, clam salt, a small rice bowl ¥150 at lunch, kara-age, ordering by voice with no ticket machine, open around 10 pm.

食べログ: 来福亭、洋食、日本橋人形町1-17-10、人形町駅A1出口から徒歩1.en: Tabelog: Raifuku Tei, yoshoku; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 1-17-10, 1 min walk from Ningyocho Station exit A1, 5 min from Suitengumae Station exit A8; Mon–Fri 11:30–13:45 and 17:00–19:45; closed Sat and Sun; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 seats; tatami room; non-smoking. Reviews (June–October 2026): founded 1904; an old house between Tamahide and an old coffee shop; two tables on the first floor and a tatami room on the second; the owner's mother carries the food; omurice ¥850; omurice with a small menchi ¥1,200; menchi katsu rice ¥1,100; katsudon ¥1,200; pork sauté ¥1,100; crab fried rice ¥850; ham salad ¥700; chicken rice ¥750; one diner went for Saturday lunch; some found the katsudon a little salty or the menchi small.

食べログ: 東京會舘 銀座スカイラウンジ、千代田区有楽町2-10-1 東京交通会.en: Tabelog: Tokyo Kaikan Ginza Sky Lounge, Yurakucho 2-10-1, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo Kotsu Kaikan 15F, in front of Yurakucho Station; 118 seats (6 counter, semi-private rooms); daily 11:30–21:30 (L.O. lunch 14:00, tea 16:30, dinner 20:00); closed at New Year; 15% service charge; official site kaikan.co.jp. Shop introduction: Tokyo Kaikan's French cooking, with its history and tradition, brought up to date; city views. October 2026 reviews: once a revolving restaurant (it no longer turns); elevator to 14F, stairs to 15F; "Tokyo Kaikan and Me" course ¥6,600 (three amuses including quiche, the traditional double consommé, sole meunière); flounder in white-wine sauce; marron chantilly; free bread refills; every seat faces the windows; a harsh view that you're paying for the location; for birthdays; about ¥18,000 for two.

食べログ: 松吟庵 東三国店、居酒屋・牛タン・そば、大阪市淀川区東三国1-33-.en: Tabelog: Shogin An Higashimikuni ten, izakaya, beef tongue and soba, 1-33-21 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 2 min from Exit 4 of Higashimikuni Station (Midosuji Line); Mon–Wed 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–23:00, Thu 17:30–23:00, Fri 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–24:00, Sat 11:00–14:30 and 17:30–23:00, Sun 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–22:00, holidays 11:00–22:30; until sold out; closing days not fixed; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 20 seats; two tables upstairs; a private room for eight or more; non-smoking. Reviews (March 2025 to October 2026): a renovated old house; a ranma; a "Ju-wari Soba" sign; at lunch ju-wari soba sets, cold or hot; daily set ¥1,300 (kayaku rice, dashimaki, tenderloin cutlet with grated daikon ponzu); a daily set with nikujaga; tempura and zaru soba; maki sushi, saba sushi and zaru soba; chicken tempura; at night thick-cut beef tongue, dashimaki, bonito tataki, chicken nanban, grilled eggplant, sweet simmered herring, maitake tempura, pork seiro soba, hamo, fried oysters, fried taro, Oni Oroshi Bukkake Soba, raw oysters with ponzu, Juyondai junmai daiginjo, soba tea; order by QR code; a line at weekday lunch; one diner found it pricey and the upstairs cramped.

食べログ: 松屋食堂、大阪市浪速区日本橋西1-8-25、恵美須町から453m、月.en: Tabelog: Matsuya Shokudo, 1-8-25 Nipponbashi-nishi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 453 m from Ebisucho; Mon–Sat 11:30–16:30; closed Sundays and holidays; closes when sold out; no cards, e-money or QR; 9 seats (and 2nd-floor seats); no smoking. October 2026 reviews: the most popular is the omurice; 5 waiting after 12:00, 7 minutes; pay cash afterwards; served in 16 minutes; ramen and fried rice; old-fashioned chuka soba; thick chashu; house-made straight noodles; fried rice large or half size; cheap; two storeys; busy even an hour before closing; omurice ¥900 with Chinese soup; large size too; a shop in a narrow alley; metal chairs; thin egg and ketchup; spicy miso ramen; stir-fried pork, bean sprouts and leek; a dark soup.

食べログ: 松庵、そば・日本料理、荒木町3 北島ビル 1F、四谷三丁目駅から徒歩.en: Tabelog: Shoan, soba, Japanese cuisine; Arakichō 3, 北島ビル 1F; 4 min walk from Yotsuya-sanchome Station; Mon–Sat and holidays 18:00–23:30 (last order food 23:00, drinks 23:15), closed Sunday; closes when sold out; courses only for now; lunch for private hire by arrangement; ¥400 seating charge; cards accepted; 14 seats (8 at tables, 6 at the counter); non-smoking; opened 10 February 2014; heirloom buckwheat milled in house; dipping sauce of two-year-aged honkarebushi. Reviews (2026): run by a couple; omakase ¥9,900; seasonal special course ¥14,300; soba kaiseki; a tasting of 2–3 soba from different regions; eaten with salt or sake; soba gelato; a strong sake list; some say it is slow with one person running it.

食べログ: 松月庵、そば、丼、ラーメン、日本橋人形町1-2-9、人形町駅から徒歩.en: Tabelog: Shogetsu An, soba, rice bowls, ramen; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 1-2-9, 2 min walk from Ningyocho Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–21:30; closed Sat and Sun; reservations accepted; private hire possible; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking 11:30–13:00, smoking allowed at other times. Reviews (June 2023–September 2026): soba, rice bowl and salad sets ¥800; mori soba set ¥800; tamago-toji soba ¥800; curry nanban soba ¥850; kake soba ¥450; chilled tanuki; delivery; 50+ years; fast; izakaya snacks in the evening; some found the warm soba overcooked or the cold noodles not cold enough.

食べログ: 栄進館、パン、四谷坂町1-8、四ツ谷駅から徒歩5分、月・火・木・金1.en: Tabelog: Eishinkan, bakery; Yotsuya Saka-machi 1-8; 5 min walk from Yotsuya Station; Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 10:00–15:00; closed Wed, Sat, Sun and holidays; 6 seats; no cards, e-money and QR accepted; takeaway; the main business, the Eishinkan, has operated at this site since 1953. Reviews (September 2025–October 2026): a bakery in the inn's entrance, kinako butter bread on sale since January 2021 at ¥260 (mini ¥150), organic kinako and Hokkaido cream butter wrapped in rice-flour dough, daily breads, pizza, a free coffee or tea with any bread, little left in the afternoon, PayPay accepted.

食べログ: 桂庵 銀座三丁目店、銀座3-10-14 東銀ビル1F、26席(4人卓.en: Tabelog: Katsura-an Ginza 3-chome, Ginza 3-10-14, 東銀 Building 1F; 26 seats (five tables for 4, one for 2); weekdays 11:00–21:00, weekends and holidays 11:00–17:00; closed at New Year. 2026 reviews: niku seiro (lots of pork, with scallions); the new roast-pork bowl (with a fried egg, half set ¥1,300); mini chicken-bowl set ¥1,200 (freshly fried karaage in a sweet-savory sauce, cash only); katsudon set (¥50 off, ¥1,200); strong Kanto-style broth; soba water; shared tables when busy; open on Saturdays too.

食べログ: 梅丘寿司の美登利総本店 銀座店、銀座7-2 東京高速道路山下ビル1F.en: Tabelog: Sushi no Midori Ginza, Ginza 7-2, 東京高速道路山下 Building 1F, 4 minutes from Ginza Station exit A2; 82 seats; weekdays 11:00–15:00, 17:00–21:00, weekends and holidays 11:00–21:00; closed 1/1; bookings changeable up to 3 days before; official site sushinomidori.co.jp. October 2026 reviews: many overseas visitors; Matsuri course (with dessert; some say the rice is firm); numbered tickets from 16:00 for dinner, about 10 people waiting before 16:00; a staffer first met at the Futako-Tamagawa shop; Akita sake; off-menu squid legs grilled with butter and onion; omakase nigiri and 大名 mackerel; satisfied in the ¥5,000 range; 45-minute limit; a staffer with a harsh tone; special nigiri and draft beer; queued from 11:00, seated after 13:00; nigiri served a few at a time.

食べログ: 森乃園、ソフトクリーム、アイス・ジェラート百名店2026、和菓子・甘.en: Tabelog: Morinoen, soft serve; Ice cream and gelato 100 2026; Japanese sweets and sweet shops TOKYO 100 2023; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-4-9; 30 seconds' walk from Ningyocho Station exit A1; daily 10:00–19:00 (tea sales and soft serve on the first floor); closed only over the New Year; the second-floor sweet shop closed on 1 December 2024; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; website morinoen.com. Reviews (September–October 2026): hojicha soft serve ¥600, ¥800 with a monaka; cup or cone; bought at the counter beside the shop; can be eaten on the benches outside; self-roasted hojicha; not too sweet; a generous portion; one diner mentions a matcha soft serve; one noticed a sewer smell near the benches.

食べログ: 棲家 富小路店、居酒屋・野菜料理・日本料理、中京区四条富小路上ル西大.en: Tabelog: Sumika Tomikoji, izakaya, vegetable dishes, Japanese cuisine; メディナ四条富小路 2F, 西大文字町615, north of Shijo on Tominokoji, Nakagyo-ku; 5 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Station; Monday–Friday 18:00–1:00, Saturday, Sunday and holidays 17:00–1:00 (L.O. 0:30); closing days not fixed; bookings for seats only; two-hour limit when busy; tell the shop about allergies; 34 seats (6 counter, 24 table); a loft for 8 and a tatami room for 14; smoking allowed; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; opened 22 August 2009; vegetarian options. Reviews (August–October 2026, in English): stone-grilled and steamed Kyoto vegetables, obanzai, tofu, sashimi, tempura, simmered pork belly and taro, fried Kyoto yuba, Kujo green onion, curry udon to finish, all-you-can-drink course ¥6,000.

食べログ: 楊國福マーラータン 大阪心斎橋店、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-6-16.en: Tabelog: Yang Guo Fu Malatang Osaka Shinsaibashi, 1F, 2-6-16 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Nippombashi stations; 31 seats; daily 11:00–21:30; no reservations; opened 1 July 2022. 2026 reviews (August–October): queues before opening; choose ingredients first, order, then join the line for seats; as much of whatever you like (wood-ear, glass noodles and more); a spiced soup; adjustable heat; tongs to fill a bowl with vegetables, seafood, meat, fish cakes and noodles, weighed at the till to set the price; beef, quail egg, squid, wood-ear, king oyster and enoki mushrooms; busy even after lunchtime; 90% of diners are women; tomato flavour recommended, like tomato ramen; glass noodles; overseas staff with limited Japanese; even heat level 1 is quite hot; sesame sauce tames the heat; lots of vegetables and few carbs.

食べログ: 極味焼肉 牛吾、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-2-13 宝山心斎橋ビル2F.en: Tabelog: Gokumi Yakiniku Gyugo, Hozan Shinsaibashi Bldg 2F, 2-2-13 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Namba stations; Mon–Sat 17:00–24:30, holidays 17:00–22:00; closed Sundays; may close early when sold out (phone to check); reservations accepted; cover charge ¥500; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 20 seats; a hideaway on the 2nd floor of a building; solo diners welcome; tables for 4–6; meat bought direct from wholesalers; courses to fit your budget. Reviews (March 2024 – August 2026): tongue, fillet, lean cuts, the day's cut; sirloin dashi chazuke to finish; good value; thick-cut fillet; ordinary tare; counter; on a full Friday a same-day online booking still worked; nakaochi; kuri; hanger; salted tongue with lemon; tongue root; kimchi platter; thin-sliced premium misuji; offal; ¥1,500–2,000 a plate; the master's recommendations; a good order of service; yuzu-tea rice; one calls the meat ordinary; the manager explains the cuts with gusto.

食べログ: 横浜家系ラーメン 一新家、大阪市浪速区桜川3-1-29、阪神桜川駅4.en: Tabelog: Yokohama Iekei Ramen Isshinya, 3-1-29 Sakuragawa, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; right by Hanshin Sakuragawa Station exit 4, on Sennichimae-dori; daily 11:30–0:30 next morning (L.O. 0:00); closed New Year's Eve and New Year's Day; no cards, e-money or QR; 23 seats (counter 7, tables 16); Kyu-chan pickles, chopped ginger, grated garlic, coarse black pepper and more free on the table. Reviews (October 2023 – August 2026): tonkotsu shoyu or salt; choose noodle firmness, strength and oil; thick wavy noodles (thin too); chashu; quail egg; spinach; nori; MAX ramen; leek ramen salt ¥1,060 (medium +¥100); tantanmen ¥980; miso ramen; rice set with free refills; karaage set; gyoza; chopped onion and sesame free too; free toppings and coupons via the app; friendly staff.

食べログ: 横浜家系ラーメン 天来家、ラーメン、大阪市淀川区西中島4-2-11.en: Tabelog: Yokohama Iekei Ramen Tenraiya, ramen, 4-2-11 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, コージーコート新大阪 1F; 2 min from Exit 1 of Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; daily 11:00–24:00; no reservations; cards (AMEX) accepted, no e-money or QR; 18 seats (10 at the counter, tables); non-smoking; opened 21 November 2022. Reviews (July 2023 to September 2026): a rich tonkotsu shoyu with a sharp soy edge; thick, chewy noodles; chashu, spinach, nori; noodle firmness, strength and oil to order; MAX ramen ¥1,050; Shio MAX ramen ¥1,250; shio negi ramen ¥1,150; salt tonkotsu with mini fried rice; seasoned-egg ramen with rice; half-chahan set ¥1,300; fried rice ¥650; spicy miso, garlic and doubanjiang on the table; compared to Machida Shoten by one diner; salty to another; energetic staff; one diner says the ticket machine took e-payment and cards too.

食べログ: 横浜家系ラーメン 幸来家、大阪市西区西本町1-5-20、本町駅から2.en: Tabelog: Yokohama Iekei Ramen Koura-ya, 1-5-20 Nishi-Hommachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 205 m from Hommachi Station; Mon–Sat 11:00–23:00; closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; 16 seats (counter 9, tables 7). Reviews (February–August 2026): on the south side of Utsubo Park; an iekei shop frequented by office workers; seasoned-egg ramen ¥1,000 (rich tonkotsu shoyu, thick noodles, spinach, chashu, 3 big sheets of nori, seasoned egg); choose noodle firmness, strength and oil; everything-on; MAX ramen; extra spinach or chashu; half fried rice; small rice free before 18:00; a tea bar of 3 tea bags at lunch; ginger, onion, spicy miso and more on the table; ticket machine; courteous, quick service.

食べログ: 横浜家系ラーメン 鶯家、根岸1-2-20、鶯谷駅から203m、毎日1.en: Tabelog: Yokohama Iekei Ramen Uguisu Ya, Negishi 1-2-20; 203 m from Uguisudani Station; daily 11:00–4:00; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 21 seats; non-smoking; opened 6 June 2015. Reviews (March–October 2026): tonkotsu ramen ¥930; shoyu tonkotsu ramen ¥980 (September 2026); ¥700 on days with a 5; salt ramen; yakiniku tsukemen; free rice; shredded ginger on the table; draft beer; lively late at night; mild pork bone; in August 2026 one diner found it cramped and dirty, the broth porky and the noodles undercooked.

食べログ: 横浜家系ラーメン赤家 人形町店、ラーメン、日本橋人形町2-26-1、.en: Tabelog: Yokohama Iekei Ramen Akaya, Ningyocho branch, ramen; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-26-1; daily 11:00–23:00; no reservations; cards and QR accepted, no e-money. Reviews (October 2025–October 2026): red exterior; pork-bone soy-sauce broth; medium-thick noodles; choose noodle firmness, richness and amount of oil; shoyu ramen ¥900 with a free large serving or free rice; Akamori ramen; miso corn butter; tantan tsukemen ¥1,040; quail eggs ¥120; garlic and onion free on the table; opened February 2025 on the former site of Niku no Marukiyo; staff from abroad; some said the broth lacked depth, and one found it lukewarm.

食べログ: 橋本屋、大阪市中央区南船場2-2-21、長堀橋駅から徒歩4分、月〜木.en: Tabelog: Hashimoto Ya, Minami-Senba 2-2-21, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min from Nagahoribashi Stn; Mon–Thu 11:45–13:30; closed Friday–Sunday and public holidays; reopened 8 September 2026; numbered tickets handed out around 10:05; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 16 seats (counter 6, tables 10); non-smoking; children from school age; The Tabelog Award 2025 and 2026 Bronze; Tabelog Curry WEST Top 100 2026; rated 4.02. Reviews (November 2025–October 2026): people line up from about 9:15–9:55; numbered tickets from about 10:05; one representative for up to 4 people; choose a time and order on the spot and pay cash in advance; come back 5 minutes before your time; slots from 10:50 to 12:20; sold out around number 35; the only dish is Rich Chicken Curry ¥1,400; spice levels 0–3; large rice +¥100; extra chicken; onion achaar; bubbling in a clay pot; tender chicken, soft-boiled egg, marinated tomatoes; a thin, soup-like curry; about 20 whole spices ground in an electric mill for each order; broth from Daisendori and two kinds of whole chicken, Rausu kombu and onions; rice cooked with chicken fat, about 10 spices and onions; a guide to eating it (aroma, the clear top, with rice, and finally tip the rice into the pot and break the egg for a porridge); spice and Sichuan-pepper mills on the table; a dim room that is a bar at night; a gentle owner and pleasant staff; some found one visit enough or the flavour monotonous.

食べログ: 次玄、お好み焼き、大阪市東淀川区東中島4-1-37、JR 新大阪駅か.en: Tabelog: Jigen, okonomiyaki, 東中島 4-1-37, Higashiyodogawa-ku, Osaka; 5 min from JR Shin-Osaka Station; Mon and Wed–Sun 11:30–13:00 and 17:30–22:00, closed Tuesday and holidays; reservations accepted; cash only; 20 seats (counter and tatami); smoking allowed; takeaway. Reviews (December 2025 to October 2026): cooked on the griddle in front of you; horumon yakisoba set ¥950–980 (rice, miso soup, pickled daikon); lunch ends when the rice runs out; pork kimchi set; mixed modern-yaki, buta-tama, negiyaki, yakisoba, stir-fried horumon, seafood stir-fry, foil-grilled shrimp, scallops in butter, stir-fried vegetables; highballs; under ¥5,000; seems family-run; an owner with a classic Osaka-uncle air; regulars chat with the owner; particular about how to add aonori and sauce; one pair was told to leave after an hour.

食べログ: 次男坊、銀座1-5-16 第3太陽ビル別館2F、銀座一丁目駅から91.en: Tabelog: Jinanbō, Ginza 1-5-16, 第3太陽 Building Annex 2F, 91 m from Ginza-itchome Station; 20 seats; weekdays 11:30–14:00, 16:00–23:00, closed weekends and holidays; otoshi ¥300; no cards, e-money or QR. 2026 reviews: cold meat soba ¥1,070 (large +¥100; meat, tenkasu, nori, scallions), "Chonanbo" set ¥1,180 (ginger pork, rice, small tanuki soba), dashi rice and zaru soba, fried soba as otoshi at night, itawasa ¥580, spicy fried burdock ¥580, bonito sashimi ¥1,200, sashimi platter ¥1,800, simmered conger eel, squid butter, sea bream, whelk, jazz, full at night with bookings.

食べログ: 次男坊ラーメン、ラーメン、大阪市東淀川区東中島1-12-30、JR.en: Tabelog: Jinanbo Ramen, ramen, 東中島 1-12-30, Higashiyodogawa-ku, Osaka; 10 min from the JR Shin-Osaka east exit; daily 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–24:00; no reservations; no cards or e-money, QR accepted; counter seating; smoking allowed. Reviews (April to September 2026): tonkotsu, tantan, shio and shoyu, plus the house "Jinanbo"; the Jinanbo is tonkotsu with spicy miso and minced meat, served in an iron pot; all toppings ¥1,350; the large size comes in a mortar-like bowl; a mild tonkotsu; a creamy tantanmen; tantan mazesoba (medium-thick curly noodles); a set with minced-meat fried rice ¥1,300; a kara-age set; a Tianjin rice set; a big table; reviews reportedly go back to 2007; one diner says it is open until 1 am.

食べログ: 歌舞伎茶屋 房の駅、銀座4-12-15 歌舞伎座B2F、東銀座駅直結.en: Tabelog: Kabuki Chaya Fusa no Eki, Ginza 4-12-15, Kabukiza B2F, directly connected to Higashi-Ginza Station; daily 9:00–18:00; no reservations; opened July 20, 2024; official site fusanoeki.fusa.co.jp. 2026 reviews: cold soba with five vegetable tempura ¥990 (thin and firm; onion, carrot and more); an open space in the Kabukiza basement, before or after a show; booked on the opening day of the summer kabuki, large meat soba; coffee in a cup with a topknot-shaped handle; the black tea's aroma is weak; the kakiage with cold soba is good; with hot soba the kakiage soon goes soggy.
