食べログ: 汁なし担担麺専門 キング軒 大阪本町店、大阪市中央区船場中央3-3-.en: Tabelog: Shirunashi Tantanmen Senmon King Ken Osaka Hommachi, Semba Center Bldg No. 9 B2F, 3-3-9 Semba-chuo, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 187 m from Hommachi Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30), Sat 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30); closed Sundays and holidays; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 18 seats (counter 12, tables 6). Reviews (April–October 2026): the Osaka branch of a Hiroshima soupless-tantanmen shop; opened March 2026; choose heat 1–4 at the ticket machine outside (2 is standard); regular ¥800; double King ¥1,150; thin, firm wavy noodles; sesame sauce; meat miso; leek; mix 30 times or more; coriander; celery ¥150; onsen egg ¥100; half rice ¥100 into the leftover sauce (tantan-rice sauce and vinegar); mapo-tofu set meal at night; freshly ground Sichuan pepper, chopped chili and vinegar on the table.

食べログ: 沖縄麺処 天願 南船場本店、大阪市中央区南船場2-8-2 宮本ビル.en: Tabelog: OKIMEN TENGAN Minamisenba honten, Miyamoto Bldg 1F, Minamisenba 2-8-2, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min on foot from Nagahoribashi Stn, 10 min from Sakaisuji-Honmachi Stn; Mon–Sat and public holidays 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 15:00); closed Sunday and the 2nd and 4th Saturdays; ends when the soup runs out; other irregular closures (check Instagram); no reservations; no cards or e-money, PayPay accepted; 10 seats (counter); non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; easier to get in after 13:00; English menu and photo menu; opened 17 April 2024. Shop introduction: Minamisenba's first Okinawa soba specialist; particular about dashi and noodles; noodles researched with a noodle factory from the blend to the thickness; katsuobushi and kombu with two Okinawan salts and dried shellfish, a little awamori; a clear golden soup. Reviews (April 2024–October 2026): Tengan soba ¥1,200 (three-layer pork and salt-cartilage Soki); salt-cartilage Soki soba ¥950; back fat ¥100; summer-only chilled Churaumi soba ¥980; Aasa soba; small jushi ¥200 with mozuku vinegar; Po-Tama onigiri (Spam and thin omelet), half ¥200, ¥150 at lunch; flat medium-thick noodles; fresh shredded ginger; kamaboko; tied kombu; koregusu and yuzu kosho on the counter; lines of office workers at weekday lunch; orders taken while waiting in line; the Honmachi shop's first anniversary (December 2025).

食べログ: 河童ラーメン本舗 千日前本店、大阪市中央区千日前1-9-12 トマト.en: Tabelog: Kappa Ramen Honpo Sennichimae main shop, Tomato Bldg 1F, 1-9-12 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 27 seats (counter only); open 24 hours; no smoking; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; official kappa-hompo.co.jp. Shop introduction: a specialist in back-fat tonkotsu shoyu; 'koime' with the sweetness of back fat and 'assari' with seafood oil; house-made thin straight noodles in 7 firmness levels from 'kona-otoshi' to 'bari-yawa'; free kimchi and fried garlic; free noodle refills 6:00–18:00 at the Sennichimae shop. Official: the original back-fat shoyu tonkotsu ramen; an allergy-care page. 2025–2026 reviews: Kappa ramen (koime) ¥930; karaage and white rice ¥350; two touch-panel ticket machines (left for mobile payment); one found koime too strong; assari with karaage set; no weekday half-fried-rice set at ¥1,000; tsukimi ramen ¥1,100 (limited from 1 September, black with squid ink); nori ¥150; white rice ¥220; customers still coming at 3 a.m.; overseas staff; fried rice and gyoza; black Kappa (garlic oil).

食べログ: 油そば A、大阪市中央区南本町2-6-8、堺筋本町駅から徒歩3〜4分.en: Tabelog: Abura Soba A, 2-6-8 Minamihommachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3–4 min walk from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–16:00 and 18:00–24:00 (noodle last order 10 minutes before closing); closed weekends and holidays; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 8 seats. Reviews (July 2025 – October 2026): a simple abura soba from about ¥500 (150 g, noodles and nori); everything-on (chashu, menma, seasoned egg, nori); medium-thick or thick noodles; regular, large or double (300 g); shoyu or tantan; rich tonkotsu ramen; a weekly free topping (leek, onion, fried onion or fried noodles); tenkasu; Sichuan-pepper chili paste, grated garlic, chili oil, vinegar, shichimi and curry powder on the table; rice; a sweet-savoury sauce that isn't heavy; a friendly owner; full at lunch.

食べログ: 油そば きりん寺 千日前店、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-4-15、26席(.en: Tabelog: Abura Soba Kirinji Sennichimae, 1-4-15 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 26 seats (counter 16, tables 10); daily 11:00–24:00; no reservations; no smoking; no cards, e-money or QR payment; opened 1 June 2023; site suzume-group.co.jp/kirinji. 2025–2026 reviews: what you crave after a gig; queues of overseas diners; vinegar on the chashu is superb; open late; regular size with soft-boiled egg under ¥1,000 (March 2026); garlic; chashu rice bowl; karaage and white rice set; how-to-eat instructions on the walls and tables; ground and 2nd floors; soft-boiled egg, kimchi, extra meat, everything-on; thick chewy noodles; vinegar and chili oil; hooked by the third visit; chashu, menma, shredded nori, sesame; the shopping street along Round1; close to Namba Walk; open until about 1 a.m. (October 2026).

食べログ: 油そば・まぜそば ロマン なんば南口店、大阪市中央区難波5-1-60.en: Tabelog: Abura Soba Mazesoba Roman Namba Minamiguchi, beside the 2nd-floor south ticket gate of Nankai Namba Station, 5-1-60 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 11:00–15:30 and 17:00–22:00; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking; opened 8 April 2025. Reviews (April–October 2026): near Nankai Namba Station but hard to find; everything-on maze-soba large; half rice to finish; a punchy maze-soba; medium-thick noodles; delivery; chewy thick noodles with meat, egg and special sauce; rice into the leftover sauce; just outside the 2nd-floor south ticket gate; not crowded; not a big shop; a flavour that divides opinion; one was bothered by staff chatter; large portions; two rounds of vinegar as the shop recommends; chili oil; extra sauce; garlic; maze-soba ¥1,000; a small, clean shop.

食べログ: 油そば・まぜそば ロマン アメ村店、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-11-9.en: Tabelog: Abura Soba Mazesoba Roman Amemura, 2-11-9 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 11:00–15:30 and 17:00–5:00 next morning; no reservations; no e-money, QR payment accepted; no smoking; opened 20 September 2026. 2026 reviews (September–October): abura soba ¥850; A set (rice and karaage) ¥300; a digital ticket machine, but just after opening electronic payment didn't work, so cash; add vinegar and chili oil; thick wavy house-made noodles; not greasy for abura soba; live-music venues nearby; first shop in Morinomiya in 2022; branches opened in Kobe Motomachi and Kishiwada the month before; maze-soba ¥1,000 and rice ¥50; about 3 tables and 8 counter seats; water and spoons self-serve; more sauce than expected and strong shoyu; spicy miso and garlic on the table; fish powder and shichimi on the self-serve shelf; tonkotsu ramen from 22:00; tonkotsu ramen ¥900 and leek ¥100; back fat; chashu; a sticker for one free topping; meat-heaped tonkotsu ramen ¥1,100 and soft-boiled egg ¥100; thin straight noodles; garlic, spicy miso, black pepper, ground sesame and chili oil on the table; everything-on abura soba with kimchi and fried onion; Taiwan maze-soba; open until morning.

食べログ: 法善寺 三平、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-7-9 日宝横丁ビル1F、26席.en: Tabelog: Hozenji Sanpei, Nippo Yokocho Bldg 1F, 1-7-9 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 26 seats (counter 8, tables 18); Mon and Wed–Fri 17:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:00, drinks L.O. 22:30), Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–15:30 (L.O. 14:45) and 17:00–23:00; closed Tuesdays; no smoking; cards and e-money accepted; features: vegetables, vegetarian menu; shop introduction: okonomiyaki with a fluffy batter, mentaiko-butter yakisoba, last entry 22:00. 2026 reviews (June–September): reservation; queues of overseas diners; the beef-tendon, leek and konnyaku is popular; the mix (pork, squid, shrimp) is on the light side; with a colleague from Nagoya; seafood yakisoba; leek tonpei; big shrimp; hard to find in the alleys of Hozenji Yokocho; you can get in right after opening; fast service; big ingredients; modan-yaki; grilled squid (salt and lemon); chicken thigh with ponzu; the fluffiest ever; bonito flakes and sauce.

食べログ: 法善寺 山岡、大阪市中央区難波1-1-14(法善寺横丁の入口)、05.en: Tabelog: Hozenji Yamaoka, 1-1-14 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka (entrance to Hozenji Yokocho), 050-5589-6219; reservations accepted; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 17:30–23:00; closed Wednesdays; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; service charge; 10 seats. Reviews (2024–2026): a menu that changes monthly; one wants to visit every season; assortment (unusual fish, small junsai); sashimi adjusted for a bonito allergy; sweet swordfish; grilled anago with plum paste; Yanagawa nabe; about 8 dishes including dessert; omakase only; for drinks, have the taisho choose the sake; the owner cooks almost single-handed; delicate cooking; sashimi on a big block of ice; house-made fruit sours; a rice ball to take home; prices on the high side.

食べログ: 法善寺 鮨 さかた、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-7-11、050-5597.en: Tabelog: Hozenji Sushi Sakata, 1-7-11 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 050-5597-0299; reservations accepted (not for those who can't eat raw food; treated as cancelled after 30 minutes without contact; cancellation fee); daily 12:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:30–22:30 (L.O. 21:30); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 10 seats (counter only); opened 1 October 2025. 2026 reviews (August–October): Hozenji Yokocho; a pale green noren; a warm wooden counter; washi lighting; Edomae omakase by a young sushi chef; aged sea bream; flounder from Aomori; bonito marinated with katsuobushi; kasugo (young sea bream); never-frozen squid from Kushimoto; anago with tsume sauce made from the bones; nothing ready-made, kanpyo, dashi and desserts all made in-house; omakase ¥14,300; full; lunch course; mostly Japanese diners; low in salt; white-miso pudding; large grains of rice with strong vinegar; oysters; bafun uni added; a friendly taisho.

食べログ: 泰明庵(たいめいあん)、銀座6-3-14、52席、平日11:30〜2.en: Tabelog: Taimei-an, Ginza 6-3-14; 52 seats; weekdays 11:30–21:00 (open straight through), closed weekends and holidays (closed Saturdays too from September 2026); no service charge; founded in 1950 as a fish shop, changed business in 1955. DIME: a long-established shop known for its winter-only "seri curry soba". Reviews: a back street near Taimei Elementary School; busy with office workers at lunch; you can drink from noon; herring and squid tempura, fried eggplant, dashimaki, seri ohitashi, seiro, chicken soba, tanuki soba ¥680 (December 2024); big portions, reasonably priced; mostly Japanese customers.

食べログ: 洋食 小春軒、洋食、カツ丼、コロッケ、洋食百名店2020・2022、.en: Tabelog: Yoshoku Koharuken, yoshoku, katsudon, croquettes; Yoshoku 100 2020 and 2022; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 1-7-9, 1 min walk from Ningyocho Station exit A2; Mon–Fri 11:00–13:30 and 17:00–20:00 (evenings not fixed), Sat 11:00–13:30; closed Sundays and holidays; no reservations; no cards or QR; transport IC and nanaco accepted; 18 seats; no smoking by day, smoking allowed at night. Reviews (March 2014–October 2026): founded 1912; the first owner, Tanemaru Kojima, trained at Seiyoken in Tsukiji and was Yamagata Aritomo's personal chef; katsudon ¥1,500 (bite-sized cutlets, vegetables simmered in demi-glace and a fried egg, with shijimi soup); special assorted platter ¥1,800; hamburg steak ¥1,300; butter-grilled swordfish; hospitality from the proprietress, the owner and the successor; queues before opening; one saw cleaning supplies left out.

食べログ: 洋食グリル木村家、銀座4-5-7 銀座木村家3F、銀座駅A9出口すぐ.en: Tabelog: Yoshoku Grill Kimuraya, Ginza 4-5-7, Ginza Kimuraya 3F, right by Ginza Station exit A9; 48 seats (all tables); daily 11:00–15:30, 16:30–20:00 (L.O. 19:00); closed 12/31 and 1/1; no reservations; allergen labeling; English menu; children's menu; strollers welcome; official site ginzakimuraya.jp. Shop introduction: old-fashioned yōshoku with all-you-can-eat Kimuraya house bread; beef stew of quality beef; crab cream croquettes packed with filling. 2026 reviews: beef stew ¥2,900; gratin ¥2,480; chicken and prosciutto salad ¥1,900; baguette fragrant with wheat; slightly sweet round bread; raisins; crab cream croquette and hamburg-steak curry gratin; 10 groups waiting at 13:00, seated in 30 minutes; window seats.

食べログ: 活魚居酒屋 マルフク、居酒屋・海鮮・ふぐ、中京区鍋屋町225 萩原ビ.en: Tabelog: 活魚居酒屋 マルフク, izakaya, seafood, fugu; 中京区鍋屋町225 萩原ビル 1F; 1 min on foot from Hankyu Kyoto Kawaramachi Station, 2 min from Gion-Shijo Station; Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00 (last food order 22:30); Sun 13:00–22:30; holidays 13:00–22:30; closing days vary; reservations taken; ¥400 charge; 19 seats; private room (4 people); sunken-floor and tatami seating; non-smoking (ashtray in front of the shop); cards accepted; particular about sake, shochu and fish. Reviews (2024–2026, in English): live hamo shabu-shabu course ¥11,000, sashimi platter, the day's tataki, an unrolled eel omelette, salt-grilled ayu, sudachi udon, matcha monaka; torafugu charcoal-grill course ¥9,800, fugu kejang, tessa, fried fugu, shichirin grill, hirezake; ramen to finish (salt or soy).

食べログ: 浅草茶屋たばねのし 大阪心斎橋店、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-6-34、.en: Tabelog: Asakusa Chaya Tabanenoshi Osaka Shinsaibashi, 1-6-34 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; opposite the Daimaru Shinsaibashi car park; weekdays and holidays 11:30–21:00, Sat 11:00–21:00, Sun 10:00–20:00 (L.O. 15 minutes before closing); opened 30 September 2024; no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; 8 seats; English menu; takeaway; a Japanese-crêpe specialist using Kakegawa matcha; official site. Reviews (September–October 2026): a chain from Asakusa; on Shimizumachi-suji; Kakegawa matcha brûlée (chewy matcha crêpe with matcha custard or cream, strawberries, matcha ice cream, caramelised top); autumn-only Tsukimi brûlée ¥1,250; hojicha and anko butter; Kakegawa matcha soft-serve; matcha latte; hojicha latte; ¥50 off drinks in a set; made in front of you; about 5 tables, full at weekends; takeaway too.

食べログ: 浪花オムライス、大阪市中央区南船場3-11-27 日宝シルバービル1.en: Tabelog: Naniwa Omurice, Nippo Silver Bldg 1F, 3-11-27 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 1; Mon 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–22:00, Tue 12:00–16:00 and 18:00–22:30, Wed 11:00–16:00 and 17:00–22:00, Thu 12:00–16:00 and 17:00–23:00, Fri–Sat 12:00–15:00 and 18:00–21:00, Sun 12:00–20:00; cash only; 6 counter seats. Reviews (July–October 2026): a back-street shop; the signature Naniwa omurice (fluffy egg, rich demi-glace, slow-simmered beef-tendon dote-ni and leek); with cheese too; sizes SS, S and regular (even SS fills you); choose rice amount and toppings; dote-ni on its own (large); hand-kneaded hamburg; the beef steak sometimes sells out; busy at lunch; a short wait at weekends.

食べログ: 浪速氷室、大阪市西区北堀江1-11-3、四ツ橋駅6番出口から徒歩1分.en: Tabelog: Naniwa Korishitsu, 1-11-3 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exit 6; 12:00–18:00; closed on rainy days; kakigori in summer only; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking; a bench for 3; takeaway. Reviews (August–September 2026): an old-style ice shop open only in summer; big blocks of clear ice shaved fine; fluffy, less brain-freeze; ¥360 a cup (strawberry, melon, Hawaiian blue, lemon with house syrup); extra milk ¥100, change from ¥500; lemonade; eaten standing on the pavement; short queues on hot afternoons; many families; a photo caption says 'next time maybe strawberry with extra milk'; the 2026 season ended on 23 September.

食べログ: 海鍋亭 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-5-6 つく志会館 1F、.en: Tabelog: Umi Nabe Tei Shinsaibashi, Tsukushi Kaikan 1F, 2-5-6 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Namba stations; Mon–Fri 18:00–1:00 next morning, Sat, Sun and holidays 17:00–1:00 next morning; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 15 seats (counter 7, two tables for 4); private hire on request; opened 20 November 2023. Reviews (August–October 2026): seafood hot pots of shrimp, offal, scallop and oyster; crab-miso gratin; shrimp shabu is popular; smoking allowed; shrimp-shabu course at 18:00 at the weekend; autograph boards; 5 kinds of sashimi (sweet shrimp and more); 2 pieces of sushi; about 1 kg of shrimp (about 10); can be eaten raw; risotto or noodles to finish; cheese; vanilla, chocolate or yuzu ice cream; hearty oyster hot pot ¥2,490 (per person); 3-shrimp tasting ¥990; 3 raw oysters ¥990; tuna yamakake ¥590; scallop skewer ¥490; squid skewer ¥290; 3-piece sushi platter ¥990; 1 kg of oysters; miso-butter soup; bean sprouts, nira, napa cabbage; 3 raw oysters ¥999 (direct from Hiroshima); hearty oyster hot pot ¥2,739; shrimp yukhoe ¥869; 2 pieces sushi ¥759; oyster miso-butter ramen ¥539; miso-butter risotto ¥649; cheese ¥100; pork and vegetables in the oyster hot pot; negitoro and eel hand rolls.

食べログ: 海鮮丼・寿司、中京区御幸町通錦小路上る船屋町389 1F、阪急河原町.en: Tabelog: kaisen-don, sushi; 中京区御幸町通錦小路上る船屋町389 1F; 4 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn; daily 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); bookings taken; 20 seats (8 counter, 12 table); non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR; English menu and English-speaking staff; children welcome; opened 27 April 2024. Reviews (May 2025–September 2026, in English): reopened 9 December 2025 with hand rolls added; Take kaisen-don ¥1,800; three soy sauces; bonito broth for chazuke to finish; mini bowl and two hand rolls set ¥2,300; Special set ¥3,000; some complaints about portions and prices.

食べログ: 深夜焼肉 じる、焼肉、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-1-25 大優ビル 1.en: Tabelog: Shinya Yakiniku Jiru, yakiniku, 大優ビル 1F, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 2-1-25, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Fri and Sat 23:00 to 4:00 the next morning, closed Sunday to Thursday; reservations by Instagram DM or phone; no cards, e-money or QR; non-smoking; Yakiniku 100 in 2026. Reviews (June 2023–November 2026): Pome's late-night second shop, where only the noren changes; à la carte centred on horumon; black tongue, tsurami, harami; horumon platter (tetchan, akasen, mino, small intestine and more) ¥1,480; mino sashimi ¥1,480; harami ¥1,680; shiso rice ¥500; 'nice white rice' ¥400; egg soup; Pome's staff-meal meat pasta (November 2026, prices without tax, table charge ¥300); a spicy ramen loaded with horumon; Shin Ramyeon; cold noodles; bibimbap; makgeolli; fully booked by reservation at 23:00 (March 2026); gas roasters; cash only; service by a woman on the floor staff.

食べログ: 清麺屋、大阪市浪速区日本橋西1-4-8 マンション田中1F、南海なん.en: Tabelog: Seimenya, Mansion Tanaka 1F, 1-4-8 Nipponbashi-nishi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 7 min walk from Nankai Namba Station, 5 min from Ebisucho Station; Mon and Wed–Fri 11:00–15:00, Sat–Sun 11:00–16:00; closed Tuesdays; PayPay accepted, no cards or e-money; 13 seats (counter 5, four tables for 2); no smoking; opened 1 November 2013; families and wheelchairs welcome. Reviews (August–October 2026): the southern end of Otaroad; limited tori-paitan curry ball; gentle tori paitan with medium-thick wavy noodles; cold niboshi soba ¥1,250; ticket machine; the two people in the kitchen and front of house are careful; red onion and chashu; strong niboshi; straight noodles; soup poured over rice like a cold chazuke; furikake; chicken-shoyu dipping soup with tenkasu and black shichimi; chicken-shoyu tsukemen (medium) ¥1,330; a shop loved for years; glossy noodles; a dipping soup that isn't too strong; about 15 minutes until served.

食べログ: 湯火功夫、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-6-19、06-6125-5283.en: Tabelog: Tang Huo Kung Fu, 2-6-19 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6125-5283; 38 seats (counter and tables); Sun–Thu and holidays 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30), Fri–Sat 11:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); irregular closing days; no smoking; cards and e-money accepted; opened 15 November 2019. 2026 reviews (March–October): many Chinese diners; authentic heat and numbing spice; coriander wilts when simmered; a chain with many shops in China; choose ingredients and soup; crab sticks, glass noodles and coriander recommended; adjustable heat; plenty of vegetables; renovated and clean; lots of seafood such as shrimp and octopus; many kinds of noodles; heat level 2 is hot enough; sesame sauce or coriander black vinegar; chicken wings, fried bread, sesame balls; sweet Chinese tea; panda-shaped ingredients; a medicinal-herb flavour; ¥380 per 100 g; soup of beef bones simmered 8 hours, finished with a special sesame and peanut sauce; tasty even non-spicy.

食べログ: 漬け野菜 イソイズム、創作料理、下京区七条通烏丸西入中居町114、京.en: Tabelog: 漬け野菜 イソイズム (Tsukeyasai Isoism), creative cuisine; 下京区七条通烏丸西入中居町114; 5 min on foot from Kyoto Station; lunch from 11:30 in four seatings (11:30, 12:00, 13:00, 13:30); dinner 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); irregular closures; reservations taken; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); QR accepted; counter seating; non-smoking; opened 18 July 2016. Reviews (2026, in English): the Gojyuya group; a sister of Sumisoudo; Kyoto vegetables from the group's own farm; 12 kinds of pickled vegetables with duck, steamed chicken or cheese; onion soup; seasonal clay-pot rice (mackerel and Kujo green onion); tofu dashimaki with homemade soy koji; fried yuba rolls; pork belly wrapped in mizuna; white-celery rare cutlet; coffee shochu.

食べログ: 濃厚中華そば よし田、大阪市中央区南船場3-6-25 IBC心斎橋e.en: Tabelog: Noukou Chuka Soba Yoshida, IBC Shinsaibashi east 1F, 3-6-25 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 211 m from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon 11:00–15:30 (L.O. 15:00), Tue–Sat 11:00–17:00 (L.O. 16:30); closed Sundays and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR; 20 seats (counter 12, four tables for 2); opened 25 April 2019. Reviews (August–October 2026): seasonal limited editions; October's sweet-spicy thickened shoyu ramen (from sweetness to heat and umami; garlic, nira, tofu; chunky chashu and back fat; thick wavy noodles; makes you want white rice); September's extra-vegetable back-fat miso butter corn; summer cold editions; a popular shop; thickened numbing-hot shoyu ramen ¥1,350 with rich fried rice set ¥280; like mapo noodles; restrained numbing and heat; small rice free until 14:00; back-fat chuka soba and maze-soba too; ticket machine; one calls it the best shoyu ramen; gentle but with solid shoyu; the fat isn't cloying; noodles with wheat flavour; many men dining alone; quick turnover; one says a strong sansho aroma but not hot.

食べログ: 炉端処 一心、焼き鳥、大阪市淀川区東三国5-7-3、東三国駅北口から.en: Tabelog: Robata Dokoro Isshin, yakitori, 5-7-3 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 2 min west of the north exit of Higashi-Mikuni Station; Mon–Fri and holidays 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–23:00 (last order food 22:15, drinks 22:30); Sat 17:00–23:00; closed Sunday; reservations accepted; cards, iD, QUICPay and PayPay accepted; raw-cabbage appetiser ¥380 medium, ¥250 small; 27 seats; tatami room; smoking allowed; English menu. Shop text: a chicken restaurant using Miyazaki Jitokko, Kawachi duck and Yamato chicken for yakitori, tataki and sashimi, with omurice, pasta and more. Reviews (February–September 2026): book at weekends; about 10 counter seats and 4–5 tatami tables; large skewers of yagen cartilage, rare breast, gizzard, seseri and tsukune; "gacha-yaki" (mixed cuts such as seseri and harami, sauce or salt); seven-cut chicken sashimi with sesame oil and salt; thigh sashimi; chicken soboro and salt-kombu potato salad; chicken nanban; fried horse mackerel; eggplant with chicken mince; white omurice; chicken and bonito rice balls; grilled nagaimo; yakisoba; lunch torijuu ¥1,100 (charcoal-grilled thigh and breast, dashimaki, two small sides, free refills of rice and miso soup).

Tabelog: Robata Dokoro Isshin, yakitori, 5-7-3 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 2 min west of the north exit of Higashi-Mikuni Station; Mon–Fri and holidays 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–23:00 (last order food 22:15, drinks 22:30); Sat 17:00–23:00; closed Sunday; reservations accepted; cards, iD, QUICPay and PayPay accepted; raw-cabbage appetiser ¥380 medium, ¥250 small; 27 seats; tatami room; smoking allowed; English menu. 食べログ: 炭屋 こばこ、大阪市中央区日本橋2-4-10 日本橋ＵＫビル 1F、.en: Tabelog: Sumiya Kobako, Nihonbashi UK Bldg 1F, 2-4-10 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nippombashi Station; daily 17:00–24:00 (L.O. food 23:00, drinks 23:30); closes when sold out; irregular closing days; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 18 seats (counter 6, three tables for 4); heated tobacco only inside. Reviews (May 2025 – October 2026): a small yakitori shop just off the shopping street; suited to small groups; skewers with salt, tare or wasabi; gizzard & negima; skin; furisode; tsukune; kokoro; neck; tsunagi; chicken sashimi platter; whole onion grilled with butter and salt-pepper; kara-age; yamaimo yuzu-zuke; chilled tofu topped with shiso; fries; a rich chicken soup with grilled rice ball to finish; katsuobushi TKG; Tanizake (about 80 ml for about ¥600); bottled Sapporo Lager Akaboshi; book ahead; one found service a little slow.

食べログ: 炭棲堂、居酒屋、南区東九条西山王町12-7、京都駅から305m、月・.en: Tabelog: 炭棲堂 (Sumizumi Do), izakaya; 南区東九条西山王町12-7; 305 m from Kyoto Station; Mon and Thu–Sun 8:00–12:00 and 17:00–23:00; Tue and Wed 17:00–23:00; reservations taken; cards, e-money and QR accepted; non-smoking; opened 26 March 2025. Leaf KYOTO (PR article): a new concept from the 五十家 group; vegetables from its own ISO FARM and partner farmers. Reviews (2026, in English): charcoal-grilled vegetables ¥800; lotus root with wild boar mince; shiitake with fermented-butter soy; domestic beef hanging tender 150 g ¥2,800; black wagyu inside round 200 g ¥3,800; bonito and vegetable carpaccio ¥1,300; yudofu ¥800; yuba and okra tempura ¥950; breakfast ¥2,400 (nine small dishes, a large yudofu, broth of nine vegetables); half portions for solo diners.

食べログ: 炭火串焼き 日向屋、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-3 GROOVE心.en: Tabelog: Sumibi Kushiyaki Hinataya, GROOVE Shinsaibashi East 1F, 1-17-3 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 6; daily 16:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); irregular closing days; opened 18 January 2021; 20 seats (counter 8 and tables); cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; smoking allowed. Reviews (April–August 2026): yakitori grilled with care one skewer at a time; pork skewers; spicy offal; fried cartilage; doteyaki; gatsu kimchi; sweet potato with honey mayo; draught beer ¥500 (incl. tax); a brimming highball; a chopstick lottery with messages; strongish seasoning, made for drinking; some found the staff cheerful, others curt and pushy.

食べログ: 炭火焼 鳥清、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-9-13 3F、長堀橋駅5-B.en: Tabelog: Sumibiyaki Torisei, 3F, 1-9-13 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station exit 5-B; Mon–Sat and holidays 17:30–23:00 (L.O. food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Sundays; cover charge ¥600 (included in course prices); cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 13 seats. Reviews (September–October 2026): on the 3rd floor of a small building, easy to walk past; courses only, such as ¥5,500; starters; tataki; skewers slow-grilled over charcoal (neck, tsukune); vegetables; grilled quail egg; a very hot chicken soup to finish; extra chicken sashimi; green-plum ice cream; Kirin Lager; small skewers but many of them, so filling; one found them salty; one felt it a little rushed.

食べログ: 炭火焼鳥専門 蔦、焼鳥・居酒屋・ラーメン、大阪市淀川区宮原5-9-2.en: Tabelog: Sumibi Yakitori Senmon Tsuta, yakitori, izakaya and ramen, 宮原 5-9-21, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; about 5 min from Higashimikuni Station (Osaka Metro), 7 min from JR Shin-Osaka Station, 10 min from Hankyu Mikuni Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–13:00 and 17:00–23:00, Sat, Sun, holidays and the days before and after a holiday 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); hours may change with supplies; closing days not fixed; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR payments (Alipay and WeChat Pay too) accepted; 25 seats (counter, sofas, tatami); private hire up to 20; heated tobacco only; wheelchair accessible; children welcome; kids menu; takeaway; opened 30 June 2023. The shop's introduction: domestic chicken over charcoal, tsukune and chicken wings, rare cuts, a homemade sweet-savoury sauce, sashimi; a yakitori course with two hours of drinks ¥5,500 (yakitori platter, chicken rice, kara-age). Reviews (June 2024 to October 2026): the charcoal grill behind glass, a five-kind chicken sashimi platter with sweet Kyushu soy sauce, tsukune as big as a rice ball, tsukune with quail egg, truffle tsukune, truffle fries, fried taro, Sapporo Black Label on draft, Takachiyo sake, a hot-pot course finished with ramen or zosui, lunch rice bowls at ¥1,000 (March 2026), one person running lunch so there can be a wait, under ¥4,000 a head.

食べログ: 炭火魚 旬彩料理 坂本、日本料理、四谷1-23-9 YOK BUIL.en: Tabelog: Sumibi Sakana Shunsai Ryori Sakamoto, Japanese cuisine; YOK BUILD 1F, Yotsuya 1-23-9; 5 min walk along Sanei-dōri from the Yotsuya exit of Yotsuya Station; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:45–22:00; closed Sundays; 20 seats (8 at the counter, 3 tables); semi-private room; non-smoking (no e-cigarettes either); cards and e-money accepted; 10% charge on top. Reviews (December 2025–October 2026): charcoal-grilled fish set ¥1,300 (black cod, Spanish mackerel, mackerel, salmon in Saikyo miso), Akita Komachi rice, red miso soup, two small sides, one free refill of grated daikon, sashimi and grilled fish set ¥2,000, negitoro bowl, cash only at lunch, full around 13:00, sashimi platters and corn tempura at night.

食べログ: 炭焼き 銀座まつもと、銀座7-7-19 ニューセンタービル2F、銀座.en: Tabelog: Sumiyaki Ginza Matsumoto, Ginza 7-7-19, New Center Building 2F, 5 minutes from Ginza Station; 36 seats; weekdays 11:45–15:00, 17:30–22:00, weekends and holidays 11:45–15:00 (also listed as lunch only on Sundays and holidays); irregular holidays; ¥500 cover charge at dinner; fully private rooms for 6–20; opened May 10, 2021; official site ginza-matsumoto.com. Shop introduction: 100% black-wagyu hamburg steak grilled over charcoal; lunch course ¥3,000 (starter, house consommé, main, curry rice); wine and seasonal grills and steak at night. 2026 reviews: Japanese black wagyu ground every morning, deep-red and rare inside; a hot iron lid to cook it to your liking; wagyu hamburg steak 200 g ¥2,300; brown rice; three sauces of onion, balsamic and grainy mustard (the mustard goes best); cut at the table; reheated a cooled iron plate; many travelers from overseas; about ¥2,000 at lunch and over ¥6,000 at night.

食べログ: 炭焼創彩鳥家 人見、焼き鳥、左京区二条通川端東入大菊町96、三条駅か.en: Tabelog: Sumiyaki Sosai Toriya Hitomi, yakitori, 左京区二条通川端東入大菊町96, about 7 min on foot from Sanjo Stn; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Wednesdays and irregularly; reservations accepted (phone easiest 15:00–16:45); 30 seats (counter and tables on 1F, tables on 2F); no cards; children welcome; Yakitori Tabelog 100 2018, 2019, 2021, 2022; Yakitori WEST Tabelog 100 2023–2025. Reviews (March–November 2026, in English): opened 2005, owner Tomoki Hitomi, Kishu binchotan, a Takasaka chicken omakase, a humble and attentive owner, hard to book.

食べログ: 炭焼鳥miya、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-3-32 登美弥ビル1F、地.en: Tabelog: Sumiyaki-dori miya, Tomiya Bldg 1F, 2-3-32 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from subway Namba Station exit 14; Mon–Sat and holidays 18:00–6:00 next morning (L.O. 5:30), Sun 18:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; smoking allowed; 16 seats (counter 10, tables 6); salt yakitori, salt tsukune, a 130 g charcoal-grilled speciality. Reviews (November 2024 – January 2026): mostly counter with one table; book for 4 or more; the owner runs it almost single-handed; salt yakitori; chicken sashimi; tataki; yukhoe; daily specials on the whiteboard (octopus, bruschetta, beef tongue, butter-fried king oyster, garlic shrimp); grilled rice ball in house chicken soup; course with all-you-can-drink ¥4,950 (yakitori, chicken sashimi, old-hen ponzu, 2 small dishes, grilled rice ball); solo bookings accepted; superb skin; all-you-can-drink with 3-dish course ¥2,750 (obanzai, 3 recommended skewers); fun conversation with the owner; a long narrow shop; regulars drinking from kept bottles; one felt prices had risen; party course ¥4,000 (3 obanzai, chicken sashimi, 5 skewers or skirt steak, house karaage, chicken-avocado baguette sandwich, grilled rice ball); smoking allowed; can't see in from outside; one called it ordinary.

食べログ: 烹祥庵、日本料理・焼肉・居酒屋、中京区先斗町通四条上ル鍋屋町227.en: Tabelog: Hosho An, Japanese cuisine, yakiniku, izakaya; 紫光会館 1F back, 鍋屋町227, north of Shijo on Pontocho-dori, Nakagyo-ku; 3 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi and Keihan Gion-Shijo stations; Tuesday–Sunday 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Monday (the Tuesday after a Monday holiday may be closed); 20 seats (tables); private hire for 20; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; cards accepted; opened 28 March 2016; kawadoko from May to the end of September; black-wagyu sukiyaki hot-pot set ¥7,000; black-wagyu yakiniku and meat sushi, yuba, yudofu; night views of the Kamo River and Higashiyama; 100% cancellation charge on the day before and the day; one dish and one drink per person. Reviews (May 2025–October 2026, in English): Fuji lava-stone yakiniku course ¥9,500, hamo shabu, lobster, abalone, yudofu, kawadoko, view of the Minamiza, mixed opinions.

食べログ: 無双心 祇園店、ラーメン・つけ麺・食堂、東山区大和大路四条下ル小松町.en: Tabelog: Musou Shin Gion, ramen, tsukemen, eatery; 小松町558-2, south of Shijo on Yamato-oji, Higashiyama-ku; 238 m from Gion-Shijo Station; every day 11:30–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); reservations accepted; 15 seats (11 counter, one table for 4); non-smoking; no cards; opened 2 July 2014; Kameoka's veggie-pota ramen; a chicken and pork-bone soup with eight aromatic vegetables; homemade flat noodles; tender chashu; mazesoba with Maeda Kaisen mentaiko; a Thai-style bowl. Reviews (September 2024–September 2026, in English): Musou Shin ramen ¥1,200, black sesame ramen, ajitama tsukemen, tonkotsu ramen, ticket machine, many overseas guests, the Toronto shop listed in the Michelin Guide, a Kameoka shop.

食べログ: 無限ラーメン 千日前店、大阪市中央区難波1-2-2、毎日11:00〜.en: Tabelog: Mugen Ramen Sennichimae, 1-2-2 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 11:00–22:00; cards accepted (VISA); opened 12 August 2023. 2026 reviews (September–October): many overseas diners and prices on the high side; limited ramen over ¥2,000; good beef-bone soup; the loin rice bowl in the set is salty; nearly all overseas diners even on weekdays; plenty of side dishes; electronic payment accepted; rich creamy beef-bone paitan; easy to eat; one had concerns about cleanliness; the tonkotsu ramen is not too strong; noodles slightly firm; a mala-style spicy condiment; frothy creamy soup; two kinds of chashu, seared and moist; soft-boiled seasoned egg; leek; menma; shoyu kaeshi; chicken bones and beef knuckle; back-fat aroma oil; thin straight noodles.

食べログ: 無限ラーメン 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区南船場3-7-24、心斎橋から2.en: Tabelog: Mugen Ramen Shinsaibashi, 3-7-24 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 287 m from Shinsaibashi; no opening hours listed; no cards, e-money or QR; opened 15 September 2024. Reviews (August–October 2026): the most expensive ramen; marbled loin like roast beef; quiet right after opening; usually a queue; frothy soup; rich but not cloying; a slight smell in one of the 2 kinds of chashu; busy around 22:00; beef-bone paitan ramen ¥1,050; chose rich; kiwi ramen; a strong beef-bone flavour; easier to drink than it looks; beef-bone paitan ramen with seasoned egg ¥130; 80% full at weekday lunch; a creamy soup and thin noodles reminiscent of Hakata ramen; slight sweetness; one slice of chashu; set with small melting-chashu rice bowl ¥1,450; toppings differ by shop.

食べログ: 無限ラーメン、大阪市浪速区難波中3-16-7、大国町から429m、毎.en: Tabelog: Mugen Ramen, 3-16-7 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 429 m from Daikokucho; daily 11:00–23:00; irregular closing days; e-money accepted, no cards or QR; no smoking; opened 21 December 2020. Reviews (April–August 2026): aroma of beef bones; beef-bone paitan ramen; spicy beef-bone chashu-men; rich and creamy; roast beef and fatty brisket; set with mini chashu rice bowl; the rice soggy and salty; many overseas staff and diners; a menu for inbound visitors; Sichuan pepper; heat milder than Shin Ramyun; nira; tough, strongly seasoned chashu; one found it underwhelming for ¥1,350; slow service; rich.

食べログ: 焼うおいし川 銀座凛華楼、銀座4-6-16 三越銀座店新館12F、2.en: Tabelog: Yaki Uo Ishikawa Ginza 凛華楼, Ginza 4-6-16, Mitsukoshi Ginza Annex 12F; 24 seats (13 counter, a private counter room for 9); weekdays 11:00–15:00, 17:00–22:00, weekends and holidays 11:00–22:00; closed January 1; opened September 25, 2025; official site yakiuo-ishikawa.jp. Shop introduction: "yakiniku that grills no meat" = yaki-uo, eight years in the making by the founder of Tsukiji Aozora; o-toro as "special kalbi"; house condiments and sauces; red-vinegar rice. 2026 reviews: ladies' lunch (rice refills, cold noodles, dessert); fish grilled in front of you, starting with the head; yukhoe-style and sukiyaki-style dishes; raw mehikari; sukiyaki course about ¥4,000 + ¥400 service charge; many customers from Hong Kong and Singapore; a little salty; some waiting.

食べログ: 焼きとり おでん さかじ、居酒屋・焼き鳥・おでん、六番町4-3 GE.en: Tabelog: Yakitori Oden Sakaji, izakaya, yakitori, oden; Rokubanchō 4-3, GEMS Ichigaya 4F; 3 min walk from Ichigaya Station; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–23:30, Sat, Sun and holidays 17:00–23:30; irregular closing days; reservations taken (online 24 hours); ¥550 cover charge (included in courses); cards and PayPay accepted; 60 seats (6 at the counter, private-room tables, a sunken kotatsu table); smoking allowed; opened 30 November 2021; yakitori of local chicken, oden all year, seasonal obanzai, regional sake. Reviews (2025–2026): salt-based oden; omakase 5 skewers ¥1,650; dashimaki ¥858; lunch set meals ¥1,000–1,300; yakitori set meal ¥1,300; oyakodon; chazuke to finish; the partitions do not reach the ceiling.

食べログ: 焼き鳥 参 木屋町店 (umaimonyaki sun)、焼き鳥・も.en: Tabelog: 焼き鳥 参 木屋町店 (umaimonyaki sun), yakitori, motsu-nabe and vegetable dishes; 中京区木屋町通四条上る下樵木町204-3; 3 min on foot from Hankyu Kawaramachi Station; daily 18:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); irregular closures; reservations taken; 30 seats (counter, tables, sunken kotatsu, tatami); the second floor can be booked for 14–20 people; a smoking area for heated tobacco only; cards accepted; menus in English, Chinese and Korean; English- and Korean-speaking staff; particular about vegetables; vegetarian options; all-you-can-drink courses. Reviews (2024–2026, in English): binchotan; local chicken; vegetables bought daily; the signature lard rice; 10-skewer assortment; tsukune; fried bonjiri; avocado with house chili oil; eggplant dengaku; lotus-root chijimi; QR ordering; steep stairs.

食べログ: 焼き鳥 熾火、大阪市中央区船場中央4-1-10 船場センタービル10.en: Tabelog: Yakitori Okibi, Semba Center Bldg No. 10 B1F, 4-1-10 Semba-chuo, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 92 m from Hommachi Station; Mon–Sat and holidays 11:30–22:30 (L.O. 22:00; lunch 11:30–15:00); closed Sundays; cards, e-money and QR accepted; smoking area in front of the shop; 15 counter seats. Reviews (September–October 2026): yakitori of Banshu Akadori aged 5 days; breast and negima ¥300 each (tare or salt); tsukune; aged thigh tataki ¥780; thigh and breast tataki tasting; crab miso and cream cheese with flaked crab and ikura; chicken liver simmered with sansho; mapo tofu; shrimp marinated in Shaoxing wine; oyakodon to finish; ramen at lunch (tori paitan; tori-paitan chashu-men with pork and chicken rare chashu and seasoned egg ¥1,450; chicken-dashi black-sesame tantanmen; noodles custom-made by Sugano Seimenjo); friendly, courteous staff.

食べログ: 焼き鳥、中京区壬生坊城町8-24、阪急四条大宮駅から徒歩2分、毎日1.en: Tabelog: yakitori, 中京区壬生坊城町8-24, 2 min on foot from Shijo-Omiya Stn (Hankyu); daily 17:00–23:00; closed irregularly; reservation only (taken until the end of December; free seats posted on Instagram @torikago.kyoto); omakase course of 11 skewers ¥15,000 with soft drinks, ¥17,000 with alcohol (tax included, 1–8 people); 8 seats; can be hired for up to 20; cards accepted; non-smoking; opened 20 August 2023; Yakitori WEST Tabelog 100 2024, 2025. Reviews (February–September 2026, in English): the owner, Kato, came from Torisaki; strong-fire grilling in the Torishiki style; Date chicken; run single-handed; two seatings, 17:00 and 20:30; a QR-code drinks menu; gizzard, neck, whole heart, chōchin, tsukune, oyakodon, takikomi gohan; the room gets hot.

食べログ: 焼き鳥・居酒屋・肉料理、南区東九条室町31、月〜金 17:00〜23.en: Tabelog: yakitori, izakaya, meat; 31 Higashikujo Muromachi, Minami-ku; Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00; closed Saturday and Sunday; bookings from a month ahead; two-hour slots 17–19, 19–21, 21–23; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; no smoking (ashtray outside); no service charge; deep in an alley, the lantern of the neighbouring Kouyouken is the landmark; 5 min walk from the Hachijo exit of Kyoto Station; Yakitori WEST Tabelog 100 2024, 2025. Reviews (March 2025 – September 2026, in English): seseri (three pieces wound on a skewer); negima; tsukune; cheese tsukune; curry negima; liver; heart; gizzard; yagen; local chicken with plum; Kyoto pork; water eggplant; Manganji peppers; chilled tomato; watermelon sour (the owner's wife grates fresh watermelon); salt, tare or omakase; about ¥4,000–4,500.

食べログ: 焼肉 Union、大阪市西区新町2-17-5 アクトワン新町 1F、.en: Tabelog: Yakiniku Union, Act One Shinmachi 1F, 2-17-5 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 7 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station, 1 min from Life Nishi-Ohashi; Mon, Wed–Sun and holidays 18:00–23:00 (L.O. food 22:30); closed Tuesdays; cards, QUICPay and PayPay accepted; heated tobacco allowed inside; 11 seats (counter 6, tables 5). Reviews (May–October 2026): a stylish yakiniku restaurant; wagyu yukhoe ¥1,600; wagyu skirt-sashimi yukhoe ¥1,600; Kuroge wagyu premium tongue ¥3,500 (limited); top salted tongue ¥2,800; premium skirt ¥2,200; premium lean ¥1,800; top lean ¥1,200; heart sashimi; abu-hatsu; tsurami; mino; kori kori; tongue kalbi; omakase platter (say lean or kalbi); wagyu chiritori nabe (lean and offal, vegetables, extra available); reimen ¥800; yukgaejang soup ¥800; kimchi ¥800; spicy grated-daikon ponzu ¥400; rice ¥350; about ¥10,000 each; same-day bookings possible; pleasant staff.

食べログ: 焼肉、下京区仏光寺通油小路西入ル、京都駅からタクシー5分、大宮駅から.en: Tabelog: yakiniku, 下京区仏光寺通油小路西入ル, 5 min by taxi from Kyoto Stn, 462 m from Omiya Stn; 17:00–21:30, closed Wednesday; reservations accepted; 16 seats (4 at the counter, 1 table, 2 tatami tables); no cards, e-money or QR; non-smoking (ashtrays outside); Yakiniku Tabelog 100 2018; Yakiniku WEST Tabelog 100 2020–2023 and 2025; Grill WEST Tabelog 100 2024 and 2026. Kyoto sightseeing site (aquadina, undated): 下京区喜吉町161; quality Omi beef; 8–9 cuts, mostly lean; ichibo tataki; yaki-shabushabu with grated daikon and ponzu. Reviews (August 2025–September 2026, in English): run by a family; the recommended order of ichibo steak, yaki-shabu, premium tongue and filet; a sauce for each cut; filet ¥2,900, yaki-shabu ¥2,000, premium tongue ¥1,800, ichibo steak ¥1,500, tetchan ¥800, kimchi ¥600; booked a month ahead.

食べログ: 焼肉、東山区祇園町南側572-10、祇園四条駅から徒歩8分、花見小路.en: Tabelog: yakiniku; 東山区祇園町南側572-10; 8 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn, right off Hanamikoji; daily 13:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); reservation only; 13:00–15:00 serves the evening menu and needs booking two days ahead; same-day bookings, private rooms, non-smoking requests and 6+ guests by phone; charcoal prepared for the booked time; same-day cancellation may be charged 100%; fillet or Chateaubriand courses only; one course per person aged 12+; 30 seats; private rooms (2, 4, 6; 10% of the food bill); designated smoking area; cards; opened 3 August 2021; invoice T9120901044728; courses (before tax): fillet or Chateaubriand 200 g ¥21,000, 300 g ¥23,000; Yakiniku WEST Tabelog 100 2023–2026. NTA corporate-number site: 株式会社瀧 (Chuo-ku, Osaka). Reviews (May–October 2026, in English): the first disciple of Kimiyah (Ikoma, Nara); unbred female cattle only; grilled while torn with a fork; three kimchi, grilled vegetables, special tongue, fillet soup, seasonal fruit.

食べログ: 焼肉とかすうどん 龍の巣 銀座七丁目 G7、銀座7-2-8、銀座駅C.en: Tabelog: Yakiniku and kasu udon Ryunosu Ginza 7-chome G7, Ginza 7-2-8, 5 minutes from Ginza Station exit C2 and Shinbashi Station Ginza exit; 40 seats (20 counter and more, 1 semi-private room); Mon–Sat 17:00–5:00, Sundays and holidays 17:00–24:00; open every day; smoking area for heated tobacco only; children welcome; opened December 21, 2020; official site ryu-nosu.co.jp. Shop introduction: carefully chosen Yamagata beef and wine by the glass; a wide counter, fine alone too; a semi-private room and big tables. 2026 reviews: tender tongue; the famous kasu udon; a guess-the-wine game; otoshi set ¥1,080; ura-harami ¥1,780; bean-sprout namul ¥580; thin-sliced lean tongue with scallions ¥1,780; raw liver ¥1,280; to finish after drinking; late-night hours; cheerful staff.

食べログ: 焼肉はうす たられば、焼肉・ホルモン、大阪市淀川区西中島3-12-8.en: Tabelog: Yakiniku House Tarareba; yakiniku, offal; 西中島3-12-8, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 2 minutes on foot from Hankyu Minamikata Station, 3 from Nishinakajima-Minamigata; Mon–Sat and days before holidays 17:00–23:00, holidays 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday; table-only bookings need ¥2,000 a head; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no cover charge; 35 seats (8 at the ground-floor counter, sunken kotatsu upstairs); opened 2 September 2024. Reviews (2026): whole Kagoshima black wagyu, A5 female cattle (BMS 10 or above); charcoal; five rare cuts (haneshita, kurimi, misuji, kainomi and more); premium assortment ¥3,300; tongue three ways ¥4,180 (half size available); large ribeye sukiyaki-style ¥1,760; yodare harami ¥990; chicken breast sashimi ¥660; premium harami sashimi ¥1,870; special tongue sashimi ¥1,980; Sakurajima yukhoe; offal; jidori; kurobuta; koune shabu-shabu; Tarare cold noodles; bibimbap; courses ¥4,500, ¥6,500 and ¥8,000; tablet and QR ordering; half sizes for solo diners.

食べログ: 焼肉やまちゃん、焼肉・日本料理、中京区蛸屋町157-11、烏丸駅・河.en: Tabelog: Yakiniku Yamachan, yakiniku and Japanese cuisine, 中京区蛸屋町157-11, 8 min on foot from Karasuma or Kawaramachi Stn; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 17:00–22:30 (last order 21:30); closed Wednesday; reservations accepted; 22 seats (counter 12, tables 10); two private rooms on 1F; smoking area outside; cards accepted; opened 2 April 2021; Yakiniku WEST Tabelog 100 2021–2023, 2025; Grill WEST Tabelog 100 2024, 2026. Reviews (May–October 2026, in English): a sister restaurant of Tomikoji Yamagishi, course only ¥13,500 (tax included), cow-shaped yukhoe, thick-cut tongue, grill-it-yourself style, a counter divided into pairs.

食べログ: 焼飯と麺、大阪市中央区大手前1-6-3、天満橋から44m、月〜金 1.en: Tabelog: Yakimeshi to Men, 1-6-3 Otemae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 44 m from Tenmabashi; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–21:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–21:00; no cards, e-money or QR; 14 seats (counter 4, five tables for 2); opened 13 May 2024. Reviews (August–October 2026): ticket machine on the ground floor (cash only, no ¥5,000 or ¥10,000 notes); seats upstairs via steep, narrow stairs; water and returns self-serve; chuka soba and half fried rice set ¥1,280–1,290 (one says it was ¥980 the week before); thin straight noodles with a soba-like texture; a light shoyu soup; 2 slices of rare chashu; thick menma; white and green leek; seasoned egg; fragrant, fluffy fried rice of leek, chashu and egg; some come for the fried rice, others found both bland; the banners advertise fried rice.

食べログ: 焼鳥 サイヒ、焼き鳥、南船場4-10-22、心斎橋駅から徒歩8分、月.en: Tabelog: Yakitori Saihi; yakitori; Minami-Senba 4-10-22; 8 min walk from Shinsaibashi station; Mon–Sat 19:00–21:30, all guests start together; closed Sunday; reservation only, course only; 7 counter seats; private hire possible; non-smoking; English menu; smart-casual dress code; cards accepted (VISA, Master, JCB); opened 13 December 2021; Yakitori WEST Tabelog 100 in 2024 and 2025. TableCheck: omakase course ¥12,000 (tax included); the meal takes two and a half to three hours. Reviews (May–September 2026): a woman owner runs it alone; an old house at the back of a Senba back alley; skin-on neck of Satsuma Gokkei chicken; thigh tataki grilled over straw and charcoal; chawanmushi with jidori chicken and bonito dashi; liver pâté; tsukune with salt; chicken tender with plum; extra skewers (furisode, cartilage with mayonnaise); clay-pot rice to finish (eel in July, new ginger in September); the course changes monthly; bookings about a month ahead; private hire for six or more; a small gift to take home.

食べログ: 焼鳥 御廉、大阪市中央区難波1-3-13、御堂筋線なんば駅B16出口.en: Tabelog: Yakitori Oren, 1-3-13 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Midosuji Line Namba Station exit B16; daily 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); irregular closing days (announced on Instagram); reservations accepted; service charge ¥500; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 14 seats (counter 6, tables 8); opened 1 June 2024; private hire by phone. Reviews (August–October 2026): the owner met a request made in advance; sasami yakitori; liver kamameshi; kamameshi to finish; draught beer from a swing tap; limited junmai daiginjo of Toyo Bijin; 9-skewer yakitori course; half jidori sashimi; the rare cut 'sori'; 7-skewer course with liver sashimi and 3 skewers; negima, neck, chochin, cartilage; reservation essential; the 2nd floor is hot-pot courses only; yakitori at the ground-floor counter; 9 skewers and chawanmushi course ¥3,500; soft-drink refills; fresh liver and tataki; 5-skewer course; kumquats pickled in shoyu; one says fewer dishes for the same price; cream cheese pickled in shoyu; private hire and all-you-can-drink upstairs; 6 seats at an L-shaped counter; neck, heart, wing, gizzard, sasami.

食べログ: 焼鳥と釜飯 なかもと、大阪市中央区難波4-3-23、06-6633-.en: Tabelog: Yakitori to Kamameshi Nakamoto, 4-3-23 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6633-3338; 48 seats (up to 50 seated); daily 17:00–4:00 next morning (food L.O. 3:00, drinks L.O. 3:30); open every day of the year; smoking on the terrace only; 2-hour limit when busy; cards and QR payment accepted (no e-money); opened 4 April 2025. 2026 reviews (January–August): reviews call it 'Yakitori to Kamameshi Gocchin'; a back alley right by Namba Station; red lanterns; a Kyushu-style izakaya; chicken soboro and burdock kamameshi; smoke drifts up to the 2nd floor; mobile ordering; on the site of a former Thai street-food place; SASAYA group; yakitori not on skewers; 3-kind yakitori platter ¥1,320 (ordered after registering on LINE); 3 grilled vegetables ¥1,078; fried mehikari ¥858; edamame as the table charge ¥418; outdoor seats; the kamameshi takes time, order early; meat dishes and vegetable dishes too.

食べログ: 焼鳥・鶏料理・創作料理、中京区下丸屋町406 グランドランド3F、京.en: Tabelog: yakitori, chicken dishes, creative; 中京区下丸屋町406 グランドランド 3F; 5 min on foot west of Keihan Sanjo Stn, 1 min south of Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn; daily 18:00–24:00; irregular closures; reservation only (17:00 and 22:00 entries by phone only); no table charge; 15 seats; private hire up to 20; smoking at table seats only; BYO possible; cards accepted; opened 27 July 2022. Reviews (November 2024–June 2026, in English): the owner runs it alone; several chicken brands including Takasaka chicken; omakase and à la carte; white-liver sashimi; breast and thigh tataki; 'tori no toro taku'; heart; liver stew; a rice bowl to finish; no prices or drinks list shown; one guest found the skewers uneven and the tare and rice bowl too spicy (June 2026); many guests from abroad.

食べログ: 熟成うどん なかや、うどん・居酒屋・うどんすき、うどん WEST 百.en: Tabelog: Jukusei Udon Nakaya, udon, izakaya and udon-suki, Tabelog Udon WEST 100 2024, フォルム新大阪 1F, 5-3-52 Miyahara, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 2 min from Exit 5 of Higashi-Mikuni Station; Mon–Fri 11:15–14:15 and 18:00–21:30, Sat and holidays 11:15–14:15 and 17:30–21:30; last lunch entry 14:00; closed Sunday and holiday Mondays; may close early when the noodles run out; phone reservations for parties, or for seats if spending ¥2,000–3,000 a head; cash only; 25 seats (5 at the counter, 20 at tables); non-smoking; children welcome; opened 15 November 2010. Reviews (July 2024 to October 2026): thick, firm, chewy noodles, best cold; torichiku-ten bukkake ¥980; hot torichiku-ten udon with kayaku rice ¥980; the cold one ¥1,100; chikuwa-tempura kitsune tororo udon ¥980; Nakaya duck udon ¥1,100 (warm duck dip with cherry tomatoes, lemon and soft-boiled egg); kamo-tama udon; today's set (bukkake udon with a pork or kakiage bowl) ¥930; a little extra udon free; an izakaya at night with katsuo fry and tartar sauce, mega chuhai, lemon hiyakake udon to finish; lines at weekday lunch.

食べログ: 熟成鮨 利他 なんば心斎橋、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-6-7 s-Fr.en: Tabelog: Jukusei Sushi Rita Namba Shinsaibashi, s-Front Dotonbori 3F, 2-6-7 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka (opposite APA Hotel Namba Shinsaibashi, a grey building beside a car park; new, so may not appear on maps); 236 m from Osaka-Namba; reservations only; dinner from 18:00 and 20:30, weekend and holiday lunch from 12:00; irregular closing days; 5% service charge from December 2025; private hire for 12 or more by arrangement a month ahead; cards accepted (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), no e-money or QR; 18 seats; private room; opened 1 May 2025. Reviews (September–October 2026): ageing time varied by fish; careful explanations; considerate about photos; a surprise birthday plate; aged-sushi omakase ¥14,800; 10–12 nigiri with sashimi, grilled, simmered and soup courses; one says many overseas diners; sea bream with tosa-vinegar jelly over binchotan; flash-frozen, scored aori squid with Himalayan rock salt and sudachi; striped jack aged 7 days; king crab and snow crab chawanmushi; seared Kesennuma bonito with ginger; dry-aged chutoro on rice at 42 °C; Densuke anago shabu-shabu; the signature botan shrimp with shrimp roe and sea urchin; Saikyo-miso yuan-yaki of yellowtail; kinmedai aged 6 days; amberjack roll with gari, sprouted leek and honey ume; ara-jiru from trimmings grilled 20 minutes and simmered 4 hours; alum-free sea urchin in brine; marinated lean tuna; vanilla pudding; 'ultimate umami with time on its side'.

食べログ: 燙楽屋 麻辣湯、大阪市中央区日本橋1-20-2 1F、06-6556.en: Tabelog: Tangleya Malatang, 1F, 1-20-2 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6556-7168; no reservations; daily 11:00–23:59 (L.O. 23:45); cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 25 seats; no smoking; opened 11 July 2025; site 0665567168.com. 2026 reviews (April–August): unlimited coriander; quail eggs; fish-roe kamaboko; sweet-potato noodles; the shrimp is best; one found the soup a little thin; unlimited leek; about ¥2,000 at 30% off; over 70 ingredients; radish cake; shredded kombu; Spam; chewy knife-cut noodles; glass noodles and fu; heat level 2 tastes like a light tonkotsu; weigh, pay and wait with a number tag; minimum weight; near Kuromon Market; 20% off; attentive staff; aprons and baskets; only slightly spicy at first, then gradually addictive; a flavour tuned for Japanese diners.

食べログ: 片岡篤司、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-13-11 クイント心斎橋ビル 1.en: Tabelog: Kataoka Atsushi, Quinto Shinsaibashi Bldg 1F, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-13-11, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 350 m from Shinsaibashi Stn, 229 m from Nagahoribashi Stn; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 18:00–23:00; closed Wednesday; reservation only; cards, Rakuten Edy, iD, QUICPay, PayPay and Rakuten Pay accepted; 9 seats (counter 8); non-smoking; opened 17 November 2024. Reviews (January 2025–October 2026): Kataoka, who led Sushi Shizuku Nagahori, went independent; bookings filled more than three months ahead before opening and now there's a six-month wait; book via the OMAKASE site or Instagram DM (@atushi.sushi); a grey Italian plaster wall with the name in vertical stainless-steel letters; several kinds of shari matched to the toppings, firm red-vinegar seasoning, firm and on the large side; sushi course ¥25,000; Akashi sea bream, Awaji squid, Nemuro ikura, charcoal-grilled Chiba hairtail, Kesennuma bonito, Lake Biwa trout, Otaru saury with matsutake rice, marinated tuna, chu-toro, Kishiwada kintaro sardine, Hokkaido botan shrimp, simmered anago; add-ons: toro-taku roll and "adult" ebi mayo; apprentice Kanta; a young taishō; some found it too salty.

食べログ: 牛料理・ステーキ、下京区北小路通新町西入井筒町656、京都駅から徒歩.en: Tabelog: beef dishes, steak; 下京区北小路通新町西入井筒町656; 8 min on foot from Kyoto Stn; daily 12:00–14:00 and 17:00–22:00; irregular closures; courses only (no à la carte); bookings are for seats and the course is chosen on arrival; two-hour seating; 10% service charge; 12 seats (counter only); private hire possible; non-smoking; cards accepted; a remodelled Kyoto townhouse built in 1890; Kyoto beef as 'meat kappo'; birthday dessert plate; opened 15 July 2023. Reviews (September–November 2026, in English): courses ¥20,000 and ¥22,000 (premium anniversary course online only); seared wagyu with ponzu jelly; tataki; beef sashimi with swordtip squid; strip loin with pickled-daikon rice; beef shabu-shabu soup; tenderloin sandwich; beef tempura or spring rolls; Chateaubriand; sudachi sorbet.

食べログ: 牛料理・ステーキ、東山区祇園町南側577-3、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分.en: Tabelog: beef dishes, steak; 祇園町南側577-3, Higashiyama-ku; 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn; Monday, Thursday, Saturday, Sunday 12:00–15:00, 16:00–18:30 and 19:00–22:30; Wednesday, Friday 16:00–18:30 and 19:00–22:30; closed Tuesday (and irregularly); reservation only; allergies in advance; 10% service charge; 8 counter seats; non-smoking; cards accepted; head chef Yoshitaka Oka, over 20 years grilling meat; aged-beef kaiseki grilled over a distant fire of charcoal and firewood; Tajima beef. Reviews (August 2024–September 2026, in English): Omi beef (Fukunaga, Shiga); Kobe beef; Tokachi beef aged 70 days; Oka katsu (Chateaubriand); tartare styled as a Kyoto garden; meat congee; aged steaks; dinner about ¥30,000–50,000 a head; lunch ¥13,200 in 2024; occasional Sunday fan lunch 'Oka Shokudo'; English spoken; originally in Shiga.

食べログ: 牛骨ら～めん ぶっこ志 北浜店、大阪市中央区道修町1-5-12、北浜.en: Tabelog: Gyukotsu Ramen Bukkoshi Kitahama, 1-5-12 Doshomachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Kitahama Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–14:30 and 17:30–22:45; closed weekends; no cards, e-money or QR; 11 counter seats; opened 11 July 2016. Reviews (September–October 2026): a beef-bone soup specialist; one says it belongs to the Kokorozashi group; spicy beef paitan with seasoned egg ¥1,100; balance of creamy soup and heat; meal tickets; self-serve water; one says about 8 counter seats; cloudy white soup; 2 slices of chashu; shredded white leek; pea shoots; noodles a little firm; extra-meat beef-bone paitan ¥1,250; white rice ¥100 at lunch; beef-belly chashu; baby corn; house-made straight noodles; check Instagram for Sunday opening; no dairy, light yet rich; roast-pork rice bowl sold out, so roast-beef rice; one found the chashu smelly; beef-bone paitan ramen (seasoned egg) ¥850; good after drinking too.

食べログ: 牡蠣 HachiRou 86、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-2-29 五つ.en: Tabelog: Kaki HachiRou 86, Itsutsuboshi Bldg 5F, 2-2-29 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; east from the GU on Shinsaibashisuji shopping street; Mon–Thu and days before and after holidays 18:00–1:00 next morning, Fri, Sat, Sun and holidays 17:30–1:00 next morning (food L.O. 24:00); reservations accepted (50% for same-day course cancellations); cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 16 seats (counter 6, tables); opened 20 April 2011. Reviews (March–September 2026): oyster tasting; steamed oysters; oyster gratin; fried oysters; oyster jjigae; oysters to enjoy affordably; superb raw oysters; piping-hot fried oysters; a bar-like atmosphere, good for a date; round tables for two; tasting of 5 seasonal raw oysters; one found some oysters fishy; rock oysters from Murotsu (Hyogo) are rich; rock oysters from Naruto (Tokushima) are milk of the sea; ajillo and clay-pot rice (takes 30 minutes, order first); 5 raw oysters; wines to match oysters; oyster pasta.

食べログ: 玉製家、大阪市中央区千日前1-4-4、日本橋駅B28出口から99m、.en: Tabelog: Gyokusei Ya, 1-4-4 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 99 m from Nippombashi Station exit B28; 14:00 until sold out; closed Wednesdays, Thursdays, Sundays and holidays (open during the equinox weeks and Obon); no cards, e-money or QR; takeaway only; Tabelog Sweets Hyakumeiten 2017–2022, Wagashi & Kanmi WEST Hyakumeiten 2023 and 2026. October 2026 reviews: about 20 people 40 minutes before opening, about 40 at opening; served at 3:10; a box of 6 with 3 smooth-bean and 3 kinako; up to 2 of the 3 kinds; made to order; not too sweet, gentle; still good 4 hours later; a 2-hour wait in the rain; coarse-bean kinako and smooth-bean kinako, 6 each ¥1,170; kinako same day, bean paste until the next day; welcomed as a gift; even people who dislike ohagi like these; a 1 hour 45 minute wait; just before selling out; a simple bean paste; smooth like mochi; small, so even 6 are manageable; a faint saltiness in the bean paste; lightly pounded glutinous rice; fine kinako; a 2-hour wait from 16:00.

食べログ: 王冠、うどん・立ち食いそば・ラーメン、大阪市阿倍野区阿倍野筋1-1-.en: Tabelog: Oukan; udon, stand-up soba and ramen; Osaka Abenobashi Station B1F, outside the ticket gates, 1-1-43 Abenosuji, Abeno-ku, Osaka; on the way up the stairs to Exit 1 after leaving the underground central gate; 33 m from Osaka Abenobashi Station; daily 6:00–16:00; closing days not fixed; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 6 counter seats with standing room in front and chairs at the back; non-smoking. Reviews (September 2024–August 2026): a shop with a noren on the stair landing; open from 6 am; buy a ticket at the machine and hand it over; kake soba ¥320, kitsune soba ¥400, kakiage soba ¥420, kakiage udon ¥420 (a large kakiage with corn and green beans), tempura udon ¥440 (shrimp tempura, kakiage, wakame), tempura soba ¥440, kasu udon ¥550, katsu udon ¥550, curry udon with braised beef, croquette soba, Ekimae soba with yellow Chinese noodles in dashi, soba set ¥500 (soba, rice, croquette), the udon-and-soba set up from ¥450 to ¥500, tsukimi soba set meal ¥530, raw egg ¥90 (earlier ¥70), boiled egg ¥70; the soy sauce goes in first, then the dashi; some praise the light Kansai-style dashi, others find the noodles soft and ordinary; some say the tempura is commercial, others that it is fried in the shop; an older man and a young woman on staff; a Showa-era feel; cash only.

食べログ: 王道家直系 我道家 OSAKA本店、大阪市浪速区湊町1-3-1 リバ.en: Tabelog: Odoya-chokkei Gadoya OSAKA main shop, River Place B1F, 1-3-1 Minatomachi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; no reservations; Tue–Sun 7:00–3:00 next morning; closed Mondays and the day after holidays (open if Monday is a holiday, closed the next day); no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking; in the Minatomachi River Place car park; opened 28 December 2024. 2026 reviews (October and others): chashu-men (large) with everything regular; plenty of spinach; the soup's strength varies by day; opens early in the morning; Odo ramen with medium rice and the famous fried offal; adjusting the soup; one calls it Osaka's No. 1 iekei; sometimes salty; ramen regular ¥1,000 (black bowl with gold rim, rich brown soup, 2 big slices of chashu, spinach, 3 sheets of nori, tonkotsu shoyu, fine droplets of oil, a strong shoyu edge with pork and chicken umami, medium-thick chewy noodles); 15 people waiting after midnight, about 40 minutes; Odoya-certified ramen (firm, regular); seasoned egg; small rice; karaage sold out; self-serve water; smoked chashu-men and chashu rice; a fast-pass system; unlimited garlic, chopped ginger and mayonnaise on the table; one was bothered by smudges on the bowl rim.

食べログ: 珉珉 なんばウォーク店、大阪市中央区千日前1 なんばウォーク、06-.en: Tabelog: Minmin Namba Walk, Namba Walk, 1 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6213-6180; 43 seats (tables only); daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed third Wednesday of odd months; no cards or e-money; no smoking; official minminhonten.com. 2026 reviews (August–October): Minmin after a long time; karaage set meal and beer; stir-fried pork and onion; clay-pot mapo tofu set meal and pan-fried gyoza; tantanmen; unfriendly service; ordering by smartphone; free Wi-Fi; Genghis Khan (lamb) set meal ¥880 (rice, zha cai, egg soup); pork tempura and beer ¥1,200; prices as shown; fried rice ¥770; pan-fried gyoza ¥450; mapo rice bowl ¥850; karaage ¥850; squid and nira stir-fry ¥820; full of office workers at lunch; light, easy gyoza.

食べログ: 珉珉 南千日前本店、大阪市中央区千日前2-11-25、06-6641.en: Tabelog: Minmin Minami-Sennichimae main shop, 2-11-25 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6641-6088; 60 seats (ground-floor counter, tables on the 2nd and 3rd floors); daily 11:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); open every day of the year; no smoking; cards accepted; official minminhonten.com. 2025–2026 reviews: gyoza and beer; gyoza ¥450; crunchy cabbage; crab and tofu stew; shoyu ramen and gyoza set ¥990 (clear amber soup, thin straight noodles); beer set ¥1,600 (gyoza, mapo tofu, draught beer); memories from over 20 years ago; narrow counter; sweet-and-sour pork set meal; brusque service; staff speak Chinese to each other; before a show at NGK; 2 servings of gyoza ¥900 and bottled beer ¥670; mapo tofu; twice-cooked pork; nira and liver.

食べログ: 珉龍 長堀店、大阪市中央区南船場1-10-16-102、長堀橋駅から.en: Tabelog: Minryu Nagahori, 1-10-16-102 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 210 m from Nagahoribashi Station; no opening hours listed; PayPay accepted, no cards or e-money; 26 seats; smoking allowed. Reviews (March–August 2026): a party of 8; century egg; jellyfish; karaage; gyoza; shrimp mayo; shrimp in chili sauce; twice-cooked pork; 3 kinds of fried rice; fried rice vermicelli; wonton soup; sesame balls; candied sweet potato; strongly seasoned dishes; fast service; champon and fried rice set ¥980; Kansai-style champon with thick sauce; thin noodles; long-established; yakisoba ¥770; 7 gyoza; karaage ¥880; large portions; clean inside; open all day; many set meals; drinks too; strong on delivery; champon ¥858; one says no children; the shoyu ramen and tenshinhan set is ordinary; seated at 15:00 on a Sunday; set meals around ¥900.

食べログ: 珍々軒、上野6-12-2、JR上野駅から徒歩3分、御徒町駅から徒歩5.en: Tabelog: Chin Chin Ken, Ueno 6-12-2, 3 min on foot from JR Ueno Station, 5 min from Okachimachi Station; Tue–Sat 10:00–23:00, Sun and holidays 10:00–20:00; closed Mondays (the next day if a holiday); no reservations; cash only; 24 seats (a counter for 8, two tables for 2, three tables for 4 outside and more); smoking allowed. Menu (2022): fried rice ¥800, gyoza ¥500, ramen ¥700, tantanmen ¥850, yakisoba ¥800, ginger-pork rice ¥900. Reviews (June–November 2026): queues before opening on Sundays, 40 minutes to an hour; hot in summer and cold in winter; many overseas customers; the gyoza were underdone; the fried rice was smaller; originally a tantanmen shop, made famous for fried rice by TV; gyoza wrapped at the front of the shop; chashu; lard-sweet fried rice; large is 1.5 times for +¥100; shio ramen; wonton noodles; gyoza rice; homemade chili oil; ginger-flavoured soup; a third-generation local Chinese restaurant; outdoor seats under the tracks; liver and bean sprouts; yakisoba.

食べログ: 珍八香、中華料理・居酒屋・ラーメン、大阪市中央区船場中央3-3-9.en: Tabelog: Chako, Chinese, izakaya and ramen, Senba Center Building No. 9 B2F, Senba-chuo 3-3-9, Chuo-ku, Osaka; directly linked to Hommachi Station exit 10; Mon–Fri 11:00–14:30 and 16:30–21:00 (food L.O. 20:30, drinks L.O. 20:45), Sat 11:00–14:45; closed Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; appetiser ¥110; cards and QR payment accepted, no e-money; 44 seats; smoking allowed. Reviews (May–October 2026): Kansai-style tenshinhan shown on the TV programme 'Himitsu no Kenmin SHOW', ramen and fried rice set, tenshinhan with mini ramen ¥950, sara udon set ¥950, champon set ¥1,050, cold noodle set ¥1,000, daily sweet and sour pork, grilled gyoza ¥350, large bottle of beer ¥700, 'Chinese Katsu Don', a long izakaya menu at night, busy with office workers at lunch.

食べログ: 現代割烹 法善寺momo、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-7-10 日宝バイス.en: Tabelog: Gendai Kappo Hozenji momo, Nippo By-Street Yokocho Bldg 1F, 1-7-10 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Namba Station; Mon and Wed–Sun 12:00–14:30 and 16:00–22:00; closed Tuesdays (some Tuesdays à la carte by reservation only from 17:00); irregular closures over New Year, Golden Week and Obon; reservations accepted (preschool children in private rooms only); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 18 seats (counter, private rooms, tatami, sunken kotatsu); no smoking; jazz playing; opened 1 October 2021; weekday-only lunch mini course with seasonal clay-pot rice ¥3,000. Reviews (April–October 2026): beautiful tableware and careful cooking; ¥5,000 is good value; the private room is a bit small; choose the main from 2; fried chicken and fish; fried okra; seasonal clay-pot rice (corn, scallop, shiso), leftovers made into rice balls; at the back of a building down an alley; Japanese food and sake in a private room; ¥5,000 course; lotus-root manju with broccoli sauce; fried sanma salad; seconds of chestnut rice and rice balls to take home; prepared ahead and pre-plated; a harsh review that the egg on rice had set; sashimi (sea bream, amberjack, raw octopus); fried sanma or chicken thigh; chestnut rice; mainly counter with one private room; fast service; Japanese creative cooking; affordable under ¥10,000.

食べログ: 瓦町仔鹿、大阪市中央区瓦町1-4-6 市岡宏産ビル B1F、堺筋本町.en: Tabelog: Kawara Machi Bambi, Ichioka Kosan Bldg B1F, 1-4-6 Kawaramachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min on foot from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Stn Exit 12, 6 min from Kitahama Stn Exit 5; Mon–Sat and holidays 18:00–22:00; closed Sunday; evenings only; closes when sold out; reservations accepted (2-hour limit when busy); cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR accepted; no e-money; 19 seats (7 at the counter, three tables of 4); private hire up to 20; non-smoking; children welcome; opened 13 October 2015. Official site: Kawara Machi Bambi, opened in October 2015 in a building's basement; original Chinese cooking by 河野幸成, former executive chef of a high-end Chinese restaurant; Chinese food that is not heavy; stocks, chili oil and sauces all blended in-house; seasonal menus; 18:00–22:30 last order; closed Sunday. Menu: steamed chicken ¥770, zha cai ¥550, century egg ¥550, house char siu ¥850, cold sliced pork belly ¥850, pan-fried gyoza ¥500, meat shumai wrapped in yuba ¥880, meat shumai with scallop ¥880, fried chicken thigh BAMBI-style ¥800, yurinchi ¥900, fried crab claws ¥880, black-vinegar sweet and sour pork ¥980, spicy mapo tofu ¥1,200, white mapo tofu ¥1,200, shrimp in chili sauce ¥1,000, big shrimp in mayonnaise sauce ¥1,680, crispy fried noodles with seafood sauce ¥1,580, spicy tantanmen ¥1,100, fried rice (green) ¥950, fried rice with crab ¥2,000, ma lai gao, sesame balls, smooth almond tofu, Shaoxing wine. Reviews (May 2025–August 2026): white mapo tofu and green fried rice, a blackboard menu, horse-meat carpaccio, cold summer stir-fry with green peppers, jellyfish, crab potato salad, beef in sweet miso wrapped in lettuce, almond tofu with brown sugar and Shaoxing wine, xiaolongbao, sansho highball, ice shaped like bears and roses, French-like plating, a friendly manager.

食べログ: 甘党 もぐらや、大阪市中央区難波5丁目 NAMBAなんなん、大阪メト.en: Tabelog: Amato Moguraya, NAMBA Nannan, 5-chome Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; directly connected to Osaka Metro Namba Station; daily 10:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:00); closing days follow Nannan; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 20 seats. Reviews (March–October 2026): takeaway ¥90 a skewer, 3 for ¥270; inside, drinks from ¥500; Moheji-yaki; kintsuba; Fukumochi is coarse bean paste in a chewy skin; the kintsuba is lightly sweet and tastes of azuki; sells out late in the day; takeaway from 10:00; mitarashi dango 3 for ¥270; parfaits; warm mitarashi dango; hojicha; moist dorayaki; mitarashi soft-serve; a 10-minute wait; order while waiting; recommended set B ¥880 (mitarashi dango, kinako kanten, bean paste, shiratama, soft-serve); 4 waiting at 14:00 on a weekday, seated in 5 minutes; courteous, quick service.

食べログ: 甘味処・カフェ・かき氷、東山区桝屋町349、毎日10:00〜17:0.en: Tabelog: Japanese sweets café, café, kakigori; 桝屋町349, Higashiyama-ku; daily 10:00–17:00; no reservations; 20 seats; no cards, e-money or QR; non-smoking; Japanese sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2023, 2026. Reviews (September–November 2026, in English): Ninenzaka; founded in 1914 according to a review; said to have been loved by Yumeji Takehisa; three-colour ohagi ¥900; Kameyama; zenzai; Iso-maki; Uji Kintoki; Shiruko Shake; usucha with a small ohagi; free sencha; one order per person; cash only; a review says about five seats.

食べログ: 甘味処・和菓子、中京区伊勢屋町341-1、阪急京都河原町駅9番出口か.en: Tabelog: Japanese-sweets café, wagashi; 中京区伊勢屋町341-1; 6 min on foot from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Hankyu) exit 9; 11:00–18:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; no reservations; 13 seats; non-smoking; no table charge; cards, transport IC, iD and QUICPay accepted; opened 16 November 2023. Reviews (August–October 2026, in English): write your name and phone number at the entrance and get a call, two-hour waits in summer, order first at the counter by the entrance, creative wagashi on a daifuku base (Ajisai with rum raisin, Yamato Kuri, Earl Grey, osmanthus with cinnamon), a choice of matcha bowls, matcha whisked in front of you, hojicha kakigori with kinako espuma, Wazuka matcha kakigori ¥1,870, a townhouse with a round window onto a small garden, takeaway wagashi about ¥400 each.

食べログ: 甚九郎、そば・居酒屋、大阪市淀川区東三国4-4-11、東三国駅②出口.en: Tabelog: Jinkuro, soba and izakaya, 4-4-11 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 1 min from Exit 2 of Higashi-Mikuni Station; Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat 11:30–14:00 (soba at lunch, until sold out) and 17:30–23:00 (sake, soba and small plates at night; last entry 22:00, last order 22:30); Wednesday nights only; closed Sunday; reservations accepted; no-shows and same-day cancellations ¥2,750 a seat; courses 50% the day before, 100% on the day; cards accepted; ¥330 charge at night; 16 seats; a semi-private table for 4; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children and strollers welcome; blog ameblo.jp/jinkurou392. Reviews (March to October 2026): a neighbourhood soba shop founded 37 years ago, taken on by the second generation and moving toward soba kaiseki; the owner is Mr. Morimoto; soba flour chosen from across Japan and milled in house; 2:8 and 100% buckwheat; zaru soba ¥950; thick, coarse country-style noodles, or thin hand-cut; a dipping sauce of five kinds of katsuobushi; soba-yu scented with yuzu; lunch sets of tempura bowl, oyakodon, tempura-and-egg bowl or katsudon with mini soba; two small side dishes ¥250; at night sashimi (sanma, katsuo, sea bream, Spanish mackerel, akagai), prosciutto with mascarpone, braised duck breast, smoked daikon with cheese; SORACHI on tap; sake such as Senkin; Kusabue soba shochu; Hibiki highball; sold out around 13:00 on a Saturday.

食べログ: 生駒軒、中華料理、ラーメン、日本橋人形町2-3-4、月〜金12:00.en: Tabelog: Ikoma-ken, Chinese, ramen; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-3-4; Mon–Fri 12:00–15:00 and 18:30–21:00, Sat 11:00–14:00; closed Sunday; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money or QR; 20 seats; smoking allowed. Reviews (May–October 2026): a town-Chinese diner; some say founded in the Taisho era, others since the Showa era; one of the noren-wake Ikoma-ken shops, and seemingly the oldest still open; ramen ¥550; set meals ¥800; Cantonese noodles ¥800; gomoku ankake ¥800; tanmen ¥700; fried rice ¥800; gyoza ¥550; no price rises for 6 years; pickled plums on the table; busy at lunch; a wait when one cook is in the kitchen.

食べログ: 白土、港区六本木4-4-8 エトワール六本木ビル2F、六本木駅7番出.en: Tabelog: shirato, Roppongi 4-4-8, エトワール六本木ビル 2F, 1 min walk from Roppongi Station exit 7; Tue–Fri 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30), Sat, Sun and holidays also 11:30–15:00; closed Mondays; everyone starts together; 10% service charge; 8 seats (counter); private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards accepted; English menu; BYO allowed; vegetarian options; opened 21 October 2019. Shop text: about 20 small dishes of seasonal ingredients from around Japan, not bound to Japanese, Western or Chinese style; the signature nodoguro soup de poisson; pairings of wine and sake or domestic teas; white plaster walls and an earth-coloured counter; chef Seiji Shirato (a Tokyo hotel, three years as sous chef at a bistro in Azabu-Juban, independent at 29). Course ¥24,200; with alcohol pairing ¥40,700. Reviews (January–September 2026): lunch course ¥9,900; brandy-marinated botan shrimp; charcoal-grilled nodoguro; Ezo venison; Obanazawa beef; truffle ramen; some found the sauces a little sweet.

食べログ: 白樺、銀座7-2-16 THE CITY 銀座6F、新橋駅から徒歩5.en: Tabelog: Shirakaba, Ginza 7-2-16, THE CITY Ginza 6F, 5 minutes from Shinbashi Station; 7 seats; weekdays 11:30–14:00, 17:00–23:30, Sat 17:00–22:00, closed Sun; opened August 20, 2024; cards accepted; ¥20,000–30,000 at night. 2026 reviews: French eaten with chopsticks, teppan, an L-shaped counter, weekday lunch hamburg steak ¥1,500 incl. tax (four sauces, including mushroom demi-glace), salad, rice, sherbet.

食べログ: 百、立ち飲み・居酒屋、中京区西魚屋町610、四条駅・阪急烏丸駅から徒.en: Tabelog: Hyaku; standing bar, izakaya; 西魚屋町610, Nakagyo-ku; 7 min walk from Shijo Stn and Hankyu Karasuma Stn; Mon–Fri 15:00–21:30; Sat–Sun 14:00–21:30; no reservations; standing only (no chairs), 20 places; separate smoking area; no cards, e-money or QR; the website field links to 遊食邸 (有限会社京フーズ, a Kyoto bento maker with three shops), which does not mention Hyaku. Reviews (December 2021 – July 2026, in English): pay-first ticket system; a ¥1,000 ticket book gives ¥1,100; draft beer up from ¥220 to ¥440, in a smallish glass; oden ¥110–220; Kyoto-style dashimaki ¥330; salted cabbage ¥220; kushikatsu from ¥110; fried chicken; sasami, shiso and cheese fry; octopus-shaped sausages; isobe-age; kimchi fried rice; sushi; churros; corn dogs; happy hour on weekends and holidays until 19:00 with a medium bottle of beer at ¥440; small highball ¥110; the ready-made side dishes are gone; the sushi rice is large; smoking allowed.

食べログ: 百十 なんばこめじるし店、もんじゃ焼き・お好み焼き・鉄板焼き、大阪市.en: Tabelog: Momoju Namba Komejirushi, monjayaki, okonomiyaki and teppanyaki, Namba CITY Namba Komejirushi, Namba-naka 2-10-25, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 3 minutes from Nankai Namba Station; daily 11:30–15:00 (food L.O. 14:00) and 17:00–22:30 (food L.O. 21:30); irregular closures (1–2 times a month, announced on Instagram); no reservations; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 40 seats (4 counter, 36 table); non-smoking; menus in English, Chinese and Korean; English-speaking staff. Osaka-style monjayaki with a Western-style stock of chicken bones, onion, celery and red wine; ochazuke too. Reviews (April–October 2026): staff cook the monjayaki for you, mentaiko special ¥1,980, curry, negi-suji curry, fluffy okonomiyaki, beef-tendon okonomiyaki, pork yakisoba ¥1,100, seafood yakisoba ¥1,440, tonpei, yam with yuzu, à la carte only at lunch, the main shop is in Nagai, some reviewers booked ahead, okonomiyaki takes about 30 minutes.

食べログ: 百景、喫茶店・カフェ、中京区富小路通錦小路下ル西大文字町601 山下.en: Tabelog: 百景 (Hyakkei), kissa and café; 中京区富小路通錦小路下ル西大文字町601 山下ビル 2F; 344 m from Kyoto Kawaramachi Station; 14:00–1:00; closed Friday; no reservations; 17 seats; smoking area (heated tobacco only); no cards; e-money and PayPay accepted; opened 10 August 2019. Reviews (2026, in English): a kissa open late at night; Hyakkei blend ¥750 (mild, medium, strong); hot au lait ¥850; cheesecake ¥600; chocolate cake ¥600; beer; smoking allowed at the tables; often full at night.

食べログ: 皇蘭 アルデ新大阪店、飲茶・点心・ラーメン・dumpling、大阪市.en: Tabelog: Koran Arude shin osaka ten, dim sum and yum cha, ramen, dumplings, 西中島 5-16-1, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, Shin-Osaka Station; daily 10:00–22:30; no reservations; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 20 seats (tables and counter); non-smoking. Official site: 株式会社皇蘭, Nada-ku, Kobe, with its own factory, SINCE 1959, main shop in Nankinmachi, 山神山人, いずみヌードル, a taste handed down and care over ingredients. Reviews (February 2024 to November 2026): near the Midosuji Line entrance, through the underground from the east exit, renovated so solo diners sit easily, Kobe Motomachi ramen, Koran's chuka soba (flavoured egg) ¥1,080, large noodles ¥150, soy-sauce chicken-bone broth, straight noodles, fatty chashu, creamy chicken paitan ramen, dandan noodles ¥1,230, tomato and basil ramen, pork bun ¥330 (Awaji onions and Kagoshima black pork), xiaolongbao sold out some days, fried rice, Tianjin rice with shrimp, Shaoxing wine ¥600, many business travellers before the Shinkansen.
