食べログ: 酒菜屋 なないろ、大阪市中央区島之内1-14-15 天野ビル 1F、.en: Tabelog: Sakanaya Nanairo, Amano Bldg 1F, 1-14-15 Shimanouchi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station exit 6; Tue–Sat 18:00–1:00 next morning (enter by 22:30), Sun and holidays 18:00–23:30 (enter by 21:00); closed Mondays; some days opens 17:30; entry by 21:30 includes dashi and 3 small dishes ¥1,650–2,200, later entry and courses dashi and 1 small dish ¥770; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 20 seats (counter 10, 2 low tables with a footwell); Instagram @sakanaya.nanairo. Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): a hideaway in a quiet spot; sea-bream dashi and small dishes; sashimi platter of wild fish (bluefin tuna, seared sawara, yellowtail, sweet shrimp with salt and sudachi); autumn aubergine in hairy-crab sauce; simmered octopus and vegetables; matsutake dobin-mushi; shrimp cream croquettes; lotus-root manju with crab; oysters grilled on kombu; shrimp sake-lees gratin; duck; wagyu; winter kue hot pot with zosui; Korean reimen; horumon jjigae; sweet-and-sour pork; spring rolls; sea-bream clay-pot rice; Dewazakura; Tenpo Ichi; courteous, friendly service; fine alone; one says portions are very modest and the air quiet.

食べログ: 金久右衛門 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-4-17、41席(1階カ.en: Tabelog: Kin'emon Dotonbori, 1-4-17 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 41 seats (ground-floor counter 23; basement counter 6 and tables 12); Mon–Thu 11:00–8:00 next morning, open 24 hours Fri, Sat, Sun and days before holidays; closes when sold out; open every day of the year; opened 29 December 2011; official site king-emon-dotonbori.com. 2026 reviews (English edition): a 34th morning ramen with 'Osaka Kinjou Shoyu' (clear chicken-bone and light-shoyu soup, thin noodles, garlic, leek, menma, soft-boiled seasoned egg); one said a large 'Osaka Black' and pork bowl topped ¥2,000, pricey and aimed at tourists; ticket machine in front; 'Osaka Black' without egg ¥1,000; glossy black, a bittersweet shoyu with the buttery aroma of chicken fat; thin noodles recommended; noodle refills available; basic bowl ¥1,200; one found the staff curt; 'Red Shoyu'; 'King Shoyu'; one noticed a tonkotsu aroma; 'Osaka Black' with seafood umami; the shop next to Kinryu with no queue; 'Osaka Black' ¥1,200 at 5 a.m., thin noodles firm.

食べログ: 金麦 難波店、大阪市浪速区難波中2-8-91 中川ビル1F、なんば駅.en: Tabelog: Kinmugi Namba, Nakagawa Bldg 1F, 2-8-91 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 200 m from Namba Station; daily 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); cards, e-money and QR accepted; 18 seats; opened 1 September 2025. Reviews (August–October 2026): ticket machine; cold corn-soup noodles ¥1,400 (sweet potato, broccoli, corn, chopped chicken, rich corn potage, thin straight noodles); tori-paitan ramen ¥1,000; mouth-watering chicken rice bowl ¥300; near Namba Parks; touch-panel ticket machine; a rich, creamy, stew-like soup; soft-boiled egg; chicken and pork chashu; tori-paitan tsukemen ¥1,100, large ¥150, seasoned egg ¥150; a light, frothy dipping soup; thick noodles chilled in cold water; 2 kinds of slightly rare chashu; a refined interior despite the back street; good service; curly noodles; a gentle, sweet chicken soup; firm noodles; overseas diners too; the second shop after Amemura; Mugikyu Co., Ltd.; PayPay.

食べログ: 金麦、大阪市西区北堀江1-2-16 おおきにサイタ・サイタビルヂング.en: Tabelog: Kinmugi, Ookini Saita Saita Bldg side building 1F, 1-2-16 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; no reservations; daily 11:00–14:30 and 18:00–21:30; irregular closing days; no cards, e-money or QR; 7 seats (counter); opened 7 July 2024. 2026 reviews (June–October): creamy tori paitan and mouth-watering chicken rice bowl; fine bubbles, smooth; rich yet the chicken stands out and isn't heavy; low-temperature pork-loin and chicken-breast chashu; shredded white leek; mizuna; onion; menma (thick, tender, well seasoned, superb); the ticket machine is now touch-panel; more beef dishes added; the previous owner has gone, now young staff; one says something is missing; one found the chewy medium-thick noodles underboiled; few seats, so a queue; many overseas diners; hot inside; always a queue; medium-thick straight noodles; 3 kinds of chashu; drank all of the light tori paitan; between sets at MINAMI WHEEL.

食べログ: 金龍ラーメン 御堂筋店、大阪市中央区難波1-7-12、なんば駅徒歩3.en: Tabelog: Kinryu Ramen Midosuji, 1-7-12 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba Station; open 24 hours; no reservations; smoking allowed; counter. 2026 reviews: in business for over 35 years; a simple old-fashioned flavour; help yourself to garlic, kimchi and nira; one was disappointed not to taste rich tonkotsu; self-serve garlic and spicy nira; the big dragon sign; standing; ramen ¥900; tonkotsu-based and lighter than it looks; fast turnover even at 2 a.m.; tables along the pavement and an open kitchen; free kimchi, garlic and nira; good chashu; rich yet clean; street-stall style: buy a ticket and eat standing.

食べログ: 金龍ラーメン 戎橋店、大阪市中央区難波3-3、毎日9:00〜22:0.en: Tabelog: Kinryu Ramen Ebisubashi, 3-3 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 9:00–22:00; no cards, e-money or QR payment; smoking allowed. Reviews (October 2025 – October 2026): ramen ¥900 (¥800 in 2025); plenty of chashu; unlimited white rice, nira kimchi and napa-cabbage kimchi; firm noodles; chairs covered in tatami fabric; only two choices on the ticket machine, ramen and chashu-men; four free extras: garlic (chopped), kimchi, spicy nira and rice; gentle tonkotsu; cloudy but not heavy; medium-thin straight noodles; thin-sliced chashu; meal ticket swapped for a number tag; some days ¥700 for the Hanshin victory sale; table seats only; one found the rice soft; 3 slices chashu; self-serve water.

食べログ: 金龍ラーメン 本店、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-1-18、38席(立ち席あ.en: Tabelog: Kinryu Ramen main shop, 1-1-18 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 38 seats (standing places; partly closed late at night); open 24 hours; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR payment; smoking allowed. 2025–2026 reviews: the classic main shop; a 10-minute wait; big chashu; unlimited garlic, nira and kimchi unchanged for half a century; king of light Osaka tonkotsu (once a one-coin ¥500, ¥800 in 2022); chashu-men; kimchi, garlic, nira; free rice; a 30-minute wait with meal ticket; several slices of chashu and offcuts even in the plain ramen; lighter than Kyushu tonkotsu; unlimited rice instead of noodle refills; after the second round of drinks; rich tonkotsu with rice and kimchi; the reviewer's son was impressed too.

食べログ: 金龍ラーメン 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-7-26、なんば駅14.en: Tabelog: Kinryu Ramen Dotonbori, 1-7-26 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Namba Station exit 14; open 24 hours; no reservations; counter and tatami seating; children welcome. Shop introduction: a Minami landmark open 24 hours, known for its giant dragon sculpture; rich tonkotsu simmered from pork bones and chicken feet (momiji) with a secret tare; house-made straight noodles; kimchi, garlic and nira chives free and unlimited. 2026 reviews: many inbound tourists; medium-thin, slightly wavy noodles; shoyu-based tonkotsu with restrained saltiness, one said it was lukewarm; the menu is only ramen and chashu-men; light tonkotsu; the free kimchi and nira are spicy; pepper suits it; ramen ¥900 (up ¥200; ¥600 in the reviewer's twenties); the main shop is under construction; a chicken-and-pork blend with a sharp finish; the aroma of chili oil; called by numbered ticket and you carry it yourself; fast turnover.

食べログ: 金龍ラーメン 難波千日前店、大阪市中央区難波千日前11-20、06-.en: Tabelog: Kinryu Ramen Namba Sennichimae, 11-20 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6649-1448; no reservations; open 24 hours; no cards or e-money; QR (PayPay) accepted; no smoking. October 2026 review: a light pork-and-chicken soup (cloudy pork-bone and chicken-bone soup with shoyu); smooth with no off-smell; 24 hours, a last stop after drinking; free kimchi, nira and garlic at the counter; free rice; ticket machine left of the entrance; the menu is only ramen and chashu-men; Kinryu ramen ¥900; collect it yourself; small tatami seats without backrests; unsure whether to take shoes off; two kinds of chashu; good as a morning ramen too; done in about 10 minutes.

食べログ: 釜あげスパゲッティ すぱじろう 銀座店、銀座3-4-1 大倉別館1F.en: Tabelog: Kamaage Spaghetti Spajiro Ginza, Ginza 3-4-1, 大倉 Annex 1F–2F, 2 minutes from Ginza-itchome Station exit 5; 44 seats; daily 11:00–22:00; no charge; cards (JCB, AMEX) and e-money accepted, no QR; takeaway; opened June 2, 2010; official site spajiro.com. October 2026 reviews: spear squid and spinach peperoncino (lots of garlic, with lemon); seasonal chicken, mushroom and sansho cream; garlicky tomato soup pasta; large portions; a ramen-shop-like counter; a loose, soup-pasta-like sauce; some say it took 40 minutes or the pasta was oily; ¥1,000–2,000.

食べログ: 釜たけうどん 新大阪店、うどん、大阪市淀川区西中島5-16-1 JR.en: Tabelog: Kamatake Udon Shin'osaka ten; udon; 5-16-1 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, in the Flavor Alley of JR Shin-Osaka Station, ground floor; 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30); closed Tuesday (open on holidays); reopened 2 September 2025; no cards or e-money, PayPay accepted; 9 counter seats; non-smoking. Reviews (July to October 2026): ticket machine outside the shop; for PayPay, call the staff; bukkake with chikuwa and soft-boiled egg tempura ¥880 (ginger, green onion, lemon); the regular size is about two portions; kake udon with chikuwa and soft-boiled egg tempura ¥880; meat bukkake ¥1,350 (domestic wagyu, maitake tempura); kasu udon ¥930; chicken tempura bukkake; Sanuki udon with a Kansai dashi; cut and boiled to order; run by the owner alone; lines at lunch.

食べログ: 釜上げうどん 二葉、大阪市中央区日本橋2-12-27、日本橋駅から徒.en: Tabelog: Kamaage Udon Futaba, 2-12-27 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nippombashi Station; Tue and Thu 11:30–15:30 and 18:30–21:00, Wed 11:30–15:00, Sat 11:30–15:30; closed Mondays, Fridays and Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; 16 seats (two tables for 4, counter 8). Reviews (April–August 2026): just outside Kuromon Market; run by Futaba Seimenjo, a noodle maker founded in 1910; the signature kamaage udon ¥680 (thin house noodles in their cooking water, lots of bonito flakes, with Yuasa shoyu and ground sesame), originally the noodle maker's staff meal; cold mentaiko raw-shoyu udon ¥830 (shiso and nori); grated-daikon udon; dashi udon; curry udon; meat udon; soba too; noodles thin, extra-thin, thick or kishimen; 1.5 portions; small rice balls; weekly rice (bamboo-shoot rice); house tenkasu and leek on the table, help yourself; clean and calm.

食べログ: 鉄板Osaka、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町6-26、大阪難波駅・なんば駅.en: Tabelog: Teppan Osaka, 6-26 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 6 min walk from Osaka-Namba, Namba and Shinsaibashi stations; Mon–Sat and holidays 18:00–3:00 next morning (L.O. food 2:00, drinks 2:30); closed Sundays; reservations accepted (listed as able to accommodate allergies and vegetarians); cards and QUICPay accepted, no QR; 19 seats (counter 11, two tables for 4); opened 29 June 2020; most popular, the limited domestic Kuroge wagyu fillet steak; second, Kuroge wagyu rump roast beef; third, Hokkaido scallops and asparagus in rich butter shoyu. Reviews (May–September 2026): two women at the counter; reasonable prices; fillet with 2 sauces; Camembert fondue; white fish; A5 chateaubriand; rosemary; finished with residual heat; squid and scallop seafood yakisoba; rump roast beef; cooked slowly on the teppan and in the oven; mashed potato; opposite Queens Court; meat and fish; truffle-scented salad; starters (shrimp sashimi, roast beef, Chinese-yam kimchi, bean-sprout namul); white fish with Genovese sauce; rump and fillet; wasabi, salt, shoyu, garlic chips, truffle oil.

食べログ: 鉄板お好み焼き 辻井、銀座6-5-12 THEplace銀座9F、1.en: Tabelog: Teppan Okonomiyaki Tsujii, Ginza 6-5-12, THEplace Ginza 9F; 13 seats; opened August 6, 2026; Mon–Fri and holidays 18:00–3:00, Sat 18:00–1:00, closed Sun; 10% late-night charge after 22:00; cards accepted (including UnionPay). September–October 2026 reviews: calm and upscale, teppan courses, okonomiyaki, generous portions, attentive service, ¥10,000–20,000.

食べログ: 鉄板処 めぐろ、銀座8-5-18 サンウッドビル2F、30席(カウン.en: Tabelog: Teppan Dokoro Meguro, Ginza 8-5-18, Sunwood Building 2F; 30 seats (8 counter, 22 table); weekdays 11:00–14:30, 17:00–23:30, Sat and holidays 11:00–14:30, 17:00–22:30, closed Sun; opened September 19, 2017; official site ginza-teppandokoromeguro.com. Shop introduction: keeps to the Osaka basics, grilling everything from okonomiyaki to steak at the right temperature; seafood and beef from Tsukiji and Toyosu; a young chef's spirit of inquiry. October 2026 reviews: a ¥9,000 course (mentaiko tamagoyaki, foie gras sushi, steak with garlic toast); seared-beef salad; Okukuji egg and shrimp-roe cream; teppan-grilled fresh fish from Tsukiji; top sirloin; fluffy pork okonomiyaki; house hamburg steak; striploin with toast; at lunch soft omurice with hamburg steak inside; booking recommended.

食べログ: 鉄板彩菜やまぐち、大阪市中央区南船場1-18-24 AXIS南船場.en: Tabelog: Teppan Saisai Yamaguchi, Minami-Senba 1-18-24, AXIS Minami-Senba 1F, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Nagahoribashi Stn; Tue–Sun and holidays 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:30–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); closed Monday (open on holidays); reservations accepted; cards, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay and au PAY accepted, no e-money; no cover charge; 9 seats (U-shaped counter); non-smoking (ashtray outside); children welcome; private hire up to 20; opened 17 January 2019; beef from Yamagata and seasonal vegetables. Courses: Black Wagyu Saisai dinner course ¥7,080, Black Wagyu omakase dinner course ¥9,200, special Black Wagyu omakase dinner course ¥12,000, special Black Wagyu omakase premium course ¥17,000; lunch ¥3,180, ¥4,280, ¥5,780, ¥6,080 (garlic rice +¥700). Reviews (July 2023–October 2026): the owner grills in front of you, assorted appetizers, potage, grilled vegetables, Wagyu eaten with salt, ponzu or soy sauce, garlic rice, a steak rice bowl limited to 10 a day ¥1,280 (October 2025), birthday plates, a shawl lent to a pregnant guest, non-alcoholic red-wine juice.

食べログ: 鉄板懐石 ふく、銀座4-8-11 善隣ビル4F、東銀座駅から1分・銀.en: Tabelog: Teppan Kaiseki Fuku, Ginza 4-8-11, 善隣 Building 4F, 1 minute from Higashi-Ginza Station, 2 minutes from Ginza Station exit A7; 16 seats (8 counter, tatami room, semi-private rooms); daily 11:00–15:00, 17:30–22:00; irregular holidays and New Year; opened December 15, 2016; sister shop of the Japanese restaurant "Aya" (English spelling); kaiseki plus A5 wagyu, live spiny lobster and abalone on the teppan. 2026 reviews: the "Kiri" lunch course ¥5,000 (five-kind hassun, seafood on the teppan, eel chawanmushi, Japanese beef, corn rice in a clay pot, akadashi and pickles, three desserts); ginger and edamame rice; service with jokes; ¥20,000–30,000 at night with abalone and wagyu.

食べログ: 鉄板料亭 銀座まつさか(GINZA MATSUSAKA)、銀座7-2.en: Tabelog: GINZA MATSUSAKA, Ginza 7-2-18, Granbell Square 3F, 5 minutes from Ginza Station exits C1/C2 and JR Shinbashi Station; 10 seats (counter); daily 11:30–16:00 (last entry 14:00), 17:30–23:00 (last entry 20:30); irregular holidays; closed December 31–January 4; opened September 15, 2023; official site ginza-matsusaka.jp. Shop introduction: a course comparing Kobe and Matsusaka beef sirloin ¥29,800. Reviews: a Matsusaka beef certificate; chef Kobayashi (English spelling) trained at a long-established Ginza teppanyaki and in French cooking; the ¥33,000 course in 2024 (prosciutto and churros, roast beef, flounder carpaccio, foie gras with pear, scale-grilled ayu, fillet and striploin); in September 2026 salmon confit, lobster and avocado, foie gras and fig, tilefish, abalone in mushroom cream sauce; some say it's pricey for a two-person shop.

食べログ: 鉄板焼 MYDO、鉄板焼き・ステーキ、大阪市中央区南船場4-1-3.en: Tabelog: Teppanyaki MYDO, teppanyaki and steak, W Osaka 1F, Minami-Senba 4-1-3, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 minutes from Shinsaibashi Station exit 3; daily 11:30–15:00 (food L.O. 14:00) and 17:30–22:00 (food L.O. 20:00, drinks L.O. 21:00); open year-round; reservations accepted (note allergies and dislikes in the request); 15% service charge, no cover; cards accepted, no e-money or QR payment; 38 seats (counters in three areas); private room for 8; non-smoking; under-12s at lunch only; smart casual; valet parking. Three areas, LUXE, FUN and KAPPO; courses of kuroge wagyu, seasonal vegetables and seafood. Reviews (May–October 2026): the name is said to come from the Osaka greeting 'maido'; weekday lunch course ¥5,500 (domestic lean beef, okonomiyaki, Napolitan); OKINI, SENBA and LIMITLESS LUXE courses (over ¥50,000); Dassai pairing; kushikatsu, akashiyaki, okonomiyaki, yakisoba, Ise lobster, abalone, dorayaki; some feel the top course lacks surprise for the price.

食べログ: 鉄板焼 かいか(テッパンヤキ カイカ)、銀座6-8-7 交詢ビル4F.en: Tabelog: Teppanyaki Kaika, Ginza 6-8-7, Kojun Building 4F, 3 minutes from Ginza Station exits A1/A2; 23 seats (13 counter, private rooms for 2–10); lunch daily 11:30–15:00 (last entry 13:30); dinner Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00 (last entry 21:00), Sundays and holidays 17:00–21:00 (last entry 19:00); opened October 1, 2004; official site ginza-kaika.com. August 2026 reviews: shows you the day's fish, meat and vegetables; starter and sashimi; fish with a stylish sauce; Kobushi course ¥7,650 (seafood, rump cap, nama-fu and grilled vegetables, garlic rice, dessert); attentive service from a woman staffer; a friendly chef; superb garlic rice; some say the striploin is on the fatty side.

食べログ: 鉄板焼 ステーキ 集 銀座(SHU GINZA)、銀座8-5-18.en: Tabelog: SHU GINZA, Ginza 8-5-18, Cortile Ginza IV BLDG B1F, 3 minutes from Shinbashi Station; 16 seats (10 at the teppan counter, 6 in a teppan private room); Mon–Sat 12:00–14:30, 17:30–23:00, closed Sundays and holidays; opened June 3, 2019; official site shu-ginza.jp. Shop introduction: Kobe beef, select wagyu, seafood from Toyosu and Tsukiji, starters changing monthly, conversation with the chef. 2026 reviews: uni and salmon-roe starter; chilled abalone, tomato and okra; corn soup; mackerel in kataifi; fish in white cream sauce; lean meat; garlic rice (sometimes extra); one abalone per person; one chef runs it alone; wine by the glass ¥1,600; ¥5,000–10,000 at lunch.

食べログ: 鉄板焼 一徹、港区新橋1-2-6 第一ホテル東京21F、JR新橋駅か.en: Tabelog: Teppanyaki Ittetsu, Shinbashi 1-2-6, Minato-ku, Dai-ichi Hotel Tokyo 21F, 2 minutes from JR Shinbashi Station; 40 seats (a private room for 8); daily 11:30–15:00, 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 14:00/21:00); service charge included in prices; children welcome; night views; official site (Hankyu Hanshin Hotels). Shop introduction: Kobe beef on the hotel's top floor. 2026 reviews: Miyazaki wagyu; beef stew and salad with wasabi dressing; Aomori garlic slowly fried into chips, with the meat cooked in that oil; scallops; abalone; vegetables; white rice or garlic rice (extra, after the meat); sherbet ¥1,400; moved to a seat with a view of Tokyo Tower for an anniversary.

食べログ: 鉄板焼 石垣島きたうち牧場 銀座店、銀座6-4-10 銀座シンヨービ.en: Tabelog: Teppanyaki Ishigakijima Kitauchi Bokujō Ginza, Ginza 6-4-10, Ginza Shinyo Building 1F, 3 minutes from Ginza Station exit C2; 16 seats; daily 11:30–15:30, 17:30–23:00; open every day; opened July 3, 2013; cards accepted; shop introduction: only heifers of black wagyu of the 但馬 bloodline, fattened long on the company's own ranch, about 6 head shipped a month. Reviews: shops on Ishigakijima and in Osaka and Tokyo; rare inner thigh; fugu carpaccio and charcoal-grilled fugu; sweet shrimp; consommé; salmon-roe rice; mushroom garlic rice; in September 2026 a single private booking per day; ¥20,000–50,000.

食べログ: 鉄板焼き Oribe、大阪市西区新町1-6-18 タカラハウス四ツ橋.en: Tabelog: Teppanyaki Oribe, Takara House Yotsubashi 1F, 1-6-18 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exit 2; Tue–Sun 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed Mondays and 3rd Tuesdays (Tuesday if Monday is a holiday); reservations accepted; starter ¥550; cards (JCB, AMEX) only, no e-money or QR; 15 seats (counter 11, tables 4); no smoking; primary-school age and under, check when booking; official site. Reviews (November 2025 – August 2026): teppanyaki with French technique; à la carte served like a course; pork rillettes with red cabbage and baguette; Canadian lobster and scallop with salted-onion mousse and lobster-consommé jelly ¥3,960; wild red shrimp and snow crab with carrot mousse; cabbage steak with Gorgonzola (half available); sautéed cod milt with Shimonita leek and port-onion sauce; Black Wagyu sirloin-cap steak 100 g; wagyu tendon and garlic rice; mixed okonomiyaki to finish; chocolate cake with vanilla ice cream; portions for 2 as standard, leftovers could be taken home; run by 2 people, so dishes take time; one says the party was pressed hard to order from starter to dessert.

食べログ: 鉄板焼き 銀座 ポルトファーロ 本店、銀座5-7-19 銀座フォリー.en: Tabelog: Teppanyaki Ginza Porto Faro main shop, Ginza 5-7-19, Ginza Folly Building 8F, 1 minute from Ginza Station exit A1; 40 seats (8F tables, 9F counter, 1 private room, room charge ¥5,000); daily lunch 11:30–15:00, afternoon 14:30–16:30, dinner 17:30–21:30; irregular holidays (building closing days); 10% service charge; seats can't be chosen; children welcome; official site portofaro.com. Shop introduction: big windows looking at the Wako clock tower; teppanyaki with Italian touches by a chef who honed skills at hotels. 2026 reviews: superb Matsusaka beef; time limits; several said end seats upstairs had no view; a noisy neighboring table; photos taken when the food was served and on leaving.

食べログ: 鉄板焼きとお酒 sAtori家、大阪市中央区南船場3-6-25 IB.en: Tabelog: Teppanyaki to Osake sAtoriya, IBC Shinsaibashi east 1F, Minamisenba 3-6-25, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min on foot north of Shinsaibashi Stn; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:30–23:30 (last order 23:00); closed Sunday and public holidays; reservations accepted; same-day cancellations charged; no cards at lunch; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 18 seats; private hire from 11 people; smoking allowed in the evening, non-smoking at lunch; Wi-Fi; call ahead before bringing children. Shop introduction: a hideaway teppanyaki in a back alley of Shinsaibashi, cooked in front of you at the counter; a daily blackboard menu with sake, and plenty of wine; à la carte to full courses; sister restaurant Yoshoku-ya Izanagi (Ebisu-cho); hamburg course ¥5,680 (food only ¥3,880); creative teppanyaki course ¥6,180 (¥4,380); sukiyaki course of crossbred beef and Awaji Island onions ¥6,680 (¥4,880); 90-minute all-you-can-drink. Reviews (September 2025–October 2026): at the back of the building; the queue for the ramen shop in front; teppan hamburg steak; Awaji Island onion steak; tonteki; tonkatsu; beef-tendon curry; weekly special (fried salmon, fried chicken with yuzu pepper); lunch ¥900–1,000 with salad; large rice free; evenings: napa cabbage steak, Awaji Island onions in browned-butter cream sauce, napa cabbage with Gouda sauce, Kumamoto red eggplant with ginger sauce, smoked daikon with cream cheese, mint pickles, misuji steak, Kuroge wagyu steak, Akashi octopus sashimi, seared duck prosciutto, scallop bruschetta, potato salad topped with a fried egg, tenderloin cutlet, sukiyaki; Kansai ingredients; some found the sauce a little spicy, or the rice soft.

食べログ: 鉄板焼き・ステーキ、下京区烏丸通塩小路下ル JR京都駅中央口 ホテル.en: Tabelog: teppanyaki, steak; Karasuma-dori south of Shiokoji, Shimogyo-ku, JR Kyoto Station central exit, Hotel Granvia Kyoto 15F; directly connected to JR Kyoto Station; 11:30–15:30 (last order 14:30) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); open every day; reservations accepted (tell the restaurant in advance about allergies to the eight specified allergens; other allergies handled as far as possible); 15% service charge; 26 seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR; Steak/Teppanyaki WEST Tabelog 100 2024, 2025. Reviews (June–October 2026, in English): view of Kyoto Tower; the 'Torii' lunch course (lobster and scallops, domestic beef fillet 70 g, garlic rice); black wagyu fillet and live lobster at dinner; Omi beef fillet and ribeye compared; matsutake and chicken kamameshi; abalone with Uji matcha sauce; lunch over ¥10,000; phone to confirm for three or more.

食べログ: 鉄板焼き屋台 テッちゃん、港区新橋1-13-3、新橋駅から172m、.en: Tabelog: Teppanyaki Yatai Tecchan, Shinbashi 1-13-3, Minato-ku, 172 m from Shinbashi Station; daily 15:00–5:00; Shinbashi Yokocho (hamakura-style.com). Reviews (2022–2026): an alley under the Shinbashi tracks; queues even after 21:00; order per shop; for a second round; modan-yaki to finish; many foreign tourists too; some say the taste is ordinary; in June 2026, live guitar and singing along; five-star service; a bottle of Kinmiya.

食べログ: 鉄板焼コルザ、銀座7-8-17 虎屋銀座ビルB1F、24席、月〜水1.en: Tabelog: Colza, Ginza 7-8-17, Toraya Ginza Building B1F; 24 seats; Mon–Wed 17:00–22:00, Thu–Sat and holidays 12:00–15:00, 17:00–22:00, closed Sundays and New Year; opened November 18, 2024; official site colza.co.jp. Shop introduction: teppanyaki of tradition and innovation; new dishes using Kikkoman soy sauce. October 2026 reviews: a teppanyaki opened by Kikkoman in 1987, moved to the Toraya Ginza Building and became Colza; interior using cedar from soy-sauce barrels; custom tableware; shows you the ingredients first; rump cap eaten with Colza's own soy sauce; onions and fried garlic; striploin; the chef's signature course (tofu of Hokkaido soybeans with autumn truffle and butternut purée; lobster with a persimmon and celery relish); for business entertaining and celebrations.

食べログ: 鉄板焼・ステーキ、下京区真町88-3 ユーイットゥ池善ビル B1F、.en: Tabelog: teppanyaki and steak; 真町88-3, Shimogyo-ku, ユーイットゥ池善ビル B1F; 1 min walk from Exit 2 of Hankyu Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn, 3 min from Exit 3 of Keihan Gion-Shijo Stn; Monday–Friday 17:00–22:00, Saturday, Sunday and holidays 12:00–14:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed irregularly; two-hour limit; 100% charge for same-day cancellations; 5% service charge; 14 seats (10 at the counter, private room for 4); non-smoking; cards and PayPay; children welcome; opened 1 June 2017; dinner (2-hour free-flow drinks + Ise lobster + lean black wagyu steak, 10 dishes) ¥14,000; lunch (wagyu lean steak course, 9 dishes) ¥6,600; Christmas course ¥15,000. macaro-ni: Kyoto Teppanyaki grow, Kawaramachi shop, top-grade A5 beef at reasonable prices. Reviews (September–November 2026, in English): foie gras roast beef, seared black wagyu sushi, wagyu tomato stew, chawanmushi, Ise lobster teppanyaki (Kujo-negi sauce, lobster-broth sauce), wagyu katsu sandwich with shibazuke tartar, soy-sauce foam, garlic rice ball, panna cotta, birthday plates, complaints about the service charge.

食べログ: 鉄板神社 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-6-4 道頓堀エリカビルB.en: Tabelog: Teppan Jinja Dotonbori, Dotonbori Erika Bldg B1F, 1-6-4 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 33 seats; Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 12:00–3:00 next morning (L.O. 2:30), Thu 12:00–2:00 next morning (L.O. 1:30); smoking allowed; cards and e-money accepted; features: vegetables, fish, vegetarian menu; shop introduction: the true flavour of the ingredients, more than just yakisoba skewers, group bookings accepted. 2026 reviews (March–July): all-you-can-drink course ¥7,700; an American colleague loved it; loin steak; staff with fluent English; skewers omakase; shrimp toast; cold beer; friendly Osaka-style staff; smoking allowed; 10-skewer omakase; highballs; skewers grilled on the teppan; vegetables and meat; 2nd-floor and ground-floor counters.

食べログ: 銀座 とよだ(ぎんざとよだ)、銀座7-5-4 ラヴィアーレ銀座ビル2.en: Tabelog: Ginza Toyoda, Ginza 7-5-4, Laviale Ginza Building 2F, on Namiki-dori; 20 seats; Tue–Fri 11:30–14:00, 17:00–23:00, weekends and holidays 11:30–14:00, 16:00–23:00, closed Mon; separate from "Kappo Toyoda" in Nihonbashi; official site ginza-toyoda.com. 2026 reviews: a long-established shop listed in Michelin for many years; uni and abalone with jelly; sashimi on a lotus leaf; omakase ¥18,000 (grilled cutlassfish with round eggplant and shungiku, young Tanba black beans with sweet shrimp, a soup of matsutake, turnip and sea bream, tuna, squid, flounder); even the most affordable course has cutlassfish, Spanish mackerel, matsutake clear soup and chestnut rice; the plain white rice to finish is superb; refined but a little salty.

食べログ: 銀座 みやざわ、銀座8-7-13 銀座全線座ビル1F、新橋駅から28.en: Tabelog: Ginza Miyazawa, Ginza 8-7-13, 銀座全線座 Building 1F, 281 m from Shinbashi Station; weekdays 11:30–14:30, 16:00–4:00, closed weekends and holidays; no reservations; separate smoking area; opened October 1, 2026. October 2026 reviews: Miyazawa, known for late-night delivery, moved nearby; lunch sandwiches limited and posted at the entrance; A pork ginger-pork ¥1,500 (with a drink); opened in Ginza 8-chome in 1983 and moved in January 2026; from a Showa kissaten to a stylish café; mixed tuna and egg sandwich ¥1,300 (takeaway); 30+ table seats; asked whether you smoke; the famous egg sandwich; omurice; Napolitan; hot coffee ¥800; a big counter with power outlets; congratulatory orchids for the opening; cocoa.

食べログ: 銀座 ミヤガワ、銀座7-3-16 東五ビル4F、10席、月〜土17:.en: Tabelog: Ginza Miyagawa, Ginza 7-3-16, 東五 Building 4F; 10 seats; Mon–Sat 17:30–22:00, closed Sundays and holidays; cards and QR accepted. Reviews (2025–2026): Japanese-style French eaten with chopsticks; run by a married couple (the chef, the husband, was formerly head chef at a Chinese restaurant; the wife is a sommelier); beef rice noodles topped with caviar; abalone in Tosa vinegar; bonito tartare; ayu with asparagus and karasumi; fried scallop and zucchini; crab and eggplant soup; fillet steak; pudding; a long-established steakhouse on 1F; bookings a month ahead.

食べログ: 銀座 佐藤養助、銀座6-4-17 出井本館1F、銀座駅C2・C3出口.en: Tabelog: Ginza Sato Yosuke, Ginza 6-4-17, 出井 Honkan 1F, 3 minutes from Ginza Station exits C2/C3; 80 seats, private rooms; weekdays 11:30–15:00, 17:00–22:00, weekends 11:30–15:00, 17:00–21:00; closed at Obon and New Year; reservations for weekday dinner only; 10% service charge after 17:00; opened December 1, 2006; official site sato-yoske.co.jp. October 2026 reviews: check in on the tablet outside and wait for your number; tempura seiro (two dipping sauces, soy and sesame miso); butter-chicken curry; tempura udon; ten-zaru udon with tendon; many overseas visitors; no queue at night; order by QR; pricey; chicken-tempura seiro; seiro with two sauces ¥1,400; the main shop in Akita dates from around 1860; smooth, refined udon.

食べログ: 銀座 平、銀座8-5-12 第2ポールスタービル4F、開店2026年.en: Tabelog: Ginza Taira, Ginza 8-5-12 Second Pole Star Building 4F, opened September 26, 2026; 8 counter seats; Mon–Sat 11:00–14:00, 17:00–23:00, closed Sun and holidays; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted. 2026 reviews: a spicy dipping sauce in the style of Hiroshima tsukemen, boiled cabbage, shredded scallion, pork belly; 0–1.5 portions of noodles at the same price; spicy SOBA ¥1,000.

食べログ: 銀座 木挽そば、銀座4-11-5 銀座アポロ木挽館1F、東銀座駅から.en: Tabelog: Ginza Kobiki Soba, Ginza 4-11-5, Ginza Apollo Kobiki-kan 1F, 149 m from Higashi-Ginza Station; 15 seats; Wed–Sun 11:30–13:30, 17:30–20:00, closed Mon, Tue and irregularly; cards accepted; no smoking. 2026 reviews: opened November 2025; the owner comes from Ginza Yabe (trained alongside Onozawa and Taiichi, per English reviews); thin, short 100% stone-ground buckwheat soba; seiro ¥1,200, tempura platter ¥1,800, duck soba ¥2,500 (yuzu aroma); smoked duck with white miso; two kinds of nama-fu dengaku; tempura of mountain vegetables, myoga, lotus root, sweet potato, pumpkin and conger eel; about ¥1,000 per gō of sake; opening a few minutes late; slow service with a small staff.

食べログ: 銀座 梅林 本店、銀座7-8-1 銀座梅林ビルB1F、銀座駅A2出口.en: Tabelog: Ginza Bairin main shop, Ginza 7-8-1, Ginza Bairin Building B1F, Ginza Station exit A2; 28 seats (12 counter, four tables for 4); daily 11:30–21:00; official site ginzabairin.jp. September–October 2026 reviews: Ginza's first tonkatsu specialist, 100 years old next February; special fillet katsudon (80 g fillet, soft egg); black-pork special loin katsudon (100 g) ¥3,200; a 15-minute wait at lunch; many foreign customers; five craftsmen at the counter; clean after a recent renovation; finely shredded sweet cabbage; tangy sauce; good value for Ginza.

食べログ: 銀座 真田(サナダ)、銀座5-6-5 NOCOビル3F、毎日11:0.en: Tabelog: Ginza Sanada, Ginza 5-6-5, NOCO Building 3F; daily 11:00–22:30; 10% service charge at dinner only; official site ginza-sanada.com. October 2026 reviews: also a shop in GINZA SIX; a Karuizawa atmosphere; soba with walnut sauce; lamb-shabu salad; soba and sake at night; dashimaki; fried eggplant; lamb chops; nozawana tempura; isaki namero; venison tataki; sudachi soba; oyster and mushroom kamameshi (about 40 minutes, 2 gō); some found it ordinary.

食べログ: 銀座 稲葉、銀座8-12-15、16席・個室(2〜8名)、朝食は平日.en: Tabelog: Ginza Inaba, Ginza 8-12-15; 16 seats, private rooms (2–8); breakfast weekdays from 10:30, weekends 9:00 and 10:30; dinner from 18:00; irregular holidays; cards accepted; budget ¥30,000–40,000 at night, ¥8,000–10,000 at breakfast; an okudo-san hearth; rice freshly cooked in a clay pot, charcoal grilling, dashimaki. 2026 reviews: a reservation-only breakfast by Masanobu Inaba, former executive chef of Amanemu; the autumn set (mandarin juice, Ise kabuse tea, peanut tofu, steamed conger eel, sea bream with sesame, grilled mushrooms, tempura of spiny lobster, kisu and fig, beef shigureni); dobin-mushi of matsutake and pike conger; young ayu; a young head chef and staff.

食べログ: 銀座 篝 本店、中央区銀座6-4-12 1F、TEL 03-6263.en: Tabelog: Ginza Kagari main shop, Ginza 6-4-12 1F, Chuo-ku, TEL 03-6263-8900, opened December 27, 2018; 18 counter seats; daily 11:00–21:30; no reservations. Cards, e-money and QR accepted; allergy information available; English menu available. 2026 reviews: chicken paitan SOBA ¥2,000, chicken paitan shoyu SOBA with fresh truffle ¥3,000; the ticket machine doesn't take cash; most customers are from overseas.

食べログ: 銀座 紫野、銀座3-7-20 銀座日本料理会館B1F、銀座一丁目駅か.en: Tabelog: Ginza Shino, Ginza 3-7-20, Ginza Nihon Ryori Kaikan B1F, 3 minutes from Ginza-itchome Station; 14 seats, private rooms; Mon–Sat 17:00–21:00, closed Sundays and holidays; cards and d-barai accepted; a smoking area for heated tobacco only; ¥20,000–30,000. Reviews (2024–2026): behind Matsuya; a teppanyaki run by a married couple; fugu; tempura of autumn eggplant, saury rolled in shiso and corn; hanpen from Kamimo in Nihonbashi (the spelling in an English review); abalone; black-wagyu fillet and sirloin; clear soup; Akkeshi, Bowmore, Ardbeg; Chablis; special fugu dishes; beef bento to take home; good for business entertaining.

食べログ: 銀座 蕎麦悠、銀座2-10-11 マロニエ通り銀座館8F、21席(カ.en: Tabelog: Ginza Soba Yū, Ginza 2-10-11, Marronnier-dori Ginza-kan 8F; 21 seats (9 counter, private rooms for 2–12); daily 11:00–15:00, 16:00–23:00; irregular holidays; cards, e-money and QR (Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted; ¥8,000–9,999 at night. 2026 reviews: soba kaiseki, starter (lotus root, buckwheat groats), sashimi of shrimp, tuna and uni, conger-eel tempura, hand-made soba, a ¥20,000 course, a caviar-soba lunch course, sudachi soba, zaru, kamo nanban, open kitchen, live piano, business entertaining in private rooms, some complaints that the tempura is oily.

食べログ: 銀座 蟹 あかつき、銀座5-4-15 銀座エフローレビルV 4F、銀.en: Tabelog: Ginza Kani Akatsuki, Ginza 5-4-15, Ginza Efflore Building V 4F, 1 minute from Ginza Station exit B7; 27 seats, private rooms (2–6); weekdays 11:30–14:00, 17:00–23:00, weekends and holidays evenings from 16:00; irregular holidays; opened May 29, 2024; 10% service charge; the owner buys brand-name crab at the market daily. 2026 reviews: live crab, crab kaiseki of hairy, king and snow crab, crab sashimi, mushroom soup, a "Crab Indulgence Course" (per English reviews) ¥25,000 incl. tax, under ¥10,000 at lunch, private rooms for those with babies (not soundproof), some complaints about cleanliness and freshness.

食べログ: 銀座 道しるべ、中央区銀座西2-2 銀座インズ2 2F、有楽町駅徒歩.en: Tabelog: Ginza Michishirube, Ginza-nishi 2-2, Chuo-ku, Ginza Inz 2, 2F, 3 minutes from Yurakucho Station, 2 from Ginza Station; 40 seats; Mon–Sat and holidays 11:00–15:00, 17:30–22:30, closed Sun; otoshi charged. Shop introduction: proud of chicken, soba and sake; at lunch a carefully made rich chicken tsuke soba; at night dishes such as crisp-grilled 大山 chicken; carefully chosen sake; highballs of Chichibu's Ichiro's Malt; stone-ground soba to finish. 2026 reviews: rich dipping broth; buckwheat tea; kind, efficient staff; curry soba with shrimp tempura; once a tsuke-soba shop, now an izakaya also serving chicken dishes and fresh fish; seiro ¥680; tuna sashimi about ¥1,500, nicely fatty; kisu fried with plum and shiso; chilled, firm seiro; some say it's a bit pricey.

食べログ: 銀座 鉄板焼き Shin Harada、銀座7-10-8 第五太陽ビ.en: Tabelog: Ginza Teppanyaki Shin Harada, Ginza 7-10-8, 第五太陽 Building 903, 3 minutes from Ginza and Higashi-Ginza stations; 8 seats; daily 11:30–15:00, 17:00–23:00; cards accepted; chef profile (English): Shinji Harada, a famous Italian chef with many books; to mark the opening, a 15-dish ¥15,000 course for ¥9,900. October 2026 reviews: beef-consommé flan, Sendai beef, Hokkaido abalone, eel, red eggplant, pumpkin, komatsuna, tomato, courses with caviar or snow crab, A5 black wagyu, plenty of non-alcoholic drinks, book by phone a week ahead, full even at 20:00 on weekdays.

食べログ: 銀座 長寿庵、銀座1-21-15、開店1935年4月29日、月〜金1.en: Tabelog: Ginza Chōjuan, Ginza 1-21-15, opened April 29, 1935; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00, 17:30–21:30, closed weekends and holidays; 56 seats (20 on 1F, 36 on 2F, all tables); otoshi ¥310; cards accepted. 2026 reviews: third-generation owner Amano (per a review); said to be where kamo nanban and kamo seiro originated; hand-made soba of stone-ground buckwheat from the shop's own Hokkaido farm (per a review); large kamo seiro ¥1,600, grated-daikon soba (nameko), curry nanban, katsudon, course with all-you-can-drink ¥9,000.

食べログ: 銀座 鰤門、銀座5-5-13 坂口ビル6F、銀座駅から徒歩2分、38.en: Tabelog: Ginza Shimon, Ginza 5-5-13, Sakaguchi Building 6F, 2 minutes from Ginza Station; 38 seats, private rooms; daily 11:30–15:00, 17:00–22:00; open every day; 10% service charge; no under-13s at the counter; cards accepted. October 2026 reviews: a 12 m bengara-lacquered counter; lunch omakase ¥10,780 (3 starters, 8 nigiri, tamago, a roll, soup, dessert); about double at night; 3–4 kinds of nikiri depending on the fish; white fish with salt and water; kasugo, akami, oysters, sweet shrimp, kombu-cured sea bream; no menu for extras.

食べログ: 銀座-LAZY(ギンザ・レイジー)、銀座1-4-8 銀座ビックウエス.en: Tabelog: Ginza-LAZY, Ginza 1-4-8, Ginza Big West Building 7F; 25 seats; Mon–Sat and holidays 17:00–23:00, closed Sun; service charge ¥500 (garlic toast and mineral water); the shop introduction calls it a 36-year-old Italian restaurant. Precious: when "Lazy" was born, the menu was worked out by Ichinohe with chef Ishikawa so as not to be a trendy Italian restaurant; mainly Italian, plus Spanish and other Mediterranean dishes and originals. 2026 reviews: Gorgonzola and French-bread gratin (small size available); grilled oysters; grilled caciocavallo from 吉田 Farm with tomato; squid-ink risotto; sautéed squid and mushrooms; avocado and vegetables; pasta; a full wine list; hard to book; some heard it would close.

食べログ: 銀座ZION(ザイオン)、銀座5-9-1 銀座コティビルB1、銀座駅.en: Tabelog: Ginza ZION, Ginza 5-9-1, Ginza Coty Building B1, 1 minute from Ginza Station exit A5 toward the Kabukiza; 48 seats (sofa seats); daily 17:00–23:00; closed at New Year; otoshi ¥600 and 10% service charge; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; opened March 18, 2011; operator site restaurantinnovation.jp. Shop introduction: decor like an overseas café; grilled black wagyu; seafood paella; full buyouts for welcome and farewell parties (¥40,000); projector and microphone. 2026 reviews: Camembert and mentaiko ajillo; quattro formaggi; chewy pizza dough; paella; ¥5,000 with 2 hours of all-you-can-drink; the only beer is Asahi Super Dry and the highball is so-so; one toilet; complaints that it was hot and noisy with groups.

食べログ: 銀座うかい亭、銀座5-15-8 時事通信ビル1F、東銀座駅6番出口徒.en: Tabelog: Ginza Ukai-tei, Ginza 5-15-8, Jiji Tsushin Building 1F, 3 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station exit 6; 94 seats (22 counter, 9 semi-private); weekdays 12:00–16:00, 17:00–21:30, Sat and holidays 11:30–13:30, 17:00–21:30; closed Sundays, twice a month on Mondays and at New Year; 13% service charge (15% from December 1, 2026); strict cancellation policy; official site ukai.co.jp/ginza; Tabelog Award 2017–2020 Bronze. Shop introduction: on Miyuki-dori; a door with a sculpture by Jean-Michel Folon; zelkova beams over 100 years old; Japanese architecture with Western art; carefully chosen "Ukai special beef" cooked in front of you. 2026 reviews: autumn-only chestnut soup and Mont Blanc; sea bream en croûte; clam soup; special-beef steak; black-wagyu tartare; milt risotto; sautéed Spanish mackerel; striploin with black-pepper sauce; the Shiba Ukai-tei has closed; about 70% full at weekday lunch; a private room for four; added matsutake; wine and sake pairing; the abalone was the best.

食べログ: 銀座すし嘉 はなれ、銀座6-7-4 銀座タカハシビル2F、銀座駅から.en: Tabelog: Ginza Sushi Yoshi Hanare, Ginza 6-7-4, Ginza Takahashi Building 2F, 2 minutes from Ginza Station; 16 seats, private rooms (4 and 6; counter private room for 4–7); Mon–Sat 12:00–14:00, 18:00–21:30, closed Sun; opened October 3, 2022; cards accepted; budget ¥20,000–30,000 at night. 2026 reviews: red-vinegar rice, first bonito with nori soy sauce, seared firefly squid, pen shell, zuke, seared kinmedai, aged ishigaki-dai, Oma tuna, a young taishō who asks how much rice you want, many overseas visitors.

食べログ: 銀座とんかつ はし勝つ、銀座3-12-1、2023年10月6日オープ.en: Tabelog: Ginza Tonkatsu Hashikatsu, Ginza 3-12-1; opened October 6, 2023; 7 seats; Mon–Fri 11:00–18:00, Sat 11:30–15:00, closed Sun and holidays; cards, transit IC and PayPay accepted; only bento can be reserved. Reviews: formerly a hanko shop, wall-facing counter, English menu, loin-cutlet set ¥1,300–1,500, katsu curry ¥1,650–1,700, eel and ramen, a ¥300-off coupon for next time. FindMeGlutenFree: 8 reviews, "when I showed a celiac card, I was told a gluten-free tonkatsu could be made".

食べログ: 銀座みゆき館 銀座5丁目店、銀座5-10-1 プリンスビル1F、銀座.en: Tabelog: Café de Ginza Miyukikan Ginza 5-chome, Ginza 5-10-1, Prince Building 1F, 3 minutes from Ginza Station exit B7; 60 seats; Mon, Tue, Sun 11:30–22:00, Wed–Sat 11:30–23:00; no reservations; separate smoking area; takeaway; official site cafe-ginza-miyukikan.com. 2026 reviews: an unchanging, elegant, classic atmosphere; forget the bustle of Suzuran-dori; carefully brewed hot coffee; iced café au lait; an elegant Mont Blanc; open late even on weekdays and quiet late on; chestnut Mont Blanc and apple chiboust (caramelized top); elegant cups; Ginza Mitsukoshi visible from the window.

食べログ: 銀座イタリアン Fabi’s(ファビズ)、銀座8-8-8 GINZA.en: Tabelog: Ginza Italian Fabi's, Ginza 8-8-8, GINZA888 Building B1F, 5 minutes from Ginza, Shinbashi and Shiodome stations; 42 seats, private rooms (2–8); weekdays 11:30–14:30, 17:30–22:30, Sat 11:00–15:30, 18:00–22:30, Sundays and holidays 11:00–15:30, 18:00–21:30; irregular holidays and New Year; ¥550 charge at dinner only; cards, PayPay and d-barai accepted; opened March 23, 2006; official site ginza-fabis.com. Shop introduction: luxury ingredients such as caviar, foie gras and wagyu; sommelier-selected wines. October 2026 reviews: a popular Italian course (starter platter, house pasta, meat main); chef's omakase (beef steak, lobster); prix-fixe lunch in a private room; ¥3,000–4,000 at lunch, ¥8,000–15,000 at dinner.

食べログ: 銀座カシータ、銀座8-4-22 ホテル ザ セレスティン銀座14F、.en: Tabelog: Ginza Casita, Ginza 8-4-22, Hotel The Celestine Ginza 14F, 5 minutes from Shinbashi Station; 50 seats (14 counter, 36 table); breakfast 7:00–12:00, lunch 12:00–15:00, dinner weekdays 18:00–24:00, weekends and holidays 18:00–22:00 (after-dinner menu after 21:00); open every day except statutory inspection days; 10% service charge; ¥1,000 table charge after 21:00; cards and IC accepted; opened October 5, 2017; official site casita.jp. 2026 reviews: part of the Omotesando Casita group; Tokyo Tower was visible; à la carte arranged as a course; staff who tell you when you've ordered too much; caviar capellini; uni pasta; white fish; sirloin steak; Basque cheesecake; choosing and sharing pasta and mains on the lunch course; service built on the philosophy of president Takahashi (English spelling).

食べログ: 銀座コージーコーナー 銀座1丁目本店、銀座1-8-1 銀座池田園ビル.en: Tabelog: Ginza Cozy Corner Ginza 1-chome main shop, Ginza 1-8-1, 銀座池田園 Building 1F–2F; 32 seats; 1F takeaway Western sweets (10:00–20:00), 2F café (pasta, cake sets, drinks, 11:00–19:00, parfaits from 14:00); open every day; no reservations; official site cozycorner.co.jp. 2026 reviews: double cream puff of custard and whipped cream; pumpkin cream puff; financiers; the café was full on a holiday, about a 5-minute wait; every seat looks toward Kyobashi; seasonal parfait and coffee set; opinions split between ordinary for Ginza and a relaxing hidden spot.

食べログ: 銀座サンド、銀座7-6-4 フィーラ銀座ビル1F、平日17:00〜翌.en: Tabelog: Ginza Sand, Ginza 7-6-4, Fira Ginza Building 1F; weekdays 17:00–3:00, Sat 11:30–23:00, closed Sundays and holidays; takeaway and delivery only; English and picture menu; opened February 4, 2019; official site kitashinchisand.com. Shop introduction: sister shop of the popular "Kitashinchi Sand" in Kitashinchi; katsu sandos particular about ingredients and method; freshly made and hot; takeaways are quick-cooled to lock in the flavor; paper bags like a jewelry shop's, for gifts. October 2026 reviews: 16-layer mille-feuille pork katsu sando ¥1,300 (a remark that it was dry about 10 minutes after buying); "tamago katsu sando" of fried egg; 8-layer Japanese-beef-fillet salt katsu sando ¥1,800 (Sicilian rock salt and butter); black paper bags; popular as a celebrity's gift; until late on Kenban-dori, lined with clubs; very expensive.

食べログ: 銀座シシリア、銀座8-3-1 GINZATOKIDENビル3F、JR.en: Tabelog: Ginza Sicilia, Ginza 8-3-1, GINZATOKIDEN Building 3F, 5 minutes from JR Shinbashi Station Ginza exit, Ginza Station exit C2 and Uchisaiwaicho Station exit A5; 38 seats (tables only); weekdays 11:30–14:30, 16:30–22:00, weekends and holidays 11:30–21:00; closed at New Year; service charge; cards, IC and QR accepted; official site ginza-sicilia.jp. Shop introduction: an unchanged Showa taste since 1971; the famous Napolitan; 23 wines including Sicilian reds and whites; moved and renovated; an open space with big windows. October 2026 reviews: Napolitan ¥900 (with soup; change the flavor with grated cheese); the famous green salad ¥850 (thin-sliced cucumber, olive-oil, vinegar and garlic dressing); chicken cutlet with demi-glace ¥1,100; square thin-crust mixed pizza; basil spaghetti; lasagna; fried cheese; ajillo; pilaf.

食べログ: 銀座バードランド、銀座4-2-15 塚本素山ビルB1F、銀座駅C6出.en: Tabelog: Ginza Birdland, Ginza 4-2-15, 塚本素山 Building B1F; a sign with a chicken picture at Ginza Station exit C6; 33 seats; Tue–Fri 17:00–22:00, Sat 17:00–21:30, closed Sun, Mon and holidays; official site ginza-birdland.sakura.ne.jp. 2026 reviews: by the Sukiyabashi crossing, next to Sukiyabashi Jiro; English-speaking staff; omakase course ¥9,800 (8 skewers, 10% service charge); liver pâté with no off-taste; liver; tsukune with egg-yolk sauce; salad and tofu as palate cleansers; well-paced service; beer ¥1,080; many foreign customers; some say it's expensive for what it is.

食べログ: 銀座バール・デルソーレ 2Due、銀座2-4-6 銀座ベルビア館1F.en: Tabelog: Ginza Bar Del Sole 2Due, Ginza 2-4-6, Ginza Bellvie-kan 1F; 28 seats; Mon–Sat 11:00–23:00, Sundays and holidays 11:00–22:30; closed when Bellvie-kan is; official site delsole.st. October 2026 reviews: double espresso ¥600 and biscotti ¥300; terrace seats at lunch; Italian customers too; Bolognese lunch set (salad, spaghetti, gelato) with a macchiato; cream pasta; set drinks ¥200; tiramisu (in a glass and by the slice); curt service.

食べログ: 銀座フィッシュバーガー NAGOMI、京橋3-4-1 TM銀座ビル1.en: Tabelog: Ginza Fish Burger NAGOMI, Kyobashi 3-4-1, TM Ginza Building 1F; 26 seats (sofa, counter, terrace); daily 11:00–24:00; closed December 29–January 4; no lunch bookings; opened August 8, 2022. 2026 reviews: mackerel fish burger ¥1,000 (a patty of fish paste grilled, not fried; free wasabi tartar dip); ginger ale ¥200; soft-shell crab burger with nuggets ¥1,750; an eel special; shrimp, salmon, mackerel; mackerel spring rolls; seafood hot dog; the nuggets are good too; stamps for the Kyobashi noren tour.

食べログ: 銀座和縁、銀座7-5-12 ニューギンザビル8号館3F、銀座駅・新橋.en: Tabelog: Ginza Waen, Ginza 7-5-12, New Ginza Building No. 8 3F, 5 minutes from Ginza and Shinbashi stations; 15 seats (9 counter, private rooms); daily 11:30–14:00, 17:30–23:00; irregular holidays; opened August 2, 2012; 10% service charge; cards accepted. Reviews (2025–2026): crab, rare for teppanyaki; live abalone taken from the tank and grilled; meat on toast; colorful vegetables; adjusts for foods you dislike; the master and the owner (okami); all-you-can-drink; ¥20,000–30,000.

食べログ: 銀座朝食ラボ、銀座7-12-9 ホテルミュッセ銀座名鉄2F、東銀座駅.en: Tabelog: Ginza Choshoku Lab, Ginza 7-12-9, Hotel Musse Ginza Meitetsu 2F, 4 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station; 46 seats; daily 7:00–11:00 (last entry 10:00, 50-minute limit); reservations only for 7:00 entry; hotel guests take priority when busy; no service charge or cover; opened July 1, 2021; official site choshoku.neu-inc.Tokyo. Shop introduction: a hotel buffet of handmade Japanese and Western small dishes. 2026 reviews: all-you-can-eat for 50 minutes ¥2,700; the entrance from the hotel's 2F is hard to find; all-you-can-eat sukiyaki and pork shabu; small dishes in house dashi; bright and clean; attentive staff; dishes served in wooden masu; salad, bread, curry and desserts; grape juice; some say 50 minutes is short.

食べログ: 銀座鮨処 まぐろ相馬水産、銀座7-2-14 第26ポールスタービル3.en: Tabelog: Maguro Soma Suisan, Ginza 7-2-14, Dai-26 Pole Star Building 3F, 8 minutes from Ginza Station; 8 seats (counter); Mon–Sat 17:00–22:30 (four sittings at 17:00, 18:00, 19:30 and 20:30), closed Sundays and holidays; opened November 21, 2023; official site ginza-maguro-souma.com. Shop introduction: 60 years of the Toyosu tuna middleman "Soma Suisan"; premium sushi course ¥11,000; a hinoki counter. 2026 reviews: all tuna (akami, chu-toro, o-toro); the famous "Everest" negitoro; uni; sweet shrimp; red-vinegar rice; nigiri keep coming until time is up; a cheerful taishō who loves puns; many foreign customers; the elevator is hard to find; full.

食べログ: 銀熊茶寮(ぎんくまさりょう)、銀座6-3-11 西銀座ビル7F、銀座.en: Tabelog: Ginkuma Saryo, Ginza 6-3-11, Nishi-Ginza Building 7F, 335 m from Ginza Station; 34 seats (including a sunken-kotatsu counter); Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00, 17:00–22:30, holidays 17:00–22:00, closed Sun; opened February 14, 2007; operator tokyo-rf.com. Shop introduction: select black wagyu; seafood from all over Japan such as king crab and spiny lobster; seasonal vegetables; fully private rooms for up to 12. 2026 reviews: take off your shoes; a quiet private room with piano and jazz; chef's omakase (seasonal starter, black wagyu, black abalone and spiny lobster); a highball of Kagoshima whisky; staff bow as you step off the elevator; a Saturday-lunch hamburg steak over ¥3,000; for business entertaining and anniversaries; some say the seating isn't suited to business talks.

食べログ: 銀蕎麦 國定、銀座6-4-16 花椿ビルB1F、20席、月〜木11:.en: Tabelog: Gin Soba Kunisada, Ginza 6-4-16, Hanatsubaki Building B1F; 20 seats; Mon–Thu 11:30–14:00, 17:00–22:00, Fri evenings only, Sat 8:00–11:00, closed Sun and holidays; no cards, e-money and d-barai accepted; otoshi ¥600; ¥8,000–9,999 at night, ¥1,000–1,999 at lunch. 2026 reviews: hand-made by a woman soba artisan, soba water in Nanbu ironware, seiro with wasabi rice, tamagoyaki set, ramen limited to 20 a day ¥1,200, kamo seiro, duck hot pot, steak, morning dashimaki set (dogs welcome), plenty of sake, smoking at the seats.

食べログ: 錦 活鮨、寿司・日本料理・天ぷら、中京区高宮町594-2、毎日 11.en: Tabelog: Nishiki Katsuzushi, sushi, Japanese cuisine, tempura; 高宮町594-2, Nakagyo-ku; every day 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:00); reservations accepted; 20 seats (16 counter, one table for 4); non-smoking; English menu; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; opened 23 January 2025; temari sushi with seafood from Nishiki Market; about 30 local sakes and an original sake. Reviews (March–August 2026, in English): 12 pieces of temari sushi, a choice of 3 obanzai, 3 tempura or 3 sashimi, red miso soup, matcha parfait, sushi lunch ¥3,600, 12 kinds of condiments, mixed opinions.

食べログ: 長崎堂 心斎橋本店、和菓子・カフェ・洋菓子、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-.en: Tabelog: 長崎堂 心斎橋本店 (Nagasaki Do Shinsaibashi honten), Japanese sweets / café / Western sweets, Shinsaibashi-suji 2-1-29, Chuo-ku, Osaka, about 2 min on foot from Shinsaibashi Station exit 6, Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 10:00–17:30, closed Wednesday, reservations accepted, cards, e-money and QR-code payments accepted, 10 seats, non-smoking, wheelchair accessible, children welcome, takeout. Official site: founded 1919 (Taisho 8); castella above all, plus Crystal Bonbon, 虹のかけら (Rainbow Fragments), dorayaki and Waffel. The founder 荒木源四郎 opened the confectionery 扇正軒 in Dejima, Nagasaki; moved to Osaka in 1924 as 合資会社長崎堂; patent for canned castella in 1934; in 1951 the second-generation head 敏夫 hung the sign 「本舗 長崎堂」 in 周防町 (now Shinsaibashi-suji 2-1-29); the canned castella was taken as rations by an Annapurna climbing expedition; in 1960 it became 株式会社大阪長崎堂 under the third-generation head 荒木一郎; around 1973 the head shop's music box was bought; Crystal Bonbon launched around 1980; in 1981 the writer 田辺聖子 visited the head shop, which appears in 「苺をつぶしながら」; the restored castella in 1982; the red-rice sweet 赤米寿 sold only on the 1st and 15th of the month; in 2003 the fourth-generation head 荒木貴史 became representative director; in 2013 the Shinsaibashi head shop was renewed with 「1919長崎堂」; centenary in 2019. Shops: the Shinsaibashi head shop and the Sumiyoshi shop, plus supermarkets and souvenir outlets (Kansai Airport, Itami Airport, Shin-Osaka Station and others). Chairman and representative director 荒木貴史. Group-company page: the Nagasaki Do group is the parent of three brands, Nagasaki Do, QUOLOFUNE (head shop in Jiyugaoka, Tokyo) and Zen Kashoin (Muromachi, Kyoto). Reviews (March 2025 – October 2026): the head-shop set ¥1,100 (Crystal Bonbon, Rainbow Fragments, castella or the red-rice sweet, coffee or a pot of tea); Crystal Bonbon ¥2,160, two per person; a line before opening; chestnut dorayaki ¥183–184; an iced dorayaki set; pudding à la mode; sakura castella; an Expo-character castella; Waffel; moist castella with coarse sugar on the base; a big music box you can play with a special coin; kind staff; one diner found the bonbons and castella ordinary.

食べログ: 長浜ラーメン浜ちゃん、ラーメン・つけ麺・餃子、大阪市淀川区西三国1丁.en: Tabelog: Nagahama Ramen Hamachan; ramen, tsukemen, gyoza; 1-2-38 Nishimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 10–13 minutes on foot from the south exit of Higashi-Mikuni Station; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00; closed Sunday; no cards, e-money or QR; 19 seats (6 at the counter, 5 in the tatami area, two tables for four); smoking allowed. Reviews (January 2025 to October 2026): run by the owner and the owner's wife; lunch paused in 2023 and resumed; Nagahama ramen ¥550; lunch set A (ramen, rice, takana) ¥650; set C (ramen, gyoza, rice, kimchi) ¥800; chashu ramen ¥800; extra noodles ¥150 (formerly ¥100); thin noodles sent from Hakata; light-looking broth that tastes of pork bone; a little salty; pickled ginger and sesame; homemade gyoza; regulars back after years.

食べログ: 開元カフェ (Kaigen cafe)、大阪市西区靭本町2-2-23.en: Tabelog: Kaigen cafe, Utsubo Koban-mae Bldg 1F, 2-2-23 Utsubo-honmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 6 min on foot from Awaza Stn Exit 1, 8 min from Hommachi Stn Exit 18; Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 11:30–20:00; closed Thursday; no reservations; cards (VISA, Master, AMEX) and e-money accepted; 20 seats (15 at tables, 5 at the counter); sofa seats; non-smoking; children welcome; takeout available; opened 15 June 2012; genres: kakigori, tantanmen, cafe. Reviews (September 2025–September 2026): near Utsubo Park, fluffy kakigori with almond or yogurt espuma, strawberry milk ¥1,760, mango tea ¥1,500, jasmine tea ¥1,265, white chocolate, white peach, black sugar douhua, toppings such as tapioca and mango, kakigori from 12:00, in summer 15 minutes or more before it arrives, pu-erh tea tapioca milk tea ¥660, sweetness and amount of ice to choose, half price on takeout during time sales, soy milk tantanmen ¥990 with rice ¥220, Taiwanese mazesoba, water dumplings ¥800, coconut balls ¥500, a dim sum set of 8 pieces ¥1,000, xiaolongbao.

食べログ: 関西風手打うどん いらっしゃい、下谷1-13-10、入谷駅から徒歩4.en: Tabelog: Kansai-style handmade udon Irasshai, Shitaya 1-13-10; 4 min on foot from Iriya Station, 5 min from JR Uguisudani; Mon–Sat 11:30–13:30, Tuesday also 18:00–19:30; closed Sundays; closes when the noodles run out; the posted hours are not very reliable (listing remarks); no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; non-smoking; Tabelog Udon 100 TOKYO 2020, EAST 2024. Menu (May 2021): kake ¥480; kitsune, kakiage, tanuki ¥550; mixed ¥600; plum, kombu, takana, shippoku, vegetable ¥650; yuzu soba ¥650. Reviews (August–October 2026): the signature shippoku udon; handmade noodles of uneven thickness; a gentle Kansai-style dashi; large sizes; a single owner; a short queue at opening; Showa retro; one diner said it was hardly clean.

食べログ: 雲仙 銀座店、銀座2-6-5 銀座トレシャス10F、銀座一丁目駅から.en: Tabelog: Unzen Ginza, Ginza 2-6-5, Ginza Treasure 10F, 1 minute from Ginza-itchome Station; 28 seats, semi-private room (4) and private room (8); daily 11:30–15:00, 17:30–23:00; closed only at New Year; cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened April 16, 2010; official site unzen.com. Shop introduction: "Unzen", founded 1950; creative kushiage of seasonal ingredients, one skewer at a time; sofa seats by the window; over 100 wines from around the world; weekend 10 kushikatsu with all-you-can-drink ¥6,900. Reviews: in January 2026 a 20-skewer course; New Caledonian angel shrimp and green asparagus; a light batter; a different sauce recommended for each skewer, placed in position; extra orders possible. In September 2026, lunch; the miso soup is good too; mention of Unzen in Kitashinchi. 2025: wagyu ¥1,000, shrimp and crab claw ¥1,200, salmon and salmon roe ¥700; lunch 10 skewers and a drink ¥3,300; a report that ordering one skewer brought two.

食べログ: 韓国料理、東山区六軒町206-1 どんぐり会館 2F、祇園四条駅1番.en: Tabelog: Korean; 六軒町206-1, Higashiyama-ku, どんぐり会館 2F; about 1 min walk from Exit 1 of Gion-Shijo Stn; daily 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed irregularly; reservations accepted (for 7 or more, an omakase course from ¥12,000 with free-flow drinks after 18:00; cancel by phone or a fee applies); 9 counter seats; heated tobacco only; no cards, e-money or QR; claims Kyoto's best samgyetang and creative Korean cooking; the owner is a former fishmonger; switched to à la carte from April. Reviews (December 2025–October 2026, in English): ganjang gejang (reserve ahead), ganjang saeu, hairy crab, white and black samgyetang, an appetizer platter, yukhoe bruschetta, steamed pork, cheese chijimi, spring rolls, makgeolli, free-flow drinks ¥2,000, a board without prices, counter only, booking required.

食べログ: 韓湯 みっちゃん、大阪市中央区難波4-3-13 富士ビル1F、予約は.en: Tabelog: Kantan Micchan, Fuji Bldg 1F, 4-3-13 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; reservations for dinner only; Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 11:30–15:00; closed Thursdays; no cards, e-money or QR; no cover charge; 10 seats; smoking allowed; opened 21 December 2020. 2026 reviews (June–October): Ura-Namba, behind Hotel Royal Classic Osaka; queues form; yukgaejang noodles ¥1,200 (lots of chunky meat, sweet and spicy enough to make you sweat); with seasoned egg; seared rare skirt-steak rice bowl set (small or large; even small is packed with rice); pour the soup over the leftover rice; soft-boiled egg softens the heat; thin noodles; Korean reimen too; yakiniku and à la carte at night; learned of it on Instagram.

食べログ: 頂賢麺、大阪市中央区日本橋1-7-4、日本橋駅から155m、毎日11.en: Tabelog: Chokenmen, 1-7-4 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 155 m from Nippombashi Station; daily 11:00–2:00 next morning; irregular closing days (currently open every day of the year); no reservations; no cards or e-money; QR accepted; counter seats; opened 21 August 2017. Reviews (December 2024 – August 2026): special rich seafood tsukemen from the ticket machine outside; the owner runs it single-handed; noodle amount asked when the ticket is handed over, large at the same price; whole-wheat extra-thick noodles in a rich tonkotsu-and-seafood dipping soup; a modest owner; a big sheet of nori; rice refill ¥100; thick, tender chashu; after a show; special rich seafood tsukemen ¥1,200 (incl. tax); thick noodles like soba; the cold noodles cool the dipping soup; ticket machine cash only (change inside); black tonkotsu ramen and chashu mayo rice bowl; the owner alone at 1 a.m.; the tonkotsu ramen has very firm thin noodles and is surprisingly mild.

食べログ: 食堂RUTA、大阪市中央区南船場2-2-21 life&design.en: Tabelog: Shokudo RUTA, life&design Bldg 2F, 2-2-21 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Thu 11:30–15:00 (L.O. food 13:00), Fri–Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. food 19:00); irregular closing days; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 13 seats (tables). Reviews (August–September 2026): a warm, calm wooden room on the 2nd floor of a building; run single-handed; seasonal ingredients and beautiful presentation; lunch A (soup, 3 breads, starter, pasta, dessert, after-meal drink); lunch B adds a toast drink and a main; dinner course with 2 pastas (chilled corn soup; curry-scented salmon fricassée; orecchiette of octopus, aonori and mushrooms; beef cheek braised in red wine; spaghetti of Ryukyu black pork, beetroot and Parmigiano; peach Melba); vegetables and desserts well received.

食べログ: 食堂、下京区烏丸通塩小路下ル東塩小路町 ジェイアール京都伊勢丹 B1.en: Tabelog: diner; JR Kyoto Isetan B1F, Higashi-Shiokoji-cho, Karasuma-dori Shiokoji-sagaru, Shimogyo-ku; every day 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 16:00–20:00 (last order 19:30); closed on JR Kyoto Isetan's closing days; numbered tickets, and same-day intake may end once full; no bookings; 21 seats; no smoking; cards and QR accepted; no e-money; allergy information available; opened 1 August 2023; Diner Tabelog 100 2026. Reviews (October–November 2026, in English): founded in 1927 as a fish wholesaler with the opening of the Kyoto Central Wholesale Market; the craft of Saikyo-zuke; marinated a full day, then re-marinated in fresh miso; its first restaurant; silver cod Saikyo-yaki set ¥2,650; Spanish mackerel set ¥2,280; salmon Saikyo-yaki à la carte ¥1,100; kinmedai; free rice refills; red miso soup; small sides such as mentaiko; numbered tickets.

食べログ: 飲茶・点心、居酒屋、ラーメン、中京区御幸町通蛸薬師下ル船屋町363-.en: Tabelog: dim sum, izakaya, ramen; 御幸町通蛸薬師下ル船屋町363-1, Nakagyo-ku, 1F; 6 min walk from Exit 9 of Hankyu Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn; Monday–Friday and days before holidays 17:00–23:00; Saturday, Sunday and holidays 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; reservations accepted (seat-only bookings 90 minutes when busy); starter ¥250; 50 seats (counter, tables, sofas, terrace); non-smoking (smoking area inside); cards and e-money; wheelchair accessible; a night-market-style Chinese izakaya cooked by a veteran of 30 years in Chinese cooking; saliva chicken, mapo tofu, Sichuan shrimp chili, Tsingtao beer, Taiwanese fruit beer. Gurunavi: listed as closed Tuesday. Reviews (March–October 2026, in English): xiaolongbao, shumai, pan-fried dumplings, dan dan noodles, lu rou fan, twice-cooked pork, black-vinegar pork, free-flow drinks about ¥1,500, weekend lunch sets about ¥1,200, free refills of shrimp crackers, lively, often full at night, some complaints about service.

食べログ: 餃子の王将 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-4-27、06-624.en: Tabelog: Gyoza no Ohsho Shinsaibashi, 1-4-27 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6241-9011; reservations accepted; daily 11:00–22:30; closed only over New Year; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR payment accepted; 40 seats; opened 2 November 2012; official ohsho.co.jp. 2026 reviews (June–August): self-serve water; 3 servings of garlicky gyoza; comes when craving tenshinhan; reimen in summer; right by the Shinsaibashisuji shopping street; goes with beer; Wednesday half-price gyoza coupon; gyoza with and without garlic; chukadon (light starch thickening, quail eggs, shrimp, squid, scallops, plenty of vegetables); the lively voice of what seemed to be the manager; 'Gyoza no Ohsho lunch' under ¥800; burnt-miso ramen (aroma of roasted miso, thick noodles).

食べログ: 餃子工房ちびすけ 南心斎橋店、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-2-10 新日.en: Tabelog: Gyoza Kobo Chibisuke Minami-Shinsaibashi, Shin-Nihon Mitsudera Bldg 1F-9, 2-2-10 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 399 m from Namba Station; 34 seats (2 tables for 2, 4 tables for 4, 3 private rooms for 4); hours 18:00–11:00; irregular closing days; reservations accepted; opened 25 October 2021. 2025–2026 reviews: cheap set meals; taste merely 'not bad'; friendly staff; a lunch crowd of inbound tourists; ginger-pork set meal ¥900; junky menu, cheap and fast; shiso gyoza; gyoza and tantanmen; Jiro-style ramen ¥1,100 (rich miso on a tonkotsu base, slightly thick flat straight high-hydration noodles, pork belly, cabbage, bean sprouts); smoking allowed inside; Osaka gyoza (sauce, mayo, leek, bonito flakes); garlic gyoza; dashimaki omelette; shrimp chili mayo; weekday afternoons mostly overseas diners; open late, good for a second stop.

食べログ: 餃子酒場 四谷本店、中華料理・餃子・四川料理、四谷1-19 アーバン.en: Tabelog: Gyoza Sakaba Yotsuya honten, Chinese, gyoza, Sichuan; アーバン四谷ビル B1F–1F, Yotsuya 1-19; 2 min walk from Exit 2 of JR and subway Yotsuya Station; daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; 50 seats (16 on 1F, 34 on B1, some semi-private); smoking allowed; cards accepted; takeaway; gyoza crisp outside and juicy inside; sweet-spicy chicken wings. Reviews (October 2025–October 2026): fried rice with six grilled gyoza ¥930 (with almond tofu), tantanmen or Taiwanese ramen with half fried rice ¥980, daily set ¥980 (free rice refills), mapo tofu set, shrimp gyoza, a three-kind gyoza platter, chicken wings, seafood yakisoba in thick sauce, sesame dumplings, PayPay accepted, some found the service curt.

食べログ: 餅匠しづく 新町店 (旧店名 日月餅、2011年7月1日に改名)、大.en: Tabelog: Mochisho Shizuku Shinmachi ten (former name 日月餅, renamed 1 July 2011), Shinmachi House 1F, 1-17-17 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station Exit 2, 7 min from Yotsubashi Station; daily 10:30–18:00, open year-round; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 8 seats (counter only); non-smoking; wheelchair access; Tabelog Sweets WEST 100 in 2018, 2019, 2020 and 2022, Wagashi WEST 100 in 2023 and 2026. Shop website: three shops — Shinmachi, Kishiwada (the workshop) and Ashiya 『上』; sales 10:30–18:00, tea room 13:00–17:30; no fixed closing days (closures announced); the owner, 石田; a sunken mochi-pounding machine in use since the previous generation; glutinous rice, azuki, rice flour, mochi flour, sugar and grains from natural farming, grown without pesticides; radiation testing every January–February; black-bean mochi (Tanba black beans salt-boiled every morning), kusa mochi, raspberry daifuku (red from beets), kuro mochi (hemp charcoal), monaka, chestnut daifuku, shigure, kurumi mochi, chestnut chakin, ginkgo daifuku, matcha soy-au-lait (soy-milk cream); on 19 January 2026 the tea room that had run for eighteen years closed for the renovation, with a temporary shop under the eaves of milia burger meanwhile; the tea room 『甘露』 is reservation-only with a low crawl-through door, two seatings a day (13:00 and 15:00), a pairing course of sweets, mochi dishes and tea ¥6,600, sake or a non-alcoholic drink extra, junior-high age and up, mention allergies when booking. Reviews (September–October 2026): a concrete, gallery-like interior; fresh sweets like jewels; chestnut daifuku, chestnut chakin, Japanese-chestnut Mont Blanc (fresh cream), raspberry daifuku, hozuki daifuku, Shine Muscat daifuku, Gastronomic Herb (Kajitani Farm edible flowers), warabi mochi, mizu yokan; the Kanro course: a crystal-like jelly confection with azuki tea, a hozuki daifuku, a mochi soup topped with crab, chestnut kinton, and Panama coffee cloth-dripped by the owner; the eat-in is over, with about six chairs outside; prices on the high side; items sell out, so go early.

食べログ: 香吾芽、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-6-5 エイトワンビル 1F、日本橋.en: Tabelog: Kagome, Eight One Bldg 1F, 2-6-5 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 437 m from Nippombashi Station; Mon–Sat 18:00–1:30 next morning; closed Sundays and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 counter seats; no smoking. Reviews (January–July 2026): thin-noodle curry udon with the dashi as the star; north across Aioibashi, just before Yawata-suji; a clean glass-fronted shop; counter only; run by two people; kizami curry udon ¥1,200; kayaku rice ¥350; tempura curry udon; busy with families and regulars at 18:30 on a weekday; a light curry and extra-thin noodles; good beef; the last stop after drinking; more overseas diners now; first time in 5 years; kizami udon; gentle; curry udon ¥1,100; sudachi udon; egg-drop nyumen.

食べログ: 香港 (ホンコン)、大阪市浪速区恵美須東1-19-12、恵美須町駅か.en: Tabelog: Hong Kong, 1-19-12 Ebisu-higashi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 5 min on foot from Ebisucho Stn, 7 min from Dobutsuen-mae Stn and JR Shin-Imamiya Stn; Mon–Sat 17:00–22:30; closed Sunday and the third Monday; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 10 seats (counter); non-smoking; takeout available. Reviews (May–October 2026): an old-style local Chinese restaurant at the foot of Tsutenkaku, red lanterns and noren, a Showa atmosphere, run by the owner alone, taken over from the previous generation about 60 years ago, the name comes from Kagawa and 'port', the signature is pork kara-age (choose loin or chuck eye roll, with mustard-vinegar soy sauce or pink rock salt), a half portion was refused, stir-fried pork and egg, stir-fried chicken and green pepper, pork and garlic chives, liver and garlic chives, shrimp omelette, five-ingredient fried rice, crab fried rice, Tianjin rice (salt or soy sauce), off-menu omurice, gyoza, fried rice vermicelli, champon, ramen ¥500, shio ramen, cold noodles ¥900, bottled beer, full soon after the 17:00 opening, and one diner was bothered by the cleanliness.

食べログ: 香香閣、四川料理・ラーメン・中華料理、大阪市東淀川区東中島4-1-1.en: Tabelog: Shanshan Kaku, Sichuan, ramen and Chinese, 東中島 4-1-13, Higashiyodogawa-ku, Osaka, サンフラッツ新大阪 1F; 7 min from JR Shin-Osaka Station; Mon–Sat 11:00–14:30 and 17:00–22:30, closed Sunday; reservations accepted; no cards or e-money, QR accepted; tatami room; smoking allowed; opened 18 July 2018. Reviews (April to October 2026): lunch sets about ¥1,000 with rice, soup, salad, pickles and two kara-age, rice and soup refilled; mapo tofu; daily yakiniku set ¥1,100; pork with green peppers; shoyu ramen with half fried rice; cold Chinese noodles; at night gyoza, sweet and sour pork, mapo eggplant, pork kimchi, water spinach, fried rice; all-you-can-eat and drink for about ¥5,000; a large room of about 50 seats; the staff seem to be from China and talk in Chinese; a friendly owner; smoking allowed inside.

食べログ: 馬肉専門店 喜心、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-15-11 日宝周防町エレ.en: Tabelog: Basashi Senmonten Kigokoro, Nippo Suomachi Elegance Bldg 1F, 1-15-11 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station, 343 m from Nagahoribashi; Mon–Sat 18:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00); closed Sundays; bookings cancelled 10 minutes after the time; parties of 2 may be seated at the counter; smoking allowed, so no entry under 20; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 20 seats; opened 1 July 2020. Reviews (January 2025 – June 2026): sakura yukhoe; 5-kind horse sashimi platter; soba to finish the horse shabu; bought direct from producers; horse-shabu salad; zosui; sweet-potato ice cream; with all-you-can-drink; visits almost monthly; dashi shabu; thick, soft soba; squid shiokara; booking essential Fri–Sat; 7-kind horse sashimi (adds heart and tongue); horse tsukune; tsuke soba; horse-meat nyumen; saiboshi; miso-pickled tofu; horse-meat gyoza; no gamey smell; a noren at the back of the building; carpaccio salad; yukhoe rice bowl; clean; kind staff; horse salami; sushi platter; horse yakiniku; koune; Kumamoto hitomoji guruguru; horse tataki; thigh, heart, tongue, fillet, futaego, loin, mane fat; 5-skewer platter with salt or sauce by cut.

食べログ: 馬肉料理・日本料理・居酒屋、中京区河原町三条下ル大黒町46-1、三条.en: Tabelog: horse-meat dishes, Japanese cuisine, izakaya; 46-1 Daikoku-cho, Kawaramachi south of Sanjo, Nakagyo Ward; about 3 min walk from Sanjo Stn; Tue–Sun 18:00–22:00 (food L.O. 21:00); closed Monday; ingredients are limited, so book early or take a course; Kyoto duck salt-grill course ¥7,900, duck hot pot course ¥9,700, horse and duck hot pot course ¥12,900 (hot pots in autumn and winter); 12 seats; hinoki counter and open kitchen; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards and QR accepted; opened 13 July 2013. Reviews (November 2024–September 2026, English): duck yukhoe; duck sashimi; horse sashimi; liver sashimi; duck hot pot in a copper pot with rice porridge; Kyoto-vegetable tempura; nama-fu tempura; mention horse meat when booking to be sure of it; some say the menu is small.

食べログ: 駄目な隣人 人形町店、ラーメン、油そば、まぜそば、つけ麺、日本橋人形.en: Tabelog: Dame na Rinjin, Ningyocho branch; ramen, abura-soba, mazesoba, tsukemen; 日本橋センチュリープラザ 1F, Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 3-7-13; right by Ningyocho Station exit A5; daily 11:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); no reservations; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; 9 seats (counter only); non-smoking; children welcome; takeaway; opened 8 February 2021; additive-free ginger-shoyu ramen; whole-wheat noodles (thick or thin); rice cooked in a clay pot; raw eggs on the table. Menu (April 2025): REGULAR ¥950, PLUS ¥1,150, SUPREME ¥1,300, green-chili-oil soba, wagyu grilled sukiyaki rice ¥550. Reviews (January 2024–October 2026): a clear soy-sauce broth with a ginger aroma; rare loin and belly chashu; raw eggs, nori, garlic chives and bonito flakes free; write your order on paper and pay first; most of the staff are from overseas; run by ZOT; SUPREME with sukiyaki rice ¥1,900 in October 2026; eight people waiting after 9 pm.

食べログ: 魁力屋 イオンモール大阪ドームシティ店、大阪市西区千代崎3-13-1.en: Tabelog: Kairikiya Aeon Mall Osaka Dome City, Aeon Mall Osaka Dome City 4F, 3-13-1 Chiyozaki, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Dome-mae Station; daily 10:00–21:00; opened 11 December 2020; cards and e-money accepted, no QR; food court; kids' menu; official site. Reviews (August–September 2026): a ramen chain born in Kitashirakawa, Kyoto; Kyoto back-fat shoyu ramen; seasoned-egg ramen ¥1,001; extra back fat; thin straight noodles; chashu, leek, menma; tonkotsu shoyu; fried rice and karaage set; fast service; lighter than it looks; half-price fried rice via the app; one found the soup lukewarm; good before a game at Kyocera Dome too.

食べログ: 魚の中俣 銀座、銀座3-14-17 kobikissGINZa 20.en: Tabelog: Sakana no Nakamata Ginza, Ginza 3-14-17, kobikissGINZa 202, 2 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station exit 3; 41 seats (11 counter, 30 table); Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00, Sat 17:00–22:30, closed Sundays and holidays; 5% service charge; 10% private-room charge; credit cards only; about a 3-hour limit when busy; please avoid strong perfume; opened July 8, 2019; official site nakamata-nodoguro.com. Shop introduction: a five-kind platter of fresh fish such as wild bluefin tuna and morning-caught botan shrimp; "Nakamata shochu" direct from the distillery; big nodoguro and uni in front of you. 2026 reviews: a regular on a 16th visit; seafood course ¥11,200 (tuna nakaochi, grilled vegetables, 5 kinds of sashimi, house satsuma-age, salt-grilled nodoguro, warasa shabu-shabu, broad bean and conger-eel clay-pot rice, warabi-mochi); a ¥12,000 course (5 starters, sashimi, tempura, nodoguro, tuna negima hot pot, Inaniwa udon); choose today's fish from a big platter; nodoguro half simmered, half grilled; uni and nodoguro are the highlights; a remark that the fried shrimp heads were oily.

食べログ: 魚介料理・日本料理、中京区木屋町通二条下ル上樵木町491-3、京都市.en: Tabelog: seafood, Japanese cuisine; 中京区木屋町通二条下ル上樵木町491-3; 3 min walk north along Kiyamachi from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn; Tue–Sat 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:00–23:00, Sun 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00; closed Monday; evening 17:00–22:00 (L.O.), to 23:00 (L.O.) in summer; à la carte at lunch and dinner; 30 seats (14 counter, 16 at tables upstairs); private room (8); designated smoking area; cards; The Tabelog Award 2019 Bronze. Sarai (October 2016 issue, online October 2017): 割烹やました; owner 山下茂 (68), over 50 years of cooking; big-hearted hospitality; knows regulars' tastes and suggests dishes to first-timers by age and way of ordering; 'the best thing is for guests to say freely what to eat'; lunch from ¥4,000, dinner from ¥8,000 (then). Reviews (October 2025–October 2026, in English): founded 1983; at the counter, discuss how to cook the seasonal ingredients; charcoal shimo-yaki of hamo, matsutake, fugu, kue, suppon hot pot; Sakura course ¥7,700 (10% service extra).

食べログ: 魚屋 UOTACHI、大阪市西区新町3-9-7 塚口ビル 1F、西長.en: Tabelog: Sakanaya UOTACHI, Tsukaguchi Bldg 1F, 3-9-7 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nishi-Nagahori and Awaza stations; Mon, Tue, Thu and holidays 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:00) and 16:30–20:00 (L.O. 19:15), Fri–Sun 11:30–15:00 and 16:30–21:30 (L.O. 20:30); closed Wednesdays and 1st and 3rd Tuesdays; closes early if no diners after last order; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 15 seats (counter 9, tables 6). Reviews (November 2024 – August 2026): a counter at the back of a fishmonger; lunch comes with 2 small dishes, fish soup and dessert; daily sashimi bowls and the Hokkaido bowl (salmon, ikura, scallop, crab) ¥1,400; seafood bowl (¥1,200 in 2024; large rice +¥200); 8 nigiri on red-vinegar rice (¥1,300 in 2024; bluefin tuna, salmon, houbou, sea bass and more); sashimi set meal; UOTACHI Taiyori Don; plenty of fish dishes at night; bento, fresh fish and deli items to take away.

食べログ: 魚屋スタンドふじ、海鮮・居酒屋、大阪市淀川区西中島5-15-5 新な.en: Tabelog: Sakanaya Stand Fuji, seafood and izakaya, inside 新なにわ大食堂, 5-15-5 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; directly connected to the north ticket gate of the subway Shin-Osaka Station (from the Midosuji Line use stairs A or B); daily 11:30–23:00; open all year; no reservations; cards, e-money and QR (incl. Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted; 50 seats (34 at the counter, four tables for 4); non-smoking; children welcome; opened 30 March 2016; site shinnaniwadaisyokudo.jp. Shop text: fish supplied direct from the fishery; the fishmonger owner buys every morning; dashi from bonito and kombu; shrimp peeled in house; "stand" means standing-bar prices, but there are seats; drink from the afternoon while waiting for the Shinkansen. Reviews (July–October 2026): a 10–30 minute wait at night, quick at lunch; the rumoured fish platter ¥980; returning katsuo sashimi with chiai; sashimi platter for two; dashimaki; fried shrimp; salt-grilled collar; oden; simmered sea bream; Fuji potato salad; black-soybean edamame; "Sakanaya Don" to finish; lunch sashimi and grilled mackerel set ¥1,000 (rice free up to large, refills ¥100); lunch items sell out around 13:30; cheap sake (Hakurakusei special junmai); several shops in Osaka; a Tennoji shop mentioned.

食べログ: 魚料理 あのの、食堂・海鮮、大阪市淀川区東三国4-9-5、東三国駅か.en: Tabelog: Sakana Ryori Anono, set-meal restaurant and seafood, 4-9-5 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; about 4 min from Higashi-Mikuni Station; Mon–Sat 12:00–22:00 (lunch 12:00–15:00, last entry 21:00); closed Sunday and holidays; reservations accepted; cards and e-money accepted; non-smoking; opened 21 March 2024.
