Reviews (April–October 2026): down a small alley; the daily "Anono Gozen" ¥1,650 (sashimi, grilled fish, kara-age, dashimaki, about ten homemade obanzai, miso soup, rice); lunch often fully booked; book by phone; if you queue before opening, the whole party must be there; ground floor 8 counter seats and a table for 4, and a first floor; at night a sashimi platter (one slice each) with nine appetisers ¥2,800; simmered shellfish; homemade ankimo with ponzu; sweet potato with butter; beer, highballs and sake; two people drinking from noon spent ¥8,000; many regulars; featured on TV.

Tabelog: Sakana Ryori Anono, set-meal restaurant and seafood, 4-9-5 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; about 4 min from Higashi-Mikuni Station; Mon–Sat 12:00–22:00 (lunch 12:00–15:00, last entry 21:00); closed Sunday and holidays; reservations accepted; cards and e-money accepted; non-smoking; opened 21 March 2024. Reviews (April–October 2026): down a small alley; the daily "Anono Gozen" ¥1,650 (sashimi, grilled fish, kara-age, dashimaki, about ten homemade obanzai, miso soup, rice); lunch often fully booked; book by phone; if you queue before opening, the whole party must be there; ground floor 8 counter seats and a table for 4, and a first floor; at night a sashimi platter (one slice each) with nine appetisers ¥2,800; simmered shellfish; homemade ankimo with ponzu; sweet potato with butter; beer, highballs and sake; two people drinking from noon spent ¥8,000; many regulars; featured on TV.

食べログ: 魚料理 ふじい、海鮮・寿司・居酒屋、大阪市淀川区西中島3-22-2、.en: Tabelog: Sakana Ryori Fujii, seafood, sushi and izakaya, 3-22-2 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 3 min from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station, 4 min from Hankyu Minamikata Station; daily 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); irregular days off; reservations accepted; change or cancel online by 14:00 the day before; 100% charge for same-day course cancellations; courses booked by 23:00 two days ahead; cards accepted; no e-money or QR; 65 seats (counter, tatami, sunken seating); private room for 5–10; smoking allowed; takeout; opened 15 April 2020. Reviews (October 2025 to October 2026): a large white lantern; lunch "Fujii Gozen" with about ten small dishes (sashimi, kara-age, grilled salmon, mozuku, mentaiko, tamagoyaki, simmered dishes); salted salmon set (large rice free); meat dishes too; the "Take" course at night (sashimi, grilled fish, clam and fresh wakame shabu-shabu, tempura, clay-pot sea bream rice, enough to take home); hassun plated individually; grilled shirako; grilled squid tentacles; chicken nanban; grilled mackerel; sake; about ¥6,000–10,000 a head at night; the private room suits business dinners; smoking at the table.

食べログ: 魚菜屋 常峰、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-14-23 住吉ビル2F、心斎.en: Tabelog: Sakanaya Tsunemine, Sumiyoshi Bldg 2F, 1-14-23 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station, 5 from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Sat 17:00–24:00; closed Sundays; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 12 seats; smoking allowed; official site. Reviews (January 2025 – September 2026): sashimi platter; salt pork with miso; sukiyaki-style spring rolls; karasumi; pork ponzu; beef tataki ponzu; fruit tomatoes; dashimaki; sashimi platter with fugu; a heap of crab meat; course of pink-tagged crab with crab miso; ume-shiso white-fish tempura; grilled yellowtail collar; fried shrimp; beef steak; anglerfish hot pot; burdock tempura; broccoli namul; plenty of sake; baby-corn tempura fried in the husk; whiskies such as Yamazaki, Chita and Macallan; hamo hot pot; eel kabayaki; shrimp mayo; stuffed fried lotus root; sukiyaki with udon to finish; 6 counter seats and 4 tables; booking recommended; calm; a friendly manager; about ¥7,000–10,000 each.

食べログ: 魚重、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-4-17 シゲタニビル 1F、心斎橋か.en: Tabelog: Uoshige, Shigetani Bldg 1F, 1-4-17 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 250 m from Shinsaibashi; Tue–Sat 11:30–20:00; closed Mondays, Sundays and holidays (holidays closed since November 2019); no cards, e-money or QR; 6 counter seats. Reviews (April–October 2026): a tekka-don specialist; 7 slices ¥900; 7 slices with large rice ¥1,000; 10 slices ¥1,100; 10 slices with large rice ¥1,200; a regular of 27 years; at the back of a building; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 7; a wooden counter; red miso soup (wakame); pickles (shibazuke, lightly pickled napa cabbage); shredded nori on warm rice; 10 slices of marinated lean tuna; quail egg yolk and wasabi; a secret sauce; sesame aroma; chutoro tekka-don on Thursdays and Fridays; full from opening but quick turnover, in within about 15 minutes; comes with the sauce on; one found the sauce strong and saltyish; softish rice; clean; pleasant service; run by two people; ends when sold out, so go early.

食べログ: 鮨 Shizuku 心斎橋、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-1-27 周防町.en: Tabelog: Sushi Shizuku Shinsaibashi, Suomachi Wings 1F, 2-1-27 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min west of Nagahoribashi along Suomachi-dori (Europe-dori); Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 18:00–23:00 (first sitting 18:00–20:30, second 21:00–23:00); closed Wednesdays; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 10 seats (counter 6, one table for 4); opened 27 July 2016; official sushi-shizuku.com; The Tabelog Award 2025 and 2026 Bronze; Tabelog Sushi WEST Hyakumeiten 2021, 2022 and 2025. Reviews (September–October 2026): creative sushi, not Edomae; house sauces and condiments for each topping; hidden knife cuts; aubergine, green pepper and sweet shrimp; flounder; red sea bream; aori squid topped with sea urchin; Beni Haruka chawanmushi; charcoal-grilled mackerel; bonito pickled in shuto; akamutsu; chutoro; lean tuna; sardine; anago nori roll; new-season kanten jelly; hard to book; a year's wait; salt-grilled cutlassfish; grouper; sea bream and water-spinach hot pot; Kanazawa mackerel sushi; toro-taku roll; pear; Amakusa (Kumamoto) kuruma prawn grilled with karasumi; yuzu sea bream; course ¥22,000; one found ¥40,000 in total with a ¥10,000 sea-urchin hand roll expensive; 6 counter seats; toro-taku and 'grown-up shrimp mayo'; one says extras weren't explained well.

食べログ: 鮨 あまと 裏難波、大阪市中央区日本橋1-19-6 福喜ビル 2F、.en: Tabelog: Sushi Amato Ura Nanba, Fukki Bldg 2F, 1-19-6 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Nippombashi Station, 7 from Midosuji Line Namba Station; daily 12:00–14:00 (L.O. food 13:00, drinks 13:45) and 16:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); 10% service charge from 1 July 2026; cards, e-money and QR (including Alipay and WeChat Pay) accepted; 15 counter seats; opened 7 July 2025; official site. October 2026 reviews: near Kuromon Market; the second shop of Sushi Amato; a hinoki counter; aged Edomae sushi; lunch Tensho omakase 10 pieces ¥4,500 (shijimi soup, otoro, kombu-cured sea bream aged 6 days with sudachi salt, aged salmon, horse mackerel, scallop, marinated bluefin tuna, ponzu chawanmushi, squid, yellowtail aged 5 days, ikura, eel, red miso soup, unlimited oolong and green tea); Tensho omakase 15 pieces ¥6,800; the exclusive Ten Sho [Goku] omakase 15 pieces ¥8,300 (otoro and chutoro, kinmedai, kinki, kombu sweet shrimp, snow crab, sea urchin, toro-taku roll, dessert); red-vinegar rice; slightly firm rice; Mimuro Sugi sake; lunch is popular, booking recommended.

食べログ: 鮨 いしやま、銀座3-3-6 銀座モリタビル4F、銀座駅から186m.en: Tabelog: Sushi Ishiyama, Ginza 3-3-6, Ginza Morita Building 4F, 186 m from Ginza Station; 15 seats (8 main, 7 sub); Tue–Sat 12:00–15:00, 17:30–22:30, closed Sun and Mon; cards accepted; budget ¥40,000–50,000 at night, ¥20,000–30,000 at lunch. 2026 reviews: the Kanesaka lineage; Matsukawa flounder, cod milt with ponzu, bonito tataki, three kinds of uni (Sadamisaki red, and bafun uni from Himeshima and Hokkaido), whale, salmon roe, crab, sweet tamago; a nigiri-only lunch course; a grandchild who has come for 10+ years.

食べログ: 鮨 かぜのぎ、大阪市中央区南船場3-8-2、長堀橋駅から徒歩5分、心.en: Tabelog: Sushi Kazenogi, 3-8-2 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station, 5–8 from Shinsaibashi and Hommachi stations; daily two sittings 18:00–20:00 and 21:00–23:30; irregular closing days and New Year; no cards, e-money or QR; 6 counter seats. Reviews (February–September 2026): omakase ¥28,000 (February 2026); starters (young bamboo shoot and wakame); ankimo; Miyazaki beef spring roll; flounder sashimi; house half-dried karasumi; otoro with ikura and egg yolk; sea urchin with caviar and honey; cod-roe cream chawanmushi; red miso soup; hojicha ice cream; nigiri (sea bream, scallop, shimaaji, otoro, kuruma prawn, fugu milt, charcoal-seared saba bozushi, anago, tamago, otoro topped with sea urchin); to finish, sea urchin and gold leaf on the back of your hand, without gold leaf if preferred; draught beer ¥1,000; Kyoto highball ¥1,500; a quiet shop; slightly soft rice; courteous, friendly hospitality.

食べログ: 鮨 こいけ、寿司、海鮮、日本橋人形町1-4-13 重本ビル 2F、人.en: Tabelog: Sushi Koike; sushi, seafood; 重本ビル 2F, Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 1-4-13; 3 min from Ningyocho Station; Tue 17:00–22:00, Wed–Sun 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Monday; cards accepted; no e-money or QR; 8 seats (counter); non-smoking; prices as of October 2026: lunch "usual" ¥3,850, lunch omakase ¥7,150, dinner nigiri ¥12,100, dinner omakase ¥16,500. Reviews (March–October 2026): book on Ikkyu; lunch fills a month ahead; chawanmushi, tamagoyaki, about 8 nigiri, a mini eel bowl, miso soup, negitoro roll; thick toppings and largish rice; house-made kanpyo and gari; one account of the chef and two women staff, another of a husband-and-wife team; the chef comes from a sushi bar near Marunouchi Nijubashi; opened 16 May 2023.

食べログ: 鮨 ふくじゅ、銀座5-8-17 銀座プラザ58ビル8F、銀座駅A3出.en: Tabelog: Ginza Sushi Fukuju, Ginza 5-8-17, Ginza Plaza 58 Building 8F, 1 minute from Ginza Station exit A3; 26 seats, private rooms (2–8); weekdays 11:30–14:00, 17:00–23:00, weekends and holidays evenings from 16:00; opened December 15, 2018; 10% service charge (courses only at lunch); cards accepted. 2026 reviews: a 17-item course for ¥6,900 (salmon-roe bowl, flounder, horse mackerel, scallop, white squid, okra, herring roe, chu-toro, zuke, o-toro, kinmedai, conger eel, chawanmushi with clams and edamame, tamago, kanpyō roll, matcha and kinako warabi-mochi); three kinds of uni added for ¥6,600; courses with caviar and wagyu shabu-shabu; private rooms for those with babies; some complaints about the service.

食べログ: 鮨 やすみつ、寿司・魚介・かに、四谷三栄町5-2、四ツ谷駅・四谷三丁.en: Tabelog: Sushi Yasumitsu, sushi, seafood, crab; Yotsuya Sanei-cho 5-2; 6 min walk from Yotsuya and Yotsuya-sanchome stations; Mon–Sat two seatings, 17:30–20:00 and 20:30–23:00; open on the last Sunday of the month and closed the following Monday; closed Sundays and holidays; reservation only (phone 10:00–15:00); change or cancel two days ahead; card payment suspended; 14 seats (8 at the counter, a private room for 6); non-smoking; Tabelog Award Bronze 2026, Sushi TOKYO Tabelog 100 2022 and 2025; the owner goes fishing; sea urchin is the speciality. Reviews (December 2025–October 2026): Watanuki, the second-generation chef, the shop was formerly Kouraku Sushi, small dishes and nigiri in turn, red-vinegar rice, sea urchin tastings in summer, crab in winter, Nagano matsutake, omakase ¥34,100, ¥30,000–40,000 per person.

食べログ: 鮨 よつ葉、大阪市西区北堀江1-15-9 輝栄ビル 1F、四ツ橋駅6.en: Tabelog: Sushi Yotsuba, Kiei Bldg 1F, 1-15-9 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exit 6; Tue–Sun 18:00–23:00 (last entry 20:30); closed Mondays; irregular closures on weekends, with lunch from 12:00 and 12:30; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) accepted, no e-money or QR; 8 seats. Reviews (August–October 2026): same group as Sushi Shinnosuke and Homura in Sakaisuji-Hommachi; Edomae nigiri; book any time you like; lunch omakase nigiri ¥6,600 with chawanmushi; careful knife work; a wall of wine cellars; sake and wine; clean and refined; a friendly counter; one found the rice a little dry and the chawanmushi underwhelming; good value.

食べログ: 鮨 昇、銀座7-12-4 友野本社ビルB1F、21席(カウンター12.en: Tabelog: Sushi Noboru, Ginza 7-12-4, 友野 Head Office Building B1F; 21 seats (12 counter, private rooms for 2 and 4); daily 12:00–14:30, 17:00–23:00; irregular holidays; 10% service charge; cards accepted; budget ¥15,000–20,000. October 2026 reviews: rice with 3-year-aged red vinegar, an 8-sake pairing, omakase ¥23,000 and ¥25,300, mozuku in vinegar, Kyoto vegetables with grilled kinmedai, from chu-toro to striped jack, cuttlefish, kasugo, red sea bream, autumn bonito, zuke, kombu-cured Matsukawa flounder, seared toro, bafun uni and a liver sauce; many overseas visitors; some say the rice falls apart.

食べログ: 鮨 樋口、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-4-30 グランドジャニスビル 1.en: Tabelog: Sushi Higuchi, Grand Janis Bldg 1F, 2-4-30 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station, 5 from Shinsaibashi and Nippombashi stations; Mon–Wed, Fri and Sat 17:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00, last entry 20:30); closed Thursdays and Sundays; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; opened 17 July 2009; Tabelog Sushi WEST Hyakumeiten 2022. Reviews (July 2023 – September 2026): 17th year; long-time regulars; 'Higuchi Theatre'; not wedded to Edomae; no course, order what you like; no fixed start time; non-drinkers can enjoy plenty of sushi too; sashimi and small dishes; good value; a pleasant, attentive owner; small bowls; grilled fish; small dishes and sake; a memorable shiitake nigiri; eel with crisp skin; flounder and striped-jack collar; Harushika; an unpretentious atmosphere; one calls the owner lively; book any time you like; softly pressed rice that sinks under the topping's weight; sake chosen by the owner; same-day phone bookings; choose from the small bowls on view; choose how it's grilled too.

食べログ: 鮨 滉心、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-5 東心斎橋ブルースタービル.en: Tabelog: Sushi Koshin, Higashi-Shinsaibashi Blue Star Bldg 3F, 1-17-5 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 17:30–22:00 (first sitting 17:30–19:30, second 20:00–22:00); cards (VISA, Master, JCB) accepted, no e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; private hire possible (up to 20); opened 5 January 2026. October 2026 reviews: an 881 Group shop; omakase ¥4,400 only; all-you-can-drink +¥2,200 (up to 2 bottles of Sapporo Lager Akaboshi); snapping-turtle soup with mitsuba; bonito tataki with Ishigaki salt and pickled shima rakkyo; mackerel aged 4 days; kombu-cured sea bass; water octopus with suckers; marinated tuna; vinegared sardine; nodoguro; mackerel bo-zushi; barracuda; sea bream with grated-daikon sauce; tuna and herring-roe hand roll; steamed anago; kanpyo roll; omelette; toro-taku roll; a seafood salt ramen to finish, in large, medium or small; up the emergency stairs from the 2nd floor to the 3rd; an unsigned door; good value; surprises accommodated; lively and casual.

食べログ: 鮨し禅、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-14-15 アルスビル 4F、心斎橋.en: Tabelog: Sushi Zen, Ars Bldg 4F, 1-14-15 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; daily two sittings from 18:00 and 20:30 (until 23:00); lunch from 12:00 on weekends and holidays; irregular closing days; book by the day before; 5% service charge; cards, e-money and QR (including Alipay and WeChat Pay) accepted; 10 counter seats; opened 18 November 2025. Reviews (November 2025 – October 2026): course ¥18,000 including alcohol or soft drinks; sea bream aged 4 days and bonito sashimi; house sesame tofu; carbonara-style chawanmushi with mascarpone; yuba and fresh cream; Densuke anago shabu-shabu; Saikyo-grilled aburabouzu; abalone with liver sauce; chutoro; marinated bluefin tuna; otoro; kombu-cured kisu; sweet shrimp; sea-urchin bowl of purple and bafun urchin; toro-taku; fried mehikari roll; eel; milk pudding; red-vinegar rice; tuna from Teramoto Shoten in Osaka; a calm counter; well-paced dishes and attentiveness.

食べログ: 鮨とよたか、大阪市中央区南船場4-10-22 船場裏路地 1F、心斎.en: Tabelog: Sushi Toyotaka, Minami-Senba 4-10-22, Senba Uraroji 1F, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 6 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Yotsubashi Stns; Mon, Wed–Sun 12:00–14:30 and 18:00–23:00, Tue 18:00–23:00; reservation only; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 8 seats; non-smoking; opened 13 December 2021. Shop description (Tabelog and the Senba Uraroji site): fresh fish aged, cured with vinegar or kombu, or simmered, each piece made into a dish of its own with Edomae techniques. The Senba Uraroji site gives 17:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); a complex of restaurants in a restored machiya left in Minami-Senba. TableCheck: omakase course with free-flow drinks ¥20,000, lunch-only omakase nigiri with free-flow drinks ¥10,000. Time Out Osaka (July 2022): Edomae sushi made by a woman sushi chef who won a Michelin Bib Gourmand. Reviews (May–August 2026): trained at Edomae sushi shops in Tokyo and at sushi shops in Kyoto (Nagoya too, says one), set on becoming a sushi chef since childhood, red-vinegar rice, aged toro-taku, abalone in ice water, aged Akashi sea bream, corn chawanmushi, mackerel sushi, Densuke anago shabu-shabu, gunkan piled with sea urchin, miso soup from the anago broth, watermelon, 15–20 kinds of sake, dislikes accommodated if told in advance, booked by phone with a deposit by SMS, the alley entrance is hard to find, a friendly head chef (taishō).

食べログ: 鮨まつもと 本店、銀座7-10-8 第五太陽ビル802、銀座駅・新橋.en: Tabelog: Sushi Matsumoto Honten, Ginza 7-10-8, 第五太陽 Building 802, 5 minutes from Ginza and Shinbashi stations; 17 seats (counter and private rooms for 2 and 4); weekdays 11:30–14:30, 17:00–23:00, weekends and holidays evenings from 16:00; irregular holidays; opened March 1, 2026; 10% service charge; cards and Rakuten Pay accepted; "Otani-mae" (English shop introduction). 2026 reviews: moved from Akasaka to Ginza; Otani of Sushi Otani in Akasaka is the taishō (per English reviews); omakase nigiri course ¥11,000 (lunch and dinner); junsai gazpacho, rock mozuku, spaghetti squash in Tosa vinegar, pumpkin chawanmushi, toro with salt; beer and highball ¥1,100; considerate of left-handers.

食べログ: 鮨まつもと、寿司、東山区祇園町南側570-123、祇園四条駅から徒歩.en: Tabelog: Sushi Matsumoto, sushi, 東山区祇園町南側570-123, 5 min on foot from Gion-Shijo Stn; Mon and Thu–Sun 12:00–14:00 (last order 13:00) and 18:00–21:00 (last order 19:00); Wednesday has no times listed; closed Tuesdays and occasionally; reservations accepted; please avoid strong perfume or fabric softener; 11 seats (counter 7, two tables for 2); smoking allowed in the courtyard; cards accepted; Sushi WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2022, 2025. Reviews (December 2025–October 2026, in English): founded 2006, Daiten Matsumoto from Kanagawa, trained at Shinbashi Shimizu, red-vinegar rice without sugar, Edomae style, one Michelin star, omakase only, many local guests.

食べログ: 鮨朗、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-7-14 NIPPO心斎橋トライアンフ.en: Tabelog: Sushi Rou, NIPPO Shinsaibashi Triumph 1F, 2-7-14 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 7 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Namba stations; daily 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 22:30); reservations accepted (mention allergies and preferences when booking; everyone starts together, so be punctual); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 7 seats (counter only); no smoking; opened 14 June 2025; a calm black-toned shop; children welcome; reasonably priced drinks; a creative sushi course by a young taisho, 'brighter and freer'. September 2026 reviews: good creative dishes; seasonal omakase course ¥12,500; the shop name takes one character from the taisho's name; aged tuna (lean, 13 days); aged sea bream; sawara; red sea bream; rare-fried hamo; striped jack; short-farmed tuna from Oki, Shimane; cola or green tea ¥400; rare-fried eel sandwich; striped jack aged 4 days; firm rice; run single-handed; some French-like dishes; Oki chutoro aged 7 days.

食べログ: 鮨處つの田、寿司、海鮮、創作料理、日本橋人形町3-2-10 千歳ビル.en: Tabelog: Sushi Dokoro Tsunoda, sushi, seafood, creative; Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 3-2-10, 1F; 3 min walk from Ningyocho Station exit A5; Mon–Fri 11:30–13:30 and 17:00–21:30; closed Sat, Sun and holidays; reservation only; cards accepted; 10% service charge; 14 seats (10 at the counter, sunken-kotatsu private rooms); private hire up to 20; non-smoking; website sushi-tsunoda.com; omakase ¥17,600, light ¥13,200, special ¥20,900, lunch nigiri ¥6,000 and special ¥8,800. Reviews (May 2022–March 2026): about 15 years; a wooden refrigerator cooled with ice; snacks between the nigiri; small rice; a hinoki counter; a chatty chef; octopus; sea urchin nigiri; nodoguro.

食べログ: 鰻ひつまぶし備長 三越銀座店、銀座4-6-16 銀座三越11F、銀座.en: Tabelog: Hitsumabushi Bincho Mitsukoshi Ginza, Ginza 4-6-16, Ginza Mitsukoshi 11F, 1 minute from Ginza Station; 32 seats; daily 11:00–15:30, 17:00–21:00; when busy, orders may close before last order; closed when Ginza Mitsukoshi is; opened September 25, 2018; official site hitsumabushi.co.jp. Shop introduction: the second Tokyo shop of the long-established Nagoya "Bincho"; grilled directly, without steaming. September 2026 reviews: Bincho kaiseki Takumi course (9 dishes) ¥10,950 (crab-miso tofu, bone crackers, grilled liver); generous hitsumabushi, change the flavor with condiments and dashi; hitsumabushi with 0.75 of an eel; dashimaki; Kansai-style grilling; book because there are queues; many foreign customers.

食べログ: 鰻家、うなぎ、大阪市淀川区西中島4-5-22 第3新大阪ビル 1F、.en: Tabelog: Unagiya; unagi; 4-5-22 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, ground floor; 3 minutes on foot from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station; Tue–Fri 11:00–17:00, Sat 11:00–19:00; closed Monday, Sunday and holidays; until sold out; reservations only for Saturday evenings, from 9:30 on the day at the shop; cards accepted; 10 counter seats; non-smoking; no photos for posting; Tabelog Unagi 100 (2018, 2019, 2022, 2024, 2026). Reviews (January 2023 to October 2026): write your name on the list at the shop from 9:30; 10 seats each at 11:00, 12:00, 13:00 and 14:00; a queue from just after 9:00; live eel split, skewered and grilled over charcoal; Kansai style without steaming; crisp skin and soft flesh; unaju regular ¥5,000, jo ¥6,200 (eel omelette, liver soup, pickles), tokujo ¥8,000 (with uzaku and yawata-maki too); unadon; grilled liver ¥550; large rice free; sauce and sansho on the table; eel from Aichi or Tokushima; Yebisu medium bottle ¥680; non-alcoholic beer ¥450.

食べログ: 鰻師玄斎、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-1-14 ZOOMビル 2F、長堀.en: Tabelog: Unagi Shi Gensai, ZOOM Bldg 2F, 2-1-14 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nagahoribashi, 7 from Nippombashi, 10 from Shinsaibashi and Namba; daily 12:00–21:00 (L.O. food 20:00, drinks 20:30); mention allergies in advance; cards (including UnionPay), transit IC, e-money and QR (including Alipay and WeChat Pay) accepted; 8 counter seats; opened 31 August 2026. Reviews (September–October 2026): toro and eel nigiri; hand rolls; live eel filleted in the shop; full from lunch to night; red-vinegar rice; 3-piece sushi; eel rice bowl ¥4,800; shirayaki like potato chips; fresh kimchi; fluffy kabayaki; the rice sauce is separate from the eel sauce; female eels; not steamed, grilled the house way, crisp skin and juicy inside; Kansai style; eel shabu-shabu; phoned 4 days ahead to add sushi; Irish tuna; ¥7,700 course (yuba tofu, 2 pieces eel shabu, 2 crisp shirayaki, 2 kabayaki, bettarazuke, fresh kimchi, unaju with a whole eel, liver soup); fierce heat; premium course ¥9,900; sesame tofu with fresh cream and yuba; 3 kinds of sansho; Yamagata Tsuyahime rice; one found the liver soup a little salty; friendly staff.

食べログ: 鳥しん、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-4-19 玉屋町ギャラクシービル3号.en: Tabelog: Tori Shin, Tamayacho Galaxy Bldg No. 3 1F, 2-4-19 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 7 min walk from Midosuji Line Shinsaibashi and Namba stations, 5 min from Nippombashi Station, 393 m from Nagahoribashi; Mon–Sat and days before and after holidays 18:00–24:00 (from 17:00 for bookings); closed Sundays and holidays; may close when ingredients run out; 2 hour 30 minute limit when busy; online bookings confirmed by phone; 3-item starter ¥660; cards (including UnionPay), QUICPay and QR accepted; 19 seats (counter 7, tables 12); opened 10 October 2007. Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): hot pots full of chicken umami; rice or noodles to finish; reliable yakitori too; the hot-pot soup comes solid and turns rich as it melts; fried gizzards; pleasant service; the popular Hakata mizutaki by reservation; a rich paitan; 5 kinds of sashimi with no off-smell; salt skewers; tsukimi tsukune with egg yolk; yuzu-kosho and ponzu; two people were stuffed; a hideaway at the end of an alley; collagen hot pot; popular and hard to get into; big dishes; tulip; zosui; got a same-day booking; tataki; grilled rice balls; fast service; loud staff.

食べログ: 鳥の木珈琲 (トリノキコーヒー)、カフェ、中京区夷川通東洞院東入る山.en: Tabelog: 鳥の木珈琲 (Torinoki Coffee), café; 中京区夷川通東洞院東入る山中町542 モア御所南 1F; 6 min walk from Marutamachi Stn; Mon, Tue, Fri, Sat, Sun 11:00–17:00, Thu 12:00–17:00 (last order 16:30); from 12:00 the day after a holiday; closed Wednesday and the third Sunday; no bookings; no groups of more than 5; 11 seats (tables 8, counter 3); non-smoking; no cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 26 April 2014; Cafe Tabelog 100 2021 and Cafe WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Mapple: 鳥の木珈琲, 夷川通東洞院東入ル山中町542 モア御所南 1st floor. Reviews (May–September 2026, in English): blend ¥550 (Kenyan base with Guatemala and Mandheling), coffee of the day ¥600, pudding ¥450 (not on its own), shiso soda ¥650, homemade ginger, adult mixed juice, nougat glacé.

食べログ: 鳥よし 銀座店、銀座7-2 銀座コリドー街1F、JR有楽町駅・銀座駅.en: Tabelog: Tori Yoshi Ginza, Ginza 7-2, Ginza Corridor-gai 1F, 4 minutes from JR Yurakucho and Ginza stations; 34 seats (18 counter, 16 table); daily 16:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:20); seat charge ¥1,000; reservations accepted; only the 2F counter (about 15 seats) can be booked out; official site yakitori-toriyoshi.com; Yakitori Top 100 2018, 2019, 2021, 2023, 2024, 2025. 2026 reviews: unlike the Nakameguro main shop, you can book; neck and chōchin; grills thick fried tofu and green peppers well too; some days you get a counter seat without booking; omakase (say stop) and à la carte; chōchin and heart sometimes sold out; some say quality varies by griller; yakitori takes a little time; from snacks and pork skewers to rice dishes.

食べログ: 鳥料理・居酒屋、下京区寺町通高辻下ル京極町497-2、阪急河原町駅か.en: Tabelog: chicken dishes, izakaya; 下京区寺町通高辻下ル京極町497-2; 5 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 18:00–24:00; closed Wednesday (open the day before holidays and on holidays); bookings taken (children's ages too); table charge ¥330 a head (none for elementary age and under); 30 seats (9 counter, 21 table); non-smoking (ashtray outside the entrance); cards, e-money and PayPay; vegetarian options; menu (English version, updated March 2026): charcoal-grilled Kyotanba chicken (thigh ¥630, breast ¥470, harami ¥550, neck ¥550, tender ¥550, skin ¥470, liver ¥520, gizzard ¥630, heart ¥520, tail ¥430, yagen cartilage ¥520), Kyotanba chicken salt hot pot (mizutaki for one) ¥1,880, 10 kushiage ¥1,320. Reviews (January 2025–November 2026, in English): grilling yourself on a shichirin, chicken sashimi platter, chicken tataki yukke, chicken and cream cheese fresh spring rolls, shiso tsukune, takana fried rice, all-you-can-drink course ¥5,500.

食べログ: 鳥料理・焼き鳥、東山区川端通四条上ル東詰、祇園四条駅から122m、1.en: Tabelog: chicken dishes, yakitori; 東山区川端通四条上ル東詰; 122 m from Gion-Shijo Stn; 17:30–22:00, Thursday 18:00–22:00, closed Wednesday; bookings taken (online at Pocket Concierge, 24 hours); 10 counter seats; non-smoking; cards; Chicken Tabelog 100 2025. Review (August 2026, in Japanese): arrived a few minutes early and rested by the Kamo River, and the staff came to call us; seated at the far end of the long counter, by the grill the master holds; appetizer of roughly cut cabbage; sashimi platter, green eggplant, breast tataki, sasami with wasabi, grilled quail thigh, neck, gizzard, sot-l'y-laisse, red liver, tsukune, jidori soup; cold sake 秋鹿, warm sake 春鹿; not served on skewers; the young staff work briskly under the master's direction. Reviews (2025–2026, in English): white liver sashimi, thigh tataki, oyakodon, Aramasa, nearly always full.

食べログ: 鳳凰楼、大阪市中央区千日前1-8-6 シンズ千日前ビル1F、28席、.en: Tabelog: Hooro, Shins Sennichimae Bldg 1F, 1-8-6 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 28 seats; Mon–Sat 17:00–5:00 next morning (L.O. 4:30), Sun and holidays 17:00–3:00 next morning (L.O. 2:30); closed 2nd and 3rd Mondays; reservations by phone; no cards or e-money; QR payment accepted; smoking allowed; genre Chinese, gyoza, knife-cut noodles. Reviews (December 2023 – July 2026): a neighbourhood Chinese diner; gyoza; all-you-can-eat ¥3,500 (December 2023); many Chinese diners; nira and liver set meal; a Chinese-language menu; lots of delivery orders; adjustable heat; a back alley off the Aioibashi-suji shopping street; seafood ramen ¥900 (salt); gomoku noodle soup ¥800; karaage; spare ribs; stir-fried water spinach; large prawns in chili sauce; Japanese hard to get across; mapo tofu set meal (cabbage and zha cai); chili oil and black vinegar.

食べログ: 鴻翔、大阪市中央区島之内1-21-32 田舎ビル1F、堺筋線長堀橋駅.en: Tabelog: Koushou, Inaka Bldg 1F, 1-21-32 Shimanouchi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 30 m east of Sakaisuji Line Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed weekends and holidays; no cards or e-money; 24 seats (counter 4, five tables for 4); smoking allowed (lunch only). Reviews (May 2025 – October 2026): one person working at lunch, so it takes time; Sichuan tantanmen; Sichuan pepper; full at lunch; karaage and mapo tofu set meals in summer; the signature is white-sesame tantanmen; closed weekends; gyoza at night; menma; the mapo tofu is thick and oily, mild in heat and strongly numbing; under ¥1,000; nira; hot inside; bok choy stir-fried with ginger; a friendly owner; previous diners' dishes left on tables; yu lin chicken ¥850, freshly fried; large portions; large rice free; citrus sauce; cash only; Sichuan-style mapo; the soup a little salty.

食べログ: 鶏soba 座銀 本店、大阪市西区江戸堀1-19-2、四つ橋線肥後橋.en: Tabelog: Tori Soba Zagin main shop, 1-19-2 Edobori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Yotsubashi Line Higobashi Station exit 8; daily 10:30–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); welcome even just before closing; closed 30 December – 3 January; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 counter seats; opened 26 May 2014; official silver-grape.com; Tabelog Ramen Hyakumeiten (WEST 2020–2022, OSAKA 2023–2025). Reviews (January–October 2026): a rich dipping soup for the chicken tsukesoba; one says the fried burdock is gone, another that it's there; an 11-visit regular's favourite ramen in Osaka; 2 kinds of chashu; salt tori paitan; one found the shoyu salty and the toppings and service worse than before; one says the bok choy dilutes the rich salt; over ¥1,000; 1 person waiting before 18:00; served in 7–8 minutes; chicken and pork chashu; queues from before noon; ticket machine at the entrance; staff guide the queue; polite language from the kitchen; a frothed creamy soup; the fried burdock goes from crisp to soft as it soaks; chicken salt soba ¥1,000; large +¥150; counter only; collect your bowl from the high counter; thin noodles; frothed just before serving; 2 slices of low-temperature chashu; tori soba shoyu ¥1,000; just-right saltiness.

食べログ: 鶏soba 鶏と麺、大阪市大正区三軒家東1-18-9 2F、大正から.en: Tabelog: Tori Soba Tori to Men, 2F, 1-18-9 Sangenya-higashi, Taisho-ku, Osaka; 193 m from Taisho; daily 11:00–14:00 and 17:00–2:00 next morning; irregular closing days; no cards, e-money or QR; opened 4 August 2023. Reviews (July 2025 – September 2026): special yuzu-salt chicken ramen ¥1,100; tori soba RED ¥950 (extra heat +¥50); chicken maze-soba ¥1,100; mini chashu rice bowl large ¥550; Akaboshi ¥660; maze-soba with lots of garlic; shredded chicken chashu; 6 waiting on the stairs; after a game at Kyocera Dome; the limited tori paitan sold out; tori soba BLACK ¥950 (garlic and black pepper); regular tori soba ¥900; D set with chicken chazuke ¥550; a light, easy soup; chicken bones; yuzu; yellow noodles rich in egg; self-serve water; one likens it to the nabeyaki ramen of Susaki, Kochi; a shoyu of old-hen bones boiled for hours; a tare of Kochi and Osaka shoyu; served piping hot; medium-thin straight noodles; one found the yuzu too strong; white pepper on the table; the tori-paitan versions with yuzu peel, chicken chashu and crunchy chicken; 2nd floor; Korean-style reimen ¥1,000 (kimchi, egg, chashu); cash only.

食べログ: 鶏か鶏以外か、大阪市大正区三軒家東1-17-20 秋月館ビル 1F、.en: Tabelog: Tori ka Tori Igai ka, Akizuki-kan Bldg 1F, 1-17-20 Sangenya-higashi, Taisho-ku, Osaka; 117 m from Taisho; Mon and Thu–Sun 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:45) and 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30), Tue 11:00–15:00; closed Wednesdays; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; 7 counter seats; opened 17 September 2024. Reviews (December 2024 – October 2026): an anniversary ramen each year; mixed rice; two lines, tori paitan and chuka soba; coupons for registering on LINE; salt ramen; 2 kinds of chashu including rare; radish sprouts; a creamy chicken soup; thin noodles; bright and clean; one calls it the first tori paitan in Taisho; summer cold editions (cold sea-bream and hamaguri salt, cold grated-yam shoyu); the cold lunch sold out; spicy tori paitan; frothed tori paitan; rare pork-shoulder chashu and another roast pork; seasoned egg; maze-soba (limited); extra-meat tori paitan ¥1,200; mini rice ¥100; noodle refill ¥150; free takana and spicy mentaiko with rice; grilled pork-belly chashu; one found the refill salty; 6 waiting before 20:00 in August; cold salt ¥1,300 with tempura; cold shoyu with grated yam ¥1,000; cartilage tsukune ¥200; rare chashu rice bowl ¥400 (egg yolk); pork-belly chashu rice bowl ¥450; the shoyu is strongly shoyu; one found the savoury-spicy ramen salty.

食べログ: 鶏と牛のお店 火澄屋、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-4-1 オリエンタル東.en: Tabelog: Tori to Gyu no Omise Kasumiya, Oriental Higashi-Shinsaibashi Bldg 1F (107), 1-4-1 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; a restaurant building right by Nagahoribashi Station exit 7; Mon–Fri 12:00–14:00 and 17:30–24:00, Sat 17:30–24:00; closed Sundays and holidays; may not answer the phone 15:00–18:00; starter ¥500; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; smoking allowed; 20 seats; semi-private rooms; Instagram. Reviews (October 2023 – June 2026): a hidden shop at the back of the building; semi-private rooms with a folk-tale feel; lunch set meals about ¥1,000 (karaage with tartare, karaage and offal, fish set meal with many sides); one says the karaage batter got thinner and better; in March 2025 curry only from ¥600 (free raw egg); chicken and beef tongue with drinks at night; small tables; cigarette smoke.

食べログ: 鶏に恋した日 寺田町店、大阪市生野区生野西2-1-37、JR寺田町駅.en: Tabelog: Tori ni Koishita Hi Teradacho, 2-1-37 Ikuno-nishi, Ikuno-ku, Osaka; 30 seconds from JR Teradacho Station north exit; daily 10:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:45) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:45); irregular closing days; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 26 seats (ground-floor counter 10, tables upstairs); opened 1 April 2023; official site. Reviews (January–September 2026): a tori-paitan specialist; a thick, rich tori paitan (shoyu-based); thin noodles; 4 slices of house rare chashu; special tori-paitan miso ramen ¥1,200 (heat and depth, chewy medium-thick noodles); tori-paitan tsukemen 200 g ¥1,000, 300 g ¥1,100 (thick noodles, big rare chashu, radish sprouts, yuzu); summer cold editions ¥1,000 (light shellfish-dashi cold ramen; refreshing cold ramen of niboshi and kombu with chicken-fat salt; shellfish-dashi cold tsukemen, 20 a day); yuzu-kosho; niboshi vinegar on the table; karaage; fried rice; ticket machine; limited items can be ordered verbally; a new, clean shop; one found portions smallish.

食べログ: 鶏や 梅の湯、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-13-10、心斎橋駅5番出口か.en: Tabelog: Toriya Ume no Yu, 1-13-10 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 5; opposite a primary school's main gate; daily 18:00–23:00 (closes when sold out); irregular closing days (announced on Instagram); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 17 counter seats; 1 November 2006. Reviews (June 2025 – May 2026): formerly a horse-meat restaurant, reopened as a yakitori shop; a public-bath theme; Showa kayokyoku; omakase yakitori set ¥2,800 (starter, 3 small dishes, 4 skewers; book ahead); Ume no Yu course ¥4,500 (8 skewers, a dish, small dish, salad, main, mini curry); 6-skewer platter; Kyoto Akadori thigh, breast, gizzard, neck; bone-in wings with rock salt; tsukune; negima; liver sashimi ¥660; Kyoto Akadori tataki ¥1,100; fried tomato with mascarpone; mozuku; potato salad; Camembert; Tochio aburage with ginger shoyu; plenty of shochu; some skewers sell out, booking recommended.

食べログ: 鶏ガラ醤油らーめん じゅうじせい、大阪市中央区南本町3-3-10、本.en: Tabelog: Torigara Shoyu Ramen Juujisei, 3-3-10 Minamihommachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 292 m from Hommachi Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 19:00–0:30 next morning, Sun 11:30–15:00 and 19:00–24:00; closed Saturdays; listed as no cards, e-money or QR; opened 5 January 2023. Reviews (August–September 2026): cold salt-shoyu ramen with lemon-juice pickles ¥800; thin straight noodles; pickled onion; prosciutto; black pepper; fried rice; white-shoyu tuna-flake ramen ¥1,030; a light shoyu of chicken bones and niboshi with bonito flakes; medium-thin straight noodles; wood-ear; leek; bean sprouts; karaage and half fried rice set ¥600; yuzu ramen; extra meat and seasoned egg; alone at 22:30; counter only; one says cards and phone payment worked at the ticket machine; add bonito flakes partway to change the flavour; not a big portion; deep chicken-bone flavour; balanced shoyu.

食べログ: 鶏ノGAKU、鶏料理・居酒屋・鍋、大阪市淀川区西中島3-22-20、.en: Tabelog: Tori no GAKU, chicken dishes, izakaya and hot pot, 3-22-20 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 3 min from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station (Midosuji Line); Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:00), closed Sat, Sun and holidays; occasional temporary closures; reservations accepted; cards, transport IC cards and PayPay accepted, Apple Pay and ICOCA too; 18 seats, counter and sofas; private hire available; heated tobacco only, no paper cigarettes; opened 14 October 2021. The shop's introduction: sister shop of 華Sansyou学, a Chinese restaurant known for Sichuan mapo tofu; fresh chicken with no gamey taste; breast tataki, chicken "Gyoopsal", charcoal-grilled dishes, creative chicken dishes, yakitori; Tajima chicken; an 8-dish course with all-you-can-drink ¥5,000; a 7-dish chicken shabu-shabu hot-pot course ¥6,000 (180 minutes). Reviews (July 2024 to September 2026): Sichuan mapo tofu ¥1,210, domestic chicken kara-age ¥638, thigh tataki with green onion and salt ¥1,078, charcoal-grilled thigh with yuzu kosho ¥1,408, breast tataki with ume and shiso ¥858, chicken sobameshi ¥1,100, French fries ¥528; almost full at 18:00 on a weekday; about 14 lunch sets from ¥1,100; free refills of rice and egg soup; chicken nanban with shiba-zuke tartar, kara-age with grated daikon and ponzu, fried horse mackerel, kimeji tuna sashimi set ¥1,300; a curry-flavoured mapo tofu too.

食べログ: 鶏白湯 大翔軒、大阪市中央区難波4-5-7、070-1736-143.en: Tabelog: Tori Paitan Daishoken, 4-5-7 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 070-1736-1434; no reservations; Tue–Sun 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–2:00 next morning; closed Mondays; no cards, e-money or QR; opened 1 April 2026. 2026 reviews (September–October): a street stall in a car park in Ura-Namba; tables and chairs in front of a kitchen car; at the back of a car park under the elevated tracks; garlic shoyu tori paitan ¥1,200; extra chashu ¥500; maze-soba ¥1,200; seared chashu rice bowl ¥1,200; shoyu tori paitan ¥1,200; rich shoyu tori paitan (thick and smooth, with a clean finish); medium-thick wavy noodles; kimchi, chopped onion, vinegar and sesame on the table; a soup of hamaguri broth; shoyu tori paitan A set ¥1,350; shellfish-broth tori paitan ¥1,200; sweetish rare chashu; leek; mizuna; many regulars; open until 2 a.m.

食べログ: 鶏白湯らーめん 自由が丘蔭山 あべのＱ'sモール店、大阪市阿倍野区阿.en: Tabelog: Tori Paitan Ramen Jiyugaoka Kageyama Abeno Q's Mall, Abeno Q's Mall 4F, 1-6-1 Abenosuji, Abeno-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Tennoji Station exit 12; daily 11:00–23:00; closing days follow Q's Mall; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 27 seats; opened 18 May 2017; official site. Reviews (October 2025 – October 2026): tori-paitan salt soba; rich and creamy yet light; chicken aroma; medium-thick noodles; squeeze lemon halfway; yuzu at the bottom; rice into the soup to finish; the special adds vegetables, wontons, soft-boiled egg, chicken chashu, chili, greens and onion chips; lunch set until 17:00 (half ramen with Sichuan-style mapo tofu or yu lin chicken); good-value evening set (mapo rice bowl); two found the mapo tofu salty; one found it underwhelming overall; queues at holiday lunch; families and large groups too.

食べログ: 鶏白湯らーめん 麺はともあれ、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-7-11 日宝.en: Tabelog: Tori Paitan Ramen Men wa Tomoare, Nippo Royal Bldg, 2-7-11 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-4708-8884; 9 seats; Mon–Fri 16:00–2:30 next morning, Sat 11:00–2:30 next morning, Sun 11:00–23:00; irregular closing days; no smoking; cards and e-money accepted; opened 22 December 2022. Shop introduction: an espuma-style soup and medium-thin flat noodles, several kinds of tori-paitan ramen, rice dishes, snacks. 2026 reviews: two groups waiting even at 10 p.m.; book at the machine in front; one says it lacks character; queued Saturday 16:45, seated 19:10; order first by QR code; 5 counter seats and one table; slow turnover; a faint smell when served; chewy flat noodles; cash only (June 2026); mentaiko tori paitan; a foamy mousse-like soup; pork chashu and soft-boiled egg; no sign on the street; ground floor of a multi-tenant building; Instagram @men_wa_tomoare; special tori-paitan ramen ¥1,705 (seasoned egg, chicken chashu, pork chashu, red onion, wood-ear); chicken umami lifted by shoyu; seasoned-egg rice.

食べログ: 鶏白湯ラーメン 鳥ぶし、上野6-1-6 御徒町グリーンハイツ 1F、.en: Tabelog: Toripaitan Ramen Toribushi, Ueno 6-1-6, Okachimachi Green Heights 1F; 86 m from Naka-Okachimachi Station; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; counter seats; non-smoking; English menu; opened 28 November 2022 (no hours listed). san-tatsu (1 November 2023): concept 'chicken paitan ramen for halal diners' — halal chicken-paitan ramen that Muslims can eat; a spicy red chicken ramen with chilli oil and doubanjiang; coriander can be swapped for green onion; chicken-dashi rice cooked with the chicken chashu; chicken gyoza; karaage; hours 11:00–21:30 L.O.; no fixed closing day; address Okachimachi Green Heights 106; 4 min on foot from JR Okachimachi. Reviews (February–October 2026): toripaitan ramen ¥1,080 (¥980 in February); seasoned egg ¥1,280; chashu or coriander ¥1,480; the ticket machine takes cash only, QR payment at the back; strollers welcome and a children's menu; some describe it as halal-certified; in September–October 2026 some found the flavour weak.

食べログ: 鶏魚酒場 炭治郎、居酒屋・焼き鳥・鳥料理、大阪市淀川区東三国2-37.en: Tabelog: Toriuo Sakaba Sumijiro; izakaya, yakitori, chicken dishes; 2-37-14 Higashimikuni, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; 1 minute on foot from exit 1 of Higashi-Mikuni Station on the Midosuji Line, next to Japan; Mon–Sat 11:30–13:30 and 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Sunday and 31 December–5 January; reservations accepted (cancel by the day before); cards accepted; no e-money or QR; 26 seats; private hire for 20–50; non-smoking; children welcome; opened 21 October 2015. Reviews (July 2024 to October 2026): all lunches under ¥1,000; chicken nanban set ¥850–900; Yamitsuki kara-age set ¥850–900; tsukimi tsukune set ¥900; shrimp tempura bowl ¥800; ¥50 less or more for small or large rice; in the evening, flounder, kanpachi and conger eel sashimi; jidori and Tanba chicken grilled over charcoal; chicken neck grilled with yuzu kosho ¥638; sasami tempura; yagen cartilage; fried oysters; grilled edamame; dashimaki; winter hot pot; shrimp mayo; garlic butter fries; course with all-you-can-drink ¥4,400; sake, shochu and awamori; at lunch the owner sometimes runs it alone.

食べログ: 鹿肉料理専門店 バトックス、大阪市中央区千日前1-4-19 中島ビル.en: Tabelog: Buttocks venison specialist, Nakajima Bldg 1F, 1-4-19 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Aioibashi-suji shopping street; 5 min walk from Namba Station; Mon–Sat and holidays 11:00–14:00 and 18:00–4:00 next morning, Sun 18:00–4:00 next morning (L.O. food 3:00, drinks 4:00); open every day of the year; starter/service charge ¥500 at dinner; 20 seats; private room upstairs for groups from 5; children welcome; cards, e-money and QR accepted; separate smoking. Reviews (November 2025 – October 2026): a venison specialist; several say no gamey smell and tender; venison lunch course ¥2,500 (venison cutlet, low-temperature roast, venison fried rice); venison bread (garlic toast with roast venison); venison rillettes; rillettes potato salad; carpaccio; roast eaten with salt, fried onion and sauce; pleat-less fried venison gyoza; venison maze-soba with choice of heat; carbonara; venison yaki-shabu course of 7 dishes by reservation ¥7,500; one says the cuts weren't explained; one says the wine was poured generously.

食べログ: 麓鳴館、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-3-12、心斎橋から206m、毎日1.en: Tabelog: Rokumeikan, 1-3-12 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 206 m from Shinsaibashi; daily 14:00–19:00 (subject to change); no cards, e-money or QR; 19 seats. Reviews (November 2025 – September 2026): a nostalgic kissaten down an alley off Shinsaibashisuji; a calm, old-fashioned interior; big speakers beside the counter; cute cups; carefully brewed coffee; Rokumeikan curry ¥1,200 (European-style, tangy with faint heat, a whole potato, soft-boiled egg, sausage, knife, fork and spoon); one found the potato cold inside; over ¥1,800 with coffee; booth seats are largely self-service; one says it was a bar from 21:00 in November 2025; given two pages in a book on Osaka kissaten.

食べログ: 麩房老舗、その他、中京区錦小路通麩屋町東入る鍛冶屋町211、毎日 9.en: Tabelog: Fufu Roho, other; 鍛冶屋町211, east of Fuyacho on Nishikikoji-dori, Nakagyo-ku; every day 9:00–18:00; no reservations; 2 seats; non-smoking; no cards, e-money or QR. Reviews (April 2023–March 2026, in English): a Kyoto nama-fu specialist, nearly 200 years old (Tenpō era); Kyoto nama-fu dengaku ¥756 (December 2024); homemade dengaku miso cooked for 8 hours; 100 servings only on Saturdays and Sundays (April 2023); set of five fried nama-fu ¥648 (millet, sesame, mugwort, plain); mugwort fu ¥432; half sizes available; about one month's shelf life; kuruma-fu.

食べログ: 麺LABO 唯奏、大阪市西区江之子島1-6-2、阿波座から220m、.en: Tabelog: Men LABO Yuisou, 1-6-2 Enokojima, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 220 m from Awaza; daily 11:00–14:30 and 17:00–21:30 (L.O. 20:30); irregular closing days; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 1 September 2022. Reviews (August–October 2026): mobile ordering; egg-on maze-soba ¥800; 2 egg yolks; a rich sauce heavy on seafood; flat medium-thick noodles; boiled firm; self-serve water; limited cold sea bream; north of Nishi Post Office; an udon shop nearby; a small, clean shop; order and pay by QR; rich chicken-pork ramen ¥950; thin or medium-thick wavy noodles; a clear, smooth soup that isn't greasy; thin-sliced pork; ¥1,150 with leek rice; log in with Apple or LINE; cash also OK; past limited editions (chicken salt, cold sea-bream salt soba, sea-bream dashi salt and shoyu, cold kombu water, noodles with Matsusaka beef fat); light chicken ramen ¥900; plenty of thin-sliced chashu; the pork comes through in the chashu, the soup is mainly chicken; straight or hand-rubbed noodles; rich tsukemen with seasoned egg; hand-rubbed noodles.

食べログ: 麺joyLife、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-7-22 日宝シルキータワ.en: Tabelog: Men joyLife, Nippo Silky Tower 1F No. 6, 2-7-22 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 10 seats; daily 20:00–8:00 next morning; open every day of the year (long holidays announced on social media); no smoking; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; opened 24 March 2023; TikTok @men_joylife. Shop introduction: carefully made soup and house-made noodles; limited-edition ramen. 2024–2026 reviews: counter only; dark shoyu (chicken bones and bonito flakes, thin straight noodles, chicken fat); cold shellfish broth (clams, oysters, hamaguri; flat medium-thin noodles); Japanese-style maze-soba (oil of clams, oysters and shijimi); shellfish-broth ramen from ¥1,000; seared rare chashu rice bowl ¥400; ticket machine inside on the left; chicken bones with clams, shijimi and oysters; gentle flavour; house-made medium-thin straight noodles; rare shoulder-loin chashu; mizuna; menma; new onion; shredded white leek; mayo chashu rice bowl; special shellfish broth ¥1,300 (whole-wheat noodles, pork-belly chashu, soft-boiled egg, red onion); next to a club; one would not recommend the sudachi rice; shoyu and dark shoyu too.

食べログ: 麺つるり、うどん、大阪市淀川区西中島5-16-1、JR 新大阪駅の東.en: Tabelog: Men Tsururi, udon, 5-16-1 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka; outside the east gate of JR Shin-Osaka Station; daily 7:00–22:00; no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; non-smoking; children welcome; opened 16 March 2021; site shinosaka.ekimaru.com. Reviews (September–October 2026): a food court outside the gates; Himi udon, thin, flat and hand-stretched, smooth with a little firmness; chiku-tama tempura udon (hot or cold); chiku-tama tempura bukkake ¥1,050; the cold broth is ago (flying-fish) dashi; kake udon and takikomi rice set ¥920; kakiage zaru udon ¥940; "Gotsu" kakiage bukkake with a huge kakiage; breakfast set ¥650 (udon with egg on rice with bonito, or takana mentaiko); burdock rice sets; a buzzer calls you; ready in 7–8 minutes; busy at peak times.

食べログ: 麺とかき氷 ドギャン 谷四店、大阪市中央区谷町4-9-11、谷町四丁.en: Tabelog: Men to Kakigori Dogyan Taniyon, 4-9-11 Tanimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min south of Tanimachi-Yonchome Station exit 8; on the corner of the Tanimachi 5 crossing; Mon, Thu and Fri 11:30–16:00 and 18:00–21:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–20:00; closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays; temporary closures on Instagram; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 18 seats. Reviews (July 2025 – October 2026): a shop decorated with anime-film merchandise; seasonal cold ramen (blue-soup Yozora no Mukou gawa ¥1,200; cold corn ramen of corn and fresh cream on a salt-and-scallop base ¥1,650; white and black figs with cheese sauce; karaage); maze-soba with mayonnaise, chili oil and kombu vinegar to change the flavour; offal maze-soba; kakigori loaded with seasonal fruit (peach, fig, chestnut Mont Blanc piped in front of you, açaí); character kakigori; QR ordering; one item per person; book via Instagram; one says the combinations divide opinion.

食べログ: 麺と旨みの神隠し、大阪市中央区難波1-8-16 ナンバヒップス B1.en: Tabelog: Men to Umami no Kamikakushi, Namba Hips B1F, 1-8-16 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; no reservations; listed as no cards, e-money or QR payment; no smoking; opened 28 December 2024. 2026 reviews: fully cashless (card and PayPay only; some couldn't pay in cash); handy when changing between OCAT and Nankai; tonkotsu ramen with tender chashu; a stylish counter; umami miso tonkotsu ¥1,550 (tang of pickled onion); back-fat shoyu ¥1,350 (black pepper, lighter than it looks); softish noodles divide opinion; large +¥150; tsukimi chashu rice bowl with special sauce ¥500; tastes like oden with daikon and konnyaku; drinks are alcohol only; in front of a pachinko parlour; one person working alone, called curt by some and kind by others; no toilet nearby; a counter along the corridor; one big slice of chashu; thin noodles; menma, pork, leek.

食べログ: 麺と無限の可能性 日本橋本店、大阪市中央区日本橋1-9-13 アメニ.en: Tabelog: Men to Mugen no Kanosei Nippombashi main shop, Amenity Bldg 1F, 1-9-13 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Nippombashi Station exit 7; Mon–Thu 11:00–24:00, Fri–Sun 11:00–1:00 next morning (L.O. 23:30), some days until 5 a.m. (announced on Instagram); temporary closures for typhoons; irregular closing days; no reservations; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 26 seats; no smoking (smoking area outside); opened 10 April 2023. Reviews (November 2025 – September 2026): maze-soba of flat noodles with oil and sweet shoyu; the cheese ramen 'Chicken Fromage' ordered verbally; about a 15-minute wait; a pasta-like hybrid flavour; maze-soba ¥1,320 (extra-thick noodles, egg yolk, onion chips, leek, onion, lots of chashu); junky; black-sesame cold tantanmen; yakitori too; many overseas diners and plenty of non-ramen dishes; slow service at lunch; one likens the noodles to udon; the chicken tantanmen is mild and adjustable; open late; tori-paitan ramen with thin noodles, mild; karaage set meal.

食べログ: 麺と肉 だいつる 鶴橋店、大阪市天王寺区舟橋町18-3、鶴橋駅から徒.en: Tabelog: Men to Niku Daitsuru Tsuruhashi, 18-3 Funahashicho, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Tsuruhashi Station; daily 11:00–22:00; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 counter seats; opened 12 September 2016. Reviews (January 2025 – October 2026): shoyu niku soba; Korean chili; standard heat 2, 0 available; sesame-oil aroma; medium-thick to thick straight noodles; ¥1,480 with melting cartilage-chashu topping; spicy offal maze-soba (heat 3) ¥1,480 (beef offal, kimchi, vegetables); a free raw egg or large size for following on social media; spicy gochujang offal ramen with flat noodles; pork belly; karaage; extra leek; large rice ¥100 to finish; garlic and ginger on the table; write your name and wait in the queue; one says it was chosen among Osaka's popular ramen shops of 2025.

食べログ: 麺に光を 別邸、大阪市浪速区難波中1-18-8 なんばカルチャービル.en: Tabelog: Men ni Hikari wo Bettei, Namba Culture Bldg 1F, 1-18-8 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; no reservations; Mon, Tue and Fri–Sun 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–20:30; closed Wednesdays and Thursdays (open on holidays); no cards, e-money or QR; 12 seats (counter 8, two tables for 2); opened 22 July 2021. 2026 reviews (September–October): 2 min walk from Nankai Namba Station; a modern Japanese interior like a kaiseki restaurant; a wait outside even after 13:00 on a weekday; the signature 'Kai no Hikari' with seasoned egg ¥1,440 (soup of Hiroshima oysters, hamaguri and dried goods; light yet rich; piping hot; yuzu aroma); special Sansho no Hikari (salt) ¥1,670 (faint sansho and shellfish); first in line before opening, a queue of 20 at opening; the shoyu ramen is clean; good noodles; beautiful arrangement of chashu and citrus; Kai no Hikari ¥1,290 (medium-thick straight noodles from Hinomoto Seimen, menma, chashu, yuzu, ikura); special shoyu ¥1,570 (clear deep amber; several kinds of chashu, seasoned egg, chopped onion, mitsuba).

食べログ: 麺に光を、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-17-8 レバンガ心斎橋ビルB1F.en: Tabelog: Men ni Hikari wo, Levanga Shinsaibashi Bldg B1F, 2-17-8 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6214-5551; no reservations; Mon, Tue and Fri–Sun 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–20:30; closed Wednesdays and Thursdays; no cards, e-money or QR; 6 seats (counter); opened 23 November 2019. 2026 reviews (September–October): a queue before opening on a Sunday; Punk (duck and hamaguri broth) ¥1,250; butter on the hamaguri; smooth flat noodles; the hamaguri, not the shoyu, is the star; limited cold R&B ¥1,200 (ticket machine; long menma, 2 slices rare chashu, leek, radish sprouts, chopped onion, fried onion, medium-thick flat noodles); the clear duck ramen (Hip Hop) has duck and pork chashu and, despite the name, is light; good seasoned egg.

食べログ: 麺のカミの、大阪市浪速区恵美須西2-1-11、恵美須町駅から286m.en: Tabelog: Men no Kamino, 2-1-11 Ebisu-nishi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 286 m from Ebisucho Station; Tue–Fri 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–22:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–21:00; closed Mondays; no cards, e-money or QR; 10 counter seats; no smoking; opened 15 November 2021. Reviews (August–October 2026): includes mitsuba; the shoyu ramen is easy to eat; thinnish meat; a strong soup that suits the noodles; courteous service; special shoyu ramen large; limited meat-and-egg rice bowl; free noodle refill on rainy days; seafood dashi with chicken fat and chicken-bone depth; slightly chewy noodles; special shoyu ramen ¥750; thin but springy noodles; a walk to Tennoji Zoo; morning ramen salt ¥500; a clear soup with deep dashi; good for a hangover; shoyu ramen ¥750 and chashu rice bowl ¥300; no toppings in the morning, ¥500; one says it wasn't open at night.

食べログ: 麺ふたり、大阪市中央区上本町西5-2-18、大阪上本町駅・谷町九丁目.en: Tabelog: Men Futari, 5-2-18 Uehommachi-nishi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Osaka-Uehommachi Station and Tanimachi-Kyuchome Station exit 7; Mon and Wed–Sun 11:00–14:30 and 18:00–21:30; closed Tuesdays and other days announced on social media; no cards, e-money or QR; 14 seats (counter 8, tables for 2 and 4); no smoking; opened 22 September 2025. October 2026 reviews: salt tsukemen large ¥1,450; firm, slippery flat medium-thick straight noodles; a dipping soup of clear chicken broth, seafood and domestic hamaguri; 2 moist slices of chashu; menu: niboshi salt, niboshi shoyu, sea-bream and hamaguri salt, limited salt tsukemen; no table condiments; pay at the till by the entrance after eating; 8 counter seats and tables; the owner and one staff member; one says bronze at the Ramen Walker Grand Prix Kansai 2026; niboshi shoyu ¥1,200; medium-thin straight noodles; a clear niboshi-and-chicken shoyu; faint tang; rare chashu; slender menma; onion; niboshi salt; sea-bream rice (sesame); sea-bream and hamaguri salt ¥1,450; salt tsukemen ¥1,350; self-serve water; one found service slow and the noodles stuck together; white leek; nori; sake; house-made flat noodles of Haruyutaka wheat; start with salt.

食べログ: 麺や 人類乃宝舟、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-10-33、毎日11:00.en: Tabelog: Menya Jinrui no Takarabune, 2-10-33 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 11:00–23:00; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; opened 17 October 2025. 2026 reviews (June–August): tastes like it belongs to the Minamen family; Daikokuten; sansho oil; maze-soba; seasoned egg; even the large size is easy; aprons provided; free large noodles and rice at weekday lunch; Benzaiten (shellfish-broth ramen); salt and umami arrive all at once; whole-wheat medium-thick wavy noodles; change the flavour with black pepper; bonito flakes on the maze-soba; produced by UNCHI of Jinrui Mina Menrui; Amemura; open until 23:00; curry ramen recommended; fragrant green-sansho ramen ¥1,200; an over-large sheet of nori; curt service; limited cold bowl ¥1,280 (10 a day; Japanese dashi, ume and pickled turnip, shiso, grated yam); thick noodles; mentaiko rice bowl; prices on the high side.

食べログ: 麺や 信、大阪市中央区北浜3-2-25 京阪淀屋橋ビル B1F、淀屋.en: Tabelog: Menya Shin, Keihan Yodoyabashi Bldg B1F, 3-2-25 Kitahama, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Yodoyabashi and Kitahama stations; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–21:00, Sat 11:00–15:00; closed Sundays and holidays; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 8 counter seats; opened 10 May 2023. Reviews (September–October 2026): a double soup of seafood and tori paitan, slightly thick; rich but easy to drink; thin low-hydration noodles from Kyoto's Menya Teigaku; just-right firmness; pork-belly chashu; menma; leek; onion; ramen ¥850; chashu ramen ¥1,000 (3 thick slices, ¥1,150 with seasoned egg); Dive Rice, kimchi-topped rice put into the soup; chashu rice bowl ¥300; rice ¥200, ¥100 at lunch; pay first; a calm Japanese atmosphere; reachable from Yodoyabashi and Kitahama stations without getting wet in the rain; a new format from the Shinsaibashi izakaya Yawaragi; bowls with sculpted rims.

食べログ: 麺や 修、大阪市天王寺区東高津町11-7、大阪上本町から334m、月.en: Tabelog: Menya Shu, 11-7 Higashi-Kozucho, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 334 m from Osaka-Uehommachi; Mon, Tue, Thu and Fri 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–20:00, Wed and Sat 11:00–14:00; closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; opened 15 December 2020. Reviews (September 2024 – October 2026): fill in the order sheet on the table; pay afterwards, cash only; about 8 counter seats; summer-only cold sea-bream salt ramen ¥850 (chicken breast, soft-boiled egg, menma, naruto, radish sprouts, yuzu salt); thin straight noodles; fast service; the rich tori-paitan ramen (strength 8) is thick and rich; tender chashu; long menma; red onion; fried leek; bonito flakes; the flavour-changing spicy miso is very hot; rice ¥100; an even richer tori paitan too; cold sea-bream soba ¥1,100 (2024, 10 a day) with grilled sea bream; one says lumps of salt made it salty; warm maze-soba ¥850; counter only and clean; a friendly owner; rich but not cloying; tori paitan ¥850 and seasoned egg ¥150; thin noodles from Menya Teikaku; chuka soba; run single-handed.

食べログ: 麺や 夢中、大阪市中央区内本町2-3-8 ダイアパレス本町ビル B1.en: Tabelog: Menya Muchu, Dia Palace Hommachi Bldg B1F, 2-3-8 Uchihommachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 474 m from Tanimachi-Yonchome; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–23:00; closed Sundays and holidays; closes if no diners by 22:00; reservations accepted; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), transit IC, iD, QUICPay, PayPay, d-barai and au PAY accepted; opened 15 March 2021. Reviews (December 2022 – June 2026): lunch is ramen and rice (choose mentaiko rice, diced-chashu rice or white rice) for ¥800; tonkotsu; butter; garlic; spicy; tonkotsu shoyu; choose noodle firmness; thin noodles; sliced garlic; tantanmen; tonkotsu ramen ¥700; order verbally; milky-white soup; 3 slices grilled chashu; leek; bean sprouts; light and creamy; plenty of thin straight noodles; noodle refill ¥100; no porky smell; Hakata style; explains carefully to overseas diners; refills come fast; rice sold out; tomato ramen (about 8 halved tomatoes); run single-handed; Kyushu-style thin noodles; 2 tables and about 7 counter seats; one wanted a bit more substance.

食べログ: 麺や 恵、大阪市中央区鎗屋町1-4-4、谷町四丁目から191m、月〜.en: Tabelog: Menya Kei, 1-4-4 Yariyamachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 191 m from Tanimachi-Yonchome; Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 and evenings from 17:30 or 18:00 to 22:30 (L.O.), Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 with evenings depending on the soup; cards AMEX; QR accepted; 7 counter seats and 2nd-floor seats; opened 16 June 2018. Reviews (December 2022 – May 2026): tsukemen; seafood tonkotsu; abura soba ¥890; a rich sauce and smooth noodles; melting chashu; ramen ¥900 and A set ¥150 (2 karaage and rice); a chicken-and-pork-bone paitan; bonito flakes on the tsukemen; short medium-thin noodles; thin pork-belly chashu; one found the menma bland with an odd smell; busy after 12:00, sent upstairs; abura soba regular and Japanese-style; shoyu and shrimp oil, light; thick glossy noodles; ¥1,070 with karaage and rice; a simple tsukemen; tsukemen ¥980; chewy medium-thick noodles; dipping soup of chicken, pork bones and seafood; plenty of oil on top; a faint tang; house-made tsukemen.

食べログ: 麺や 煌、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-6-30 日宝清水街ビル1F、06.en: Tabelog: Menya Kou, Nippo Shimizugai Bldg 1F, 1-6-30 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6244-5788; no reservations; Mon and Wed–Sun 11:30–14:30 and 17:30–22:30; closed Tuesdays; some days no evening service; no cards or e-money; 8 seats (L-shaped counter); opened 1 October 2021. Reviews (November 2025 – June 2026): special salt ramen ¥1,300 (3 kinds of chashu, shiso wontons, sake-scented seasoned egg, fried enoki, a sweet clean salt, thin straight noodles); special shoyu (sharpness and depth in balance, careful dashi); salt niboshi seasoned-egg ramen ¥1,050 and rice ¥150 (firm thin straight noodles, clear seafood salt, pork-loin and chicken-breast chashu); no table condiments; pay at your seat; the owner runs it single-handed; ramen at lunch, Chinese dishes and ramen at night (the owner); at the back of the building on the left, look for the Chuka Bar Sakurai lantern; shoyu is the most popular; special shoyu ¥1,350; shoyu ramen ¥900; a clear golden salt soup (rare pork chashu, chicken chashu, leek, shiso, menma); sign: 'a supreme bowl, made with care'.

食べログ: 麺や 誠風軒、大阪市西区靱本町3-10-21、阿波座駅から徒歩2分、.en: Tabelog: Menya Seifuuken, 3-10-21 Utsubo-hommachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Awaza Station; Mon–Sat 10:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30), Sun 10:00–15:00; closed holidays; from 8:00 Fri–Sun; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 seats; opened 20 April 2026. Reviews (September–October 2026): Moto-Aji chuka men; Shin-Aji shrimp-flake chuka men ¥1,000; a salt base with aroma oil of house shrimp flakes, squid and chicken flakes; red shrimp oil; chashu; white and green leek; flat wavy noodles; mala takuan; niboshi vinegar; Shin-Aji Uo-bushi chuka men; shrimp-salt abura soba; a gentle sweetish shoyu; whole-wheat wavy noodles; shichimi; a clean, calm new shop; service vouchers; special shrimp-salt maze-soba ¥1,300; the Uo-bushi chuka men smells of niboshi oil; seasoned-egg shrimp-salt abura soba; a cash-only ticket machine and change machine; water and paper aprons self-serve; morning ramen too; limited shrimp-curry maze-soba with diced rare chashu; one calls it 'the next brand after Kasumi'.

食べログ: 麺や 轍 木屋町店、ラーメン、中京区鍋屋町209、祇園四条駅から22.en: Tabelog: 麺や 轍 木屋町店, ramen; 中京区鍋屋町209; 226 m from Gion-Shijo Station; no hours listed; no reservations; 11 seats (7 counter, 2 table); no cards, e-money or QR payments; opened 1 May 2023. Reviews (2025–2026, in English): open from late night into the morning; back-fat soy sauce ramen ¥950–960; lemon salt ramen ¥900; curry mazesoba; mini kara-age rice bowl; fried rice ¥500; cash only; a shop in Kokura.

食べログ: 麺や 醤すけ 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-6-23 清水町会館.en: Tabelog: Menya Hishosuke Shinsaibashi, Shimizumachi Kaikan 1F, 1-6-23 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6125-5351; no reservations; daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–5:00 next morning; listed as no cards, e-money or QR; a service charge may apply; 26 seats; no smoking; sofa seats and standing drinking; opened 18 October 2025. 2026 reviews (August–October): lively even at 1 a.m.; ordering by smartphone QR; chashu rice bowl and gyoza; shoyu ramen ¥900 (looks strong but is delicate; chicken umami with seafood; medium-thin straight noodles); seasoned egg; the maze-soba is junky and tasty; salt niboshi ramen ¥900 and Suntory draught beer ¥650 (clear soup with chashu, leek, menma, naruto); moved a short way; special shoyu ramen ¥1,400 (Hokkaido-wheat noodles, wontons, seasoned egg, enoki); return dishes to the counter.

食べログ: 麺やkotetsu 難波、大阪市中央区千日前1-9-9、8席(カウン.en: Tabelog: Menya kotetsu Namba, 1-9-9 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 8 seats (counter); Mon and Wed–Sun and holidays 17:00–2:00 next morning; closed Tuesdays; no smoking; cards and e-money accepted. 2026 reviews (August–September): special chicken-salt ramen ¥1,550 (smooth thin straight noodles, thick sweet menma, shoyu-scented seasoned egg, thick tender chashu, leek and white leek); 2 gyoza ¥350 (big and juicy); shoyu ramen ¥950 (slightly thick straight noodles, chicken and niboshi); a clear golden soup; originally a gyoza specialist; a red lantern and yellow noren; an extra-hot challenge ramen; special tantanmen ¥1,650 (heavy on sesame); hurried to order; change in ¥50 coins.

食べログ: 麺乃家、大阪市中央区上本町西5-1-6 寛永ビル1F、大阪上本町駅8.en: Tabelog: Men no Ya, Kanei Bldg 1F, 5-1-6 Uehommachi-nishi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk north from Osaka-Uehommachi Station exit 8; Mon and Wed–Sun 11:30–14:30 and 18:00–21:30; closed Tuesdays; PayPay and au PAY accepted, no cards or e-money; 13 seats (counter 9, tables 4); no smoking; Facebook page. Reviews (July–October 2026): chicken-salt ramen with Banshu Hyakunichi-dori (limited); thin straight noodles; chicken ham; shoulder-loin chashu; tomato; dried wakame; sudachi; 1.5 portions of noodles; soup over rice; curry tsukemen; shortish noodles; the summer-to-autumn menu; salt mazemen and rich salt ramen; rice to finish; grown-up aemen; change the flavour with ginger and Sichuan-pepper oil; meal tickets; courteous service; family queues from right after opening on Sunday; Men no Ya ramen original ¥1,050, a light shoyu; full-belly set +¥480 for gyoza, karaage and rice; noodle refill ¥180; spinach; a gentle bowl; opened 2002, house-made noodles since 2006; ticket machine to the right of the entrance; summer-only cold chicken-salt ramen with tomato and sudachi (large) ¥1,500; small, medium and large the same price; Hida tomatoes; Tokushima sudachi; wakame aged 8 years from Kumihama, Kyotango; cold grown-up aemen ¥1,500; seasoned egg ¥150; shiso and myoga; Senshu water aubergine; Sichuan-pepper oil; soup-wari; cold chicken salt with sansho oil.

食べログ: 麺人、大阪市西区南堀江3-9-21、桜川駅・西長堀駅から5分、火〜土.en: Tabelog: Men Chu, 3-9-21 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min from Sakuragawa and Nishi-Nagahori stations; Tue–Sat 11:30–14:45 and 17:30–23:50, Sun 11:30–14:45 and 17:30–22:45; closed Mondays; no cards; smoking allowed; 14 seats (counter 6, two tables for 4). Reviews (October 2025 – September 2026): an old-style light chicken shoyu ramen; Horie ramen ¥930 (large +¥150); chicken shoyu ramen ¥770 (chashu, menma, bean sprouts, white leek); small fried rice ¥420; white-leek topping; the ticket machine takes ¥1,000 notes; medium-thin straight noodles; the tare at the bottom makes it stronger later; chashu and menma praised; some found the soup underwhelming; warm service.

食べログ: 麺処 HACK、大阪市西区九条1-13-22 JJCourt九条 1.en: Tabelog: Mendokoro HACK, JJCourt Kujo 1F, 1-13-22 Kujo, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 131 m from Kujo Station; Mon–Wed, Fri–Sun and holidays 11:00–22:30 (Instagram announced a change to all-day service); closed Thursdays; no cards, e-money or QR; opened 1 April 2025 (shop info not verified by the shop). Reviews (March–October 2026): opened in Namba, Naniwa-ku, on 12 December 2022 and moved to Kujo on 1 April 2025; a second shop, mendokoro HACK Nakazaki, in March 2026; the most popular chuka soba has kombu and shellfish dashi; wheat aroma; 2 kinds of chashu and grilled pork belly; salt soba; a paitan (white tonkotsu) soba that changes every 3 months; autumn salmon and miso paitan soba ¥1,180 (frothy miso white tonkotsu, loose wavy noodles, grilled salmon, chashu, stir-fried onion, cabbage and shimeji, bean sprouts, kinome, fried onion, shichimi); summer Sichuan Chengdu tantan paitan; spring firefly squid and sakura shrimp paitan with smoked soft-boiled egg; summer cold tantanmen (rare chashu, chicken breast, lemon, cream cheese, chicken soboro); burnt-shoyu fried rice with extra butter or large; set ¥1,580; gyoza; ticket machine at the entrance; cash only; a counter facing the kitchen; courteous service; a 'NO NOODLE, NO LIFE' sticker from the owner; one says some may find the fried rice a little salty.

食べログ: 麺処 全て、大阪市生野区桃谷2-17-12、桃谷から527m、月・火.en: Tabelog: Mendokoro Subete, 2-17-12 Momodani, Ikuno-ku, Osaka; 527 m from Momodani; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 10:00–16:00 (closes when sold out); closed Wednesdays; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; opened 11 January 2025. Reviews (March 2025 – October 2026): opposite Koreatown; lunch only; on holidays a queue of about 20 before opening, a 40-minute wait; rich chicken soba ¥1,050 (large ¥1,150–1,250; thick enough to stand a spoon; a sharp dark shoyu; medium-thick noodles; rare pork shoulder-loin and pork-belly or leg chashu; diced menma; leek; chopped onion and green pepper); chopped Aomori garlic; rich tsukemen (large ¥1,400; an oily chicken, shoyu and seafood dipping soup; thick flat noodles in kombu water; fish-flake powder on the side; chashu served separately); limited grilled-sanma soba (Hokkaido sanma and tori paitan, sudachi, shiso, large ¥1,400) with sanma soboro rice ¥300; cold mackerel-niboshi ramen; a 20th-of-the-month rich chicken soba curry; pork yukhoe rice bowl ¥550; seasoned egg ¥150; free Tsuruhashi kimchi; bottled beer; two found the noodles softish; one says it was in the Bib Gourmand; a clean, stylish interior.

食べログ: 麺処 天川、大阪市西区本田1-11-20、九条から532m、火〜金.en: Tabelog: Mendokoro Amakawa, 1-11-20 Honden, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 532 m from Kujo; Tue–Fri 11:00–14:00 and 18:00–20:30, Sat and holidays 11:00–14:00 and 17:00–20:30, Sun 11:00–14:00; closed Mondays (on holidays, lunch only and closed the next day); no cards, e-money or QR; 9 counter seats; children's chairs; opened 5 March 2019; Tabelog Ramen OSAKA Hyakumeiten 2024 and 2025. Reviews (May 2024 – October 2026): salt ramen ¥1,100 (clear chicken-and-pork umami with kombu; high-hydration noodles from Tsurumi Seimen; chashu, menma, leek, napa cabbage, nori); stir-fried noodles with domestic chicken shoulder ¥1,200; salt ramen ¥950 (a slightly cloudy clear broth, meat base with a hint of seafood, medium-thick noodles); Amakawa Onomichi ¥1,100 (black shoyu with back fat; seafood, chicken, pork); 3 people before opening; 7 min walk from Kujo Station exit 6; Hyakumeiten 2024 and 2025; full at 12:40; large +¥200; cold ramen ¥1,200; large +¥100; a little rice ¥50; 2 kinds of Agu pork chashu; salt soba ¥900 (just leek and onion; a meat base of Agu pork and Tamba black chicken; flat straight noodles of Hokkaido Haru yo Koi wheat); Amakawa kake soba shoyu ¥800; no chemical seasonings; 99.9999% sterilised water; never-frozen Tamba black chicken; Tsurumi Seimen of domestic wheat; seasoned-egg shoyu ramen ¥1,250; Agu pork-belly chashu; 4 people at 10:48 on a Sunday; the owner tossing an iron wok; kabosu; black pepper; cold salmon-flake soba ¥1,100; Tamba jidori and pork bones with bonito, mackerel, sanma flakes, iriko and Hokkaido kombu; Agu pork back fat; extra-thin flat straight noodles; seasonal mixed rice (sweet potato and Tamba black chicken).

食べログ: 麺処 山椒 そのだ裏天王寺店、大阪市天王寺区堀越町15-5、JR天王.en: Tabelog: Mendokoro Sansho Sonoda Ura-Tennoji, 15-5 Horikoshicho, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from JR Tennoji Station north exit, right by subway Tennoji Station exit 8; daily 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–2:00 next morning; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; smoking allowed; takeaway and delivery; opened 25 July 2026. Reviews (September–October 2026): the Showa-retro arcade of the Hanwa shopping street in front of Tennoji Station; a new format from Ring Co., operator of Stand Sonoda; a street-stall-style L-shaped counter enclosed in clear vinyl; ticket machine at the entrance; sansho maze-soba ¥1,200 (meat miso, egg yolk, menma, leek, new onion, thick flat noodles, rice to finish); the sansho is restrained, add more from the mill on the table; house chili oil; nam pla vinegar; sansho banmian ¥880; chuka soba ¥980; Cyberpunk Noodles ¥1,500.

食べログ: 麺処 晴、下谷1-11-7、入谷駅2番出口から徒歩1分、JR鶯谷駅南.en: Tabelog: Mendokoro HARU, Shitaya 1-11-7; 1 min on foot from Exit 2 of Iriya Station, 5 min from the JR Uguisudani South Exit; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–21:00, Sat–Sun 11:00–17:00; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 7 counter seats; Tabelog Ramen TOKYO 100 2025. Reviews (October–November 2026): niboshi and soy-sauce broth; thin straight noodles; chopped onion; two slices of chashu; menma; shoyu ramen (chūka soba) ¥1,150; seasoned egg ¥1,300; special ¥1,500; a rich version; aedama (soy or salt) ¥300; meal tickets; a queue of 4–6 at weekend lunch; quick turnover.

食べログ: 麺処 藤山二郎 あべのHoop店、大阪市阿倍野区阿倍野筋1-2-30.en: Tabelog: Mendokoro Fujiyama Jirou Abeno Hoop, B1F, 1-2-30 Abenosuji, Abeno-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Kintetsu Osaka-Abenobashi Station; dining court in the basement of Abeno HOOP; daily 11:00–23:00; closing days follow HOOP; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 6 counter seats; English, Chinese and Korean menus; opened 20 September 2024; official site. Reviews (December 2024 – October 2026): Jiro style leaning Takaida; a strong shoyu with tang; extra-thick chewy straight noodles; bean sprouts and cabbage; thick chashu; lots of leek; thick menma; the salt Jiro is very salty; soupless; a Takaida-style ramen with thinner noodles; choose garlic, back fat and vegetables (extra vegetables cost extra); cheddar cheese; spicy nira; raw egg; extra chashu; free black oolong tea; vinegar and shichimi on the table; a counter with partitions; ticket machine and buzzer; regular 200 g; mild for Jiro style, one says; one found the chashu tough (2024).

食べログ: 麺処かいしん 六本木店、港区六本木3-11-7 海上ビル1F、大江戸.en: Tabelog: Mendokoro Kaishin Roppongi, Roppongi 3-11-7, 海上ビル 1F, 30 seconds from Roppongi Stn exit 5 (Oedo line), right by Roppongi crossing; Mon–Thu 11:30–06:30 next day (L.O. 6:00), Fri–Sat 11:30–07:00 next day, Sun 11:30–04:30 next day; 19 seats (counter 11, two tables for 4); non-smoking; cards and QR accepted; children welcome; opened 28 June 2023. Reviews (September–October 2026): clam and seafood shio ramen; a clear, gentle soup; ultra-thin straight noodles; a big clam; shio ramen ¥1,100, the fuller bowl ¥1,300, a ¥2,200 bowl with three chashu, seasoned egg and white truffle oil; chashu rice bowl ¥400; a chicken shoyu ramen too; one reviewer says it was formerly named Tsunagu; staff from overseas.

食べログ: 麺匠至誠、大阪市西区新町1-5-7 四ツ橋ビルディングB1F、四ツ橋.en: Tabelog: Mensho Shisei, Yotsubashi Building B1F, 1-5-7 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 30 seconds from Yotsubashi Station exit 2; Mon–Wed and Sat 11:00–14:30, Thu–Fri 11:00–14:30 and 17:30–20:00; closed Sundays and holidays, and about twice a month on Mondays (announced on Instagram); closes when sold out; closes on days the soup isn't ready; no cards, e-money or QR; 18 seats (counter 6, two tables for 4, two for 2); opened 9 June 2015; Ramen Hyakumeiten 2023–2025. Reviews (August–October 2026): formerly named Jikon; seasonal rich editions; chicken salt; Kamatsu tsukemen; change to Mochihime noodles for ¥100; special (seasoned egg, chashu, menma); Kujo leek; noodles sitting in kombu water; limited Tanohata duck paitan salt ¥1,300; smoked shoulder-loin chashu ¥150; seasoned egg ¥100; rice to finish ¥50; yuzu-kosho; cold Rausu kombu with koutake-mushroom oil; dashi rice balls; shellfish-dashi ramen; a superb seasoned egg; queues at lunch; ticket machine; one found it rich but not to taste; tender duck breast.

食べログ: 麺喰い メン太ジスタ、大阪市天王寺区玉造本町3-6、JR玉造駅西口か.en: Tabelog: Men Kui Men Tajisuta, 3-6 Tamatsukuri-hommachi, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from JR Tamatsukuri Station west exit, 2 from subway Tamatsukuri Station exit 6; daily 11:00–23:00; no cards, e-money or QR; 15 seats (counter 7, two tables for 4); opened 11 October 2011. Reviews (2019 – October 2026): Daniel Punch ¥1,000 (a strong shoyu with sansho; slightly wavy flat medium-thick noodles; raw egg on the side; radish sprouts; chopped onion; meat miso; tenkasu; rice to finish); rich chuka soba (thick tori paitan with seafood, fish powder on the nori, thin firm noodles, rare chashu, half a seasoned egg); Men-Ta soba ¥950 (a sweetish Osaka-style shoyu, medium-thin noodles, big chashu, wontons, menma, half a seasoned egg); shoyu ramen with wontons; leek-only Negi Soba (shoyu or salt) ¥680; Jiro style with grated garlic; summer cold editions; the famous karaage ¥600 (takeaway too); gyoza set with miso sauce; highball ¥200 and shoyu ramen ¥800 until 19:00 on weekdays; cash only.

食べログ: 麺喰金家、うどん、東山区博多町112-2、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月.en: Tabelog: 麺喰金家 (Men Kui Kin Ya), udon; 東山区博多町112-2; 5 min on foot from Gion-Shijo Station; Mon–Wed, Sat and Sun 11:30–15:40 and 18:00–19:40; closed Thursday and Friday; no reservations; 15 seats (7 counter, two tables for 4); non-smoking; no cards; e-money and QR payments accepted. Shop introduction (English translation): noodles researched and handmade by the owner; tempura and kushikatsu; a street of tea houses in Miyagawacho. Reviews (2025–2026, in English): flat noodles of Kyoto wheat; a clear bonito-and-kombu broth; kake udon ¥650; tanuki udon ¥1,150; Kujo negi tempura with cold udon ¥1,300; tempura bowl; tamago kake gohan; English menu; vegan options; many guests from abroad; an October 2025 review gives 11:30–20:00 (last order 19:30), closed Monday.

食べログ: 麺屋 7.5Hz 黒門市場店、大阪市中央区日本橋1-16-8、近鉄日.en: Tabelog: Menya 7.5Hz Kuromon Market, 1-16-8 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 142 m from Kintetsu Nippombashi Station; open 24 hours; closed Thursdays and 2nd and 4th Wednesdays; no reservations; a service charge may apply; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 10 seats (counter 9); no smoking; opened 12 February 2023. Reviews (September–October 2026): morning ramen at 8 a.m. on a weekend in Kuromon Market; Takaida-style ramen in Namba; 7.5Hz (nanahan); the same chashu and noodles as the main shop, the soup a little milder; diced chashu; garlic spice, pepper and shichimi on the table; a little cramped; chashu-men large ¥1,100; strong soup and thick noodles; after drinking; the chopped leek is irresistible; a sharp shoyu; slightly thick noodles; chuka soba regular with leek; more sour than expected; straight low-hydration noodles; efficient even with one member of staff; chashu rice bowl; chuka soba ¥800.
