食べログ: 麺屋 TAKA、大阪市西区土佐堀3-3-21、阿波座から491m、月.en: Tabelog: Menya TAKA, 3-3-21 Tosabori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 491 m from Awaza; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 11:30–14:30 and 18:00–22:00; closed Wednesdays; may close early; no cards, e-money or QR; 11 counter seats; opened 14 March 2016. Reviews (October 2024 – August 2026): chuka soba ¥1,000; about 6 min walk from Awaza Station exit 9; a clear shoyu soup of chicken bones, pork bones and niboshi; medium flat straight noodles; firmness not selectable; 4 thin slices of chashu; chopped onion; leek; about 10 seats at an L-shaped counter; smooth high-hydration noodles; egg-on noodles (TKM) ¥1,000 (2 eggs, niboshi aroma); tantanmen; mazemen; salt ¥930 (2024); 2 kinds of chashu; chuka soba and fried rice ¥500; no lunch menu; run single-handed; the mini rice bowl is 'Hashi Niku Don'; shoyu ramen large with seasoned egg; a gentle soup; simple is best; a light niboshi soup; pepper sharpens the taste; house-made medium-thick flat noodles; wheat aroma; chopped onion makes it like Hachioji ramen.

食べログ: 麺屋 しらかわ 大阪なんば店、大阪市浪速区難波中1-17-13、なん.en: Tabelog: Menya Shirakawa Osaka Namba, 1-17-13 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 163 m from Namba Station; daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:30; irregular closing days; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; no smoking; counter seats; opened 15 November 2023. Reviews (December 2023 – October 2026): house-made tsukemen regular 130 g ¥1,100; glossy flat noodles; kabosu; at opening there was just one dish, chuka soba ¥950; A set (fairly strong shoyu, thin wavy noodles, lots of menma, about 4 slices chashu, karaage, a small portion of rice); many overseas diners; the tsukemen is light and clings well; seared chashu; Hida-Takayama chuka soba; a Japanese-style shoyu fragrant with bonito flakes and other seafood; extra-thin noodles a little thicker than somen; leek; big chashu; ramen from Gifu; a modern interior; tsukemen, karaage and chashu rice bowl set; a shoyu dipping soup of chicken bones and bonito flakes.

食べログ: 麺屋 たにぐち 難波店、大阪市浪速区難波中1-15-23、06-66.en: Tabelog: Menya Taniguchi Namba, 1-15-23 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka, 06-6631-6639; no reservations; daily 11:30–15:00; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking; opened 26 September 2022. 2026 reviews (May–October): remembered as an izakaya at night; the standard tori-paitan ramen; free toppings; thin noodles and a fairly strong soup; choice of toppings and noodles; drank all the shellfish-dashi soup; frothy creamy soup; fragrant, tender chashu; crisp vegetables and onion; has also been to the Tennoji shop; about 8 counter seats; limited chicken, pork and shellfish salt ramen ¥1,050 (extra-thin noodles, salty); special tori paitan; orders taken verbally, one unhappy with the service; good chashu and seasoned egg.

食べログ: 麺屋 つばき 寺田町店、大阪市天王寺区大道3-1-7、JR寺田町駅か.en: Tabelog: Menya Tsubaki Teradacho, 3-1-7 Daido, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from JR Teradacho Station, 10 from Tennoji Station; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sat 11:00–14:00 and 18:00–21:00, Sun and holidays 11:00–14:00; closed Wednesdays; no cards, e-money or QR; 21 seats (counter and 3 tables); opened 3 November 2017; official site. Reviews (November 2025 – October 2026): Taiwan maze-soba; meal tickets (cash only); noodles 150 g or 200 g; large ¥200; 3 heat levels; garlic or not; minced meat, leek, egg yolk, fish powder, shredded nori; mix well; vinegar partway; rice to finish; ¥870 in 2025, ¥1,100 with rice in 2026; chewy, smooth thick noodles; you sweat even at medium heat; a spacious shop with a high ceiling; chashu ramen too.

食べログ: 麺屋 のスたOSAKA 難波千日前店、大阪市中央区難波千日前8-5、.en: Tabelog: Menya Nosuta OSAKA Namba Sennichimae, 8-5 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nankai Namba Station; Mon 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00, Tue–Sun and holidays 11:00–22:00; breaks and temporary closures announced on the official X; no reservations; meal-ticket system; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no cover charge; 18 seats (counter only); opened 24 August 2011. 食べログ: 麻婆麺専門店 麻仁 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-6-10、06.en: Tabelog: Mabo-men Senmonten Majin Shinsaibashi, 1-6-10 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6125-5758; no reservations; Mon 18:00–24:00, Tue–Sat 0:00–6:00 and 18:00–24:00, Sun 0:00–6:00; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 15 seats (counter 7, two tables for 4); opened 17 January 2022. 2026 reviews (July–October): mala mapo ramen and small rice; the hell mapo ramen was too hot; an oasis after drinking; sweat from the face, neck and head; a sweetish sauce; a strong medicinal-herb flavour with a gritty texture; dim sum set and highball; a ramen shop where you can smoke; open until morning; gyoza and karaage; medicinal mapo ramen topped with coriander; mala mapo ramen ¥1,300; a story that the main shop closed and only the Shinsaibashi shop remains; thick noodles; chicken-bone base; spicy and medicinal lines; one wished the mapo had more depth.

食べログ: 黎明、焼き鳥、鶏料理、日本橋人形町2-7-13 レイフォリア人形町.en: Tabelog: Reimei; yakitori, chicken dishes; レイフォリア人形町 2F, Nihonbashi-Ningyocho 2-7-13; 5 min from Ningyocho Station; Tue–Sat 18:30–23:30; closed Sunday and Monday; reservations only; same-day cancellation 100%; service charge 10%; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 10 seats (counter only); opened 1 April 2026; a new challenge from a chef whose restaurant was a Yakitori Tabelog 100 five years running; experience from a Hokkaido yakitori restaurant plus techniques learned in Tokyo; charcoal, straw and iron plate; a short course from 21:00 for ¥6,800. Reviews (August–October 2026): Yohei Fujimoto, who created BLESS in Morishita; BLESS sold; chicken sashimi; nakaochi chicken sushi; thigh, tsukune, gizzard; mizutaki; tapioca-flour noodles; duck; finishing choice of duck soboro rice, chicken tempura rice bowl or chazuke; omakase ¥13,000; a sake omakase of five kinds ¥6,000; some call it their best of the year, some say it's pricey for yakitori.

食べログ: 黒豚とんこつ金田家 なんばラーメン一座店、大阪市中央区難波3-2-1.en: Tabelog: Kurobuta Tonkotsu Kanedaya Namba Ramen Ichiza, Edion Namba main store 9F, 3-2-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6630-6733; no reservations; daily 11:00–22:00 (food L.O. 21:30); no cards or e-money; QR payment accepted; no smoking; opened 7 June 2019. 2026 reviews (September–October): born in Yukuhashi, Fukuoka; kurobuta ramen ¥980; B set (rice and 3 karaage) ¥460; a creamy, frothy, rich soup (like a cappuccino; explained as boiling only black-pig bones for over 20 hours); thin straight noodles (firm on request); chashu, leek, wood-ear, nori; takana and red pickled ginger partway through; chashu-men and fried rice; richer than Ichiran or Ippudo; pan-fried gyoza; 3 big slices of chashu; quiet before noon on a Sunday; one wished the soup were hotter.

食べログ: 黒門 三よ志、大阪市中央区日本橋1-16-4、日本橋駅8番出口から徒.en: Tabelog: Kuromon Miyoshi, 1-16-4 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nippombashi Station exit 8; Tue, Wed, Fri and Sat 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Sundays, Mondays, Thursdays and holidays; 2 weeks' summer break and New Year; announced on Instagram and Google Maps; no cards, e-money or QR; 17 seats; non-smoking since April 2020. Reviews (March–October 2026): just off Kuromon Market, in front of a public bath; run by two people; a homely shop with a TV; mostly local diners; reasonable for a tourist area (just under ¥3,000 each); small, thin-skinned gyoza with sweet cabbage and garlic, 6 for ¥450, frozen to take away at the same price; pork okonomiyaki; beef-tendon, leek and egg; shrimp okonomiyaki (8 plump shrimp, ¥900); omusoba; yakisoba; tonpei-yaki with ketchup and mayo; stir-fried beef (shoyu, sauce, ponzu); dashimaki; grilled salmon; stir-fried shishito; nira and meat stir-fry; yakitori; chilled tomato; draught beer; highball; okonomiyaki crisp outside and fluffy inside, served cut; book for large groups.

食べログ: 龍、大阪市浪速区桜川3-1-28、桜川駅から徒歩1分、汐見橋駅から2.en: Tabelog: Ron, 3-1-28 Sakuragawa, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Sakuragawa Station, 2 from Shiomibashi Station; Mon and Wed–Sun 11:30–21:00; closed Tuesdays; no cards, e-money or QR; 45 seats. Reviews (August–October 2026): a Beijing-style neighbourhood Chinese diner founded 1970; facing Sennichimae-dori; a display case of food models and menus on the wall; tables and tatami; busy with office workers at lunch; fast service; gomoku fried rice (¥940); yakisoba (¥770); hand-made gyoza (6 for ¥420, half price on Fridays); curry champon or curry ramen set about ¥1,150 (thin noodles); Chinese-style katsudon with thick sauce ¥940; pork tendon; mapo harusame; lightish seasoning; cash only.

食べログ: 﨑ちゃんラーメン、大阪市中央区南本町1-5-1 安平ビル 1F、堺筋.en: Tabelog: Sakichan Ramen, 1F of a building at 1-5-1 Minamihonmachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 193 m from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Stn; Mon–Sat 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30); closed Sundays and public holidays; no reservations; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; non-smoking; children welcome; opened 9 September 2024. Instagram (@sakichan.ramen): Sakichan Ramen, opened 9/9 in Sakaisuji-Hommachi. The yakiniku restaurant's Instagram (@yakiniku.kazuchan): Yakiniku Horumon Kazuchan / Sakaisuji-Hommachi. Reviews (April–September 2025): yakiniku at night, ramen by day; A5 wagyu beef tendon; BLACK (soy-based), WHITE (beef-bone broth), RED (spicy with Korean chili); beef tendon BLACK ¥780; Mashi Mashi BLACK ¥1,100 (extra beef tendon and green onion); beef tendon bokkake rice ¥350; rice set with kimchi; limited chilled lemon ramen and chilled mazesoba; menma, green onion, onion, egg yolk; a sweet aroma of seafood soy; not as heavy as it looks; medium-thick, chewy noodles (described variously as straight, flat or slightly curled); full around 12:30; the newest review is from September 2025.

食べログおよびミシュランまとめによると、2026年6月14日、西区樋の口町（名古.en: According to Tabelog and Michelin round-ups, it reopened after moving to Hinokuchi-cho, Nishi-ku (near Nagoya Castle) on 14 June 2026. Its predecessor, the izakaya Fukurou, ran for about 20 years in Aoi, Higashi-ku (Shinsakae) and earned a Plate in the Michelin Guide Aichi 2019 (seven izakaya listed in all: three Bib, four Plate). Centred on fresh-fish sashimi with sake, shōchū and wine; 18 seats.

食べログおよび名古屋焼肉セレクションによると、オーナーシェフHIRO氏は30代前.en: According to Tabelog and Nagoya Yakiniku Selection, owner-chef HIRO is in the early thirties; studied geography at university, discovered food culture while in the US (California) and turned to cooking. Deals directly with Chita beef farmers; strictly by introduction and membership, one or two groups a day. Chateaubriand rolled in nori is the signature.

食べログが2012年開業、店主一人営業、瀬戸内の刺身盛り合わせ、広島の地酒重視、.en: Tabelog confirms opening in 2012, the owner running it alone, Seto Inland Sea sashimi platters, an emphasis on Hiroshima local sake, and keywords such as mackerel curry and cheese. Retty confirms brown-rice soup curry at lunch and the owner choosing sake to suit each guest and explaining it even to beginners.

食べログが、2025年9月開業、丸の内堀江ビル（丸の内駅徒歩約2分）、女性店主、.en: Tabelog reports: opened September 2025, Marunouchi Horie Building (about 2 minutes on foot from Marunouchi Station), a woman owner, counter + a private room for 4, 13 seats in all, obanzai and rolled omelette with plenty of dashi, and an atmosphere comfortable even for solo diners.

食べログがサムギョプサル・チヂミ・ケジャン・韓国ラーメン・日替わり定食を確認。運.en: Tabelog confirms samgyeopsal, chijimi, gejang, Korean ramen and a daily set meal. The operators' names are not public, so rather than asserting the owners are 'a Korean couple', it is described modestly as a family business, per reviews.

食べログが流川（歓楽街）の立地、薬研堀通り近くの黄色い看板、カウンター10席のみ.en: Tabelog confirms the Nagarekawa (entertainment district) location, a yellow sign near Yagenbori-dori, only 10 counter seats, late-night hours 21:00–03:00, meat-and-egg soba (with spring-onion topping), and cabbage and noodles cooked just right.

食べログが胡町2-12 広栄ビルB1F「てっぱん横丁」の立地、18:00-05:.en: Tabelog confirms the location at 'Teppan Yokocho', a basement in Ebisucho 2-12, late-night hours 18:00–05:00, meat-and-egg soba, offal, potato-cheese bake and Otafuku sauce.

食べログが魚新を鳥羽2-1-5の寿司店とし、最寄りは中之郷駅(約457m)と記載.en: Tabelog lists Uoshin as a sushi shop at Toba 2-1-5, nearest station Nakanogo (about 457 m). Reviews, menus and other details are not posted, so little is known about the shop.

食べログで1960年創業、南町商店街（山陽姫路駅近く）、全17席のカウンターのみ.en: Tabelog confirms: founded in 1960; Minami-machi shopping street (near Sanyo-Himeji Station); 17 counter seats only; shio ramen in a clear chicken-and-pork soup with white pepper; wonton noodles (about ¥850); old photos of Himeji. ma8coro confirms about 5 seats were lost when a fridge was installed during renovation, but the queues continue.

食べログで2022年8月5日開店、姫路市本町、山陽姫路駅から583m、10席のカ.en: Tabelog confirms: opened 5 August 2022; Honmachi, Himeji; 583 m from Sanyo-Himeji Station; a 10-seat counter; a hideaway serving organic vegetables and game (venison). The owner's name is not public.

食べログで2023年8月1日開店・西区花の木3-6-14・浄心駅徒歩約7分・食べ.en: Tabelog confirms the opening on 1 August 2023, 3-6-14 Hananoki, Nishi-ku, about 7 minutes on foot from Joshin Station, Tabelog French EAST Hyakumeiten 2025, and that the chef comes from La Vagabonde and that it is run by a married couple (chef + pâtissier). The 33inc.jp blog confirms the course's Satō Nishiki cherry × foie gras terrine, scallop and pig's trotter croquette, and venison loin. Reviews confirm an episode of the couple's child appearing. The chef's surname is not published in any outlet, so it is null.

食べログでTRIVENIは2025年6月30日オープン、丸の内、昼カレー／夜バー.en: Tabelog confirms TRIVENI opened on 30 June 2025 in Marunouchi, curry by day / bar by night, spice 0–5, free refills of naan, soup and salad, and over 30 wines. Nepalese dishes such as chicken tikka are available. The bio's 'frango (Portuguese for chicken)' was a contextual error and has been corrected.

食べログで中区丸の内1-10-17・丸の内駅徒歩2分・そば店であることを確認。た.en: Tabelog confirms 1-10-17 Marunouchi, Naka-ku, 2 minutes on foot from Marunouchi Station, and that it is a soba shop. The Tanshin blog confirms the wall chart of soba prices since the Meiji era, a Showa atmosphere like 'THE SOBAYA', and the mini tendon + mini soba set.

食べログで住所（西区浅間2-8-14、旧美濃路沿い）・浅間町駅徒歩約5分・中華そ.en: Tabelog confirms the address (2-8-14 Sengen, Nishi-ku, on the old Minoji road), about 5 minutes on foot from Sengencho Station, chūka soba (yellow noodles), kishimen, miso-nikomi and katsudon. Ekiten confirms the wall-length menu and the Showa-era popular-canteen atmosphere.

食べログで姫路市魚町の素朴な炉端焼き・おでんの店（17時開店、山陽姫路駅から約3.en: Tabelog confirms a simple robata and oden shop in Uomachi, Himeji (opens 17:00, about 323 m from Sanyo-Himeji Station). ma8coro confirms a counter around the hearth suited to groups of about 8, grilled rice balls, and serving with a long robata paddle. The owner's name is not public.

食べログで西区天神山町8-2・浄心駅徒歩5分・予算1,000円未満・地元客中心の.en: Tabelog confirms the street address in Nishi-ku, 5 minutes on foot from Joshin Station, a budget under ¥1,000, and a calm coffee shop with mostly local customers, with Kaya Blend coffee + morning service (thick toast). Retty confirms a morning set with lots of extras and lunch service.

食べログとRettyが、名古屋市東区白壁（東大手駅至近）の隠れ家、ご夫妻が営むカ.en: Tabelog and Retty agree: a hideaway in Shirakabe, Higashi-ku, Nagoya (right by Higashi-Ote Station); run by a married couple with only 7–8 counter seats; open only from the autumn equinox to the spring equinox; thick-cut fugu sashimi, grilled milt, tetchiri and hire-zake; first visits by a regular's introduction only.

食べログとoinagoyaが、浄心駅近くのラーメン店「高豚」が手がける担々麺専門.en: Tabelog and oinagoya support that this is a tantanmen specialist from the ramen shop Haiton near Joshin Station, opened in spring 2025, in Kami-Nagoya, serving mala tantanmen and tantan mazesoba. The branch label "third shop" could not be confirmed, so it is described generally as an affiliated tantanmen specialist.

食べログと公式サイトが、江戸末期創業・現5代目、東大手駅徒歩約3分、備長炭で焼く.en: Tabelog and the official site support: founded at the end of the Edo period, now in its fifth generation; about 3 minutes on foot from Higashi-Ote Station; Kansai style grilled over binchōtan (split down the belly, not steamed) with a crisp texture; live eels rested in well water; ohitsumabushi and unadon. A blog (ameblo) reports thick eel from Kagoshima, autographed boards from celebrities, and no grilled liver or umaki (liver soup is included). No primary source confirming an old topped-up sauce was found, so the description was softened to 'a strong house-made sauce'.

食べログと旅館公式サイトが、母体が南知多町内海（伊勢湾に面する）の旅館しぼりやで.en: Tabelog and the ryokan's official site support that the parent business is the ryokan Shiboriya in Utsumi, Minamichita (on Ise Bay), the 13 March 2026 Marunouchi opening and the fried prawn / fried white-fish set-meal format. The owner's personal name is not published.

食べログによると、2026年5月15日、西区押切にオープンした12席（カウンター.en: According to Tabelog, a 12-seat izakaya (8 at the counter, 4 at tables) opened on 15 May 2026 in Oshikiri, Nishi-ku. The owner is from Myanmar, but the current menu has 'zero Myanmar feel'; Myanmar dishes are planned for later. Tender braised pork is the signature, and sets with a drink are the core.

食べログによると、名古屋市西区・城信駅から徒歩約10分の手打ちうどん・そばの店。.en: According to Tabelog, a hand-made udon and soba shop in Nishi-ku, Nagoya, about 10 minutes on foot from the station. 5 counter seats + 16 in a sunken-kotatsu tatami room, 21 in all. Lunch sets around ¥780. Popular for the chicken katsudon, a thick chicken cutlet with house-made soy sauce, and grated-daikon kishimen; praised for a homely atmosphere like coming home and the owner's warm service.

食べログのランチメニューと口コミが、丸の内駅徒歩5分、チョイスセット790円、ナ.en: Tabelog's lunch menu and reviews support 5 minutes on foot from Marunouchi Station, a ¥790 choice set, one extra naan free, and weekday lunches full. Another review tells of its origin selling ¥500 chicken curry & naan at events in Nishi-ku, and a former shop at Kokusai Center. Hitosara says Nepalese food is also served.

食べログのレビューは1950年創業、初代・山本ユキエ、弟へ、そして甥の三代目とい.en: Tabelog reviews report founding in 1950: first owner Yamamoto Yukie, then a younger brother, then a nephew as the third generation; the shop name comes from customers marvelling that its round, hefty shape looked like a sunfish (manbo); and Kyoto's own manbo-yaki using takuan, beef tendon and spring onion.

食べログの写真キャプションで700円と確認。あずきは小麦不使用だがクリーム＝乳、.en: Confirmed at ¥700 in a Tabelog photo caption. The azuki has no wheat, but the cream = dairy; watch the wafer served with it.

食べログの口コミが、以前カラオケ店だった場所を母の死後に娘が改装しべた焼き店とし.en: Tabelog reviews record that after the mother's death the daughter renovated the former karaoke site and opened it as a betayaki shop. Respect for the mother, 'Setsuko', and the 2024 opening come from the owner's own Instagram posts. Address, tabletop griddles and menu confirmed on the Tabelog shop page.

食べログの口コミが、醤油ラーメン一本の簡素な屋台風の店であることを伝えるのみ。店.en: Tabelog reviews say only that it is a simple, stall-style shop serving shoyu ramen alone. No detailed public information, such as the owner's name, can be found.

食べログの口コミが築100年超の古民家再利用、穴子・海老天ぷら、蒸し牡蠣、揚げも.en: Tabelog reviews confirm the reuse of an old house over 100 years old, anago and prawn tempura, steamed oysters and fried momiji manjū (anago is not a mistake for hamo). The roughly two-month ageing of the dipping sauce is kept as coming from a retty review.

食べログの料理写真で確認。つけ醤油＝小麦。価格未確認。.en: Confirmed from a Tabelog food photo. Dipping soy sauce = wheat. Price unconfirmed.

食べログマガジンによると、約60年続き2015年に閉店した名店を継ぎ2016年2.en: According to Tabelog Magazine, it took over a famous shop that ran for about 60 years and closed in 2015, reopening in Funairi in February 2016. The owner was once an office worker drawing air-conditioning plans, and made the partitions and ceiling ducts by hand. Besides soy-pork-bone chūka soba, Sichuan-style items such as red spicy soba and brothless dandan noodles were added.

食べログマガジン（473277）とoinagoyaで2025年6月8日開業、厨房.en: Tabelog Magazine (473277) and oinagoya confirm the opening on 8 June 2025, two in the kitchen (3 years at popular cafés / 2 years at Erick South), chicken curry with no added stock or umami seasoning, and cardamom karaage. liverary confirms 'Hour's Wedding Reception' on 7 June (Bar Kanata, BUTTER NOTE). A claim of a renovated 'former bicycle shop' could not be supported and was removed.

食べログマガジン（magazine.tabelog.com/articles/3.en: Tabelog Magazine (magazine.tabelog.com/articles/369395), Leaf Kyoto and kyotopi (FdcL1) report that Chef Shiga was sous-chef and sommelier at the sister shop 'Pizzeria Napoletana Da Yuki', a Michelin Bib Gourmand and Tabelog 'Pizza Hyakumeiten', and opened the 18-seat Senza X on its former site (Okazaki, Sakyo-ku) on 9 February 2024. Every item uses no wheat, gluten, egg or dairy; the pasta is made from Italian corn and rice, and the bread from rice flour. Described as a 20-year dream; Da Yuki's stone oven remains.

食べログ・Rettyが、淀本町(淀駅至近・京都競馬場近く)の町中華、1000円未.en: Tabelog and Retty record a neighbourhood Chinese restaurant in Yodo-honmachi (right by Yodo Station, near Kyoto Racecourse), set meals under ¥1,000, fragrant fried rice, a menu of gyoza, karaage, sweet-and-sour pork, tenshinhan and more, and comfort and value. The owner's name is not public.

食べログ・budou-chan・ヒトサラ・家老屋敷跡公園利用者組合サイトより。2.en: From Tabelog, budou-chan, Hitosara and the chief-retainer residences park users' association site. Opened 25 March 2023 at Honmachi 68, Himeji, "I residence / chief-retainer residence building A, no. 1". Known for domestic kara-age of Banshu jidori chicken (breast and thigh, freshly fried in about 5 minutes) and whole-orange juice. "Serious spice" optional. The owner's name is not public.

食べログ・gorp・genjitsutouhiが、旧『熟豚』、伏見の熟成庫での3.en: Tabelog, gorp and genjitsutouhi record the former 'Jukuton', ageing for 3–5 weeks in an ageing room in Fushimi, double-frying in lard and rapeseed oil, Tokyo Nakaya panko, a Michelin Bib Gourmand, rare pork such as Tokyo X, Meishan and Saddleback, and several condiments including salt. About 12 seats.

食べログ・kyotopi・gcjapan・公式が、1951年創業、フレンチ出身シ.en: Tabelog, kyotopi, gcjapan and the official site record founding in 1951, a married couple with a French-trained chef, second generation, 16 seats, hand-kneaded hamburger steak blended with A5 Kuroge wagyu (fried egg + demi-glace), and Kuroge wagyu tendon curry since founding. Shinshu Premium A5 wagyu is used for the beef cutlet.

食べログ・ma8coroブログ・Rettyより。姫路市十二所前町、山陽姫路駅から.en: From Tabelog, the ma8coro blog and Retty. A detached-house Italian hideaway in Juniisho-mae-cho, Himeji, about 200 m (about 3 min walk) from Sanyo-Himeji Station. Many regulars; the counter is lively. Squid-ink risotto, fresh pasta, wood-fired pizza, carpaccio, sautéed white asparagus, prosciutto and melon, etc. The homemade basil butter and baguette are well liked. The owner-chef's name is not public.

食べログ・sun-maltによると、炭火焼西尾の店内を昼だけ間借りする昼営業限定.en: According to Tabelog and sun-malt, a lunch-only ramen that borrows the dining room of the charcoal-grill restaurant only by day. Nagarekawa / Kanayama-cho. Light, clear shoyu ramen and kombu-water tsukemen, rare in Hiroshima. A clear broth of Shiga's Omi black chicken with about 4 dried ingredients such as Ibukijima niboshi, and hand-rubbed medium-thick noodles.

食べログ・ぐるなびが、JR姫路駅南口至近（徒歩1〜2分）の炭火焼居酒屋、山上ビル.en: Tabelog and Gurunavi confirm: a charcoal-grill izakaya very close to JR Himeji Station's south exit (1–2 min walk); Yamagami Bldg 1F; a renewal opening and a lunch service started on request; seasonal seafood from the Harima-nada; yakitori and skewers. The exact years in business are unconfirmed, so it is called "long-established".

食べログ・ぐるなび・鳥羽観光協会等によると、鳥羽駅南口から徒歩約4分の海鮮食堂。.en: According to Tabelog, Gurunavi and the Toba tourism association, a seafood diner about 4 minutes' walk from the south exit of Toba Station. Shellfish and Ise lobster bought that day swim in the tank, and every set meal (about ¥1,500–1,650) comes with Ise lobster miso soup (with half a lobster). The fried shrimp set and the all-shellfish set are popular. The owner and the owner's wife are praised for a warm welcome and the homey atmosphere. Closed Thursdays.

食べログ・エキテンのレビューが、特選刺身盛り合わせ・踊り活けタコ・鯛かぶと焼き・.en: Tabelog and Ekiten reviews confirm: the special sashimi platter, live octopus, grilled sea bream head and eel with egg, sashimi described as "best in Himeji", and a hideaway location with no lit sign. The owner's name is not public. The TripAdvisor original now returns 403 and could not be rechecked.

食べログ・ヒトサラで住所（本町68-4）と2023年4月24日開店、暗めでおしゃ.en: Tabelog and Hitosara confirm the address (Honmachi 68-4), the opening on 24 April 2023, and a dim, stylish izakaya. goguynet and ameblo confirm one owner running the counter alone and a "festival bar" vibe; rrmat288 confirms nostalgic Japanese punk and new-wave music; ma8coro confirms a three-item chef's-choice plate and Koeigiku Anastasia Green sake.

食べログ・ホットペッパー: 金沢市片町2-8-16、香林坊東急スクエア裏手のせせ.en: Tabelog and Hot Pepper: 2-8-16 Katamachi, Kanazawa, along Seseragi-dori behind Korinbo Tokyu Square. A long-established soba and udon shop of over 120 years. Cold soba, inari udon, tempura udon, katsudon and more. Generous and affordable (mostly under ¥1,000). 24 seats.

食べログ・ホットペッパーが2025年10月13日開業、西区幅下（シャトル浅間1F.en: Tabelog and HotPepper confirm the opening on 13 October 2025, Habashita, Nishi-ku (1st floor of a building), 10 seats in all (6 at the counter + 2 tables for two). A first-hand Ameblo post supports the chef's name (Ishida Katsuhisa) and plates of French technique × domestic seasonal ingredients. No public information detailing the career before opening was found.

食べログ・ホットペッパーが、2025年11月16日大手前通り沿い（本町68）開業.en: Tabelog and Hot Pepper confirm: opened 16 November 2025 on Otemae-dori (Honmachi 68); café by day, izakaya by night; French technique with fresh fish and selected meat; rare salmon cutlet, seared wagyu, sea bream meunière. The owner's name is not public.

食べログ・ホットペッパーの店舗情報とレビューが、土佐備長炭、天草大王のもも・むね.en: Tabelog and HotPepper shop information and reviews confirm Tosa binchōtan, thigh and breast of Amakusa Daiō, offal of Hiroshima brand chicken, Ehime Himekko jidori and the opening on 3 April 2023.

食べログ・ホットペッパーの店舗情報とレビューで、2026年2月11日開業、久保町.en: Tabelog and Hot Pepper shop information and reviews confirm: opened 11 February 2026; a hideaway Japanese kappo for grown-ups in Kubo-cho; serves Himeji Densuke conger eel, salt-grilled sweetfish and domestic beef; about 17 seats. The signature is conger eel (anago), not pike conger (hamo).

食べログ・ラーメンWalker・kyotopiより、店主・山内健吾(和食出身)、.en: Tabelog, Ramen Walker and kyotopi confirm owner Kengo Yamauchi (from Japanese cuisine), the rename and move from 'Kobushi' on 28 March 2011, medium-thin noodles from Teigaku, Kyoto duck and nodoguro niboshi soba, and a regular in the Michelin Bib Gourmand. After a temporary closure while the owner was in hospital it reopened, with a renewal opening on 17 November 2025.

食べログ・金沢日和・観光協会・検索で、昭和32年(1957)創業、先代逝去後に息.en: Tabelog, Kanazawa Biyori, the tourism association and searches confirm: founded Shōwa 32 (1957), revived by a son after the previous owner died, going about 70 years; the proprietress Koshida Yoshie and the proprietress's son Kōta (third generation); a gentle taste without MSG; salt level measured daily; whelk; member of the Kanazawa Oden 50-Year Shops Association.

食べログ・金鯱系サイトによると、2023年6月15日、名駅近くの人気立ち食い寿司.en: According to Tabelog and Kinshachi-related sites, on 15 June 2023 the popular stand-up sushi bar Kiwami near Meieki opened Hanare, a sit-down offshoot, in Endoji Yokocho, Nishi-ku. About 10 seats (6 at the counter + small tables); Edomae nigiri built around red-vinegar rice. Reviews praise the nodoguro, kinmedai and more.

食べログ公式ページの説明文。価格帯は店の登録予算でディナー¥5,000〜¥5,9.en: Description from the official Tabelog page. Price range per the shop's registered budget: dinner ¥5,000–5,999, lunch ¥3,000–3,999. The batter is wheat.

食べログ店舗ページで2026年1月17日開店・西区那古野『＆tree』・丸の内駅.en: The Tabelog page confirms the opening on 17 January 2026, at &tree in Nagono, Nishi-ku, about 5 minutes on foot from Marunouchi Station, 6 seats, a sister shop of Bistro KIZKI run by the owner's wife, serving French deli food and specialty coffee. The main bistro opened in May 2023 in Higashi-ku and was named to Tabelog French EAST Hyakumeiten 2025.

食べログ店舗ページで2026年1月7日開店・12席（2名テーブル×6）・オーナー.en: The Tabelog page confirms the opening on 7 January 2026, 12 seats (6 tables for two), the owner-chef being the former head chef of Nangoku Shuka in Nagoya Tokyu Hotel, and Saturday full houses and sell-outs. Ameblo confirms the make-up of the ¥1,500 lunch (three starters, soup, white fish, salt-sauce fried noodles, almond tofu).

食べログ店舗・メニューページで2026年4月24日開店・中区丸の内1-4-29・.en: Tabelog's shop and menu pages confirm the 24 April 2026 opening, 1-4-29 Marunouchi, Naka-ku, about 3 minutes on foot from Marunouchi Station, binchōtan robata grilling and sake, silver salmon with ikura / fatty mackerel / Kuroge wagyu / salmon-ikura bowl.

食べログ（穴子・鰻の割烹会席、カウンター9席を含む全31席、大将の丁寧な仕込み、.en: Confirmed by Tabelog (kappo set courses of conger eel and eel; 31 seats including 9 at the counter; careful preparation by the chef-owner; seasonal cooking) and Ekiten (a kappo in Shiocho; excellent seasonal dishes; conger eel and shrimp tempura; off-menu requests considered). The owner's name is not public.

食べログ（英語版店舗ページ）でオーナーシェフ飯泉雄大、実家が日本料理店、服部栄養.en: Tabelog (English shop page) confirms owner-chef Iizumi Yudai, a family Japanese restaurant, a Hattori Nutrition College graduate, top Tokyo restaurants and then training at the one-Michelin-star Sumibi Kappo Shirasaka (Akasaka), opening in June 2023, and about 14 seats (10 at the counter, 4 in a private room). sushi-blog confirms Toyohama octopus, Chita vegetables, Ichinomiya eel and Kisarazu bonito, ayu × 12-month-aged Comté, and the episode of river fish ordered via Instagram not arriving because of bad weather.

食べログ：兵庫県姫路市本町68 家老屋敷跡 ろの屋敷、姫路城前、くずもち・抹茶わ.en: Tabelog: Honmachi 68, Himeji, Hyogo, "Ro" residence in the former chief-retainer residences, in front of Himeji Castle; kuzu mochi, matcha warabi mochi, Tanba black-bean kuzu, shaved ice, dango; a sweets tea room with no reservations. Reviews praise the bouncy kuzu mochi and refined sweetness. Kuzu manju, the matcha set and others are unconfirmed, so the description was narrowed.

A shaved-ice blog (momoclobiyori) confirms the hojicha shaved ice (house-made bean paste, hojicha ice cream).

香川県丸亀市。骨付鳥は1953年（昭和28年）、丸亀の居酒屋「一鶴」の創業者・近.en: Marugame, Kagawa. Honetsuki-dori (bone-in chicken) is said to have been created in 1953 (Showa 28) by the founders of the Marugame izakaya Ikkaku, inspired by a roast-chicken scene in a Hollywood film.

香港海鮮飲茶樓.en: Hong Kong Seafood Yum cha Ro

Seasoning, based on salt and pepper, is measured to the milligram to keep the taste the same in every shop. Slowly roasted in a dedicated oven (kama-yaki).

骨切りした鱧。湯引きなら小麦なし、粉をはたいて焼く／揚げるなら不可。.en: Hamo (pike conger) with its bones scored. Blanched has no wheat; floured and grilled or fried is not OK.

Buying up branded chickens would "leave none for the local shops working hard there", so the policy is not to take resources away from producing areas. Each shop serves "Sanuki Cloudy", a special cloudy sake made with three times the usual white koji, as a pairing.

鰹節・魚介だしを使用した伝統的な日本料理店。植物性への配慮・切り替えに関する記録.en: A traditional Japanese restaurant using bonito flakes and seafood dashi. No record of any plant-based accommodation or substitution.

鰹＝非ヴィーガン、出汁の醤油含有を確認。.en: Bonito = not vegan; check whether the dashi has soy sauce.

鰻のタレ＝醤油・味醂、茶そばに小麦。.en: Eel sauce = soy sauce and mirin; wheat in the matcha soba.

鰻の伝統文化の伝承.en: passing on the traditional culture of eel

鰻の蒲焼のタレは醤油・味醂ベース＝小麦。バター＝乳。.en: Eel kabayaki tare is soy-sauce and mirin based = wheat. Butter = dairy.

鰻玉めし／鰻茶だし.en: eel and egg rice / eel tea dashi

鳥せんは浅草で30年以上続く老舎で、人情味あふれる店主と奥さんの人柄が温かく、お.en: Torisen is a long-established shop in Asakusa for over 30 years; the warm-hearted owner and the owner's wife have kind personalities, and many regulars come to see the two.

鳥刺し＝生肉。醤油使用多数。.en: Chicken sashimi = raw meat. Soy sauce used in many dishes.

鳥羽商工会議所の会員検索サイトが、みしお(鳥羽1-5-8)を令和元年新規オープン.en: The Toba Chamber of Commerce member search lists Mishio (Toba 1-5-8) as an izakaya newly opened in 2019 (Reiwa 1) and carries its opening greeting. Hitosara confirms an izakaya at ¥3,000–3,999 in the evening. The specific menu was not confirmed, so it was generalised.

鳥羽商工会議所サイト・伊勢志摩観光ナビ・ブログで確認：駅徒歩5分の寿司割烹、店名.en: Confirmed on the Toba Chamber of Commerce site, the Ise-Shima tourism navigator and blogs: a sushi and kappo restaurant 5 minutes' walk from the station; the name comes from the owner's training in Osaka; Ise-Shima seasonal fish always in the tank (winter: oysters and Ise lobster; spring: rockfish); the famous butterflied fried shrimp (looks like fried horse mackerel, the tail tells you it's shrimp); sets with 2–3 shrimp and the Umi no Zen.

鳥羽商船高専.en: Toba National College of Maritime Technology

鳥羽国際ホテル公式のシーホース紹介ページ(オーシャンウイング1階・88席・日本百.en: Each point is confirmed on the Toba Kokusai Hotel official Sea Horse page (Ocean Wing 1F, 88 seats, resort French overlooking Toba Bay, one of Japan's hundred best views) and the dinner menu page (graded courses Voyage / Signature / Terroir / Gastronomique, a bouillabaisse course and a vegan course).

鳥羽市観光協会(eat/1827)が、元海女さんが貝を焼き『焼き加減が絶妙』、海.en: The Toba tourism association (eat/1827) confirms that a former ama diver grills the shellfish with 'perfect timing' and will also talk about ama diving and how to eat the season's shellfish. A personal blog records eating turban shell grilled in the shell, oysters, hiogi scallops and Ise lobster (the claim that the oysters come from Matoya could not be verified, so it was generalised).

鳥羽市観光協会(eat/1836)がサザエストリートの焼き貝店として、さざえ・伊.en: The Toba tourism association (eat/1836) confirms a grilled-shellfish shop on Sazae Street selling turban shell, Ise lobster, abalone and other shellfish, the shop's own grilled oysters, and take-home gifts. Tabelog describes the style of choosing the shellfish you like and having it grilled on the spot.

鳥羽市観光協会と公式サイトによれば、ザ・貝屋はJR鳥羽駅前「さざえストリート」（.en: According to the Toba tourism association and the official site, The Kaiya is a grilled-shellfish specialist on 'Sazae Street' in front of JR Toba Station (where about 11 grilled-shellfish shops line up). You choose Ise lobster, abalone, turban shell, oysters and more from the tank and eat them grilled on the spot. The official site says the tank water has a sterilisation system so it can serve raw oysters. A small shop mostly of tables; the proprietress's service is well regarded, and hiogi scallops (appa-gai) are a speciality.

鳥羽市観光協会ページが、鳥羽駅前・地元漁師直送の伊勢えび/あわび/さざえ/大あさ.en: The Toba tourism association page states that, in front of Toba Station, it serves Ise lobster, abalone, turban shell, large clams, hard clams and grilled oysters sent straight from local fishermen; that 'we are the only place around Toba Station with a large range of Mie local sake' (including Jikon); and that solo diners at the counter are welcome.

鳥羽市観光協会・伊勢志摩観光ナビ・店の屋号(寿司・鰻・活魚)で確認：創業明治初年.en: Confirmed by the Toba tourism association, the Ise-Shima tourism navigator and the shop's own sign (sushi, eel, live fish): founded in the first year of Meiji, continuously at Toba Port, among the oldest in Mie Prefecture; nigiri sushi mainly of local fish, eel and live fish, local production for local consumption, house-made simmered dishes, about a 10-minute walk from the station. 'Edomae / hand rolls' are not in the sources, so corrected to nigiri sushi.

鳥羽市（鳥羽一番街・鳥羽駅前）.en: Toba City (Toba Ichiban-gai, in front of Toba Station)

鳥羽水族館公式の館内ショップページが、花さんごを大型サンゴ礁水槽に面した落ち着い.en: The Toba Aquarium official in-house shop page introduces Hanasango as a calm restaurant facing a large coral-reef tank and confirms a menu with women in mind, Mei-chan's curry (medium-hot or mild), napolitan spaghetti with octopus sausages and a walrus parfait.

鳥羽駅 + おかげ横丁 · ベジ・グルテンフリー.en: Toba Station + Okage Yokocho · vegetarian & gluten-free

鳥羽駅直結の鳥羽一番街3階にある海鮮のお店。鳥羽湾に浮かぶ答志島（漁業・観光の島.en: A seafood restaurant on the third floor of Toba Ichiban-gai, connected to Toba Station. It buys seafood from Toshijima (an island of fishing and tourism in Toba Bay) and serves it as sashimi, grilled shellfish, small fish, dried fish, simmered fish heads and more. The signature Misasa bowl is piled with eight kinds: sea bream, amberjack, tuna, squid, small fish, wakame, sweet shrimp, salmon roe and others.

鳥羽駅近くの「さざえストリート（さざえ街道）」にある、赤ちょうちんが目印の貝焼き.en: A shellfish-grill shop on 'Sazae Street' near Toba Station, marked by a red lantern. Counter and table seats, bright and lively. Tell the staff your budget and recommended dishes are prepared to match. Charcoal-grilled turban shell, plus oysters, abalone, scallops and Ise lobster, abalone and large-clam sashimi, seasonal sea urchin and more. Sake and bottled beer too. Open 8:30–17:00.

鴨せいろ・鴨南蛮そば.en: duck dipping soba · duck nanban soba

鴨にしか出せないコクと奥行き.en: body and depth only duck can give

鴨の氷室の氷.en: ice of the Kamo ice house

鴨料理 風月はやきとり 風月と同じ宮治グループが那古野／四間道エリアに展開する姉.en: Kamo Ryori Fugetsu is a sister shop of Yakitori Fugetsu, run by the same Miyaji Group in the Nagono / Shikemichi area, and shares the Fugetsu name. In Japan, duck has long been prized as a delicacy, so much so that the phrase 'the taste of duck' has been used as a byword for something delicious.

鴨肉。つけ汁は小麦醤油＋鰹だし。.en: Duck. The dipping broth is wheat soy sauce + bonito dashi.

鴨肉をトレイの中の片栗粉と小麦粉で適量にまぶして.en: dust the duck in the tray with the right amount of potato starch and wheat flour

鴨＝家禽、醤油ダレ＝小麦、中華麺＝小麦。.en: Duck = poultry, soy-sauce tare = wheat, Chinese noodles = wheat.

鶏か鶏以外か.en: Tori ka Tori Igai ka (chicken or not chicken)

鶏がら出汁。塩か醤油かは未記載＝要確認。.en: Chicken-carcass stock. Salt or soy sauce not listed = check.

鶏なんこつのヌクマム揚げ.en: chicken cartilage fried with nuoc mam

鶏ガラでとったスープに醤油を合わせた.en: soy sauce combined with a chicken-bone soup

鶏ガラスープ・唐揚げ・餃子など動物性食材が全品に使用されており、植物性対応の分離.en: Animal ingredients (chicken-bone soup, karaage, gyoza and so on) are used in every dish; separate plant-based preparation cannot be expected.

鹿児島・屋久島八万寿茶園の緑茶を使用し、カシューナッツベースの濃厚なムースとバニ.en: Uses green tea from the 八万寿 tea garden on Yakushima, Kagoshima; two layers, a rich cashew-based mousse and a mellow vanilla mousse; "a sugar-free recipe sweetened only with maple syrup, no sugar"

鹿児島県ヨロン島出身の夫婦が営む.en: run by a married couple from Yoron Island, Kagoshima Prefecture
鹿児島県ヨロン島出身の夫婦が営む.r: かごしまけんヨロンとうしゅっしんのふうふがいとなむ

鹿肉料理専門店.r: しかにくりょうりせんもんてん

麦味噌なら大麦。だしは鰹で植物性ではない。.en: Barley if barley miso. The dashi is bonito, so not plant-based.

麦焼酎が含まれる可能性＝銘柄を確認。日本酒は米・米麹。価格は別途ドリンクメニュー.en: May include barley shochu = check the brand. Sake is rice and rice koji. Prices on the separate drinks menu.

麦焼酎＝大麦が原料。麦は日本の表示義務対象外。.en: Barley shochu = made from barley. Barley isn't subject to Japan's mandatory labeling.

麦焼酎＝大麦原料。蒸留酒だが、麦を避けたい方には勧められない。.en: Barley shōchū = made from barley. A distilled spirit, but not recommended for those avoiding barley.

麦芽・大麦を使用。ノンアルでもグルテンは残る。.en: Uses malt and barley. Gluten remains even in non-alcoholic.

麦芽使用。ノンアルでも大麦は残る。.en: Uses malt. Barley remains even non-alcoholic.

麦芽使用。ノンアルコールでもグルテン含有。.en: Contains malt. Even non-alcoholic, it contains gluten.

麦芽＝グルテン。オーガニックであってもビールは大麦。.en: Malt = gluten. Even organic, beer is barley.

麦芽＝グルテン。オーガニックでもグルテンは残る。.en: Malt = gluten. Gluten remains even if organic.

麦芽＝グルテン。価格は別途ドリンクメニュー。.en: Malt = gluten. Prices on the separate drinks menu.

麦芽＝グルテン。価格は店頭のドリンクメニュー参照（この料理カードには未掲載）。.en: Malt = gluten. See the drinks menu in the shop for prices (not on this food card).

麦芽＝大麦。プレミアムモルツ小瓶も770円、オリオンビール777円。.en: Malt = barley. Premium Malt's small bottle also 770 yen; Orion Beer 777 yen.

麦芽＝大麦。ランチプレート注文時はドリンク各500円。.en: Malt = barley. With a lunch-plate order, drinks are 500 yen each.

麦芽＝大麦。中瓶880円／小瓶680円。.en: Malt = barley. Medium bottle ¥880 / small bottle ¥680.

麦芽＝大麦。大瓶900円／小瓶700円。.en: Malt = barley. Large bottle ¥900 / small bottle ¥700.

麦＝大麦。佐藤・兼八（麦）は各1,100円。グルテン回避には不可。.en: Mugi = barley. Sato and Kanehachi (barley) are ¥1,100 each. Not OK for avoiding gluten.

麦＝大麦が原料。グルテン回避には不可。495円〜。.en: Barley = made from barley. Not OK for avoiding gluten. From ¥495.

麩＝小麦グルテンそのもの。おでん出汁＝昆布・鰹節・醤油（小麦）。.en: Fu = wheat gluten itself. Oden broth = kombu, katsuobushi, soy sauce (wheat).

麹菌を用いて、国産米のタンパク質を発酵させてつくった.en: made by fermenting Japanese rice protein with koji mold
